🎯 数量方法做题技巧 · 提分策略🎯 Quantitative Methods Exam Tactics
  • TVM:普通年金(期末付)vs 期初年金(annuity-due,现值 ×(1+i)) vs 递延年金(两步:先算年金现值定位在起付前一期,再折回今天);连续复利 EAR = e^r − 1。TVM: ordinary annuity (end of period) vs annuity-due (PV × (1+i)) vs deferred annuity (two steps: value the annuity one period before the first payment, then discount to today); continuous compounding EAR = e^r − 1.
  • 收益度量:几何平均 ≤ 算术平均;资金加权(MWRR)= IRR(对现金流时点敏感,不用于比经理);时间加权(TWRR)才用于比经理。Return measures: geometric mean ≤ arithmetic mean; money-weighted (MWRR) = IRR (sensitive to flow timing, not for comparing managers); time-weighted (TWRR) is for comparing managers.
  • 偏度:左偏(负偏)均值 < 中位数 < 众数;右偏(正偏)反之(长尾把均值拉向尾巴方向)。左尾长=负偏。Skew: left (negative) skew - mean < median < mode; right (positive) skew - the reverse (the long tail pulls the mean toward it). A long left tail = negative skew.
  • 离散:MAD ≤ 标准差;CV = σ/均值(每单位收益的风险);目标下行偏差只算低于目标的偏差。截尾均值剔除极端值、缩尾均值替换极端值。Dispersion: MAD ≤ standard deviation; CV = σ/mean (risk per unit of return); target downside deviation counts only below-target deviations. A trimmed mean drops extremes; a winsorized mean replaces them.
  • 分布与抽样:中心极限定理对"任意"总体成立,样本均值标准误 = σ/√n;对数正态右偏、下界0、用于给价格建模;自助法有放回重抽样。Distributions & sampling: the CLT holds for any population, and the sample-mean standard error = σ/√n; the lognormal is right-skewed, bounded at 0, and models prices; the bootstrap resamples with replacement.
  • 假设检验:功效 = 1 − β(正确拒绝假的原假设);α 越小 β 越大;p 值 < α 则拒绝。检验选择:配对 t(相依)、合并 t(独立)、卡方(单方差/独立性)、F(两方差)、斯皮尔曼(非参数相关)。Hypothesis testing: power = 1 − β (correctly rejecting a false null); a smaller α raises β; reject if p-value < α. Test choice: paired t (dependent), pooled t (independent), chi-square (single variance/independence), F (two variances), Spearman (nonparametric correlation).
  • 回归:F 检验的原假设是"斜率=0";SEE = √(SSE/(n−2))衡量典型预测误差;R² = SSR/SST;残差要正态、同方差、独立;SEE 越大预测区间越宽。Regression: the F-test null is "slope = 0"; SEE = √(SSE/(n−2)) measures typical prediction error; R² = SSR/SST; residuals should be normal, homoskedastic, independent; a larger SEE widens the prediction interval.
  • 函数形式:lin-log(仅自变量取对数)、log-lin(仅因变量)、log-log(都取对数);关系非线性时需先变换。大数据:另类数据、NLP、机器学习过拟合/欠拟合。Functional forms: lin-log (only the independent variable logged), log-lin (only the dependent), log-log (both); a nonlinear relationship needs a transformation first. Big data: alternative data, NLP, machine-learning over/underfitting.

§1 利率的三种解读与构成§1 Three Interpretations & Components of Interest Rates 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: interpret interest rates as required rates of return, discount rates, or opportunity costs and explain their components。
🔰 零基础讲解:利率其实有三张面孔🔰 Beginner: an interest rate really has three faces

利率💡 同一个利率,站在不同角度有三种含义:
① 投资者要求的"最低回报率"(不给这么多我不投);
② 把未来的钱折算到今天的"折现率";
③ 把钱借出去/投出去而放弃其他用途的"机会成本"。三种说法,同一个数。= 要求回报率 = 折现率 = 机会成本,三位一体。Interest rate💡 The same interest rate has three meanings from different angles:
① the 'minimum return' investors require (I won't invest unless I get this much);
② the 'discount rate' that translates future money to today;
③ the 'opportunity cost' of lending/investing money instead of using it elsewhere. Three phrasings, one number. = required return = discount rate = opportunity cost, three-in-one.

Interest rate💡 The same rate carries three meanings depending on your angle:
① the "minimum required return" an investor demands;
② the "discount rate" that brings future money back to today;
③ the "opportunity cost" of lending/investing rather than using the money elsewhere. Three phrasings, one number.= required return = discount rate = opportunity cost — three-in-one.

利率 = 实际无风险利率 + 通胀溢价 + 违约风险溢价 + 流动性溢价 + 期限溢价
(1 + 名义无风险利率) = (1 + 实际无风险利率) × (1 + 通胀率)
组成Component含义Meaning
实际无风险利率Real risk-free rate无通胀、无风险下对推迟消费的补偿Compensation for deferring consumption, with no inflation and no risk
通胀溢价Inflation premium补偿预期通胀对购买力的侵蚀Compensates for expected inflation eroding purchasing power
违约风险溢价Default-risk premium补偿借款人可能违约Compensates for the borrower possibly defaulting
流动性溢价Liquidity premium补偿资产不易快速变现Compensates for the asset not being easily converted to cash quickly
期限溢价Maturity premium补偿期限越长、对利率变动越敏感Compensates for longer maturities being more sensitive to rate changes
Interest rate = real risk-free rate + inflation premium + default-risk premium + liquidity premium + maturity premium
(1 + nominal risk-free rate) = (1 + real risk-free rate) × (1 + inflation rate)
ComponentMeaning
Real risk-free rateCompensation for deferring consumption, with no inflation and no risk
Inflation premiumCompensation for expected inflation eroding purchasing power
Default-risk premiumCompensation for the borrower possibly defaulting
Liquidity premiumCompensation for an asset that cannot be sold quickly
Maturity premiumCompensation for greater sensitivity to rate changes at longer maturities

1. 下列各项中,最不可能作为利率经济含义解读的是:Which of the following is LEAST likely to be a valid economic interpretation of an interest rate: 官方题Official

  • A. 要求回报率Required rate of return
  • B. 机会成本Opportunity cost
  • C. 债券的票面利率A bond's coupon rate
答案 C。利率可解读为要求回报率、折现率与机会成本;票面利率是债券的合同条款,并非利率的通用经济解读。Answer C. An interest rate can be read as a required return, a discount rate, or an opportunity cost; the coupon rate is a contractual term of a bond, not a general interpretation of an interest rate.

2. 下列各项中,不属于名义利率构成部分的是:Which of the following is NOT a component of a nominal interest rate: 官方题Official

  • A. 通胀溢价Inflation premium
  • B. 流动性溢价Liquidity premium
  • C. 汇率升水Currency forward premium
答案 C。名义利率 = 实际无风险利率 + 通胀溢价 + 违约风险溢价 + 流动性溢价 + 期限溢价;汇率升水不是其构成。Answer C. Nominal rate = real risk-free rate + inflation + default-risk + liquidity + maturity premiums; a currency forward premium is not a component.
1. 某投资者考虑三只面值购买、期限与违约风险相同的定期存单:CD 1 收益 2.2%、CD 2 为 3.3%、CD 3 为 4.4%。若买入 CD 1,其机会成本最接近于:1. An investor considers three certificates of deposit (CDs) available for purchase at face value, all with the same maturity and default risk: CD 1 yields 2.2%, CD 2 yields 3.3%, CD 3 yields 4.4%. If the investor buys CD 1, the opportunity cost is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 0.0%0.0%
  • B. 1.1%1.1%
  • C. 2.2%2.2%
答案 C。机会成本 = 放弃的最优替代方案的回报。买 CD1(2.2%)就放弃了更高的 CD3(4.4%)?——不,机会成本是"本可选的次优/该资金的回报",此处即 CD1 自身收益率 2.2%(资金投入 CD1 所放弃的、按其自身衡量的机会成本)。Answer C. Opportunity cost = the return on the best alternative given up. The opportunity cost of the funds committed to CD1 is measured by its own rate, 2.2% (the return forgone by tying up the money there).
2. 某个人今天可投资 $19,000,一年后收到 $20,000。若要求回报率为 5%,该投资的回报率:2. An individual can invest $19,000 today and receive $20,000 in one year's time. If the required rate of return is 5%, the rate of return on the investment is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 低于要求回报率。less than the required rate of return.
  • B. 等于要求回报率。equal to the required rate of return.
  • C. 高于要求回报率。greater than the required rate of return.
答案 C。$19,000 → $20,000 的回报 = 1,000/19,000 ≈ 5.26% > 要求回报 5% → 回报高于要求回报,该投资划算。Answer C. The return on $19,000 → $20,000 = 1,000/19,000 ≈ 5.26% > the 5% required return → the return is above the required rate, so the investment is attractive.
3. 下列哪种风险溢价补偿投资者:当投资需迅速变现时相对其公允价值发生损失的风险?3. Which of the following risk premiums compensates investors for the risk of loss relative to an investment's fair value if the investment needs to be converted to cash quickly? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 流动性溢价Liquidity premium
  • B. 通胀溢价Inflation premium
  • C. 期限溢价Maturity premium
答案 A。补偿"急需变现时相对公允价值受损"风险的是流动性溢价(liquidity premium)。通胀溢价补偿购买力损失;期限溢价补偿长期限的利率风险。Answer A. Compensation for the risk of a loss relative to fair value when an asset must be sold quickly is the liquidity premium. The inflation premium compensates for lost purchasing power; the maturity premium for interest-rate risk over a longer term.

§2 持有期回报与多期回报§2 Holding Period Return & Multi-Period Return

LOS 对应:LOS: calculate and interpret holding period return。
持有期回报 HPR = (P1 − P0 + 现金流) / P0
多期连乘:总 HPR = (1 + R1)(1 + R2)…(1 + Rn) − 1
符号Symbol含义Meaning
P0, P1期初、期末价格Beginning and ending price
现金流Cash flow期间收到的股息/利息Dividends/interest received during the period
连乘Chained product多个子期回报用(1+R)连乘再减 1,得到累计回报Chain multiple sub-period returns as (1+R) and subtract 1 to get the cumulative return

3. 单期持有期回报(HPR)的正确公式是:The correct formula for a single-period holding period return (HPR) is: 官方题Official

  • A. (P₁ − P₀)/P₁(P₁ − P₀)/P₁
  • B. (P₁ + 现金流)/P₀(P₁ + cash flow)/P₀
  • C. (P₁ − P₀ + 现金流)/P₀(P₁ − P₀ + cash flow)/P₀
答案 C。HPR 以期初价格为分母,分子含价格变动与期间现金流:(P₁ − P₀ + CF)/P₀。Answer C. HPR uses the beginning price as the denominator; the numerator captures the price change plus interim cash flow: (P₁ − P₀ + CF)/P₀.

4. 由各子期回报 R₁…Rₙ 求多期总回报,正确表达式是:To obtain a multi-period total return from sub-period returns R₁…Rₙ, the correct expression is: 官方题Official

  • A. R₁ + R₂ + … + RₙR₁ + R₂ + … + Rₙ
  • B. (1+R₁)(1+R₂)…(1+Rₙ) − 1(1+R₁)(1+R₂)…(1+Rₙ) − 1
  • C. [(1+R₁)(1+R₂)…(1+Rₙ)]^(1/n) − 1[(1+R₁)(1+R₂)…(1+Rₙ)]^(1/n) − 1
答案 B。多期回报为各期增长因子连乘再减 1;C 项是几何平均(年化),A 项忽略了复利。Answer B. Chain the growth factors and subtract 1; C is the geometric mean (annualized), and A ignores compounding.
1. 某投资者以 $450 买入股票,在收到 $2 股利后立即卖出。若持有期收益为 −10.2%,则卖出价最接近于:1. An investor purchased a stock for $450 and then sold the stock immediately after receiving a dividend of $2. If the holding period return is a loss of 10.2%, the investor sold the stock at a price closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. $402$402
  • B. $404$404
  • C. $406$406
答案 A。方法:HPR =(卖价 + 股利 − 买价)/买价。−10.2% =(P + 2 − 450)/450 → P ≈ $402。Answer A. Method: HPR = (sale price + dividend − purchase price)/purchase price. −10.2% = (P + 2 − 450)/450 → P ≈ $402.
2. 某投资者以 $100 买入股票,在收到 $7 股利后立即以 $107 卖出。其持有期收益最接近于:2. An investor purchases a stock for $100. Immediately after receiving a dividend of $7, the investor sells the stock for $107. The holding period return is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 0%0%
  • B. 7%7%
  • C. 14%14%
答案 C。HPR =(107 + 7 − 100)/100 = 14%(资本利得 7% + 股利收益 7%)。Answer C. HPR = (107 + 7 − 100)/100 = 14% (7% capital gain + 7% dividend yield).

§3 算术平均 vs 几何平均§3 Arithmetic vs Geometric Mean 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: calculate and compare arithmetic and geometric means of returns。
🔰 零基础讲解:两种"平均回报",别用错

算术 vs 几何📉📈 涨 50% 再跌 50%,算术平均是 0%,但你实际亏了 25%!几何平均才反映"真实复合增长"。算术平均适合估计"下一期的期望回报";几何平均适合衡量"过去一段的实际复合表现"。波动越大,两者差距越大,且几何 ≤ 算术。:算术平均看单期期望,几何平均看复合实现。Arithmetic vs geometric📉📈 Up 50% then down 50% averages 0% arithmetically, but you actually lost 25%! The geometric mean reflects 'true compound growth.' The arithmetic mean suits estimating 'next period's expected return'; the geometric mean suits measuring 'the actual compound performance over a past stretch.' The greater the volatility, the bigger the gap, and geometric ≤ arithmetic.: the arithmetic mean is for single-period expectation, the geometric mean for realized compounding.

算术平均 = (R1 + R2 + … + Rn) / n
几何平均 = [ (1+R1)(1+R2)…(1+Rn) ]1/n − 1
指标Measure用途 / 特性Use / property
算术平均Arithmetic mean估计单期期望回报;不考虑复利Estimates the single-period expected return; ignores compounding
几何平均Geometric mean衡量多期复合实现回报;考虑复利Measures the multi-period compound realized return; accounts for compounding
大小关系Size relationship几何 ≤ 算术;波动越大差距越大(仅当所有回报相同才相等)Geometric ≤ arithmetic; the greater the volatility, the bigger the gap (equal only if all returns are the same)
算术 vs 几何 官方题Official

两年回报 +50%、−50%。算术 = (50%−50%)/2 = 0%;几何 = [(1.5)(0.5)]1/2 − 1 = 0.750.5 − 1 = 0.866 − 1 = −13.4%。几何反映了实际的复合亏损。Two-year returns +50%, −50%. Arithmetic = (50%−50%)/2 = 0%; geometric = [(1.5)(0.5)]1/2 − 1 = 0.750.5 − 1 = 0.866 − 1 = −13.4%. The geometric mean reflects the actual compound loss.

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

算术平均 vs 几何平均

• 算术平均:简单相加除以 n,适合估计单期未来期望回报。
• 几何平均:复合增长率,(1+g) = [Π(1+r_i)]^(1/n),衡量过去多期实现的复利回报。

两者关系

几何平均 ≤ 算术平均,且波动率越大、二者差距越大(差距 ≈ ½ 方差)。所以用算术平均描述历史复合回报会高估。

易错对比

① 报告历史累计/复合回报用几何;② 预测下一期期望用算术;③ 有波动时几何必小于算术。

Arithmetic vs geometric mean

• Arithmetic mean: simple sum ÷ n, best for estimating a single-period expected return.
• Geometric mean: the compound growth rate, (1+g) = [Π(1+r_i)]^(1/n), measuring realized compounded return over many periods.

Relationship

Geometric ≤ arithmetic, and the gap grows with volatility (≈ ½ variance). Using the arithmetic mean for historical compounded return overstates it.

Common traps

① Report historical/compounded return with the geometric mean; ② forecast next-period expectation with the arithmetic mean; ③ with volatility, geometric is always below arithmetic.

5. 关于算术平均与几何平均回报的用途,最恰当的是:Regarding the uses of the arithmetic and geometric mean returns, the most appropriate statement is: 官方题Official

  • A. 算术平均衡量多期已实现的复合回报The arithmetic mean measures realized multi-period compound return
  • B. 几何平均用于估计单期期望回报The geometric mean is used to estimate the single-period expected return
  • C. 算术平均估计单期期望回报,几何平均衡量多期复合已实现回报The arithmetic mean estimates the single-period expected return, while the geometric mean measures realized multi-period compound return
答案 C。算术平均是单期期望回报的无偏估计;几何平均反映多期复合的实际增长。Answer C. The arithmetic mean is an unbiased estimate of the single-period expected return; the geometric mean reflects actual compound growth over multiple periods.

6. 关于几何平均与算术平均回报的大小关系,最恰当的是:Regarding the relationship between the geometric and arithmetic mean returns, the most appropriate statement is: 官方题Official

  • A. 几何平均 ≥ 算术平均Geometric ≥ arithmetic
  • B. 两者恒相等They are always equal
  • C. 几何平均 ≤ 算术平均,波动越大差距越大Geometric ≤ arithmetic, and the gap widens as volatility rises
答案 C。几何 ≤ 算术,回报波动越大差距越大;仅当各期回报完全相同时二者相等。Answer C. Geometric ≤ arithmetic; the more volatile the returns, the larger the gap, with equality only when all returns are identical.

7. 某资产第一年 +50%、第二年 −50%,两年的几何平均回报最接近:An asset returns +50% in year 1 and −50% in year 2. Its two-year geometric mean return is closest to: 官方题Official

  • A. 0%0%
  • B. −13.4%−13.4%
  • C. −25%−25%
答案 B。[(1.5)(0.5)]^0.5 − 1 = 0.866 − 1 = −13.4%;算术平均为 0% 是常见陷阱。Answer B. [(1.5)(0.5)]^0.5 − 1 = 0.866 − 1 = −13.4%; the arithmetic mean of 0% is a common trap.
1. 某公司估计其收入将在四年后比现在高 50%。其复合年增长率最接近于:1. A company estimates its revenue will be 50% higher than today in four years' time. The compound annual growth rate is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 10.7%10.7%
  • B. 11.8%11.8%
  • C. 12.5%12.5%
答案 A。复合年增长率 CAGR =(期末/期初)^(1/年) − 1。四年后高 50%(比值 1.5):1.5^(1/4) − 1 ≈ 10.7%。Answer A. CAGR = (ending/beginning)^(1/years) − 1. 50% higher in 4 years (ratio 1.5): 1.5^(1/4) − 1 ≈ 10.7%.

  • B. 10.80%10.80%

答案 B。几何平均收益 = [Π(1+Rₜ)]^(1/n) − 1(把各期毛回报连乘再开 n 次方)。按表 ≈ 10.80%。几何平均永远 ≤ 算术平均。Answer B. Geometric mean return = [Π(1+Rₜ)]^(1/n) − 1 (multiply the gross returns and take the n-th root). Per the table ≈ 10.80%. The geometric mean is always ≤ the arithmetic mean.

§4 资金加权 vs 时间加权回报§4 Money-Weighted vs Time-Weighted Return 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: calculate and interpret the money-weighted and time-weighted rates of return。
指标Measure含义Meaning是否受资金进出时点影响Affected by the timing of cash in/outflows?
资金加权 MWRRMoney-weighted return (MWRR)组合现金流的内部收益率 IRRThe internal rate of return (IRR) of the portfolio's cash flows受影响——放大了投资者申赎时点的运气Affected — it amplifies the luck of the investor's contribution/withdrawal timing
时间加权 TWRRTime-weighted return (TWRR)各子期回报几何连接,与资金进出无关The sub-period returns are geometrically linked, independent of cash in/outflows不受影响——衡量经理真实业绩Not affected — measures the manager's true performance
考点提示:
① 评价基金经理业绩用时间加权(TWRR)——剔除客户申赎时点的影响。
② 衡量投资者自身实际体验用资金加权(MWRR)。
③ 若在高点大额买入,MWRR 会低于 TWRR。
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

资金加权 vs 时间加权

• 时间加权回报(TWR):把每段子期回报复合相乘,剔除现金流进出的影响 → 评价基金经理能力的标准。
• 资金加权回报(MWR):即组合的 IRR,受现金流时点与金额影响。

何时二者背离

若在高点追加资金、低点赎回,MWR 会被拉低,MWR < TWR;反之则相反。因为现金流通常由客户决定,经理不应为此负责,故考核用 TWR。

易错对比

① 评价经理用 TWR;② MWR = IRR、被现金流时点扭曲;③ 高买低卖 → MWR < TWR。

Money-weighted vs time-weighted return

• Time-weighted return (TWR): compounds sub-period returns, removing the effect of cash flows → the standard for judging manager skill.
• Money-weighted return (MWR): the portfolio's IRR, affected by the timing and size of cash flows.

When they diverge

Adding money at highs and withdrawing at lows drags MWR down, so MWR < TWR; the reverse otherwise. Since cash flows are usually the client's choice, managers are judged by TWR.

Common traps

① Judge the manager with TWR; ② MWR = IRR, distorted by flow timing; ③ buy-high/sell-low → MWR < TWR.

8. 资金加权回报率(MWRR)本质上等于:The money-weighted rate of return (MWRR) is essentially: 官方题Official

  • A. 各子期回报的几何平均The geometric mean of the sub-period returns
  • B. 组合所有现金流的内部收益率(IRR)The internal rate of return (IRR) of all the portfolio's cash flows
  • C. 期初、期末价值的算术平均The arithmetic mean of the beginning and ending values
答案 B。MWRR 即令所有现金流现值等于零的 IRR,受资金进出时点与金额影响。Answer B. MWRR is the IRR that sets the present value of all cash flows to zero; it is affected by the timing and size of contributions and withdrawals.

9. 关于时间加权回报率(TWRR),最恰当的是:Regarding the time-weighted rate of return (TWRR), the most appropriate statement is: 官方题Official

  • A. 受资金进出时点影响,反映投资者实际体验It is affected by cash-flow timing and reflects the investor's actual experience
  • B. 各子期回报几何连接,剔除资金进出影响,衡量经理业绩It geometrically links sub-period returns, removing the effect of cash flows, to measure manager performance
  • C. 等于组合所有现金流的 IRRIt equals the IRR of all the portfolio's cash flows
答案 B。TWRR 将各子期回报几何连接,消除申赎时点影响,是评价经理业绩的标准;A、C 描述的是 MWRR。Answer B. TWRR geometrically links sub-period returns, eliminating the impact of contribution/withdrawal timing, and is the standard for evaluating manager performance; A and C describe MWRR.

10. 评价基金经理的选股与择时能力,最应使用:To evaluate a fund manager's stock-selection and timing skill, you should use: 官方题Official

  • A. 时间加权回报率(TWRR)The time-weighted rate of return (TWRR)
  • B. 资金加权回报率(MWRR)The money-weighted rate of return (MWRR)
  • C. 持有期回报(HPR)The holding period return (HPR)
答案 A。经理无法控制客户的资金进出,故应用剔除该影响的 TWRR 评价其业绩。Answer A. A manager cannot control client cash flows, so TWRR — which strips out that effect — is used to assess performance.

11. 投资者在市场高点大额买入、随后市场下跌,其 MWRR 与 TWRR 相比:An investor makes a large purchase at a market peak, after which the market falls. Their MWRR compared with TWRR is: 官方题Official

  • A. MWRR 高于 TWRRMWRR higher than TWRR
  • B. MWRR 低于 TWRRMWRR lower than TWRR
  • C. 两者相等The two are equal
答案 B。不利时点投入的大额资金被赋予更高权重,拖累 MWRR,使其低于 TWRR。Answer B. The large sum invested at an unfavourable time receives a higher weight, dragging MWRR below TWRR.
1. 下列哪项陈述最准确?资金加权收益率:1. Which of the following statements is most accurate? The money-weighted return: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 忽略现金的提取与追加投资。ignores cash withdrawals and additional cash investments.

The money-weighted return (MWRR) is the IRR accounting for cash flows, measuring the return actually earned on the money invested. It is sensitive to the timing of flows, so it is not suitable for comparing managers (use time-weighted for that).

§5 年化与实际年利率 EAR§5 Annualization & the Effective Annual Rate (EAR)

LOS 对应:LOS: calculate and interpret the effective annual rate。
实际年利率 EAR = (1 + 周期利率)m − 1,m = 每年复利次数
连续复利:EAR = er − 1
符号Symbol含义Meaning
周期利率Periodic rate= 名义年利率 / m= nominal annual rate / m
m每年复利次数(月 12、季 4、日 365)Compounding periods per year (monthly 12, quarterly 4, daily 365)
结论Conclusion复利越频繁,EAR 越高The more frequent the compounding, the higher the EAR
EAR 计算 官方题Official

名义年利率 12%、按月复利。EAR = (1 + 0.12/12)12 − 1 = 1.0112 − 1 = 12.68%,高于名义的 12%。Nominal annual rate 12%, compounded monthly. EAR = (1 + 0.12/12)12 − 1 = 1.0112 − 1 = 12.68%, higher than the nominal 12%.

考点·利率换算与连续复利:
• 有效年利率 EAR = (1 + 名义/m)^m − 1(m = 每年复利次数)。
• 连续复利(continuous compounding):EAR = e^(名义) − 1;反解 名义 = ln(1 + EAR)。
• 复利越频繁,达到同一 EAR 所需名义利率越低;连续复利是其极限。Exam - rate conversion & continuous compounding:
- Effective annual rate EAR = (1 + nominal/m)^m − 1 (m = compounding periods per year).
- Continuous compounding: EAR = e^(nominal) − 1; invert: nominal = ln(1 + EAR).
- The more frequent the compounding, the lower the nominal rate needed for a given EAR; continuous is the limit.

12. 有效年利率(EAR)的正确公式是:The correct formula for the effective annual rate (EAR) is: 官方题Official

  • B. (1 + 名义年利率)^m − 1(1 + nominal annual rate)^m − 1
  • C. (1 + 名义年利率/m)^m − 1(1 + nominal annual rate/m)^m − 1
答案 C。m 为每年复利次数,先按周期利率复利 m 次再减 1。Answer C. m is the number of compounding periods per year; compound at the periodic rate m times, then subtract 1.

15. 在名义年利率不变的前提下,复利频率提高,EAR 将:Holding the nominal annual rate constant, as the compounding frequency rises, the EAR will: 补充Extra

1. 定期存款 1 的名义年利率 4%、按季复利。使投资者在两者间无差异的定期存款 2(连续复利)的名义年利率最接近于:1. Term Deposit 1 has a 4% stated annual rate compounded quarterly. The stated annual rate for Term Deposit 2 (continuously compounded) that makes the investor indifferent between the two is closest to: 真题模考Mock

Method: convert the quarterly-compounded nominal rate to an EAR, then back out the continuously-compounded nominal rate. EAR = (1+0.04/4)⁴−1; continuous nominal = ln(1+EAR) ≈ 3.98% (the more continuous the compounding, the lower the nominal rate for the same EAR).
2. 某银行储蓄账户第一年名义年利率 3%、第二年 5%,按季复利。若期初存入 €90,000,则第二年末账户价值最接近于:2. A bank offers a savings account with a stated annual rate of 3% in the first year and 5% in the second year, compounded quarterly. If €90,000 is deposited at the beginning of the first year, the account's value at the end of the second year is closest to: 真题模考Mock

3. 在 16 个月期间,某投资者取得 12% 的收益。其年化收益最接近于:3. Over a period of 16 months, an investor has earned a return of 12%. The investor's annualized return is closest to: 真题模考Mock

§6 名义 vs 实际利率§6 Nominal vs Real Interest Rates

LOS 对应:LOS: distinguish nominal and real returns。
(1 + 名义) = (1 + 实际) × (1 + 通胀)  →  实际 ≈ 名义 − 通胀

名义回报未剔除通胀;实际回报反映购买力真实增长。精确式用连乘,粗略估计可直接相减。The nominal return does not strip out inflation; the real return reflects the true growth in purchasing power. The exact formula multiplies the factors; a rough estimate can simply subtract.

16. 名义利率、实际利率与通胀率之间的精确关系式是:The EXACT relationship among the nominal rate, the real rate, and inflation is: 官方题Official

  • A. 名义 = 实际 × 通胀nominal = real × inflation
  • B. (1 + 实际) = (1 + 名义)(1 + 通胀)(1 + real) = (1 + nominal)(1 + inflation)
  • C. (1 + 名义) = (1 + 实际)(1 + 通胀)(1 + nominal) = (1 + real)(1 + inflation)
答案 C。费雪精确式;近似式为实际 ≈ 名义 − 通胀。Answer C. The exact Fisher relation; the approximation is real ≈ nominal − inflation.

§7 货币时间价值:PV 与 FV§7 Time Value of Money: PV & FV 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: calculate the present value and future value of a single sum。
🔰 零基础讲解:今天的 1 块 > 明天的 1 块

货币时间价值⏰ 今天手里的钱可以立刻投资生息,所以比未来同样金额的钱更值钱。把未来的钱"折现"回今天(除以 (1+r)ⁿ)得现值 PV;把今天的钱"复利"到未来(乘 (1+r)ⁿ)得终值 FV。这是整个金融估值的地基。:钱有时间价值,FV 和 PV 靠 (1+r)ⁿ 互相换算。Time value of money⏰ Money in hand today can be invested to earn interest immediately, so it is worth more than the same amount in the future. 'Discount' future money back to today (divide by (1+r)ⁿ) to get the present value PV; 'compound' today's money to the future (multiply by (1+r)ⁿ) to get the future value FV. This is the foundation of all financial valuation.: money has time value, and FV and PV convert to each other via (1+r)ⁿ.

终值 FV = PV × (1 + r)n    现值 PV = FV / (1 + r)n
符号Symbol含义Meaning
PV / FV现值 / 终值Present value / future value
r每期利率(折现率)Per-period rate (discount rate)
n期数;n 是指数(幂),不是下标Number of periods; n is an exponent (power), not a subscript
PV/FV 计算 官方题Official

今天存 $1,000、年利率 6%、5 年后?FV = 1000 × 1.065 = 1000 × 1.3382 = $1,338.2。反之,5 年后要 $1,000、现在需存?PV = 1000 / 1.065 = $747.3。Deposit $1,000 today at a 6% annual rate — how much after 5 years? FV = 1000 × 1.065 = 1000 × 1.3382 = $1,338.2. Conversely, to have $1,000 in 5 years, how much to deposit now? PV = 1000 / 1.065 = $747.3.

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

货币时间价值:PV 与 FV

核心:FV = PV × (1 + r)^n,PV = FV ÷ (1 + r)^n。同一笔钱在不同时点不可直接比较,必须先折现或复利到同一时点。

复利频率

每年复利 m 次时,用周期利率 r/m 与期数 n×m。频率越高,同一名义利率的实际增长越快(见 EAR)。

易错对比

① 折现率、期数、复利频率要口径一致(半年付息 → r/2、n×2);② 计算器里流入为正、流出为负,PV 与 FV 通常异号;③ 未来的钱要先折现再比较。

Time value of money: PV & FV

Core: FV = PV × (1 + r)^n, PV = FV ÷ (1 + r)^n. The same money at different times is not directly comparable — first discount or compound to a common date.

Compounding frequency

With m compounds per year, use the periodic rate r/m and n×m periods. Higher frequency grows faster for the same nominal rate (see EAR).

Common traps

① Keep rate, periods, and frequency consistent (semiannual → r/2, n×2); ② in the calculator inflows positive, outflows negative, so PV and FV usually differ in sign; ③ discount future money before comparing.

17. 已知现值 PV、利率 r、期数 n,终值 FV 为:Given present value PV, rate r, and n periods, the future value FV is: 官方题Official

  • A. FV = PV/(1+r)ⁿFV = PV/(1+r)ⁿ
  • B. FV = PV(1+r)ⁿFV = PV(1+r)ⁿ
  • C. FV = PV(1 + rn)FV = PV(1 + rn)
答案 B。复利终值 FV = PV(1+r)ⁿ;A 是求现值,C 为单利。Answer B. Compound future value FV = PV(1+r)ⁿ; A finds the present value and C is simple interest.

18. $1,000 按年利率 6% 投资 5 年,终值最接近:$1,000 invested at 6% per year for 5 years grows to closest: 官方题Official

19. 5 年后需要 $1,000、折现率 6%,现值最接近:You need $1,000 in 5 years at a 6% discount rate; the present value is closest to: 官方题Official

  • C. $747.3$747.3
答案 C。1,000 / 1.06⁵ = $747.3。Answer C. 1,000 / 1.06⁵ = $747.3.
1. 某养老基金需在 15 年后支付一次性 $10,000,000。若年利率 5%、按半年复利,则今天所需金额最接近于:1. A pension fund needs to pay a lump sum $10,000,000 in 15 years. If it earns 5% per year compounded semi-annually, the amount needed today is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. $4,767,427$4,767,427

§8 年金与永续年金§8 Annuities & Perpetuities

LOS 对应:LOS: calculate the present value of annuities and perpetuities。
普通年金现值 PV = PMT × [ 1 − (1+r)−n ] / r
永续年金现值 PV = PMT / r    增长永续年金 PV = PMT1 / (r − g)
类型Type说明Description
普通年金 ordinaryOrdinary annuity每期期末支付固定 PMTPays a fixed PMT at the end of each period
期初年金 annuity dueAnnuity due每期期初支付 = 普通年金 × (1+r)Pays at the beginning of each period = ordinary annuity × (1+r)
永续年金 perpetuityPerpetuity永远支付固定 PMT;PV = PMT/r(如优先股)Pays a fixed PMT forever; PV = PMT/r (e.g., preferred stock)
增长永续年金Growing perpetuityPMT 以 g 增长;PV = PMT₁/(r−g)(如戈登模型,需 r>g)PMT grows at g; PV = PMT₁/(r−g) (e.g., the Gordon model, requires r>g)
永续年金 官方题Official

每年永续支付 $50、折现率 8%。PV = 50 / 0.08 = $625。(与优先股估值 D/r 一致)A perpetual payment of $50 per year, discount rate 8%. PV = 50 / 0.08 = $625. (Consistent with preferred-stock valuation D/r)

20. 普通年金(期末支付)的现值公式是:The present value formula for an ordinary annuity (end-of-period payments) is: 官方题Official

  • A. PV = PMT × [1 − (1+r)^(−n)] / rPV = PMT × [1 − (1+r)^(−n)] / r
  • B. PV = PMT × [(1+r)ⁿ − 1] / rPV = PMT × [(1+r)ⁿ − 1] / r
  • C. PV = PMT / rPV = PMT / r
答案 A。B 是年金终值因子,C 是永续年金现值。Answer A. B is the annuity FUTURE-value factor, and C is the present value of a perpetuity.

21. 期初年金(annuity due)现值与普通年金现值的关系是:The relationship between the present value of an annuity due and that of an ordinary annuity is: 官方题Official

  • A. 期初 = 普通 / (1 + r)Due = ordinary / (1 + r)
  • B. 两者相等They are equal
  • C. 期初 = 普通 × (1 + r)Due = ordinary × (1 + r)
答案 C。期初年金每笔现金流早一期,故现值 = 普通年金现值 × (1+r)。Answer C. Each cash flow of an annuity due arrives one period earlier, so its PV = ordinary-annuity PV × (1+r).

22. 每期支付 PMT、折现率 r 的永续年金,现值为:For a perpetuity paying PMT each period at discount rate r, the present value is: 官方题Official

  • A. PMT × rPMT × r
  • B. PMT / rPMT / r
  • C. PMT / (r − g)PMT / (r − g)
答案 B。永续年金现值 = PMT/r;C 为增长型永续年金。Answer B. Perpetuity PV = PMT/r; C is a GROWING perpetuity.

23. 每年永续支付 $50、折现率 8%,现值为:For a perpetuity paying $50 per year at an 8% discount rate, the present value is: 官方题Official

  • A. $400$400
  • B. $6.25$6.25
  • C. $625$625
答案 C。50 / 0.08 = $625。Answer C. 50 / 0.08 = $625.

24. 首期支付 PMT₁、增长率 g、折现率 r(r > g)的增长永续年金,现值为:For a growing perpetuity with first payment PMT₁, growth g, and discount rate r (r > g), the present value is: 补充Extra

  • A. PMT₁ / rPMT₁ / r
  • B. PMT₁ / (r − g)PMT₁ / (r − g)
  • C. PMT₁ / (r + g)PMT₁ / (r + g)
答案 B。增长永续年金现值 = PMT₁/(r−g),需 r > g,与戈登增长模型一致。Answer B. Growing-perpetuity PV = PMT₁/(r−g), requiring r > g, consistent with the Gordon growth model.
1. 某投资需从今天起第 3 年开始支付 10 笔每年 $1,000 的等额款项。若折现率 6%、按年复利,则今天的现值最接近于:1. An investment requires 10 equal annual payments starting three years from today. If the discount rate is 6% compounded annually and each payment is $1,000, the present value today is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. $3,537$3,537
  • B. $3,749$3,749
  • C. $4,212$4,212
答案 B。方法:先算普通年金现值(在第2年末),再折回今天。10 笔从第3年开始 → 年金现值定位在第2年末,再 ÷(1.06)² 折到今天 ≈ $3,749。递延年金要两步。Answer B. Method: value the ordinary annuity (at end of year 2), then discount to today. 10 payments starting year 3 → the annuity PV sits at end of year 2, then ÷ (1.06)² to today ≈ $3,749. A deferred annuity needs two steps.
2. 某投资者有三种选择:(1) 今天一次性收 $136,000;(2) 从一年后开始每年 $12,000、共 30 期;(3) 从今天开始每年 $13,000、共 20 期。若年折现率 8%,现值最高的是:2. An investor has three options: (1) a single payment of $136,000 today; (2) 30 annual payments of $12,000 beginning one year from today; (3) 20 annual payments of $13,000 beginning today. If the annual discount rate is 8%, the option with the highest present value is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 选择 1Option 1
  • B. 选择 2Option 2
  • C. 选择 3Option 3
答案 C。方法:分别算三选项现值再比较。选项3是"期初年金(annuity-due)"(从今天起),现值通常最高;按 8% 折现,选项3 现值最大 → 选3。Answer C. Method: compute each option's PV and compare. Option 3 is an annuity-due (starting today), so its PV is typically highest; at 8%, option 3 has the largest PV → choose 3.
3. 某投资需从今天起支付 10 笔等额年款,并在 15 年后支付一次性 $500,000。若年利率 4%、按年复利,则每年所需支付额最接近于:3. An investment requires 10 equal annual payments starting today and will pay out a lump sum of $500,000 in 15 years. If the interest rate is 4% per year compounded annually, the required annual payment is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. $32,913$32,913
  • B. $34,230$34,230
  • C. $40,044$40,044
答案 A。方法:让"10 笔年款的现值 = 15 年后 $500,000 的现值"。500,000/(1.04)^15 = 年金现值 = 年款 × 年金因子(10期,4%),解年款 ≈ $32,913。Answer A. Method: set the PV of the 10 payments equal to the PV of $500,000 in 15 years. 500,000/(1.04)^15 = annuity PV = payment × annuity factor (10 periods, 4%); solving ≈ $32,913.
4. 某投资者需在 4 年中每年年初支付 $50,000 学费,首笔从今天起第 10 年开始。若年折现率 3%,则今天所需最低投资额最接近于:4. An investor needs to pay college tuition of $50,000 at the beginning of each year for 4 years, with the first payment starting 10 years from today. If the annual discount rate is 3%, the minimum investment required today is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. $138,294$138,294
  • B. $142,442$142,442
  • C. $146,716$146,716
答案 B。方法:期初年金(每年年初付),且首笔在第10年 → 递延年金。先算 annuity-due 现值定位在第9年末,再折回今天 ≈ $142,442。Answer B. Method: an annuity-due (paid at the start of each year) with the first payment in year 10 → a deferred annuity. Value the annuity-due (at end of year 9), then discount to today ≈ $142,442.

§1 现金流可加性与无套利§1 Cash-Flow Additivity & No-Arbitrage 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应：explain the cash flow additivity principle and its use in no-arbitrage valuation。

现金流可加性指：若两个组合在每个未来时点、每种状态下的现金流完全相同，则它们今天的价值必须相同。否则可以卖空高价组合、买入低价组合，锁定无风险利润。Cash-flow additivity means: if two portfolios have exactly the same cash flows at every future time point and in every state, their values today must be the same. Otherwise you could short the expensive portfolio and buy the cheap one, locking in a risk-free profit.

PV(CFA + CFB) = PV(CFA) + PV(CFB)
应用Application可加性思路Additivity idea
远期利率Forward rate投资两年，应等价于先投资一年，再锁定第二年的一年期远期利率。Investing for two years should be equivalent to investing for one year and then locking in the one-year forward rate for the second year.
远期汇率Forward exchange rate本币投资，应等价于换成外币投资并锁定未来换回本币。Investing in the home currency should be equivalent to converting to a foreign currency, investing, and locking in the future conversion back.
期权平价Option parity保护性看跌与受托看涨到期现金流相同，所以今天价值相同。A protective put and a fiduciary call have the same maturity cash flows, so they are worth the same today.
例题

一年期即期利率 3%，两年期即期利率 4%。一年后开始的一年期远期利率满足：The one-year spot rate is 3% and the two-year spot rate is 4%. The one-year forward rate starting one year out satisfies:

(1.04)2 = 1.03(1 + f1,1)

所以 f1,1 = 5.01%。若市场远期利率偏离该数值，就可能产生跨期限套利。So f1,1 = 5.01%. If the market forward rate deviates from this value, cross-maturity arbitrage may arise.

1.2 隐含收益率、要求回报率与隐含增长率

LOS 对应：calculate an implied return for fixed-income instruments and calculate and interpret required return and implied growth for equity instruments。

TVM 题目经常把普通现值公式反过来使用：已知今天的价格和未来现金流，求使两者相等的折现率。这个折现率就是投资的隐含收益率或内部收益率。TVM problems often use the ordinary present-value formula in reverse: given today's price and future cash flows, solve for the discount rate that equates them. That discount rate is the investment's implied yield or internal rate of return.

债券价格 P0 = Σ CFt/(1+r)t；反求 r = 隐含收益率
Gordon 模型 P0 = D1/(r−g)
要求回报率 r = D1/P0 + g；隐含增长率 g = r − D1/P0
例题 1 · 固定收益隐含回报

一年期零息债券现价 95，到期支付 100。95 = 100/(1+r)，所以 r = 100/95−1 = 5.263%。若是多期付息债券，应求解使全部现金流现值等于价格的 IRR。A one-year zero-coupon bond is priced at 95 and pays 100 at maturity. 95 = 100/(1+r), so r = 100/95−1 = 5.263%. For a multi-period coupon bond, solve for the IRR that makes the present value of all cash flows equal the price.

例题 2 · 权益要求回报与隐含增长

股票现价 40，下一年股息 D1=2，长期增长率 4%，则要求回报率 r = 2/40+4% = 9%。反过来，若市场要求回报率为 10%，其他条件不变，则市场价格隐含的长期增长率 g = 10%−2/40 = 5%。A stock is priced at 40, next-year dividend D1=2, long-run growth 4%, so the required return r = 2/40+4% = 9%. Conversely, if the market required return is 10%, all else equal, the long-run growth rate implied by the market price is g = 10%−2/40 = 5%.

易错点：
① Gordon 模型使用下一期股息 D1，不是 D0；
② 必须满足 r>g；
③ 隐含增长率是由当前价格和假设反推的市场一致预期，不保证实际实现；
④ 多期债券通常不能用简单的“总收益/价格”，必须求 IRR。
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

现金流可加性与无套利

• 现金流可加性(cash-flow additivity):同一时点的现金流其现值可直接相加。这让复杂工具能拆成简单现金流之和来定价。
• 无套利(no-arbitrage):现金流完全相同的两个组合必须同价,否则可无风险套利。

应用

远期、互换、期权定价都建立在此:用可复制的简单头寸拼出目标现金流,其成本即无套利价格。

易错对比

① 只有同一时点的现金流才能直接相加(不同时点先折现);② 无套利不需要预测未来价格;③ 价差存在 → 买低卖高套利至消失。

Cash-flow additivity & no-arbitrage

• Cash-flow additivity: present values of cash flows at the same date can be added directly, letting complex instruments be priced as sums of simple flows.
• No-arbitrage: two portfolios with identical cash flows must have the same price, else a riskless arbitrage exists.

Application

Forwards, swaps, and options all rest on this: replicate the target cash flow with simple positions; their cost is the no-arbitrage price.

Common traps

① Only same-date flows add directly (discount others first); ② no-arbitrage needs no price forecast; ③ a price gap → buy low/sell high until it closes.

1. 一年期零息债券价格 96、到期价值 100,隐含收益率最接近:A one-year zero-coupon bond priced at 96 with a maturity value of 100 has an implied yield closest to:

  • A. 4.167%4.167%
  • B. 4.000%4.000%
  • C. 6.000%6.000%
答案 A。100/96 − 1 = 4.167%。Answer A. 100/96 − 1 = 4.167%.

2. P0=50、D1=2、r=9%,隐含长期增长率 g 最接近:With P₀=50, D₁=2, r=9%, the implied long-run growth rate g is closest to:

  • A. 9%9%
  • B. 5%5%
  • C. 4%4%
答案 B。由戈登模型 r = D₁/P₀ + g,得 g = 9% − 2/50 = 5%。Answer B. From the Gordon model r = D₁/P₀ + g, so g = 9% − 2/50 = 5%.

第二讲 · 资产回报的统计度量、概率与组合数学Lecture 2 · Statistical Measures of Asset Returns, Probability & Portfolio Mathematics

对应教材:LM3《Statistical Measures of Asset Returns》+ LM4《Probability Trees and Conditional Expectations》+ LM5《Portfolio Mathematics》 · 建议学习时长:3.5–4 小时Curriculum: LM3 Statistical Measures of Asset Returns + LM4 Probability Trees and Conditional Expectations + LM5 Portfolio Mathematics · Suggested study time: 3.5–4 hours

这一讲讲"如何用数字描述一堆回报数据、以及如何处理不确定性":集中趋势与离散度、偏度峰度、概率规则与贝叶斯、组合的期望方差协方差。这些是风险度量和组合理论的直接基础。This lecture is about 'how to describe a body of return data with numbers and how to handle uncertainty': central tendency and dispersion, skewness and kurtosis, probability rules and Bayes, and a portfolio's expected value, variance, and covariance. These are the direct foundation of risk measurement and portfolio theory.

§1 集中趋势§1 Central Tendency

LOS 对应:LOS: calculate and interpret measures of central tendency。
指标Measure含义Meaning
算术均值 meanArithmetic mean所有值之和/个数;受极端值影响大Sum of all values / count; heavily affected by extremes
中位数 medianMedian排序后中间值;抗极端值The middle value after sorting; robust to extremes
众数 modeMode出现最多的值The most frequent value
加权均值Weighted mean按权重加权(如组合回报);调和均值用于平均成本(如定投)Weighted by weights (e.g., portfolio return); the harmonic mean is used for average cost (e.g., dollar-cost averaging)
考点·稳健均值(降低离群值影响):
• 截尾均值(trimmed mean):剔除两端各 x% 的极端值,再对剩余求均值。
• 缩尾均值(winsorized mean):把两端极端值"替换"为某分位点的值(不剔除),再求均值。Exam - robust means (reducing outlier impact):
- Trimmed mean: drop the top and bottom x% of extreme values, then average the rest.
- Winsorized mean: replace the extreme values with percentile values (do not drop them), then average.

1. 关于均值与中位数对极端值(离群值)的敏感性,最恰当的是:Regarding the sensitivity of the mean vs the median to extreme values (outliers), the most appropriate statement is: 官方题Official

  • A. 均值更抗极端值The mean is more resistant to extremes
  • B. 中位数更抗极端值The median is more resistant to extremes
  • C. 两者受极端值影响相同Both are equally affected by extremes
答案 B。均值受极端值影响大,中位数只看位置,更稳健。Answer B. The mean is heavily affected by extreme values, while the median depends only on position and is more robust.

2. 调和均值最常应用于下列哪种场景:The harmonic mean is most commonly applied in which scenario: 补充Extra

  • A. 多期复合回报Multi-period compound return
  • B. 单期期望回报估计Estimating the single-period expected return
  • C. 定期定额投资(定投)的平均买入成本The average purchase cost of periodic fixed-amount (dollar-cost-averaging) investing
答案 C。等额资金分批买入的平均成本用调和均值;多期复合用几何均值。Answer C. The average cost of buying in equal dollar amounts uses the harmonic mean; multi-period compounding uses the geometric mean.
1. 分析师剔除样本中最低 2.5% 与最高 2.5% 的值,并对剩余 95% 计算均值。该均值最恰当地被称为:1. An analyst discards the lowest 2.5% and highest 2.5% of values in a sample and computes the mean of the remaining 95%. The resulting mean is best described as a: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 截尾均值trimmed mean
  • B. 调和均值harmonic mean
  • C. 缩尾均值winsorized mean
答案 A。剔除两端各 2.5%、对中间 95% 求均值 = 截尾均值(trimmed mean)。缩尾均值(winsorized)是把极端值"替换"为分位点值(不剔除)。Answer A. Dropping the top and bottom 2.5% and averaging the middle 95% = a trimmed mean. A winsorized mean replaces extreme values with percentile values (does not drop them).

§2 离散度§2 Dispersion 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: calculate and interpret measures of dispersion。
总体方差 σ2 = Σ(xi − μ)2 / N    样本方差 s2 = Σ(xi − x̄)2 / (n − 1)
变异系数 CV = 标准差 / 均值
指标Measure含义Meaning
方差 / 标准差Variance / standard deviation离散程度;标准差 = 方差开方,单位同原数据Degree of dispersion; standard deviation = square root of variance, same units as the data
样本用 n−1Sample uses n−1样本方差分母用 n−1(自由度修正,无偏估计)The sample variance uses n−1 in the denominator (degrees-of-freedom correction, unbiased estimate)
变异系数 CVCoefficient of variation (CV)每单位回报承担的风险;越低越好,用于跨资产比较风险Risk borne per unit of return; lower is better, used to compare risk across assets
变异系数 官方题Official

A:均值 10%、标准差 15% → CV=1.5;B:均值 8%、标准差 10% → CV=1.25。B 的每单位回报风险更低,风险调整后更优。A: mean 10%, SD 15% → CV=1.5; B: mean 8%, SD 10% → CV=1.25. B has lower risk per unit of return and is better on a risk-adjusted basis.

考点·离散度度量:
• 平均绝对离差(MAD):|偏差| 的平均,总是 ≤ 标准差(标准差对大偏差平方放大)。
• 变异系数(CV)= 标准差 ÷ 均值:每单位收益承担的风险,可跨资产比较。
• 目标下行偏差(target semideviation):只对"低于目标"的偏差平方后开方,< 标准差——专门衡量下行风险。Exam - measures of dispersion:
- Mean absolute deviation (MAD): the average of |deviations|, always ≤ the standard deviation (which squares and amplifies large deviations).
- Coefficient of variation (CV) = standard deviation ÷ mean: risk per unit of return, comparable across assets.
- Target semideviation (downside deviation): squares only deviations below the target then takes the root, < the standard deviation - it measures downside risk specifically.
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

离散度的度量

• 方差/标准差:围绕均值的平均平方偏离(样本方差除 n−1)。
• 平均绝对离差(MAD)。
• 变异系数(CV)= σ ÷ 均值:无量纲,衡量每单位回报承担的风险,便于跨不同规模/量纲比较。
• 目标下行偏差:只看低于阈值的偏离。

易错对比

① 样本方差除 n−1(总体除 N);② CV 越小越好(单位风险回报的风险更低);③ CV 适合比较均值不同的资产,标准差不适合。

Measures of dispersion

• Variance/standard deviation: average squared deviation from the mean (sample variance ÷ n−1).
• Mean absolute deviation (MAD).
• Coefficient of variation (CV) = σ ÷ mean: unitless, measuring risk per unit of return, good for comparing across scales/units.
• Target downside deviation: only deviations below a threshold.

Common traps

① Sample variance divides by n−1 (population by N); ② lower CV is better (less risk per unit return); ③ CV compares assets with different means; standard deviation alone does not.

3. 样本方差以 n−1(而非 n)作分母,主要是为了:The sample variance uses n−1 (rather than n) as the denominator mainly to: 官方题Official

  • A. 使方差数值更小Make the variance number smaller
  • B. 修正分布的偏度Correct the distribution's skewness
  • C. 使样本方差成为总体方差的无偏估计Make the sample variance an unbiased estimator of the population variance
答案 C。n−1 是自由度修正,消除样本方差对总体方差的系统性低估。Answer C. n−1 is the degrees-of-freedom correction, removing the systematic underestimation of the population variance.

4. 变异系数(CV)的正确定义是:The correct definition of the coefficient of variation (CV) is: 官方题Official

  • A. 均值 / 标准差mean / standard deviation
  • B. 标准差 / 均值standard deviation / mean
  • C. 标准差 / 方差standard deviation / variance
答案 B。CV = σ/均值,衡量每单位回报承担的风险,越低越好,便于跨资产比较。Answer B. CV = σ/mean, measuring risk per unit of return; lower is better and it enables comparison across assets.

5. A:μ=10%、σ=15%;B:μ=8%、σ=10%。按变异系数衡量,风险调整后更优的是:A: μ=10%, σ=15%; B: μ=8%, σ=10%. Measured by CV, the risk-adjusted better one is: 官方题Official

  • A. A(CV = 1.5)A (CV = 1.5)
  • B. B(CV = 1.25)B (CV = 1.25)
  • C. 两者相同They are the same
答案 B。CV_A=15/10=1.5,CV_B=10/8=1.25;B 每单位回报的风险更低。Answer B. CV_A=15/10=1.5, CV_B=10/8=1.25; B carries less risk per unit of return.
1. 下列哪种度量最能刻画每单位平均收益所承担的风险?1. Which of the following measures best quantifies the amount of risk per unit of mean return? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 夏普比率Sharpe ratio
  • B. 标准差Standard deviation
  • C. 变异系数Coefficient of variation
答案 C。每单位平均收益承担的风险 = 变异系数(CV)= 标准差/平均收益。夏普是每单位风险的"超额"收益;标准差只是绝对风险。Answer C. Risk per unit of mean return = the coefficient of variation (CV) = standard deviation/mean return. Sharpe is excess return per unit of risk; standard deviation is absolute risk only.
2. 分析师收集某证券样本收益:−2%、−1%、1%、2%。该样本收益的平均绝对离差(MAD)是:2. An analyst gathers the following sample returns for a security: −2%, −1%, 1%, 2%. The mean absolute deviation of the sample returns is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 小于样本标准差。less than the sample standard deviation.
  • B. 等于样本标准差。equal to the sample standard deviation.
  • C. 大于样本标准差。greater than the sample standard deviation.
答案 A。平均绝对离差(MAD)总是 ≤ 标准差(标准差对大偏差"平方"放大)。对 −2,−1,1,2,MAD < 样本标准差。Answer A. The mean absolute deviation (MAD) is always ≤ the standard deviation (standard deviation squares and amplifies large deviations). For −2,−1,1,2, MAD < the sample standard deviation.
3. 某组合平均收益 1.0%、收益标准差 2.7%。若设定的最低目标收益为 1.0%,则样本目标半离差(下行偏差)是:3. A portfolio has a mean return of 1.0% and a standard deviation of returns of 2.7%. If the specified minimum target return is 1.0%, the sample target semideviation is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 小于 2.7%。less than 2.7%.
  • B. 等于 2.7%。equal to 2.7%.
  • C. 大于 2.7%。greater than 2.7%.
答案 A。目标半离差(下行偏差)只计"低于目标"的偏差,而标准差计上下双向。故门槛=均值时,下行偏差 < 标准差 2.7%(只算一半的偏差)。Answer A. Target semideviation (downside deviation) counts only deviations below the target, while standard deviation counts both directions. So with the target equal to the mean, downside deviation < the 2.7% standard deviation.
4. 组合月收益的变异系数最恰当地定义为下列哪项之比:4. The coefficient of variation of a portfolio's monthly returns is best defined as the ratio of the: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 组合收益标准差 ÷ 平均收益。standard deviation of the portfolio's returns to the mean return.
  • B. 平均超额收益 ÷ 收益标准差。mean excess portfolio return to the standard deviation of returns.
  • C. 组合收益标准差 ÷ 平均超额收益。standard deviation of the portfolio's returns to the mean excess return.
答案 A。变异系数(CV)= 收益标准差 ÷ 平均收益(每单位平均收益的风险)。B 是夏普比率的形式;C 分母用超额收益不对。Answer A. Coefficient of variation (CV) = return standard deviation ÷ mean return (risk per unit of mean return). B is the Sharpe form; C wrongly uses excess return in the denominator.
5. 某组合五年年收益如下,目标收益 6%:
年12345
收益−23%20%3%13%−1%
该组合的目标下行偏差最接近于:5. A portfolio has the following annual returns over five years, with a target return of 6%:
Year12345
Return−23%20%3%13%−1%
The portfolio's target downside deviation is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 12%12%
  • B. 13%13%
  • C. 15%15%
答案 C。方法:目标下行偏差 = √[Σ min(0, Rₜ−目标)² / (n−1)],只取低于 6% 的年份平方。按表 ≈ 15%。Answer C. Method: target downside deviation = √[Σ min(0, Rₜ−target)² / (n−1)], using only years below 6%. Per the table ≈ 15%.
6. 组合月收益的变异系数最恰当地定义为下列哪项之比:6. The coefficient of variation of a portfolio's monthly returns is best defined as the ratio of the: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 组合收益标准差 ÷ 平均收益。standard deviation of the portfolio's returns to the mean return.
  • B. 平均超额收益 ÷ 收益标准差。mean excess portfolio return to the standard deviation of returns.
  • C. 组合收益标准差 ÷ 平均超额收益。standard deviation of the portfolio's returns to the mean excess return.
答案 A。同[24]:变异系数 = 标准差 ÷ 平均收益。Answer A. Same as [24]: CV = standard deviation ÷ mean return.

§3 偏度与峰度§3 Skewness & Kurtosis 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: interpret skewness and kurtosis。
🔰 零基础讲解:分布的"歪"和"尖"

偏度峰度📊 偏度=分布歪向哪边:右偏(正偏)有个别超大值把右尾拉长,均值>中位数;左偏相反。峰度=尾巴有多肥、峰有多尖:肥尾(尖峰,超额峰度>0)意味着极端事件比正态更常见——金融回报常是肥尾,风险被正态假设低估。:偏度看对称性,峰度看极端值频率。Skewness & kurtosis📊 Skewness = which way the distribution leans: right (positive) skew has a few very large values stretching the right tail, mean > median; left skew is the reverse. Kurtosis = how fat the tails and how sharp the peak: fat tails (leptokurtic, excess kurtosis > 0) mean extreme events are more common than under a normal — financial returns are often fat-tailed, so risk is understated by a normal assumption.: skewness looks at symmetry, kurtosis at the frequency of extremes.

特征Feature含义Meaning
右偏(正偏)Right (positive) skew右尾长;均值 > 中位数 > 众数;偏度 > 0Long right tail; mean > median > mode; skewness > 0
左偏(负偏)Left (negative) skew左尾长;均值 < 中位数 < 众数;偏度 < 0Long left tail; mean < median < mode; skewness < 0
正态分布Normal distribution偏度 = 0,峰度 = 3(超额峰度 = 0)Skewness = 0, kurtosis = 3 (excess kurtosis = 0)
尖峰肥尾 leptokurticLeptokurtic (fat-tailed)峰度 > 3(超额 > 0);极端值更多——金融回报常见,风险更高Kurtosis > 3 (excess > 0); more extreme values — common in financial returns, higher risk
低峰薄尾 platykurticPlatykurtic (thin-tailed)峰度 < 3(超额 < 0)Kurtosis < 3 (excess < 0)
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

偏度与峰度

• 偏度(skewness):正偏(右尾长)→ 均值 > 中位数 > 众数;负偏(左尾长)→ 均值 < 中位数。
• 峰度(kurtosis):超额峰度 > 0 = 尖峰厚尾(leptokurtic),极端值比正态多;< 0 = 平峰薄尾。正态超额峰度 = 0。

对投资的含义

投资者偏好正偏、厌恶负偏与厚尾:负偏 + 高峰度意味「大亏」概率被低估——只看均值方差会低估尾部风险。

易错对比

① 正偏 均值 > 中位数、负偏相反;② 超额峰度 > 0 = 厚尾(金融回报常见);③ 均值-方差框架忽略偏度峰度带来的尾部风险。

Skewness & kurtosis

• Skewness: positive (long right tail) → mean > median > mode; negative (long left tail) → mean < median.
• Kurtosis: excess kurtosis > 0 = leptokurtic (peaked, fat tails), more extremes than normal; < 0 = platykurtic. Normal has excess kurtosis = 0.

Investment meaning

Investors like positive skew, dislike negative skew and fat tails: negative skew + high kurtosis means the chance of a big loss is understated — mean-variance alone understates tail risk.

Common traps

① Positive skew has mean > median, negative the reverse; ② excess kurtosis > 0 = fat tails (common in returns); ③ mean-variance ignores the tail risk from skew/kurtosis.

6. 右偏(正偏)分布中,均值、中位数、众数的大小关系是:In a right-skewed (positively skewed) distribution, the ordering of mean, median, and mode is: 官方题Official

  • A. 均值 > 中位数 > 众数mean > median > mode
  • B. 众数 > 中位数 > 均值mode > median > mean
  • C. 三者相等the three are equal
答案 A。右偏时长尾在右,均值被拉高,故均值 > 中位数 > 众数。Answer A. A right skew has a long right tail that pulls the mean up, so mean > median > mode.

7. 正态分布的偏度与峰度分别为:The skewness and kurtosis of a normal distribution are, respectively: 官方题Official

  • A. 偏度 3、峰度 0skewness 3, kurtosis 0
  • B. 偏度 0、峰度 0skewness 0, kurtosis 0
  • C. 偏度 0、峰度 3skewness 0, kurtosis 3
答案 C。正态偏度=0、峰度=3,故超额峰度(峰度−3)=0。Answer C. Normal skewness = 0 and kurtosis = 3, so excess kurtosis (kurtosis − 3) = 0.

8. 尖峰肥尾(leptokurtic)分布的风险含义是:The risk implication of a leptokurtic (fat-tailed) distribution is: 官方题Official

  • A. 极端值比正态分布更少见Extreme values are rarer than under a normal distribution
  • B. 超额峰度>0,极端值比正态更常见,正态假设会低估尾部风险Excess kurtosis > 0, extremes are more common than under normal, and a normal assumption understates tail risk
  • C. 分布完全对称、无尾部风险The distribution is perfectly symmetric with no tail risk
答案 B。肥尾意味着极端事件概率更高,用正态假设会低估 VaR 等尾部风险。Answer B. Fat tails mean extreme events are more likely; assuming normality understates tail risk such as VaR.
1. 若单峰收益分布为负偏(左偏),下列哪项最可能取值最大?1. If a unimodal return distribution is negatively skewed, which of the following most likely has the highest value? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 均值Mean
  • B. 众数Mode
  • C. 中位数Median
答案 B。负偏(左偏)分布:均值 < 中位数 < 众数(长尾在左把均值拉低)。故取值最大的是众数(mode)。Answer B. In a negatively (left) skewed distribution: mean < median < mode (the long left tail pulls the mean down). So the largest is the mode.
2. 对于连续、正偏(右偏)的单峰分布:2. For a continuous positively skewed unimodal distribution: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 众数和中位数都小于均值。both the mode and the median are less than the mean.
  • B. 众数和中位数都大于均值。both the mode and the median are greater than the mean.
  • C. 众数小于均值而中位数大于均值。the mode is less than the mean and the median is greater than the mean.
答案 A。正偏(右偏):众数 < 中位数 < 均值(长尾在右把均值拉高)。故"众数和中位数都小于均值"。Answer A. In a positively (right) skewed distribution: mode < median < mean (the long right tail pulls the mean up). So "mode and median both below the mean."
3. 某连续分布的图形显示左尾比右尾长。该分布最恰当地被描述为具有:3. A graphical depiction of a continuous distribution shows the left tail to be longer than the right tail. The distribution is best described as having: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 负偏(左偏)negative skewness
  • B. 尖峰(高峰态)leptokurtosis
  • C. 正偏(右偏)positive skewness
答案 A。左尾更长 = 负偏(左偏, negatively skewed)。尖峰(高峰态)描述的是峰度,不是偏度。Answer A. A longer left tail = negative (left) skew. Leptokurtic (peakedness) describes kurtosis, not skewness.

§4 分位数§4 Quantiles

LOS 对应:LOS: calculate quantiles。

分位数把排序数据分段:四分位(quartile)、五分位、十分位、百分位。四分位距 IQR = Q3 − Q1,衡量中间 50% 数据的离散度、抗极端值。箱线图用 Q1、中位数、Q3 直观展示分布。Quantiles divide sorted data into segments: quartiles, quintiles, deciles, percentiles. The interquartile range IQR = Q3 − Q1 measures the dispersion of the middle 50% of the data and is robust to extremes. A box plot uses Q1, the median, and Q3 to display the distribution visually.

9. 四分位距(IQR)的计算方法是:The interquartile range (IQR) is computed as: 官方题Official

  • A. Q3 − Q1Q3 − Q1
  • B. Q2 − Q1Q2 − Q1
  • C. 最大值 − 最小值maximum − minimum
答案 A。IQR = Q3 − Q1,衡量中间 50% 数据的离散程度;C 是极差。Answer A. IQR = Q3 − Q1, measuring the spread of the middle 50% of the data; C is the range.
1. 分析师对 100 个观测计算:第一四分位=11、第二=62、第三=93、第四=359。四分位距(IQR)等于:1. An analyst calculates the following statistics for a sample of 100 observations: first quartile = 11, second quartile = 62, third quartile = 93, fourth quartile = 359. The interquartile range is equal to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 3131
  • B. 8282
  • C. 348348
答案 B。四分位距 IQR = 第三四分位 − 第一四分位 = 93 − 11 = 82。IQR 衡量中间 50% 的离散度。Answer B. Interquartile range IQR = Q3 − Q1 = 93 − 11 = 82. The IQR measures the spread of the middle 50%.
2. 在按升序排列的 75 个样本中,第 19 个观测位于第二个:2. Ranked in ascending order, the 19th observation in a sample of 75 is in the second: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 十分位decile
  • B. 五分位quintile
  • C. 四分位quartile
答案 B。方法:第 19 个/75 → 位置分位。19/75 ≈ 25% → 落在第二个"五分位(quintile)"(每五分位 20%,第二五分位覆盖 20–40%)。Answer B. Method: rank 19 of 75. 19/75 ≈ 25% → within the second quintile (each quintile is 20%; the second covers 20–40%).
3. 分析师观察到四家公司的 EPS:−£0.50、£0.50、£2.50、£5.50。这些 EPS 的第 50 百分位最接近于:3. An analyst observes the following EPS for four companies: −£0.50, £0.50, £2.50, and £5.50. The 50th percentile of the EPS values is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. £1.50£1.50
  • B. £2.00£2.00
  • C. £2.50£2.50
答案 A。第 50 百分位 = 中位数。四个 EPS 排序后取中间两值平均:(0.50 + 2.50)/2 = £1.50。Answer A. The 50th percentile = the median. Sorting the four EPS values and averaging the middle two: (0.50 + 2.50)/2 = £1.50.
4. 分析师收集了七只基金的收益:12%、7%、5%、4%、8%、3%、3%。第二四分位收益是:4. An analyst gathers returns for seven funds: 12%, 7%, 5%, 4%, 8%, 3%, 3%. The second quartile return is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 4%4%
  • B. 5%5%
  • C. 6%6%
答案 B。第二四分位 = 中位数(50%)。七个收益排序后取中间(第4个)= 5%。Answer B. The second quartile = the median (50%). Sorting the seven returns and taking the middle (4th) = 5%.

§5 概率的基本规则§5 Basic Probability Rules

LOS 对应:LOS: describe the probability rules。
加法:P(A 或 B) = P(A) + P(B) − P(A 且 B)
乘法(独立):P(A 且 B) = P(A) × P(B)  一般:P(A 且 B) = P(A|B) × P(B)
概念Concept含义Meaning
互斥 mutually exclusiveMutually exclusive不能同时发生,P(A 且 B)=0Cannot occur together, P(A and B)=0
独立 independentIndependent一个发生不影响另一个,P(A|B)=P(A)One occurring does not affect the other, P(A|B)=P(A)
期望值 E(X)Expected value E(X)= Σ P(xᵢ)·xᵢ,概率加权平均= Σ P(xᵢ)·xᵢ, a probability-weighted average

10. 概率加法规则 P(A 或 B) 等于:The probability addition rule P(A or B) equals: 官方题Official

  • A. P(A) + P(B)P(A) + P(B)
  • B. P(A) + P(B) − P(A 且 B)P(A) + P(B) − P(A and B)
  • C. P(A) × P(B)P(A) × P(B)
答案 B。需减去重复计算的交集;仅当互斥时 P(A且B)=0 才退化为 A。Answer B. You must subtract the double-counted intersection; only for mutually exclusive events (P(A and B)=0) does it reduce to A.

11. 关于互斥事件与独立事件,最恰当的是:Regarding mutually exclusive vs independent events, the most appropriate statement is: 官方题Official

  • A. 互斥即 P(A且B)=0;独立即 P(A|B)=P(A)Mutually exclusive means P(A and B)=0; independent means P(A|B)=P(A)
  • B. 互斥与独立是同一概念Mutually exclusive and independent are the same concept
  • C. 独立事件一定互斥Independent events must be mutually exclusive
答案 A。互斥=不能同时发生,独立=互不影响;两者不同,互斥的非零概率事件反而不独立。Answer A. Mutually exclusive = cannot occur together; independent = do not affect each other; a mutually exclusive pair with non-zero probabilities is in fact NOT independent.

12. 两个独立事件同时发生的概率为:The probability that two independent events both occur is: 官方题Official

  • A. P(A) + P(B)P(A) + P(B)
  • B. P(A) × P(B)P(A) × P(B)
  • C. P(A) − P(B)P(A) − P(B)
答案 B。独立事件的联合概率为各自概率相乘。Answer B. The joint probability of independent events is the product of their individual probabilities.

13. 离散随机变量期望值 E(X) 的计算式是:The expected value E(X) of a discrete random variable is computed as: 官方题Official

  • A. Σ P(xᵢ)·xᵢΣ P(xᵢ)·xᵢ
  • B. Σ xᵢ / nΣ xᵢ / n
  • C. Σ P(xᵢ)Σ P(xᵢ)
答案 A。期望值是以概率为权重的加权平均;B 是简单均值,C 为概率求和(=1)。Answer A. Expected value is a probability-weighted average; B is a simple mean and C is the sum of probabilities (=1).

§6 条件概率、全概率与贝叶斯§6 Conditional Probability, Total Probability & Bayes 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: calculate and interpret conditional and total probabilities and apply Bayes' formula。
条件概率:P(A|B) = P(A 且 B) / P(B)
全概率:P(A) = P(A|B₁)P(B₁) + P(A|B₂)P(B₂) + …
贝叶斯:P(B|A) = [ P(A|B) × P(B) ] / P(A)
公式Formula用途Use
全概率Total probability把一个事件按互斥情形拆开加总求总概率Decompose an event across mutually exclusive scenarios and sum to get the total probability
贝叶斯Bayes用新信息更新先验概率,得到后验概率Use new information to update the prior probability, obtaining the posterior
贝叶斯更新 官方题Official

某检测准确率:病人中 90% 呈阳性 P(+|病)=0.9;人群患病率 P(病)=1%;健康者误报 P(+|健)=5%。全概率 P(+) = 0.9×0.01 + 0.05×0.99 = 0.009+0.0495 = 0.0585。后验 P(病|+) = 0.009/0.0585 = 15.4%——即使检测阳性,真正患病概率也只有约 15%(低基础概率的反直觉)。A test's accuracy: 90% of the ill test positive, P(+|ill)=0.9; population prevalence P(ill)=1%; false-positive rate for the healthy P(+|healthy)=5%. Total probability P(+) = 0.9×0.01 + 0.05×0.99 = 0.009+0.0495 = 0.0585. Posterior P(ill|+) = 0.009/0.0585 = 15.4% — even with a positive test, the true probability of being ill is only about 15% (the counterintuitive effect of a low base rate).

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

贝叶斯更新

P(A|B) = P(B|A) × P(A) ÷ P(B)。用新证据 B 把先验 P(A) 更新为后验 P(A|B)。分母 P(B) 由全概率公式:P(B) = P(B|A)P(A) + P(B|Aᶜ)P(Aᶜ)。

直觉

后验 ∝ 先验 × 似然。证据越「像」在 A 下才会出现,越推高 A 的后验概率。

易错对比

① 别把 P(A|B) 与 P(B|A) 搞反(逆条件谬误);② 分母要用全概率展开;③ 先验很低时,即使似然高,后验也可能不高(基率不可忽视)。

Bayesian updating

P(A|B) = P(B|A) × P(A) ÷ P(B). Use new evidence B to update the prior P(A) to the posterior P(A|B). The denominator by total probability: P(B) = P(B|A)P(A) + P(B|Aᶜ)P(Aᶜ).

Intuition

Posterior ∝ prior × likelihood. The more the evidence is characteristic of A, the more it lifts A's posterior.

Common traps

① Don't swap P(A|B) and P(B|A) (the inverse fallacy); ② expand the denominator with total probability; ③ with a very low prior, even a high likelihood may keep the posterior low (base rate matters).

14. 条件概率 P(A|B) 等于:The conditional probability P(A|B) equals: 官方题Official

  • A. P(A 且 B) / P(B)P(A and B) / P(B)
  • B. P(A 且 B) / P(A)P(A and B) / P(A)
  • C. P(A) × P(B)P(A) × P(B)
答案 A。在 B 已发生的条件下,用联合概率除以 P(B)。Answer A. Given that B has occurred, divide the joint probability by P(B).

15. 全概率公式 P(A)=ΣP(A|Bᵢ)P(Bᵢ) 的作用是:The role of the total probability rule P(A)=ΣP(A|Bᵢ)P(Bᵢ) is: 官方题Official

  • A. 更新先验概率To update a prior probability
  • B. 把事件按一组互斥且完备的情形拆解以求其总概率To decompose an event across a set of mutually exclusive, exhaustive scenarios to obtain its total probability
  • C. 计算两资产的相关系数To compute the correlation of two assets
答案 B。全概率把 A 拆到各互斥情形 Bᵢ 上加权求和;更新先验是贝叶斯公式的功能。Answer B. Total probability sums A weighted over each mutually exclusive scenario Bᵢ; updating a prior is Bayes' rule.

16. 贝叶斯公式的正确形式是:The correct form of Bayes' formula is: 官方题Official

  • A. P(B|A) = P(A|B)P(B) / P(A)P(B|A) = P(A|B)P(B) / P(A)
  • B. P(B|A) = P(A|B)P(A) / P(B)P(B|A) = P(A|B)P(A) / P(B)
  • C. P(B|A) = P(A)P(B)P(B|A) = P(A)P(B)
答案 A。后验 = 似然 × 先验 / 证据。Answer A. Posterior = likelihood × prior / evidence.

17. 贝叶斯公式主要用于:Bayes' formula is mainly used to: 官方题Official

  • A. 计算组合方差Compute portfolio variance
  • B. 检验分布是否正态Test whether a distribution is normal
  • C. 用新信息(证据)更新先验概率,得到后验概率Update a prior probability with new information (evidence) to obtain a posterior probability
答案 C。贝叶斯是"以新证据修正概率"的框架。Answer C. Bayes is the framework for revising probabilities with new evidence.

18. 患病率 1%、真阳性率 90%、误报率 5%,某人检测为阳性,其真患病概率最接近:Prevalence 1%, true-positive rate 90%, false-positive rate 5%; a person tests positive. The probability they are truly ill is closest to: 官方题Official

  • A. 90%90%
  • B. 15.4%15.4%
  • C. 1%1%
答案 B。P(+)=0.9×0.01+0.05×0.99=0.0585;P(病|+)=0.009/0.0585≈15.4%,远低于直觉的 90%。Answer B. P(+)=0.9×0.01+0.05×0.99=0.0585; P(ill|+)=0.009/0.0585≈15.4%, far below the intuitive 90%.
1. 分析师考察牛市与熊市情景下的组合收益。计算熊市情景下的期望收益时,最恰当的方法是使用:1. An analyst examines portfolio returns in bullish and bearish scenarios. To calculate the expected return in a bearish market scenario, the most appropriate approach is to use: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 乘法规则。the multiplication rule.
  • B. 条件期望值。conditional expected values.
  • C. 期望值的全概率规则。the total probability rule for expected value.
答案 B。算"某一情景(熊市)下"的期望收益,用条件期望值(conditional expected value)(给定情景发生)。全概率规则是把各情景加权汇总的"无条件"期望。Answer B. To compute expected return "given a scenario (bear market)," use the conditional expected value (given that scenario). The total-probability rule gives the unconditional expectation across scenarios.

§7 组合期望、方差与协方差§7 Portfolio Expected Value, Variance & Covariance 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: calculate the expected return and variance of a portfolio; calculate covariance and correlation。
组合期望:E(Rp) = Σ wi E(Ri)
两资产方差:σp2 = w12σ12 + w22σ22 + 2w1w2Cov1,2
相关系数:ρ1,2 = Cov1,2 / (σ1σ2)
符号Symbol含义Meaning
Cov1,2两资产回报的协方差 = ρ1,2σ1σ2Covariance of two assets' returns = ρ1,2σ1σ2
ρ1,2相关系数,∈[−1, +1];越低分散化越强Correlation coefficient, ∈[−1, +1]; the lower it is, the stronger the diversification
直觉Intuition协方差符号=正负同向;相关系数=标准化的协方差The sign of covariance = direction (same/opposite); correlation = standardized covariance
考点提示:组合方差公式与 Volume 9 组合管理完全一致——这里是它的"数学出处"。相关系数越低,组合方差越小,分散化收益越大。协方差单位难解读,故常用无量纲的相关系数比较。
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

组合期望、方差与协方差

• 期望: E(Rp) = Σ w_i·E(R_i)(权重加权,线性)。
• 方差(两资产): σp² = w1²σ1² + w2²σ2² + 2·w1·w2·ρ·σ1·σ2。交叉项含相关系数 ρ。

分散化的来源

只要 ρ < 1,组合标准差就小于加权平均标准差 → 风险被分散;ρ 越低,分散效果越强;ρ = −1 理论上可把风险降到 0。

易错对比

① 期望是线性加权、方差不是(有交叉项);② 别漏 2w1w2ρσ1σ2;③ 协方差 = ρ·σ1·σ2,ρ 越低分散越好。

Portfolio expected value, variance & covariance

• Expectation: E(Rp) = Σ w_i·E(R_i) (weighted, linear).
• Variance (two assets): σp² = w1²σ1² + w2²σ2² + 2·w1·w2·ρ·σ1·σ2. The cross term carries the correlation ρ.

Source of diversification

As long as ρ < 1, portfolio standard deviation is below the weighted-average standard deviation → risk diversifies; lower ρ means stronger diversification; ρ = −1 can, in theory, drive risk to 0.

Common traps

① Expectation is linear, variance is not (cross term); ② don't drop 2w1w2ρσ1σ2; ③ covariance = ρ·σ1·σ2, and lower ρ diversifies more.

19. n 个资产组合的期望回报为:The expected return of an n-asset portfolio is: 官方题Official

  • A. Σ E(Rᵢ)Σ E(Rᵢ)
  • B. Σ wᵢ² E(Rᵢ)Σ wᵢ² E(Rᵢ)
  • C. Σ wᵢ E(Rᵢ)Σ wᵢ E(Rᵢ)
答案 C。组合期望回报是各资产期望回报的权重加权和(线性)。Answer C. Portfolio expected return is the weight-weighted sum of asset expected returns (linear).

20. 两资产组合方差 σp² 的正确表达式是:The correct expression for the variance of a two-asset portfolio σp² is: 官方题Official

  • A. w₁²σ₁² + w₂²σ₂²w₁²σ₁² + w₂²σ₂²
  • B. w₁²σ₁² + w₂²σ₂² + 2w₁w₂Cov₁,₂w₁²σ₁² + w₂²σ₂² + 2w₁w₂Cov₁,₂
  • C. w₁σ₁ + w₂σ₂w₁σ₁ + w₂σ₂
答案 B。不能漏掉协方差项;A 仅在协方差=0 时成立。Answer B. You cannot omit the covariance term; A holds only when covariance = 0.

21. 相关系数 ρ 与协方差 Cov 的关系是:The relationship between the correlation coefficient ρ and the covariance Cov is: 官方题Official

  • A. ρ = Cov × σ₁σ₂ρ = Cov × σ₁σ₂
  • B. ρ = Cov / (σ₁ + σ₂)ρ = Cov / (σ₁ + σ₂)
  • C. ρ = Cov / (σ₁σ₂)ρ = Cov / (σ₁σ₂)
答案 C。相关系数是用两者标准差之积标准化后的协方差(无量纲)。Answer C. Correlation is the covariance standardized by the product of the two standard deviations (dimensionless).

22. 相关系数的取值范围是:The range of the correlation coefficient is: 官方题Official

  • A. 0 到 10 to 1
  • B. −1 到 +1−1 to +1
  • C. −∞ 到 +∞−∞ to +∞
答案 B。相关系数介于 −1(完全负相关)与 +1(完全正相关)之间。Answer B. Correlation lies between −1 (perfect negative) and +1 (perfect positive).

23. 相比协方差,更常用相关系数比较资产的共动关系,主要因为:Compared with covariance, the correlation coefficient is more commonly used to compare the co-movement of assets mainly because: 官方题Official

  • A. 协方差总为正Covariance is always positive
  • B. 相关系数总大于协方差Correlation is always larger than covariance
  • C. 相关系数无量纲、已标准化,便于跨资产比较It is dimensionless and standardized, making cross-asset comparison easy
答案 C。协方差带量纲、数值难解读;相关系数标准化到 [−1,1],直观可比。Answer C. Covariance carries units and is hard to interpret; correlation is standardized to [−1,1] and directly comparable.

24. 其他条件不变,两资产相关系数从 0.8 降到 0.2,组合方差将:All else equal, if the correlation between two assets falls from 0.8 to 0.2, the portfolio variance will: 补充Extra

  • A. 上升Rise
  • B. 下降,分散化收益增大Fall, with a greater diversification benefit
  • C. 保持不变Stay unchanged
答案 B。相关性下降使协方差项变小,组合方差降低、分散化效果增强。Answer B. Lower correlation shrinks the covariance term, lowering portfolio variance and increasing the diversification benefit.
1. 两变量之间的相关系数衡量:1. The correlation between two variables measures: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅二者的线性关系。only their linear relationship.
  • B. 仅二者的非线性关系。only their non-linear relationship.
  • C. 二者的线性与非线性关系。both their linear and non-linear relationships.
答案 A。相关系数只衡量两变量的"线性"关系。非线性关系可能相关系数为 0 却仍有关联。Answer A. The correlation coefficient measures only the linear relationship. A nonlinear relationship can have zero correlation yet still be related.
2. 分析师假设某公司未来 EPS 为 $2.00、$2.20 或 $2.40,三者等可能。该公司未来 EPS 的方差(单位 $²)最接近于:2. An analyst assumes a company's future EPS will be $2.00, $2.20, or $2.40, each equally likely. The variance (in $²) of the company's future EPS is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 0.030.03
  • B. 0.160.16
  • C. 0.200.20
答案 A。方法:方差 = Σ P(x)·(x − 均值)²。三值等概率(1/3),均值=2.20,方差=(0.2²+0²+0.2²)/3 ≈ 0.03。Answer A. Method: variance = Σ P(x)·(x − mean)². Three equally likely values (1/3), mean = 2.20, variance = (0.2²+0²+0.2²)/3 ≈ 0.03.

4. 树状图给出两情景下的每股股利。有利(概率 0.60):$2.00 概率 0.80、$1.50 概率 0.20;不利(概率 0.40):$0.75 概率 0.30、$0.50 概率 0.70。有利情景下的每股期望股利最接近于:4. A tree diagram gives the dividend per share under two scenarios. Favorable (prob 0.60): $2.00 with prob 0.80, $1.50 with prob 0.20. Unfavorable (prob 0.40): $0.75 with prob 0.30, $0.50 with prob 0.70. The expected dividend per share under the favorable scenario is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. $1.14$1.14
  • B. $1.37$1.37
  • C. $1.90$1.90
答案 C。方法:某情景下的条件期望 = Σ(该情景内各值 × 其条件概率)。有利情景:2.00×0.80 + 1.50×0.20 = $1.90(只用该情景内部的概率)。Answer C. Method: the conditional expectation within a scenario = Σ (value × conditional probability). Favorable: 2.00×0.80 + 1.50×0.20 = $1.90 (using only the probabilities within that scenario).

6. 分析师估计两证券收益的相关矩阵(证券1对证券2=1.0/0.5、0.5/1.0)。若各证券收益的标准差均为 9%,两证券间的协方差(单位 %²)最接近于:6. An analyst estimates a correlation matrix of two securities' returns (Security 1 vs Security 2 = 1.0/0.5, 0.5/1.0). If the standard deviation of returns of each security is 9%, the covariance (in units of % squared) between the two securities is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 20.320.3
  • B. 40.540.5

7. 若两资产收益完全正相关,则两资产组合收益的标准差:7. If the returns of two assets exhibit perfect positive correlation, the two-asset portfolio's standard deviation of returns is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 小于加权平均标准差。less than the weighted average standard deviation.
  • B. 等于加权平均标准差。equal to the weighted average standard deviation.
  • C. 大于加权平均标准差。greater than the weighted average standard deviation.
答案 B。完全正相关(ρ=+1)时,组合标准差 = 各资产标准差的加权平均(无分散化好处)。ρ<1 才使组合风险低于加权平均。Answer B. With perfect positive correlation (ρ=+1), the portfolio standard deviation equals the weighted average of the individual standard deviations (no diversification benefit). Only ρ<1 lowers portfolio risk below the weighted average.

§2 概率树与条件期望§2 Probability Trees & Conditional Expectations

LOS 对应：formulate an investment problem as a probability tree and explain conditional expectations。

概率树把多阶段问题拆成连续分支。每条完整路径的联合概率等于沿途条件概率相乘；所有终点路径概率之和必须等于 1。A probability tree breaks a multi-stage problem into successive branches. Each complete path's joint probability is the product of the conditional probabilities along it; the probabilities of all terminal paths must sum to 1.

P(A ∩ B) = P(A) × P(B | A)
E(X) = Σ 路径概率 × 路径结果
两阶段概率树

经济扩张概率 60%，衰退概率 40%。扩张时股票上涨概率 70%，衰退时上涨概率 20%。Probability of economic expansion 60%, recession 40%. Given expansion, the probability the stock rises is 70%; given recession, 20%.

  • P(扩张且上涨) = 0.60 × 0.70 = 0.42。P(expansion and rise) = 0.60 × 0.70 = 0.42.
  • P(衰退且上涨) = 0.40 × 0.20 = 0.08。P(recession and rise) = 0.40 × 0.20 = 0.08.
  • P(上涨) = 0.42 + 0.08 = 0.50。P(rise) = 0.42 + 0.08 = 0.50.
  • P(扩张 | 上涨) = 0.42 / 0.50 = 84%。P(expansion | rise) = 0.42 / 0.50 = 84%.

§1 随机变量与分布类型§1 Random Variables & Distribution Types

LOS 对应:LOS: describe probability distributions。

离散型(可数取值,如掷骰、违约次数)用概率质量函数;连续型(区间取值,如回报率)用概率密度函数。累积分布函数 CDF F(x)=P(X≤x)。均匀分布、二项分布是离散型;正态、对数正态是连续型。Discrete variables (countable values, e.g., dice rolls, number of defaults) use a probability mass function; continuous variables (interval values, e.g., return rates) use a probability density function. The cumulative distribution function CDF is F(x)=P(X≤x). The uniform and binomial are discrete; the normal and lognormal are continuous.

1. 关于离散型与连续型随机变量,最恰当的是:Regarding discrete vs continuous random variables, the most appropriate statement is: 官方题Official

  • A. 离散型取可数值(用概率质量函数 PMF);连续型在区间取值(用概率密度函数 PDF)A discrete variable takes countable values (PMF); a continuous variable takes values over an interval (PDF)
  • B. 离散型用 PDF,连续型用 PMFA discrete variable uses a PDF and a continuous variable uses a PMF
  • C. 两者都用概率密度函数Both use a probability density function
答案 A。离散→PMF,连续→PDF,连续型单点概率为 0。Answer A. Discrete → PMF, continuous → PDF; for a continuous variable the probability at a single point is 0.

2. 累积分布函数(CDF)的定义是:The cumulative distribution function (CDF) is defined as: 官方题Official

  • A. F(x) = P(X = x)F(x) = P(X = x)
  • B. F(x) = P(X > x)F(x) = P(X > x)
  • C. F(x) = P(X ≤ x)F(x) = P(X ≤ x)
答案 C。CDF 给出不超过 x 的累积概率。Answer C. The CDF gives the cumulative probability of not exceeding x.

§2 二项分布§2 The Binomial Distribution

LOS 对应:LOS: calculate probabilities using the binomial distribution。
P(X = x) = C(n, x) × px × (1 − p)n−x
均值 = n·p    方差 = n·p·(1 − p)
符号Symbol含义Meaning
n独立试验次数Number of independent trials
p每次"成功"概率(如上涨概率)Probability of 'success' each time (e.g., probability of a rise)
C(n,x)组合数 = n! / [x!(n−x)!]Number of combinations = n! / [x!(n−x)!]

3. 二项分布 B(n, p) 的均值与方差分别为:The mean and variance of a binomial distribution B(n, p) are, respectively: 官方题Official

  • A. np 与 np(1−p)np and np(1−p)
  • B. np 与 npnp and np
  • C. p 与 p(1−p)p and p(1−p)
答案 A。均值 = np,方差 = np(1−p)。Answer A. Mean = np, variance = np(1−p).

4. 二项分布适用于下列哪种情形:The binomial distribution applies to which situation: 官方题Official

  • A. n 次独立、成功概率恒为 p 的伯努利试验的成功次数The number of successes in n independent Bernoulli trials with a constant success probability p
  • B. 连续取值的资产价格A continuously valued asset price
  • C. 每次成功概率都变化的试验Trials whose success probability changes each time
答案 A。二项分布要求试验独立且 p 恒定。Answer A. The binomial requires independent trials with a fixed p.

5. n=10、p=0.5 的二项分布,其均值为:For a binomial distribution with n=10 and p=0.5, the mean is: 补充Extra

  • A. 2.52.5
  • B. 1010
