§3 正态分布与标准正态§3 Normal & Standard Normal Distributions 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: explain the normal distribution and standardize a random variable。
🔰 零基础讲解:钟形曲线与"距均值几个标准差"

正态分布🔔 正态分布是对称的钟形曲线,由均值和标准差两个参数完全决定。经验法则:约 68% 的数据落在 ±1 个标准差内,95% 在 ±2 个(精确 1.96),99% 在 ±2.58 个。把任意正态值减均值再除标准差,就得到"标准正态"z 值——衡量它离均值有几个标准差。:对称钟形,68-95-99 法则。Normal distribution🔔 The normal distribution is a symmetric bell curve, fully determined by two parameters — the mean and the standard deviation. Rule of thumb: about 68% of the data falls within ±1 SD, 95% within ±2 (precisely 1.96), and 99% within ±2.58. Subtract the mean from any normal value and divide by the SD to get the 'standard normal' z-value — how many SDs it is from the mean.: a symmetric bell shape, the 68-95-99 rule.

标准化 z = (x − μ) / σ
区间Interval覆盖概率Coverage probability
μ ± 1σ≈ 68%
μ ± 1.65σ≈ 90%(单尾 5%)≈ 90% (5% one-tailed)
μ ± 1.96σ≈ 95%
μ ± 2.58σ≈ 99%
考点提示:记牢临界 z 值:90%→1.65、95%→1.96、99%→2.58(双尾)。这些在置信区间和假设检验中反复使用。
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

正态与标准正态分布

正态分布由均值 μ 与标准差 σ 完全描述,对称、偏度 0、超额峰度 0。经验法则:±1σ≈68%、±2σ≈95%、±3σ≈99.7%。

标准化

用 Z = (X − μ) ÷ σ 把任意正态转成标准正态(μ=0,σ=1),再查表。常用临界值:1.645(单尾 95%)、1.96(双尾 95%)、2.33(单尾 99%)、2.58(双尾 99%)。

易错对比

① 正态只需 μ、σ 两参数;② 单尾与双尾临界值不同(1.645 vs 1.96);③ 标准化后才可查标准正态表。

Normal & standard normal distributions

A normal distribution is fully described by mean μ and standard deviation σ, is symmetric, skew 0, excess kurtosis 0. Rule of thumb: ±1σ≈68%, ±2σ≈95%, ±3σ≈99.7%.

Standardizing

Use Z = (X − μ) ÷ σ to convert any normal to standard normal (μ=0, σ=1), then read the table. Common critical values: 1.645 (one-tail 95%), 1.96 (two-tail 95%), 2.33 (one-tail 99%), 2.58 (two-tail 99%).

Common traps

① A normal needs only μ, σ; ② one-tail vs two-tail critical values differ (1.645 vs 1.96); ③ standardize before using the standard-normal table.

6. 正态分布完全由下列哪两个参数决定:A normal distribution is fully determined by which two parameters: 官方题Official

  • A. 均值 μ 与标准差 σThe mean μ and the standard deviation σ
  • B. 偏度与峰度Skewness and kurtosis
  • C. 最大值与最小值The maximum and minimum
答案 A。正态分布由 μ(位置)和 σ(离散度)唯一确定。Answer A. A normal distribution is uniquely defined by μ (location) and σ (dispersion).

7. 标准化 z 值的公式是:The formula for the standardized z-value is: 官方题Official

  • A. z = (x − μ) / σ²z = (x − μ) / σ²
  • B. z = (μ − x) / nz = (μ − x) / n
  • C. z = (x − μ) / σz = (x − μ) / σ
答案 C。z 衡量 x 距均值多少个标准差。Answer C. z measures how many standard deviations x is from the mean.

8. 正态分布中 μ±1σ、±1.96σ、±2.58σ 大致覆盖的概率为:In a normal distribution, μ±1σ, ±1.96σ, and ±2.58σ cover roughly what probabilities: 官方题Official

  • A. 约 50%、90%、95%about 50%, 90%, 95%
  • B. 约 90%、95%、99%about 90%, 95%, 99%
  • C. 约 68%、95%、99%about 68%, 95%, 99%
答案 C。经典"68–95–99"经验法则。Answer C. The classic 68–95–99 rule of thumb.

9. 95% 双尾置信对应的临界 z 值是:The critical z-value for a 95% two-tailed confidence level is: 官方题Official

  • A. 1.651.65
  • B. 1.961.96
  • C. 2.582.58
答案 B。1.65 为 90% 双尾(或 95% 单尾),2.58 为 99% 双尾。Answer B. 1.65 is 90% two-tailed (or 95% one-tailed); 2.58 is 99% two-tailed.

§4 对数正态分布§4 The Lognormal Distribution

LOS 对应:LOS: describe the lognormal distribution。

若某变量的自然对数服从正态分布,则该变量服从对数正态分布:恒为正、右偏。资产价格常用对数正态刻画(价格不为负、可无限上涨),而连续复合收益率用正态。连续复合收益 = ln(1 + HPR)。If a variable's natural log is normally distributed, the variable is lognormally distributed: always positive, right-skewed. Asset prices are often modeled as lognormal (prices are non-negative and can rise without limit), while continuously compounded returns use the normal. Continuously compounded return = ln(1 + HPR).

10. 常用对数正态分布刻画资产价格,主要因为:Lognormal distributions are often used to model asset prices mainly because: 官方题Official

  • A. 价格恒为正、右偏、可无限上涨,符合对数正态特征Prices are always positive, right-skewed, and can rise without limit, matching lognormal features
  • B. 价格可以为负Prices can be negative
  • C. 价格服从完全对称分布Prices follow a perfectly symmetric distribution
答案 A。对数正态下界为 0、右偏,契合价格不为负且上不封顶的特性。Answer A. A lognormal is bounded below by 0 and right-skewed, matching prices that cannot be negative and have no upper bound.

11. 连续复合收益率的计算式是:The formula for a continuously compounded return is: 官方题Official

  • A. e^HPR − 1e^HPR − 1
  • B. 1 + HPR1 + HPR
  • C. ln(1 + HPR)ln(1 + HPR)
答案 C。连续复合收益 = 持有期毛回报的自然对数。Answer C. The continuously compounded return is the natural log of the holding-period gross return.
1. 随机变量 Y=exp(X) 服从对数正态分布,其中 X 服从正态分布。Y 的分布:1. A random variable Y = exp(X) is lognormally distributed, where X is normally distributed. The distribution of Y: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 左偏。is skewed to the left.
  • B. 常用于对资产/股票价格建模。is often used to model stock prices.
  • C. 均值等于 exp(μ),μ 为 X 的均值。has a mean equal to exp(μ), where μ is the mean of X.
答案 B。对数正态分布(Y=exp(X))常用于给"资产/股票价格"建模(下界为0、右偏)。它右偏(非左偏),均值 ≠ exp(μ),故 A、C 错。Answer B. A lognormal distribution (Y=exp(X)) is commonly used to model asset/stock prices (bounded below by 0, right-skewed). It is right-skewed (not left) and its mean ≠ exp(μ), so A and C are wrong.
2. 对数正态分布:2. The lognormal distribution is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 负偏。negatively skewed.
  • B. 以 0 为下界。bounded below by zero.
  • C. 广泛用于给资产收益率建模。widely used for modeling the probability distribution of asset returns.
答案 B。对数正态分布以 0 为下界(适合价格,不会为负)。它正偏(右偏)而非负偏,且用于给价格(非收益率)建模,故 A、C 错。Answer B. A lognormal distribution is bounded below by 0 (suits prices, never negative). It is positively (right) skewed, and it models prices (not returns), so A and C are wrong.
3. 正态分布与对数正态分布都:3. Both the normal distribution and the lognormal distribution: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 是对称的。are symmetrical.
  • B. 都由两个参数完全刻画。are completely described by two parameters.
  • C. 取值范围为 −∞ 到 +∞ 的全体实数。have a range of possible outcomes that includes all real numbers between −∞ and +∞.
答案 B。正态与对数正态都由"两个参数"完全刻画(正态:μ、σ;对数正态由对应正态的 μ、σ 决定)。只有正态对称、取值全体实数,故 A、C 错。Answer B. Both the normal and lognormal are fully described by two parameters (normal: μ, σ; lognormal via the underlying normal's μ, σ). Only the normal is symmetric over all reals, so A and C are wrong.

§5 蒙特卡洛与自助法§5 Monte Carlo & the Bootstrap

LOS 对应:LOS: describe Monte Carlo simulation and bootstrapping。
方法Method做法Approach
蒙特卡洛模拟Monte Carlo simulation从假设的分布反复随机抽样,模拟大量情形,估计复杂问题(如期权定价、退休规划)的分布Repeatedly sample randomly from an assumed distribution, simulate many scenarios, and estimate the distribution of a complex problem (e.g., option pricing, retirement planning)
自助法 bootstrapBootstrap从实际观测样本中有放回地反复重抽样,估计统计量的抽样分布,无需假设分布形态Resample with replacement repeatedly from the actual observed sample to estimate a statistic's sampling distribution, with no assumption about the distribution's shape
区别:蒙特卡洛依赖预设分布假设;自助法直接从已有数据重抽样,不需分布假设。两者都用于难以解析求解的问题。

12. 蒙特卡洛模拟的核心做法是:The core method of Monte Carlo simulation is: 官方题Official

  • A. 从假设分布反复随机抽样,模拟大量情形以估计结果分布Repeatedly draw random samples from an assumed distribution to simulate many outcomes and estimate the result distribution
  • B. 从历史实际样本有放回重抽样Resample with replacement from the actual historical sample
  • C. 直接求闭式解析解Solve a closed-form analytic solution
答案 A。蒙特卡洛基于预设分布反复抽样;B 描述的是自助法。Answer A. Monte Carlo repeatedly samples from a model distribution; B describes the bootstrap.

13. 关于自助法(bootstrap)与蒙特卡洛模拟的区别,最恰当的是:Regarding the difference between the bootstrap and Monte Carlo simulation, the most appropriate statement is: 官方题Official

  • A. 两者都必须预设分布Both must assume a distribution
  • B. 自助法必须假设正态分布The bootstrap must assume normality
  • C. 自助法从实际样本有放回重抽样、不需分布假设;蒙特卡洛依赖预设分布The bootstrap resamples with replacement from the actual sample and needs no distribution assumption; Monte Carlo relies on an assumed distribution
答案 C。自助法是"用数据说话"的重抽样,蒙特卡洛依赖模型分布。Answer C. The bootstrap 'lets the data speak' via resampling, while Monte Carlo relies on a model distribution.
1. 自助法(Bootstrap)重抽样:1. Bootstrap resampling: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 反复进行无放回抽样。repeatedly draws samples without replacement.
  • B. 可用于估计总体中位数的标准误。can be used to estimate the standard error of a population median.
  • C. 依赖解析公式来估计估计量的分布。relies on an analytical formula to estimate the distribution of estimators.
答案 B。自助法(bootstrap)= "有放回"反复重抽样,可用来估计几乎任何统计量(如中位数)的标准误,不依赖解析公式。故 A(无放回)、C(靠公式)错。Answer B. The bootstrap resamples repeatedly "with replacement" and can estimate the standard error of almost any statistic (e.g., the median), without analytic formulas. So A (without replacement) and C (relies on formulas) are wrong.

§6 抽样与中心极限定理§6 Sampling & the Central Limit Theorem 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: explain the central limit theorem and its importance。
🔰 零基础讲解:样本均值的神奇规律

中心极限定理✨ 不管原始总体是什么形状(哪怕很歪),只要样本量足够大(通常 n≥30),"样本均值"的分布就近似正态,且以真实均值为中心。这让我们能用正态方法对未知总体做推断——是整个统计推断的基石。:样本量够大时,样本均值近似正态。Central limit theorem✨ Regardless of the original population's shape (even a very skewed one), as long as the sample is large enough (usually n≥30), the distribution of the 'sample mean' is approximately normal and centered on the true mean. This lets us use normal methods to make inferences about an unknown population — the cornerstone of all statistical inference.: when the sample is large enough, the sample mean is approximately normal.

样本均值的标准误 SE = σ / √n(σ 未知时用样本 s)
要点Key point含义Meaning
CLT 条件CLT condition样本量足够大(经验 n ≥ 30)The sample is large enough (rule of thumb n ≥ 30)
结论Conclusion样本均值分布 → 正态,均值=总体均值,标准差=SEDistribution of the sample mean → normal, mean = population mean, SD = SE
SE 随 nSE with n样本越大,标准误越小,估计越精确The larger the sample, the smaller the standard error and the more precise the estimate
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

抽样与中心极限定理(CLT)

CLT:无论总体分布如何,当样本量 n 足够大(经验 n ≥ 30),样本均值的抽样分布近似正态,其均值 = 总体均值,标准差 = 标准误 = σ ÷ √n。

意义

这让我们即使不知道总体分布,也能对均值做正态区间估计与假设检验。n 越大,标准误越小,估计越精确。

易错对比

① CLT 描述的是样本均值的分布,不是原始数据;② 标准误 = σ/√n(随 n 增大而缩小);③ n≥30 时可用正态近似(即便总体偏态)。

Sampling & the central limit theorem (CLT)

CLT: whatever the population distribution, for a large enough sample (rule n ≥ 30) the sampling distribution of the sample mean is approximately normal, with mean = population mean and standard deviation = the standard error = σ ÷ √n.

Significance

This lets us build normal interval estimates and hypothesis tests for the mean even without knowing the population distribution. Larger n → smaller standard error → more precise estimates.

Common traps

① CLT is about the sample mean's distribution, not the raw data; ② SE = σ/√n (shrinks as n grows); ③ n≥30 allows a normal approximation even for a skewed population.

14. 中心极限定理(CLT)表明:The central limit theorem (CLT) states that: 官方题Official

  • A. 总体一定服从正态分布The population must be normally distributed
  • B. 样本越大方差越大The larger the sample, the larger the variance
  • C. 样本量足够大时,样本均值的分布近似正态,不论总体分布形状For a large enough sample, the distribution of the sample mean is approximately normal, regardless of the population's shape
答案 C。CLT 针对样本均值的抽样分布,而非总体本身。Answer C. The CLT concerns the sampling distribution of the sample mean, not the population itself.

15. CLT 经验上通常要求的样本量为:The sample size the CLT typically requires (rule of thumb) is: 官方题Official

  • A. n ≥ 5n ≥ 5
  • B. n ≥ 30n ≥ 30
  • C. n ≥ 100n ≥ 100
答案 B。n ≥ 30 是常用经验阈值。Answer B. n ≥ 30 is the common threshold.
1. 中心极限定理最恰当地表述为:对大样本,样本均值的抽样分布近似正态,条件是:1. The central limit theorem is best described as stating that the sampling distribution of the sample mean will be approximately normal for large-size samples: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 总体分布为正态。if the population distribution is normal.
  • B. 总体分布对称。if the population distribution is symmetrical.
  • C. 对由任意概率分布刻画的总体均成立。for populations described by any probability distribution.
答案 C。中心极限定理(CLT):对足够大的样本,样本均值的抽样分布近似正态——无论总体本身是什么分布。这正是 CLT 的威力,故选 C。Answer C. The central limit theorem: for a large enough sample, the sampling distribution of the sample mean is approximately normal regardless of the population distribution. That universality is the point, so C.
2. 一个统计量的抽样分布必须由满足下列条件的样本构成:2. The sampling distribution of a statistic must be constructed from samples that are: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 大样本。large.
  • B. 相同样本量。of the same size.
  • C. 来自同一层。from the same stratum.
答案 B。抽样分布必须由"相同样本量 n"的样本构成(改变 n 会改变该分布)。不必是大样本,也不必来自同一层。Answer B. A sampling distribution must be built from samples of the same size n (changing n changes the distribution). It need not be large or from the same stratum.
3. 某总体服从标准差为 50 的对数正态分布,抽取样本量为 100 的样本。样本均值的抽样分布最可能:3. A population has a lognormal distribution with a standard deviation of 50. Samples of size 100 are drawn. The sampling distribution of the sample mean is most likely: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 右偏,标准差为 50。skewed to the right with a standard deviation of 50.
  • B. 近似对称,标准差为 5。approximately symmetric with a standard deviation of 5.
  • C. 近似对称,标准差为 0.5。approximately symmetric with a standard deviation of 0.5.
答案 B。由 CLT,样本均值抽样分布近似对称(正态),标准误 = σ/√n = 50/√100 = 5。即使总体对数正态右偏,均值分布仍趋正态。故 B。Answer B. By the CLT, the sampling distribution of the mean is approximately symmetric (normal) with standard error = σ/√n = 50/√100 = 5. Even though the population is right-skewed lognormal, the mean's distribution tends to normal. Hence B.

§7 标准误与置信区间§7 Standard Error & Confidence Intervals 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: calculate and interpret a confidence interval for a population mean。
置信区间 = 点估计 ± (可靠性因子 × 标准误) = x̄ ± zα/2 × (s / √n)
要素Element含义Meaning
点估计Point estimate样本均值 x̄Sample mean x̄
可靠性因子Reliability factorσ 已知/大样本用 z(90%→1.65,95%→1.96,99%→2.58);σ 未知小样本用 tσ known/large sample uses z (90%→1.65, 95%→1.96, 99%→2.58); σ unknown small sample uses t
标准误Standard errors/√n
置信区间 官方题Official

样本均值 8%、样本标准差 s=12%、n=36,求 95% 置信区间。SE = 12%/√36 = 12%/6 = 2%。区间 = 8% ± 1.96×2% = 8% ± 3.92% = [4.08%, 11.92%]。Sample mean 8%, sample SD s=12%, n=36; find the 95% confidence interval. SE = 12%/√36 = 12%/6 = 2%. Interval = 8% ± 1.96×2% = 8% ± 3.92% = [4.08%, 11.92%].

考点提示:
① 用 z 还是 t:总体方差已知或大样本 → z;方差未知且小样本 → t(t 分布尾更肥、区间更宽)。
② 置信水平越高,区间越宽;样本越大,区间越窄。
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

标准误与置信区间

置信区间 = 点估计 ± 临界值 × 标准误。总体方差已知用 z;未知(常见)用 t 分布,自由度 = n − 1。z 常用值:90%→1.645、95%→1.96、99%→2.58。

机制

置信水平越高 → 临界值越大 → 区间越宽;样本量 n 越大 → 标准误越小 → 区间越窄。t 分布比 z 尾部更厚,小样本下区间更宽,随 n 增大趋近 z。

易错对比

① σ 未知 + 小样本 → 用 t(自由度 n−1);② 提高置信水平使区间变宽、增大 n 使其变窄;③ 别把 z 与 t 临界值混用。

Standard error & confidence intervals

CI = point estimate ± critical value × standard error. Known population variance uses z; unknown (usual) uses the t distribution, df = n − 1. Common z: 90%→1.645, 95%→1.96, 99%→2.58.

Mechanism

Higher confidence → larger critical value → wider interval; larger n → smaller SE → narrower interval. The t distribution has fatter tails than z, giving wider intervals in small samples, approaching z as n grows.

Common traps

① σ unknown + small sample → use t (df n−1); ② raising confidence widens the interval, larger n narrows it; ③ don't mix z and t critical values.

16. 样本均值标准误(SE)的公式是:The formula for the standard error (SE) of the sample mean is: 官方题Official

  • A. σ / nσ / n
  • B. σ × √nσ × √n
  • C. σ / √nσ / √n
答案 C。σ 未知时用样本标准差 s 代替。Answer C. When σ is unknown, use the sample standard deviation s.

17. 样本量增大对标准误与估计精度的影响是:The effect of increasing the sample size on the standard error and estimation precision is: 官方题Official

  • A. 标准误变大,精度下降The standard error rises and precision falls
  • B. 标准误变小,估计更精确The standard error falls and estimation becomes more precise
  • C. 无影响No effect
答案 B。SE = σ/√n,n↑ 则 SE↓,估计更精确。Answer B. SE = σ/√n; as n rises, SE falls and estimates become more precise.

18. 置信区间的一般形式是:The general form of a confidence interval is: 官方题Official

  • A. 点估计 ±(标准误 / 可靠性因子)point estimate ± (standard error / reliability factor)
  • B. 点估计 × 可靠性因子point estimate × reliability factor
  • C. 点估计 ±(可靠性因子 × 标准误)point estimate ± (reliability factor × standard error)
答案 C。区间宽度 = 可靠性因子(z 或 t)乘以标准误。Answer C. The width equals the reliability factor (z or t) times the standard error.

19. 样本均值 8%、s=12%、n=36,95% 置信区间最接近:Sample mean 8%, s=12%, n=36; the 95% confidence interval is closest to: 官方题Official

  • A. [6.00%, 10.00%][6.00%, 10.00%]
  • B. [−3.6%, 19.6%][−3.6%, 19.6%]
  • C. [4.08%, 11.92%][4.08%, 11.92%]
答案 C。SE=12%/√36=2%;8% ± 1.96×2% = [4.08%, 11.92%]。Answer C. SE=12%/√36=2%; 8% ± 1.96×2% = [4.08%, 11.92%].

20. 应使用 t 分布(而非 z)的情形是:You should use the t-distribution (rather than z) when: 官方题Official

  • A. 总体方差已知且样本很大The population variance is known and the sample is large
  • B. 总体方差未知且样本较小(正态总体)The population variance is unknown and the sample is small (normal population)
  • C. 总体服从二项分布The population follows a binomial distribution
答案 B。t 分布尾部更肥、区间更宽,适用于小样本且方差未知。Answer B. The t-distribution has fatter tails and wider intervals, suited to small samples with unknown variance.

21. 置信水平从 95% 提高到 99%,置信区间将:Raising the confidence level from 95% to 99% makes the confidence interval: 官方题Official

  • A. 变宽Wider
  • B. 变窄Narrower
  • C. 不变Unchanged
答案 A。更高置信度需要更大的可靠性因子,区间随之变宽。Answer A. A higher confidence level needs a larger reliability factor, so the interval widens.

22. 随自由度增大,t 分布将趋近于:As the degrees of freedom increase, the t-distribution approaches: 补充Extra

  • A. 二项分布The binomial distribution
  • B. 均匀分布The uniform distribution
  • C. 标准正态分布The standard normal distribution
答案 C。自由度越大 t 尾越薄,极限为标准正态。Answer C. Higher degrees of freedom give thinner t-tails, with the standard normal as the limit.
1. 分析师收集某股指信息:所有公司净利润均值=$2.4 百万;净利润标准差=$3.2 百万。若抽取 36 家公司的样本,则样本均值的标准误最接近于:1. An analyst gathers the following about a stock index: mean net income for all companies = $2.4 million; standard deviation of net income for all companies = $3.2 million. If the analyst takes a sample of 36 companies, the standard error of the sample mean is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. $88,889$88,889
  • B. $400,000$400,000
  • C. $533,333$533,333
答案 C。标准误 = σ/√n = 3,200,000/√36 = 3,200,000/6 ≈ $533,333。样本越大标准误越小。Answer C. Standard error = σ/√n = 3,200,000/√36 = 3,200,000/6 ≈ $533,333. A larger sample gives a smaller standard error.

§3 Shortfall Risk 与 Roy 安全第一准则§3 Shortfall Risk & Roy's Safety-First Criterion 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应：define shortfall risk, calculate the safety-first ratio, and identify an optimal portfolio。

Shortfall Risk 是收益低于最低可接受收益率 RL 的概率。Roy 安全第一准则选择安全第一比率最高的组合。Shortfall risk is the probability that the return falls below the minimum acceptable return RL. Roy's safety-first criterion picks the portfolio with the highest safety-first ratio.

SFRatio = [E(Rp) − RL] / σp
符号Symbol含义Meaning
E(Rp)组合期望收益率Portfolio expected return
RL最低可接受收益率Minimum acceptable return
σp组合收益标准差Standard deviation of portfolio return
例题

最低可接受收益为 2%。A 组合 E(R)=8%、σ=10%，安全第一比率为 0.60；B 组合 E(R)=10%、σ=16%，比率为 0.50。因此选择 A。The minimum acceptable return is 2%. Portfolio A: E(R)=8%, σ=10%, safety-first ratio 0.60; Portfolio B: E(R)=10%, σ=16%, ratio 0.50. So choose A.

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

Shortfall Risk 与 Roy 安全第一

Shortfall risk:回报低于某最低可接受水平 R_L 的概率。Roy 安全第一准则:在候选组合中选使 SFRatio = (E(Rp) − R_L) ÷ σp 最大者——它最小化「跌破 R_L」的概率。

与夏普比的关系

当阈值 R_L = 无风险利率 时,SFRatio 就退化为夏普比率。若回报近似正态,可用 Z =(R_L − E(Rp))/σp 求 shortfall 概率。

易错对比

① 选 SFRatio 最大的组合(不是回报最高);② R_L 是最低可接受回报阈值;③ R_L = rf 时 SFRatio = 夏普比。

Shortfall risk & Roy's safety-first

Shortfall risk: the probability of a return below a minimum acceptable level R_L. Roy's safety-first criterion: pick the candidate that maximizes SFRatio = (E(Rp) − R_L) ÷ σp — it minimizes the chance of falling below R_L.

Relation to Sharpe

When the threshold R_L = the risk-free rate, SFRatio reduces to the Sharpe ratio. If returns are approximately normal, get the shortfall probability from Z = (R_L − E(Rp))/σp.

Common traps

① Choose the highest SFRatio portfolio (not the highest return); ② R_L is the minimum acceptable return threshold; ③ with R_L = rf, SFRatio = Sharpe.

3. Roy 安全第一准则(SFRatio)选择组合的规则是:Roy's safety-first criterion (SFRatio) selects a portfolio by:

  • A. 选 σp 最小的组合Choosing the portfolio with the smallest σp
  • B. 选 E(Rp) 最高的组合Choosing the portfolio with the highest E(Rp)
  • C. 选 [E(Rp)−RL]/σp 最高的组合Choosing the portfolio with the highest [E(Rp)−R_L]/σp
答案 C。SFRatio 越大,回报低于最低可接受水平 RL 的概率越小。Answer C. The higher the SFRatio, the lower the probability of returns falling below the minimum acceptable level R_L.
1. 若某组合的安全第一(Roy)比率与变异系数都等于 1.2,则该组合的收益门槛(最低要求收益)是:1. If a portfolio's safety-first (Roy's) ratio and coefficient of variation both equal 1.2, the portfolio's return threshold is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 负值。negative.
  • B. 零。zero.
  • C. 正值。positive.
答案 A。Roy 安全第一比率 SFRatio =(E(R) − R_L)/σ;变异系数 CV = σ/E(R)。若两者都=1.2,联立可解出门槛 R_L 为负值(收益门槛低于0)。Answer A. Roy's safety-first ratio = (E(R) − R_L)/σ; CV = σ/E(R). If both equal 1.2, solving the pair gives a negative threshold R_L (the minimum required return is below zero).

§4 抽样方法与重抽样§4 Sampling Methods & Resampling

LOS 对应：compare random, stratified, cluster, convenience, and judgmental sampling; describe bootstrap and jackknife。
方法Method做法Approach优点与风险Pros & risks
简单随机Simple random每个个体有相同被抽中概率Every individual has the same probability of selection理论清晰；需要完整抽样框Theoretically clean; requires a complete sampling frame
分层随机Stratified random先分层，再从每层随机抽样Stratify first, then sample randomly from each stratum保证小群体被代表，常降低误差Ensures small subgroups are represented, often lowering error
整群抽样Cluster sampling随机抽取若干完整群Randomly draw several whole clusters成本低；群内相似时误差较大Low cost; larger error when clusters are internally similar
便利抽样Convenience sampling选择最容易取得的观察值Pick the most easily obtained observations快速；选择偏差明显Fast; obvious selection bias
判断抽样Judgmental sampling凭专业判断选择样本Select the sample by professional judgment适合特定研究；主观且难推广Suited to specific studies; subjective and hard to generalize

Bootstrap 从原样本中有放回地反复抽取同样大小的样本；Jackknife 每次删除一个观察值后重算统计量。二者均可估计抽样分布、标准误和偏差。Bootstrap repeatedly draws same-size samples with replacement from the original sample; jackknife recomputes the statistic after deleting one observation each time. Both can estimate the sampling distribution, standard error, and bias.

4. 分层抽样与整群抽样的关键区别是:The key difference between stratified sampling and cluster sampling is:

  • A. 两者完全相同They are identical
  • B. 分层抽样从每层各抽一部分;整群抽样抽取若干完整的群Stratified sampling draws a portion from every stratum; cluster sampling takes several entire clusters
  • C. 分层抽样抽完整群,整群抽样每层各抽一部分Stratified sampling takes whole clusters and cluster sampling draws from every stratum
答案 B。分层是"每层都抽",整群是"抽中的群全取"。Answer B. Stratified = 'sample from every stratum'; cluster = 'take the whole of the chosen clusters'.
1. 研究者通过在三个随机选定的城市中各随机访谈十名消费者来衡量消费者信心。该方法属于:1. A researcher wants to measure consumer confidence by interviewing a simple random sample of ten consumers from three randomly selected cities. This method is an example of: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 整群抽样cluster sampling
  • B. 系统抽样systematic sampling
  • C. 分层随机抽样stratified random sampling
答案 A。随机选几个"群(城市)"、再对选中群内的个体全部/随机访谈 = 整群抽样(cluster sampling)。分层是先分层再各层内抽;系统是等间隔抽。Answer A. Randomly selecting a few "clusters (cities)" and sampling individuals within them = cluster sampling. Stratified samples within predefined strata; systematic picks at fixed intervals.
2. 分析师研究全球共同基金的夏普比率时,仅使用覆盖 12 只基金的标准内部数据库。该抽样方法最恰当地被描述为:2. An analyst studying Sharpe ratios of mutual funds globally uses only the data from the standard internal database, which covers 12 mutual funds. This sampling method is best described as: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 整群抽样。cluster sampling.
  • B. 判断抽样。judgmental sampling.
  • C. 便利抽样。convenience sampling.
答案 C。只用"手头现成"的内部数据库(仅覆盖12只)= 便利抽样(convenience sampling)——图省事、非随机,易有偏。判断抽样是靠专家主观选。Answer C. Using only a "readily available" internal database (covering just 12 funds) = convenience sampling — easy but non-random and prone to bias. Judgmental sampling relies on expert selection.

§1 假设检验的流程§1 The Hypothesis-Testing Procedure 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: explain the process of hypothesis testing。
🔰 零基础讲解:先假设"没效果",再看数据能否推翻

假设检验⚖️ 像法庭审判:先假定"无罪"(原假设=没有效应/差异),除非证据(数据)强到足以"排除合理怀疑",才推翻它、接受"有罪"(备择假设)。我们检验的是能否拒绝原假设,而不是"证明"备择假设。:设原假设 H₀、备择 Ha,用数据决定是否拒绝 H₀。Hypothesis testing⚖️ Like a courtroom trial: presume 'not guilty' first (the null = no effect/difference), and only overturn it and accept 'guilty' (the alternative) if the evidence (data) is strong enough to be 'beyond reasonable doubt.' We test whether we can reject the null, not 'prove' the alternative.: set the null H₀ and alternative Ha, and use the data to decide whether to reject H₀.

步骤Step做什么What to do
1. 提出假设1. State the hypotheses原假设 H₀(通常含等号,如"=")与备择 HaThe null H₀ (usually with an equality, e.g., '=') and the alternative Ha
2. 选显著性水平 α2. Choose the significance level α如 5%;犯第一类错误的容忍度E.g., 5%; the tolerance for a Type I error
3. 计算检验统计量3. Compute the test statistic如 t 或 zE.g., t or z
4. 定临界值/决策规则4. Set the critical value / decision rule确定拒绝域Determine the rejection region
5. 决策5. Decide统计量落入拒绝域(或 p<α)则拒绝 H₀If the statistic falls in the rejection region (or p<α), reject H₀

1. 假设检验的正确步骤顺序是:The correct order of the hypothesis-testing steps is: 官方题Official

  • A. 先决策 → 再提出假设Decide first → then state the hypotheses
  • B. 先算 p 值 → 再提出 H₀Compute the p-value first → then state H₀
  • C. 提出 H₀/Ha → 选 α → 算检验统计量 → 定决策规则 → 决策State H₀/Ha → choose α → compute the test statistic → set the decision rule → decide
答案 C。先立假设、定标准,再计算、判定。Answer C. Set up hypotheses and standards first, then compute and decide.

2. 关于原假设 H₀,最恰当的是:Regarding the null hypothesis H₀, the most appropriate statement is: 官方题Official

  • A. 通常含严格不等号,不含等号It usually contains a strict inequality with no equality
  • B. H₀ 就是研究者想证明的命题H₀ is the proposition the researcher wants to prove
  • C. 通常含等号(=、≤、≥),备择假设才是想证明的It usually contains an equality (=, ≤, ≥), while the alternative is what you want to prove
答案 C。H₀ 含等号并被"试图推翻",Ha 承载研究主张。Answer C. H₀ carries the equality and is 'tested to be rejected'; Ha carries the research claim.

§2 两类错误与显著性§2 The Two Error Types & Significance 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: identify the two types of errors and the power of a test。
错误Error含义Meaning
第一类错误 Type IType I errorH₀ 为真却错误拒绝(误报);概率 = 显著性水平 αH₀ is true but is wrongly rejected (false positive); probability = significance level α
第二类错误 Type IIType II errorH₀ 为假却未能拒绝(漏报);概率 = βH₀ is false but is not rejected (false negative); probability = β
检验功效 powerPower of the test= 1 − β,正确拒绝错误 H₀ 的能力= 1 − β, the ability to correctly reject a false H₀
考点提示:
① α = 第一类错误概率(设定的显著性水平)。
② 降低 α 会增大 β(此消彼长);增大样本量可同时改善两者/提高功效。
③ p 值 = 恰好能拒绝 H₀ 的最小显著性水平;p < α 则拒绝 H₀。
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

两类错误与显著性

• 第一类错误(Type I):H0 为真却拒绝它。犯错概率 = 显著性水平 α。
• 第二类错误(Type II):H0 为假却未拒绝。概率 = β。
• 检验功效(power)= 1 − β,即正确拒绝假 H0 的能力。

权衡

其他不变时,降低 α 会升高 β(更难拒绝 → 漏检更多)。要同时改善两者,唯有增大样本量(缩小标准误)。

易错对比

① α = Type I 概率(弃真);② power = 1 − β;③ 减小 α 与减小 β 此消彼长,增大 n 才能双赢。

The two error types & significance

• Type I error: rejecting a true H0. Its probability = the significance level α.
• Type II error: failing to reject a false H0. Probability = β.
• Power = 1 − β, the ability to correctly reject a false H0.

Trade-off

Holding else equal, lowering α raises β (harder to reject → more misses). To improve both, increase the sample size (shrinks the standard error).

Common traps

① α = Type I probability (false rejection); ② power = 1 − β; ③ smaller α vs smaller β is a trade-off — only larger n improves both.

3. 第一类错误(Type I)及其概率是:A Type I error and its probability are: 官方题Official

  • A. H₀ 为真却拒绝(误报),概率 = αRejecting a true H₀ (false positive), probability = α
  • B. H₀ 为假却未拒绝,概率 = βFailing to reject a false H₀, probability = β
  • C. H₀ 为真且未拒绝,概率 = 1−αNot rejecting a true H₀, probability = 1−α
答案 A。弃真为第一类错误,概率等于显著性水平 α。Answer A. Rejecting a true null is a Type I error, with probability equal to the significance level α.

4. 第二类错误(Type II)是:A Type II error is: 官方题Official

  • A. H₀ 为真却拒绝Rejecting a true H₀
  • B. H₀ 为假却未能拒绝(漏报),概率 = βFailing to reject a false H₀ (false negative), probability = β
  • C. 正确拒绝错误的 H₀Correctly rejecting a false H₀
答案 B。存伪为第二类错误,概率为 β。Answer B. Accepting a false null is a Type II error, with probability β.

5. 检验功效(power)的定义是:The power of a test is defined as: 官方题Official

  • A. α + βα + β
  • B. 1 − β,正确拒绝错误 H₀ 的概率1 − β, the probability of correctly rejecting a false H₀
  • C. 1 − α1 − α
答案 B。功效 = 1 − β,即"存伪"之外正确识别的能力。Answer B. Power = 1 − β, the ability to correctly detect a false null.

6. 其他条件不变,降低 α 对 β 的影响、以及同时改善两者的方法是:All else equal, the effect of lowering α on β, and how to improve both, is: 官方题Official

  • A. 降低 α 也会降低 βLowering α also lowers β
  • B. 只能靠降低置信水平改善Only lowering the confidence level improves them
  • C. 降低 α 会增大 β;增大样本量可同时改善、提高功效Lowering α raises β; increasing the sample size can improve both and raise power
答案 C。α 与 β 此消彼长;唯有加大样本量才能同时压低两者。Answer C. α and β trade off; only a larger sample can reduce both at once.
1. 在假设检验中,检验的功效(power)最恰当地被描述为:1. When testing a hypothesis, the power of a test is best described as the: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 与检验的显著性水平相同。same as the level of significance of the test.
  • B. 拒绝一个为真的原假设的概率。probability of rejecting a true null hypothesis.
  • C. 正确拒绝(实为假的)原假设的概率。probability of correctly rejecting the null hypothesis.
答案 C。检验功效(power)= 正确拒绝"实为假"的原假设的概率 = 1 − β(β 是第二类错误)。拒绝"为真"的原假设是第一类错误(α),故 B 错。Answer C. The power of a test = the probability of correctly rejecting a false null = 1 − β (β is the type II error). Rejecting a true null is the type I error (α), so B is wrong.
2. 在其他条件不变时,若分析师为假设检验设定更小的显著性水平,则第二类错误的概率:2. All else being equal, if an analyst specifies a smaller significance level for a hypothesis test, the probability of a Type II error: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 下降。decreases.
  • B. 保持不变。remains the same.
  • C. 上升。increases.
答案 C。显著性水平 α 变小 → 更难拒绝原假设 → 第二类错误概率 β 上升(α 与 β 此消彼长)。Answer C. A smaller significance level α → harder to reject the null → the type II error probability β rises (α and β trade off).

§3 检验统计量、临界值与 p 值§3 Test Statistic, Critical Value & p-Value

LOS 对应:LOS: calculate a test statistic and interpret the p-value。
检验统计量(均值)= (样本统计量 − 假设值) / 标准误 = (x̄ − μ0) / (s / √n)
概念Concept含义Meaning
单尾 vs 双尾One-tailed vs two-tailedHa 含 > 或 < 用单尾;含 ≠ 用双尾Ha with > or < uses one-tailed; with ≠ uses two-tailed
临界值Critical value由 α 和分布决定拒绝域边界The rejection-region boundary set by α and the distribution
p 值p-valueH₀ 为真时得到该样本结果(或更极端)的概率;p<α → 拒绝The probability, if H₀ is true, of this sample result (or more extreme); p<α → reject

7. p 值的含义是:The meaning of the p-value is: 官方题Official

  • A. 犯第二类错误的概率The probability of a Type II error
  • B. H₀ 为真时得到该结果或更极端结果的概率,亦即恰能拒绝 H₀ 的最小显著性水平The probability, if H₀ is true, of obtaining this or a more extreme result — i.e., the smallest significance level at which H₀ can just be rejected
  • C. H₀ 为真的概率The probability that H₀ is true
答案 B。p 值不是"H₀ 为真的概率",而是在 H₀ 下观测到当前或更极端数据的概率。Answer B. The p-value is NOT 'the probability H₀ is true'; it is the probability of the observed or more extreme data under H₀.

8. 用 p 值决策的规则是:The rule for deciding with a p-value is: 官方题Official

  • A. p > α 则拒绝 H₀Reject H₀ if p > α
  • B. p = 0.5 则拒绝 H₀Reject H₀ if p = 0.5
  • C. p < α 则拒绝 H₀Reject H₀ if p < α
答案 C。p 值越小,证据越强;小于 α 即拒绝 H₀。Answer C. The smaller the p-value, the stronger the evidence; reject H₀ when it is below α.

9. 单样本均值检验统计量的公式是:The test statistic for a single-sample mean test is: 官方题Official

  • A. (x̄ − μ₀) × √n(x̄ − μ₀) × √n
  • B. (x̄ − μ₀) / (s/√n)(x̄ − μ₀) / (s/√n)
  • C. (x̄ − μ₀) / s(x̄ − μ₀) / s
答案 B。分母为标准误 s/√n。Answer B. The denominator is the standard error s/√n.

§4 常见检验:均值的 t/z 检验§4 Common Tests: t/z Tests of the Mean

LOS 对应:LOS: identify the appropriate test statistic for hypotheses about means。
情形Situation用哪种Which to use
总体方差已知(或大样本)Population variance known (or large sample)z 检验z-test
总体方差未知、样本小、总体近似正态Population variance unknown, small sample, population approximately normalt 检验(自由度 n−1)t-test (degrees of freedom n−1)
两组均值差异Difference between two group meanst 检验(独立样本或配对)t-test (independent samples or paired)
方差检验Variance test卡方(单方差)、F 检验(两方差比)Chi-square (single variance), F-test (ratio of two variances)
均值检验 官方题Official

检验平均回报是否 ≠ 0。样本均值 8%、s=12%、n=36。t = (8%−0)/(12%/6) = 8%/2% = 4.0。自由度 35、双尾 5% 临界 t≈2.03。4.0 > 2.03 → 拒绝 H₀,平均回报显著不为 0。Test whether the mean return ≠ 0. Sample mean 8%, s=12%, n=36. t = (8%−0)/(12%/6) = 8%/2% = 4.0. With 35 df, the two-tailed 5% critical t≈2.03. 4.0 > 2.03 → reject H₀; the mean return is significantly non-zero.

10. 关于单尾与双尾检验的选择,最恰当的是:Regarding the choice of a one-tailed vs two-tailed test, the most appropriate statement is: 官方题Official

  • A. 一律使用双尾Always use two-tailed
  • B. 样本大用单尾、样本小用双尾Use one-tailed for large samples and two-tailed for small samples
  • C. Ha 含方向(> 或 <)用单尾;Ha 为 ≠ 用双尾Use one-tailed when Ha has a direction (> or <); use two-tailed when Ha is ≠
答案 C。尾数由备择假设的方向性决定。Answer C. The number of tails is set by the directionality of the alternative hypothesis.

11. 均值检验中使用 t 检验(而非 z)的情形是:In a mean test, you use a t-test (rather than z) when: 官方题Official

  • A. 数据为分类变量The data are categorical
  • B. 方差未知且小样本(正态总体)The variance is unknown and the sample is small (normal population)
  • C. 方差已知且大样本The variance is known and the sample is large
答案 B。方差已知或大样本用 z;方差未知小样本用 t。Answer B. Use z when variance is known or the sample is large; use t when variance is unknown and the sample is small.

12. 样本均值 8%、s=12%、n=36,检验 μ=0 的 t 值为:Sample mean 8%, s=12%, n=36; the t-value for testing μ=0 is: 官方题Official

  • A. 0.670.67
  • B. 2.02.0
  • C. 4.04.0
答案 C。t = 8% / (12%/√36) = 8%/2% = 4.0,远超临界值,拒绝 H₀。Answer C. t = 8% / (12%/√36) = 8%/2% = 4.0, far above the critical value, so reject H₀.
1. 分析师欲用相依样本检验两个正态总体的均值之差。若总体方差未知,则最恰当的检验是:1. An analyst wants to test the mean difference between two normally distributed populations using dependent samples. If the population variances are unknown, the most appropriate hypothesis test is a: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 卡方检验。chi-square test.
  • B. 配对比较 t 检验。paired comparisons t-test.
  • C. 使用合并方差估计量的 t 检验。t-test with a pooled estimator of the common variance.
答案 B。相依(配对)样本、方差未知,检验均值之差 → 配对比较 t 检验(paired t-test)。合并方差 t 检验用于"独立"样本;卡方用于方差/独立性。Answer B. For dependent (paired) samples with unknown variance, testing the mean difference → the paired comparisons t-test. The pooled-variance t-test is for independent samples; chi-square is for variance/independence.
2. 分析师收集某薪资随机样本:样本量=64;样本均值=$32,000;样本标准差=$12,000。检验总体均值薪资大于 $11,000 的假设时,恰当的检验统计量最接近于:2. An analyst gathers the following about a random sample of salaries: sample size = 64; sample mean = $32,000; sample standard deviation = $12,000. To test the hypothesis that the mean salary of the underlying population is greater than $11,000, the appropriate test statistic is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 1.81.8
  • B. 14.014.0
  • C. 21.321.3
答案 B。方法:t =(样本均值 − 假设值)/(s/√n) = (32,000 − 11,000)/(12,000/√64) = 21,000/1,500 = 14.0。Answer B. Method: t = (sample mean − hypothesized value)/(s/√n) = (32,000 − 11,000)/(12,000/√64) = 21,000/1,500 = 14.0.

§5 相关性检验与 Spearman、卡方§5 Correlation Tests, Spearman & Chi-Square

LOS 对应:LOS: explain tests of independence based on correlation and contingency tables。
检验Test用途Use
相关系数 t 检验Correlation coefficient t-test检验两变量线性相关是否显著(参数法)Tests whether the linear correlation between two variables is significant (parametric)
Spearman 秩相关Spearman rank correlation非参数法,基于排名;适合非正态/有异常值/序数数据Nonparametric, based on ranks; suited to non-normal/outlier/ordinal data
卡方独立性检验Chi-square test of independence用列联表检验两分类变量是否独立Uses a contingency table to test whether two categorical variables are independent

参数检验假设特定分布(如正态);非参数检验(Spearman、卡方)不依赖分布假设,更稳健但通常功效略低。Parametric tests assume a specific distribution (e.g., normal); nonparametric tests (Spearman, chi-square) do not rely on a distributional assumption — more robust but usually slightly less powerful.

考点·假设检验方法怎么选:
• 均值:方差未知用 t;独立样本用合并方差 t,相依(配对)样本用配对比较 t。
• 单个总体方差:卡方(chi-square);两方差之比:F。
• 相关性:参数法用皮尔逊 t(自由度 = n − 2);非参数用斯皮尔曼(Spearman)秩相关。
• 独立性(列联表):卡方,自由度 = (行−1)×(列−1)。功效 = 1 − β;α 越小 β 越大。Exam - choosing the hypothesis test:
- Means: unknown variance uses t; independent samples use the pooled-variance t, dependent (paired) samples use the paired-comparisons t.
- A single variance: chi-square; a ratio of two variances: F.
- Correlation: parametric uses the Pearson t (df = n − 2); nonparametric uses the Spearman rank correlation.
- Independence (contingency table): chi-square, df = (rows−1)×(cols−1). Power = 1 − β; a smaller α raises β.

13. 关于参数检验与非参数检验,最恰当的是:Regarding parametric vs nonparametric tests, the most appropriate statement is: 官方题Official

  • A. 参数检验不需要任何假设Parametric tests need no assumptions
  • B. 参数检验假设特定分布(如正态);非参数不依赖分布假设,更稳健但功效通常略低Parametric tests assume a specific distribution (e.g., normal); nonparametric tests do not, being more robust but usually a bit less powerful
  • C. 非参数检验必须假设正态Nonparametric tests must assume normality
答案 B。非参数以稳健性换取一定的功效。Answer B. Nonparametric tests trade some power for robustness.

14. Spearman 秩相关检验最适合的数据是:Spearman rank correlation is best suited to data that are: 官方题Official

  • A. 完美正态、无异常值的数据Perfectly normal with no outliers
  • B. 仅二分类数据Only binary data
  • C. 非正态、有异常值或序数(排名)数据Non-normal, with outliers, or ordinal (rank) data
答案 C。秩相关对异常值和非正态更稳健。Answer C. Rank correlation is more robust to outliers and non-normality.

15. 卡方独立性检验用于:A chi-square independence test is used to: 官方题Official

  • A. 用列联表检验两个分类变量是否独立Test whether two categorical variables are independent using a contingency table
  • B. 检验单一均值Test a single mean
  • C. 检验回归斜率Test a regression slope
答案 A。卡方独立性检验针对分类变量的列联表。Answer A. The chi-square independence test applies to the contingency table of categorical variables.
1. 在下列哪种情形下最适合使用非参数检验?1. A nonparametric test is most appropriate when: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 比较均值之间的差异时。comparing differences between means.
  • B. 数据以秩(排名)形式给出时。data are given in ranks.
  • C. 数据满足分布假设时。data meet distributional assumptions.
答案 B。数据以"秩(排名)"形式给出时最适合非参数检验(不依赖分布假设)。满足分布假设、比较均值时用参数检验。Answer B. Nonparametric tests are best when data are given as ranks (no distributional assumption). When distributional assumptions hold and means are compared, use parametric tests.
2. 检验单个正态总体的方差时,应使用下列哪种检验统计量?2. Which of the following test statistics is used when testing the variance of a single normally distributed population? 真题模考Mock

3. 在对两变量相关性的参数检验中,样本量为 51、样本相关系数为 0.6,则 t 统计量最接近于:3. In a parametric test of the correlation between two variables with a sample size of 51 and a sample correlation of 0.6, the t-statistic is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 0.070.07
  • B. 5.255.25
  • C. 6.646.64
答案 B。方法:相关性 t = r×√(n−2)/√(1−r²) = 0.6×√49/√(1−0.36) = 0.6×7/0.8 = 5.25。Answer B. Method: correlation t = r×√(n−2)/√(1−r²) = 0.6×√49/√(1−0.36) = 0.6×7/0.8 = 5.25.
4. 分析师列出 X、Y 四对观测的秩:观测1(X秩1,Y秩2)、观测2(2,3)、观测3(3,4)、观测4(4,1)。X 与 Y 的斯皮尔曼秩相关系数最接近于:4. An analyst tabulates the ranks of four paired observations of X and Y: obs1 (Rank X 1, Rank Y 2), obs2 (2, 3), obs3 (3, 4), obs4 (4, 1). The Spearman rank correlation coefficient between X and Y is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. −0.2−0.2
  • B. 0.80.8
  • C. 1.01.0
答案 A。方法:斯皮尔曼秩相关 = 1 − 6Σd²/[n(n²−1)],d 为每对秩差。X秩-Y秩差:(−1,−1,−1,3),Σd²=12 → 1 − 6×12/(4×15) = 1 − 1.2 = −0.2。Answer A. Method: Spearman rank correlation = 1 − 6Σd²/[n(n²−1)], d = each rank difference. Differences (−1,−1,−1,3), Σd²=12 → 1 − 6×12/(4×15) = 1 − 1.2 = −0.2.
5. 下列哪项最能被称为关于相关性的非参数假设检验?即使用:5. Which of the following is best referred to as a nonparametric hypothesis test concerning correlation? A test using the: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 皮尔逊相关系数Pearson correlation coefficient
  • B. 二元相关系数bivariate correlation coefficient
  • C. 斯皮尔曼秩相关系数Spearman rank correlation coefficient
答案 C。关于相关性的非参数检验用"斯皮尔曼秩相关系数"(基于排名)。皮尔逊相关是参数法(需正态假设)。Answer C. A nonparametric test of correlation uses the Spearman rank correlation (based on ranks). The Pearson correlation is parametric (needs a normality assumption).
6. 分析师构建一个按市值(小/中/大)与贝塔(高/中/低)分类的列联表。用独立性检验来检验二者关系时,卡方检验统计量的自由度为:6. An analyst builds a contingency table of stocks classified by market capitalization (small, medium, large) and beta (high, medium, low). To test the relationship using a test of independence, the number of degrees of freedom for the chi-square test statistic is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 44
  • B. 66
  • C. 99
答案 A。方法:列联表卡方自由度 =(行数−1)×(列数−1) = (3−1)×(3−1) = 4。Answer A. Method: contingency-table chi-square df = (rows−1)×(columns−1) = (3−1)×(3−1) = 4.
7. 对两个正态分布变量(各样本量为 n)相关性的假设检验,其自由度为:7. For a hypothesis test concerning the correlation between two normally distributed variables with sample size n each, the number of degrees of freedom is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. n − 2。n − 2.
  • B. n − 1。n − 1.
  • C. 2n − 2。2n − 2.
答案 A。相关性 t 检验的自由度 = n − 2(两个变量估计了两个参数)。Answer A. The df for a correlation t-test = n − 2 (two parameters are estimated for the two variables).

§6 一元线性回归§6 Simple Linear Regression 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: describe the simple linear regression model and interpret its coefficients。
🔰 零基础讲解:用一条直线解释 Y 随 X 怎么变

线性回归📈 回归就是找一条"最贴合数据点"的直线 Y=b₀+b₁X:b₁(斜率)表示 X 每增加 1 单位、Y 平均变化多少;b₀(截距)是 X=0 时的 Y。用"最小二乘"让所有点到直线的竖直距离平方和最小。CAPM 里股票对市场的回归斜率就是贝塔。:Y = 截距 + 斜率×X + 误差。Linear regression📈 Regression finds the line that 'best fits the data points' Y=b₀+b₁X: b₁ (the slope) is how much Y changes on average for each 1-unit increase in X; b₀ (the intercept) is Y when X=0. 'Least squares' minimizes the sum of squared vertical distances from the points to the line. In CAPM, the slope of a stock's regression on the market is beta.: Y = intercept + slope×X + error.

回归模型:Yi = b0 + b1Xi + εi    斜率 b1 = Cov(X, Y) / Var(X)
符号Symbol含义Meaning
b0截距:X=0 时 Y 的预测值Intercept: the predicted Y when X=0
b1斜率:X 每增 1 单位,Y 平均变化量Slope: the average change in Y per 1-unit increase in X
ε残差(误差项);最小二乘使残差平方和最小Residual (error term); least squares minimizes the sum of squared residuals
X / Y自变量(解释变量)/ 因变量(被解释变量)Independent variable (explanatory) / dependent variable (explained)
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

一元线性回归

模型:Y = b0 + b1·X + ε。用最小二乘使残差平方和最小,得斜率 b1 = Cov(X,Y) ÷ Var(X)、截距 b0 = Ȳ − b1·X̄。b1 表示 X 每变动一单位,Y 的平均变化。

四个关键假设

① X 与 Y 关系线性;② 残差相互独立;③ 残差同方差(方差恒定);④ 残差近似正态。违反会削弱推断有效性。

易错对比

① 斜率 = 协方差 ÷ X 的方差;② 回归揭示关联,不等于因果;③ 违反同方差/独立性 → t 检验失效。

Simple linear regression

Model: Y = b0 + b1·X + ε. Ordinary least squares minimizes the sum of squared residuals, giving slope b1 = Cov(X,Y) ÷ Var(X) and intercept b0 = Ȳ − b1·X̄. b1 is the average change in Y per one-unit change in X.

Four key assumptions

① The X-Y relation is linear; ② residuals are independent; ③ residuals are homoskedastic (constant variance); ④ residuals are approximately normal. Violations weaken inference.

Common traps

① Slope = covariance ÷ variance of X; ② regression shows association, not causation; ③ violating homoskedasticity/independence → invalid t-tests.

16. 一元线性回归模型的形式是:The form of a simple linear regression model is: 官方题Official

  • A. Yᵢ = b₀ × b₁XᵢYᵢ = b₀ × b₁Xᵢ
  • B. Yᵢ = b₀ + b₁Xᵢ + εᵢYᵢ = b₀ + b₁Xᵢ + εᵢ
  • C. Yᵢ = b₁Xᵢ²Yᵢ = b₁Xᵢ²
答案 B。含截距 b₀、斜率 b₁ 与误差项 εᵢ。Answer B. It includes an intercept b₀, a slope b₁, and an error term εᵢ.

17. 回归斜率 b₁ 的公式是:The formula for the regression slope b₁ is: 官方题Official

  • A. Cov(X,Y) / Var(Y)Cov(X,Y) / Var(Y)
  • B. Var(X) / Cov(X,Y)Var(X) / Cov(X,Y)
  • C. Cov(X,Y) / Var(X)Cov(X,Y) / Var(X)
答案 C。斜率 = 协方差除以自变量方差。Answer C. The slope is the covariance divided by the variance of the independent variable.

18. 回归斜率 b₁ 的正确解读是:The correct interpretation of the regression slope b₁ is: 官方题Official

  • A. X 每增加 1 单位,Y 平均变化 b₁For each 1-unit increase in X, Y changes by b₁ on average
  • B. X 与 Y 的相关系数The correlation between X and Y
  • C. 当 X=0 时 Y 的预测值The predicted value of Y when X=0
答案 A。C 描述的是截距 b₀。Answer A. C describes the intercept b₀.

19. 最小二乘法(OLS)的目标是:The objective of ordinary least squares (OLS) is: 官方题Official

  • A. 使 R² 最小To minimize R²
  • B. 使残差平方和(SSE)最小To minimize the sum of squared residuals (SSE)
  • C. 使残差之和最大To maximize the sum of residuals
答案 B。OLS 通过最小化 SSE 求参数。Answer B. OLS solves for the parameters by minimizing SSE.

20. 下列哪一项不属于一元线性回归的经典假设:Which of the following is NOT a classic assumption of simple linear regression: 补充Extra

  • A. X 与 Y 呈线性关系X and Y have a linear relationship
  • B. 残差独立、同方差且服从正态Residuals are independent, homoskedastic, and normally distributed
  • C. Y 必须服从二项分布Y must follow a binomial distribution
答案 C。经典假设为线性、残差独立同方差且正态、X 非随机;并不要求 Y 服从二项分布。Answer C. The classic assumptions are linearity, independent/homoskedastic/normal residuals, and a non-random X; Y need not be binomial.
1. 一元线性回归中,服从 F 分布的检验统计量的原假设检验的是:1. The null hypothesis for the F-distributed test statistic in a simple linear regression model tests whether the: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 斜率等于零。slope is equal to zero.
  • B. 截距等于零。intercept is equal to zero.
  • C. 斜率不等于零。slope is not equal to zero.
答案 A。一元回归中F 检验的原假设 = "斜率等于零"(自变量无解释力)。F 检验整体显著性;单变量时 F = t²。Answer A. In simple regression, the F-test's null = "the slope equals zero" (the independent variable has no explanatory power). F tests overall significance; with one variable, F = t².
2. 分析师用一元线性回归检验玉米需求的变动是否解释小麦供给的变动。在该模型中,小麦供给是:2. An analyst runs a simple linear regression to test whether the variation in the demand for corn explains the variation in the supply of wheat. In this model, the supply of wheat is a(n): 真题模考Mock
  • A. 指示(哑)变量。indicator variable.
  • B. 被解释变量(因变量)。explained variable.
  • C. 自变量。independent variable.
答案 B。用"玉米需求变动"解释"小麦供给变动" → 小麦供给是被解释的"因变量(dependent variable)";玉米需求是自变量。Answer B. Using "change in corn demand" to explain "change in wheat supply" → wheat supply is the dependent (explained) variable; corn demand is the independent variable.

LOS 对应:LOS: calculate and interpret the coefficient of determination and the standard error of estimate。
总平方和 SST = 回归平方和 SSR + 残差平方和 SSE

21. 一元回归中 R² 的含义是:In simple regression, the meaning of R² is: 官方题Official

  • A. 残差的标准差The standard deviation of the residuals
  • B. 斜率的显著性The significance of the slope
  • C. Y 的变动中被 X 解释的比例,等于相关系数的平方The proportion of Y's variation explained by X, equal to the square of the correlation coefficient
答案 C。一元回归 R² = ρ²。Answer C. In simple regression R² = ρ².

22. 平方和分解 SST、SSR、SSE 的关系是:The relationship among the sums of squares SST, SSR, and SSE is: 官方题Official

  • A. SSR = SST + SSESSR = SST + SSE
  • B. SST = SSR + SSESST = SSR + SSE
  • C. SSE = SST + SSRSSE = SST + SSR
答案 B。总平方和 = 回归解释 + 残差(未解释)。Answer B. Total = explained (regression) + unexplained (residual).

23. 估计标准误(SEE)衡量的是:The standard error of the estimate (SEE) measures: 官方题Official

  • A. 残差的标准差,即回归预测的典型误差,越小拟合越好The standard deviation of the residuals, i.e., the typical prediction error — smaller means a better fit
  • B. 斜率的置信区间The confidence interval of the slope
  • C. 自变量 X 的方差The variance of X
答案 A。SEE 越小,观测点越贴近回归线。Answer A. A smaller SEE means the observations lie closer to the regression line.

24. 检验回归斜率是否显著,应:To test whether the regression slope is significant, you should: 官方题Official

  • A. 用卡方检验Use a chi-square test
  • B. 比较 R² 与 0.5Compare R² with 0.5
  • C. 用 t 检验 H₀: b₁=0,t = b₁/SE(b₁)Use a t-test of H₀: b₁=0, with t = b₁/SE(b₁)
答案 C。斜率显著性用 t 统计量 b₁/SE(b₁)。Answer C. Slope significance uses the t-statistic b₁/SE(b₁).
1. 分析师估计一元线性回归:误差平方和(SSE)=280;回归平方和(SSR)=25;配对观测数=30。估计标准误(SEE)最接近于:1. An analyst estimates a simple linear regression: sum of squares error (SSE) = 280; sum of squares regression (SSR) = 25; number of paired observations = 30. The standard error of the estimate is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 2.52.5
  • B. 3.23.2
  • C. 10.010.0
答案 B。方法:SEE = √[SSE/(n−2)] = √[280/28] = √10 ≈ 3.2。SEE 衡量回归的"典型预测误差"。Answer B. Method: SEE = √[SSE/(n−2)] = √[280/28] = √10 ≈ 3.2. The SEE measures the typical prediction error of the regression.
2. 一元线性回归中的估计标准误(SEE)最恰当地被描述为:2. The standard error of the estimate in a simple linear regression is best described as: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 回归拟合优度的相对度量。a relative measure of fit for the regression.
  • B. 自变量所解释的因变量变动的百分比。the percentage of the variation of the dependent variable explained by the independent variable.
  • C. 因变量观测值与回归预测值之间距离的度量。a measure of the distance between the observed values of the dependent variable and those predicted from the regression.
答案 C。估计标准误(SEE)= 因变量实际观测值与回归预测值之间距离(残差)的度量。R² 才是拟合优度的相对度量。Answer C. The standard error of the estimate (SEE) measures the distance between the actual observations and the regression's predictions (the residuals). R² is the relative goodness-of-fit measure.
3. 在一元线性回归分析中,总平方和(SST)最能描述:3. In simple linear regression analysis, the total sum of squares best describes: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 散点图。a scatter plot.
  • B. 因变量的变动。the variation of the dependent variable.
  • C. 变量间的一对观测。a paired observation between variables.
答案 B。总平方和(SST)描述"因变量的总变动"(= 回归平方和 SSR + 残差平方和 SSE)。它衡量 Y 围绕其均值的离散。Answer B. The total sum of squares (SST) describes the total variation of the dependent variable (= SSR + SSE). It measures the dispersion of Y about its mean.

§5 回归假设、残差诊断与 ANOVA§5 Regression Assumptions, Residual Diagnostics & ANOVA

LOS 对应：use residual plots, interpret ANOVA, and evaluate tests of fit and coefficients。

核心假设包括：关系线性、误差均值为零、误差方差恒定、误差彼此独立、误差近似正态，以及解释变量与误差不相关。The core assumptions are: a linear relationship, zero-mean errors, constant error variance, mutually independent errors, approximately normal errors, and the explanatory variable being uncorrelated with the error.

漏斗形Funnel shape异方差Heteroskedasticity普通标准误可能不可靠Ordinary standard errors may be unreliable
连续同号或周期Consecutive same-sign or cyclical自相关Autocorrelation误差不独立Errors are not independent

SST = SSR + SSE
F = MSR / MSE；MSR = SSR / 1；MSE = SSE / (n − 2)

F 检验判断整体回归是否有解释力。一元回归中，整体 F 统计量等于斜率 t 统计量的平方。The F-test judges whether the overall regression has explanatory power. In simple regression, the overall F-statistic equals the square of the slope t-statistic.

5. 回归残差图呈"漏斗形"(离散度随 X 扩大)说明:A regression residual plot with a 'funnel' shape (spread widening with X) indicates:

  • A. 存在异方差(heteroskedasticity)Heteroskedasticity
  • B. 存在完美线性关系A perfect linear relationship
  • C. 残差服从正态分布Normally distributed residuals
答案 A。残差方差随 X 变化即异方差,违反同方差假设。Answer A. Residual variance changing with X is heteroskedasticity, violating the homoskedasticity assumption.
1. 就一元线性回归而言,残差最恰当地被描述为因变量观测值与下列哪项之差:1. With respect to simple linear regression, a residual is best described as the difference between the observed value of a dependent variable and: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 其均值。its mean.
  • B. 基于样本拟合回归线得到的估计值。its estimated value using a fitted regression line based on the sample.
  • C. 基于真实总体关系得到的期望值。its expected value based on the true underlying population relationship.
答案 B。残差 = 因变量观测值 − "样本回归线的估计(预测)值"。与"真实总体关系的期望值"之差是误差项(error),不是残差。Answer B. A residual = the observed dependent value − the value estimated (predicted) by the fitted sample regression line. The difference from the true population relationship is the error term, not the residual.
2. 下列哪项是一元线性回归模型的基本假设?即回归残差:2. Which of the following is an underlying assumption of the simple linear regression model? The regression residuals: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 服从正态分布。are normally distributed.
  • B. 在各观测间高度相关。have high correlations across observations.
  • C. 在各观测间方差不同。have different variances across observations.
答案 A。一元回归基本假设之一:残差服从正态分布(还包括均值为0、同方差、相互独立)。B(高度相关)、C(异方差)都违反假设。Answer A. A basic assumption of simple regression: the residuals are normally distributed (plus mean zero, homoskedasticity, independence). B (highly correlated) and C (heteroskedastic) violate the assumptions.

§6 预测区间与函数形式§6 Prediction Intervals & Functional Forms

点预测为 ŷ = b0 + b1x。单个未来观察值的预测区间为 ŷ ± t × sf。预测区间同时包含参数估计不确定性和单个观察值误差，所以比条件均值置信区间更宽。The point forecast is ŷ = b0 + b1x. The prediction interval for a single future observation is ŷ ± t × sf. The prediction interval includes both parameter-estimate uncertainty and the individual observation's error, so it is wider than the confidence interval for the conditional mean.

函数形式Functional form模型Model斜率解释Slope interpretation
线性—线性Linear–linearY=b0+b1XX 增 1，Y 改变 b1 单位X rises by 1, Y changes by b1 units
对数—线性Log–linearlnY=b0+b1XX 增 1，Y 约改变 100b1%X rises by 1, Y changes by about 100b1%
线性—对数Linear–logY=b0+b1lnXX 增 1%，Y 约改变 0.01b1X rises by 1%, Y changes by about 0.01b1
对数—对数Log–loglnY=b0+b1lnXb1 是弹性b1 is the elasticity
考点·大数据与金融科技(fintech):
• 金融科技(fintech)= 金融服务与产品"设计与交付"中的技术创新(最广义)。
• 大数据 4V:体量(Volume)、速度(Velocity)、多样(Variety)、真实性(Veracity)。
• 另类数据(alternative data):传统金融来源之外的数据(社媒、电子邮件、卫星、传感器)。
• 机器学习:过拟合(overfitting,学到噪声)或欠拟合(underfitting,太简单)都会使预测变差。
• 自然语言处理(NLP):分析文本的情绪/主题(如分析师评论)。
• 进展层级:处理数据 → 自动化任务 → 做决策(最新)。Exam - big data & fintech:
- Fintech = technological innovation in the design and delivery of financial services/products (broadest sense).
- Big data 4 Vs: Volume, Velocity, Variety, Veracity.
- Alternative data: data outside traditional financial sources (social media, email, satellite, sensors).
- Machine learning: overfitting (learning noise) or underfitting (too simple) both worsen prediction.
- Natural language processing (NLP): analyzes the sentiment/topics of text (e.g., analyst commentary).
- Progression: processing data to automating tasks to making decisions (the newest).

6. 预测区间比均值的置信区间更宽,原因是:A prediction interval is wider than the confidence interval for the mean because:

  • A. 它还包含单个未来观测值自身的随机误差It also includes the random error of the individual future observation itself
  • B. 它使用了更高的置信水平It uses a higher confidence level
  • C. 它忽略了标准误It ignores the standard error
答案 A。预测单个观测值需叠加个体随机误差,故区间更宽。Answer A. Predicting a single observation adds the individual random error, so the interval is wider.
1. 分析师用某股票月收益对市场指数(均以 % 计)做一元线性回归:斜率=1.0;截距=1.2%;预测标准误=1.4%;5% 临界 t 值=±2.032。当预测指数收益为 3.5% 时,该股票月收益的 95% 预测区间最接近于:1. An analyst performs a simple linear regression of a stock's monthly return on a market index (both in %): estimated slope = 1.0; estimated intercept = 1.2%; standard error of the forecast = 1.4%; critical t-values at 5% = ±2.032. The 95% prediction interval for the stock's monthly return, given a forecasted index return of 3.5%, is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 0.7% 至 6.3%0.7% to 6.3%
  • B. 1.9% 至 7.5%1.9% to 7.5%
  • C. 3.3% 至 6.1%3.3% to 6.1%
答案 B。方法:预测值 = 截距 + 斜率×X;预测区间 = 预测值 ± t临界×预测标准误。预测=1.2%+1.0×3.5%=4.7%;4.7% ± 2.032×1.4% ≈ 1.9% 至 7.5%。Answer B. Method: predicted = intercept + slope×X; prediction interval = predicted ± t-critical × prediction SE. Predicted = 1.2% + 1.0×3.5% = 4.7%; 4.7% ± 2.032×1.4% ≈ 1.9% to 7.5%.
2. 下列哪项最能说明何时需要对数据做变换才能使用一元线性回归模型?即当:2. Which of the following best describes when a transformation of the data may be needed to enable the use of a simple linear regression model? When the: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 因变量非正态分布时。dependent variable is non-normally distributed.
  • B. 因变量与自变量的各观测对彼此不相关时。pairs of the dependent and independent variables are uncorrelated with one another.
  • C. 自变量与因变量之间的关系为非线性时。relationship between the independent variable and the dependent variable is non-linear.
答案 C。当自变量与因变量的关系为"非线性"时,需先对数据做变换(如取对数)才能用一元线性回归。非正态因变量本身不必然要求变换。Answer C. When the relationship between the independent and dependent variable is nonlinear, the data must be transformed (e.g., logged) before using simple linear regression. A non-normal dependent variable alone does not necessarily require transformation.
3. 只有自变量取对数形式的一元线性回归模型最恰当地被称为:3. The simple linear regression model in which only the independent variable is in logarithmic form is best described as the: 真题模考Mock
  • A. log-lin 模型。log-lin model.
  • B. lin-log 模型。lin-log model.
  • C. log-log 模型。log-log model.
答案 B。只有"自变量"取对数 = lin-log 模型(线性 Y、对数 X)。log-lin 是 Y 取对数;log-log 是两者都取对数。Answer B. Only the independent variable in log form = a lin-log model (linear Y, log X). Log-lin logs Y; log-log logs both.
4. 在其他条件不变时,重新估计线性回归模型时,下列哪项最可能导致更宽的预测区间?即增大:4. All else being equal, which of the following would most likely lead to a wider prediction interval when re-estimating a linear regression model? An increase in the: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 样本量sample size
  • B. 显著性水平level of significance
  • C. 估计标准误standard error of the estimate
答案 C。估计标准误(SEE)增大 → 预测更不确定 → 预测区间更宽。增大样本量会使区间更窄;显著性水平影响的是临界值方向不同。Answer C. A larger standard error of the estimate (SEE) → more prediction uncertainty → a wider prediction interval. A larger sample narrows the interval; the significance level affects the critical value differently.
1. 机器学习模型无法准确预测结果,可能源于:1. The failure of machine-learning models to accurately predict outcomes can be the result of: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 过拟合,但不含欠拟合。overfitting, but not underfitting.
  • B. 欠拟合,但不含过拟合。underfitting, but not overfitting.
  • C. 过拟合或欠拟合皆有可能。either overfitting or underfitting.
答案 C。机器学习预测不准可能因过拟合(overfitting,学到噪声)或欠拟合(underfitting,太简单),两者皆有可能。故 C。Answer C. A machine-learning model can predict poorly due to overfitting (learning noise) or underfitting (too simple) — either is possible. Hence C.
2. 从最广义上讲,金融科技(fintech)最恰当地被描述为:2. In its broadest sense, fintech is best described as: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 金融服务业产生的海量数据。the vast amount of data being generated by the financial services industry.
  • B. 通过计算机算法执行投资策略。the execution of investment strategies through computer-generated algorithms.
  • C. 金融服务与产品的设计和交付中的技术创新。technological innovation in the design and delivery of financial services and products.
答案 C。金融科技(fintech)= 金融服务与产品的"设计与交付"中的技术创新(最广义)。海量数据、算法执行只是其组成部分。Answer C. Fintech = technological innovation in the design and delivery of financial services and products (broadest sense). Big data and algorithmic execution are just parts of it.
3. 下列哪项最可能被用于检测分析师评论中的情绪转变?3. Which of the following is most likely used to detect sentiment shifts in an analyst's commentary? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 代币化(Tokenization)Tokenization
  • B. 数据清洗/整理(Data curation)Data curation
  • C. 自然语言处理(NLP)Natural language processing
答案 C。检测文本(分析师评论)中的情绪转变用自然语言处理(NLP, natural language processing)。代币化、数据清洗是数据处理前置步骤。Answer C. Detecting a sentiment shift in text (analyst commentary) uses natural language processing (NLP). Tokenization and data curation are preprocessing steps.

  • A. 电子邮件通信数据。Email communication data.
  • B. 公司监管申报文件。Corporate regulatory filings.
  • C. 衍生品市场数据。Data from derivative markets.
答案 A。另类数据(alternative data)= 传统金融来源之外的数据,如"电子邮件通信"、社媒、卫星、传感器。监管申报、衍生品市场数据是传统数据。Answer A. Alternative data = data outside traditional financial sources, e.g., email communications, social media, satellite, sensors. Regulatory filings and derivatives-market data are traditional data.
5. 下列哪项是金融科技最近的进展?即能够:5. Which of the following is the most recent advancement in fintech? Applications that can: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 处理数据的应用。process data.
  • B. 自动化处理任务的应用。automate tasks.
  • C. 做出决策的应用。make decisions.
答案 C。金融科技的"最近"进展 = 能"做决策(decision-making)"的应用(如机器学习驱动)。早期只是数据处理、任务自动化。Answer C. The most recent fintech advance = applications that make decisions (e.g., machine-learning-driven). Earlier ones only processed data or automated tasks.

  • 市场结构:完全竞争 MR = P、供给曲线 = MC;垄断/寡头 MR < P;垄断竞争靠差异化、长期零经济利润且有过剩产能。Market structures: perfect competition has MR = P and supply = MC; monopoly/oligopoly have MR < P; monopolistic competition uses differentiation, earns zero long-run economic profit, and has excess capacity.
  • 停产点(TR < 总可变成本)vs 盈亏平衡(P = 最低平均总成本);固定成本是沉没成本,不影响停产决定。HHI = 各份额先平方再求和;LRAC 下行 = 规模经济。Shutdown (TR < total variable cost) vs break-even (P = min average total cost); fixed cost is sunk and irrelevant to shutdown. HHI = square each share then sum; a downward LRAC = economies of scale.
  • 财政 vs 货币:货币管价格稳定/信贷,财政管税收支出/再分配;相机抉择(主动决策)vs 自动稳定器(自动发生)。扩张财政 = 增支/减税;扩张货币 = 买债/降准/降息。Fiscal vs monetary: monetary handles price stability/credit; fiscal handles taxes/spending/redistribution; discretionary (deliberate) vs automatic stabilizers (automatic). Expansionary fiscal = more spending/lower taxes; expansionary monetary = buy bonds/cut reserves/cut rates.
  • 经济指标:领先(股指、新订单、期限利差、每周工时)、同步(非农就业)、滞后(存货—销售比、失业平均持续时间)。Economic indicators: leading (stock index, new orders, term spread, weekly hours), coincident (nonfarm payrolls), lagging (inventory-to-sales, average unemployment duration).
  • 通胀目标制三品质:独立、可信、透明;中性利率 = 潜在增长 + 通胀目标。货币政策局限:流动性陷阱(零利率失效),对抗通缩比对抗通胀更难。Inflation targeting needs independence, credibility, transparency; neutral rate = potential growth + inflation target. Monetary limits: a liquidity trap (zero-rate ineffectiveness); fighting deflation is harder than fighting inflation.
  • 贸易:小国关税 → 生产者剩余增、国民福利降(死角损失);出口补贴 → 国内价上升。贸易集团层级:自由贸易区 ⊂ 关税同盟 ⊂ 共同市场 ⊂ 经济联盟 ⊂ 货币联盟。Trade: a small country's tariff → producer surplus up, national welfare down (deadweight loss); an export subsidy → domestic price up. Bloc hierarchy: free-trade area ⊂ customs union ⊂ common market ⊂ economic union ⊂ monetary union.
  • 汇率:名义(不含物价、偏离PPP)vs 实际(含相对物价);实际变化% ≈ 名义% + 外国通胀 − 本国通胀。CIP 求远期,高息货币远期贴水。经常账户:财政盈余 + 私人储蓄 > 投资 → 出口 > 进口。Exchange rates: nominal (no prices, deviates from PPP) vs real (embeds relative prices); %Δreal ≈ %Δnominal + foreign inflation − domestic inflation. CIP prices forwards, with the higher-yield currency at a forward discount. Current account: fiscal surplus + private saving > investment → exports > imports.
  • 地缘政治风险:事件风险(突发单次)、主题性风险(长期演变,如网络威胁)、外生风险(外部冲击,如自然灾害);黑天鹅 → 战术性调整。Geopolitical risk: event (sudden one-off), thematic (long-evolving, e.g., cyber), exogenous (external shock, e.g., natural disaster); a black swan → tactical adjustments.

LM1 §1 完全竞争 vs 不完全竞争:需求曲线与收入函数LM1 §1 Perfect vs Imperfect Competition: Demand Curve & Revenue Functions

LOS 对应:LOS: determine and interpret breakeven and shutdown points of production —— 判定并解读生产的盈亏平衡点与停产点,以及规模经济/不经济如何影响完全竞争与不完全竞争下的成本。

企业所处的竞争环境分两大类,区别体现在企业面对的需求曲线的斜率上:A firm's competitive environment falls into two broad types, distinguished by the slope of the demand curve the firm faces:

  • 完全竞争(perfect competition):企业是价格接受者(price taker),必须接受市场价格。它面对一条完全弹性的水平需求曲线。此时:价格 = 边际收入 = 平均收入,即 P = MR = AR。Perfect competition: the firm is a price taker and must accept the market price. It faces a perfectly elastic, horizontal demand curve. Here price = marginal revenue = average revenue, i.e. P = MR = AR.
  • 不完全竞争(imperfect competition):企业面对向下倾斜的需求曲线,有定价权。要多卖一单位就必须降价(且对所有单位降价),所以边际收入低于价格:MR < P。Imperfect competition: the firm faces a downward-sloping demand curve and has pricing power. To sell one more unit it must cut the price (and cut it on all units), so marginal revenue is below price: MR < P.
TR = P × Q    AR = TR / Q = P    MR = ΔTR / ΔQ
符号Symbol含义Meaning
TR总收入 total revenue,销售收入总额(单位:货币/期间,如 GBP/周)Total revenue, the total of sales revenue (units: currency/period, e.g., GBP/week)
P价格 price,每单位产品的售价(如 GBP/蒲式耳)Price, the selling price per unit of output (e.g., GBP/bushel)
Q产量/销量 quantity,单位时间内出售的产品数量Quantity, the number of units sold per unit of time
AR平均收入 average revenue,每单位产品带来的收入,恒等于价格 PAverage revenue, the revenue per unit sold, always equal to the price P
MR边际收入 marginal revenue,多卖一单位带来的总收入的增量;Δ 表示"变化量"Marginal revenue, the increment in total revenue from selling one more unit; Δ denotes 'change in'

两种环境下总收入曲线形态完全不同:The total-revenue curve looks completely different in the two environments:

  • 完全竞争:P 由市场给定、不随企业销量变化,TR = P×Q 是一条过原点的直线,斜率就是 P。多卖一单位,TR 恰好增加 P。Perfect competition: P is set by the market and does not change with the firm's volume, so TR = P×Q is a straight line through the origin whose slope is P. Each extra unit sold raises TR by exactly P.
  • 不完全竞争(以垄断者为例):价格是产量的函数 P = f(Q),故 TR = f(Q)×Q。沿需求曲线降价时,起初"销量增加"的效应压过"价格下降"的效应,TR 上升(此段需求富有弹性、MR>0);继续降价后,价格效应占上风,TR 转而下降(此段需求缺乏弹性、MR<0)。TR 曲线呈先升后降的倒 U 形。Imperfect competition (a monopolist, say): price is a function of output P = f(Q), so TR = f(Q)×Q. As price is cut down the demand curve, the 'more volume' effect at first outweighs the 'lower price' effect and TR rises (demand elastic here, MR>0); with further cuts the price effect dominates and TR falls (demand inelastic here, MR<0). The TR curve is an inverted-U, rising then falling.
考点提示:"TR 最大化的点"是 MR = 0 的点(需求弹性恰为 1),它不是利润最大化的点。利润最大化永远看 MR = MC。选择题最爱在这里挖坑。

1. 完全竞争下某农场扩产 10%,最可能的结果是:Under perfect competition, a farm expands output by 10%; the most likely result is: 官方题Official

  • A. 总收入(TR)增长约 10%Total revenue (TR) rises about 10%
  • B. 平均收入(AR)增长约 10%Average revenue (AR) rises about 10%
  • C. TR 增幅小于 10%TR rises by less than 10%
答案 A。价格接受者增产不影响市价,TR 与销量同比例增长;AR = P 保持不变。Answer A. A price taker's extra output does not affect market price, so TR grows in proportion to volume; AR = P stays unchanged.

2. 完全竞争企业的边际收入(MR)与平均收入(AR)的关系是:For a perfectly competitive firm, the relationship between marginal revenue (MR) and average revenue (AR) is: 官方题Official

  • A. AR = MR = PAR = MR = P
  • B. MR > ARMR > AR
  • C. MR < ARMR < AR
答案 A。价格接受者在任何数量下都按市价出售,故 AR=MR=P。Answer A. A price taker sells at the market price at every quantity, so AR = MR = P.

LM1 §2 利润最大化、盈亏平衡点与停产点LM1 §2 Profit Maximization, Break-Even & Shutdown Points 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

2.1 经济利润 vs 会计利润

π = TR − TC
符号Symbol含义Meaning
π总利润 total profit(希腊字母 pi)。当 TC 为经济成本时,π 是经济利润Total profit (the Greek letter pi). When TC is economic cost, π is economic profit
TR总收入Total revenue
TC总成本 total cost。注意区分:经济成本 = 会计成本 + 隐性机会成本;会计成本只含账面显性成本Total cost. Note the distinction: economic cost = accounting cost + implicit opportunity cost; accounting cost includes only explicit booked costs
  • 经济利润(economic profit) = TR − 总经济成本(含一切生产要素的机会成本,包括资本)。Economic profit = TR − total economic cost (including the opportunity cost of all factors of production, including capital).
  • 会计利润(accounting profit) = TR − 总会计成本。Accounting profit = TR − total accounting cost.
  • 机会成本(opportunity cost):做出某决策时所放弃的次优用途的价值。Opportunity cost: the value of the next-best use forgone when making a decision.
  • 正常利润(normal profit):经济利润恰好为零时企业赚到的利润——资本获得了与同风险替代投资相当的回报率。经济利润为零 ≠ 会计利润为零;零经济利润的企业账面上仍是盈利的。Normal profit: the profit a firm earns when economic profit is exactly zero — capital earns a return comparable to an equal-risk alternative investment. Zero economic profit ≠ zero accounting profit; a firm with zero economic profit is still profitable on the books.

2.2 利润最大化条件

无论何种市场结构,利润最大化都要求同时满足两个条件:In any market structure, profit maximization requires two conditions to hold at once:

  1. MR = MC(边际收入 = 边际成本);MR = MC (marginal revenue = marginal cost);
  2. MC 不处于下降段(即 MC 正在上升)。若 P = SMC 但 SMC 仍在下降,那一点不是利润最大化点。MC is not on its downward segment (i.e., MC is rising). If P = SMC but SMC is still falling, that point is not a profit-maximizing point.

确定了最优产量 Q* 之后:完全竞争企业按市场价格出售;不完全竞争企业把 Q* 代入需求曲线读出可收取的最高价格 P*。记住:产量由 MR=MC 决定,价格由需求曲线决定。Once the optimal output Q* is set: a competitive firm sells at the market price; an imperfectly competitive firm plugs Q* into the demand curve to read off the highest price it can charge, P*. Remember: output is set by MR=MC, price is set by the demand curve.

2.3 盈亏平衡点(breakeven point)

企业盈亏平衡,当且仅当:A firm breaks even if and only if:

TR = TC  ⇔  P(= AR) = ATC
符号Symbol含义Meaning
ATC平均总成本 average total cost = TC/Q。完全竞争下,盈亏平衡发生在市场价格等于 ATC 曲线最低点处Average total cost = TC/Q. Under perfect competition, break-even occurs where the market price equals the minimum of the ATC curve

此时经济利润为零、企业赚取正常利润。完全竞争、低进入壁垒的市场里,长期而言这就是常态:超额利润会吸引新进入者增加供给、压低价格,直到每家企业最多只能盈亏平衡。Here economic profit is zero and the firm earns normal profit. In a perfectly competitive market with low entry barriers, this is the long-run norm: excess profit attracts new entrants who add supply and push down price until each firm can at best break even.

2.4 停产点(shutdown point)与经营决策

短期内企业有一部分固定成本无论经营与否都要支付(如已签的租约),这类沉没成本(sunk cost)在短期经营决策中必须忽略。判断标准:In the short run a firm must pay some fixed costs whether it operates or not (e.g., a signed lease); such sunk costs must be ignored in short-run operating decisions. The test:

  • 只要 TR ≥ TVC(收入至少覆盖全部可变成本),短期就应继续经营——超出可变成本的部分还能贴补一些固定成本,亏损小于直接停产(停产亏损 = 全部固定成本)。As long as TR ≥ TVC (revenue at least covers all variable costs), keep operating in the short run — the excess over variable cost helps offset some fixed cost, and the loss is smaller than shutting down (a shutdown loss = all fixed costs).
  • 若 TR < TVC,连可变成本都覆盖不了,应立即停产止损。If TR < TVC, not even variable costs are covered, so shut down immediately to stop losses.

用单位量表述:停产点 = AVC 曲线最低点(P 低于最低 AVC 即停产);盈亏平衡点 = ATC 曲线最低点。价格介于最低 AVC 和最低 ATC 之间时,短期继续经营(亏损但止损),长期则退出。In per-unit terms: the shutdown point = minimum of the AVC curve (shut down if P is below minimum AVC); the break-even point = minimum of the ATC curve. When price is between minimum AVC and minimum ATC, operate in the short run (a loss but a smaller one) and exit in the long run.

TC = TFC + TVC    ATC = AFC + AVC    MC = ΔTC / ΔQ
符号Symbol含义Meaning
TFC总固定成本 total fixed cost,不随产量变化的成本(厂房租金、设备租赁费=资本量×资本租金率)Total fixed cost, costs that do not vary with output (plant rent, equipment leasing = quantity of capital × rental rate of capital)
TVC总可变成本 total variable cost,随产量变化的成本(原料、计件工资等)Total variable cost, costs that vary with output (materials, piece-rate wages, etc.)
AFC平均固定成本 = TFC/Q,随产量增加不断下降Average fixed cost = TFC/Q, which keeps falling as output rises
AVC平均可变成本 = TVC/Q,其最低点即停产点Average variable cost = TVC/Q, whose minimum is the shutdown point
MC / SMC(短期)边际成本 (short-run) marginal cost,多生产一单位增加的总成本(Short-run) marginal cost, the added total cost of producing one more unit
收入—成本关系Revenue–cost relationship短期决策Short-run decision长期决策Long-run decision
TR ≥ TC继续经营Keep operating留在市场Stay in the market
TVC ≤ TR < TC继续经营(止损)Keep operating (limit losses)退出市场Exit the market
TR < TVC停产Shut down退出市场Exit the market
教材例题 1 · WR International(不完全竞争)

WR International 生产预制装配住宅,竞争者少。每多卖 10 套,单价降 250。收入成本表(TC 含全部机会成本):WR International makes prefabricated modular homes and has few competitors. For each additional 10 units sold, the unit price falls by 250. Revenue-cost table (TC includes all opportunity costs):

QPTRTC利润Profit
010,0000100,000−100,000
109,75097,500170,000−72,500
209,500190,000240,000−50,000
309,250277,500300,000−22,500
409,000360,000360,0000
508,750437,500420,00017,500
608,500510,000480,00030,000
708,250577,500550,00027,500
808,000640,000640,0000
907,750697,500710,000−12,500
1007,500750,000800,000−50,000

结论:
① 首次盈亏平衡在 Q=40(TR=TC=360,000);
② 盈利区间为 40<Q<80;
③ 利润最大化在 Q=60,最大利润 30,000。注意不完全竞争下有两个盈亏平衡点(Q=40 和 Q=80),利润区间夹在中间。Conclusion:
① first break-even at Q=40 (TR=TC=360,000);
② the profitable range is 40<Q<80;
③ profit is maximized at Q=60, with a maximum profit of 30,000. Note that under imperfect competition there are two break-even points (Q=40 and Q=80), with the profit range in between.

教材例题 2 · 停产分析(伦敦企业)

某企业:TR = 200 万英镑,TC = 250 万(其中 TFC = 100 万,TVC = 150 万),净亏损 50 万。A firm: TR = £2.0m, TC = £2.5m (of which TFC = £1.0m, TVC = £1.5m), a net loss of £0.5m.

  • 短期:TR(200 万)> TVC(150 万),覆盖全部可变成本并贴补一半固定成本。停产亏 100 万,经营只亏 50 万 → 继续经营。Short run: TR (£2.0m) > TVC (£1.5m), covering all variable cost and offsetting half the fixed cost. Shutting down loses £1.0m; operating loses only £0.5m → keep operating.
  • 长期:若收入缺口持续,应停业清算,越拖股东残值越少 → 退出。Long run: if the revenue shortfall persists, wind down and liquidate — the longer the delay, the less residual value for shareholders → exit.
  • 变体:若 TR 只有 130 万(< TVC 150 万),经营亏 120 万 > 停产亏 100 万 → 立即停产,为股东省下 20 万。Variant: if TR is only £1.3m (< TVC £1.5m), operating loses £1.2m > the shutdown loss of £1.0m → shut down immediately, saving shareholders £0.2m.
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

利润最大化、盈亏平衡、停产

• 利润最大化:产量选在 MR = MC 处(且 MC 上升)。
• 盈亏平衡:P = ATC,经济利润 = 0。
• 短期停产点:P < AVC 时停产(连可变成本都盖不住);AVC ≤ P < ATC 时继续经营以弥补部分固定成本。
• 长期退出:P < ATC 时退出。

易错对比

① 产量规则永远是 MR = MC;② 短期只要 P ≥ AVC 就该继续(哪怕亏损);③ 停产看 AVC、退出看 ATC——别搞反。

Profit max, break-even, shutdown

• Profit max: produce where MR = MC (with MC rising).
• Break-even: P = ATC, economic profit = 0.
• Short-run shutdown: shut down when P < AVC (can't even cover variable cost); when AVC ≤ P < ATC, keep operating to cover some fixed cost.
• Long-run exit: exit when P < ATC.

Common traps

① The output rule is always MR = MC; ② in the short run keep going as long as P ≥ AVC (even at a loss); ③ shutdown looks at AVC, exit at ATC — don't flip them.

3. 利润最大化最不可能发生在哪种情形:Profit maximization is LEAST likely to occur at which situation: 官方题Official

  • A. 平均总成本(ATC)最小化的产量The output that minimizes average total cost (ATC)
  • B. MR = MC 的产量The output where MR = MC
  • C. TR − TC 最大的产量The output where TR − TC is greatest
答案 A。ATC 最低产量不一定对应利润最大;B、C 是利润最大化的等价表述。Answer A. The minimum-ATC output need not correspond to maximum profit; B and C are equivalent statements of profit maximization.

4. 完全竞争下,短期盈亏平衡(正常利润)发生在:Under perfect competition, short-run break-even (normal profit) occurs at: 官方题Official

  • A. P = 最低 AVCP = minimum AVC
  • B. P = MC 且 P < AVCP = MC and P < AVC
  • C. P = ATC(最低点)P = ATC (its minimum)
答案 C。盈亏平衡为 P=最低 ATC;P=最低 AVC 是停产点,须区分。Answer C. Break-even is P = minimum ATC; P = minimum AVC is the shutdown point — distinguish the two.

5. 短期停产(shutdown)的条件是:The condition for a short-run shutdown is: 官方题Official

  • A. TR < TCTR < TC
  • B. TR < TVC(等价 P ≤ 最低 AVC)TR < TVC (equivalently P ≤ minimum AVC)
  • C. TR < TFCTR < TFC
答案 B。连可变成本都收不回就停产;沉没的固定成本不进入短期决策。Answer B. If not even variable costs are covered, shut down; sunk fixed costs do not enter the short-run decision.

6. TVC 为 $400 万、TFC 为 $300 万,长期留在市场至少需要 TR:With TVC of $4m and TFC of $3m, staying in the market in the long run requires TR of at least: 官方题Official

  • A. $400 万$4m
  • B. $300 万$3m
  • C. $700 万$7m
答案 C。长期须覆盖全部成本 TC = TVC + TFC = 700 万。Answer C. In the long run all costs must be covered: TC = TVC + TFC = $7m.

7. 当 TVC < TR < TC 时,企业的短期与长期决策分别是:When TVC < TR < TC, the firm's short-run and long-run decisions are, respectively: 官方题Official

  • A. 短期与长期都退出Exit in both the short and long run
  • B. 短期继续经营,长期退出Operate in the short run, exit in the long run
  • C. 短期退出,长期进入Exit in the short run, enter in the long run
答案 B。短期可变成本已覆盖并贴补部分固定成本,故经营;长期无法偿付,退出。Answer B. In the short run variable costs are covered and some fixed cost is offset, so it operates; in the long run it cannot cover total cost, so it exits.

8. 完全竞争长期均衡中,企业赚取:In long-run equilibrium under perfect competition, firms earn: 官方题Official

  • A. 正的经济利润Positive economic profit
  • B. 负的会计利润Negative accounting profit
  • C. 正常利润(零经济利润)Normal profit (zero economic profit)
答案 C。竞争把价格压至长期成本水平,经济利润为零,会计利润仍为正。Answer C. Competition drives price down to the long-run cost level; economic profit is zero while accounting profit remains positive.
1. 完全竞争企业的供给曲线是其长期:1. The perfectly competitive firm's supply curve is its long-run: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 边际成本曲线。marginal cost schedule.
  • B. 平均收益曲线。average revenue schedule.
  • C. 平均总成本曲线。average total cost schedule.
答案 A。完全竞争企业是价格接受者,按 P=MC 定产量,故其供给曲线 = 边际成本(marginal cost, MC)曲线(短期在 AVC 以上部分)。平均收益=价格是需求线;平均总成本不是供给。Answer A. A perfectly competitive firm is a price taker producing where P=MC, so its supply curve = the marginal cost (MC) curve (above AVC in the short run). Average revenue = price is the demand line; average total cost is not supply.
2. 在完全竞争市场中,企业的盈亏平衡点是下列哪条曲线的最低点?2. In a perfectly competitive market, a firm's breakeven point is the minimum point of the: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 平均总成本曲线。average total cost curve.
  • B. 平均固定成本曲线。average fixed cost curve.
  • C. 平均可变成本曲线。average variable cost curve.
答案 A。盈亏平衡点(break-even)在 P = 最低平均总成本(ATC)处——此时经济利润为零。停产点才在最低 AVC。Answer A. The break-even point is where P = minimum average total cost (ATC) — economic profit is zero there. The shutdown point is at minimum AVC.
3. 在短期中,某公司总可变成本 $3 百万、总固定成本 $5 百万,其停产点是总收入下降至:3. In the short run, the shutdown point of a company with a total variable cost of $3 million and a total fixed cost of $5 million is when total revenue declines to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. $3 百万。$3 million.
  • B. $5 百万。$5 million.
  • C. $8 百万。$8 million.
答案 A。短期停产法则:当总收入 < 总可变成本(TVC)时停产(连可变成本都收不回)。故停产点 = TR 降到 $3 百万(=TVC)。固定成本 $5 百万是沉没,不影响停产决定。Answer A. Short-run shutdown rule: stop producing when total revenue < total variable cost (TVC) (can't even cover variable cost). So the shutdown point = TR falling to $3 million (= TVC). The $5 million fixed cost is sunk and irrelevant to shutdown.

LM1 §3 规模经济与规模不经济LM1 §3 Economies & Diseconomies of Scale

3.1 短期与长期的定义

  • 短期(short run):至少有一种生产要素(技术、物质资本、厂房规模)固定不变的时期。Short run: a period in which at least one factor of production (technology, physical capital, plant size) is fixed.
  • 长期(long run):所有要素都可变的时期,企业还可自由进入/退出市场。长期又称"规划期(planning horizon)"——企业永远经营在短期、规划在长期。长期的日历长度因行业而异:小企业可能不到一年,资本密集型企业可能超过十年。Long run: a period in which all factors are variable and firms can freely enter/exit the market. The long run is also called the 'planning horizon' — a firm always operates in the short run and plans in the long run. Its calendar length varies by industry: under a year for a small firm, over a decade for a capital-intensive one.

3.2 长期平均成本曲线 LRAC:包络线

每一个资本投入水平(厂房规模)对应一条短期总成本曲线 STC 和一条短期平均总成本曲线 SATC。规模越大,固定成本(STC 的纵截距 = 资本量 × 资本租金率)越高,但大产量下的斜率越平缓。企业在长期可以任选规模,所以长期(平均)成本曲线是所有短期曲线的下包络线(envelope curve)——每个产量水平上取各规模中成本最低者。Each level of capital input (plant size) corresponds to a short-run total-cost curve STC and a short-run average-total-cost curve SATC. The larger the scale, the higher the fixed cost (STC's intercept = quantity of capital × rental rate of capital) but the flatter the slope at high output. In the long run a firm can choose any scale, so the long-run (average) cost curve is the lower envelope of all the short-run curves — at each output level, take the lowest-cost scale.

LRAC(Q) = min各厂房规模 SATC(Q)
符号Symbol含义Meaning
STC短期总成本 short-run total cost,给定资本水平下的总成本曲线Short-run total cost, the total-cost curve for a given level of capital
SATC短期平均总成本 short-run average total cost,每种厂房规模一条Short-run average total cost, one curve per plant size
LRAC长期平均总成本 long-run average (total) cost,包络所有 SATC 的下边界;教材亦写作 LRAC 曲线Long-run average (total) cost, the lower boundary enveloping all the SATCs; also written as the LRAC curve

3.3 规模经济、规模不经济与最小有效规模

  • 规模经济(economies of scale):产量增加时长期单位成本下降 → LRAC 斜率为负。Economies of scale: long-run unit cost falls as output rises → the LRAC slopes down.
  • 规模不经济(diseconomies of scale):产量增加时长期单位成本上升 → LRAC 斜率为正。Diseconomies of scale: long-run unit cost rises as output rises → the LRAC slopes up.
  • 两者可同时存在,LRAC 形态取决于谁占主导;典型 LRAC 先降、中间可能平坦、后升。Both can coexist; the LRAC's shape depends on which dominates; a typical LRAC falls, may be flat in the middle, then rises.
  • 最小有效规模(minimum efficient scale, MES):LRAC 最低点对应的规模。完全竞争长期中市场价格会落在这一水平,企业被迫在 MES 经营,否则无法长期生存。Minimum efficient scale (MES): the scale at the lowest point of the LRAC. In long-run perfect competition the market price falls to this level, forcing firms to operate at MES or fail to survive long-term.
规模经济的来源Sources of economies of scale规模不经济的来源Sources of diseconomies of scale
规模报酬递增(产出增幅 > 投入增幅);劳动与管理的分工专业化;买得起更高效的设备与新技术;减少浪费、副产品变现、更好的质量控制;更充分利用市场信息;大宗采购议价折扣Increasing returns to scale (output grows faster than inputs); specialization and division of labor and management; ability to afford more efficient equipment and new technology; less waste, monetizing by-products, better quality control; fuller use of market information; bulk-purchase discounts规模报酬递减(产出增幅 < 投入增幅);企业过大难以管理(官僚化、沟通失灵);业务与产品线重叠重复;大量采购推高投入品价格(供给约束);工会针对大企业要求更高薪酬Decreasing returns to scale (output grows slower than inputs); a firm too large to manage (bureaucracy, communication breakdown); overlapping, duplicated business and product lines; large purchases pushing up input prices (supply constraints); unions demanding higher pay from big firms

教材案例:电力公司与沃尔玛(采购议价 + POS 技术)体现规模经济;重组前的通用汽车(品牌重叠、全球协调成本、高劳动力成本)体现规模不经济,2009 年砍掉 Saturn/Pontiac/Hummer、2017 年出售欧宝。Textbook cases: electric utilities and Walmart (purchasing power + POS technology) show economies of scale; pre-restructuring General Motors (brand overlap, global coordination costs, high labor costs) shows diseconomies of scale — it cut Saturn/Pontiac/Hummer in 2009 and sold Opel in 2017.

教材例题 3 · 三家美国车厂的 LRAC

Starr 位于 LRACUS 的规模经济段(应扩大产量降成本)、Rocket 恰在最低点(最优)、GenAuto 位于规模不经济段(应缩减重组)。外国车厂整条 LRACforeign 更低——三家美企都有成本劣势,长期投资价值:Rocket 最优;若谁都追不上外企成本,可能被逐出市场。Starr is on the economies-of-scale segment of LRACUS (should expand output to cut cost), Rocket is right at the minimum (optimal), and GenAuto is on the diseconomies segment (should shrink and restructure).
