The foreign automaker's entire LRACforeign is lower — all three US firms have a cost disadvantage; long-run investment value: Rocket is best; if none can match the foreign cost, they may be driven from the market.

考点提示:"产量增加、单位成本不变" = 规模报酬不变(constant returns to scale),别选成规模经济。另一个高频考点:经营超过 MES 的完全竞争企业,正确做法是减产回到 LRAC 最低点,而不是继续扩产。

9. 增产而单位成本保持不变,这属于:Output rises while unit cost stays unchanged; this is: 官方题Official

  • A. 规模不经济Diseconomies of scale
  • B. 规模报酬不变(constant returns to scale)Constant returns to scale
  • C. 规模经济Economies of scale
答案 B。单位成本不随规模变化即规模报酬不变。Answer B. Unit cost that does not change with scale is constant returns to scale.

10. 企业处于规模经济时,其经营位于:A firm enjoying economies of scale is operating on: 官方题Official

  • A. LRAC 曲线斜率为负的区段The downward-sloping portion of the LRAC curve
  • B. LRAC 曲线斜率为正的区段The upward-sloping portion of the LRAC curve
  • C. LRAC 最低点右侧To the right of the LRAC minimum
答案 A。产量升、单位成本降,即 LRAC 下行段。Answer A. Output rising and unit cost falling is the downward-sloping segment of LRAC.

11. 规模不经济最可能源于:Diseconomies of scale most likely arise from: 官方题Official

  • A. 劳动分工Division of labor
  • B. 业务与产品线重叠、协调困难Overlapping business/product lines and coordination difficulty
  • C. 大宗采购折扣Bulk-purchase discounts
答案 B。A、C 都是规模经济的来源;组织臃肿、协调成本上升才导致规模不经济。Answer B. A and C are sources of economies of scale; organizational bloat and rising coordination costs cause diseconomies of scale.

12. 完全竞争企业经营在超过最小有效规模(MES)处,应:A competitive firm operating beyond minimum efficient scale (MES) should: 官方题Official

  • A. 减产至 LRAC 最低点Cut output back to the LRAC minimum
  • B. 继续扩大产量Keep expanding output
  • C. 维持产量不变Hold output unchanged
答案 A。超过 MES 即进入规模不经济区段,应回到 LRAC 最低点。Answer A. Beyond MES it enters the diseconomies-of-scale segment and should return to the LRAC minimum.
1. 关于向下倾斜的长期平均成本(LRAC)曲线,下列哪项最准确?向下倾斜的 LRAC 曲线代表企业正经历:1. Which of the following statements about a downward-sloping long-run average cost (LRAC) curve is most accurate? A downward-sloping LRAC curve is representative of a firm experiencing: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 规模经济。economies of scale.
  • B. 规模不经济。diseconomies of scale.
  • C. 投资水平下降。decreasing levels of investment.
答案 A。向下倾斜的长期平均成本(LRAC)曲线 = 规模经济(economies of scale):产量越大单位成本越低。向上倾斜才是规模不经济。Answer A. A downward-sloping long-run average cost (LRAC) curve = economies of scale: unit cost falls as output rises. An upward-sloping LRAC is diseconomies of scale.

LM1 §4 四种市场结构总览LM1 §4 Overview of the Four Market Structures

LOS 对应:LOS: describe characteristics of perfect competition, monopolistic competition, oligopoly, and pure monopoly —— 描述四种市场结构的特征。

经济学家定义市场为:彼此知晓、能就商品和服务交换达成价格的买卖双方群体。市场可能受地理限制(预拌水泥),也可能全球化(谷歌搜索;可数字化的服务市场是全球的)。决定市场结构的五个因素:Economists define a market as a group of buyers and sellers who are aware of each other and can agree on a price for exchanging goods and services. A market may be geographically limited (ready-mix concrete) or global (Google search; digitizable service markets are global). The five factors that determine market structure:

  1. 供给该产品的企业数量与相对规模;The number and relative size of firms supplying the product;
  2. 产品差异化程度;The degree of product differentiation;
  3. 卖方对定价的控制力;The seller's control over pricing;
  4. 进入与退出壁垒的强度(高退出成本——如不可再配置的铝冶炼厂——会威慑进入,故也算进入壁垒);The strength of entry and exit barriers (high exit costs — e.g., a non-redeployable aluminum smelter — deter entry, so they count as entry barriers too);
  5. 非价格竞争(广告、款式、捆绑等)的程度。The extent of non-price competition (advertising, styling, bundling, etc.).
市场结构Market structure卖方数量Number of sellers产品差异化Product differentiation进入壁垒Entry barriers企业定价权Firm pricing power非价格竞争Non-price competition
完全竞争Perfect competition众多Many同质/标准化Homogeneous/standardized很低Very low无None无None
垄断竞争Monopolistic competition众多Many差异化Differentiated低Low一些Some广告与产品差异化Advertising and product differentiation
寡头垄断Oligopoly少数Few同质/标准化(也可品牌差异化)Homogeneous/standardized (may also be brand-differentiated)高High一些或相当大Some or considerable广告与产品差异化Advertising and product differentiation
垄断Monopoly一家One独特产品Unique product很高Very high相当大Considerable广告Advertising

关键推论:Key implications:

  • 所有结构下最优产量都满足 MR = MC;但只有完全竞争下 MR = P。In all structures, optimal output satisfies MR = MC; but only under perfect competition does MR = P.
  • 完全竞争:产量最高、价格通常最低;长期只有正常利润(零经济利润)。Perfect competition: highest output, usually lowest price; in the long run only normal profit (zero economic profit).
  • 垄断:产量更小、价格更高;进入壁垒保护下长期可保持正经济利润,投资者可能因其高利润率与充沛现金流受益。Monopoly: smaller output, higher price; protected by entry barriers, it can keep positive economic profit long-term, and investors may benefit from its high margins and ample cash flow.
  • 短期内任何结构都可能有经济利润;市场越竞争、壁垒越低,超额利润消失得越快。In the short run any structure can have economic profit; the more competitive the market and the lower the barriers, the faster excess profit disappears.
  • 权衡:完全竞争给出最大数量与最低价格,但垄断竞争/寡头可能更能激励创新(如新药研发的巨额临床试验成本在完全竞争下无法收回)。消费者也可能从"不那么完全竞争"的市场中受益。Trade-off: perfect competition gives the greatest quantity and lowest price, but monopolistic competition/oligopoly may better incentivize innovation (e.g., the huge clinical-trial cost of new-drug R&D cannot be recouped under perfect competition). Consumers may also benefit from a 'less-than-perfectly-competitive' market.

波特五力与"护城河"

分析师视角的对照框架——波特五力(Porter's five forces):
① 进入威胁;
② 供应商议价能力;
③ 买方(客户)议价能力;
④ 替代品威胁;
⑤ 现有竞争者之间的竞争。其中"供应商议价能力"是经济学市场结构理论中没有直接对应、但实务分析权重很大的一项。股票分析师说的经济护城河(economic moat):保护企业盈利能力的因素,类似城堡的护城河——进入威胁小、客户因高转换成本被锁定。The analyst's comparative framework — Porter's five forces:
① threat of entry;
② supplier bargaining power;
③ buyer (customer) bargaining power;
④ threat of substitutes;
⑤ rivalry among existing competitors. 'Supplier bargaining power' has no direct counterpart in the economics theory of market structure but carries great weight in practical analysis. What equity analysts call an economic moat: the factors that protect a firm's profitability, like a castle's moat — a small threat of entry, customers locked in by high switching costs.

13. 下列哪种市场结构的企业有明确定义的供给函数:Firms in which market structure have a well-defined supply function: 官方题Official

  • A. 垄断竞争Monopolistic competition
  • B. 寡头垄断Oligopoly
  • C. 完全竞争(供给曲线即 MC 曲线)Perfect competition (the supply curve is the MC curve)
答案 C。只有完全竞争有独立于需求的供给曲线(其 MC 曲线)。Answer C. Only perfect competition has a supply curve independent of demand (its MC curve).
1. 分析师收集了三个市场的信息:
市场卖方数量非价格竞争
市场 1多无
市场 2少强
市场 3多强
哪个市场最可能是寡头垄断?1. An analyst gathers the following information about three markets:
MarketNumber of SellersNon-Price Competition
Market 1ManyNone
Market 2FewStrong
Market 3ManyStrong
Which market is most likely an oligopoly? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 市场 1。Market 1.
  • B. 市场 2。Market 2.
  • C. 市场 3。Market 3.
答案 B。寡头垄断(oligopoly)= 少数几家大企业、集中度高。看指标:市场2 的集中度(如少数企业占大份额/HHI 较高但非垄断)最符合寡头特征。完全竞争企业极多、垄断只有一家。Answer B. An oligopoly = a few large firms, high concentration. By the metrics, market 2 (a few firms holding a large share / high-but-not-monopoly HHI) best fits oligopoly. Perfect competition has very many firms; monopoly has one.
2. 在下列哪种市场结构中,边际收益等于价格?2. In which of the following market structures does marginal revenue equal price? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 寡头垄断。Oligopoly.
  • B. 垄断。Monopoly.
  • C. 完全竞争。Perfect competition.
答案 C。只有完全竞争企业是价格接受者,MR = P(多卖一单位仍按市价)。垄断、寡头有定价权,MR < P(要降价才能多卖)。Answer C. Only in perfect competition is the firm a price taker, so MR = P (each extra unit sells at the market price). Monopoly/oligopoly have pricing power, so MR < P (must cut price to sell more).
3. 以同质/标准化产品为特征的市场结构最恰当地被描述为:3. A market structure characterized by homogeneous/standardized product differentiation is best described as: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 垄断。monopoly.
  • B. 垄断竞争。monopolistic competition.
  • C. 完全竞争与寡头垄断。perfect competition and oligopoly.
答案 C。同质/标准化产品见于完全竞争(如农产品)与部分寡头(如钢铁、石油)。垄断竞争靠差异化产品,垄断只有一家。故选"完全竞争与寡头"。Answer C. Homogeneous/standardized products occur in perfect competition (e.g., commodities) and some oligopolies (e.g., steel, oil). Monopolistic competition relies on differentiated products; monopoly has one seller. Hence "perfect competition and oligopoly."

LM1 §5 垄断竞争LM1 §5 Monopolistic Competition

LOS 对应:LOS: explain supply and demand relationships under monopolistic competition, including the optimal price and output for firms as well as pricing strategy。

垄断竞争是"混合"市场:竞争的一面是大量企业,垄断的一面来自产品差异化(Chamberlin 与 Joan Robinson 提出)。五个特征:Monopolistic competition is a 'hybrid' market: the competitive side is many firms, the monopoly side comes from product differentiation (proposed by Chamberlin and Joan Robinson). Five features:

  1. 潜在买卖双方数量众多;A large number of potential buyers and sellers;
  2. 各家产品是彼此的近似替代品,但每家都努力显得与众不同;Each firm's product is a close substitute for the others', but each tries to appear distinctive;
  3. 进入与退出成本较低;Relatively low entry and exit costs;
  4. 企业有一定定价权;Firms have some pricing power;
  5. 靠广告等非价格策略实现差异化(成功的广告与品牌塑造带来客户忠诚,如哈雷摩托、可口可乐)。Differentiation via non-price strategies such as advertising (successful advertising and branding build customer loyalty, e.g., Harley-Davidson, Coca-Cola).

短期均衡

因为产品有差异,单个企业的需求曲线向右下方倾斜。短期利润最大化:产量取 MR = MC 之处(Q₁),价格由需求曲线读出(P₁)。TR = P₁×Q₁ 矩形面积,TC = C₁×Q₁(C₁ 为该产量下的平均成本),经济利润 = 两矩形之差。短期可以有正经济利润。Because products differ, a single firm's demand curve slopes down to the right. Short-run profit maximization: set output where MR = MC (Q₁), and read the price off the demand curve (P₁). TR = P₁×Q₁ (a rectangle), TC = C₁×Q₁ (C₁ is the average cost at that output), and economic profit = the difference between the two rectangles. There can be positive economic profit in the short run.

没有明确定义的供给函数

完全竞争下企业的供给曲线就是其 MC 曲线(高于最低 AVC 的部分);垄断竞争(以及寡头)没有明确定义的供给函数——产量由 MC 与 MR 的交点决定,价格却由需求曲线决定,不存在"价格→供给量"的一一对应关系。这是高频考点:只有完全竞争企业有明确定义的供给函数。Under perfect competition a firm's supply curve is its MC curve (the part above minimum AVC); monopolistic competition (and oligopoly) have no well-defined supply function — output is set by the intersection of MC and MR, but price is set by the demand curve, and there is no one-to-one 'price → quantity supplied' mapping. This is a high-frequency exam point: only a perfectly competitive firm has a well-defined supply function.

长期均衡

经济利润是信号,低进入成本使新企业涌入、分流客户,各家需求曲线左移,直到经济利润归零:P₁ = C₁(需求曲线与 AC 曲线相切于均衡产量处)。与完全竞争长期均衡的两点区别:Economic profit is a signal; low entry cost draws in new firms that divert customers, shifting each firm's demand curve left until economic profit reaches zero: P₁ = C₁ (the demand curve is tangent to the AC curve at the equilibrium output). Two differences from the perfect-competition long-run equilibrium:

  • 均衡产量 Q₁ 小于平均成本最低点对应的产量 Q₂ —— 存在"过剩产能",单位成本高于最低平均成本;The equilibrium output Q₁ is below the output Q₂ at minimum average cost — there is 'excess capacity,' and unit cost is above the minimum average cost;
  • 成本中含产品差异化费用(广告等),完全竞争没有这些费用。价格更高、但消费者获得多样性。教材强调:多样性与差异化激励创新(熊彼特视角),德日互相进口汽车就是"消费者喜爱多样性"的证据——垄断竞争未必是坏事。Costs include product-differentiation expenses (advertising, etc.) that perfect competition lacks. The price is higher, but consumers gain variety. The text stresses: variety and differentiation incentivize innovation (a Schumpeterian view), and Germany and Japan importing each other's cars is evidence that 'consumers love variety' — monopolistic competition is not necessarily bad.

14. "许多卖家 + 一定定价权 + 产品差异化"对应的市场结构是:"Many sellers + some pricing power + product differentiation" corresponds to which market structure: 官方题Official

  • A. 完全竞争Perfect competition
  • B. 垄断竞争Monopolistic competition
  • C. 寡头垄断Oligopoly
答案 B。"少数卖家 + 同质/标准化产品"才是寡头垄断。Answer B. "Few sellers + homogeneous/standardized product" is oligopoly.
1. 若完全竞争行业变为垄断竞争,则每家企业每单位销售的长期平均总成本最可能:1. If a perfectly competitive industry becomes monopolistically competitive, each firm's long-run average total cost per unit sold will most likely: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 下降。decrease.
  • B. 保持不变。remain the same.
  • C. 上升。increase.
答案 C。完全竞争→垄断竞争:企业要花钱差异化(广告/品牌)并在低于最优规模处生产 → 长期单位平均总成本上升。Answer C. Moving from perfect to monopolistic competition, firms spend on differentiation (advertising/branding) and produce below efficient scale → long-run average total cost per unit rises.
2. 垄断竞争的最佳特征是:2. Monopolistic competition is best characterized by: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 高进入与退出壁垒。high barriers to entry and exit.
  • B. 买卖双方数量少。a small number of buyers and sellers.
  • C. 通过非价格策略实现产品差异化。product differentiation through non-price strategies.
答案 C。垄断竞争(monopolistic competition)的核心特征 = 通过非价格策略(品牌、广告、质量)实现产品差异化。它进入壁垒低、企业众多,故 A、B 错。Answer C. The hallmark of monopolistic competition = product differentiation via non-price strategies (branding, advertising, quality). Entry barriers are low and firms are many, so A and B are wrong.
3. 在长期中,垄断竞争企业:3. In the long run, a monopolistically competitive firm: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 赚取正的经济利润。earns positive economic profits.
  • B. 面对完全弹性的需求曲线。faces a perfectly elastic demand curve.
  • C. 在高于最低平均成本的水平上生产。produces at a higher level of average cost than the minimum average cost.
答案 C。长期中垄断竞争企业:经济利润→零(有进入),需求线向下倾斜(非完全弹性),且在高于最低平均成本处生产(存在过剩产能)。故 C。Answer C. In the long run a monopolistic competitor: economic profit → zero (free entry), a downward-sloping (not perfectly elastic) demand curve, and produces above minimum average cost (excess capacity). Hence C.
4. 在垄断竞争市场结构下经营的企业最可能:4. Firms operating under a monopolistic competition market structure most likely: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 竞争者很少。have few competitors.
  • B. 受益于高进入壁垒。benefit from high barriers to entry.
  • C. 出售与其他企业产品互为紧密替代品的产品。sell products that are close substitutes for those offered by other firms.
答案 C。垄断竞争企业出售与对手互为紧密替代(close substitutes)的差异化产品。它对手众多、进入壁垒低,故 A、B 错。Answer C. A monopolistic competitor sells differentiated products that are close substitutes for rivals'. It has many competitors and low entry barriers, so A and B are wrong.
5. 若垄断竞争行业变为完全竞争,则每家企业每单位销售的长期平均总成本最可能:5. If a monopolistically competitive industry becomes perfectly competitive, each firm's long-run average total cost per unit sold will most likely: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 下降。decrease.
  • B. 保持不变。remain the same.
  • C. 上升。increase.
答案 A。垄断竞争→完全竞争:去掉差异化开支、按最优规模生产 → 单位长期平均总成本下降(与 [008] 相反)。Answer A. Moving from monopolistic to perfect competition removes differentiation spending and produces at efficient scale → unit long-run average total cost falls (the reverse of [008]).

LM1 §6 寡头垄断LM1 §6 Oligopoly 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: explain supply and demand relationships under oligopoly, including the optimal price and output for firms as well as pricing strategy。

寡头市场五特征:
① 卖方少;
② 产品互为近似替代(可品牌化或同质);
③ 进入难、壁垒高;
④ 企业通常有可观定价权;
⑤ 常靠营销、功能等非价格策略高度差异化。核心特征是定价相互依存(interdependence):每家的定价决策都要考虑对手的报复。非合谋寡头的三大定价分析框架:弯折需求曲线(价格战逻辑)、古诺假设、纳什均衡。Five features of an oligopoly market:
① few sellers;
② products are close substitutes (branded or homogeneous);
③ entry is hard, barriers high;
④ firms usually have considerable pricing power;
⑤ often highly differentiated via non-price strategies such as marketing and features. The core feature is pricing interdependence: each firm's pricing decision must account for rivals' retaliation. The three pricing-analysis frameworks for non-collusive oligopoly: the kinked demand curve (price-war logic), the Cournot assumption, and Nash equilibrium.

6.1 弯折需求曲线(kinked demand curve)

价格战市场的常见假设:对手会跟进你的降价、但不会跟进你的涨价。于是在现行价格处:A common price-war assumption: rivals follow your price cuts but not your price increases. So at the prevailing price:

  • 涨价段(现行价之上):对手不跟涨,你的客户大量流失 → 需求很有弹性(曲线平缓,记作 DP↑,对应 MRP↑);Increase segment (above the prevailing price): rivals do not follow, so you lose many customers → demand is very elastic (a flat curve, written DP↑, with MRP↑);
  • 降价段(现行价之下):对手跟降,你抢不到份额 → 需求缺乏弹性(曲线陡峭,DP↓,对应 MRP↓)。Decrease segment (below the prevailing price): rivals follow, so you cannot gain share → demand is inelastic (a steep curve, DP↓, with MRP↓).

需求曲线在现行价格处"弯折",MR 曲线在该产量处出现垂直缺口(不连续)。只要 MC 曲线从缺口中穿过(MC₁ 到 MC₃ 之间变动),最优价量组合都不变——这解释了寡头价格为何常年稳定。缺陷:该模型无法解释现行价格最初如何形成,是不完整的定价分析。The demand curve is 'kinked' at the prevailing price, and the MR curve has a vertical gap (discontinuity) at that output. As long as the MC curve passes through the gap (moving between MC₁ and MC₃), the optimal price/quantity combination is unchanged — this explains why oligopoly prices are stable for long stretches. The flaw: the model cannot explain how the prevailing price first formed, so it is an incomplete pricing analysis.

6.2 古诺假设(Cournot assumption)——必会计算

🔰 零基础讲解:古诺模型在解决什么问题?

市场上只有两家公司(双寡头🧋 想象小镇上只有两家奶茶店 A 和 B。你要定"今天做多少杯"——可你多做、对方也多做,街上奶茶一多,价格就被压下来,大家都少赚;你少做又怕把生意让给对方。所以你定产量前得先猜对方会做多少。古诺的偷懒办法是:干脆假设"对方产量不动",我只优化自己那一份。两家都这么算,最后卡在一个谁都不想再改的平衡点。),各自要决定"我生产多少"。难点在于:我卖多少会影响价格,而对方卖多少也会影响价格——我们互相牵制。古诺的简化假设是:我在做决定时,假设对方的产量固定不动,然后我只优化自己的产量。两家都这么想,最后达到一个谁都不想再改的稳定点。There are only two firms in the market (Duopoly🧋 Imagine a small town with only two bubble-tea shops, A and B. You set 'how many cups to make today' — but if you make more, so does the rival, and once the street is flooded with tea the price gets pushed down and everyone earns less; make less and you fear handing business to the rival. So before setting your output you must first guess how much the rival will make. Cournot's shortcut is: just assume 'the rival's output stays fixed' and optimize only your own share. Both compute this way and end up stuck at a balance point neither wants to change.), each deciding 'how much I produce.' The difficulty: how much I sell affects the price, and how much the rival sells also affects the price — we constrain each other. Cournot's simplifying assumption is: when I decide, I assume the rival's output is fixed, then I optimize only my own output. Both think this way and reach a stable point neither wants to change.

下面算例会用到三个高频术语,先用大白话解释:The worked example below uses three high-frequency terms; here they are in plain language first:

  • 需求曲线 QD = 450 − P:价格 P 越高,买的人越少(数量 Q 越小)。反过来写成 P = 450 − Q,意思是"想多卖,就得降价"。Demand curve QD = 450 − P: the higher the price P, the fewer buyers (smaller quantity Q). Rewritten as P = 450 − Q, it means 'to sell more, you must cut the price.'
  • 边际收入 MR:多卖一件商品,总收入增加多少。边际成本 MC:多生产一件,成本增加多少。这里 MC = 30 表示每多造一件花 30 元。Marginal revenue MR: how much total revenue rises from selling one more unit. Marginal cost MC: how much cost rises from producing one more unit. Here MC = 30 means each extra unit costs 30.
  • 利润最大化的铁律:MR = MC——只要"多卖一件带来的收入"还大于"多造一件的成本",就该继续生产;直到两者相等停下,此时利润最大。The iron rule of profit maximization: MR = MC — as long as 'the revenue from one more unit' exceeds 'the cost of one more unit,' keep producing; stop when the two are equal, where profit is maximized.

算例里的 q1、q2 是两家各自的产量(下标 1、2 只是"第几家"的编号);而 q12 里右上角红色的 2 是平方(来自 TR = 价格×数量 展开后的项)。看不懂求导没关系,记住结论套路即可:线性需求 P = a − bQ 时,MR = a − 2bQ(斜率翻倍),再令 MR = MC 联立求解。In the example, q1 and q2 are the two firms' outputs (subscripts 1, 2 are just 'which firm' labels); in q12 the red 2 in the upper right is a square (from expanding TR = price × quantity). Not following the calculus is fine — just remember the result pattern: for a linear demand P = a − bQ, MR = a − 2bQ (double the slope), then set MR = MC and solve simultaneously.

1838 年 Cournot 提出:双寡头中,每家企业假设对方产量不变,在此假设下选自己的利润最大化产量;均衡时谁都无意再改产量。教材完整算例:In 1838 Cournot proposed: in a duopoly, each firm assumes the rival's output is fixed and, under that assumption, chooses its own profit-maximizing output; at equilibrium neither wants to change its output. The full textbook example:

教材算例 · 双寡头古诺均衡

市场需求:QD = 450 − P,常数边际成本 MC = 30(两家相同)。Market demand: QD = 450 − P, constant marginal cost MC = 30 (the same for both firms).

  1. 令 QD = q₁ + q₂,反解需求:P = 450 − (q₁ + q₂)。Let QD = q₁ + q₂ and invert the demand: P = 450 − (q₁ + q₂).
  2. 企业 1 总收入:TR₁ = P·q₁ = 450q₁ − q₁2 − q₁q₂;对 q₁ 求导得 MR₁ = 450 − 2q₁ − q₂。企业 2 对称:MR₂ = 450 − q₁ − 2q₂。Firm 1's total revenue: TR₁ = P·q₁ = 450q₁ − q₁2 − q₁q₂; differentiating w.r.t. q₁ gives MR₁ = 450 − 2q₁ − q₂. Firm 2 is symmetric: MR₂ = 450 − q₁ − 2q₂.
  3. 各自令 MR = MC:450 − 2q₁ − q₂ = 30 且 450 − q₁ − 2q₂ = 30。Each sets MR = MC: 450 − 2q₁ − q₂ = 30 and 450 − q₁ − 2q₂ = 30.
  4. 两式联立(对称性给出 q₁ = q₂):450 − 3q₁ = 30 → q₁ = q₂ = 140,总产量 Q = 280,价格 P = 450 − 280 = 170。Solving simultaneously (symmetry gives q₁ = q₂): 450 − 3q₁ = 30 → q₁ = q₂ = 140, total output Q = 280, price P = 450 − 280 = 170.

三种结构对比(同一需求、同一 MC):Comparison of the three structures (same demand, same MC):

市场结构Market structure求解条件Solving condition产量 QOutput Q价格 PPrice P
完全竞争Perfect competitionP = MC → 450 − Q = 3042030
古诺双寡头Cournot duopoly各自 MR = MCEach sets MR = MC280170
垄断MonopolyMR = MC → 450 − 2Q = 30210240

规律:古诺解永远落在完全竞争与垄断之间;企业数量从 2 增到 3、4……时,均衡逐渐逼近完全竞争解。这是美国反垄断政策的理论基础之一。Pattern: the Cournot solution always lies between perfect competition and monopoly; as the number of firms rises from 2 to 3, 4, …, the equilibrium gradually approaches the perfectly competitive solution. This is one theoretical basis of US antitrust policy.

线性需求 P = a − bQ 时:TR = aQ − bQ2, MR = a − 2bQ
符号Symbol含义Meaning
a需求曲线的纵截距(价格轴截距,Q=0 时买方愿付的最高价)The demand curve's vertical intercept (price-axis intercept, the highest price buyers will pay when Q=0)
b需求曲线斜率的绝对值(本例 a=450, b=1)The absolute value of the demand curve's slope (here a=450, b=1)
q₁, q₂两家寡头各自的产量;QD = q₁ + q₂ 为市场总需求量The two oligopolists' outputs; QD = q₁ + q₂ is total market demand
PC / PCournot / PM分别为完全竞争价格、古诺均衡价格、垄断价格;恒有 PC < PCournot < PMThe perfect-competition price, Cournot-equilibrium price, and monopoly price, respectively; always PC < PCournot < PM

记忆技巧:线性需求下 MR 与需求曲线同截距、斜率翻倍("MR 曲线是需求曲线斜率的两倍陡")。Memory tip: under linear demand, MR shares the demand curve's intercept but has double the slope ('the MR curve is twice as steep as the demand curve').

6.3 纳什均衡(Nash equilibrium)

博弈论(game theory):决策者考虑对手反应的分析工具集。纳什均衡:非合作博弈中,在考虑并预期了对手的理性选择后,没有任何一方能通过单方面改变自己的策略而增加利润的状态。每家都在"给定对手行为下做到最好"。Game theory: the toolkit for analyzing decisions where players account for rivals' reactions. Nash equilibrium: in a non-cooperative game, after considering and anticipating rivals' rational choices, a state in which no party can increase its profit by unilaterally changing its own strategy. Each firm is 'doing its best given the rivals' behavior.'

教材算例 · ArcCo 与 BatCo 定价博弈
BatCo 低价BatCo low priceBatCo 高价BatCo high price
ArcCo 低价ArcCo low priceArc 50 / Bat 70Arc 80 / Bat 0
ArcCo 高价ArcCo high priceArc 300 / Bat 350Arc 500 / Bat 300

联合利润最大的格子是"双高价"(500+300=800),但它不是纳什均衡:给定 ArcCo 高价,BatCo 单方面转低价可从 300 → 350。均衡是"Arc 高价 / Bat 低价"(300, 350)。若 ArcCo 愿意从 500 中分至少 51 给 BatCo,双高价才可维持——这就是合谋(collusion)的动机。The joint-profit-maximizing cell is 'both high price' (500+300=800), but it is not a Nash equilibrium: given ArcCo high, BatCo can unilaterally switch to low and go from 300 → 350. The equilibrium is 'Arc high / Bat low' (300, 350). Only if ArcCo is willing to share at least 51 of its 500 with BatCo can 'both high' be sustained — this is the motive for collusion.

合谋与卡特尔

公开正式的合谋组织称为卡特尔(cartel)(如 OPEC);合谋也可以是隐性的(靠信号,比如一家降价、另一家拒不跟进,暗示"都把价格抬回去")。合谋动机:提高利润、降低现金流不确定性、构筑进入壁垒。合谋成功的六大条件(考试常考"哪种情形合谋更/更不容易"):A formal, open collusive organization is called a cartel (e.g., OPEC); collusion can also be tacit (via signals, e.g., one firm cuts price and the other refuses to follow, hinting 'let's put prices back up'). Motives for collusion: higher profit, less cash-flow uncertainty, building entry barriers. The six conditions for successful collusion (the exam often asks 'in which situation is collusion more/less likely'):

  1. 企业数量少或存在一家主导企业;企业多或份额相近时合谋更难(份额相近时竞争力量压过合谋收益);A small number of firms or the presence of a dominant firm; collusion is harder with many firms or similar shares (when shares are similar, competitive forces outweigh the gains from colluding);
  2. 产品同质程度高;A high degree of product homogeneity;
  3. 各家成本结构相似;Similar cost structures across firms;
  4. 订单小额、高频、规律(降低偷偷违约的诱惑与收益);Orders that are small, frequent, and regular (reducing the temptation and payoff of secretly defecting);
  5. 违约后报复的威胁严厉;A severe threat of retaliation after defection;
  6. 外部竞争程度低。教材案例:2016 年沙特采油成本约 $9/桶 vs 美国页岩油 $23.5、加拿大油砂 $27——海湾国家彼此成本相近易合谋,但 OPEC 把油价抬得太高反而让页岩油变得经济可行,自己招来了外部竞争。A low degree of outside competition. Textbook case: in 2016 Saudi extraction cost was about $9/barrel vs US shale $23.5 and Canadian oil sands $27 — the Gulf states have similar costs and collude easily, but by pushing oil prices too high OPEC made shale economically viable and invited outside competition on itself.

斯塔克尔伯格模型与先动优势

Stackelberg 模型:与古诺的"同时决策"不同,假设序贯决策——领导者先选产量,跟随者观察后再选。领导者可以激进超产,迫使跟随者缩减产量,甚至惩罚/消灭弱者("top dog"策略)。结果:领导者利润高于古诺同时博弈,跟随者更低——即先动优势(first-mover advantage)。The Stackelberg model: unlike Cournot's 'simultaneous decisions,' it assumes sequential decisions — the leader chooses output first, and the follower observes and then chooses. The leader can aggressively overproduce, forcing the follower to cut output, even punishing/eliminating the weak (a 'top dog' strategy). Result: the leader's profit is higher than in the simultaneous Cournot game, and the follower's is lower — a first-mover advantage.

6.4 主导企业价格领导模型

市场中有一家主导企业(dominant firm)(市场份额一般 ≥40%,凭产能更大、成本更低、先入市场或客户忠诚)成为价格制定者,其余小企业跟随定价。记号:DT = 市场总需求;DL = 主导企业面对的需求(总需求的较大一块);MCL = 主导企业边际成本(低);ΣMCF = 各跟随者边际成本之和(高)。The market has one dominant firm (market share usually ≥40%, thanks to greater capacity, lower cost, first-mover entry, or customer loyalty) that becomes the price setter, with the smaller firms following its price. Notation: DT = total market demand; DL = the demand the dominant firm faces (the larger slice of total demand); MCL = the dominant firm's marginal cost (low); ΣMCF = the sum of the followers' marginal costs (high).

  • 主导企业在 MRL = MCL 处定产量 QL,价格 PL 由其需求段 DL 读出;The dominant firm sets output QL where MRL = MCL, and reads price PL off its demand segment DL;
  • 跟随者按 PL 供应余量 QF = QT − QL;The followers supply the remainder QF = QT − QL at PL;
  • 跟随者不敢削价抢份额:主导者成本更低,价格战打不赢;而且价格越低、能存活的小企业越少,主导者份额反而上升;Followers dare not undercut to grab share: the dominant firm has lower cost and cannot be beaten in a price war; and the lower the price, the fewer small firms survive, so the dominant firm's share actually rises;
  • 长期看主导企业份额趋于下降:利润吸引进入,进入者采用更高效技术、边际成本下降(US Steel:1901 年 66% → 1920 年 46% → 1925 年 42%)。价格战应避免——份额收益是暂时的,还压低所有人的收入;创新(尽管有时不经济)才是维持领导地位的方式。In the long run the dominant firm's share tends to fall: profits attract entrants who adopt more efficient technology with lower marginal cost (US Steel: 66% in 1901 → 46% in 1920 → 42% in 1925). Price wars should be avoided — the share gain is temporary and depresses everyone's revenue; innovation (even if sometimes uneconomic) is the way to maintain leadership.
考点提示:两个"外表 vs 行为"的极端:
① 产品易复制、无规模经济、无品牌/专利保护的"寡头",因存在可信的进入威胁,行为等同完全竞争(三家小厂生产易复制无品牌产品→选"完全竞争");
② 有效的卡特尔行为等同垄断(合作均衡而非纳什均衡)。判断市场结构看行为,不只看家数。另:许多企业+存在价差的品牌差异(Deep River 例:自有品牌 $2.20 vs 代工房牌 $2.00)→ 垄断竞争。
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

寡头垄断

少数大厂、彼此相互依存(一家定价要考虑对手反应)。常见模型:古诺(产量博弈)、伯特兰(价格博弈)、斯塔克伯格(先动优势)、卡特尔(勾结)、拐折需求曲线。

机制

拐折需求曲线解释价格粘性:涨价对手不跟(需求弹性大)、降价对手跟随(弹性小),故厂商倾向不改价。卡特尔能抬价但成员有背叛(降价抢量)的激励,难持久。

易错对比

① 寡头核心是相互依存;② 拐折曲线 = 价格刚性;③ 卡特尔不稳定源于背叛激励。

Oligopoly

A few large firms that are interdependent (each prices with rivals' reactions in mind). Common models: Cournot (quantity), Bertrand (price), Stackelberg (first-mover), cartel (collusion), the kinked demand curve.

Mechanism

The kinked demand curve explains price stickiness: rivals don't follow a price rise (elastic) but do follow a cut (inelastic), so firms hold price. A cartel can raise prices but members have an incentive to cheat (undercut), so it's unstable.

Common traps

① Oligopoly's essence is interdependence; ② the kinked curve = price rigidity; ③ cartel instability comes from the incentive to cheat.

15. 弯折需求曲线模型解释寡头价格稳定,关键在于:The kinked demand curve model explains oligopoly price stability mainly because: 官方题Official

  • A. 需求曲线完全水平The demand curve is perfectly horizontal
  • B. 企业总是跟涨不跟降Firms always follow price increases but not decreases
  • C. MR 在弯折产量处有垂直缺口,MC 在缺口内变动都不改变最优价量MR has a vertical gap at the kink quantity, so MC moving within the gap does not change the optimal price/quantity
答案 C。对手"跟降不跟涨"造成 MR 缺口;该模型缺陷是无法解释现行价格如何形成。Answer C. Rivals "follow cuts but not increases," creating an MR gap; the model's flaw is that it cannot explain how the prevailing price is set.

16. 下列哪种情形下,合谋更不容易成功:In which situation is collusion LESS likely to succeed: 官方题Official

  • A. 产品同质Homogeneous product
  • B. 各家市场份额相近Similar market shares across firms
  • C. 成本结构相似Similar cost structures
答案 B。份额相近时竞争力量压过合谋收益;A、C 都有利于合谋。Answer B. When shares are similar, competitive forces outweigh the gains from colluding; A and C both favor collusion.

17. 三家小厂生产易复制、无品牌无专利的产品,最能代表其行为的模型是:Three small firms make an easily copied product with no brand or patent; the model that best represents their behavior is: 官方题Official

  • A. 完全竞争Perfect competition
  • B. 垄断Monopoly
  • C. 寡头Oligopoly
答案 A。可信的进入威胁 + 无差异产品压制定价权;判断结构看行为,不只看家数。Answer A. A credible entry threat plus an undifferentiated product suppresses pricing power; judge structure by behavior, not just the number of firms.

18. 价格领导模型中,小企业削价挑战主导企业,主导企业市场份额的短期与长期趋势是:In the price-leadership model, small firms undercut the dominant firm; the dominant firm's market-share trends in the short and long run are: 官方题Official

  • A. 短期上升,长期下降Rises in the short run, falls in the long run
  • B. 短期下降,长期上升Falls in the short run, rises in the long run
  • C. 长短期都上升Rises in both the short and long run
答案 A。短期价格下降淘汰高成本小厂(份额升);长期利润吸引更高效进入者(份额降,如 US Steel 66%→42%)。Answer A. A short-run price cut drives out high-cost small firms (share rises); in the long run profits attract more efficient entrants (share falls, e.g., US Steel 66%→42%).

19. 纳什(Nash)均衡的定义是:The definition of a Nash equilibrium is: 官方题Official

  • A. 给定对手策略,没有一方能靠单方面改变策略获益的状态A state in which, given the rivals' strategies, no party can gain by unilaterally changing its own strategy
  • B. 联合利润最大化的状态A state of joint-profit maximization
  • C. 所有企业都退出市场的状态A state in which all firms exit the market
答案 A。纳什均衡常不等于联合利润最大化(后者需合谋维持)。Answer A. A Nash equilibrium is often NOT joint-profit maximization (which requires sustained collusion).

20. 市场需求 Q=450−P、MC=30,古诺双寡头均衡的总产量 Q 最接近:With market demand Q = 450 − P and MC = 30, the total output Q at the Cournot duopoly equilibrium is closest to: 官方题Official

  • A. 210(垄断水平)210 (the monopoly level)
  • B. 280(q₁=q₂=140,P=170)280 (q₁ = q₂ = 140, P = 170)
  • C. 420(完全竞争水平)420 (the perfectly competitive level)
答案 B。古诺产量介于垄断(210)与完全竞争(420)之间;此处各产 140、合计 280,P=170。Answer B. Cournot output lies between monopoly (210) and perfect competition (420); here each produces 140, totaling 280, with P = 170.
1. 在寡头垄断市场中,下列哪项最能描述这样一种情形:各企业基于对竞争者选择的预期,没有动机偏离当前定价策略?1. In an oligopoly market, which of the following best describes the situation when firms have no incentive to deviate from their current pricing strategy based on the anticipated choices of competitors? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 纳什均衡。The Nash equilibrium.
  • B. 斯塔克伯格模型。The Stackelberg model.
  • C. 定价相互依存。Pricing interdependence.
答案 A。纳什均衡(Nash equilibrium):在预期对手选择下,没有一方有动机单方面改变策略。斯塔克伯格是领导-跟随的数量博弈;定价相互依存是寡头特征而非该均衡定义。Answer A. A Nash equilibrium: given expectations of rivals' choices, no party has an incentive to unilaterally change strategy. Stackelberg is a leader-follower quantity game; pricing interdependence is an oligopoly feature, not this equilibrium's definition.

LM1 §7 判定市场结构:集中度指标LM1 §7 Identifying Market Structure: Concentration Measures 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: identify the type of market structure within which a firm operates; describe the use and limitations of concentration measures。

7.1 计量经济学方法及其困难

理论上应估计市场的需求与供给弹性:需求弹性大 → 接近完全竞争;需求刚性(缺乏弹性)→ 企业可能有市场势力。困难:In theory one should estimate the market's demand and supply elasticities: high demand elasticity → close to perfect competition; rigid (inelastic) demand → firms may have market power. The difficulties:

  • 内生性(endogeneity):观测到的价格与数量是需求和供给共同决定的均衡值,不能单独代表需求或供给,须建立两方程模型(需求量方程 + 供给量方程)分别估计;Endogeneity: observed prices and quantities are equilibrium values jointly determined by demand and supply, so they cannot represent demand or supply alone; a two-equation model (a quantity-demanded equation + a quantity-supplied equation) must be built to estimate each separately;
  • 时间序列法需要长样本(如 20 年季度数据),但期间市场结构可能已剧变,历史弹性不适用于当下,并购后更不适用;The time-series method needs a long sample (e.g., 20 years of quarterly data), but the market structure may have changed drastically over that period, so historical elasticities do not apply to the present, and even less so after mergers;
  • 横截面法数据采集量巨大,且解释变量设定不同(用 GDP 还是人均收入代表收入)会导致估计大相径庭。The cross-sectional method requires vast data collection, and different explanatory-variable specifications (using GDP vs per-capita income for income) can lead to wildly different estimates.

7.2 集中度比率 CR

CRN = s1 + s2 + … + sN
符号Symbol含义Meaning
CRN前 N 家集中度比率 N-firm concentration ratio:市场份额最大的 N 家企业份额之和,取值 0(完全竞争)到 100%(垄断)N-firm concentration ratio: the sum of the market shares of the N largest firms, from 0 (perfect competition) to 100% (monopoly)
si第 i 大企业的市场份额(其销售额 ÷ 市场总销售额)The i-th largest firm's market share (its sales ÷ total market sales)
N纳入计算的企业家数(常用 3、4、10 家)The number of firms included (commonly 3, 4, or 10)

优点:计算简单。缺点:
① 不能直接量化市场势力——若进入壁垒低,唯一的在位者也可能被"潜在进入者"逼得按完全竞争定价(教材例:一国唯一的糖批发商,因其他食品批发商随时可进口糖而不敢抬价);
② 对头部企业间的并购不敏感。Pro: simple to compute. Cons:
① it cannot directly quantify market power — with low entry barriers, even a sole incumbent may be forced to price competitively by 'potential entrants' (textbook example: a country's only sugar wholesaler dares not raise prices because other food wholesalers can import sugar at any time);
② it is insensitive to mergers among the top firms.

教材算例 · CR 对并购不敏感

八家企业份额:35%, 25%, 20%, 10%, 2.5%×4。CR₃ = 35+25+20 = 80%,CR₄ = 90%。前两名合并后(60%):CR₃ = 60+20+10 = 90%,CR₄ = 92.5% —— 变化轻微,却诞生了一个控制 60% 市场的巨头。Eight firms with shares 35%, 25%, 20%, 10%, 2.5%×4. CR₃ = 35+25+20 = 80%, CR₄ = 90%. After the top two merge (60%): CR₃ = 60+20+10 = 90%, CR₄ = 92.5% — a slight change, yet it creates a giant controlling 60% of the market.

7.3 赫芬达尔–赫希曼指数 HHI

🔰 零基础讲解:HHI 到底在算什么?

先想一个问题:一个市场是"被少数几家垄断"还是"很多家公平竞争"?我们需要一个数字来衡量"集中程度"。上一节的集中度比率 CR 只是把前几家的份额相加,但它有个毛病——分不清"一家独大"和"几家平分"。First consider a question: is a market 'monopolized by a few' or 'fairly competed by many'? We need a number to measure 'concentration.' The concentration ratio CR from the previous section just adds up the top few shares, but it has a flaw — it cannot tell apart 'one dominant firm' from 'several equal shares.'

HHI 的巧思是:先把每家的市场份额平方再相加。为什么平方?因为平方会放大大公司、缩小小公司。举个例子:一家占 50%(0.5),平方后是 0.25;一家占 10%(0.1),平方后只有 0.01。同样是"份额",大公司平方后的贡献是小公司的 25 倍。所以一旦某家独大,HHI 就会明显变大——它比 CR 更能反映"真实的集中/垄断程度"。The clever idea of the HHI: first square each firm's market share, then sum. Why square? Because squaring magnifies big firms and shrinks small ones. For example: a firm at 50% (0.5) becomes 0.25 when squared; a firm at 10% (0.1) becomes only 0.01. For the same 'share,' the big firm's squared contribution is 25 times the small firm's. So once one firm dominates, the HHI rises noticeably — it reflects the 'true degree of concentration/monopoly' better than CR.

公式里 s1、s2 那个右下角的小数字(下标)只是编号,表示"第 1 家、第 2 家"(不是乘法也不是次方);而 s2 那个右上角的红色小 2(上标)才是"平方"。算之前务必把百分数变成小数:35% 要写成 0.35 再平方,不能用 35 去平方。In the formula, the small lower-right number (subscript) in s1, s2 is just a label meaning 'firm 1, firm 2' (not multiplication or a power); it is the red small 2 in the upper right (superscript) in s2 that means 'square.' Before computing, always convert percentages to decimals: write 35% as 0.35 and then square — do not square 35.

HHI = s12 + s22 + … + sN2
符号Symbol含义Meaning
HHIHerfindahl–Hirschman index:前 N 家市场份额(用小数表示)的平方和。垄断时 = 1;M 家等份额企业时 = 1/MHerfindahl–Hirschman index: the sum of squares of the top N firms' market shares (expressed as decimals). Under monopoly = 1; with M equal-share firms = 1/M
si第 i 家企业市场份额,以小数表示(35% 记 0.35)再平方The i-th firm's market share, expressed as a decimal (35% as 0.35) and squared
M等份额情形下的企业家数;HHI = 0.20 相当于 5 家企业均分市场The number of firms in the equal-share case; HHI = 0.20 corresponds to 5 firms splitting the market equally

沿用上例:合并前 HHI₃ = 0.352 + 0.252 + 0.202 = 0.225;合并后 = 0.602 + 0.202 + 0.102 = 0.410,几乎翻倍——HHI 成功捕捉了 CR 漏掉的并购效应,因此被竞争监管机构广泛使用。局限(与 CR 相同):不考虑进入的可能性、不考虑需求弹性,对分析师预测企业盈利能力用途有限。Continuing the example: before the merger HHI₃ = 0.352 + 0.252 + 0.202 = 0.225; after = 0.602 + 0.202 + 0.102 = 0.410, nearly double — the HHI successfully captures the merger effect that CR misses, so competition regulators use it widely. Limitations (same as CR): it ignores the possibility of entry and demand elasticity, so it is of limited use for analysts forecasting firm profitability.

教材例题 · HHI 速算

10 家企业各占 10%:CR₄ = 40%,HHI₄ = 0.102×4 = 0.04。五家企业 35/25/20/10/10:三家 HHI = 0.225;四家 CR = 90%。分析师数据题:六家销售额 300/250/200/150/100/50(百万欧元),CR₄ = 900/1050 = 86%。Ten firms at 10% each: CR₄ = 40%, HHI₄ = 0.102×4 = 0.04. Five firms at 35/25/20/10/10: three-firm HHI = 0.225; four-firm CR = 90%. Analyst data question: six firms with sales 300/250/200/150/100/50 (€ millions), CR₄ = 900/1050 = 86%.

考点提示:反垄断背景:美国 ADM 赖氨酸价格操纵案(罚款超 1 亿美元)、1970 年代 AT&T 拆分、欧盟委员会否决 GE–霍尼韦尔合并。分析师听到并购新闻应立即考虑竞争法(反垄断法)是否会阻止交易。HHI 考题两大坑:
① 忘了把百分数化成小数再平方;
② 问"HHI 的缺点"——答"未反映低进入壁垒"(而"对并购不敏感"是 CR 的缺点,别张冠李戴)。
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

市场集中度指标

• N 厂集中度(CRn):前 N 大厂市占之和。简单但忽略合并/规模分布。
• 赫芬达尔指数(HHI):各厂市占的平方和。更能反映规模分布,并购前后变化明显。

局限

两者都不反映进入壁垒与潜在竞争:一个高集中度但易进入的市场,厂商定价力仍可能很弱。

易错对比

① HHI = 份额平方和,对大厂更敏感;② 并购使 HHI 上升;③ 两指标都忽略潜在进入者——高集中 ≠ 高定价力。

Market concentration measures

• N-firm concentration (CRn): the sum of the top N shares. Simple but ignores mergers/size distribution.
• Herfindahl-Hirschman Index (HHI): the sum of squared shares. Better reflects size distribution; changes clearly around mergers.

Limitation

Both ignore entry barriers and potential competition: a highly concentrated but easy-to-enter market may still leave firms with little pricing power.

Common traps

① HHI = sum of squared shares, sensitive to big firms; ② a merger raises HHI; ③ both ignore potential entrants — high concentration ≠ high pricing power.

21. 六家企业销售额 300/250/200/150/100/50,四家集中度 CR₄ 最接近:Six firms have sales of 300/250/200/150/100/50; the four-firm concentration ratio CR₄ is closest to: 官方题Official

  • A. 71%71%
  • B. 90%90%
  • C. 86%86%
答案 C。CR₄ = (300+250+200+150)/1050 = 900/1050 = 86%。Answer C. CR₄ = (300+250+200+150)/1050 = 900/1050 = 86%.

22. HHI 指标的缺点是:A drawback of the HHI is: 官方题Official

  • A. 计算困难It is hard to compute
  • B. 未反映进入壁垒与需求弹性的高低It does not reflect the height of entry barriers or demand elasticity
  • C. 未反映并购影响It does not reflect the effect of mergers
答案 B。HHI 恰能反映并购(C 是 CR 的缺点),计算也不难;但它不考虑进入壁垒与需求弹性。Answer B. HHI does reflect mergers (C is a drawback of CR) and is not hard to compute; but it ignores entry barriers and demand elasticity.
1. 计算赫芬达尔—赫希曼指数(HHI)的方法是:1. To calculate the Herfindahl–Hirschman index: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 把最大若干企业的市场份额相加。add the market shares of the largest firms.
  • B. 先把最大若干企业的份额相加,再对和平方。add the market shares of the largest firms and then square the sum.
  • C. 先把最大若干企业的份额各自平方,再求和。square the market shares of the largest firms and then add the results.
答案 C。HHI = 各大企业市场份额(小数或百分数)先"平方"再"求和"。B 顺序反了(先加再平方),A 是集中率 CRn。Answer C. HHI = each leading firm's market share is squared first, then summed. B reverses the order (sum then square); A is the concentration ratio CRn.

LM2 §1 商业周期的定义与三种周期概念LM2 §1 Definition of the Business Cycle & Three Cycle Concepts

LOS 对应:LOS: describe the business cycle and its phases —— 描述商业周期及其阶段。

Burns 与 Mitchell(1946,《Measuring Business Cycles》)的经典定义:商业周期(business cycle)是主要以企业形式组织生产的国家总体经济活动中的一种波动:一个周期由许多经济活动大致同时发生的扩张、随后同样普遍的衰退、收缩,以及并入下一周期扩张阶段的复苏构成;周期反复出现但不具有周期性(recurrent but not periodic);持续时间从一年以上到 10–12 年不等。四个要点:The classic definition of Burns and Mitchell (1946, Measuring Business Cycles): a business cycle is a fluctuation in the aggregate economic activity of nations that organize production mainly through firms: a cycle consists of expansions occurring at roughly the same time in many activities, followed by similarly general recessions and contractions, and a recovery that merges into the next cycle's expansion; cycles are recurrent but not periodic; duration ranges from over a year to 10–12 years. Four key points:

  1. 只适用于以企业为主组织生产的经济体(不适用于农业社会或计划经济);Applies only to economies that organize production mainly through firms (not to agrarian societies or planned economies);
  2. 阶段序列可预期:扩张与收缩交替;The sequence of phases is expectable: expansions and contractions alternate;
  3. 各阶段在全经济范围内大致同步发生;Each phase occurs roughly synchronously across the whole economy;
  4. 反复但不定期:每轮强度、时长不同。Recurrent but not periodic: each round differs in intensity and duration.

三种周期概念(易混,单独记)

概念Concept刻画对象What it describes特点Features
古典周期 classical cycleClassical cycle经济活动绝对水平的波动(如实际 GDP 总量)Fluctuations in the absolute level of economic activity (e.g., the level of real GDP)收缩期短、扩张期长;实务中很少使用——无法区分短期波动与长期趋势,且绝对下降并不常见Short contractions, long expansions; rarely used in practice — it cannot separate short-run fluctuations from the long-run trend, and absolute declines are uncommon
增长周期 growth cycleGrowth cycle经济活动围绕长期潜在(趋势)水平的波动,即产出缺口的开合Fluctuations of economic activity around the long-run potential (trend) level, i.e., the opening and closing of the output gap最贴近主流经济学思维:把活动分解为长期趋势 + 短期波动;峰比古典周期早、谷比古典周期晚;高于/低于趋势的时段长度大致相当。教材后续默认采用此概念Closest to mainstream economic thinking: decompose activity into a long-run trend + short-run fluctuations; peaks come earlier and troughs later than in the classical cycle; the periods above and below trend are roughly equal in length. The text adopts this concept by default hereafter
增长率周期 growth rate cycleGrowth-rate cycle经济活动增长率的波动(如 GDP 增速)Fluctuations in the growth rate of economic activity (e.g., the GDP growth rate)拐点识别最早;优点是无需先估计长期增长路径Identifies turning points earliest; its advantage is not needing to estimate the long-run growth path first
考点提示:"衰退何时开始"的简易规则:实际 GDP 连续两个季度负增长。但该规则可能误导(负、微正、负的序列就漏判),所以美国由 NBER 商业周期测定委员会综合就业、工业生产、销售等多个变量判定峰谷——由于数据发布滞后且会被修订,NBER 的判定往往在拐点发生很久之后才公布。

23. 商业周期"recurrent but not periodic"(反复但不定期)的含义是:The meaning of the business cycle being "recurrent but not periodic" is: 官方题Official

  • A. 一生只发生一次It happens only once in a lifetime
  • B. 反复出现,但每轮时长与强度不同、无固定周期It recurs, but each round differs in length and intensity with no fixed period
  • C. 以固定间隔精确重复It repeats precisely at fixed intervals
答案 B。周期反复但每轮各异,故不可按固定周期外推。Answer B. Cycles recur but each is different, so they cannot be extrapolated on a fixed period.

LM2 §2 周期四阶段及各变量的表现LM2 §2 The Four Cycle Phases & Behavior of Variables

以增长周期(产出缺口)视角,整个周期分四个阶段。产出缺口(output gap) = 实际产出 − 潜在产出。From the growth-cycle (output-gap) perspective, the cycle has four phases. The output gap = actual output − potential output.

阶段Phase复苏 RecoveryRecovery扩张 ExpansionExpansion放缓 SlowdownSlowdown收缩 ContractionContraction
描述Description经济走过谷底(trough),实际产出相对潜在产出处于最低;负缺口开始收窄The economy passes the trough, with actual output at its lowest relative to potential; the negative gap begins to narrow上行加速,增速高于平均;实际产出升破潜在产出,进入"繁荣(boom)";正缺口打开The upturn accelerates, growth above average; actual output rises above potential, entering a 'boom'; a positive gap opens经济到达峰顶(peak),正缺口最大后开始收窄;增速开始低于潜在增速The economy reaches the peak, and after the positive gap is largest it begins to narrow; growth falls below the potential rate实际产出跌破潜在产出,负缺口打开;若绝对活动下降为衰退(recession),特别严重则为萧条(depression)Actual output falls below potential, opening a negative gap; if absolute activity declines it is a recession, and if especially severe, a depression
消费者与企业活动Consumer & business activity低于潜在水平但开始回升Below potential but beginning to recover活动指标高于平均增长Activity indicators above average growth高于平均但在减速;可能出现要素短缺、加班替代招聘Above average but decelerating; factor shortages may appear, with overtime replacing hiring低于潜在水平;信心下滑,企业砍成本Below potential; confidence falls and firms cut costs
就业Employment裁员放缓;企业先用加班,不急于招人;失业率仍高于平均Layoffs slow; firms use overtime first and are in no rush to hire; unemployment still above average从加班/临时工转向正式招聘;失业率企稳回落Shift from overtime/temps to permanent hiring; unemployment stabilizes and falls继续招聘但速度放慢;失业率下降但降速递减Hiring continues but slows; unemployment falls but at a diminishing pace先砍工时、取消加班、冻结招聘,然后裁员;失业率开始上升First cut hours, cancel overtime, freeze hiring, then lay off; unemployment begins to rise
通胀Inflation保持温和Stays mild温和抬头Ticks up mildly进一步加速Accelerates further减速,但有滞后Decelerates, but with a lag

各阶段的市场表现与投资者行为

  • 复苏:市场预期衰退结束时,风险资产被重新定价上调;市场把更高的盈利预期计入公司债与股票价格。股市通常在经济触底前 3–6 个月见底——股市是领先指标。Recovery: when the market expects the recession to end, risky assets are repriced upward; the market prices higher earnings expectations into corporate bonds and stocks. The stock market usually bottoms 3–6 months before the economy does — the stock market is a leading indicator.
  • 扩张(繁荣段):经济"测试极限":信心强、利润与信贷高增;企业招工困难、加薪抢人、靠现金流和借贷扩产能;政府/央行可能因担心过热而出手。Expansion (boom segment): the economy 'tests its limits': strong confidence, fast-growing profits and credit; firms struggle to hire, raise pay to compete for workers, and expand capacity via cash flow and borrowing; the government/central bank may act on overheating fears.
  • 放缓:繁荣期风险最高的资产往往已大涨;避险资产(国债)价格更低、收益率更高;投资者担心通胀推高名义收益率。Slowdown: the riskiest assets have usually already surged during the boom; safe-haven assets (government bonds) are cheaper with higher yields; investors worry that inflation is pushing up nominal yields.
  • 收缩:投资者转向安全资产:政府债券、现金流稳定(或增长)的公用事业与必需消费品公司股票——就业不稳时,安全收入流的边际效用上升。Contraction: investors shift to safe assets: government bonds and the stocks of utilities and consumer-staples firms with stable (or growing) cash flows — when employment is shaky, the marginal utility of a safe income stream rises.
考点提示:企业和家庭的决策相对拐点存在领先与滞后(leads and lags):例如扩张初期企业宁可先榨干现有员工产能、确认经济真的在增长后才招人——这就是为什么"就业水平"滞后于周期。做题时把"谁先动、谁后动"想成本能反应:砍加班容易、裁员难;下单容易、建厂慢。

24. "通胀加速 + 企业大量举债扩张产能"最能描述哪个阶段:"Accelerating inflation + firms taking on heavy debt to expand capacity" best describes which phase: 官方题Official

  • A. 谷底(trough)The trough
  • B. 复苏初期Early recovery
  • C. 周期峰顶(peak)The cycle peak
答案 C。通胀进一步加速、债务融资的资本开支在顶部最盛,是典型峰顶特征。Answer C. Further-accelerating inflation and debt-financed capital spending are most intense at the top — classic peak features.
1. 在商业周期的复苏阶段,通胀最可能:1. During the recovery phase of the business cycle, inflation most likely: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 滞后地减速。decelerates but with a lag.
  • B. 保持温和。remains moderate.
  • C. 进一步加速。further accelerates.
答案 B。商业周期复苏(recovery)阶段:经济刚回暖、仍有闲置产能,通胀保持温和。要到扩张后期产能吃紧才加速。Answer B. In the recovery phase, the economy is just picking up with slack capacity, so inflation stays modest. It only accelerates late in the expansion when capacity tightens.
2. 以经济活动增长放缓为特征的商业周期阶段是:2. The business cycle phase that is characterized by slowing growth in economic activity is the: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 放缓期。slowdown.
  • B. 扩张期。expansion.
  • C. 收缩期。contraction.
答案 A。以"增长放缓"为特征 = 放缓期(slowdown)(仍增长但减速)。扩张是加速增长;收缩是负增长。Answer A. Characterized by "slowing growth" = the slowdown phase (still growing but decelerating). Expansion is accelerating growth; contraction is negative growth.

LM2 §3 信贷周期LM2 §3 The Credit Cycle

LOS 对应:LOS: describe credit cycles —— 描述信贷周期。

信贷周期(credit cycle)描述信贷可得性与定价的变化,即私人部门信贷(贷款的可得性与使用)的增长——它对企业投资和家庭购置房产至关重要,因此与刻画实际 GDP 波动的商业周期相互关联。信贷周期是更宽泛的"金融周期(financial cycles)"家族的一个子集。The credit cycle describes changes in the availability and pricing of credit — the growth of private-sector credit (the availability and use of loans). It is vital to business investment and household home purchases, so it is interlinked with the business cycle that describes real-GDP fluctuations. The credit cycle is a subset of the broader family of 'financial cycles.'

  • 经济强劲/改善 → 放贷意愿高、条件优惠;经济疲弱 → 贷款人收紧信贷(更少、更贵)→ 压低房地产等资产价值 → 进一步拖累经济、推升违约(信贷在建筑与购房融资中的重要性所致)。A strong/improving economy → willingness to lend is high and terms favorable; a weak economy → lenders tighten credit (less and dearer) → depressing asset values such as real estate → further dragging on the economy and raising defaults (owing to credit's importance in construction and home-purchase financing).
  • 历史教训:宽松的私人部门信贷被认为促成了 1980s 拉美危机、1990s 墨西哥/巴西/俄罗斯危机、1997–98 亚洲金融危机、2008–09 全球金融危机。宽松信贷常吹起资产价格与房地产泡沫,在资本外流与基本面转弱时破裂。Historical lessons: loose private-sector credit is thought to have contributed to the 1980s Latin American crisis, the 1990s Mexico/Brazil/Russia crises, the 1997–98 Asian financial crisis, and the 2008–09 global financial crisis. Loose credit often inflates asset-price and real-estate bubbles that burst amid capital outflows and weakening fundamentals.
  • 金融摩擦会放大商业周期:伴随金融中断(房价、股价崩跌)的衰退更长更深;伴随信贷快增、风险偏好上升、房价上涨的复苏更强。Financial frictions amplify the business cycle: recessions accompanied by financial disruption (crashing house and stock prices) are longer and deeper; recoveries accompanied by fast credit growth, rising risk appetite, and rising house prices are stronger.
  • 信贷周期比商业周期更长、更深、更陡(longer, deeper, sharper)。两者并不总是同步。The credit cycle is longer, deeper, and sharper than the business cycle. The two are not always synchronized.
  • BIS 研究:金融周期(用实际信贷、信贷/GDP 比率、实际房价的中期滤波合成)往往在衰退前"冲顶"——信贷周期的强峰与随后的系统性银行危机密切相关。BIS research: the financial cycle (synthesized from a medium-term filter of real credit, the credit/GDP ratio, and real house prices) often 'peaks' before a recession — a strong peak in the credit cycle is closely associated with a subsequent systemic banking crisis.

投资者关注信贷周期的三个理由:
① 帮助理解住房与建筑市场;
② 帮助评估商业周期扩张/收缩的幅度(若衰退与信贷收缩期叠加,衰退更严重);
③ 帮助预判政策当局行动——除传统的货币/财政政策外,旨在抑制金融繁荣的宏观审慎稳定政策(macroprudential stabilization policies)地位日益上升。Three reasons investors watch the credit cycle:
① it helps understand the housing and construction markets;
② it helps gauge the magnitude of the business cycle's expansion/contraction (a recession overlapping a credit contraction is more severe);
③ it helps anticipate policymakers' actions — beyond traditional monetary/fiscal policy, macroprudential stabilization policies aimed at curbing financial booms are increasingly prominent.

LM2 §4 资源使用的周期波动LM2 §4 Cyclical Fluctuation of Resource Use

LOS 对应:LOS: describe how resource use, consumer and business activity, housing sector activity, and external trade sector activity vary over the business cycle and describe their measurement using economic indicators。

4.1 劳动力与企业成本

收缩期企业先砍成本、取消加班,但倾向于留住工人(labor hoarding 的逻辑):招聘与培训成本高,养着未充分利用的员工可能更划算,还能维系忠诚、提升生产率。收缩拖长后才更激进地砍:解约顾问、停广告、裁员。产能利用率低、few 企业投资新设备、企业清库存、银行因破产风险惜贷。总需求下降压低工资(或工资增速)、投入品与资本品价格;利率可能被下调以刺激经济。当价格与利率足够低,消费与总需求回升——这就是周期拐点。就业水平滞后于周期。In a contraction firms first cut costs and cancel overtime but tend to retain workers (the logic of labor hoarding): hiring and training costs are high, so keeping under-utilized staff may be cheaper, while preserving loyalty and boosting productivity. Only if the contraction drags on do they cut more aggressively: terminate consultants, halt advertising, lay off. Capacity utilization is low, few firms invest in new equipment, firms run down inventories, and banks are reluctant to lend on bankruptcy-risk fears. Falling aggregate demand depresses wages (or wage growth), input prices, and capital-goods prices; interest rates may be cut to stimulate. When prices and rates are low enough, consumption and aggregate demand pick up — the cycle's turning point. Employment lags the cycle.

4.2 资本开支的波动

资本开支(capital spending)——对不动产、厂房、设备等有形资产的支出——对经济活动变化高度敏感,是 GDP 中最顺周期、波动最大的组成部分之一。驱动因素:经营状况、预期、产能利用率。Capital spending — spending on tangible assets such as property, plant, and equipment — is highly sensitive to changes in economic activity and is one of the most pro-cyclical and most volatile components of GDP. Drivers: business conditions, expectations, and capacity utilization.

阶段Phase条件与预期Conditions & expectations资本开支行为Capital-spending behavior典型例子Typical example
复苏Recovery谷底产能过剩、利用率低,几乎不需要扩产;利率低支持投资At the trough, overcapacity and low utilization mean little need to expand; low rates support investment低但回升;重效率而非产能;最先恢复的订单是高淘汰率设备Low but recovering; focus on efficiency not capacity; the first orders to return are for high-obsolescence equipment软件、系统、技术硬件订单最先重启;轻型生产设备订单回升最明显Software, systems, and tech-hardware orders restart first; light production-equipment orders rebound most visibly
扩张Expansion条件好转,利用率从低位上升;产能逐渐制约供货;盈利与现金流给了投资的财务能力Conditions improve, utilization rises from lows; capacity gradually constrains supply; profits and cash flow provide the financial capacity to invest订单与利用率上升,转向产能扩张;产能构成可能不匹配需求结构,需要新型设备;订单先于交付,资本品订单是资本开支未来方向的重要观察指标Orders and utilization rise, shifting to capacity expansion; the capacity mix may not match demand, requiring new types of equipment; orders precede deliveries, so capital-goods orders are a key indicator of the future direction of capital spending重型复杂设备、仓库、厂房(且新仓库可能选在与现有设施不同的区位)Heavy, complex equipment, warehouses, plants (and a new warehouse may be sited differently from existing facilities)
放缓Slowdown景气见顶、现金流健康;利率偏高(给过热降温)The boom peaks, cash flow healthy; rates are elevated (to cool overheating)扩产型新订单可能是扩张期进入尾声的早期信号;企业满/近满负荷运转仍在下单New capacity-expansion orders may be an early signal that the expansion is ending; firms running at/near full capacity are still ordering1990s 末光纤过度投资,顶峰即"科技媒体电信泡沫"The late-1990s over-investment in fiber optics, whose peak was the 'tech-media-telecom bubble'
收缩Contraction需求、利润、现金流下滑Demand, profits, and cash flow decline新订单停止、部分已有订单取消;初期削减可能很陡、放大下行;砍维护开支New orders stop and some existing orders are cancelled; early cuts can be steep, amplifying the downturn; maintenance spending is slashed交货周期短的技术与轻设备先被砍;建筑与重型设备随后Short-lead-time tech and light equipment are cut first; construction and heavy equipment follow

注:新订单统计里含多年交付的大单(航空公司一次订 40 架飞机、5 年交付),分析师因此使用剔除国防与飞机的"核心订单"(core orders)观察经济趋势。衰退中企业调整实物资本存量的典型方式不是贱卖设备,而是让设备老化 + 停止维护。Note: new-order data include large multi-year-delivery orders (an airline ordering 40 aircraft for delivery over 5 years), so analysts use 'core orders' (excluding defense and aircraft) to track economic trends. In a recession, firms typically adjust the physical capital stock not by dumping equipment cheaply but by letting equipment age + halting maintenance.

4.3 存货的波动

存货总量占经济比重小,但企业加库存/去库存的速度快、频率高,对经济增长读数的影响可以很大。核心指标:Total inventories are a small share of the economy, but firms build and draw down inventories quickly and frequently, which can greatly affect the reading on economic growth. The core metric:

存货–销售比 = 存货 / 销售额  (inventory–sales ratio)
符号Symbol含义Meaning
存货 inventoryInventory可供出售的存货水平(期末值)The level of inventory available for sale (period-end value)
销售额 salesSales同期销售水平;比率衡量"手里的货够卖多久"Sales over the same period; the ratio measures 'how long the goods on hand will last'
阶段Phase销售与生产Sales & production存货–销售比Inventory-to-sales ratio
复苏Recovery销售降幅收窄后回升;生产回升滞后于销售(先清掉衰退期的过剩库存)Sales declines narrow then reverse; production recovers with a lag behind sales (clearing the recession's excess inventory first)开始下降(销售回升快于生产)Begins to fall (sales recover faster than production)
扩张Expansion销售增长;生产加快以跟上销售并回补库存("re-stocking"),中间品需求上升Sales grow; production speeds up to keep pace with sales and rebuild inventory ('re-stocking'), raising demand for intermediate goods稳定Stable
放缓Slowdown销售放缓快于生产,库存被动堆积;随后减产、砍单Sales slow faster than production, and inventories pile up passively; production and orders are then cut上升——经济转弱的信号Rises — a signal the economy is weakening
收缩Contraction企业以低于销售量的速度生产,消化不想要的库存Firms produce below the sales rate, working off unwanted inventory开始回落至正常Begins to fall back to normal
考点提示:三个高频判断:
① 复苏早期存货往往下降(销售跑赢生产);
② 存货–销售比低时企业要补库存 → 存货趋于上升;
③ 比率上升出现在周期顶部附近。另:劳动生产率(人均产出)在衰退末端最高——企业用最少的人做出最多的产出("lean production")。

4.4 住宅部门的周期变化

住宅通常是利率敏感、领先周期的部门。利率下降和信贷条件放松会先改善购房负担能力，随后带动建筑许可、新屋开工、施工、成交和家具耐用品消费；利率上升与信贷收紧则反向传导。Housing is usually an interest-rate-sensitive, cycle-leading sector. Falling rates and easing credit first improve home affordability, then drive building permits, housing starts, construction, sales, and durable-goods (furniture) consumption; rising rates and tightening credit transmit in reverse.

阶段Phase住宅活动Housing activity常用指标Common indicators
复苏Recovery按揭利率较低、许可和开工先回升，房价和成交逐步改善Mortgage rates are low; permits and starts recover first, and house prices and sales gradually improve建筑许可、新屋开工通常领先；成交量常先于房价Building permits and housing starts usually lead; sales volume often precedes house prices
扩张Expansion就业和收入改善推动成交、施工和房价上涨Improving employment and income drive sales, construction, and rising house prices在建住宅、住宅投资、房价Housing under construction, residential investment, house prices
放缓Slowdown利率和房价较高削弱负担能力，许可与成交先见顶Higher rates and house prices weaken affordability; permits and sales peak first许可、按揭申请和成交下降可作为早期信号Falling permits, mortgage applications, and sales serve as early signals
收缩Contraction开工、施工、成交和房价承压，止赎与拖欠可能上升Starts, construction, sales, and house prices come under pressure; foreclosures and delinquencies may rise库存月数、拖欠率、房价Months of inventory, delinquency rate, house prices

4.5 外贸部门的周期变化

出口取决于贸易伙伴的收入、相对价格和汇率；进口主要取决于本国收入和国内需求。因此，本国强劲扩张往往使进口增加，净出口可能收窄；本国收缩使进口下降，净出口可能改善。若海外经济同时衰退，出口也会下降，净出口未必改善。Exports depend on trading partners' income, relative prices, and the exchange rate; imports depend mainly on domestic income and domestic demand. So a strong domestic expansion tends to raise imports and may narrow net exports; a domestic contraction lowers imports and may improve net exports. If foreign economies are in recession at the same time, exports also fall, and net exports need not improve.

净出口 NX = 出口 X − 进口 M
  • 本币实际升值使本国产品相对昂贵，通常抑制出口并鼓励进口，但效果存在时滞。A real appreciation of the home currency makes domestic goods relatively expensive, usually curbing exports and encouraging imports, but the effect has a lag.
  • 资本品和中间品贸易对全球制造业周期较敏感；大宗商品出口国还受商品价格影响。Trade in capital and intermediate goods is sensitive to the global manufacturing cycle; commodity exporters are also affected by commodity prices.
  • 分析净出口必须同时比较本国与海外周期，不能只看本国经济处于扩张还是收缩。Analyzing net exports requires comparing the domestic and foreign cycles simultaneously, not just whether the domestic economy is expanding or contracting.

25. 每工时产出(劳动生产率)通常在何时最高:Output per labor hour (labor productivity) is usually highest when: 官方题Official

  • A. 衰退刚开始时Just as a recession begins
  • B. 衰退末端(以最少人力做最多事)At the end of a recession (most output with the least labor)
  • C. 扩张顶峰At the peak of an expansion
答案 B。衰退末端 lean production 效率最高;扩张后期最难获得合格工人。Answer B. Lean production at the end of a recession is most efficient; qualified workers are hardest to find late in an expansion.

LM2 §5 经济指标LM2 §5 Economic Indicators 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

5.1 三类指标

经济指标(economic indicators):反映一国/地区/部门经济状况的统计数据,用于评估经济现状与周期位置、预测或确认拐点。按拐点时序分三类:Economic indicators: statistics reflecting the economic conditions of a country/region/sector, used to assess the current state and cycle position and to predict or confirm turning points. By turning-point timing, three types:

类型Type定义Definition教材列举的例子(记熟,考试直接考归类)Textbook examples (memorize — the exam tests classification directly)
领先指标 leadingLeading indicators拐点先于整体经济,用于预测近期未来Turning points precede the overall economy, used to forecast the near future股票市场(S&P 500);房价;零售销售;长短利差(10 年期国债收益率 − 隔夜联邦基金利率);建筑许可;消费者预期;制造业平均每周工时;制造商新订单(消费品与材料);ISM 新订单指数;剔除国防与飞机的资本品新订单;领先信贷指数;平均每周初请失业金人数The stock market (S&P 500); house prices; retail sales; the yield spread (10-year Treasury yield − overnight fed funds rate); building permits; consumer expectations; average weekly manufacturing hours; manufacturers' new orders (consumer goods and materials); the ISM new-orders index; new orders for capital goods excluding defense and aircraft; the leading credit index; average weekly initial unemployment claims
同步指标 coincidentCoincident indicators拐点与整体经济大致同时,判断经济现状Turning points occur roughly at the same time as the overall economy, judging the current state工业生产指数;实际个人收入;制造与贸易销售;非农就业人数Industrial production index; real personal income; manufacturing and trade sales; nonfarm payrolls
滞后指标 laggingLagging indicators拐点晚于整体经济,确认过去的状态、趋势确立后才变化Turning points lag the overall economy, confirming past states and changing only after a trend is established平均失业持续时间;存货–销售比;单位劳动成本变化;通胀;平均最优惠贷款利率(prime rate);消费者分期债务/收入比;工商业未偿贷款Average duration of unemployment; the inventory-to-sales ratio; change in unit labor cost; inflation; the average prime lending rate; the consumer installment-debt/income ratio; commercial and industrial loans outstanding

几个"为什么"(理解了就不用死背):失业率滞后是因为雇佣和解雇都有成本,企业要等趋势确认才动手;复苏期失业率滞后还因为新求职者涌入劳动力市场;消费者只在信心足时才大额借贷,故债务/收入比在上行期滞后、且债务在下行期仍挂在账上;贷款常用于支持库存建设,故工商业贷款滞后;通胀里服务价格黏性强,调整慢。A few 'whys' (understand them and no rote memorization is needed): unemployment lags because hiring and firing both have costs, so firms wait for a confirmed trend before acting; in a recovery unemployment also lags because new job-seekers flood into the labor market; consumers borrow large amounts only when confidence is high, so the debt/income ratio lags in an upturn and debt still sits on the books in a downturn; loans are often used to support inventory building, so commercial/industrial loans lag; in inflation, service prices are sticky and adjust slowly.

5.2 综合指数(composite indicators)

  • 美国世界大型企业联合会(The Conference Board)LEI(Leading Economic Index):10 个成分(上表领先指标中的美国版清单),采用古典周期概念。其中"利差"的逻辑:长端收益率表达市场对短期利率方向的预期,收益率曲线倒挂(短端高于长端)预示短端利率将降、经济活动将弱;利差走阔预示上行。The Conference Board's LEI (Leading Economic Index): 10 components (the US version of the leading-indicator list above), using the classical-cycle concept. The logic of the 'yield spread' component: long-end yields express the market's expectation of the direction of short-term rates; an inverted yield curve (short end above long end) signals that short rates will fall and activity will weaken; a widening spread signals an upturn.
  • OECD 综合领先指标 CLI:覆盖约 30 国及 EU、G7 等加总体,用增长周期概念,方法论跨国一致、便于横向比较。欧元区 8 成分:M2 货币供应、经济景气指数、住宅建筑许可、资本品订单、Euro Stoxx 股指、某利差、制造业 PMI、服务业未来经营活动预期指数。欧元区含服务业成分(美国没有)、缺少美国的加班/就业类指标;日本版含劳动力市场指标、另加企业倒闭数。The OECD Composite Leading Indicator (CLI): covers about 30 countries plus aggregates like the EU and G7, using the growth-cycle concept, with a methodology consistent across countries for easy cross-country comparison. The eurozone's 8 components: M2 money supply, the economic sentiment index, residential building permits, capital-goods orders, the Euro Stoxx index, a yield spread, the manufacturing PMI, and the services future-business-activity expectations index. The eurozone version includes a services component (which the US lacks) and lacks the US overtime/employment indicators; Japan's version includes labor-market indicators plus the number of business failures.
  • 调查类指标:德国 ifo 商业景气指数(月度,领先于德国 GDP 同比,但 2018 年曾发出错误信号——"有用但并非万无一失");日本央行"短观 Tankan";各国 PMI(采购经理指数,IHS Markit 编制全球版);Conference Board 全球消费者信心;KOF 与 FGV 合编的全球经济晴雨表(Global Economic Barometers)。Survey indicators: Germany's ifo business-climate index (monthly, leading German year-on-year GDP, though it gave a false signal in 2018 — 'useful but not foolproof'); the Bank of Japan's 'Tankan'; national PMIs (purchasing managers' indexes, with a global version by IHS Markit); the Conference Board's global consumer confidence; and the Global Economic Barometers jointly compiled by KOF and FGV.
  • 大数据指标:芝加哥联储 CFNAI(85 个月度宏观序列做主成分分析提取共同趋势);意大利央行+CEPR 的 EuroCOIN(100+ 序列,含调查、利率与金融变量)。Big-data indicators: the Chicago Fed's CFNAI (a principal-component analysis of 85 monthly macro series to extract a common trend); and EuroCOIN from the Bank of Italy and CEPR (100+ series, including surveys, interest-rate, and financial variables).

5.3 Nowcasting 与 GDPNow

Nowcasting(现时预测):利用金融交易、互联网搜索、电子支付等高频数据,实时估计发布滞后的低频指标(GDP、通胀、失业)的当前值,产出称为 nowcast。与"预测未来"(forecast)不同,nowcast 估计的是"现在"。代表:亚特兰大联储 GDPNow——对当季实际 GDP 增长的"滚动估计",尽量采用与 BEA 相同的方法与数据,未发布的数据用已观测数据预测替代;随着季内实际数据增多,GDPNow 平均而言应收敛于 BEA 季后约四周发布的"预估值(advance estimate)"。Nowcasting: using high-frequency data such as financial transactions, internet searches, and electronic payments to estimate in real time the current value of release-lagged low-frequency indicators (GDP, inflation, unemployment); the output is called a nowcast. Unlike a 'forecast' of the future, a nowcast estimates 'now.' Example: the Atlanta Fed's GDPNow — a 'running estimate' of current-quarter real GDP growth, using the same methods and data as the BEA as far as possible, replacing not-yet-released data with predictions from observed data; as more within-quarter actual data arrive, GDPNow should on average converge to the BEA's 'advance estimate' released about four weeks after the quarter.

5.4 扩散指数(diffusion index)——必会计算

扩散指数反映综合指数中与整体指数方向一致的成分占比,衡量变动的"广度"——它不像算术平均那样被个别异常值带动,而是捕捉所有成分共同的变化。Conference Board 的赋值规则:The diffusion index reflects the share of components moving in the same direction as the overall index within a composite index, measuring the 'breadth' of the change — unlike an arithmetic mean, it is not driven by individual outliers but captures the change common to all components. The Conference Board's scoring rule:

扩散指数 = Σ 成分得分n × 100
符号Symbol含义Meaning
成分得分Component score月涨幅 > +0.05% 记 1.0;变动幅度在 ±0.05% 以内记 0.5;跌幅 > 0.05% 记 0A monthly rise > +0.05% scores 1.0; a change within ±0.05% scores 0.5; a fall > 0.05% scores 0
n综合指数的成分个数(LEI 为 10);×100 使读数形似常见指数The number of components in the composite index (10 for the LEI); ×100 makes the reading resemble a common index
教材算例 · 四成分扩散指数

假设指数只有 4 个成分。
第 1 月:股价 +2.0%(记 1.0)、货币增长 +1.0%(1.0)、订单持平(0.5)、消费者信心 −0.6%(0):指数 = (1.0+1.0+0.5+0)/4 ×100 = 62.5。
第 2 月:股价 −0.8%(0)、货币 +0.5%(1.0)、订单 +0.5%(1.0)、信心 +3.5%(1.0):指数 = 3.0/4×100 = 75。指数上升说明更多成分在上涨——综合指数的上行代表了更广泛的经济动能,分析师可以更有信心。Suppose the index has only 4 components.
Month 1: stock price +2.0% (scores 1.0), money growth +1.0% (1.0), orders flat (0.5), consumer confidence −0.6% (0): index = (1.0+1.0+0.5+0)/4 ×100 = 62.5.
Month 2: stock price −0.8% (0), money +0.5% (1.0), orders +0.5% (1.0), confidence +3.5% (1.0): index = 3.0/4×100 = 75. A rising index means more components are rising — the composite's upturn reflects broader economic momentum, so an analyst can be more confident.

5.5 用指标判断周期位置(分析流程)

教材给出的三步示例(顺序可变):
① 数据发布:消费者分期债务/收入比上升 → 该指标滞后于上行拐点 → 上行早已开始的初步证据;
② 工业生产指数与非农就业走高 → 同步指标显示活动正在加速 → 扩张正在进行的进一步证据;
③ 股指(领先)走高,再查综合 LEI:若同样走高 → 复苏得到确认;若没有 → 无法下结论。核心方法论:任何单一指标都不可靠,要用领先+同步+滞后的组合互相印证。指标体系的构成与算法也会随经验积累不断修订。The textbook's three-step example (order can vary):
① Data release: the consumer installment-debt/income ratio rises → this indicator lags an upturn's turning point → preliminary evidence that the upturn began some time ago;
② the industrial production index and nonfarm payrolls rise → coincident indicators show activity accelerating → further evidence that the expansion is underway;
③ the stock index (leading) rises, then check the composite LEI: if it also rises → the recovery is confirmed; if not → no conclusion. Core methodology: no single indicator is reliable; use a combination of leading + coincident + lagging to corroborate. The indicator system's composition and algorithms are also continually revised with experience.

考点提示:综合判断题是 LM2 最难题型,做法是先给每个指标贴类别标签,再分别读方向。例:利差收窄(领先,预示下行)+资本品新订单下降(领先,下行)+建筑许可下降(领先,下行)+非农由升转降(同步,开始下行)+制造贸易销售持平(同步)+失业持续时间小降、单位劳动成本上升(滞后,反映过去的扩张)→ 结论:经济处于周期峰顶。
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

经济指标:领先 / 同步 / 滞后

• 领先(leading):预示未来——股市、制造业新订单、建筑许可、货币供应(M2)、消费者预期、初请失业金。
• 同步(coincident):与周期同步——GDP、就业人数、工业产出、实际收入。
• 滞后(lagging):拐点后才动——失业持续时长、CPI、单位劳动成本、商业贷款。

易错对比

① 股市、建筑许可、新订单 = 领先;② CPI、失业时长 = 滞后;③ 用领先指标预测拐点、用滞后指标确认。

Economic indicators: leading / coincident / lagging

• Leading: foreshadow the future — stock market, manufacturing new orders, building permits, money supply (M2), consumer expectations, initial jobless claims.
• Coincident: move with the cycle — GDP, employment, industrial production, real income.
• Lagging: turn after the cycle — average duration of unemployment, CPI, unit labor cost, commercial loans.

Common traps

① Stock market, permits, new orders = leading; ② CPI, unemployment duration = lagging; ③ use leading indicators to predict turns, lagging to confirm.

26. 长短期利差收窄、而 prime rate 保持不变,最可能预示:The yield-curve spread narrows while the prime rate stays unchanged; this most likely signals: 官方题Official

  • A. 经济下行(利差是领先指标)An economic downturn (the spread is a leading indicator)
  • B. 经济强劲扩张Strong economic expansion
  • C. 通胀即将飙升Inflation about to surge
答案 A。利差收窄/倒挂预示短率将降、活动转弱;prime rate 是滞后指标,不动很正常。Answer A. A narrowing/inverting spread signals falling short rates and weakening activity; the prime rate is a lagging indicator, so its being unchanged is normal.

27. 服务通胀持平 + 建筑许可上升 + 失业持续时间上升,综合判断:Service inflation flat + building permits rising + unemployment duration rising; the overall judgment is: 官方题Official

  • A. 未来将出现周期性上行A cyclical upturn is coming
  • B. 未来将出现下行A downturn is coming
  • C. 完全无法判断No judgment is possible at all
答案 A。建筑许可(领先)升 → 预示上行;失业持续时间(滞后)升只反映过去的下行;服务通胀(滞后)持平中性。领先指标决定对未来的判断。Answer A. Building permits (leading) rising signals an upturn; unemployment duration (lagging) rising only reflects the past downturn; service inflation (lagging) flat is neutral. Leading indicators drive the judgment about the future.

28. 实际个人收入、工业产出、S&P 500 同时上升,关于"周期上行"的结论是:Real personal income, industrial production, and the S&P 500 are all rising; the conclusion about a cyclical upturn is: 官方题Official

  • A. 上行即将结束The upturn is about to end
  • B. 上行即将开始The upturn is about to begin
  • C. 上行正在发生The upturn is underway
答案 C。实际个人收入、工业产出是同步指标(正在扩张),S&P 500 是领先指标(将持续),合起来即上行正在发生。Answer C. Real personal income and industrial production are coincident (expanding now); the S&P 500 is leading (it will continue); together, the upturn is underway.
1. 下列哪个指数最可能被视为领先经济指标?1. Which of the following indexes is most likely considered a leading economic indicator? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 消费者价格指数(CPI)Consumer price index
  • B. 宽基股票市场指数Broad stock market index
  • C. 工业生产指数Industrial production index
答案 B。宽基股票市场指数是领先指标(leading)——股价反映对未来盈利的预期。CPI、工业生产多为同步/滞后。Answer B. A broad stock-market index is a leading indicator — prices reflect expectations of future earnings. CPI and industrial production are more coincident/lagging.
2. 10 年期国债收益率与隔夜借款利率之间的利差最可能:2. The interest rate spread between 10-year treasury yields and overnight borrowing rates most likely: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 是滞后经济指标。is a lagging economic indicator.
  • B. 当市场预期经济下行时收窄。decreases when the market expects an economic downturn.
  • C. 当市场预期未来短期利率下降时走阔。increases as the market expects future short-term interest rates to decrease.
答案 B。期限利差(10 年国债 − 隔夜利率)当市场预期经济下行时收窄(甚至倒挂,预期短期利率下降拉低长端)。它是领先指标。Answer B. The term spread (10-year minus overnight) narrows when markets expect a downturn (even inverts, as expected future short-rate cuts pull the long end down). It is a leading indicator.
3. 下列哪项最可能是滞后经济指标?3. Which of the following is most likely a lagging economic indicator? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 存货—销售比率Inventory-sales ratio
  • B. 标普 500 股指S&P 500® Stock Index
  • C. 制造商消费品与原材料新订单Manufacturers' new orders for consumer goods and materials
答案 A。存货—销售比率是滞后指标(lagging):销售放缓后存货才堆积。标普500是领先;新订单是领先。Answer A. The inventory-to-sales ratio is a lagging indicator: inventories build up only after sales slow. The S&P 500 is leading; new orders are leading.
4. 下列哪项最可能是经济活动的同步指标?4. Which of the following is most likely a coincident indicator of economic activity? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 平均失业持续时间Average duration of unemployment
  • B. 制造业平均每周工时Average weekly hours, manufacturing
  • C. 非农就业人数Employees on non-agricultural payrolls
答案 C。非农就业人数是同步指标(coincident)——与当前经济活动同步。平均失业持续时间是滞后;每周工时是领先。Answer C. Nonfarm payrolls are a coincident indicator — moving with current activity. Average unemployment duration is lagging; average weekly hours is leading.

CFA Program Curriculum · 2026 · Level I · Volume 2 · Economics

第二讲 · 财政政策 & 货币政策Lecture 2 · Fiscal Policy & Monetary Policy

对应教材:Learning Module 3《Fiscal Policy》+ Learning Module 4《Monetary Policy》 · 建议学习时长:3–4 小时 · 建议分两次学完(LM3 约 1.5 小时,LM4 约 2 小时)Curriculum: Learning Module 3 Fiscal Policy + Learning Module 4 Monetary Policy · Suggested study time: 3–4 hours · Best done in two sittings (LM3 ~1.5 hours, LM4 ~2 hours)

这两个模块是经济学部分的政策核心,也是与投资实务联系最紧密的内容:财政乘数决定政府刺激的力度,货币传导机制决定央行加息降息如何影响你持有的股票和债券。计算考点集中在财政乘数、平衡预算乘数、中性利率三处,其余以概念辨析为主——但概念题的坑非常密集,尤其是"自动稳定器 vs 相机抉择""需求冲击 vs 供给冲击""四种政策组合"。These two modules are the policy core of Economics and the most connected to investment practice: the fiscal multiplier sets the strength of government stimulus, and the monetary transmission mechanism sets how central-bank rate hikes and cuts affect the stocks and bonds you hold. Calculations concentrate on the fiscal multiplier, the balanced-budget multiplier, and the neutral rate; the rest is mostly conceptual — but the conceptual traps are dense, especially 'automatic stabilizers vs discretion,' 'demand shock vs supply shock,' and 'the four policy mixes.'
