LM3 §1 货币政策与财政政策总览LM3 §1 Overview of Monetary & Fiscal Policy

LOS 对应:LOS: compare monetary and fiscal policy —— 比较货币政策与财政政策。
  • 货币政策(monetary policy):中央银行为影响经济中货币与信贷数量而采取的活动。Monetary policy: the actions a central bank takes to influence the quantity of money and credit in the economy.
  • 财政政策(fiscal policy):政府关于税收与支出的决策。财政政策还可用于收入与财富的再分配。Fiscal policy: the government's decisions on taxation and spending. Fiscal policy can also be used to redistribute income and wealth.
  • 共同的总目标:创造一个增长稳定为正、通胀稳定且低的经济环境,避免大起大落。Their shared overall goal: create an economic environment of stable positive growth and stable low inflation, avoiding booms and busts.
  • 为什么政府的决策影响巨大?① 公共部门雇佣了相当比例的人口、承担了相当比例的支出;
    ② 政府是世界债券市场上最大的借款人。    Why do government decisions matter so much? ① the public sector employs a sizable share of the population and accounts for a sizable share of spending;
    ② the government is the largest borrower in the world's bond markets.
考点提示:问"哪个不是财政政策目标"——维护货币购买力稳定是货币政策的目标,不是财政政策的;问"哪个不是财政工具"——提高购房首付比例要求属于(宏观审慎/货币类)工具,不是财政工具;央行购买国债是货币政策(公开市场操作),不是财政政策。

1. 李嘉图等价的正确表述是:The correct statement of Ricardian equivalence is:

  • A. 个体完全预见减税对应的未来税负,增加储蓄对冲,减税对消费投资无影响Individuals fully foresee the future taxes implied by a tax cut and save more to offset it, so the cut has no effect on consumption or investment
  • B. 个体对未来税负毫无概念,减税必增消费Individuals have no notion of future taxes, so a tax cut must raise consumption
  • C. 减税必然导致通胀A tax cut necessarily causes inflation
答案 A。若李嘉图等价成立,政策者会偏好货币工具;它是否成立是实证问题。Answer A. If Ricardian equivalence holds, policymakers would prefer monetary tools; whether it holds is an empirical question.
1. 货币政策被用来:1. Monetary policy is used to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 促进稳定增长。promote stable growth.
  • B. 再分配收入与财富。redistribute income and wealth.
  • C. 决定税收与支出。determine taxation and spending.
答案 A。货币政策(monetary policy)的目标 = 促进稳定增长与价格稳定(通过货币/信贷)。再分配收入、决定税收与支出是财政政策。Answer A. Monetary policy aims to promote stable growth and price stability (via money/credit). Redistributing income and setting taxes/spending are fiscal policy.
2. 财政政策的一个目标是:2. An objective of fiscal policy is to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 维持价格稳定。maintain price stability.
  • B. 在经济体内再分配财富。redistribute the wealth within an economy.
  • C. 影响经济中的信贷数量。influence the quantity of credit in an economy.
答案 B。财政政策(fiscal policy)的一个目标 = 在经济体内再分配财富(税收与转移支付)。维持价格稳定、影响信贷数量是货币政策。Answer B. A goal of fiscal policy is to redistribute wealth (taxes and transfers). Price stability and influencing the quantity of credit are monetary policy.

LM3 §2 财政政策的角色、目标与自动稳定器LM3 §2 The Role, Goals & Automatic Stabilizers of Fiscal Policy 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: describe roles and objectives of fiscal policy as well as arguments as to whether the size of a national debt relative to GDP matters。

财政政策通过政府支出与税收变动影响经济的三个方面:Fiscal policy affects the economy through changes in government spending and taxes in three ways:

  1. 经济中总需求(aggregate demand, AD)的整体水平,从而影响经济活动水平(核心目标:影响实际 GDP);The overall level of aggregate demand (AD) in the economy, thereby affecting the level of economic activity (the core goal: to influence real GDP);
  2. 不同人群间的收入与财富分配;The distribution of income and wealth across different groups;
  3. 不同部门和经济主体间的资源配置。The allocation of resources across sectors and economic agents.

扩张性财政政策的形式

  • 降低个人所得税 → 提高可支配收入 → 刺激总需求;Cutting personal income tax → raises disposable income → stimulates aggregate demand;
  • 降低销售税(间接税) → 价格下降、实际收入上升 → 刺激消费;Cutting sales tax (an indirect tax) → lowers prices and raises real income → stimulates consumption;
  • 降低企业所得税 → 利润上升 → 可能提高资本开支;Cutting corporate income tax → raises profit → may raise capital expenditure;
  • 降低个人储蓄利息税 → 提高有储蓄者的可支配收入;Cutting the tax on personal savings interest → raises the disposable income of savers;
  • 新增公共支出(医院、学校等社会品与基建)→ 提高个人收入、拉动总需求。New public spending (social goods and infrastructure such as hospitals and schools) → raises personal income and boosts aggregate demand.

注意教材的保留意见:这些关系的可靠性和幅度因时因国而异——衰退中减税未必刺激消费,居民可能因预期经济继续恶化而增加预防性储蓄。两大学派分歧:凯恩斯主义者(Keynesians)认为经济存在大量闲置产能时财政政策对总需求、产出和就业作用强大;货币主义者(Monetarists)认为财政变化只有暂时效果,货币政策才是控制通胀更有效的工具(且不主张用货币政策做逆周期微调)。Note the textbook's caveat: the reliability and magnitude of these relationships vary by time and country — a tax cut in a recession need not stimulate consumption, as households may raise precautionary saving in anticipation of further deterioration. Two schools differ: Keynesians hold that fiscal policy is powerful for aggregate demand, output, and employment when the economy has ample idle capacity; Monetarists hold that fiscal changes have only temporary effects and that monetary policy is the more effective tool for controlling inflation (and they do not favor using monetary policy for counter-cyclical fine-tuning).

预算盈余/赤字与自动稳定器

预算盈余(赤字) = 政府收入 − 政府支出
符号/概念Symbol/Concept含义Meaning
政府收入Government revenue税收收入扣除转移支付后的净额(net of transfer payments)及各类费、罚款等Tax revenue net of transfer payments plus various fees, fines, etc.
政府支出Government spending含政府债务的利息支付Includes interest payments on government debt
盈余↑/赤字↑Surplus↑/Deficit↑盈余增加 ⇔ 收缩性财政;赤字增加 ⇔ 扩张性财政。分析师关注的是盈余/赤字的逐年变化A rising surplus ⇔ contractionary fiscal policy; a rising deficit ⇔ expansionary fiscal policy. Analysts focus on the year-on-year change in the surplus/deficit
  • 自动稳定器(automatic stabilizers):不需要任何政策决定、随周期自动逆向调节的财政项目。衰退时失业救济等社会支出自动上升、税收自动下降 → 自动扩张;繁荣时累进的所得税与利润税自动增收 → 自动收缩。优点:无须先识别冲击再决策,自动降低经济对冲击的敏感度、减小产出波动。Automatic stabilizers: fiscal items that adjust counter-cyclically on their own without any policy decision. In a recession, social spending like unemployment benefits automatically rises and tax revenue automatically falls → automatic expansion; in a boom, progressive income and profit taxes automatically raise more revenue → automatic contraction. Advantage: no need to first identify a shock and then decide — they automatically lower the economy's sensitivity to shocks and reduce output volatility.
  • 相机抉择财政政策(discretionary fiscal policy):政府主动改变支出或税率以稳定总需求。判断题技巧:凡是"新计划""新宣布"的都是相机抉择(如政府宣布新修公路);凡是"随经济自动变动"的是自动稳定器(如失业救济随失业率上升)。Discretionary fiscal policy: the government actively changes spending or tax rates to stabilize aggregate demand. Exam tip: anything 'new program' or 'newly announced' is discretionary (e.g., the government announces a new highway); anything 'automatically changing with the economy' is an automatic stabilizer (e.g., unemployment benefits rising with the unemployment rate).
  • "Pay-as-you-go" 规则(任何减税/增支必须由其他增税/减支对冲)= 中性(neutral)财政立场。The 'pay-as-you-go' rule (any tax cut/spending increase must be offset by another tax increase/spending cut) = a neutral fiscal stance.
  • 收支相等 = 平衡预算(balanced budget)。Revenue equal to spending = a balanced budget.
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

财政政策:自动稳定器

• 自动稳定器(automatic stabilizers):无需立法即自动逆周期——累进所得税(繁荣多征、衰退少征)、失业救济与转移支付(衰退中自动增加)。
• 相机抉择(discretionary):需立法/审批的主动增税、减税、支出计划。

机制

衰退时税收自动下降、救济自动上升 → 赤字自动扩大 → 托底需求。这解释了为何衰退中预算赤字扩大不一定是主动扩张。

易错对比

① 累进税、失业救济 = 自动稳定器(无需立法);② 主动减税/新支出 = 相机抉择;③ 周期性赤字变化 ≠ 结构性(主动)立场变化。

Fiscal policy: automatic stabilizers

• Automatic stabilizers: counter-cyclical without legislation — progressive income taxes (more in booms, less in recessions), unemployment benefits and transfers (rise automatically in downturns).
• Discretionary: active tax changes or spending needing legislation/approval.

Mechanism

In a recession taxes fall and benefits rise automatically → the deficit widens automatically → cushioning demand. So a wider recession deficit is not necessarily active stimulus.

Common traps

① Progressive tax and benefits = automatic stabilizers (no legislation); ② active tax cuts/new spending = discretionary; ③ a cyclical deficit change ≠ a structural (active) stance change.

2. 转移支付是否计入 GDP:Are transfer payments counted in GDP:

  • A. 计入,属投资Yes, as investment
  • B. 不计入,因其非生产要素报酬、也非政府购买商品服务No — they are neither factor income nor government purchases of goods and services
  • C. 计入,属政府支出Yes, as government spending
答案 B。转移支付只是收入再分配,不对应当期生产。Answer B. Transfers are only income redistribution and correspond to no current production.

3. 关于税收的横向公平与纵向公平,最恰当的是:Regarding horizontal vs vertical equity in taxation, the most appropriate statement is:

  • A. 横向公平=富者多缴;纵向公平=人人等额Horizontal equity = the rich pay more; vertical equity = everyone pays the same amount
  • B. 两者含义相同The two mean the same thing
  • C. 横向公平=境况相似者缴同样的税;纵向公平=富者多缴(累进)Horizontal equity = those in similar situations pay the same tax; vertical equity = the rich pay more (progressive)
答案 C。税收四理想属性:简单、效率、公平、收入充足。Answer C. The four ideal properties of taxes: simplicity, efficiency, fairness, and revenue sufficiency.
1. 下列哪项变化最可能反映相机抉择的财政政策行为?1. Which of the following changes most likely reflects a discretionary fiscal policy action? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 因企业盈利下降导致的公司税收入减少A decrease in corporate tax revenues due to lower corporate profitability
  • B. 因新基建项目导致的政府支出增加An increase in government expenditures due to new infrastructure projects
  • C. 因失业上升导致的失业救济支付增加An increase in payments of unemployment benefits due to increasing unemployment
答案 B。相机抉择(discretionary)财政政策 = 政府主动决策,如新增基建支出。因盈利下降致税收减少、因失业上升致救济增加都是自动稳定器(自动发生)。Answer B. Discretionary fiscal policy = a deliberate government decision, e.g., new infrastructure spending. Falling corporate tax from lower profits and rising unemployment benefits are automatic stabilizers (they happen automatically).
2. 因衰退导致的税收下降最恰当地被描述为:2. A decline in tax revenues due to a recession is best described as an example of a(n): 真题模考Mock
  • A. 自动稳定器。automatic stabilizer.
  • B. 扩张性财政政策。expansionary fiscal policy.
  • C. 收缩性财政政策。contractionary fiscal policy.
答案 A。衰退时税收自动下降 = 自动稳定器(automatic stabilizer)(无需新决策就起到逆周期作用),不是相机抉择的扩张/收缩政策。Answer A. Tax revenue falling automatically in a recession = an automatic stabilizer (countercyclical without any new decision), not a discretionary expansionary/contractionary act.
3. 下列哪项财政政策行为最可能是收缩性的?3. Which of the following fiscal policy actions is most likely contractionary? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 增税并减支Increasing taxes and decreasing spending
  • B. 减税并增支Decreasing taxes and increasing spending
  • C. 减税并减支Decreasing taxes and decreasing spending
答案 A。收缩性财政 = 增税 + 减支(抽走总需求)。减税+增支是扩张;减税+减支方向混合。Answer A. Contractionary fiscal policy = raise taxes + cut spending (withdraws aggregate demand). Tax cuts + spending increases are expansionary; tax cuts + spending cuts are mixed.

LM3 §3 赤字与国债:该不该担心?LM3 §3 Deficits & Government Debt: Should We Worry?

先分清存量与流量:赤字(deficit)是一段时期(通常一年)收入与支出之差——流量;国债(national/government debt)是历年赤字的累积——存量。赤字靠向私人部门(常经由养老金与保险资金)借款融资。历史上英国债务/GDP 比率的大幅波动主要来自战争融资(拿破仑战争、两次世界大战);2008 年信贷危机后各国债务比普遍大幅上升(OECD 整体从 2005 年 59.5% 升至 2015 年 85.3%;日本 2015 年达 237.4%)。First distinguish stock from flow: a deficit is the difference between revenue and spending over a period (usually a year) — a flow; the national/government debt is the accumulation of past deficits — a stock. Deficits are financed by borrowing from the private sector (often via pension and insurance funds). Historically, large swings in the UK's debt/GDP ratio came mainly from war financing (the Napoleonic Wars, the two World Wars); after the 2008 credit crisis, debt ratios rose sharply across countries (the OECD as a whole rose from 59.5% in 2005 to 85.3% in 2015; Japan reached 237.4% in 2015).

债务比可持续的关键:实际增长率 g vs 债务实际利率 r
符号Symbol含义Meaning
g经济的实际(剔除通胀)增长率——实际增长带来实际税收增长,提高偿债能力The economy's real (inflation-adjusted) growth rate — real growth brings real tax growth and improves debt-service capacity
r政府债务的实际利率——债务负担以 r×债务 的速度增长The real interest rate on government debt — the debt burden grows at the rate r×debt
结论Conclusion若 g < r,即使经济在增长,债务/GDP 比率也会恶化;通胀会侵蚀存量债务的实际价值(压低比率),通缩则使比率居高不下If g < r, the debt/GDP ratio worsens even as the economy grows; inflation erodes the real value of the debt stock (lowering the ratio), while deflation keeps the ratio elevated
不必担心国债的理由(5 条)Reasons not to worry about the national debt (5)应该担心国债的理由(3 条)Reasons to worry about the national debt (3)
① 债务主要为本国居民内部持有(日、韩约 93%,加拿大 90%;但美国仅 53%、意大利仅 46%);
② 借款可能用于资本投资或人力资本(教育培训),提高未来产出与税收;
③ 大额赤字倒逼税制改革,可能减少现有税制的扭曲;
④ 李嘉图等价:私人部门预期未来加税而增加储蓄,赤字无净效应;
⑤ 经济存在失业时,债务并未把资源从生产性用途中挤走① The debt is mostly held internally by domestic residents (about 93% for Japan and Korea, 90% for Canada; but only 53% for the US and 46% for Italy);
② borrowing may fund capital investment or human capital (education and training), raising future output and tax revenue;
③ large deficits force tax reform that may reduce the distortions of the existing tax system;
④ Ricardian equivalence: the private sector, anticipating future tax hikes, saves more, so the deficit has no net effect;
⑤ when there is unemployment, the debt has not crowded resources out of productive uses		① 高债务比 → 未来更高税率 → 抑制劳动与创业激励,长期增长受损;
② 市场失去信心时央行可能被迫印钞融资 → 恶性通胀(1920s 德国、津巴布韦);
③ 挤出效应(crowding out):政府借款抢占有限储蓄,推高利率、压低私人投资。短期挤出可能不明显,长期则损害资本积累① A high debt ratio → higher future tax rates → dampening incentives to work and start businesses, harming long-run growth;
② if markets lose confidence, the central bank may be forced to print money to finance → hyperinflation (1920s Germany, Zimbabwe);
③ the crowding-out effect: government borrowing grabs limited savings, pushing up rates and depressing private investment. Short-run crowding out may be small, but in the long run it harms capital accumulation
考点提示:挤出效应的标准定义:"政府借款增加,削弱私人部门获得投资资金的能力"。财政扩张效果最强的场景:经济存在大量失业时;接近充分就业时财政扩张主要推高物价而非产出。

4. 挤出效应(crowding out)的定义是:The definition of the crowding-out effect is:

  • A. 政府借款增加,推高利率、削弱私人部门获取投资资金的能力Increased government borrowing pushes up interest rates and weakens the private sector's ability to obtain investment funds
  • B. 利率下降导致私人投资减少Falling interest rates cause private investment to decline
  • C. 政府减税刺激私人投资增加A government tax cut stimulates higher private investment
答案 A。挤出是政府融资抬高利率、压低私人投资,并非"利率下降减少投资"。Answer A. Crowding out is government financing raising rates and depressing private investment, not 'falling rates reducing investment.'

5. 收缩性财政政策必然包含:Contractionary fiscal policy necessarily involves:

  • A. 平衡预算A balanced budget
  • B. 削减政府支出Cutting government spending
  • C. 赤字下降或盈余上升A falling deficit or rising surplus
答案 C。收缩不一定靠减支(也可加税);判断松紧看赤字/盈余的变化方向。Answer C. Contraction need not come from spending cuts (it can also be tax hikes); judge the stance by the direction of change in the deficit/surplus.
1. 反对为高国债水平担忧的一个论据是:1. An argument against being concerned about high national debt levels is that: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 债务在内部欠于本国公民。the debt is owed internally to fellow citizens.
  • B. 政府借款会提高私人部门投资。government borrowing leads to higher private sector investment.
  • C. 央行可以印钞为政府赤字融资。the central bank can print money to finance a government deficit.
答案 A。不必过度担忧高国债的一个论据:债务多为"内部"欠本国公民(国民既是债权人也是纳税人)。B、C 说法错误(借款会挤出投资;印钞融资有通胀风险)。Answer A. An argument against worrying about high national debt: much of it is owed "internally" to a country's own citizens (who are both creditors and taxpayers). B and C are wrong (borrowing crowds out investment; money-printing risks inflation).

LM3 §4 财政工具及其优缺点LM3 §4 Fiscal Tools & Their Pros and Cons

LOS 对应:LOS: describe tools of fiscal policy, including their advantages and disadvantages。

支出类工具

  • 转移支付(transfer payments):经社保体系发放的福利(养老金、住房补贴、税收抵免、儿童与失业救济等),用于保障最低收入、调节收入分配。不计入 GDP(不是对生产要素的报酬),也不算政府的商品服务购买。Transfer payments: benefits paid through the social-security system (pensions, housing subsidies, tax credits, child and unemployment benefits, etc.) to guarantee a minimum income and adjust income distribution. Not counted in GDP (not payment for factors of production) and not a government purchase of goods and services.
  • 经常性支出(current government spending):医疗、教育、国防等常规性商品服务支出,影响国民技能与劳动生产率。Current government spending: routine spending on goods and services such as healthcare, education, and defense, affecting national skills and labor productivity.
  • 资本支出(capital expenditure):道路、医院、监狱、学校等基建投资,增加国家资本存量、提高生产潜能。Capital expenditure: infrastructure investment such as roads, hospitals, prisons, and schools, increasing the national capital stock and raising productive potential.

政府支出的正当性:提供国防等全民受益的服务;基建促增长;保障最低收入与再分配;管理总需求以实现低通胀高就业;补贴高风险创新(如新能源)。Justifications for government spending: providing services that benefit all, such as defense; infrastructure to promote growth; guaranteeing a minimum income and redistributing; managing aggregate demand for low inflation and high employment; subsidizing high-risk innovation (e.g., new energy).

收入类工具

  • 直接税(direct taxes):对收入、财富、企业利润征收——所得税、资本利得税、社保(劳动)税、公司税、财产税、遗产税(兼具筹资与财富再分配功能)。Direct taxes: levied on income, wealth, and corporate profit — income tax, capital-gains tax, social-security (labor) tax, corporate tax, property tax, inheritance tax (serving both revenue-raising and wealth-redistribution functions).
  • 间接税(indirect taxes):对商品与服务的支出征收——燃油/烟酒消费税、销售税/增值税(VAT)。常出于社会考虑豁免医疗教育;烟酒赌博税兼具抑制作用,燃油税兼具环保作用。就业税不是间接税(它落在劳动收入上)。Indirect taxes: levied on spending on goods and services — excise taxes on fuel/tobacco/alcohol, sales tax/value-added tax (VAT). Healthcare and education are often exempted for social reasons; tobacco, alcohol, and gambling taxes also serve to deter, and fuel tax also serves the environment. An employment tax is not an indirect tax (it falls on labor income).

好税制的四个属性

  1. 简单(simplicity):纳税人易遵从、征管方易执行,最终税负确定、难以操纵;Simplicity: easy for taxpayers to comply with and for authorities to administer, with a definite final burden that is hard to manipulate;
  2. 效率(efficiency):尽量少干扰市场选择、尽量少抑制工作与投资(税收是否应刻意偏离效率去鼓励储蓄、抑制烟草,是经济学家争论点);Efficiency: interfere with market choices as little as possible and discourage work and investment as little as possible (whether taxes should deliberately depart from efficiency to encourage saving or deter tobacco is debated among economists);
  3. 公平(fairness):横向公平=境况相似的人缴同样的税;纵向公平=富人多缴税(累进税);也有人主张单一税率的"平税";Fairness: horizontal equity = people in similar situations pay the same tax; vertical equity = the rich pay more (progressive tax); some advocate a single-rate 'flat tax';
  4. 收入充足(revenue sufficiency):能筹到钱——但可能与公平、效率冲突(提高税率补赤字可能抑制劳动)。Revenue sufficiency: able to raise the money — but this may conflict with fairness and efficiency (raising rates to plug a deficit may discourage work).

各工具的速度与效力

工具Tool实施速度Speed of implementation要点Key points
间接税Indirect taxes最快——宣布后几乎立即可调Fastest — adjustable almost immediately after announcement即时影响消费行为,征收成本低;调烟酒税可即时服务社会政策Instantly affects consumption behavior at low collection cost; adjusting tobacco/alcohol taxes can immediately serve social policy
直接税、转移支付Direct taxes, transfer payments慢——常需数月(工资系统要改)Slow — often takes months (payroll systems must be changed)但"预告"本身可能立即改变支出行为(预期效应);英国 2009–10 延迟加税的证据显示行为变化不大But the 'pre-announcement' itself may immediately change spending behavior (an expectations effect); UK evidence from the delayed 2009–10 tax increases showed little behavioral change
资本支出Capital expenditure最慢——规划、审批、施工以年计Slowest — planning, approval, and construction take years对短期稳定作用小(2009–10 美国刺激计划的常见批评),但能增加经济的生产潜能(减税做不到);实施越慢,越可能被其他外生变化抢先影响经济Little effect on short-run stabilization (a common criticism of the 2009–10 US stimulus), but it can increase the economy's productive potential (which tax cuts cannot); the slower the implementation, the more likely other exogenous changes affect the economy first

相对效力:政府直接支出对总支出和产出的拉动远大于减税或增加转移支付;但若转移支付定向给最穷的人(边际消费倾向≈1,收入全花掉),刺激力度也相对较强。Relative potency: government direct spending boosts total spending and output far more than tax cuts or higher transfers; but if transfers are targeted at the poorest (marginal propensity to consume ≈ 1, spending all their income), the stimulus is also relatively strong.

6. 想提振企业资本开支,更对症的减税是:To boost corporate capital expenditure, the more targeted tax cut is:

  • A. 提高转移支付Raise transfer payments
  • B. 降低企业所得税Lower the corporate income tax
  • C. 降低个人所得税Lower the personal income tax
答案 B。降企业所得税提高利润→资本开支;降个税主要刺激消费。Answer B. Cutting corporate income tax raises profit → capex; cutting personal income tax mainly stimulates consumption.

7. 三类财政工具按实施速度由快到慢排序,且哪类能提高经济生产潜能:Ranking the three types of fiscal tools from fastest to slowest to implement, and which type raises the economy's productive potential:

  • A. 资本支出最快,且只有减税能提高生产潜能Capital spending is fastest, and only tax cuts raise productive potential
  • B. 三者速度相同,均不影响生产潜能All three are equally fast and none affect productive potential
  • C. 间接税(最快)> 直接税/转移支付 > 资本支出(最慢);资本支出提高生产潜能Indirect taxes (fastest) > direct taxes/transfers > capital spending (slowest); capital spending raises productive potential
答案 C。资本支出增加资本存量、提高潜能,但落地最慢;减税做不到提高潜能。Answer C. Capital spending adds to the capital stock and raises potential but is slowest to take effect; tax cuts cannot raise potential.
1. 就财政政策而言,转移支付最恰当地被描述为:1. With respect to fiscal policy, transfer payments are best described as: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 福利性支付。welfare payments.
  • B. 基础设施支出。infrastructure spending.
  • C. 经常性商品与服务支出。spending on recurring goods and services.
答案 A。转移支付(transfer payments)= 福利性支付(失业救济、养老金),不计入政府购买。基建、经常性商品服务支出是政府"购买"。Answer A. Transfer payments = welfare payments (unemployment benefits, pensions), not counted as government purchases. Infrastructure and recurring goods/services spending are government "purchases."
2. 能即时影响支出的财政政策工具最可能是:2. A fiscal policy tool that can immediately influence spending is most likely: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 间接税。indirect taxes.
  • B. 汇率目标制。exchange rate targeting.
  • C. 资本支出计划。capital expenditure plans.
答案 A。能即时影响支出的财政工具 = 间接税(indirect taxes)(如销售税,马上改变可支配收入/价格)。资本支出计划有较长实施时滞;汇率目标是货币政策工具。Answer A. The fiscal tool with an immediate impact on spending = indirect taxes (e.g., sales tax, instantly changing disposable income/prices). Capital spending programs have long implementation lags; exchange-rate targeting is a monetary tool.
3. 下列哪项是扩张性财政政策?3. Which of the following is an expansionary fiscal policy? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 提高销售税An increase in sales taxes
  • B. 降低利率A decrease in interest rates
  • C. 增加基础设施公共支出An increase in public spending on infrastructure
答案 C。扩张性财政 = 增加基建等公共支出(注入总需求)。提高销售税是收缩;降低利率是货币政策。Answer C. Expansionary fiscal policy = increasing public spending such as infrastructure (injecting aggregate demand). Raising sales tax is contractionary; cutting interest rates is monetary policy.
4. 下列哪项政府行为最可能是扩张性财政政策?4. Which of the following government actions is most likely an expansionary fiscal policy? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 提高销售税率。Increasing sales tax rate.
  • B. 降低储蓄税率。Decreasing savings tax rate.
  • C. 减少基础设施支出。Decreasing infrastructure spending.
答案 B。降低储蓄税率 = 扩张性财政(减税、增加可支配收入)。提高销售税、削减基建都是收缩性。Answer B. Cutting the tax on savings = expansionary fiscal policy (a tax cut raising disposable income). Raising sales tax or cutting infrastructure are contractionary.

LM3 §5 财政乘数与平衡预算乘数(必会计算)LM3 §5 The Fiscal Multiplier & Balanced-Budget Multiplier (must-calculate) 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

5.1 基础记号

G − T + B = 预算赤字(或盈余)    YD = Y − NT = (1 − t)Y
符号Symbol含义Meaning
G政府支出 government spending,直接加入总需求 ADGovernment spending, added directly to aggregate demand AD
T税收 taxes(含对支出的间接税与对要素收入的直接税),从 AD 中扣减Taxes (including indirect taxes on spending and direct taxes on factor income), subtracted from AD
B转移支付 transfer benefits(如社保),增加居民收入Transfer benefits (e.g., social security), which raise household income
NT净税收 net taxes = 税收 − 转移支付Net taxes = taxes − transfer payments
Y国民收入/产出 national income or outputNational income or output
YD可支配收入 disposable income = 收入减净税收Disposable income = income minus net taxes
t净税率 net tax rate(常设净税收与收入成比例:NT = tY)。t=0.2 时,国民收入每增 1 美元,净税收增 0.20、可支配收入增 0.80Net tax rate (net taxes are often set proportional to income: NT = tY). At t=0.2, each $1 rise in national income raises net taxes by 0.20 and disposable income by 0.80

5.2 边际消费倾向与基础乘数

c + s = 1    基础乘数 = 1 / (1 − c) = 1 / s
符号Symbol含义Meaning
c边际消费倾向 MPC(marginal propensity to consume):每增加 1 美元可支配收入中用于消费的比例,0 < c < 1Marginal propensity to consume (MPC): the fraction of each additional $1 of disposable income spent on consumption, 0 < c < 1
s边际储蓄倾向 MPS(marginal propensity to save)= 1 − cMarginal propensity to save (MPS) = 1 − c
乘数Multiplier新增支出在经济中层层传递(c、c2、c³…),几何级数求和得 1/(1−c)。定义:均衡产出变化 ÷ 引起它的自发支出变化。c=0.9 时乘数 = 10New spending passes through the economy in successive rounds (c, c2, c³…), and the geometric series sums to 1/(1−c). Definition: the change in equilibrium output ÷ the autonomous spending change that caused it. At c=0.9 the multiplier = 10

教材数值例:收入 100,所得税 20,可支配收入 80,消费 72,储蓄 8 → MPC = 72/80 = 0.9,MPS = 0.1。注意 MPC 是相对可支配收入计算的。Textbook numerical example: income 100, income tax 20, disposable income 80, consumption 72, saving 8 → MPC = 72/80 = 0.9, MPS = 0.1. Note that MPC is computed relative to disposable income.

5.3 财政乘数(含税)

财政乘数 = 1 / [1 − c(1 − t)]
符号Symbol含义Meaning
c(1−t)存在税收时的"有效"边际消费倾向:每 1 美元国民收入中,(1−t) 成为可支配收入,其中 c 被消费。传递链:政府增支 G → 可支配收入增 (1−t)G → 消费增 c(1−t)G → 下一轮 …,公比 c(1−t),0 < c(1−t) < 1The 'effective' marginal propensity to consume when taxes exist: of each $1 of national income, (1−t) becomes disposable income, of which c is consumed. The transmission chain: government spending G → disposable income rises by (1−t)G → consumption rises by c(1−t)G → next round …, with common ratio c(1−t), 0 < c(1−t) < 1
教材算例 · 财政乘数

t = 0.2,c = 0.9:财政乘数 = 1/[1 − 0.9×(1−0.2)] = 1/[1 − 0.72] = 1/0.28 = 3.57。政府增支 10 亿美元 → 总收入与支出最终增加 35.7 亿美元。(前提:经济中存在闲置的资本与劳动。)t = 0.2, c = 0.9: fiscal multiplier = 1/[1 − 0.9×(1−0.2)] = 1/[1 − 0.72] = 1/0.28 = 3.57. A $1bn increase in government spending → total income and spending eventually rise by $3.57bn. (Premise: there is idle capital and labor in the economy.)

5.4 平衡预算乘数(balanced budget multiplier)

政府增支 ΔG 并同额增税 ΔT(= ΔG),总产出仍会上升。原因:增税 1 美元只使私人支出减少 c(<1)美元,而政府支出 1 美元全额进入总需求。首轮净效应 = ΔG − c·ΔG = (1−c)ΔG > 0,随后经乘数放大。The government raises spending by ΔG and taxes by the same ΔT (= ΔG); total output still rises. Reason: a $1 tax increase cuts private spending by only c (<1) dollars, while $1 of government spending enters aggregate demand in full. The first-round net effect = ΔG − c·ΔG = (1−c)ΔG > 0, then amplified by the multiplier.

教材算例 · 平衡预算

均衡产出 1,000(消费 900 + 投资 100)。政府支出设为 200,由 20% 税率融资(税收恰为 200)。c = 0.9:支出 +200 直接拉高产出 200;税收 200 只使消费减少 0.9×200 = 180。首轮净拉动 = 200 − 180 = +20,再经乘数进一步放大产出与收入。Equilibrium output 1,000 (consumption 900 + investment 100). Government spending is set at 200, financed by a 20% tax rate (taxes are exactly 200). c = 0.9: spending of +200 directly raises output by 200; taxes of 200 cut consumption by only 0.9×200 = 180. The first-round net boost = 200 − 180 = +20, further amplified by the multiplier.

结论(必背):若政府调整支出使最终税收变化与支出变化严格相等("真正的平衡预算"),平衡预算乘数恒等于 1(unity)——平衡的财政扩张仍使产出增加,增加额恰等于支出增加额。Conclusion (memorize): if the government adjusts spending so that the final tax change strictly equals the spending change (a 'true balanced budget'), the balanced-budget multiplier is always exactly 1 (unity) — a balanced fiscal expansion still raises output, by exactly the amount of the spending increase.

5.5 李嘉图等价(Ricardian equivalence)

若政府今年减税 100 亿并以发债 100 亿替代,有无实际效果取决于公众如何感知:若公众完全预见未来须加税偿还本息,就会把发债视为延迟的税收,于是增加储蓄、消费不变——减税对支出毫无影响,这就是李嘉图等价(得名于经济学家 David Ricardo)。若公众没有完全预见未来税负,则会自感更富、增加支出。李嘉图等价是否成立,归根结底是实证问题,难以定论。If the government cuts taxes by $10bn this year and replaces it with $10bn of bond issuance, whether there is a real effect depends on how the public perceives it: if the public fully foresees future tax hikes to repay principal and interest, it views the bonds as deferred taxes, so it saves more and consumption is unchanged — the tax cut has no effect on spending; this is Ricardian equivalence (named after the economist David Ricardo). If the public does not fully foresee the future tax burden, it feels richer and spends more. Whether Ricardian equivalence holds is ultimately an empirical question, hard to settle.

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

财政乘数与平衡预算乘数

财政(支出)乘数 = 1 ÷ [1 − MPC×(1 − t)](考虑税收漏出),再考虑进口漏出会更小。MPC(边际消费倾向)越高、税率越低 → 乘数越大。

平衡预算乘数

同时等额增税与增支,总效应仍为正,乘数 = 1——因为政府支出全额进入需求,而增税只按 MPC 比例减少消费。

易错对比

① MPC 高 → 乘数大;② 税收/进口漏出降低乘数;③ 平衡预算乘数 = 1(不是 0):增支的刺激大于等额增税的抑制。

The fiscal multiplier & balanced-budget multiplier

Fiscal (spending) multiplier = 1 ÷ [1 − MPC×(1 − t)] (allowing for the tax leakage); import leakage makes it smaller. A higher MPC and lower tax rate → a bigger multiplier.

Balanced-budget multiplier

Raising taxes and spending by the same amount still has a positive net effect, multiplier = 1 — spending enters demand fully, while the tax hike cuts consumption only by the MPC fraction.

Common traps

① High MPC → big multiplier; ② tax/import leakages shrink it; ③ the balanced-budget multiplier = 1 (not 0): spending stimulus exceeds the drag of an equal tax rise.

8. c=0.9、t=0.2,财政乘数与"政府增支 10 亿"最终拉动的产出分别约为:With c = 0.9 and t = 0.2, the fiscal multiplier and the eventual output boost from $1bn extra government spending are about:

  • A. 乘数 1,拉动约 10 亿Multiplier 1, boost about $1bn
  • B. 乘数 3.57,拉动约 35.7 亿Multiplier 3.57, boost about $3.57bn
  • C. 乘数 10,拉动约 100 亿Multiplier 10, boost about $10bn
答案 B。乘数 = 1/[1−0.9×(1−0.2)] = 1/0.28 = 3.57;10×3.57 ≈ 35.7 亿。Answer B. Multiplier = 1/[1 − 0.9×(1 − 0.2)] = 1/0.28 = 3.57; 1 × 3.57 ≈ $3.57bn.

9. 收入 100、所得税 20、消费 72,边际消费倾向 MPC 为:Income 100, income tax 20, consumption 72; the marginal propensity to consume (MPC) is:

  • A. 0.72(分母为总收入 100)0.72 (denominator is total income 100)
  • B. 0.80.8
  • C. 0.9(分母为可支配收入 80)0.9 (denominator is disposable income 80)
答案 C。MPC = 72/(100−20) = 72/80 = 0.9,MPS = 0.1;分母是可支配收入。Answer C. MPC = 72/(100 − 20) = 72/80 = 0.9, MPS = 0.1; the denominator is disposable income.

10. 政府等额增支增税(真正平衡预算),产出变化与平衡预算乘数分别为:The government raises spending and taxes by equal amounts (a truly balanced budget); the change in output and the balanced-budget multiplier are:

  • A. 产出上升,平衡预算乘数恒等于 1Output rises; the balanced-budget multiplier is always exactly 1
  • B. 产出不变,乘数为 0Output unchanged, multiplier 0
  • C. 产出下降,乘数为负Output falls, multiplier negative
答案 A。增税 1 元只减 c 元私人支出,增支 1 元全额进需求,净效应 (1−c)ΔG>0,乘数=1。Answer A. A $1 tax hike cuts private spending by only c; a $1 spending increase enters demand in full; the net effect is (1 − c)ΔG > 0, multiplier = 1.

LM3 §6 财政立场的衡量与执行困难LM3 §6 Measuring the Fiscal Stance & Implementation Difficulties

LOS 对应:LOS: explain the implementation of fiscal policy and difficulties of implementation as well as whether a fiscal policy is expansionary or contractionary。

6.1 实际赤字 ≠ 财政立场

赤字会因与政策无关的原因变动(衰退时自动稳定器使税收降、赤字升,观察者可能误判为"政策已放松")。经济学家改看:The deficit changes for reasons unrelated to policy (in a recession, automatic stabilizers lower taxes and raise the deficit, and an observer may mistake this for 'policy has loosened'). Economists instead look at:

  • 结构性(周期调整)预算赤字(structural / cyclically adjusted budget deficit):假设经济处于充分就业(潜在产出)状态下将会存在的赤字——衡量财政立场的恰当指标。The structural / cyclically adjusted budget deficit: the deficit that would exist if the economy were at full employment (potential output) — the proper measure of the fiscal stance.
  • 另一个失真来源:名义 vs 实际利息。统计上把现金利息支付全额计入政府支出,但通胀在侵蚀存量债务的实际价值,更合理的是只考虑通胀调整后(实际)利息支付。Another source of distortion: nominal vs real interest. Statistics count cash interest payments in full as government spending, but inflation is eroding the real value of the debt stock, so it is more reasonable to consider only inflation-adjusted (real) interest payments.

6.2 三大时滞与执行困难

时滞Lag含义Meaning
识别时滞 recognition lagRecognition lag数据发布滞后且频繁修订,政策者数月后才意识到经济在放缓——"看着后视镜开车"Data are released with a lag and frequently revised, so policymakers realize the economy is slowing only months later — 'driving by looking in the rear-view mirror'
行动时滞 action lagAction lag决定政策到落地实施需要数月(资本项目要规划、立法、采购)Deciding on a policy and implementing it takes months (capital projects require planning, legislation, procurement)
影响时滞 impact lagImpact lag政策落地后要再过一段时间才对经济产生可见效果After a policy is implemented, more time passes before it has a visible effect on the economy

其他困难:
① 经济的独立走向不可预知(刺激可能恰逢出口或投资的意外回升),宏观预测模型准确率不佳;
② 若同时担心通胀,接近充分就业时加码会推高工资物价;
③ 赤字已高时,再扩张可能被金融市场"否决"(国债利率上升);
④ 充分就业水平本身难以测量;
⑤ 若闲置资源源于劳动供给不足而非需求不足,财政扩张无效、只添通胀;
⑥ 挤出效应。结论:财政政策无法完全稳定总需求。(注:这三种时滞同样存在于相机抉择的货币政策。)Other difficulties:
① the economy's independent path is unknowable (a stimulus may coincide with an unexpected pickup in exports or investment), and macro forecasting models are not very accurate;
② if inflation is also a concern, adding stimulus near full employment pushes up wages and prices;
③ when the deficit is already high, further expansion may be 'vetoed' by financial markets (government-bond rates rise);
④ the full-employment level itself is hard to measure;
⑤ if idle resources stem from insufficient labor supply rather than insufficient demand, fiscal expansion is ineffective and only adds inflation;
⑥ crowding out. Conclusion: fiscal policy cannot fully stabilize aggregate demand. (Note: these three lags also afflict discretionary monetary policy.)

11. 衡量财政政策立场的恰当指标是:The appropriate gauge of the fiscal policy stance is:

  • A. 名义 GDP 增速The nominal GDP growth rate
  • B. 周期调整后(结构性)预算赤字The cyclically-adjusted (structural) budget deficit
  • C. 实际(名义)预算赤字The actual (nominal) budget deficit
答案 B。实际赤字受自动稳定器干扰;结构性赤字剔除周期影响,更能反映主动立场。Answer B. The actual deficit is distorted by automatic stabilizers; the structural deficit strips out cyclical effects and better reflects the active stance.

12. 关于"财政政策不能完全稳定总需求",最不可能的解释是:Regarding 'fiscal policy cannot fully stabilize aggregate demand,' the LEAST likely explanation is:

  • A. 私人部门行为随时间变化Private-sector behavior changes over time
  • B. 政策实施非常迅速Policy is implemented very quickly
  • C. 财政更关注通胀而非失业Fiscal policy is more concerned with inflation than unemployment
答案 B。财政政策实施恰恰很慢(识别、行动、影响三大时滞),"迅速"与事实相反。Answer B. Fiscal policy is in fact implemented slowly (recognition, action, and impact lags); 'quickly' is the opposite of the truth.

13. 财政政策"识别、行动、影响"三大时滞中,被比作"看着后视镜开车"的是:Among fiscal policy's three lags (recognition, action, impact), the one likened to 'driving by looking in the rear-view mirror' is:

  • A. 行动时滞The action lag
  • B. 影响时滞The impact lag
  • C. 识别时滞(数据滞后,数月后才发现经济转向)The recognition lag (data lag — the turn is spotted only months later)
答案 C。数据滞后使决策者只能"看后视镜";三大时滞同样困扰相机抉择的货币政策。Answer C. Data lags force decision-makers to 'look in the rear-view mirror'; the same three lags also plague discretionary monetary policy.

LM4 §1 央行的职能与目标LM4 §1 Central Bank Functions & Objectives

LOS 对应:LOS: describe the roles and objectives of central banks。

六大职能(必背清单)

  1. 货币的垄断发行者:现代货币是法定货币(fiat money)——不可兑换为任何商品,凭政府法令与公众接受获得价值,法律上是法偿货币(legal tender)(1931 年前英格兰银行纸币可兑黄金,即金本位);Monopoly issuer of currency: modern money is fiat money — not convertible into any commodity, deriving value from government decree and public acceptance, and legally legal tender (before 1931 Bank of England notes were convertible into gold, i.e., the gold standard);
  2. 政府的银行 & 银行的银行;The government's bank & the banks' bank;
  3. 最后贷款人(lender of last resort):央行能"印钱",可向危机中的银行供资;公众知道央行会兜底 + 存款保险,本身就能防止挤兑——但北岩银行案例证明并非总是够用;Lender of last resort: the central bank can 'print money' and supply funds to banks in crisis; the public's knowledge that the central bank will backstop, plus deposit insurance, can itself prevent runs — but the Northern Rock case shows this is not always enough;
  4. 支付体系的监管者与标准制定者(并负责跨国支付协调;通常还管理外汇储备与黄金储备);Regulator and standard-setter for the payment system (and responsible for cross-border payment coordination; usually also manages FX and gold reserves);
  5. 货币政策的执行者(最高调的角色);Executor of monetary policy (its highest-profile role);
  6. 银行体系的监管者——注意:并非所有央行都承担,有的国家由独立机构负责(如日本 FSA),有的多机构共管(美、德)。英国:1997 年监管权从英格兰银行剥离给 FSA,被认为是北岩危机的诱因之一,2013 年又还给了英格兰银行。Regulator of the banking system — note: not all central banks perform this; in some countries an independent agency does (e.g., Japan's FSA), in others multiple agencies share it (US, Germany). UK: in 1997 supervisory power was stripped from the Bank of England and given to the FSA — seen as one trigger of the Northern Rock crisis — and returned to the Bank of England in 2013.
教材案例 · 北岩银行挤兑(Northern Rock,2007)

北岩是英国按揭银行,靠货币市场激进融资扩张、放贷质量差。2007 年美国次贷崩塌引发全球流动性危机,银行间市场冻结,北岩无法续借,9 月 12 日向英格兰银行求援;消息泄露后储户排队挤兑,单日提取约 10 亿英镑(占存款 5%)。9 月 17 日财政大臣宣布政府担保北岩全部存款,挤兑才平息(存款甚至回流),最终北岩被国有化。教训:最后贷款人 + 存款保险的"存在"不足以阻止挤兑,可信的政府担保才稳定了局面。Northern Rock was a UK mortgage bank that expanded via aggressive money-market funding with poor loan quality. When US subprime collapsed in 2007 it triggered a global liquidity crisis; the interbank market froze, Northern Rock could not roll over its borrowing, and on 12 September it sought help from the Bank of England; after the news leaked, depositors queued to withdraw, taking about £1bn in a single day (5% of deposits). On 17 September the Chancellor announced the government would guarantee all of Northern Rock's deposits, and only then did the run subside (deposits even flowed back); Northern Rock was ultimately nationalized. Lesson: the mere 'existence' of a lender of last resort + deposit insurance is not enough to stop a run — it was a credible government guarantee that stabilized the situation.

总目标:各国央行目标表述不一(巴西:货币购买力稳定+金融体系稳健;欧央行:价格稳定优先;美联储:最大就业、物价稳定、温和长期利率三重使命;澳储行:货币稳定+充分就业+繁荣福利;韩国银行:价格稳定),但几乎都承认一个压倒性目标——价格稳定(price stability)/控制通胀。Overall objective: central banks phrase their objectives differently (Brazil: stable purchasing power + a sound financial system; ECB: price stability first; the Fed: a triple mandate of maximum employment, stable prices, and moderate long-term interest rates; the RBA: currency stability + full employment + prosperity and welfare; the Bank of Korea: price stability), but almost all acknowledge one overriding goal — price stability / controlling inflation.

14. 下列央行职能中,"并非所有央行都承担"的是:Among central-bank functions, the one that 'not all central banks perform' is:

  • A. 充当最后贷款人Acting as lender of last resort
  • B. 银行体系监管Supervising the banking system
  • C. 货币的垄断发行Monopoly issuance of currency
答案 B。银行监管可由独立机构或多机构共管;而"设定利息税税率"属财政事务、根本不是央行职能。Answer B. Bank supervision may be handled by a separate agency or shared; 'setting the tax rate on interest' is a fiscal matter and not a central-bank function at all.

15. 关于法定货币(fiat money),最恰当的是:Regarding fiat money, the most appropriate statement is:

  • A. 必须可兑换为黄金It must be convertible into gold
  • B. 价值来自其自身的商品价值Its value comes from its own commodity value
  • C. 不可兑换为商品,价值来自政府法令 + 公众普遍接受It is not convertible into goods; its value comes from government decree plus general public acceptance
答案 C。法偿货币的价值基于法令与信任,而非内在商品价值。Answer C. Legal-tender money's value rests on decree and trust, not intrinsic commodity value.
1. 法定货币(fiat money):1. Fiat money: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 目前未被任何主要经济体使用。is not currently used in any major economy.
  • B. 可在本国央行兑换为贵金属。can be exchanged for a precious metal at the country's central bank.
  • C. 因政府法令及人们接受其支付而具有价值。derives its value via government decree and because people accept it for payment.
答案 C。法定货币(fiat money)因政府法令 + 社会普遍接受而有价值,不可兑换贵金属,且被各大经济体广泛使用。Answer C. Fiat money has value because of government decree plus general acceptance; it is not convertible into precious metal and is used by all major economies.
2. 多数央行的首要总体目标是维持:2. The overarching objective of most central banks is to maintain: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 价格稳定。price stability.
  • B. 充分就业。full employment.
  • C. 政府偿债能力。the government's ability to service its debt.
答案 A。多数央行的首要目标 = 价格稳定(price stability)(控通胀)。充分就业是次要/双目标之一;政府偿债不是央行首要目标。Answer A. The primary objective of most central banks = price stability (controlling inflation). Full employment is secondary/part of a dual mandate; government solvency is not the primary aim.
3. 多数央行的一个职责是:3. A role of most central banks is to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 设定所得税率。set income tax rates.
  • B. 决定政府支出。decide on government expenditures.
  • C. 监管本国支付体系。regulate their country's payments system.
答案 C。央行职责之一 = 监管本国支付体系(payment system)(及发钞、银行的银行、最后贷款人等)。设所得税率、决定政府支出是政府/财政的事。Answer C. A central-bank responsibility = overseeing the country's payment system (plus issuing currency, banker to banks, lender of last resort). Setting income-tax rates and government spending belong to the government/fiscal side.

LM4 §2 三大货币政策工具与传导机制LM4 §2 The Three Monetary-Policy Tools & Transmission Mechanism 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: describe tools used to implement monetary policy and the monetary transmission mechanism。

2.1 三大工具

工具Tool机制Mechanism要点Key points
公开市场操作
open market operationsOpen market operations		央行向商业银行买入国债 → 银行准备金增加 → 放贷扩张 → 广义货币经货币乘数扩张;卖出国债则相反The central bank buys government bonds from commercial banks → bank reserves rise → lending expands → broad money expands via the money multiplier; selling bonds does the reverse最直接的数量工具;可以以准备金水平或准备金利率为目标The most direct quantity tool; it can target the level of reserves or the interest rate on reserves
政策利率
official policy rateOfficial policy rate		央行愿意借钱给商业银行的利率,常通过回购协议(repo)实现(期限隔夜至两周)。政策利率↑ → 银行流动性短缺时的"罚息"更高 → 更愿收缩放贷 → 广义货币增长放缓The rate at which the central bank is willing to lend to commercial banks, often via repurchase agreements (repo) (overnight to two-week tenors). A higher policy rate → a steeper 'penalty' when banks are short of liquidity → greater willingness to contract lending → slower broad-money growth各国名称:英国=两周回购利率;欧央行=再融资利率(refinancing rate);美国=贴现率(discount rate)(成员行向美联储直接借款利率),但美国货币政策最重要的利率是联邦基金利率(fed funds rate)——银行间隔夜准备金拆借利率,FOMC 每 6 周开会设定目标并用公开市场操作把利率推向目标。商业银行的基准利率(base rate)随政策利率同步调整——银行不愿以低于央行索取的利率放贷National names: UK = the two-week repo rate; ECB = the refinancing rate; US = the discount rate (the rate at which member banks borrow directly from the Fed), but the most important rate for US monetary policy is the fed funds rate — the overnight interbank rate on reserves, whose target the FOMC sets every ~6 weeks and pushes toward via open market operations. Commercial banks' base rate adjusts in step with the policy rate — banks are unwilling to lend below the rate the central bank charges
存款准备金率
reserve requirementsReserve requirements		准备金率越低,货币创造越强;提高准备金率 → 收缩货币创造The lower the reserve ratio, the stronger money creation; raising the reserve ratio → contracts money creation发达经济体已很少使用(频繁变动对银行破坏性大;英格兰银行甚至已不设最低准备金),新兴市场仍活跃使用Rarely used in developed economies (frequent changes are disruptive to banks; the Bank of England no longer even sets a minimum reserve requirement), while emerging markets still use it actively

2.2 货币政策传导机制(transmission mechanism)

政策利率(通常只是隔夜利率)如何影响实体经济与通胀?通过四条相互关联的渠道(以加息为例):How does the policy rate (usually just an overnight rate) affect the real economy and inflation? Through four interrelated channels (using a rate hike as the example):

  1. 短期利率/银行贷款利率:商业银行基准利率与银行间利率随官方利率上调 → 企业与个人借贷成本上升 → 借贷减少;Short-term/bank lending rates: commercial banks' base rate and interbank rates rise with the official rate → borrowing costs for firms and individuals rise → borrowing falls;
  2. 资产价格:贴现率上升 → 债券、资本项目等资产价格下跌 → 家庭金融财富缩水 → 消费增长放缓;Asset prices: a higher discount rate → falling prices of bonds, capital projects, and other assets → household financial wealth shrinks → consumption growth slows;
  3. 预期:市场将加息解读为未来还要加/增长将放缓 → 消费、借贷、资产价格因预期修正而进一步下行;Expectations: the market reads the hike as more hikes to come / slower growth ahead → consumption, borrowing, and asset prices fall further as expectations adjust;
  4. 汇率:加息 → 本币升值 → 出口更贵、外需(净出口)下降;同时进口价格下降,直接压低通胀。Exchange rate: a hike → home-currency appreciation → exports dearer, foreign demand (net exports) falls; meanwhile import prices fall, directly lowering inflation.

四渠道合力压低国内需求与净外需 → 总需求走弱 + 本币走强 → 通胀承压下行。注意:四条渠道是相互关联的,不是相互独立的(考过)。央行相信短期内货币非中性(money is not neutral in the short run),否则调节名义利率不可能影响实际变量。The four channels together depress domestic demand and net external demand → weaker aggregate demand + a stronger home currency → downward pressure on inflation. Note: the four channels are interrelated, not independent (previously tested). The central bank believes money is not neutral in the short run, otherwise adjusting nominal rates could not affect real variables.

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

三大货币政策工具与传导

工具:① 公开市场操作(买卖国债)——最常用、灵活;② 存款准备金率;③ 政策/贴现利率。降息/购债 = 宽松,加息/售债 = 紧缩。

传导机制

政策利率 → 市场利率 → 影响投资与消费、资产价格、汇率、通胀预期 → 总需求 → 产出与通胀。整个链条存在时滞,且效果依赖信心与银行放贷意愿。

易错对比

① 公开市场操作是日常主力工具;② 降息→刺激、加息→抑制;③ 传导有时滞且并非总有效(见流动性陷阱)。

The three monetary tools & transmission

Tools: ① open-market operations (buy/sell government bonds) — the main, flexible tool; ② the reserve requirement; ③ the policy/discount rate. Rate cuts/bond buying = easing; hikes/selling = tightening.

Transmission mechanism

Policy rate → market rates → investment and consumption, asset prices, the exchange rate, inflation expectations → aggregate demand → output and inflation. The chain has lags and depends on confidence and banks' willingness to lend.

Common traps

① Open-market operations are the everyday workhorse; ② cuts stimulate, hikes restrain; ③ transmission has lags and isn't always effective (see the liquidity trap).

16. 三大货币政策工具中,发达经济体已很少使用的是:Among the three main monetary-policy tools, the one rarely used in developed economies is:

  • A. 政策利率The policy rate
  • B. 存款准备金率The reserve requirement ratio
  • C. 公开市场操作Open-market operations
答案 B。准备金率对银行破坏性大,发达国家少用,新兴市场仍常用。Answer B. Reserve requirements are disruptive to banks, so developed countries rarely use them, while emerging markets still do.

17. 央行反复公开市场买入国债,属于何种政策立场:The central bank repeatedly buys government bonds in the open market; this is what policy stance:

  • A. 收缩性Contractionary
  • B. 中性Neutral
  • C. 扩张性Expansionary
答案 C。买入国债→准备金增加→信贷与广义货币扩张(QE 同理);提高准备金率才是收缩。Answer C. Buying bonds → reserves rise → credit and broad money expand (QE works the same); raising the reserve ratio is contractionary.

18. 关于美国"贴现率"与"联邦基金利率",最恰当的是:Regarding the US 'discount rate' and 'federal funds rate,' the most appropriate statement is:

  • A. 贴现率才是银行间拆借利率The discount rate is the interbank lending rate
  • B. 贴现率=银行直接向美联储借款的利率;联邦基金利率=银行间隔夜拆借准备金的利率(货币政策最重要)The discount rate = the rate at which banks borrow directly from the Fed; the fed funds rate = the overnight interbank rate on reserves (the most important for monetary policy)
  • C. 两者是同一利率They are the same rate
答案 B。FOMC 每约 6 周设定联邦基金利率目标,并用公开市场操作实现。Answer B. The FOMC sets a fed funds rate target roughly every six weeks and achieves it via open-market operations.

19. 货币政策传导的四条渠道(短期利率、资产价格、预期、汇率)之间的关系是:The relationship among the four monetary-policy transmission channels (short-term rates, asset prices, expectations, exchange rate) is:

  • A. 完全相互独立They are completely independent
  • B. 只有一条真正起作用Only one really works
  • C. 相互关联,并不独立They are interrelated, not independent
答案 C。四渠道彼此交织,"相互独立"是常见错误选项。Answer C. The four channels are intertwined; 'independent' is a common trap answer.
1. 下列哪项货币政策行为最可能被视为扩张性?即央行:1. Which of the following monetary policy actions is most likely considered expansionary? The central bank: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 在回购协议中充当出借方(买入债券)。acts as the lender in a repurchase agreement.
  • B. 向商业银行出售政府债券。sells government bonds to commercial banks.
  • C. 提高商业银行的准备金要求。raises reserve requirements of commercial banks.
答案 A。扩张性货币行为 = 央行"放钱":在回购中充当出借方、买入债券(注入准备金/流动性)。卖债、提高准备金要求都是收缩。Answer A. Expansionary monetary action = the central bank injecting money: acting as lender in a repo and buying bonds (adding reserves/liquidity). Selling bonds or raising reserve requirements are contractionary.
2. 当央行向商业银行出售政府债券时,广义货币增长:2. When a central bank sells government bonds to commercial banks, broad money growth: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 下降。decreases.
  • B. 保持不变。remains the same.
  • C. 上升。increases.
答案 A。央行卖出政府债券 → 收回银行准备金 → 广义货币增长下降(收缩)。买入才增加货币。Answer A. When the central bank sells government bonds, it drains bank reserves → broad money growth falls (contractionary). Buying would increase money.
3. 为增加流动性,央行最可能实施的利率政策是:3. To increase liquidity, a central bank most likely implements an interest rate policy that is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 收缩性。contractionary.
  • B. 中性。neutral.
  • C. 扩张性。expansionary.
答案 C。为增加流动性要用扩张性(降息)利率政策。收缩会收紧流动性;中性无此效果。Answer C. To add liquidity, use an expansionary (rate-cutting) policy. Contractionary tightens liquidity; neutral does neither.

LM4 §3 通胀目标制:独立性、可信度、透明度LM4 §3 Inflation Targeting: Independence, Credibility, Transparency

LOS 对应:LOS: describe qualities of effective central banks; contrast inflation, interest rate, and exchange rate targeting。

通胀目标制(inflation targeting):1989 年新西兰首创(《储备银行法》把 0–2% 目标写入法律,RBNZ 获得操作独立性),1990 年代成为共识,加拿大、英国、瑞典、欧央行等广泛采纳。成功取决于三个关键概念:Inflation targeting: pioneered by New Zealand in 1989 (the Reserve Bank Act wrote a 0–2% target into law and gave the RBNZ operational independence), it became a consensus in the 1990s and was widely adopted by Canada, the UK, Sweden, the ECB, and others. Success rests on three key concepts:

要素Element内容Content
独立性 independenceIndependence政客盯着连任,可能在选前压低利率、酿成通胀,故决策应远离选举周期。但独立有程度之分:央行行长几乎都由政府任命,完全隔离不可能。目标独立(target independent)=自行决定盯什么通胀、目标多少、多长期限达成(如欧央行,目标+操作双独立);操作独立(operationally independent)=目标由政府定,央行只自主决定利率如何达成(如新西兰、瑞典、英国)Politicians eyeing re-election may cut rates before an election and breed inflation, so decisions should be insulated from the election cycle. But independence comes in degrees: central-bank governors are almost always appointed by the government, so complete insulation is impossible. Target independent = decides on its own what inflation to target, at what level, and over what horizon (e.g., the ECB, both target- and operationally independent); operationally independent = the target is set by the government and the bank only decides how to hit it (e.g., New Zealand, Sweden, the UK)
可信度 credibilityCredibility若由负债累累的政府自己定通胀目标(通胀能侵蚀其债务实际价值),没人会信。可信的央行的目标会成为自我实现的预言:大家相信明年 2%,2% 就被写进工资合同与名义契约,从而真的实现 2%。因此央行高度关注通胀预期(如油价大涨后预期若失控,会嵌入工资谈判)If a debt-laden government set its own inflation target (inflation erodes the real value of its debt), no one would believe it. A credible central bank's target becomes a self-fulfilling prophecy: if everyone believes next year will be 2%, 2% gets written into wage contracts and nominal agreements and is thereby actually achieved. So central banks watch inflation expectations closely (e.g., after a big oil-price rise, if expectations become unanchored they get embedded in wage bargaining)
透明度 transparencyTransparency定期(通常每季)发布通胀报告,依次阐述:广义货币与信贷状况 → 金融市场状况 → 实体经济(如劳动力市场)→ 价格演变,并给出中期(约两年)增长与通胀预测。公开决策逻辑积累声誉与可信度Regularly (usually quarterly) publishes an inflation report, addressing in turn: broad money and credit conditions → financial-market conditions → the real economy (e.g., the labor market) → price developments, with medium-term (about two-year) growth and inflation forecasts. Publicizing the decision logic builds reputation and credibility

目标为什么是 2%(而非 0% 或 10%)?

  • 目标 0% → 通胀难免有时为负,陷入通缩风险,而利率降不到零下太多,应对通缩很难;A 0% target → inflation will inevitably sometimes be negative, risking deflation, and rates cannot fall much below zero, making deflation hard to fight;
  • 目标 10% → 与价格稳定不符,高通胀伴随高波动与不确定性;A 10% target → inconsistent with price stability, as high inflation comes with high volatility and uncertainty;
  • 2%(通常 ±1 个百分点区间,基于 CPI)被认为离通缩足够远、又低到不会引发破坏性冲击。各国:澳 2–3%、加 1–3%、欧央行"接近但低于 2%"、韩 2%、新西兰 1–3% 均值靠近 2%、瑞典/英国 2%±1pp;2% (usually a ±1-percentage-point band, based on CPI) is deemed far enough from deflation yet low enough not to cause damaging shocks. By country: Australia 2–3%, Canada 1–3%, ECB 'close to but below 2%', Korea 2%, New Zealand 1–3% averaging near 2%, Sweden/UK 2%±1pp;
  • 盯的是约两年后的通胀而非当前通胀:公布的通胀是过去 12 个月的历史,且利率变化经传导机制起效需要时间。It targets inflation about two years out, not current inflation: published inflation is the past 12 months' history, and rate changes take time to work through the transmission mechanism.

两大例外与发展中国家的障碍

  • 日本央行(BoJ):长期对抗通缩,通胀目标制被视为"控通胀"的工具,似乎无用武之地;有人主张宣布 3% 目标促成自我实现,但 BoJ 从未成功制造持续通胀,可信度存疑;The Bank of Japan (BoJ): long fighting deflation, inflation targeting is seen as a tool for 'controlling inflation' with seemingly no role to play; some argue for announcing a 3% target to spark a self-fulfilling result, but the BoJ has never successfully manufactured sustained inflation, so its credibility is in doubt;
  • 美联储:法定三重使命(最大就业、物价稳定、温和长期利率),单一通胀目标可能损害"最大就业";实践中以核心 PCE 平减指数约 2% 或略低为物价稳定的标尺,市场紧盯该指标预判 Fed 动作;The Fed: a legal triple mandate (maximum employment, stable prices, moderate long-term rates), so a single inflation target might harm 'maximum employment'; in practice it uses core PCE deflator around 2% or slightly below as its price-stability yardstick, which markets watch closely to anticipate Fed moves;
  • 发展中国家障碍(5 条):缺乏流动性充足的国债市场与发达的银行间市场;经济变化快、中性利率与货币-经济关系难以把握;金融创新快、货币供应定义频繁变化;历史控通胀记录差、政策可信度低;政府不愿给央行真正的独立性。Obstacles in developing countries (5): the lack of a liquid government-bond market and a developed interbank market; a fast-changing economy where the neutral rate and money-economy relationship are hard to gauge; rapid financial innovation that frequently changes the definition of money supply; a poor track record on inflation control and low policy credibility; governments unwilling to give the central bank genuine independence.

20. 关于"目标独立"与"操作独立",以及欧央行、英格兰银行的归类,最恰当的是:Regarding 'goal independence' vs 'operational independence,' and the classification of the ECB and the Bank of England, the most appropriate is:

  • A. 两行均无任何独立性Neither bank has any independence
  • B. 目标独立=自定通胀目标;操作独立=只决定如何达成;欧央行双独立,英格兰银行仅操作独立Goal independence = sets its own inflation target; operational independence = decides only how to achieve it; the ECB has both, the BoE has only operational independence
  • C. 欧央行仅操作独立,英格兰银行双独立The ECB has only operational independence, the BoE has both
答案 B。英格兰银行(及新西兰、瑞典)仅操作独立,目标由政府设定。Answer B. The BoE (and New Zealand, Sweden) has only operational independence; the target is set by government.

21. 通胀目标定 2% 而非 0%、且盯"两年后"通胀,主要原因是:Setting the inflation target at 2% rather than 0%, and targeting inflation 'two years ahead,' is mainly because:

  • A. 0% 目标易引发通缩风险(利率难降至零下);且公布的通胀是历史数据、利率传导需要时间A 0% target risks deflation (rates cannot easily go below zero), and published inflation is historical while rate transmission takes time
  • B. 2% 是法律强制的上限2% is a legally mandated ceiling
  • C. 央行无法测量当期通胀The central bank cannot measure current inflation
答案 A。留出正的缓冲避免通缩,并因传导时滞而前瞻性地盯未来通胀。Answer A. A positive buffer avoids deflation, and transmission lags mean targeting future inflation forward-looking.
1. 独立性、可信度与透明度最可能是:1. Independence, credibility, and transparency are most likely: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 财政政策的关键目标。key objectives of fiscal policy.
  • B. 货币传导机制的性质。properties of the monetary transmission mechanism.
  • C. 决定通胀目标制央行成败的品质。qualities that determine the success of an inflation-targeting central bank.
答案 C。独立性、可信度、透明度 = 决定"通胀目标制"央行成败的三大品质。它们不是财政目标,也不是传导机制本身。Answer C. Independence, credibility, and transparency = the three qualities that determine the success of an inflation-targeting central bank. They are not fiscal goals or the transmission mechanism itself.
2. 有效央行的通胀目标最可能是:2. The inflation target of an effective central bank is most likely: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 等于零以避免通缩风险。equal to zero to avoid the risk of deflation.
  • B. 足够低于零以维持高可信度。sufficiently below zero to maintain high credibility.
  • C. 足够低以确保相当程度的价格稳定。low enough to ensure a significant degree of price stability.
答案 C。有效央行的通胀目标设为"足够低"以确保价格稳定(通常约 2%),但高于零以留缓冲、避免通缩。故 A(零)、B(低于零)都错。Answer C. An effective central bank sets its inflation target low enough to ensure price stability (typically ~2%) but above zero to leave a buffer and avoid deflation. So A (zero) and B (below zero) are wrong.
3. 为有效实施通胀目标制,央行最不需要的是:3. To be effective in targeting inflation a central bank is least likely to need: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 政府监督。government oversight.
  • B. 决策透明。transparency of decisions.
  • C. 对市场参与者的可信度。credibility with market participants.
答案 A。通胀目标制央行最不需要"政府监督"——它需要独立性(不受政府干预)。透明度和可信度是必需的。Answer A. An inflation-targeting central bank least needs "government oversight" — it needs independence (freedom from government interference). Transparency and credibility are essential.

LM4 §4 汇率目标制LM4 §4 Exchange-Rate Targeting

许多发展中经济体不盯国内通胀,而是盯住汇率:对某主要货币设定固定水平或区间,央行在外汇市场买卖本币维持目标。逻辑:把本币与低通胀、政策可信经济体的货币绑定,相当于"进口"对方的低通胀。(1980 年代英国在货币供应目标失败后曾盯住德国马克。)Many developing economies do not target domestic inflation but peg the exchange rate: set a fixed level or band against a major currency, with the central bank buying/selling the home currency in the FX market to hold the target. The logic: tying the home currency to that of a low-inflation, policy-credible economy amounts to 'importing' the other's low inflation. (In the 1980s, after its money-supply target failed, the UK pegged to the German mark.)

  • 机制(本国通胀高于美国时):本币面临贬值压力 → 央行卖外储、买本币 → 国内货币供应收缩、短期利率上升 → 货币被动收紧(若预期能压下通胀,汇率回升);本国通胀偏低时反向操作(卖本币 → 货币供应扩张、利率下降);Mechanism (when domestic inflation exceeds the US): the home currency faces depreciation pressure → the central bank sells reserves and buys the home currency → domestic money supply contracts and short rates rise → money passively tightens (if this is expected to curb inflation, the exchange rate recovers); when domestic inflation is low, do the reverse (sell home currency → money supply expands, rates fall);
  • 代价:国内利率与货币供应必须服从汇率目标,变得更波动——盯住汇率就放弃了独立的国内货币政策;Cost: domestic rates and money supply must serve the exchange-rate target and become more volatile — pegging surrenders independent domestic monetary policy;
  • 可信度是生死线:不可信就会招来投机攻击——1992 年英镑被逐出欧洲汇率机制(ERM),1997 年泰国央行为守泰铢耗尽外储,7 月贬值引爆亚洲金融危机(外币借款企业与银行的债务危机、区域传染);Credibility is a matter of survival: a non-credible peg invites speculative attack — in 1992 sterling was forced out of the European Exchange Rate Mechanism (ERM); in 1997 Thailand's central bank exhausted its reserves defending the baht, and the July devaluation ignited the Asian financial crisis (a debt crisis for foreign-currency-borrowing firms and banks, with regional contagion);
  • 形式谱系:盯住(peg,如沙特、卡塔尔、阿联酋、中国香港、黎巴嫩、巴哈马、百慕大盯美元)→ 管理浮动(区间内浮动)→ 美元化(dollarization):直接采用美元为本国货币(巴拿马 1904、厄瓜多尔 2000、萨尔瓦多 2000、东帝汶 2001),比盯住更彻底。Spectrum of forms: a peg (e.g., Saudi Arabia, Qatar, the UAE, Hong Kong, Lebanon, the Bahamas, and Bermuda peg to the USD) → a managed float (floating within a band) → dollarization: adopting the US dollar directly as the national currency (Panama 1904, Ecuador 2000, El Salvador 2000, Timor-Leste 2001), more thorough than a peg.

22. 盯住汇率的国家,当本国通胀高于目标国时会发生什么:For a country pegging its exchange rate, what happens when domestic inflation exceeds the target country's:

  • A. 本币升值→利率下降The home currency appreciates → rates fall
  • B. 汇率与利率均不受影响Neither the exchange rate nor rates are affected
  • C. 本币贬值压力→央行卖外储买本币→货币供应收缩、短期利率被动上升Downward pressure on the home currency → the central bank sells reserves and buys home currency → money supply contracts and short rates are passively pushed up
答案 C。好处是"进口"目标国低通胀,代价是失去独立货币政策;不可信则遭投机攻击(1992 英镑、1997 泰铢)。Answer C. The benefit is 'importing' the target country's low inflation; the cost is loss of independent monetary policy; if not credible it is attacked by speculators (1992 sterling, 1997 baht).

LM4 §5 扩张与收缩:中性利率与冲击来源LM4 §5 Expansion & Contraction: The Neutral Rate & Shock Sources 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

5.1 中性利率(必会计算)

中性利率 = 实际趋势增长率 + 长期预期通胀(通胀目标)
符号/概念Symbol/Concept含义Meaning
中性利率 neutral rateNeutral rate既不刺激也不减速经济的政策利率;应等于一个完整商业周期内政策利率的平均值。政策利率 高于中性利率 = 收缩性;低于 = 扩张性The policy rate that neither stimulates nor slows the economy; it should equal the average policy rate over a full business cycle. A policy rate above the neutral rate = contractionary; below = expansionary
实际趋势增长率Real trend growth rate长期可持续且通胀稳定的实际增速(难测,信贷泡沫破裂后许多西方国家被下修)The long-run sustainable, inflation-stable real growth rate (hard to measure; revised down for many Western countries after the credit-bubble burst)
长期预期通胀Long-run expected inflation可信通胀目标制下即通胀目标Under credible inflation targeting, this is the inflation target
教材算例 · 中性利率

趋势增长 2.5% + 通胀目标 2.0% → 中性利率 = 4.5%:政策利率高于 4.5% 为收缩、低于为扩张。课后题:趋势增长 3% + 目标 2% → 中性利率 5%,选项 4%/5%/6% 中4% 是扩张性。理论上把政策利率设在中性利率 → 促成稳定的通胀。Trend growth 2.5% + inflation target 2.0% → neutral rate = 4.5%: a policy rate above 4.5% is contractionary, below is expansionary. Practice question: trend growth 3% + target 2% → neutral rate 5%, and among options 4%/5%/6%, 4% is expansionary. In theory, setting the policy rate at the neutral rate → produces stable inflation.

5.2 冲击来源决定该不该动利率

  • 需求冲击(demand shock):信心上升 → 消费与投资增速上升 → 通胀走高。应对:加息收紧,合理;Demand shock: rising confidence → faster consumption and investment growth → higher inflation. Response: hike to tighten, which is reasonable;
  • 供给冲击(supply shock):如油价上涨推高通胀。此时加息可能雪上加霜——消费者已被油价挤压,利润与消费将降、失业将升,加息只会加剧油价引发的下行,最终通胀反而骤降。央行必须先识别冲击来源,再决定松紧。Supply shock: e.g., an oil-price rise pushes up inflation. Here hiking may make things worse — consumers are already squeezed by oil prices, profits and consumption will fall and unemployment will rise, and a hike only deepens the oil-driven downturn, ultimately making inflation plunge. The central bank must first identify the shock's source, then decide on tightening/loosening.
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

中性利率与冲击来源

中性(自然)政策利率 ≈ 趋势实际增长率 + 目标通胀率,是既不刺激也不抑制经济的水平。政策利率 < 中性 → 扩张性;政策利率 > 中性 → 收缩性。

需求冲击 vs 供给冲击

• 需求冲击:产出与通胀同向,央行方向明确(降温或托底)。
• 供给冲击(如油价):产出与通胀反向(滞胀)→ 央行两难:抑通胀会加深衰退。

易错对比

① 松紧看政策利率相对中性利率,不是相对零;② 供给冲击让央行陷入两难;③ 中性利率随趋势增长与通胀目标变动。

The neutral rate & sources of shocks

The neutral (natural) policy rate ≈ trend real growth + target inflation, the level that neither stimulates nor restrains. Policy rate < neutral → expansionary; policy rate > neutral → contractionary.

Demand vs supply shocks

• Demand shock: output and inflation move together, so the central bank's direction is clear.
• Supply shock (e.g., oil): output and inflation move oppositely (stagflation) → a central-bank dilemma: fighting inflation deepens the downturn.

Common traps

① Judge stance versus the neutral rate, not versus zero; ② supply shocks create a dilemma; ③ the neutral rate shifts with trend growth and the inflation target.

23. 趋势增长 3%、通胀目标 2%,政策利率 4% 的立场,及中性利率的构成:With trend growth 3% and an inflation target of 2%, the stance of a 4% policy rate, and the components of the neutral rate:

  • A. 4% 恰好等于中性利率4% exactly equals the neutral rate
  • B. 中性利率=5%,4% 低于中性→扩张性;中性利率=实际趋势增长率 + 长期预期通胀Neutral rate = 5%, so 4% is below neutral → expansionary; neutral rate = real trend growth + long-run expected inflation
  • C. 中性利率=1%,4% 为收缩性Neutral rate = 1%, so 4% is contractionary
答案 B。中性利率 3+2=5%;政策利率低于中性即扩张性。Answer B. Neutral rate 3 + 2 = 5%; a policy rate below neutral is expansionary.

24. 通胀由油价上涨(供给冲击)引起,央行是否应加息:If inflation is caused by rising oil prices (a supply shock), should the central bank raise rates:

  • A. 应谨慎——供给冲击下加息可能加剧下行,需先识别冲击来源It should be cautious — under a supply shock a rate hike may deepen the downturn, so identify the shock's source first
  • B. 立即大幅加息Hike sharply immediately
  • C. 必须降息刺激It must cut rates to stimulate
答案 A。供给冲击已压制利润、消费、就业,加息会雪上加霜;唯需求过热才适合加息。Answer A. A supply shock already depresses profits, consumption, and employment; hiking makes it worse; only demand overheating warrants a hike.
1. 分析师收集某经济体数据:
实际趋势增长率0.5%
央行政策利率1.5%
若货币政策是收缩性的,则央行的通胀目标为:1. An analyst gathers the following data about an economy:
Real trend growth rate0.5%
Central bank's policy rate1.5%
If monetary policy is contractionary, the central bank's inflation target is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 低于 1.0%。less than 1.0%.
  • B. 等于 1.0%。equal to 1.0%.
  • C. 高于 1.0%。greater than 1.0%.
答案 A。方法:收缩性 → 政策利率 > 中性利率(= 潜在增长 + 通胀目标)。由给定政策利率与增长反解,得通胀目标 < 1.0%。Answer A. Method: contractionary → policy rate > neutral rate (= potential growth + inflation target). Back-solving from the given policy rate and growth gives an inflation target < 1.0%.
2. 若某经济体长期增长潜力为每年 2%,央行通胀目标为每年 3%,则中性利率最可能为:2. If an economy has a long-term growth potential of 2% per year and the central bank's inflation target is 3% per year, the neutral rate of interest is most likely: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 1%。1%.
  • B. 3%。3%.
  • C. 5%。5%.
答案 C。中性(名义)利率 = 长期潜在增长 + 通胀目标 = 2% + 3% = 5%。Answer C. Neutral (nominal) rate = long-run potential growth + inflation target = 2% + 3% = 5%.

LM4 §6 货币政策的局限:流动性陷阱、通缩与 QELM4 §6 Limits of Monetary Policy: Liquidity Trap, Deflation & QE

6.1 传导机制会失灵

  • 长期利率取决于预期的短期利率路径:若债市认为央行加息过头、将引发衰退并低于通胀目标,通胀预期下降反而令长期利率下跌——长期借贷变便宜,经济反被刺激,与央行意图相反;Long-term rates depend on the expected path of short-term rates: if the bond market thinks the central bank has hiked too much and will cause a recession undershooting the inflation target, falling inflation expectations actually lower long-term rates — long-term borrowing becomes cheaper and the economy is stimulated instead, contrary to the central bank's intent;
  • 债市义警(bond market vigilantes):认为央行控不住通胀时抛售长债、推高长端收益率,给宽松政策"踩刹车";预期紧缩将引发急剧放缓时又买入长债、压低长端利率。央行越可信,长端越稳定,越不需要"义警"代劳;Bond market vigilantes: when they think the central bank cannot control inflation, they sell long bonds and push up long-end yields, putting a 'brake' on loose policy; when they expect tightening to cause a sharp slowdown, they buy long bonds and lower long-end rates. The more credible the central bank, the more stable the long end, and the less need for 'vigilantes';
  • 流动性陷阱(liquidity trap):货币需求变得无限弹性(货币需求曲线水平),继续注入货币也无法进一步压低利率或影响实际活动——货币政策完全失效。其经济条件与通缩相伴。Liquidity trap: money demand becomes infinitely elastic (a horizontal money-demand curve), so further money injections cannot push rates down or affect real activity — monetary policy is wholly ineffective. Its economic condition accompanies deflation.

6.2 通缩为什么难对付

  • 通缩(deflation):一般价格指数普遍且持续的下跌。名义利率难以降到零下太多(2014 年欧洲部分国家、2016 年日本曾负利率),常规工具触底;Deflation: a general and sustained fall in the overall price index. Nominal rates cannot fall much below zero (some European countries had negative rates in 2014, Japan in 2016), so conventional tools hit bottom;
  • 通缩抬高债务的实际价值;价格持续下跌诱使消费者推迟消费 → 需求进一步下降 → 通缩加剧——"通缩陷阱":消费疲软、价格下跌、实际债务上升的自我强化循环(1990 年代初地产泡沫破裂后的日本)。Deflation raises the real value of debt; continually falling prices induce consumers to defer consumption → demand falls further → deflation deepens — a 'deflationary trap': a self-reinforcing loop of weak consumption, falling prices, and rising real debt (Japan after its early-1990s property-bubble burst).

6.3 量化宽松(QE)

量化宽松(quantitative easing):利率到零后的"非常规"政策,操作上类似公开市场买入,但规模大得多——央行印钞购买资产、向经济注入准备金,希望重启放贷、扩张广义货币、拉动实体活动。案例:Quantitative easing (QE): an 'unconventional' policy once rates hit zero, operationally similar to open-market buying but on a much larger scale — the central bank prints money to buy assets and inject reserves, hoping to restart lending, expand broad money, and boost real activity. Cases:

  • 英国:买入 3–5 年期金边债券(gilts,英国国债);UK: bought 3–5-year gilts (UK government bonds);
  • 美国:QE1 主要买房利美/房地美发行或担保的按揭债券(压低按揭利率、支撑楼市;之前还救助了银行间与商业票据市场);QE2(2010.11):新造 6,000 亿美元、8 个月内均匀买入长期国债,目的是压低长债收益率、鼓励借贷;QE3(2012.9):每月 400 亿美元买机构 MBS,"直到劳动力市场实质改善",2013.12 开始缩减(tapering),2014.10 结束;US: QE1 mainly bought mortgage bonds issued or guaranteed by Fannie Mae/Freddie Mac (lowering mortgage rates and supporting housing; it had earlier rescued the interbank and commercial-paper markets); QE2 (Nov 2010): created $600bn and bought long-term Treasuries evenly over 8 months to lower long-bond yields and encourage borrowing; QE3 (Sep 2012): $40bn/month of agency MBS 'until the labor market improves substantially,' with tapering from Dec 2013 and an end in Oct 2014;
  • 日本(教材案例):1989 年 Nikkei 225 达 38,915 点,泡沫破裂后 2003 年 3 月跌 80% 至 7,972;BoJ 把利率从 1990 年的 8% 降到 1996 年 1%、2001 年 2 月降到零;零利率后的两条互补路径:
    ① 承诺长期不加息(压低整条收益率曲线)、② QE 买入资产——BoJ 2001 年双管齐下,把准备金水平而非利率作为目标。效果难言成功:通缩一度转正,2008–09 又回通缩;2013 年起 BoJ 资产/GDP 从约 30% 飙到 2020 年超 170%,仍未根除通缩——货币政策的力量存在极限;    Japan (textbook case): the Nikkei 225 reached 38,915 in 1989, and after the bubble burst it fell 80% to 7,972 by March 2003; the BoJ cut rates from 8% in 1990 to 1% in 1996 and to zero in February 2001; two complementary paths after zero:
    ① a commitment not to hike for a long time (lowering the whole yield curve),
    ② QE asset purchases — the BoJ did both from 2001, targeting the level of reserves rather than the interest rate. The results are hard to call a success: deflation briefly turned positive, then returned in 2008–09; from 2013 the BoJ's assets/GDP soared from about 30% to over 170% by 2020, yet deflation was not eradicated — there are limits to the power of monetary policy;
  • QE 的风险:央行若买入含信用风险的资产而亏损,可能对其"主产品"——法定货币——造成致命的信心丧失;银行也可能宁愿囤积超额准备金而不放贷(经济环境差时贷给可能违约的家庭企业不如持有准备金)。Risks of QE: if the central bank buys credit-risky assets and takes losses, it may inflict a fatal loss of confidence in its 'main product' — fiat money; banks may also prefer to hoard excess reserves rather than lend (in a bad environment, lending to potentially defaulting households and firms is worse than holding reserves).
考点提示:货币政策的根本局限(高频考点):央行无法控制家庭和企业存多少钱进银行,也无法轻易控制银行扩张信贷的意愿——因此不能完全控制货币供应。零利率长期无增长 → 说明货币政策效果可能有限。QE 属于扩张性立场;提高准备金率属于收缩性。想鼓励借贷投资时,央行最不可能做的是卖出长期国债(那会推高长端利率)。

25. 关于流动性陷阱与货币政策的"根本局限",最恰当的是:Regarding the liquidity trap and the 'fundamental limit' of monetary policy, the most appropriate is:

  • A. 货币需求无限弹性时注入货币也压不动利率;根本局限是央行控制不了公众存款与银行放贷意愿When money demand is infinitely elastic, injecting money cannot push rates down; the fundamental limit is that the central bank cannot control the public's deposits or banks' willingness to lend
  • B. 流动性陷阱下利率必然飙升In a liquidity trap rates must surge
  • C. 央行能完全控制货币供应The central bank can fully control the money supply
答案 A。流动性陷阱常伴通缩;货币政策无法直接掌控存款与放贷行为。Answer A. A liquidity trap often accompanies deflation; monetary policy cannot directly control deposit and lending behavior.
1. 在下列哪种条件下货币政策最有效?即当:1. Under which of the following conditions is monetary policy most effective? When the: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 货币需求无限弹性时。demand for money is infinitely elastic.
  • B. 央行盯住汇率时。central bank targets an exchange rate.
  • C. 通胀风险大于通缩风险时。risk of inflation is greater than deflation.
答案 C。货币政策在"通胀风险 > 通缩风险"时最有效——加息抑制通胀好用。盯汇率会牺牲货币自主;货币需求无限弹性=流动性陷阱,政策失效。Answer C. Monetary policy is most effective when inflation risk > deflation risk — hiking to curb inflation works well. Pegging FX sacrifices autonomy; infinitely elastic money demand = a liquidity trap where policy fails.
2. 就传统货币政策而言,对抗通胀最可能:2. With respect to conventional monetary policy, combating inflation is most likely: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 比对抗通缩更容易。less difficult than combating deflation.
  • B. 与对抗通缩同样困难。equally difficult as combating deflation.
  • C. 比对抗通缩更困难。more difficult than combating deflation.
答案 A。对抗通胀比对抗通缩容易:加息几乎总能压住通胀,但降息到零后遇通缩就"弹尽"(流动性陷阱)。Answer A. Fighting inflation is easier than fighting deflation: raising rates almost always curbs inflation, but once rates hit zero in deflation, policy is "out of ammunition" (liquidity trap).
3. 下列哪项最可能限制货币政策的有效性?3. Which of the following is most likely to limit the effectiveness of monetary policy? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 流动性陷阱A liquidity trap
  • B. 挤出效应The crowding out effect
  • C. 政府支出实施的时滞A time lag to implement government spending
答案 A。流动性陷阱(liquidity trap)限制货币政策:利率近零时再降息也刺激不动经济。挤出效应、财政时滞是财政政策的问题。Answer A. A liquidity trap limits monetary policy: near zero rates, further cuts fail to stimulate. Crowding out and implementation lags are fiscal-policy issues.
4. 下列哪项是货币政策的一个局限?4. Which of the following is a limitation of monetary policy? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 经济中自动稳定器的存在The presence of automatic stabilizers in the economy
  • B. 通缩环境下利率调整的失效The ineffectiveness of interest rate adjustments in deflationary environments
  • C. 不同人群间收入与财富分配不均The uneven distribution of income and wealth among different segments of the population
答案 B。货币政策的一个局限 = 通缩环境下利率调整失效(零利率下限)。自动稳定器、分配不均是财政话题。Answer B. A limitation of monetary policy = rate adjustments failing in a deflationary environment (the zero lower bound). Automatic stabilizers and distribution are fiscal topics.

LM4 §7 货币与财政政策的互动LM4 §7 Interaction of Monetary & Fiscal Policy 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: explain the interaction of monetary and fiscal policy。

7.1 四种政策组合(必背矩阵)

组合Mix效果Effect
松财政 + 紧货币Loose fiscal + tight monetary财政扩张拉高产出,货币收缩推高利率、压制私人需求 → 产出更高、利率更高、政府部门占 GDP 比重上升Fiscal expansion raises output while monetary contraction raises rates and suppresses private demand → higher output, higher rates, and the government sector's share of GDP rises
紧财政 + 松货币Tight fiscal + loose monetary低利率刺激私人部门 → 私人部门占比上升、公共部门收缩(适合想促进私人投资、提高潜在增长时)Low rates stimulate the private sector → the private sector's share rises and the public sector shrinks (suited to promoting private investment and raising potential growth)
双松Both loose高度扩张:总需求大增、利率更低(若货币效应占上风)、公私部门同时扩张Highly expansionary: aggregate demand surges, rates lower (if the monetary effect dominates), and both public and private sectors expand
双紧Both tight利率上升压制私人需求,加税减支压制公共需求 → 总需求全面下降Rising rates suppress private demand while tax hikes and spending cuts suppress public demand → aggregate demand falls across the board

政策组合受政治环境影响:弱势政府可能迫于利益集团压力扩大支出,此时需要紧货币来对冲通胀风险。相比财政政策,货币政策的优势:独立央行决策快、不受政治阻力(收紧财政在政治上很难,自动稳定器常是财政收紧的实际来源);若李嘉图等价成立(减税被完全储蓄对冲),政策者更会偏好货币工具。The policy mix is influenced by the political environment: a weak government may expand spending under interest-group pressure, in which case tight money is needed to hedge inflation risk. Monetary policy's advantages over fiscal policy: an independent central bank decides quickly and free of political resistance (fiscal tightening is politically hard, and automatic stabilizers are often the real source of fiscal tightening); if Ricardian equivalence holds (a tax cut fully offset by saving), policymakers will further prefer monetary tools.

7.2 IMF 模型的实证结论(记相对大小)

  • 无货币配合(利率随需求立即上升):政府支出对 GDP 的拉动是同等规模普通社会转移支付的 6 倍;定向给最穷者的转移支付效果是非定向的 2 倍;劳动税减税略强于非定向转移;Without monetary accommodation (rates rise immediately with demand): government spending boosts GDP 6 times as much as an equal-size ordinary social transfer; a transfer targeted at the poorest is 2 times as effective as an untargeted one; a labor-tax cut is slightly stronger than an untargeted transfer;
  • 有货币配合(利率两年不动):除劳动税减税外,乘数显著放大——政府支出的累积乘数从 1.6 → 3.9;定向转移从 0.5 → 1.7。放大机制:总需求与通胀上升 + 名义利率不动 → 实际利率下降 → 私人支出追加;With monetary accommodation (rates held for two years): except for the labor-tax cut, the multipliers are greatly amplified — the cumulative government-spending multiplier goes from 1.6 → 3.9; the targeted transfer from 0.5 → 1.7. The amplification mechanism: rising aggregate demand and inflation + fixed nominal rates → falling real rates → additional private spending;
  • 信誉与承诺:若赤字被认为将长期持续,通胀预期与长期利率上升,刺激效果减半;若美国债务/GDP 永久上升 10 个百分点,世界实际利率 +0.14%、世界 GDP 永久 −0.6%;Credibility and commitment: if the deficit is thought to persist long-term, inflation expectations and long-term rates rise, and the stimulus effect is halved; if US debt/GDP rises permanently by 10 percentage points, the world real rate rises 0.14% and world GDP is permanently −0.6%;
  • QE 与财政的边界:央行大规模购买国债,实质上是在为预算赤字融资——货币政策独立性沦为幻觉,即所谓赤字货币化(monetization of the deficit),与常规通胀目标无关,不少经济学家质疑独立央行是否应为之。The QE-fiscal boundary: large-scale central-bank purchases of government bonds are in effect financing the budget deficit — monetary-policy independence becomes an illusion, so-called monetization of the deficit, unrelated to conventional inflation targeting, and many economists question whether an independent central bank should do it.
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

货币与财政政策的互动

四种组合决定利率与产出结构:
• 松货币 + 松财政:强力刺激,产出大升,利率方向不定。
• 紧货币 + 紧财政:强力抑制。
• 松财政 + 紧货币:利率偏高,财政赤字推高利率挤出私人投资,结构偏政府部门。
• 松货币 + 紧财政:利率偏低,结构偏私人部门。

易错对比

① 组合影响的是利率水平与产出构成;② 挤出效应:财政扩张抬高利率、压低私人投资;③ 「松财政+紧货币」利率最高、私人被挤出最明显。

Interaction of monetary & fiscal policy

Four combinations shape rates and the composition of output:
• Loose money + loose fiscal: strong stimulus, big output rise, ambiguous rate direction.
• Tight money + tight fiscal: strong restraint.
• Loose fiscal + tight money: higher rates; the deficit pushes rates up and crowds out private investment, tilting toward the public sector.
• Loose money + tight fiscal: lower rates, tilting toward the private sector.

Common traps

① The mix drives rate levels and output composition; ② crowding out: fiscal expansion raises rates and cuts private investment; ③ "loose fiscal + tight money" gives the highest rates and clearest crowding out.

26. 关于财政货币政策组合,最恰当的是:Regarding fiscal-monetary policy mixes, the most appropriate is:

  • A. 松财政+紧货币使政府部门占比下降Loose fiscal + tight monetary lowers the government share
  • B. 紧财政+紧货币使公私部门同时扩张Tight fiscal + tight monetary expands both sectors together
  • C. 松财政+紧货币时政府部门占 GDP 比重上升;双松使公私部门同时扩张;IMF 研究中政府直接支出对总需求冲击最大Loose fiscal + tight monetary raises the government sector's share of GDP; both loose expands public and private sectors together; in IMF studies direct government spending has the biggest impact on aggregate demand
答案 C。政府直接支出乘数最大(约为普通转移支付的 6 倍,有货币配合时达 3.9)。Answer C. Direct government spending has the largest multiplier (about 6× an ordinary transfer, reaching 3.9 with monetary support).
1. 若收缩性财政政策与扩张性货币政策对 GDP 的影响相互抵消,则公共部门占 GDP 的比重最可能:1. If contractionary fiscal policy and expansionary monetary policy have offsetting effects on GDP, the public sector's share of GDP will most likely: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 下降。decrease.
  • B. 保持不变。remain the same.
  • C. 上升。increase.
答案 A。收缩财政(减支/增税)+ 扩张货币(降息),对 GDP 影响抵消但政府支出下降 → 公共部门占 GDP 比重下降。Answer A. Contractionary fiscal (less spending/higher tax) + expansionary monetary (lower rates) offset on GDP, but government spending falls → the public sector's share of GDP declines.
2. 在其他条件不变、且工资与物价刚性的假设下,政府支出减少且利率下降最可能反映:2. All else being equal, and assuming that wages and prices of goods are rigid, a decrease in government spending and decreasing interest rates most likely reflect: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 宽松财政+宽松货币。easy fiscal policy and easy monetary policy.
  • B. 紧缩财政+宽松货币。tight fiscal policy and easy monetary policy.
  • C. 宽松财政+紧缩货币。easy fiscal policy and tight monetary policy.
答案 B。政府支出减少(紧缩财政)+ 利率下降(宽松货币)= 紧缩财政 + 宽松货币。这种组合压低政府占比、支持私人投资。Answer B. Government spending falls (tight fiscal) while rates fall (easy monetary) = tight fiscal + easy monetary. This mix shrinks the government share and supports private investment.

学完本讲后,建议做教材 LM3 第 110–111 页、LM4 第 145–147 页的 Practice Problems 原题,再对照本页自测题解析。After this lecture, work through the original Practice Problems on curriculum pages 110–111 (LM3) and 145–147 (LM4), then compare with the self-test explanations on this page.

CFA Program Curriculum · 2026 · Level I · Volume 2 · Economics

第三讲 · 地缘政治导论 & 国际贸易Lecture 3 · Introduction to Geopolitics & International Trade

对应教材:Learning Module 5《Introduction to Geopolitics》+ Learning Module 6《International Trade》 · 建议学习时长:3–4 小时 · 建议分两次学完(LM5 约 2 小时,LM6 约 1.5 小时)Curriculum: Learning Module 5 Introduction to Geopolitics + Learning Module 6 International Trade · Suggested study time: 3–4 hours · Best done in two sittings (LM5 ~2 hours, LM6 ~1.5 hours)

这两个模块风格差异很大。LM5 地缘政治几乎没有公式,全是框架与概念辨析——考点密集在"合作 vs 非合作""四种国家原型""三类地缘政治风险""三类政策工具",靠的是把每个术语的定义和归类背准。LM6 国际贸易则有本讲唯一的计算模块:关税的福利效应(消费者剩余、生产者剩余、无谓损失),以及关税/配额/VER/出口补贴四者的效应对比表——这是一级考试国际贸易部分最爱考的一张表。These two modules differ greatly in style. LM5 Geopolitics has almost no formulas — it is all frameworks and conceptual distinctions — with exam points clustered on 'cooperative vs non-cooperative,' 'the four country archetypes,' 'the three types of geopolitical risk,' and 'the three types of policy tools,' relying on memorizing each term's definition and classification. LM6 International Trade holds the lecture's only calculation module: the welfare effects of a tariff (consumer surplus, producer surplus, deadweight loss), and the effects-comparison table of tariff/quota/VER/export subsidy — the table the Level I trade section loves to test.
