LM5 §1 地缘政治:合作 vs 非合作LM5 §1 Geopolitics: Cooperative vs Non-Cooperative

LOS 对应:LOS: describe geopolitics from a cooperation versus competition perspective。

地缘政治(geopolitics):研究地理如何影响政治与国际关系的学科。分析行为主体(actors)——从事政治、经济、金融活动的个人、组织、公司和政府——及其相互作用。两类主体:Geopolitics: the study of how geography influences politics and international relations. It analyzes actors — individuals, organizations, companies, and governments engaged in political, economic, and financial activity — and their interactions. Two types of actors:

  • 国家主体(state actors):对国家安全与资源行使权力的政府、政治组织、国家领导人(如英国首相、马来西亚议会);State actors: governments, political organizations, and national leaders that exercise power over national security and resources (e.g., the UK Prime Minister, the Malaysian Parliament);
  • 非国家主体(non-state actors):参与全球事务但不直接控制国家安全或资源的主体(NGO、跨国公司、慈善机构、有影响力的商界或文化名人)。Non-state actors: actors that participate in global affairs but do not directly control national security or resources (NGOs, multinational corporations, charities, influential business or cultural figures).

政治合作 vs 非合作(一条连续谱)

政治合作(political cooperation):各国就相互间活动的规则与标准化达成一致的程度。一个"合作型"国家的特征 vs "非合作型"国家:Political cooperation: the degree to which countries agree on the rules and standardization of their mutual activities. The features of a 'cooperative' country vs a 'non-cooperative' one:

合作(cooperation)Cooperation非合作(non-cooperation)Non-cooperation
规则标准化;关税协调;边境自由流动;允许商品、服务、资本流动;对等回报(reciprocation);技术交流Rule standardization; tariff coordination; free flow across borders; allowing flows of goods, services, and capital; reciprocation; technology exchange规则不一致、任意专断;跨境流动受限;贸易限制、资本管制;报复;缺乏技术交流Inconsistent, arbitrary rules; restricted cross-border flows; trade restrictions and capital controls; retaliation; a lack of technology exchange

国家选择合作的原因由其国家利益(national interest)——目标与抱负——决定,可以是军事、经济或文化的:A country's reasons for choosing cooperation are determined by its national interest — its goals and aspirations — which can be military, economic, or cultural:

  • 国家安全/军事利益:保护国家、公民、经济和制度免受外部威胁。地理因素影响合作倾向:内陆国(如瑞士)高度依赖邻国获取资源,更需要合作;而位于贸易要道的国家(新加坡)或贸易通道国(巴拿马)可把地理位置当作权力杠杆。National-security/military interest: protecting the country, its citizens, economy, and institutions from external threats. Geographic factors affect the tendency to cooperate: a landlocked country (e.g., Switzerland) depends heavily on neighbors for resources and needs cooperation more; a country astride a trade artery (Singapore) or a trade-conduit country (Panama) can use its location as power leverage.
  • 经济利益:国家安全概念已扩展到能源、粮食、水等资源获取。合作型国家通常聚焦两点:通过贸易确保关键资源,或通过标准化为本国企业创造公平的全球竞争环境。Economic interest: the concept of national security has expanded to access to resources such as energy, food, and water. Cooperative countries usually focus on two things: securing key resources through trade, or creating a level global playing field for domestic firms through standardization.
考点提示:判断"是否属于政治合作"——凡涉及规则与标准化的协议就是合作(engages and reciprocates in rules standardization);而"充当贸易通道"(如巴拿马利用地理位置当杠杆)、"选用软实力而非军事报复"都属于非合作行为(软实力只是较温和的非合作)。注意:合作型国家必须既参与又对等回报——只参与不回报不算合作。

1. 以下哪种行为最可能属于地缘政治合作:Which behavior is most likely to constitute geopolitical cooperation:

  • A. 充当贸易通道(利用地理位置当杠杆)Acting as a trade conduit (using geographic position as leverage)
  • B. 参与规则与标准的标准化Participating in the standardization of rules and standards
  • C. 用软实力代替军事报复Using soft power in place of military retaliation
答案 B。合作以规则/标准化协议为标志;A 是非合作,C 中软实力与军事报复都属非合作(只是较温和)。Answer B. Cooperation is marked by rules/standardization agreements; A is non-cooperative, and in C both soft power and military retaliation are non-cooperative (just milder).

2. 国家安全工具是否必然是非合作的:Are national-security tools necessarily non-cooperative:

  • A. 是,除非放弃军事Yes, unless the military is abandoned
  • B. 否;武装冲突、间谍是非合作用法,但集体安全协议(如 NATO)是合作用法No; armed conflict and espionage are non-cooperative uses, but collective-security pacts (e.g., NATO) are cooperative uses
  • C. 是,国家安全工具一律非合作Yes, national-security tools are always non-cooperative
答案 B。NATO 等集体安全减少成员间及对外冲突,属合作用法。Answer B. Collective security such as NATO reduces conflict among members and outward, a cooperative use.

LM5 §2 资源禀赋、标准化、软实力与利益层级LM5 §2 Resource Endowment, Standardization, Soft Power & the Hierarchy of Interests

  • 地球物理资源禀赋(geophysical resource endowment):宜居地理气候、粮食与水的获取。各国极不均衡:美、俄、澳、中相对自给;西欧、日本、土耳其高度依赖他国的化石燃料;沙特化石燃料充裕但许多基本需求依赖进口。资源富国有政治杠杆,但若资源收益分配不均也可能引发内部不稳。Geophysical resource endowment: livable geography and climate, and access to food and water. It is highly uneven across countries: the US, Russia, Australia, and China are relatively self-sufficient; Western Europe, Japan, and Turkey depend heavily on others for fossil fuels; Saudi Arabia is rich in fossil fuels but imports many basic needs. Resource-rich countries have political leverage, but if resource proceeds are unevenly distributed, internal instability may result.
  • 标准化(standardization):为产品/服务的生产、销售、运输或使用制定协议。三类(记教材三个例子):监管合作(巴塞尔银行监管委员会 BCBS)、流程标准化(SWIFT 全球支付电信协会)、操作同步(集装箱标准化 Containerization)。也可由行业组织等非国家主体推动。Standardization: setting agreements for the production, sale, transport, or use of products/services. Three types (memorize the three textbook examples): regulatory cooperation (the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision, BCBS), process standardization (SWIFT, the global payments-messaging society), and operational synchronization (containerization). It can also be driven by non-state actors such as industry organizations.
  • 软实力(soft power):不靠武力或胁迫影响他国决策的手段,通过文化项目、广告、旅行资助、大学交流等长期建立(如欧盟 Erasmus+ 交流项目、韩国在全球地铁投放首尔旅游广告)。Soft power: means of influencing other countries' decisions without force or coercion, built over the long term through cultural programs, advertising, funded travel, and university exchanges (e.g., the EU's Erasmus+ exchange program, Korea placing Seoul tourism ads in subways worldwide).
  • 制度(institutions):社会中既定的组织或惯例,可以是正式的(大学、法律支撑的组织流程)或非正式的(习俗、行为模式)。强制度(问责、法治、产权保护)带来更稳定的内外政治力量,使合作关系更持久、降低国家背弃合作的可能。Institutions: established organizations or practices in a society, either formal (universities, law-backed organizational processes) or informal (customs, patterns of behavior). Strong institutions (accountability, rule of law, property-rights protection) bring more stable domestic and external political forces, making cooperative relationships more durable and lowering the chance a country abandons cooperation.

利益层级(hierarchy of interests)

可把国家利益看作一个层级:生存所必需的在顶端,"锦上添花但非必需"的在底部。政府用这个层级指导行为——在有利时选择合作,但当两种需求导致冲突的合作策略时,层级更高者优先。例:关税协调本身有利,但若两国处于军事冲突且军事决心排位更高,则合作不符合国家利益。基本需求满足后,层级会变得更主观(新政府对军备/医保的排序可能与前任大不相同)。National interests can be viewed as a hierarchy: those essential to survival at the top, 'nice-to-have but not essential' at the bottom. Governments use this hierarchy to guide behavior — choosing cooperation when advantageous, but when two needs imply conflicting cooperation strategies, the higher-ranked one prevails. Example: tariff coordination is beneficial in itself, but if two countries are in military conflict and military resolve ranks higher, cooperation is not in the national interest. Once basic needs are met, the hierarchy becomes more subjective (a new government's ranking of defense vs healthcare may differ greatly from its predecessor's).

考点提示:
① 利益层级中文化项目开发通常排最低(军事决心是国家安全核心、关税协调改善经济,都比文化项目高)。
② 政治周期长度影响优先级设定:周期短(如澳大利亚议会任期较短)的政府缺乏动力关注气候变化、收入不平等这类长期议题——"政治周期不影响优先级"是错误表述。
③ 决策者的心理与不可预测性也会影响国家的合作/非合作选择。

极端非合作案例:委内瑞拉因贩毒、不配合反恐及政治压制受到美欧制裁——注意施加制裁本身就是美欧的一种非合作手段,而委内瑞拉把政治自决置于公民人道代价之上。这类极端案例罕见,因为其他国家对合作的重视往往会促使它们施压迫使非合作国参与。An extreme non-cooperation case: Venezuela faced US and European sanctions over drug trafficking, non-cooperation on counterterrorism, and political repression — note that imposing sanctions is itself a form of non-cooperation by the US and Europe, while Venezuela placed political self-determination above the humanitarian cost to its citizens. Such extreme cases are rare, because other countries' emphasis on cooperation often leads them to pressure the non-cooperative country to participate.

3. 国家利益层级中,以下哪项通常排在最低优先级:In the hierarchy of national interests, which typically ranks lowest in priority:

  • A. 关税协调Tariff coordination
  • B. 军事决心Military resolve
  • C. 文化项目开发Cultural program development
答案 C。军事决心是国家安全核心,关税协调改善经济活动;文化项目优先级最低。Answer C. Military resolve is core to national security and tariff coordination improves economic activity; cultural programs are lowest priority.

4. 三类标准化与教材例子的正确配对是:The correct pairing of the three types of standardization with the textbook examples is:

  • A. 监管合作—SWIFT;流程标准化—集装箱Regulatory cooperation — SWIFT; process standardization — containers
  • B. 操作同步—BCBSOperational synchronization — BCBS
  • C. 监管合作—巴塞尔委员会(BCBS);流程标准化—SWIFT;操作同步—集装箱标准化Regulatory cooperation — Basel Committee (BCBS); process standardization — SWIFT; operational synchronization — container standardization
答案 C。监管→BCBS、流程→SWIFT、操作→集装箱。Answer C. Regulatory → BCBS, process → SWIFT, operational → containers.
1. 就地缘政治而言,为运输集装箱的尺寸和形状设定标准最可能是下列哪项的例子?1. With respect to geopolitics, setting standards for the size and shape of containers used for shipping is most likely an example of: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 监管合作。regulatory cooperation.
  • B. 流程标准化。process standardization.
  • C. 运营同步化。operational synchronization.
答案 C。为集装箱设定统一尺寸标准 = 运营同步化(operational cooperation/harmonization)——让流程跨国衔接。监管合作是规则协调;这里是实操层面的标准统一。Answer C. Setting standard container dimensions = operational harmonization — making processes interoperate across borders. Regulatory cooperation is about rules; this is standardizing operations.

LM5 §3 全球化:动因、收益与成本LM5 §3 Globalization: Drivers, Benefits & Costs

LOS 对应:LOS: describe geopolitics and its relationship with globalization。

全球化(globalization):全球范围内人、企业、政府之间互动与融合的过程,以产品、信息、工作、文化的跨境传播为标志——是经济与金融合作的结果,主要由非国家主体(公司、个人、组织)推动。相对地,反全球化/民族主义(nationalism)是以损害他国利益为代价促进本国经济利益,以有限的经济金融合作为标志。世界银行开放指数(全球贸易占 GDP 比重)从 1970 年 27% 升至 2019 年超 60%,但 2008 年后遇逆风(金融危机、民族主义抬头、容量约束)。Globalization: the process of interaction and integration among people, firms, and governments worldwide, marked by the cross-border spread of products, information, jobs, and culture — it is the result of economic and financial cooperation, driven mainly by non-state actors (firms, individuals, organizations). By contrast, anti-globalization/nationalism promotes domestic economic interests at the expense of other countries, marked by limited economic and financial cooperation. The World Bank openness index (global trade as a share of GDP) rose from 27% in 1970 to over 60% in 2019, but hit headwinds after 2008 (the financial crisis, rising nationalism, capacity constraints).

考点提示(高频填空):政治合作与非合作可由国家(national)主体驱动;而全球化作为经济金融合作的结果,主要由次国家(subnational)/非政府主体(公司、个人、组织)推动;有机的私人部门(private sector)力量即使没有政府支持也能驱动产品与思想的交流。全球化与合作相关但独立——政治合作能促进/加速全球化,但全球化本身是独立过程。

全球化的动因(三大潜在收益)

动因Driver内容Content
提高利润Raising profit两条途径:
① 增加销售——进入新市场获取新客户(可能需在当地建厂、雇工培训);
② 降低成本——进入低税环境、降低劳动力成本、供应链效率提升。资本密集型行业(如汽车业整合)靠扩产获得规模经济降低平均成本Two routes:
① increasing sales — entering new markets to gain new customers (may require building plants and hiring/training locally);
② lowering costs — entering low-tax environments, lowering labor costs, improving supply-chain efficiency. Capital-intensive industries (e.g., auto consolidation) achieve economies of scale by expanding output to lower average cost
获取资源与市场Accessing resources and markets获取本国稀缺或昂贵的人才、原材料;寻求海外市场准入与投资机会。两类跨境资金流:组合投资流(portfolio investment flows)= 对外国股票债券的短期投资;外国直接投资(FDI)= 对外国生产能力的长期投资Accessing talent and raw materials that are scarce or expensive at home; seeking overseas market access and investment opportunities. Two types of cross-border capital flow: portfolio investment flows = short-term investment in foreign stocks and bonds; foreign direct investment (FDI) = long-term investment in foreign productive capacity
内在收益(intrinsic gain)Intrinsic gain超越利润本身的副产品收益,难以衡量但推动全球化势头,也是稳定力量(增进主体间共情、降低地缘威胁)。例:个人拓展视野的成长/教育、学习新方法带来的生产率加速By-product gains beyond profit itself, hard to measure but driving globalization's momentum and also a stabilizing force (building empathy among actors, lowering geopolitical threats). Examples: personal growth/education that broadens horizons, productivity acceleration from learning new methods

其他总体收益:更多选择、更高质量商品、企业竞争加剧、更高效率、劳动力流动性提高。Other aggregate gains: more choice, higher-quality goods, intensified competition among firms, greater efficiency, and higher labor mobility.

全球化的成本

  • 收益分配不均:总量改善不等于人人受益。企业把工厂迁到他国,在新国创造就业却减少本国就业。Uneven distribution of gains: an aggregate improvement does not mean everyone benefits. A firm moving a plant abroad creates jobs in the new country but reduces jobs at home.
  • 更低的 ESG 标准:企业到低成本国按当地(较低)的环保、社会、治理标准生产,账面利润可能上升但整体效应可能为负。Lower ESG standards: firms producing in low-cost countries to those countries' (lower) environmental, social, and governance standards may raise book profit but the overall effect can be negative.
  • 政治后果:上述两点造成国内外收入与财富不平等、机会差异,反映到国内政治,成为削减甚至回退政治合作的力量。Political consequences: the two points above create income and wealth inequality and differences in opportunity at home and abroad, which feed into domestic politics and become a force to cut or even roll back political cooperation.
  • 相互依存(interdependence):企业和国家可能依赖他国资源支撑供应链,一旦供应链中断(含政治非合作)就无法自产。例:稀土(LED、显示屏)主要产自中国,铜(可再生能源)主要产自智利;COVID-19 半导体短缺推高全球汽车价格。Interdependence: firms and countries may depend on other countries' resources to support supply chains, and cannot produce domestically if the chain breaks (including via political non-cooperation). Examples: rare earths (LEDs, displays) are mostly produced in China, copper (renewable energy) mostly in Chile; the COVID-19 semiconductor shortage pushed up global car prices.

全球化回退(rollback)案例:2018 年起美国"America first"政策、贸易战(对欧盟加征关税、重谈 NAFTA→USMCA)。但完全逆转不太可能,企业用三种策略巩固供应链:
① 关键品回流(reshoring the essentials)——把必需品供应链迁回本国应急;
② 再全球化生产(reglobalizing)——复制或强化供应链;
③ 加倍押注关键市场(doubling down)——因大市场规模、基础设施、成熟供应链,某些企业选择留在中国、加拿大、墨西哥等关键市场,"在国内、为国内"生产结合外部供应链。A globalization rollback case: from 2018 the US 'America first' policy and trade war (tariffs on the EU, renegotiating NAFTA→USMCA). But a full reversal is unlikely, and firms use three strategies to shore up supply chains:
① reshoring the essentials — bringing essential supply chains home for contingencies;
② reglobalizing production — duplicating or reinforcing supply chains;
③ doubling down on key markets — because of large market size, infrastructure, and mature supply chains, some firms choose to stay in key markets like China, Canada, and Mexico, combining 'in-country, for-country' production with external supply chains.

考点提示:
① 最能增加地缘政治风险的行为是限制外汇兑换(反全球化特征);增加资本流动、增加商品服务贸易都降低风险。
② 区分三回流策略:在现有加拿大工厂扩大关键零件产能供应本国市场 = 回流(reshoring)(USMCA 下美加经济紧密整合,等同迁回本国降低制造风险),不是"再全球化"(那要复制/新建供应链),也不是"加倍押注"(那要扩大在该市场的销售存在)。

5. 全球化与政治合作/非合作分别主要由谁驱动:Globalization vs political cooperation/non-cooperation are each driven mainly by whom:

  • A. 两者都由政府独家驱动Both are driven exclusively by governments
  • B. 全球化由次国家/非政府主体(公司、个人、组织)推动;政治合作/非合作由国家主体驱动Globalization is driven by sub-national/non-governmental actors (firms, individuals, organizations); political cooperation/non-cooperation is driven by state actors
  • C. 全球化由国家主体推动;政治合作由企业驱动Globalization is driven by state actors; political cooperation by firms
答案 B。私人部门力量即使无政府支持也能驱动全球化;政治合作/非合作是国家行为。Answer B. Private-sector forces can drive globalization even without government support; political cooperation/non-cooperation is state behavior.

6. 下列哪种行为最能增加地缘政治风险:Which behavior most increases geopolitical risk:

  • A. 增加资本流动Increasing capital flows
  • B. 限制外汇兑换Restricting currency convertibility
  • C. 从事商品服务贸易Engaging in trade of goods and services
答案 B。限制外汇兑换是反全球化特征,降低合作、抬升风险;A、C 增加流动、降低风险。Answer B. Restricting currency convertibility is an anti-globalization feature, lowering cooperation and raising risk; A and C increase flows and lower risk.

7. 组合投资流与外国直接投资(FDI)的区别是:The difference between portfolio investment flows and foreign direct investment (FDI) is:

  • A. 组合投资流是长期,FDI 是短期Portfolio flows are long-term and FDI is short-term
  • B. 两者都是短期投机Both are short-term speculation
  • C. 组合投资流是对外国股债的短期投资;FDI 是对外国生产能力的长期投资Portfolio flows are short-term investment in foreign stocks/bonds; FDI is long-term investment in foreign productive capacity
答案 C。FDI 着眼长期产能,组合投资流是短期金融投资。Answer C. FDI targets long-term capacity; portfolio flows are short-term financial investment.

8. 美国公司在其现有加拿大工厂扩大关键零件产能以供应本国客户,属于哪种供应链策略:A US firm expands key-component capacity at its existing Canadian plant to supply domestic customers; which supply-chain strategy is this:

  • A. 回流关键品(reshoring the essentials)Reshoring the essentials
  • B. 再全球化(re-globalization)Re-globalization
  • C. 加倍押注(doubling down)Doubling down
答案 A。USMCA 下美加紧密整合,等同迁回本国降低制造风险;再全球化需新建,加倍押注需扩大当地销售。Answer A. Under USMCA, tight US-Canada integration makes this equivalent to bringing production home to reduce manufacturing risk; re-globalization requires new build-out, and doubling down requires expanding local sales.
1. 下列哪项最可能导致全球化程度上升?即下列哪项的下降:1. Which of the following would most likely lead to an increase in globalization? A decrease in: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 软实力。soft power.
  • B. 民族主义。nationalism.
  • C. 标准化。standardization.
答案 B。民族主义(nationalism)下降 → 全球化上升(更开放)。软实力、标准化上升反而促进全球化,故其"下降"不利全球化。Answer B. A fall in nationalism → more globalization (greater openness). Rising soft power and standardization promote globalization, so their "decline" would hinder it.
2. 下列哪项最可能是全球化的收益?2. Which of the following is most likely a benefit of globalization? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 利润增加Increased profits
  • B. 收入分配更平均More equal income distribution
  • C. 更严格的 ESG 标准Stronger environmental, social, and governance standards
答案 A。全球化的收益之一 = 利润增加(更大市场、更低成本)。它常使收入分配更不均、并不必然提高 ESG 标准,故 B、C 错。Answer A. A benefit of globalization = higher profits (larger markets, lower costs). It often makes income distribution less even and does not necessarily tighten ESG standards, so B and C are wrong.
3. 就全球化的动因而言,下列哪项最能被刻画为内在收益(intrinsic gain)?3. With respect to motivations for globalization, which of the following is best characterized as an intrinsic gain? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 供应链效率提升Increased supply chain efficiency
  • B. 因学习新方法而加速的生产率Accelerated productivity from learning new methods
  • C. 获取本国难以获得的资源Access to resources that are not readily available in the home country
答案 B。内在收益(intrinsic gain)= 因学习新方法而提升的生产率(能力本身的提升)。供应链效率、获取稀缺资源是"交易性"收益。Answer B. An intrinsic gain = productivity boosted by learning new methods (a genuine capability improvement). Supply-chain efficiency and accessing scarce resources are "transactional" gains.

LM5 §4 三大国际贸易组织LM5 §4 The Three International Trade Bodies

LOS 对应:LOS: describe functions and objectives of the international organizations that facilitate trade — World Bank, IMF, WTO。

历史背景:1930 年代大萧条中各国竞相提高贸易壁垒、竞争性贬值、限制外汇,结果自我毁灭、世界贸易大幅萎缩。1944 年布雷顿森林会议(45 国)确立国际经济合作框架,催生世界银行(会议期间成立)与IMF(1945 年 12 月正式成立)。第三个机构 ITO(国际贸易组织)因美国国会反对而流产,GATT(关税与贸易总协定,1947 签署、1948 生效)成为 1948–1995 年间唯一管辖国际贸易的多边工具,直到 1995 年 WTO 成立。Historical background: in the 1930s Great Depression, countries raced to raise trade barriers, competitively devalue, and restrict foreign exchange, resulting in self-destruction and a sharp shrinkage of world trade. The 1944 Bretton Woods Conference (45 countries) established a framework for international economic cooperation, giving rise to the World Bank (created during the conference) and the IMF (formally established in December 1945). A third body, the ITO (International Trade Organization), was stillborn due to US Congressional opposition, and GATT (the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade, signed 1947, effective 1948) became the only multilateral instrument governing international trade from 1948 to 1995, until the WTO was created in 1995.

组织Organization核心使命Core mission要点Key points
IMF
国际货币基金组织IMF (International Monetary Fund)		确保国际货币体系(汇率与国际支付体系)的稳定,使各国能互相买卖商品服务Ensure the stability of the international monetary system (exchange rates and the international payments system) so countries can buy and sell goods and services with each other向有重大外部赤字/国际收支问题的成员国临时借出外汇(严格条件+持续监测)。职能:提供国际货币问题合作论坛、促进贸易增长与就业、支持汇率稳定与开放支付体系。投资视角:控制国别市场风险与全球系统性风险(2010 希腊主权债务危机——申请等值 SDR 264 亿的备用安排 SBA,防止主权债务危机蔓延;SDR 是日元/美元/英镑/欧元四种货币的一篮子;1997 东亚危机也施以援手)Temporarily lends foreign exchange to members with major external deficits/balance-of-payments problems (strict conditions + continuous monitoring). Functions: providing a cooperative forum on international monetary problems, promoting trade growth and employment, and supporting exchange-rate stability and an open payments system. Investment angle: controlling country-market risk and global systemic risk (the 2010 Greek sovereign-debt crisis — applying for a Stand-By Arrangement (SBA) worth SDR 26.4bn to prevent contagion; the SDR is a basket of four currencies — yen/dollar/pound/euro; the IMF also aided the 1997 East Asian crisis)
世界银行
World BankWorld Bank		帮助发展中国家脱贫并促进环境可持续的经济增长Help developing countries reduce poverty and promote environmentally sustainable economic growth两个附属实体:IBRD(国际复兴开发银行,市场化、靠发行 AAA 债券融资、把低利率传导给借款的发展中国家)和 IDA(国际开发协会,全球最大的对最穷国无息贷款与赠款来源,由 40 个捐助国每三年补充)。均不以营利为目的。投资视角:为发展中国家创造基础经济设施,IBRD 是国际资本市场最重要的超国家借款人之一(顶级投资级评级)Two affiliated entities: the IBRD (International Bank for Reconstruction and Development, market-based, funding itself by issuing AAA bonds and passing low rates through to borrowing developing countries) and the IDA (International Development Association, the world's largest source of interest-free loans and grants to the poorest countries, replenished every three years by 40 donor countries). Both are non-profit. Investment angle: building basic economic infrastructure for developing countries; the IBRD is one of the most important supranational borrowers in international capital markets (top investment-grade rating)
WTO
世界贸易组织WTO (World Trade Organization)		提供多边贸易体系的法律与制度基础,是唯一在全球范围规管国家间跨境贸易关系的国际组织Provide the legal and institutional foundation of the multilateral trading system; it is the only international body regulating cross-border trade relations among nations globally1995 年成立取代 GATT。GATT(货物贸易主协定,1994 更新版仍存在)与 GATS(服务贸易总协定)是核心协定。最重要职能:实施/管理各项协定、充当谈判平台、解决争端,并审查成员贸易政策。最近一轮多哈回合(2001 卡塔尔)未达成最终协议,但促成中国 2001 年 12 月入世。投资视角:全球贸易规则框架是今天跨国公司存在的制度基础Established in 1995 to replace GATT. GATT (the main goods-trade agreement, whose 1994 updated version still exists) and GATS (the General Agreement on Trade in Services) are the core agreements. Its most important functions: implementing/administering the agreements, serving as a negotiating platform, resolving disputes, and reviewing members' trade policies. The most recent round, the Doha Round (2001, Qatar), reached no final agreement but led to China's WTO accession in December 2001. Investment angle: the global trade-rules framework is the institutional basis for today's multinational corporations

9. 关于 IMF、世界银行、WTO,以及"唯一全球规管跨境贸易的组织",最恰当的是:Regarding the IMF, World Bank, and WTO, and 'the only global body regulating cross-border trade,' the most appropriate is:

  • A. WTO 负责国际货币体系稳定The WTO is responsible for international monetary stability
  • B. IMF 稳定国际货币体系;世界银行助发展中国家脱贫增长;WTO 制定全球贸易规则,且是唯一全球规管跨境贸易的组织The IMF stabilizes the international monetary system; the World Bank helps developing countries reduce poverty and grow; the WTO sets global trade rules and is the only global body regulating cross-border trade
  • C. 世界银行是唯一规管贸易的组织The World Bank is the only body regulating trade
答案 B。防止 2010 希腊危机蔓延、控制系统性风险的是 IMF。Answer B. It was the IMF that prevented the 2010 Greek crisis from spreading and controlled systemic risk.

10. 1948–1995 年间唯一管辖国际贸易的多边机构是:The only multilateral body governing international trade from 1948–1995 was:

  • A. WTOThe WTO
  • B. ITOThe ITO
  • C. GATT(关税与贸易总协定)GATT (General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade)
答案 C。ITO 因美国国会反对流产;WTO 1995 年才成立。Answer C. The ITO was stillborn due to US Congressional opposition; the WTO was created only in 1995.
1. 下列哪个组织的成立目标是协助重建国际支付体系?1. Which of the following organizations was founded with the goal of assisting in the reconstruction of the international payment system? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 世界贸易组织(WTO)The World Trade Organization
  • B. 国际货币基金组织(IMF)The International Monetary Fund
  • C. 国际复兴开发银行(IBRD)The International Bank for Reconstruction and Development
答案 B。IMF(国际货币基金组织)成立目标 = 协助重建国际支付体系、稳定汇率。WTO 管贸易规则;IBRD(世界银行)促发展/减贫。Answer B. The IMF was founded to help rebuild the international payments system and stabilize exchange rates. The WTO governs trade rules; the IBRD (World Bank) promotes development/poverty reduction.
2. 世界银行集团的主要目标是:2. The main objective of the World Bank Group is to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 支持汇率稳定与开放的国际支付体系。support exchange rate stability and an open system of international payments.
  • B. 为多边贸易体系提供法律与制度基础。provide the legal and institutional foundation of the multinational trading system.
  • C. 帮助发展中国家消除贫困并促进环境可持续的经济增长。help developing countries fight poverty and enhance environmentally sound economic growth.
答案 C。世界银行集团的主要目标 = 帮助发展中国家减贫、促进可持续增长。稳定汇率是 IMF;贸易法律框架是 WTO。Answer C. The World Bank Group's main goal = helping developing countries reduce poverty and achieve sustainable growth. Exchange-rate stability is the IMF; the trade legal framework is the WTO.

LM5 §5 四种国家行为原型LM5 §5 The Four Country Behavior Archetypes 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: describe geopolitical risk(框架部分)。

用两个坐标轴——政治合作 vs 非合作、全球化 vs 民族主义——构成四象限,得到四种国家行为原型(archetypes)。每种都有各自的成本、收益和地缘政治风险权衡。核心洞见:越依赖跨境商品与资本流动的国家/行业,增长与投资回报越受益于全球合作;但同样的相互依存也使合作型主体比不依赖合作的主体更易受地缘政治风险冲击——多元化生产提供一定保护,但也提供了更多风险触点。Two axes — political cooperation vs non-cooperation, and globalization vs nationalism — form four quadrants, giving four state-behavior archetypes. Each has its own cost, benefit, and geopolitical-risk trade-offs. The core insight: the more a country/industry depends on cross-border goods and capital flows, the more its growth and investment returns benefit from global cooperation; but the same interdependence also makes cooperative actors more vulnerable to geopolitical-risk shocks than actors that do not depend on cooperation — diversified production offers some protection but also more risk touchpoints.

原型Archetype坐标位置Quadrant position特征与例子Features and examples
自给自足
AutarkyAutarky		非合作 + 民族主义Non-cooperation + nationalism寻求政治自给自足,几乎无对外贸易或金融;国企控制战略性国内产业。好处:政治更强、完全掌控技术与舆论;有时带来更快发展。例:20 世纪大部分时间的中国(后转向合作,大幅脱贫);朝鲜、委内瑞拉(导致经济政治发展逐步倒退)Seeks political self-sufficiency, with almost no foreign trade or finance; state-owned enterprises control strategic domestic industries. Benefits: stronger politically, full control of technology and public opinion; sometimes faster development. Examples: China for much of the 20th century (later turning to cooperation and greatly reducing poverty); North Korea, Venezuela (leading to gradual regression in economic and political development)
霸权
HegemonyHegemony		非合作 + 全球化Non-cooperation + globalization区域或全球领导者,用政治/经济影响力控制资源;国企控制关键出口市场。好处:对全球事务的重要影响力;盟友享受领导者标准带来的稳定。成本:霸权影响力增减时可能更具竞争性、增加风险。例:中国的技术转让要求;俄罗斯的天然气管道杠杆(2014 吞并克里米亚)A regional or global leader using political/economic influence to control resources; state-owned enterprises control key export markets. Benefits: significant influence over global affairs; allies enjoy stability from the leader's standards. Costs: may become more competitive and raise risk as hegemonic influence waxes and wanes. Examples: China's technology-transfer requirements; Russia's gas-pipeline leverage (annexing Crimea in 2014)
多边主义
MultilateralismMultilateralism		合作 + 全球化Cooperation + globalization参与互利贸易关系和广泛的规则协调;私企完全融入有多个贸易伙伴的全球供应链。经济增长率更高,但也更易受地缘政治风险冲击。例:德国、新加坡(全球最开放经济体、地理位于贸易要道、制度稳定、多元英语人口)Engages in mutually beneficial trade relations and broad rule coordination; private firms are fully integrated into global supply chains with multiple trading partners. Higher economic growth rates, but also more vulnerable to geopolitical-risk shocks. Examples: Germany, Singapore (the world's most open economy, geographically astride a trade artery, with stable institutions and a diverse English-speaking population)
双边主义
BilateralismBilateralism		合作 + 民族主义Cooperation + nationalism两国之间一对一的政治/经济/金融/文化合作(可与多国有关系,但都是逐一协议)。介于双边与多边之间的是区域主义(regionalism)——一组国家相互合作,可排斥外部。例:曾经的日本(为建强出口市场而政治合作,但不全球化进口;如今已是多边主体)One-to-one political/economic/financial/cultural cooperation between two countries (it may have relationships with many countries, but each is a bilateral agreement). Between bilateralism and multilateralism lies regionalism — a group of countries cooperating with each other, possibly excluding outsiders. Example: Japan in the past (political cooperation to build strong export markets but without globalizing imports; now a multilateral actor)
考点提示:
① 两坐标都是连续谱,国家很少处于极端,且位置是移动的目标——地缘政治风险分析本质上是动态的(地理因素相对恒久并不意味着分析稳定)。风险分析不仅看当前在哪个象限,还看在该象限内的稳定性。
② 行为差异最大的一对原型:多边主义 vs 自给自足(在两个坐标轴上都相距最远)。双边主义与自给自足共享"反全球化"倾向、但在合作维度分歧;多边主义与霸权共享"全球化"倾向、但在合作维度分歧。

11. 四种国家行为原型中,差异最大的一对是:Among the four archetypes of state behavior, the pair that differs most is:

  • A. 多边 vs 双边Multilateral vs bilateral
  • B. 多边主义 vs 自给自足Multilateralism vs autarky
  • C. 霸权 vs 双边Hegemony vs bilateral
答案 B。自给自足(非合作+民族)与多边(合作+全球化)在两轴上都相距最远。Answer B. Autarky (non-cooperative + nationalist) and multilateral (cooperative + globalist) are farthest apart on both axes.
1. 下列哪种行为原型最能描述一个在全球化维度高、但在合作维度低的国家?1. Which of the following behavioral archetypes best describes a country that is high on the globalization spectrum but low on the cooperation spectrum? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 自给自足(autarky)Autarky
  • B. 霸权(hegemony)Hegemony
  • C. 双边主义(bilateralism)Bilateralism
答案 B。全球化高、合作低 → 霸权(hegemony)(单方主导规则)。自给自足是全球化低;双边主义是合作中等的两两安排。Answer B. High globalization but low cooperation → hegemony (one power dominates the rules). Autarky is low globalization; bilateralism is pairwise arrangements with moderate cooperation.

LM5 §6 地缘政治的三类工具LM5 §6 The Three Types of Geopolitical Tools

LOS 对应:LOS: describe tools of geopolitics and their impact on regions and economies。

工具是投资者面对的地缘政治风险的最终来源。三类,每类都有促进合作与升级冲突两种用法(促进合作 = 增加国家间商品/服务/资本/劳动力的流动;升级冲突 = 减少这些流动):Tools are the ultimate source of the geopolitical risk investors face. There are three types, each with both a cooperation-promoting use and a conflict-escalating use (promoting cooperation = increasing flows of goods/services/capital/labor between countries; escalating conflict = reducing these flows):

工具类型Tool type合作用法Cooperative use非合作用法Non-cooperative use
国家安全工具
national securityNational-security tools		军事联盟威慑冲突(如 NATO 北约——集体安全,减少成员间及对外冲突)Military alliances that deter conflict (e.g., NATO — collective security, reducing conflict among members and outward)武装冲突(最极端,直接且主动;两大影响:摧毁物质基础设施、引发移民);间谍活动(espionage)(间接工具)Armed conflict (the most extreme, direct and active; two main effects: destroying physical infrastructure, triggering migration); espionage (an indirect tool)
经济工具
economicEconomic tools		多边贸易协定(MERCOSUR、WTO 关税协调)、共同市场(欧盟)、共同货币(欧元)Multilateral trade agreements (MERCOSUR, WTO tariff coordination), common markets (the EU), a common currency (the euro)国有化(nationalization)(把产业从私有转为国有,常见于能源等战略部门,如阿根廷 2012 重新国有化 YPF);自愿出口限制(VER);国内含量要求Nationalization (converting an industry from private to state ownership, common in strategic sectors like energy, e.g., Argentina renationalizing YPF in 2012); voluntary export restraints (VERs); domestic-content requirements
金融工具
financialFinancial tools		货币跨境自由兑换、允许外国投资Free cross-border currency convertibility, allowing foreign investment限制进入本地货币市场、限制外国投资;制裁(sanctions)Restricting access to the local money market, restricting foreign investment; sanctions
考点提示:
① 国家安全工具并非只能非合作——NATO 等集体安全协议是合作用法(所以"国家安全工具本质上是非合作的"是错误表述)。
② 金融工具的双刃性:合作性金融工具若鼓励安全/经济/金融合作可降低风险,但过度依赖也会制造脆弱性——美元主导地位就是例子:既促进金融活动,又使他国易受美国货币政策变化冲击(美国收紧货币政策会使无法维持美元储备的国家出现流动性短缺)。
③ 工具与例子配对题(高频):金融↔货币自由跨境兑换;经济↔国有化;国家安全↔间谍活动。
④ 多面工具例:cabotage(沿海运输权,外国公司在他国境内运输的权利)牵涉物理安全与经济协调,是高度多边的过程。

12. 金融/经济/国家安全工具与"货币自由兑换/国有化/间谍"的正确配对是:The correct pairing of financial/economic/national-security tools with 'free currency convertibility/nationalization/espionage' is:

  • A. 金融—国有化;经济—间谍Financial — nationalization; economic — espionage
  • B. 国家安全—货币自由兑换National security — free currency convertibility
  • C. 金融—货币自由跨境兑换;经济—国有化;国家安全—间谍活动Financial — free cross-border currency convertibility; economic — nationalization; national security — espionage
答案 C。金融→兑换、经济→国有化、安全→间谍。Answer C. Financial → convertibility, economic → nationalization, security → espionage.

LM5 §7 地缘政治风险:三类型、三维评估与应对LM5 §7 Geopolitical Risk: Three Types, Three-Dimension Assessment & Response 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: describe geopolitical risk; describe the impact of geopolitical risk on investments。

地缘政治风险(geopolitical risk):与国家/非国家主体之间的紧张或行动相关、影响正常和平国际关系的风险。当支撑国家关系的地理与政治因素发生变化时,风险趋于上升。Geopolitical risk: the risk associated with tensions or actions among state/non-state actors that affect normal, peaceful international relations. Risk tends to rise when the geographic and political factors underpinning national relationships change.

7.1 三类地缘政治风险(必背归类)

类型Type定义Definition例子Example
事件风险
event riskEvent risk		围绕事先已知的固定日期展开(选举、新立法、节日、政治周年)Centered on a known, fixed date in advance (elections, new legislation, holidays, political anniversaries)英国脱欧公投(2016.6.23,事先计划;多数投资者预期"留欧",结果相反,巨幅改变预期)。可预测性不改变其发生概率、冲击速度或大小,只给投资者更多准备时间The UK Brexit referendum (23 June 2016, planned in advance; most investors expected 'Remain,' the result was the opposite, drastically changing expectations). Predictability does not change its probability, speed of impact, or size — it only gives investors more time to prepare
外生风险
exogenous riskExogenous risk		突发或未预料的风险,影响国家合作立场或非国家主体全球化能力Sudden or unexpected risk affecting a country's cooperation stance or non-state actors' ability to globalize突发起义、入侵、自然灾害余波。例:日本福岛核事故(2011);"黑天鹅"事件多属此类Sudden uprisings, invasions, the aftermath of natural disasters. Example: Japan's Fukushima nuclear accident (2011); 'black swan' events mostly fall here
主题风险
thematic riskThematic risk		已知但随时间演变扩大的风险Known risk that evolves and grows over time气候变化、模式化移民、民粹势力崛起、恐怖主义、网络威胁(如 2017 Equifax 数据泄露 1.47 亿人)Climate change, patterned migration, the rise of populist forces, terrorism, cyber threats (e.g., the 2017 Equifax data breach affecting 147 million people)

哪些是"事先已知"的?事件风险(固定日期)和主题风险(已知但渐变)—— 外生风险是突发的、不事先已知。不确定性最小的类型是事件风险(日期已知)。Which are 'known in advance'? Event risk (a fixed date) and thematic risk (known but gradual) — exogenous risk is sudden and not known in advance. The type with the least uncertainty is event risk (the date is known).

7.2 三维评估

投资者从三个维度评估地缘政治风险,必须三者合起来看:Investors assess geopolitical risk on three dimensions, which must be viewed together:

  1. 发生概率(likelihood):高度合作与全球化的国家整体上较不易遭遇风险(伙伴施加风险的成本更高),但同样的相互连接使其更易受某些风险波及。测量更像艺术而非科学。Likelihood: highly cooperative and globalized countries are less prone to risk overall (it costs partners more to impose risk on them), but the same interconnection makes them more exposed to certain risks. Measuring it is more art than science.
  2. 冲击速度/速率(velocity):高速(短期)——市场波动、避险情绪,外生/黑天鹅事件多属此类,投资者做战术调整;中期——损害企业流程成本、拉低估值,集中于特定行业;低速(长期)——ESG 等影响,可能改变资产配置。Velocity (speed of impact): high-velocity (short-term) — market volatility and risk aversion, mostly exogenous/black-swan events, prompting investors to make tactical adjustments; medium-velocity — harming firms' process costs and lowering valuations, concentrated in specific industries; low-velocity (long-term) — effects like ESG, which may change asset allocation.
  3. 冲击的规模与性质(size and nature):高冲击值得深研,低冲击可能不必;冲击可能被外部因素放大(经济衰退期风险冲击更大)。离散(discrete)=只影响单个公司/行业;广泛(broad)=整个行业/国家/全球经济。Size and nature of the impact: high impact is worth deep study, low impact may not be; the impact can be amplified by external factors (risk shocks are larger during a recession). Discrete = affects only a single company/industry; broad = a whole industry/country/the global economy.
考点提示(速度↔反应配对):低速→调整资产配置;中速→调整特定行业投资;高速→避险(flight to quality)。另:高速风险主要表现为资产价格的即时波动(如 9/11 后市场急跌快速反弹);低速风险才对投资者的输入变量(收入、成本、估值)有持久影响——"高速风险持久影响输入"是错误表述。

7.3 应对:情景分析、路标、风险的体现

  • 地缘政治风险很少线性发展,故投资者多用情景分析(scenario analysis)+ 路标(signposting)而非单点预测。情景分析:评估不同世界状态下的组合结果;需警惕群体思维(groupthink)。Geopolitical risk rarely develops linearly, so investors mostly use scenario analysis + signposting rather than a single-point forecast. Scenario analysis: assessing portfolio outcomes under different states of the world; beware groupthink.
  • 路标(signpost):预示风险变得更可能/更不可能的指标、市场水平、数据或事件——像交通灯(绿=无需行动、黄=提高警惕、红=需要行动方案)。区分信号与噪音的经验法则:区分"政治(politics)"与"政策(policy)"——两位领导人的"政治"可能差异很大,但真正造成持久组合影响的是他们出台的"政策"。A signpost: an indicator, market level, data point, or event signaling that risk is becoming more/less likely — like a traffic light (green = no action needed, yellow = heightened alert, red = an action plan needed). A rule of thumb for separating signal from noise: distinguish 'politics' from 'policy' — two leaders' 'politics' may differ greatly, but what truly creates lasting portfolio impact is the 'policy' they enact.
  • 风险的体现:高速风险 → 市场波动(商品、外汇、股票、债券价格)。低速风险 → 持久影响企业收入成本估值。对被视为持续高风险的国家/地区/行业,投资者要求更高补偿,即提高估值时用的贴现率——这也是新兴市场资产价格相对发达市场折价的关键原因。GPR 地缘政治风险指数发现:高风险降低美国投资、就业和股市;而威胁本身随时间的影响比实际事件更大。How risk manifests: high-velocity risk → market volatility (commodity, FX, stock, bond prices). Low-velocity risk → lasting effects on firms' revenue, cost, and valuation. For countries/regions/industries seen as persistently high-risk, investors demand higher compensation, i.e., a higher discount rate in valuation — this is also the key reason emerging-market asset prices trade at a discount to developed markets. The GPR geopolitical-risk index finds: high risk lowers US investment, employment, and the stock market; and the threat itself has a bigger impact over time than actual events.
  • 应对:自上而下——资产配置者据风险调整国别/区域配置;组合层面——把地缘政治风险作为多因子模型的一个因子。最终取决于投资者的目标、风险承受度和时间跨度:长跨度投资者可能视外生冲击为买入机会,而临近退休者可能遭受重大负面影响。Response: top-down — asset allocators adjust country/region allocation for risk; portfolio-level — treat geopolitical risk as a factor in a multi-factor model. Ultimately it depends on the investor's objectives, risk tolerance, and time horizon: a long-horizon investor may see an exogenous shock as a buying opportunity, while someone near retirement may suffer a major negative impact.
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

地缘政治风险:类型与评估

三类型:事件风险(event,已知日程如选举)、外生风险(exogenous,突发如战争)、主题风险(thematic,长期如移民/气候)。评估三维:可能性(likelihood)、速度(velocity 爆发快慢)、影响大小(impact/severity)。

机制与应对

高影响 + 高速度的风险最需对冲/降低敞口;主题风险速度慢但持续累积,适合结构性调整。投资含难以量化,常用情景分析而非单一概率。

易错对比

① velocity(爆发速度)是关键维度,别只看概率;② 主题风险慢而持久、事件风险有日程;③ 高速度高影响 → 主动对冲。

Geopolitical risk: types & assessment

Three types: event risk (scheduled, e.g., elections), exogenous risk (sudden, e.g., war), thematic risk (long-run, e.g., migration/climate). Assess on three dimensions: likelihood, velocity (how fast it hits), and impact/severity.

Mechanism & response

High impact + high velocity risks most warrant hedging/reducing exposure; thematic risks are slow but compound, suiting structural adjustment. Impact is hard to quantify, so use scenario analysis rather than a single probability.

Common traps

① Velocity is a key dimension, not just likelihood; ② thematic risk is slow but persistent, event risk is scheduled; ③ high velocity + high impact → actively hedge.

13. 关于地缘政治风险,下列哪项正确:Regarding geopolitical risk, which is correct:

  • A. 建模容易标准化It is easy to standardize in modeling
  • B. 只参与不回报也算合作Merely participating without reciprocating still counts as cooperation
  • C. 制度强度关系到合作关系的持久性Institutional strength relates to the durability of a cooperative relationship
答案 C。强制度使合作更持久;建模难标准化,合作型国家须既参与又对等回报。Answer C. Strong institutions make cooperation more durable; modeling is hard to standardize, and a cooperative state must both participate and reciprocate.

14. 地理因素相对恒久,是否意味着地缘政治风险分析是稳定的:Since geographic factors are relatively permanent, does that make geopolitical risk analysis stable:

  • A. 是,只需看当前象限Yes, just look at the current quadrant
  • B. 否,风险分析本质动态,国家在框架中的位置是移动的目标No — risk analysis is inherently dynamic, and a country's position within the framework is a moving target
  • C. 是,分析结果长期不变Yes, results are unchanging over the long run
答案 B。不仅看当前象限,还要看象限内的稳定性。Answer B. Look not only at the current quadrant but also at stability within it.

15. 三类地缘政治风险中,不确定性最小的是:Among the three types of geopolitical risk, the one with the least uncertainty is:

  • A. 外生风险(突发,如地震)Exogenous risk (sudden, e.g., an earthquake)
  • B. 主题风险(已知渐变,如持续内战)Thematic risk (a known gradual change, e.g., an ongoing civil war)
  • C. 事件风险(已知日期,如选举)Event risk (a known date, e.g., an election)
答案 C。事件与主题事先已知,外生突发不可知;事件因有明确日期而不确定性最小。Answer C. Event and thematic risks are known in advance while exogenous shocks are unknowable; event risk has the least uncertainty because it has a definite date.

16. 风险速度(低/中/高)与投资者反应的正确配对是:The correct pairing of risk velocity (low/medium/high) with investor response is:

  • A. 中速→避险Medium velocity → flight to quality
  • B. 低速→调整资产配置;中速→调整特定行业;高速→避险(flight to quality)Low velocity → adjust asset allocation; medium → adjust specific sectors; high → flight to quality
  • C. 高速→调整资产配置;低速→避险High velocity → adjust asset allocation; low → flight to quality
答案 B。速度越快,反应越偏向紧急避险。Answer B. The faster the velocity, the more the response shifts to emergency risk-aversion.

17. 高速风险是否对投资者的输入变量有持久影响:Does high-velocity risk have a lasting effect on investors' input variables:

  • A. 是,持久改变收入与估值Yes, it permanently changes income and valuations
  • B. 是,永久抬高成本Yes, it permanently raises costs
  • C. 否;高速风险主要表现为资产价格即时波动(如 9/11 急跌快反弹),低速风险才有持久影响No; high-velocity risk mainly shows up as immediate asset-price swings (e.g., 9/11's sharp drop and quick rebound); only low-velocity risk has lasting effects
答案 C。持久影响收入/成本/估值的是低速风险。Answer C. It is low-velocity risk that lastingly affects income/costs/valuations.

18. 新兴市场资产价格相对发达市场折价的原因是:The reason emerging-market asset prices trade at a discount to developed markets is:

  • A. 发达市场货币贬值Developed-market currencies depreciate
  • B. 被视为持续高地缘政治风险,投资者要求更高补偿→提高贴现率→资产折价They are seen as carrying persistently high geopolitical risk, so investors demand higher compensation → higher discount rate → asset discount
  • C. 新兴市场盈利一定更低Emerging-market earnings must be lower
答案 B。GPR 指数还显示:事件"威胁"本身随时间的影响比实际事件更大。Answer B. The GPR index also shows: the 'threat' of an event itself has a bigger impact over time than the actual event.
1. 网络威胁最可能属于下列哪类风险?1. Cyber threats most likely fall into the category of: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 事件风险。event risk.
  • B. 主题性风险。thematic risk.
  • C. 外生风险。exogenous risk.
答案 B。网络威胁 = 主题性风险(thematic risk)——长期、跨领域、持续演变。事件风险是突发单次;外生风险是外部冲击(如自然灾害)。Answer B. Cyber threats = a thematic risk — long-term, cross-cutting, continuously evolving. Event risk is a sudden one-off; exogenous risk is an external shock (e.g., natural disaster).
2. 自然灾害是下列哪类风险的例子?2. Natural disasters are an example of: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 事件风险。event risk.
  • B. 主题性风险。thematic risk.
  • C. 外生风险。exogenous risk.
答案 C。自然灾害 = 外生风险(exogenous risk)——源于经济政治体系之外的突发冲击。事件风险是可预见的特定事件;主题性风险是长期演变。Answer C. A natural disaster = an exogenous risk — a sudden shock from outside the economic/political system. Event risk is a foreseeable specific event; thematic risk evolves over the long term.
3. 面对黑天鹅风险,投资者最可能做出下列哪类调整?3. Which of the following changes are investors most likely to make in response to a black swan risk? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 战术性调整Tactical
  • B. 特定行业调整Sector specific
  • C. 资产配置调整Asset allocation
答案 A。面对黑天鹅(不可预测)风险,投资者最可能做"战术性(tactical)调整"(短期灵活应对),而非重构长期资产配置。Answer A. Facing an unpredictable black-swan risk, investors most likely make tactical adjustments (short-term, flexible responses) rather than overhauling the long-term asset allocation.

LM6 §1 国际贸易的收益与成本LM6 §1 The Benefits & Costs of International Trade

LOS 对应:LOS: describe the benefits and costs of international trade。

支持国际贸易的五大论点

  1. 各国从交换与专业化中获益(gains from exchange and specialization);Countries gain from exchange and specialization;
  2. 行业实现更大的规模经济;Industries achieve greater economies of scale;
  3. 家庭和企业有更多产品多样性;Households and firms have more product variety;
  4. 竞争加剧(削弱国内企业垄断力、迫使其提效);Intensified competition (weakening domestic firms' monopoly power and forcing them to be more efficient);
  5. 资源配置更有效率。Resource allocation is more efficient.

交换收益(gains from exchange):贸易让各国出口能得到更高价格(更多利润)、进口能付更低价格(而非低效地自产)。传统贸易模型:李嘉图模型(基于技术差异的比较优势)、赫克歇尔-俄林模型(基于要素禀赋差异)。较新模型聚焦规模经济、产品多样性、竞争加剧带来的收益,并解释了产业内贸易(intra-industry trade)——一国在同一产品类别既出口又进口(如欧盟进出口不同类型汽车),用垄断竞争模型解释。此外贸易可提高实际 GDP,途径包括"干中学"(learning by doing,如半导体业单位成本随产量降)、知识溢出、外国研发对国内生产率的正面影响。Gains from exchange: trade lets countries get higher prices for exports (more profit) and pay lower prices for imports (rather than producing inefficiently at home). Traditional trade models: the Ricardian model (comparative advantage based on technology differences), the Heckscher-Ohlin model (based on factor-endowment differences). Newer models focus on gains from economies of scale, product variety, and intensified competition, and explain intra-industry trade — a country both exports and imports within the same product category (e.g., the EU exporting and importing different types of cars), explained with the monopolistic-competition model. Trade can also raise real GDP, through 'learning by doing' (e.g., semiconductor unit cost falling with volume), knowledge spillovers, and the positive effect of foreign R&D on domestic productivity.

反对自由贸易的论点与"贸易收益"的真义

反对者指出:进口竞争导致收入不平等加剧和发达国家失业。走向自由贸易时,出口行业扩张、进口竞争行业收缩,低效企业被迫退出,工人需再培训。关键辨析:Critics note that import competition causes worse income inequality and unemployment in developed countries. In moving toward free trade, export industries expand while import-competing industries contract, inefficient firms are forced out, and workers must retrain. Key distinctions:

核心考点:贸易提高整体福利,不等于每个消费者和生产者都受益。它的真正含义是:赢家在理论上可以补偿输家后仍有剩余(winners could compensate the losers and still be better off)。即使长期,留在进口竞争行业的工人也可能因行业专用技能贬值而永久受损——所以贸易未必让每个利益相关者都更好,但整体福利效应为正。国际贸易的成本正确表述:资源需在行业间重新配置、低效企业被迫退出、可能导致更高失业与再培训需求。

19. 下列哪项最好地描述国际贸易的收益:Which best describes the gains from international trade:

  • A. 贸易让所有个人和公司长期都受益Trade benefits every individual and firm in the long run
  • B. 只有发达国家能获益Only developed countries can gain
  • C. 各国从交换与专业化中获益(出口得更高价、进口付更低价)Countries gain from exchange and specialization (getting higher prices for exports and paying lower prices for imports)
答案 C。贸易带来整体收益,但并非让每个个人和公司长期都受益。Answer C. Trade brings aggregate gains, but not to every individual and firm in the long run.

20. 关于国际贸易的成本,正确表述是:The correct statement about the costs of international trade is:

  • A. 发达国家获益远少于发展中国家Developed countries gain far less than developing ones
  • B. 资源需在行业间重新配置、低效企业被迫退出、可能带来更高失业与再培训需求Resources must be reallocated across industries, inefficient firms are forced out, and higher unemployment and retraining needs may result
  • C. 无绝对优势就无法从贸易获益Without absolute advantage no gains from trade are possible
答案 B。比较优势即可获益(无需绝对优势);成本体现在结构调整与失业。Answer B. Comparative advantage suffices for gains (no absolute advantage needed); the costs are structural adjustment and unemployment.

21. Tealand 产茶相对铜的成本低于 Copperland。贸易后 Copperland 的铜产业将:Tealand's cost of tea relative to copper is lower than Copperland's. After trade, Copperland's copper industry will:

  • A. 收缩Contract
  • B. 保持不变Stay unchanged
  • C. 扩张(相对成本低者出口铜)Expand (the lower relative-cost producer exports copper)
答案 C。铜相对茶在 Copperland 更便宜,故出口铜、产业扩张。Answer C. Copper is relatively cheaper than tea in Copperland, so it exports copper and the industry expands.
1. 反对自由贸易的一个论据是:1. An argument against free trade is that: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 它可能加剧收入不平等。it has the potential to lead to greater income inequality.
  • B. 它提高商品与服务的平均生产成本。it increases average production costs in goods and services.
  • C. 它抑制经济中的境外研发。it discourages foreign research and development in an economy.
答案 A。反对自由贸易的一个论据:可能加剧收入不平等(受冲击行业的工人受损)。自由贸易实际降低平均成本、并促进而非抑制研发,故 B、C 错。Answer A. An argument against free trade: it may worsen income inequality (workers in exposed industries lose). Free trade actually lowers average costs and encourages (not suppresses) R&D, so B and C are wrong.

LM6 §2 关税的福利效应(必会计算)LM6 §2 Welfare Effects of a Tariff (must-calculate) 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: compare types of trade restrictions — tariffs, quotas, and export subsidies, and their economic implications。

贸易限制(trade restrictions):限制国内家庭和企业与他国自由贸易的政府政策(关税、进口配额、VER、补贴、禁运、国内含量要求)。资本限制(capital restrictions)则限制金融市场开放度(外国人持有国内资产/居民持有外国资产的能力),两者不同。Trade restrictions: government policies that limit domestic households' and firms' free trade with other countries (tariffs, import quotas, VERs, subsidies, embargoes, domestic-content requirements). Capital restrictions, by contrast, limit the openness of financial markets (the ability of foreigners to hold domestic assets/of residents to hold foreign assets); the two are different.

2.1 小国 vs 大国

  • 小国(small country):世界市场上的价格接受者,无法影响世界价格(不一定指面积/人口/GDP 小,如巴西在汽车世界市场上是价格接受者)。Small country: a price taker in the world market, unable to affect the world price (not necessarily small in area/population/GDP, e.g., Brazil is a price taker in the world car market).
  • 大国(large country):该产品的大进口国,能影响世界价格。大国征关税时出口国会降价保市场份额,改善大国贸易条件——理论上大国若① 对方不报复且② 无谓损失小于贸易条件改善的收益,可通过征关税提高自身福利;但全球福利仍净减少(大国的收益是以对贸易伙伴更大的损失为代价)。Large country: a large importer of the product, able to affect the world price. When a large country imposes a tariff, the exporting country lowers its price to protect market share, improving the large country's terms of trade — in theory a large country can raise its own welfare with a tariff if ① the other side does not retaliate and ② the deadweight loss is smaller than the terms-of-trade gain; but global welfare still falls net (the large country's gain comes at the exporting partner's larger loss).

2.2 关税的福利效应(核心图与四块面积)

自由贸易时世界价格 P*:国内供给 Q₁、国内消费 Q₄、进口 Q₁Q₄。征收单位关税 t 后,国内价格升至 Pₜ = P* + t:国内生产增至 Q₂、国内消费降至 Q₃、进口缩减为 Q₂Q₃。四块面积:Under free trade the world price is P*: domestic supply Q₁, domestic consumption Q₄, imports Q₁Q₄. After a per-unit tariff t, the domestic price rises to Pₜ = P* + t: domestic production rises to Q₂, domestic consumption falls to Q₃, and imports shrink to Q₂Q₃. Four areas:

净福利效应 = ΔCS + ΔPS + Δ政府收入 = −(A+B+C+D) + A + C = −B − D
面积/符号Area/Symbol含义Meaning
A + B + C + D消费者剩余(CS)的损失(价格上升所致)The loss of consumer surplus (CS) (due to the higher price)
A生产者剩余(PS)的增加(本国生产者获更高价)The gain of producer surplus (PS) (domestic producers get a higher price)
C政府的关税收入(= 单位关税 × 进口量 Q₂Q₃)The government's tariff revenue (= per-unit tariff × import volume Q₂Q₃)
B + D无谓损失(deadweight loss)——国家福利的净损失。B = 生产侧低效(高成本本国生产者进入市场);D = 消费侧低效(愿付高于 P* 低于 Pₜ 的消费者无法消费)The deadweight loss — the net loss of national welfare. B = production-side inefficiency (high-cost domestic producers enter the market); D = consumption-side inefficiency (consumers willing to pay above P* but below Pₜ cannot consume)

结论:消费者剩余的损失 > 生产者剩余增加 + 政府收入之和,净福利损失 = B + D(小国情形一定为负;大国若贸易条件改善足够大可能为正)。Conclusion: the consumer-surplus loss > producer-surplus gain + government revenue, so the net welfare loss = B + D (always negative for a small country; possibly positive for a large country if the terms-of-trade gain is large enough).

教材例题 · 南非纸张关税(小国)

南非产纸 11 万吨,需求 20 万吨,世界价 $5/吨 → 自由贸易进口 9 万吨。政府征 20% 关税 → 进口价升至 $6(单位关税 t=$1)。关税后:国内产量升至 13 万吨,需求降至 17 万吨。四块面积计算(梯形/三角形):South Africa produces 110k tons of paper, demand 200k tons, world price $5/ton → free-trade imports of 90k tons. The government imposes a 20% tariff → the import price rises to $6 (per-unit tariff t=$1). After the tariff: domestic output rises to 130k tons, demand falls to 170k tons. Computing the four areas (trapezoids/triangles):

  • 消费者剩余损失(A+B+C+D) = $1×170,000 + ½×$1×30,000 = $185,000Consumer-surplus loss (A+B+C+D) = $1×170,000 + ½×$1×30,000 = $185,000
  • 生产者剩余增加(A) = $1×110,000 + ½×$1×20,000 = $120,000Producer-surplus gain (A) = $1×110,000 + ½×$1×20,000 = $120,000
  • 政府收入(C) = $1×进口量40,000 = $40,000(注:关税后进口 = 170,000−130,000 = 40,000)Government revenue (C) = $1×import volume 40,000 = $40,000 (note: post-tariff imports = 170,000−130,000 = 40,000)
  • 无谓损失(B+D) = ½×$1×20,000 + ½×$1×30,000 = $25,000Deadweight loss (B+D) = ½×$1×20,000 + ½×$1×30,000 = $25,000

验证:损失 185,000 = 增益 120,000(A) + 40,000(C) + 25,000(B+D) ✓。记忆技巧:矩形部分用"单位关税×底边",三角形部分用"½×单位关税×产量变化"。Check: loss 185,000 = gain 120,000 (A) + 40,000 (C) + 25,000 (B+D) ✓. Memory tip: for the rectangular part use 'per-unit tariff × base', and for the triangular part use '½ × per-unit tariff × change in quantity'.

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

关税的福利效应

进口国征关税 → 国内价上升、国内产量上升、进口减少。福利分配:消费者剩余下降、生产者剩余上升、政府获关税收入;三者相抵后是净福利损失(无谓损失)。

无谓损失的两块

无谓损失 = 生产扭曲(高成本国内产替代低成本进口)+ 消费扭曲(价高使部分消费消失)。小国必有净损失;大国可能靠压低进口价改善贸易条件而部分抵消。

易错对比

① 消费者损失 > 生产者所得 + 政府收入 → 净损失;② 无谓损失含生产与消费两处扭曲;③ 仅大国可能通过贸易条件获益。

Welfare effects of a tariff

An importing country's tariff → domestic price up, domestic output up, imports down. Distribution: consumer surplus falls, producer surplus rises, government gains tariff revenue; on net there is a welfare loss (deadweight loss).

Two parts of deadweight loss

Deadweight loss = production distortion (costly domestic output replaces cheap imports) + consumption distortion (higher price kills some consumption). A small country always loses; a large country may offset part by improving its terms of trade.

Common traps

① Consumer loss > producer gain + government revenue → net loss; ② deadweight loss has production and consumption distortions; ③ only a large country can gain via terms of trade.

22. 关税福利效应中,面积 A、C、B+D 的含义及小国净福利是:In the welfare effects of a tariff, the meaning of areas A, C, and B+D, and a small country's net welfare:

  • A. A=生产者剩余增加、C=政府关税收入、B+D=无谓损失;小国净福利一定为负(−B−D)A = gain in producer surplus, C = government tariff revenue, B+D = deadweight loss; a small country's net welfare is always negative (−B−D)
  • B. A=政府收入、C=生产者剩余;小国净福利为正A = government revenue, C = producer surplus; a small country's net welfare is positive
  • C. B+D=消费者剩余增加B+D = gain in consumer surplus
答案 A。消费者剩余损失 A+B+C+D,其中 A、C 转移给生产者与政府,B+D 为净损失。Answer A. Consumers lose A+B+C+D, of which A and C are transferred to producers and government, and B+D is net loss.

23. 南非纸张例:世界价 $5、20% 关税、产量 11 万→13 万吨、需求 20 万→17 万吨,无谓损失最接近:South Africa paper example: world price $5, 20% tariff, output 110k→130k tons, demand 200k→170k tons; the deadweight loss is closest to:

  • A. $40,000$40,000
  • B. $25,000$25,000
  • C. $185,000$185,000
答案 B。单位关税 $1;无谓损失 = ½×1×20,000 + ½×1×30,000 = $25,000($185k 是消费者剩余损失,$40k 是政府收入)。Answer B. Unit tariff $1; deadweight loss = ½×1×20,000 + ½×1×30,000 = $25,000 ($185k is the consumer-surplus loss, $40k is government revenue).

24. 大国能否通过贸易限制获益:Can a large country gain from trade restrictions:

  • A. 大国可通过征关税获益——若贸易条件改善足以抵消资源低效的福利损失(小国不能;全球福利仍净减)A large country can gain from a tariff — if the terms-of-trade improvement is enough to outweigh the welfare loss from resource inefficiency (a small country cannot; global welfare still falls net)
  • B. 大国与小国一样必然受损A large country, like a small one, must lose
  • C. 大国靠出口补贴获益A large country gains through export subsidies
答案 A。大国征关税可改善贸易条件;出口补贴对大国仍是净损失。Answer A. A large country's tariff can improve its terms of trade; an export subsidy is still a net loss for a large country.
1. 当一个作为价格接受者的国家对进口商品征收关税时:1. When a country that is a price taker imposes a tariff on an imported good: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 国民福利上升。national welfare increases.
  • B. 消费者获得消费者剩余。consumers gain consumer surplus.
  • C. 本国生产者获得生产者剩余。local producers gain producer surplus.
答案 C。小国(价格接受者)征收进口关税:进口价升 → 本国生产者获得生产者剩余(可卖更高价)。消费者剩余减少、整体国民福利下降(死角损失)。Answer C. When a small (price-taking) country imposes an import tariff, the import price rises → domestic producers gain producer surplus (can sell higher). Consumer surplus shrinks and total national welfare falls (deadweight loss).

LM6 §3 配额、VER 与出口补贴LM6 §3 Quotas, VERs & Export Subsidies

配额(quota)

配额限制一定时期内可进口的商品数量(用进口许可证 import license 指定数量)。与关税的关键区别在于面积 C 的归属:关税下 C 是政府关税收入;配额下 C 是配额租金(quota rents)——通常被外国生产者攫取(他们能抬价获利)。A quota limits the quantity of a good that may be imported in a period (specifying the quantity via an import license). Its key difference from a tariff is who gets area C: under a tariff, C is government tariff revenue; under a quota, C is quota rents — usually captured by foreign producers (who can raise prices and profit).

  • 若配额租金被外国生产者/外国政府攫取 → 进口国福利损失 = B + D + C,大于等效关税;If the quota rents are captured by foreign producers/the foreign government → the importing country's welfare loss = B + D + C, larger than the equivalent tariff;
  • 若进口国政府通过拍卖进口许可证攫取配额租金 → 福利损失 = B + D,与关税相同。If the importing country's government captures the quota rents by auctioning import licenses → the welfare loss = B + D, the same as a tariff.

自愿出口限制(VER)

VER(voluntary export restraint):与配额类似,但由出口国施加(配额由进口国施加)。VER 使配额租金被出口国攫取,因此 VER 一定给进口国造成福利损失(1981 年日本对美汽车出口 VER)。A VER (voluntary export restraint): similar to a quota but imposed by the exporting country (a quota is imposed by the importing country). A VER lets the exporting country capture the quota rents, so a VER always inflicts a welfare loss on the importing country (the 1981 Japanese VER on car exports to the US).

出口补贴(export subsidy)

出口补贴:政府为每单位出口商品向企业支付的款项,目标刺激出口,但扭曲了比较优势、降低福利。反补贴税(countervailing duties):进口国对补贴出口品征收的关税。出口商有动机把销售从国内市场转向出口市场(每单位可得国际价+补贴),导致:小国情形——国内价格上升补贴额;大国情形——增加出口使世界价格下降,部分补贴转移给外国。两种情形净福利效应都为负,大国损失更大。An export subsidy: a payment the government makes to firms per unit of exported goods, aiming to stimulate exports, but it distorts comparative advantage and lowers welfare. Countervailing duties: tariffs the importing country levies on subsidized exports. Exporters have an incentive to shift sales from the domestic market to the export market (getting the international price + subsidy per unit), leading to: for a small country — the domestic price rises by the subsidy amount; for a large country — more exports make the world price fall, transferring part of the subsidy to foreigners. In both cases the net welfare effect is negative, with the large country losing more.

1. 对小国生产的正常商品实施出口补贴,最可能提高:1. The implementation of an export subsidy for a normal good produced in a small country will most likely increase the: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 该商品的国内消费domestic consumption of the good
  • B. 该商品在国内市场的价格。price of the good in the domestic market.
  • C. 提供补贴国家的国民福利。national welfare of the country providing the subsidy.
答案 B。对小国出口补贴 → 出口增加、国内供给减少 → 该商品国内价格上升。它使国内消费减少、并降低补贴国的国民福利,故 A、C 错。Answer B. An export subsidy for a small country raises exports and reduces domestic supply → the domestic price rises. Domestic consumption falls and the subsidizing country's welfare declines, so A and C are wrong.

考点提示:
① 四种限制里只有关税一定增加政府收入(配额不定、出口补贴下降、VER 无变化)。
② 对进口国福利损失最大的是 VER(配额租金全归外国出口方;关税/等效配额若进口国拍卖许可证则损失最小)。
③ 出口补贴是唯一影响出口国、且使贸易(出口)增加的工具。

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

四种贸易限制:谁拿走了「租金」

• 关税:国内价升,政府获收入。
• 配额(quota):限进口量;「配额租金」归持证进口商或外国出口商(视许可证分配)。
• 自愿出口限制(VER):由出口国自限数量 → 租金归外国出口商,对进口国最不利。
• 出口补贴:政府支出,补贴本国出口生产者。

易错对比

① 关税收入归政府、配额租金可能归外国、VER 租金外流;② VER 对进口国福利最差;③ 补贴是政府付钱而非收钱。

Four trade restrictions: who gets the "rent"

• Tariff: domestic price up, the government gets revenue.
• Quota: limits import volume; the "quota rent" goes to license-holding importers or foreign exporters (depending on allocation).
• Voluntary export restraint (VER): the exporting country limits volume → rent to foreign exporters, worst for the importing country.
• Export subsidy: government spends, subsidizing domestic export producers.

Common traps

① Tariff revenue to the government, quota rent possibly to foreigners, VER rent flows abroad; ② VER is worst for the importer's welfare; ③ a subsidy pays out, it doesn't collect.

25. 四种贸易限制中,必然增加进口国政府收入的、以及给进口国福利损失最大的,分别是:Among the four trade restrictions, which necessarily increases the importing country's government revenue, and which imposes the largest welfare loss on the importer:

  • A. 关税必增政府收入;VER 使进口国损失最大(配额租金全归外国)A tariff necessarily raises government revenue; a VER imposes the largest loss on the importer (all quota rents go to foreigners)
  • B. 配额必增政府收入;关税损失最大A quota necessarily raises government revenue; a tariff imposes the largest loss
  • C. 出口补贴增加进口国政府收入An export subsidy raises the importing country's government revenue
答案 A。影响出口国且使其出口增加的是出口补贴;配额收入不定、VER 无政府收入。Answer A. What affects the exporting country and increases its exports is an export subsidy; quota revenue is uncertain and a VER has no government revenue.

LOS 对应:LOS: explain motivations for and advantages of trading blocs, common markets, and economic unions。

若经济同盟成员采用共同货币,则同时是货币同盟(monetary union)(如 19 个欧盟国采用欧元)。If economic-union members adopt a common currency, it is also a monetary union (e.g., 19 EU countries using the euro).

考点提示(层级辨认题):
① 只有成员间自由贸易、各自对外壁垒 = FTA(智利与澳大利亚例);
② 免除成员关税 + 对非成员共同对外关税、但不更深 = 关税同盟(巴西与南非例);
③ 关税同盟 + 要素自由流动 = 共同市场;
④ 再加共同经济制度与政策协调 = 经济同盟。判断口诀:商品自由→FTA,加对外统一→关税同盟,加要素流动→共同市场,加政策协调→经济同盟。

5.2 贸易创造 vs 贸易转移(必考辨析)

概念Concept定义Definition福利效应Welfare effect
贸易创造
trade creationTrade creation		区域一体化使高成本的国内生产被成员国更低成本的进口替代Regional integration replaces high-cost domestic production with lower-cost imports from member countries提高效率、正福利效应Raises efficiency, a positive welfare effect
贸易转移
trade diversionTrade diversion		非成员国的更低成本进口被成员国更高成本的进口替代(因非成员仍面临关税)Lower-cost imports from non-members are replaced by higher-cost imports from members (because non-members still face tariffs)降低效率、可能减少福利Lowers efficiency, may reduce welfare

教材例(Qualor 与 Vulcan 组关税同盟):Qualor 本国衬衫产量从 1000 万降到 700 万、转而多进口——被低成本的 Vulcan 替代的部分是贸易创造。若原先从最低成本的非成员 Aurelia 进口,组同盟后因 Aurelia 仍被征 10% 关税而转向 Vulcan,则是贸易转移(尽管 Aurelia 成本最低,但含关税后价格更高)。若贸易创造大于贸易转移,净福利效应为正。Textbook example (Qualor and Vulcan form a customs union): Qualor's domestic shirt output falls from 10m to 7m as it imports more instead — the part replaced by low-cost Vulcan is trade creation. If Qualor previously imported from the lowest-cost non-member Aurelia, and after the union it switches to Vulcan because Aurelia still faces a 10% tariff, that is trade diversion (although Aurelia's cost is lowest, its tariff-inclusive price is higher). If trade creation exceeds trade diversion, the net welfare effect is positive.

5.3 区域一体化的动因、成本与挑战

  • 为何流行:在少数国家间消除壁垒比 WTO 多边谈判更容易、政治上争议更小、更快,政策协调也更简单。Why they are popular: removing barriers among a few countries is easier, less politically contentious, and faster than WTO multilateral negotiation, and policy coordination is simpler too.
  • 收益:自由贸易的全部好处(比较优势专业化、削弱垄断、规模经济、干中学、技术转让、知识溢出、更多外国投资、世界价格的优质中间投入)+ 增强成员相互依存降低冲突可能 + 抱团获得更大议价权和政治影响力 + 增长跨境溢出(OECD 高度一体化,任一成员强增长利及他国)。Benefits: all the benefits of free trade (comparative-advantage specialization, weakening monopoly, economies of scale, learning by doing, technology transfer, knowledge spillovers, more foreign investment, quality intermediate inputs at the world price) + stronger interdependence among members lowering conflict + greater bargaining power and political influence from banding together + cross-border growth spillovers (in the highly integrated OECD, strong growth in any member benefits the others).
  • 成本:对某些群体(如美国低技能工人面对墨西哥进口)造成调整成本、失业;主权关切(大小国同处一集团,如南亚集团中印度角色的挑战)。Costs: adjustment costs and unemployment for some groups (e.g., US low-skilled workers facing Mexican imports); sovereignty concerns (large and small countries in one bloc, e.g., the challenge of India's role in a South Asian bloc).
  • 深度一体化的挑战:
    ① 文化差异与历史(战争冲突)使一体化的社会政治过程复杂化;
    ② 高度一体化限制成员国推行独立经济社会政策的能力——货币同盟尤其如此(货币政策不由个别国掌控、无法用货币贬值/升值纠正持续失衡,持续失衡可能引发危机蔓延,如 2010 希腊财政危机)。    Challenges of deep integration:
    ① cultural differences and history (wars and conflicts) complicate the socio-political process of integration;
    ② high integration limits members' ability to pursue independent economic and social policies — especially a monetary union (monetary policy is not controlled by individual countries, and persistent imbalances cannot be corrected by currency devaluation/appreciation, so persistent imbalances may trigger contagion, e.g., the 2010 Greek fiscal crisis).

26. 相互自由贸易 + 对第三方共同贸易政策 + 要素不自由流动,构成:Free trade among members + a common trade policy toward third parties + no free factor mobility constitutes:

  • A. 关税同盟(customs union)A customs union
  • B. 共同市场(common market)A common market
  • C. 自由贸易区(FTA)A free-trade area (FTA)
答案 A。有共同对外政策但无要素流动即关税同盟;RTA 更流行因政策协调更快、政治争议小;贸易创造 > 贸易转移时净福利为正。Answer A. A common external policy but no factor mobility is a customs union; RTAs are more popular because policy coordination is faster and less politically contentious; net welfare is positive when trade creation > trade diversion.
1. 就贸易集团而言,共同市场最可能涵盖下列哪项的全部方面?1. With respect to trading blocs, a common market most likely incorporates all aspects of a(n): 真题模考Mock
  • A. 关税同盟。customs union.
  • B. 货币联盟。monetary union.
  • C. 经济联盟。economic union.
答案 A。贸易集团层级:自由贸易区 ⊂ 关税同盟(customs union) ⊂ 共同市场(common market) ⊂ 经济联盟 ⊂ 货币联盟。共同市场涵盖关税同盟的全部(共同对外关税)再加要素自由流动。故选关税同盟。Answer A. Trade-bloc hierarchy: free-trade area ⊂ customs union ⊂ common market ⊂ economic union ⊂ monetary union. A common market includes everything in a customs union (a common external tariff) plus free factor movement. Hence customs union.

CFA Program Curriculum · 2026 · Level I · Volume 2 · Economics

第四讲 · 资本流动与外汇市场 & 汇率计算Lecture 4 · Capital Flows & the FX Market & Exchange-Rate Calculations

对应教材:Learning Module 7《Capital Flows and the FX Market》+ Learning Module 8《Exchange Rate Calculations》 · 建议学习时长:3–4 小时 · 这是 Volume 2 经济学的收官讲,也是计算最密集的一讲(LM8 全是计算) · 建议分两次学完(LM7 约 2 小时,LM8 约 1.5 小时)Curriculum: Learning Module 7 Capital Flows and the FX Market + Learning Module 8 Exchange Rate Calculations · Suggested study time: 3–4 hours · This is the finale of Volume 2 Economics and the most calculation-heavy lecture (LM8 is all calculation) · Best done in two sittings (LM7 ~2 hours, LM8 ~1.5 hours)

终于到 Volume 2 的最后一讲。LM7 是概念为主 + 少量计算(实际汇率、货币升贬值百分比),重点在报价约定(价格货币/基准货币、直接/间接、买卖价差)、名义 vs 实际汇率、外汇市场参与者、汇率制度分类(从美元化到独立浮动)、贸易差额与资本账户的恒等关系、资本管制。LM8 则是纯计算:交叉汇率与三角套利、远期点数与远期升贴水、套利平价公式。一级考试外汇部分的计算题几乎全部出自这两个模块,务必把每个公式和"哪个是基准货币"练到条件反射。Finally, the last lecture of Volume 2. LM7 is mostly conceptual + a little calculation (real exchange rate, currency appreciation/depreciation percentage), focusing on quote conventions (price/base currency, direct/indirect, bid-offer spread), nominal vs real exchange rate, FX market participants, the classification of exchange-rate regimes (from dollarization to independent float), the identity linking the trade balance and the capital account, and capital controls. LM8 is pure calculation: cross rates and triangular arbitrage, forward points and forward premium/discount, and the covered-interest-parity formula. Almost all FX calculation questions on the Level I exam come from these two modules, so drill every formula and 'which is the base currency' until it is reflexive.
