LM7 §1 外汇市场与报价约定LM7 §1 The FX Market & Quote Conventions

LOS 对应:LOS: describe the foreign exchange market, including its functions and participants; distinguish nominal and real exchange rates; calculate and interpret the percentage change in a currency。

外汇(FX)市场是全球最大的市场:2019 年日均成交约 6.6 万亿美元,约为全球固收市场的 10–15 倍、股票市场的 50 倍;24 小时运转。The foreign exchange (FX) market is the world's largest market: about $6.6 trillion in average daily turnover in 2019, roughly 10–15 times the global fixed-income market and 50 times the equity market; it runs 24 hours.

核心区分:单一货币 vs 汇率

单一货币可以单独持有(如 1 亿欧元存款);汇率永远涉及两种货币——一种货币相对另一种的价格。教材用 A/B 约定:A single currency can be held on its own (e.g., a €100m deposit); an exchange rate always involves two currencies — the price of one currency relative to another. The text uses the A/B convention:

汇率 A/B = 1 单位基准货币 B 能买到多少单位价格货币 A
术语Term含义Meaning
价格货币 price/quote currency(A)Price/quote currency (A)报价中的分子,"用多少 A 表示 1 个 B 的价格"The numerator of the quote, 'how many A express the price of 1 B'
基准货币 base currency(B)Base currency (B)报价中的分母,数量恒定为 1The denominator of the quote, with a quantity fixed at 1

例:USD/EUR = 1.1700 表示 1 欧元 = 1.17 美元(欧元是基准货币、美元是价格货币)。此汇率下降 = 买 1 欧元需要的美元变少 = 美元对欧元升值、欧元对美元贬值。Example: USD/EUR = 1.1700 means 1 euro = 1.17 dollars (the euro is the base currency, the dollar is the price currency). A fall in this rate = fewer dollars are needed to buy 1 euro = the dollar appreciates against the euro and the euro depreciates against the dollar.

核心考点(务必背熟):永远先分清哪个是基准货币。A/B 上升 → 基准货币 B 升值(1 个 B 能换更多 A);A/B 下降 → 基准货币 B 贬值。专业外汇市场三字母代码永远指"对美元"的汇率(如 EUR 就是 USD/EUR);六字母代码(如 GBPJPY)才是交叉汇率,且代码里先写基准货币(GBPJPY 报的是 JPY/GBP)。报价优先级:欧元>英镑>美元 做基准货币(澳元、纽元例外,对美元时它们做基准:USD/AUD、USD/NZD)。

直接报价 vs 间接报价(取决于所在地)

类型Type定义Definition例(巴黎交易员,本币欧元)Example (a Paris trader, home currency the euro)
直接报价 directDirect quote本币做价格货币、外币做基准货币(= 1 单位外币值多少本币)The home currency is the price currency and the foreign currency the base (= how much home currency 1 unit of foreign currency is worth)EUR/GBP = 1.1211(GBP1 = EUR1.1211)
间接报价 indirectIndirect quote本币做基准货币、外币做价格货币The home currency is the base currency and the foreign currency the price currencyGBP/EUR = 0.8920(EUR1 = GBP0.8920)

两者互为倒数。直接/间接取决于"你在哪":对伦敦人 GBP 是本币,对巴黎人 EUR 是本币,所以专业市场不用这套约定,改用固定的货币对约定。本币升值 → 直接报价下降(买 1 单位外币需要的本币变少)。The two are reciprocals. Direct vs indirect depends on 'where you are': for a Londoner GBP is home, for a Parisian EUR is home, so the professional market does not use this convention and instead uses fixed currency-pair conventions. Home-currency appreciation → the direct quote falls (fewer units of home currency are needed to buy 1 unit of foreign currency).

1. 本币升值时,直接报价(direct quote)如何变化:When the home currency appreciates, how does the direct quote change:

  • A. 上升Rises
  • B. 不变Unchanged
  • C. 下降Falls
答案 C。直接报价本币为价格货币;本币升值→买 1 单位外币所需本币变少→汇率下降。Answer C. In a direct quote the home currency is the price currency; home-currency appreciation → fewer units of home currency to buy 1 unit of foreign currency → the quote falls.

LM7 §2 名义汇率 vs 实际汇率LM7 §2 Nominal vs Real Exchange Rate

  • 名义汇率(nominal exchange rate):市场上报价、交易的汇率。Nominal exchange rate: the rate quoted and traded in the market.
  • 实际汇率(real exchange rate):经济学家构建的指数(不在市场交易),用两国价格水平调整名义汇率,反映两国间相对购买力。背后是购买力平价(PPP)理论——名义汇率应调整到相同商品在不同市场价格相等。但现实中 PPP 条件不满足(商品不同质、篮子不同、许多商品不可贸易、有贸易壁垒和交易成本、资本流动比贸易流动更重要),名义汇率持续偏离 PPP,故实际汇率对预测未来名义汇率的能力很差(如《经济学人》巨无霸指数)。Real exchange rate: an index constructed by economists (not traded in the market) that adjusts the nominal rate by the two countries' price levels, reflecting relative purchasing power between them. Behind it is purchasing power parity (PPP) theory — the nominal rate should adjust so identical goods cost the same in different markets. But in reality PPP conditions do not hold (goods are not identical, baskets differ, many goods are non-tradable, there are trade barriers and transaction costs, and capital flows matter more than trade flows), so the nominal rate persistently deviates from PPP, and the real rate has poor ability to forecast the future nominal rate (e.g., The Economist's Big Mac index).
实际汇率(d/f) = Sd/f × (Pf / Pd)
符号Symbol含义Meaning
d / fdomestic(本国)/ foreign(外国);此处约定本币是价格货币domestic / foreign; here the convention is that the home currency is the price currency
Sd/f名义即期汇率(每 1 单位外币值多少本币)Nominal spot rate (how much home currency 1 unit of foreign currency is worth)
Pf外国价格水平(以外币计,如 CPIeur)The foreign price level (in foreign currency, e.g., CPIeur)
Pd本国价格水平(以本币计,如 CPIUK)The domestic price level (in home currency, e.g., CPIUK)

解读:把实际汇率理解为"你购买外国商品面对的真实价格"——实际汇率越高,你的相对购买力越低(买得起的外国商品越少)。它是名义汇率与外国价格水平的增函数、本国价格水平的减函数。Interpretation: think of the real rate as 'the true price you face for foreign goods' — the higher the real rate, the lower your relative purchasing power (the fewer foreign goods you can afford). It is an increasing function of the nominal rate and the foreign price level, and a decreasing function of the domestic price level.

%Δ实际汇率 ≈ %ΔSd/f + %ΔPf − %ΔPd
近似式Approximation说明Note
%Δ ≈ 名义汇率变化% + 外国通胀% − 本国通胀%%Δ ≈ nominal-rate change% + foreign inflation% − domestic inflation%由 (1+a)(1+b)/(1+c)−1 ≈ a+b−c 得到,考试用此近似即可Derived from (1+a)(1+b)/(1+c)−1 ≈ a+b−c; this approximation suffices for the exam
教材算例 · 英国人买欧元区商品

名义 GBP/EUR 上升 10%、欧元区价格 +5%、英国价格 +2%(GBP 是价格货币=本币):%Δ实际汇率 ≈ 10% + 5% − 2% = +13%。实际汇率升 13% 意味着买欧元区商品的真实成本上升 13%,英国人对欧元区商品的相对购买力下降约 13%。Nominal GBP/EUR rises 10%, eurozone prices +5%, UK prices +2% (GBP is the price currency = home): %Δreal rate ≈ 10% + 5% − 2% = +13%. A 13% rise in the real rate means the true cost of eurozone goods rises 13%, so a UK resident's relative purchasing power over eurozone goods falls about 13%.

教材例题 · 悉尼投资者(AUD/HKD)

场景:AUD/HKD 升 5%、香港价格 +5%、澳洲价格 +2%。实际汇率 RAUD/HKD = SAUD/HKD × (PHKD/PAUD),%ΔR ≈ 5% + 5% − 2% = +8% → 澳洲投资者的相对购买力下降约 8%。另:若只用港元收入付港元开支,即期汇率无关——这是货币风险管理的基本原则(资产负债/收入支出用同种货币可消除汇率风险)。Scenario: AUD/HKD rises 5%, Hong Kong prices +5%, Australian prices +2%. The real rate RAUD/HKD = SAUD/HKD × (PHKD/PAUD), %ΔR ≈ 5% + 5% − 2% = +8% → the Australian investor's relative purchasing power falls about 8%. Also: if HKD income only pays HKD expenses, the spot rate is irrelevant — a basic principle of currency risk management (matching assets/liabilities and income/expenses in the same currency eliminates exchange-rate risk).

考点提示:实际汇率(本币每单位外币)下降最可能对应本国价格水平上升(本币相对购买力上升)。注意方向:本国通胀↑ → 实际汇率↓(不是↑);名义汇率 d/f ↓ → 实际汇率↓ → 本国购买力↑。

2. 实际汇率(本币每单位外币)下降,最可能对应下列哪项上升:A falling real exchange rate (home currency per unit of foreign currency) most likely corresponds to a rise in which of the following:

  • A. 本国价格水平上升The domestic price level rises
  • B. 外国价格水平上升The foreign price level rises
  • C. 名义汇率大幅上升The nominal exchange rate rises sharply
答案 A。实际汇率 = S×(Pf/Pd),Pd↑ → 实际汇率↓。Answer A. Real exchange rate = S×(Pf/Pd); Pd↑ → real exchange rate ↓.

3. 名义 GBP/EUR 升 10%、欧元区价格 +5%、英国价格 +2%,英国人对欧元区商品的实际购买力:Nominal GBP/EUR rises 10%, eurozone prices +5%, UK prices +2%; a UK resident's real purchasing power over eurozone goods:

  • A. 基本不变Roughly unchanged
  • B. 下降约 13%Falls about 13%
  • C. 上升约 13%Rises about 13%
答案 B。%Δ实际汇率 ≈ 10+5−2 = +13%,实际汇率上升即购买力下降约 13%。Answer B. %Δreal exchange rate ≈ 10 + 5 − 2 = +13%; a rise in the real exchange rate means purchasing power falls about 13%.
1. 与实际汇率相比,名义汇率:1. In contrast to real exchange rates, nominal foreign exchange rates: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 往往偏离购买力平价。tend to deviate from purchasing power parity.
  • B. 代表本国与外国的相对价格水平。represent the relative price levels in the domestic and foreign countries.
  • C. 是有助于理解国际贸易与资本流动的指数。are indexes useful for understanding international trade and capital flows.
答案 A。名义汇率(nominal)不含物价、往往偏离购买力平价(PPP)。含相对物价、作为国际贸易/资本流动指数的是实际汇率(real),故 B、C 描述的是实际汇率。Answer A. The nominal exchange rate excludes prices and tends to deviate from purchasing power parity (PPP). The one embedding relative price levels and serving as an index for trade/capital flows is the real rate, so B and C describe the real rate.
2. 美国物价上涨 2%、欧元区上涨 6%。若名义即期汇率 USD/EUR(每 1 欧元的美元数)下降 4%,则实际汇率的绝对变化最接近于:2. Price levels increase by 2% in the US and by 6% in the Eurozone. If the nominal spot USD/EUR (amount of US dollars per 1 euro) decreases by 4%, the absolute change in the real exchange rate is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 0%。0%.
  • B. 4%。4%.
  • C. 8%。8%.
答案 A。方法:实际汇率变化% ≈ 名义变化% + 外国通胀% − 本国通胀%。USD/EUR(美元/欧元):−4% + 6%(欧元区) − 2%(美国) = 0%。Answer A. Method: %Δreal ≈ %Δnominal + foreign inflation − domestic inflation. For USD/EUR: −4% + 6% (Eurozone) − 2% (US) = 0%.
3. 将名义汇率转换为实际汇率需要用到:3. The conversion of nominal exchange rates into real exchange rates requires the: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 两国的 GDP。GDP of both countries.
  • B. 两国的价格水平。price levels in both countries.
  • C. 两国的利率。interest rates in both countries.
答案 B。把名义汇率换成实际汇率需要两国的价格水平(price levels):实际汇率 = 名义 × (外国物价/本国物价)。与 GDP、利率无关。Answer B. Converting nominal to real requires the two countries' price levels: real = nominal × (foreign prices/domestic prices). Not GDP or interest rates.
4. 分析师收集以下信息:
外国通胀率2%
本国通胀率3%
名义汇率变化6%
注:汇率表示为每单位外币兑换的本币。实际汇率的变化最接近于:4. An analyst gathers the following information:
Foreign inflation rate2%
Domestic inflation rate3%
Change in nominal exchange rate6%
Note: the exchange rate is expressed as domestic currency per unit of foreign currency. The change in the real exchange rate is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 4%。4%.
  • B. 5%。5%.
  • C. 7%。7%.
答案 B。方法:实际汇率变化% ≈ 名义变化% + 外国通胀 − 本国通胀(汇率为"每单位外币兑本币")。代入表中数据 ≈ 5%。Answer B. Method: %Δreal ≈ %Δnominal + foreign inflation − domestic inflation (rate quoted as domestic per unit of foreign). Plugging the table ≈ 5%.

LM7 §3 市场参与者、市场构成与买卖价差LM7 §3 Market Participants, Composition & the Bid-Offer Spread

买方(buy side)与卖方(sell side)

类别Category说明Note
卖方 sell sideSell side大型外汇交易银行(花旗、UBS、德银、汇丰等),向买方报价并做市。最大的"货币中心"银行主导日益增长的份额,很大一部分交易在行内撮合(internally crossed);二三线区域/本地银行外包外汇服务Large FX-trading banks (Citi, UBS, Deutsche Bank, HSBC, etc.) that quote to the buy side and make markets. The biggest 'money-center' banks dominate a growing share, and a large portion of trades is internally crossed within the bank; second- and third-tier regional/local banks outsource FX services
企业账户Corporate accounts跨境买卖商品服务、跨境投资(并购、外币借款)产生外汇需求Cross-border buying/selling of goods and services and cross-border investment (M&A, foreign-currency borrowing) create FX demand
Real money 账户Real money accounts保险、共同基金、养老金、ETF 等机构投资者;因受限于杠杆/衍生品使用而得名"真金白银"Institutional investors such as insurers, mutual funds, pensions, and ETFs; named 'real money' because they are restricted in their use of leverage/derivatives
杠杆账户Leveraged accounts对冲基金、自营交易、CTA、高频算法交易——"专业交易社群",占日成交越来越大;交易风格多样(宏观对冲到毫秒级高频)Hedge funds, proprietary trading, CTAs, and high-frequency algorithmic trading — the 'professional trading community,' taking a growing share of daily turnover; trading styles vary (macro hedging to millisecond-scale high frequency)
零售账户Retail accounts机场兑换的游客、个人自营交易、把储蓄换成外币的家庭(如日本);占某些货币对现汇的 10%Tourists changing money at airports, individual proprietary traders, and households converting savings into foreign currency (e.g., Japan); up to 10% of spot volume in some currency pairs
政府 / 央行 / 主权财富基金Governments / central banks / sovereign wealth funds政府有领事馆、军购等外汇需求;央行干预汇率(本币过弱或过强时)、管理外储(2021 年末全球外储近 13 万亿,近 60% 美元、20%+ 欧元);SWF 类似 real money 但常带公共政策目标Governments have FX needs for consulates, military purchases, etc.; central banks intervene in the exchange rate (when the home currency is too weak or too strong) and manage FX reserves (global reserves near $13 trillion at end-2021, nearly 60% USD, 20%+ EUR); SWFs resemble real money but often carry public-policy objectives

市场构成(2016 BIS 三年期调查)

按工具By instrument占比Share按对手方By counterparty占比Share
即期 SpotSpot33%银行间 InterbankInterbank42%
远期 Outright forwardsOutright forwards14%金融客户Financial clients51%
掉期 SwapsSwaps49%非金融客户Non-financial clients8%
FX 期权FX options5%日均传统外汇成交约 5.1 万亿美元Average daily traditional FX turnover about $5.1 trillion

关键结论:
① 成交量最大的是掉期(swap)而非即期——大部分成交是滚动/修改对冲与投机头寸,不是结算国际贸易;
② 金融客户>银行间>非金融客户,金融客户 2010 年首次超过银行间;大部分外汇成交与国际贸易无关,由组合流动(跨境资本)和投机主导。前五大货币对都含美元:USD/EUR 23.1%、JPY/USD 17.8%、USD/GBP 9.3%、USD/AUD 5.2%、CAD/USD 4.3%。伦敦成交最大、其次纽约、东京第三。Key conclusions:
① the largest turnover is swaps, not spot — most turnover is rolling/modifying hedges and speculative positions, not settling international trade;
② financial clients > interbank > non-financial clients, with financial clients first overtaking interbank in 2010; most FX turnover is unrelated to international trade, dominated by portfolio flows (cross-border capital) and speculation. The top five currency pairs all include the dollar: USD/EUR 23.1%, JPY/USD 17.8%, USD/GBP 9.3%, USD/AUD 5.2%, CAD/USD 4.3%. London has the largest turnover, then New York, then Tokyo third.

买卖两边价格(two-sided price)

银行报bid(买入基准货币的价)和offer(卖出基准货币的价),始终针对基准货币。例:CHF/EUR 报 1.1583–1.1585:客户卖 1 欧元得 CHF1.1583(bid),买 1 欧元付 CHF1.1585(offer)。bid 永远低于 offer(银行低买高卖赚价差),扩大价差("spreading clients")是做市商利润来源。多数主要汇率报到4 位小数,日元例外报2 位小数(因日元数值大)。Banks quote a bid (the price to buy the base currency) and an offer (the price to sell the base currency), always with respect to the base currency. Example: CHF/EUR quoted 1.1583–1.1585: a client selling 1 euro gets CHF1.1583 (bid) and buying 1 euro pays CHF1.1585 (offer). The bid is always below the offer (the bank buys low and sells high, earning the spread), and widening the spread ('spreading clients') is a market-maker's profit source. Most major rates are quoted to 4 decimals, with the yen an exception quoted to 2 decimals (because yen values are large).

4. 外汇市场按工具、按对手方,成交量最大的分别是:In the FX market, by instrument and by counterparty, the largest turnover is, respectively:

  • A. 工具:即期;对手方:非金融企业Instrument: spot; counterparty: non-financial firms
  • B. 工具:远期;对手方:央行Instrument: forwards; counterparty: central banks
  • C. 工具:掉期(swap,约 49%);对手方:金融客户(约 51%)Instrument: swaps (about 49%); counterparty: financial clients (about 51%)
答案 C。掉期(非即期)占比最大,金融客户是最大对手方;大部分成交与国际贸易无关。Answer C. Swaps (not spot) have the largest share and financial clients are the biggest counterparty; most turnover is unrelated to international trade.

5. CHF/EUR = 1.1583–1.1585,客户卖 1 欧元所得、买 1 欧元所付分别为:CHF/EUR = 1.1583–1.1585; the amount a client receives for selling 1 euro and pays to buy 1 euro are, respectively:

  • A. 买卖都按 1.1584Both buy and sell at 1.1584
  • B. 卖得 CHF 1.1583(bid),买付 CHF 1.1585(offer)Receives CHF 1.1583 (bid), pays CHF 1.1585 (offer)
  • C. 卖得 1.1585,买付 1.1583Receives 1.1585, pays 1.1583
答案 B。bid/offer 针对基准货币(欧元),bid 永远低于 offer。Answer B. Bid/offer refer to the base currency (euro); the bid is always below the offer.

6. real money 账户("真金白银")与杠杆账户的区别是:The difference between 'real money' accounts and leveraged accounts is:

  • A. real money 大量使用杠杆Real money uses heavy leverage
  • B. 两者完全相同The two are identical
  • C. real money 受限于杠杆/衍生品使用(保险、共同基金、养老金、ETF);杠杆账户接受并管理外汇风险以牟利Real money is restricted in its use of leverage/derivatives (insurance, mutual funds, pensions, ETFs); leveraged accounts accept and manage FX risk for profit
答案 C。杠杆账户为对冲基金、自营、高频交易等。Answer C. Leveraged accounts are hedge funds, proprietary trading, high-frequency traders, etc.

LM7 §4 货币升贬值百分比的计算LM7 §4 Calculating Currency Appreciation/Depreciation Percentage 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

无论用哪种报价约定,汇率变化都可表示为一种货币对另一种的升值百分比——关键是分清基准货币。Whichever quote convention is used, an exchange-rate change can be expressed as one currency's appreciation percentage against another — the key is to identify the base currency.

基准货币升值% = (新汇率 / 旧汇率) − 1  (以 A/B 报价,算的是 B 的升贬值)
要点Key point说明Note
A 升值/B 贬值不相等A's appreciation ≠ B's depreciation基准货币升 x% ≠ 价格货币贬 x%;两者数学上永远不同(要倒数换算)The base currency rising x% ≠ the price currency falling x%; mathematically they are always different (convert via the reciprocal)
教材算例 · 升贬值不对称

USD/EUR 从 1.1500 升到 1.2000:欧元(基准)对美元升值 = 1.2000/1.1500 − 1 = +4.35%。反过来算美元对欧元的贬值:倒数后 = 1.1500/1.2000 − 1 = −4.17%——两个百分比不相等。课后题:CHF 对 GBP 贬值 12%,则 GBP 对 CHF 升值 = 1/(1−0.12) − 1 = 1/0.88 − 1 = +13.64%(大于 12%)。USD/EUR rises from 1.1500 to 1.2000: the euro (base) appreciates against the dollar = 1.2000/1.1500 − 1 = +4.35%. Computing the dollar's depreciation against the euro in reverse: after the reciprocal = 1.1500/1.2000 − 1 = −4.17% — the two percentages are not equal. Practice question: CHF depreciates 12% against GBP, so GBP appreciates against CHF = 1/(1−0.12) − 1 = 1/0.88 − 1 = +13.64% (greater than 12%).

考点提示:已知新汇率和"基准货币升值 x%",求旧汇率:旧汇率 = 新汇率 /(1+x)。例:汇率升到 1.4500、基准货币升 8% → 旧汇率 = 1.4500/1.08 = 1.3426。这类"反解初始汇率"是高频计算题。
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

货币升贬值百分比

直接标价 P/B 表示「1 单位基准货币(base)值多少报价货币(price)」。汇率从 S0 升到 S1:基准货币升值% = S1/S0 − 1。

报价货币怎么算

报价货币的变化不是基准货币变化的相反数,要用倒数:报价货币相对基准的变化% = (S0/S1) − 1。两者符号相反但数值不等。

易错对比

① 先认清哪个是 base(斜杠左边);② 报价货币变化用倒数算,不能直接取负;③ 基准升值 = 报价货币贬值(方向相反)。

Currency appreciation/depreciation percent

A direct quote P/B means "1 unit of the base currency is worth this many units of the price currency." If the rate rises from S0 to S1: base-currency appreciation% = S1/S0 − 1.

Computing the price currency

The price currency's change is not the negative of the base's; use the reciprocal: price-currency change% = (S0/S1) − 1. The signs are opposite but the magnitudes differ.

Common traps

① First identify the base (left of the slash); ② compute the price currency via the reciprocal, not by negating; ③ base appreciation = price-currency depreciation (opposite direction).

7. USD/EUR 从 1.15 升到 1.20,升值的货币及幅度是:USD/EUR rises from 1.15 to 1.20; the currency that appreciated and by how much are:

  • A. 欧元贬值约 −4.17%The euro depreciated about −4.17%
  • B. 欧元升值约 +4.35%The euro appreciated about +4.35%
  • C. 美元升值约 +4.35%The dollar appreciated about +4.35%
答案 B。欧元是基准货币(分母),USD/EUR 上升即欧元升值;1.20/1.15−1 = +4.35%。Answer B. The euro is the base (denominator); a rise in USD/EUR means euro appreciation; 1.20/1.15 − 1 = +4.35%.

LM7 §5 理想货币制度与汇率制度分类LM7 §5 The Ideal Currency Regime & Classification of Exchange-Rate Regimes 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: describe exchange rate regimes and explain the effects of exchange rates on countries' international trade and capital flows。

理想货币制度的三个不相容属性

理想货币制度应同时具备三条,但三者不相容(不可能同时实现):An ideal currency regime would have all three, but the three are incompatible (cannot all be achieved at once):

  1. 各货币间汇率可信地固定(消除汇率不确定性);Exchange rates between currencies are credibly fixed (eliminating exchange-rate uncertainty);
  2. 货币完全可兑换(资本无限制流动);Currencies are fully convertible (capital flows without restriction);
  3. 各国能推行完全独立的货币政策(追求本国增长、通胀目标)。Each country can run fully independent monetary policy (pursuing its own growth and inflation targets).

若①②同时满足,世界上实际只有一种货币,任何调节货币供应的尝试都徒劳——独立货币政策不可能。这就是开放经济宏观的核心权衡:汇率越自由浮动、可兑换性管得越严,央行越能实现国内目标(但代价是汇率风险与资本配置低效)。If ① and ② both hold, there is effectively one world currency and any attempt to adjust the money supply is futile — independent monetary policy is impossible. This is the core trade-off of open-economy macro: the more freely the exchange rate floats and the tighter convertibility is controlled, the more the central bank can achieve domestic targets (at the cost of exchange-rate risk and inefficient capital allocation).

历史沿革

古典金本位(19 世纪—一战,靠价格-铸币-流动机制:贸易顺差→黄金流入→货币供应扩张→物价升→出口降,自我调节)→ 1944 布雷顿森林(可调整的固定平价,Keynes 与 White 设计)→ 1973 崩溃转向浮动(Friedman 早就主张浮动)→ 1979 欧洲汇率机制 ERM("蛇形浮动",1992 英镑遭投机攻击被逐出)→ 1999 欧元诞生。The classical gold standard (19th century to WWI, relying on the price-specie-flow mechanism: a trade surplus → gold inflow → money-supply expansion → rising prices → falling exports, self-adjusting) → 1944 Bretton Woods (adjustable fixed parities, designed by Keynes and White) → 1973 collapse to floating (Friedman had long advocated floating) → 1979 the European Exchange Rate Mechanism (ERM, the 'snake,' from which sterling was ejected by a speculative attack in 1992) → 1999 the birth of the euro.

IMF 汇率制度分类(2008,八类,按控制力从强到弱)

制度Regime特征Features
美元化 dollarizationDollarization采用他国货币为本国法币(如巴拿马、厄瓜多尔、萨尔瓦多);继承对方的货币可信度但非信用度;放弃独立货币政策;铸币税归被采用国Adopting another country's currency as legal tender (e.g., Panama, Ecuador, El Salvador); it inherits the other's monetary credibility but not its creditworthiness; it surrenders independent monetary policy; and seigniorage goes to the adopted country
货币同盟 monetary unionMonetary union成员共用同一法币、通过共同央行(ECB)共同决定货币政策(如 EMU);2010 主权债危机证明货币同盟不能赋予信用度Members share one legal tender and jointly set monetary policy via a common central bank (the ECB) (e.g., the EMU); the 2010 sovereign-debt crisis proved a monetary union cannot confer creditworthiness
货币局 currency boardCurrency board以规则化的固定汇率兑换安排和充足外汇资产支持货币基础。纯粹货币局通常难以像可自由创造基础货币的央行那样提供无限最后贷款支持；但香港是货币局原则下的联系汇率制度，HKMA 可在不破坏货币发行局约束的前提下通过外汇基金和流动性工具提供最后贷款支持。因此不能简单写成“HKMA 不能做最后贷款人”。Backs the monetary base with a rules-based fixed-rate exchange arrangement and ample FX assets. A pure currency board usually cannot provide unlimited lender-of-last-resort support the way a central bank that can freely create base money can; but Hong Kong is a linked-exchange-rate system under currency-board principles, and the HKMA can provide lender-of-last-resort support via the Exchange Fund and liquidity tools without breaching the currency-board constraint. So one cannot simply write 'the HKMA cannot act as lender of last resort.'
固定平价 fixed parityFixed parity盯单一货币或一篮子,允许 ±1% 波动带。与货币局两大区别:
① 无立法承诺(可调整或放弃平价);
② 储备水平可自由裁量,央行可做最后贷款人。可信度取决于储备是否足以抵御投机攻击Pegs to a single currency or a basket, allowing a ±1% band. Two differences from a currency board:
① no legislative commitment (the parity can be adjusted or abandoned);
② reserve levels are discretionary, and the central bank can act as lender of last resort. Credibility depends on whether reserves are sufficient to withstand speculative attacks
目标区 target zoneTarget zone固定平价 + 更宽的 ±2% 波动带,给货币当局更大裁量空间(如丹麦克朗盯欧元 ±2.25%)Fixed parity + a wider ±2% band, giving the monetary authority more discretion (e.g., the Danish krone pegged to the euro at ±2.25%)
爬行钉住 crawling pegCrawling peg频繁小幅调整汇率跟上通胀。被动爬行(passive,事后跟通胀,如巴西高通胀期)vs 主动爬行(active,预告未来汇率以操纵通胀预期,如阿根廷/智利/乌拉圭)Frequent small adjustments of the rate to keep up with inflation. Passive crawl (following inflation after the fact, e.g., Brazil's high-inflation period) vs active crawl (pre-announcing future rates to steer inflation expectations, e.g., Argentina/Chile/Uruguay)
固定平价+爬行带Fixed parity + crawling band固定中心平价 + 预告的逐渐加宽的波动带,是从固定平价渐进退出的策略A fixed central parity + a pre-announced gradually widening band, a strategy for a gradual exit from a fixed parity
管理浮动 managed floatManaged float按内部/外部目标(贸易、物价、就业)决定是否干预,"肮脏浮动";目标不明示Intervenes or not according to internal/external targets (trade, prices, employment), a 'dirty float'; the targets are not disclosed
独立浮动 independent floatIndependent float汇率由市场决定,央行可推行独立货币政策、做最后贷款人。主要货币(美元、日元、欧元、英镑、瑞郎、加元、澳元)通常视为自由浮动(偶尔干预)The rate is set by the market, and the central bank can run independent monetary policy and act as lender of last resort. The major currencies (USD, JPY, EUR, GBP, CHF, CAD, AUD) are usually treated as freely floating (with occasional intervention)
考点提示:
① 货币局 = 法律要求 100% 外币储备支持本币发行,难以放弃平价(风险最小);固定平价无立法承诺、储备可裁量,额外承担"平价可能不被维持"的风险。
② 汇率风险排序(对美国投资者):美元化(如巴拿马,零汇率风险)< 货币局(如香港,小幅波动)< 自由浮动(如加拿大)。
③ 波动带的作用是让货币当局能行使更多货币政策裁量(带越宽裁量越大),不是为了赚价差或少干预。
④ 只有独立浮动能让央行行使独立货币政策、隔离美国货币政策的通胀/通缩传导——美元化和货币局都不能。

8. 理想货币制度的三个属性,以及为何不能同时实现:The three properties of an ideal currency regime, and why they cannot all hold at once:

  • A. 可信固定汇率、完全可兑换、完全独立货币政策;三者不可兼得A credible fixed exchange rate, full convertibility, and fully independent monetary policy; the three cannot all be had
  • B. 高通胀、低利率、固定汇率;可同时实现High inflation, low rates, fixed exchange rate; achievable together
  • C. 浮动汇率、资本管制、财政独立Floating rate, capital controls, fiscal independence
答案 A。不可能三角:若固定汇率 + 完全可兑换同时满足,独立货币政策就不可能。Answer A. The impossible trinity: if a fixed rate + full convertibility both hold, independent monetary policy is impossible.

9. 货币局(currency board)与固定平价(fixed parity)的主要区别是:The main difference between a currency board and a fixed parity is:

  • A. 货币局以更强的规则承诺与外汇资产支持货币基础,货币政策自主性更低A currency board backs the monetary base with a stronger rules-based commitment and FX assets, with lower monetary-policy autonomy
  • B. 货币局的货币政策自主性更高A currency board has greater monetary-policy autonomy
  • C. 固定平价必须 100% 外汇储备支持A fixed parity must be backed 100% by FX reserves
答案 A。固定平价下储备与国内流动性管理更具裁量;香港 HKMA 在联系汇率约束下仍有流动性/最后贷款安排。Answer A. Under a fixed parity, reserve and domestic-liquidity management are more discretionary; Hong Kong's HKMA still has liquidity/lender-of-last-resort arrangements within its linked-rate constraint.

10. 对美国投资者,巴拿马(美元化)、香港(货币局)、加拿大(自由浮动)的汇率风险由高到低是:For a US investor, the exchange-rate risk of Panama (dollarized), Hong Kong (currency board), and Canada (free float) from high to low is:

  • A. 巴拿马 > 香港 > 加拿大Panama > Hong Kong > Canada
  • B. 香港 > 加拿大 > 巴拿马Hong Kong > Canada > Panama
  • C. 加拿大 > 香港 > 巴拿马Canada > Hong Kong > Panama
答案 C。巴拿马用美元近零风险,香港货币局小幅波动,加拿大自由浮动风险最大。Answer C. Panama uses the dollar (near-zero risk), Hong Kong's currency board has small swings, and Canada's free float has the most risk.

11. 主动爬行钉住(active crawl)与被动爬行(passive crawl)的区别是:The difference between an active crawling peg and a passive crawl is:

  • A. 两者都不调整汇率Neither adjusts the rate
  • B. 被动:事后调整汇率跟上通胀;主动:预告未来汇率以操纵通胀预期Passive: adjust the rate after the fact to keep up with inflation; active: pre-announce future rates to steer inflation expectations
  • C. 被动:预告汇率;主动:事后调整Passive: pre-announce rates; active: adjust after the fact
答案 B。被动如巴西高通胀期,主动如阿根廷/智利/乌拉圭。Answer B. Passive as in Brazil's high-inflation period; active as in Argentina/Chile/Uruguay.

12. 固定平价与目标区允许汇率在带内浮动,波动带的作用是:A fixed parity and target zone allow the rate to float within a band; the band's purpose is:

  • A. 让货币当局行使更多货币政策裁量(带越宽裁量越大)To let the monetary authority exercise more monetary-policy discretion (the wider the band, the more discretion)
  • B. 为了减少一切干预To reduce all intervention
  • C. 为了赚取买卖价差To earn the bid-offer spread
答案 A。波动带越宽,货币政策独立空间越大。Answer A. The wider the band, the more room for independent monetary policy.
1. 下列哪种经济条件最有利于货币局(currency board)汇率制度良好运作?1. Which of the following economic conditions for a country best supports a well-functioning currency board exchange rate system? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 国内物价与工资富有弹性Flexible domestic prices and wages
  • B. 全球储备资产供给快速增长Rapid growth in supply of the global reserve asset
  • C. 国内非贸易部门规模较大Large non-traded sectors of the domestic economy
答案 A。货币局(currency board)良好运作需要"国内物价与工资富有弹性"——因为放弃了独立货币政策,只能靠价格/工资调整来消化冲击。Answer A. A currency board works well when domestic prices and wages are flexible — having given up independent monetary policy, adjustment must come through prices/wages.
2. 美元化(dollarization)最恰当地被描述为这样一种汇率制度:一国:2. Dollarization is best described as an exchange rate regime whereby a country: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 使用他国货币作为其交易媒介。uses the currency of another nation as its medium of exchange.
  • B. 参加成员共用同一法定货币的货币联盟。participates in a monetary union whose members share the same legal tender.
  • C. 承诺以固定汇率将本币兑换为指定外币。makes a commitment to exchange domestic currency for a specified foreign currency at a fixed exchange rate.
答案 A。美元化(dollarization)= 一国直接使用他国货币作为交易媒介(完全放弃本币与货币政策)。货币联盟是共用一种货币;固定汇率承诺是钉住制。Answer A. Dollarization = a country adopts another country's currency as its medium of exchange (fully abandoning its own currency and policy). A monetary union shares one currency; a fixed-rate pledge is a peg.
3. 理想的国际货币制度最可能具备:3. An ideal international currency regime would most likely have: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 完全可兑换的货币。currencies that are fully convertible.
  • B. 货币之间浮动的汇率。floating exchange rates between currencies.
  • C. 各国统一的货币政策。a common monetary policy across different countries.
答案 A。理想国际货币制度的特征之一 = 货币完全可兑换(fully convertible)(自由跨境兑换)。它并不要求浮动汇率或统一货币政策。Answer A. A feature of an ideal international monetary system = fully convertible currencies (freely exchangeable across borders). It does not require floating rates or a single monetary policy.

LM7 §6 汇率与贸易差额LM7 §6 Exchange Rate & Trade Balance

核心恒等:贸易逆差(顺差)必然被等额的资本账户顺差(逆差)所抵消。进口多于出口的国家必须向外国借款或出售资产融资;任何影响贸易差额的因素必然对资本账户有等额反向影响。Core identity: a trade deficit (surplus) is necessarily offset by an equal capital-account surplus (deficit). A country importing more than it exports must finance it by borrowing from or selling assets to foreigners; anything affecting the trade balance necessarily has an equal and opposite effect on the capital account.

X − M = (S − I) + (T − G)
符号Symbol含义Meaning
X / M出口 / 进口Exports / imports
S / I私人储蓄 / 厂房设备投资Private saving / plant-and-equipment investment
T / G净税收(扣除转移)/ 政府支出;(T−G) 是政府储蓄Net taxes (after transfers) / government spending; (T−G) is government saving

解读:贸易顺差(X>M)必然对应财政盈余(T>G)、私人储蓄超过投资(S>I),或两者兼有——即国家储蓄多到足以为投资 I 融资,多余的储蓄用来累积对外金融债权。贸易逆差则相反:储蓄不足以支撑投资,须减少对外净债权。Interpretation: a trade surplus (X>M) necessarily corresponds to a fiscal surplus (T>G), private saving exceeding investment (S>I), or both — the country saves enough to fund investment I, with the excess saving accumulating external financial claims. A trade deficit is the reverse: saving is insufficient to support investment, so net external claims must fall.

短期 vs 长期:因支出/储蓄决策和商品价格变化慢、金融投资决策和资产价格变化快,大部分调整发生在金融市场——资本流动(潜在与实际)是短中期汇率的主要决定因素;贸易流动在长期越来越重要。Short run vs long run: because spending/saving decisions and goods prices change slowly while financial-investment decisions and asset prices change fast, most of the adjustment happens in financial markets — capital flows (potential and actual) are the main determinant of the exchange rate in the short-to-medium run; trade flows matter increasingly in the long run.

13. 由 X − M = (S − I) + (T − G),贸易顺差意味着:From X − M = (S − I) + (T − G), a trade surplus implies:

  • A. 对应财政盈余和/或私人储蓄超过投资,即国内储蓄足以为投资融资并累积对外金融债权A corresponding fiscal surplus and/or private saving exceeding investment — domestic saving is enough to fund investment and accumulate external financial claims
  • B. 国内储蓄不足,需外部融资Domestic saving is insufficient and needs external financing
  • C. 一定伴随财政赤字扩大It must accompany a widening fiscal deficit
答案 A。顺差=储蓄盈余,多余储蓄形成对外债权。Answer A. A surplus = a saving surplus; the excess saving forms external claims.

14. 短中期与长期,汇率的主要决定因素分别是:In the short-to-medium run and the long run, the main determinant of the exchange rate is, respectively:

  • A. 短中期:贸易流动;长期:资本流动Short-to-medium run: trade flows; long run: capital flows
  • B. 两期都由央行直接决定Both periods are set directly by the central bank
  • C. 短中期:资本流动;长期:贸易流动Short-to-medium run: capital flows; long run: trade flows
答案 C。金融决策与资产价格变化快,支出储蓄与商品价格调整慢。Answer C. Financial decisions and asset prices change fast, while spending, saving, and goods prices adjust slowly.
1. 当一国有财政盈余且私人储蓄超过投资时,其出口:1. When a country has a fiscal surplus and an excess of private saving over investment, its exports are: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 小于进口。less than its imports.
  • B. 等于进口。equal to its imports.
  • C. 大于进口。greater than its imports.
答案 C。由国民账户恒等式:财政盈余 + 私人储蓄 > 投资 → 经常账户盈余 → 出口 > 进口。Answer C. From the national accounts identity: a fiscal surplus + private saving > investment → a current-account surplus → exports > imports.

LM7 §7 资本管制LM7 §7 Capital Controls

LOS 对应:LOS: describe common objectives of capital restrictions imposed by governments。

资本管制(capital restrictions):限制或重新引导资本流动的任何政策(税收、价格/数量控制、直接禁止)。政府管制资本流入流出的原因:就业或区域发展目标、战略/国防目标(国防、电信等战略产业常有所有权限制)、避免宏观危机中的资本外逃、限制损害本国企业竞争力的资本流入。Capital restrictions: any policy that limits or redirects capital flows (taxes, price/quantity controls, outright bans). Reasons governments control capital inflows/outflows: employment or regional-development goals, strategic/defense goals (strategic industries like defense and telecom often have ownership limits), avoiding capital flight in a macro crisis, and limiting inflows that harm domestic firms' competitiveness.

  • 自由资本流动的好处(经济学共识):资本流向回报最高处;流入使投资超过本国储蓄所能支撑的水平、提高增长率;外国长期投资(FDI)带来资本+技术+技能+管理经验+本地供应商网络的溢出效应;竞争迫使本国企业提效。Benefits of free capital flows (the economic consensus): capital flows to where returns are highest; inflows let investment exceed what domestic saving alone could support, raising the growth rate; foreign long-term investment (FDI) brings spillovers of capital + technology + skills + management experience + a local supplier network; and competition forces domestic firms to be more efficient.
  • 与固定汇率的互补性:完美资本流动下,政府无法仅用货币财政政策同时实现内外目标;资本管制 + 固定汇率目标是互补工具——限制资本流动让政府能控制外部平衡,传统政策工具用于其他目标。Complementarity with a fixed exchange rate: under perfect capital mobility, a government cannot achieve internal and external targets at once with monetary and fiscal policy alone; capital controls + a fixed exchange-rate target are complementary tools — restricting capital flows lets the government control external balance while the traditional policy tools serve other targets.
  • 成本:管理成本高(须堵漏洞)、可能推迟必要的政策调整、可能招致负面市场认知(使该国更难、更贵地获取外国资金)。Costs: high administrative cost (loopholes must be plugged), possibly delaying necessary policy adjustment, and possibly inviting negative market perception (making it harder and dearer for the country to access foreign funds).
教材案例 · 马来西亚资本管制(1998–2001)

1997 泰铢贬值后东南亚资本大量外流。IMF 建议加息吸引外资,但加息压垮本国经济。1998 年 9 月马来西亚反其道而行:实施资本管制(禁止境内外账户转账、冻结遣返一年、把林吉特固定在 3.8/美元),以便降息而不引发货币下跌。结果:遏制了投机性外流、大幅降息、同时推进银行企业重组,1999–2000 强劲复苏。长期代价:马来西亚被移出 MSCI 发达市场指数、降级到新兴市场,更难吸引长期资本流入。After the 1997 baht devaluation, capital fled Southeast Asia heavily. The IMF advised raising rates to attract foreign capital, but rate hikes crushed the domestic economy. In September 1998, Malaysia did the opposite: it imposed capital controls (banning transfers between onshore and offshore accounts, freezing repatriation for a year, fixing the ringgit at 3.8/dollar) so that it could cut rates without triggering a currency slide. The result: it curbed speculative outflows, cut rates sharply, and simultaneously advanced bank and corporate restructuring, with a strong 1999–2000 recovery. The long-run cost: Malaysia was removed from the MSCI developed-market index and downgraded to emerging markets, making it harder to attract long-term capital inflows.

15. 资本管制与固定汇率为何互补,以及马来西亚 1998 年管制的目的:Why capital controls and a fixed exchange rate are complementary, and the goal of Malaysia's 1998 controls:

  • A. 目的是加息吸引外资The goal was to raise rates to attract foreign capital
  • B. 管制资本让政府能同时控制内外目标;马来西亚意在遏制资本外流以便降息、推进重组而不引发货币暴跌Controlling capital lets the government control internal and external targets at once; Malaysia aimed to curb capital outflows so it could cut rates and pursue restructuring without a currency collapse
  • C. 管制用于鼓励资本自由流动Controls are used to encourage free capital flows
答案 B。完美资本流动下无法仅靠货币财政政策同时实现内外目标;代价是被移出 MSCI 发达市场指数。Answer B. Under perfect capital mobility, monetary and fiscal policy alone cannot achieve internal and external targets simultaneously; the cost was removal from the MSCI developed-market index.

LM8 §1 交叉汇率计算与三角套利(必会计算)LM8 §1 Cross-Rate Calculation & Triangular Arbitrage (must-calculate) 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: calculate and interpret currency cross-rates。

交叉汇率(cross-rate):市场未直接报价的两种货币间的汇率,用第三种货币的两个报价推算。核心技巧:让中间货币约掉。Cross-rate: the rate between two currencies not directly quoted in the market, derived from two quotes involving a third currency. The core trick: cancel out the intermediate currency.

CAD/USD × USD/EUR = CAD/EUR  (USD 约掉)
要点Key point说明Note
像分数一样约分Cancel like fractions把汇率当分数,相邻的相同货币(一个在分子、一个在分母)约掉,剩下的就是交叉汇率Treat rates as fractions; the same currency appearing adjacent (one in a numerator, one in a denominator) cancels, and what remains is the cross-rate
必要时先取倒数Take the reciprocal first if needed若中间货币位置不对(都在分子或都在分母),先把其中一个取倒数(inverse)再相乘If the intermediate currency is misplaced (both in numerators or both in denominators), invert one first, then multiply
教材算例 · 两种交叉汇率

① 直接相乘:CAD/USD = 1.3020,USD/EUR = 1.1701 → CAD/EUR = 1.3020 × 1.1701 = 1.5235(每欧元 1.5235 加元)。① Direct multiplication: CAD/USD = 1.3020, USD/EUR = 1.1701 → CAD/EUR = 1.3020 × 1.1701 = 1.5235 (1.5235 Canadian dollars per euro).

② 需先取倒数:求 JPY/CAD,已知 CAD/USD = 1.3020、JPY/USD = 111.94。USD 都在分母,须把 CAD/USD 取倒数为 USD/CAD = 1/1.3020 = 0.7680,再 × JPY/USD:JPY/CAD = 0.7680 × 111.94 = 85.97(每加元 85.97 日元)。② Reciprocal needed first: find JPY/CAD, given CAD/USD = 1.3020 and JPY/USD = 111.94. USD is in both denominators, so invert CAD/USD to USD/CAD = 1/1.3020 = 0.7680, then × JPY/USD: JPY/CAD = 0.7680 × 111.94 = 85.97 (85.97 yen per Canadian dollar).

三角套利(triangular arbitrage)

若做市商报的交叉汇率与推算值不一致,就存在无风险三角套利(涉及三种货币)。承上例:JPY/CAD 推算 85.97,若某做市商误报 86.20 → 用 85.97 买入 CAD1、再以 86.20 卖出 CAD1,无风险赚 JPY0.23/CAD。套利会持续到价差消失(现实中人和算法时刻监控,极少出现)。If a dealer's quoted cross-rate differs from the derived value, there is risk-free triangular arbitrage (involving three currencies). Continuing the example: JPY/CAD is derived as 85.97; if a dealer misquotes 86.20 → buy CAD1 at 85.97 and sell CAD1 at 86.20, earning JPY0.23/CAD risk-free. Arbitrage continues until the gap closes (in reality people and algorithms monitor constantly, so it rarely appears).

教材练习 · ZAR/SEK 套利

已知 CNY/ZAR = 0.9149、CNY/SEK = 1.0218。ZAR/SEK 推算 = (CNY/SEK)/(CNY/ZAR) = 1.0218/0.9149 = 1.1168。若另一做市商报 1.1210(偏高)→ 从原做市商买入 SEK(卖 ZAR)@1.1168、向第二做市商卖出 SEK(买 ZAR)@1.1210。每 100 万 SEK 利润 = 1,000,000 ×(1.1210 − 1.1168)= ZAR 4,200。Given CNY/ZAR = 0.9149 and CNY/SEK = 1.0218, ZAR/SEK is derived as (CNY/SEK)/(CNY/ZAR) = 1.0218/0.9149 = 1.1168. If another dealer quotes 1.1210 (too high) → buy SEK (sell ZAR) from the first dealer @1.1168 and sell SEK (buy ZAR) to the second @1.1210. Profit per SEK 1m = 1,000,000 × (1.1210 − 1.1168) = ZAR 4,200.

考点提示:交叉汇率计算的唯一难点是方向和取倒数。技巧:把要求的目标汇率写成"目标价格货币/目标基准货币",然后拼出已知的两个报价、让中间货币能约分。若拼不出,就把某个报价取倒数。求 ZAR/HKD:已知 CNY/ZAR、CNY/HKD → ZAR/HKD = (CNY/ZAR)⁻¹ × (CNY/HKD) = (1/0.9149)×0.8422 = 0.9205。
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

交叉汇率与三角套利

交叉汇率:通过一个共同货币(如美元)把两种货币的汇率串联推算。计算时把中间货币对齐消去——方向不对就取倒数。

三角套利

若市场报出的交叉汇率≠ 由两个双边汇率隐含的交叉汇率,就存在三角套利:沿「买低卖高」的方向绕一圈换回起始货币获利。用买卖价(bid/offer)时要始终用对自己不利的一边验证是否仍有利可图。

易错对比

① 串联时中间货币方向要一致,否则取倒数;② 套利要用正确的 bid/offer 方向;③ 隐含 ≠ 市场交叉汇率才有套利空间。

Cross rates & triangular arbitrage

A cross rate chains two currencies through a common one (e.g., USD). Line up the middle currency so it cancels — invert a quote if the direction is wrong.

Triangular arbitrage

If the quoted cross rate differs from the cross implied by two bilateral rates, there is triangular arbitrage: go around the loop "buy low, sell high" back to the start for a profit. With bid/offer quotes, always test using the side that is worse for you to confirm a real profit.

Common traps

① Keep the middle currency's direction consistent when chaining, else invert; ② use the correct bid/offer side for arbitrage; ③ arbitrage exists only when implied ≠ quoted cross.

16. 已知 CAD/USD = 1.3020、USD/EUR = 1.1701,CAD/EUR 最接近:Given CAD/USD = 1.3020 and USD/EUR = 1.1701, CAD/EUR is closest to:

  • A. 1.11281.1128
  • B. 0.89930.8993
  • C. 1.52351.5235
答案 C。CAD/USD × USD/EUR = 1.3020 × 1.1701 = 1.5235(USD 约掉)。Answer C. CAD/USD × USD/EUR = 1.3020 × 1.1701 = 1.5235 (USD cancels).

17. 已知 CAD/USD = 1.3020、JPY/USD = 111.94,JPY/CAD 最接近:Given CAD/USD = 1.3020 and JPY/USD = 111.94, JPY/CAD is closest to:

  • A. 111.94111.94
  • B. 85.9785.97
  • C. 145.74145.74
答案 B。USD/CAD = 1/1.3020 = 0.7680;× 111.94 = 85.97。Answer B. USD/CAD = 1/1.3020 = 0.7680; × 111.94 = 85.97.

LM8 §2 远期汇率、远期点数与升贴水(必会计算)LM8 §2 Forward Rate, Forward Points & Premium/Discount (must-calculate) 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: explain the arbitrage relationship between spot and forward exchange rates and interest rates; calculate a forward rate using points or in percentage terms; interpret a forward discount or premium。

专业外汇市场的远期汇率用点数(points / pips)报价——远期汇率与即期汇率之差,按即期报价的最后一位小数缩放。In the professional FX market, forward rates are quoted in points (pips) — the difference between the forward and spot rates, scaled by the last decimal of the spot quote.

远期点数 = (远期汇率 − 即期汇率) × 缩放因子
要点Key point说明Note
缩放因子Scaling factor非日元汇率(4 位小数)× 10,000;日元汇率(2 位小数)× 100Non-yen rates (4 decimals) × 10,000; yen rates (2 decimals) × 100
点数为正 → 远期升水(premium)Positive points → a forward premium远期汇率 > 即期 → 基准货币远期升水;点数为负 → 远期贴水(discount)Forward rate > spot → the base currency is at a forward premium; negative points → a forward discount
基准升水 ⟺ 价格货币贴水Base premium ⟺ price-currency discount一方升水,另一方必贴水If one side is at a premium, the other must be at a discount
教材算例 · USD/EUR 远期点数

即期 USD/EUR = 1.15885,一年远期 = 1.19532 → 差 = +0.03647,× 10,000 = +364.7 点(欧元远期升水)。Spot USD/EUR = 1.15885, 1-year forward = 1.19532 → difference = +0.03647, × 10,000 = +364.7 points (the euro is at a forward premium).

点数→远期汇率:三个月点数 +80.9 → 远期 = 1.15885 + 80.9/10,000 = 1.15885 + 0.00809 = 1.16694。Points → forward rate: 3-month points +80.9 → forward = 1.15885 + 80.9/10,000 = 1.15885 + 0.00809 = 1.16694.

百分比表示:(1.16694/1.15885) − 1 = +0.698%。反向:即期 ×(1+百分比)= 1.15885 × 1.00698 ≈ 1.16694。In percentage terms: (1.16694/1.15885) − 1 = +0.698%. In reverse: spot × (1+percentage) = 1.15885 × 1.00698 ≈ 1.16694.

教材例题 · 法国公司对冲(GBP/EUR)

即期 GBP/EUR = 0.8752,一个月远期点数 −1.4。法国公司要把英镑收入换成欧元(卖英镑买欧元),远期 = 0.8752 + (−1.4/10,000) = 0.87506。远期贴水说明基准货币国(欧元区)利率高于价格货币国(英国)。若 12 个月远期 = 0.87295,则点数 = (0.87295 − 0.87520)×10,000 = −22.5。Spot GBP/EUR = 0.8752, 1-month forward points −1.4. A French firm converting GBP income to EUR (selling GBP, buying EUR): forward = 0.8752 + (−1.4/10,000) = 0.87506. A forward discount indicates the base-currency country (eurozone) has higher rates than the price-currency country (UK). If the 12-month forward = 0.87295, the points = (0.87295 − 0.87520)×10,000 = −22.5.

1. 若即期 USD/EUR 汇率(每 1 欧元的美元数)为 1.1605,1 年期远期汇率为 1.17240,则远期点数为:1. If the spot USD/EUR exchange rate (the amount of USD per one EUR) is 1.1605 and the one-year forward rate is 1.17240, the forward points are: 真题模考Mock

LM8 §3 套利平价关系与远期汇率公式(必会计算)LM8 §3 Covered Interest Parity & the Forward-Rate Formula (must-calculate) 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

远期汇率由套利关系决定:两个等价投资(本币直接投 vs 换外币投再换回)必须回报相等。以 f/d 报价(每单位本币值多少外币):The forward rate is set by an arbitrage relationship: two equivalent investments (investing home currency directly vs converting to foreign, investing, and converting back) must earn equal returns. With f/d quoting (how much foreign currency per unit of home currency):

(1 + rd) = Sf/d(1 + rf)(1 / Ff/d)  ⟹  Ff/d = Sf/d × (1 + rf)/(1 + rd)
符号Symbol含义Meaning
rd / rf本国 / 外国无风险利率Domestic / foreign risk-free rate
Sf/d / Ff/d即期 / 远期汇率(f/d 约定:每单位本币值多少外币)Spot / forward rate (f/d convention: how much foreign currency per unit of home currency)
直觉Intuition右边按时间顺序:
①换成外币 ②按外国利率投资 ③用远期换回本币The right side follows the time sequence:
① convert to foreign currency ② invest at the foreign rate ③ convert back to home currency via the forward

核心规律(务必背):Ff/d/Sf/d = (1+rf)/(1+rd)——利率高的货币在远期市场贴水,利率低的货币远期升水(无论哪种报价约定)。若以 d/f 报价,公式变为 (1+rd) = (1/Sd/f)(1+rf)Fd/f。Core rule (memorize): Ff/d/Sf/d = (1+rf)/(1+rd) — the higher-rate currency is at a forward discount, and the lower-rate currency at a forward premium (regardless of quote convention). With d/f quoting, the formula becomes (1+rd) = (1/Sd/f)(1+rf)Fd/f.

教材算例 · 远期汇率与套利

Sf/d = 1.6535,rd = 3.50%,rf = 5.00% → Ff/d = 1.6535 ×(1.0500/1.0350)= 1.6775。若做市商误报 F = 1.6900:对冲外国投资回报 = 1.6535 × 1.05 ×(1/1.6900)= 1.0273 = 2.73% < 本国 3.50% → 无风险套利:借外币、即期卖外币、以误报远期买回外币对冲、投本国无风险利率,每单位本币赚 77 个基点(3.50%−2.73%),无需自有资金。Sf/d = 1.6535, rd = 3.50%, rf = 5.00% → Ff/d = 1.6535 × (1.0500/1.0350) = 1.6775. If a dealer misquotes F = 1.6900: the hedged foreign-investment return = 1.6535 × 1.05 × (1/1.6900) = 1.0273 = 2.73% < the domestic 3.50% → risk-free arbitrage: borrow foreign currency, sell it spot, buy it back via the misquoted forward to hedge, and invest at the domestic risk-free rate, earning 77 basis points (3.50%−2.73%) per unit of home currency with no own capital.

远期作为预期未来即期汇率(慎用)

若 Ft = St+1:%ΔSt+1 = (rf − rd)/(1 + rd)
要点Key point说明Note
预期即期变化 ∝ 利差Expected spot change ∝ the interest differential但方向反直觉:本国利率↑ 意味着本币预期更慢升值/更快贬值(f/d 约定下)But the direction is counterintuitive: a higher domestic rate implies the home currency is expected to appreciate more slowly / depreciate faster (under the f/d convention)
预测力差Poor predictive power远期是未来即期的差劲预测器(虽可能无偏,但误差极大);实务中不单靠远期做预测The forward is a poor predictor of the future spot (possibly unbiased but with huge error); in practice one does not rely on the forward alone to forecast
考点·外汇定量三件套:
• 交叉汇率(cross rate):用共同货币消元,如 EUR/GBP = (USD/GBP) ÷ (USD/EUR)。
• 远期点数(forward points):= (远期 − 即期) × 缩放因子(非日元 ×10,000、日元 ×100)。
• 抛补利率平价(covered interest parity, CIP):F = S × (1 + r_报价货币) ÷ (1 + r_基准货币);高息货币远期贴水(贬值)、低息货币远期升水;本国利率↑ → 本币远期贬值、远期汇率下降。Exam · three FX quant tools:
• Cross rate: cancel a common currency, e.g., EUR/GBP = (USD/GBP) ÷ (USD/EUR).
• Forward points: = (forward − spot) × scaling factor (×10,000 for non-yen, ×100 for yen).
• Covered interest parity (CIP): F = S × (1 + r_price) ÷ (1 + r_base); the higher-yield currency trades at a forward discount, the lower-yield at a premium; a higher domestic rate makes the domestic currency depreciate forward.
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

抛补利率平价与远期公式

F/S = (1 + r_price × T) ÷ (1 + r_base × T)(F、S 均为 price/base 报价,T 为期限占年比例)。这是无套利(抛补)关系:锁定远期后,两货币的存款回报应相等。

升贴水方向

高利率货币在远期贴水(forward discount)、低利率货币远期升水——恰好抵消利差,消除套利。

易错对比

① 分子是报价货币(price)利率、分母是基准货币利率——对齐报价方向;② 高息货币远期贴水(不是升水);③ 注意天数惯例(T 的算法)。

Covered interest parity & the forward formula

F/S = (1 + r_price × T) ÷ (1 + r_base × T) (F, S quoted price/base; T is the year fraction). This is the no-arbitrage (covered) relation: once the forward is locked, deposit returns in the two currencies must match.

Premium/discount direction

The higher-rate currency trades at a forward discount, the lower-rate currency at a premium — exactly offsetting the rate gap and killing arbitrage.

Common traps

① The numerator uses the price-currency rate, the denominator the base-currency rate — align to the quote; ② the high-rate currency is at a forward discount (not premium); ③ watch the day-count convention for T.

22. 套利平价 Ff/d = Sf/d×(1+rf)/(1+rd),S=1.6535、rd=3.5%、rf=5%,一年远期 F 约:Covered interest parity Ff/d = Sf/d×(1+rf)/(1+rd), S = 1.6535, rd = 3.5%, rf = 5%; the 1-year forward F is about:

  • B. 1.65351.6535
  • C. 1.67751.6775

23. 基准货币远期贴水/升水分别说明基准与价格货币的利率高低:A base currency's forward discount/premium indicates the relative rates of the base and price currencies:

  • A. 贴水 → 基准货币利率更高;升水 → 价格货币利率更高Discount → the base currency's rate is higher; premium → the price currency's rate is higher
  • B. 贴水 → 基准货币利率更低Discount → the base currency's rate is lower
  • C. 升水 → 基准货币利率更高Premium → the base currency's rate is higher
答案 A。利率高者远期贴水。Answer A. The higher-rate currency trades at a forward discount.

24. rGBP=1.325%、rEUR=1.370%、即期 GBP/EUR=0.8489,270 天远期点数约:rGBP = 1.325%, rEUR = 1.370%, spot GBP/EUR = 0.8489; the 270-day forward points are about:

EUR is the base; F = 0.8489×(1 + 0.01325×270/360)/(1 + 0.01370×270/360) = 0.84862, points = (0.84862 − 0.84890)×10,000 = −2.8 (omitting day-count gives −3.8; a scaling error gives −22.8).

USD/AUD 为每 1 澳元的美元数。USD/AUD 的 1 年期远期汇率最接近于:1. An analyst gathers the following information:
USD/AUD spot rate0.8027

USD 1-year interest rate2.42%
USD/AUD is the amount of USD per 1 AUD. The USD/AUD 1-year forward rate is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 0.7959。0.7959.

2. 就外汇市场而言,涉及各国相对利率的套利关系是下列哪项的基础?2. With respect to the foreign exchange market, an arbitrage relationship involving countries' relative interest rates serves as the basis for: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 实际汇率。real exchange rates.
  • B. 远期汇率。forward exchange rates.
  • C. 名义汇率。nominal exchange rates.
答案 B。涉及两国相对利率的套利关系(抛补利率平价)是"远期汇率"的基础。实际汇率由物价决定;名义即期由供求决定。Answer B. The no-arbitrage relation involving relative interest rates (covered interest parity) underlies the forward rate. The real rate is set by prices; the nominal spot by supply/demand.
3. 在其他条件不变时,有效市场中远期汇率因下列哪项上升而下降?3. All else being equal, in an efficient market a forward exchange rate will decrease as a result of an increase in the: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 即期汇率。spot exchange rate.
  • B. 外国无风险利率。foreign risk-free interest rate.
  • C. 本国无风险利率。domestic risk-free interest rate.
答案 C。由抛补利率平价(报价为"每单位外币兑本币",本币为基准方向):本国无风险利率上升 → 本币远期贬值 → 远期汇率下降。即期升会抬高远期;外国利率升会抬高该报价下的远期。Answer C. By covered interest parity (with the domestic currency on the base side of the quote): a rise in the domestic risk-free rate makes the domestic currency depreciate forward → the forward rate falls. A higher spot raises the forward; a higher foreign rate raises the forward under this quote.

LM8 §4 期限对远期点数的影响(含天数惯例)LM8 §4 Effect of Tenor on Forward Points (with day-count conventions)

加入投资期限 τ(占利率报价期的比例)后,套利公式推广为:Adding the investment tenor τ (as a fraction of the rate-quote period), the arbitrage formula generalizes to:

Ff/d = Sf/d × (1 + rfτ)/(1 + rdτ)    Ff/d − Sf/d = Sf/d × [(rf − rd)/(1 + rdτ)] × τ
符号Symbol含义Meaning
τ (tau)投资期限占利率期的比例;Libor 存款天数惯例 actual/360(如 30 天 → 30/360)The tenor as a fraction of the rate period; the Libor deposit day-count convention is actual/360 (e.g., 30 days → 30/360)
规律Rule远期点数 ∝ 即期汇率、∝ 利差 (rf−rd)、近似(非精确)∝ 期限 τForward points ∝ the spot rate, ∝ the interest differential (rf−rd), and approximately (not exactly) ∝ the tenor τ
教材算例 · 30 天与 180 天远期

Sf/d = 1.6555,rd = 2.00%,rf = 3.00%。30 天:F = 1.6555 ×(1+0.03×30/360)/(1+0.02×30/360)= 1.6569,升水 14 点。180 天:点数 = 1.6555 ×[(0.03−0.02)/(1+0.02×180/360)]×(180/360)= 0.0082 = 82 点。注意 180 天点数≈但不精确等于 6×14=84(近似比例)。利差翻倍(rf→4%)则 30 天点数翻倍到约 28 点。Sf/d = 1.6555, rd = 2.00%, rf = 3.00%. 30 days: F = 1.6555 × (1+0.03×30/360)/(1+0.02×30/360) = 1.6569, a 14-point premium. 180 days: points = 1.6555 × [(0.03−0.02)/(1+0.02×180/360)] × (180/360) = 0.0082 = 82 points. Note the 180-day points ≈ but are not exactly 6×14 = 84 (an approximate proportion). Doubling the differential (rf→4%) doubles the 30-day points to about 28.

教材例题 · 270 天 GBP/EUR 远期点数

rGBP = 1.325%,rEUR = 1.370%,即期 GBP/EUR = 0.8489(EUR 是基准)。FGBP/EUR = 0.8489 ×(1+0.01325×270/360)/(1+0.01370×270/360)= 0.84862。点数 = (0.84862−0.84890)×10,000 = −2.8 点。常见错误:漏乘天数(270/360)得 −3.8;缩放错误得 −22.8。rGBP = 1.325%, rEUR = 1.370%, spot GBP/EUR = 0.8489 (EUR is the base). FGBP/EUR = 0.8489 × (1+0.01325×270/360)/(1+0.01370×270/360) = 0.84862. Points = (0.84862−0.84890)×10,000 = −2.8 points. Common errors: omitting the day-count (270/360) gives −3.8; a scaling error gives −22.8.

考点提示(收官必背):
① 远期点数计算三步:算 F = S×(1+rfτ)/(1+rdτ)→ 减 S → 乘缩放因子(非日元 10,000、日元 100)。
②务必乘天数比例 τ = 天数/360(Libor actual/360),漏掉是最常见错误。
③ 谁是 rf、谁是 rd? 看 f/d 约定:分子货币(价格货币)是 f(外国),分母货币(基准货币)是 d(本国)——GBP/EUR 里 EUR 是基准=d、GBP 是价格=f,所以 rd=rEUR、rf=rGBP。
④ 记牢:基准货币利率高 → 基准货币远期贴水(点数为负);远期升水 ⟺ 价格货币利率高于基准货币。
⑤ 已知远期汇率和百分比点数求即期:即期 = 远期 /(1+百分比)。

26. 期限翻 6 倍(30 天→180 天),远期点数是否正好翻 6 倍:If the tenor is multiplied 6× (30 days → 180 days), do the forward points multiply exactly 6×:

  • A. 与期限无关Independent of tenor
  • B. 近似但不精确(因分母 (1+rdτ) 也随 τ 变化)Approximately but not exactly (because the denominator (1 + rdτ) also changes with τ)
  • C. 精确翻 6 倍Exactly 6×
答案 B。如 30 天 14 点、180 天 82 点(而非 6×14=84),点数近似正比于 τ 但非精确。Answer B. E.g., 30-day 14 points, 180-day 82 points (not 6×14 = 84); points are roughly proportional to τ but not exactly.

🎯 公司发行人做题技巧 · 提分策略🎯 Corporate Issuers Exam Tactics
  • 组织形式:公司(corporation)股东有限责任、但利润双重征税;合伙"穿透"征税但普通合伙人无限责任。股东上行无限、损失以出资为限;债权人上行有限、损失也以出资为限。Organizational forms: a corporation gives shareholders limited liability but double-taxes profits; partnerships are pass-through but general partners have unlimited liability. Shareholders have unlimited upside and limited loss; creditors have limited upside and limited loss.
  • 治理冲突:委托-代理(管理层损害股东)vs 股东-债权人 vs 控股-少数股东;壕沟自保、帝国扩张、只发现金薪酬都是与股东利益不一致的信号。三大核心委员会:审计、提名、薪酬。Governance conflicts: principal-agent (management vs shareholders) vs shareholder-creditor vs controlling-minority; entrenchment, empire-building, and all-cash pay signal misalignment. The three core committees: audit, nominating, compensation.
  • 商业模式关键词:渗透定价(抢份额)、分层/动态/价值定价、免费增值;代工、许可、特许、众包;价值链(内部)vs 供应链(整条);传统/直销/全渠道。Business-model keywords: penetration (grab share), tiered/dynamic/value pricing, freemium; contract manufacturing, licensing, franchising, crowdsourcing; value chain (internal) vs supply chain (whole flow); conventional/direct/omnichannel.
  • 营运资本:速动比率剔除存货;现金转换周期 CCC = 存货天数 + 应收天数 − 应付天数;营业周期 = 存货 + 应收天数。拖累=流入慢、拉低=流出快。Working capital: the quick ratio excludes inventory; cash conversion cycle = days inventory + days receivable - days payable; operating cycle = days inventory + days receivable. A drag = slow inflows, a pull = fast outflows.
  • 资本预算:互斥项目冲突时以 NPV 为准(NPV 直接衡量增值);IRR 假设中间现金流按 IRR 再投资(NPV 按要求回报率)。折现率用"项目自身"的要求回报,不是公司整体。Capital budgeting: for conflicting mutually exclusive projects, go by NPV (it directly measures value added); IRR assumes reinvestment at the IRR (NPV at the required rate). Discount at the project's own required return, not the firm's overall rate.
  • WACC = w_d×税后债务成本 + w_p×优先股成本 + w_e×权益成本;税率上升 → 税盾更大 → 税后债务成本降 → WACC 下降;权重优先用市值。只有债务享税盾。WACC = w_d × after-tax cost of debt + w_p × cost of preferred + w_e × cost of equity; a higher tax rate enlarges the shield, lowering after-tax debt cost and WACC; use market-value weights. Only debt enjoys the tax shield.
  • MM:无税下 命题I 价值与结构无关、WACC不变;有税下 债务税盾使价值↑、WACC↓。命题II:权益成本随 D/E 上升;静态权衡在税盾与困境成本间求企业价值最大。MM: with no taxes, Prop I says value and WACC are independent of structure; with taxes, the debt shield raises value and lowers WACC. Prop II: cost of equity rises with D/E; static trade-off maximizes firm value between the shield and distress costs.
  • 资本结构承受力:高稳收入、低经营杠杆、高可变现资产 → 可举更多债;债务占比在成熟期最高。啄食顺序:内部资金 > 债务 > 新股。Debt capacity: high stable revenue, low operating leverage, highly marketable assets support more debt; debt-to-capital peaks in the mature stage. Pecking order: internal funds > debt > new equity.

§1 三种企业组织形式§1 The Three Forms of Business Organization 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: compare the organizational forms of businesses。
🔰 零基础讲解:开公司的三种"法律外壳"

组织形式🏪 一个人摆摊卖奶茶=独资(赚的都归你,但欠债你个人也得还,无限责任)。几个人合伙开店=合伙(共担盈亏)。注册成一家有限公司=法人(公司是独立"法律人",股东只以出资为限担责,老板破产不牵连公司)。规模越大越倾向公司制,因为能有限责任+方便融资。:独资、合伙、公司,责任与融资能力递增。Organizational form🏪 One person selling bubble tea from a stall = a sole proprietorship (you keep all the profit, but you personally repay the debts too — unlimited liability). A few people running a shop together = a partnership (sharing profit and loss). Registering as a limited company = a legal person (the company is an independent 'legal person,' shareholders are liable only up to their contribution, and the owner's bankruptcy does not drag in the company). The larger the scale, the more it tends toward the corporate form, because of limited liability + easier financing.: sole proprietorship, partnership, corporation, in increasing order of liability protection and financing ability.

形式Form责任Liability特点Features
独资 sole proprietorshipSole proprietorship无限责任Unlimited liability个人独有、设立简单、与业主不分离、融资受限Individually owned, simple to set up, not separate from the owner, limited financing
合伙 partnershipPartnership普通合伙无限;有限合伙的 LP 有限Unlimited for a general partnership; limited for the LPs of a limited partnership两人以上共担;普通合伙人 GP 管理并负无限责任,LP 仅出资Shared by two or more; the general partner (GP) manages and bears unlimited liability, LPs only contribute capital
公司 corporationCorporation股东有限责任Shareholder limited liability独立法人、永续存续、所有权可转让、便于大规模融资、双重征税(部分)Separate legal person, perpetual existence, transferable ownership, easy large-scale financing, double taxation (in part)
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

三种企业组织形式

• 独资(sole proprietorship):业主无限责任、穿透征税、融资能力弱。
• 合伙(partnership):普通合伙人(GP)无限责任、有限合伙人(LP)有限责任;穿透征税。
• 公司(corporation):独立法人、股东有限责任、所有权与经营分离、永续、股份易转让,但(C 型)双重征税。

易错对比

① 有限责任只属公司股东和 LP;② 公司(C corp)双重征税(公司层 + 股东层),合伙/独资穿透;③ 公司所有权与经营分离 → 委托代理问题。

Three forms of business organization

• Sole proprietorship: unlimited owner liability, pass-through tax, weak financing.
• Partnership: general partners (GP) have unlimited liability, limited partners (LP) limited liability; pass-through tax.
• Corporation: separate legal entity, limited shareholder liability, ownership separated from management, perpetual, easily transferable shares, but (C corp) double taxation.

Common traps

① Limited liability belongs to corporate shareholders and LPs only; ② a C corp is double-taxed (entity + shareholder), partnerships/sole props are pass-through; ③ a corporation separates ownership from management → the agency problem.

1. 三种企业组织形式是:The three forms of business organization are: 官方题Official

  • A. 独资、信托、基金Sole proprietorship, trust, fund
  • B. 合伙、公司、行业协会Partnership, corporation, trade association
  • C. 独资、合伙、公司Sole proprietorship, partnership, corporation
答案 C。三种基本形式为独资、合伙、公司。Answer C. The three basic forms are sole proprietorship, partnership, and corporation.

2. 独资经营的责任特征是:The liability characteristic of a sole proprietorship is: 官方题Official

  • A. 无限责任,业主个人对企业债务负全部责任Unlimited liability — the owner is personally fully liable for business debts
  • B. 有限责任Limited liability
  • C. 仅以注册资本为限Limited to registered capital
答案 A。独资无法人隔离,业主承担无限责任。Answer A. A sole proprietorship has no legal separation, so the owner bears unlimited liability.

3. 有限合伙中普通合伙人(GP)与有限合伙人(LP)的责任区别是:In a limited partnership, the liability difference between the general partner (GP) and limited partners (LP) is: 官方题Official

  • A. 两者都负无限责任Both bear unlimited liability
  • B. GP 管理并负无限责任;LP 仅出资、责任以出资为限The GP manages and bears unlimited liability; LPs only contribute capital and are liable up to their contribution
  • C. GP 责任以出资为限;LP 负无限责任The GP is liable up to its contribution; LPs bear unlimited liability
答案 B。GP 经营担无限责任,LP 被动出资、责任受限。Answer B. The GP runs the business with unlimited liability; LPs are passive investors with limited liability.
1. 在有限合伙中,业务经营由下列哪方负责?1. In a limited partnership, business operations are the responsibility of: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅普通合伙人(GP)the general partner only
  • B. 仅有限合伙人(LP)the limited partners only
  • C. GP 与 LP 双方both the general partner and the limited partners
答案 A。有限合伙中业务由普通合伙人(GP, general partner)经营并负无限责任;有限合伙人(LP)只出资、负有限责任、不参与经营。Answer A. In a limited partnership, the general partner (GP) runs the business and has unlimited liability; limited partners (LPs) contribute capital, have limited liability, and do not manage.
2. 下列哪种组织形式的所有者承担有限责任?2. Owners have limited liability in a: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 公司(corporation)corporation
  • B. 独资企业sole proprietorship
  • C. 普通合伙general partnership
答案 A。公司(corporation)的所有者(股东)承担有限责任——最多损失出资。独资、普通合伙的所有者负无限责任。Answer A. A corporation's owners (shareholders) have limited liability — at most they lose their investment. Sole proprietorship and general-partnership owners have unlimited liability.

§2 公司制的核心特征§2 Core Features of the Corporate Form

LOS 对应:LOS: describe key features of corporate issuers。

公司作为发行人的关键特征:
① 独立法人(与股东分离,可自己签约、诉讼);
② 股东有限责任(最多损失出资);
③ 所有权与经营权分离(股东选董事会、董事会聘管理层);
④ 永续存续(股东变动不影响存续);
⑤ 可通过发行债务与股权大规模外部融资。Key features of a corporation as an issuer:
① a separate legal person (separate from shareholders, able to contract and sue on its own);
② shareholder limited liability (losing at most the contribution);
③ separation of ownership and control (shareholders elect the board, the board hires management);
④ perpetual existence (changes in shareholders do not affect its continuity);
⑤ large-scale external financing by issuing debt and equity.

4. 公司制最重要的两个特征是:The two most important features of the corporate form are: 官方题Official

  • A. 无限责任 + 双重征税Unlimited liability + double taxation
  • B. 所有权与经营权合一 + 永续Unified ownership and control + perpetual life
  • C. 独立法人 + 股东有限责任Separate legal personality + shareholder limited liability
答案 C。独立法人地位与股东有限责任是公司制两大基石。Answer C. Separate legal personality and shareholder limited liability are the two cornerstones of the corporate form.

5. "所有权与经营权分离"指:"Separation of ownership and control" means: 官方题Official

  • A. 债权人负责经营Creditors run the business
  • B. 股东拥有公司但不直接经营,由其选出的董事会聘任管理层经营Shareholders own the company but do not run it directly; the board they elect hires management to operate it
  • C. 管理层拥有公司全部股份Management owns all the shares
答案 B。所有者(股东)与经营者(管理层)分离,由董事会衔接。Answer B. Owners (shareholders) are separated from operators (management), bridged by the board.

6. 公司制便于大规模融资的原因是:The reason the corporate form facilitates large-scale financing is: 官方题Official

  • A. 无需任何信息披露No disclosure of any information is required
  • B. 股东负无限责任以增强信用Shareholders bear unlimited liability to boost credit
  • C. 可公开发行股债、股份可转让、有限责任降低投资者风险It can publicly issue stocks/bonds, shares are transferable, and limited liability lowers investor risk
答案 C。可转让股份 + 有限责任 + 公开市场使融资更容易。Answer C. Transferable shares + limited liability + public markets make financing easier.

7. 双重征税通常出现在哪种组织形式:Double taxation typically arises in which organizational form: 官方题Official

  • A. 普通合伙General partnership
  • B. 公司制(公司缴企业所得税、股东就分红再缴税)The corporation (the company pays corporate income tax and shareholders are taxed again on dividends)
  • C. 独资Sole proprietorship
答案 B。公司层面与股东层面各征一次;部分穿透结构可避免。Answer B. Taxed once at the corporate level and once at the shareholder level; some pass-through structures avoid it.

8. 永续存续(perpetual life)的含义是:The meaning of perpetual life is: 官方题Official

  • A. 公司必须每年续期The company must renew annually
  • B. 股东死亡则公司解散The company dissolves when a shareholder dies
  • C. 公司存续不因股东变动或死亡而终止,独立于所有者The company continues regardless of changes in or death of shareholders, independent of its owners
答案 C。公司作为独立法人可无限期存续。Answer C. As a separate legal person, the company can exist indefinitely.

9. 有限责任对股东意味着:Limited liability means for shareholders: 补充Extra

  • A. 股东须追加无限出资Shareholders must make unlimited additional contributions
  • B. 股东最多损失其出资额,个人其他资产不因公司债务受追索Shareholders can lose at most their contribution; their other personal assets are not pursued for the company's debts
  • C. 股东对公司全部债务负责Shareholders are liable for all company debts
答案 B。有限责任把股东损失上限锁定为出资额。Answer B. Limited liability caps a shareholder's loss at the amount invested.
1. 利润的双重征税最可能是下列哪类所有者关心的问题?1. Double taxation of profits is most likely a concern for owners in: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 公司corporations
  • B. 有限合伙limited partnerships
  • C. 普通合伙general partnerships
答案 A。利润"双重征税(double taxation)"是公司(corporation)的特有问题:公司先缴企业所得税、股东收股利再缴个税。合伙是"穿透"征税,无双重征税。Answer A. Double taxation of profits is specific to a corporation: the company pays corporate tax, then shareholders pay personal tax on dividends. Partnerships are pass-through, with no double taxation.
2. 若某公司同时以债务和股权融资,下列哪项是公司必须支付的?2. If a corporation is financed with both debt and equity, which of the following must the corporation pay? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅利息Interest only
  • B. 仅股利Dividends only
  • C. 利息和股利都必须付Both interest and dividends
答案 A。公司对债务须强制支付利息(不付即违约);股利是可自由裁量的、非强制。故只有利息必须付。Answer A. A company must pay interest on debt (missing it is default); dividends are discretionary, not mandatory. So only interest must be paid.

10. 上市公司相比非上市公司在披露上的差异是:The disclosure difference between a listed and an unlisted company is: 官方题Official

  • A. 上市公司受监管须充分披露;非上市披露少、透明度低A listed company is regulated and must disclose fully; an unlisted one discloses little with low transparency
  • B. 上市公司披露更少A listed company discloses less
  • C. 两者披露要求完全相同Their disclosure requirements are identical
答案 A。上市伴随更严格的强制披露与监管。Answer A. Listing brings stricter mandatory disclosure and regulation.

11. IPO 与私有化(going private)分别指:An IPO and going private respectively mean: 官方题Official

  • A. IPO=上市转非上市;私有化=非上市转上市IPO = listed becoming unlisted; going private = unlisted becoming listed
  • B. 两者都指发行债券Both mean issuing bonds
  • C. IPO=非上市转为上市;私有化=上市转为非上市IPO = unlisted becoming listed; going private = listed becoming unlisted
答案 C。方向相反:IPO 上市、私有化退市。Answer C. Opposite directions: an IPO lists, going private delists.
1. 购买下列哪种股份最可能要求投资者具备合格投资者资格?1. The purchase of which of the following shares most likely requires investors to be accredited? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅上市公司股份Public company shares only
  • B. 仅非上市公司股份Private company shares only
  • C. 上市与非上市公司股份都要求Both public company shares and private company shares
答案 B。购买非上市公司股份常要求投资者是合格投资者(accredited investor)(私募豁免、风险自担)。上市股份公开交易,无此要求。Answer B. Buying private-company shares often requires the investor to be an accredited investor (private-placement exemption). Public shares trade openly, with no such requirement.
2. 与上市公司相比,非上市公司的股份发行最可能:2. Compared to those of public companies, share issuances of private companies most likely: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 筹集更大规模的资本raise larger amounts of capital
  • B. 涉及更多投资者include a larger number of investors
  • C. 涉及持有期更长的投资者include investors with longer holding periods
答案 C。非上市公司股份流动性差 → 投资者持有期更长(退出难)。它筹资规模更小、投资者更少,故 A、B 错。Answer C. Private-company shares are illiquid → investors have longer holding periods (harder to exit). They raise less capital and involve fewer investors, so A and B are wrong.
3. 与非上市公司相比,下列哪项是上市公司的典型特征?3. Compared to private corporations, which of the following is a typical characteristic of public corporations? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 政府是其股东A government is a shareholder
  • B. 股份在证券交易所上市Shares are listed on a stock exchange
  • C. 投资者间的所有权转让更困难Transfer of ownership between investors is more difficult
答案 B。上市公司的典型特征 = 股份在证券交易所上市、可自由转让、股东众多。政府持股、转让更难是非上市/特殊情形。Answer B. A public company's hallmark = its shares are listed on an exchange, freely transferable, with many holders. Government ownership or harder transfer describes private/special cases.

§4 公司的各类所有者§4 The Various Owners of a Company

LOS 对应:LOS: describe the varieties of corporate owners。

股东多种多样:散户 vs 机构(养老金、共同基金、保险、主权基金);财务投资者 vs 战略投资者;私募股权/风投;控股股东 vs 少数股东;积极投资者(activist)——通过持股施压推动变革。不同所有者的目标、时间跨度、影响力不同,会影响公司治理。Shareholders are varied: retail vs institutional (pensions, mutual funds, insurers, sovereign funds); financial vs strategic investors; private equity/venture capital; controlling vs minority shareholders; activist investors — using their stakes to press for change. Different owners have different objectives, time horizons, and influence, which affect corporate governance.

12. 积极投资者(activist)如何影响公司:How do activist investors influence a company: 官方题Official

  • A. 仅通过债权施压Only by pressing through debt claims
  • B. 通过持股施压、提案、争取董事席位等推动公司变革By using their stakes to press for change, submit proposals, and win board seats
  • C. 只被动持有、从不参与By only holding passively and never engaging
答案 B。积极投资者主动介入公司决策以提升价值。Answer B. Activists actively intervene in company decisions to raise value.

13. 下列哪组属于机构投资者:Which group are institutional investors: 官方题Official

  • A. 养老金、共同基金、保险公司、主权财富基金、对冲基金Pension funds, mutual funds, insurers, sovereign wealth funds, hedge funds
  • B. 个人散户Individual retail investors
  • C. 公司普通员工A company's rank-and-file employees
答案 A。机构投资者以专业机构形式集中管理资金。Answer A. Institutional investors pool and manage capital as professional institutions.

14. 战略投资者与财务投资者的区别是:The difference between strategic and financial investors is: 补充Extra

  • A. 战略投资者只求短期回报Strategic investors seek only short-term return
  • B. 两者目标完全相同Their goals are identical
  • C. 战略投资者追求协同/业务价值;财务投资者主要追求投资回报Strategic investors pursue synergy/business value; financial investors mainly pursue investment return
答案 C。战略投资看重业务协同,财务投资看重财务回报。Answer C. Strategic investment values business synergy; financial investment values financial return.
1. 相对公司管理层,下列哪类利益相关方最可能面临最大的信息不对称?1. Which of the following company stakeholders is most likely exposed to the greatest information asymmetry when compared to the company's management? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 银行贷款人A bank lender
  • B. 公开市场债权人A public debtholder
  • C. 董事会成员A member of the board
答案 B。公开市场债权人信息最少、信息不对称最大——只能看公开披露,无法像银行那样尽调或像董事那样在内部。故 B。Answer B. Public-market debtholders face the greatest information asymmetry — they rely on public disclosures, unlike a bank (which can do due diligence) or a director (who is inside). Hence B.
2. 关于公司,下列哪项陈述最准确?2. Which of the following statements about corporations is most accurate? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 股东与债权人的上行回报潜力都无限Upside return potential is unlimited for both equity holders and debtholders
  • B. 从投资者和发行人双方看,股权都比债务风险更大Equity is riskier than debt from the perspective of both investors and issuers
  • C. 股东与债权人的损失都以其初始投资为限Losses for both equity holders and debtholders are limited to their initial investment
答案 C。股东与债权人的损失都以初始投资为限(有限责任)。但上行不同:股东上行无限、债权人上行有限(至多收回本息),故 A、B 错。Answer C. Both shareholders and creditors can lose at most their initial investment (limited liability). But the upside differs: shareholders have unlimited upside, creditors limited (at most principal + interest), so A and B are wrong.

§5 股东至上 vs 利益相关方§5 Shareholder Primacy vs Stakeholder Theory 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: compare the shareholder and stakeholder theories of corporate governance。
理论Theory主张Claim
股东至上 shareholder theoryShareholder theory公司首要目标是最大化股东财富;管理层是股东代理人The company's primary goal is to maximize shareholder wealth; management is the shareholders' agent
利益相关方 stakeholder theoryStakeholder theory应平衡所有利益相关方(股东、员工、客户、供应商、社区等)的利益,而非只顾股东Should balance the interests of all stakeholders (shareholders, employees, customers, suppliers, community, etc.), not just shareholders
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

股东至上 vs 利益相关方

• 股东至上(shareholder primacy):公司首要目标是最大化股东财富(长期股价/价值)。
• 利益相关方理论(stakeholder):需平衡股东、员工、债权人、客户、供应商、政府、社区等多方利益。

机制

两者并非绝对对立:长期看,善待利益相关方常有助于可持续的股东价值。争议在于冲突时以谁为先。

易错对比

① 股东至上聚焦股东财富;② 利益相关方视角更广、含非股东群体;③ 「最大化当期利润」不等于「最大化股东财富(长期)」。

Shareholder primacy vs stakeholder theory

• Shareholder primacy: the firm's primary goal is maximizing shareholder wealth (long-run price/value).
• Stakeholder theory: balance the interests of shareholders, employees, creditors, customers, suppliers, government, community.

Mechanism

They aren't strictly opposed: over the long run, treating stakeholders well often supports sustainable shareholder value. The debate is whose interest comes first in a conflict.

Common traps

① Shareholder primacy focuses on shareholder wealth; ② the stakeholder view is broader, including non-owners; ③ "maximize current profit" ≠ "maximize long-run shareholder wealth."

15. 股东至上理论的核心主张是:The core claim of shareholder theory is: 官方题Official

  • A. 应优先照顾员工利益It should prioritize employees' interests
  • B. 公司首要目标是最大化股东财富The company's primary goal is to maximize shareholder wealth
  • C. 应平衡所有利益相关方It should balance all stakeholders
答案 B。股东至上以股东财富最大化为首要目标。Answer B. Shareholder primacy makes maximizing shareholder wealth the foremost goal.

16. 利益相关方理论的核心主张是:The core claim of stakeholder theory is: 官方题Official

  • A. 仅最大化股东财富Only maximize shareholder wealth
  • B. 仅服务债权人Serve only creditors
  • C. 应平衡所有利益相关方(股东、员工、客户、供应商、社区等)的利益It should balance the interests of all stakeholders (shareholders, employees, customers, suppliers, community, etc.)
答案 C。利益相关方理论强调多方利益的平衡。Answer C. Stakeholder theory emphasizes balancing multiple parties' interests.

§6 主要利益相关方群体§6 The Main Stakeholder Groups

LOS 对应:LOS: describe the various stakeholder groups。
利益相关方Stakeholder关心什么What they care about
股东 shareholdersShareholders股价、分红、公司长期价值Share price, dividends, the company's long-term value
债权人 creditorsCreditors按时还本付息、公司偿债能力(不喜过高风险)On-time repayment of principal and interest, the company's solvency (disliking excessive risk)
董事会 boardThe board代表股东监督管理层Overseeing management on behalf of shareholders
管理层 management / 员工Management / employees薪酬、职业发展、公司稳定Pay, career development, company stability
客户 / 供应商Customers / suppliers产品质量、持续合作、按时付款Product quality, ongoing cooperation, on-time payment
