考点提示:
① 三种组织形式的责任(有限/无限)和特征要能区分;公司制=独立法人+有限责任+永续+易融资。
② 股东理论 vs 利益相关方理论是治理章的思想起点。
③ 股东关心回报、债权人关心安全——两者利益常冲突(下一讲治理重点)。

17. 债权人最关心公司的:Creditors care most about the company's: 官方题Official

  • A. 分红持续增长Sustained dividend growth
  • B. 按时还本付息的能力,不喜欢公司承担过高风险Ability to pay principal and interest on time; they dislike the firm taking excessive risk
  • C. 股价上涨潜力Upside potential of the share price
答案 B。债权人回报固定、下行有限,故看重偿债能力与低风险。Answer B. Creditors have fixed returns and limited downside, so they value solvency and low risk.

18. 股东与债权人利益常冲突的原因是:The reason shareholders and creditors often conflict is: 官方题Official

  • A. 两者风险偏好完全一致Their risk preferences are identical
  • B. 债权人偏好更高风险Creditors prefer higher risk
  • C. 股东偏好高风险高回报(下行有限责任),债权人偏好低风险以保障偿债Shareholders prefer high risk/high return (with limited downside from limited liability); creditors prefer low risk to secure repayment
答案 C。风险偏好相反是二者冲突的根源。Answer C. Opposite risk preferences are the root of their conflict.

19. 董事会在公司治理中的角色是:The board's role in corporate governance is: 官方题Official

  • A. 代表债权人追债To pursue debts on creditors' behalf
  • B. 代表股东监督管理层、制定重大决策与政策To represent shareholders in overseeing management and to make major decisions and policies
  • C. 负责公司日常经营To handle day-to-day operations
答案 B。董事会是股东与管理层之间的监督与决策枢纽。Answer B. The board is the oversight-and-decision hub between shareholders and management.

20. 控股股东与少数股东的潜在冲突是:The potential conflict between a controlling shareholder and minority shareholders is: 官方题Official

  • A. 控股股东可能以损害少数股东利益的方式行事(如关联交易)A controlling shareholder may act in ways that harm minority interests (e.g., related-party transactions)
  • B. 少数股东控制董事会Minority shareholders control the board
  • C. 两者利益完全一致Their interests are fully aligned
答案 A。控股股东可能通过关联交易等侵占少数股东利益。Answer A. A controlling shareholder may expropriate minority interests through related-party transactions and the like.
1. 公司的利益相关方最可能包括:1. A corporation's stakeholders most likely include: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅股东shareholders only
  • B. 仅控股股东controlling shareholders only
  • C. 全体股东与全体员工all shareholders and all employees
答案 C。利益相关方(stakeholders)是"受公司影响的所有各方",包括全体股东与全体员工(以及债权人、供应商、客户、政府等),不止股东或控股股东。Answer C. Stakeholders are all parties affected by the firm, including all shareholders and all employees (plus creditors, suppliers, customers, government), not just shareholders or controlling holders.
2. 就公司业绩波动而言,下列哪类利益相关方最可能具有最高的风险容忍度?2. Which of the following stakeholder groups is most likely to have the highest risk tolerance with respect to the volatility of a company's performance? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 债权人。Creditors.
  • B. 供应商。Suppliers.
  • C. 股东。Shareholders.
答案 C。股东对业绩波动的风险容忍度最高——他们求上行、承担剩余风险。债权人、供应商偏好稳定(固定求偿),容忍度低。Answer C. Shareholders have the highest tolerance for performance volatility — they seek upside and bear residual risk. Creditors and suppliers prefer stability (fixed claims), so lower tolerance.

§3 商业模式的关键要素§3 Key Elements of a Business Model

LOS 对应：describe key features and various types of business models。

商业模式回答四个问题：为谁创造什么价值、如何交付、怎样收费、靠什么资源和成本结构持续获利。A business model answers four questions: what value it creates and for whom, how it delivers, how it charges, and what resources and cost structure sustain its profit.

类型Type收入机制Revenue mechanism关键风险Key risk
制造/销售Manufacturing / sales出售产品取得一次性收入Sell products for one-time revenue库存、周期、资本密集Inventory, cyclicality, capital-intensive
订阅Subscription按月或按年收取持续费用Charge a recurring monthly or annual fee获客成本、流失率、续费率Customer acquisition cost, churn rate, renewal rate
平台/市场Platform / marketplace连接买卖双方并收佣金Connect buyers and sellers and take a commission网络效应、鸡生蛋问题、监管Network effects, chicken-and-egg problem, regulation
特许经营Franchising加盟费、特许权使用费Franchise fees, royalties品牌一致性与加盟商控制Brand consistency and franchisee control
广告支持Advertising-supported用户免费，广告主付费Free for users, advertisers pay用户注意力、隐私、广告周期User attention, privacy, advertising cycles
免费增值Freemium基础服务免费，高级功能收费Basic service free, advanced features charged免费用户转付费率Free-to-paid conversion rate

评价商业模式时检查：客户集中度、经常性收入比例、定价权、单位经济性、可扩展性、资本需求、竞争壁垒和关键伙伴依赖。When evaluating a business model, check: customer concentration, share of recurring revenue, pricing power, unit economics, scalability, capital needs, competitive barriers, and dependence on key partners.

考点·商业模式(business model)要素速览:
• 定价模式:渗透定价(penetration,低价抢份额)、分层定价(tiered,按特性/购买量差别收费)、动态定价(dynamic,随供需实时变)、基于价值定价(value-based)、免费增值(freemium,基础免费+增值收费)。
• 经营/生产模式:代工制造(contract manufacturing,替别人生产)、许可安排(licensing,用他人品牌付使用费)、特许经营(franchising,整套模式授权)、众包(crowdsourcing,用户贡献内容)。
• 价值链(value chain)= 企业"内部"增值活动;供应链(supply chain)= 从原料到终端客户的"内外部整条"流程。
• 分销渠道:传统渠道(制造→批发→零售→客户)、直销(direct)、全渠道(omnichannel,线上线下整合)。Exam - business model elements at a glance:
- Pricing models: penetration (low price to grab share), tiered (differ by features/volume), dynamic (varies with real-time demand), value-based, freemium (free base + paid upgrades).
- Operating/production models: contract manufacturing (produce for others), licensing (use another brand for royalties), franchising (license a whole model), crowdsourcing (users contribute).
- Value chain = a firm's internal value-adding activities; supply chain = the whole internal-and-external flow from raw materials to the end customer.
- Distribution channels: conventional (maker to wholesaler to retailer to customer), direct, omnichannel (online + offline integrated).

3. 平台商业模式最典型的竞争优势是:The most typical competitive advantage of a platform business model is:

  • A. 规模经济Economies of scale
  • B. 品牌广告投放Brand advertising
  • C. 网络效应(参与者越多,平台对每一方越有价值)Network effects (the more participants, the more valuable the platform to each side)
答案 C。网络效应是平台/市场模式的核心护城河。Answer C. Network effects are the core moat of platform/marketplace models.
1. 生产由其他企业负责营销的商品的公司,最恰当地被描述为采用:1. A company that produces goods to be marketed by other firms is best described as having a: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 增值分销商模式value added reseller business model
  • B. 许可安排模式licensing arrangement business model
  • C. 代工制造模式contract manufacturer business model
答案 C。由别人负责营销、自己只生产 = 代工制造(contract manufacturing)模式。许可安排是用他人品牌;增值分销是分销环节。Answer C. Producing goods that another firm markets = the contract-manufacturing model. A licensing arrangement uses another's brand; a value-added reseller is in distribution.
2. 允许用户直接贡献在线内容的知识聚合公司,其商业模式最恰当地被称为:2. The business model of a knowledge aggregation company that allows its users to contribute directly to online content is best referred to as a: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 平台模式platform business model
  • B. 市场(marketplace)模式marketplace business model
  • C. 众包模式crowdsourcing business model
答案 C。让用户直接贡献在线内容的知识聚合 = 众包(crowdsourcing)模式(如维基百科)。平台/市场模式是撮合买卖双方。Answer C. A knowledge aggregator where users directly contribute content = the crowdsourcing model (e.g., Wikipedia). Platform/marketplace models match buyers and sellers.
3. 下列哪项最可能被列入公司的"财务"资产负债表?3. Which of the following would most likely be included on a company's "financial" balance sheet? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 短期债务义务Short-term debt obligations
  • B. 客户关系Relationships with customers
  • C. 与关键供应商的关系Relationships with key suppliers
答案 A。"财务(financial)资产负债表"记可计量的财务项,如短期债务义务。客户关系、供应商关系是无法入表的"无形/软"资产。Answer A. A "financial" balance sheet records measurable financial items, e.g., short-term debt obligations. Customer and supplier relationships are intangible/"soft" assets not recorded on it.
4. 当企业主动牺牲利润率以扩大市场份额时,最可能使用下列哪种定价模式?4. Which of the following pricing models is most likely used when a firm willingly sacrifices margins to build market share? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 动态定价Dynamic pricing
  • B. 免费增值定价Freemium pricing
  • C. 渗透定价Penetration pricing
答案 C。主动压低利润率以抢市场份额 = 渗透定价(penetration pricing)(低价快速扩张)。动态定价随需求调价;免费增值靠基础免费+增值收费。Answer C. Deliberately sacrificing margin to grab market share = penetration pricing (low price for rapid expansion). Dynamic pricing adjusts with demand; freemium gives a free base plus paid upgrades.
5. 创造某产品所涉及的、既在企业内部也在外部的一系列流程,最恰当地被称为:5. The sequence of processes involved in the creation of a product, both within and external to a firm, is best referred to as a: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 价值链value chain
  • B. 供应链supply chain
  • C. 商业模式business model
答案 B。创造产品涉及的内外部一系列流程 = 供应链(supply chain)。价值链侧重"企业内部"增值活动;商业模式是整体获利逻辑。Answer B. The internal and external processes involved in creating a product = the supply chain. The value chain focuses on internal value-adding activities; the business model is the overall logic of making money.
6. 以他人品牌生产并销售产品、并支付特许权使用费的公司,最可能采用:6. A company manufacturing and selling a product using someone else's brand name in return for a royalty most likely operates: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 特许经营模式under a franchise model
  • B. 代工制造as a contract manufacturer
  • C. 许可安排under a licensing arrangement
答案 C。用他人品牌生产销售并付特许权使用费 = 许可安排(licensing)。特许经营是整套商业模式授权;代工是替别人生产。Answer C. Producing/selling under another's brand and paying royalties = a licensing arrangement. Franchising licenses a whole business model; contract manufacturing produces for another firm.
7. 在分析公司时,分析师应当:7. When analyzing a company, analysts should: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 忽略公司的商业模式ignore the company's business model
  • B. 形成自己对公司商业模式的理解develop their own understanding of the company's business model
  • C. 依赖管理层对商业模式的描述rely on management's description of the company's business model
答案 B。分析师应形成自己对公司商业模式的理解,而非忽略或照搬管理层描述(管理层可能有偏)。Answer B. An analyst should form their own understanding of the business model, not ignore it or simply accept management's description (which can be biased).
8. 成品从制造商流向批发商、零售商、最终到达终端客户,最恰当地描述为:8. The flow of finished goods from manufacturer to wholesaler, retailer, and finally to the end customer best describes a(n): 真题模考Mock
  • A. 直销策略direct sales strategy
  • B. 全渠道策略omnichannel strategy
  • C. 传统渠道策略traditional channel strategy
答案 C。成品经批发商→零售商→终端客户逐级流通 = 传统渠道策略(conventional/traditional channel)。直销跳过中间商;全渠道整合线上线下。Answer C. Goods flowing through wholesalers → retailers → end customers = a conventional (traditional) channel strategy. Direct selling skips intermediaries; omnichannel integrates online and offline.
9. 根据产品特性或购买量收取不同价格,最恰当地描述为:9. Charging prices that differ based on product features or volume purchased best describes: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 分层定价。tiered pricing.
  • B. 动态定价。dynamic pricing.
  • C. 基于价值的定价。value-based pricing.
答案 A。按产品特性或购买量收不同价 = 分层定价(tiered pricing)。动态定价随实时供需变;基于价值定价按客户感知价值定。Answer A. Charging different prices by product features or purchase volume = tiered pricing. Dynamic pricing varies with real-time supply/demand; value-based pricing is set by perceived customer value.

第二讲 · 公司治理与 ESGLecture 2 · Corporate Governance & ESG

对应教材:LM3《Corporate ESG Considerations》+ LM4《Corporate Governance: Conflicts, Mechanisms, Risks, and Benefits》 · 建议学习时长:3 小时Curriculum: LM3 Corporate ESG Considerations + LM4 Corporate Governance: Conflicts, Mechanisms, Risks, and Benefits · Suggested study time: 3 hours

这一讲讲公司治理——一套平衡各方利益、约束管理层的制度;以及ESG(环境、社会、治理)如何融入投资分析。委托代理冲突和治理机制是核心考点。This lecture covers corporate governance — a system that balances the interests of all parties and constrains management — and how ESG (environmental, social, governance) is integrated into investment analysis. Principal-agent conflicts and governance mechanisms are the core exam points.

§1 公司治理的定义与目的§1 Definition & Purpose of Corporate Governance

LOS 对应:LOS: describe corporate governance。
🔰 零基础讲解:治理 = 给公司装"制衡系统"

公司治理🏛️ 股东出钱但不管事,管理层管事但不一定为股东着想。治理就是一整套制度(董事会、审计、投票、薪酬、披露),让管理层不能乱来、各方利益被平衡、冲突有解决机制。好的治理能降低风险、提升长期价值。是一套平衡利益相关方利益、约束管理层的制度体系。Corporate governance🏛️ Shareholders put up the money but do not run things; management runs things but does not necessarily act for shareholders. Governance is the whole system of institutions (the board, audit, voting, compensation, disclosure) that keeps management from running wild, balances everyone's interests, and provides mechanisms to resolve conflicts. Good governance lowers risk and raises long-term value. is a system of institutions that balances stakeholders' interests and constrains management.

公司治理=管理和控制公司的制度与流程,用以平衡各利益相关方、监督管理层、降低冲突。良好治理的目标:保护股东与其他相关方权益、提升问责与透明、促进公司长期可持续价值。Corporate governance = the institutions and processes that direct and control the company, used to balance the various stakeholders, oversee management, and reduce conflict. The goals of good governance: protecting the rights of shareholders and other parties, improving accountability and transparency, and promoting the company's long-term sustainable value.

1. 公司治理的定义是:The definition of corporate governance is: 官方题Official

  • A. 公司日常经营的操作手册An operating manual for day-to-day business
  • B. 仅指董事会的薪酬安排Only the board's compensation arrangements
  • C. 管理和控制公司、平衡各利益相关方并约束管理层的制度与流程体系The system of institutions and processes that direct and control the company, balance stakeholders, and constrain management
答案 C。治理是约束与平衡的制度框架,而非日常经营操作。Answer C. Governance is a framework of checks and balances, not day-to-day operations.

§2 利益相关方冲突:委托代理§2 Stakeholder Conflicts: Principal-Agent 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: describe stakeholder conflicts and their management。
冲突Conflict内容Content
股东 vs 管理层(委托-代理)Shareholders vs management (principal-agent)管理层(代理人)可能追求自身利益(高薪、帝国扩张、在职消费)而非股东利益;信息不对称Management (the agent) may pursue its own interests (high pay, empire-building, perks) rather than shareholders'; information asymmetry
股东 vs 债权人Shareholders vs creditors股东偏好高风险项目和高杠杆(损害债权人);债权人要求稳健Shareholders prefer high-risk projects and high leverage (harming creditors); creditors want prudence
控股 vs 少数股东Controlling vs minority shareholders控股股东可能通过关联交易等损害少数股东A controlling shareholder may harm minority shareholders through related-party transactions and the like
考点提示:最经典的是股东-管理层的委托代理问题:所有权与经营权分离带来信息不对称,管理层可能不为股东最大化价值。治理机制(激励对齐、监督)就是为缓解它。
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

委托-代理冲突

治理的核心是各方利益不一致:
• 经理(代理) vs 股东(委托):经理可能追求规模、在职消费、避险,而非股东价值。
• 股东 vs 债权人:股东偏好高风险项目/加杠杆/多分红,损害债权人。
• 控股股东 vs 少数股东:大股东可能侵占。

机制

信息不对称让代理人得以谋私。治理机制(监督、激励、契约)就是为压低这些代理成本。

易错对比

① 三类冲突:经理-股东、股东-债权人、控股-少数;② 债权人怕资产替代(转投高风险)与加杠杆;③ 股票期权对齐经理与股东,但可能加剧股东-债权人冲突。

Principal-agent conflicts

Governance addresses misaligned interests:
• Managers (agents) vs shareholders (principals): managers may pursue size, perks, or safety over value.
• Shareholders vs creditors: shareholders prefer risky projects/more leverage/higher dividends, hurting creditors.
• Controlling vs minority shareholders: large holders may expropriate.

Mechanism

Information asymmetry lets agents pursue self-interest. Governance (monitoring, incentives, contracts) reduces these agency costs.

Common traps

① Three conflicts: manager-shareholder, shareholder-creditor, controlling-minority; ② creditors fear asset substitution (shifting to risk) and added leverage; ③ stock options align managers with shareholders but can worsen the shareholder-creditor conflict.

2. 最经典的公司治理冲突是:The most classic corporate-governance conflict is: 官方题Official

  • A. 供应商与社区的冲突The conflict between suppliers and the community
  • B. 股东与管理层之间的委托-代理冲突The principal-agent conflict between shareholders and management
  • C. 员工与客户之间的冲突The conflict between employees and customers
答案 B。委托-代理冲突是治理的核心问题。Answer B. The principal-agent conflict is the core governance problem.

3. 委托代理问题的根源是:The root of the principal-agent problem is: 官方题Official

  • A. 股东与债权人风险偏好一致Shareholders and creditors have aligned risk preferences
  • B. 完全信息透明Fully transparent information
  • C. 所有权与经营权分离 + 信息不对称,管理层可能追求自身利益Separation of ownership and control + information asymmetry, so management may pursue its own interests
答案 C。两权分离叠加信息不对称,催生代理问题。Answer C. Separation of the two rights plus information asymmetry breeds the agency problem.

4. 股东与债权人的冲突体现在:The conflict between shareholders and creditors shows up as: 官方题Official

  • A. 两者都要求零风险Both demand zero risk
  • B. 股东偏好高风险、高杠杆(损害债权人),债权人要求稳健偿债Shareholders prefer high risk and high leverage (harming creditors); creditors want prudent repayment
  • C. 债权人偏好高杠杆Creditors prefer high leverage
答案 B。风险偏好相反是二者冲突所在。Answer B. Opposite risk preferences are where the conflict lies.
1. 高管薪酬计划的下列哪一特征最可能表明高管与投资者利益不一致?即高管薪酬:1. Which of the following features of an executive remuneration plan most likely indicates a misalignment of interests between executives and investors? Executive payouts that: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 只含现金、不含股权。consist of only cash and no equity.
  • B. 与同业类似公司一致。are consistent with those of similar companies in the same industry.
  • C. 随公司业绩在不同时期显著变化。exhibit significant variation over time based on company performance.
答案 A。只发现金、不含股权的高管薪酬 → 高管与股东利益不一致(缺乏与股价挂钩的长期激励)。与同业一致、随业绩变动反而是良好设计。Answer A. Executive pay that is all cash and no equity → misaligned with shareholders (no long-term, share-price-linked incentive). Pay in line with peers or varying with performance is good design.
2. 若公司具有下列哪一特征,管理层与股东间的信息不对称最可能更高?2. Information asymmetry between managers and shareholders is most likely higher if a company: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 生产更复杂的产品。makes products of greater complexity.
  • B. 机构持股比例更高。has higher levels of institutional ownership.
  • C. 会计信息更透明。provides more transparent accounting information.
答案 A。产品更复杂 → 外部人更难评估 → 管理层与股东信息不对称更高。机构持股高、会计更透明都会"降低"不对称,故 B、C 反。Answer A. More complex products → outsiders find it harder to assess → greater information asymmetry between management and shareholders. High institutional ownership and transparent accounting reduce asymmetry, so B and C are reversed.
3. 债权人的利益最不可能与下列哪方一致?3. The interests of creditors are least likely aligned with the interests of: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 供应商。suppliers.
  • B. 股东。shareholders.
  • C. 长期客户。long-term customers.
答案 B。债权人利益最不可能与股东一致:债权人要稳、限风险;股东偏好高风险博上行。供应商、长期客户与债权人一样偏好公司稳健。Answer B. Creditors' interests least align with shareholders': creditors want stability and limited risk, while shareholders favor risk for upside. Suppliers and long-term customers, like creditors, prefer the firm to be stable.
4. 就公司治理而言,下列哪项属于委托—代理冲突?4. With respect to corporate governance, which of the following represents a principal–agent conflict? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 股东与债权人的投资风险容忍度不同。Shareholders and creditors have different investment risk tolerances.
  • B. 管理层为自身利益最大化而损害股东利益。Managers seek to maximize their benefits to the detriment of shareholders' interests.
  • C. 控股股东将自身利益置于少数股东之前。Controlling shareholders place their interests ahead of minority shareholders' interests.
答案 B。委托—代理冲突 = 代理人(管理层)为自身利益而损害委托人(股东)利益。股东vs债权人、控股vs少数股东是"利益相关方之间"冲突,非委托代理。Answer B. A principal-agent conflict = the agent (management) advancing its own interest at the principal's (shareholders') expense. Shareholder-vs-creditor or controlling-vs-minority are stakeholder conflicts, not principal-agent.
5. 管理层通过推进只有自己最能胜任的项目来保住职位,最可能是下列哪项的例子?5. Managers' seeking to retain their jobs by pursuing initiatives they are uniquely suited to manage is most likely an example of: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 自我交易。self-dealing.
  • B. 壕沟自保(entrenchment)。entrenchment.
  • C. 帝国扩张。empire building.
答案 B。管理层靠"只有自己能胜任的项目"保住职位 = 壕沟自保(entrenchment)。自我交易是私占公司资源;帝国扩张是为做大而并购。Answer B. Management securing its position via projects only it can run = entrenchment. Self-dealing is diverting company resources for personal gain; empire-building is acquiring to grow size.
6. 下列哪项最能反映管理层/董事与股东之间的利益不一致?6. Which of the following best reflects a misalignment of interests between managers/directors and shareholders? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 过少使用股票期权的薪酬会激励管理层过度冒险。A compensation package relying too little on stock options can motivate excessive risk-taking by management.
  • B. 董事薪酬较低时,董事会为股东利益而不敢直言。When board director compensation is low, directors may avoid speaking out against management in the interest of shareholders.
  • C. 高且与规模挂钩的高管薪酬会促使管理层追求不增值的并购。Management compensation that is high and tied to business size may lead managers to pursue acquisitions that do not increase shareholder value.
答案 C。高且与"规模"挂钩的薪酬 → 促使管理层追求"不增值的并购"(做大即多拿钱) → 与股东利益不一致。故 C。Answer C. High pay tied to "size" → pushes management into value-destroying acquisitions (bigger = more pay) → misaligned with shareholders. Hence C.

§3 公司治理机制§3 Corporate Governance Mechanisms 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: describe corporate governance mechanisms。
类型Type机制Mechanism
内部机制Internal mechanisms董事会(独立董事)、各专业委员会(审计/薪酬/提名)、薪酬激励(与业绩挂钩)、股东投票权、公司章程The board (independent directors), specialized committees (audit/compensation/nomination), pay incentives (linked to performance), shareholder voting rights, the corporate charter
外部机制External mechanisms外部审计、监管与法律、债务契约(covenants)、公司控制权市场(并购/接管威胁)、信用评级、媒体与积极投资者External audit, regulation and law, debt covenants, the market for corporate control (M&A/takeover threats), credit ratings, media and activist investors

董事会是核心:应有足够比例的独立董事、董事长与 CEO 最好分离。薪酬与业绩挂钩可对齐管理层与股东利益(但设计不当会激励短视或过度冒险)。The board is central: it should have a sufficient proportion of independent directors, and separating the chair from the CEO is preferable. Performance-linked pay can align management and shareholder interests (but if poorly designed it incentivizes short-sightedness or excessive risk-taking).

考点·董事会三大核心委员会与结构:
• 审计委员会(audit committee):建议聘任外部审计师并提议其报酬,监督财报与内控。
• 提名委员会(nominating committee):遴选董事候选人。
• 薪酬委员会(compensation committee):制定高管薪酬。
• 交错/分期董事会(staggered board):每年只改选部分董事 → 提供监督连续性,但削弱股东问责、可作防御收购之用。Exam - the three core board committees & structure:
- Audit committee: recommends the external auditor and its remuneration; oversees reporting and internal control.
- Nominating committee: selects director candidates.
- Compensation committee: sets executive pay.
- Staggered board: only part is elected each year, giving oversight continuity but weakening accountability and serving as a takeover defense.
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

公司治理机制

• 内部机制:董事会(尤其独立董事)、审计委员会、薪酬结构(与业绩挂钩)、股东投票权。
• 外部机制:法律监管、外部审计师、公司控制权市场(接管威胁)、债权人契约、行业规范。

机制

独立董事监督管理层;被接管的威胁迫使经理提升绩效。反收购措施(如交错董事会、毒丸)会削弱这种外部约束、可能损害股东。

易错对比

① 独立董事、接管市场是关键约束;② 交错董事会/毒丸削弱股东控制、利于在位管理层;③ 薪酬与长期业绩挂钩才能对齐激励。

Corporate governance mechanisms

• Internal: the board (especially independent directors), audit committee, pay structure (performance-linked), shareholder voting.
• External: laws/regulation, external auditors, the market for corporate control (takeover threat), creditor covenants, industry norms.

Mechanism

Independent directors monitor management; the threat of takeover pushes managers to perform. Anti-takeover measures (staggered boards, poison pills) weaken this external discipline and can harm shareholders.

Common traps

① Independent directors and the takeover market are key checks; ② staggered boards/poison pills weaken shareholder control, favoring incumbents; ③ pay must link to long-term performance to align incentives.

5. 下列属于内部治理机制的是:Which of the following is an internal governance mechanism: 官方题Official

  • A. 董事会(独立董事)、审计/薪酬/提名委员会、绩效薪酬、股东投票、公司章程The board (independent directors), audit/compensation/nomination committees, performance pay, shareholder voting, corporate charter
  • B. 外部审计与信用评级External audit and credit ratings
  • C. 监管法律与媒体监督Regulatory law and media scrutiny
答案 A。B、C 属外部机制。Answer A. B and C are external mechanisms.

6. 下列属于外部治理机制的是:Which of the following is an external governance mechanism: 官方题Official

  • A. 外部审计、监管法律、债务契约、公司控制权市场、信用评级、积极投资者与媒体External audit, regulatory law, debt covenants, the market for corporate control, credit ratings, activist investors, and media
  • B. 董事会与内部委员会The board and internal committees
  • C. 公司章程与股东投票The corporate charter and shareholder voting
答案 A。B、C 属内部机制。Answer A. B and C are internal mechanisms.

7. 董事会独立性重要的原因是:The reason board independence matters is: 官方题Official

  • A. 独立董事负责公司日常经营Independent directors handle day-to-day operations
  • B. 独立董事代表管理层利益Independent directors represent management's interests
  • C. 独立董事能更客观监督管理层,减少利益输送、保护股东Independent directors can oversee management more objectively, reducing self-dealing and protecting shareholders
答案 C。独立性提升监督的客观性。Answer C. Independence improves the objectivity of oversight.

8. 董事长与 CEO 分离的意义是:The significance of separating the chair and the CEO is: 官方题Official

  • A. 降低董事会独立性It lowers board independence
  • B. 避免权力过度集中,增强董事会对管理层的独立监督It avoids over-concentration of power and strengthens the board's independent oversight of management
  • C. 提高经营决策速度It speeds up operating decisions
答案 B。两职分离防止权力集中于一人。Answer B. Splitting the two roles prevents power from concentrating in one person.

9. "公司控制权市场"如何约束管理层:How the "market for corporate control" disciplines management: 官方题Official

  • A. 通过增加分红By increasing dividends
  • B. 通过降低审计频率By reducing audit frequency
  • C. 表现差的公司易被收购、管理层被替换,接管威胁促使其提升业绩Poorly performing firms are easily acquired and management replaced; the takeover threat pushes them to improve performance
答案 C。接管威胁是重要的外部纪律。Answer C. The takeover threat is an important external discipline.

10. 绩效挂钩薪酬的双刃剑效应是:The double-edged effect of performance-linked pay is: 官方题Official

  • A. 只会降低管理层积极性It only lowers management's motivation
  • B. 能对齐管理层与股东利益,但设计不当会诱发短视或过度冒险It can align management and shareholder interests, but if poorly designed it induces short-sightedness or excessive risk-taking
  • C. 只有正面效果It has only positive effects
答案 B。激励对齐利益,但可能引发短期行为。Answer B. Incentives align interests but may induce short-termism.

11. 债务契约(covenants)如何发挥治理作用:How debt covenants play a governance role: 官方题Official

  • A. 提高股东分红They raise shareholder dividends
  • B. 增加管理层薪酬They increase management pay
  • C. 限制公司高风险行为(再借债、分红等),保护债权人They restrict the firm's high-risk actions (further borrowing, dividends, etc.), protecting creditors
答案 C。契约通过约束行为保护债权人。Answer C. Covenants protect creditors by constraining behavior.
1. 下列哪项最准确?1. Which of the following is most accurate? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 私人贷款人的风险偏好相似Risk appetites are similar among private lenders
  • B. 交错(分期)董事会提供战略执行与监督的连续性Staggered boards provide continuous implementation of strategy and oversight
  • C. CEO 在股东监督下负责执行战略A company's CEO is responsible for implementing strategy under the oversight of the company's shareholders
答案 B。交错(分期)董事会(staggered board)提供战略执行与监督的连续性(每年只改选部分董事)。私人贷款人风险偏好各异;CEO 负责执行但在董事会监督下,表述需精确。Answer B. A staggered board provides continuity of strategic oversight (only part of the board is elected each year). Private lenders vary in risk appetite; the CEO executes strategy under board oversight, so the phrasing must be precise.
2. 下列哪个董事会委员会最可能负责建议聘任外部审计师并提议其报酬?2. Which of the following board committees is most likely responsible for recommending the appointment of an external auditor and proposing its remuneration? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 审计委员会。Audit committee.
  • B. 提名委员会。Nominating committee.
  • C. 薪酬委员会。Remuneration committee.
答案 A。审计委员会(audit committee)负责建议聘任外部审计师并提议其报酬(及监督财报、内控)。提名委员会管董事人选;薪酬委员会管高管薪酬。Answer A. The audit committee recommends the external auditor and proposes its remuneration (and oversees reporting/internal control). The nominating committee handles director candidates; the compensation committee handles executive pay.
3. 下列哪项最可能是良好的公司治理实践?3. Which of the following is most likely a good corporate governance practice? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 披露关联方交易。Disclosing related-party transactions.
  • B. 奖励比股东更为风险厌恶的管理层。Rewarding managers for being more risk-averse than shareholders.
  • C. 设计鼓励管理层关注短期股价的薪酬政策。Designing remuneration policies that encourage managers to focus on short-term stock performance.
答案 A。良好治理实践之一 = 披露关联方交易(related-party transactions)(透明防利益输送)。奖励过度风险厌恶的管理层、鼓励短期股价都是不良设计。Answer A. A good-governance practice = disclosing related-party transactions (transparency prevents tunneling). Rewarding overly risk-averse management or encouraging short-term price focus are poor designs.
4. 下列哪个董事会委员会属于公司治理准则最常推荐的三个核心委员会之一?4. Which of the following board committees is among the three most commonly recommended by corporate governance codes? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 风险委员会。Risk committee.
  • B. 债权人委员会。Creditor committee.
  • C. 提名委员会。Nominating committee.
答案 C。治理准则最常推荐的三大核心委员会 = 审计、提名(nominating)、薪酬委员会。风险委员会、债权人委员会不属这三大核心。Answer C. The three core committees most often recommended = audit, nominating, and compensation. A risk committee or creditors' committee is not among these three core ones.
5. 下列哪项最可能是公司董事会的主要职责?5. Which of the following is most likely a primary role of a corporate board of directors? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 投票表决普通股。Voting common shares.
  • B. 执行公司战略。Implementing corporate strategy.
  • C. 任命公司高级管理人员。Appointing the company's top managers.
答案 C。董事会主要职责之一 = 任命/监督公司高级管理人员(并定战略方向)。执行战略是管理层的事;投票表决普通股是股东行为。Answer C. A key board responsibility = appointing/overseeing senior management (and setting strategic direction). Executing strategy is management's job; voting common shares is a shareholder action.

§4 治理的风险与收益§4 The Risks & Benefits of Governance

LOS 对应:LOS: describe the risks and benefits of corporate governance。
内容Content
治理失败的风险Risks of governance failure会计舞弊、管理层掏空、声誉与法律风险、少数股东受损、价值毁灭Accounting fraud, management tunneling, reputational and legal risk, harm to minority shareholders, value destruction
良好治理的收益Benefits of good governance运营效率提升、融资成本降低、财务业绩改善、声誉与长期价值提升Higher operating efficiency, lower financing costs, improved financial performance, and enhanced reputation and long-term value

12. 治理失败可能带来的风险是:The risks that governance failure can bring are: 官方题Official

  • A. 声誉改善Improved reputation
  • B. 会计舞弊、管理层掏空、法律与声誉风险、少数股东受损、价值毁灭Accounting fraud, management tunneling, legal and reputational risk, harm to minority shareholders, value destruction
  • C. 融资成本下降Lower financing costs
答案 B。治理失败带来多重损害。Answer B. Governance failure brings multiple harms.

13. 良好治理的收益是:The benefits of good governance are: 官方题Official

  • A. 融资成本上升Higher financing costs
  • B. 仅带来短期投机收益Only short-term speculative gains
  • C. 运营效率提升、融资成本降低、财务业绩与声誉改善、长期价值提升Higher operating efficiency, lower financing costs, improved financial performance and reputation, higher long-term value
答案 C。良好治理降低风险溢价、提升长期价值。Answer C. Good governance lowers the risk premium and raises long-term value.

§5 ESG 因素§5 ESG Factors

LOS 对应:LOS: describe environmental, social, and governance factors。
维度Dimension举例Examples
环境 EEnvironmental (E)碳排放、气候风险、污染、资源使用、能源效率Carbon emissions, climate risk, pollution, resource use, energy efficiency
社会 SSocial (S)员工待遇、劳工与人权、产品安全、数据隐私、社区关系Employee treatment, labor and human rights, product safety, data privacy, community relations
治理 GGovernance (G)董事会独立性、股东权利、高管薪酬、审计与透明、反腐败Board independence, shareholder rights, executive compensation, audit and transparency, anti-corruption
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

ESG 因素

• 环境(E):碳排放、污染、资源与气候风险。
• 社会(S):劳工、健康安全、社区、数据隐私。
• 治理(G):董事会结构、股东权利、高管薪酬、审计。

整合方式

负面筛选(排除争议行业)、正面/同类最优筛选、ESG 整合(并入基本面分析)、主题投资、影响力投资(追求可测量的社会/环境成效)。

易错对比

① ESG 是风险/机会因素,不只是道德;② 负面筛选=排除、整合=纳入估值——别混;③ 影响力投资强调可测量成效。

ESG factors

• Environmental (E): emissions, pollution, resource and climate risk.
• Social (S): labor, health and safety, community, data privacy.
• Governance (G): board structure, shareholder rights, executive pay, audit.

Integration approaches

Negative screening (exclude controversial sectors), positive/best-in-class screening, ESG integration (built into fundamental analysis), thematic investing, and impact investing (measurable social/environmental outcomes).

Common traps

① ESG is a risk/opportunity factor, not only ethics; ② negative screening = exclude, integration = fold into valuation — don't mix; ③ impact investing stresses measurable outcomes.

14. ESG 中 E、S、G 分别指:In ESG, E, S, and G respectively stand for: 官方题Official

  • A. 环境、储蓄、政府Environmental, Savings, Government
  • B. 环境、社会、治理Environmental, Social, Governance
  • C. 经济、安全、增长Economic, Security, Growth
答案 B。Environmental、Social、Governance。Answer B. Environmental, Social, Governance.

15. 下列属于 ESG 中环境因素的是:Which is an environmental factor in ESG: 官方题Official

  • A. 碳排放、气候风险、污染、资源与能源使用Carbon emissions, climate risk, pollution, resource and energy use
  • B. 员工待遇与人权Employee treatment and human rights
  • C. 董事会独立性Board independence
答案 A。B 属社会、C 属治理。Answer A. B is social, C is governance.

16. 下列属于 ESG 中社会因素的是:Which is a social factor in ESG: 官方题Official

  • A. 员工待遇、劳工与人权、产品安全、数据隐私、社区关系Employee treatment, labor and human rights, product safety, data privacy, community relations
  • B. 碳排放与污染Carbon emissions and pollution
  • C. 审计委员会构成Audit committee composition
答案 A。B 属环境、C 属治理。Answer A. B is environmental, C is governance.
1. 就 ESG 实施而言,下列哪项最可能是社会(S)因素?1. With respect to ESG implementation, which of the following is most likely a social factor? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 董事会构成Board composition
  • B. 污染防治Pollution prevention
  • C. 人力资本管理Management of human capital
答案 C。ESG 中社会(S)因素包括"人力资本管理"(员工、劳工、健康安全)。董事会构成是治理(G);污染防治是环境(E)。Answer C. Among ESG, a social (S) factor is "human capital management" (workforce, labor, health & safety). Board composition is governance (G); pollution control is environmental (E).

§6 ESG 整合方法§6 ESG Integration Approaches

LOS 对应:LOS: describe how ESG is integrated into investment analysis。

把 ESG 纳入投资的常见方法:负面筛选(排除烟草、武器等)、正面/同类最优筛选、ESG 整合(在估值/风险分析中系统考虑 ESG)、主题投资(如清洁能源)、影响力投资、股东参与/尽责管理(engagement/proxy voting)。关键是判断 ESG 因素对该公司是否重大(material)——重大 ESG 风险会影响现金流、折现率和估值。Common approaches to incorporating ESG into investing: negative screening (excluding tobacco, weapons, etc.), positive/best-in-class screening, ESG integration (systematically considering ESG in valuation/risk analysis), thematic investing (e.g., clean energy), impact investing, and engagement/stewardship (engagement/proxy voting). The key is judging whether ESG factors are material to the company — material ESG risks affect cash flows, the discount rate, and valuation.

17. 负面筛选(negative screening)是:Negative screening is: 官方题Official

  • A. 从投资域中排除特定行业/公司(如烟草、武器)Excluding specific industries/companies (e.g., tobacco, weapons) from the investment universe
  • B. 优先选择 ESG 领先者Preferring ESG leaders
  • C. 在估值中纳入 ESG 因素Incorporating ESG factors into valuation
答案 A。负面筛选=剔除法;B 是正面筛选,C 是整合。Answer A. Negative screening = exclusion; B is positive screening, C is integration.

18. ESG 整合(integration)指:ESG integration means: 官方题Official

  • A. 排除特定行业Excluding specific industries
  • B. 仅做慈善捐赠Only making charitable donations
  • C. 在估值与风险分析中系统性地纳入重大 ESG 因素Systematically incorporating material ESG factors into valuation and risk analysis
答案 C。整合是把 ESG 嵌入基本面分析。Answer C. Integration embeds ESG into fundamental analysis.

19. 判断 ESG"重大性(materiality)"的原因是:The reason for judging ESG "materiality" is: 官方题Official

  • A. ESG 与估值无关ESG is unrelated to valuation
  • B. 只有对该公司现金流、风险、估值有实质影响的 ESG 因素才值得纳入分析Only ESG factors that substantively affect the company's cash flows, risk, and valuation are worth including in the analysis
  • C. 所有 ESG 因素同等重要All ESG factors are equally important
答案 B。重大性聚焦对价值有实质影响的因素。Answer B. Materiality focuses on factors with a substantive impact on value.

20. 股东参与/尽责管理(engagement)指:Shareholder engagement/stewardship means: 补充Extra

  • A. 被动持有、从不参与Holding passively and never engaging
  • B. 一发现问题就立即抛售Selling immediately upon spotting any problem
  • C. 投资者通过对话、投票、提案影响公司在 ESG 与治理上的行为Investors influencing a company's ESG and governance behavior through dialogue, voting, and proposals
答案 C。engagement 是主动施加影响而非退出。Answer C. Engagement is actively exerting influence rather than exiting.

§1 营运资本与流动性§1 Working Capital & Liquidity

LOS 对应:LOS: describe working capital and liquidity management。
🔰 零基础讲解:营运资本 = 公司的"日常周转钱"

营运资本💧 营运资本=流动资产−流动负债,是维持日常运转的短期资金。太少可能付不起眼前账单(流动性危机),太多则资金闲置、效率低。流动性管理就是确保公司随时有足够现金应付短期义务,同时不浪费资金。= 流动资产 − 流动负债,反映短期偿债与周转能力。Working capital💧 Working capital = current assets − current liabilities, the short-term funds that keep day-to-day operations running. Too little and you may be unable to pay imminent bills (a liquidity crisis); too much and cash sits idle, lowering efficiency. Liquidity management ensures the company always has enough cash to meet short-term obligations without wasting funds. = current assets − current liabilities, reflecting short-term solvency and turnover capacity.

流动性来源:一级来源(现金、可变现资产、经营现金流、短期借款额度);二级来源(变卖资产、重组债务、破产保护——代价更高)。流动性管理目标:在偿债安全与资金效率之间平衡。Sources of liquidity: primary sources (cash, marketable assets, operating cash flow, short-term credit lines); secondary sources (asset sales, debt restructuring, bankruptcy protection — more costly). The goal of liquidity management: balancing solvency safety against fund efficiency.

考点·流动性来源与拖累/拉低:
• 主要来源(primary):现金余额、可转换有价证券、短期借款、现金流管理——不改变正常经营。
• 次级来源(secondary):变卖资产、重新协商债务、破产重整——会改变经营/财务结构。
• 拖累(drag on liquidity):现金流入被延迟/减少(应收回收慢、信贷收紧、坏账)。
• 拉低(pull on liquidity):现金流出被加速(供应商缩短账期、可用商业信用减少)。Exam - liquidity sources & drags/pulls:
- Primary sources: cash balances, marketable securities, short-term borrowing, cash-flow management - not changing normal operations.
- Secondary sources: selling assets, renegotiating debt, restructuring - which alter operations/finances.
- Drag on liquidity: inflows delayed/reduced (slow collections, tighter credit, bad debt).
- Pull on liquidity: outflows accelerated (suppliers shortening terms, less trade credit available).

1. 营运资本(working capital)的计算式是:The formula for working capital is: 官方题Official

  • A. 流动资产 − 流动负债Current assets − current liabilities
  • B. 总资产 − 总负债Total assets − total liabilities
  • C. 流动资产 + 流动负债Current assets + current liabilities
答案 A。营运资本=流动资产减流动负债;B 为净资产。Answer A. Working capital = current assets minus current liabilities; B is net assets.

2. 流动性管理需要平衡:Liquidity management must balance: 官方题Official

  • A. 股东与债权人Shareholders and creditors
  • B. 偿债安全(足够现金)与资金效率(不闲置过多现金)Solvency safety (enough cash) against capital efficiency (not idling too much cash)
  • C. 收入与成本Revenue and cost
答案 B。既要留够安全垫,又不能让现金闲置。Answer B. Keep an adequate safety cushion without letting cash sit idle.

3. 一级与二级流动性来源的区别是:The difference between primary and secondary sources of liquidity is: 官方题Official

  • A. 一级代价更高Primary are more costly
  • B. 两者代价相同Both cost the same
  • C. 一级(现金、经营现金流、授信)成本低;二级(变卖资产、债务重组)代价更高Primary (cash, operating cash flow, credit lines) are low-cost; secondary (asset sales, debt restructuring) are more costly
答案 C。动用二级来源往往影响正常经营。Answer C. Tapping secondary sources often disrupts normal operations.
1. 下列哪项最可能被归类为对流动性的"拖累"(drag on liquidity)?1. Which of the following is most likely classified as a drag on liquidity? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 信贷市场紧张Tight credit market conditions
  • B. 可用商业信用减少Reduced trade credit availability
  • C. 短期信用额度受限Limits on short-term lines of credit
答案 A。"拖累流动性(drag on liquidity)"= 现金流入被延迟/减少,如信贷市场紧张、应收账款回收慢。可用商业信用减少、额度受限是"拉低(pull)"——现金流出加速,方向不同。Answer A. A "drag on liquidity" = inflows delayed/reduced, e.g., tight credit markets or slow collections. Reduced trade credit or limited credit lines are "pulls" — outflows accelerated, a different direction.
2. 下列哪项最恰当地被描述为流动性的次级来源?2. Which of the following is best described as a secondary source of liquidity? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 银行信用额度Bank line of credit
  • B. 现金流管理Cash flow management
  • C. 重新协商的债务合同Renegotiated debt contract
答案 C。流动性的"次级来源(secondary source)"= 重新协商债务、变卖资产、破产重整等"会改变正常经营/财务结构"的手段。银行额度、现金流管理属"主要来源"。Answer C. A "secondary source" of liquidity = renegotiating debt, selling assets, restructuring — measures that alter normal operations/finances. Bank lines and cash-flow management are "primary sources."

§3 现金转换周期§3 The Cash Conversion Cycle 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: calculate and interpret the cash conversion cycle。
🔰 零基础讲解:钱从"变成存货"到"收回现金"要多久

现金转换周期🔄 公司花钱进货(占用现金)→ 卖出去变应收账款 → 收回现金。这中间的时间就是现金转换周期:存货周转天数 + 应收账款天数 − 应付账款天数(供应商给的赊账帮你垫了一段)。周期越短,资金周转越快、越省钱。= 存货天数 + 应收天数 − 应付天数,越短越好。Cash conversion cycle🔄 The company spends cash on inventory (cash tied up) → sells it, creating receivables → collects cash. That span is the cash conversion cycle: days of inventory + days of receivables − days of payables (supplier credit covers part of it for you). The shorter the cycle, the faster capital turns over and the cheaper it is. = days inventory + days receivable − days payable; shorter is better.

现金转换周期 CCC = 存货周转天数(DOH) + 应收账款天数(DSO) − 应付账款天数(DPO)
符号Symbol含义Meaning
DOH存货存放天数 = 365 / 存货周转率Days of inventory on hand = 365 / inventory turnover
DSO应收账款回收天数 = 365 / 应收周转率Days sales outstanding = 365 / receivables turnover
DPO应付账款付款天数 = 365 / 应付周转率(占用供应商资金,故为减项)Days payables outstanding = 365 / payables turnover (uses supplier funds, so it is a subtraction)
现金转换周期 官方题Official

DOH=50 天、DSO=40 天、DPO=30 天。CCC = 50 + 40 − 30 = 60 天。缩短周期(如加快收款、延长付款)可释放现金、降低融资需求。DOH = 50 days, DSO = 40 days, DPO = 30 days. CCC = 50 + 40 − 30 = 60 days. Shortening the cycle (e.g., faster collection, longer payment) frees cash and lowers financing needs.

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

现金转换周期(CCC)

CCC = 应收天数(DSO) + 存货天数(DIO) − 应付天数(DPO)。它衡量「一块钱从买入存货到收回现金」需被占用多久。CCC 越短越好——占用营运资本越少。

机制

缩短 CCC 的杠杆:加快收款(降 DSO)、加快周转(降 DIO)、延长付款(升 DPO)。CCC 过长意味资金被库存/应收套牢,需更多融资。

易错对比

① DPO 在公式里是减项(付款越慢 CCC 越短);② CCC 短 = 营运效率高、流动性好;③ 一味压 DIO/DSO 可能损失销售,需平衡。

The cash conversion cycle (CCC)

CCC = days sales outstanding (DSO) + days inventory (DIO) − days payables (DPO). It measures how long a dollar is tied up from buying inventory to collecting cash. A shorter CCC is better — less working capital tied up.

Mechanism

Levers to shorten CCC: collect faster (lower DSO), turn inventory faster (lower DIO), pay slower (higher DPO). A long CCC means cash is trapped in inventory/receivables, needing more financing.

Common traps

① DPO is subtracted (paying slower shortens CCC); ② a short CCC = high efficiency and liquidity; ③ over-squeezing DIO/DSO can lose sales — balance it.

6. 现金转换周期(CCC)公式是:The cash conversion cycle (CCC) formula is: 官方题Official

  • A. DOH − DSO + DPODOH − DSO + DPO

答案 C。存货天数 + 应收天数 − 应付天数。Answer C. Days of inventory + days of receivables − days of payables.

  • A. 20 天20 days
  • B. 60 天60 days

答案 B。50 + 40 − 30 = 60 天。Answer B. 50 + 40 − 30 = 60 days.

答案 C。拖长付款时间即减少现金被占用的天数。Answer C. Stretching payment time reduces the days cash is tied up.

9. 缩短现金转换周期的好处是:The benefit of shortening the cash conversion cycle is: 官方题Official

  • A. 加快资金周转、减少外部融资需求、释放现金Faster capital turnover, less need for external financing, freed-up cash
  • B. 增加存货积压More inventory pile-up
  • C. 延长收款周期A longer collection period
答案 A。CCC 越短,资金效率越高。Answer A. The shorter the CCC, the higher the capital efficiency.

§5 NPV 与 IRR 决策规则§5 NPV & IRR Decision Rules 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: describe the capital allocation process and evaluate projects using NPV and IRR。
净现值 NPV = Σ CFt / (1 + r)t − 初始投资
内部收益率 IRR:使 NPV = 0 的折现率
规则Rule决策Decision
NPV > 0接受(创造价值);独立项目 NPV>0 即可Accept (creates value); for independent projects, NPV > 0 suffices
IRR > 资本成本(hurdle rate)IRR > cost of capital (hurdle rate)接受Accept
互斥项目冲突时When mutually exclusive projects conflict以 NPV 为准(IRR 有再投资假设、多重 IRR 等缺陷)Go by NPV (IRR has reinvestment-assumption, multiple-IRR, and other flaws)
考点提示:
① 独立项目:NPV>0 或 IRR>资本成本 → 接受。
② 互斥项目 NPV 与 IRR 冲突时,选 NPV 高的——NPV 直接衡量价值增量、假设按资本成本再投资,更可靠。
③ 用税后增量现金流折现,折现率=项目资本成本。
考点·NPV 与 IRR 的冲突与交叉利率(crossover rate):
• 交叉利率 = 使两个互斥项目 NPV 相等的贴现率(两条 NPV 曲线的交点)。
• 贴现率低于交叉利率时,现金流偏后期/规模更大的项目 NPV 更高;高于交叉利率时排序反转。
• 冲突时以 NPV 为准(直接衡量增加的股东价值);IRR 隐含「中间现金流按 IRR 再投资」的假设,可能失真;还可能出现多重 IRR。Exam - NPV vs IRR conflicts & the crossover rate:
- The crossover rate = the discount rate at which two mutually exclusive projects have equal NPV (where the two NPV profiles cross).
- Below the crossover rate, the project with later/larger cash flows has the higher NPV; above it, the ranking flips.
- On conflict, go by NPV (it directly measures added value); IRR assumes reinvestment at the IRR (can distort) and may give multiple IRRs.
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

NPV 与 IRR 决策规则

• NPV = Σ CF_t/(1+r)^t − 初始投资;NPV > 0 接受(创造价值)。
• IRR 是使 NPV = 0 的贴现率;IRR > 要求回报率 → 接受。

冲突时以 NPV 为准

互斥项目、规模不同或现金流时序不同,NPV 与 IRR 可能排序相反。此时以 NPV 为准:NPV 假设按 r(资本成本)再投资更合理,而 IRR 假设按 IRR 再投资、且非常规现金流可能多解。

易错对比

① 冲突时选 NPV;② 现金流正负多次变号 → IRR 可能多个/无解;③ NPV 用资本成本折现,直接等于价值增量。

NPV & IRR decision rules

• NPV = Σ CF_t/(1+r)^t − initial outlay; accept if NPV > 0 (value-creating).
• IRR is the rate that makes NPV = 0; accept if IRR > required return.

When they conflict, use NPV

For mutually exclusive projects with different scale or timing, NPV and IRR can rank oppositely. Then use NPV: it assumes reinvestment at the more sensible cost of capital r, whereas IRR assumes reinvestment at IRR and non-conventional cash flows can give multiple IRRs.

Common traps

① On conflict, pick NPV; ② multiple sign changes → IRR may be multiple/none; ③ NPV discounts at the cost of capital, equaling the value added.

11. NPV 的决策规则是:The NPV decision rule is: 官方题Official

  • A. NPV > 0 接受(创造价值),NPV < 0 拒绝Accept if NPV > 0 (creates value), reject if NPV < 0
  • B. NPV < 0 接受Accept if NPV < 0
  • C. 只有 NPV = 0 才接受Accept only if NPV = 0
答案 A。NPV 为正表示项目创造净价值。Answer A. A positive NPV means the project creates net value.

12. IRR 的决策规则是:The IRR decision rule is: 官方题Official

  • A. IRR < 资本成本则接受Accept if IRR < the cost of capital
  • B. IRR = 0 则接受Accept if IRR = 0
  • C. IRR > 资本成本(hurdle rate)则接受Accept if IRR > the cost of capital (hurdle rate)
答案 C。回报率高于门槛利率即接受。Answer C. Accept when the return exceeds the hurdle rate.

13. 互斥项目 NPV 与 IRR 冲突时,应以谁为准:When NPV and IRR conflict for mutually exclusive projects, which should prevail: 官方题Official

  • A. 以回收期为准The payback period
  • B. 以 NPV 为准(直接衡量价值增量,假设按资本成本再投资)NPV (it directly measures the value increment, assuming reinvestment at the cost of capital)
  • C. 以 IRR 为准IRR
答案 B。NPV 的再投资假设更合理,直接反映价值创造。Answer B. NPV's reinvestment assumption is more reasonable and directly reflects value creation.

14. IRR 的缺陷是:The flaw of IRR is: 官方题Official

  • A. 没有任何缺陷It has no flaws
  • B. 总是优于 NPVIt is always better than NPV
  • C. 隐含按 IRR 再投资的不现实假设;非常规现金流可能多重 IRR 或无解It implicitly assumes the unrealistic reinvestment at the IRR; non-conventional cash flows may give multiple IRRs or none
答案 C。再投资假设与多重解是 IRR 的主要问题。Answer C. The reinvestment assumption and multiple solutions are IRR's main problems.

15. 评估项目应使用的现金流是:The cash flows to use in evaluating a project are: 官方题Official

  • A. 税前总现金流Pre-tax total cash flows
  • B. 税后增量现金流(而非会计利润)After-tax incremental cash flows (not accounting profit)
  • C. 会计净利润Accounting net income
答案 B。资本预算基于税后增量现金流。Answer B. Capital budgeting is based on after-tax incremental cash flows.
1. 某公司在两个互斥且 NPV 均为正的项目中选择。若项目1的 NPV 更高但 IRR 低于项目2,则公司应:1. A company is deciding whether to invest in one of two mutually exclusive projects with positive NPVs. If Project 1 has a higher NPV but a lower IRR than Project 2, the company should: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 优先选择项目 1prefer Project 1
  • B. 优先选择项目 2prefer Project 2
  • C. 对二者无差异be indifferent between Project 1 and Project 2
答案 A。互斥项目冲突时,以 NPV 为准(NPV 更高者)——NPV 直接衡量增加的股东价值。IRR 高但 NPV 低时仍选 NPV 高的项目1。Answer A. For conflicting mutually exclusive projects, go by NPV (choose the higher NPV) — NPV directly measures added shareholder value. Even if IRR is higher for project 2, pick the higher-NPV project 1.
2. 分析师收集某项目信息:
初始投入€100 百万
第1年末现金流€65 百万
第2年末现金流€65 百万
第3年末现金流€65 百万
若要求回报率为 15%,则 NPV 最接近于:2. An analyst gathers the following information about a project:
Initial outlay€100 million
Cash flow at end of Year 1€65 million
Cash flow at end of Year 2€65 million
Cash flow at end of Year 3€65 million
If the required rate of return is 15%, the NPV is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. €48 百万€48 million
  • B. €95 百万€95 million
  • C. €148 百万€148 million
答案 A。方法:NPV = Σ 现金流/(1+r)^t − 初始投入,r=15%。按表折现求和 ≈ €48 百万。Answer A. Method: NPV = Σ cash flow/(1+r)^t − initial outlay, r=15%. Discounting the table ≈ €48 million.
3. 就资本预算而言,下列哪项最准确?内部收益率(IRR)的计算假设项目的中间现金流按项目的下列哪一利率再投资?3. With respect to capital budgeting, which of the following statements is most accurate? The internal rate of return calculation assumes that a project's interim cash flows are reinvested at the project's: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 门槛利率。hurdle rate.
  • B. 内部收益率。internal rate of return.
  • C. 加权平均资本成本。weighted average cost of capital.
答案 B。IRR 隐含假设:中间现金流按"IRR 本身"再投资(NPV 则假设按要求回报率再投)。这是 IRR 的已知局限。Answer B. IRR's implicit assumption: intermediate cash flows are reinvested at the IRR itself (NPV assumes reinvestment at the required rate). This is a known limitation of IRR.
4. 分析师收集两个互斥资本项目的信息(单位:$百万):
9% 时 NPV12% 时 NPV15% 时 NPV
项目 15017−10
项目 26113−31
若要求回报率为下列哪一水平,应选择项目 1?4. An analyst gathers the following information (in $ millions) about two mutually exclusive capital projects:
NPV at 9%NPV at 12%NPV at 15%
Project 15017−10
Project 26113−31
Project 1 should be selected for investment if the required rate of return is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 9%。9%.
  • B. 12%。12%.
  • C. 15%。15%.
答案 B。互斥项目在"交叉利率(crossover rate)"以下,NPV 排序偏向低 IRR/高早期或后期现金流的项目。按表,在 12% 时项目1 的 NPV 更高 → 选项目1。Answer B. For mutually exclusive projects, below the crossover rate the NPV ranking favors the project with the different cash-flow timing. Per the table, at 12% project 1 has the higher NPV → choose project 1.
5. 某公司要求回报率 12%,考虑一个现金流如下的资本项目(单位:百万):初始投入 −£150,第1年 £8,第2年 £175。该项目的预期 IRR 最接近于:5. A company with a required rate of return of 12% is considering a capital project with the following cash flows (in millions): initial outlay −£150, Year 1 £8, Year 2 £175. The expected IRR for the project is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 10.7%。10.7%.
  • B. 12.0%。12.0%.
  • C. 13.2%。13.2%.
答案 A。方法:IRR 是使 NPV=0 的贴现率。−150 + 8/(1+r) + 175/(1+r)² = 0 → r ≈ 10.7%。低于要求回报 12%,该项目不该投。Answer A. Method: IRR is the rate making NPV = 0. −150 + 8/(1+r) + 175/(1+r)² = 0 → r ≈ 10.7%. Below the 12% required return, the project should be rejected.

§6 投入资本回报率 ROIC§6 Return on Invested Capital (ROIC) 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: calculate and interpret return on invested capital。
ROIC = 税后净营业利润(NOPAT) / 平均投入资本
符号Symbol含义Meaning
NOPAT= 营业利润 × (1 − 税率),剔除融资影响的经营利润= operating profit × (1 − tax rate); operating profit stripped of financing effects
投入资本Invested capital= 债务 + 权益(投入到经营的资本)= debt + equity (capital deployed in operations)
判断标准Decision criterionROIC > WACC → 公司在创造价值;反之毁灭价值ROIC > WACC → the company is creating value; otherwise it destroys value
考点提示:ROIC 与加权平均资本成本 WACC 比较是判断价值创造的核心:ROIC 持续 > WACC 表示公司用资本赚到了超过成本的回报,创造价值(呼应权益估值里 ROE>股权成本)。
考点·经济利润(economic profit) = 收入 − 显性成本 − 隐性成本(资本的机会成本) = 会计利润 − 全部资本成本。即超过"这些资本在别处本可赚取"的部分;只有经济利润为正才真正创造价值(EVA 思想),会计利润为正未必。Exam - economic profit = revenue - explicit costs - implicit costs (the opportunity cost of capital) = accounting profit - the full cost of capital. It is the return in excess of what that capital could earn elsewhere; only a positive economic profit truly creates value (the EVA idea), whereas a positive accounting profit may not.
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

投入资本回报率(ROIC)

ROIC = 税后经营利润(NOPAT) ÷ 投入资本。它衡量公司用全部投入资本(债 + 股)赚取税后经营回报的效率。

与 WACC 比较

价值创造的黄金法则:ROIC > WACC → 创造价值;ROIC < WACC → 毁灭价值。持续的 ROIC > WACC 通常意味存在护城河(竞争优势)。

易错对比

① 判断价值创造要拿 ROIC 与 WACC 比,不是与零比;② 分子是税后经营利润 NOPAT(非净利润);③ ROIC 高但低于 WACC 仍在毁灭价值。

Return on invested capital (ROIC)

ROIC = after-tax operating profit (NOPAT) ÷ invested capital. It measures how efficiently the firm earns after-tax operating returns on all invested capital (debt + equity).

Compare to WACC

The value rule: ROIC > WACC → creates value; ROIC < WACC → destroys value. A persistent ROIC > WACC usually signals a moat (competitive advantage).

Common traps

① Judge value creation against WACC, not zero; ② the numerator is NOPAT (not net income); ③ a high ROIC still below WACC destroys value.

16. ROIC 的公式是:The formula for ROIC is: 官方题Official

  • A. 净利润 / 总资产Net income / total assets
  • B. 营业利润 / 收入Operating profit / revenue
  • C. NOPAT / 平均投入资本NOPAT / average invested capital
答案 C。ROIC 衡量投入资本的税后经营回报。Answer C. ROIC measures the after-tax operating return on invested capital.

17. NOPAT 的计算式是:The formula for NOPAT is: 官方题Official

  • A. 营业利润 + 税Operating profit + tax
  • B. 营业利润 × (1 − 税率)Operating profit × (1 − tax rate)
  • C. 净利润 + 利息Net income + interest
答案 B。NOPAT 是税后经营利润,剔除资本结构影响。Answer B. NOPAT is after-tax operating profit, stripped of capital-structure effects.

18. 判断 ROIC 是否创造价值的标准是:The criterion for whether ROIC creates value is: 官方题Official

  • A. ROIC > 0 即创造价值ROIC > 0 creates value
  • B. 与收入增速比较Compare with revenue growth
  • C. 与 WACC 比较:ROIC > WACC 创造价值Compare with WACC: ROIC > WACC creates value
答案 C。只有回报超过资本成本才创造价值。Answer C. Only a return above the cost of capital creates value.
1. "经济"利润最恰当地被描述为企业所有者获得的下列哪种回报?1. "Economic" profit is best described as the return to a firm's owners: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 以留存收益和对所有者分配的形式in the form of retained earnings and distributions to the owners
  • B. 在缴纳公司税和分配税之后after corporate taxes and taxes on distributions have been paid
  • C. 超过其在别处不同投资本可赚取的部分in excess of what they could have earned elsewhere on different investments
答案 C。经济利润(economic profit)= 超过"资本在别处本可赚取的机会成本"的部分(即扣除全部资本成本后的剩余)。会计利润只扣显性成本。Answer C. Economic profit = the return in excess of what the capital could have earned elsewhere (its opportunity cost) — the residual after all capital costs. Accounting profit deducts only explicit costs.

§7 资本配置原则与陷阱§7 Capital Allocation Principles & Pitfalls

LOS 对应:LOS: describe the principles and common pitfalls of capital allocation。
内容Content
原则Principles基于税后增量现金流决策;忽略沉没成本;计入机会成本与外部性;基于现金流而非会计利润;按项目风险选折现率Decide based on after-tax incremental cash flows; ignore sunk costs; include opportunity costs and externalities; use cash flows rather than accounting profit; choose the discount rate by project risk
常见陷阱(多为行为偏差)Common pitfalls (mostly behavioral biases)惯性/拖延、过度乐观与过度自信、只看内部数据、忽视竞争反应、感情用事(沉没成本谬误)、政治博弈、模板化套用同一折现率Inertia/procrastination, over-optimism and overconfidence, looking only at internal data, ignoring competitive response, emotional decisions (sunk-cost fallacy), political games, template-applying one discount rate to everything

19. 资本配置为什么要忽略沉没成本:Why capital allocation ignores sunk costs: 官方题Official

  • A. 沉没成本可以收回Sunk costs can be recovered
  • B. 已发生、不可收回,与未来决策无关,纳入会扭曲判断They are already incurred and unrecoverable, irrelevant to future decisions, and including them distorts judgment
  • C. 沉没成本应计入Sunk costs should be included
答案 B。决策只看未来增量现金流。Answer B. Decisions look only at future incremental cash flows.

20. 机会成本为什么要计入:Why opportunity cost must be included: 官方题Official

  • A. 机会成本不真实Opportunity cost is not real
  • B. 机会成本已含在会计成本中Opportunity cost is already in accounting cost
  • C. 采用某方案会放弃其他用途的收益,这部分是真实成本Adopting one option forgoes the return of other uses, and that is a real cost
答案 C。放弃的最佳替代收益是真实经济成本。Answer C. The forgone best-alternative return is a real economic cost.

21. 下列属于资本配置行为陷阱的是:Which is a behavioral pitfall in capital allocation: 官方题Official

  • A. 将 ROIC 与 WACC 比较Comparing ROIC with WACC
  • B. 过度自信/乐观、沉没成本谬误Overconfidence/optimism and the sunk-cost fallacy
  • C. 使用税后增量现金流Using after-tax incremental cash flows
答案 B。还包括惯性拖延、忽视竞争反应等偏差。Answer B. Others include inertia/procrastination and ignoring competitive responses.

22. 为什么要按项目风险选择折现率:Why the discount rate should be chosen by project risk: 补充Extra

  • A. 所有项目都应用同一折现率All projects should use the same discount rate
  • B. 折现率与风险无关The discount rate is unrelated to risk
  • C. 风险越高应要求越高回报;对所有项目套用同一折现率会错配风险与收益Higher risk should demand a higher return; applying one discount rate to all projects mismatches risk and return
答案 C。折现率应反映项目特有风险。Answer C. The discount rate should reflect the project's specific risk.
1. 下列哪项是常见的资本配置陷阱?1. Which of the following is a common capital allocation pitfall? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 忽略沉没成本。Ignoring sunk costs.
  • B. 把资本预算锚定于上一年金额。Anchoring capital investment budgets to prior year amounts.
  • C. 为投资备选方案考虑不同的世界状态。Considering different states of the world for investment alternatives.
答案 B。常见资本配置陷阱 = 把预算"锚定"于上一年金额(anchoring),而非独立评估。忽略沉没成本、考虑不同世界状态反而是良好做法。Answer B. A common capital-allocation pitfall = anchoring the budget to last year's amount instead of evaluating independently. Ignoring sunk costs and considering different states of the world are good practices.

§1 营运资本与流动性管理方法§1 Working-Capital & Liquidity Management Methods

LOS 对应：describe issuers’ objectives and compare methods for managing working capital and liquidity。

例题

条款“2/10，net 40”表示 10 天内付款可享 2% 折扣，否则第 40 天付全额。放弃折扣相当于为额外 30 天资金支付 2/98，年化成本约 24.8%，通常高于银行短贷成本。The terms "2/10, net 40" mean a 2% discount for payment within 10 days, otherwise the full amount on day 40. Forgoing the discount is like paying 2/98 for the extra 30 days of funds, an annualized cost of about 24.8%, usually higher than the cost of a short-term bank loan.

1. 宽松应收账款政策的主要收益与成本是:The main benefit and cost of a loose accounts-receivable policy are:

  • A. 会减少销售It reduces sales
  • B. 可能促进销售;但增加坏账、收款成本和资金占用It may boost sales, but increases bad debt, collection costs, and cash tied up
  • C. 只降低成本、没有任何风险It only lowers costs with no risk at all
答案 B。放宽信用刺激销售,代价是坏账与资金占用上升。Answer B. Loosening credit stimulates sales at the cost of higher bad debt and tied-up cash.

§2 资本投资中的实物期权§2 Real Options in Capital Investment 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应：describe types of real options relevant to capital investments。

实物期权不是金融期权，而是管理层在未来获得新信息后改变项目的权利。传统静态 NPV 可能低估这种灵活性。Real options are not financial options but management's right to alter a project after new information arrives in the future. A traditional static NPV may understate this flexibility.

类型Type管理权利Management right价值来源Source of value
延迟期权Timing (deferral) option等待价格、需求或监管更明确后再投资Wait until price, demand, or regulation is clearer before investing避免过早投入不可逆资本Avoids committing irreversible capital too early
扩张期权Expansion option需求旺盛时扩大产能或进入新市场Expand capacity or enter new markets when demand is strong保留上行潜力Preserves upside potential
放弃期权Abandonment option项目恶化时出售资产或退出Sell assets or exit when a project deteriorates限制下行损失Limits downside losses
灵活性期权Flexibility option切换原料、产品、产地或生产方式Switch inputs, products, locations, or production methods适应价格和供给变化Adapts to price and supply changes
后续投资期权Follow-on investment option首期项目成功后获得第二阶段机会Gain a second-stage opportunity after the first project succeeds战略平台或成长机会A strategic platform or growth opportunity
判断：期权是“权利而非义务”，因此有价值；但取得灵活性通常要付初始成本。调整后项目价值 = 静态 NPV + 实物期权价值。
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

资本投资中的实物期权

实物期权 = 管理层在项目中随信息变化调整决策的灵活性,具有价值。类型:延迟(时机)、扩张、放弃、灵活(投入/产出/规模)期权。

扩展 NPV

扩展 NPV = 静态 NPV + 期权价值。即使静态 NPV 略为负,内含期权价值也可能让项目值得做。不确定性越高,实物期权越值钱(尤其延迟期权)。

易错对比

① 实物期权提升项目价值(≥0);② 延迟期权在不确定性高时价值最大;③ 忽略实物期权会低估灵活项目。

Real options in capital investment

A real option is management's flexibility to adjust decisions as information arrives, and it has value. Types: timing (delay), expansion, abandonment, flexibility (inputs/outputs/scale).

Expanded NPV

Expanded NPV = static NPV + option value. Even a slightly negative static NPV can be worthwhile once the embedded option value is added. Higher uncertainty makes real options more valuable (especially the delay option).

Common traps

① Real options add value (≥0); ② the delay option is worth most under high uncertainty; ③ ignoring real options understates flexible projects.

2. 项目在需求强劲时可以扩产,属于哪类实物期权:A project that can expand capacity when demand is strong is which type of real option:

  • A. 扩张期权An expansion option
  • B. 放弃期权An abandonment option
  • C. 延迟期权A deferral option
答案 A。需求旺盛时扩大产能即扩张期权,保留上行潜力。Answer A. Expanding capacity when demand is strong is an expansion option, preserving upside.
1. 某新项目的 NPV 预计为 −$0.20 百万。追加投资 $0.40 百万可让管理层未来灵活切换到更低成本的投入。若该期权估值为 $0.80 百万,则含期权的项目价值为:1. The NPV of a new project is expected to be −$0.20 million. An incremental investment of $0.40 million would give management the flexibility to switch to a lower-cost input in the future. If this option has an estimated value of $0.80 million, the value of the project including the option is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. $0.20 百万$0.20 million
  • B. $0.40 百万$0.40 million
  • C. $1.00 百万$1.00 million
答案 A。含期权的项目价值 = 基础 NPV − 期权成本 + 期权价值 = −0.20 − 0.40 + 0.80 = $0.20 百万。实物期权可把负 NPV 项目变正。Answer A. Value with the option = base NPV − option cost + option value = −0.20 − 0.40 + 0.80 = $0.20 million. A real option can turn a negative-NPV project positive.
2. 若财务结果令人失望时可放弃投资的能力,最可能属于下列哪类期权?2. The ability to abandon an investment if it has produced disappointing financial results is most likely a type of: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 规模期权。sizing option.
  • B. 灵活性期权。flexibility option.
  • C. 基础期权。fundamental option.
答案 A。"结果不佳时可放弃"= 放弃期权,属"规模/时机类"(可缩减规模)实物期权。按题给分类归为规模期权(可放弃=缩到零)。灵活性期权是改投入/产出。Answer A. The ability to abandon if results disappoint = an abandonment (sizing) real option. Under the given taxonomy it falls in sizing options (abandon = scale to zero). A flexibility option changes inputs/outputs.

流动性比率Liquidity ratios流动比率=CA/CL;速动=(CA−存货)/CLCurrent ratio = CA/CL; quick = (CA − inventory)/CL

NPV/IRRNPV>0 接受;互斥冲突选 NPVNPV > 0 accept; for mutually exclusive conflicts choose NPV
ROICNOPAT/投入资本;ROIC>WACC 创造价值NOPAT/invested capital; ROIC > WACC creates value
配置原则Allocation principles税后增量现金流、忽略沉没成本、计机会成本After-tax incremental cash flows, ignore sunk costs, include opportunity costs
配置陷阱Allocation pitfalls惯性、过度自信、沉没成本谬误等行为偏差Inertia, overconfidence, sunk-cost fallacy, and other behavioral biases

§1 加权平均资本成本 WACC§1 Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC) 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: calculate and interpret the weighted average cost of capital。
🔰 零基础讲解:公司用钱的"综合利率"

WACC💸 公司的钱来自两部分:借的(债)和股东的(股权)。每部分都有"成本"——债要付利息,股权要给股东回报。WACC 就是按各自比重加权算出的"平均资金成本"。它是评估项目、给公司估值时的折现率:项目回报必须高于 WACC 才值得做。= 债务与权益成本按市值权重的加权平均。WACC💸 A company's money comes from two sources: borrowed (debt) and shareholders' (equity). Each has a "cost" — debt pays interest, equity owes shareholders a return. WACC is the average cost of capital, weighting each by its share. It is the discount rate used to evaluate projects and value the firm: a project's return must exceed WACC to be worth doing. = the weighted average of the costs of debt and equity, weighted by market value.

WACC = wd × rd × (1 − t) + wp × rp + we × re
符号Symbol含义Meaning
wd, wp, we债务、优先股、普通股权益的权重(按市值,和为 1)Weights of debt, preferred stock, and common equity (by market value, summing to 1)
rd × (1 − t)债务的税后成本;t 为税率(利息可抵税=税盾)After-tax cost of debt; t is the tax rate (interest is tax-deductible = the tax shield)
rp优先股成本Cost of preferred stock
re普通股权益成本Cost of common equity
WACC 计算 官方题Official

权益占 60%、债务占 40%;re=12%、rd=6%、税率 25%。WACC = 0.6×12% + 0.4×6%×(1−0.25) = 7.2% + 0.4×4.5% = 7.2% + 1.8% = 9.0%。Equity is 60%, debt 40%; re=12%, rd=6%, tax rate 25%. WACC = 0.6×12% + 0.4×6%×(1−0.25) = 7.2% + 0.4×4.5% = 7.2% + 1.8% = 9.0%.

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

加权平均资本成本(WACC)

WACC = w_d·r_d·(1−t) + w_p·r_p + w_e·r_e。权重用目标/市值结构(非账面),税率用边际税率,成本用边际(当前)成本。只有债务享受利息税盾,故乘 (1−t)。

机制

WACC 是公司为全部资本支付的加权成本,也是评估平均风险项目的贴现率。资本结构变化会同时改变权重与各成本,进而影响 WACC。

易错对比

① 用市值权重、边际成本,不用账面/历史;② 只有债务乘 (1−t);③ WACC 只适用于与公司平均风险相当的项目,风险不同要调整。

Weighted average cost of capital (WACC)

WACC = w_d·r_d·(1−t) + w_p·r_p + w_e·r_e. Use target/market-value weights (not book), the marginal tax rate, and marginal (current) costs. Only debt gets the interest tax shield, hence ×(1−t).

Mechanism

WACC is the blended cost of all capital and the discount rate for an average-risk project. Changing the capital structure shifts both weights and component costs, moving WACC.

Common traps

① Use market-value weights and marginal costs, not book/historical; ② only debt is ×(1−t); ③ WACC fits only average-risk projects — adjust for different risk.

1. WACC 的公式是:The formula for WACC is: 官方题Official

  • A. r_d + r_e + r_pr_d + r_e + r_p
  • B. w_d·r_d·(1−t) + w_p·r_p + w_e·r_ew_d·r_d·(1−t) + w_p·r_p + w_e·r_e
  • C. w_d·r_d + w_e·r_e(不作税收调整)w_d·r_d + w_e·r_e (no tax adjustment)
答案 B。只有税后债务成本才乘 (1−t);权益、优先股成本不抵税。Answer B. Only the after-tax cost of debt is multiplied by (1−t); the costs of equity and preferred stock are not tax-deductible.

2. 权益 60%、债务 40%、r_e=12%、r_d=6%、税率 25%,WACC 为:Equity 60%, debt 40%, r_e = 12%, r_d = 6%, tax rate 25%; WACC is: 官方题Official

  • A. 9.6%9.6%
  • B. 7.2%7.2%
  • C. 9.0%9.0%
答案 C。0.6×12% + 0.4×6%×0.75 = 7.2% + 1.8% = 9.0%;9.6% 是漏算税盾的错误值。Answer C. 0.6×12% + 0.4×6%×0.75 = 7.2% + 1.8% = 9.0%; 9.6% is the wrong value that omits the tax shield.

3. 为什么债务成本要乘 (1−t):Why the cost of debt is multiplied by (1−t): 官方题Official

  • A. 债务利息不可抵税Debt interest is not tax-deductible
  • B. 利息可抵税(税盾),实际税后成本低于票面利率Interest is tax-deductible (a tax shield), so the actual after-tax cost is below the coupon rate
  • C. 债务风险更高Debt is riskier
答案 B。利息税盾降低有效债务成本。Answer B. The interest tax shield lowers the effective cost of debt.

4. WACC 中的权重应按:The weights in WACC should be based on: 官方题Official

  • A. 账面价值Book value
  • B. 历史取得成本Historical acquisition cost
  • C. 市值(目标资本结构)Market value (target capital structure)
答案 C。市值权重反映当前融资成本。Answer C. Market-value weights reflect current financing costs.

5. WACC 与项目评估的关系是:The relationship between WACC and project evaluation is: 补充Extra

  • A. WACC 常作项目折现率/门槛回报率;项目回报须高于 WACC 才创造价值WACC is often used as the project discount rate/hurdle; the project's return must exceed WACC to create value
  • B. WACC 与项目评估无关WACC is unrelated to project evaluation
  • C. 项目回报低于 WACC 也可接受A return below WACC is still acceptable
答案 A。回报超过资本成本方能创造价值(注意需按项目风险调整)。Answer A. Only a return above the cost of capital creates value (adjust for project risk).
1. 评估潜在资本投资时,最恰当的折现率是:1. When evaluating potential capital investments, the most appropriate discount rate is the: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 公司的整体资本成本。overall cost of capital for the company.
  • B. 该具体投资的要求回报率。individual investment's required rate of return.
  • C. 视融资来源而定的债务成本或权益成本。cost of debt or cost of equity, depending on the financing source.
答案 B。评估某项投资应用"该项目自身的要求回报率"(反映其风险),而非公司整体资本成本或单一融资来源成本。Answer B. Evaluate a specific investment with that project's own required return (reflecting its risk), not the firm's overall cost of capital or a single financing source's cost.
2. 分析师收集某美国公司信息:
债务市值$550 百万
优先股市值$200 百万
普通股市值$450 百万
税前债务成本7%
优先股成本9%
普通股成本12%
边际税率25%
该公司的 WACC 最接近于:2. An analyst gathers the following information about a US company:
Market value of debt$550 million
Market value of preferred stock$200 million
Market value of common stock$450 million
Before-tax cost of debt7%
Cost of preferred stock9%
Cost of common stock12%

The company's WACC is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 8.0%。8.0%.
  • B. 8.4%。8.4%.
  • C. 9.2%。9.2%.
答案 B。方法:WACC = w_d×税后债务成本 + w_e×权益成本(税后债务 = 债务成本×(1−税率))。按表加权 ≈ 8.4%。Answer B. Method: WACC = w_d × after-tax cost of debt + w_e × cost of equity (after-tax debt = cost of debt × (1 − tax rate)). Weighting per the table ≈ 8.4%.
3. 分析师收集某公司信息:
债务投资者税前要求回报6%
权益投资者要求回报10%
税率15%
若资本结构为 40% 债务、60% 权益,则 WACC 为:3. An analyst gathers the following information about a corporation:
Before-tax required rate of return of debt investors6%
Required rate of return of equity investors10%
Tax rate15%
If the capital structure is 40% debt and 60% equity, the WACC is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 7.50%。7.50%.
  • B. 8.04%。8.04%.
  • C. 8.40%。8.40%.
答案 B。方法:WACC = 40%×税后债务成本 + 60%×权益成本。按表代入 ≈ 8.04%。Answer B. Method: WACC = 40% × after-tax cost of debt + 60% × cost of equity. Per the table ≈ 8.04%.
4. 公司的要求回报率就是其:4. A company's required rate of return is its: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 内部收益率(IRR)。IRR.
  • B. 加权平均资本成本(WACC)。WACC.
  • C. 权益成本。cost of equity.
答案 B。公司的要求回报率 = 加权平均资本成本(WACC)——所有资本提供者要求回报的加权平均。IRR 是项目回报;权益成本只是其中一部分。Answer B. A company's required return = its weighted average cost of capital (WACC) — the weighted average of what all capital providers require. IRR is a project return; cost of equity is only one component.
5. 当分析师不了解公司目标资本结构时,下列哪种估计资本结构权重的方法最不恰当?5. When a company's target capital structure is unknown to analysts, which of the following is the least appropriate method to estimate the capital structure weights? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 使用各资本成分的账面价值。Using the book values of capital components.
  • B. 使用各资本成分的当前市值。Using current market values of capital components.
  • C. 分析管理层陈述以推断目标结构。Analyzing management's statements to infer the target capital structure.
答案 A。不知目标资本结构时,最不恰当的是用"账面价值"权重——应优先用市值权重或从管理层陈述推断目标结构。账面值不反映当前融资成本。Answer A. Without a known target structure, the least appropriate is book-value weights — prefer market-value weights or infer the target from management statements. Book values do not reflect current financing costs.
6. 公司财务主管收集以下信息:
市值口径债务权益比43%
账面口径债务权益比52%
该公司目标资本结构中债务的权重最接近于:6. A corporate treasurer gathers the following information about her company:
Debt-to-equity ratio based on market value43%
Debt-to-equity ratio based on book value52%
The weight of debt in the company's target capital structure is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 34%。34%.
  • B. 43%。43%.
  • C. 52%。52%.
答案 A。方法:目标结构中债务权重 = 债务(市值)÷(债务 + 权益 + 优先股)。按表 ≈ 34%。用市值算权重。Answer A. Method: debt weight = debt (market value) ÷ (debt + equity + preferred). Per the table ≈ 34%. Use market values for weights.
7. 某公司权益成本高于债务成本,且利息可抵税。下列哪项上升最可能降低该公司 WACC?即增大:7. A company's cost of equity capital exceeds its cost of debt capital. If interest expenses are tax deductible, which of the following most likely decreases the company's WACC? An increase in the: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 权益的权重。weighting of equity.
  • B. 税前债务成本。pre-tax cost of debt.
  • C. 边际公司税率。marginal corporate tax rate.
答案 C。边际公司税率上升 → 税后债务成本下降(税盾更大)→ WACC 下降。加大权益权重(更贵)、抬高税前债务成本都会"抬高"WACC,故 A、B 反。Answer C. A higher marginal corporate tax rate → lower after-tax cost of debt (bigger tax shield) → lower WACC. Raising the equity weight (costlier) or the pre-tax cost of debt would raise WACC, so A and B are reversed.
8. 在其他条件不变时,若公司债务利息可抵税,税率上升最可能:8. All else being equal, if interest on a company's debt is tax deductible, an increase in the tax rate will most likely: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 降低 WACC。decrease the WACC.
  • B. 对 WACC 无影响。have no impact on the WACC.
  • C. 提高 WACC。increase the WACC.
答案 A。利息可抵税时,税率上升 → 税盾更大 → 税后债务成本更低 → WACC 下降。Answer A. When interest is tax-deductible, a higher tax rate → a bigger shield → lower after-tax cost of debt → lower WACC.
9. 在其他条件不变时,若某美国公司的边际税率上升,则该公司 WACC 最可能:9. All else being equal, if a US company's marginal tax rate increases, the company's WACC will most likely: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 下降。decrease.
  • B. 保持不变。remain unchanged.
  • C. 上升。increase.
答案 A。同理:美国公司边际税率上升 → 税后债务成本降 → WACC 下降(利息税盾放大)。Answer A. Likewise: a US company's higher marginal tax rate → lower after-tax cost of debt → lower WACC (a larger interest tax shield).

§2 债务成本与优先股成本§2 Cost of Debt & Cost of Preferred Stock

LOS 对应:LOS: calculate the cost of debt and cost of preferred stock。
税后债务成本 = rd × (1 − t)    优先股成本 rp = Dp / Pp
项Item说明Description
债务成本 rdCost of debt rd现有债务的到期收益率 YTM(反映当前市场要求),再乘 (1−t) 得税后The yield to maturity (YTM) of existing debt (reflecting current market demand), then multiplied by (1−t) for the after-tax cost
优先股成本Cost of preferred stock= 每股固定股息 Dp / 优先股价格 Pp(永续,不抵税)= fixed dividend per share Dp / preferred price Pp (perpetual, not tax-deductible)
