  • A. 用无风险利率The risk-free rate
  • B. 用现有债务的到期收益率 YTMThe yield to maturity (YTM) on existing debt
  • C. 用票面利率The coupon rate
答案 B。YTM 反映市场当前对该债务的要求回报。Answer B. YTM reflects the market's current required return on that debt.

7. 优先股成本的公式是:The formula for the cost of preferred stock is: 官方题Official

  • A. r_p = D_p × P_pr_p = D_p × P_p
  • B. r_p = P_p / D_pr_p = P_p / D_p
  • C. r_p = D_p / P_pr_p = D_p / P_p
答案 C。固定股息除以价格(永续,不抵税)。Answer C. Fixed dividend divided by price (perpetual, not tax-deductible).
1. 最可能从税盾中获益的资本来源是:1. The source of capital that most likely benefits from a tax shield is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 债务debt
  • B. 普通股权益equity
  • C. 优先股权益preferred equity
答案 A。能享"税盾(tax shield)"的资本 = 债务(利息可抵税)。普通股股利、优先股股利不可抵税,无税盾。Answer A. The capital that enjoys a tax shield = debt (interest is deductible). Common and preferred dividends are not deductible, so no shield.

§3 权益成本:三种估计法§3 Cost of Equity: Three Estimation Methods 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: calculate the cost of equity using CAPM, the dividend discount model, and the bond yield plus risk premium approach。
① CAPM:re = Rf + β × (E(Rm) − Rf)
② 股利折现:re = D1 / P0 + g
③ 债券收益率加风险溢价:re = 公司债 YTM + 股权风险溢价
方法Method要点Key point
CAPM用贝塔衡量系统性风险;最常用Uses beta to measure systematic risk; the most common
股利折现(戈登)Dividend discount (Gordon)re = 股息率 + 增长率;适合稳定分红公司re = dividend yield + growth rate; suits companies with stable dividends
债券收益率+溢价Bond yield plus premium在公司自身债务 YTM 上加 3–5% 左右的股权溢价;快速粗估Add roughly a 3–5% equity premium to the firm's own debt YTM; a quick rough estimate
CAPM 权益成本 官方题Official

Rf=3%、β=1.1、市场风险溢价 5.5%。re = 3% + 1.1×5.5% = 3% + 6.05% = 9.05%。Rf=3%, β=1.1, market risk premium 5.5%. re = 3% + 1.1×5.5% = 3% + 6.05% = 9.05%.

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

权益成本:三种估计法

• CAPM: r_e = r_f + β × (市场风险溢价)。需要贝塔。
• 股利折现(戈登): r_e = D1/P0 + g。需稳定股利与增长率。
• 债券收益率加风险溢价: r_e = r_d + 股权风险溢价。适合无公开贝塔的公司。

易错对比

① CAPM 依赖 β 与市场溢价;② DDM 法要求付息且可估 g;③ 「债券收益率 + 溢价」用于私有/无 β 公司;三法结果可能不同,取合理者。

Cost of equity: three methods

• CAPM: r_e = r_f + β × (market risk premium). Needs beta.
• Dividend discount (Gordon): r_e = D1/P0 + g. Needs stable dividends and growth.
• Bond yield plus risk premium: r_e = r_d + equity risk premium. For firms without a public beta.

Common traps

① CAPM relies on β and the market premium; ② the DDM method needs dividends and an estimable g; ③ "bond yield + premium" suits private/no-β firms; the three can differ — use the reasonable one.

8. 用 CAPM 估权益成本的公式是:The CAPM formula for the cost of equity is: 官方题Official

  • A. r_e = R_f + βr_e = R_f + β
  • B. r_e = R_f + β(E(R_m) − R_f)r_e = R_f + β(E(R_m) − R_f)
  • C. r_e = R_f × βr_e = R_f × β
答案 B。无风险利率加贝塔乘市场风险溢价。Answer B. Risk-free rate plus beta times the market risk premium.

9. R_f=3%、β=1.1、市场风险溢价 5.5%,权益成本为:R_f = 3%, β = 1.1, market risk premium 5.5%; the cost of equity is: 官方题Official

  • A. 8.50%8.50%
  • B. 6.05%6.05%
  • C. 9.05%9.05%
答案 C。3% + 1.1×5.5% = 9.05%。Answer C. 3% + 1.1×5.5% = 9.05%.

10. 股利折现法(DDM)估权益成本的公式是:The dividend discount model (DDM) formula for the cost of equity is: 官方题Official

  • A. r_e = g − D₁/P₀r_e = g − D₁/P₀
  • B. r_e = D₁/P₀ + gr_e = D₁/P₀ + g
  • C. r_e = D₁/P₀ − gr_e = D₁/P₀ − g
答案 B。股息率加增长率。Answer B. Dividend yield plus growth rate.

11. 债券收益率加风险溢价法估权益成本是:The bond-yield-plus-risk-premium method for the cost of equity is: 官方题Official

  • A. 无风险利率 + βRisk-free rate + β
  • B. YTM − 风险溢价YTM − risk premium
  • C. 公司自身债务 YTM + 股权风险溢价(约 3–5%)The company's own debt YTM + an equity risk premium (about 3–5%)
答案 C。在公司债务收益率上加一层股权风险补偿。Answer C. Add a layer of equity risk compensation on top of the company's debt yield.

§4 经营风险 vs 财务风险§4 Business Risk vs Financial Risk

LOS 对应:LOS: distinguish between business risk and financial risk。
风险Risk来源Source
经营风险 business riskBusiness risk经营层面:需求/售价/成本波动(销售风险)+ 固定经营成本(经营杠杆)。与融资方式无关At the operating level: volatility of demand/price/cost (sales risk) + fixed operating costs (operating leverage). Independent of how the firm is financed
财务风险 financial riskFinancial risk由使用债务融资带来:固定利息负担放大股东回报波动(财务杠杆)Arises from using debt financing: fixed interest burden amplifies the volatility of shareholder returns (financial leverage)
考点·三种杠杆与「发行人特有(issuer-specific)」:
• 经营杠杆(operating leverage) = 营业利润对收入变化的敏感度,由固定成本占比决定;它是发行人特有因素(取决于公司自身成本结构,而非行业或金融市场因素)。
• 财务杠杆(financial leverage) = 净利润对营业利润的敏感度,由债务/利息决定。
• 总杠杆 = 经营杠杆 × 财务杠杆。固定成本越高、杠杆越大,利润对收入波动越敏感。Exam - the three leverages & the "issuer-specific" factor:
- Operating leverage = sensitivity of operating profit to revenue, driven by the share of fixed costs; it is an issuer-specific factor (it depends on the firm's own cost structure, not the industry or markets).
- Financial leverage = sensitivity of net income to operating profit, driven by debt/interest.
- Total leverage = operating x financial. More fixed cost / more leverage means profit is more sensitive to revenue swings.

12. 经营风险的来源是:The source of business risk is: 官方题Official

  • A. 财务杠杆Financial leverage
  • B. 销售风险(需求/售价/成本波动)+ 经营杠杆(固定经营成本);与融资无关Sales risk (fluctuations in demand/price/cost) + operating leverage (fixed operating costs); unrelated to financing
  • C. 债务利息负担The interest burden of debt
答案 B。经营风险源于经营,不涉及融资结构。Answer B. Business risk arises from operations, not the financing structure.

13. 财务风险的来源是:The source of financial risk is: 官方题Official

  • A. 销售量波动Sales-volume fluctuations
  • B. 固定经营成本Fixed operating costs
  • C. 使用债务融资带来的固定利息负担(财务杠杆)The fixed interest burden from using debt financing (financial leverage)
答案 C。财务风险来自债务的固定偿付义务。Answer C. Financial risk comes from debt's fixed payment obligations.
1. 下列哪项被定义为企业营业利润对收入变化的敏感度?1. Which of the following is defined as the sensitivity of a firm's operating profit to a change in its revenues? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 总杠杆Total leverage
  • B. 财务杠杆Financial leverage
  • C. 经营杠杆Operating leverage
答案 C。营业利润对收入变化的敏感度 = 经营杠杆(operating leverage)(固定成本占比越高越大)。财务杠杆是利息带来的;总杠杆是两者之积。Answer C. The sensitivity of operating profit to a change in revenue = operating leverage (higher with more fixed costs). Financial leverage comes from interest; total leverage is their product.

§5 MM 命题:无税§5 MM Propositions: No Taxes 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: explain the Modigliani-Miller propositions regarding capital structure。
🔰 零基础讲解:切蛋糕的方式改变不了蛋糕大小

MM 命题🍰 在没有税、没有破产成本的理想世界里,公司价值取决于它的资产赚钱能力,而不是"用债还是用股"来融资——就像一块蛋糕,不管你怎么切(债 vs 股),总量不变。但现实有税:利息可抵税,适度负债能让"蛋糕"变大(税盾),于是资本结构就有意义了。:无税世界资本结构无关,有税则债务因税盾增加价值。MM propositions🍰 In an ideal world with no taxes and no bankruptcy costs, a firm's value depends on how well its assets earn money, not on whether it finances with debt or equity — like a cake, however you slice it (debt vs equity) the total is unchanged. But reality has taxes: interest is deductible, so moderate debt can make the "cake" bigger (the tax shield), and then capital structure does matter.: with no taxes capital structure is irrelevant; with taxes debt adds value via the tax shield.

MM 命题 II(无税):re = r0 + (r0 − rd) × (D / E)
命题(无税)Proposition (no tax)结论Conclusion
命题 IProposition I公司价值与资本结构无关(有杠杆=无杠杆公司价值);WACC 不变Firm value is independent of capital structure (levered value = unlevered value); WACC is unchanged
命题 IIProposition II权益成本随杠杆(D/E)线性上升——负债越多,股东要求补偿越高,恰好抵消便宜债务的好处,WACC 保持不变The cost of equity rises linearly with leverage (D/E) — more debt means shareholders demand more compensation, exactly offsetting the benefit of cheap debt, keeping WACC unchanged
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

MM 命题(无税)

在无税、无破产成本、无摩擦的完美市场:
• 命题 I:公司价值与资本结构无关——加杠杆不创造价值。
• 命题 II:权益成本随杠杆线性上升(补偿更高的财务风险),恰好抵消便宜债务的好处,使 WACC 保持不变。

直觉

「切披萨的方式不改变披萨大小」。杠杆只是把同样的经营现金流在债股间重新分配风险,不改变总价值。

易错对比

① 无税下杠杆不改变价值、只抬高 r_e;② WACC 恒定;③ 这是有税/困境成本分析的基准。

MM propositions (no taxes)

In a perfect market with no taxes, no bankruptcy costs, no frictions:
• Proposition I: firm value is independent of capital structure — leverage creates no value.
• Proposition II: the cost of equity rises linearly with leverage (compensating higher financial risk), exactly offsetting cheap debt so WACC stays constant.

Intuition

"How you slice the pizza doesn't change its size." Leverage just redistributes risk across debt and equity over the same operating cash flows, leaving total value unchanged.

Common traps

① Without taxes, leverage doesn't change value, only raises r_e; ② WACC is constant; ③ this is the baseline for the taxes/distress analysis.

14. MM 命题 I(无税)的结论是:The conclusion of MM Proposition I (no taxes) is: 官方题Official

  • A. 权益越多价值越高More equity means higher value
  • B. 公司价值与资本结构无关,WACC 不变Firm value is independent of capital structure, and WACC is unchanged
  • C. 债务越多价值越高More debt means higher value
答案 B。无税无摩擦下资本结构不影响价值。Answer B. With no taxes or frictions, capital structure does not affect value.

15. MM 命题 II(无税)说明:MM Proposition II (no taxes) states: 官方题Official

  • A. 权益成本恒定不变The cost of equity is constant
  • B. 权益成本随杠杆下降The cost of equity falls with leverage
  • C. 权益成本随 D/E 线性上升:r_e = r₀ + (r₀−r_d)(D/E)The cost of equity rises linearly with D/E: r_e = r₀ + (r₀−r_d)(D/E)
答案 C。杠杆上升抬高权益成本,抵消便宜债务的好处。Answer C. Rising leverage raises the cost of equity, offsetting the benefit of cheap debt.

16. 无税下增加杠杆为什么 WACC 不变:Why WACC is unchanged as leverage rises (no taxes): 官方题Official

  • A. 权益成本随杠杆下降The cost of equity falls with leverage
  • B. 便宜债务比重上升被权益成本上升恰好抵消The rising weight of cheap debt is exactly offset by the rising cost of equity
  • C. 债务没有成本Debt has no cost
答案 B。两种效应相互抵消,WACC 保持不变。Answer B. The two effects cancel, keeping WACC unchanged.
1. 根据无税 MM 命题 I,当企业提高资本结构中债务比例时,企业价值:1. According to the Modigliani–Miller Proposition I without taxes, when a firm increases the proportion of debt in its capital structure, the firm value: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 下降decreases
  • B. 保持不变remains unchanged
  • C. 上升increases
答案 B。无税 MM 命题 I:资本结构与企业价值无关 → 提高债务比例,企业价值"保持不变"(价值只由资产的现金流决定)。Answer B. MM Proposition I (no taxes): capital structure is irrelevant to firm value → raising the debt ratio leaves firm value unchanged (value depends only on the assets' cash flows).
2. 某公司将债务从资本结构的 20% 提高到 60%。根据无税 MM 命题,该公司的 WACC:2. A company increases its debt from 20% to 60% of its capital structure. Based on the Modigliani and Miller proposition (without taxes), the WACC of the company: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 下降decreases
  • B. 保持不变remains the same
  • C. 上升increases
答案 B。无税 MM 下 WACC 与资本结构无关 → 债务从 20% 提到 60%,WACC "保持不变"(便宜债务的好处被权益成本上升抵消)。Answer B. Under MM with no taxes, WACC is independent of capital structure → moving debt from 20% to 60% leaves WACC unchanged (cheaper debt is offset by a rising cost of equity).
3. 根据无税 MM 命题 I,在其他条件不变时,有杠杆企业的价值随下列哪项上升而增加?3. According to Modigliani–Miller Proposition I without taxes, all else being equal, the value of a levered firm increases as its: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 无杠杆价值下降。unlevered value decreases.
  • B. 债务权益比下降。debt-to-equity ratio decreases.
  • C. 预期未来现金流增加。expected future cash flows increase.
答案 C。无税 MM 命题 I 下,企业价值只随预期未来现金流增加而增加(与资本结构无关)。故 A、B(资本结构变量)无关。Answer C. Under MM Proposition I (no taxes), firm value rises only with higher expected future cash flows (independent of capital structure). So A and B (structure variables) are irrelevant.

§6 MM 有税与最优资本结构§6 MM With Taxes & the Optimal Capital Structure

LOS 对应:LOS: explain the effect of taxes and financial distress on optimal capital structure。

加入公司税:利息可抵税(税盾),举债提升公司价值——极端结论是"负债越多越好"。但现实还有财务困境成本(破产、信用受损、经营受扰)。静态权衡理论(static trade-off):最优资本结构在债务税盾收益与财务困境成本的边际权衡点——此时 WACC 最低、公司价值最高。Adding corporate taxes: interest is tax-deductible (the tax shield), so borrowing raises firm value — the extreme conclusion is "more debt is always better." But reality also has financial distress costs (bankruptcy, damaged credit, operating disruption). The static trade-off theory: the optimal capital structure sits at the marginal balance between the tax-shield benefit of debt and financial distress costs — where WACC is lowest and firm value highest.

考点提示:
① 无税 MM:结构无关、WACC 不变、命题 II 权益成本线性升。
② 有税 MM:税盾使价值随债务上升。
③ 加入困境成本后 → 存在使 WACC 最低的最优资本结构。
④ 啄食顺序理论(pecking order):因信息不对称,融资偏好顺序为内部留存 > 债务 > 外部股权。
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

MM 有税与最优资本结构

引入公司税后,利息税盾使价值随杠杆上升:V_L = V_U + t×D(税盾现值 = 税率 × 债务)。仅此推论「100% 债务最优」,不现实。

静态权衡理论

再加入财务困境成本(破产、信用受损、代理成本):V_L = V_U + 税盾现值 − 困境成本现值。二者权衡产生一个最优杠杆点——此处公司价值最大、WACC 最低。

易错对比

① 税盾使有税下杠杆提升价值;② 困境成本限制杠杆 → 存在最优结构;③ 现实中并非 100% 债务最优。

MM with taxes & the optimal structure

Adding corporate taxes, the interest tax shield raises value with leverage: V_L = V_U + t×D (PV of shield = tax rate × debt). Alone, this implies "100% debt is best," which is unrealistic.

Static trade-off theory

Add financial distress costs (bankruptcy, damaged credit, agency costs): V_L = V_U + PV(tax shield) − PV(distress costs). Their trade-off yields an optimal leverage point where firm value is highest and WACC lowest.

Common traps

① The tax shield makes leverage add value with taxes; ② distress costs cap leverage → an optimal structure exists; ③ 100% debt is not optimal in reality.

17. 加入公司税后,债务如何影响公司价值:After adding corporate taxes, how does debt affect firm value: 官方题Official

  • A. 公司价值下降Firm value falls
  • B. 公司价值不变Firm value is unchanged
  • C. 利息税盾使公司价值随债务增加而上升The interest tax shield makes firm value rise as debt increases
答案 C。有税 MM:价值 = 无杠杆价值 + 税盾现值。Answer C. MM with taxes: value = unlevered value + present value of the tax shield.

18. 只考虑税盾时,MM 有税模型的极端结论是:Considering only the tax shield, the extreme conclusion of MM with taxes is: 官方题Official

  • A. 恰好 50% 债务最优Exactly 50% debt is optimal
  • B. 负债越多越好(趋向 100% 债务),但不现实The more debt the better (toward 100% debt), but unrealistic
  • C. 零债务最优Zero debt is optimal
答案 B。忽略困境成本会得出极端全债务结论。Answer B. Ignoring distress costs yields the extreme all-debt conclusion.

19. 静态权衡理论的最优资本结构位于:Under the static trade-off theory, the optimal capital structure lies at: 官方题Official

  • A. 100% 债务处100% debt
  • B. 零债务处Zero debt
  • C. 债务税盾收益与财务困境成本的边际权衡点,此时 WACC 最低、公司价值最高The marginal trade-off point between the debt tax-shield benefit and financial-distress costs, where WACC is lowest and firm value highest
答案 C。在税盾边际收益等于困境边际成本处达到最优。Answer C. The optimum is where the marginal tax-shield benefit equals the marginal distress cost.

20. 财务困境成本包括:Financial distress costs include: 官方题Official

  • A. 股息支付Dividend payments
  • B. 破产直接成本 + 信用受损、客户/供应商流失、经营受扰等间接成本Direct bankruptcy costs + indirect costs such as damaged credit, lost customers/suppliers, and disrupted operations
  • C. 利息税盾The interest tax shield
答案 B。困境成本含直接(法律等)与间接(经营)两类。Answer B. Distress costs include direct (legal, etc.) and indirect (operating) types.

21. 税率高低如何影响债务的吸引力:How the tax rate affects the attractiveness of debt: 补充Extra

  • A. 税率越高,利息税盾越有价值,债务越有吸引力The higher the tax rate, the more valuable the interest tax shield and the more attractive debt
  • B. 税率越高债务越无吸引力A higher tax rate makes debt less attractive
  • C. 税率与债务吸引力无关The tax rate is unrelated to debt attractiveness
答案 A。高税率放大税盾价值。Answer A. A high tax rate amplifies the value of the tax shield.

2. 根据有税 MM 命题 II,若企业资本结构中有债务且税率上升,则企业权益成本将:2. Based on Modigliani–Miller's Proposition II with taxes, if a firm has debt in its capital structure and the tax rate increases, the firm's cost of equity will: 真题模考Mock

3. 在静态权衡理论下,最优资本结构使下列哪项最大化?3. Under the static trade-off theory, the optimal capital structure maximizes: 真题模考Mock

§7 影响资本结构的因素§7 Factors Affecting Capital Structure

LOS 对应:LOS: describe factors affecting capital structure。

影响一家公司实际负债水平的因素:业务的经营风险与现金流稳定性(稳定→可承受更多债)、资产有形性(有形资产多→易抵押→可多借)、税率(税率高→税盾更有价值)、成长性(高成长→偏股权,保留灵活性)、行业惯例、市场时机与管理层偏好。Factors driving a company's actual debt level: the business's operating risk and cash-flow stability (stable → can bear more debt), asset tangibility (more tangible assets → easier to pledge → can borrow more), the tax rate (high rate → tax shield more valuable), growth prospects (high growth → favor equity, preserving flexibility), industry norms, market timing, and management preferences.

考点·资本结构理论与生命周期:
• 静态权衡理论(static trade-off):在债务税盾收益与财务困境成本间权衡,最优结构使企业价值最大。
• 啄食顺序理论(pecking order):融资偏好 内部资金 > 债务 > 新发股权(发股信号最差、成本最高)。
• 自由现金流假说(FCF hypothesis):增加债务迫使管理层用现金还债、减少浪费 → 降低权益的代理成本。
• 生命周期:债务占总资本比例在成熟期(mature)最高(现金流稳);初创/成长期现金流不稳、举债较少。Exam - capital-structure theories & the life cycle:
- Static trade-off: balances the debt tax shield against financial-distress costs; the optimal structure maximizes firm value.
- Pecking order: financing preference is internal funds > debt > new equity (equity sends the worst signal and costs most).
- Free-cash-flow hypothesis: more debt forces management to service debt with cash, curbing waste - lowering the agency cost of equity.
- Life cycle: the debt-to-capital ratio is highest in the mature stage (stable cash flows); start-up/growth stages have unstable cash flows and use less debt.

22. 啄食顺序理论的融资偏好顺序是:The financing preference order under pecking-order theory is: 官方题Official

  • A. 外部股权 > 债务 > 内部留存External equity > debt > internal retained earnings
  • B. 债务 > 内部留存 > 股权Debt > internal retained earnings > equity
  • C. 内部留存 > 债务 > 外部股权Internal retained earnings > debt > external equity
答案 C。源于信息不对称,优先用内部资金、最后才发新股。Answer C. Arising from information asymmetry, use internal funds first and issue new shares last.

23. 资产有形性高的公司为何能承受更多债务:Why a firm with high asset tangibility can bear more debt: 官方题Official

  • A. 资产有形性与债务无关Asset tangibility is unrelated to debt
  • B. 有形资产可作抵押、清算价值高,降低债权人风险,更易借债Tangible assets serve as collateral with high liquidation value, lowering creditor risk and making borrowing easier
  • C. 有形资产没有价值Tangible assets have no value
答案 B。可抵押资产提升举债能力。Answer B. Collateralizable assets raise borrowing capacity.

24. 高成长公司为何常偏好股权融资:Why high-growth firms often prefer equity financing: 官方题Official

  • A. 债务成本更低所以偏好股权Debt is cheaper, so they prefer equity
  • B. 高成长公司无需任何融资High-growth firms need no financing at all
  • C. 现金流不稳、资产多为无形,过高债务风险大;股权保留灵活性Cash flows are unstable and assets are largely intangible, so excessive debt is risky; equity preserves flexibility
答案 C。不稳定现金流难以支撑固定偿债。Answer C. Unstable cash flows struggle to support fixed debt service.
1. 下列哪组因素最可能提高公司在资本结构中支撑债务的能力?1. Which of the following combination of factors most likely increases a company's ability to support debt in its capital structure? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 高收入、低现金流波动、低可变现资产High revenue, low cash flow volatility, and a low level of fungible assets
  • B. 高收入、低经营杠杆、高可变现资产High revenue, low operating leverage, and a high level of fungible assets
  • C. 低现金流波动、低经营杠杆、低可变现资产Low cash flow volatility, low operating leverage, and a low level of fungible assets
答案 B。支撑更多债务的因素 = 高且稳定的收入、低经营杠杆、高可变现(易变卖)资产(还债有保障)。故 B。高经营杠杆、低可变现资产会削弱举债能力。Answer B. Factors supporting more debt = high, stable revenue, low operating leverage, and highly marketable (liquid) assets (repayment is secured). Hence B. High operating leverage or illiquid assets weaken debt capacity.
2. 在其他条件不变时,下列哪种情形下公司的债务承受能力下降?2. All else being equal, a company most likely has a reduced debt capacity when its: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 流动比率上升current ratio increases
  • B. 杠杆比率下降leverage ratio decreases
  • C. 利息保障倍数下降interest coverage ratio decreases
答案 C。利息保障倍数(interest coverage)下降 → 偿息能力变弱 → 债务承受能力下降。流动比率上升、杠杆比率下降都会"增强"举债能力,故 A、B 反。Answer C. A falling interest-coverage ratio → weaker ability to service interest → lower debt capacity. A rising current ratio or falling leverage would strengthen capacity, so A and B are reversed.
3. 根据啄食顺序理论,公司管理者最可能倾向于:3. According to the pecking order theory, company managers most likely prefer to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 把发债作为最后手段issue debt as the last resort
  • B. 优先发股以保留现金流raise equity first to preserve cash-flow
  • C. 偏好内部融资甚于新发股权rely on internal financing over new equity
答案 C。啄食顺序理论(pecking order):偏好内部融资 > 债务 > 新发股权(股权信号最差、成本最高)。故"偏好内部融资甚于发股"。Answer C. Pecking-order theory: prefer internal financing > debt > new equity (equity sends the worst signal and costs the most). Hence "internal financing over issuing equity."
4. 根据下列哪一理论,增加债务使用可降低权益的代理成本?4. An increased use of debt may result in a reduction in the agency costs of equity according to the: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 自由现金流假说。free cash flow hypothesis.
  • B. 资本结构的啄食顺序理论。pecking order theory of capital structure.
  • C. 资本结构的静态权衡理论。static trade-off theory of capital structure.
答案 A。自由现金流假说(free-cash-flow hypothesis):增加债务迫使管理层用现金还债、减少浪费 → 降低权益的代理成本。啄食顺序、权衡理论解释的是别的现象。Answer A. The free-cash-flow hypothesis: more debt forces management to use cash to service debt, curbing waste → reducing the agency cost of equity. Pecking-order and trade-off theories explain other phenomena.
5. 就资本结构而言,经营杠杆是:5. With respect to capital structure, operating leverage is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 行业因素。an industry factor.
  • B. 发行人特有因素。an issuer-specific factor.
  • C. 金融市场因素。a financial market factor.
答案 B。经营杠杆是"发行人特有(issuer-specific)"因素(取决于公司自身成本结构),不是行业或金融市场因素。Answer B. Operating leverage is an issuer-specific factor (it depends on the firm's own cost structure), not an industry or financial-market factor.
6. 目标资本结构常用权益与债务的账面价值表示,原因是:6. Target capital structure is often expressed using book values of equity and debt because: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 资本结构政策与第三方所用度量不一致。capital structure policy is not aligned to measures used by third parties.
  • B. 市值波动大且很少影响适当的借款水平。market values can fluctuate substantially and seldom impact the appropriate level of borrowing.
  • C. 对管理层而言,首要关注是投入到公司的资本,而非公司对外投资。for management, the primary concern is the amount and types of capital invested in the company, not by the company.
答案 B。目标资本结构常用账面价值表示,因为市值波动大、且短期市值波动很少改变"合适的借款水平"。故 B。Answer B. Target capital structure is often stated in book values because market values are volatile and short-term swings rarely change the appropriate borrowing level. Hence B.

处于生命周期成长阶段的公司最可能是:7. An analyst gathers the following information about three companies in the same industry but at different stages of their life cycles:
CompanyYr1 Rev ($m)Yr2 Rev ($m)Yr3 Rev ($m)Yr3 Debt/Capital

The company in the growth phase of its lifecycle is most likely: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 公司 1。Company 1.
  • B. 公司 2。Company 2.
  • C. 公司 3。Company 3.
答案 B。成长阶段公司:收入快增、盈利上升但现金流仍偏紧、开始用债。按表,公司2 的这些特征最符合成长期。初创亏损、成熟稳定高杠杆。Answer B. A growth-stage company: fast revenue growth, rising profits but still tight cash flow, beginning to use debt. Per the table, company 2 best fits growth. Start-ups are loss-making; mature firms are stable with high leverage.
8. 债务占总资本的比例最可能在公司下列哪个生命周期阶段最高?8. Debt as a proportion of total capital is most likely greatest in which of the following life-cycle stages of a company? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 初创期Start-up
  • B. 成长期Growth
  • C. 成熟期Mature
答案 C。债务占比在"成熟期(mature)"最高——现金流稳定、可支撑较高杠杆(常回购/派息)。初创、成长期现金流不稳,举债少。Answer C. The debt-to-capital ratio is highest in the mature stage — stable cash flows support higher leverage (often with buybacks/dividends). Start-up and growth stages have unstable cash flows and use less debt.

Volume 4 · 财务报表分析
CFA Program Curriculum · Level I · Financial Statement Analysis

第一讲 · 财报分析导论 & 利润表分析Lecture 1 · Introduction to Financial Statement Analysis & Income Statement Analysis

对应教材:2026 CFA Program Curriculum · Financial Statement Analysis — Learning Module 1《Introduction to Financial Statement Analysis》+ Learning Module 2《Analyzing Income Statements》 · 建议学习时长:3–4 小时 · 建议分两次学完(LM1 约 1.5 小时,LM2 约 2 小时)Curriculum: 2026 CFA Program Curriculum · Financial Statement Analysis — Learning Module 1 Introduction to Financial Statement Analysis + Learning Module 2 Analyzing Income Statements · Suggested study time: 3–4 hours · Best done in two sittings (LM1 ~1.5 hours, LM2 ~2 hours)

欢迎进入 Volume 4——财务报表分析(FSA),这是 CFA 一级权重最高的科目之一(约 11–14%),也是股票与信用分析的基本功。这一册风格与经济学差异很大:LM1 几乎全是框架与制度(分析流程、监管申报、审计意见、IFRS vs US GAAP),重在把每个术语和归类背准;LM2 则进入会计计算——收入确认五步法、费用确认(资本化 vs 费用化)、非经常性项目,以及本册第一个硬核计算点:基本每股收益与稀释每股收益(basic / diluted EPS)。注意页面顶部配色已切换为靛蓝色,表示你正处在 Volume 4;点顶部标签可随时切回 Volume 2。Welcome to Volume 4 — Financial Statement Analysis (FSA), one of the most heavily weighted Level I subjects (about 11–14%) and the foundation of equity and credit analysis. This volume differs greatly in style from Economics: LM1 is almost entirely frameworks and institutions (the analysis process, regulatory filings, audit opinions, IFRS vs US GAAP), focused on memorizing each term and classification; LM2 moves into accounting calculation — the five-step revenue-recognition model, expense recognition (capitalize vs expense), non-recurring items, and this volume's first hardcore calculation point: basic and diluted EPS. Note the page's top color has switched to indigo, indicating you are in Volume 4; click the top tab to switch back to Volume 2 anytime.

🎯 财务报表分析做题技巧 · 提分策略🎯 Financial Statement Analysis Exam Tactics
  • EPS:基本 =(净利 − 优先股利)/加权平均股;稀释用 if-converted(可转债加回税后利息、可转优先股加回股利)与库存股法;凡使EPS 升高的证券是反稀释、须剔除。EPS: basic = (net income - preferred dividends)/weighted-average shares; diluted uses if-converted (add back after-tax interest for convertible debt, preferred dividends for convertible preferred) and the treasury-stock method; any security that would raise EPS is antidilutive and excluded.
  • 现金流分类:已付利息 IFRS 可经营/筹资、US GAAP 只经营;已付股利 IFRS 可经营/筹资、US GAAP 只筹资;固定资产出售全额现金进投资活动(利得要从间接法经营中扣除)。Cash-flow classification: interest paid - IFRS operating/financing, US GAAP operating only; dividends paid - IFRS operating/financing, US GAAP financing only; the full cash from an asset sale is an investing inflow (the gain is subtracted from operating under the indirect method).
  • 存货:成本上升期 LIFO 的销货成本高、利润低、存货低(最不易减记);FIFO 反之。存货按成本与 NRV 孰低;减记转回仅 IFRS 允许(US GAAP 永不转回)。Inventory: in rising costs, LIFO has higher COGS, lower profit, lower inventory (least likely to be written down); FIFO the reverse. Inventory is at lower of cost and NRV; write-down reversal is IFRS-only (US GAAP never reverses).
  • 长期资产:减值后账面 = 可收回金额;重估模式仅 IFRS(升值进OCI、贬值先冲盈余);购入无形进投资活动、内部研究费用化(经营)。寿命不确定资产不摊销,只测减值。Long-lived assets: post-impairment value = recoverable amount; the revaluation model is IFRS-only (increase to OCI, decrease first offsets surplus); a purchased intangible is investing while internal research is expensed (operating). Indefinite-life assets are not amortized, only impairment-tested.
  • 递延税:资产账面 > 税基(或税费 > 应交税)→ 递延税负债(DTL);应税所得 > 会计利润 → 递延税资产(DTA)。暂时性差异才产生递延税;永久性差异不产生。Deferred tax: asset carrying > tax base (or book tax expense > taxes payable) gives a DTL; taxable income > accounting profit gives a DTA. Only temporary differences create deferred tax; permanent differences do not.
  • 杜邦(DuPont):ROE = 净利率 × 总资产周转率 × 财务杠杆(五步版再拆出税负担、利息负担)。用它定位 ROE 变化的来源。DuPont: ROE = net margin x total-asset turnover x financial leverage (the 5-step version further splits tax and interest burden). Use it to locate what drives a change in ROE.
  • 现金转换周期 CCC = 存货天数 + 应收天数 − 应付天数;越短越好。应收周转率↑=收款更快;应付周转率↑=更早付款、CCC 变长。Cash conversion cycle = days inventory + days receivable - days payable; shorter is better. A higher receivables turnover = faster collection; a higher payables turnover = paying sooner, lengthening CCC.
  • 质量:报告质量(是否如实)vs 盈余质量(是否可持续)。汇率/一次性带来的利润 = 报告质量高但盈余质量低;提高残值、跌价期改FIFO = 激进(抬高当期利润)的警示信号。Quality: reporting quality (faithful?) vs earnings quality (sustainable?). Profit from FX/one-offs = high reporting but low earnings quality; raising residual value or switching to FIFO in falling prices = aggressive warning signs.
  • 正常化盈利 = 剔除临时因素的中周期盈利(周期性公司估值用);股份回购减少股数 → 抬高 EPS。Normalized earnings = mid-cycle earnings excluding temporary factors (used to value cyclicals); a buyback reduces shares, raising EPS.

LM1 §1 财报分析框架:六个步骤LM1 §1 The Financial-Analysis Framework: Six Steps

LOS 对应:LOS: describe the steps in the financial statement analysis framework。

财务分析(financial analysis):在经济环境背景下解读和评价一家公司的业绩与财务状况的过程,用于做投资、信贷等决策。核心关注点:公司赚取的资本回报是否至少等于其资本成本、能否盈利地增长、能否产生足够现金履行义务并抓住机会。债权投资者关心偿息还本能力,股权投资者关心盈利能力与每股价值。Financial analysis: the process of interpreting and evaluating a company's performance and financial position in its economic context, used for investment, credit, and other decisions. Core focus: whether the company earns a return on capital at least equal to its cost of capital, can grow profitably, and can generate enough cash to meet obligations and seize opportunities. Debt investors care about the ability to pay interest and repay principal; equity investors care about profitability and per-share value.

步骤Step信息来源Information source产出Output
① 明确分析的目的与背景① Define the purpose and context of the analysis分析师职能(股权/债权/评级)、与客户或主管沟通、机构指引The analyst's function (equity/credit/rating), communication with the client or supervisor, institutional guidelines目的陈述、待回答的具体问题清单、报告的性质与内容、时间表与预算A statement of purpose, a list of specific questions to answer, the nature and content of the report, timeline and budget
② 收集数据② Collect data财务报表、问卷、行业/经济数据、与管理层供应商客户竞争者交流、实地走访Financial statements, questionnaires, industry/economic data, discussions with management/suppliers/customers/competitors, site visits可用形式(如电子表格)的财务与定量数据、完成的问卷Financial and quantitative data in usable form (e.g., spreadsheets), completed questionnaires
③ 处理数据③ Process data上一步的数据Data from the previous step调整后的财报、共同比报表、比率与图表Adjusted statements, common-size statements, ratios and charts
④ 分析/解读数据④ Analyze/interpret data输入数据 + 处理后数据Input data + processed data分析结果、预测、估值Analytical results, forecasts, valuation
⑤ 得出并沟通结论与建议⑤ Develop and communicate conclusions and recommendations分析结果、以往报告、机构对已发布报告的指引Analytical results, prior reports, institutional guidance on issued reports回答第①步问题的分析报告、投资/信贷建议An analytical report answering the Step ① questions, an investment/credit recommendation
⑥ 跟进(follow-up)⑥ Follow-up定期重复前述步骤收集的信息Information gathered by periodically repeating the above steps实际与预期的比较、修订预测、更新报告与建议Comparison of actual vs expected, revised forecasts, updated reports and recommendations
考点提示:面对海量数据,经验不足的分析师容易一上来就算比率——教材建议先问:"如果所有比率瞬间算好,我要回答什么问题?这个答案支持什么决策?"。分析流程从明确目的开始,以跟进结束(过程不因报告结束而终止)。收集数据阶段常用自上而下(top-down):先懂宏观 → 再分析行业 → 最后判断公司。

1. 财报分析框架的第一步和最后一步分别是:The first and last steps of the financial-analysis framework are, respectively:

  • A. 第一步:跟进;最后一步:明确目的First: follow-up; last: define the purpose
  • B. 第一步:明确分析目的与背景;最后一步:跟进(follow-up)First: define the purpose and context of the analysis; last: follow-up
  • C. 第一步:收集数据;最后一步:得出结论First: gather data; last: draw conclusions
答案 B。跟进指定期重复前述步骤,判断是否修订持仓或建议。Answer B. Follow-up means periodically repeating the earlier steps to judge whether to revise holdings or recommendations.

2. "自上而下(top-down)"方法的顺序是:The order of the top-down approach is:

  • A. 公司 → 行业 → 宏观经济Company → industry → macroeconomy
  • B. 行业 → 公司 → 宏观经济Industry → company → macroeconomy
  • C. 宏观经济 → 行业 → 公司Macroeconomy → industry → company
答案 C。自上而下先看宏观、再看行业、最后看公司。Answer C. Top-down looks at the macro first, then the industry, and finally the company.
1. 共同比（common-size）报表最可能是财务报表分析框架中哪一阶段的产出？1. Common-size statements are most likely the output of which of the following phases of the financial statement analysis framework? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 处理数据Process data
  • B. 分析/解读已处理数据Analyze/interpret the processed data
  • C. 形成并传达结论与建议Develop and communicate conclusions and recommendations
答案 A。共同比(common-size)报表是"处理数据(process data)"阶段的产出——把原始数据加工成可比形式。之后才是解读、下结论。Answer A. Common-size statements are an output of the "process data" stage — turning raw data into a comparable form. Interpretation and conclusions come afterward.

LM1 §2 财报分析的角色与范围LM1 §2 The Role & Scope of Financial Analysis

LOS 对应:LOS: describe the roles of financial statement analysis。

财报分析的角色:利用公司编制的财报结合其他信息,评价公司过去、现在与潜在的业绩和财务状况,以做投资、信贷等经济决策。典型决策场景:The role of financial statement analysis: using company-prepared statements together with other information to evaluate a company's past, present, and potential performance and financial position, for investment, credit, and other economic decisions. Typical decision settings:

  • 评价股权投资是否纳入组合;为证券估值以向他人推荐;Evaluating whether to include an equity investment in a portfolio; valuing a security to recommend to others;
  • 判断公司信用度以决定是否放贷及条款;给公司或债券评级;Judging a company's creditworthiness to decide whether to lend and on what terms; rating a company or bond;
  • 决定是否进行风险投资/私募股权投资;评价并购标的。Deciding whether to make a venture-capital/private-equity investment; evaluating an M&A target.

共同主题:分析师检视过去与现在的业绩和财务状况,以形成对未来的预期,并关注影响未来业绩的风险因素。业绩考察包括盈利能力(从提供商品服务中获利的能力)和产生正现金流的能力。公司内部管理者也做财务分析,但不完全依赖对外财报(他们有非公开信息)。新闻常把公司业绩放在分析师预期的背景下报道(如"营收未达预期但盈利超预期")。Common theme: analysts examine past and present performance and financial position to form expectations about the future, focusing on the risk factors affecting future performance. Performance review covers profitability (the ability to profit from providing goods and services) and the ability to generate positive cash flow. Internal managers also do financial analysis but do not rely solely on external statements (they have non-public information). News often reports company performance against analyst expectations (e.g., "revenue missed but earnings beat expectations").

1. 下列哪种表述最准确？财务报表分析的作用是：1. Which of the following statements is most accurate? The role of financial statement analysis is to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 对经审计报表不存在重大错误提供保证。provide assurance that the audited financial statements are free from material error.
  • B. 提供关于公司业绩、财务状况及其变动的信息。provide information about a company’s performance, financial position, and changes in financial position.
  • C. 评估公司过去、当前及潜在的业绩与财务状况，以作出投资、信贷及其他经济决策。evaluate the past, current, and potential performance and financial position of a company for making investment, credit, and other economic decisions.
答案 C。财务报表分析的作用 = 评估公司过去/当前/潜在的业绩与财务状况,以支持投资、信贷等经济决策。它不"保证"报表无错(那是审计),也不只是"提供信息"。Answer C. The role of financial statement analysis = assessing a company's past, current, and potential performance and position to support investment, credit, and other economic decisions. It does not "assure" the statements are error-free (that is auditing).

LM1 §3 受监管的信息来源LM1 §3 Regulated Information Sources 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: describe the importance of regulatory filings, financial statement notes and supplementary information, management's commentary, and audit reports。

3.1 国际证监会组织 IOSCO

IOSCO(International Organization of Securities Commissions)成立于 1983 年,虽非监管机构,但其成员监管了全球95% 以上的金融资本市场(115+ 个司法辖区)。其《证券监管目标与原则》基于三大核心目标:IOSCO (International Organization of Securities Commissions), founded in 1983, is not itself a regulator, but its members regulate over 95% of the world's financial capital markets (115+ jurisdictions). Its Objectives and Principles of Securities Regulation rest on three core objectives:

  1. 保护投资者;Protecting investors;
  2. 确保市场公平、高效、透明;Ensuring markets are fair, efficient, and transparent;
  3. 降低系统性风险。Reducing systemic risk.

"发行人原则"里两条直接关系财务报告:
① 对财务结果、风险等重大信息应充分、准确、及时披露;
② 发行人使用的会计准则应具有高质量且国际可接受。Two of the "issuer principles" bear directly on financial reporting:
① material information on financial results, risks, etc. should be disclosed fully, accurately, and timely;
② the accounting standards an issuer uses should be high-quality and internationally acceptable.

3.2 美国 SEC 与三部关键法律

美国 SEC 是 IOSCO 普通成员,成立于 1929 年股灾后的改革。三部最重要的法律:The US SEC is an ordinary IOSCO member, created in the reforms after the 1929 crash. Its three most important laws:

法律Law要点Key point
1933 年证券法Securities Act of 1933规定证券销售时投资者必须获得的财务及重大信息、禁止虚假陈述、要求所有公开发行首次注册Specifies the financial and material information investors must receive when securities are sold, prohibits misrepresentation, and requires initial registration of all public offerings
1934 年证券交易法Securities Exchange Act of 1934创立了 SEC、赋予其对证券业的全面权力、授权要求上市公司定期报告Created the SEC, gave it broad authority over the securities industry, and authorized requiring listed companies to file periodic reports
2002 年萨班斯-奥克斯利法(SOX)Sarbanes-Oxley Act of 2002 (SOX)创立 PCAOB(上市公司会计监督委员会)监督审计师;强化审计师独立性(禁止向审计客户提供某些非审计服务);要求高管认证财报公允反映公司状况;要求管理层报告内部控制有效性(并经外部审计师确认)Created the PCAOB (Public Company Accounting Oversight Board) to oversee auditors; strengthened auditor independence (barring certain non-audit services to audit clients); required executives to certify that statements fairly reflect the company; required management to report on internal control effectiveness (confirmed by the external auditor)

3.3 分析师常用的 SEC 申报表(必背归类)

表格Form用途Purpose
证券发行注册声明Securities-offering registration statement1933 法要求发行证券时提交;含所售证券信息、与其他资本证券关系、年报信息、近期经审计财报、业务风险因素(不含预测现金流/盈利,也不含承销商公允意见)Required by the 1933 Act when issuing securities; contains information on the securities sold, their relationship to other capital securities, annual-report information, recent audited statements, and business risk factors (excluding projected cash flows/earnings and any underwriter fairness opinion)
10-K / 20-F / 40-F年度报告(10-K 美国注册人、40-F 某些加拿大注册人、20-F 其他非美注册人);含经审计财报及附注、MD&A、审计师报告——法律性文件,营销色彩弱Annual report (10-K for US registrants, 40-F for certain Canadian registrants, 20-F for other non-US registrants); contains audited statements and notes, MD&A, and the auditor's report — a legal document with little marketing flavor
年报(Annual Report)Annual Report致股东,非 SEC 要求;高度精美的营销文件(CEO 致辞、图片等),与 10-K 有大量重叠Addressed to shareholders, not SEC-required; a highly polished marketing document (CEO letter, images, etc.), overlapping heavily with the 10-K
10-Q / 6-K中期报告(美国公司季度 10-Q、许多非美公司半年 6-K);含未经审计财报与中期 MD&AInterim reports (quarterly 10-Q for US companies, semiannual 6-K for many non-US companies); contains unaudited statements and interim MD&A
代理声明 / DEF-14AProxy statement / DEF-14A股东大会前提供;含需股东表决的提案、管理层与主要股东持股、董事简历、高管薪酬Provided before the shareholder meeting; contains proposals requiring a shareholder vote, management and major-shareholder holdings, director bios, and executive compensation
8-K(非美 6-K)8-K (6-K for non-US)当期报告:公告重大事件(收购处置资产、证券变动、会计师事项、治理与管理层变动、Reg FD 披露)Current report: announces material events (acquisition/disposal of assets, changes in securities, accountant matters, governance and management changes, Reg FD disclosures)
Form 3/4/5、144报告受益所有权(董事、高管、>10% 持有人);3=初始、4=变动、5=年度;144=拟出售受限证券通知。用于观察内部人买卖Reports beneficial ownership (directors, officers, >10% holders); 3 = initial, 4 = change, 5 = annual; 144 = notice of intent to sell restricted securities. Used to watch insider buying and selling

3. IOSCO 的三大核心监管目标是:IOSCO's three core regulatory objectives are:

  • A. 稳定汇率、控制通胀、促进就业Stabilize the exchange rate, control inflation, promote employment
  • B. 保护投资者;确保市场公平、高效、透明;降低系统性风险Protect investors; ensure fair, efficient, transparent markets; reduce systemic risk
  • C. 最大化交易量、提高税收、限制外资Maximize trading volume, raise taxes, restrict foreign capital
答案 B。投资者保护、市场公平透明、系统性风险防控。Answer B. Investor protection, fair/transparent markets, and systemic-risk control.

4. 1934 年证券交易法与 SOX 分别创立了什么机构:The Securities Exchange Act of 1934 and SOX respectively created which bodies:

  • A. 1934 法创立 PCAOB;SOX 创立 SECThe 1934 Act created the PCAOB; SOX created the SEC
  • B. 两者都创立 FASBBoth created the FASB
  • C. 1934 法创立 SEC;SOX 创立 PCAOB 监督审计师The 1934 Act created the SEC; SOX created the PCAOB to oversee auditors
答案 C。SOX 还强化了内控报告要求。Answer C. SOX also strengthened internal-control reporting requirements.

5. 证券发行注册声明最可能包含以下哪项:A securities registration statement most likely includes which of the following:

  • A. 承销商的公允意见The underwriter's fairness opinion
  • B. 业务风险因素评估An assessment of business risk factors
  • C. 预测现金流与盈利Projected cash flows and earnings
答案 B。注册声明含风险因素、近期经审计财报;通常不含预测或承销商公允意见。Answer B. A registration statement includes risk factors and recent audited financials; it usually excludes projections or an underwriter's fairness opinion.

6. 10-K、10-Q、8-K、DEF-14A 的正确对应是:The correct correspondence of 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, DEF-14A is:

  • A. 10-K=年度(含审计财报+MD&A);10-Q=季度(未审计);8-K=当期重大事件;DEF-14A=代理声明10-K = annual (with audited financials + MD&A); 10-Q = quarterly (unaudited); 8-K = current material events; DEF-14A = proxy statement
  • B. 10-K=季度;10-Q=年度10-K = quarterly; 10-Q = annual
  • C. 8-K=年度报告8-K = the annual report
答案 A。DEF-14A 用于股东表决、高管薪酬等代理事项。Answer A. DEF-14A is used for shareholder votes, executive compensation, and other proxy matters.
1. 业绩发布电话会议（earnings calls）最可能属于哪类信息来源？1. Earnings calls are most likely sourced from: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 发行人（公司自身）。issuers.
  • B. 公开第三方。public third parties.
  • C. 专有第三方。proprietary third parties.
答案 A。业绩发布电话会(earnings calls)由公司自己举办 → 发行人(公司自身)来源。第三方来源指独立机构/数据商。Answer A. Earnings calls are hosted by the company itself → an issuer (company) source. Third-party sources are independent agencies/data vendors.

LM1 §4 财务附注、分部报告、MD&A、审计报告LM1 §4 Financial Notes, Segment Reporting, MD&A, Audit Report 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

4.1 财务附注与补充附表

附注(footnotes)是必须的,往往占披露的大部分。它披露:编制基础(会计年度、采用 IFRS 还是 US GAAP、合并基础等)、会计政策/方法/估计。IFRS 与 US GAAP 都允许在某些项目上灵活选择政策方法——灵活性能贴合各企业的经济实质,但也降低了公司间的可比性,分析师须理解这些选择以做恰当调整。附注还披露:分部报告、并购处置、表内外债务、金融工具与风险、法律诉讼、关联方交易、资产负债表日后事项等。Notes (footnotes) are required and often make up most of the disclosure. They disclose: the basis of preparation (fiscal year, whether IFRS or US GAAP, consolidation basis, etc.) and accounting policies/methods/estimates. Both IFRS and US GAAP allow flexibility in choosing policies and methods for certain items — flexibility fits each firm's economic substance but also reduces comparability across companies, so analysts must understand these choices to make proper adjustments. Notes also disclose: segment reporting, acquisitions/disposals, on- and off-balance-sheet debt, financial instruments and risk, legal proceedings, related-party transactions, subsequent events after the balance-sheet date, etc.

4.2 分部报告(segment reporting)

经营分部(operating segment):公司的一个组成部分,
① 从事可能产生收入和费用的活动、② 其业绩由高管定期审阅、③ 有单独的财务信息。量化门槛(10% 规则):某分部的收入、资产或利润占合并各分部的 10% 及以上时,须单独披露。若所有可报告分部对外收入合计 < 总收入的 75%,须增加可报告分部直到达 75%。每个可报告分部须披露:收入(区分对外与分部间)、盈亏、(若定期审阅的)资产负债、利息收支、资本支出、折旧摊销、所得税等。此外:任一单一客户占公司总收入 ≥10% 须披露该事实(但不必披露客户身份)。Operating segment: a component of a company that ① engages in activities that may generate revenue and expenses,
② whose performance is regularly reviewed by senior management, and ③ has separate financial information. Quantitative thresholds (the 10% rule): a segment must be disclosed separately when its revenue, assets, or profit is 10% or more of the combined segments. If the external revenue of all reportable segments together is < 75% of total revenue, add reportable segments until 75% is reached. Each reportable segment must disclose: revenue (separating external and intersegment), profit or loss, (if regularly reviewed) assets and liabilities, interest income/expense, capital expenditure, depreciation and amortization, income taxes, etc. Also: if any single customer is ≥10% of total revenue, that fact must be disclosed (but the customer's identity need not be).

4.3 管理层评论 / MD&A

MD&A(Management's Discussion and Analysis):管理层讨论业务性质、过去业绩与展望。除财报摘录外,MD&A 通常未经审计(德国例外,1931 年起要求且经审计)。IASB 的《管理层评论》实务声明给出五个内容要素:
① 业务性质;
② 管理层目标与战略;
③ 重要资源、风险与关系;
④ 经营成果;
⑤ 关键业绩指标。美国 SEC 要求上市公司提供 MD&A 并规定内容:须突出有利/不利趋势、影响流动性资本资源经营成果的重大事件与不确定性、通胀影响、表外义务、合同承诺、需主观判断的关键会计政策。MD&A 是理解财报的好起点,但只是分析师的一个输入。MD&A (Management's Discussion and Analysis): management discusses the nature of the business, past performance, and outlook. Apart from financial-statement excerpts, MD&A is generally unaudited (Germany is an exception, requiring it and auditing it since 1931). The IASB's Management Commentary practice statement gives five content elements:
① the nature of the business;
② management's objectives and strategies;
③ significant resources, risks, and relationships;
④ results of operations;
⑤ key performance measures. The US SEC requires listed companies to provide MD&A and prescribes its content: it must highlight favorable/unfavorable trends, material events and uncertainties affecting liquidity/capital resources/results, inflation effects, off-balance-sheet obligations, contractual commitments, and critical accounting policies requiring subjective judgment. MD&A is a good starting point for understanding the statements but is only one analyst input.

4.4 审计报告与四类意见(高频考点)

年报中的财报一般须由独立会计师事务所按审计准则审计并出具审计报告(书面意见)。国际审计准则 ISA 由 IAASB 制定;美国上市公司审计准则由 SOX 下的 PCAOB 制定。审计采用抽样技术,故只能提供合理保证(reasonable assurance)而非绝对保证——高概率认为财报不含重大错报/舞弊。四类意见:The financial statements in an annual report must generally be audited by an independent accounting firm under auditing standards, which issues an audit report (a written opinion). International Standards on Auditing (ISA) are set by the IAASB; US listed-company auditing standards are set by the PCAOB under SOX. Auditing uses sampling, so it provides only reasonable assurance, not absolute assurance — a high probability that the statements are free of material misstatement/fraud. Four types of opinion:

审计意见Audit opinion含义Meaning
无保留意见 unqualified(clean / 无修饰)Unqualified opinion (clean)财报"真实与公允"/"公允列报",符合适用准则——分析师最想看到的意见The statements are "true and fair" / "fairly presented" in accordance with the applicable standards — the opinion analysts most want to see
保留意见 qualifiedQualified opinion存在某种范围限制或对准则的例外;例外在报告中以额外说明段描述There is some scope limitation or exception to the standards; the exception is described in an additional explanatory paragraph
否定意见 adverseAdverse opinion审计师认定财报严重偏离准则、未公允列报The auditor finds the statements materially depart from the standards and are not fairly presented
无法表示意见 disclaimerDisclaimer of opinion因范围限制等原因,审计师无法出具意见Due to scope limitations or the like, the auditor is unable to issue an opinion

报告还会讨论关键审计事项(国际)/关键审计事项 Critical Audit Matters(美国)——审计师认为最重要、最具挑战性或最主观复杂的事项。此外美国 SOX 下审计师还须对公司内部控制系统出具意见。The report also discusses key audit matters (international) / Critical Audit Matters (US) — matters the auditor considers most important, most challenging, or most subjective and complex. In addition, under US SOX the auditor must also issue an opinion on the company's internal control system.

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

四类披露载体各管什么

• 财务附注(notes):会计政策、估计与明细,在审计范围内。
• 分部报告(segment):按业务/地区披露收入、利润、资产。
• MD&A(管理层讨论与分析):前瞻性趋势、风险、流动性,通常未经审计。
• 审计报告:独立审计师意见。

审计意见类型

无保留(unqualified/clean)最好;其次保留(qualified)、否定(adverse)、无法表示(disclaimer)。另含对内部控制的意见。

易错对比

① 附注经审计、MD&A 一般不经审计;② 无保留=「干净」意见;③ 分部数据帮助看清各业务真实盈利。

What each disclosure vehicle covers

• Notes: accounting policies, estimates, details — within the audit scope.
• Segment reporting: revenue, profit, assets by business/geography.
• MD&A: forward-looking trends, risks, liquidity — usually unaudited.
• Audit report: the independent auditor's opinion.

Types of audit opinion

Unqualified/clean is best; then qualified, adverse, disclaimer. Also includes an opinion on internal controls.

Common traps

① Notes are audited; MD&A generally is not; ② unqualified = a "clean" opinion; ③ segment data reveals the true profitability of each business.

7. 分部报告的量化门槛是:The quantitative thresholds for segment reporting are:

  • A. 某分部收入/资产/利润占各分部 10%+ 须单独披露;若可报告分部对外收入 < 总收入 75%,须增补至 75%A segment with 10%+ of the combined revenue/assets/profit must be disclosed separately; if reportable segments' external revenue < 75% of total, add segments until 75% is reached
  • B. 门槛为 50% 与 90%The thresholds are 50% and 90%
  • C. 分部报告无任何量化门槛Segment reporting has no quantitative thresholds
答案 A。单一客户 ≥10% 收入也须披露该事实。Answer A. A single customer at ≥10% of revenue must also be disclosed as a fact.

8. MD&A 是否经过审计:Is the MD&A audited:

  • A. 除财报摘录外通常未经审计(德国例外)Apart from excerpts of the financials, it is usually unaudited (Germany is an exception)
  • B. 全部经过审计It is fully audited
  • C. 从不包含任何财务数据It never contains any financial data
答案 A。德国自 1931 年起要求 MD&A 并审计,属例外。Answer A. Germany has required and audited the MD&A since 1931, an exception.

9. 四类审计意见,以及分析师最想看到的是:The four types of audit opinion, and the one analysts most want to see:

  • A. 只有两类意见There are only two types
  • B. 无保留、保留、否定、无法表示;最想看到无保留(clean)意见Unqualified, qualified, adverse, disclaimer; they most want an unqualified (clean) opinion
  • C. 最想看到否定意见They most want an adverse opinion
答案 B。无保留意见表示财报公允反映。Answer B. An unqualified opinion means the financials present fairly.

10. 审计提供的是绝对保证还是合理保证,为什么:Does an audit provide absolute or reasonable assurance, and why:

  • A. 绝对保证Absolute assurance
  • B. 不提供任何保证No assurance at all
  • C. 合理保证——因抽样技术与估计假设,只能高概率认为不含重大错报Reasonable assurance — because of sampling techniques and estimation assumptions, it can only conclude with high probability that there is no material misstatement
答案 C。审计给出的是 reasonable assurance。Answer C. An audit gives reasonable assurance.
1. 下列哪种审计意见最能表明审计师认为财务报表严重偏离会计准则、未公允列报？1. Which of the following opinions is the best indication that the auditor believes the financial statements depart materially from accounting standards and are not fairly presented? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 否定意见Adverse opinion
  • B. 保留意见Qualified opinion
  • C. 无法表示意见Disclaimer of opinion
答案 A。否定意见(adverse opinion)= 审计师认为报表严重偏离准则、未公允列报(最严重)。保留意见是局部问题;无法表示意见是范围受限、无法判断。Answer A. An adverse opinion = the auditor concludes the statements materially depart from standards and are not fairly presented (the most severe). A qualified opinion is a limited issue; a disclaimer means scope was limited so no opinion is possible.
2. 下列哪项最可能出现在管理层评论（MD&A）中？2. Which of the following is most likely found in the management commentary (MD&A)? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 前瞻性披露Forward-looking disclosures
  • B. 财务报表的编制基础Basis of preparation for the financial statements
  • C. 对报表整体是否不存在重大错报的合理保证Reasonable assurance whether the financial statements as a whole are free from material misstatement
答案 A。MD&A(管理层评论)含前瞻性披露(展望、风险、趋势)。编制基础在附注;"合理保证无重大错报"是审计报告的措辞。Answer A. The MD&A contains forward-looking disclosures (outlook, risks, trends). The basis of preparation is in the notes; "reasonable assurance of no material misstatement" is audit-report language.
3. 关于审计的固有局限，下列哪项最准确？3. Which of the following is most accurate with respect to inherent limitations of audits? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 审计意见仅基于对审计师所编制信息的复核。An audit opinion is based on a review of information only prepared by the auditor.
  • B. 审计基于对一个财年内所有交易的详尽复核。An audit is based on an exhaustive review of all transactions during a financial year.
  • C. 审计师的角色与公众对审计师的期望之间可能存在"期望差距"。An expectations gap may exist between the auditor's role and the public's expectation of auditors.
答案 C。审计的固有局限:审计师职责与公众期望之间存在"期望差距(expectations gap)"。审计是抽样(非全查),且基于管理层(非审计师)编制的信息,故 A、B 错。Answer C. An inherent limitation of auditing: an "expectations gap" between the auditor's role and the public's expectations. An audit samples (not all transactions) and reviews management-prepared (not auditor-prepared) information, so A and B are wrong.

LM1 §5 IFRS vs US GAAP 与其他信息来源LM1 §5 IFRS vs US GAAP & Other Information Sources

  • 两大准则制定机构:IASB(制定 IFRS)与 FASB(制定 US GAAP)。尽管长期趋同,两者仍有差异影响财务报告,分析师必须留意尚未趋同的领域。Two major standard-setters: the IASB (sets IFRS) and the FASB (sets US GAAP). Despite long-run convergence, the two still differ in ways that affect financial reporting, and analysts must watch the areas not yet converged.
  • 欧盟:各成员国监管本国资本市场,但 2005 年起欧盟上市公司的合并报表须用 IFRS。相关机构:欧洲证券委员会(ESC)、欧洲证券和市场管理局(ESMA)。EU: each member state regulates its own capital market, but since 2005 the consolidated statements of EU listed companies must use IFRS. Relevant bodies: the European Securities Committee (ESC) and the European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA).
  • 其他(非监管)信息来源:发行人还通过财报电话会、投资者日、新闻稿、公司网站、实地走访沟通;分析师也与管理层、投资者关系部门交流。第三方来源:行业白皮书、分析师报告、政府经济信息、行业新闻、电子数据平台;分析师还用调查、访谈、产品评测自行生成信息。Other (non-regulatory) information sources: issuers also communicate through earnings calls, investor days, press releases, company websites, and site visits; analysts also talk with management and investor relations. Third-party sources: industry white papers, analyst reports, government economic information, industry news, electronic data platforms; analysts also generate their own information through surveys, interviews, and product testing.

11. 两大会计准则及其制定机构,以及欧盟上市公司合并报表所用准则:The two major accounting standards and their standard-setters, and the standard used for EU listed companies' consolidated statements:

  • A. 欧盟合并报表使用 US GAAPEU consolidated statements use US GAAP
  • B. IFRS(IASB)与 US GAAP(FASB);欧盟合并报表 2005 年起用 IFRSIFRS (IASB) and US GAAP (FASB); EU consolidated statements have used IFRS since 2005
  • C. IFRS 由 FASB 制定IFRS is set by the FASB
答案 B。IASB→IFRS、FASB→US GAAP。Answer B. IASB → IFRS, FASB → US GAAP.

LM2 §1 收入确认:五步法LM2 §1 Revenue Recognition: The Five-Step Model 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: describe general principles of revenue recognition, specific revenue recognition applications, and implications of revenue recognition choices for financial analysis。

权责发生制核心:收入在赚得时确认(记入利润表),即所有权的风险与报酬转移时(通常是交付商品/服务时),不一定与收现同期。赊销产生应收账款;预收货款则先记递延收入(unearned/deferred revenue)负债,随交付逐步确认收入(如预付一年的云软件订阅)。The core of accrual accounting: revenue is recognized when earned (recorded in the income statement), i.e., when the risks and rewards of ownership transfer (usually on delivery of goods/services), not necessarily in the same period as cash collection. Credit sales create receivables; cash received in advance is first recorded as a deferred (unearned) revenue liability and recognized as revenue over delivery (e.g., a prepaid one-year cloud-software subscription).

2018 年起 IFRS 与 US GAAP 的收入确认已趋同。核心原则:确认收入应"反映向客户转移承诺商品/服务的过程,金额反映主体预期有权换取的对价"。五步法(务必记熟顺序):Since 2018 revenue recognition under IFRS and US GAAP has converged. The core principle: revenue should be recognized to "depict the transfer of promised goods/services to a customer, in an amount reflecting the consideration the entity expects to be entitled to in exchange." The five-step model (memorize the order):

识别合同 → 识别履约义务 → 确定交易价格 → 分摊交易价格 → 履约时确认收入
步骤Step含义Meaning
① 识别与客户的合同① Identify the contract with a customer有商业实质、确立各方权利义务的协议;仅当收款很可能(probable)时合同才存在。IFRS 的"probable"= 更可能发生;US GAAP = 很可能发生——门槛不同,经济上相似的合同可能处理不同An agreement with commercial substance that establishes each party's rights and obligations; a contract exists only when collection is probable. IFRS's "probable" = more likely than not; US GAAP = likely to occur — different thresholds, so economically similar contracts may be treated differently
② 识别合同中单独/可区分的履约义务② Identify the separate/distinct performance obligations in the contract转移可区分商品/服务的承诺;若客户能单独或结合易得资源受益、且该承诺能与其他承诺分开,即"可区分"Promises to transfer distinct goods/services; a promise is "distinct" if the customer can benefit from it alone or with readily available resources and it can be separated from other promises
③ 确定交易价格③ Determine the transaction price卖方预期换取的对价The consideration the seller expects to receive in exchange
④ 把交易价格分摊到各履约义务④ Allocate the transaction price to the performance obligations步骤③④解决"金额"问题Steps ③ and ④ resolve the "amount" question
⑤ 在(或随着)主体履行履约义务时确认收入⑤ Recognize revenue when (or as) the entity satisfies a performance obligation解决"时点"问题;当把商品/服务的控制权转移给客户时确认(考虑:是否有现时收款权、客户是否取得法定所有权/实物占有/风险报酬/已验收)Resolves the "timing" question; recognized when control of the goods/services transfers to the customer (considering: present right to payment, whether the customer has legal title/physical possession/risks and rewards/has accepted it)

特殊应用(理解归类即可):Special applications (understanding the classification is enough):

  • 主要责任人 vs 代理人(principal vs agent):作为主要责任人(在转移前控制商品)按全额对价确认收入;作为代理人(只安排第三方商品转移)仅按佣金/手续费确认收入。结果:代理模式收入更低但利润率更高——对共同比和比率分析影响很大。Principal vs agent: as a principal (controlling the goods before transfer) recognize revenue at the gross consideration; as an agent (merely arranging a third party's transfer) recognize only the commission/fee. Result: the agent model has lower revenue but a higher margin — a big effect on common-size and ratio analysis.
  • 特许经营/许可:如比萨公司按加盟店销售额的固定比例(如 5.5%)确认特许权使用费收入(不是加盟店总销售额);开店预付费先记递延收入,再在协议期(如 10 年)直线摊销。Franchising/licensing: e.g., a pizza company recognizes a royalty at a fixed percentage of franchisee sales (e.g., 5.5%) as revenue (not total franchisee sales); an upfront store-opening fee is first recorded as deferred revenue and then amortized straight-line over the agreement term (e.g., 10 years).
  • 软件许可 vs SaaS:纯许可("as is"、客户自行安装)在转移时点一次确认;若供应商需持续提供影响软件的活动(升级)或云服务(SaaS,客户不占有软件),则在合同期内逐步确认。Software license vs SaaS: a pure license ("as is," installed by the customer) is recognized at a point in time on transfer; if the vendor must keep providing activities that affect the software (upgrades) or a cloud service (SaaS, where the customer doesn't possess the software), it is recognized over the contract term.
  • 长期合同(over time):满足三条件之一即按时间确认(客户同时接受并消耗利益 / 主体的履约创造或增强客户控制的资产 / 所造资产无替代用途且主体有权就已完成部分收款)。进度可用产出法或投入法(如已发生成本 ÷ 预计总成本)衡量。Long-term contracts (over time): recognized over time if one of three conditions holds (the customer simultaneously receives and consumes the benefits / the entity's performance creates or enhances an asset the customer controls / the asset created has no alternative use and the entity has an enforceable right to payment for work completed). Progress can be measured by an output method or an input method (e.g., costs incurred ÷ estimated total costs).
教材算例 · 长期合同(投入法)

合同总价 $10M,预计总成本 $7M,预计利润 $3M,两年完成。第 1 年发生成本 $4.2M = 总成本的 60% → 确认收入 $6M(60%×10)、利润 $1.8M(60%×3)。第 2 年完工,累计实际成本 $7.5M → 第 2 年确认收入 $4M、成本 $3.3M、利润 $0.7M,累计利润 $2.5M。Total contract price $10M, estimated total cost $7M, estimated profit $3M, completed over two years. Year 1 incurs $4.2M of cost = 60% of total cost → recognize revenue $6M (60%×10) and profit $1.8M (60%×3). Completed in Year 2, cumulative actual cost $7.5M → Year 2 recognizes revenue $4M, cost $3.3M, profit $0.7M, cumulative profit $2.5M.

考点·完工百分比法(percentage-of-completion):长期合同按履约进度确认收入:
• 本期收入 = 合同总价 × (累计已发生成本 ÷ 预计总成本)(投入法/成本比例法);
• 进度也可用产出量等"产出法"衡量;
• 若结果不可可靠估计但成本可收回,则按已发生成本确认等额收入(零利润法),不提前认利润。Exam - percentage-of-completion: a long-term contract recognizes revenue by progress toward completion:
- period revenue = total contract price x (cumulative costs incurred / total expected costs) (an input/cost-ratio method);
- progress can also use an output method (e.g., units);
- if the outcome cannot be reliably estimated but costs are recoverable, revenue equals costs incurred (the zero-profit method), booking no early profit.
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

收入确认五步法

① 识别合同;② 识别履约义务;③ 确定交易价格;④ 把价格分摊到各义务;⑤ 在履约义务满足时确认收入。核心原则:控制权转移给客户时确认,而非收到现金时。

时点 vs 时段

若客户随进度持续获得控制(如长期建造)→ 按时段(over time)确认;否则在交付某一时点(point in time)确认。

易错对比

① 收入按履约确认,与收现无关;② 预收款先记负债,履约后转收入;③ 按时段需可靠计量进度。

The five-step revenue model

① Identify the contract; ② identify performance obligations; ③ determine the transaction price; ④ allocate price to obligations; ⑤ recognize revenue as each obligation is satisfied. Core principle: recognize when control transfers to the customer, not when cash is received.

Point in time vs over time

If the customer gains control continuously (e.g., long-term construction) → recognize over time; otherwise at a delivery point in time.

Common traps

① Revenue follows performance, not cash receipt; ② advances are a liability first, then revenue on performance; ③ over-time needs reliable progress measurement.

12. 收入确认五步法的正确顺序是:The correct order of the five-step revenue-recognition model is:

  • A. 先确认收入 → 再识别合同Recognize revenue first → then identify the contract
  • B. 先分摊价格 → 再识别合同Allocate the price first → then identify the contract
  • C. 识别合同 → 识别履约义务 → 确定交易价格 → 分摊价格 → 履约(控制权转移)时确认收入Identify the contract → identify performance obligations → determine the transaction price → allocate the price → recognize revenue when performance (transfer of control) occurs
答案 C。控制权转移是确认收入的时点。Answer C. Transfer of control is the point of revenue recognition.

13. 主要责任人与代理人确认收入的区别及对利润率的影响:The difference between principal and agent revenue recognition and its effect on margins:

  • A. 主要责任人按全额对价确认;代理人仅按佣金确认,代理模式收入更低但利润率更高A principal recognizes the gross consideration; an agent recognizes only the commission — the agent model has lower revenue but a higher margin
  • B. 代理人按全额确认收入An agent recognizes gross revenue
  • C. 两者确认的收入相同The two recognize the same revenue
答案 A。代理模式收入基数小,毛利率反而更高。Answer A. The agent model has a small revenue base but a higher gross margin.
1. 按趋同后的收入确认准则，卖方资产负债表上确认应收款的时点是：1. According to the converged standards for revenue recognition, a receivable is recognized on the seller's balance sheet when: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 签订合同时。a contract is signed.
  • B. 除收款外所有履约义务均已完成时。all performance obligations have been met except for payment.
  • C. 在转让商品或服务之前收到对价时。consideration is received in advance of transferring goods or services.
答案 B。趋同收入准则:当除"收款"外所有履约义务都已完成时,确认应收款(控制权已转移、只等收钱)。签合同时、预收时都不确认应收。Answer B. Under the converged revenue standard, a receivable is recognized when all performance obligations except collection are satisfied (control transferred, only payment pending). Not at contract signing or when cash is received in advance.
2. 按趋同后的收入确认准则，下列哪项可能表明卖方已在某一时点将资产控制权转移给买方？卖方：2. According to the converged standards for revenue recognition, which of the following might indicate that a seller has transferred control of an asset to a buyer at a point in time? The seller has: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 拥有该资产的法定所有权。legal title of the asset.
  • B. 拥有就该资产收取款项的现时权利。a present right to payment for the asset.
  • C. 承担与该资产所有权相关的重大风险和报酬。significant risks and rewards of ownership related to the asset.
答案 B。控制权转移的迹象之一:卖方拥有"就该资产收款的现时权利"。法定所有权、承担风险报酬是"旧"标准(风险报酬转移),新标准看控制权。Answer B. A sign that control has transferred: the seller has a present right to payment for the asset. Legal title or bearing risks/rewards reflects the old model; the new standard focuses on control.
3. 某公司签订一份为期5年、总售价 £3,000,000 的建造合同。预计总成本 £2,000,000，第一年实际发生成本 £500,000。已发生成本可恰当计量进度。假设收入极可能不会被冲回，第一年确认的收入最可能为：3. A company entered into a 5-year construction contract with a total sales price of £3,000,000. Estimated total costs are £2,000,000 and £500,000 actual costs were incurred in the first year. Costs incurred provide an appropriate measure of progress. Assuming it is highly probable that revenue will not be reversed, revenue recognized in Year 1 is most likely: 真题模考Mock
  • A. £500,000。£500,000.
  • B. £600,000。£600,000.
  • C. £750,000。£750,000.
答案 C。方法:按完工百分比确认收入 = 总合同价 × (已发生成本/预计总成本) = 3,000,000 × (500,000/2,000,000) = £750,000。收入随履约进度确认。Answer C. Method: percentage-of-completion revenue = total price × (costs incurred/total expected costs) = 3,000,000 × (500,000/2,000,000) = £750,000. Revenue is recognized as the obligation is satisfied.
4. 对按日历年度报告的公司而言，第一年收到客户就第二年提供服务而支付的款项，最可能增加：4. For a company reporting on a calendar year basis, the receipt of a payment from a client in Year 1 for the delivery of services in Year 2 most likely increases: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 第一年的净利润。net income for Year 1.
  • B. 第一年12月31日的负债。liabilities as of 31 December of Year 1.
  • C. 第二年的经营活动现金流。cash flow from operating activities for Year 2.
答案 B。预收下年服务的款项 → 义务未完成 → 确认为负债(合同负债/递延收入),不进第一年利润。收现是第一年经营现金流入,但利润与负债才是问的重点。Answer B. Cash received for next year's service → the obligation is unmet → recorded as a liability (contract liability/deferred revenue), not first-year income. The cash is a first-year operating inflow, but the liability is the point.
5. 按趋同后的收入确认准则，收入确认五步法中的第一步是下列哪项？5. According to the converged accounting standards for revenue recognition, which of the following is the first of five steps in recognizing revenue? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 确定交易价格Determine the transaction price
  • B. 识别与客户的合同Identify the contract with the customer
  • C. 识别合同中各单独履约义务Identify the distinct performance obligations in the contract
答案 B。收入确认五步法第一步 = 识别与客户的合同。之后依次:识别履约义务 → 确定交易价格 → 分摊价格 → 履约时确认收入。Answer B. The revenue five-step model's first step = identify the contract with the customer. Then: identify performance obligations → determine the transaction price → allocate it → recognize revenue as obligations are satisfied.

LM2 §2 费用确认LM2 §2 Expense Recognition 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: describe general principles of expense recognition; contrast costs that are capitalized versus those expensed in the period incurred。

费用在公司消耗相关经济利益的期间确认。三种确认模型:Expenses are recognized in the period the company consumes the related economic benefit. Three recognition models:

  1. 配比原则(matching):费用与相关收入同期确认(如销货成本 COGS)。注意 IFRS 用"配比概念"而非"配比原则"这一措辞。Matching principle: expenses are recognized in the same period as the related revenue (e.g., cost of goods sold, COGS). Note that IFRS uses the wording "matching concept" rather than "matching principle."
  2. 发生即费用化(period costs / expensing as incurred):与收入关联不直接的支出(管理、IT、研发、维修、多数薪酬)在发生时费用化。Period costs (expensing as incurred): spending not directly tied to revenue (administration, IT, R&D, repairs, most compensation) is expensed as incurred.
  3. 资本化后折旧/摊销(capitalization):先记为资产,再在预计使用年限内以折旧/摊销费用化——是配比原则的一种形式(土地不折旧、无限寿命无形资产不摊销)。Capitalization then depreciation/amortization: first recorded as an asset, then expensed over the estimated useful life as depreciation/amortization — a form of the matching principle (land is not depreciated; indefinite-life intangibles are not amortized).
教材算例 · 存货成本与 COGS 配比(KDL)

全年采购 7,600 件、总成本 $321,600;售出 5,600 件 @$50 = 收入 $280,000;期末存货 2,000 件(经具体辨认,1,900 件来自第四季、100 件来自第三季)。COGS = 全部采购成本 − 期末存货成本 = $321,600 − $89,800 = $231,800,毛利 = 280,000 − 231,800 = $48,200。剩余 $89,800 待未来售出时再与收入配比。Purchased 7,600 units for the year at a total cost of $321,600; sold 5,600 units @ $50 = revenue $280,000; ending inventory 2,000 units (by specific identification, 1,900 from Q4 and 100 from Q3). COGS = total purchase cost − ending inventory cost = $321,600 − $89,800 = $231,800, gross profit = 280,000 − 231,800 = $48,200. The remaining $89,800 is matched against revenue when sold in the future.

资本化 vs 费用化的财报影响(核心考点)

🔰 零基础讲解:先说清"更高/更低"是跟谁比

同一笔钱花出去,会计上有两种记法。用具体例子:公司花 900 元买一台设备,能用 3 年,直线法折旧(每年记 300)。The same money spent can be recorded two ways in accounting. A concrete example: a company spends 900 on a piece of equipment, usable for 3 years, depreciated straight-line (300 per year).

  • 记法 A · 资本化:先把 900 当成"资产",每年只把 300(折旧)算成费用,分 3 年慢慢摊。Method A · Capitalize: treat the 900 as an "asset" and expense only 300 (depreciation) each year, spreading it over 3 years.
  • 记法 B · 立即费用化:第一年就把 900 全部一次算成费用。Method B · Expense immediately: expense the full 900 at once in year one.

后面所有的"更高 / 更低",指的都是记法 A 和记法 B 互相比——不是跟去年比、也不是跟别的公司比。All the "higher / lower" below refer to Method A vs Method B compared to each other — not vs last year, and not vs another company.

先用真实数字感受一下(假设每年收入 1,500、其他现金费用 500、税率 30%,算出每年净利润):First, get a feel for it with real numbers (assume annual revenue 1,500, other cash expenses 500, tax rate 30%, computing each year's net income):

每年净利润Net income per year第 1 年Year 1第 2 年Year 2第 3 年Year 33 年合计3-year total
记法 A 资本化Method A capitalize4904904901,470
记法 B 费用化Method B expense707007001,470

看第 1 年:A 的净利润 490 比 B 的 70 高一大截——因为 A 只扣了 300 折旧,B 一次扣了 900。这就是"当期净利润资本化更高"的意思。Look at Year 1: A's net income of 490 far exceeds B's 70 — because A deducted only 300 of depreciation while B deducted 900 at once. This is what "capitalizing gives higher current net income" means.

但第 2、3 年反过来:B(700)比 A(490)高——B 早就把设备一次扣完了,后面没费用可扣,利润显得节节高。这就是"后续年度费用化更高、增长趋势更好"。But Years 2 and 3 reverse: B (700) exceeds A (490) — B already expensed the equipment at once, so with no expense left afterward its profit rises steadily. This is "expensing gives higher later-year income and a better growth trend."

而 3 年合计都是 1,470,完全相同——两种记法无非"早扣还是晚扣",总账一样。And the 3-year total is 1,470, exactly the same — the two methods differ only in "deduct early or deduct late"; the total ledger is identical.

把这个规律整理成对比表,每一格都是"A 资本化" ↔ "B 费用化"互相比较的结果:Organizing this pattern into a comparison table, each cell is the result of comparing "A capitalize" ↔ "B expense":
