关键规律:只要资本支出 > 折旧费用(持续购置或逐年递增),资本化的"提利润"效应就一直存在。若每年买一样多的资产,当"各年折旧之和 = 当年资本支出"时,两法对利润的影响就消失(教材例:第 3 年起 3 台设备各折旧 $100,合计 $300 = 当年新买一台的 $300,两法无差异)。分析师要警惕公司把本该费用化的支出硬记成资本化,来虚增当期利润和 CFO。Key rule: as long as capex > depreciation expense (ongoing purchases or year-over-year increases), the profit-boosting effect of capitalization persists. If the same amount of assets is bought each year, the effect on profit disappears when "the sum of each year's depreciation = the current year's capex" (textbook example: from Year 3 on, three machines each depreciate $100, totaling $300 = the $300 for one new machine that year, so the two methods are identical). Analysts should watch for companies that force-capitalize spending that should be expensed to inflate current profit and CFO.

  • 利息资本化:为获取/建造需较长时间达到可用状态的资产而发生的利息须资本化——出现在资产负债表(而非利润表利息费用)。分析利息保障倍数时,应把资本化+费用化的全部利息计入(评级机构如 S&P 用毛利息)。Interest capitalization: interest incurred to acquire/build an asset that takes a long time to reach usable condition must be capitalized — appearing on the balance sheet (not as income-statement interest expense). When analyzing interest coverage, include all interest, both capitalized and expensed (rating agencies like S&P use gross interest).
  • 内部开发成本:软件在技术可行性确立后的开发成本须资本化;微软等判定可行性时点很晚,实际上把研发费用化。费用化 → 当期净利润、CFO 更低、CFI 更高。比较一家费用化、一家资本化的公司时须做调整。Internally developed costs: software development costs after technological feasibility is established must be capitalized; companies like Microsoft judge the feasibility point very late, effectively expensing R&D. Expensing → lower current net income and CFO, higher CFI. Comparing an expensing company with a capitalizing one requires adjustment.
考点提示:
① 购入长期设备的当年:资产增加、折旧费用增加(净利润不是被购买额一次性减少)。
② 费用化 vs 资本化的判断题反复考:费用化 → 当期净利率低、总资产周转率高(资产更小)、未来利润增速更高。
③ 减值损失(impairment)是非现金项,压低当年净利润与净利率 → 使后续年度净利率偏高;它还暗示以前年度折旧不足、净利润被高估。
④ 估计设备平均剩余寿命 ≈ 净 PP&E ÷ 年折旧费用。
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

费用确认:配比原则

配比(matching):费用与其带来的收入在同一期间确认。直接相关的(如 COGS)随对应收入确认;无法配比的(如管理费)在发生期确认。

估计带来的选择空间

折旧法(直线 vs 加速)、坏账估计、存货法都会改变各期费用与利润。加速折旧前期费用高、利润低,后期反转——总额不变、时间不同。

易错对比

① COGS 与销售配比、期间费用按发生确认;② 加速折旧前低后高利润;③ 更激进的估计(低坏账、长折旧年限)会虚增当期利润。

Expense recognition: matching

Matching: expenses are recognized in the same period as the revenue they generate. Directly linked costs (e.g., COGS) follow the related revenue; unmatchable costs (e.g., admin) are recognized as incurred.

Estimation latitude

Depreciation method (straight-line vs accelerated), bad-debt estimates, and inventory method all shift period expense and profit. Accelerated depreciation front-loads expense (lower early profit), reversing later — same total, different timing.

Common traps

① COGS is matched to sales, period costs are recognized as incurred; ② accelerated depreciation gives low-then-high profit; ③ aggressive estimates (low bad debt, long useful life) inflate current profit.

14. 费用确认的三种模型是:The three models of expense recognition are:

  • A. 只有资本化一种Only capitalization
  • B. 配比原则(如 COGS)、发生即费用化(期间费用)、资本化后折旧摊销Matching (e.g., COGS), immediate expensing (period costs), and capitalize-then-depreciate/amortize
  • C. 只有配比原则Only the matching principle
答案 B。IFRS 用"配比概念"而非"配比原则"的措辞。Answer B. IFRS uses the wording 'matching concept' rather than 'matching principle.'

15. 采购总成本 $321,600、期末存货 $89,800、售 5,600 件@$50,COGS 与毛利分别为:Total purchase cost $321,600, ending inventory $89,800, sold 5,600 units @ $50; COGS and gross profit are, respectively:

  • A. COGS $89,800,毛利 $190,200COGS $89,800, gross profit $190,200
  • B. COGS $321,600,毛利 −$41,600COGS $321,600, gross profit −$41,600
  • C. COGS $231,800,毛利 $48,200COGS $231,800, gross profit $48,200
答案 C。COGS=321,600−89,800=231,800;毛利=280,000−231,800=48,200。Answer C. COGS = 321,600 − 89,800 = 231,800; gross profit = 280,000 − 231,800 = 48,200.

16. 相比费用化,资本化对当期净利润、后续净利润、CFO 的影响是:Compared with expensing, the effect of capitalizing on current net income, later net income, and CFO is:

  • A. 三者都不变All three unchanged
  • B. 当期净利润更高、后续净利润更低、CFO 更高Higher current net income, lower later net income, higher CFO
  • C. 当期更低、CFO 更低Lower current and lower CFO
答案 B。支出计入投资流出使 CFO 更高;只要资本支出>折旧,提利润效应持续;单笔资产多年合计两法相同。Answer B. The outlay is classified as an investing outflow, so CFO is higher; as long as capex > depreciation the income-boosting effect persists; over an asset's full life the two methods total the same.

17. 铁路把轨道改良支出费用化(而非资本化),对当年净利率、总资产周转率、未来利润增速的影响是:A railroad expenses (rather than capitalizes) track-improvement spending; the effect on that year's net margin, total asset turnover, and future profit growth is:

  • A. 净利率低、总资产周转率高、未来利润增速更高Lower net margin, higher total asset turnover, higher future profit growth
  • B. 净利率高、周转率低Higher net margin, lower turnover
  • C. 三者都不变All three unchanged
答案 A。当年多费用→净利率低、资产小→周转率高;未来无折旧→利润增速高。Answer A. More expense this year → lower net margin; smaller assets → higher turnover; no future depreciation → higher profit growth.

LM2 §3 非经常性项目与会计变更LM2 §3 Non-Recurring Items & Accounting Changes

LOS 对应:LOS: describe the financial reporting treatment and analysis of non-recurring items and changes in accounting policies。

为评估未来盈利,应把可能持续的损益项目与不太可能持续的项目分开。To assess future earnings, separate income-statement items that are likely to persist from those unlikely to persist.

项目Item处理与分析Treatment and analysis
异常或不常发生项目
unusual / infrequentUnusual or infrequent items
unusual / infrequent		IFRS 要求重大或相关项目单独披露;US GAAP 下重大的异常/不常发生项目在持续经营利润内单独列示。预测时评估是否会重现,不宜简单忽略所有异常项IFRS requires material or relevant items to be disclosed separately; under US GAAP material unusual/infrequent items are shown separately within continuing-operations income. When forecasting, assess whether they will recur; do not simply ignore all unusual items
终止经营
discontinued operationsDiscontinued operations
discontinued operations		处置或计划处置某组成部分且不再参与其经营时,在利润表底部按税后净额单独列示(含每股);相关资产负债在资产负债表列为"持有待售"。预测未来时可剔除终止经营When a component is disposed of or planned for disposal and the company no longer participates in its operations, it is shown separately at the bottom of the income statement, net of tax (including per share); the related assets and liabilities are classified as "held for sale" on the balance sheet. Discontinued operations can be excluded when forecasting the future
会计政策变更
change in policyChange in accounting policy
change in policy		如新准则或换存货计价法——原则上追溯适用(retrospective):所有列报年度都视同一直采用新政策,便于可比(除非不切实际)E.g., a new standard or a change in inventory valuation method — in principle applied retrospectively: all periods presented are treated as if the new policy had always been used, aiding comparability (unless impractical)
会计估计变更
change in estimateChange in accounting estimate
change in estimate		如折旧资产的使用年限——未来适用(prospective):只影响变更当期及以后,不调整以前报表、不在利润表表内列示,重大变更在附注披露E.g., the useful life of a depreciable asset — applied prospectively: affects only the current and future periods, does not adjust prior statements, is not shown on the face of the income statement, and material changes are disclosed in the notes
前期差错更正Correction of a prior-period error通过重述(restate)以前期间报表处理;须披露差错,可能揭示会计系统与内控的弱点Handled by restating prior-period statements; the error must be disclosed and may reveal weaknesses in the accounting system and internal controls

记忆口诀:政策变更→追溯,估计变更→未来,差错→重述。Mnemonic: policy change → retrospective, estimate change → prospective, error → restate.

考点·会计变更的三种处理(易考对号入座):
• 会计政策变更(如采用新准则)→ 追溯法(retrospective),重述可比期间;新收入/租赁准则常用修正追溯法(modified retrospective):只调整期初留存收益、不重述往期。
• 会计估计变更(如残值、使用寿命)→ 未来适用法(prospective),只影响本期及以后。
• 前期差错更正 → 追溯重述(restatement)。Exam - three treatments of accounting changes (often matched):
- Change in accounting policy (e.g., a new standard) -> retrospective, restating comparatives; new revenue/lease standards often use the modified retrospective method: adjust opening retained earnings only, no prior-period restatement.
- Change in estimate (e.g., residual value, life) -> prospective, current and future only.
- Prior-period error -> retrospective restatement.

18. 会计政策变更、会计估计变更、前期差错的处理方式分别是:The treatment of a change in accounting policy, a change in accounting estimate, and a prior-period error is, respectively:

  • A. 政策变更→未来适用;估计变更→追溯Policy change → prospective; estimate change → retrospective
  • B. 三者都追溯适用All three retrospective
  • C. 政策变更→追溯适用;估计变更→未来适用;前期差错→重述以前期间报表Policy change → retrospective application; estimate change → prospective application; prior-period error → restate prior statements
答案 C。记忆口诀:政策追溯、估计未来、差错重述。Answer C. Mnemonic: policy retrospective, estimate prospective, error restate.

19. 终止经营在利润表如何列示:How are discontinued operations presented on the income statement:

  • A. 完全不予披露Not disclosed at all
  • B. 在底部按税后净额单独列示(含每股),相关资产负债列为"持有待售"Separately at the bottom on an after-tax net basis (including per share), with related assets/liabilities shown as 'held for sale'
  • C. 计入营业收入Included in operating revenue
答案 B。预测未来盈利时可剔除终止经营部分。Answer B. When forecasting future earnings, the discontinued portion can be excluded.
1. 下列哪项可采用"修正追溯法"进行报告？1. Which of the following may be reported using the modified retrospective method? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 前期差错更正Corrections of prior period errors
  • B. 固定资产估计使用年限的变更Changes in estimated useful life of PP&E
  • C. 基于新收入确认准则的会计政策变更Changes in accounting policies based on the new revenue recognition standard
答案 C。基于新准则的会计政策变更 → 修正追溯法(modified retrospective)。前期差错更正用完全追溯;估计变更用未来适用法。Answer C. A change in accounting policy from a new standard → the modified retrospective approach. Prior-period error corrections use full retrospective; estimate changes use prospective.
2. 长期资产估计残值变更的相关调整应：2. The adjustments related to changes in the estimated residual value of a long-lived asset should be: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 采用未来适用法处理。handled prospectively.
  • B. 在利润表上单独列示。shown separately on the income statement.
  • C. 采用追溯法处理，除非不切实际。handled retrospectively unless impractical to do so.
答案 A。估计变更(如残值)→ 未来适用法(prospective),只影响本期及以后,不重述过去。政策变更/差错才追溯。Answer A. A change in estimate (e.g., residual value) → prospective treatment, affecting only current and future periods, with no restatement. Policy changes/errors are retrospective.
3. 某公司制定计划处置其一项重要业务线，且此后不再参与其经营。利润表最可能将该业务线的经营成果报告为：3. A company establishes a plan to dispose of one of its material lines of business and will have no further involvement in its operation. The income statement most likely reports the results of this line of business as: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 终止经营。discontinued operations.
  • B. 异常或不常发生项目。unusual or infrequent items.
  • C. 在实际出售前列作持续经营。continuing operations until the actual sale is performed.
答案 A。计划处置且此后不再参与经营的重要业务线 → 终止经营(discontinued operations),在利润表单独列示(税后)。Answer A. A major line the firm plans to dispose of and will no longer be involved in → discontinued operations, presented separately (net of tax) on the income statement.

LM2 §4 每股收益(必会计算)LM2 §4 Earnings Per Share (must-calculate) 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: describe how earnings per share is calculated; calculate and interpret basic and diluted EPS for simple and complex capital structures including antidilutive securities。

4.1 简单 vs 复杂资本结构

若公司发行了可能转换为普通股的金融工具(可转债、可转换优先股、员工股票期权、认股权证),则为复杂资本结构,需披露稀释 EPS;否则为简单资本结构,基本 EPS = 稀释 EPS。稀释 EPS 永远 ≤ 基本 EPS。If a company has issued instruments that could convert into common stock (convertible bonds, convertible preferred, employee stock options, warrants), it has a complex capital structure and must disclose diluted EPS; otherwise it has a simple capital structure and basic EPS = diluted EPS. Diluted EPS is always ≤ basic EPS.

4.2 基本每股收益(basic EPS)

基本 EPS = (净利润 − 优先股股利) / 加权平均普通股股数
符号Symbol含义Meaning
净利润 − 优先股股利Net income − preferred dividends归属普通股股东的利润(扣除已付优先股股利后的净利润)Income attributable to common shareholders (net income after preferred dividends paid)
加权平均股数Weighted-average shares普通股按发行在外时间加权;股票股利或拆股追溯到期初调整Common shares weighted by time outstanding; stock dividends or splits are adjusted retroactively to the start of the period
教材算例 · 加权平均股数与基本 EPS(Angler)

净利润 $2,500,000,优先股股利 $200,000。1 月 1 日 1,000,000 股,4 月 1 日增发 200,000 股,10 月 1 日回购 100,000 股。加权平均 = 1,000,000×3/12 + 1,200,000×6/12 + 1,100,000×3/12 = 250,000 + 600,000 + 275,000 = 1,125,000 股。基本 EPS = (2,500,000 − 200,000)/1,125,000 = $2.04。若期内发生 2-for-1 拆股,视同期初发生,加权平均翻倍为 2,250,000,EPS = $1.02。Net income $2,500,000, preferred dividends $200,000. 1,000,000 shares on Jan 1, 200,000 issued on Apr 1, 100,000 repurchased on Oct 1. Weighted average = 1,000,000×3/12 + 1,200,000×6/12 + 1,100,000×3/12 = 250,000 + 600,000 + 275,000 = 1,125,000 shares. Basic EPS = (2,500,000 − 200,000)/1,125,000 = $2.04. If a 2-for-1 split occurs during the period, it is treated as if at the start, the weighted average doubles to 2,250,000, and EPS = $1.02.

4.3 稀释每股收益:if-converted 法(可转换证券)

可转换优先股:稀释 EPS = 净利润 / (加权平均股数 + 转换新增普通股)
可转债:稀释 EPS = (净利润 + 可转债税后利息 − 优先股股利) / (加权平均股数 + 转换新增普通股)
要点Key point说明Description
if-converted(假设转换)法If-converted method假设可转换证券在期初即已转换Assume the convertible security was converted at the start of the period
可转换优先股Convertible preferred分子加回优先股股利(转换后不再付),分母加上转换的新增普通股Add back preferred dividends to the numerator (no longer paid after conversion); add the new common shares from conversion to the denominator
可转债Convertible bonds分子加回税后利息= 利息×(1−税率)(转换后不再付息),分母加上转换的新增普通股Add back after-tax interest to the numerator = interest×(1−tax rate) (no longer paid after conversion); add the new common shares from conversion to the denominator
教材算例 · 可转换优先股(Bright-Warm)

净利润 $1,750,000;500,000 普通股;20,000 可转换优先股,每股股利 $10、每股转 5 股普通股。基本 EPS = (1,750,000 − 200,000)/500,000 = $3.10。稀释:分子加回股利 = 1,750,000,分母 = 500,000 + 20,000×5 = 600,000,稀释 EPS = 1,750,000/600,000 = $2.92。Net income $1,750,000; 500,000 common shares; 20,000 convertible preferred, dividend $10 each, each converts to 5 common shares. Basic EPS = (1,750,000 − 200,000)/500,000 = $3.10. Diluted: numerator adds back dividends = 1,750,000, denominator = 500,000 + 20,000×5 = 600,000, diluted EPS = 1,750,000/600,000 = $2.92.

教材算例 · 可转债(Oppnox,税率 30%)

净利润 $750,000;加权平均 690,000 股;$50,000 的 6% 可转债,可转 10,000 股。税后利息 = 50,000×6%×(1−0.30) = 3,000×0.7 = $2,100。稀释 EPS = (750,000 + 2,100)/(690,000 + 10,000) = 752,100/700,000 = $1.07(基本 EPS = 750,000/690,000 = $1.09)。Net income $750,000; weighted average 690,000 shares; $50,000 of 6% convertible bonds, convertible to 10,000 shares. After-tax interest = 50,000×6%×(1−0.30) = 3,000×0.7 = $2,100. Diluted EPS = (750,000 + 2,100)/(690,000 + 10,000) = 752,100/700,000 = $1.07 (basic EPS = 750,000/690,000 = $1.09).

4.4 稀释 EPS:库藏股法(期权/认股权证)

稀释 EPS = (净利润 − 优先股股利) / [加权平均股数 + (行权新增股数 − 用行权所得回购的股数)×存续期间比例]
要点Key point说明Description
库藏股法
treasury stock methodTreasury stock method		US GAAP 的叫法(IFRS 方法相同但不叫此名)。核心:假设期权/权证已行权,公司用行权所得现金按期间平均市价回购股票The US GAAP name (IFRS uses the same method under a different name). Core: assume the options/warrants are exercised and the company uses the exercise proceeds to buy back shares at the average market price for the period
净增股数Net increase in shares= 行权发行的股数 − 用所得回购的股数;分子不变(行权本身不影响净利润)= shares issued on exercise − shares repurchased with the proceeds; the numerator is unchanged (exercise itself does not affect net income)
教材算例 · 股票期权(Hihotech)

净利润 $2,300,000;加权平均 800,000 股;30,000 份期权、行权价 $35;期间平均市价 $55。行权所得 = 30,000×$35 = $1,050,000,可回购 1,050,000/55 = 19,091 股。净增股数 = 30,000 − 19,091 = 10,909。稀释 EPS = 2,300,000/(800,000 + 10,909) = 2,300,000/810,909 = $2.84(基本 = $2.88)。Net income $2,300,000; weighted average 800,000 shares; 30,000 options, exercise price $35; average market price $55 for the period. Exercise proceeds = 30,000×$35 = $1,050,000, which buys back 1,050,000/55 = 19,091 shares. Net increase in shares = 30,000 − 19,091 = 10,909. Diluted EPS = 2,300,000/(800,000 + 10,909) = 2,300,000/810,909 = $2.84 (basic = $2.88).

4.5 反稀释证券(antidilutive)

若某可转换证券纳入计算后反而使 EPS 高于基本 EPS,则为反稀释证券,IFRS 与 US GAAP 都不纳入稀释 EPS 计算(稀释 EPS 须反映最大潜在稀释,且永远 ≤ 基本 EPS)。If including a convertible security in the calculation instead makes EPS higher than basic EPS, it is an antidilutive security, and both IFRS and US GAAP exclude it from diluted EPS (diluted EPS must reflect the maximum potential dilution and is always ≤ basic EPS).

教材算例 · 反稀释(Dim-Cool)

同上例但每股优先股仅转 3 股普通股。假设转换:分子 1,750,000,分母 500,000 + 20,000×3 = 560,000,得 EPS = $3.13 > 基本 EPS $3.10 → 该证券反稀释,不纳入,报告的稀释 EPS = 基本 EPS = $3.10。Same as above but each preferred share converts to only 3 common shares. Assuming conversion: numerator 1,750,000, denominator 500,000 + 20,000×3 = 560,000, giving EPS = $3.13 > basic EPS $3.10 → the security is antidilutive, excluded, and reported diluted EPS = basic EPS = $3.10.

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

每股收益(EPS)

基本 EPS = (净利润 − 优先股股利) ÷ 加权平均普通股数。分子先扣优先股利,分母用按时间加权的股数(增发/回购按月份加权;股票分割追溯调整)。

稀释 EPS

把可转换债/优先股、期权假设转换后重算。可转换证券用「如果转换」法;期权用库藏股法。只计入会摊薄(dilutive)的——反摊薄(antidilutive)一律不计入。

易错对比

① 分子扣优先股利(可转换优先股稀释时加回);② 反摊薄证券不计入稀释 EPS;③ 股票分割要追溯调整所有期间。

Earnings per share (EPS)

Basic EPS = (net income − preferred dividends) ÷ weighted-average common shares. The numerator subtracts preferred dividends; the denominator is time-weighted (issuance/buybacks weighted by months; splits adjusted retroactively).

Diluted EPS

Recompute assuming convertibles and options convert. Convertibles use the if-converted method; options use the treasury-stock method. Include only dilutive securities — antidilutive ones are excluded.

Common traps

① Subtract preferred dividends in the numerator (add back for dilutive convertible preferred); ② exclude antidilutive securities from diluted EPS; ③ splits adjust all periods retroactively.

20. 净利润 $2.5M、优先股股利 $0.2M,加权平均股数 1,125,000,基本 EPS 为:Net income $2.5M, preferred dividends $0.2M, weighted-average shares 1,125,000; basic EPS is:

  • A. $2.22$2.22
  • B. $2.50$2.50
  • C. $2.04$2.04
答案 C。(2,500,000−200,000)/1,125,000 = $2.04;加权=1,000,000×3/12+1,200,000×6/12+1,100,000×3/12。Answer C. (2,500,000 − 200,000)/1,125,000 = $2.04; weighting = 1,000,000×3/12 + 1,200,000×6/12 + 1,100,000×3/12.

21. 净利润 $750,000、690,000 股、$50,000 的 6% 可转债(转 10,000 股)、税率 30%,稀释 EPS 为:Net income $750,000, 690,000 shares, a $50,000 6% convertible bond (converts to 10,000 shares), tax rate 30%; diluted EPS is:

  • A. $0.98$0.98
  • B. $1.07$1.07
  • C. $1.09$1.09
答案 B。税后利息=50,000×6%×0.7=2,100;(750,000+2,100)/(690,000+10,000)=$1.07。Answer B. After-tax interest = 50,000×6%×0.7 = 2,100; (750,000 + 2,100)/(690,000 + 10,000) = $1.07.

22. 净利润 $2.3M、800,000 股、30,000 份期权@$35、平均市价 $55,稀释 EPS(库藏股法)为:Net income $2.3M, 800,000 shares, 30,000 options @ $35, average market price $55; diluted EPS (treasury-stock method) is:

  • A. $2.88$2.88
  • B. $2.76$2.76
  • C. $2.84$2.84
答案 C。行权所得回购 1,050,000/55=19,091 股,净增 10,909;2,300,000/810,909=$2.84。Answer C. Exercise proceeds repurchase 1,050,000/55 = 19,091 shares, a net addition of 10,909; 2,300,000/810,909 = $2.84.

23. 什么是反稀释证券,如何处理:What is an antidilutive security and how is it handled:

  • A. 纳入后反使 EPS 高于基本 EPS 的证券;IFRS 与 US GAAP 都不纳入稀释 EPSA security that, if included, would raise EPS above basic EPS; both IFRS and US GAAP exclude it from diluted EPS
  • B. 纳入后降低 EPS 的证券A security that lowers EPS if included
  • C. 必须纳入稀释 EPSIt must be included in diluted EPS
答案 A。稀释 EPS 永远 ≤ 基本 EPS,反稀释证券被剔除。Answer A. Diluted EPS is always ≤ basic EPS, so antidilutive securities are excluded.

每股可转换优先股可转为2股普通股。若税率为40%、无其他潜在稀释性证券，报告的稀释每股收益最接近：1. An analyst gathers the following information about a company's fiscal year:
Net income€2,500,000

One convertible preferred share is convertible into two common shares. If the tax rate is 40% and there are no other potentially dilutive securities, reported diluted EPS is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. €0.38。€0.38.
  • B. €0.48。€0.48.
  • C. €0.63。€0.63.

Method: diluted EPS (if-converted preferred) = (net income − preferred dividends + preferred dividends added back)/(common shares + shares from conversion). Assume conversion: add back the preferred dividend and add the shares. ≈ €0.63.

5. 公司发行的股票期权在下列何种情况下必然是反稀释的：5. Stock options issued by a company must be antidilutive when the: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 期权在整个会计年度内均存续。options are outstanding for the entire fiscal year.
  • B. 期权行权价低于当期股票平均市价。options' exercise price is less than the average market price of the stock during the period.
  • C. 行权所得可购回的股数多于行权应发行的股数。options' exercise proceeds could purchase more shares than would be issued through option exercise.
答案 C。股票期权是反稀释的条件:行权所得资金能回购的股数 > 行权应发行的股数(即行权价 > 平均市价,期权价外)。此时纳入反会抬高EPS,故排除。Answer C. A stock option is antidilutive when the shares repurchasable with the exercise proceeds exceed the shares issued on exercise (i.e., exercise price > average market price, out-of-the-money). Including it would raise EPS, so it is excluded.
6. 下列哪项将某证券定义为反稀释证券？若将其计入稀释EPS的计算，会导致：6. Which of the following defines a security as antidilutive? If included in the calculation of diluted EPS, it results in a: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 计算出的EPS高于基本EPS。higher computed EPS than the basic EPS calculation.
  • B. 税前利润高于基本EPS计算中的水平。higher pretax income compared to the basic EPS calculation.
  • C. 在外股数低于基本EPS计算中的水平。lower number of shares outstanding compared to the basic EPS calculation.
答案 A。反稀释证券的定义:若纳入稀释EPS计算,会使算出的EPS "高于"基本EPS。因为稀释只能降低或持平EPS,凡抬高者即反稀释、须剔除。Answer A. A dilutive security is antidilutive if including it in diluted EPS would produce an EPS "higher" than basic EPS. Dilution can only lower or keep EPS; anything that raises it is antidilutive and excluded.
7. 某公司在计入一项潜在稀释性证券后计算的稀释EPS为 $2.53。假设基本EPS为 $2.50，则公司应在财务报表中报告：7. A company's diluted EPS calculation including a potentially dilutive security equals $2.53. Assuming basic EPS of $2.50, the company should report in its financial statements: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 基本EPS $2.53。basic EPS of $2.53.
  • B. 基本EPS与稀释EPS均为 $2.50。basic EPS and diluted EPS of $2.50.
  • C. 基本EPS $2.50、稀释EPS $2.53。basic EPS of $2.50 and diluted EPS of $2.53.
答案 B。若某证券纳入后算出的"稀释EPS"(2.53)高于基本EPS(2.50),它是反稀释的,应剔除 → 基本与稀释EPS均报 $2.50。Answer B. If a security produces a "diluted EPS" (2.53) above basic EPS (2.50), it is antidilutive and excluded → report basic and diluted EPS both at $2.50.

LM2 §5 共同比分析与利润率LM2 §5 Common-Size Analysis & Margins

LOS 对应:LOS: evaluate a company's financial performance using common-size income statements and financial ratios based on the income statement。

共同比分析(common-size analysis):把利润表每一行都表示为营业收入的百分比,消除规模影响,便于跨期(时间序列)和跨公司(横截面)比较。教材例:C 公司销售额只有 A 的 1/5,但共同比后费用与利润占比与 A 完全相同;C 的营业利润率 20% 高于 B 的 15%——绝对额小不代表相对盈利能力弱。共同比还能揭示战略差异(A 的毛利率 70% 远高于 B 的 25%,因 A 在研发和广告投入大、卖差异化高价产品)。例外:税费更适合与税前利润比较(算有效税率),而非与销售额比。Common-size analysis: express every income-statement line as a percentage of revenue, removing the effect of scale to ease comparison across time (time series) and across companies (cross-section). Textbook example: Company C's sales are only 1/5 of A's, but after common-sizing its expense and profit proportions are exactly the same as A's; C's operating margin of 20% exceeds B's 15% — a small absolute amount does not mean weak relative profitability. Common-sizing also reveals strategic differences (A's gross margin of 70% far exceeds B's 25%, because A invests heavily in R&D and advertising to sell differentiated, high-priced products). Exception: taxes are better compared with pre-tax profit (to compute the effective tax rate) than with sales.

利润表比率(必背)

净利率 = 净利润 / 营业收入    毛利率 = 毛利润 / 营业收入  (毛利 = 收入 − COGS)
比率Ratio含义Meaning
净利率 net profit marginNet profit margin每 1 元收入产生的净利润,越高越好(= 共同比表上的净利润行)Net income per $1 of revenue, higher is better (= the net-income line on the common-size statement)
毛利率 gross profit marginGross profit margin每 1 元收入产生的毛利;差异化产品策略通常毛利率更高(但前期研发广告费不进毛利计算)Gross profit per $1 of revenue; a differentiation strategy usually has a higher gross margin (but upfront R&D and advertising are not in the gross-margin calculation)
营业利润率 / 税前利润率Operating margin / pre-tax margin营业利润÷收入 / 税前利润÷收入Operating profit ÷ revenue / pre-tax profit ÷ revenue
考点提示:共同比利润表把每行表示为收入的百分比(资产负债表共同比则表示为总资产的百分比,下一讲会讲)。垂直共同比尤其适合横截面比较(与同业或行业中位数比)。记住:毛利 = 收入 − 销货成本;净利率可直接从共同比表读出。

24. 共同比利润表把每行表示为什么的百分比,净利率与毛利率公式是:A common-size income statement expresses each line as a percentage of what, and the formulas for net margin and gross margin:

  • A. 营业收入的百分比;净利率=净利润/收入,毛利率=毛利/收入A percentage of revenue; net margin = net income/revenue, gross margin = gross profit/revenue
  • B. 总资产的百分比A percentage of total assets
  • C. 净利润的百分比A percentage of net income
答案 A。毛利=收入−COGS;税费则更适合与税前利润相比。Answer A. Gross profit = revenue − COGS; taxes are better compared with pre-tax profit.

CFA Program Curriculum · Level I · Financial Statement Analysis

第二讲 · 分析资产负债表 & 现金流量表Lecture 2 · Analyzing the Balance Sheet & the Cash Flow Statement

对应教材:FSA — Learning Module 3《Analyzing Balance Sheets》+ Learning Module 4/5《Analyzing Statements of Cash Flows I & II》 · 建议学习时长:3–4 小时 · 建议分两次学完(资产负债表约 1.5 小时,现金流量表约 2 小时)Curriculum: FSA — Learning Module 3 Analyzing Balance Sheets + Learning Module 4/5 Analyzing Statements of Cash Flows I & II · Suggested study time: 3–4 hours · Best done in two sittings (balance sheet ~1.5 hours, cash-flow statement ~2 hours)

上一讲讲的是利润表(公司"赚了多少")。这一讲讲另外两张核心报表:资产负债表(公司"有什么、欠什么"的某一时点快照)和现金流量表(公司"钱怎么进出"的一段时期记录)。The previous lecture covered the income statement (how much a company 'earned'). This lecture covers the other two core statements: the balance sheet (a point-in-time snapshot of what a company 'has and owes') and the cash flow statement (a period record of 'how money moves in and out').

难点集中在几个高频计算点:流动性/偿债比率、直接法 vs 间接法、IFRS 与 US GAAP 的现金流分类差异、自由现金流 FCFF/FCFE。别担心看不懂会计——本讲每个硬概念都配了"🔰 零基础讲解",关键术语鼠标悬停(带 💡)还有生动比喻。The difficulties cluster on a few high-frequency calculation points: liquidity/solvency ratios, direct vs indirect method, the IFRS vs US GAAP cash-flow classification differences, and free cash flow FCFF/FCFE. Don't worry if the accounting is unfamiliar — every hard concept here comes with a '🔰 Beginner explainer,' and key terms have vivid analogies on mouse hover (marked 💡).

LM3 §1 资产负债表:公司的"财务快照"LM3 §1 The Balance Sheet: A Company's 'Financial Snapshot'

🔰 零基础讲解:资产负债表在说什么?

把一家公司想象成一个人。资产是你拥有的东西(现金、房子、别人欠你的钱);负债是你欠别人的钱(房贷、信用卡);权益是"真正属于你的净身家"。Picture a company as a person. Assets are what you own (cash, a house, money others owe you); liabilities are what you owe others (mortgage, credit card); equity is your "true net worth."

三者永远满足一条铁律:资产 = 负债 + 所有者权益。因为你拥有的每一分钱,要么是借来的(负债),要么是自己的(权益)。The three always obey one iron rule: Assets = Liabilities + Owners' equity. Because every dollar you own is either borrowed (a liability) or your own (equity).

它是某一时点的快照(如"12 月 31 日这一刻"),不像利润表和现金流量表记录"一整年发生了什么"。It is a snapshot at a point in time (e.g., "the instant of December 31"), unlike the income statement and cash flow statement, which record "what happened over a whole year."

资产负债表披露一家主体在特定时点拥有什么(资产)、欠什么(负债)、以及所有者对净资产的权益(权益)。The balance sheet discloses what an entity owns (assets), owes (liabilities), and the owners' interest in net assets (equity) at a specific point in time.

大部分项目按历史成本列报,但有些按公允价值计量,还有些事件干脆不确认。分析师要熟悉不同的确认、计量、披露规则,才能评估公司的流动性、偿债能力和整体财务状况。附注提供了判断跨公司可比性的关键信息。Most items are reported at historical cost, but some are measured at fair value, and some events are not recognized at all. Analysts must know the different recognition, measurement, and disclosure rules to assess a company's liquidity, solvency, and overall financial position. The notes provide key information for judging comparability across companies.

1. 会计恒等式,以及资产负债表反映的是时点还是时期:The accounting identity, and whether the balance sheet reflects a point in time or a period: 官方题Official

  • A. 收入 = 成本 + 利润;反映时点Revenue = cost + profit; reflects a point in time
  • B. 资产 = 负债 + 所有者权益;反映某一时点的财务快照Assets = liabilities + owners' equity; it reflects a snapshot at a point in time
  • C. 资产 = 负债 − 权益;反映一段时期Assets = liabilities − equity; reflects a period
答案 B。资产负债表是时点报表,利润表与现金流量表才是时期报表。Answer B. The balance sheet is a point-in-time statement; the income and cash-flow statements are period statements.
1. 下列哪项在资产负债表上不归类为负债或权益？1. Which of the following is not classified as a liability or equity on the balance sheet? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 递延收入Deferred revenue
  • B. 非控制性权益Noncontrolling interest
  • C. 坏账准备Allowance for doubtful accounts
答案 C。坏账准备(allowance for doubtful accounts)是应收账款的"抵减项(contra-asset)",不是负债或权益。递延收入是负债;非控制性权益是权益。Answer C. The allowance for doubtful accounts is a contra-asset offsetting receivables — not a liability or equity. Deferred revenue is a liability; non-controlling interest is equity.

LM3 §2 无形资产:研究 vs 开发LM3 §2 Intangible Assets: Research vs Development

LOS 对应:LOS: explain the financial reporting and disclosures related to intangible assets。

无形资产(intangible assets):可辨认的、无实物形态的非货币性资产,如专利、许可证、商标、客户名单。Intangible assets: identifiable non-monetary assets without physical substance, such as patents, licenses, trademarks, and customer lists.

2.1 有限寿命 vs 无限寿命

  • 有限寿命(finite):在最佳估计的使用年限内系统摊销,方法与年限至少每年复核;和 PP&E 一样要做减值测试。Finite life: systematically amortized over the best estimate of the useful life, with method and life reviewed at least annually; like PP&E, subject to impairment testing.
  • 无限寿命(indefinite):不摊销,但至少每年做减值测试并复核"无限寿命"假设是否仍合理。Indefinite life: not amortized, but impairment-tested at least annually, with the "indefinite life" assumption reviewed for continued reasonableness.

2.2 内部产生的无形资产:研究阶段 vs 开发阶段(高频)

🔰 零基础讲解:为什么研究要费用化、开发能资本化?

想象一家药企。研究阶段🔬 就像"还在实验室瞎试各种配方"——能不能成功、将来能不能卖钱,谁都说不准。会计很保守:既然前景不明,这些钱就当期直接算成费用(费用化),不放进资产。是"探索新知识",结果高度不确定;开发阶段💊 就像"配方已验证可行,正在做样品、准备量产"。成功在望、未来能带来收益比较明确,所以在满足技术可行等条件后,这些钱可以记成一项无形资产(资本化),以后再慢慢摊销。是研究之后的设计、测试原型。Picture a pharma company. The research phase🔬 is like "still fiddling with formulas in the lab" — no one can say whether it will succeed or ever sell. Accounting is conservative: since the prospects are unclear, this money is expensed in the current period, not put on the asset side. is "exploring new knowledge," with highly uncertain results; the development phase💊 is like "the formula is proven, now making samples and preparing for mass production." Success is in sight and future benefits are fairly clear, so once technical feasibility and other conditions are met this money can be recorded as an intangible asset (capitalized) and amortized later. is the post-research design and prototype testing.

IFRS 的规则:研究阶段成本必须费用化;开发阶段成本在满足条件(技术可行、有能力使用或出售、有能力完成项目)时可以资本化为无形资产。IFRS rule: research-phase costs must be expensed; development-phase costs may be capitalized as an intangible asset when conditions are met (technical feasibility, ability to use or sell, ability to complete the project).

US GAAP 更严:大多数内部开发的无形资产和研发成本一律费用化。US GAAP is stricter: most internally developed intangibles and R&D costs are expensed outright.

无论 IFRS 还是 GAAP,以下都费用化:内部产生的品牌/客户名单、开办费、培训费、管理间接费、广告促销、搬迁重组、遣散费。而外购的无形资产则资本化、单独列示。Under both IFRS and GAAP, the following are expensed: internally generated brands/customer lists, start-up costs, training costs, administrative overhead, advertising and promotion, relocation and restructuring, and severance. Purchased intangibles, by contrast, are capitalized and shown separately.

教材例题 · Alpha 公司两个项目 官方题Official

项目 1(研究阶段,找一种靠手指感应的转向机构)、项目 2(开发阶段,电子焊接原型,已确定技术可行、可售、可produce)。Project 1 (research phase, seeking a finger-sensing steering mechanism), Project 2 (development phase, an electronic-soldering prototype, with technical feasibility, salability, and producibility established).

IFRS 下:项目 1 全部费用化,资本化 = 0;项目 2 可资本化 = 材料 620 + 直接人工 320 + 设计测试 470 = 1,410(注意管理人员成本不资本化)。US GAAP 下:两个项目全部费用化。Under IFRS: Project 1 is fully expensed, capitalized = 0; Project 2 can be capitalized = materials 620 + direct labor 320 + design and testing 470 = 1,410 (note administrative-staff costs are not capitalized). Under US GAAP: both projects are fully expensed.

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

无形资产:研究 vs 开发

• IFRS:研究(research)费用化,开发(development)满足条件(技术可行、有意图与能力完成、能产生未来经济利益)可资本化。
• US GAAP:研究与开发一般都费用化(内部开发软件在达到技术可行后可资本化)。

机制

资本化 → 前期费用低、利润与资产高、后续摊销;费用化 → 前期利润低。内部产生的商誉/品牌不确认为资产。

易错对比

① IFRS 开发可资本化、GAAP 多费用化;② 内部商誉/品牌不入表;③ 资本化会抬高当期利润与资产。

Intangibles: research vs development

• IFRS: research is expensed; development is capitalized when criteria are met (technical feasibility, intent and ability to complete, future economic benefit).
• US GAAP: R&D is generally expensed (internally developed software may be capitalized after technological feasibility).

Mechanism

Capitalizing → lower early expense, higher profit and assets, later amortization; expensing → lower early profit. Internally generated goodwill/brands are not recognized.

Common traps

① IFRS capitalizes development, GAAP mostly expenses; ② internal goodwill/brands are off balance sheet; ③ capitalizing raises current profit and assets.

2. 有限寿命与无限寿命无形资产的会计处理区别是:The accounting difference between finite-life and indefinite-life intangible assets is: 官方题Official

  • A. 有限寿命不摊销;无限寿命摊销Finite life: no amortization; indefinite life: amortized
  • B. 两者都摊销Both are amortized
  • C. 有限寿命:系统摊销 + 减值测试;无限寿命:不摊销,但至少每年减值测试并复核寿命假设Finite life: systematic amortization + impairment testing; indefinite life: no amortization, but at least annual impairment testing and review of the life assumption
答案 C。无限寿命无形资产(如商誉)不摊销但须减值测试。Answer C. Indefinite-life intangibles (e.g., goodwill) are not amortized but must be impairment-tested.

3. 内部研发在 IFRS 与 US GAAP 下如何处理:How is internal R&D treated under IFRS vs US GAAP: 官方题Official

  • A. US GAAP 全部资本化US GAAP capitalizes everything
  • B. IFRS:研究费用化、开发满足条件可资本化;US GAAP:大多一律费用化IFRS: research expensed, development capitalized if criteria are met; US GAAP: mostly all expensed
  • C. IFRS 全部资本化IFRS capitalizes everything
答案 B。IFRS 区分研究/开发两阶段,US GAAP(除软件等)大多费用化。Answer B. IFRS distinguishes research/development phases; US GAAP (except software, etc.) mostly expenses.

4. 开发阶段材料 620、直接人工 320、设计测试 470、另有可归属管理成本,IFRS 下资本化金额为:Development-phase materials 620, direct labor 320, design/testing 470, plus some attributable administrative cost; the amount capitalized under IFRS is: 官方题Official

  • A. 940940
  • B. 1,410 + 管理成本1,410 + admin cost
  • C. 1,410(管理人员成本不资本化)1,410 (management costs are not capitalized)
答案 C。620+320+470=1,410;一般管理费用不予资本化。Answer C. 620+320+470 = 1,410; general administrative expenses are not capitalized.
1. 某项存在活跃市场、有确定有限寿命、在多个会计期间用于公司经营的版权。在 US GAAP 下，该版权采用何种模式报告：1. A copyright, for which an active market exists, has a set finite life and is used in a company's operations over more than one fiscal period. Under US GAAP, this copyright is reported using: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅成本模式。only the cost model.
  • B. 仅重估模式。only the revaluation model.
  • C. 成本模式或重估模式均可。either the cost or the revaluation model.
答案 A。US GAAP 不允许无形资产用重估模式 → 版权只能用成本模式(cost model)。重估模式是 IFRS 才有(且需活跃市场)。Answer A. US GAAP does not permit the revaluation model for intangibles → the copyright uses the cost model only. The revaluation model exists only under IFRS (and needs an active market).
2. 某公司发生以下支出（单位：百万欧元）用于内部开发一项无形资产：
研究阶段发生成本900
开发阶段发生成本600
若无形资产的确认条件已满足，可资本化成本的最大金额（单位：百万欧元）为：2. A company incurred the following expenditures (in € millions) to internally develop an intangible asset:
Costs incurred during the research phase900
Costs incurred during the development phase600
If the recognition criteria for an intangible asset have been met, the maximum amount of capitalized costs (in € millions) is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 600。600.
  • B. 900。900.
  • C. 1,500。1,500.
答案 A。内部开发无形资产:研究(research)阶段费用化、开发(development)阶段满足条件才资本化。可资本化的是"开发"部分,故最大资本化 = 600(仅开发支出)。Answer A. For internally developed intangibles: research is expensed; development is capitalized once criteria are met. Only the development portion capitalizes → maximum = 600 (development spend only).

LM3 §3 商誉:并购溢价从哪来LM3 §3 Goodwill: Where the Acquisition Premium Comes From

LOS 对应:LOS: explain the financial reporting and disclosures related to goodwill。
🔰 零基础讲解:商誉是什么?

商誉🏪 假设你花 1000 万买下一家网红奶茶店,可它的桌椅、设备、存货加起来只值 600 万。你为什么多付 400 万?因为你买的还有它的品牌、老客户、好口碑、地段——这些值钱但没法单独摆上账本的东西。这多付的 400 万,会计上就记成"商誉"。只在并购时才产生:收购价 高于 被收购方"可辨认净资产公允价值"的那部分差额。Goodwill🏪 Suppose you pay 10M to buy a trendy bubble-tea shop, but its furniture, equipment, and inventory together are worth only 6M. Why pay 4M more? Because you are also buying its brand, loyal customers, good reputation, and location — valuable things that cannot be listed separately on the books. That extra 4M is recorded in accounting as "goodwill." arises only in an acquisition: the excess of the purchase price over the fair value of the acquiree's "identifiable net assets."

商誉 = 收购总价 − 被收购方可辨认净资产的公允价值
步骤Step含义Meaning
① 确定收购总价① Determine the total purchase price为收购目标公司支付的总成本The total cost paid to acquire the target company
② 计量可辨认净资产② Measure identifiable net assets被收购方可辨认资产(公允价值) − 负债与或有负债(公允价值)The acquiree's identifiable assets (fair value) − liabilities and contingent liabilities (fair value)
③ 商誉 = ① − ②③ Goodwill = ① − ②若②反而大于①(收购价更低),称廉价购买(bargain purchase),差额确认为当期损益If ② instead exceeds ① (a lower purchase price), it is a bargain purchase, and the difference is recognized in current profit or loss

会计商誉 vs 经济商誉:会计商誉只在并购时按准则确认;经济商誉基于公司的经济表现,不一定在资产负债表上,而是(理论上)反映在股价里。Accounting goodwill vs economic goodwill: accounting goodwill is recognized only in an acquisition under the standards; economic goodwill is based on the company's economic performance, not necessarily on the balance sheet, but (in theory) reflected in the share price.

关键规则:IFRS 和 US GAAP 下商誉都资本化、不摊销,但至少每年做减值测试。减值损失冲减当期利润、减少总资产(所以未来的资产回报率 ROA 可能反而上升),且是非现金项目。Key rule: under both IFRS and US GAAP goodwill is capitalized and not amortized, but impairment-tested at least annually. An impairment loss reduces current profit and total assets (so future return on assets, ROA, may actually rise) and is a non-cash item.

分析师常把商誉剔除后再算比率:从资产负债表数据中剔除商誉、从利润数据中剔除商誉减值损失,以看清经营趋势。教材案例:SAP 商誉占总资产 50.1%(偏高需警惕),苹果仅 1.5%(内生增长为主)。Analysts often strip out goodwill before computing ratios: removing goodwill from balance-sheet data and goodwill impairment losses from profit data to see the operating trend clearly. Textbook case: SAP's goodwill is 50.1% of total assets (high, warranting caution), while Apple's is only 1.5% (mostly organic growth).

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

商誉从哪来

商誉 = 收购价 − 被购方可辨认净资产的公允价值。它只在企业合并中产生,代表协同、品牌、团队等无法单独辨认的价值。内部产生的商誉不确认。

后续处理

商誉不摊销,而是每年做减值测试;一旦减值,IFRS 与 US GAAP 均不可转回。

易错对比

① 商誉不摊销、只减值;② 内生商誉不入表;③ 商誉减值不可转回(与其他资产不同)。

Where goodwill comes from

Goodwill = purchase price − fair value of the acquiree's identifiable net assets. It arises only in a business combination, capturing synergy, brand, team — value not separately identifiable. Internally generated goodwill is not recognized.

Subsequent treatment

Goodwill is not amortized; it is tested for impairment annually, and once impaired it is not reversible under either IFRS or US GAAP.

Common traps

① Goodwill is not amortized, only impaired; ② internal goodwill is off balance sheet; ③ goodwill impairment is not reversible (unlike other assets).

5. 商誉如何计算、是否摊销:How is goodwill computed, and is it amortized: 官方题Official

  • A. 可辨认净资产 − 收购价Identifiable net assets − purchase price
  • B. 收购总价 − 可辨认净资产公允价值;不摊销,至少每年减值测试Total purchase price − fair value of identifiable net assets; not amortized, impairment-tested at least annually
  • C. 按 10 年直线摊销Straight-line amortized over 10 years
答案 B。商誉减值为非现金项,冲减当期利润。Answer B. Goodwill impairment is a non-cash item that reduces current profit.

6. 会计商誉与经济商誉的区别是:The difference between accounting goodwill and economic goodwill is: 官方题Official

  • A. 经济商誉必须入表Economic goodwill must be booked
  • B. 两者含义相同The two mean the same thing
  • C. 会计商誉只在并购时确认入表;经济商誉基于经济表现、不一定在表上,理论上反映在股价里Accounting goodwill is recognized on the books only at acquisition; economic goodwill is based on economic performance, is not necessarily on the books, and theoretically shows up in the share price
答案 C。只有并购才产生会计商誉。Answer C. Only an acquisition generates accounting goodwill.
1. 收购产生的会计商誉应：1. Accounting goodwill arising from acquisitions is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 在其产生的期间费用化。expensed in the period it arises.
  • B. 资本化并在有限期间摊销。capitalized and amortized over a finite period.
  • C. 资本化并每年进行减值测试。capitalized and tested for impairment annually.
答案 C。收购商誉(goodwill)资本化、不摊销,每年做减值测试(减值不可转回)。US GAAP/IFRS 均不摊销商誉。Answer C. Acquisition goodwill is capitalized, not amortized, and tested for impairment annually (impairment is not reversed). Neither US GAAP nor IFRS amortizes goodwill.

LM3 §4 金融工具的三种计量方式LM3 §4 The Three Measurement Methods for Financial Instruments

LOS 对应:LOS: explain the financial reporting and disclosures related to financial instruments。

金融工具:一份合同,使一方产生金融资产、另一方产生金融负债或权益工具。计量方式基本两类:公允价值或摊余成本。公允价值计量下,价值变动的确认又分两种去向——① 计入利润表(损益);
② 计入其他综合收益 OCI(绕过利润表)。Financial instruments: a contract that creates a financial asset for one party and a financial liability or equity instrument for another. Measurement is basically of two kinds: fair value or amortized cost. Under fair-value measurement, value changes are recognized in one of two places — ① in the income statement (profit or loss);
② in other comprehensive income (OCI) (bypassing the income statement).

计量类别Measurement category典型资产Typical asset未实现利得/损失去向Destination of unrealized gains/losses
摊余成本
(US GAAP: 持有至到期)Amortized cost
(US GAAP: held-to-maturity)		持有至到期的债券、贷款与应收票据Held-to-maturity bonds, loans, and notes receivable不确认公允价值变动;资产按摊余成本列示Fair-value changes are not recognized; the asset is shown at amortized cost
公允价值计入 OCI
(US GAAP: 可供出售债券)Fair value through OCI
(US GAAP: available-for-sale debt)		业务模式"既收本息又出售"的债券;IFRS 下可不可撤销地选择此法的权益投资Bonds under a "collect interest and principal and also sell" business model; under IFRS, equity investments irrevocably designated to this method未实现利得/损失计入其他综合收益,不进利润表;资产按公允价值列示Unrealized gains/losses go to other comprehensive income, not the income statement; the asset is shown at fair value
公允价值计入损益 FVPL
(US GAAP: 交易性证券)Fair value through profit or loss (FVPL)
(US GAAP: trading securities)		交易性债券;US GAAP 下几乎所有权益证券(除非有重大影响)Trading bonds; under US GAAP nearly all equity securities (unless there is significant influence)利息 + 未实现利得/损失都进利润表Interest + unrealized gains/losses all go to the income statement
考点提示:同一笔证券,三种分类对财报影响不同。教材算例(投 1 亿、半年收息 250 万、公允价值升 200 万):
① 摊余成本/持有至到期:利润表只认利息 250 万;
② 公允价值计入 OCI/可供出售:利润表只认利息 250 万,200 万利得进 OCI;
③ FVPL/交易性:利润表认 250 + 200 = 450 万。注意:只有已实现(卖出)的利得损失才一定进利润表。
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

金融工具的三种计量

• 摊余成本(amortized cost):打算持有到期收本息的债务工具。
• FVPL(公允价值,变动计入损益):交易性/短线持有,公允价值变动直接进利润表。
• FVOCI(公允价值,变动计入其他综合收益):变动进 OCI、不进当期损益。

机制

分类决定公允价值变动去哪:进 P&L 会放大利润波动,进 OCI 则绕过当期利润。分类取决于业务模式与现金流性质。

易错对比

① 交易性 → FVPL;② FVOCI 的市值波动不进当期利润;③ 摊余成本适用收合同现金流的债务工具。

Three measurements for financial instruments

• Amortized cost: debt instruments held to collect principal and interest.
• FVPL (fair value through profit or loss): trading/short-term; fair-value changes go straight to the income statement.
• FVOCI (fair value through OCI): changes go to OCI, not current profit.

Mechanism

Classification decides where fair-value changes land: through P&L amplifies profit volatility; through OCI bypasses current profit. It depends on the business model and cash-flow nature.

Common traps

① Trading → FVPL; ② FVOCI market swings do not hit current profit; ③ amortized cost fits debt held to collect contractual cash flows.

7. 三种金融工具计量类别中,把未实现利得计入利润表的是:Among the three measurement categories for financial instruments, the one that puts unrealized gains on the income statement is: 官方题Official

  • A. 公允价值计入 OCI(FVOCI)Fair value through OCI (FVOCI)
  • B. 公允价值计入损益(FVPL,交易性)Fair value through profit or loss (FVPL, held-for-trading)
  • C. 摊余成本Amortized cost
答案 B。FVOCI 的未实现利得计入其他综合收益,不进利润表。Answer B. FVOCI's unrealized gains go to other comprehensive income, not the income statement.

8. 投 1 亿、半年收息 250 万、公允价值升 200 万,三种分类下利润表各确认:Invest $100m, receive $2.5m interest in half a year, fair value rises $2m; each classification recognizes on the income statement: 补充Extra

  • A. 三者都认 450 万All three recognize $4.5m
  • B. 三者都认 250 万All three recognize $2.5m
  • C. 摊余成本 250 万;FVOCI 250 万(200 万进 OCI);FVPL 450 万Amortized cost $2.5m; FVOCI $2.5m ($2m to OCI); FVPL $4.5m
答案 C。只有 FVPL 把 200 万未实现利得计入利润表。Answer C. Only FVPL puts the $2m unrealized gain on the income statement.
1. 某按 US GAAP 报告的公司购买另一公司发行的权益性证券。若该证券占发行公司在外权益不足1%，且收购方不持有其他权益，则该投资在收购方资产负债表上最可能按何种方式列示：1. A company reporting under US GAAP purchases an equity security issued by another company. If the equity security represents less than 1% of the outstanding equity of the issuing company and the acquiring company owns no other equity stake in the issuing company, the investment is most likely carried on the acquiring company's balance sheet at: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 摊余成本。amortized cost.
  • B. 公允价值，未实现持有利得/损失计入利润表。fair value with any unrealized holding gains/losses recognized in the income statement.
  • C. 公允价值，未实现持有利得/损失计入其他综合收益。fair value with any unrealized holding gains/losses recognized in other comprehensive income.
答案 B。持有另一公司 <1% 权益、无重大影响 → 按公允价值计量,未实现利得/损失计入利润表(FVPL)(US GAAP 对权益投资默认 FVPL)。Answer B. Holding <1% of another firm's equity with no significant influence → measured at fair value with unrealized gains/losses through profit or loss (FVPL) (US GAAP's default for equity investments).

LM3 §5 非流动负债与递延所得税LM3 §5 Non-Current Liabilities & Deferred Taxes

LOS 对应:LOS: explain the financial reporting and disclosures related to non-current liabilities。

不属于流动负债的都归为非流动(长期)负债。两类常见:Anything not a current liability is classified as non-current (long-term) liabilities. Two common kinds:

  • 长期金融负债:银行借款、应付票据/债券。一般按摊余成本列报——到期时账面额等于面值。例:折价发行(97.5% 面值)$1000 万债券,发行时记 $975 万负债,$25 万折价在存续期内摊销,到期时记回 $1000 万。(交易性、衍生品等少数情形按公允价值。)Long-term financial liabilities: bank loans, notes/bonds payable. Generally reported at amortized cost — at maturity the carrying amount equals face value. Example: a $10M bond issued at a discount (97.5% of face) is recorded as a $9.75M liability at issue, the $0.25M discount is amortized over the life, and $10M is recorded back at maturity. (Trading, derivatives, and a few other cases are at fair value.)
  • 递延所得税负债:因"税务口径的应税所得"与"财报口径的税前利润"之间的暂时性时间差异产生。典型:公司税务上用加速折旧、财报上用直线折旧——早期税务折旧多、应税所得少、当期实缴税少于财报所得税费用,差额形成递延所得税负债(相当于"欠税以后再交")。Deferred tax liabilities: arise from temporary timing differences between "taxable income on the tax basis" and "pre-tax profit on the reporting basis." Typical: a company uses accelerated depreciation for tax and straight-line for reporting — early on, tax depreciation is larger, taxable income is smaller, and cash tax paid is less than the income-statement tax expense; the difference forms a deferred tax liability (like "owing tax to be paid later").

9. 递延所得税负债如何产生,典型例子是:How does a deferred tax liability arise, and a typical example: 官方题Official

  • A. 因汇率变动From exchange-rate changes
  • B. 因应税所得与财报税前利润的暂时性差异,如税务用加速折旧、财报用直线折旧From a temporary difference between taxable income and pre-tax accounting profit, e.g., accelerated depreciation for tax and straight-line for reporting
  • C. 因永久性差异From a permanent difference
答案 B。早期税务折旧多、实缴税少于财报所得税费用,差额成 DTL。Answer B. Early on, more tax depreciation means tax paid is below the reported tax expense, and the difference becomes a DTL.

LM3 §6 共同比资产负债表与流动性/偿债比率LM3 §6 Common-Size Balance Sheet & Liquidity/Solvency Ratios 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: calculate and interpret common-size balance sheets and related financial ratios。

共同比资产负债表:把每一项都表示为总资产的百分比(利润表共同比是占收入的百分比,别混)。便于跨期和跨公司比较,消除规模影响。Common-size balance sheet: express each item as a percentage of total assets (the common-size income statement is a percentage of revenue, don't confuse them). Eases comparison across time and companies by removing the effect of scale.

6.1 流动性比率(短期偿债能力)

🔰 零基础讲解:流动性 = 手头够不够"救急"

流动性💰 流动性就是"手头能多快凑出现金还眼前的债"。想象月底房租要交,你看看钱包(现金)、随时能卖的股票(有价证券)、朋友马上要还你的钱(应收账款)够不够。三个比率就是把"能救急的资产"从宽到严,分别去比"眼前要还的债(流动负债)"。衡量公司还短期债的能力。三个比率由宽到严:Liquidity💰 Liquidity is "how fast you can scrape together cash to pay imminent debts." Picture rent due at month-end: you check your wallet (cash), stocks you can sell anytime (marketable securities), and money a friend is about to repay you (receivables) to see if it's enough. The three ratios line up "emergency-usable assets" from broad to strict against "imminent debts (current liabilities)." measures a company's ability to pay short-term debts. Three ratios from broad to strict:

流动比率 = 流动资产 / 流动负债
速动比率(酸性测试)= (现金 + 有价证券 + 应收账款) / 流动负债
现金比率 = (现金 + 有价证券) / 流动负债
比率Ratio含义Meaning
流动比率 currentCurrent ratio最宽:所有流动资产 ÷ 流动负债,越高短期偿债能力越强Broadest: all current assets ÷ current liabilities; higher means stronger short-term solvency
速动比率 quickQuick ratio较严:剔除了不易变现的存货和预付费用Stricter: excludes hard-to-liquidate inventory and prepaid expenses
现金比率 cashCash ratio最严:只算现金和有价证券Strictest: counts only cash and marketable securities
教材例题 · SAP 流动比率 官方题Official

2017 年:流动资产 €11,930,流动负债 €10,210 → 流动比率 = 11,930/10,210 = 1.17(2016 年为 1.20,略降)。速动 = (4,011+990+5,899)/10,210 = 1.07;现金 = (4,011+990)/10,210 = 0.49。2017: current assets €11,930, current liabilities €10,210 → current ratio = 11,930/10,210 = 1.17 (1.20 in 2016, a slight decline). Quick = (4,011+990+5,899)/10,210 = 1.07; cash = (4,011+990)/10,210 = 0.49.

6.2 偿债(杠杆)比率(长期偿债能力)

负债权益比 = 总负债 / 总权益    财务杠杆 = 总资产 / 总权益
长期负债权益比 = 长期负债 / 总权益    总负债比率 = 总负债 / 总资产
比率Ratio含义Meaning
负债权益比 debt-to-equityDebt-to-equity反映财务风险与杠杆;越高杠杆越大、风险越高Reflects financial risk and leverage; higher means more leverage and higher risk
财务杠杆 financial leverageFinancial leverage总资产 ÷ 总权益;越高说明用越少的自有资本撬动越多资产Total assets ÷ total equity; higher means using less own capital to lever more assets
考点提示:教材共同比例子里,A 公司近 60% 资产是现金和有价证券 → 流动性强;C 公司 98.5% 资产靠负债融资 → 偿债风险高、A 远比 C 有偿债能力。判断题套路:流动性看短期(现金/流动资产 vs 流动负债)、偿债看长期(负债 vs 权益/资产)。

10. 共同比资产负债表把每项表示为什么的百分比:A common-size balance sheet expresses each item as a percentage of what: 官方题Official

  • A. 占总资产的百分比A percentage of total assets
  • B. 占总负债的百分比A percentage of total liabilities
  • C. 占营业收入的百分比A percentage of revenue
答案 A。资产负债表共同比以总资产为分母,利润表以收入为分母,别混。Answer A. Balance-sheet common-size uses total assets as the denominator, the income statement uses revenue — don't mix them.

11. 流动、速动、现金比率的区别是:The difference among the current, quick, and cash ratios is: 官方题Official

  • A. 现金比率包含存货The cash ratio includes inventory
  • B. 速动比率包含存货The quick ratio includes inventory
  • C. 流动=流动资产/流动负债;速动=(现金+有价证券+应收)/流动负债;现金=(现金+有价证券)/流动负债(最严)Current = current assets/current liabilities; quick = (cash + marketable securities + receivables)/current liabilities; cash = (cash + marketable securities)/current liabilities (strictest)
答案 C。越往后剔除的资产越多、口径越严。Answer C. The further down, the more assets excluded and the stricter the measure.

12. 流动资产 €11,930、流动负债 €10,210,流动比率为:Current assets €11,930, current liabilities €10,210; the current ratio is: 官方题Official

  • A. 1.711.71
  • B. 1.171.17
  • C. 0.860.86
答案 B。11,930/10,210 = 1.17。Answer B. 11,930/10,210 = 1.17.

13. 财务杠杆比率与负债权益比的公式是:The formulas for the financial leverage ratio and the debt-to-equity ratio are: 官方题Official

  • A. 财务杠杆=总权益/总资产Financial leverage = total equity/total assets
  • B. 负债权益比=总资产/总负债Debt-to-equity = total assets/total liabilities
  • C. 财务杠杆=总资产/总权益;负债权益比=总负债/总权益Financial leverage = total assets/total equity; debt-to-equity = total liabilities/total equity
答案 C。两者都衡量财务杠杆与偿债风险。Answer C. Both measure financial leverage and solvency risk.
1. 分析师获得某公司以下信息（单位：百万欧元）：
现金及现金等价物40
流动资产合计125
非流动资产合计35
收入200
对资产负债表进行纵向共同比分析，现金及现金等价物占比为：1. An analyst gathers the following information (in € millions) about a company:
Cash and cash equivalents40
Total current assets125
Total non-current assets35
Revenue200
Applying vertical common-size analysis to the company's balance sheet, cash and cash equivalents are: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 20%。20%.
  • B. 25%。25%.
  • C. 32%。32%.
答案 B。纵向共同比(资产负债表)= 各项 ÷ 总资产。现金/总资产 = 25%。Answer B. Vertical common-size (balance sheet) = each item ÷ total assets. Cash/total assets = 25%.

LM4 §7 三张报表的勾稽关系LM4 §7 The Articulation of the Three Statements

LOS 对应:LOS: describe how the cash flow statement is linked to the income statement and the balance sheet。
🔰 零基础讲解:为什么"有利润"不等于"有钱"?

利润表用权责发生制:货一发出、就算收入,哪怕客户还没付钱。所以一家公司可以账面利润很漂亮,银行卡里却没钱(客户都赊账)。现金流量表🏦 利润表像"记账本",赊出去的也算你赚了;现金流量表像"银行流水",只记真金白银的进出。一家公司可能利润表上笑开花、现金流量表上却在流血——这也是识别财务造假的关键:利润高但经营现金流长期为负,就要警惕。就是专门记录"真金白银进出"的那张表。The income statement uses accrual accounting: revenue is recognized once goods ship, even if the customer hasn't paid. So a company can show great book profit yet have no money in the bank (all sales on credit). The cash flow statement🏦 The income statement is like a "ledger" — credit sales still count as earned; the cash flow statement is like a "bank statement," recording only real cash in and out. A company can be all smiles on the income statement yet bleeding on the cash flow statement — this is also key to spotting financial fraud: high profit but persistently negative operating cash flow is a warning sign. is the statement dedicated to recording "real cash in and out."

四张主要报表相互勾连:资产负债表是时点快照;利润表、现金流量表、股东权益变动表都是"流量表",把上期资产负债表连到下期。The four main statements interlock: the balance sheet is a point-in-time snapshot; the income statement, cash flow statement, and statement of changes in equity are all "flow statements" that connect one period's balance sheet to the next.

期初现金 + 本期现金流入 − 本期现金流出 = 期末现金
勾稽Tie含义Meaning
现金勾稽Cash tie现金流量表底部把上期资产负债表的现金连到本期现金The bottom of the cash flow statement connects the prior period's balance-sheet cash to the current period's cash
应收账款勾稽Receivables tie期初应收 + 收入 − 向客户收到的现金 = 期末应收Beginning receivables + revenue − cash received from customers = ending receivables
留存收益勾稽Retained-earnings tie期初留存收益 + 净利润 − 股利 = 期末留存收益Beginning retained earnings + net income − dividends = ending retained earnings

14. 为什么"账面有利润"不代表"有现金":Why does 'profit on the books' not mean 'cash on hand': 官方题Official

  • A. 利润与现金总是相等Profit and cash are always equal
  • B. 利润表用权责发生制,货一发出就算收入,即使客户赊账未付The income statement uses accrual accounting, counting revenue once goods are shipped even if the customer buys on credit
  • C. 利润表用收付实现制The income statement uses cash accounting
答案 B。利润高而 CFO 为负是识别财务造假的线索。Answer B. High profit but negative CFO is a clue to financial fraud.

LM4 §8 三类现金流 + 直接法 vs 间接法LM4 §8 The Three Cash-Flow Categories + Direct vs Indirect Method

LOS 对应:LOS: describe the steps in the preparation of direct and indirect cash flow statements。

现金流量表把现金进出分为三类活动:The cash flow statement divides cash in and out into three activities:

  • 经营活动 CFO:日常经营(卖货收现、付供应商、付工资)。Operating (CFO): day-to-day operations (cash sales, paying suppliers, paying wages).
  • 投资活动 CFI:买卖长期资产(买设备、卖厂房、买卖投资)。Investing (CFI): buying/selling long-term assets (buying equipment, selling a plant, buying/selling investments).
  • 筹资活动 CFF:与出资人往来(借款、还本、发股、付股利)。Financing (CFF): dealings with capital providers (borrowing, repaying principal, issuing shares, paying dividends).

直接法 vs 间接法(只影响 CFO 的列报)

🔰 零基础讲解:两种方法只是"CFO 怎么写",结果一样

直接法像列银行流水:直接列"从客户收到多少现金、付给供应商多少现金"。间接法像"倒推":从净利润出发,把不花钱的项目(如折旧)加回来、再调整营运资本变化,推出经营现金流。The direct method is like listing a bank statement: it lists "how much cash received from customers, how much cash paid to suppliers." The indirect method "works backward": starting from net income, adding back non-cash items (like depreciation), and adjusting for working-capital changes to derive operating cash flow.

两种方法算出的 CFO 数字完全一样,只是写法不同;而 CFI 和 CFF 无论哪种方法都用直接法列报。间接法最常见。The CFO computed by the two methods is exactly the same number, only written differently; and CFI and CFF are reported by the direct method regardless. The indirect method is most common.

间接法:CFO = 净利润 + 非现金项目(如折旧摊销) ± 营运资本变化
调整项Adjustment方向Direction
折旧、摊销、减值等非现金费用Non-cash expenses like depreciation, amortization, and impairment加回(它们减了利润但没花现金)Add back (they reduced profit but used no cash)
处置资产的利得Gains on asset disposal减去(属于投资活动,不该留在 CFO)Subtract (they belong to investing, should not remain in CFO)
应收账款、存货增加Increases in receivables and inventory减去(占用了现金)Subtract (they tie up cash)
应付账款等增加Increases in payables, etc.加上(占用了别人的钱,等于省了现金)Add (they use others' money, effectively saving cash)

直接法算"向客户收到的现金":收入 ± 应收账款变化。应收增加说明"赊的比收的多",收入高于现金,要减去增加额。教材 Acme 例:收入 23,598 − 应收增加 55 = 向客户收现 23,543。Direct method computing "cash received from customers": revenue ± change in receivables. An increase in receivables means "more sold on credit than collected," revenue exceeds cash, so subtract the increase. Textbook Acme example: revenue 23,598 − receivables increase 55 = cash from customers 23,543.

从间接法完整转换为直接法 🔥 必会演示

LOS 对应:LOS: demonstrate the conversion of cash flows from the indirect to direct method。
客户收现 = 销售收入 − 应收账款增加
采购额 = COGS + 存货增加；支付供应商现金 = 采购额 − 应付账款增加
支付经营费用现金 = 相关费用 − 相关应付负债增加 + 相关预付资产增加
支付所得税现金 = 所得税费用 − 应付所得税增加
完整转换例题

公司销售收入 1,000、COGS 600、工资费用 180、利息费用 20、所得税费用 70，净利润 130。应收账款增加 30、存货增加 30、应付账款增加 20、应付工资减少 5、应付所得税增加 6。Company: sales revenue 1,000, COGS 600, wage expense 180, interest expense 20, income tax expense 70, net income 130. Receivables up 30, inventory up 30, payables up 20, wages payable down 5, income tax payable up 6.

直接法项目Direct-method item计算Calculation现金流Cash flow
客户收现Cash from customers1,000−30970
采购额Purchases600+30630
支付供应商Paid to suppliers630−20610
支付工资Wages paid180−(−5)185
支付利息Interest paid应付利息不变Interest payable unchanged20
支付所得税Income tax paid70−664
直接法 CFODirect-method CFO970−610−185−20−6491

交叉验证：间接法 CFO = 130−30−30+20−5+6 = 91。两种方法结果相同。应付负债增加代表费用尚未付现，所以从费用中减去；应付负债减少则代表本期多付现金。Cross-check: indirect-method CFO = 130−30−30+20−5+6 = 91. Both methods give the same result. An increase in a payable means the expense has not yet been paid in cash, so it is subtracted from the expense; a decrease in a payable means more cash was paid this period.

易错点：先由 COGS 推采购额，再由采购额推供应商现金付款，不能直接用 COGS 调整应付账款；处置资产利得在间接法中扣除，但出售资产收到的现金归 CFI，不进入直接法 CFO。

15. 现金流量表把现金分为哪三类活动:The cash-flow statement divides cash into which three activities: 官方题Official

  • A. 收入、成本、利润Revenue, cost, profit
  • B. 流动、非流动、权益Current, non-current, equity
  • C. 经营(CFO)、投资(CFI)、筹资(CFF)Operating (CFO), investing (CFI), financing (CFF)
答案 C。CFO/CFI/CFF 三分法。Answer C. The CFO/CFI/CFF three-way split.

16. 直接法与间接法的区别、影响范围与 CFO 结果:The difference between the direct and indirect methods, their scope, and the CFO result: 官方题Official

  • A. 两法算出的 CFO 不同The two give different CFO
  • B. 只影响 CFO 列报,直接法列毛收付、间接法从净利润倒推;两法 CFO 数字相同They affect only the CFO presentation — the direct method lists gross receipts/payments and the indirect method works back from net income; both give the same CFO figure
  • C. 影响 CFI 与 CFFThey affect CFI and CFF
答案 B。CFI、CFF 都用直接法;两法 CFO 恒等。Answer B. CFI and CFF both use the direct method; CFO is identical under both.

17. 间接法下,折旧与"处置资产利得"分别如何调整:Under the indirect method, how are depreciation and 'gain on asset disposal' adjusted, respectively: 官方题Official

  • A. 折旧减去;利得加回Depreciation subtracted; gain added back
  • B. 两者都加回Both added back
  • C. 折旧加回;处置资产利得减去(属投资活动)Depreciation added back; gain on disposal subtracted (it belongs to investing)
答案 C。非现金费用加回,投资性利得从 CFO 剔除。Answer C. Non-cash expenses are added back and investing gains are removed from CFO.

18. 收入 23,598、应收账款增加 55,向客户收到的现金为:Revenue 23,598, accounts receivable increased 55; cash received from customers is: 官方题Official

  • A. 23,54323,543
  • B. 23,65323,653
  • C. 5555
答案 A。应收增加=赊多于收,现金=23,598−55=23,543。Answer A. A rise in receivables = more credit sales than collections, so cash = 23,598 − 55 = 23,543.
1. 在间接法编制经营活动现金流时，递延所得税负债的减少应：1. Under the indirect method of reporting cash flow from operating activities, a decrease in deferred income tax liabilities is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 忽略不计。ignored.
  • B. 加回净利润。added back to net income.
  • C. 从净利润中扣减。subtracted from net income.
答案 C。间接法:递延所得税负债减少 → 从净利中"扣减"(该项是非现金费用的反向:DTL 减少意味着当期实际多缴税、现金流出)。Answer C. Indirect method: a decrease in a deferred tax liability is subtracted from net income (a falling DTL means more cash tax was actually paid this period — a cash outflow).
2. 分析师获得某公司会计年度以下信息：
1月1日应付利息£45,000
当年支付利息现金£15,000
当年利息费用£50,000

  • A. £30,000。£30,000.

答案 B。方法:期末应付利息 = 期初 + 利息费用 − 已付利息现金。按表倒推 ≈ £80,000。Answer B. Method: ending interest payable = beginning + interest expense − interest cash paid. Working the table ≈ £80,000.

The company sold equipment having a historical cost of €5,000,000 and reported a loss on sale of €250,000. The cash received from the sale of equipment is: 真题模考Mock

  • B. €1,750,000。€1,750,000.

6. 基于利润表和资产负债表数据计算支付给供应商的现金时，销售成本应针对下列哪项的变动进行调整：6. When calculating cash paid to suppliers based on income statement and balance sheet data, cost of sales is adjusted for changes in: 真题模考Mock

答案 C。算付给供应商的现金要对销售成本作存货和应付账款"两者"的调整:付现 = 销货成本 + 存货增加 − 应付增加。Answer C. Computing cash paid to suppliers adjusts COGS for both inventory and accounts payable: cash = COGS + increase in inventory − increase in payables.
7. 一家净利润为正的公司若发生下列何种情况，可能报告经营活动现金流为负：7. A company with positive net income could report negative cash flow from operating activities if the company: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 赎回在外债券。retires outstanding bonds.
  • B. 确认大额折旧费用。recognizes significant depreciation expense.
  • C. 实现固定资产出售利得。realizes a gain from the sale of a fixed asset.
答案 C。净利为正却经营现金流为负,常因确认了固定资产出售"利得"——利得进净利但属投资活动,间接法要从经营中扣除,可能把CFO拉负。折旧是加回项(利好CFO)。Answer C. Positive net income but negative operating cash flow often arises from a gain on selling fixed assets — the gain is in net income but belongs to investing, so it is subtracted from operations, potentially turning CFO negative. Depreciation is added back (helps CFO).

LM4 §9 IFRS vs US GAAP 现金流分类差异LM4 §9 IFRS vs US GAAP Cash-Flow Classification Differences 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: contrast cash flow statements prepared under IFRS and US GAAP。

这是现金流部分最爱考的一张表。US GAAP 分类固定,IFRS 更灵活:This is the most frequently tested table in the cash-flow section. US GAAP classification is fixed, IFRS is more flexible:

项目ItemIFRSUS GAAP
收到的利息Interest received经营 或 投资Operating or investing经营Operating
支付的利息Interest paid经营 或 筹资Operating or financing经营Operating
收到的股利Dividends received经营 或 投资Operating or investing经营Operating
支付的股利Dividends paid经营 或 筹资Operating or financing筹资Financing
支付的所得税Income taxes paid一般经营,可辨认部分归投资/筹资Generally operating; identifiable portions to investing/financing经营Operating
银行透支Bank overdraft视为现金等价物的一部分Treated as part of cash equivalents不算,归筹资Not included, classified as financing
考点提示:记忆技巧——US GAAP 下利息收付、股利收到、所得税全进经营,只有"支付的股利"进筹资;IFRS 全部"二选一"更灵活。这直接影响 CFO 的可比性:同样一家公司,把"支付利息"放筹资(IFRS 允许)会让 CFO 显得更高。格式上两者都可用直接或间接法(都鼓励直接法),但 US GAAP 无论用哪种都必须附"净利润→CFO"的调节表。

19. US GAAP 下,支付利息、收到股利、支付股利分别归哪类活动:Under US GAAP, interest paid, dividends received, and dividends paid are classified as which activities: 官方题Official

  • A. 三者都进经营All three → operating
  • B. 支付利息→经营;收到股利→经营;支付股利→筹资Interest paid → operating; dividends received → operating; dividends paid → financing
  • C. 支付利息→筹资;收到股利→投资Interest paid → financing; dividends received → investing
答案 B。US GAAP 只有"支付股利"进筹资,其余利息股利税都进经营。Answer B. Under US GAAP only 'dividends paid' is financing; interest, dividends, and taxes otherwise go to operating.

20. IFRS 相比 US GAAP 在现金流分类上的特点是:The feature of IFRS relative to US GAAP in cash-flow classification is: 官方题Official

  • A. 更严格,分类完全固定Stricter, with fully fixed classification
  • B. 与 US GAAP 完全一致Identical to US GAAP
  • C. 更灵活:利息、股利收付可在经营/投资/筹资间二选一,影响 CFO 可比性More flexible: interest and dividends received/paid can be placed in operating/investing/financing at the firm's choice, affecting CFO comparability
答案 C。IFRS 的分类弹性会削弱 CFO 的跨公司可比性。Answer C. IFRS's classification flexibility weakens cross-company comparability of CFO.
1. 在现金流量表中，已付利息应分类为：1. On the statement of cash flows, interest paid should be classified as: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅筹资活动现金流。a financing cash flow only.
  • B. 仅经营活动现金流。an operating cash flow only.
  • C. 筹资或经营活动现金流均可。either a financing or an operating cash flow.
答案 C。已付利息:IFRS 可列经营或筹资;US GAAP 只列经营。故"经营或筹资均可"(泛指两准则合起来看)。Answer C. Interest paid: IFRS allows operating or financing; US GAAP requires operating. Hence "either operating or financing" (across the two standards).
2. 在现金流量表中，利息支付可在何种准则下分类为筹资活动现金流：2. On the statement of cash flows, interest payments may be classified as a financing cash flow under: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅 IFRS。IFRS only.
  • B. 仅 US GAAP。US GAAP only.
  • C. IFRS 与 US GAAP 均可。both IFRS and US GAAP.
答案 A。利息支付列作"筹资"活动 → 仅 IFRS 允许。US GAAP 规定利息付款只能进经营。Answer A. Classifying interest paid as financing → only IFRS allows it. US GAAP requires interest paid in operating.
3. 在现金流量表中，已付现金股利可在何种准则下分类为经营活动：3. On the statement of cash flows, cash dividends paid may be classified as an operating activity under: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅 IFRS。IFRS only.
  • B. 仅 US GAAP。US GAAP only.
  • C. IFRS 与 US GAAP 均可。both IFRS and US GAAP.
答案 A。已付现金股利列作"经营"活动 → 仅 IFRS 允许。US GAAP 规定股利支付只能进筹资。Answer A. Classifying dividends paid as operating → only IFRS allows it. US GAAP requires dividends paid in financing.

LM5 §10 自由现金流 FCFF 与 FCFELM5 §10 Free Cash Flow: FCFF & FCFE 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: calculate and interpret free cash flow to the firm and free cash flow to equity。
🔰 零基础讲解:自由现金流 = "真正能自由分配的钱"

公司赚的经营现金,得先拿一部分去买设备、维持运转(资本开支)。剩下能自由分配的才是"自由现金流"。FCFF 是分给所有出资人(债主 + 股东)之前的自由现金;FCFE 是还完债主后、只剩给股东的自由现金。The operating cash a company earns must first go partly to buying equipment and keeping running (capex). What remains freely distributable is "free cash flow." FCFF is the free cash before distribution to all capital providers (creditors + shareholders); FCFE is the free cash left only for shareholders after paying off creditors.

FCFF = NI + NCC + Int×(1 − 税率) − FCInv − WCInv
FCFF = CFO + Int×(1 − 税率) − FCInv  (从 CFO 出发更快)
符号Symbol含义Meaning
NI净利润 net incomeNet income
NCC非现金费用 non-cash charges(折旧、摊销)Non-cash charges (depreciation, amortization)
Int×(1−税率)Int×(1−tax rate)税后利息:因 FCFF 是给债主+股东的现金,要把已扣的税后利息加回After-tax interest: because FCFF is cash to creditors + shareholders, the deducted after-tax interest must be added back
FCInv固定资本投资(资本开支,买设备等)Fixed capital investment (capex, buying equipment, etc.)
WCInv营运资本投资Working-capital investment
FCFE = CFO − FCInv + 净借款
符号Symbol含义Meaning
净借款 net borrowingNet borrowing新借款 − 还款;若为负(还的比借的多),则 FCFE = CFO − FCInv − 净还款New borrowing − repayments; if negative (repaying more than borrowing), then FCFE = CFO − FCInv − net repayment
关系RelationshipFCFE 比 FCFF 少了"给债主的部分";正的 FCFE 表示付完资本开支和还债后,还有钱可分给股东FCFE is FCFF less "the part to creditors"; positive FCFE means that after capex and debt repayment there is still cash to distribute to shareholders
教材算例 · Acme 的 FCFF 与 FCFE 官方题Official

CFO = 2,606,税后利息 = 258×(1−0.34) = 170,固定资本净投资 = 1,300 − 762 = 538,还债 500。CFO = 2,606, after-tax interest = 258×(1−0.34) = 170, net fixed-capital investment = 1,300 − 762 = 538, debt repayment 500.

FCFF = 2,606 + 170 − 538 = 2,238;FCFE = 2,606 − 538 − 500 = 1,568。

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

自由现金流:FCFF vs FCFE

• FCFF(公司自由现金流,归债+股): = 净利 + 非现金 + 利息×(1−税率) − 资本支出 − 营运资本增加;或 = CFO + 利息×(1−t) − 资本支出(美国 GAAP 下利息在 CFO 时)。
• FCFE(股权自由现金流,归股东): = CFO − 资本支出 + 净借款;或 = FCFF − 利息×(1−t) + 净借款。

机制

FCFF 站在全体资本角度,故加回税后利息;FCFE 已扣利息与还本,只剩股东能拿的。折现:FCFF 用 WACC、FCFE 用权益成本。

易错对比

① FCFF 加回税后利息、FCFE 不加;② FCFE 要加净借款;③ 折现率别配错(FCFF↔WACC、FCFE↔r)。

Free cash flow: FCFF vs FCFE

• FCFF (to all capital, debt + equity): = net income + non-cash + interest×(1−tax) − capex − increase in working capital; or = CFO + interest×(1−t) − capex (when interest is in CFO under US GAAP).
• FCFE (to equity): = CFO − capex + net borrowing; or = FCFF − interest×(1−t) + net borrowing.

Mechanism

FCFF takes the all-capital view, so it adds back after-tax interest; FCFE is after interest and principal, leaving only what equity gets. Discount: FCFF with WACC, FCFE with the cost of equity.

Common traps

① FCFF adds back after-tax interest, FCFE does not; ② FCFE adds net borrowing; ③ don't mismatch the rate (FCFF↔WACC, FCFE↔r).

21. FCFF 的公式及为何要加回税后利息:The FCFF formula and why after-tax interest is added back: 官方题Official

  • A. 无需加回利息No need to add back interest
  • B. FCFF = CFO + Int(1−t) − FCInv;因 FCFF 是给债主与股东的现金,利息已从利润中扣过要加回FCFF = CFO + Int(1−t) − FCInv; because FCFF is cash to both creditors and shareholders, and interest already deducted from profit must be added back
  • C. FCFF = CFO − IntFCFF = CFO − Int
答案 B。等价式 FCFF = NI + NCC + Int(1−t) − FCInv − WCInv。Answer B. The equivalent form is FCFF = NI + NCC + Int(1−t) − FCInv − WCInv.

22. FCFE 的公式及与 FCFF 的区别:The FCFE formula and its difference from FCFF: 官方题Official

  • A. FCFE = CFO + 利息FCFE = CFO + interest
  • B. FCFE 一定大于 FCFFFCFE is always larger than FCFF
  • C. FCFE = CFO − FCInv + 净借款;只给股东,比 FCFF 少了给债主的部分FCFE = CFO − FCInv + net borrowing; it goes only to shareholders and is smaller than FCFF by the portion paid to creditors
答案 C。FCFE 已扣除对债主的偿付,加回净借款。Answer C. FCFE has already deducted payments to creditors and adds back net borrowing.

23. CFO=2,606、税后利息=170、固定资本净投资=538、还债 500,FCFF 与 FCFE 分别为:CFO = 2,606, after-tax interest = 170, net fixed-capital investment = 538, debt repayment 500; FCFF and FCFE are, respectively: 官方题Official

  • A. FCFF=2,776,FCFE=2,068FCFF = 2,776, FCFE = 2,068
  • B. FCFF=2,238,FCFE=1,568FCFF = 2,238, FCFE = 1,568
  • C. FCFF=1,568,FCFE=2,238FCFF = 1,568, FCFE = 2,238
答案 B。FCFF=2,606+170−538=2,238;FCFE=2,606−538−500=1,568。Answer B. FCFF = 2,606 + 170 − 538 = 2,238; FCFE = 2,606 − 538 − 500 = 1,568.

LM5 §11 现金流比率LM5 §11 Cash-Flow Ratios

现金流比率分两类:业绩(盈利)比率和覆盖(偿债)比率。都以 CFO 为核心。Cash-flow ratios come in two kinds: performance (profitability) ratios and coverage (solvency) ratios. Both center on CFO.

比率Ratio计算Calculation衡量Measures
现金流对收入Cash flow to revenueCFO / 营业收入CFO / revenue每 1 元收入产生的经营现金Operating cash per $1 of revenue
现金资产回报Cash return on assetsCFO / 平均总资产CFO / average total assets每 1 元资产产生的经营现金Operating cash per $1 of assets
现金对利润Cash to incomeCFO / 营业利润CFO / operating profit经营的现金生成能力Cash-generating ability of operations
债务覆盖Debt coverageCFO / 总债务CFO / total debt财务风险与杠杆Financial risk and leverage
利息覆盖Interest coverage(CFO + 已付利息 + 已付税) / 已付利息(CFO + interest paid + tax paid) / interest paid偿付利息的能力Ability to pay interest
再投资 / 债务偿还 / 股利支付Reinvestment / debt payment / dividend paymentCFO / 相应现金支出CFO / the corresponding cash outlay用经营现金购置资产、还债、分红的能力Ability to buy assets, repay debt, and pay dividends with operating cash

24. 现金流利息覆盖比率的公式是:The formula for the cash-flow interest coverage ratio is: 官方题Official

  • A. CFO / 总负债CFO / total liabilities

  • C. (CFO + 已付利息 + 已付税) / 已付利息(CFO + interest paid + taxes paid) / interest paid
答案 C。衡量用经营现金偿付利息的能力。Answer C. It measures the ability to cover interest with operating cash.

第三讲 · 存货分析 & 长期资产分析Lecture 3 · Inventory Analysis & Long-Term Asset Analysis

对应教材:FSA — Learning Module 6《Analysis of Inventories》+ Learning Module 7《Analysis of Long-Term Assets》 · 建议学习时长:3–4 小时 · 建议分两次学完(存货约 1.5 小时,长期资产约 2 小时)Curriculum: FSA — Learning Module 6 Analysis of Inventories + Learning Module 7 Analysis of Long-Term Assets · Suggested study time: 3–4 hours · Best done in two sittings (inventory ~1.5 hours, long-term assets ~2 hours)

前两讲讲了三张报表本身。这一讲深入两类具体资产:存货(卖的货)和长期资产(用的设备、专利、商誉)。The first two lectures covered the three statements themselves. This lecture goes deeper into two specific asset classes: inventory (goods for sale) and long-term assets (equipment, patents, goodwill in use).

高频计算点很集中:成本与可变现净值孰低、通胀下 FIFO vs LIFO 的差异、存货周转率、资产减值(IFRS 两步 vs US GAAP)、处置损益。每个难点都配了 🔰 零基础讲解,关键术语鼠标悬停(💡)还有生动比喻。The high-frequency calculation points are concentrated: lower of cost and net realizable value, the FIFO vs LIFO difference under inflation, inventory turnover, asset impairment (IFRS two-step vs US GAAP), and disposal gain/loss. Every difficulty comes with a 🔰 Beginner explainer, and key terms have vivid analogies on mouse hover (💡).
