LM6 §1 存货计量:成本与可变现净值孰低LM6 §1 Inventory Measurement: Lower of Cost and NRV

LOS 对应:LOS: describe the measurement of inventory at the lower of cost and net realisable value。
🔰 零基础讲解:存货为什么要"孰低"计量?

存货📦 存货就是公司仓库里等着卖的货——服装店的衣服、手机厂的手机。会计很谨慎:如果这批货砸手里贬值了(过时、滞销、跌价),就得立刻按更低的价记账、认亏,不能还挂着当初的高成本自欺欺人。这叫"成本与可变现净值孰低"。怕的是"货砸手里贬值"——比如去年的手机今年卖不动、只能降价甩卖。Inventory📦 Inventory is the goods sitting in a company's warehouse waiting to be sold — clothes in an apparel store, phones in a phone factory. Accounting is cautious: if the goods lose value on your hands (obsolete, unsellable, marked down), you must immediately record them at the lower value and recognize the loss, not keep carrying them at the original high cost and fool yourself. This is "lower of cost and net realizable value." fears "goods losing value on your hands" — e.g., last year's phones won't sell this year and can only be dumped at a markdown.

会计原则:存货按成本和可变现净值(NRV)两者中的较低者记在资产负债表上。一旦 NRV 跌破成本,就要减记(write-down)并认作费用。Accounting principle: inventory is carried on the balance sheet at the lower of cost and net realizable value (NRV). Once NRV falls below cost, a write-down is required and recognized as an expense.

可变现净值(NRV)= 正常经营下的估计售价 − 完成销售所需的估计成本。Net realizable value (NRV) = the estimated selling price in the ordinary course of business − the estimated costs to complete the sale.

考点提示(IFRS vs US GAAP 高频):
① IFRS:按"成本与 NRV 孰低"计量,且允许减值转回(转回以原减记额为限,冲减销货成本)。
② US GAAP:非 LIFO/零售法用"成本与 NRV 孰低";LIFO/零售法用"成本与市价孰低"(市价=重置成本,受 NRV 上限和"NRV−正常利润"下限约束),且禁止转回。一句话记:减值转回——IFRS 可以,US GAAP 不行。

1. 存货在资产负债表上按什么计量,NRV 如何算:On what basis is inventory measured on the balance sheet, and how is NRV computed: 官方题Official

  • A. 一律按公允价值Always fair value
  • B. 成本与可变现净值(NRV)孰低;NRV=估计售价−完成销售所需的估计成本The lower of cost and net realizable value (NRV); NRV = estimated selling price − estimated costs to complete the sale
  • C. 一律按历史成本Always historical cost
答案 B。存货遵循成本与 NRV 孰低原则。Answer B. Inventory follows the lower-of-cost-and-NRV principle.
1. 分析师获得某公司第1年12月31日商品存货以下信息（单位：百万欧元）：
成本65
可变现净值60
当前重置成本58
在第2年12月31日，存货可变现净值高于其账面价值 €7 百万。在 US GAAP 下，前期减记的转回金额（单位：百万欧元）为：1. An analyst gathers the following information (in € millions) relating to a company's merchandise inventory as of 31 December of Year 1:
Cost65
Net realizable value60
Current replacement cost58
On 31 December of Year 2, the net realizable value of the inventory is €7 million higher than its carrying value. Under US GAAP, the amount (in € millions) of the reversal of the prior write-down is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 0。0.
  • B. 5。5.
  • C. 7。7.
答案 A。US GAAP 下存货减记不可转回 → 即使 NRV 回升 €7 百万,转回金额 = 0。只有 IFRS 才允许在原减记范围内转回。Answer A. Under US GAAP, inventory write-downs cannot be reversed → even if NRV recovers by €7 million, the reversal = 0. Only IFRS allows reversal up to the original write-down.
2. 在 US GAAP 下，下列哪项是关于存货的必需财务报表披露？2. Under US GAAP, which of the following is a required financial statement disclosure concerning inventory? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 后进先出存货清算产生的重大收益金额The material amount of income resulting from the liquidation of LIFO inventory
  • B. 确认为销售成本减少的任何减记转回金额The amount of any reversal of a write-down recognized as a reduction in cost of goods sold
  • C. 后进先出清算收益与减记转回金额两者Both the LIFO liquidation income and the amount of any write-down reversal
答案 A。US GAAP 存货必需披露之一:LIFO 清算产生的重大收益。而"减记转回"US GAAP 不允许、无需披露该项。Answer A. A required US GAAP inventory disclosure: material gains from LIFO liquidation. Write-down reversals do not exist under US GAAP, so there is no such disclosure.
3. 下列哪项是 US GAAP 下必需的存货相关财务报表披露？3. Which of the following is an inventory-related financial statement disclosure required under US GAAP? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 以公允价值减去销售成本计量的存货账面金额。The carrying amount of inventories carried at fair value less costs to sell.
  • B. 导致前期存货减记转回的情形。The circumstances that led to the reversal of a prior-year write-down of inventories.
  • C. 确认为销售成本减少的任何前期减记转回金额。The amount of reversal of any prior-year write-down recognized as a reduction in cost of sales.
答案 A。US GAAP 必需披露:以"公允价值减销售成本"计量的存货账面金额。转回相关项属 IFRS,US GAAP 不适用。Answer A. A required US GAAP disclosure: the carrying amount of inventories measured at fair value less costs to sell. Reversal-related items are IFRS matters, not US GAAP.
4. 分析师获得某制造企业存货以下信息（单位：千欧元）：
期末存货成本750
正常经营中的估计售价1,100
估计销售必要成本50
使存货达到可销售状态的估计成本50
存货的可变现净值（单位：千欧元）为：4. An analyst gathers the following information (in € thousands) about a manufacturing company's inventory:
Cost of ending inventory750
Estimated selling price in the ordinary course of business1,100
Estimated costs necessary to sell the inventory50
Estimated costs to get the inventory in condition for sale50
The net realizable value of the inventory (in € thousands) is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 750。750.
  • B. 850。850.
  • C. 1,000。1,000.
答案 C。可变现净值(NRV)= 估计售价 − 完工成本 − 销售成本。按表计算 ≈ 1,000。存货按"成本与 NRV 孰低"。Answer C. Net realizable value (NRV) = estimated selling price − costs to complete − costs to sell. Per the table ≈ 1,000. Inventory is carried at the lower of cost and NRV.
5. 分析师获得某零售商存货以下信息（单位：百万英镑）：
原始成本250
可变现净值255
可变现净值减正常利润240
期末存货的账面金额（单位：百万英镑）为：5. An analyst gathers the following information (in £ millions) about a retailer's inventory:
Original cost250
Net realizable value255
Net realizable value less a normal profit margin240
The carrying amount (in £ millions) of ending inventory is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 240。240.
  • B. 250。250.
  • C. 255。255.
答案 B。存货账面 = 成本与可变现净值(NRV)孰低。按表取较低者 ≈ 250。Answer B. Inventory carrying amount = lower of cost and NRV. Taking the lower per the table ≈ 250.
6. 若前期已减记的存货其后价值回升，最初减记的金额可在何种准则下转回：6. If inventory that was written down in a previous period subsequently increases in value, the amount of the original write-down may be reversed under: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅 IFRS。IFRS only.
  • B. 仅 US GAAP。US GAAP only.
  • C. IFRS 与 US GAAP 均可。both IFRS and US GAAP.
答案 A。存货减记转回 → 仅 IFRS 允许(在原减记范围内)。US GAAP 一律不许转回。Answer A. Inventory write-down reversal → only IFRS allows it (up to the original write-down). US GAAP never permits reversal.
7. 某电子制造商以成本与下列何者孰低计量其存货：7. An electronics manufacturer measures its inventories at the lower of cost and: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 重置成本。replacement cost.
  • B. 可变现净值。net realizable value.
  • C. 估计售价。estimated selling price.
答案 B。存货按成本与"可变现净值(NRV)"孰低计量(IFRS;US GAAP 一般也是 LCNRV,LIFO/零售法除外用市值)。重置成本、估计售价都不是计量基准本身。Answer B. Inventory is measured at the lower of cost and net realizable value (NRV) (IFRS; US GAAP also uses LCNRV except LIFO/retail using market). Replacement cost and estimated selling price are not the measurement base themselves.
8. 分析师获得某公司商品存货某项目以下信息（单位：千欧元）：
原始成本18
第1年12月31日可变现净值15
第2年12月31日可变现净值20
该存货项目在第2年12月31日资产负债表上列示为：8. An analyst gathers the following information (in € thousands) about an item in a company's merchandise inventory:
Original cost18
Net realizable value at 31 December of Year 115
Net realizable value at 31 December of Year 220
The inventory item (in € thousands) is carried on the 31 December of Year 2 balance sheet at: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 15。15.
  • B. 18。18.
  • C. 20。20.
答案 B。方法:资产负债表列示 = 成本与 NRV 孰低。按表取较低者 ≈ 18。Answer B. Method: balance-sheet value = lower of cost and NRV. Taking the lower per the table ≈ 18.

LM6 §2 存货减值对财报和比率的影响LM6 §2 The Effect of Inventory Write-Downs on Statements & Ratios

存货减值同时干两件事:压低利润(认了费用)、压低资产(存货账面值变小)。它对各类比率的影响方向不同,是考试爱挖的坑:An inventory write-down does two things at once: lowers profit (recognizes an expense) and lowers assets (the inventory carrying amount shrinks). Its effect on different ratios goes in different directions — a favorite exam trap:

比率类型Ratio type减值后的影响Effect after write-down原因Reason
盈利比率(毛利率、净利率)Profitability ratios (gross margin, net margin)变差 ↓Worse ↓费用增加、利润减少Expenses up, profit down
流动性/偿债比率Liquidity/solvency ratios变差 ↓Worse ↓资产和权益减少Assets and equity decrease
活动比率(存货周转率、总资产周转率)Activity ratios (inventory turnover, total asset turnover)变好 ↑Better ↑分母(资产)变小,周转率反而升高The denominator (assets) shrinks, so turnover actually rises
考点提示:因为减值会压低当期利润(有些还触发债务契约里的财务比率限制),所以一些公司不愿主动减值,除非跌价证据非常确凿——在 US GAAP 下尤其如此(反正减值转回不了)。另:用 LIFO 的公司比用 FIFO/加权平均的更不容易发生减值——因为 LIFO 下账面存货已经是最老、最低的成本,本身就很保守。

2. 存货减值转回,IFRS 与 US GAAP 的规定分别是:The rules for reversing an inventory write-down under IFRS vs US GAAP are: 官方题Official

  • A. IFRS 禁止,US GAAP 允许IFRS prohibits, US GAAP allows
  • B. 两者都禁止Both prohibit
  • C. IFRS 允许转回(以原减记额为限,冲减 COGS);US GAAP 禁止转回IFRS allows reversal (up to the original write-down, crediting COGS); US GAAP prohibits reversal
答案 C。存货减值转回是 IFRS 与 US GAAP 的典型差异点。Answer C. Reversal of inventory write-downs is a classic IFRS/US GAAP difference.

3. 存货减值对盈利比率与活动比率(周转率)的影响是:The effect of an inventory write-down on profitability ratios and activity (turnover) ratios is: 官方题Official

  • A. 两类比率都不变Both types unchanged
  • B. 盈利/流动性比率变差;活动比率(周转率)变好(分母资产变小)Profitability/liquidity ratios worsen; activity ratios (turnover) improve (the asset denominator shrinks)
  • C. 盈利比率变好、周转率变差Profitability improves, turnover worsens
答案 B。资产减少抬高周转率,但盈利与流动性变差。Answer B. Fewer assets raise turnover, but profitability and liquidity worsen.

4. 成本 €5.2M、NRV €4.9M,2017 减记;2018 若 NRV 回升 €0.5M(IFRS)如何处理:Cost €5.2M, NRV €4.9M, written down in 2017; if NRV recovers €0.5M in 2018 (IFRS), how is it handled: 官方题Official

  • A. 2018 全额转回 €0.5M2018 full reversal of €0.5M
  • B. 2017 减记 €0.5M2017 write-down €0.5M
  • C. 2017 减记 €0.3M;2018 转回以原 €0.3M 为限、冲减 COGS €0.3M2017 write-down €0.3M; 2018 reversal capped at the original €0.3M, crediting COGS €0.3M
答案 C。转回上限为原减记额,不能超过。Answer C. The reversal is capped at the original write-down and cannot exceed it.
1. 在 US GAAP 下、其他条件相同，在存货数量稳定而单位成本上升的期间，哪种存货计价方法最不可能发生存货减记？1. Under US GAAP and all else being equal, in a period of stable inventory quantities and rising inventory unit costs, which inventory valuation method is least likely to incur inventory write-downs? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 先进先出法FIFO
  • B. 后进先出法LIFO
  • C. 加权平均成本法Weighted average cost
答案 B。成本上升期,LIFO 把"最新高成本"计入销货成本、留"旧低成本"在存货 → 存货账面已偏低,最不可能触发减记。FIFO 存货是高成本、更易减记。Answer B. In rising-cost periods, LIFO puts the newest high costs into COGS and leaves old low costs in inventory → inventory is already low, so it is least likely to be written down. FIFO holds high-cost inventory, more prone to write-downs.
2. 下列哪一比率最可能因当年存货减记而上升？2. Which of the following ratios will most likely increase as a result of an inventory write-down in the current year? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 速动比率Quick ratio
  • B. 流动比率Current ratio
  • C. 营运资本周转率Working capital turnover ratio
答案 C。存货减记 → 存货(分母)下降 → 营运资本周转率(销售/营运资本)上升。速动、流动比率因流动资产下降而下降,故 A、B 错。Answer C. A write-down lowers inventory (a denominator) → the working-capital turnover (sales/working capital) rises. Quick and current ratios fall as current assets drop, so A and B are wrong.
3. 其他条件相同，某电子制造公司的存货减记会导致下列何者上升：3. All else being equal, an inventory write-down by an electronics manufacturing company results in a higher: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 毛利率（相较于未发生减记）。gross profit margin than if the write-down had not occurred.
  • B. 总资产周转率（相较于未发生减记）。total asset turnover ratio than if the write-down had not occurred.
  • C. 存货在手天数（相较于未发生减记）。days of inventory on hand than if the write-down had not occurred.
答案 B。存货减记 → 总资产下降 → 总资产周转率(销售/总资产)上升。毛利率下降(减记进销货成本)、存货在手天数下降,故 A、C 反。Answer B. A write-down lowers total assets → total-asset turnover (sales/assets) rises. Gross margin falls (the write-down hits COGS) and days-inventory falls, so A and C are reversed.

LM6 §3 通胀/通缩下 FIFO vs LIFO vs 加权平均LM6 §3 FIFO vs LIFO vs Weighted-Average Under Inflation/Deflation 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: calculate and explain how inflation and deflation of inventory costs affect the financial statements and ratios。
🔰 零基础讲解:三种"成本流转假设"是什么?

仓库里同一种货,是分几批、不同价格进的。卖出去时,到底算的是哪一批的成本?这就需要一个假设:The same good in the warehouse was bought in several batches at different prices. When it is sold, which batch's cost is used? This needs an assumption:

  • FIFO 先进先出🥛 想象超市货架上的牛奶:员工总把最早进的(快过期的)摆前面先卖。FIFO 假设"卖出去的是最早进的那批",于是留在仓库里的是最新、最贵的——所以涨价时期末存货金额高、销货成本低、利润显得高。:假设先买的先卖掉,期末剩的是最近买的。FIFO (first-in, first-out)🥛 Picture milk on a supermarket shelf: staff always put the oldest (soon-to-expire) in front to sell first. FIFO assumes "what is sold is the earliest batch," so what remains in the warehouse is the newest and most expensive — so in a rising-price period ending inventory is high, COGS is low, and profit looks high.: assume the earliest-bought are sold first, and what remains is the most recently bought.
  • LIFO 后进先出🪨 想象一堆沙子,你总是从最上面(最近倒的)铲走。LIFO 假设"卖出去的是最近买的那批",于是销货成本贴近当前市价——涨价时销货成本高、利润低、交的税也少(所以美国有些公司爱用 LIFO 省税);但留在账上的存货是最老最低的成本,严重偏离现值。IFRS 禁止用 LIFO,只有 US GAAP 允许。:假设后买的先卖掉,期末剩的是最早买的。LIFO (last-in, first-out)🪨 Picture a pile of sand — you always shovel from the top (most recently dumped). LIFO assumes "what is sold is the most recently bought," so COGS is close to the current market price — in a rising-price period COGS is high, profit is low, and less tax is paid (so some US companies favor LIFO to save tax); but the inventory left on the books is at the oldest, lowest cost, badly out of line with present value. IFRS bans LIFO; only US GAAP allows it.: assume the most recently bought are sold first, and what remains is the earliest bought.
  • 加权平均:所有货算一个平均成本,结果介于 FIFO 和 LIFO 之间。Weighted average: compute one average cost for all goods, with a result between FIFO and LIFO.

核心规律(以"存货成本上涨、数量不变或增加"为例——最常考的情形):Core pattern (using "inventory cost rising, quantity flat or increasing" — the most tested case):

项目ItemFIFO(相比 LIFO)FIFO (vs LIFO)LIFO(相比 FIFO)LIFO (vs FIFO)
销货成本 COGSCOGS更低(用的是早期低价)Lower (uses early low prices)更高(用的是近期高价)Higher (uses recent high prices)
期末存货(资产负债表)Ending inventory (balance sheet)更高(剩的是近期高价,贴近现值)Higher (what remains is recent high prices, close to present value)更低(剩的是早期低价,严重偏离现值)Lower (what remains is early low prices, badly out of line with present value)
毛利/营业利润/税前利润Gross/operating/pre-tax profit更高(COGS 低)Higher (COGS low)更低(COGS 高)Lower (COGS high)
所得税Income tax更高Higher更低(利润低,省税)Lower (low profit, tax saving)

记忆钥匙:涨价时,FIFO 让"资产负债表更真实"(期末存货贴近现值),LIFO 让"利润表更真实"(销货成本贴近现值)。价格下跌时,以上全部反过来。Memory key: in rising prices, FIFO makes "the balance sheet more realistic" (ending inventory close to present value), LIFO makes "the income statement more realistic" (COGS close to present value). When prices fall, all of the above reverses.

考点提示:教材算例(Company F 用 FIFO、Company L 用 LIFO,除方法外完全相同,4% 通胀):涨价环境下 LIFO 的销货成本更高、利润更低、期末存货更低;但 LIFO 的存货周转率反而更高(因为分母存货金额低,看起来"管理更高效",实为假象)。这类"两家除方法外完全相同"的对比是经典题型。
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

通胀期 FIFO vs LIFO vs 加权平均

物价上涨时:
• FIFO(先进先出):卖的是旧的低成本 → COGS 低、利润高、税高;期末存货用近期成本 → 存货高、更贴近现值。
• LIFO(后进先出):卖的是新的高成本 → COGS 高、利润低、税低;期末存货是旧成本 → 被低估。
• 加权平均:居中。

机制

LIFO 税低 → 现金流更好(仅美国 GAAP 允许;IFRS 禁用 LIFO)。通缩期结论反过来。

易错对比

① 通胀期 FIFO 利润高/税高、LIFO 现金流好;② LIFO 期末存货偏旧、被低估;③ IFRS 不允许 LIFO。

FIFO vs LIFO vs weighted-average under inflation

When prices rise:
• FIFO: sells old, low-cost units → low COGS, high profit, high tax; ending inventory at recent cost → higher, closer to current value.
• LIFO: sells new, high-cost units → high COGS, low profit, low tax; ending inventory at old cost → understated.
• Weighted-average: in between.

Mechanism

LIFO's lower tax means better cash flow (allowed only under US GAAP; IFRS bans LIFO). Under deflation the conclusions reverse.

Common traps

① Under inflation FIFO = high profit/tax, LIFO = better cash flow; ② LIFO ending inventory is old and understated; ③ IFRS prohibits LIFO.

5. 为什么用 LIFO 的公司比 FIFO 更不易发生存货减值:Why is a LIFO firm less prone to inventory write-downs than a FIFO firm: 官方题Official

  • A. LIFO 账面存货是最老、最低成本,已很保守、贴近或低于 NRVLIFO's booked inventory is the oldest, lowest-cost layer — already conservative and near or below NRV
  • B. LIFO 账面存货是最高成本LIFO's booked inventory is the highest cost
  • C. LIFO 不允许减值LIFO does not allow write-downs
答案 A。保守的低账面值使减值需求更小、幅度更低。Answer A. A conservative low carrying value means less need and smaller magnitude of write-downs.

6. FIFO(先进先出)假设卖出与期末剩存分别是哪批:Under FIFO, which batch is assumed sold and which remains at period-end: 官方题Official

  • A. 随机确定Determined randomly
  • B. 先买的先卖;期末剩最近买的(贴近现值)The earliest purchased are sold first; the most recently purchased remain (near current value)
  • C. 后买的先卖;期末剩最早买的The latest purchased are sold first; the earliest remain
答案 B。FIFO 期末存货贴近当前成本。Answer B. FIFO ending inventory is close to current cost.

7. 成本上涨时,FIFO 相比 LIFO 的 COGS、期末存货、利润、税分别是:When costs are rising, FIFO's COGS, ending inventory, profit, and taxes vs LIFO are, respectively: 官方题Official

  • A. 四项全部更低All four lower
  • B. 与 LIFO 完全相同Identical to LIFO
  • C. COGS 更低、期末存货更高、利润更高、税更高Lower COGS, higher ending inventory, higher profit, higher taxes
答案 C。涨价时 FIFO 卖旧低成本→COGS 低、利润高;LIFO 相反。Answer C. With rising prices, FIFO sells old low-cost goods → low COGS, high profit; LIFO is the opposite.

8. "FIFO 让资产负债表更真实,LIFO 让利润表更真实"的含义是:The meaning of 'FIFO makes the balance sheet more realistic and LIFO makes the income statement more realistic' is: 官方题Official

  • A. FIFO 使 COGS 最真实FIFO makes COGS most realistic
  • B. 涨价时 FIFO 期末存货贴近当前重置价,LIFO 的 COGS 贴近当前重置价When prices rise, FIFO's ending inventory is close to current replacement cost, while LIFO's COGS is close to current replacement cost
  • C. LIFO 使期末存货最真实LIFO makes ending inventory most realistic
答案 B。价格下跌时结论相反。Answer B. When prices fall, the conclusion reverses.
1. 其他条件相同，在存货数量稳定而单位成本下降的期间，采用后进先出法将导致较低的：1. All else being equal, in a period of stable inventory quantities and declining inventory unit costs, using the LIFO inventory valuation method will result in a lower: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 毛利（相较于采用先进先出法）。gross profit than if the FIFO method had been used.
  • B. 流动比率（相较于采用先进先出法）。current ratio than if the FIFO method had been used.
  • C. 存货周转率（相较于采用先进先出法）。inventory turnover ratio than if the FIFO method had been used.
答案 C。成本下降期,LIFO 把"最新低成本"计入销货成本 → 存货留高成本、销货成本低、利润高 → 存货周转率(销货成本/存货)较 FIFO 低。Answer C. In falling-cost periods, LIFO puts the newest low costs into COGS → high-cost inventory remains, COGS is low, profit high → inventory turnover (COGS/inventory) is lower than under FIFO.
2. 在价格与数量持续上升的环境下，报告的期末存货最接近当前重置价值的方法是：2. In an environment of steadily increasing prices and quantities, reported ending inventory most closely reflects current replacement value under the: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 采用定期盘存制的先进先出法。FIFO method using a periodic inventory system.
  • B. 采用定期盘存制的后进先出法。LIFO method using a periodic inventory system.
  • C. 采用永续盘存制的后进先出法。LIFO method using a perpetual inventory system.
答案 A。价格数量持续上升时,FIFO 的期末存货由"最新高价"构成,最接近当前重置价。LIFO 期末存货是旧低价,远离现值。Answer A. When prices and quantities keep rising, FIFO ending inventory consists of the newest high costs, closest to current replacement value. LIFO ending inventory holds old low costs, far from current value.
3. 其他条件相同，在存货单位成本下降、数量不变的期间，哪种存货计价方法最可能将较高比例的可供销售商品总成本分配至利润表的销售成本？3. All else being equal, in a period of declining inventory unit costs and constant inventory quantities, which inventory valuation method most likely allocates a higher amount of the total cost of goods available for sale to cost of sales on the income statement? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 先进先出法FIFO
  • B. 后进先出法LIFO
  • C. 加权平均成本法Weighted average cost
答案 A。成本下降期,FIFO 把"最早的高成本"先计入销货成本 → 较高比例的总成本进入销货成本(利润更低)。LIFO 则用最新低成本。Answer A. In falling-cost periods, FIFO expenses the oldest (highest) costs first → a higher proportion of total cost goes to COGS (lower profit). LIFO uses the newest low costs.

LM6 §4 LIFO 清算与存货比率LM6 §4 LIFO Liquidation & Inventory Ratios

LIFO 清算(LIFO liquidation):用 LIFO 的公司如果某年卖的比买的多,库存下降,就会动用到很老、很便宜的存货层。这些老存货的低成本进入销货成本 → 虚高的毛利(和更高的税)。分析师要警惕这种"卖老库存撑起来的利润",它不可持续。LIFO liquidation: if a LIFO company sells more than it buys in a year, inventory falls and it dips into very old, very cheap inventory layers. The low cost of these old layers enters COGS → inflated gross profit (and higher tax). Analysts must beware this "profit propped up by selling old inventory" — it is not sustainable.

存货三大比率(必记)

存货周转率 = 销货成本 / 平均存货
存货周转天数 = 365 / 存货周转率
毛利率 = 毛利 / 销售收入
比率Ratio含义Meaning
存货周转率 inventory turnoverInventory turnover一年把存货"卖空"几次;越高通常越高效(但要小心 LIFO 或减值造成的假象)How many times a year inventory is "sold out"; higher is usually more efficient (but beware illusions from LIFO or write-downs)
存货周转天数 days of inventoryDays of inventory平均一批货在仓库待多少天;越短越快On average how many days a batch sits in the warehouse; shorter is faster
毛利率 gross marginGross margin受存货计价方法直接影响Directly affected by the inventory valuation method
教材算例 · 沃尔沃存货周转 官方题Official

2017 年销货成本 254,581,期末存货 52,701、上期 48,287。存货周转率 = 254,581 / [(52,701+48,287)/2] = 5.04;周转天数 = 365 / 5.04 = 72.4 天。(若把减值准备加回、存货变大,周转率反而降到 4.71、天数升到 77.5——印证"减值让活动比率变好"。)2017 COGS 254,581, ending inventory 52,701, prior period 48,287. Inventory turnover = 254,581 / [(52,701+48,287)/2] = 5.04; days = 365 / 5.04 = 72.4 days. (Adding back the write-down allowance, so inventory is larger, turnover instead falls to 4.71 and days rise to 77.5 — confirming that "write-downs improve activity ratios.")

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

LIFO 清算与存货比率

LIFO 清算(liquidation):当销量超过采购,企业动用旧的、低成本存货层 → COGS 被虚低、利润虚高,但这是不可持续的一次性效应。

LIFO 储备的用途

LIFO 储备 = FIFO 存货 − LIFO 存货。分析时把 LIFO 加回储备即可还原成 FIFO 口径,使不同公司可比;同时调整 COGS 与利润、递延税。

易错对比

① LIFO 清算虚增利润、质量差;② 用 LIFO 储备把 LIFO 存货调回 FIFO;③ 存货周转率因存货口径不同而失真——先统一口径再比。

LIFO liquidation & inventory ratios

LIFO liquidation: when sales exceed purchases, the firm digs into old, low-cost layers → understated COGS and inflated profit, an unsustainable one-off effect.

Using the LIFO reserve

LIFO reserve = FIFO inventory − LIFO inventory. Add the reserve back to LIFO inventory to restate to a FIFO basis for comparability, adjusting COGS, profit, and deferred tax accordingly.

Common traps

① LIFO liquidation inflates profit, low quality; ② use the LIFO reserve to convert LIFO inventory to FIFO; ③ inventory turnover is distorted by the basis — align bases before comparing.

9. LIFO 清算是什么、为何要警惕:What is LIFO liquidation and why be wary of it: 官方题Official

  • A. 指存货大量增加It means inventory rising sharply
  • B. 会降低毛利It lowers gross margin
  • C. 卖多于买、动用很老很便宜的库存层,老低成本进 COGS→虚高毛利,利润不可持续Selling more than is bought draws on very old, cheap layers, putting old low costs into COGS → inflated gross margin and unsustainable profit
答案 C。LIFO 清算带来一次性、不可持续的高毛利与高税。Answer C. LIFO liquidation brings a one-off, unsustainable high gross margin and high taxes.

  • A. 两者都允许Both allow it
  • B. 两者都禁止Both prohibit it

Year 2Year 1
Cost of goods sold600700

The inventory turnover (using average inventory) in Year 2 is closest to: 真题模考Mock

LM7 §5 无形资产的三种取得方式LM7 §5 The Three Ways of Acquiring Intangible Assets

LOS 对应:LOS: compare the financial reporting of intangible assets: purchased, internally developed, and acquired in a business combination。

无形资产怎么记账,取决于怎么来的。三种途径:How an intangible is accounted for depends on how it was obtained. Three routes:

取得方式Means of acquisition会计处理Accounting treatment
① 单独外购(非并购,如买一项专利)① Purchased separately (not in an acquisition, e.g., buying a patent)按公允价值(=购买价)资本化,和买设备一样;一组一起买则按各自公允价值分摊Capitalized at fair value (= purchase price), just like buying equipment; if a group is bought together, allocate by their respective fair values
② 内部开发② Internally developed一般费用化。IFRS:研究阶段费用化,开发阶段满足条件可资本化;US GAAP:研发一律费用化,但软件在技术可行(对外售)/很可能完成(自用)后须资本化。现金流上:内部开发计入经营流出,外购计入投资流出Generally expensed. IFRS: research phase expensed, development phase capitalizable when conditions are met; US GAAP: R&D all expensed, but software must be capitalized after technological feasibility (for sale) / probable completion (for internal use). On cash flow: internal development goes to operating outflow, purchases go to investing outflow
③ 并购取得③ Acquired in a business combination用收购法(acquisition method):把收购价按公允价值分摊到各项可辨认资产和负债;超出可辨认净资产公允价值的部分记为商誉Use the acquisition method: allocate the purchase price at fair value to each identifiable asset and liability; the excess over the fair value of identifiable net assets is recorded as goodwill
考点提示:"内部开发 vs 外购"造成可比性问题:靠自研积累专利/品牌的公司,资产会显得比靠收购的公司少(因为自研大多费用化了)。IFRS 软件开发和一般无形资产开发一样处理;US GAAP 唯独对软件网开一面允许资本化。软件例:自用软件开发月花 €1,000,若 2 月才满足资本化条件,则 1 月的 €1,000 费用化、其余 €11,000 资本化。

12. 无形资产三种取得方式的会计处理是:The accounting treatment of the three ways of acquiring intangible assets is: 官方题Official

  • A. 三者都资本化All three capitalized
  • B. 单独外购→按公允价资本化;内部开发→一般费用化;并购取得→超额部分记商誉Separate purchase → capitalize at fair value; internal development → generally expensed; acquired in a business combination → the excess is goodwill
  • C. 三者都费用化All three expensed
答案 B。IFRS 开发阶段、US GAAP 软件成本可资本化,是费用化的例外。Answer B. The IFRS development phase and US GAAP software costs may be capitalized, exceptions to expensing.

13. 内部开发 vs 外购无形资产的现金流分类不同在于:The cash-flow classification difference between internally developed and purchased intangibles is: 官方题Official

  • A. 内部开发成本计经营活动流出;外购无形资产计投资活动流出Internal development costs are operating outflows; purchased intangibles are investing outflows
  • B. 两者都计投资活动Both are investing
  • C. 内部开发计投资、外购计经营Internal development is investing, purchased is operating
答案 A。外购资产属资本性支出(CFI),内部开发费用属经营(CFO)。Answer A. A purchased asset is capital expenditure (CFI); internal development costs are operating (CFO).
1. 不考虑所得税，购入一项无形资产最可能导致：1. Ignoring income taxes, acquiring an intangible asset would most likely result in: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 经营活动净现金流低于内部开发该无形资产。a lower net operating cash flow than internally developing the intangible asset.
  • B. 经营活动净现金流与内部开发相同。the same net operating cash flow as internally developing the intangible asset.
  • C. 经营活动净现金流高于内部开发该无形资产。a higher net operating cash flow than internally developing the intangible asset.
答案 C。购入无形资产 → 现金流出记投资活动;而内部开发常把支出费用化(经营流出) → 因此购入者的经营净现金流"更高"(把流出移到了投资)。Answer C. Purchasing an intangible records the outflow in investing; internal development often expenses the spend (an operating outflow) → so the purchaser's operating cash flow is higher (the outflow shifted to investing).
2. 某公司取得一项为期5年的许可证，用于其计划在可预见的将来持续销售的产品；该许可证可以极低成本续期。该许可证应：2. A company acquires a 5-year license for a product it plans to continue selling for the foreseeable future. The license can be renewed at minimal cost. The license should be: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 按历史成本列示于资产负债表。carried on the balance sheet at historical cost.
  • B. 按直线法在其估计使用寿命内摊销。amortised using the straight-line method over its estimated useful life.
  • C. 按产量法在其估计使用寿命内摊销。amortised using the units-of-production method over its estimated useful life.
答案 A。可极低成本续期、计划持续销售 → 该许可证实质上寿命不确定(indefinite) → 不摊销,按历史成本列示并做减值测试。故 B、C(摊销)错。Answer A. Renewable at negligible cost with ongoing planned use → the license is effectively indefinite-lived → not amortized, carried at historical cost with impairment testing. So B and C (amortizing) are wrong.

LM7 §6 资产减值:IFRS vs US GAAPLM7 §6 Asset Impairment: IFRS vs US GAAP 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: explain and evaluate how impairment and derecognition of PP&E and intangible assets affect the financial statements。
🔰 零基础讲解:折旧 vs 减值,别搞混

折旧/摊销是"按计划、慢慢地"把资产成本分摊到各年——像手机每年正常掉价。减值💥 减值是"意外地、突然地"发现资产不值那么多了。比如你花 100 万买的机器,突然出了个竞品把你的产品打得没人要——机器一下子只值 60 万了,这 40 万的坑就得当期一次认亏。折旧是"预料之中的正常损耗",减值是"预料之外的突然跳水"。是"意外地"发现资产价值大跌、账面价太高,要一次性写下来。Depreciation/amortization "planned, gradual" allocation of an asset's cost across years — like a phone losing value normally each year. Impairment💥 Impairment is "unexpectedly, suddenly" finding an asset isn't worth that much. Say a machine you bought for 1M is suddenly wrecked by a competing product that leaves your product unwanted — the machine is worth only 600K overnight, and this 400K hole must be recognized as a one-time loss in the current period. Depreciation is "expected normal wear," impairment is "an unexpected sudden plunge." is "unexpectedly" finding an asset's value has dropped sharply and the carrying amount is too high, requiring a one-time write-down.

什么时候测?PP&E 和有限寿命无形资产:只在有减值迹象时才测(不用每年);无限寿命无形资产和商誉:至少每年测一次。减值损失压低利润和资产,是非现金项,不影响经营现金流。When to test? PP&E and finite-life intangibles: tested only when there is an indication of impairment (not every year); indefinite-life intangibles and goodwill: tested at least annually. An impairment loss lowers profit and assets, is a non-cash item, and does not affect operating cash flow.

两套准则判定和计量减值的方法不同,这是最爱考的对比:The two standards differ in how they identify and measure impairment — the most tested comparison:

IFRS(一步法)IFRS (one-step)US GAAP(两步法)US GAAP (two-step)
判定是否减值Identifying impairment账面值 > 可收回金额 即减值Carrying amount > recoverable amount means impaired第 1 步:账面值 > 未折现的预期未来现金流 → 才算"不可收回"Step 1: carrying amount > undiscounted expected future cash flows → then "unrecoverable"
可收回金额 / 计量Recoverable amount / measurement可收回金额 = ①公允价值−处置成本 与 ②使用价值(未来现金流现值) 两者中的较高者;减值损失 = 账面 − 可收回金额Recoverable amount = the higher of ① fair value − costs to sell and ② value in use (present value of future cash flows); impairment loss = carrying amount − recoverable amount第 2 步:若不可收回,减值损失 = 账面 − 公允价值Step 2: if unrecoverable, impairment loss = carrying amount − fair value
减值转回Impairment reversal允许(计入利润,但不得超过原账面)Allowed (recognized in profit, but not above the original carrying amount)不允许(持有使用的资产;持有待售的可在公允价值回升时转回)Not allowed (assets held for use; assets held for sale may be reversed when fair value recovers)
教材算例 · 机器减值(Essex,两准则都减值) 官方题Official

账面 £18,000;未折现未来现金流 £16,000;现值 £14,000;公允价值 £10,000、处置成本 £2,000。Carrying amount £18,000; undiscounted future cash flows £16,000; present value £14,000; fair value £10,000, costs to sell £2,000.

IFRS:可收回金额 = max(公允价值−处置成本 £8,000,使用价值 £14,000) = £14,000。减值损失 = 18,000 − 14,000 = £4,000,机器记为 £14,000。IFRS: recoverable amount = max(fair value − costs to sell £8,000, value in use £14,000) = £14,000. Impairment loss = 18,000 − 14,000 = £4,000, machine recorded at £14,000.

US GAAP:第 1 步 账面 18,000 > 未折现现金流 16,000 → 不可收回。
第 2 步 减值损失 = 账面 18,000 − 公允价值 10,000 = £8,000,机器记为 £10,000。US GAAP: Step 1, carrying amount 18,000 > undiscounted cash flows 16,000 → unrecoverable.
Step 2, impairment loss = carrying 18,000 − fair value 10,000 = £8,000, machine recorded at £10,000.

注意:同一台机器,US GAAP 减记得更多(£8,000 > £4,000)——因为它减到公允价值,而 IFRS 减到较高的使用价值。这会造成两准则下股东权益账面值的差异。Note: for the same machine, US GAAP writes down more (£8,000 > £4,000) — because it writes down to fair value, while IFRS writes down to the higher value in use. This creates a difference in the book value of shareholders' equity under the two standards.

考点提示:另一道经典题(Sussex):账面 £18,000、未折现现金流 £19,000、现值 £16,000。US GAAP 下不减值(账面 18,000 < 未折现 19,000,可收回);但 IFRS 下要减值(账面 18,000 > 可收回金额 £16,000)。记住:US GAAP 第一关用未折现现金流,门槛更宽松,常出现"IFRS 减、US GAAP 不减"的情形。
考点·重估模式(revaluation model, 仅 IFRS):
• 首次升值 → 计入其他综合收益(OCI)的"重估盈余(revaluation surplus)",不进利润表;
• 后续贬值先冲减已有重估盈余,超出部分才作利润表损失(反向亦然);
• 重估上调 → 资产、权益增加 → 资产负债率下降、财务杠杆下降;
• US GAAP 不允许重估。减值后账面 = 可收回金额 = max(公允价值−处置费, 使用价值)。Exam - revaluation model (IFRS only):
- an initial increase goes to a "revaluation surplus" in OCI, not profit or loss;
- a later decrease first reduces the existing surplus, with the excess to P&L (and vice versa);
- an upward revaluation raises assets and equity, so the debt-to-assets ratio and financial leverage fall;
- US GAAP prohibits revaluation. Post-impairment value = the recoverable amount = max(fair value minus costs to sell, value in use).
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

资产减值:IFRS vs US GAAP

• IFRS(一步法):当账面值 > 可收回金额时减值。可收回金额 = max(公允价值−处置成本, 使用价值)。
• US GAAP(传统两步/触发法):先看账面值是否 > 未折现未来现金流(触发),再减记至公允价值。

能否转回

IFRS 允许减值转回(商誉除外);US GAAP 一律不可转回(持有资产)。

易错对比

① IFRS 用可收回金额、GAAP 触发看未折现现金流;② IFRS 可转回(非商誉)、GAAP 不可转回;③ 减值当期利润下降、后续折旧减少。

Asset impairment: IFRS vs US GAAP

• IFRS (one step): impair when carrying value > recoverable amount, where recoverable amount = max(fair value − cost to sell, value in use).
• US GAAP (traditional two-step/trigger): test whether carrying value > undiscounted future cash flows (trigger), then write down to fair value.

Reversal

IFRS allows reversal (except goodwill); US GAAP never allows reversal for held assets.

Common traps

① IFRS uses recoverable amount, GAAP triggers on undiscounted cash flows; ② IFRS reverses (non-goodwill), GAAP does not; ③ impairment cuts current profit and future depreciation.

14. 折旧/摊销与减值的本质区别是:The essential difference between depreciation/amortization and impairment is: 官方题Official

  • A. 两者含义相同They mean the same thing
  • B. 减值也是按计划进行Impairment is also planned
  • C. 折旧/摊销是按计划分摊(正常损耗);减值是意外发现价值大跌、一次性写下Depreciation/amortization is a planned allocation (normal wear); impairment is an unexpected, one-off write-down when value drops sharply
答案 C。一个是预料之中的分摊,一个是预料之外的跳水。Answer C. One is an expected allocation, the other an unexpected plunge.

15. 哪些资产只在有迹象时测减值、哪些至少每年测:Which assets are impairment-tested only when there is an indication, and which at least annually: 官方题Official

  • A. 所有资产都每年测All assets are tested annually
  • B. PP&E 与有限寿命无形资产:有迹象时测;无限寿命无形资产与商誉:至少每年测PP&E and finite-life intangibles: tested when indicated; indefinite-life intangibles and goodwill: tested at least annually
  • C. 商誉只在有迹象时测Goodwill is tested only when indicated
答案 B。不摊销的资产(商誉、无限寿命无形资产)须至少年度测试。Answer B. Non-amortized assets (goodwill, indefinite-life intangibles) must be tested at least annually.

16. IFRS 下减值如何判定,"可收回金额"是什么:Under IFRS, how is impairment determined, and what is the 'recoverable amount': 官方题Official

  • A. 可收回=min(公允价−处置成本, 使用价值)Recoverable = min(fair value − costs of disposal, value in use)
  • B. 可收回=历史成本Recoverable = historical cost
  • C. 账面值 > 可收回金额即减值;可收回=max(公允价−处置成本, 使用价值)Impaired if carrying value > recoverable amount; recoverable = max(fair value − costs of disposal, value in use)
答案 C。使用价值=未来现金流现值;减值损失=账面−可收回金额。Answer C. Value in use = present value of future cash flows; impairment loss = carrying − recoverable amount.

17. US GAAP 下减值的两步是:The two steps of impairment under US GAAP are: 官方题Official

  • A. 只有一步There is only one step
  • B. 第1步:账面值 > 未折现预期未来现金流→判为不可收回;
    第2步:减值=账面值−公允价值    Step 1: carrying value > undiscounted expected future cash flows → deemed unrecoverable;
    Step 2: impairment = carrying value − fair value
  • C. 第1步用折现现金流判定Step 1 uses discounted cash flows
答案 B。US GAAP 用未折现现金流做"回收性测试",再按公允价值计量减值。Answer B. US GAAP uses undiscounted cash flows for the 'recoverability test,' then measures impairment at fair value.

18. 账面 £18,000、未折现 £16,000、现值 £14,000、公允价 £10,000、处置成本 £2,000,IFRS 与 US GAAP 各减多少:Carrying £18,000, undiscounted £16,000, present value £14,000, fair value £10,000, costs of disposal £2,000; how much is written down under IFRS and US GAAP: 官方题Official

  • A. IFRS 减 £8,000;US GAAP 减 £4,000IFRS £8,000; US GAAP £4,000
  • B. 两者都减 £4,000Both £4,000
  • C. IFRS 减 £4,000(可收回=max(8,000,14,000)=14,000);US GAAP 减 £8,000(减到公允价 10,000)IFRS writes down £4,000 (recoverable = max(8,000, 14,000) = 14,000); US GAAP writes down £8,000 (down to fair value 10,000)
答案 C。US GAAP 先判 18,000>16,000 不可收回,再减到公允价 10,000。Answer C. US GAAP first judges 18,000 > 16,000 as unrecoverable, then writes down to fair value 10,000.

19. 账面 £18,000、未折现 £19,000、可收回金额 £16,000,哪个准则减值:Carrying £18,000, undiscounted £19,000, recoverable amount £16,000; which standard records impairment: 官方题Official

  • A. 两者都减Both record
  • B. US GAAP 不减(18,000 < 未折现 19,000);IFRS 减 £2,000(18,000 > 可收回 16,000)US GAAP does not (18,000 < undiscounted 19,000); IFRS writes down £2,000 (18,000 > recoverable 16,000)
  • C. US GAAP 减,IFRS 不减US GAAP records, IFRS does not
答案 B。US GAAP 回收性测试通过则不减,IFRS 直接比可收回金额。Answer B. If the US GAAP recoverability test passes, no write-down; IFRS compares directly with the recoverable amount.
1. 分析师获得某公司在任何重估前以下信息（单位：百万欧元）：
平均总资产20
平均总负债8

Average total assets20
Average total liabilities8
Average total equity12
An initial revaluation increases the carrying value of the asset valued under the revaluation model. Ignoring taxes, the financial leverage ratio most likely: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 下降。decreases.
  • B. 不变。remains the same.
  • C. 上升。increases.
答案 A。重估上调资产账面 → 权益(重估盈余)增加、资产增加 → 财务杠杆(资产/权益)下降(分子分母同增,权益增比例更影响该比率下行)。Answer A. An upward revaluation raises the asset and equity (revaluation surplus) → the financial leverage ratio (assets/equity) falls (equity rises, lowering the ratio).
2. 分析师获得某公司按重估模式计量的一项不可折旧资产以下信息：

Reported value after second revaluation€22,500

  • A. −€2,500。−€2,500.
  • B. €0。€0.
  • C. €2,500。€2,500.
答案 B。重估模式:先升值计入 OCI(重估盈余),二次贬值先冲减已有盈余。若刚好冲平,重估盈余 = €0(超出部分才进利润表损失)。Answer B. Under the revaluation model, an increase goes to OCI (revaluation surplus); a later decrease first reduces that surplus. If it exactly offsets, the revaluation surplus = €0 (only the excess would hit P&L).

4. 分析师获得某设备以下信息（单位：千欧元）：

7. 不考虑所得税，设备的减值损失最可能降低：7. Ignoring income taxes, an impairment loss on equipment will most likely decrease: 真题模考Mock

LM7 §7 减值转回与终止确认(处置损益)LM7 §7 Impairment Reversal & Derecognition (Disposal Gain/Loss)

减值转回:减值后若资产可收回金额回升,IFRS 允许转回(计入利润,但不超过原账面,且不是重估到更高)。US GAAP:持有使用的资产一旦减值不可转回;持有待售的可在公允价值回升时转回(以原减值额为限)。Impairment reversal: if the recoverable amount recovers after impairment, IFRS allows reversal (recognized in profit, but not above the original carrying amount, and not a revaluation to a higher figure). US GAAP: assets held for use cannot be reversed once impaired; assets held for sale may be reversed when fair value recovers (capped at the original impairment).

终止确认(derecognition):资产被处置(出售、交换、报废、分拆给股东)或不再产生未来利益时,从报表移除。Derecognition: an asset is removed from the statements when disposed of (sold, exchanged, scrapped, spun off to shareholders) or when it no longer generates future benefits.

出售长期资产的损益(必会计算)

处置损益 = 出售所得 − 处置时的账面净值
符号Symbol含义Meaning
账面净值 carrying amountCarrying amount= 历史成本 − 累计折旧(若已减值/重估则用调整后的值)= historical cost − accumulated depreciation (use the adjusted value if impaired/revalued)
正数=利得,负数=损失Positive = gain, negative = loss利得/损失在利润表列示;间接法现金流量表要把它从经营活动中剔除,把全部售价计入投资活动The gain/loss is shown on the income statement; in the indirect-method cash flow statement it must be removed from operating activities, with the full sale price recorded in investing activities
教材算例 · 卖旧披萨炉 官方题Official

原值 $5.1M,累计折旧 $3.2M → 账面净值 = 5.1 − 3.2 = $1.9M。售价 $3.1M → 处置利得 = 3.1 − 1.9 = $1.2M 利得。现金流上,$3.1M 全部计入投资活动流入。Original cost $5.1M, accumulated depreciation $3.2M → carrying amount = 5.1 − 3.2 = $1.9M. Sale price $3.1M → disposal gain = 3.1 − 1.9 = $1.2M gain. On cash flow, the full $3.1M is recorded as an investing inflow.

其他处置方式:报废/放弃(无现金收入,按账面值全额认损失);交换(以放弃资产的公允价值计,差额认损益);分拆(spin-off,把整个业务单元分给股东,通常不产生损益,如 2016 年菲亚特克莱斯勒分拆法拉利)。Other disposals: scrapping/abandonment (no cash proceeds, recognize a loss for the full carrying amount); exchange (measured at the fair value of the asset given up, with the difference recognized in profit or loss); spin-off (distributing an entire business unit to shareholders, usually producing no gain or loss, e.g., Fiat Chrysler spinning off Ferrari in 2016).

20. 减值损失是否为现金项、是否影响经营现金流:Is an impairment loss a cash item, and does it affect operating cash flow: 官方题Official

  • A. 非现金项,压低利润和资产,但不影响 CFO(间接法下加回)A non-cash item — it lowers profit and assets but does not affect CFO (added back under the indirect method)
  • B. 是现金项,减少 CFOA cash item that reduces CFO
  • C. 增加 CFOIt increases CFO
答案 A。减值与折旧类似,是非现金费用。Answer A. Impairment, like depreciation, is a non-cash expense.

21. 长期资产减值转回,IFRS 与 US GAAP 分别如何:Reversal of a long-lived-asset impairment under IFRS vs US GAAP: 官方题Official

  • A. 两者都允许转回Both allow reversal
  • B. 两者都禁止转回Both prohibit reversal
  • C. IFRS 允许转回(计入利润,不超原账面);US GAAP 持有使用的不可转回,持有待售的可转回IFRS allows reversal (through profit, not above the original carrying value); US GAAP: no reversal for held-and-used, reversal allowed for held-for-sale
答案 C。US GAAP 对持有使用资产的减值不可转回。Answer C. US GAAP does not allow reversal for held-and-used assets.

22. 出售长期资产的损益如何计算:How is the gain/loss on selling a long-lived asset computed: 官方题Official

  • A. 处置损益=累计折旧−账面净值Disposal gain/loss = accumulated depreciation − net carrying value
  • B. 处置损益=出售所得−账面净值;账面净值=历史成本−累计折旧Disposal gain/loss = sale proceeds − net carrying value; net carrying value = historical cost − accumulated depreciation
  • C. 处置损益=出售所得−历史成本Disposal gain/loss = sale proceeds − historical cost
答案 B。与账面净值比较得出处置损益。Answer B. Compared with net carrying value to get the disposal gain/loss.

23. 原值 $5.1M、累计折旧 $3.2M、售价 $3.1M,是利得还是损失、多少:Original cost $5.1M, accumulated depreciation $3.2M, sale price $3.1M; is it a gain or loss, and how much: 官方题Official

  • A. $2.0M 损失$2.0M loss
  • B. $3.1M 利得$3.1M gain
  • C. $1.2M 利得(账面净值 1.9M,3.1−1.9)$1.2M gain (net carrying value 1.9M, 3.1 − 1.9)
答案 C。账面净值=5.1−3.2=1.9M;利得=3.1−1.9=1.2M;$3.1M 计入投资活动流入。Answer C. Net carrying value = 5.1 − 3.2 = 1.9M; gain = 3.1 − 1.9 = 1.2M; the $3.1M is an investing inflow.

24. 分拆(spin-off)把业务单元分给股东,是否产生处置损益:A spin-off distributes a business unit to shareholders; does it produce a disposal gain/loss: 补充Extra

  • A. 通常不产生损益;分拆前资产列为"持有待分配"Usually no gain/loss; before the spin-off, the assets are classified as 'held for distribution'
  • B. 一定产生大额利得It always produces a large gain
  • C. 一定产生损失It always produces a loss
答案 A。如菲亚特克莱斯勒 2016 分拆法拉利,不确认处置损益。Answer A. E.g., Fiat Chrysler's 2016 spin-off of Ferrari recognized no disposal gain/loss.
1. 分析师获得某公司一项不可折旧资产以下信息（单位：千欧元）：

  • A. 40。40.
  • B. 50。50.
  • C. 60。60.

For a non-depreciable asset that recovers after impairment: IFRS allows reversal, but the ceiling = the carrying amount had there been no impairment (i.e., original cost). So the maximum ≈ 50 (cannot exceed the original).
2. 下列关于不动产、厂场及设备(PP&E)的披露中，哪项是 US GAAP 下必需的？2. Which of the following financial statement disclosures concerning PP&E is required under US GAAP? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 各主要类别可折旧资产的余额The balances of major classes of depreciable assets
  • B. 重估模式下的重估日期The date of revaluation under the revaluation model
  • C. 期初与期末账面金额的调节表A reconciliation of the carrying amount at the beginning and end of the period
答案 A。US GAAP 对 PP&E 必需披露:各主要类别可折旧资产的余额(以及累计折旧、方法)。重估日期是 IFRS 重估模式的事;调节表非 US GAAP 必需。Answer A. A required US GAAP PP&E disclosure: balances of major classes of depreciable assets (plus accumulated depreciation, methods). Revaluation dates are an IFRS matter; a roll-forward is not required under US GAAP.
3. 若某公司出售账面金额 £75,000 的 PP&E 并报告 £2,000 的利得，投资活动现金流为：3. If a company sold PP&E with a carrying amount of £75,000 and reported a gain of £2,000, cash flow from investing activities is: 真题模考Mock

6. 分析师获得一项被废弃、采用成本模式核算的 PP&E 以下信息：

7. 按成本模式计量的每一类 PP&E 需披露下列哪项？7. Which of the following disclosures is required for each class of PP&E carried under the cost model? 真题模考Mock

  • B. 总账面金额Gross carrying amount
  • C. 公允价值及其取得方式的细节Fair value and details of how it was obtained
答案 B。成本模式下每类 PP&E 需披露"总账面金额(gross carrying amount)"(及累计折旧)。剩余寿命、公允价值细节不是成本模式必需披露。Answer B. Under the cost model, each PP&E class must disclose its gross carrying amount (and accumulated depreciation). Remaining life and fair-value details are not required under the cost model.

1. 存货增长显著快于销售通常提示:Inventory growing significantly faster than sales usually suggests:

第四讲 · 长期负债与权益专题Lecture 4 · Topics in Long-Term Liabilities & Equity

对应教材:FSA — Learning Module 8《Topics in Long-Term Liabilities and Equity》 · 建议学习时长:3–4 小时 · 建议分两次学完(租赁约 1.5 小时,养老金与股权激励约 2 小时)Curriculum: FSA — Learning Module 8 Topics in Long-Term Liabilities and Equity · Suggested study time: 3–4 hours · Best done in two sittings (leases ~1.5 hours, pensions and share-based comp ~2 hours)

这一讲讲三种"复杂的长期义务":租赁、养老金、股权激励。它们的共同点是——公司现在就欠下了未来要兑现的承诺,会计上怎么记、放哪张表,直接影响利润和负债的可比性。This lecture covers three 'complex long-term obligations': leases, pensions, and share-based compensation. What they share is that the company incurs now a promise to be honored in the future, and how it is recorded and on which statement directly affects the comparability of profit and liabilities.

高频点集中在:融资租赁 vs 经营租赁的五条判定标准、承租人 IFRS(单一模型)vs US GAAP(双模型)、确定提存 vs 确定受益养老金谁担风险、股权激励按授予日公允价值摊销。每个难点配 🔰 零基础讲解,关键术语鼠标悬停(💡)有比喻。The high-frequency points cluster on: the five criteria for finance vs operating leases, lessee accounting IFRS (single model) vs US GAAP (dual model), who bears the risk in defined-contribution vs defined-benefit pensions, and amortizing share-based comp at grant-date fair value. Every difficulty comes with a 🔰 Beginner explainer, and key terms have analogies on mouse hover (💡).

§1 租赁:什么是租赁、有何优势§1 Leases: What a Lease Is & Its Advantages

LOS 对应:LOS: explain the financial reporting of leases from the perspectives of lessors and lessees。
🔰 零基础讲解:租赁到底是什么?

租赁🚚 想象你开公司要用一辆货车。你可以买(一次掏一大笔钱、车归你),也可以租(每月付租金、用一段时间)。租赁就是"花钱买'使用权'而不买'所有权'"。用车的一方叫承租人(lessee),车主叫出租人(lessor)。对承租人来说,长期租赁很像"分期贷款买车"。是一份合同:出租人把资产的使用权让给承租人一段时间,承租人付钱。A lease🚚 Imagine your company needs a truck. You can buy it (a big lump sum up front, the truck is yours) or lease it (pay rent each month, use it for a while). Leasing is "paying for the 'right to use' rather than buying 'ownership.'" The party using the truck is the lessee, the owner is the lessor. For the lessee, a long-term lease is a lot like "buying a car on an installment loan." is a contract: the lessor transfers the right to use an asset to the lessee for a period, and the lessee pays.

一份合同构成租赁,须同时满足:
① 指明特定的标的资产;
② 承租人取得该资产在合同期内几乎全部的经济利益;
③ 承租人(而非供应商)有权主导资产如何使用。A contract is a lease only if it simultaneously:
① identifies a specific underlying asset;
② the lessee obtains substantially all the economic benefits of the asset over the contract term;
③ the lessee (not the supplier) has the right to direct how the asset is used.

租赁相比买断的优势:前期现金支出少;成本更低(有担保借款,违约时出租人直接收回资产,所以利率通常低于无担保贷款);减少所有权风险(如过时淘汰)。对出租人:能赚利息收入、扩大产品的可及市场。Advantages of leasing over buying outright: less up-front cash outlay; lower cost (as secured borrowing, on default the lessor simply reclaims the asset, so the rate is usually below an unsecured loan); reduced ownership risk (e.g., obsolescence). For the lessor: it earns interest income and expands the product's addressable market.

1. 一份合同构成租赁需满足哪三个条件:What three conditions must a contract meet to constitute a lease: 官方题Official

  • A. 只需存在付款义务Only a payment obligation is needed
  • B. 指明特定标的资产;承租人取得几乎全部经济利益;承租人(非供应商)有权主导资产使用It specifies a particular underlying asset; the lessee obtains substantially all the economic benefits; the lessee (not the supplier) has the right to direct the asset's use
  • C. 由供应商主导资产使用The supplier directs the asset's use
答案 B。识别资产、获取经济利益、主导使用权三要素齐备才是租赁。Answer B. All three — an identified asset, obtaining the economic benefits, and directing use — must be present for a lease.
1. 下列哪项可能促使承租人选择租赁而非购买一项高价值、长期资产？租赁合同：1. Which of the following could motivate a lessee to lease a high-value, long-lived asset rather than to purchase it? Lease contracts: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 通常只需很少甚至无需首付。usually require little, if any, down payment.
  • B. 列作表外融资结构。are reported as off-balance sheet financing structures.
  • C. 无需在资产负债表上确认负债。do not require the recognition of a liability on the balance sheet.
答案 A。促使承租的一个原因:租赁通常首付很少甚至为零(保留现金)。新准则下经营租赁也要上表(确认使用权资产/负债),故 B、C(表外、无负债)已过时。Answer A. A reason to lease: leases usually need little or no down payment (preserving cash). Under the new standard even operating leases are on-balance-sheet (a right-of-use asset/liability), so B and C (off-balance-sheet, no liability) are outdated.
2. 与用债务购买资产相比，租赁一项资产最可能：2. Compared to purchasing an asset using debt, leasing an asset is most likely to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 融资成本更高。have a higher financing cost.
  • B. 需要更高首付。require a greater down payment.
  • C. 降低承租人对陈旧过时的风险敞口。reduce lessee's exposure to obsolescence.
答案 C。租赁相对借钱购买:降低对"陈旧过时(obsolescence)"的风险敞口(到期可换新)。它融资成本通常不高、首付更低,故 A、B 错。Answer C. Leasing vs buying with debt: it reduces exposure to obsolescence (swap for newer at term end). Its financing cost is usually not higher and the down payment lower, so A and B are wrong.

§2 融资租赁 vs 经营租赁:五条判定标准§2 Finance vs Operating Lease: The Five Criteria 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

🔰 零基础讲解:一句话分清两种租赁

融资租赁(finance lease)本质像"分期买下这个资产"——租期几乎覆盖资产整个寿命、或最后归你。经营租赁(operating lease)本质像"短租"——用一阵子就还回去。例:租一辆用 10 年的车、租满 10 年 ≈ 买车(融资租赁);租一台能用 20 年的机器只租 1 年 ≈ 短租(经营租赁)。A finance lease is essentially "buying the asset on installments" — the term covers almost the asset's whole life, or it becomes yours at the end. An operating lease is essentially a "short rental" — used for a while and returned. Example: leasing a car for its 10-year life for the full 10 years ≈ buying it (finance lease); leasing a machine usable for 20 years for just 1 year ≈ a short rental (operating lease).

只要满足以下五条中任意一条,就是融资租赁;一条都不满足则为经营租赁。IFRS 和 US GAAP 判定标准相同,承租人和出租人也用同一套标准:If any one of the following five is met, it is a finance lease; if none is met, it is an operating lease. IFRS and US GAAP use the same criteria, and lessee and lessor use the same set:

#融资租赁判定标准(满足任一即是)Finance-lease criteria (any one qualifies)
1租赁期末所有权转移给承租人Ownership transfers to the lessee at the end of the lease
2承租人有购买选择权且几乎确定会行使The lessee has a purchase option reasonably certain to be exercised
3租期覆盖资产大部分使用寿命The term covers most of the asset's useful life
4租赁付款额的现值 ≥ 资产公允价值的绝大部分The present value of lease payments ≥ substantially all of the asset's fair value
5该资产对出租人无其他用途(高度定制)The asset has no alternative use to the lessor (highly customized)
教材例题 · 租赁判定 官方题Official

两年租一台机器,每年末付 1 亿日元,付款现值 1.86 亿;期末归还、无购买选择权、机器可他用、剩余寿命 4 年。若公允价值 1.9 亿:现值/公允价 = 186/190 = 98% ≥ 绝大部分 → 融资租赁(满足第 4 条)。若公允价值改为 3 亿:186/300 = 62%,五条都不满足 → 变成经营租赁。A two-year lease of a machine, ¥100M paid at each year-end, payments' present value ¥186M; returned at the end, no purchase option, the machine has alternative uses, remaining life 4 years. If fair value is ¥190M: PV/fair value = 186/190 = 98% ≥ substantially all → finance lease (criterion 4 met). If fair value is instead ¥300M: 186/300 = 62%, none of the five is met → it becomes an operating lease.

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

融资租赁 vs 经营租赁:判定标准

满足任一即倾向融资租赁(finance):① 期末所有权转移;② 有便宜购买选择权;③ 租期占资产经济寿命的大部分;④ 租金现值 ≈ 资产公允价值;⑤ 资产专用、无替代用途。否则为经营租赁(operating)。

机制

融资租赁实质是「分期买资产」——把资产与负债都上表;经营租赁实质是「租用」。US GAAP 承租人据此分两类费用模式,IFRS 承租人则统一模型。

易错对比

① 满足任一条即融资租赁;② 判断看风险报酬是否实质转移;③ IFRS 承租人几乎都资本化、无「经营租赁」费用分类。

Finance vs operating lease: the criteria

Meeting any one points to a finance lease: ① ownership transfers at end; ② a bargain purchase option; ③ term covers most of the asset's economic life; ④ PV of payments ≈ fair value; ⑤ asset is specialized with no alternative use. Otherwise it is an operating lease.

Mechanism

A finance lease is essentially "buying the asset in installments" — both asset and liability go on the books; an operating lease is essentially "renting." US GAAP lessees split expense models on this; IFRS lessees use a single model.

Common traps

① Any one criterion makes it a finance lease; ② judge by whether risks and rewards substantially transfer; ③ IFRS lessees capitalize almost all, with no "operating lease" expense split.

2. 融资租赁的五条判定标准,满足几条即算融资租赁:The five criteria for a finance lease, and how many must be met to qualify: 官方题Official

  • A. 须同时满足全部五条All five must be met simultaneously
  • B. 须满足至少三条At least three must be met
  • C. 满足任一条即融资租赁(所有权转移、购买选择权、租期覆盖大部分寿命、付款现值≥公允价值绝大部分、资产无其他用途)Meeting any one criterion makes it a finance lease (transfer of ownership, purchase option, term covering most of the life, present value of payments ≥ substantially all of fair value, asset with no alternative use)
答案 C。五条都不满足才是经营租赁。Answer C. Only if none of the five are met is it an operating lease.

3. 租金现值 1.86 亿、资产公允价值 1.9 亿,是哪种租赁:PV of rent $186m, asset fair value $190m; which type of lease: 官方题Official

  • A. 无法判断Cannot be determined
  • B. 融资租赁(186/190=98% ≥ 绝大部分)Finance lease (186/190 = 98% ≥ substantially all)
  • C. 经营租赁Operating lease
答案 B。满足第 4 条;若公允价值为 3 亿(62%)则五条皆不满足,为经营租赁。Answer B. It meets criterion 4; if fair value were $300m (62%), none of the five would be met and it would be an operating lease.

§3 承租人会计:IFRS 单一模型 vs US GAAP 双模型§3 Lessee Accounting: IFRS Single Model vs US GAAP Dual Model 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

豁免:承租人对①租期 ≤12 个月(IFRS 和 GAAP)或②低价值资产(≤$5,000,仅 IFRS)的租赁,可选择直接把租金按直线法费用化(出租人无此豁免)。Exemptions: for leases with ① a term ≤12 months (IFRS and GAAP) or ② a low-value asset (≤$5,000, IFRS only), the lessee may elect to simply expense the rent straight-line (the lessor has no such exemption).

🔰 零基础讲解:IFRS 和 US GAAP 的关键区别

两套准则在租赁开始时做法一样:承租人在资产负债表上同时确认一项使用权资产(ROU asset)和一项租赁负债,都等于未来租金的现值。The two standards do the same thing at lease commencement: the lessee recognizes on the balance sheet both a right-of-use (ROU) asset and a lease liability, each equal to the present value of future rents.

区别在后续怎么记费用:IFRS 对所有租赁只有一个模型(都当融资租赁处理:利息费用 + 摊销费用分开列);US GAAP 分两个模型:融资租赁同 IFRS,但经营租赁把利息和摊销合并成一条"租赁费用",还让 ROU 资产和负债始终相等。The difference is how the expense is recorded afterward: IFRS has a single model for all leases (all treated as finance leases: interest expense + amortization expense listed separately); US GAAP has two models: finance leases as under IFRS, but for an operating lease interest and amortization are combined into one "lease expense" and the ROU asset and liability are kept equal.

IFRS(单一模型)IFRS (single model)US GAAP 经营租赁US GAAP operating lease
利润表Income statement利息 + 摊销分开列(前期总费用较高、递减)Interest + amortization listed separately (higher total expense early on, declining)合并为一条"租赁费用"(每期相等,算经营费用)Combined into one "lease expense" (equal each period, treated as an operating expense)
ROU 资产摊销ROU asset amortization通常直线摊销,与负债本金还款不同步→资产与负债逐年背离Usually straight-line, not synchronized with the liability's principal repayment → asset and liability diverge year by year摊销 = 租金 − 利息,使 ROU 资产与负债始终相等Amortization = rent − interest, keeping the ROU asset and liability always equal
现金流量表Cash flow statement本金还款计入筹资、利息计入经营或筹资Principal repayment in financing, interest in operating or financing整笔租金都计入经营活动The entire rent in operating activities
考点提示:同一笔租赁,若从融资租赁改按经营租赁(US GAAP)记:EBITDA 利润率更低(租赁费进营业费用,而非利息+摊销)、总资产周转率更低(ROU 资产摊得慢、资产更大)、经营现金流更低(整笔租金进经营,而融资租赁只有利息进经营)。融资租赁前期总费用高于经营租赁(后期反低),因为利息前高后低。
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

承租人会计:IFRS 单一 vs US GAAP 双模型

两准则都要求(除短期/小额)在表内确认使用权资产(ROU)+ 租赁负债。区别在利润表费用模式:
• IFRS 单一模型:所有租赁按融资处理 → 利息费用 + 资产摊销,前期费用高(前重后轻)。
• US GAAP 双模型:融资租赁同上;经营租赁确认单一直线租金费用(但仍上表)。

现金流影响

融资租赁把本金偿还计入筹资活动、利息按准则分类 → 抬高经营现金流(CFO);经营租赁(GAAP)租金全进 CFO。

易错对比

① 无论哪种,都上表(ROU+负债);② IFRS 一律前重后轻、GAAP 经营租赁直线;③ 融资租赁使 CFO 偏高、筹资流出增加。

Lessee accounting: IFRS single vs US GAAP dual

Both standards require (except short-term/low-value) an on-balance-sheet right-of-use (ROU) asset + lease liability. The difference is the income-statement expense pattern:
• IFRS single model: all leases treated as finance → interest + amortization, front-loaded expense.
• US GAAP dual model: finance leases as above; operating leases take a single straight-line lease expense (still on-balance-sheet).

Cash-flow impact

A finance lease puts principal repayment in financing → boosts operating cash flow (CFO); a GAAP operating lease runs all rent through CFO.

Common traps

① Either way it is on the balance sheet (ROU + liability); ② IFRS is always front-loaded, GAAP operating is straight-line; ③ finance leases raise CFO and financing outflows.

4. 承租人在租赁开始时,资产负债表上记什么:At lease inception, what does the lessee record on the balance sheet: 官方题Official

  • A. 只记一项租赁负债Only a lease liability
  • B. 只记一笔租赁费用Only a single lease expense
  • C. 同时记使用权资产(ROU)与租赁负债,都等于未来租金现值Both a right-of-use (ROU) asset and a lease liability, each equal to the present value of future rents
答案 C。新准则下承租人几乎所有租赁都上表。Answer C. Under the new standards, nearly all lessee leases go on the balance sheet.

5. IFRS 与 US GAAP 对承租人的会计模型区别是:The difference between the IFRS and US GAAP lessee accounting models is: 官方题Official

  • A. 两者完全相同They are identical
  • B. IFRS 单一模型(利息+摊销分列);US GAAP 双模型,经营租赁合并为一条"租赁费用"、整笔进 CFOIFRS single model (interest + amortization shown separately); US GAAP dual model, with operating leases combined into one 'lease expense' entirely in CFO
  • C. IFRS 双模型,US GAAP 单一模型IFRS dual model, US GAAP single model
答案 B。US GAAP 保留经营/融资双模型。Answer B. US GAAP retains the operating/finance dual model.

6. 承租人可对哪些租赁豁免、直接按直线法费用化租金:Which leases can a lessee exempt and simply expense on a straight-line basis: 官方题Official

  • A. 所有租赁都可豁免All leases can be exempted
  • B. 只有融资租赁可豁免Only finance leases can be exempted
  • C. 租期 ≤12 个月(IFRS 与 GAAP),或低价值资产 ≤$5,000(仅 IFRS)Terms ≤ 12 months (IFRS and GAAP), or low-value assets ≤ $5,000 (IFRS only)
答案 C。出租人无此豁免。Answer C. The lessor has no such exemption.

7. 用经营租赁替代融资租赁记账,对 EBITDA 利润率、资产周转率、CFO 的影响是:The effect of using operating-lease (instead of finance-lease) accounting on the EBITDA margin, asset turnover, and CFO is: 官方题Official

  • A. 均无影响No effect on any
  • B. 三者都更低All three lower
  • C. 三者都更高All three higher
答案 B。租赁费入营业费用(EBITDA率↓)、资产大(周转↓)、整笔租金进经营(CFO↓)。Answer B. Lease expense enters operating expense (EBITDA margin ↓), assets are large (turnover ↓), and the whole rent enters operating (CFO ↓).
1. 在 US GAAP 下，多年期租赁的第二年，采用经营租赁的承租人最可能报告：1. Under US GAAP, in the second year of a multi-year lease, a lessee with an operating lease most likely reports a: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 高于将其作为融资租赁时的利息费用。higher interest expense than it would if the lease were a finance lease.
  • B. 低于将其作为融资租赁时的折旧费用。lower depreciation expense than it would if the lease were a finance lease.
  • C. 大于将其作为融资租赁时的筹资活动现金流出。greater financing cash outflow than it would if the lease were a finance lease.
答案 B。经营租赁承租人报单一"租赁费用"(直线),其折旧+利息合计等于融资租赁,但单独看"折旧"低于融资租赁的折旧(因经营租赁不拆分利息)。Answer B. An operating-lease lessee reports a single straight-line lease expense; its depreciation is lower than a finance lease's depreciation (an operating lease does not split out interest, though total expense is similar early on).
2. 对于租期12个月或更短的租赁，承租人：2. For leases with a term of twelve months or less, the lessee: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 可按直线法确认租赁付款。may recognize lease payments on a straight-line basis.
  • B. 须在租赁开始日确认使用权资产与租赁负债，两者均等于未来租赁付款的现值。must report at lease inception a right-of-use asset and a lease liability, both equal to the present value of future lease payments.
  • C. 须在租赁开始日确认使用权资产与租赁负债，两者均等于未来租赁付款的未折现价值。must report at lease inception a right-of-use asset and a lease liability, both equal to the undiscounted value of future lease payments.
答案 A。短期租赁(≤12 个月):承租人可选择"按直线法确认租赁付款"为费用,无需上表确认使用权资产/负债。故 B、C 错。Answer A. For a short-term lease (≤12 months): the lessee may elect to recognize lease payments straight-line as an expense, with no right-of-use asset/liability on the balance sheet. So B and C are wrong.

§4 出租人会计§4 Lessor Accounting

出租人的会计在 IFRS 和 US GAAP 下基本相同(US GAAP 把融资租赁再分"销售型"和"直接融资型",但对分析师无实质区别)。Lessor accounting is basically the same under IFRS and US GAAP (US GAAP further splits finance leases into "sales-type" and "direct-financing," but with no substantive difference for analysts).

  • 融资租赁:出租人确认一项租赁应收款(= 未来租金现值)、注销被租资产,差额计利得/损失;之后用实际利率法收回,每期租金 = 利息收入 + 本金收回。整笔现金收入计入经营活动。Finance lease: the lessor recognizes a lease receivable (= present value of future rents), derecognizes the leased asset, and records the difference as a gain/loss; it then collects via the effective-interest method, with each rent = interest income + principal recovery. The entire cash receipt goes to operating activities.
  • 经营租赁:本质是出租,资产留在出租人账上继续折旧,租金收入按直线法确认(不确认利息)。整笔现金收入也计入经营活动。Operating lease: essentially a rental — the asset stays on the lessor's books and continues to depreciate, and rental income is recognized straight-line (no interest recognized). The entire cash receipt also goes to operating activities.

8. 出租人对融资租赁和经营租赁分别如何处理:How does the lessor treat finance leases and operating leases, respectively: 官方题Official

  • A. 两者都注销资产Both derecognize the asset
  • B. 两者都保留资产折旧Both keep and depreciate the asset
  • C. 融资:确认应收款、注销资产、实际利率法收息;经营:资产留账折旧、直线确认租金收入Finance: recognize a receivable, derecognize the asset, and record interest by the effective-interest method; operating: keep the asset and depreciate it, recognizing rent straight-line
答案 C。两者的现金收入都进经营活动。Answer C. Cash receipts under both go to operating activities.
1. 出租人在下列哪种租赁分类下，会在租赁开始日终止确认租赁资产并确认租赁应收款？1. Under which of the following classifications of leases will a lessor derecognize the leased asset and recognize a lease receivable on the balance sheet at lease inception? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅 IFRS 下的融资租赁Only a finance lease under IFRS
  • B. 仅 US GAAP 下的经营租赁Only an operating lease under US GAAP
  • C. IFRS 融资租赁与 US GAAP 经营租赁两者Both a finance lease under IFRS and an operating lease under US GAAP
答案 A。出租人在融资租赁下,租赁开始时终止确认标的资产、确认租赁应收款。US GAAP 经营租赁下出租人仍保留资产,故只选 IFRS 融资租赁。Answer A. A lessor derecognizes the asset and recognizes a lease receivable at commencement under a finance lease. Under a US GAAP operating lease the lessor keeps the asset, so only the IFRS finance lease qualifies.

§5 养老金:确定提存 vs 确定受益§5 Pensions: Defined Contribution vs Defined Benefit 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: explain the financial reporting of defined contribution, defined benefit, and stock-based compensation plans。
🔰 零基础讲解:两种养老金,谁担风险?

确定提存(DC)🐷 就像公司帮你往一个"个人养老储蓄罐"里定期存固定的钱(比如你存 5%,公司配 2.5%)。存进去后公司就不管了——将来你能领多少,取决于这罐钱投资赚了多少。投资和寿命风险全由员工自己承担。公司当期存多少,就记多少费用,简单。:公司承诺存入的金额固定,最终领多少看投资表现。Defined contribution (DC)🐷 It's like the company regularly putting a fixed amount into a "personal retirement piggy bank" for you (say you put in 5% and the company matches 2.5%). Once deposited, the company is done — how much you get later depends on how much that pot earns from investing. The investment and longevity risk falls entirely on the employee. Whatever the company contributes this period is exactly the expense recorded — simple.: the amount the company promises to contribute is fixed, and how much is ultimately received depends on investment performance.

确定受益(DB)🎁 就像公司承诺"你退休后每年领相当于退休前工资 70% 的养老金,直到去世"。领多少是说好的,但公司得自己想办法凑够钱、承担投资亏损和"员工比预期活得久"的风险。所以风险全在公司,会计也复杂得多。:公司承诺退休后领取的金额固定(按公式),风险由公司承担。Defined benefit (DB)🎁 It's like the company promising "after retirement you'll draw a pension equal to 70% of your pre-retirement salary each year, until death." The amount received is agreed in advance, but the company must find a way to fund it and bears the investment loss and the risk that "employees live longer than expected." So the risk is entirely on the company, and the accounting is far more complex.: the amount the company promises to pay after retirement is fixed (by formula), with the risk borne by the company.

确定提存 DCDefined contribution (DC)确定受益 DBDefined benefit (DB)
什么是"确定"的What is "defined"公司存入的金额The amount the company contributes退休后领取的金额The amount received after retirement
投资/精算风险Investment/actuarial risk员工承担Borne by the employee公司承担Borne by the company
会计Accounting简单:当期缴款即养老金费用,计经营现金流出Simple: the period's contribution is the pension expense, recorded as an operating cash outflow复杂:见 §6Complex: see §6
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

养老金:DC vs DB

• 确定提存(DC):公司只按约定缴款,投资/长寿风险由员工承担;公司费用 = 当期缴款,表内无养老金资产/负债。
• 确定受益(DB):公司承诺未来给付水平,投资与长寿风险由公司承担;需精算,产生养老金净资产/净负债。

DB 的净额

净养老金负债 = 预计给付义务(PBO) − 计划资产公允价值(资产不足即净负债)。

易错对比

① 风险:DC 归员工、DB 归公司;② DB 才上表净资产/负债;③ 净额 = PBO − 计划资产。

Pensions: DC vs DB

• Defined contribution (DC): the firm only contributes a set amount; investment/longevity risk sits with the employee; expense = the period contribution, with no pension asset/liability on the books.
• Defined benefit (DB): the firm promises a future benefit level; investment and longevity risk sit with the firm; actuarial estimates create a net pension asset/liability.

The DB net figure

Net pension liability = projected benefit obligation (PBO) − fair value of plan assets (a shortfall is a net liability).

Common traps

① Risk: DC on the employee, DB on the firm; ② only DB puts a net asset/liability on the books; ③ net = PBO − plan assets.

9. DC 与 DB 计划分别"确定"什么、谁承担投资风险:What does a DC vs DB plan 'define,' and who bears the investment risk: 官方题Official

  • A. DB 风险由员工担DB risk borne by the employee
  • B. DC:存入金额确定、风险由员工担;DB:领取金额确定、风险由公司担DC: the amount contributed is defined, risk borne by the employee; DB: the amount received is defined, risk borne by the company
  • C. DC 风险由公司担DC risk borne by the company
答案 B。DC 存入定、DB 领取定,风险归属相反。Answer B. DC defines contributions, DB defines benefits, with opposite risk-bearing.

10. DC 计划的养老金费用如何算:How is a DC plan's pension expense computed: 官方题Official

  • A. 按精算义务现值计算Computed as the present value of the actuarial obligation
  • B. 按计划资产公允价值计算Computed from the fair value of plan assets
  • C. 当期缴入金额即费用,计经营现金流出;未付部分挂应计负债The amount contributed in the period is the expense, an operating cash outflow; any unpaid portion is an accrued liability
答案 C。DC 无精算复杂性,费用即当期缴款。Answer C. DC has no actuarial complexity; the expense is the period's contribution.

§6 确定受益计划的财报处理§6 Reporting of Defined-Benefit Plans

🔰 零基础讲解:资产负债表上记什么?

公司通常把钱存进一个独立的养老金信托基金投资。资产负债表上记的是净额(资金状况 funded status):The company usually invests the money in a separate pension trust fund. The balance sheet records the net amount (funded status):

净养老金资产(负债) = 计划资产的公允价值 − 养老金义务的现值
结果Result含义Meaning
资产 > 义务Assets > obligation盈余,记净养老金资产Surplus, record a net pension asset
义务 > 资产Obligation > assets赤字(underfunded),记净养老金负债(非流动)Deficit (underfunded), record a net pension liability (non-current)

养老金义务的现值用高质量公司债收益率作折现率;折现率等假设对义务规模影响很大。The present value of the pension obligation is discounted at a high-quality corporate bond yield; assumptions like the discount rate greatly affect the size of the obligation.

每期净额变化怎么记(IFRS 分 3 项 vs US GAAP 分 5 项):How the period's change in the net amount is recorded (IFRS 3 components vs US GAAP 5 components):

成分ComponentIFRS(3 项)IFRS (3 items)US GAAP(5 项)US GAAP (5 items)
当期服务成本(员工多干一年新增的义务现值)Current service cost (the present value of the obligation added by one more year of employee service)计入利润表To the income statement计入利润表To the income statement
净利息(净负债/资产 × 折现率)Net interest (net liability/asset × discount rate)计入利润表(净额)To the income statement (net)拆成:利息费用(义务×折现率)+ 计划资产的预期回报(冲减费用)Split into: interest expense (obligation × discount rate) + the expected return on plan assets (offsetting expense)
过去服务成本(改计划产生)Past service cost (from a plan amendment)并入服务成本计利润表Included in service cost, to the income statement先计 OCI,再逐年摊销进利润表First to OCI, then amortized into the income statement over years
重新计量(精算损益 + 实际回报超预期部分)Remeasurement (actuarial gains/losses + the part of actual return above expected)计入 OCI,不再摊销To OCI, not amortized精算损益计 OCI,可逐年摊销(GAAP 允许平滑)Actuarial gains/losses to OCI, may be amortized over years (GAAP allows smoothing)
考点提示:核心记忆:资金状况 = 计划资产公允价值 − 义务现值,赤字挂非流动负债。IFRS 把"重新计量"永久留在 OCI(不摊销),US GAAP 允许把过去服务成本和精算损益放 OCI 再摊销进利润表以平滑。养老金费用最终按职能分摊(生产员工的进存货/销货成本,其他进 SG&A),所以利润表上通常看不到单独一行养老金费用,细节在附注。

11. DB 计划资产负债表上的净额如何算:How is the net amount for a DB plan on the balance sheet computed: 官方题Official

  • A. 累计缴入金额Cumulative contributions
  • B. 计划资产公允价值 − 养老金义务现值;义务 > 资产为赤字,记非流动负债Fair value of plan assets − present value of the pension obligation; obligation > assets is a deficit, recorded as a non-current liability
  • C. 义务现值 − 资产公允价值PV of the obligation − fair value of assets
答案 B。资产减义务得净盈余(资产)或赤字(负债)。Answer B. Assets minus obligation gives a net surplus (asset) or deficit (liability).

12. DB 养老金义务现值用什么折现率:What discount rate is used for the present value of a DB pension obligation: 官方题Official

  • A. 无风险国债利率The risk-free government-bond rate
  • B. 计划资产预期回报率The plan assets' expected return
  • C. 高质量公司债的收益率The yield on high-quality corporate bonds
答案 C。折现率假设对义务规模影响很大。Answer C. The discount-rate assumption greatly affects the size of the obligation.

13. IFRS 下 DB 每期变化分几项,"重新计量"计入哪里、是否摊销:Under IFRS, into how many items are DB period changes split, and where do 'remeasurements' go and are they amortized: 官方题Official

  • A. 重新计量摊销进利润表Remeasurements amortized into the income statement
  • B. 3 项(服务成本、净利息进利润表;重新计量进 OCI 且不再摊销)3 items (service cost and net interest to the income statement; remeasurements to OCI and no longer amortized)
  • C. 全部进利润表All to the income statement
答案 B。IFRS 的重新计量永久留在 OCI。Answer B. IFRS remeasurements stay permanently in OCI.

14. US GAAP 相比 IFRS 在 DB 处理上的"平滑"特点是:The 'smoothing' feature of US GAAP relative to IFRS in DB accounting is: 官方题Official

  • A. 全部立即计入利润表All recognized immediately in the income statement
  • B. 全部永久留在 OCIAll kept permanently in OCI
  • C. 把过去服务成本和精算损益先放 OCI 再逐年摊销进利润表It puts past service cost and actuarial gains/losses into OCI first, then amortizes them into the income statement over years
答案 C。逐年摊销起到平滑养老金费用的作用。Answer C. Amortizing over years smooths the pension expense.

15. 为什么利润表上通常看不到单独一行养老金费用:Why is there usually no single line for pension expense on the income statement: 官方题Official

  • A. 按职能分摊(生产员工进存货/COGS,其他进 SG&A),细节在附注披露It is allocated by function (production employees into inventory/COGS, others into SG&A), with details disclosed in the notes
  • B. 从不确认养老金费用Pension expense is never recognized
  • C. 全部计入营业外支出It is all recorded as non-operating expense
答案 A。费用被分配到各职能项目,单独明细见附注。Answer A. The expense is spread across functional lines, with a separate breakdown in the notes.
1. 设定受益养老金计划净养老金资产或负债变动的下列哪一组成部分计入其他综合收益？1. Which of the following components of change in the net pension asset or liability of a defined-benefit pension plan is recognized in other comprehensive income? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 员工服务成本Employees' service costs
  • B. 精算利得与损失Actuarial gains and losses
  • C. 按期初净养老金资产或负债计提的净利息费用或收益Net interest expense or income accrued on the beginning net pension asset or liability
答案 B。设定受益养老金:精算利得与损失(actuarial gains/losses)计入其他综合收益(OCI)(IFRS 的重计量)。服务成本、净利息进利润表。Answer B. For a defined-benefit plan, actuarial gains and losses go to other comprehensive income (OCI) (the remeasurement under IFRS). Service cost and net interest go to profit or loss.

§7 股权激励:股票授予与股票期权§7 Share-Based Compensation: Stock Grants & Stock Options

🔰 零基础讲解:为什么给员工发股票/期权?

为了让员工和股东利益一致——员工持股后,公司股价涨他也赚,自然更卖力。而且股权激励可能不用当期掏现金。但它仍要确认为费用(即使没花现金),还可能稀释每股收益。To align employee and shareholder interests — once employees hold shares, they gain when the share price rises, so they naturally work harder. And equity compensation may require no current cash outlay. But it must still be recognized as an expense (even without cash) and may dilute EPS.

核心计量规则(IFRS 和 US GAAP 相同):股权激励按授予日(grant date)的公允价值计量,在行权等待期(vesting period)内摊销为薪酬费用。授予日之后股价怎么变,不影响财报。Core measurement rule (same under IFRS and US GAAP): equity compensation is measured at the grant-date fair value and amortized as compensation expense over the vesting period. How the share price moves after the grant date does not affect the statements.

类型Type公允价值如何确定How fair value is determined
股票授予(含限制性股票 RSU、业绩股票)Stock grants (including restricted stock units RSUs, performance shares)用授予日市价(通常),在服务期内摊销;限制性股票要求员工满足留任/业绩条件Use the grant-date market price (usually), amortized over the service period; restricted stock requires the employee to meet retention/performance conditions
股票期权Stock options市价拿不到(员工期权与交易所期权不同),须用期权定价模型估计(如 Black–Scholes 或二叉树);准则不规定用哪个模型No market price available (employee options differ from exchange options), so estimated with an option-pricing model (e.g., Black–Scholes or a binomial tree); the standards don't specify which model
考点提示(期权定价输入的方向):期权公允价值随以下输入变化:股价波动率↑ → 价值↑;估计存续期↑ → 价值↑;无风险利率↑ → 价值↑;股息率↑ → 价值↓。这些主观假设(尤其波动率、存续期)能显著改变估值和薪酬费用,须看附注披露。趋势:公司越来越多用限制性股票(RSU),越来越少用期权(RSU 只要股价 >0 就有价值,期权若股价不超过行权价会一文不值)。

16. 股权激励按什么时点、什么价值计量,在哪个期间摊销:At what date and value is share-based compensation measured, and over what period is it amortized: 官方题Official

  • A. 每期按当期股价重新计量Remeasured each period at the current share price
  • B. 授予日公允价值计量,行权等待期内摊销;授予后股价变动不影响财报Measured at grant-date fair value, amortized over the vesting period; post-grant share-price changes do not affect the financials
  • C. 行权日市价计量Measured at market price on the exercise date
答案 B。授予日锁定公允价值,在服务期内摊销。Answer B. Fair value is locked at the grant date and amortized over the service period.

17. 股票授予与股票期权,公允价值确定方式的区别:The difference in how fair value is determined for stock grants vs stock options: 官方题Official

  • A. 两者都直接用市价Both use the market price directly
  • B. 期权用票面价值Options use par value
  • C. 股票授予用授予日市价;股票期权须用期权定价模型(Black–Scholes、二叉树)Stock grants use the grant-date market price; stock options must use an option-pricing model (Black–Scholes, binomial tree)
答案 C。期权无现成市价,须建模估值。Answer C. Options have no ready market price and must be modeled.

18. 期权公允价值随波动率、存续期、无风险利率、股息率如何变化:How does an option's fair value change with volatility, term, risk-free rate, and dividend yield: 官方题Official

  • A. 股息率↑ → 价值↑Higher dividend yield ↑ → higher value
  • B. 波动率↑、存续期↑、无风险利率↑ → 价值↑;股息率↑ → 价值↓Higher volatility ↑, longer term ↑, higher risk-free rate ↑ → higher value; higher dividend yield ↑ → lower value
  • C. 波动率↑ → 价值↓Higher volatility ↑ → lower value
答案 B。唯有股息率与期权价值负相关。Answer B. Only dividend yield is negatively related to option value.

19. 股权激励不花现金,为何仍确认费用、有何副作用:Share-based compensation uses no cash, so why still recognize an expense, and what is the side effect: 官方题Official

  • A. 不确认任何费用No expense is recognized
  • B. 反而增加现金流It actually increases cash flow
  • C. 它仍是薪酬费用冲减利润;副作用是稀释每股收益、稀释现有股东It is still a compensation expense that reduces profit; the side effect is diluting EPS and existing shareholders
答案 C。非现金薪酬也是真实成本,并带来股本稀释。Answer C. Non-cash compensation is still a real cost and brings share dilution.

20. 为什么公司越来越倾向用限制性股票(RSU)而非期权:Why are companies increasingly favoring restricted stock units (RSUs) over options: 补充Extra

  • A. RSU 完全不稀释股东RSUs cause no dilution at all
  • B. RSU 只要股价 >0 就有价值;期权若股价不超行权价会一文不值,激励不稳定RSUs have value as long as the share price is > 0; options can be worthless if the price does not exceed the strike, making incentives unstable
  • C. 期权成本更低Options cost less
答案 B。RSU 的留人与激励效果更稳定。Answer B. RSUs give more stable retention and incentive effects.

Volume 4 · 财务报表分析
CFA Program Curriculum · Level I · Financial Statement Analysis

第五讲 · 所得税分析 & 财务报告质量Lecture 5 · Income Tax Analysis & Financial Reporting Quality

对应教材:FSA — Learning Module《Analysis of Income Taxes》+《Financial Reporting Quality》 · 建议学习时长:3–4 小时 · 建议分两次学完(所得税约 2 小时,财报质量约 1.5 小时)Curriculum: FSA — Learning Module Analysis of Income Taxes + Financial Reporting Quality · Suggested study time: 3–4 hours · Best done in two sittings (income taxes ~2 hours, reporting quality ~1.5 hours)

这一讲两个主题很不一样:所得税分析是会计里最烧脑的计算题之一(递延所得税);财务报告质量则几乎没有计算,考的是"识别一份财报靠不靠谱"的判断力——是分析师的看家本领。This lecture's two themes are very different: income tax analysis is one of the most brain-burning calculations in accounting (deferred taxes); financial reporting quality has almost no calculation and tests the judgment of 'telling whether a financial report is reliable' — an analyst's core skill.

所得税的高频点:递延所得税资产/负债怎么产生、税基 vs 账面值、暂时性 vs 永久性差异、法定/有效/现金税率。财报质量的高频点:质量光谱、盈余质量、约束机制、警示信号。每个难点配 🔰 零基础讲解,关键术语鼠标悬停(💡)有比喻。Income-tax high-frequency points: how deferred tax assets/liabilities arise, tax base vs carrying value, temporary vs permanent differences, and statutory/effective/cash tax rates. Reporting-quality high-frequency points: the quality spectrum, earnings quality, constraint mechanisms, and warning signs. Every difficulty comes with a 🔰 Beginner explainer, and key terms have analogies on mouse hover (💡).
