§1 会计利润 vs 应税所得:四个易混概念§1 Accounting Profit vs Taxable Income: Four Easily-Confused Concepts

LOS 对应:LOS: contrast accounting profit, taxable income, taxes payable, and income tax expense。
🔰 零基础讲解:公司为什么有"两套账"?

递延所得税🧾 公司其实按两套规则算"利润":一套给股东看(会计准则,算出"会计利润"),一套给税务局看(税法,算出"应税所得")。两套规则对"某笔收入/费用哪年算"经常不一致,于是同一年两个利润数不一样,交的税也和账面"该交的税"对不上——这个差额就用"递延所得税"记在资产负债表上,相当于"欠税以后交"或"预交税以后抵"。——很多人一看到就头大,其实核心就一句:公司算利润有"会计"和"税务"两套规则,两者时间上对不齐,差额就挂账。Deferred taxes🧾 A company actually computes "profit" under two sets of rules: one for shareholders (accounting standards, giving "accounting profit") and one for the tax authority (tax law, giving "taxable income"). The two often disagree on "which year a given revenue/expense counts," so in the same year the two profit figures differ and the tax paid doesn't match the book "tax owed" — that difference is recorded as "deferred taxes" on the balance sheet, like "owing tax to pay later" or "prepaid tax to offset later." — many people panic at the term, but the core is one sentence: a company computes profit under two rule sets, "accounting" and "tax," they don't line up in timing, and the difference is carried on the books.

概念Concept含义Meaning
会计利润(accounting profit)Accounting profit按会计准则在利润表上报的税前利润(不含所得税费用)The pre-tax profit reported on the income statement under accounting standards (excluding income tax expense)
应税所得(taxable income)Taxable income按税法算出、要交税的那个所得The income computed under tax law on which tax is due
应交税款(taxes payable)Taxes payable按应税所得算出的、当期要交给税务局的税(资产负债表上的负债)The tax computed on taxable income that is owed to the tax authority this period (a balance-sheet liability)
所得税费用(income tax expense)Income tax expense利润表上的税费 = 应交税款 ± 递延所得税资产/负债的变化The tax on the income statement = taxes payable ± the change in deferred tax assets/liabilities

关键公式:Key formula:

所得税费用 = 应交税款 + Δ递延所得税负债 − Δ递延所得税资产
符号Symbol含义Meaning
应交税款Taxes payable按税法当期实际要交的税(现金口径)The tax actually due this period under tax law (cash basis)
Δ递延Δ deferred递延所得税负债/资产的当期变化;这样处理是遵循配比原则——反映当期活动的全部税务后果(即使税款在未来才付)The period's change in deferred tax liabilities/assets; this follows the matching principle — reflecting all the tax consequences of the period's activities (even if the tax is paid in the future)

1. 会计利润、应税所得、应交税款、所得税费用四者的关系是:The relationship among accounting profit, taxable income, taxes payable, and income tax expense is: 官方题Official

  • A. 所得税费用恒等于应交税款Income tax expense always equals taxes payable
  • B. 会计利润恒等于应税所得Accounting profit always equals taxable income
  • C. 会计利润=准则税前利润;应税所得=税法应税所得;应交税款=当期按应税所得交的税;所得税费用=应交税款 ± Δ递延所得税Accounting profit = pre-tax profit under the standards; taxable income = taxable income under tax law; taxes payable = the period's tax on taxable income; income tax expense = taxes payable ± Δ deferred taxes
答案 C。所得税费用在应交税款基础上加减递延部分。Answer C. Income tax expense adjusts taxes payable by the deferred portion.

2. 2018 年初就 2017 所得向税务局付 €37,000,在 2017 年末财报上记为:Paying €37,000 to the tax authority in early 2018 for 2017 income is recorded on the 2017 year-end financials as: 官方题Official

  • A. 应交税款(taxes payable)Taxes payable
  • B. 递延所得税负债A deferred tax liability
  • C. 递延所得税资产A deferred tax asset
答案 A。即将支付的当期税是应交税款,不是递延税。Answer A. Current tax about to be paid is taxes payable, not deferred tax.

§2 税基 vs 账面值,暂时性 vs 永久性差异§2 Tax Base vs Carrying Value, Temporary vs Permanent Differences 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: explain temporary versus permanent differences。
  • 账面值(carrying amount):资产/负债在财务报表上的记账金额。Carrying amount: the amount at which an asset/liability is recorded on the financial statements.
  • 税基(tax base):资产/负债为税务目的计价的金额。Tax base: the amount at which an asset/liability is valued for tax purposes.
🔰 零基础讲解:暂时性 vs 永久性,一个会"还"一个不会

暂时性差异(temporary):只是"时间差",将来会反转抹平——比如税务上头几年多提折旧、后几年就少提,最终总额一样。它产生递延所得税。Temporary differences: merely a "timing difference" that will reverse and even out in the future — e.g., more depreciation for tax in early years, less later, with the same total in the end. It produces deferred taxes.

永久性差异(permanent):永远不会反转——比如罚款(会计算费用、税法不让抵)、免税的股息收入。它不产生递延所得税,但会让有效税率偏离法定税率。Permanent differences: never reverse — e.g., fines (an accounting expense but not tax-deductible), tax-exempt dividend income. They produce no deferred taxes but cause the effective tax rate to deviate from the statutory rate.

经典例子:税务上用加速折旧(前期多抵、少交税)、财报上用直线折旧——年年不同,但资产总成本最终都摊完,是暂时性差异。Classic example: accelerated depreciation for tax (more deducted early, less tax paid) and straight-line for reporting — differing year by year, but the asset's total cost is fully depreciated in the end, a temporary difference.

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

暂时性 vs 永久性差异

会计利润与应税所得的差异分两类:
• 暂时性差异(temporary):账面值与税基不同,但未来会转回 → 产生递延所得税(DTA/DTL)。
• 永久性差异(permanent):永不转回(如免税收入、罚款、超标业务招待)→ 只影响有效税率,不产生递延。

税基是什么

税基= 税务上认可的金额。资产账面 > 税基(未来多缴税)→ DTL;负债账面 > 税基 → DTA。

易错对比

① 暂时性 → 递延;永久性 → 只调有效税率;② 免税利息/罚款是永久性;③ 加速税务折旧属暂时性 → DTL。

Temporary vs permanent differences

Differences between accounting profit and taxable income split into:
• Temporary: carrying value differs from the tax base but will reverse → creates deferred tax (DTA/DTL).
• Permanent: never reverses (e.g., tax-exempt income, fines, non-deductible entertainment) → affects only the effective tax rate, no deferral.

What the tax base is

The tax base is the amount recognized for tax. Asset carrying > tax base (more future tax) → DTL; liability carrying > tax base → DTA.

Common traps

① Temporary → deferral; permanent → effective-rate only; ② tax-exempt interest/fines are permanent; ③ accelerated tax depreciation is temporary → DTL.

3. 会计准则要求确认、但税法不允许扣除的费用,产生什么差异:An expense the accounting standards require but tax law does not allow to deduct produces what difference: 官方题Official

  • A. 永久性差异(不反转,不产生递延税)A permanent difference (does not reverse, no deferred tax)
  • B. 暂时性差异A temporary difference
  • C. 递延所得税资产A deferred tax asset
答案 A。永久性差异只影响有效税率,不产生递延税。Answer A. A permanent difference affects only the effective tax rate and produces no deferred tax.

4. 暂时性差异与永久性差异的本质区别是:The essential difference between a temporary and a permanent difference is: 官方题Official

  • A. 暂时性差异将来反转(产生递延税);永久性差异永不反转(不产生递延税,但使有效税率偏离法定税率)A temporary difference reverses later (producing deferred tax); a permanent difference never reverses (no deferred tax, but it moves the effective rate away from the statutory rate)
  • B. 两者都会反转Both reverse
  • C. 暂时性差异永不反转A temporary difference never reverses
答案 A。会不会反转是二者的分水岭。Answer A. Whether it reverses is the dividing line.
1. 资产账面金额高于其计税基础可视为：1. The carrying amount of an asset being higher than its tax base may be considered a: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 产生递延所得税资产的暂时性差异。temporary difference resulting in a deferred tax asset.
  • B. 产生递延所得税资产的永久性差异。permanent difference resulting in a deferred tax asset.
  • C. 产生递延所得税负债的暂时性差异。temporary difference resulting in a deferred tax liability.
答案 C。资产账面 > 计税基础 → 未来要多交税 → 产生"递延所得税负债(DTL)"的暂时性差异。(反之资产账面<税基或负债账面>税基→DTA。)Answer C. Asset carrying amount > tax base → more tax payable later → a temporary difference creating a deferred tax liability (DTL). (Conversely, asset carrying < tax base, or liability carrying > tax base → a DTA.)

§3 递延所得税资产(DTA)与负债(DTL)§3 Deferred Tax Assets (DTA) & Liabilities (DTL) 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: explain how deferred tax liabilities and assets are created。
🔰 零基础讲解:DTA 像"预付卡",DTL 像"欠条"

递延所得税资产 DTA💳 DTA 像一张"税务预付卡":你现在按税法多交了税(应税所得 > 会计利润),将来能少交、抵回来,所以是项"资产"。例:预收租金,税务上现在就要交税,但会计上还没确认收入——现在多交、以后抵。= 现在多交税、将来能抵(未来的税收利益)。Deferred tax asset (DTA)💳 A DTA is like a "prepaid tax card": you have overpaid tax now under tax law (taxable income > accounting profit) and can pay less and recoup it later, so it is an "asset." Example: rent received in advance is taxed now but not yet recognized as revenue for accounting — pay more now, offset later. = paying more tax now, offset later (a future tax benefit).

递延所得税负债 DTL📝 DTL 像一张"欠税条":你现在按税法少交了税(会计上的所得税费用 > 税务上实缴),将来要补上,所以是项"负债"。例:税务上加速折旧、前期少交税,后期要多交——现在少交、以后还。= 现在少交税、将来要补(未来的纳税义务)。Deferred tax liability (DTL)📝 A DTL is like an "IOU for tax": you have paid less tax now under tax law (accounting income tax expense > tax actually paid) and must make it up later, so it is a "liability." Example: accelerated depreciation for tax means less tax paid early and more later — pay less now, repay later. = paying less tax now, to be made up later (a future tax obligation).

判定口诀(务必背这张表):Determination mnemonic (memorize this table):

资产负债表项目Balance-sheet item账面值 vs 税基Carrying amount vs tax base产生Produces
资产Asset账面值 > 税基Carrying amount > tax base递延所得税负债 DTLDeferred tax liability (DTL)
资产Asset账面值 < 税基Carrying amount < tax base递延所得税资产 DTADeferred tax asset (DTA)
负债Liability账面值 > 税基Carrying amount > tax base递延所得税资产 DTADeferred tax asset (DTA)
负债Liability账面值 < 税基Carrying amount < tax base递延所得税负债 DTLDeferred tax liability (DTL)
考点提示:
① 税率变化会改变已记的 DTA/DTL:税率从 35% 降到 21%,未来税收利益/义务变小,DTA 和 DTL 的账面值都下调。
② DTA 的可实现性:只有预期未来有足够利润能用上这项抵扣时才能确认 DTA。若前景存疑——US GAAP 设估值备抵(valuation allowance)把 DTA 减到"很可能实现"的金额;IFRS 直接转回该 DTA。
③ 永久性差异不产生递延税,但直接造成有效税率≠法定税率。
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

递延所得税资产(DTA)与负债(DTL)

• DTL(负债):现在少缴、未来多缴税。典型:税务折旧 > 会计折旧(前期税盾大)。
• DTA(资产):现在多缴、未来少缴税。典型:可结转经营亏损、预提但税上未扣的费用。

估值备抵与税率变化

DTA 只有很可能实现时才全额确认,否则计提估值备抵(valuation allowance)。税率下降 → DTL 减少(记为当期利得)、DTA 也减少。

易错对比

① 税务折旧快 → DTL;亏损结转 → DTA;② 税率下降使 DTL 缩小、产生利得;③ DTA 可实现性存疑要计备抵。

Deferred tax assets (DTA) & liabilities (DTL)

• DTL: pay less now, more later. Classic: tax depreciation > accounting depreciation (bigger early tax shield).
• DTA: pay more now, less later. Classic: carryforward operating losses, accrued expenses not yet deductible.

Valuation allowance & rate changes

A DTA is recognized in full only if more likely than not to be realized, else a valuation allowance is booked. A rate cut → smaller DTL (a current gain) and a smaller DTA.

Common traps

① Fast tax depreciation → DTL; loss carryforward → DTA; ② a rate cut shrinks the DTL, creating a gain; ③ a doubtful DTA needs a valuation allowance.

5. 税收抵免(直接减税)是否产生递延所得税:Does a tax credit (a direct reduction in tax) produce deferred tax: 官方题Official

  • A. 会产生 DTLIt produces a DTL
  • B. 不会,它是永久性差异No — it is a permanent difference
  • C. 会产生 DTAIt produces a DTA
答案 B。永久性差异不产生递延所得税。Answer B. Permanent differences produce no deferred tax.

6. 资产的账面值 > 税基,产生 DTA 还是 DTL:If an asset's carrying value > tax base, does it produce a DTA or a DTL: 官方题Official

  • A. DTL(递延所得税负债)A DTL (deferred tax liability)
  • B. DTAA DTA
  • C. 不产生递延税No deferred tax
答案 A。资产 CA<税基→DTA;负债 CA>税基→DTA;负债 CA<税基→DTL。Answer A. Asset CV < tax base → DTA; liability CV > tax base → DTA; liability CV < tax base → DTL.

7. 预收租金(会计未确认收入、税务已征税)产生 DTA 还是 DTL:Unearned rent (accounting has not recognized revenue but tax has been levied) produces a DTA or a DTL: 官方题Official

  • A. DTA(现在多交、将来能抵;负债账面值 > 税基 0)A DTA (pay more now, deductible later; liability carrying value > tax base of 0)
  • B. DTLA DTL
  • C. 永久性差异A permanent difference
答案 A。提前纳税形成未来可抵扣的 DTA。Answer A. Paying tax early creates a future-deductible DTA.

8. 税务用加速折旧、财报用直线折旧,前期产生什么:Accelerated depreciation for tax and straight-line for reporting produces what in the early years: 官方题Official

  • A. DTL(税务前期多提折旧少交税,资产账面值 > 税基)A DTL (more tax depreciation early means less tax paid, asset carrying value > tax base)
  • B. DTAA DTA
  • C. 永久性差异A permanent difference
答案 A。现在少交、将来补交,是暂时性差异形成的 DTL。Answer A. Pay less now, more later — a DTL from a temporary difference.

9. 法定税率从 35% 降到 21%,已记的 DTA 与 DTL 如何变:If the statutory rate falls from 35% to 21%, how do recorded DTAs and DTLs change: 官方题Official

  • A. 两者都上调Both revised up
  • B. DTA 上调、DTL 下调DTA up, DTL down
  • C. 两者账面值都下调Both carrying values are revised down
答案 C。未来税收利益与义务都随税率下降而缩小。Answer C. Both future tax benefits and obligations shrink as the rate falls.

10. DTA 前景存疑时,US GAAP 与 IFRS 分别如何处理:When a DTA's prospects are doubtful, how do US GAAP and IFRS respectively handle it: 官方题Official

  • A. 两者都不调整Neither adjusts
  • B. US GAAP 设估值备抵减到"很可能实现"金额;IFRS 直接转回该 DTAUS GAAP sets a valuation allowance reducing it to the 'more likely than not' amount; IFRS directly reverses the DTA
  • C. US GAAP 直接转回;IFRS 设备抵US GAAP directly reverses; IFRS sets an allowance
答案 B。估值备抵 vs 直接转回是二者差异。Answer B. Valuation allowance vs direct reversal is the difference.
1. 递延所得税负债可能在下列何种情况下产生：1. A deferred tax liability could arise when: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 资产的计税基础大于其账面金额。the tax base of an asset is greater than its carrying amount.
  • B. 负债的账面金额大于其计税基础。the carrying amount of a liability is greater than its tax base.
  • C. 财务会计的所得税费用超过应交所得税。financial accounting income tax expense exceeds income taxes payable.
答案 C。DTL 产生于"财务会计的所得税费用 > 应交所得税"(会计上先认了费用、税上晚缴)。A(税基>账面)、B(负债账面>税基)产生的是 DTA。Answer C. A DTL arises when book income-tax expense > taxes currently payable (book recognizes the expense before tax does). A (tax base > carrying) and B (liability carrying > tax base) create a DTA.
2. 此前已确认一项递延所得税资产。在当前资产负债表日，经济利益标准不再满足，但税会差异仍预期为暂时性。因此：2. A deferred tax asset has been previously recognized. At the current balance sheet date, the criteria for economic benefits are not met but the tax differences are still expected to be temporary. As a result: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 应转回现有的递延所得税资产。the existing deferred tax asset should be reversed.
  • B. 应设立估值备抵账户。a valuation allowance account should be established.
  • C. 应将现有递延所得税资产重分类为权益。the existing deferred tax asset should be reclassified as equity.
答案 A。已确认 DTA,但经济利益标准不再满足、差异仍为暂时性 → 应转回(reverse)现有 DTA(IFRS 无估值备抵,直接调减)。US GAAP 才用估值备抵。Answer A. A recognized DTA whose economic-benefit criterion is no longer met, but the difference stays temporary → reverse the existing DTA (IFRS has no valuation allowance; it adjusts directly). US GAAP would use a valuation allowance.
3. 某公司发生的研究成本在本财年为财务报告目的全部费用化。适用税法要求研究成本在5年内摊销费用化。若将有应纳税利润可用于抵扣可抵扣暂时性差异，本财年公司最可能确认：3. A company incurred research costs which were all expensed in the current fiscal year for financial reporting purposes. Applicable tax laws require research costs to be expensed over a 5-year period. If taxable profit will be available against which the deductible temporary differences can be utilized, in the current fiscal year the company will most likely record: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 递延所得税资产。a deferred tax asset.
  • B. 递延所得税负债。a deferred tax liability.
  • C. 既非递延所得税资产也非递延所得税负债。neither a deferred tax asset nor a deferred tax liability.
答案 A。研究成本财务上全费用化、税上分5年摊 → 账面费用先高、税上晚扣 → 形成可抵扣暂时性差异 → 递延所得税资产(DTA)(有未来应税利润可用)。Answer A. Research expensed fully for books but amortized over 5 years for tax → book expense is higher now, deductible later → a deductible temporary difference → a deferred tax asset (DTA) (given future taxable profit).
4. 递延所得税资产可能在下列何种情况下产生：4. Deferred tax assets could arise when: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 应纳税所得额大于会计利润。taxable income is greater than accounting profit.
  • B. 资产账面金额超过其计税基础。the carrying amount of an asset exceeds its tax base.
  • C. 负债账面金额低于其计税基础。the carrying amount of a liability is lower than its tax base.
答案 A。DTA 产生于"应纳税所得额 > 会计利润"(税上先多交、以后可抵)。B(资产账面>税基)、C(负债账面<税基)产生的是 DTL。Answer A. A DTA arises when taxable income > accounting profit (more tax paid now, recoverable later). B (asset carrying > tax base) and C (liability carrying < tax base) create a DTL.
5. 关于收购拥有税前亏损结转的目标公司，下列哪项最准确？若收购方盈利：5. Which of the following statements about the acquisition of a target company with tax loss carryforwards is most accurate? If the acquirer is profitable: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 其当前税率对收购价格无影响。its current tax rate will have no impact on the acquisition price.
  • B. 该收购方理论上会比税率更低的另一收购方愿意支付更多。the acquirer would theoretically be willing to pay more than another acquirer with a lower tax rate.
  • C. 该收购方理论上会比税率更高的另一收购方愿意支付更多。the acquirer would theoretically be willing to pay more than another acquirer with a higher tax rate.
答案 C。目标公司有税前亏损结转 → 可抵未来利润。盈利更多的收购方(税率更高者)能更充分利用该抵税 → 理论上愿付更高价。Answer C. A target with tax-loss carryforwards can shelter future profit. A more profitable acquirer (higher tax rate) can use the shield more fully → would theoretically pay more.

§4 三种税率:法定 / 有效 / 现金§4 The Three Tax Rates: Statutory / Effective / Cash

LOS 对应:LOS: calculate, interpret, and contrast statutory, effective, and cash tax rates。
法定税率 = 辖区规定的公司税率    有效税率 = 所得税费用 / 税前会计利润    现金税率 = 实付税款 / 税前会计利润
税率Tax rate含义Meaning
法定税率 statutoryStatutory rate所在辖区法律规定的公司所得税率The corporate income tax rate set by law in the jurisdiction
有效税率 effectiveEffective rate利润表所得税费用 ÷ 税前利润;因永久性差异、不同辖区税率、税收抵免等而偏离法定税率Income-statement income tax expense ÷ pre-tax profit; deviates from the statutory rate due to permanent differences, different-jurisdiction rates, tax credits, etc.
现金税率 cashCash rate实际付出的现金税款 ÷ 税前利润;因暂时性差异而与有效税率不同The actual cash tax paid ÷ pre-tax profit; differs from the effective rate due to temporary differences

附注里会给出法定税率到有效税率的调节表(reconciliation),列出哪些项目导致有效税率暂时偏高或偏低——是分析师判断盈利可持续性的重要信息。The notes give a reconciliation from the statutory rate to the effective rate, listing which items push the effective rate temporarily higher or lower — important information for analysts judging earnings sustainability.

11. 有效税率与现金税率的算法及为何不同:How are the effective tax rate and the cash tax rate computed, and why do they differ: 官方题Official

  • A. 两者恒相等They are always equal
  • B. 两者不同仅因永久性差异They differ only because of permanent differences
  • C. 有效税率=所得税费用/税前利润;现金税率=实付税款/税前利润;两者不同因暂时性差异Effective rate = income tax expense/pre-tax profit; cash rate = tax actually paid/pre-tax profit; they differ because of temporary differences
答案 C。递延部分导致有效税率与现金税率分离;有效税率偏离法定税率则主要因永久性差异。Answer C. The deferred portion separates the effective and cash rates; the effective rate departs from the statutory rate mainly due to permanent differences.

§5 财报质量:报告质量 vs 盈余质量§5 Reporting Quality: Reporting Quality vs Earnings Quality

LOS 对应:LOS: compare financial reporting quality with the quality of reported results。
🔰 零基础讲解:两个"质量"别搞混

报告质量(financial reporting quality):说的是财报本身可不可信——数字是否相关、完整、中立、无错(甚至有没有造假)。Financial reporting quality: whether the statements themselves are trustworthy — whether the numbers are relevant, complete, neutral, and free of error (even whether there is fraud).

盈余质量(earnings quality):说的是业绩本身好不好、可不可持续——赚的钱是不是靠真实、能长期重复的经营活动得来的。Earnings quality: whether the performance itself is good and sustainable — whether the earnings come from real, long-term repeatable operating activities.

两者关系📊 打个比方:报告质量是"这份体检报告可不可信",盈余质量是"这个人身体到底好不好"。报告不可信(低报告质量),你连他身体好坏都判断不了;报告可信了(高报告质量),才谈得上评估他真实的健康(盈余质量)。所以:没有报告质量,盈余质量无从谈起。:先有报告质量,才谈得上评估盈余质量。The relationship📊 An analogy: reporting quality is "whether this medical report is trustworthy," earnings quality is "whether this person is actually healthy." If the report is untrustworthy (low reporting quality), you can't even judge their health; only once the report is trustworthy (high reporting quality) can you assess their real health (earnings quality). So: without reporting quality, earnings quality is moot.: reporting quality comes first, only then can earnings quality be assessed.

报告质量 低Reporting quality low报告质量 高Reporting quality high
盈余质量 高Earnings quality high低报告质量妨碍评估,无法估值Low reporting quality blocks assessment; valuation impossible可评估;高盈余质量提升公司价值Assessable; high earnings quality raises firm value
盈余质量 低Earnings quality low无法评估Cannot be assessed可评估;低盈余质量拉低公司价值Assessable; low earnings quality lowers firm value

12. 报告质量与盈余质量的含义及两者关系是:The meanings of reporting quality and earnings quality and their relationship: 官方题Official

  • A. 两者含义相同They mean the same thing
  • B. 报告质量=财报是否相关、完整、中立、无错;盈余质量=业绩好坏与可持续;先有报告质量才谈得上评估盈余质量Reporting quality = whether the financials are relevant, complete, neutral, error-free; earnings quality = how good and sustainable performance is; reporting quality must come first before assessing earnings quality
  • C. 盈余质量优先于报告质量Earnings quality takes priority over reporting quality
答案 B。报告可信是评估盈余质量的前提。Answer B. Credible reporting is a prerequisite for assessing earnings quality.
1. 某公司此前被认为具有高财务报告质量。若其营业利润大幅增加，主要源于汇率变动，则该公司最可能表现为：1. A company was previously considered to have high financial reporting quality. If operating profit dramatically increases, primarily due to foreign exchange rate movements, the company most likely demonstrates: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 低财务报告质量、高盈余质量。low financial reporting quality and high earnings quality.
  • B. 高财务报告质量、低盈余质量。high financial reporting quality and low earnings quality.
  • C. 高财务报告质量、高盈余质量。high financial reporting quality and high earnings quality.
答案 B。营业利润大增主要来自汇率变动(非核心、不可持续) → 报告质量仍高(如实反映)但盈余质量低(不可持续)。故 B。Answer B. Operating profit surging mainly from FX moves (non-core, unsustainable) → reporting quality stays high (faithfully reported) but earnings quality is low (not sustainable). Hence B.

§6 质量光谱:从高质量到虚构交易§6 The Quality Spectrum: From High Quality to Fabricated Transactions 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: describe a spectrum for assessing financial reporting quality。

把报告质量和盈余质量合起来看,财报质量是一条从高到低的光谱(务必记住这个由好到坏的排序):Taking reporting quality and earnings quality together, financial-statement quality is a spectrum from high to low (memorize this best-to-worst ranking):

档次(从高到低)Tier (high to low)含义Meaning
① 合规 + 决策有用 + 盈余可持续① Compliant + decision-useful + sustainable earnings最高质量:符合 GAAP、信息决策有用、且盈余高质量可持续、回报充足Highest quality: complies with GAAP, decision-useful information, and high-quality sustainable earnings with adequate returns
② 合规 + 决策有用,但盈余质量低② Compliant + decision-useful, but low earnings quality报告本身没问题,但业绩不可持续(低盈余质量)The report itself is fine, but performance is unsustainable (low earnings quality)
③ 合规,但有偏的选择③ Compliant, but biased choices仍在 GAAP 内,但会计选择带有偏向(如刻意乐观的估计)Still within GAAP, but the accounting choices are biased (e.g., deliberately optimistic estimates)
④ 合规,但盈余操纵(EM)④ Compliant, but earnings management (EM)仍在 GAAP 内但操纵:真实操纵(如为拉利润硬压研发/砍必要开支)+ 会计操纵(用会计手法调数字)Still within GAAP but manipulated: real manipulation (e.g., cutting R&D/necessary spending to prop up profit) + accounting manipulation (using accounting techniques to adjust the numbers)
⑤ 不合规的会计⑤ Non-compliant accounting违反 GAAPViolates GAAP
⑥ 虚构交易⑥ Fabricated transactions最低:编造根本不存在的交易(纯造假)Lowest: inventing transactions that never occurred (pure fraud)
考点提示:注意区分"真实盈余操纵(real EM)"和"会计盈余操纵(accounting EM)":真实操纵是改变真实经营决策(如年底为冲利润疯狂促销、砍掉本该做的研发),会计操纵是只动账面数字(如改估计、改政策)。真实操纵不违反准则、却损害公司长期价值,更隐蔽。Pro forma / 非 GAAP 盈余(公司自己调整后的"经调整盈利")若刻意剔除负面项目,是激进列报的典型标志。

13. 财报质量光谱从高到低的排序是:The financial-reporting quality spectrum from high to low is: 官方题Official

  • A. 虚构交易质量最高Fabricated transactions are the highest quality
  • B. 不合规优于盈余操纵Non-compliant is better than earnings manipulation
  • C. 合规+决策有用+可持续 → 合规但盈余质量低 → 合规但有偏选择 → 合规但盈余操纵 → 不合规 → 虚构交易Compliant + decision-useful + sustainable → compliant but low earnings quality → compliant but biased choices → compliant but earnings manipulation → non-compliant → fabricated transactions
答案 C。从合规且有用逐级降到虚构交易。Answer C. It descends step by step from compliant-and-useful to fabricated transactions.

14. "真实盈余操纵"与"会计盈余操纵"的区别是:The difference between 'real earnings management' and 'accounting earnings management' is: 官方题Official

  • A. 两者含义相同They mean the same thing
  • B. 真实操纵改变真实经营决策(如砍研发),不违规却损害长期价值;会计操纵只动账面数字Real management changes actual operating decisions (e.g., cutting R&D) — not a violation but harms long-term value; accounting management only moves the book numbers
  • C. 真实操纵只动账面数字Real management only moves book numbers
答案 B。真实操纵动经营、会计操纵动账目。Answer B. Real management moves operations, accounting management moves the books.

§7 动机、条件与约束机制§7 Motivations, Conditions & Constraint Mechanisms

LOS 对应:LOS: describe motivations, conditions, and mechanisms disciplining financial reporting quality。
维度Dimension内容Content
动机(为什么造假)Motivation (why commit fraud)掩盖糟糕业绩、抬高股价、增加个人薪酬、避免违反债务契约Cover up poor performance, prop up the share price, boost personal compensation, avoid breaching debt covenants
条件(舞弊三角)Conditions (the fraud triangle)① 机会(内控弱、监管松);
② 动机(压力,如业绩目标);
③ 合理化(自我说服"这么做没问题")。三者齐备最易出问题① Opportunity (weak internal controls, lax oversight);
② Motivation (pressure, e.g., performance targets);
③ Rationalization (self-justifying "this is fine"). Problems are most likely when all three are present
约束机制(什么在管着)Constraints (what keeps it in check)① 开放的资本市场 + 降低资本成本的激励;
② 独立审计师;
③ 专门惩罚错报的合同条款(如契约);
④ 监管机构执法① Open capital markets + the incentive to lower the cost of capital;
② independent auditors;
③ contractual clauses that specifically penalize misstatement (e.g., covenants);
④ regulator enforcement

15. 管理层发布低质量财报的常见动机是:Common motives for management to publish low-quality financials are: 官方题Official

  • A. 主动压低股价Deliberately depress the share price
  • B. 故意多缴税款Intentionally overpay taxes
  • C. 掩盖糟糕业绩、抬高股价、增加个人薪酬、避免违反债务契约Cover up poor performance, prop up the share price, increase personal pay, avoid breaching debt covenants
答案 C。薪酬、股价与契约约束是主要诱因。Answer C. Compensation, share price, and covenant constraints are the main triggers.

16. 舞弊三角(导致低质量报告的条件)是哪三个:The three conditions of the fraud triangle (leading to low-quality reporting) are: 官方题Official

  • A. 压力、审计、监管Pressure, audit, regulation
  • B. 机会(内控弱、监管松)、动机/压力、合理化Opportunity (weak controls, lax oversight), motivation/pressure, rationalization
  • C. 机会、资本、技术Opportunity, capital, technology
答案 B。机会、动机、合理化三者共同催生舞弊。Answer B. Opportunity, motivation, and rationalization together breed fraud.

17. 约束财报质量的机制包括:The mechanisms that constrain financial-reporting quality include: 官方题Official

  • A. 只有监管执法一种Only regulatory enforcement
  • B. 没有任何约束机制No constraining mechanisms at all
  • C. 开放资本市场、独立审计师、惩罚错报的契约条款、监管机构执法Open capital markets, independent auditors, contract terms that penalize misstatement, and regulatory enforcement
答案 C。市场、审计、契约、监管形成多重约束。Answer C. Markets, audit, contracts, and regulation form multiple constraints.

§8 会计选择与财报质量的警示信号§8 Accounting Choices & Warning Signs of Reporting Quality

管理层在会计政策和估计上有很大裁量空间,这是激进会计的温床。受影响的常见项目:Management has broad discretion over accounting policies and estimates, a breeding ground for aggressive accounting. Commonly affected items:

  • 存货成本流转假设(FIFO/LIFO);应收账款坏账估计;DTA 可实现性估计;Inventory cost-flow assumption (FIFO/LIFO); bad-debt estimates for receivables; DTA realizability estimates;
  • 折旧方法、残值、使用年限的估计。Depreciation method, salvage value, and useful-life estimates.

经营现金流(CFO)是投资者重视的指标,可被管理层的经营选择(如拖延支付应付账款)甚至分类选择所"美化"。Operating cash flow (CFO) is a metric investors value and can be "dressed up" by management's operating choices (e.g., delaying payment of payables) or even by classification choices.

考点提示:警示信号常见于:收入增长但应收账款增长更快(可能提前确认收入);净利润持续高于经营现金流(盈利质量存疑);频繁的"一次性"项目;非 GAAP 盈余总是剔除负面项;会计估计无正当理由地频繁变动。记住:盈利可以"管理",现金流更难造假——所以 CFO 与净利润的长期背离是重要红旗。

18. Pro forma / 非 GAAP 盈余若剔除负面项目,说明:If pro forma / non-GAAP earnings exclude negative items, this indicates: 官方题Official

  • A. 是激进列报的典型标志A classic sign of aggressive presentation
  • B. 是保守列报Conservative presentation
  • C. 与 GAAP 完全一致Fully consistent with GAAP
答案 A。公司使用非 GAAP 指标须做额外披露。Answer A. Companies using non-GAAP measures must make additional disclosures.

19. 哪些会计选择/估计给激进会计留下空间:Which accounting choices/estimates leave room for aggressive accounting: 官方题Official

  • A. 股本面值Share par value
  • B. 存货成本流转假设、坏账估计、DTA 可实现性、折旧方法/残值/使用年限估计Inventory cost-flow assumptions, bad-debt estimates, DTA realizability, and depreciation method/salvage/useful-life estimates
  • C. 现金余额The cash balance
答案 B。需主观判断的估计最易被操纵。Answer B. Estimates requiring subjective judgment are the easiest to manipulate.

20. 经营现金流可以被怎样"美化":How can operating cash flow be 'dressed up': 官方题Official

  • A. CFO 无法被操纵CFO cannot be manipulated
  • B. 只能通过减少收入Only by reducing revenue
  • C. 通过经营选择(如拖延支付应付账款)甚至现金流的分类选择来抬高 CFOThrough operating choices (e.g., delaying payment of payables) or even cash-flow classification choices to inflate CFO
答案 C。拖延付款与分类选择都能短期抬高 CFO。Answer C. Delaying payment and classification choices can both temporarily inflate CFO.

21. 为什么"净利润持续高于经营现金流"是重要红旗:Why is 'net income persistently above operating cash flow' an important red flag: 补充Extra

  • A. 与盈利质量无关It is unrelated to earnings quality
  • B. 盈利可被会计手法管理、现金流更难造假;长期背离往往意味盈利质量存疑Earnings can be managed with accounting techniques while cash flow is harder to fake; a long-run divergence often means earnings quality is questionable
  • C. 说明盈利质量很高It shows very high earnings quality
答案 B。常见于提前确认收入、激进应计。Answer B. Common with premature revenue recognition and aggressive accruals.

22. 高质量信息的基本特征与增强特征分别是:The fundamental and enhancing characteristics of high-quality information are, respectively: 补充Extra

  • A. 基本:可比与及时Fundamental: comparable and timely
  • B. 增强:相关性与如实反映Enhancing: relevance and faithful representation
  • C. 基本:相关性与如实反映(完整、中立、无错);增强:可比、可验证、及时、可理解Fundamental: relevance and faithful representation (complete, neutral, error-free); enhancing: comparable, verifiable, timely, understandable
答案 C。相关性与如实反映是两大基本质量特征。Answer C. Relevance and faithful representation are the two fundamental qualities.
1. 下列哪项可能表明公司采用激进的会计选择以提高当期报告业绩与财务状况？1. Which of the following might indicate that a company uses aggressive accounting choices to increase its reported performance and financial position in the current period? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 提高 PP&E 的估计残值Increasing the estimated salvage values of PP&E
  • B. 将折旧方法由直线法改为双倍余额递减法Changing the depreciation method from straight-line to double-declining balance
  • C. 在存货价格下降、数量不变期间由加权平均法改为先进先出法Changing from weighted average to FIFO inventory valuation method in a period of declining inventory prices and constant quantities
答案 A。激进会计以抬高当期业绩的迹象:提高 PP&E 估计残值(减少折旧、抬高利润)。改双倍余额递减、跌价期改 FIFO 都会降低当期利润(保守),故 B、C 反。Answer A. A sign of aggressive accounting to boost current results: raising the estimated residual value of PP&E (less depreciation, higher profit). Switching to double-declining or to FIFO in falling prices lowers current profit (conservative), so B and C are reversed.

§2 所得税披露与分析处理§2 Income-Tax Disclosures & Analytical Treatment

分析师应阅读法定税率到有效税率调节表、DTA/DTL 构成、税损结转、估值备抵和未确认税务利益。Analysts should read the statutory-to-effective tax rate reconciliation, the composition of DTAs/DTLs, tax-loss carryforwards, valuation allowances, and unrecognized tax benefits.

  • 可持续有效税率：剔除一次性税务和解、税率变更和不可重复优惠。Sustainable effective tax rate: strip out one-time tax settlements, rate changes, and non-repeatable incentives.
  • DTA 可实现性：若未来应税利润不足，DTA 可能需要估值备抵并减记。DTA realizability: if future taxable profit is insufficient, the DTA may need a valuation allowance and write-down.
  • 分析分类：若 DTL 预计长期滚动、不发生现金结算，可在特定分析中接近权益；若预计反转并纳税，则更像负债。Analytical classification: if a DTL is expected to roll forward indefinitely with no cash settlement, in certain analyses it can be treated closer to equity; if it is expected to reverse and be paid, it is more like a liability.
  • 现金税率：帮助判断所得税费用与实际现金流出的差异。Cash tax rate: helps gauge the gap between income tax expense and actual cash outflow.
常见陷阱：有效税率低并不自动代表经营优势。先判断低税率来自稳定地域结构，还是一次性优惠。

2. 为什么要区分一次性税率变化与结构性低税率:Why distinguish a one-off tax-rate change from a structural low tax rate:

  • A. 只有结构性因素才适合用于长期盈利和现金流预测Only structural factors are suitable for long-term earnings and cash-flow forecasting
  • B. 一次性变化更适合长期预测A one-off change is better for long-term forecasting
  • C. 两者对预测没有差别The two make no difference to forecasting
答案 A。一次性因素不可持续,不应外推。Answer A. One-off factors are unsustainable and should not be extrapolated.

§1 比率分析:为什么用比率、怎么用§1 Ratio Analysis: Why & How to Use Ratios

LOS 对应:LOS: describe tools and techniques used in financial analysis, including their uses and limitations。
🔰 零基础讲解:比率就是"给公司体检"

单看"净利润 10 亿"没意义——大公司赚 10 亿平平,小公司赚 10 亿惊人。财务比率🩺 比率就像体检指标:光看"体重 80 公斤"不知道胖不胖,得算 BMI(体重÷身高²)才有意义。财务比率也一样——把两个数字相除,消除规模,才能横向比同行、纵向比历史。而且要看一组指标而非单一指标(就像体检不能只看一项),才能全面判断公司健康。把两个财报数字相除,消除规模,才能跨公司、跨时间比较。"Net income of $1B" alone means nothing — $1B is ordinary for a big company, astonishing for a small one. Financial ratios🩺 Ratios are like health-check metrics: "weight 80 kg" alone doesn't tell you if you're overweight; you compute BMI (weight ÷ height²) to make it meaningful. Financial ratios are the same — dividing two figures removes scale so you can compare peers cross-sectionally and history over time. And you look at a set of metrics, not a single one (like a checkup that can't rely on one test), to judge a company's health comprehensively. divide two statement figures, removing scale to enable comparison across companies and over time.

四大类比率分别体检公司的四个方面:活动(经营效率)、流动性(短期还债)、偿债(长期还债)、盈利(赚钱能力)。The four ratio categories each check a different aspect of the company: activity (operating efficiency), liquidity (short-term solvency), solvency (long-term solvency), and profitability (earning power).

关键原则:不能只看单一比率或单一类别,要综合一组比率;还要结合行业特性(有些行业看重的指标在别的行业无关紧要)。Key principle: don't rely on a single ratio or category; combine a set of ratios and factor in industry characteristics (metrics that matter in some industries are irrelevant in others).

1. 为什么用比率而非绝对数,分析比率的原则是:Why use ratios rather than absolute numbers, and the principles of ratio analysis: 官方题Official

  • A. 应只依赖单一比率One should rely on a single ratio
  • B. 比率消除规模、便于跨公司跨时间比较;应看一组比率而非单一指标,并结合行业特性Ratios remove scale, easing comparison across companies and time; look at a set of ratios rather than a single one, and consider industry traits
  • C. 比率只能用于单一公司Ratios can only be used for a single company
答案 B。比率标准化规模,须组合使用并联系行业。Answer B. Ratios standardize scale and must be used in combination and in industry context.

2. 四大类比率各体检公司哪方面:What aspect of a company does each of the four ratio categories check: 官方题Official

  • A. 活动(经营效率)、流动性(短期偿债)、偿债(长期偿债)、盈利(赚钱能力)Activity (operating efficiency), liquidity (short-term solvency), solvency (long-term solvency), profitability (earning power)
  • B. 只有盈利与流动性两类Only profitability and liquidity
  • C. 活动比率衡量长期偿债Activity ratios measure long-term solvency
答案 A。活动、流动性、偿债、盈利四维体检。Answer A. A four-dimensional check-up: activity, liquidity, solvency, profitability.
1. 下列哪种分析可用于将公司财务比率与其主要竞争对手进行比较？1. Which of the following analyses can be used to compare a company's financial ratios with those of its major competitors? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅趋势分析Trend only
  • B. 仅横截面分析Cross-sectional only
  • C. 趋势分析与横截面分析两者Both trend and cross-sectional
答案 C。与竞争对手比较可用横截面(cross-sectional)分析;趋势(trend)分析看自身时间序列。题问"可用于",两者都可服务于比较分析,故"两者"。Answer C. Comparing with competitors uses cross-sectional analysis; trend analysis looks at the firm's own time series. Since both can serve comparative analysis, "both."

§2 活动比率(经营效率)§2 Activity Ratios (Operating Efficiency)

LOS 对应:LOS: calculate and interpret activity, liquidity, solvency, and profitability ratios。
存货周转率 = 销货成本 / 平均存货    存货周转天数 = 365 / 存货周转率
应收账款周转率 = 收入 / 平均应收账款    应收账款周转天数(DSO) = 365 / 应收账款周转率
应付账款周转率 = 采购 / 平均应付账款    总资产周转率 = 收入 / 平均总资产
比率Ratio含义Meaning
存货周转率 / 天数Inventory turnover / days一年卖空几次存货 / 一批货待多少天;越快越高效How many times inventory sells out a year / how many days a batch sits; faster is more efficient
应收账款周转率 / DSOReceivables turnover / DSO收款速度 / 平均多少天收回货款;DSO 越短回款越快Collection speed / on average how many days to collect; shorter DSO means faster collection
应付账款周转率 / 天数Payables turnover / days付款速度 / 平均多少天付供应商Payment speed / on average how many days to pay suppliers
总资产周转率Total asset turnover每 1 元资产产生多少收入;衡量整体资产使用效率How much revenue each $1 of assets generates; measures overall asset-use efficiency
🔰 零基础讲解:现金转换周期

现金转换周期💵 想象你开店:先进货(钱压在存货里)→ 赊卖出去(钱压在应收里)→ 客户付款(收回现金)。同时你也赊欠供应商(占用别人的钱)。现金转换周期 = 你的钱"被套牢"的天数。越短越好——说明你很快就能把投进去的钱收回来,资金周转灵活。衡量"投入的现金多久能收回来":The cash conversion cycle💵 Picture running a store: first stock up (cash tied up in inventory) → sell on credit (cash tied up in receivables) → the customer pays (cash recovered). Meanwhile you also owe suppliers on credit (using their money). The cash conversion cycle = the number of days your cash is "locked up." Shorter is better — meaning you recover the money you put in quickly and your capital turns over flexibly. measures how long it takes to recover the cash invested:

现金转换周期 = 存货周转天数 + 应收账款天数(DSO) − 应付账款天数
组成Component含义Meaning
存货天数 + DSODays inventory + DSO钱被压在存货和应收里的天数Days cash is tied up in inventory and receivables
− 应付账款天数− days payables减去"占用供应商资金"的天数;周期越短越好Subtract the days of "using supplier funds"; a shorter cycle is better

3. 存货周转率与总资产周转率的公式是:The formulas for inventory turnover and total asset turnover are: 官方题Official

  • A. 存货周转=收入/平均存货Inventory turnover = revenue/average inventory
  • B. 总资产周转=净利润/平均总资产Total asset turnover = net income/average total assets
  • C. 存货周转=销货成本/平均存货;总资产周转=收入/平均总资产Inventory turnover = COGS/average inventory; total asset turnover = revenue/average total assets
答案 C。存货周转分子用 COGS,总资产周转分子用收入。Answer C. Inventory turnover uses COGS in the numerator, total asset turnover uses revenue.

4. 应收账款周转天数(DSO)怎么算,越短还是越长好:How is days sales outstanding (DSO) computed, and is shorter or longer better: 官方题Official

  • A. DSO=365/(收入/平均应收);越短越好(回款快)DSO = 365/(revenue/average receivables); shorter is better (fast collection)
  • B. 越长越好Longer is better
  • C. DSO=平均应收/收入DSO = average receivables/revenue
答案 A。回款周期越短,资金效率越高。Answer A. A shorter collection cycle means higher capital efficiency.

5. 现金转换周期怎么算,越短还是越长好:How is the cash conversion cycle computed, and is shorter or longer better: 官方题Official

  • A. 存货天数 + DSO − 应付天数;越短越好Days of inventory + DSO − days of payables; shorter is better
  • B. 越长越好Longer is better
  • C. 存货天数 − DSO + 应付天数Days of inventory − DSO + days of payables
答案 A。CCC 越短,投入现金回收越快。Answer A. A shorter CCC means faster recovery of invested cash.

6. 存货周转率高一定说明管理更高效吗:Does high inventory turnover necessarily mean more efficient management: 官方题Official

  • A. 一定低效It always means inefficient
  • B. 不一定;也可能因减值/LIFO 使存货账面低,或多卖但不赚钱Not necessarily; it may reflect low booked inventory from write-downs/LIFO, or selling more without making money
  • C. 一定更高效It always means more efficient
答案 B。需结合其他指标综合判断。Answer B. It must be judged together with other metrics.

7. 应付账款周转率的分子用什么:What does the numerator of accounts-payable turnover use: 补充Extra

  • A. 营业收入Operating revenue
  • B. 净利润Net income
  • C. 采购额(purchases),不是销货成本或收入;应付天数=365/应付周转率Purchases, not COGS or revenue; days payable = 365/payables turnover
答案 C。应付账款对应采购而非收入。Answer C. Payables correspond to purchases, not revenue.
1. 下列哪项最可能表明公司信用与收款政策效率提高？下列何者的增加：1. Which of the following most likely indicates improved efficiency of a company's credit and collection policy? An increase in: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 应收账款周转率receivables turnover ratio
  • B. 应收账款周转天数(DSO)days of sales outstanding
  • C. 应付账款周转天数number of days of payables
答案 A。信用与收款效率提高的迹象:应收账款周转率上升(收款更快)。DSO 上升、应付天数上升都表示放慢,故 B、C 反。Answer A. A sign of better credit/collection efficiency: a rising receivables turnover (faster collection). Rising DSO or payables days indicate slowing, so B and C are reversed.
2. 其他条件相同，现金转换周期最可能在下列何种情况下缩短：2. All else being equal, the cash conversion cycle most likely shortens if: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 应付账款周转率下降。payables turnover decreases.
  • B. 存货周转率下降。inventory turnover decreases.
  • C. 应收账款周转天数增加。days of sales outstanding increases.
答案 A。现金转换周期 CCC = 存货天数 + 应收天数 − 应付天数。应付账款周转率下降 → 应付天数变长 → CCC 缩短(晚付钱、占用供应商资金)。Answer A. Cash conversion cycle = days inventory + days receivable − days payable. A falling payables turnover → longer days payable → a shorter CCC (paying suppliers later frees cash).
3. 其他条件相同，资产较旧的公司其固定资产周转率相较于资产较新的公司：3. All else being equal, a company with older assets has a fixed asset turnover ratio that is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 更高。higher compared to a company with newer assets.
  • B. 相同。the same compared to a company with newer assets.
  • C. 更低。lower compared to a company with newer assets.
答案 A。资产较旧 → 账面净值(分母)因累计折旧而更小 → 固定资产周转率(销售/净固定资产)更高。这是"旧资产"造成的会计假象,非真实更高效。Answer A. Older assets → a smaller net carrying value (denominator) due to accumulated depreciation → a higher fixed-asset turnover (sales/net fixed assets). This is an accounting artifact of old assets, not true efficiency.
4. 下列哪类财务比率最可能用于衡量公司完成日常任务的效率？4. Which category of financial ratios is most likely used to measure how efficiently a company performs day-to-day tasks? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 活动比率Activity
  • B. 流动性比率Liquidity
  • C. 偿债能力比率Solvency
答案 A。衡量"完成日常任务效率"的是活动比率(activity ratios)(周转率类)。流动性比率看短期偿债;偿债能力比率看长期杠杆。Answer A. Efficiency at day-to-day tasks is measured by activity ratios (turnover-type). Liquidity ratios gauge short-term solvency; solvency ratios gauge long-term leverage.
5. 分析师获得某公司以下信息（单位：百万欧元）：
收入15
销售成本12

The receivables turnover ratio is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 0.7。0.7.
  • B. 1.2。1.2.
  • C. 1.5。1.5.
答案 C。方法:应收账款周转率 = 收入(赊销)÷ 平均应收账款。代入 ≈ 1.5。Answer C. Method: receivables turnover = (credit) sales ÷ average receivables. ≈ 1.5.
6. 分析师获得两家公司以下信息：
公司1公司2
应付账款天数7060
存货在手天数2025
应收账款天数4040
哪家公司最可能需要为营运资本目的筹集额外资金？6. An analyst gathers the following information about two companies:
Company 1Company 2
Number of days of payables7060
Days of inventory on hand2025
Days of sales outstanding4040
Which company most likely needs to raise additional funds for working capital purposes? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅公司1Only Company 1
  • B. 仅公司2Only Company 2
  • C. 公司1与公司2两者Both Company 1 and Company 2
答案 B。现金转换周期越长、营运资本占用越多的公司,越需为营运资本额外筹资。按表比较,公司2 的 CCC/营运资本需求更高 → 仅公司2。Answer B. The firm with a longer cash conversion cycle / more working capital tied up needs more external working-capital financing. Per the table, company 2 has the higher CCC/need → company 2 only.
7. 下列哪项最可能延长现金转换周期？下列何者的增加：7. Which of the following most likely lengthens the cash conversion cycle? An increase in: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 应付账款周转率payables turnover
  • B. 存货周转率inventory turnover
  • C. 应收账款周转率receivables turnover
答案 A。CCC = 存货天数 + 应收天数 − 应付天数。应付账款周转率上升 → 应付天数缩短 → CCC 延长(更早付供应商)。Answer A. CCC = days inventory + days receivable − days payable. A rising payables turnover → shorter days payable → a longer CCC (paying suppliers sooner).

§3 流动性比率(短期偿债)§3 Liquidity Ratios (Short-Term Solvency)

流动比率 = 流动资产 / 流动负债    速动比率 = (现金 + 有价证券 + 应收账款) / 流动负债
现金比率 = (现金 + 有价证券) / 流动负债
比率Ratio含义Meaning
流动比率Current ratio最宽:全部流动资产覆盖流动负债的能力Broadest: the ability of all current assets to cover current liabilities
速动比率(酸性测试)Quick ratio (acid test)较严:剔除不易变现的存货和预付Stricter: excludes hard-to-liquidate inventory and prepaids
现金比率Cash ratio最严:只算现金和有价证券Strictest: counts only cash and marketable securities

(这三个比率第二讲已讲过,这里作为流动性类别的一部分再列出。此外还有防御区间比率=可用速动资产/日常经营现金支出,衡量能撑多少天。)(These three were covered in Lecture 2 and are relisted here as part of the liquidity category. There is also the defensive interval ratio = available quick assets / daily operating cash outlays, measuring how many days it can hold out.)

考点·流动性比率一览:
• 流动比率 = 流动资产 ÷ 流动负债;
• 速动比率(quick) = (现金 + 有价证券 + 应收) ÷ 流动负债(剔除存货);
• 现金比率 = (现金 + 有价证券) ÷ 流动负债;
• 防御性区间比率(defensive interval ratio) = 现金类资产 ÷ 日均现金支出(无收入下能撑多少天开支)。Exam - liquidity ratios at a glance:
- current ratio = current assets / current liabilities;
- quick ratio = (cash + marketable securities + receivables) / current liabilities (excludes inventory);
- cash ratio = (cash + marketable securities) / current liabilities;
- defensive interval ratio = liquid assets / average daily cash expenditure (how many days of expenses can be covered with no revenue).

8. 流动、速动、现金比率的区别是:The difference among the current, quick, and cash ratios is: 官方题Official

  • A. 速动比率包含存货The quick ratio includes inventory
  • B. 由宽到严:流动(全部流动资产)→速动(剔除存货预付)→现金(只算现金+有价证券)From loose to strict: current (all current assets) → quick (excludes inventory and prepayments) → cash (only cash + marketable securities)
  • C. 现金比率口径最宽The cash ratio is the loosest
答案 B。越往后剔除越多,口径越严。Answer B. The further down, the more excluded and the stricter.
1. 分析师获得某公司流动资产与流动负债以下信息（单位：千英镑）：
现金及等价物800

Cash and equivalents800

The company's quick ratio is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 0.13。0.13.

  • C. 0.40。0.40.
答案 B。方法:速动比率 =(现金 + 有价证券 + 应收)÷ 流动负债(剔除存货)。代入 ≈ 0.33。Answer B. Method: quick ratio = (cash + marketable securities + receivables) ÷ current liabilities (excludes inventory). ≈ 0.33.
2. 下列哪项是流动性比率的例子？2. Which of the following is an example of a liquidity ratio? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 防御性区间比率Defensive interval ratio
  • B. 存货周转率Inventory turnover ratio
  • C. 营运资本周转率Working capital turnover ratio
答案 A。防御性区间比率(defensive interval ratio)是流动性比率(现金类资产能支撑多少天开支)。存货周转率、营运资本周转率是活动比率。Answer A. The defensive interval ratio is a liquidity ratio (how many days of expenses liquid assets can cover). Inventory and working-capital turnover are activity ratios.

第2年第1年

总负债€730€608

Year 2Year 1
Cash and marketable securities€55€50

§4 偿债比率(长期偿债)§4 Solvency Ratios (Long-Term Solvency)

负债资产比 = 总负债 / 总资产    负债资本比 = 总负债 / (总负债+总权益)
负债权益比 = 总负债 / 总权益    财务杠杆 = 平均总资产 / 平均总权益
利息保障倍数 = EBIT / 利息费用
比率Ratio含义Meaning
负债类比率Debt ratios负债占资产/资本/权益的比例;越高杠杆越大、风险越高Debt as a proportion of assets/capital/equity; higher means more leverage and higher risk
财务杠杆Financial leverage平均总资产 ÷ 平均总权益;杜邦分析里的杠杆项Average total assets ÷ average total equity; the leverage term in DuPont analysis
利息保障倍数Interest coverage ratioEBIT ÷ 利息费用;衡量赚的钱够付几倍利息,越高越安全EBIT ÷ interest expense; measures how many times over earnings cover interest — higher is safer
考点·偿债能力比率(solvency)细分:
• 利息保障倍数 = EBIT ÷ 利息费用(盈利对利息的覆盖)。
• 固定费用保障倍数(fixed-charge coverage) = (EBIT + 租赁费) ÷ (利息 + 租赁费) —— 把「租赁」等固定融资负担也算进去,更全面地衡量偿付固定支出的能力。
• 杠杆比率:债务/权益(D/E)、债务/资本(D/(D+E))、债务/EBITDA、财务杠杆(资产/权益)。Exam - solvency ratios in detail:
- Interest coverage = EBIT / interest expense (earnings covering interest).
- Fixed-charge coverage = (EBIT + lease payments) / (interest + lease payments) - it also captures fixed financing charges like leases, a fuller measure of the ability to meet fixed obligations.
- Leverage ratios: debt/equity, debt/capital (D/(D+E)), debt/EBITDA, and financial leverage (assets/equity).

9. 利息保障倍数怎么算、衡量什么:How is the interest coverage ratio computed, and what does it measure: 官方题Official

  • A. 净利润/利息费用Net income/interest expense
  • B. 收入/利息费用Revenue/interest expense
  • C. EBIT/利息费用;衡量赚的钱够付几倍利息,越高越安全EBIT/interest expense; it measures how many times earnings cover interest — higher is safer
答案 C。用 EBIT 衡量偿息能力。Answer C. It measures interest-paying ability using EBIT.

10. 财务杠杆(权益乘数)的公式是:The formula for financial leverage (the equity multiplier) is: 官方题Official

  • A. 总负债/总权益Total liabilities/total equity
  • B. 平均总资产/平均总权益Average total assets/average total equity
  • C. 平均总权益/平均总资产Average total equity/average total assets
答案 B。权益乘数是杜邦分析中的杠杆项。Answer B. The equity multiplier is the leverage term in DuPont analysis.
1. 下列哪一比率最适合衡量公司偿付债务的能力？1. Which of the following ratios is most appropriate in measuring a company's ability to cover its debt payments? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 净资产收益率Return on equity
  • B. 固定资产周转率Fixed asset turnover
  • C. 固定费用保障倍数Fixed charge coverage
答案 C。衡量偿债能力最合适 = 固定费用保障倍数(fixed-charge coverage)(盈利对固定融资费用的覆盖)。ROE 是盈利;固定资产周转率是活动比率。Answer C. The best measure of debt-servicing ability = the fixed-charge coverage ratio (earnings covering fixed financing charges). ROE is profitability; fixed-asset turnover is an activity ratio.

3. 产权比率（债务/权益）为1.0，最可能对应的债务资本比（债务/资本）为：3. A debt-to-equity ratio of 1.0 most likely results in a debt-to-capital ratio of: 真题模考Mock

§5 盈利比率§5 Profitability Ratios

毛利率 = 毛利 / 收入  营业利润率 = 营业利润 / 收入  税前利润率 = 税前利润 / 收入  净利率 = 净利润 / 收入
ROA = 净利润 / 平均总资产    ROE = 净利润 / 平均股东权益
比率Ratio含义Meaning
销售利润率系列(毛利/营业/税前/净)Sales margin series (gross/operating/pre-tax/net)每 1 元收入在各层级留下多少利润How much profit each $1 of revenue leaves at each level
ROA 资产回报率ROA (return on assets)每 1 元资产赚多少净利润How much net income each $1 of assets earns
ROE 净资产回报率ROE (return on equity)每 1 元股东权益赚多少净利润——股东最关心How much net income each $1 of shareholders' equity earns — shareholders care most about this

11. ROA 与 ROE 的公式与区别是:The formulas and difference between ROA and ROE: 官方题Official

  • A. ROA=净利润/权益ROA = net income/equity
  • B. 两者完全相同They are identical
  • C. ROA=净利润/平均总资产;ROE=净利润/平均股东权益(股东最关心)ROA = net income/average total assets; ROE = net income/average shareholders' equity (what shareholders care about most)
答案 C。ROE 反映每元股东资本的回报。Answer C. ROE reflects the return on each dollar of shareholder capital.
1. 分析师获得某公司以下信息（单位：百万欧元）：
EBIT150
税前利润130
净利润110
平均总资产1,000
资产收益率(ROA)为：1. An analyst gathers the following information (in € millions) about a company:
EBIT150
Earnings before taxes130
Net income110
Total average assets1,000
ROA is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 11%。11%.
  • B. 13%。13%.
  • C. 15%。15%.
答案 A。方法:ROA = 净利润 ÷ 平均总资产。代入 ≈ 11%。Answer A. Method: ROA = net income ÷ average total assets. ≈ 11%.
2. 分析师获得某会计年度截至12月31日的公司以下信息（单位：千欧元）：
第1年截至6月30日的半年盈利2,000
第1年截至12月31日的全年盈利1,500
第2年截至6月30日的半年盈利2,200
该公司截至第2年6月30日的滚动12个月盈利（单位：千欧元）为：2. An analyst gathers the following information (in € thousands) about a company whose fiscal year ends on 31 December:
Earnings for the six months ended 30 June of Year 12,000
Earnings for the year ended 31 December of Year 11,500
Earnings for the six months ended 30 June of Year 22,200
The company's trailing 12-month earnings (in € thousands) for the period ended 30 June of Year 2 is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 1,700。1,700.

答案 A。方法:滚动12个月盈利 = 上年全年 − 上年前半年 + 本年前半年(把最新两个半年拼成12个月)。按表 ≈ 1,700。Answer A. Method: trailing-12-month earnings = prior full year − prior first half + current first half (stitching the latest 12 months). Per the table ≈ 1,700.

§6 杜邦分析:拆解 ROE(三步与五步)§6 DuPont Analysis: Decomposing ROE (Three-Step & Five-Step) 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: demonstrate the application of DuPont analysis of return on equity。
🔰 零基础讲解:杜邦分析是"给 ROE 做归因"

ROE(净资产回报率)是股东最关心的指标。但两家公司 ROE 都是 15%,原因可能完全不同:一家靠高利润率,一家靠高杠杆(借钱多)——后者风险大得多。杜邦分析🔍 杜邦分析就像把"总分"拆成"各科成绩":两个学生都考 90 分,一个是靠数学满分、一个是靠语文满分,底子完全不同。ROE 也一样——杜邦把它拆成"赚钱能力×资产效率×杠杆",让你看清这家公司的高 ROE 到底是真本事(高利润率、高效率)还是靠借钱撑的(高杠杆),从而判断可持续性和风险。就是把 ROE 拆成几个"分项",看清它到底靠什么撑起来。ROE (return on equity) is the metric shareholders care about most. But two companies can both have 15% ROE for entirely different reasons: one from a high profit margin, the other from high leverage (lots of borrowing) — the latter far riskier. DuPont analysis🔍 DuPont analysis is like breaking a "total score" into "subject scores": two students both score 90, one from a perfect math score, the other from a perfect language score — completely different foundations. ROE is the same — DuPont splits it into "earning power × asset efficiency × leverage," letting you see whether a high ROE is real skill (high margin, high efficiency) or propped up by borrowing (high leverage), so you can judge sustainability and risk. splits ROE into several "sub-terms" to reveal what really holds it up.

两步:ROE = ROA × 权益乘数(杠杆)
三步:ROE = 净利率 × 总资产周转率 × 财务杠杆
五步:ROE = 税负担 × 利息负担 × EBIT利润率 × 总资产周转率 × 财务杠杆
分项Sub-term公式Formula反映Reflects
净利率Net margin净利润 / 收入Net income / revenue盈利能力Profitability
总资产周转率Total asset turnover收入 / 平均总资产Revenue / average total assets效率Efficiency
财务杠杆(权益乘数)Financial leverage (equity multiplier)平均总资产 / 平均总权益Average total assets / average total equity偿债/杠杆Solvency/leverage
税负担 tax burdenTax burden净利润 / 税前利润(EBT)Net income / pre-tax profit (EBT)税收留存比例(越高税负越轻)The proportion of earnings retained after tax (higher means a lighter tax burden)
利息负担 interest burdenInterest burden税前利润(EBT) / EBITPre-tax profit (EBT) / EBIT利息侵蚀程度(越高负担越轻)The degree of interest erosion (higher means a lighter burden)
EBIT 利润率EBIT marginEBIT / 收入EBIT / revenue经营盈利能力Operating profitability

记忆要点:三步 = 净利率(盈利)× 周转率(效率)× 杠杆(负债);五步是把"净利率"再拆成"税负担 × 利息负担 × EBIT 利润率",从而把税收、利息、经营三种影响分开看。Memory point: three-step = net margin (profitability) × turnover (efficiency) × leverage (solvency); five-step further splits "net margin" into "tax burden × interest burden × EBIT margin," separating the tax, interest, and operating effects.

教材算例 · 杜邦三步归因 官方题Official

某公司 ROE 从 −0.62% 升到 5.92%。三步分解显示:净利率从 −0.47% 升到 3.33%、总资产周转率从 0.84 升到 1.11、杠杆基本稳定(约 1.6)。结论:ROE 上升主要靠盈利能力改善 + 效率提升(而非加杠杆),质量较好。A company's ROE rose from −0.62% to 5.92%. The three-step decomposition shows: net margin rose from −0.47% to 3.33%, total asset turnover from 0.84 to 1.11, and leverage roughly stable (~1.6). Conclusion: the ROE rise was driven mainly by improved profitability + higher efficiency (not more leverage), a higher-quality improvement.

对比题:A 公司 ROE 5.92%、B 公司 9.28%。B 更高的原因是它杠杆更大(2.00 vs 1.60)且净利率更高(4.38% vs 3.33%)——B 的高 ROE 一部分靠借钱撑,风险更高。Comparison: Company A ROE 5.92%, Company B 9.28%. B is higher because it has more leverage (2.00 vs 1.60) and a higher net margin (4.38% vs 3.33%) — part of B's high ROE is propped up by borrowing, so it is riskier.

考点提示:杜邦题的标准解法:
① 记住三步/五步公式;
② 把各年(或各公司)的分项列出来对比;
③ 判断 ROE 变化"主要由哪个分项驱动"。关键判断:靠利润率/效率提升的 ROE 质量高;靠加杠杆撑起来的 ROE 风险高、不可持续。注意税负担和利息负担的定义是"留存比例"(净利润/EBT、EBT/EBIT),数值越大代表税/息侵蚀越少。
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

杜邦分析:拆解 ROE

三步:ROE = 净利率 × 总资产周转率 × 权益乘数(盈利能力 × 运营效率 × 财务杠杆)。
五步:ROE = 税负担 × 息负担 × EBIT 利润率 × 总资产周转 × 权益乘数,把净利率进一步拆成税、利息、经营三部分。

机制

杜邦告诉你 ROE 的驱动来源:是靠高利润率、快周转,还是靠加杠杆?加杠杆能抬 ROE 但同时抬风险。

易错对比

① 三步 = 利润率×周转×杠杆;② 五步多拆出税负担(NI/EBT)与息负担(EBT/EBIT);③ 高 ROE 若主要来自杠杆,质量低、风险高。

DuPont: decomposing ROE

Three-step: ROE = net margin × asset turnover × equity multiplier (profitability × efficiency × leverage).
Five-step: ROE = tax burden × interest burden × EBIT margin × asset turnover × equity multiplier, splitting net margin into tax, interest, and operating parts.

Mechanism

DuPont shows the drivers of ROE: high margins, fast turnover, or just more leverage? Leverage lifts ROE but also risk.

Common traps

① Three-step = margin × turnover × leverage; ② five-step adds tax burden (NI/EBT) and interest burden (EBT/EBIT); ③ a high ROE driven mainly by leverage is low quality and high risk.

12. 杜邦两步分解是:The two-step DuPont decomposition is: 官方题Official

  • A. ROE = ROA + 杠杆ROE = ROA + leverage
  • B. ROE = ROA × 财务杠杆(权益乘数)ROE = ROA × financial leverage (equity multiplier)
  • C. ROE = 净利率 × 收入ROE = net margin × revenue
答案 B。两步分解把 ROE 拆成资产回报与杠杆。Answer B. The two-step split breaks ROE into asset return and leverage.

13. 杜邦三步分解的三个分项是:The three components of the three-step DuPont decomposition are: 官方题Official

  • A. 税负 × 利息负担 × 杠杆Tax burden × interest burden × leverage
  • B. 收入 × 成本 × 杠杆Revenue × cost × leverage
  • C. 净利率 × 总资产周转率 × 财务杠杆Net margin × total asset turnover × financial leverage
答案 C。盈利×效率×杠杆。Answer C. Profitability × efficiency × leverage.

14. 杜邦五步分解把净利率进一步拆成哪几项:The five-step DuPont decomposition further splits net margin into which items: 官方题Official

  • A. 拆成收入与成本Into revenue and cost
  • B. 税负担(NI/EBT) × 利息负担(EBT/EBIT) × EBIT利润率(EBIT/收入),再 × 周转率 × 杠杆Tax burden (NI/EBT) × interest burden (EBT/EBIT) × EBIT margin (EBIT/revenue), then × turnover × leverage
  • C. 只拆成周转率与杠杆Only into turnover and leverage
答案 B。五步在三步基础上把净利率再拆三层。Answer B. The five-step further splits net margin into three layers on top of the three-step.

15. 税负担 = NI/EBT,数值越大代表:Tax burden = NI/EBT; a larger value means: 官方题Official

  • A. 税后留存比例越高,即税负越轻A higher after-tax retention ratio, i.e., a lighter tax burden
  • B. 税负越重A heavier tax burden
  • C. 与税负无关Unrelated to tax burden
答案 A。利息负担 EBT/EBIT 同理,越大代表利息侵蚀越少。Answer A. Interest burden EBT/EBIT is analogous — larger means less interest erosion.

16. 两公司 ROE 相同,一家靠高净利率、一家靠高杠杆,哪个质量更高:Two firms have the same ROE, one from a high net margin and one from high leverage; which is higher quality: 官方题Official

  • A. 靠高杠杆的质量更高The one from high leverage is higher quality
  • B. 两者质量相同They are equal quality
  • C. 靠高净利率(和高效率)的质量更高、更可持续The one from a high net margin (and high efficiency) is higher quality and more sustainable
答案 C。杠杆撑起的 ROE 风险更大、不可持续。Answer C. ROE propped up by leverage is riskier and unsustainable.

17. ROE 从 −0.62% 升到 5.92%,净利率与周转率都升、杠杆稳定,说明:ROE rises from −0.62% to 5.92%, with net margin and turnover both up and leverage stable; this indicates: 官方题Official

  • A. 主要靠盈利能力改善 + 效率提升(非加杠杆),质量较好Mainly improved profitability + higher efficiency (not more leverage), fairly good quality
  • B. 主要靠加杠杆Mainly more leverage
  • C. 质量恶化Deteriorating quality
答案 A。非杠杆驱动的 ROE 提升更健康。Answer A. A non-leverage-driven ROE improvement is healthier.

18. A(杠杆1.60、净利率3.33%、ROE 5.92%)vs B(杠杆2.00、净利率4.38%、ROE 9.28%),B 更高的驱动因素是:A (leverage 1.60, net margin 3.33%, ROE 5.92%) vs B (leverage 2.00, net margin 4.38%, ROE 9.28%); the drivers of B's higher ROE are: 官方题Official

  • A. 更大的杠杆 + 更高的净利率;更高杠杆意味风险也更高Greater leverage + higher net margin; higher leverage also means higher risk
  • B. 仅靠更低成本Only lower costs
  • C. 仅靠更高周转率Only higher turnover
答案 A。B 的高 ROE 兼有更高杠杆与净利率。Answer A. B's high ROE comes from both higher leverage and higher net margin.

§7 财报建模:预测与情景分析§7 Financial Modeling: Forecasting & Scenario Analysis

LOS 对应:LOS: describe techniques used to forecast future financial performance。
🔰 零基础讲解:建模就是"预测公司未来的报表"

分析师估值前,得先预测公司未来几年的收入、成本、利润。这就是财报建模。最关键、也最难的是预测收入——因为其他很多项(成本、利润)都是跟着收入走的。Before valuing, analysts must first forecast the company's revenue, costs, and profit for the next few years. This is financial-statement modeling. The most crucial and hardest part is forecasting revenue — because many other items (costs, profit) follow from it.

预测收入的两种思路:Two approaches to forecasting revenue:

方法Method思路Approach
自上而下(top-down)Top-down从宏观/行业出发:先估行业总规模(如与 GDP 挂钩),再乘以公司的市场份额Start from macro/industry: estimate total industry size (e.g., tied to GDP), then multiply by the company's market share
自下而上(bottom-up)Bottom-up从公司内部驱动因素出发:如"门店数 × 单店收入""销量 × 单价",逐项加总Start from the company's internal drivers: e.g., "number of stores × revenue per store," "volume × unit price," summed item by item
混合法Hybrid两者结合,交叉验证Combine the two, cross-validating

成本与利润预测:常用共同比假设(如把销货成本、销售费用按收入的固定百分比预测),再结合规模经济、通胀等调整;毛利率是关键假设。Cost and profit forecasting: commonly uses common-size assumptions (e.g., forecasting COGS and selling expenses as a fixed percentage of revenue), adjusted for economies of scale, inflation, etc.; the gross margin is the key assumption.

应对不确定性的三种技术:Three techniques for handling uncertainty:

技术Technique含义Meaning
敏感性分析(sensitivity)Sensitivity analysis只变一个关键假设(如收入增速),看结果怎么变——"如果…会怎样"Vary just one key assumption (e.g., revenue growth) and see how the result changes — "what if…"
情景分析(scenario)Scenario analysis同时变一组假设,构建乐观/基准/悲观等几套完整情景Vary a set of assumptions at once, building complete optimistic/base/pessimistic scenarios
模拟(simulation,如蒙特卡洛)Simulation (e.g., Monte Carlo)给关键变量设定概率分布,计算机跑成千上万次,得出结果的概率分布Assign probability distributions to key variables and let the computer run thousands of times to obtain a probability distribution of the result
考点提示:区分三种技术:敏感性=一次动一个变量;情景=一次动一组变量(几套剧本);模拟=用概率分布跑大量随机情形。此外,分析师还要考虑竞争格局(波特五力)和通胀对预测的影响——通胀既影响收入(提价)也影响成本,能否转嫁取决于公司的定价权。

正常化盈利(normalized earnings):剔除异常或临时性因素(一次性事件、周期高/低点)后,公司在中周期(mid-cycle)预期的盈利水平。对周期性公司尤为重要——用正常化盈利(而非当前可能处于周期顶/底的盈利)估值,更能反映可持续的盈利能力。Normalized earnings: the company’s expected mid-cycle level of earnings after removing unusual or temporary factors (one-off events, cyclical peaks/troughs). It is especially important for cyclical companies — valuing on normalized earnings, rather than current (possibly peak/trough) earnings, better reflects sustainable earning power.

考点·用价格弹性预测收入:需求价格弹性 = |销量变化% ÷ 价格变化%|。若弹性 = 0.8(缺乏弹性,<1),提价 10% → 销量降 0.8×10% = 8%,但收入仍上升(缺乏弹性时提价利于收入);弹性 > 1(富有弹性)时提价反而使收入下降。Exam - using price elasticity to forecast revenue: price elasticity of demand = |%change in quantity / %change in price|. If elasticity = 0.8 (inelastic, <1), a 10% price rise makes quantity fall 0.8x10% = 8%, but revenue still rises (raising price helps revenue when inelastic); with elasticity > 1 (elastic), a price rise lowers revenue.

19. 财报建模中最关键、最难预测的通常是哪一项:In financial-statement modeling, which item is usually the most critical and hardest to forecast: 官方题Official

  • A. 利息费用Interest expense
  • B. 收入(许多项都跟着收入走,收入预测错则满盘皆错)Revenue (many items follow revenue, so a wrong revenue forecast ruins everything)
  • C. 折旧Depreciation
答案 B。收入是整个模型的驱动变量。Answer B. Revenue is the driving variable of the whole model.

20. 预测收入的"自上而下"与"自下而上"分别是:The 'top-down' and 'bottom-up' approaches to forecasting revenue are, respectively: 官方题Official

  • A. 自上而下从门店数逐项加总Top-down sums up store counts item by item
  • B. 两者完全相同They are identical
  • C. 自上而下:行业总规模(如挂钩 GDP)× 市场份额;自下而上:从公司内部驱动(门店数×单店收入、销量×单价)逐项加总Top-down: total industry size (e.g., tied to GDP) × market share; bottom-up: sum up internal drivers (store count × revenue per store, volume × price)
答案 C。一个从宏观份额切入,一个从微观驱动累加。Answer C. One enters from macro share, the other builds up from micro drivers.

21. 预测成本常用什么假设:What assumption is commonly used to forecast costs: 官方题Official

  • A. 共同比假设(成本按收入的固定百分比),再结合规模经济、通胀;毛利率是关键假设A common-size assumption (costs as a fixed percentage of revenue), combined with economies of scale and inflation; gross margin is the key assumption
  • B. 成本与收入完全无关Costs are entirely unrelated to revenue
  • C. 成本永远固定不变Costs are forever fixed
答案 A。成本多以收入百分比预测,毛利率为核心假设。Answer A. Costs are mostly forecast as a percentage of revenue, with gross margin as the core assumption.

22. 敏感性分析、情景分析、模拟三者的区别是:The difference among sensitivity analysis, scenario analysis, and simulation is: 官方题Official

  • A. 情景=设概率分布跑随机情形Scenario = assign distributions and run random cases
  • B. 敏感性=一次动一个变量;情景=一次动一组变量(几套剧本);模拟(蒙特卡洛)=给变量设概率分布跑大量随机情形Sensitivity = change one variable at a time; scenario = change a set of variables at once (a few scripts); simulation (Monte Carlo) = assign probability distributions and run many random cases
  • C. 敏感性=一次动一组变量Sensitivity = change a set of variables at once
答案 B。单变量/多变量/概率分布是三者的递进区别。Answer B. Single-variable/multi-variable/probability-distribution is the progressive difference.

23. 通胀对收入预测的影响取决于:The effect of inflation on revenue forecasts depends on: 官方题Official

  • A. 与定价权无关It is unrelated to pricing power
  • B. 只影响成本不影响收入It affects only costs, not revenue
  • C. 公司能否把成本上涨转嫁给客户,即公司的定价权Whether the company can pass cost increases on to customers — its pricing power
答案 C。通胀既提价(收入)也抬成本,关键看定价权。Answer C. Inflation raises both prices (revenue) and costs; pricing power is key.

24. 建模时为什么要考虑竞争格局(波特五力):Why consider the competitive landscape (Porter's five forces) when modeling: 补充Extra

  • A. 只影响资产负债表It affects only the balance sheet
  • B. 竞争格局决定定价权、市场份额与利润率的可持续性,直接影响收入利润假设The competitive landscape determines the sustainability of pricing power, market share, and margins, directly affecting revenue/profit assumptions
  • C. 与预测无关It is unrelated to forecasting
答案 B。五力分析支撑收入与利润率假设的合理性。Answer B. Five-forces analysis supports the reasonableness of revenue and margin assumptions.
1. 对处于周期性行业的公司而言，正常化盈利最恰当的描述是：1. For a company in a cyclical industry, normalized earnings are best described as: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 包含收购影响的当期盈利。current earnings that include the impact of acquisitions.
  • B. 在无临时性因素情况下的中周期盈利。mid-cycle earnings in the absence of temporary factors.
  • C. 剔除临时性因素后的高峰年盈利。earnings from the peak years excluding temporary factors.
答案 B。周期性公司的正常化盈利(normalized earnings)= 剔除临时因素后的"中周期(mid-cycle)"盈利(既非高峰也非低谷)。故 A、C 错。Answer B. For a cyclical firm, normalized earnings = "mid-cycle" earnings with temporary factors removed (neither peak nor trough). So A and C are wrong.
2. 分析师用以下信息预测某公司毛利率：
当前金额($百万)预测增长
销售额1,2008%
销售成本3004%
分析师预测的毛利率最接近：2. An analyst uses the following information to forecast a company's gross profit margin:
Current Amount ($ millions)Forecasted Growth
Sales1,2008%
Cost of sales3004%
The analyst's forecasted gross profit margin should be closest to a(n): 真题模考Mock
  • A. 下降约1%。decrease of 1%.
  • B. 上升约1%。increase of 1%.
  • C. 上升约4%。increase of 4%.
答案 B。方法:预测毛利率 = 预测(收入−销货成本)/收入,由各驱动假设推算。按表 ≈ 较上期上升约 1%。Answer B. Method: forecast gross margin = projected (revenue − COGS)/revenue from the driver assumptions. Per the table ≈ up ~1% from the prior period.
3. 若某产品需求价格弹性为0.8且单位成本不变，售价上涨10%最可能导致：3. If the price elasticity of demand for a product is 0.8 and its unit cost remains constant, a 10% increase in its selling price will most likely result in: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 销售成本不变。no change in cost of sales.
  • B. 销量下降8%。a decrease in volume of 8%.
  • C. 收入增加8%。an increase in revenue of 8%.
答案 B。需求价格弹性 0.8 → 售价 +10% → 销量 −(0.8×10%)= −8%。因弹性<1(缺乏弹性),收入仍上升(不是 +8%),销售成本随销量降而降。故选"销量下降8%"。Answer B. Price elasticity 0.8 → a 10% price rise → quantity falls by 0.8×10% = 8%. Since elasticity <1 (inelastic), revenue still rises (not +8%), and COGS falls with volume. Hence "volume down 8%."
4. 其他条件相同，预测下列哪项增加最可能提高公司预测的每股收益？4. All else being equal, forecasting an increase in which of the following will most likely increase forecasted EPS for a company? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 股份回购Share repurchases
  • B. 二次股票发行Secondary stock issuances
  • C. 员工股权激励Equity-based compensation of employees
答案 A。股份回购减少在外股数 → 每股收益(EPS)上升。二次发行、员工股权激励增加股数、摊薄 EPS,故 B、C 反。Answer A. A share buyback reduces shares outstanding → EPS rises. A secondary issue or employee stock grants increase shares and dilute EPS, so B and C are reversed.
5. 波特五力分析与财务预测结合使用，可用于估计公司未来利润率相对于何者的水平：5. Porter's five forces analysis, used in conjunction with financial forecasting, can be used to estimate a company's future profit margin relative to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅其竞争对手。only its competitors.
  • B. 仅其历史利润率。only its historic margins.
  • C. 其竞争对手与其历史利润率两者。both its competitors and its historic margins.
答案 C。波特五力 + 财务预测可估计公司未来利润率相对于"竞争对手与自身历史"两者的水平(判断护城河与趋势)。Answer C. Porter's Five Forces plus forecasting estimates future margins relative to both competitors and the firm's own history (assessing the moat and the trend).
6. 因未充分纳入新信息而维持先前观点或预测，最能描述下列哪种偏差：6. Maintaining prior views or forecasts by inadequately incorporating new information best describes: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 保守性偏差。conservatism bias.
  • B. 过度自信偏差。overconfidence bias.
  • C. 代表性偏差。representativeness bias.
答案 A。因未充分纳入新信息而固守旧观点/预测 = 保守性偏差(conservatism)。过度自信是高估自身;代表性是以刻板印象过度概括。Answer A. Clinging to a prior view/forecast by underweighting new information = conservatism bias. Overconfidence overrates one's own ability; representativeness over-generalizes from stereotypes.
7. 在波特五力框架中，公司在下列何种情况下最可能获得最高盈利能力：7. In the Porter's five forces framework, a company is most likely to have the greatest profitability if: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 替代品威胁低且买方议价能力低。the threat of substitutes is low and the bargaining power of buyers is low.
  • B. 替代品威胁低但买方议价能力高。the threat of substitutes is low and the bargaining power of buyers is high.
  • C. 替代品威胁高但买方议价能力低。the threat of substitutes is high and the bargaining power of buyers is low.
答案 A。波特框架下,替代品威胁低 + 买方议价力低 → 企业最能保持高盈利(竞争压力小、定价权强)。任一威胁/议价力高都会侵蚀利润。Answer A. In Porter's framework, low threat of substitutes + low buyer power → the firm best sustains high profitability (little competitive pressure, strong pricing power). A high threat or high buyer power erodes profit.

§3 行业专用比率§3 Industry-Specific Ratios

LOS 对应：describe uses of industry-specific ratios。
行业Industry常见指标Common metrics用途Purpose
零售Retail同店销售增长、每平方米销售额Same-store sales growth, sales per square meter区分门店扩张与既有门店真实增长Separate store expansion from real growth at existing stores
酒店Hotels入住率、ADR、RevPAROccupancy rate, ADR, RevPAR拆分客房利用率与定价Split room utilization from pricing

§4 销售驱动式 Pro Forma 模型§4 The Sales-Driven Pro Forma Model 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应：demonstrate development of a sales-based pro forma company model。
  1. 预测收入：销量×价格，或行业规模×市场份额。Forecast revenue: volume × price, or industry size × market share.
  2. 预测经营成本：按收入百分比、单位成本或固定/变动成本分别预测。Forecast operating costs: forecast separately as a percentage of revenue, per-unit cost, or fixed/variable costs.
  3. 预测营运资本：用 DSO、存货天数和 DPO 推导应收、存货和应付。Forecast working capital: derive receivables, inventory, and payables from DSO, days inventory, and DPO.
  4. 预测长期资产：由资本支出、折旧、处置和减值滚动 PP&E。Forecast long-term assets: roll PP&E forward from capex, depreciation, disposals, and impairment.
  5. 预测融资：根据现金缺口决定新增债务、利息费用和股利。Forecast financing: decide new debt, interest expense, and dividends based on the cash gap.
  6. 完成勾稽：留存收益连接净利润与股利；现金流量表连接资产负债表变动。Complete the ties: retained earnings link net income and dividends; the cash flow statement links the balance-sheet changes.
应收账款 = 收入 × DSO / 365
存货 = COGS × 存货天数 / 365；应付账款 = 采购额 × DPO / 365
简例

预测收入 1,000，DSO 36.5 天，则应收账款为 100。若预测 COGS 为 600、存货天数 60 天，则存货约为 98.6。Forecast revenue 1,000, DSO 36.5 days, so receivables are 100. If forecast COGS is 600 and days inventory is 60, inventory is about 98.6.

4.1 三张预测报表完整联动例题

销售驱动式三表模型

基期：销售 1,000；应收 100；存货 120；应付 80；净 PP&E 400；现金 50；债务 200；权益 390。预测销售增长 10%，COGS/销售=60%，SG&A/销售=20%，折旧 55，资本开支 80，利息 20，税率 25%，股利 30。营运资本周转天数保持不变。Base period: sales 1,000; receivables 100; inventory 120; payables 80; net PP&E 400; cash 50; debt 200; equity 390. Forecast sales growth 10%, COGS/sales = 60%, SG&A/sales = 20%, depreciation 55, capex 80, interest 20, tax rate 25%, dividends 30. Working-capital turnover days held constant.

预测利润表Forecast income statement计算Calculation结果Result
销售Sales1,000×1.101,100
COGS1,100×60%660
SG&A1,100×20%220
EBIT1,100−660−220−55165
税前利润Pre-tax profit165−20145
净利润Net income145×(1−25%)108.75

预测资产负债表：应收=110；存货=132；应付≈81.40；净 PP&E=400+80−55=425；期末权益=390+108.75−30=468.75。若债务保持 200，则现金作为平衡项：Forecast balance sheet: receivables = 110; inventory = 132; payables ≈ 81.40; net PP&E = 400+80−55 = 425; ending equity = 390+108.75−30 = 468.75. If debt stays at 200, cash is the balancing item:

现金 = (应付 81.40 + 债务 200 + 权益 468.75) − (应收 110 + 存货 132 + PP&E 425) = 83.15

预测现金流量表：CFO = 108.75+55−应收增加 10−存货增加 12+应付增加 1.40 = 143.15；CFI=−80；CFF=−30；现金净增加=33.15，期末现金=50+33.15=83.15，与资产负债表平衡项一致。Forecast cash flow statement: CFO = 108.75+55 − receivables increase 10 − inventory increase 12 + payables increase 1.40 = 143.15; CFI = −80; CFF = −30; net increase in cash = 33.15, ending cash = 50+33.15 = 83.15, matching the balance-sheet balancing item.

若计算得到的平衡现金为负，说明模型存在融资缺口，应增加短期借款或其他融资，并重新计算利息费用和所得税，直到三表闭合。If the computed balancing cash is negative, the model has a financing gap; add short-term borrowing or other financing and recompute interest expense and income tax until the three statements reconcile.

建模检查：
① 资产=负债+权益；
② 期末现金必须与现金流量表一致；
③ 留存收益增加=净利润−股利；
④ PP&E 期末=期初+资本开支−折旧−处置；
⑤ 新增债务会改变利息，必要时需迭代计算。

3. 如何用销售和 DSO 预测应收账款:How to forecast accounts receivable using sales and DSO:

  • A. 应收账款 = DSO × 365Accounts receivable = DSO × 365
  • B. 应收账款 = 销售收入 × DSO / 365Accounts receivable = sales revenue × DSO / 365
  • C. 应收账款 = 销售收入 / DSOAccounts receivable = sales revenue / DSO
答案 B。由 DSO 定义反推期末应收余额。Answer B. Back out the ending receivables balance from the DSO definition.

4. 销售驱动模型中三张报表闭合的两个关键检查是:In a sales-driven model, the two key checks that close the three statements are:

  • A. 收入=成本+利润Revenue = cost + profit
  • B. 只需检查利润表是否平衡Only check whether the income statement balances
  • C. 资产=负债+权益;资产负债表期末现金=期初现金+现金流量表净变动Assets = liabilities + equity; balance-sheet ending cash = beginning cash + net change from the cash-flow statement
答案 C。会计恒等式与现金勾稽是模型闭合的两大校验。Answer C. The accounting identity and cash reconciliation are the two main checks for closing the model.

§5 预测偏差、通胀与预测期§5 Forecasting Bias, Inflation & the Forecast Horizon

问题Problem表现Manifestation修正Correction
锚定Anchoring过度依赖管理层指引或上年数字Over-reliance on management guidance or last year's figures使用独立基准和多种估值情景Use independent benchmarks and multiple valuation scenarios
确认偏差Confirmation bias只寻找支持原有观点的信息Seeking only information that supports the existing view主动建立反方情景和失效条件Actively build a counter-scenario and failure conditions
过度自信Overconfidence预测区间过窄Forecast ranges too narrow使用历史预测误差校准区间Calibrate ranges using historical forecast errors
通胀Inflation只提高收入、忽略成本和营运资本Raising only revenue while ignoring costs and working capital分别预测价格、销量、工资和投入成本Forecast price, volume, wages, and input costs separately

显性预测期应覆盖公司向稳定状态过渡所需时间。周期性、重组或高速成长公司通常需要更长预测期。预测期之后的增长率、利润率和资本回报率必须与成熟状态一致。The explicit forecast period should cover the time needed for the company to transition to a steady state. Cyclical, restructuring, or high-growth companies usually need a longer forecast period. Beyond the forecast period, the growth rate, margins, and return on capital must be consistent with the mature state.
