  • 保证金杠杆三式:最大杠杆 = 1/最低保证金;权益回报 ≈ 资产回报 ÷ 保证金比例;追加保证金触发价 P = P₀×(1−初始)/(1−维持)。Three margin formulas: max leverage = 1/min margin; equity return ≈ asset return ÷ margin ratio; margin-call price P = P₀×(1−initial)/(1−maintenance).
  • 卖空:收益有限(最多跌到0)、损失无限(股价可无限涨)。Short selling: limited gain (price can only fall to 0), unlimited loss (price can rise without limit).
  • 一级市场发行人收钱、二级市场只在交易者之间;股票"发行"才募资,股票"股利/分割"不募资、不改比例所有权。The primary market brings cash to the issuer; the secondary market is investor-to-investor. A share issuance raises capital; a stock dividend/split does not, and leaves proportional ownership unchanged.
  • 指数:总回报 > 价格回报(含股息再投资);等权重需频繁再平衡且低配大盘股;基本面加权"高卖低买"(反向);重构(reconstitution)= 改成分,再平衡 = 改权重。Indexes: total return > price return (income reinvested); equal-weighting needs frequent rebalancing and underweights large caps; fundamental-weighting "sells high/buys low"; reconstitution = change constituents, rebalancing = change weights.
  • 有效市场三形式:弱式(历史价量)→技术分析无效;半强式(公开信息)→基本面分析无效;强式(私有信息)→内幕也无效。只有弱式下基本面分析可持续跑赢。Three efficiency forms: weak (past price/volume) → technicals fail; semi-strong (public info) → fundamentals fail; strong (private info) → even insider fails. Only under weak form can fundamental analysis persistently outperform.
  • 行为偏差:保守性(反应迟缓)、过度反应、羊群、损失厌恶、过度自信;"风险厌恶"是理性偏好、不是行为偏差(常作陷阱)。Behavioral biases: conservatism (underreaction), overreaction, herding, loss aversion, overconfidence; "risk aversion" is a rational preference, not a bias (a common trap).
  • 股利时间线:宣告日 → 除息日 → 登记日 → 支付日;除息日开盘价 ≈ 前收盘 − 每股股利。累积投票利小股东;可转换优先股分享上行。Dividend timeline: declaration → ex-dividend → record → payment; the ex-date opening price ≈ prior close − dividend per share. Cumulative voting helps minority holders; convertible preferred shares the upside.
  • 估值模型分类:现值模型(DDM、FCFE)、乘数模型(P/E、EV/EBITDA)、资产法(净资产,适合流动资产多的公司);FCFE 可给不派息股估值。Valuation model families: present-value (DDM, FCFE), multiplier (P/E, EV/EBITDA), asset-based (net assets, suits liquid-asset-heavy firms); FCFE can value non-dividend payers.
  • 戈登与增长:P = D₁/(r−g);可持续增长 g = ROE × 留存率;合理前瞻 P/E = 派息率/(r−g);永续优先股价值 = 固定股利 / 要求回报率。Gordon & growth: P = D₁/(r−g); sustainable growth g = ROE × retention; justified forward P/E = payout/(r−g); perpetual preferred value = fixed dividend / required return.
  • 波特五力 vs 行业外部(PEST):新进入者威胁属"行业内力量";人口/技术/社会/政府是"外部影响";买方议价力受"客户数量"影响(客户越少越强)。Porter's Five Forces vs external (PEST): threat of new entrants is an industry-level force; demographics/technology/social/government are external; buyer power depends on the number of customers (fewer → stronger).

LM1 §1 金融系统的功能LM1 §1 The Functions of the Financial System

LOS 对应:LOS: explain the main functions of the financial system。
🔰 零基础讲解:金融系统在干嘛?

金融系统🏦 想象一个大集市,一边是"手里有闲钱、想让钱生钱"的人(储蓄者),一边是"缺钱、想借钱办事"的人(借款人/企业)。金融系统就是这个集市加上里面的中介(银行、券商、交易所),负责把钱从有钱的人手里,高效地送到能把钱用好的人手里,同时帮大家管理风险。本质是把资金从"闲钱方"高效送到"用钱方",并帮各方管理风险、发现价格。The financial system🏦 Picture a big marketplace: on one side are people with spare cash who want their money to earn more (savers), on the other are people short of cash who want to borrow to do things (borrowers/firms). The financial system is this marketplace plus its intermediaries (banks, brokers, exchanges), which efficiently move money from those who have it to those who can put it to good use, while helping everyone manage risk. essentially moves funds efficiently from "those with spare cash" to "those who need it," while helping all parties manage risk and discover prices.

人们使用金融系统的六个目的:
① 为未来储蓄;
② 为当下借款;
③ 筹集股权资本;
④ 管理风险(对冲);
⑤ 交换资产(即期/远期交割);
⑥ 基于信息交易(信息驱动型交易者)。Six purposes for which people use the financial system:
① saving for the future;
② borrowing for the present;
③ raising equity capital;
④ managing risk (hedging);
⑤ exchanging assets (spot/forward settlement);
⑥ trading on information (information-motivated traders).

金融系统的三大功能:
① 帮助人们实现上述目的;
② 发现使总储蓄=总借款的回报率(利率/收益率);
③ 把资本配置到最优用途。良好的系统:交易成本低、能给储蓄和投资合理定价、稀缺资本用得好。Three main functions of the financial system:
① helping people achieve the above purposes;
② discovering the rate of return (interest rate/yield) that equates total saving with total borrowing;
③ allocating capital to its best use. A good system: low transaction costs, sensible pricing of saving and investment, and scarce capital well used.

1. 人们使用金融系统的六个目的是:The six purposes for which people use the financial system are: 官方题Official

  • A. 印钞、征税、监管Printing money, taxing, regulating
  • B. 储蓄、借款、筹集股权资本、管理风险、交换资产、基于信息交易Saving, borrowing, raising equity capital, managing risk, exchanging assets, and trading on information
  • C. 只有储蓄与借款两项Only saving and borrowing
答案 B。六大目的涵盖储蓄借款、筹资、管险、交换与信息交易。Answer B. The six purposes cover saving/borrowing, raising capital, managing risk, exchanging, and information trading.

2. 金融系统的三大功能是:The three functions of the financial system are: 官方题Official

  • A. 印钞、收税、发债Print money, collect taxes, issue bonds
  • B. 仅负责支付清算Only handle payments and settlement
  • C. 帮助人们实现目的;发现使总储蓄=总借款的回报率;把资本配置到最优用途Help people achieve their purposes; discover the rate of return that equates total saving and total borrowing; allocate capital to its best uses
答案 C。实现目的、发现均衡回报率、优化资本配置。Answer C. Achieve purposes, discover the equilibrium return, and optimize capital allocation.

LM1 §2 资产与市场的分类LM1 §2 Classification of Assets & Markets

LOS 对应:LOS: describe classifications of assets and markets; describe the major types of securities, currencies, contracts, commodities, and real assets。
资产类别Asset class内容Content
金融资产Financial assets证券(债务类如债券/票据、权益类如普通股/优先股)、衍生品(远期、期货、期权、互换)、货币Securities (debt like bonds/notes, equity like common/preferred stock), derivatives (forwards, futures, options, swaps), currencies
汇集投资工具Pooled investment vehicles共同基金、ETF、对冲基金——把众多投资者的钱汇集起来投资Mutual funds, ETFs, hedge funds — pooling many investors' money to invest
实物资产Real assets房地产、大宗商品、设备等Real estate, commodities, equipment, etc.

市场的分类(常考的对立概念):Classifying markets (frequently tested opposing concepts):

分类Classification区别Distinction
一级市场 vs 二级市场Primary vs secondary market一级=发行新证券融资;二级=已发行证券在投资者之间转手Primary = issuing new securities to raise funds; secondary = issued securities changing hands among investors
货币市场 vs 资本市场Money market vs capital market货币市场=期限 ≤1 年的债务;资本市场=长期债务和权益Money market = debt with maturity ≤1 year; capital market = long-term debt and equity
即期市场 vs 远期/期货市场Spot vs forward/futures market即期=立即交割;远期/期货=约定未来交割Spot = immediate delivery; forward/futures = agreed future delivery
公开市场 vs 私募市场Public vs private market公开=公开交易、流动性好;私募=不公开、流动性差Public = publicly traded, good liquidity; private = not public, poor liquidity

3. 货币市场与资本市场怎么区分:How are the money market and capital market distinguished: 补充Extra

  • A. 资本市场=期限 ≤1 年Capital market = maturity ≤ 1 year
  • B. 货币市场=期限 ≤1 年的债务工具;资本市场=长期债务和权益Money market = debt instruments with maturity ≤ 1 year; capital market = long-term debt and equity
  • C. 货币市场=长期债务Money market = long-term debt
答案 B。以 1 年期限划分货币市场与资本市场。Answer B. The 1-year maturity divides the money and capital markets.
1. 国库券（government bills）最可能在哪类市场交易？1. In which markets are government bills most likely traded? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 货币市场Money markets
  • B. 资本市场Capital markets
  • C. 另类投资市场Alternative investment markets
答案 A。国库券(government bills)期限 ≤ 1 年 → 货币市场(money market)。资本市场是>1 年的证券。短期政府工具是典型货币市场证券。Answer A. Government bills mature in ≤ 1 year → the money market. The capital market is for securities > 1 year. Short-term government instruments are classic money-market securities.
2. 若一位欧洲投资者认为美国股市在未来三个月将下跌，最可能让其从该判断中获利的交易是买入：2. If a European investor believes the US equity market will decline in the next three months, the transaction most likely to allow the investor to profit from this view is the purchase of a: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 看跌期权。put option.
  • B. 看涨期权。call option.
  • C. 货币互换。currency swap.
答案 A。看跌下跌行情:预期美股下跌要用看跌期权(put)获利(标的跌、看跌值钱)。看涨(call)赌上涨,方向反了;货币互换对冲汇率、不针对股市方向。Answer A. To profit from an expected fall in US stocks, buy a put (it gains as the underlying drops). A call bets on a rise (wrong direction); a currency swap hedges FX, not the market's direction.

LM1 §3 金融中介机构LM1 §3 Financial Intermediaries

LOS 对应:LOS: describe types of financial intermediaries and services。

中介机构是金融系统的"润滑剂"。常考类型:Intermediaries are the "lubricant" of the financial system. Frequently tested types:

  • 经纪商(broker):代客户找交易对手、只收佣金,不用自有资金持仓;交易商/做市商(dealer):用自有存货买卖、提供流动性,靠买卖价差获利。经纪自营商(broker-dealer)兼具两者(有利益冲突)。Broker: finds a counterparty for the client and charges only a commission, using no own capital to hold positions; dealer/market maker: buys and sells from own inventory, provides liquidity, and profits from the bid-ask spread. A broker-dealer does both (with a conflict of interest).
  • 交易所与另类交易系统(ATS/暗池):提供交易场所与规则。Exchanges and alternative trading systems (ATS/dark pools): provide venues and rules for trading.
  • 清算所(clearinghouse)与存管机构:充当交易对手、保证结算、降低对手方风险。Clearinghouses and depositories: act as counterparty, guarantee settlement, and reduce counterparty risk.
  • 银行、保险公司:银行汇集存款放贷;保险公司汇集保费、分散风险。Banks, insurance companies: banks pool deposits to lend; insurers pool premiums and spread risk.
  • 套利者(arbitrageur):在不同市场间抹平价差;证券化机构(securitizer):把贷款打包成可交易证券。Arbitrageurs: eliminate price differences across markets; securitizers: bundle loans into tradable securities.
考点·交易场所与中介类型:
• 交易所(exchange):受监管的集中交易场所。
• 另类交易系统 / 多边交易设施(MTF, multilateral trading facility):非交易所的电子撮合平台(欧洲称 MTF、美国称 ATS/暗池),提供额外流动性与匿名性,但监管/透明度通常低于交易所。
• 做市商/交易商(dealer):用自有存货双边报价、提供即时流动性;经纪商(broker):只撮合、不用自有资本;投资银行:承销新发行。Exam - trading venues & intermediary types:
- Exchange: a regulated central marketplace.
- Alternative trading system / multilateral trading facility (MTF): a non-exchange electronic matching venue (MTF in Europe, ATS/dark pool in the US), adding liquidity and anonymity but usually with less regulation/transparency.
- Dealer/market maker: quotes both sides from own inventory, providing immediacy; broker: only matches, no own capital; investment bank: underwrites new issues.

4. 经纪商(broker)与交易商(dealer)的区别是:The difference between a broker and a dealer is: 官方题Official

  • A. 经纪商代客找对手、只收佣金、不用自有资金;交易商用自有存货买卖、赚买卖价差A broker finds a counterparty for clients, charging only commission and using no own capital; a dealer trades from its own inventory and earns the bid-ask spread
  • B. 经纪商用自有资金做市A broker makes markets with its own capital
  • C. 两者完全相同They are identical
答案 A。交易商提供流动性并承担存货风险。Answer A. A dealer provides liquidity and bears inventory risk.

5. 清算所(clearinghouse)的主要作用是:The main role of a clearinghouse is: 官方题Official

  • A. 制定货币政策Set monetary policy
  • B. 发行新股Issue new shares
  • C. 充当交易对手、保证结算、降低对手方违约风险Act as counterparty, guarantee settlement, and reduce counterparty default risk
答案 C。清算所居中担保,降低违约风险。Answer C. The clearinghouse stands in the middle as guarantor, lowering default risk.
1. 下列哪种金融中介最可能为其客户提供流动性服务？1. Which of the following financial intermediaries is most likely to provide liquidity service to its clients? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 经纪商Brokers
  • B. 做市商/交易商Dealers
  • C. 交易所Exchanges
答案 B。做市商/交易商(dealer/market maker)用自有存货随时报买卖价 → 提供流动性(liquidity)。经纪商只撮合、不用自有资本;交易所提供场所,不做市。Answer B. A dealer/market maker quotes bid/ask from its own inventory → providing liquidity. A broker only matches trades without own capital; an exchange provides the venue, not market-making.
2. 帮助客户安排增发（seasoned）证券发行的金融中介最常被称为：2. Financial intermediaries that help their clients arrange seasoned securities offerings are best known as: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 投资银行。investment banks.
  • B. 商业银行。commercial banks.
  • C. 多边交易设施(MTF)。multi-lateral trading facilities.
答案 A。帮助发行人安排(增发)证券发行=投资银行(investment bank)的承销职能。商业银行做存贷;MTF 是交易平台。Answer A. Arranging a (seasoned) securities issue for an issuer = the underwriting role of an investment bank. Commercial banks take deposits/make loans; an MTF is a trading venue.
3. 下列哪种金融中介最可能在不同市场以不同价格买卖相似工具？3. Which of the following financial intermediaries most likely buy and sell similar instruments at different prices in different markets? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 做市商Dealers
  • B. 经纪商Brokers
  • C. 套利者Arbitrageurs
答案 C。套利者(arbitrageur)在不同市场以不同价格买卖相似工具、赚价差,从而促进价格趋同。做市商在同一市场双边报价;经纪商只撮合。Answer C. An arbitrageur buys and sells similar instruments across markets at different prices to capture the spread, driving prices together. A dealer quotes both sides in one market; a broker only matches.

LM1 §4 多头与空头、杠杆与保证金LM1 §4 Long & Short, Leverage & Margin 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: compare positions an investor can take; calculate and interpret the leverage ratio, the rate of return on a margin transaction, and the margin call price。
🔰 零基础讲解:多头、空头、加杠杆

多头 vs 空头📈📉 多头(long)= 买入并持有,赌涨——涨了赚钱,最多亏光本金。空头(short)= 先借来股票卖掉,赌跌,等跌了低价买回还给出借人赚差价。空头风险大得多:股价可以无限涨,所以亏损理论上无上限。:多头赌涨,空头借券卖出赌跌。Long vs short📈📉 Long = buy and hold, betting on a rise — gain if it rises, lose at most your principal. Short = first borrow shares and sell them, betting on a fall, then buy back cheaply to return to the lender and pocket the difference. Shorting is far riskier: a share price can rise without limit, so losses are theoretically unbounded.: long bets on a rise, short borrows shares to sell betting on a fall.

保证金交易💳 加杠杆买股票就像"首付买房":你自己出一部分钱(保证金/首付),其余向券商借。这样能放大收益——但也放大亏损。跌到一定程度,券商会要求你追加保证金("追缴"),就像房子严重贬值时银行要你补钱。(加杠杆):自己出一部分钱(保证金),其余向券商借,放大盈亏。Margin trading💳 Buying stock on leverage is like "buying a house with a down payment": you put up part yourself (the margin/down payment) and borrow the rest from the broker. This magnifies gains — but also losses. Below a certain level, the broker demands more margin (a "margin call"), just as a bank demands more money when a house drops sharply in value. (leverage): put up part yourself (margin) and borrow the rest from the broker, magnifying gains and losses.

杠杆比率 = 头寸价值 / 自有权益    最大杠杆比率 = 1 / 初始保证金率
保证金追缴价 P = P0 × (1 − 初始保证金率) / (1 − 维持保证金率)
符号Symbol含义Meaning
头寸价值 / 自有权益Position value / own equity杠杆比率表示头寸是自有资金的几倍。初始保证金率 40% → 最大杠杆 = 1/0.4 = 2.5 倍The leverage ratio shows how many times the position is of own funds. Initial margin rate 40% → maximum leverage = 1/0.4 = 2.5×
P0买入时的股价;初始保证金率=自己出的比例;维持保证金率=权益占比不得低于的下限The share price at purchase; initial margin rate = the fraction you put up; maintenance margin rate = the floor below which the equity proportion may not fall
保证金交易的回报率Return on a margin trade= (股价变动收益 − 借款利息 − 佣金) / 初始自有权益;杠杆同时放大正负回报= (gain from price change − borrowing interest − commissions) / initial own equity; leverage magnifies both positive and negative returns
教材算例 · 保证金追缴价 官方题Official

股价 P0=$20,初始保证金率 40%(自出 $8),维持保证金率 25%。追缴价 = 20×(1−0.40)/(1−0.25) = 20×0.6/0.75 = $16。验证:股价跌到 $16 时,每股权益 = 8 + (16−20) = $4,占股价 4/16 = 25%,恰好触及维持线。Share price P0 = $20, initial margin rate 40% (put up $8), maintenance margin rate 25%. Margin-call price = 20×(1−0.40)/(1−0.25) = 20×0.6/0.75 = $16. Check: when the price falls to $16, equity per share = 8 + (16−20) = $4, which is 4/16 = 25% of the price, exactly hitting the maintenance line.

考点提示:
① 记牢追缴价公式 P₀(1−IM)/(1−MM)——高频计算。
② 最大杠杆 = 1/初始保证金率。
③ 加杠杆的回报率算法:分子要扣掉借款利息和佣金,分母是初始自有权益(不是全部头寸)。
④ 空头也要交保证金;股价上涨时空头亏损、可能被追缴。
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

多头、空头、杠杆与保证金

• 多头(long):买入,看涨获利。
• 空头(short):借券卖出、日后买回还券,看跌获利,理论亏损无上限。
• 保证金交易:用自有资金 + 借款建仓,杠杆放大盈亏。杠杆比率 = 总头寸 ÷ 自有资金。

追缴保证金

价格下跌使权益低于维持保证金(maintenance margin)时触发追缴(margin call)。多头触发价 ≈ P0 ×(1 − 初始保证金)÷(1 − 维持保证金)。

易错对比

① 空头亏损无上限、多头最多亏本金;② 杠杆双向放大(含亏损);③ 权益 = 市值 − 借款,跌破维持线才追缴。

Long, short, leverage & margin

• Long: buy, profit when prices rise.
• Short: borrow and sell, buy back later to return; profit when prices fall, loss theoretically unlimited.
• Margin trading: own funds + borrowing; leverage magnifies P/L. Leverage ratio = total position ÷ own equity.

Margin call

A price drop that pushes equity below the maintenance margin triggers a margin call. Long trigger price ≈ P0 ×(1 − initial margin)÷(1 − maintenance margin).

Common traps

① A short's loss is unlimited, a long loses at most its capital; ② leverage magnifies both ways; ③ equity = value − loan, a call comes only below the maintenance line.

6. 初始保证金率 40%,最大杠杆比率是:With an initial margin requirement of 40%, the maximum leverage ratio is: 官方题Official

  • A. 1.4 倍1.4×
  • B. 2.5 倍2.5×
  • C. 4.0 倍4.0×
答案 B。最大杠杆 = 1/0.40 = 2.5。Answer B. Max leverage = 1/0.40 = 2.5.

7. 股价 $20、初始保证金率 40%、维持保证金率 25%,保证金追缴价是:Share price $20, initial margin 40%, maintenance margin 25%; the margin call price is: 官方题Official

  • A. $12$12
  • B. $15$15
  • C. $16$16
答案 C。P = 20×(1−0.40)/(1−0.25) = 20×0.6/0.75 = $16。Answer C. P = 20×(1−0.40)/(1−0.25) = 20×0.6/0.75 = $16.

8. 计算保证金交易回报率时,分子扣除什么、分母是什么:When computing the return on a margin trade, what is deducted in the numerator and what is the denominator: 官方题Official

  • A. 分子不扣任何费用The numerator deducts no fees
  • B. 分子扣借款利息和佣金;分母是初始自有权益Deduct borrowing interest and commission in the numerator; the denominator is the initial own equity
  • C. 分母是全部头寸价值The denominator is the full position value
答案 B。杠杆放大正负回报,分母只算自有权益。Answer B. Leverage amplifies both positive and negative returns; the denominator counts only own equity.

9. 空头(卖空)在什么情况下亏损、风险特点是:When does a short position lose money, and its risk characteristics: 官方题Official

  • A. 股价上涨时亏损;因可无限上涨,理论亏损无上限,风险大于多头Loses when the price rises; since prices can rise without limit, the theoretical loss is unbounded and riskier than a long
  • B. 股价下跌时亏损Loses when the price falls
  • C. 空头亏损有上限Short losses are capped
答案 A。多头亏损上限为本金,空头亏损理论上无限。Answer A. A long's loss is capped at the principal; a short's loss is theoretically unlimited.
1. 某投资者卖出（写出）一份富时100指数期货的看跌期权。下列哪项分别最好地描述其对该看跌合约的头寸及其对标的指数期货的敞口？1. An investor writes a put option on FTSE 100 Index futures. Which of the following best describes the investor's position with respect to the put contract and her exposure to the underlying index future, respectively? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 看跌合约多头，标的空头Long, short
  • B. 看跌合约空头，标的多头Short, long
  • C. 看跌合约空头，标的空头Short, short
答案 B。卖出(写出)看跌 = 看跌合约空头;卖看跌者义务在低价接货 → 相当于看多标的 → 标的多头敞口。故"看跌空头 + 标的多头"。Answer B. Writing a put = a short put position; the put writer is obligated to buy at the strike → effectively bullish → long exposure to the underlying. Hence "short put, long underlying."
2. 卖空者最可能面临：2. Short sellers are most likely exposed to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 无限收益、有限损失。unlimited gains and limited losses.
  • B. 有限收益、无限损失。limited gains and unlimited losses.
  • C. 无限收益、无限损失。unlimited gains and unlimited losses.
答案 B。卖空:先高卖、盼低买回。股价理论上可无限上涨 → 损失无限;最多跌到 0 → 收益有限。故"有限收益、无限损失"。Answer B. Short selling: sell high hoping to buy back low. The price can rise without limit → unlimited loss; it can fall only to 0 → limited gain. Hence "limited gain, unlimited loss."
3. 某投资者以保证金买入证券，初始价格的50%为自有权益。其他条件不变，若价格下跌25%，其新的杠杆比率最接近：3. An investor buys a security on margin posting 50% of the initial price as equity. All else being equal, if the price declines 25%, the investor's new leverage ratio is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 2。2.
  • B. 3。3.
  • C. 4。4.
答案 B。杠杆比率 = 头寸价值 ÷ 权益。初始 50% 权益即杠杆 2。价格跌 25%:资产=0.75,权益=0.75−0.5=0.25 → 杠杆=0.75/0.25=3。价格下跌会放大杠杆。Answer B. Leverage ratio = position value ÷ equity. Starting at 50% equity means leverage 2. After a 25% fall: assets = 0.75, equity = 0.75 − 0.5 = 0.25 → leverage = 0.75/0.25 = 3. A price drop raises leverage.
4. 经纪商1的最低保证金要求为62.5%，经纪商2的最大杠杆比率为1.6。使用经纪商1可获得的最大财务杠杆是：4. Broker 1 has a minimum margin requirement of 62.5% and Broker 2 has a maximum leverage ratio of 1.6. The maximum financial leverage possible with Broker 1 is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 小于经纪商2的最大财务杠杆。less than the maximum financial leverage with Broker 2.
  • B. 等于经纪商2的最大财务杠杆。equal to the maximum financial leverage with Broker 2.
  • C. 大于经纪商2的最大财务杠杆。greater than the maximum financial leverage with Broker 2.
答案 B。最大杠杆 = 1 ÷ 最低保证金要求。经纪商1:1/62.5% = 1.6,与经纪商2 的 1.6 相等。二者提供的最大杠杆相同。Answer B. Max leverage = 1 ÷ minimum margin requirement. Broker 1: 1/62.5% = 1.6, equal to broker 2's 1.6. Both offer the same maximum leverage.
5. 若以保证金买入证券、最大杠杆比率为1.75，则最低保证金要求最接近：5. If securities are purchased on margin with a maximum leverage ratio of 1.75, the minimum margin requirement is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 43%。43%.
  • B. 57%。57%.
  • C. 75%。75%.
答案 B。由 最大杠杆 = 1 ÷ 最低保证金 反解:最低保证金 = 1/1.75 ≈ 57%。Answer B. From max leverage = 1 ÷ minimum margin: minimum margin = 1/1.75 ≈ 57%.
6. 交易者以保证金买入股票，条件如下：
每股买入价$50
每股自有权益$25
维持保证金要求25%
若股价下跌，触发追加保证金通知的最高价格最接近：6. A trader buys a stock on margin with the following conditions:
Purchase price per share$50
Equity per share$25
Maintenance margin requirement25%
If the share price declines, the highest price at which the trader will receive a margin call is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. $12.50。$12.50.
  • B. $33.33。$33.33.
  • C. $37.50。$37.50.
答案 B。追加保证金触发价 P = P₀ × (1 − 初始保证金)/(1 − 维持保证金)。代入表中初始价与两保证金率,得触发价 ≈ $33.33(跌到此价权益比例降至维持线)。Answer B. Margin-call price P = P₀ × (1 − initial margin)/(1 − maintenance margin). Plugging the table's initial price and the two margin rates ≈ $33.33 (where the equity ratio falls to the maintenance level).
7. 交易者报告一项持有1年后卖出的股票投资信息：
买入股数2,000
杠杆比率3
每股买入价$12.00
每股卖出价$9.50
年拆借利率3%
该交易后交易者的权益价值最接近：7. A trader reports the following information about an equity investment which was sold after 1 year:
Number of shares purchased2,000
Leverage ratio3
Purchase price per share$12.00
Sale price per share$9.50
Call money rate per year3%
The trader's equity value as a result of the trade is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. $460。$460.
  • B. $2,520。$2,520.
  • C. $3,000。$3,000.
答案 B。方法:期末权益 = 卖出市值 − 借款本息 + 收到股利(减融资利息与佣金)。按表逐项结算,权益 ≈ $2,520。Answer B. Method: ending equity = sale proceeds − loan repaid with interest + dividends received (less margin interest and commissions). Settling the table line by line ≈ $2,520.
8. 若以30%保证金买入的股票价格上涨40%，买方的权益回报率最接近：8. If the price of a stock bought on 30% margin increases by 40%, the return on equity to the buyer is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 52%。52%.
  • B. 75%。75%.
  • C. 133%。133%.
答案 C。杠杆放大回报:权益回报 ≈ 资产回报 ÷ 保证金比例。40% 涨幅、30% 保证金:0.40/0.30 ≈ 133%(还需扣融资成本,近似 133%)。Answer C. Leverage magnifies returns: equity return ≈ asset return ÷ margin ratio. A 40% gain at 30% margin: 0.40/0.30 ≈ 133% (before financing cost) ≈ 133%.
9. 若以75%保证金、每股$30买入1,000股，后以每股$26卖出，权益回报率最接近：9. If 1,000 shares of stock purchased at $30 per share on 75% margin are later sold at $26 per share, the return on equity is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. −17.8%。−17.8%.
  • B. −13.3%。−13.3%.
  • C. −10.0%。−10.0%.
答案 A。以 75% 保证金买入、价格从 30 跌到 26(−13.3%)。权益回报 = 资产回报 ÷ 保证金 − 融资成本 ≈ −13.3%/0.75 再扣利息 ≈ −17.8%。杠杆同样放大亏损。Answer A. Bought at 75% margin; price fell 30→26 (−13.3%). Equity return = asset return ÷ margin − financing cost ≈ −13.3%/0.75 less interest ≈ −17.8%. Leverage magnifies losses too.
10. 某投资者以35%保证金买入一只不派息股票。若股价上涨7%，该杠杆头寸的总回报最接近：10. An investor purchases a nondividend-paying stock using 35% margin. If the stock price rises by 7%, the total return on this leveraged position is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 9.5%9.5%
  • B. 10.8%10.8%
  • C. 20.0%20.0%
答案 C。35% 保证金即杠杆 ≈ 1/0.35 ≈ 2.86。7% 涨幅 × 2.86 ≈ 20%(不派息、忽略利息)。Answer C. 35% margin means leverage ≈ 1/0.35 ≈ 2.86. A 7% gain × 2.86 ≈ 20% (no dividend, ignoring interest).
11. 某投资者以25%自有权益的保证金买入股票。若买入价$40、卖出价$30，杠杆头寸的总回报最接近：11. An investor purchases stock on margin by posting 25% as equity. If the purchase price was $40 and the sale price was $30, the total return on the leveraged position is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. −100%。−100%.
  • B. −33%。−33%.
  • C. −25%。−25%.
答案 A。25% 权益即杠杆 4。价格 40→30 = −25%。−25% × 4 = −100%:权益全部亏光(股价跌 25% 恰好抹平 25% 的自有权益)。Answer A. 25% equity means leverage 4. Price 40→30 = −25%. −25% × 4 = −100%: the entire equity is wiped out (a 25% price fall exactly erases the 25% own equity).
12. 以保证金融资头寸的最大初始杠杆比率等于1除以：12. The maximum initial leverage ratio associated with a position financed by margin is one divided by: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 最低保证金要求。the minimum margin requirement.
  • B. 1加最低保证金要求。one plus the minimum margin requirement.
  • C. 1减最低保证金要求。one minus the minimum margin requirement.
答案 A。最大初始杠杆 = 1 ÷ 最低保证金要求(定义)。不是 1±保证金。Answer A. Maximum initial leverage = 1 ÷ minimum margin requirement (by definition). Not 1 ± margin.

LM1 §5 订单类型:市价单 vs 限价单LM1 §5 Order Types: Market vs Limit Orders

LOS 对应:LOS: compare execution, validity, and clearing instructions; compare market orders with limit orders。

下单指令分三类:执行指令(怎么成交)、有效性指令(何时有效)、清算指令(如何结算)。最核心的是执行指令里的两种:Order instructions come in three kinds: execution instructions (how to fill), validity instructions (when in effect), and clearing instructions (how to settle). The most core are the two execution instructions:

类型Type特点Characteristic
市价单 market orderMarket order按当前市价立即成交——保证成交,但不保证价格(有价格不确定性)Fills immediately at the current market price — guarantees execution but not price (price uncertainty)
限价单 limit orderLimit order设定最差可接受价格(买单不超某价、卖单不低于某价)——保证价格,但不保证成交Sets the worst acceptable price (a buy no higher than a price, a sell no lower than a price) — guarantees price but not execution

其他:止损单(stop order)在价格触及某水平后才激活。有效性指令:当日有效、撤销前有效(GTC)、立即成交否则取消(IOC)等。Others: a stop order activates only after the price reaches a level. Validity instructions: good-for-day, good-till-cancelled (GTC), immediate-or-cancel (IOC), etc.

10. 市价单与限价单的区别是:The difference between a market order and a limit order is: 官方题Official

  • A. 市价单保成交、不保价;限价单保价、不保成交A market order guarantees execution but not price; a limit order guarantees price but not execution
  • B. 市价单保价、不保成交A market order guarantees price but not execution
  • C. 两者完全相同They are identical
答案 A。速度与价格的权衡。Answer A. A trade-off between speed and price.
1. 订单的清算指令（clearing instructions）最可能表明：1. Clearing instructions for an order most likely indicate: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 如何成交该订单。how to fill the order.
  • B. 该订单何时可成交。when the order may be filled.
  • C. 如何安排交易的最终结算。how to arrange the settlement of the trade.
答案 C。清算指令(clearing instructions)说明交易如何最终结算/交收(哪方清算等)。"如何成交"是执行指令;"何时可成交"是有效性指令。Answer C. Clearing instructions specify how the trade is finally settled/cleared. "How it is filled" is an execution instruction; "when it can trade" is a validity instruction.
2. 交易者获得某股票以下限价订单簿信息：
买方数量价格 ($)卖方数量
1075.70---
2075.80---
---75.905
---76.0010
---76.1015
若交易者提交一份"成交否则撤销"(fill or kill)的买单，20股、限价 $76.00，则该笔成交的每股均价最接近：2. A trader gathers the following limit order information about a stock:
Bid SizePrice ($)Offer Size
1075.70---
2075.80---
---75.905
---76.0010
---76.1015
If the trader submits a fill or kill buy order for 20 shares at a limit price of $76.00, the trader's average price per share for this trade is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. $75.80。$75.80.
  • B. $75.97。$75.97.
  • C. $76.00。$76.00.
答案 B。方法:从限价簿最优价逐档吃单,直到 20 股或触及 $76 限价,再求成交均价。按簿中各档量价加权 ≈ $75.97。"成交否则撤销"要么立即全额成交、要么取消。Answer B. Method: sweep the book from the best price up to 20 shares or the $76 limit, then average. Weighting the levels by size ≈ $75.97. A "fill or kill" fills fully at once or is cancelled.
3. 表明订单何时可以成交的指令最可能是：3. An instruction that indicates when an order may be filled is most likely a(n): 真题模考Mock
  • A. 有效性指令。validity instruction.
  • B. 清算指令。clearing instruction.
  • C. 执行指令。execution instruction.
答案 A。表明订单何时可以成交的指令 = 有效性指令(validity instructions)(如当日有效、GTC)。清算指令管结算;执行指令管如何成交。Answer A. An instruction stating when an order may fill = a validity instruction (e.g., day, GTC). Clearing instructions cover settlement; execution instructions cover how it fills.
4. 一份指示经纪商立即以可获得的最优价格成交、且不指定最低价的卖单是：4. A sell order that instructs the broker to obtain the best price immediately available without specifying a minimum price is a: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 止损单。stop order.
  • B. 限价单。limit order.
  • C. 市价单。market order.
答案 C。立即以最优可得价成交、不设最低价 = 市价单(market order)。限价单设了价格底线;止损单要触发价触及后才激活。Answer C. Execute immediately at the best available price with no price limit = a market order. A limit order sets a price floor; a stop order activates only after a trigger price is hit.
5. 一份指示经纪商立即以可获得的最优价格成交、且不指定最低价的卖单是：5. A sell order that instructs the broker to obtain the best price immediately available without specifying a minimum price is a: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 止损单。stop order.
  • B. 限价单。limit order.
  • C. 市价单。market order.
答案 C。同上:不限价、立即成交 = 市价单。Answer C. Same as above: no price limit, immediate execution = a market order.

LM1 §6 一级市场、二级市场与市场结构LM1 §6 Primary Market, Secondary Market & Market Structure

LOS 对应:LOS: define primary and secondary markets; describe quote-driven, order-driven, and brokered markets。
  • 一级市场(primary):发行人卖新证券融资——IPO(首次公开发行)、增发(seasoned/后续发行)、私募配售、配股(rights)。Primary market: the issuer sells new securities to raise funds — IPO (initial public offering), seasoned/follow-on offering, private placement, rights offering.
  • 二级市场(secondary):已发行证券在投资者间转手。二级市场支持一级市场:有流动的二级市场,投资者才愿意在一级市场认购(因为将来能卖掉)。Secondary market: issued securities change hands among investors. The secondary market supports the primary market: only with a liquid secondary market will investors subscribe in the primary market (because they can sell later).

三种市场结构:Three market structures:

结构Structure成交方式How trades occur
报价驱动 quote-driven(做市商市场)Quote-driven (dealer market)投资者与交易商成交,交易商报买卖价(如多数债券、外汇)Investors trade with dealers, who quote bid and ask prices (e.g., most bonds, FX)
指令驱动 order-driven(竞价市场)Order-driven (auction market)买卖订单按规则互相撮合(多数股票交易所)Buy and sell orders are matched against each other by rules (most stock exchanges)
经纪撮合 brokeredBrokered经纪商为难交易的独特资产寻找对手方(如大宗房地产、艺术品)A broker finds a counterparty for unique, hard-to-trade assets (e.g., large real estate, art)

11. 一级市场与二级市场的区别,以及二级市场如何支持一级市场:The difference between the primary and secondary markets, and how the secondary supports the primary: 官方题Official

  • A. 一级=转手,二级=发行Primary = resale, secondary = issuance
  • B. 两者互不关联They are unrelated
  • C. 一级=发行新证券融资;二级=已发行证券转手;有流动二级市场投资者才愿在一级认购Primary = issuing new securities to raise funds; secondary = reselling issued securities; with a liquid secondary market, investors are willing to subscribe in the primary
答案 C。二级市场的流动性支撑一级市场的发行意愿。Answer C. Secondary-market liquidity supports the willingness to issue in the primary.

12. 三种市场结构(报价驱动/指令驱动/经纪撮合)各适合什么:What is each of the three market structures (quote-driven/order-driven/brokered) suited to: 官方题Official

  • A. 经纪撮合用于活跃股票Brokered is for active stocks
  • B. 报价驱动=与做市商成交(债券/外汇);指令驱动=订单撮合(股票交易所);经纪撮合=难交易资产找对手(房地产/艺术品)Quote-driven = trade with market makers (bonds/FX); order-driven = order matching (stock exchanges); brokered = finding counterparties for hard-to-trade assets (real estate/art)
  • C. 指令驱动用于债券外汇Order-driven is for bonds and FX
答案 B。不同资产适配不同的市场结构。Answer B. Different assets suit different market structures.
1. 下列哪项最可能用于为资本项目筹集资金？1. Which of the following is most likely used to raise funds for a capital project? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅股票发行Equity issuance only
  • B. 仅股票股利A stock dividend only
  • C. 股票发行与股票股利两者Both equity issuance and a stock dividend
答案 A。只有股票发行(share issuance)才为公司募集新资本;股票股利(stock dividend)只是把留存收益转股本、不带来现金。故"仅股票发行"。Answer A. Only a share issuance raises new capital for the firm; a stock dividend merely reclassifies retained earnings into share capital with no cash raised. Hence "share issuance only."
2. 当投资银行以协商的发行价格保证售出整个发行时，这最好地描述了：2. When an investment bank guarantees the sale of an entire issue at a negotiated offering price, this best describes a(n): 真题模考Mock
  • A. 配股发行。rights offering.
  • B. 尽力代销发行。best effort offering.
  • C. 包销发行。underwritten offering.
答案 C。投行以协商价保证售出整个发行=包销(firm-commitment underwriting),承销商承担卖不掉的风险。尽力代销(best efforts)不保证;配股是向现股东按比例发行。Answer C. An investment bank guaranteeing to sell the whole issue at a negotiated price = a firm-commitment (underwritten) offering, with the underwriter bearing unsold risk. Best-efforts does not guarantee; a rights offering sells pro rata to existing holders.
3. 订单驱动交易系统中的订单撮合规则用于：3. Order matching rules in order-driven trading systems are used to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 将买单与卖单进行撮合。match buy orders to sell orders.
  • B. 确定做市商所提交订单的成交价格。determine the prices at which the orders submitted by dealers are matched.
  • C. 确定客户所提交订单的成交价格。determine the prices at which the orders submitted by customers are matched.
答案 A。订单驱动市场的撮合规则就是把买单和卖单配对成交(按价格/时间优先)。价格由订单簿决定,不是做市商定价。Answer A. In an order-driven market the matching rules pair buy and sell orders (by price/time priority). Prices come from the order book, not from a dealer.
4. 在二级市场中，资金流向为：4. In the secondary market, funds flow from: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 交易者之间。traders to traders.
  • B. 发行人流向投资者。issuers to investors.
  • C. 投资者流向发行人。investors to issuers.
答案 A。二级市场(secondary market)资金在交易者之间流动——发行人不收到钱。发行人向投资者卖新券、收资金的是一级市场(primary market)。Answer A. In the secondary market money flows among traders — the issuer receives nothing. The issuer selling new securities to investors and receiving cash is the primary market.
5. 当发行人向投资者出售证券时：5. When issuers sell securities to investors: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 其交易发生在一级市场。they trade in the primary market.
  • B. 其交易发生在二级市场。they trade in the secondary market.
  • C. 资金在一级与二级市场之间流动。funds flow between the primary and the secondary market.
答案 A。发行人向投资者卖证券 = 一级市场(募集资金)。二级市场是投资者之间转手;资金不在一二级之间"流动"。Answer A. An issuer selling securities to investors = the primary market (capital raised). The secondary market is investor-to-investor; funds do not "flow between" primary and secondary.
6. 当公司在公开市场募集普通股权资本时，公司最可能：6. When a company raises common equity capital in the public market, the company most likely: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 将资金从现在转移到未来。moves money from the present to the future.
  • B. 同意在未来按计划进行分配。agrees to make scheduled distributions in the future.
  • C. 需满足监管报告要求。is required to meet regulatory reporting requirements.
答案 C。公开募集普通股需满足监管报告(信息披露)要求(招股书、持续披露)。"资金转移到未来"是储蓄、"未来按计划分配"是债务特征,都不是股权募集的必然。Answer C. Raising public common equity requires meeting regulatory reporting/disclosure requirements (prospectus, ongoing filings). "Moving funds to the future" is saving and "scheduled future payments" is a debt feature — neither is inherent to an equity raise.
7. 使用成交定价规则来撮合买卖双方的市场结构最可能是：7. The market structure that uses trade pricing rules to match buyers and sellers is most likely a(n): 真题模考Mock
  • A. 经纪市场。brokered market.
  • B. 订单驱动市场。order-driven market.
  • C. 报价驱动市场。quote-driven market.
答案 B。用成交定价规则撮合买卖 = 订单驱动市场(order-driven)。报价驱动靠做市商报价;经纪市场靠经纪撮合难找对手的资产。Answer B. Matching buyers and sellers by trade-pricing rules = an order-driven market. A quote-driven market relies on dealer quotes; a brokered market uses brokers for hard-to-match assets.

LM1 §7 良好运转的金融系统与监管LM1 §7 A Well-Functioning Financial System & Regulation

LOS 对应:LOS: describe characteristics of a well-functioning financial system; describe objectives of market regulation。

良好运转的金融系统具备:
① 完备市场(complete markets,满足各种储蓄/借贷/风险/交易需求);
② 运营高效(operationally efficient,交易成本低);
③ 信息高效(informationally efficient,价格快速反映信息);
④ 充足流动性。A well-functioning financial system has:
① complete markets (meeting all saving/borrowing/risk/trading needs);
② operational efficiency (low transaction costs);
③ informational efficiency (prices quickly reflect information);
④ ample liquidity.

市场监管的目标(与 IOSCO 一致):
① 保护投资者(防欺诈、防内幕交易);
② 确保市场公平、高效、透明;
③ 降低系统性风险。监管还要求充分披露、最低资本金等。Goals of market regulation (consistent with IOSCO):
① protect investors (against fraud and insider trading);
② ensure markets are fair, efficient, and transparent;
③ reduce systemic risk. Regulation also requires full disclosure, minimum capital, etc.

13. 良好运转的金融系统的特征是:The features of a well-functioning financial system are: 官方题Official

  • A. 高成本、低流动性High cost, low liquidity
  • B. 信息不透明Opaque information
  • C. 完备市场、运营高效(低成本)、信息高效、充足流动性Complete markets, operational efficiency (low cost), informational efficiency, ample liquidity
答案 C。完备、高效、透明、流动是良好系统四特征。Answer C. Complete, efficient, transparent, and liquid are the four features of a good system.

14. 市场监管的三大目标是:The three objectives of market regulation are: 官方题Official

  • A. 限制外资进入Restrict foreign entry
  • B. 保护投资者、确保市场公平高效透明、降低系统性风险Protect investors, ensure fair/efficient/transparent markets, reduce systemic risk
  • C. 最大化交易税收Maximize trading tax revenue
答案 B。与 IOSCO 三目标一致。Answer B. Consistent with IOSCO's three objectives.
1. 若成交成本上升，市场的信息效率最可能：1. If the cost to fill trades increases, the market's informational efficiency most likely: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 下降。decreases.
  • B. 不变。remains the same.
  • C. 上升。increases.
答案 A。成交成本上升 → 套利/交易变难 → 价格纠偏变慢 → 信息效率下降。低交易成本才利于市场高效反映信息。Answer A. Higher trading costs → arbitrage/trading harder → slower price correction → lower informational efficiency. Low trading costs help markets reflect information efficiently.
2. 若客户识别称职代理人的能力增强，对监管的需求最可能：2. If the ability of clients to identify competent agents increases, the need for regulation most likely: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 下降。decreases.
  • B. 不变。remains the same.
  • C. 上升。increases.
答案 A。客户越能自己识别称职代理人,越不需要外部监管来解决代理问题 → 监管需求下降。Answer A. The better clients can identify competent agents themselves, the less external regulation is needed to address agency problems → demand for regulation falls.
3. 下列哪项是市场监管的目标？3. Which of the following is an objective of market regulation? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅控制代理问题Controlling agency problems only
  • B. 仅确保长期负债得到资金保障Ensuring that long-term liabilities are funded only
  • C. 控制代理问题与确保长期负债资金保障两者Both controlling agency problems and ensuring that long-term liabilities are funded
答案 C。市场监管的目标同时包括控制代理问题和确保长期负债(如养老金)有资金保障(以及公平、披露等)。故"两者"。Answer C. Market regulation aims both to control agency problems and to ensure long-term liabilities (e.g., pensions) are funded (plus fairness, disclosure). Hence "both."
4. 在运转良好的金融体系中，资产价格变动主要反映：4. In a well-functioning financial system, changes in asset prices primarily reflect changes in: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 执行成本。execution costs.
  • B. 流动性需求。the demand for liquidity.
  • C. 基本面价值。fundamental asset values.
答案 C。运转良好的金融体系中,资产价格变动主要反映基本面价值(fundamental value)的变化,而非执行成本或流动性冲击。Answer C. In a well-functioning system, asset-price changes mainly reflect changes in fundamental value, not execution costs or liquidity shocks.

LM2 §8 指数的编制与价格/总回报LM2 §8 Index Construction & Price/Total Return

LOS 对应:LOS: describe security market indexes and how they are constructed。
🔰 零基础讲解:指数是什么?

证券指数📊 指数就像给一篮子股票算一个"平均分"。比如沪深300、标普500,把一批代表性股票的表现汇总成一个数,让你一眼看出"整个市场今天涨了还是跌了"。它既是市场的"温度计",也是基金业绩的"及格线(基准)"。是一篮子证券的综合表现指标,既是市场的晴雨表,也是衡量基金业绩的基准。A securities index📊 An index is like computing an "average score" for a basket of stocks. Indexes like the CSI 300 or S&P 500 aggregate the performance of a representative set of stocks into one number, letting you see at a glance "did the whole market rise or fall today." It is both a "thermometer" of the market and a "passing bar (benchmark)" for fund performance. is a composite performance measure of a basket of securities, both a barometer of the market and a benchmark for fund performance.

编制指数的步骤:
① 确定目标市场;
② 选择成分券;
③ 决定加权方法;
④ 定期再平衡与重构。Steps to construct an index:
① define the target market;
② select constituents;
③ decide the weighting method;
④ periodically rebalance and reconstitute.

价格回报 = 只算价格变动    总回报 = 价格变动 + 收到的现金(股息/利息)
类型Type含义Meaning
价格回报指数 price returnPrice return index只反映成分券的价格变动Reflects only the price change of constituents
总回报指数 total returnTotal return index价格变动 + 再投资的股息/利息;长期看总回报明显高于价格回报Price change + reinvested dividends/interest; over the long run total return is clearly higher than price return

15. 编制一个指数的步骤是:The steps to construct an index are: 官方题Official

  • A. 先加权再确定目标市场Weight first, then define the target market
  • B. 只需选择成分券Only select constituents
  • C. 确定目标市场 → 选择成分券 → 决定加权方法 → 定期再平衡与重构Define the target market → select constituents → decide the weighting method → periodically rebalance and reconstitute
答案 C。目标市场→成分券→加权→维护四步。Answer C. Target market → constituents → weighting → maintenance, in four steps.

16. 价格回报指数与总回报指数的区别是:The difference between a price-return index and a total-return index is: 官方题Official

  • A. 两者完全相同They are identical
  • B. 价格回报只算价格变动;总回报=价格变动 + 再投资股息/利息Price return counts only price changes; total return = price changes + reinvested dividends/interest
  • C. 价格回报包含股息Price return includes dividends
答案 B。长期看总回报明显高于价格回报。Answer B. Over the long run, total return is clearly higher than price return.

17. 为什么固定收益指数比股票指数更难复制:Why are fixed-income indexes harder to replicate than stock indexes:

  • A. 债券数量太少Bonds are too few
  • B. 债券永不到期Bonds never mature
  • C. 债券数量多、许多不活跃,且新券不断发行、旧券到期,交易成本高、持续重构Bonds are numerous and many are inactive, with new issues constantly appearing and old ones maturing — high trading costs and continual reconstitution
答案 C。庞大且流动性差的债券宇宙难以完全复制。Answer C. The vast, illiquid bond universe is hard to fully replicate.

18. 商品期货指数总回报通常由哪三部分构成:A commodity-futures index's total return is usually made up of which three parts:

  • A. 现货价格变化、展期收益、抵押品收益Spot-price change, roll yield, and collateral yield
  • B. 股息、利息、资本利得Dividends, interest, capital gains
  • C. 汇率、利率、通胀Exchange rate, interest rate, inflation
答案 A。现货 + 展期(roll) + 抵押品(collateral)三部分。Answer A. Spot + roll + collateral, in three parts.

19. 对冲基金指数常见的三种数据偏差是:The three common data biases in hedge-fund indexes are:

  • A. 完全没有偏差No bias at all
  • B. 自选择偏差、生存偏差、回填偏差Self-selection bias, survivorship bias, and backfill bias
  • C. 汇率偏差、利率偏差、通胀偏差Exchange-rate bias, interest-rate bias, inflation bias
答案 B。自愿报告、幸存者、历史回填三类偏差抬高了指数回报。Answer B. Voluntary reporting, survivor, and historical-backfill biases inflate index returns.
1. 固定收益指数最可能：1. Fixed-income indexes most likely: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 比股票指数更易复制。are more easily replicated than equity indexes.
  • B. 需指数提供者估计部分成分券的价格。require the provider to estimate the prices of some constituent securities.
  • C. 由比股票更小的可选成分范围构建。are created from a smaller universe of possible constituent securities than equities.
答案 B。固定收益指数成分券多、许多不活跃,提供商常需估价(matrix pricing)部分债券 → 比股指更难复制、可选范围更大。Answer B. A fixed-income index has many, often illiquid constituents, so the provider must estimate (matrix-price) some → it is harder to replicate and drawn from a larger universe than an equity index.
2. 在设立后随时间推移，指数价格版本的数值：2. As time passes after inception, the value of the price version of an index is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 小于总回报版本的数值。less than the value of the total return version.
  • B. 等于总回报版本的数值。equal to the value of the total return version.
  • C. 大于总回报版本的数值。greater than the value of the total return version.
答案 A。价格回报版只算价格,总回报版还把股息再投资 → 时间越久,总回报版越高 → 价格版数值小于总回报版。Answer A. A price-return index counts only price; a total-return index also reinvests income → over time the total-return version is higher → the price version is less than the total-return version.
3. 分析师获得某证券指数以下信息：
期间回报(%)

若期初（第1期开始）指数值为100，第3期末的指数值最接近：3. An analyst gathers the following information about a security index:
PeriodReturn (%)

If the index's value is 100 at the beginning of Period 1, the index's value at the end of Period 3 is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 103。103.
  • B. 105。105.
  • C. 106。106.
答案 B。方法:逐期用当期收益率把指数值滚动(指数ₜ=指数ₜ₋₁×(1+当期回报))。从 100 复利三期 ≈ 105。Answer B. Method: roll the index forward each period by that period's return (indexₜ = indexₜ₋₁×(1+return)). Compounding from 100 over three periods ≈ 105.
4. 某指数期初值为1540、期末值为1575。若当期收益为55，指数的总回报最接近：4. The beginning value for an index is 1540 and the ending value is 1575. If the income for the period is 55, the total return of the index is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 1.3%。1.3%.
  • B. 2.2%。2.2%.
  • C. 5.8%。5.8%.
答案 C。总回报 = (期末 − 期初 + 当期收益)/期初 = (1575 − 1540 + 55)/1540 ≈ 5.8%。总回报把收益(收入)也算进去。Answer C. Total return = (ending − beginning + income)/beginning = (1575 − 1540 + 55)/1540 ≈ 5.8%. Total return includes the income.
5. 总回报指数反映：5. A total return index reflects: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅成分证券的价格。only the prices of constituent securities.
  • B. 仅设立以来所收到全部收益的再投资。only the reinvestment of all income received since inception.
  • C. 成分证券价格与设立以来全部收益再投资两者。both the prices of constituent securities and the reinvestment of all income received since inception.
答案 C。总回报指数 = 成分价格变动 + 设立以来全部收益的再投资两者。只算价格是价格回报版。Answer C. A total-return index = constituent price changes + reinvestment of all income since inception, both. Price only is the price-return version.

LM2 §9 三种加权方法LM2 §9 The Three Weighting Methods 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: compare the different weighting methods used in index construction。
🔰 零基础讲解:凭什么决定每只股票占多大比重?

一篮子股票里,每只占多大权重会极大影响指数走势。三种主流方法,各有偏向:In a basket of stocks, how much weight each carries greatly affects the index's path. Three mainstream methods, each with a bias:

加权方法Weighting method怎么加权How it weights偏向/问题Bias/problem
价格加权
(如道琼斯 DJIA)Price-weighted
(e.g., Dow Jones DJIA)		指数 = 成分股价格之和 / 除数;高价股权重大Index = sum of constituent prices / a divisor; high-priced stocks carry more weight偏向高价股;拆股会扭曲,须调整除数;逻辑上无经济意义Biased toward high-priced stocks; splits distort it and require adjusting the divisor; economically meaningless in logic
市值加权 / 价值加权
(如标普500)Market-cap / value-weighted
(e.g., S&P 500)		按市值(流通市值)加权,大公司权重大;最常用流通股本调整Weighted by market cap (float-adjusted), large companies carry more weight; most commonly uses free-float adjustment偏向大盘股;会超配被高估的股票(价格越高权重越大);拆股自动调整Biased toward large caps; overweights overvalued stocks (the higher the price, the greater the weight); splits adjust automatically
等权重Equal-weighted每只股票权重相同Every stock carries the same weight偏向小盘股;须频繁再平衡(否则涨的权重自然变大)Biased toward small caps; requires frequent rebalancing (otherwise winners' weights naturally grow)
加权方法计算演示 补充Extra

三只股票 A=$100、B=$50、C=$10。价格加权:A 权重 = 100/(100+50+10) = 62.5%(高价股主导)。市值加权:若 A 市值 10 亿、B 50 亿、C 40 亿,则 B 权重 = 50/100 = 50%(市值大者主导,与股价高低无关)。等权重:各 1/3。同一批股票、三种权重,指数走势会明显不同。Three stocks A=$100, B=$50, C=$10. Price-weighted: A's weight = 100/(100+50+10) = 62.5% (high-priced stock dominates). Market-cap-weighted: if A's cap is 1B, B's 5B, C's 4B, then B's weight = 50/100 = 50% (the larger cap dominates, regardless of share price). Equal-weighted: 1/3 each. Same stocks, three weightings, and the index path differs markedly.

考点提示:
① 价格加权→偏高价股、要除数、拆股需调整;市值加权→偏大盘股、超配高估股、拆股自动调整;等权重→偏小盘股、需频繁再平衡。
② 还有基本面加权(按营收/账面价值/股息等基本面指标加权,与股价无关)——它有价值/逆向倾斜(股价涨、权重不自动涨,再平衡时反而卖出涨得多的),这点和市值加权正相反。
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

三种指数加权法

• 价格加权(price-weighted,如道指):按股价加权,高价股主导;股票分割会改变权重,用除数调整。
• 市值加权(cap-weighted,如标普500):按市值加权,大盘股主导,自动再平衡;缺点是对被高估股配置过多(动量偏差)。
• 等权重(equal-weighted):每只权重相同,偏小盘,需频繁再平衡。

易错对比

① 价格加权受股票分割影响、与公司规模无关;② 市值加权偏大盘、被高估股权重大;③ 等权偏小盘、再平衡成本高。

Three index weighting methods

• Price-weighted (e.g., the Dow): weighted by price, dominated by high-priced stocks; splits change weights, adjusted via a divisor.
• Cap-weighted (e.g., S&P 500): weighted by market cap, dominated by large caps, self-rebalancing; drawback: overweights overvalued stocks (momentum tilt).
• Equal-weighted: same weight each, tilts small-cap, needs frequent rebalancing.

Common traps

① Price-weighted is affected by splits, unrelated to company size; ② cap-weighted tilts large-cap, overweighting overvalued names; ③ equal-weighted tilts small-cap with high rebalancing cost.

20. 价格加权指数(如道琼斯)的偏向与问题是:The tilt and problems of a price-weighted index (e.g., the Dow) are: 官方题Official

  • A. 偏向大盘股Tilts toward large-cap stocks
  • B. 偏向小盘股Tilts toward small-cap stocks
  • C. 偏向高价股;拆股会扭曲须调整除数;经济意义弱Tilts toward high-priced stocks; stock splits distort it and require a divisor adjustment; weak economic meaning
答案 C。高价股主导,拆股须调整除数。Answer C. High-priced stocks dominate, and splits require a divisor adjustment.

21. 市值加权指数(如标普500)的偏向与缺陷是:The tilt and flaw of a market-cap-weighted index (e.g., the S&P 500) are: 官方题Official

  • A. 需要频繁再平衡Needs frequent rebalancing
  • B. 偏向大盘股;会超配被高估股(价格越高权重越大);拆股自动调整Tilts toward large-caps; overweights overvalued stocks (higher price = higher weight); splits are auto-adjusted
  • C. 偏向高价股Tilts toward high-priced stocks
答案 B。常用流通股本调整;缺陷是自动超配高估股。Answer B. It commonly uses free-float adjustment; the flaw is automatically overweighting overvalued stocks.

22. 等权重指数的特点是:The characteristics of an equal-weighted index are: 官方题Official

  • A. 偏向大盘股Tilts toward large-caps
  • B. 无需再平衡Needs no rebalancing
  • C. 每只权重相同;偏向小盘股;需频繁再平衡Each has the same weight; tilts toward small-caps; needs frequent rebalancing
答案 C。否则上涨股票权重会自然变大。Answer C. Otherwise, rising stocks' weights would naturally grow.

23. A=$100、B=$50、C=$10,价格加权下 A 的权重是:A = $100, B = $50, C = $10; under price weighting, A's weight is: 补充Extra

  • A. 62.5%62.5%
  • B. 33.3%33.3%
  • C. 50%50%
答案 A。100/(100+50+10)=62.5%,高价股主导。Answer A. 100/(100+50+10) = 62.5%, dominated by the high-priced stock.

24. 为什么市值加权被批评"超配高估股":Why is market-cap weighting criticized for 'overweighting overvalued stocks': 官方题Official

  • A. 会自动卖出高估股It auto-sells overvalued stocks
  • B. 权重随价格上升而增大,若某股被高估、价格虚高,权重也偏大,相当于自动买入高估股Weights grow with price, so if a stock is overvalued with an inflated price, its weight is also too large — effectively auto-buying overvalued stocks
  • C. 权重与价格无关Weights are unrelated to price
答案 B。价格驱动的权重使高估股被系统性超配。Answer B. Price-driven weights systematically overweight overvalued stocks.
1. 分析师获得由三只证券组成的等权重指数以下信息：
证券期初价(€)期末价(€)总股利(€)
120181
210153
315210
该指数的价格回报最接近：1. An analyst gathers the following information about an equal-weighted index composed of three securities:
SecurityBegin Price (€)End Price (€)Total Dividends (€)
120181
210153
315210
The price return of the index is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 20%。20%.
  • B. 27%。27%.
  • C. 38%。38%.
答案 B。等权重指数价格回报 = 各成分回报的简单平均(每只权重相同)。把三只回报取算术平均 ≈ 27%。Answer B. An equal-weighted index's price return = the simple average of the constituents' returns (each equally weighted). Averaging the three ≈ 27%.
2. 控股股东持股增加最可能影响下列哪种指数的成分权重？2. An increase in shares held by controlling shareholders most likely impacts the constituent weightings of a(n): 真题模考Mock
  • A. 价格加权指数。price-weighted index.
  • B. 等权重指数。equal-weighted index.
  • C. 自由流通市值加权指数。float-adjusted market-capitalization-weighted index.
答案 C。控股股东增持 → 自由流通股减少 → 只有自由流通市值加权(free-float market-cap)指数的权重会变。价格加权看股价、等权重固定,不受流通量影响。Answer C. A controlling holder buying more reduces free float → only a free-float market-cap-weighted index's weights change. Price-weighted uses price and equal-weighted is fixed, unaffected by float.
3. 随时间推移，下列哪种指数的组合权重最可能从相对升值的证券转向相对贬值的证券？3. Over time, which of the following indexes most likely has portfolio weights that shift away from securities that have increased in relative value and toward securities that have fallen in relative value? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 价格加权指数Price-weighted index
  • B. 基本面加权指数Fundamentally weighted index
  • C. 市值加权指数Market-capitalization-weighted index
答案 B。基本面加权(fundamental)指数按销售/账面等基本面定权重,再平衡时会"高卖低买"——从涨多的(相对升值)转向跌多的(相对贬值),具反向/价值倾向。市值加权则相反(追涨)。Answer B. A fundamental-weighted index sets weights by sales/book, etc., and on rebalancing "sells high, buys low" — shifting from relatively appreciated to relatively depreciated names, a contrarian/value tilt. A cap-weighted index does the opposite.
4. 分析师获得某市值加权指数及其四只成分股之一的以下信息：
总市值(十亿美元)
该股20
指数57
若股价为每股$30、指数值为100，该股在指数中的权重最接近：4. An analyst gathers the following information about a market-capitalization-weighted index and one of its four constituent stocks:
Total Market Cap (in $ billions)
Stock20
Index57
If the stock price is $30 per share and the index value is 100, the stock's weight in the index is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 25%。25%.
  • B. 30%。30%.
  • C. 35%。35%.
答案 C。市值权重 = 该股市值 ÷ 指数总市值。用表中股数×$30 得该股市值,除以总市值 ≈ 35%。Answer C. Cap weight = the stock's market value ÷ the index's total market value. Using shares × $30 for its value over the total ≈ 35%.
5. 等权重指数的一个缺点是：5. A disadvantage of an equal-weighted index is that: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 维持等权重需频繁对指数进行重构（reconstitution）。maintaining equal weights requires frequent reconstitution of the index.
  • B. 占目标市场价值较大份额的证券被低估权重。securities that represent a relatively large fraction of the target market value are underrepresented.
  • C. 占目标市场价值较小份额的证券被低估权重。securities that represent a relatively small fraction of the target market value are underrepresented.
答案 B。等权重的缺点:大市值证券被"低配"、小市值被"高配"(不按市值),且需频繁再平衡(rebalancing)维持等权。故选"占市场份额大的证券被低估权重"。Answer B. Equal weighting's drawback: large-cap names are underweighted and small-caps overweighted (weights ignore size), and it needs frequent rebalancing. Hence "securities that are a large share of the market are underweighted."
6. 分析师获得某指数及其中一只证券的以下信息：
证券指数
价格€38.00---
在外股数5.4亿---
全部成分价格之和---€808.50
全部成分市值之和---€4200亿
成分数量---18
哪种指数加权方法最可能给予该证券最大的权重？6. An analyst gathers the following information about an index and one security in the index:
SecurityIndex
Price€38.00---
Shares outstanding540 million---
Sum of prices of all constituents---€808.50
Sum of market caps of all constituents---€420 billion
Number of constituent securities---18
Which index-weighting method most likely gives this security the greatest weight in the index? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 价格加权Price weighting
  • B. 等权重Equal weighting
  • C. 市值加权Market capitalization weighting
答案 B。等权重给每只相同权重,故对"市值小、股价低"的证券给出的权重通常最大(相对其真实占比)。价格加权偏向高价股,市值加权偏向大公司。Answer B. Equal weighting gives every name the same weight, so it typically assigns the largest weight (relative to true size) to a small, low-priced security. Price-weighting favors high-priced stocks and cap-weighting large companies.

LM2 §10 再平衡、重构与指数的用途LM2 §10 Rebalancing, Reconstitution & Uses of Indexes

LOS 对应:LOS: describe rebalancing and reconstitution; describe uses of security market indexes。
概念Concept含义Meaning
再平衡 rebalancingRebalancing把成分券的权重调回目标(等权重指数尤其需要频繁做)Adjust constituents' weights back to target (especially needed frequently for equal-weighted indexes)
重构 reconstitutionReconstitution更换成分券(剔除不合格的、纳入新合格的)Replace constituents (drop those no longer qualifying, add newly qualifying ones)

指数的用途:
① 反映市场情绪的晴雨表;
② 衡量基金业绩的基准(benchmark);
③ 作为资产类别/风险的代理(用于资产配置和研究);
④ 作为指数基金/ETF的跟踪标的。指数类型:宽基、多市场、行业、风格(大盘/小盘、成长/价值)、固收、另类(商品等)。Uses of indexes:
① a barometer of market sentiment;
② a benchmark for fund performance;
③ a proxy for an asset class/risk (for asset allocation and research);
④ the tracking target for index funds/ETFs. Index types: broad-based, multi-market, sector, style (large/small cap, growth/value), fixed income, alternatives (commodities, etc.).

10.1 不同资产类别指数的类型与构建难点

LOS 对应:LOS: describe types of equity and fixed-income indexes, compare types of security market indexes, and describe indexes representing alternative investments。
指数类别Index category常见细分Common subtypes构建与解释重点Construction and interpretation focus
权益指数Equity indexes宽基、多市场、行业、规模、成长/价值风格Broad-based, multi-market, sector, size, growth/value style股票交易活跃，常按流通市值加权；行业与风格边界可能随公司业务和价格变化Stocks trade actively, often weighted by free-float market cap; sector and style boundaries can shift as companies' businesses and prices change
固定收益指数Fixed-income indexes按发行人、信用质量、期限、币种、地区、税务状态分类Classified by issuer, credit quality, maturity, currency, region, tax status证券数量远多于股票、成交稀疏、持续有新券发行和旧券到期；市场价值加权会使负债最多的发行人权重最大Far more securities than stocks, sparse trading, continual new issuance and maturities; market-value weighting gives the most indebted issuers the largest weight
商品指数Commodity indexes能源、金属、农产品；通常通过期货表示Energy, metals, agriculture; usually expressed via futures总回报包含现货价格、展期收益和抵押品收益；不同换月规则会造成显著差异Total return includes the spot price, roll yield, and collateral yield; different roll rules cause significant differences
房地产指数Real estate indexesREIT 市场指数、评估型直接房地产指数、交易型指数REIT market indexes, appraisal-based direct real-estate indexes, transaction-based indexesREIT 流动但更像股票；评估型指数平滑且滞后；交易型指数受样本构成影响REITs are liquid but behave more like stocks; appraisal-based indexes are smoothed and lagged; transaction-based indexes are affected by sample composition
对冲基金指数Hedge fund indexes策略指数、综合指数、可投资指数Strategy indexes, composite indexes, investable indexes自愿报告带来自选择偏差；倒闭基金退出造成生存偏差；历史数据回填造成回填偏差Voluntary reporting brings self-selection bias; failed funds exiting causes survivorship bias; backfilling historical data causes backfill bias
私募资本指数Private capital indexes按年份、地区、策略汇总基金现金流或估值Aggregate fund cash flows or valuations by vintage year, region, strategy估值频率低、现金流时点不一致，常使用 IRR 或投资倍数，不能直接与时间加权公开市场指数混比Low valuation frequency and inconsistent cash-flow timing, often using IRR or investment multiples, cannot be directly mixed with time-weighted public-market indexes
考试判断：固定收益指数最大的现实难点是成分券多、流动性低和到期更替；商品指数不能只看现货涨跌；房地产评估指数常低估真实短期波动；对冲基金指数最需要警惕自选择、生存和回填偏差。

25. 基本面加权与市值加权在再平衡倾向上的相反之处是:The opposite rebalancing tendency of fundamental weighting vs market-cap weighting is: 官方题Official

  • A. 基本面加权追涨Fundamental weighting chases gains
  • B. 两者倾向相同They tilt the same way
  • C. 基本面加权有价值/逆向倾斜(再平衡时反而卖出涨多的);市值加权则涨多的权重自动变大Fundamental weighting has a value/contrarian tilt (rebalancing actually sells the big gainers); market-cap weighting lets gainers' weights grow automatically
答案 C。基本面加权与股价脱钩,天然逆向。Answer C. Fundamental weighting is decoupled from price and naturally contrarian.

26. 再平衡与重构的区别是:The difference between rebalancing and reconstitution is: 官方题Official

  • A. 两者完全相同They are identical
  • B. 再平衡=把成分券权重调回目标;重构=更换成分券(剔除/纳入)Rebalancing = adjust constituent weights back to target; reconstitution = replace constituents (remove/add)
  • C. 再平衡=更换成分券Rebalancing = replace constituents
答案 B。一个调权重,一个换标的。Answer B. One adjusts weights, the other swaps the holdings.

27. 证券指数有哪些用途:What are the uses of a securities index: 官方题Official

  • A. 市场晴雨表、基金业绩基准、资产类别/风险的代理、指数基金/ETF 的跟踪标的A market barometer, a fund performance benchmark, a proxy for an asset class/risk, and a tracking target for index funds/ETFs
  • B. 只用于报税Only for tax filing
  • C. 没有实际用途No practical use
答案 A。指数兼具晴雨表、基准、代理与跟踪标的等多种用途。Answer A. An index serves as a barometer, benchmark, proxy, and tracking target.
1. 下列哪种指数由期货合约构成？1. Which of the following indexes is composed of futures contracts? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 商品指数Commodity index
  • B. 对冲基金指数Hedge fund index
  • C. 宽基股票市场指数Broad equity market index
答案 A。商品指数(commodity index)由期货合约构成(不持实物)。对冲基金指数按基金业绩;宽基股票指数持股票。Answer A. A commodity index is built from futures contracts (not physical holdings). A hedge-fund index tracks fund returns; a broad equity index holds stocks.
2. 下列哪项最好地描述了对冲基金指数？2. Which of the following statements best describes hedge fund indexes? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 成分为受监管的机构。Index constituents are regulated entities.
  • B. 自愿业绩报告降低了潜在的幸存者偏差。Potential survivorship bias is reduced by voluntary performance reporting.
  • C. 不同提供者的不同指数之间成分可能重叠很少。There may be little overlap in index constituents between different indexes offered by different index providers.
答案 C。对冲基金指数:业绩自愿上报 → 有幸存者/自选偏差,且各提供者成分重叠很少(定义/纳入标准不同)。故 C。A、B 说反了。Answer C. Hedge-fund indexes rely on voluntary reporting → survivorship/self-selection bias, and different providers' indexes overlap little (different definitions). Hence C. A and B are reversed.
3. 证券市场指数最可能充当下列何者的代理：3. Security market indices most likely serve as proxies for: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 非系统性风险。nonsystematic risk.
  • B. 资产配置模型中的资产类别。asset classes in asset allocation models.
  • C. 基于资产估值模型中资产的公允价值。the fair value of assets in asset-based valuation models.
答案 B。证券市场指数最常被用作资产配置模型里"资产类别(asset class)"的代理。它不代理非系统性风险,也不给个券公允价值。Answer B. A security-market index most often serves as a proxy for an asset class in asset-allocation models. It does not proxy unsystematic risk or provide fair values for individual securities.
4. 多市场指数最恰当地用作以下哪种基准：4. A multi-market index is most appropriately used as a benchmark: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 单一国家 ETF 的基准。for a single country ETF.
  • B. 小盘成长股经理的基准。for a small-capitalization growth stock manager.
  • C. 计算全球股票经理组合 beta 的基准。to calculate beta for the portfolio of a global stock manager.
答案 C。多市场指数(如全球股票指数)适合做全球组合的基准(算全球 beta)。单一国家 ETF、小盘成长经理要用更贴合的窄基准。Answer C. A multi-market (e.g., global equity) index suits a global portfolio benchmark (computing global beta). A single-country ETF or a small-cap growth manager needs a narrower, better-fitting benchmark.
5. 价格加权指数的管理最可能涉及：5. Management of a price-weighted index most likely entails: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅再平衡。rebalancing only.
  • B. 仅重构。reconstitution only.
  • C. 再平衡与重构两者。both rebalancing and reconstitution.
答案 B。价格加权指数成分除数固定,平时无需按市值再平衡;主要涉及重构(reconstitution)(增删成分)。市值加权也很少需再平衡。Answer B. A price-weighted index has a fixed divisor and needs no market-cap rebalancing; it mainly involves reconstitution (adding/dropping constituents). Cap-weighted indexes also rarely need rebalancing.
6. 全球股票指数最可能被视为：6. A world equity index is most likely considered a: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 风格指数。style index.
  • B. 行业指数。sector index.
  • C. 多市场指数。multi-market index.
答案 C。全球股票指数 = 多市场指数(multi-market)(跨多个国家市场)。风格、行业指数是按风格/行业切分的窄指数。Answer C. A global equity index = a multi-market index (across many country markets). Style and sector indexes are narrower cuts by style/industry.
7. 股票风格指数最可能代表按以下何种标准分类的证券组合：7. Equity style indexes most likely represent groups of securities classified by: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 地域与行业。geography and sector.
  • B. 价值和/或成长以及市值。value and/or growth and market capitalization.
  • C. 资产类别与 GDP 权重。asset class and gross domestic product (GDP) weight.
答案 B。股票风格指数按价值/成长以及市值(大/中/小)分类证券。地域+行业、资产类别是别的分类维度。Answer B. An equity style index classifies securities by value/growth and market cap (large/mid/small). Geography+sector or asset class are different classification schemes.
8. 证券指数的重构（reconstitution）最好地描述为改变以下何者的过程：8. Reconstitution of a security index is best described as the process of changing the: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 指数中的成分证券。constituent securities in the index.
  • B. 指数中成分证券的权重。weights of the constituent securities in the index.
  • C. 指数提供者审查成分证券的日期。date on which the index provider reviews the constituent securities.
答案 A。重构(reconstitution)= 改变指数的成分证券(增删)。改变"权重"是再平衡;改"审查日期"都不是重构定义。Answer A. Reconstitution = changing the index's constituent securities (adds/drops). Changing "weights" is rebalancing; changing review dates is neither.

Volume 5 · 权益投资
CFA Program Curriculum · Level I · Equity Investments

第二讲 · 市场有效性 & 权益证券概览Lecture 2 · Market Efficiency & Overview of Equity Securities

对应教材:Equity Investments — Learning Module 3《Market Efficiency》+ Learning Module 4《Overview of Equity Securities》 · 建议学习时长:3–4 小时Curriculum: Equity Investments — Learning Module 3 Market Efficiency + Learning Module 4 Overview of Equity Securities · Suggested study time: 3–4 hours

上一讲讲了市场怎么运转、指数怎么编。这一讲回答两个更根本的问题:市场价格到底"准不准"(有效市场理论),以及股票到底有哪些种类、投资股票的风险回报从哪来。这两块是权益投资的思想核心,考试也爱考概念辨析。The previous lecture covered how markets work and how indexes are built. This lecture answers two more fundamental questions: whether market prices are 'right' (efficient-market theory), and what types of stocks exist and where the risk-return of stock investing comes from. These two are the conceptual core of equity investing, and the exam loves conceptual distinctions here.
