🎯 固定收益做题技巧 · 提分策略🎯 Fixed Income Exam Tactics · Score Boosters
  • 价格-收益率永远反向 + 溢价/折价一眼定:票息率 > 市场利率 → 溢价;< → 折价;= → 平价。价格随时间被"拉向面值(pull to par)"。Price and yield always move inversely; spot premium/discount instantly: coupon > market rate → premium; < → discount; = → par. Price is "pulled to par" over time.
  • 收益率家族别混:当期收益率(current yield,只票息)< YTM(含资本利得,溢价债时);YTW(最差收益率)= 到期与各赎回收益率中最低者。Don't mix up the yield family: current yield (coupon only) vs YTM (includes capital gain); YTW = the lowest of maturity and all call yields.
  • 久期怎么选(高频):无期权、现金流确定 → 修正久期(modified);含权/现金流不确定 → 有效久期(effective);曲线形状(非平行)变 → 关键利率久期(key rate)。零息久期 = 期限;永续 = (1+y)/y。Which duration (high-yield): option-free, fixed cash flows → modified; optioned/uncertain cash flows → effective; non-parallel curve shape change → key-rate. Zero duration = term; perpetual = (1+y)/y.
  • 价格变动公式:ΔP% ≈ −修正久期×Δy + ½×凸性×Δy²。凸性总是利好(无期权债恒正):同幅变动,收益率降的涨幅 > 升的跌幅;久期相同则凸性高者跑赢。Price-change formula: ΔP% ≈ −ModDur×Δy + ½×convexity×Δy². Convexity always helps (positive for option-free): for equal moves, the rise on a fall exceeds the drop on a rise; equal duration → higher convexity wins.
  • 组合久期 = 市值加权平均(不是简单平均);近似久期/凸性都用 (V₋∓V₊)…/(…V₀…) 的上下移价格套公式。Portfolio duration = market-value-weighted average (not a simple average); approximate duration/convexity both use the up/down repriced values in the (V₋, V₊, V₀) formulas.
  • FRN:票息在期初(重置日)按当期 MRR 定、期末支付;合约写定的是报价利差(quoted margin),市场要求的是要求利差(required margin)。FRN: the coupon is set at the start (reset date) from the current MRR and paid at period end; the contract fixes the quoted margin, the market demands the required margin.
  • 远期利率 = 盈亏平衡再投资率;用即期利率链式 (1+z_L)^L=(1+z_S)^S(1+f)^(L−S) 求远期,或反过来用远期链折现给债券定价。Forward rate = break-even reinvestment rate; chain spot rates (1+z_L)^L=(1+z_S)^S(1+f)^(L−S) to get forwards, or discount a bond through the forward chain.
  • 货币市场收益率按单利(simple interest);银行贴现率(bank discount)以面值为基,低估真实收益,加息收益率(add-on)以价格为基更准。Money-market yields use simple interest; the bank discount yield is face-based and understates the true return, while the add-on (price-based) yield is more accurate.
  • 利差对号入座:G-spread(对主权债)、I-spread(对互换利率)、Z-spread(对整条即期曲线的常数利差)、OAS(剔除期权后的利差,用于含权债)。Match the spreads: G-spread (vs sovereign), I-spread (vs swap rate), Z-spread (constant spread over the whole spot curve), OAS (option-removed spread for optioned bonds).
  • 信用:预期损失 = 违约概率 × 损失severity(= 1 − 回收率);投资级最低 = Baa3/BBB−;发行人评级 = 高级无担保债评级,担保上调、次级下调(notching)。Credit: expected loss = PD × loss severity (= 1 − recovery rate); lowest investment grade = Baa3/BBB−; issuer rating = senior-unsecured rating, with secured notched up and subordinated down.
  • 证券化:信用分级(credit tranching,次级先吸损)vs 时间分级(time tranching,按期限分本金);利率降 = 紧缩风险、利率升 = 展期风险;担保债券(covered bond)双重追索。Securitization: credit tranching (subordinated absorbs losses first) vs time tranching (principal by maturity); rates down = contraction risk, rates up = extension risk; covered bonds have dual recourse.

§1 什么是债券:五大要素§1 What Is a Bond: The Five Elements

LOS 对应:LOS: describe the features of a fixed-income security; describe the contents of a bond indenture。
🔰 零基础讲解:债券 = 一张"标准化的借条"

债券📜 你把钱借给政府或公司,对方给你一张"借条":约定什么时候还本金(到期日)、每期付你多少利息(票息)。这张借条能在市场上转手买卖,价格随利率涨跌。买债券的人是债权人(不是股东),到期能拿回本金+利息,风险和回报都比股票低。本质是发行人向投资者借款、承诺按约定还本付息的凭证。买债券=当债权人。A bond📜 You lend money to a government or company, and they give you an "IOU": promising when to repay the principal (maturity date) and how much interest to pay each period (the coupon). This IOU can be bought and sold in the market, with its price moving as rates change. A bondholder is a creditor (not a shareholder), gets principal + interest at maturity, and has lower risk and return than stocks. is essentially a certificate by which the issuer borrows from investors and promises to repay principal and interest on agreed terms. Buying a bond = becoming a creditor.

识别一只债券看五大要素:To identify a bond, look at five key elements:

要素Element含义Meaning
发行人 issuerIssuer谁借钱:主权政府、非主权政府、超国家机构、公司、金融机构Who borrows: sovereign governments, non-sovereign governments, supranationals, corporations, financial institutions
期限 maturity(tenor)Maturity (tenor)还本时间;货币市场证券 ≤1 年,资本市场债券 >1 年,永续债无到期Time to principal repayment; money-market securities ≤1 year, capital-market bonds >1 year, perpetuals have no maturity
面值 par / face valuePar / face value到期偿还的本金,也是计算票息的基数(报价按面值百分比,如 98.5 表示面值的 98.5%)The principal repaid at maturity, also the base for computing the coupon (quoted as a percentage of par, e.g., 98.5 means 98.5% of par)
票息率 coupon rateCoupon rate每期利息 = 票息率 × 面值;可年付、半年付等Each period's interest = coupon rate × par; can be paid annually, semiannually, etc.
货币 currencyCurrency计价货币;双货币债、外币债等The denomination currency; dual-currency bonds, foreign-currency bonds, etc.
考点提示:债券报价是面值的百分比。面值 $1,000、报价 102.5 → 价格 $1,025。票息 = 票息率 × 面值,与市场价格无关(市场价变,票息金额不变)。

1. 识别一只债券的五大要素是:The five elements identifying a bond are: 官方题Official

  • A. 发行人与当前股价Issuer and current share price
  • B. 发行人、期限(到期日)、面值、票息率、计价货币Issuer, term (maturity date), par value, coupon rate, currency of denomination
  • C. 只有面值与票息率Only par value and coupon rate
答案 B。发行人、期限、面值、票息、货币构成债券的基本身份。Answer B. Issuer, term, par, coupon, and currency make up a bond's basic identity.

2. 债券报价 102.5、面值 $1,000,价格是:A bond quoted at 102.5 with $1,000 par; the price is: 官方题Official

  • A. $1,025$1,025
  • B. $102.5$102.5
  • C. $1,000$1,000
答案 A。报价是面值百分比:1,000×102.5%=$1,025。Answer A. The quote is a percentage of par: 1,000×102.5% = $1,025.

3. 市场价格变动会改变票息金额吗:Does a change in market price change the coupon amount: 官方题Official

  • A. 会随市价上升It rises with the market price
  • B. 会随市价下降It falls with the market price
  • C. 不会;票息=票息率×面值,与市价无关,变的是收益率No; coupon = coupon rate × par, independent of market price; what changes is the yield
答案 C。票息金额固定,价格变化改变的是到期收益率。Answer C. The coupon amount is fixed; a price change alters the yield to maturity.

§2 债券契约与条款§2 The Bond Indenture & Covenants

LOS 对应:LOS: describe how legal, regulatory, and tax considerations affect the issuance and trading of fixed-income securities。

债券契约(indenture / trust deed)是发行人与债权人之间的法律合同,规定各项条款。核心是限制性条款(covenants):The bond indenture (trust deed) is the legal contract between issuer and creditors that sets out the terms. At its core are the covenants:

类型Type含义Meaning
肯定性条款 affirmativeAffirmative covenants发行人必须做的事:按时付息、保持资产、提供财报、维持某些比率Things the issuer must do: pay interest on time, maintain assets, provide financial statements, maintain certain ratios
否定性条款 negative(restrictive)Negative (restrictive) covenants发行人不得做的事:限制再借债、限制分红、限制资产出售、负担池限制Things the issuer must not do: limits on additional borrowing, on dividends, on asset sales, negative-pledge restrictions

其他:担保 vs 无担保(secured 有抵押资产,如设备信托;unsecured=debenture 仅凭信用)、求偿顺序(seniority:优先级越高,违约时越先获偿)。税务:多数债券利息按普通所得征税;部分市政债利息免税;原始折价发行(OID)可能每年计入应税利息。Others: secured vs unsecured (secured has pledged assets, e.g., an equipment trust; unsecured = debenture, backed only by credit), seniority (the higher the priority, the earlier repaid in default). Taxes: most bond interest is taxed as ordinary income; some municipal-bond interest is tax-exempt; original issue discount (OID) may accrue as taxable interest each year.

4. 肯定性条款与否定性条款的区别是:The difference between affirmative and negative covenants is: 官方题Official

  • A. 两者含义相同They mean the same thing
  • B. 肯定性=发行人必须做(付息、提供财报);否定性=不得做(限制再借债、分红)Affirmative = things the issuer must do (pay interest, provide financials); negative = things it must not do (restrict further borrowing, dividends)
  • C. 肯定性=不得做Affirmative = must not do
答案 B。affirmative 是义务,negative 是限制。Answer B. Affirmative is an obligation, negative is a restriction.

5. 有担保与无担保(debenture)债券的区别是:The difference between secured and unsecured (debenture) bonds is: 官方题Official

  • A. 无担保债券有抵押Unsecured bonds are collateralized
  • B. 两者受偿顺序相同Their priority is the same
  • C. 有担保有特定抵押资产;无担保仅凭发行人信用;违约时有担保优先受偿Secured has specific pledged assets; unsecured relies only on the issuer's credit; secured is paid first on default
答案 C。抵押品决定了违约时的受偿优先级。Answer C. Collateral determines priority on default.
1. 下列哪项最可能是一项限制性（负面）条款（negative covenant）？1. Which of the following is most likely a negative covenant? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 发行人须遵守所有法律法规The issuer must comply with all laws and regulations
  • B. 新发行债务须次级于现有债券持有人的债务The issuance of new debt must be junior to existing bondholder debt
  • C. 新债务与借款人其他高级债务同等对待New debt obligations are treated the same as the borrower’s other senior debt instruments
答案 B。限制性(负面)条款=限制发行人"做某事"以保护债权人。B"新债务须次级于现有债权人"防止稀释现有债权,是负面条款。A(遵守法律)属肯定性条款;C(与其他高级债同等)是 pari passu 描述,不是限制。Answer B. A negative (restrictive) covenant limits what the issuer may do, protecting creditors. B (new debt must be subordinated to existing holders) prevents dilution of existing claims — a negative covenant. A (obey laws) is an affirmative covenant; C (rank equally with other senior debt) is a pari-passu description, not a restriction.

§3 现金流结构§3 Cash-Flow Structure

LOS 对应:LOS: describe common cash flow structures of fixed-income instruments。
结构Structure本金偿还方式How principal is repaid
子弹型 bulletBullet存续期只付息,到期一次性还本(最常见)Interest only during the life, principal repaid in one lump at maturity (most common)
全摊销 fully amortizingFully amortizing每期还款含本金+利息,到期本金还清(如房贷),期末无大额本金Each payment includes principal + interest, with principal fully repaid by maturity (like a mortgage), no large final principal
部分摊销 partially amortizingPartially amortizing期间摊还部分本金,到期有大额尾款(balloon)Some principal amortized over the term, with a large balloon at maturity
偿债基金 sinking fundSinking fund发行人定期赎回/回购部分本金,降低到期集中偿付风险The issuer periodically redeems/repurchases part of the principal, reducing the risk of concentrated repayment at maturity

6. 子弹型与全摊销债券的本金偿还有何不同:How do bullet and fully amortizing bonds differ in principal repayment: 官方题Official

  • A. 两者偿还方式相同They repay the same way
  • B. 子弹型只付息、到期一次还本;全摊销每期还本+息、到期无大额本金Bullet pays only interest and repays principal once at maturity; fully amortizing repays principal + interest each period with no large principal at maturity
  • C. 子弹型每期还本Bullet repays principal each period
答案 B。bullet 到期集中还本,amortizing 逐期摊还。Answer B. Bullet concentrates repayment at maturity, amortizing pays down gradually.

7. 什么是 balloon payment:What is a balloon payment: 官方题Official

  • A. 部分摊销债券到期时的大额本金尾款The large final principal payment at the maturity of a partially amortizing bond
  • B. 首期的大额付款A large first payment
  • C. 每期等额付款Equal payments each period
答案 A。partially amortizing 到期留有大额尾款。Answer A. A partially amortizing bond leaves a large final payment at maturity.

8. 偿债基金(sinking fund)的作用是:The role of a sinking fund is: 官方题Official

  • A. 增加到期偿付压力It increases the maturity repayment burden
  • B. 提高票息It raises the coupon
  • C. 发行人定期赎回/回购部分本金,降低到期集中偿付(再融资)风险The issuer periodically redeems/repurchases part of the principal, reducing the risk of concentrated repayment (refinancing) at maturity
答案 C。分期偿还降低到期集中偿付风险。Answer C. Staged repayment lowers the risk of concentrated repayment at maturity.
1. 若发行人被要求每年偿还债券本金的特定部分，则该债券最可能：1. If an issuer is required to retire a specified portion of the bond’s principal each year, the bond most likely: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 是可赎回债券。is callable.
  • B. 是递升票据。is a step-up note.
  • C. 含偿债基金条款。has a sinking fund provision.
答案 C。每年偿还本金的特定部分→偿债基金(sinking fund)条款,分期摊还本金以降低到期集中偿付风险。可赎回是发行人整体提前赎回;递升票据是票息逐期递增,都不是"每年还部分本金"。Answer C. Repaying a set portion of principal each year → a sinking-fund provision, amortizing principal to reduce refinancing risk at maturity. A callable bond is a whole early redemption; a step-up note has a rising coupon — neither is "repay part of principal yearly."

§4 票息结构§4 Coupon Structure

LOS 对应:LOS: describe contingency provisions and coupon structures。
浮动利率票息 = 参考利率(reference rate) + 利差(quoted margin / spread)
结构Structure含义Meaning
固定票息Fixed coupon票息率固定不变The coupon rate is fixed and unchanging
浮动利率 FRNFloating-rate note (FRN)票息 = 参考利率(如 SOFR)+ 固定利差,随利率重设;利率上升时票息跟涨Coupon = reference rate (e.g., SOFR) + a fixed spread, reset with rates; the coupon rises with rates
递增票息 step-upStep-up coupon票息按预定或与评级挂钩逐步上调(评级下调则票息上升,补偿投资者)The coupon rises by schedule or tied to the rating (a downgrade raises the coupon, compensating investors)
递延/PIKDeferred/PIK递延票息初期不付息;实物支付(payment-in-kind)以增发债券代替现金付息Deferred coupon pays no interest early on; payment-in-kind pays interest by issuing more bonds instead of cash
零息 zero-couponZero-coupon不付息,折价发行、面值兑付,回报来自价差Pays no interest, issued at a discount and redeemed at par, with the return coming from the price difference

9. 浮动利率债券(FRN)的票息怎么定:How is a floating-rate note's (FRN) coupon set: 官方题Official

  • A. 与股价挂钩Tied to the share price
  • B. 参考利率(如 SOFR)+ 固定利差(quoted margin),定期重设Reference rate (e.g., SOFR) + a fixed spread (quoted margin), reset periodically
  • C. 固定不变Fixed and unchanging
答案 B。FRN 票息随参考利率浮动。Answer B. An FRN's coupon floats with the reference rate.

10. 利率上升时,固定票息债券与 FRN 谁的价格更稳定:When rates rise, whose price is more stable — a fixed-coupon bond or an FRN: 官方题Official

  • A. 固定票息债券更稳定The fixed-coupon bond is more stable
  • B. 两者价格波动相同Their price swings are the same
  • C. FRN;票息随利率重设,价格更接近面值The FRN; its coupon resets with rates, keeping its price close to par
答案 C。浮息使 FRN 价格对利率不敏感。Answer C. Floating coupons make an FRN's price insensitive to rates.

11. 递增票息(step-up)常与什么挂钩、保护谁:What is a step-up coupon commonly tied to, and whom does it protect: 官方题Official

  • A. 常与评级挂钩:评级下调票息上升,补偿投资者的更高信用风险Often tied to the rating: a downgrade raises the coupon, compensating investors for higher credit risk
  • B. 与股价挂钩Tied to the share price
  • C. 保护发行人Protects the issuer
答案 A。step-up 保护投资者免受信用恶化损失。Answer A. A step-up protects investors from credit deterioration.

12. 零息债券的回报来自:A zero-coupon bond's return comes from: 官方题Official

  • A. 折价发行、面值兑付,回报全部来自价差Issued at a discount and redeemed at par — the return is entirely the price gap
  • B. 定期票息Periodic coupons
  • C. 股息分红Dividends
答案 A。零息债无票息,回报来自折价与面值之差。Answer A. A zero has no coupon; the return is the difference between the discount and par.
1. 下列哪项最可能是零息债券？一张面值 £1,000、在正收益率市场发行的债券，其发行价为：1. Which of the following is most likely a zero-coupon bond? A bond with a par value of £1,000 that was issued in a positive yield market at: 真题模考Mock
  • A. £920£920
  • B. £1,000£1,000
  • C. £1,100£1,100
答案 A。零息债券不付息,靠折价发行、到期还面值赚回报。正收益率下发行价必低于面值 → £920。£1,000 是平价、£1,100 是溢价,零息债不会这样发行。Answer A. A zero-coupon bond pays no coupon; its return comes from being issued at a discount and redeemed at par. With positive yields the issue price must be below par → £920. £1,000 is par and £1,100 a premium — not how a zero is issued.
2. 允许发行人以增发同一债券的方式（而非现金）支付利息的债券，最好地描述为：2. A bond that allows the issuer to pay interest in the form of additional amounts of the existing bond issue rather than a cash payment best describes a: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 递升票息债券。step-up coupon bond.
  • B. 递延票息债券。deferred coupon bond.
  • C. 实物支付（PIK）票息债券。payment-in-kind coupon bond.
答案 C。用增发同种债券(而非现金)支付利息 = 实物支付(PIK)票息债券,常见于高杠杆发行人以保留现金。递升是票息率递增;递延是前期不付、后期补付。Answer C. Paying interest by issuing more of the same bond (not cash) = a payment-in-kind (PIK) coupon bond, common for highly levered issuers to conserve cash. A step-up raises the coupon rate; a deferred coupon skips early payments and pays later.
3. 一只浮动利率票据(FRN)半年付息，票息率等于6个月市场参考利率(MRR)加45个基点。付息在6月和12月。若同年6月的6个月MRR为1.95%、12月为2.25%，则该年12月支付的票息率最接近：3. A floating-rate note makes semiannual interest payments and has a coupon rate equal to the six-month market reference rate plus 45 basis points. Interest payments are made in June and December. If the six-month MRR was 1.95% in June and 2.25% in December of the same year, the coupon rate paid in December of that year was closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 2.40%2.40%
  • B. 2.55%2.55%
  • C. 2.70%2.70%
答案 A。FRN 票息在重置日(期初)按当期 MRR 确定、期末支付。12 月支付的用的是6 月定的 MRR 1.95% + 利差 0.45% = 2.40%。用 12 月的 2.25% 是常见陷阱(那是为下一期定的)。Answer A. An FRN's coupon is set at the reset date (period start) from the then-current MRR and paid at period end. The December payment uses the MRR set in June 1.95% + spread 0.45% = 2.40%. Using December's 2.25% is the classic trap (that sets the next period).

§5 或有条款:内含期权§5 Contingency Provisions: Embedded Options 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: describe contingency provisions affecting the timing and/or nature of cash flows and their benefits and costs to issuers and investors。
🔰 零基础讲解:谁手里握着"提前了结"的权利?

或有条款给发行人或投资者一个选择权。关键是权利在谁手里、对谁有利——这决定了债券要给投资者更高还是更低的收益率。A contingency provision gives the issuer or investor an option. The key is who holds the right and whom it favors — this determines whether the bond must offer investors a higher or lower yield.

条款Provision权利在谁Who holds the right何时行使 / 对谁有利When exercised / whom it favors
可赎回 callableCallable发行人可提前赎回The issuer can redeem early利率下降时发行人赎回再低息借款 → 对发行人有利 → 投资者要求更高收益率补偿When rates fall, the issuer redeems and re-borrows more cheaply → favors the issuer → investors demand a higher yield as compensation
可回售 putablePutable投资者可提前回售The investor can sell back early利率上升时投资者回售拿回本金再投 → 对投资者有利 → 投资者接受更低收益率When rates rise, the investor sells back, recovers principal, and reinvests → favors the investor → investors accept a lower yield
可转换 convertibleConvertible投资者可转成股票The investor can convert into stock股价上涨时转股获益 → 对投资者有利 → 票息通常更低When the share price rises, converting profits → favors the investor → the coupon is usually lower
考点提示:
① 可赎回对发行人有利 → 收益率更高(投资者要补偿再投资风险);可回售/可转换对投资者有利 → 收益率/票息更低。
② 记价值关系:可赎回债券价值 = 直债价值 − 赎回期权价值;可回售债券价值 = 直债价值 + 回售期权价值。
③ 可转换相关术语:转换价、转换比率、转换价值 = 股价 × 转换比率。
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

三种内含期权

• 可赎回(callable):发行人有权提前赎回,利率下降时行使(去发低息新债)→ 对投资者不利 → 投资者要求更高收益率、价格上行受限(负凸性)。
• 可回售(putable):投资者有权提前卖回,利率上升时行使 → 对投资者有利 → 更低收益率。
• 可转换(convertible):投资者可转成股票,分享上行。

易错对比

① callable 利好发行人(收益率↑、价格↓);putable/convertible 利好投资者;② 含权债必须用有效久期(现金流随利率变);③ callable 在低利率区呈负凸性。

Three embedded options

• Callable: the issuer can redeem early, exercised when rates fall (to refinance cheaper) → bad for investors → they demand a higher yield, capped upside (negative convexity).
• Putable: the investor can sell back early, exercised when rates rise → good for investors → a lower yield.
• Convertible: the investor can convert to shares, sharing the upside.

Common traps

① Callable favors the issuer (yield ↑, price ↓); putable/convertible favor the investor; ② option-bearing bonds require effective duration (cash flows change with rates); ③ callable shows negative convexity at low rates.

13. 可赎回债券的赎回权在谁手里、利率怎样时行使:Who holds the call right on a callable bond, and when is it exercised: 官方题Official

  • A. 在发行人手里;利率下降时赎回、以更低利率再融资The issuer; it calls when rates fall to refinance at a lower rate
  • B. 在投资者手里The investor
  • C. 利率上升时行使Exercised when rates rise
答案 A。callable 让发行人在低利率时提前偿还。Answer A. A call lets the issuer repay early when rates are low.

14. 为什么可赎回债券要给投资者更高收益率:Why must a callable bond offer investors a higher yield: 官方题Official

  • A. 无需任何补偿No compensation is needed
  • B. 赎回对发行人有利、对投资者不利(再投资风险),需以更高收益率补偿The call benefits the issuer and hurts the investor (reinvestment risk), so it must be compensated with a higher yield
  • C. 因赎回对投资者有利Because the call benefits the investor
答案 B。投资者承担再投资风险,故要求更高收益。Answer B. Investors bear reinvestment risk and thus demand a higher yield.

15. 可回售债券的回售权在谁手里、利率怎样时行使:Who holds the put right on a putable bond, and when is it exercised: 官方题Official

  • A. 在投资者手里;利率上升时回售、拿回本金再投更高息资产The investor; it puts when rates rise to get principal back and reinvest at higher rates
  • B. 在发行人手里The issuer
  • C. 利率下降时行使Exercised when rates fall
答案 A。putable 让投资者在高利率时提前收回本金。Answer A. A put lets the investor recover principal early when rates are high.

16. 可回售/可转换债券的收益率/票息为什么更低:Why do putable/convertible bonds have lower yields/coupons: 官方题Official

  • A. 因这些期权对发行人有利Because these options favor the issuer
  • B. 与期权无关Unrelated to the options
  • C. 这些期权对投资者有利,投资者愿接受更低收益率/票息作为代价These options favor the investor, who accepts a lower yield/coupon as the price
答案 C。有利于投资者的期权压低了收益率。Answer C. Investor-favorable options depress the yield.

17. 可赎回与可回售债券的价值关系式是:The value relationships for callable and putable bonds are: 官方题Official

  • A. 可回售=直债−回售期权Putable = straight bond − put option
  • B. 可赎回=直债价值−赎回期权价值;可回售=直债价值+回售期权价值Callable = straight-bond value − call-option value; putable = straight-bond value + put-option value
  • C. 可赎回=直债+赎回期权Callable = straight bond + call option
答案 B。赎回权归发行人(减值),回售权归投资者(增值)。Answer B. The call belongs to the issuer (reduces value), the put to the investor (adds value).

18. 可转换债券的转换价值怎么算:How is a convertible bond's conversion value computed: 官方题Official

  • A. 面值 × 票息率Par × coupon rate
  • B. 股价 + 转换比率Share price + conversion ratio
  • C. 当前股价 × 转换比率(每张债券可转换的股数)Current share price × conversion ratio (shares per bond)
答案 C。转换价值=股价乘以可转股数。Answer C. Conversion value = share price times the number of convertible shares.
1. 其他条件相同，再投资风险最大的是：1. All else being equal, reinvestment risk is greatest for: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 可回售债券。putable bonds.
  • B. 可赎回债券。callable bonds.
  • C. 不可赎回的可转换债券。non-callable convertible bonds.
答案 B。再投资风险=被提前收回本金后只能按更低利率再投。利率下降时可赎回债最易被赎回、本金被迫再投 → 再投资风险最大。可回售、可转换的期权对投资者有利,不增再投资风险。Answer B. Reinvestment risk = principal returned early must be reinvested at lower rates. When rates fall, a callable bond is most likely called and its principal forced into reinvestment → highest reinvestment risk. Putable/convertible options favor the investor and don't add this risk.
2. 与其他条件相同的无期权债券相比，投资者对含下列何种条款的公司债要求更高收益率：2. Compared to an otherwise similar option-free bond, investors require a higher yield for a corporate bond with a: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 回售条款。put provision.
  • B. 赎回条款。call provision.
  • C. 转换条款。conversion provision.
答案 B。赎回条款对投资者不利(利率降时被提前赎回),投资者要求更高收益率作补偿。回售、转换条款对投资者有利,反而压低要求收益率。Answer B. A call provision hurts the investor (bond called away when rates fall), so investors demand a higher yield as compensation. Put and conversion features favor the investor and lower the required yield instead.
3. 一张可转换债券可转换成的普通股股数是：3. The number of common shares a convertible bond can be converted into is the: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 转换比率。conversion ratio.
  • B. 转换价格。conversion price.
  • C. 转换价值。conversion value.
答案 A。可转换债能换成的股数=转换比率(conversion ratio)。转换价格=面值/转换比率;转换价值=转换比率×股价。三者别混。Answer A. The number of shares a convertible converts into = the conversion ratio. Conversion price = par / ratio; conversion value = ratio × share price. Don't confuse the three.
4. 在其他条件相同的三只债券中，价格最高的最可能是：4. Among three otherwise comparable bonds, the bond with the highest price is most likely to be: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 可回售债券。putable.
  • B. 可赎回债券。callable.
  • C. 无期权债券。option-free.
答案 A。口诀:期权对谁有利,谁的债券价格就高。可回售(put)权对投资者有利 → 价格最高;可赎回(call)对发行人有利 → 价格最低;无期权居中。Answer A. Rule: whoever the option benefits, that bond is priced higher. A put benefits the investor → highest price; a call benefits the issuer → lowest; the option-free bond sits in between.

§6 债券的分类维度§6 Dimensions of Bond Classification

LOS 对应:LOS: describe the various classifications of fixed-income markets。

债券市场常按以下维度分类:发行人类型(政府/公司/证券化);信用质量(投资级 ≥BBB−/BBB3 vs 高收益级);期限(货币市场 ≤1 年 vs 资本市场);货币(本币/外币/欧洲债券);票息(固定/浮动/零息);地域(国内债、外国债、欧洲债券 Eurobond)。Bond markets are commonly classified by: issuer type (government/corporate/securitized); credit quality (investment grade ≥BBB−/BBB3 vs high yield); maturity (money market ≤1 year vs capital market); currency (domestic/foreign/Eurobond); coupon (fixed/floating/zero); geography (domestic bonds, foreign bonds, Eurobonds).

19. 投资级与高收益级的分界在:The dividing line between investment grade and high yield is: 官方题Official

  • A. 分界在 CCCThe line is at CCC
  • B. 投资级 ≥ BBB−(标普/惠誉)或 Baa3(穆迪);低于此为高收益/投机级Investment grade ≥ BBB− (S&P/Fitch) or Baa3 (Moody's); below that is high-yield/speculative
  • C. 分界在 AAAThe line is at AAA
答案 B。BBB−/Baa3 是投资级的最低门槛。Answer B. BBB−/Baa3 is the minimum threshold for investment grade.

20. 货币市场证券与资本市场债券按期限如何区分:How are money-market securities and capital-market bonds distinguished by maturity: 官方题Official

  • A. 货币市场 >1 年Money market > 1 year
  • B. 两者没有期限区分There is no maturity distinction
  • C. 货币市场 ≤1 年;资本市场 >1 年Money market ≤ 1 year; capital market > 1 year
答案 C。以 1 年期限为界。Answer C. The dividing line is 1 year.

21. PIK(payment-in-kind)债券如何付息:How does a PIK (payment-in-kind) bond pay interest: 补充Extra

  • A. 完全不付息It pays no interest at all
  • B. 以增发额外债券(而非现金)支付利息,常见于高杠杆发行人It pays interest by issuing additional bonds (not cash), common for highly leveraged issuers
  • C. 以现金付息It pays interest in cash
答案 B。PIK 以实物(增发债券)代替现金付息。Answer B. PIK pays interest in kind (extra bonds) instead of cash.

22. 什么是 Eurobond(欧洲债券):What is a Eurobond: 补充Extra

  • A. 以某货币计价、但在该货币本国以外市场发行的债券,通常监管较松、不记名A bond denominated in a currency but issued outside that currency's home market, usually with lighter regulation and in bearer form
  • B. 只在欧洲发行的债券A bond issued only in Europe
  • C. 只以欧元计价的债券A bond denominated only in euros
答案 A。Eurobond 与货币的本土市场无关,监管更宽松。Answer A. A Eurobond is unrelated to the currency's home market and is more lightly regulated.
1. 一张2年期国债票据（treasury note）最好地归类为：1. A 2-year treasury note is best classified as a(n): 真题模考Mock
  • A. 资产支持证券。asset-backed security.
  • B. 资本市场证券。capital market security.
  • C. 货币市场证券。money market security.
答案 B。按期限分:货币市场证券 ≤ 1 年,资本市场证券 > 1 年。2 年期国债票据 > 1 年 → 资本市场证券。它是政府债,不是 ABS。Answer B. By maturity: money-market ≤ 1 year, capital-market > 1 year. A 2-year Treasury note > 1 year → a capital-market security. It is government debt, not an ABS.
2. 在欧洲债券（Eurobond）市场发行的债券最可能：2. Bonds issued in the Eurobond market are most likely: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅以欧元计价。denominated only in euros.
  • B. 为记名债券形式。in the form of registered bonds.
  • C. 在发行人母国司法管辖区内发行。issued within the jurisdiction of the issuer's home country.
答案 B。欧洲债券(Eurobond)在离岸市场发行、不受任何单一国家监管,可用非发行人本国货币计价,且历史上多以无记名(bearer)形式发行。排除 A(不限于欧元)、C(不在发行人母国辖区发行)。Answer B. A Eurobond is issued offshore, outside any single country's regulation, may be denominated in a currency other than the issuer's home currency, and has historically been issued in bearer form. Eliminate A (not only euros) and C (not issued in the issuer's home jurisdiction).
3. 一家美国公司在英国发行、以英镑计价的债券，其价格最可能在何时变动：3. The price of a bond issued in the United Kingdom by a US-based company and denominated in British pounds most likely changes when: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅美国利率变动时。US interest rates change only.
  • B. 仅英国利率变动时。British interest rates change only.
  • C. 美英利率均变动时。both US and British interest rates change.
答案 B。债券价格由其计价货币所属国的利率决定。以英镑计价 → 只随英国利率变动;发行人是美国公司并不改变这一点。故排除 A、C。Answer B. A bond's price is driven by the interest rate of the country of its denomination currency. Denominated in GBP → moves only with UK rates; the issuer being a US company does not change this. Eliminate A and C.

第二讲 · 债券的发行、交易与市场Lecture 2 · Bond Issuance, Trading & Markets

对应教材:Fixed-Income Issuance and Trading + Markets for Corporate Issuers + Markets for Government Issuers · 建议学习时长:3 小时Curriculum: Fixed-Income Issuance and Trading + Markets for Corporate Issuers + Markets for Government Issuers · Suggested study time: 3 hours

这一讲讲债券"在哪买、怎么发、谁来发"。重点是公司的短期融资工具(回购 repo、商业票据)和政府发行人的层级。回购利率、商业票据是高频概念点。This lecture covers 'where bonds are bought, how they are issued, and who issues them.' The focus is corporate short-term funding tools (repos, commercial paper) and the tiers of government issuers. The repo rate and commercial paper are high-frequency conceptual points.

§1 一级市场:公募发行与私募§1 Primary Market: Public Offering & Private Placement

LOS 对应:LOS: describe fixed-income market issuance and the primary market。
方式Method说明Description
包销 underwrittenUnderwritten投行买下全部债券再转售,承担销售风险The investment bank buys the entire issue and resells it, bearing the sales risk
代销 best effortsBest efforts投行尽力代销、不承担买断风险The investment bank sells on a best-efforts basis, bearing no purchase risk
拍卖 auctionAuction政府债常用,按竞价确定利率/价格(如国债招标)Common for government bonds, setting the rate/price by competitive bidding (e.g., Treasury auctions)
私募 private placementPrivate placement面向少数合格机构发行,不公开、流动性差Issued to a few qualified institutions, not public, with poor liquidity

1. 包销与代销发行的区别是:The difference between underwritten and best-efforts offerings is: 官方题Official

  • A. 包销不承担任何风险Underwritten bears no risk
  • B. 两者完全相同They are identical
  • C. 包销=投行买断全部债券再转售、承担销售风险;代销=尽力代销、不承担买断风险Underwritten = the bank buys the entire issue and resells it, bearing sales risk; best-efforts = sells on a best-efforts basis without buyout risk
答案 C。underwritten 承担买断风险,best-efforts 不承担。Answer C. Underwritten bears buyout risk, best-efforts does not.

2. 政府债最常用哪种发行方式:What issuance method do government bonds most commonly use: 官方题Official

  • A. 尽力代销Best-efforts
  • B. 拍卖(auction),按竞价确定利率/价格Auction, setting the rate/price by competitive bidding
  • C. 私募配售Private placement
答案 B。主权债多通过拍卖发行。Answer B. Sovereign bonds are mostly issued via auction.

3. 私募发行相比公开发行的特点是:The features of a private placement vs a public offering are: 官方题Official

  • A. 流动性更好More liquid
  • B. 披露要求更多More disclosure required
  • C. 面向少数合格机构、不公开、披露少、流动性差,但发行更快更灵活Targeted at a few qualified institutions, non-public, little disclosure, illiquid, but faster and more flexible
答案 C。私募以流动性换取速度与灵活性。Answer C. Private placement trades liquidity for speed and flexibility.

§2 二级市场:场内与 OTC§2 Secondary Market: Exchange & OTC

LOS 对应:LOS: describe secondary markets for bonds。

绝大多数债券在场外市场(OTC)由做市商(交易商)报买卖价成交,而非交易所集中撮合。流动性差异大:国债流动性最好,公司债、证券化产品相对差。结算通常为 T+1、T+2 等。The vast majority of bonds trade in the over-the-counter (OTC) market, filled at dealers' (market makers') bid and ask quotes rather than centralized exchange matching. Liquidity varies widely: government bonds are most liquid, corporate bonds and securitized products relatively less. Settlement is usually T+1, T+2, etc.

4. 大多数债券在哪种市场交易:In which market do most bonds trade: 官方题Official

  • A. 拍卖市场The auction market
  • B. 场外市场(OTC),由做市商报买卖价The over-the-counter (OTC) market, with dealers quoting bid/offer
  • C. 交易所集中撮合Centralized exchange matching
答案 B。债券以 OTC 做市商市场为主。Answer B. Bonds trade mainly in the OTC dealer market.

5. 债券二级市场结算的典型周期是:The typical settlement cycle in the bond secondary market is: 补充Extra

  • A. T+30T+30
  • B. 即时结算Instant settlement
  • C. 通常 T+1 或 T+2(政府债常 T+1,公司债常 T+2)Usually T+1 or T+2 (government bonds often T+1, corporates often T+2)
答案 C。政府债结算通常更快。Answer C. Government bonds usually settle faster.

§3 公司短期融资:商业票据§3 Corporate Short-Term Funding: Commercial Paper

LOS 对应:LOS: describe short-term funding alternatives available to corporations。

商业票据(commercial paper, CP):大型高信用公司发行的短期(≤1 年,常≤270 天)无担保本票,用于周转性资金需求。折价发行(如美国 CP),回报=面值−买价。分美国 CP(USCP)与欧洲 CP(ECP)。滚动发行有展期风险(rollover risk),常配备银行备用授信支持。Commercial paper (CP): short-term (≤1 year, often ≤270 days) unsecured promissory notes issued by large, high-credit companies for working-capital needs. Issued at a discount (e.g., US CP), with return = par − purchase price. Split into US CP (USCP) and Euro CP (ECP). Rolling issuance carries rollover risk and is often backed by a bank standby credit facility.

6. 商业票据的期限与担保情况是:The maturity and collateral of commercial paper are: 官方题Official

  • A. 短期(≤1 年,常≤270 天)、无担保、折价发行,由高信用大公司发行Short-term (≤ 1 year, often ≤ 270 days), unsecured, issued at a discount by high-credit large companies
  • B. 长期且有担保Long-term and secured
  • C. 5 年期票息债A 5-year coupon bond
答案 A。CP 是短期无担保折价工具。Answer A. CP is a short-term unsecured discount instrument.

7. 什么是商业票据的展期风险(rollover risk):What is commercial paper's rollover risk: 官方题Official

  • A. 没有任何风险There is no risk
  • B. 到期需滚动发新票据偿旧,市场紧张无法续发则流动性危机;常配银行备用授信At maturity, new paper must be rolled to repay the old; if the market tightens and it cannot be reissued, a liquidity crisis follows — often backed by a bank credit line
  • C. 指利率上升的风险It means the risk of rising rates
答案 B。续发失败会引发流动性危机,故配备用信用额度。Answer B. Failed reissuance causes a liquidity crisis, so a backup credit line is arranged.

8. 金融机构的短期融资工具有:The short-term funding instruments of financial institutions include: 补充Extra

  • A. 只有发行股票Only issuing stock
  • B. 只有长期债券Only long-term bonds
  • C. 存款、同业拆借、大额存单(CD)、回购等Deposits, interbank borrowing, certificates of deposit (CDs), repos, etc.
答案 C。银行短期资金来源多样。Answer C. Banks have diverse short-term funding sources.

9. 商业票据的回报如何产生(折价发行):How does commercial paper generate a return (discount issuance): 补充Extra

  • A. 折价买入、面值兑付,回报=面值−买入价,无显性票息Bought at a discount and redeemed at par — return = par − purchase price, with no explicit coupon
  • B. 靠定期票息From periodic coupons
  • C. 靠股息分红From dividends
答案 A。折价工具的回报来自买入价与面值之差。Answer A. A discount instrument's return is the gap between purchase price and par.

§4 回购协议 repo§4 Repurchase Agreements (Repo) 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: describe repurchase agreements (repos) and their importance to investors who borrow short term。
🔰 零基础讲解:回购 = 用债券做抵押的短期借钱

回购 repo🔁 我今天把手里的国债"卖"给你换现金,同时约定明天(或几天后)用略高的价格把它"买"回来。本质就是:我用国债作抵押,向你借了几天钱,那点差价就是利息(回购利率)。对借钱方叫 repo,对借出现金方(反过来)叫逆回购 reverse repo。:一方卖出证券换现金、约定日后按约定价买回,实质是以证券为抵押的短期借款。Repo🔁 Today I "sell" my Treasury to you for cash, agreeing to "buy" it back tomorrow (or in a few days) at a slightly higher price. In essence: I borrowed cash from you for a few days using the Treasury as collateral, and that small price difference is the interest (the repo rate). From the borrower's side it's a repo; from the cash lender's side (in reverse) it's a reverse repo.: one party sells securities for cash and agrees to buy them back later at an agreed price — essentially a short-term loan collateralized by securities.

回购利息 = 回购本金 × 回购利率 × (天数 / 360)
回购保证金/折扣(haircut):贷出现金 = 抵押品价值 × (1 − haircut)
术语Term含义Meaning
repo rate回购利率(借款成本);受抵押品质量、期限、供求、货币市场利率影响The repo rate (cost of borrowing); affected by collateral quality, term, supply and demand, and money-market rates
haircut(折扣)Haircut抵押品价值高于贷出现金的比例,保护出借方;抵押品越差 haircut 越大The margin by which collateral value exceeds the cash lent, protecting the lender; the worse the collateral, the larger the haircut
repo vs reverse repo同一笔交易:出售证券借现金方看是 repo;买入证券放现金方看是 reverse repoSame trade: to the party selling securities to borrow cash it's a repo; to the party buying securities to place cash it's a reverse repo
考点提示:回购利率越低当抵押品质量高、期限短、需求高;haircut 越大当抵押品信用/流动性差。repo 是金融机构和债券投资者加杠杆与短期融资的核心工具。
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

回购协议(repo)

回购 = 以证券作抵押的短期借款:今天卖出证券并约定日后按略高价回购,差价即回购利率(repo rate)。从放款方看是逆回购(reverse repo)。

利率与折扣

repo rate 取决于抵押品质量、期限与供求:高质量抵押品 → 更低利率;某券被抢做抵押(special)→ 利率更低。折扣(haircut)是抵押品市值高出借款额的比例,保护放款方。

易错对比

① repo 是抵押融资,不是卖断;② repo rate 与抵押品质量反向;③ 期限越长、抵押品越差 → 利率越高、haircut 越大。

Repurchase agreements (repo)

A repo = short-term borrowing secured by securities: sell a security today and agree to buy it back later at a slightly higher price; the difference is the repo rate. From the lender's side it is a reverse repo.

Rate & haircut

The repo rate depends on collateral quality, term, and supply/demand: higher-quality collateral → lower rate; a security in demand as collateral ("special") → lower rate. The haircut is how much the collateral value exceeds the loan, protecting the lender.

Common traps

① A repo is secured financing, not an outright sale; ② the repo rate moves inversely with collateral quality; ③ longer term / poorer collateral → higher rate and bigger haircut.

10. 回购协议的实质是:The essence of a repurchase agreement is: 官方题Official

  • A. 以证券作抵押的短期借款:卖出证券换现金,约定日后按约定价买回A short-term secured loan collateralized by securities: sell securities for cash, agreeing to buy them back later at an agreed price
  • B. 永久出售证券A permanent sale of securities
  • C. 股权融资Equity financing
答案 A。repo 本质是抵押式短期融资。Answer A. A repo is essentially collateralized short-term financing.

11. 本金 $1,000 万、利率 3%、7 天,回购利息为:Principal $10m, rate 3%, 7 days; the repo interest is: 官方题Official

  • A. $2,100$2,100
  • B. $5,833$5,833
  • C. $58,333$58,333
答案 B。1,000万×3%×7/360=$5,833。Answer B. 10m × 3% × 7/360 = $5,833.

12. repo 与 reverse repo 的关系是:The relationship between a repo and a reverse repo is: 官方题Official

  • A. 完全不同的两笔交易Two entirely different trades
  • B. 两者都是借现金方Both are the cash-borrowing side
  • C. 同一笔交易两端:借现金(卖证券)方看是 repo;放现金(买证券)方看是 reverse repoTwo ends of the same trade: to the cash borrower (selling securities) it is a repo; to the cash lender (buying securities) it is a reverse repo
答案 C。视角不同,同一交易两端。Answer C. Different perspectives on the two ends of the same trade.

13. haircut(折扣)保护谁、抵押品差时如何变化:Whom does the haircut protect, and how does it change with poorer collateral: 官方题Official

  • A. 抵押品差时 haircut 变小The haircut shrinks with poorer collateral
  • B. 保护出借现金方;抵押品信用/流动性越差,haircut 越大It protects the cash lender; the worse the collateral's credit/liquidity, the larger the haircut
  • C. 保护借现金方It protects the cash borrower
答案 B。差抵押品要求更高折扣以保护出资方。Answer B. Poor collateral requires a bigger haircut to protect the lender.

14. 什么因素会降低回购利率:What factors lower the repo rate: 官方题Official

  • A. 抵押品质量高、期限短、市场对该抵押品需求高、货币市场利率低High-quality collateral, short term, high demand for that collateral, low money-market rates
  • B. 抵押品质量差Poor-quality collateral
  • C. 期限很长A very long term
答案 A。优质、抢手、短期的抵押品对应更低回购利率。Answer A. High-quality, in-demand, short-term collateral corresponds to a lower repo rate.
1. 在回购协议(repo)中，初始保证金保护：1. In a repurchase agreement, the initial margin protects: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅现金出借方。the cash lender only.
  • B. 仅现金借入方。the cash borrower only.
  • C. 现金出借方与借入方两者。both the cash lender and the cash borrower.
答案 A。回购(repo)中的初始保证金(haircut)保护现金出借方(借出现金、持有抵押品的一方),防抵押品跌价后不足偿。借入方由"到期回购价"约束,不靠初始保证金保护。Answer A. In a repo, the initial margin (haircut) protects the cash lender (who lends cash and holds collateral) against a fall in collateral value. The borrower is bound by the repurchase price, not protected by the haircut.

§5 公司长期债务§5 Corporate Long-Term Debt

LOS 对应:LOS: describe long-term corporate debt。

公司长期融资:银行贷款/银团贷款(syndicated loan,多家银行共同放贷)、公司债券(公开发行的中长期债)、中期票据(MTN)(可按需连续发行、期限灵活)。金融机构还有专门的短期融资(存款、同业拆借、大额存单 CD)。Corporate long-term financing: bank/syndicated loans (a syndicated loan is jointly funded by several banks), corporate bonds (publicly issued medium- to long-term debt), medium-term notes (MTN) (issued continuously as needed, with flexible maturities). Financial institutions also have dedicated short-term financing (deposits, interbank lending, certificates of deposit CDs).

15. 银团贷款(syndicated loan)是什么:What is a syndicated loan: 官方题Official

  • A. 由多家银行组成银团共同向一个借款人放贷,分散单家风险A loan from a syndicate of multiple banks to one borrower, spreading each bank's risk
  • B. 单家银行放贷A loan from a single bank
  • C. 向多个借款人分散放贷A loan spread across multiple borrowers
答案 A。银团共担一笔大额贷款的风险。Answer A. The syndicate shares the risk of one large loan.

16. 中期票据(MTN)的特点是:The features of a medium-term note (MTN) are: 官方题Official

  • A. 可按需连续发行、期限和金额灵活Can be issued continuously on demand, with flexible term and amount
  • B. 只能一次性发行Can only be issued all at once
  • C. 期限完全固定A completely fixed term
答案 A。MTN 便于发行人灵活匹配融资需求。Answer A. MTNs let issuers flexibly match funding needs.

§6 政府发行人层级§6 Tiers of Government Issuers

LOS 对应:LOS: describe the fixed-income markets for government issuers。
层级Tier说明Description
主权 sovereignSovereign中央政府发行(如美国国债 T-bills/notes/bonds);本币主权债信用最高Issued by the central government (e.g., US Treasuries — T-bills/notes/bonds); local-currency sovereign debt has the highest credit
非主权 non-sovereignNon-sovereign地方/州/市政府(如美国 municipal bonds)Local/state/municipal governments (e.g., US municipal bonds)
准政府/机构 agencyQuasi-government/agency政府相关机构(如 GSE)Government-related entities (e.g., GSEs)
超国家 supranationalSupranational跨国机构(世界银行、IMF、EIB 等)Multinational institutions (World Bank, IMF, EIB, etc.)
考点·登记形式与非主权还款来源:
• 记名债券(registered):发行人登记持有人身份。无记名/不记名债券(bearer):不登记持有人、持券即所有(Eurobond 历史上多为 bearer)。
• 非主权(州/市)政府债两类还款来源:一般责任(GO, general obligation):靠发行人整体征税能力还债(看人均收入、税基广度);收益支持(revenue bond):靠特定项目现金流还债,关键看项目偿债覆盖率(DSC)。Exam - registration form & non-sovereign repayment sources:
- Registered: the issuer records holders. Bearer: holders are not recorded - possession is ownership (Eurobonds were historically bearer).
- Non-sovereign (state/city) debt has two repayment sources: general obligation (GO): repaid from the issuer's overall taxing power (look at per-capita income, tax-base breadth); revenue bond: repaid from a specific project's cash flows, keyed to the project's debt-service coverage (DSC).

17. 主权债与非主权债的区别是:The difference between sovereign and non-sovereign bonds is: 官方题Official

  • A. 主权=地方政府发行Sovereign = issued by local government
  • B. 两者相同They are the same
  • C. 主权=中央政府发行;非主权=地方/州/市政府(如市政债)Sovereign = issued by the central government; non-sovereign = local/state/municipal governments (e.g., municipal bonds)
答案 C。发行主体层级不同。Answer C. The issuing government tier differs.

18. 下列属于超国家机构债券发行人的是:Which are supranational bond issuers: 官方题Official

  • A. 世界银行、IMF、欧洲投资银行(EIB)等The World Bank, IMF, European Investment Bank (EIB), etc.
  • B. 某国财政部A country's finance ministry
  • C. 某市政府A city government
答案 A。超国家机构由多国共同设立。Answer A. Supranationals are jointly established by multiple countries.

19. 为什么本币主权债信用通常最高:Why is local-currency sovereign debt usually the highest credit: 官方题Official

  • A. 因为有外部担保Because of an external guarantee
  • B. 中央政府可通过征税和发行本币偿债,本币违约概率极低The central government can repay through taxation and issuing its own currency, so local-currency default probability is extremely low
  • C. 因为它无需偿还Because it need not be repaid
答案 B。本币债可用货币发行权兜底。Answer B. Local-currency debt is backstopped by the power to issue currency.

20. 美国国债按期限如何分类:How is US Treasury debt classified by maturity: 补充Extra

  • A. T-bills 是长期债T-bills are long-term
  • B. T-bonds 是短期债T-bonds are short-term
  • C. T-bills(≤1 年,折价)、T-notes(2–10 年)、T-bonds(>10 年)T-bills (≤ 1 year, discount), T-notes (2–10 years), T-bonds (> 10 years)
答案 C。按期限从短到长:bills、notes、bonds。Answer C. From short to long: bills, notes, bonds.
1. 美国市政债券最好地描述为：1. US municipal bonds are best described as: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 机构债券。agency bonds.
  • B. 非主权债券。non-sovereign bonds.
  • C. 准政府债券。quasi-government bonds.
答案 B。美国市政债券(州/市发行,非中央政府)=非主权(non-sovereign)政府债券。机构债、准政府是另一类发行人。Answer B. US municipal bonds (issued by states/cities, not the central government) = non-sovereign government bonds. Agency/quasi-government bonds are a different issuer class.

§1 法律、监管、税务与固定收益指数§1 Legal, Regulatory, Tax & Fixed-Income Indexes

LOS 对应：describe legal, regulatory, and tax considerations; describe types of fixed-income indexes。
  • 法律：发行实体、担保、契约、抵押权和破产优先顺序决定投资者的现金流权利。Legal: the issuing entity, guarantees, covenants, security interests, and bankruptcy priority determine investors' rights to cash flows.
  • 监管：公开发行通常要求注册和持续披露；私募面向合格投资者，披露和流动性通常较低。Regulatory: public offerings usually require registration and ongoing disclosure; private placements target qualified investors, with typically lower disclosure and liquidity.
  • 税务：票息、资本利得和折价摊销的税务处理可能不同；某些政府债券享受税收优惠。Tax: the tax treatment of coupons, capital gains, and discount amortization can differ; certain government bonds enjoy tax advantages.

债券指数常按市场价值加权，导致负债最多的发行人权重更高。复制也比股票指数困难，因为债券数量多、交易不活跃且持续到期。Bond indexes are commonly market-value-weighted, giving the most indebted issuers a higher weight. Replication is also harder than for stock indexes, because bonds are numerous, trade thinly, and continually mature.

§1 债券定价:现金流折现§1 Bond Pricing: Discounting Cash Flows 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: calculate a bond's price given a market discount rate。
🔰 零基础讲解:债券价格 = 未来所有钱折现到今天

债券定价💵 债券未来会给你一串现金:每期票息 + 到期面值。今天它值多少?把每一笔未来的钱按市场利率"打折"回今天再加总——利率越高,打折越狠,价格越低。这就是"价格和收益率反向"的根源。把每期票息和到期面值按市场折现率折现求和。Bond pricing💵 A bond gives you a stream of future cash: a coupon each period + par at maturity. What is it worth today? Discount each future amount back to today at the market rate and sum them — the higher the rate, the harsher the discount and the lower the price. This is the root of "price and yield move inversely." discounts each period's coupon and the par at maturity by the market discount rate and sums them.

价格 P = Σt=1..N PMT / (1 + r)t + FV / (1 + r)N
符号Symbol含义Meaning
P债券价格(现值)Bond price (present value)
PMT每期票息 = 票息率 × 面值 ÷ 每年付息次数Each period's coupon = coupon rate × par ÷ payments per year
FV到期面值(par)Par value at maturity
r每期市场折现率(=每期 YTM);年利率 ÷ 付息次数The per-period market discount rate (= per-period YTM); annual rate ÷ number of payments
N总付息期数 = 年数 × 每年付息次数;t、N 是指数(幂)Total number of coupon periods = years × payments per year; t, N are exponents (powers)
债券定价计算 官方题Official

面值 $1,000、票息率 5% 年付、3 年期、市场折现率(YTM)6%。P = 50/1.06 + 50/1.062 + 1050/1.063 = 47.17 + 44.50 + 881.60 = $973.27(折价,因为票息率 5% < YTM 6%)。Par $1,000, coupon rate 5% paid annually, 3-year term, market discount rate (YTM) 6%. P = 50/1.06 + 50/1.062 + 1050/1.063 = 47.17 + 44.50 + 881.60 = $973.27 (a discount, because the 5% coupon rate < 6% YTM).

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

债券定价 = 现金流折现

价格 = 各期票息现值 + 本金现值:P = Σ C ÷ (1+r)^t + FV ÷ (1+r)^N,折现率 r 是市场要求收益率(YTM),不是票息率。

价格-利率反向

市场利率上升 → 折现更狠 → 价格下降;反之上升。这是固收最核心的反向关系,且关系是凸的(下跌少、上涨多)。

易错对比

① 折现用市场收益率,不是票息率;② 利率与价格反向;③ 半年付息要把利率与期数都除/乘 2。

Bond pricing = discounting cash flows

Price = PV of coupons + PV of principal: P = Σ C ÷ (1+r)^t + FV ÷ (1+r)^N, where r is the market required yield (YTM), not the coupon rate.

Price-yield inverse

Higher market rates → harder discounting → lower price, and vice versa. This inverse relation is the core of fixed income and is convex (falls less, rises more).

Common traps

① Discount at the market yield, not the coupon rate; ② price and yield move inversely; ③ for semiannual coupons, halve the rate and double the periods.

1. 付息债券的定价公式是:The pricing formula for a coupon bond is: 官方题Official

  • A. P = Σ PMT/(1+r)ᵗ + FV/(1+r)ᴺP = Σ PMT/(1+r)ᵗ + FV/(1+r)ᴺ
  • B. P = PMT × NP = PMT × N
  • C. P = FV − PMTP = FV − PMT
答案 A。各期票息与到期面值折现之和。Answer A. The sum of discounted coupons and the maturity par value.
1. 分析师获得一只年付息债券以下信息：
票息率4%
期限3年
面值$100,000
若市场贴现率为5%，该债券的市场价值最接近：1. An analyst gathers the following information about a bond that pays interest annually:
Coupon rate4%
Time-to-maturity3 years
Par value$100,000
If the market discount rate is 5%, the market value of this bond is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. $89,839$89,839
  • B. $97,277$97,277
  • C. $102,775$102,775
答案 B。方法:债券价值 = 各期现金流按市场贴现率折现之和。逐期把票息与到期本金用 5% 折现相加即得市值。溢价/折价由票息率与贴现率的高低关系决定(票息>贴现率则溢价)。Answer B. Method: bond value = the sum of cash flows discounted at the market discount rate. Discount each coupon and the final principal at 5% and add. Premium/discount follows whether the coupon exceeds the discount rate.
2. 一只3年期、半年付息、面值$100、票息率5%的债券以$108买入。一年后，若到期收益率下降100个基点，该债券价值的变动最接近：2. A three-year, semiannual-pay bond with a $100 par value and a 5% coupon rate is purchased for $108. One year later, if the yield to maturity has decreased by 100 basis points, the change in the value of this bond is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. $0.57$0.57
  • B. $1.52$1.52
  • C. $3.08$3.08
答案 A。方法:先按新 YTM 重算价格,再与原价比较。收益率下降 → 价格上升;但已过一年、且债券原为溢价(向面值回落),两效应叠加后净变动很小 → 约 $0.57。Answer A. Method: reprice at the new YTM, then compare to the old price. A yield fall raises the price, but a year has passed and the premium bond pulls toward par; netting the two leaves a small change ≈ $0.57.
3. 一只债券具有以下特征：
期限3年
票息率12%
付息周期半年
若到期收益率为4%，每100面值的债券价格最接近：3. A bond has the following characteristics:
Time to maturity3 years
Coupon rate12%
Payment periodSemiannual
For a yield to maturity of 4%, the price of the bond per 100 of par value is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 122.20122.20
  • B. 122.41122.41
  • C. 122.53122.53
答案 B。方法:把各期现金流按 4% 折现求和(每 100 面值)。票息率高于 4% → 价格>面值(溢价),约 122.41。此类题就是按贴现率逐期折现相加。Answer B. Method: sum the cash flows discounted at 4% (per 100 face). Coupon above 4% → price above par (premium), ≈ 122.41. These questions are just discount-and-add at the given rate.

§2 折价、溢价、平价§2 Discount, Premium, Par

LOS 对应:LOS: describe the relationships between a bond's price and its coupon rate, maturity, and market discount rate。
关系Relationship价格Price
票息率 > YTMCoupon rate > YTM溢价(价格 > 面值)Premium (price > par)
票息率 = YTMCoupon rate = YTM平价(价格 = 面值)Par (price = par)
票息率 < YTMCoupon rate < YTM折价(价格 < 面值)Discount (price < par)

关键规律:
① 价格与收益率反向(利率涨、价格跌);
② 随着接近到期,价格向面值收敛(pull to par);
③ 凸性:收益率下降带来的价格上涨,大于同幅收益率上升带来的下跌;
④ 其他相同,期限越长、票息越低,价格对利率越敏感。Key patterns:
① price and yield move inversely (rates up, price down);
② as maturity nears, the price converges to par (pull to par);
③ convexity: the price rise from a yield decline exceeds the price fall from an equal yield rise;
④ all else equal, the longer the maturity and the lower the coupon, the more sensitive the price to rates.

2. 票息率 5%、3 年、YTM 6%、面值 $1,000,价格及溢折状态是:Coupon rate 5%, 3 years, YTM 6%, par $1,000; the price and premium/discount status are: 官方题Official

  • A. =$1,000,平价=$1,000, par
  • B. ≈$973.27,折价(票息率 < YTM)≈$973.27, discount (coupon rate < YTM)
  • C. ≈$1,027,溢价≈$1,027, premium
答案 B。票息率低于 YTM,债券折价。Answer B. Coupon rate below YTM means the bond is at a discount.

3. 票息率、YTM、价格三者的溢折价关系是:The premium/discount relationship among coupon rate, YTM, and price is: 官方题Official

  • A. 票息率 > YTM→折价Coupon rate > YTM → discount
  • B. 与 YTM 无关Unrelated to YTM
  • C. 票息率 > YTM→溢价;=→平价;<→折价Coupon rate > YTM → premium; = → par; < → discount
答案 C。票息率与 YTM 的高低决定溢价或折价。Answer C. The coupon rate relative to YTM determines premium or discount.

4. 利率上升时债券价格如何变化:How does a bond's price change when rates rise: 官方题Official

  • A. 下降;价格与收益率反向Falls; price and yield move inversely
  • B. 上升Rises
  • C. 保持不变Stays unchanged
答案 A。价格与收益率呈反向关系。Answer A. Price and yield are inversely related.

5. "pull to par"是什么意思:What does 'pull to par' mean: 官方题Official

  • A. 价格越来越偏离面值The price deviates further from par over time
  • B. 随接近到期,溢价/折价债券价格逐渐向面值收敛As maturity approaches, a premium/discount bond's price gradually converges to par
  • C. 价格永远高于面值The price is always above par
答案 B。到期时价格必然收敛到面值。Answer B. At maturity the price necessarily converges to par.

6. 其他条件相同,期限越长、票息越低,对利率敏感性的影响是:All else equal, the effect of a longer term and lower coupon on interest-rate sensitivity is: 官方题Official

  • A. 敏感性越高(久期越长),价格对利率变动反应越大Higher sensitivity (longer duration), so the price reacts more to rate changes
  • B. 敏感性越低Lower sensitivity
  • C. 没有影响No effect
答案 A。长期限、低票息对应更长久期。Answer A. A long term and low coupon correspond to longer duration.
1. 债券的净价(flat price)：1. The flat price of a bond: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 也称为"全价/脏价"。is also referred to as the dirty price.
  • B. 沿等收益率价格轨迹被"拉向面值"。is "pulled to par" along the constant-yield price trajectory.
  • C. 包含结算日卖方收到的利息。includes interest received by the seller on the settlement date.
答案 B。净价(flat price)沿"等收益率价格轨迹"被拉向面值(pull to par):溢价债随时间下滑、折价债上行。含应计利息的是全价(脏价),不是净价。Answer B. The flat price is pulled to par along the constant-yield price trajectory: a premium bond drifts down, a discount bond up. The price that includes accrued interest is the full (dirty) price, not the flat price.
2. 投资者卖出一只原以折价买入的固定利率债券。由此产生的资本利得或损失应以其卖出价与下列何者比较来衡量：2. An investor sells a fixed-rate bond originally purchased at a discount. The resulting capital gain or loss should be measured by comparing the bond's selling price with its: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 面值。par value.
  • B. 账面价值。carrying value.
  • C. 购买价格。purchase price.
答案 B。折价买入债券的资本利得/损失 = 卖价 − 账面价值(carrying value),账面值沿 YTM 摊余轨迹随时间上升(折价债)。不是与面值或原购买价比。Answer B. The capital gain/loss on a bond bought at a discount = sale price − carrying value, where carrying value rises along the constant-yield (amortized) path. Not versus par or the original purchase price.

§3 整洁价、应计利息与全价§3 Flat Price, Accrued Interest & Full Price

LOS 对应:LOS: calculate the full price, flat price, and accrued interest。
全价(dirty)= 整洁价(flat/clean)+ 应计利息(AI)
应计利息 AI = 票息 × (自上次付息以来天数 t / 付息周期天数 T)
术语Term含义Meaning
全价 full/dirtyFull/dirty price买方实际支付的价格(含已累积利息)The price the buyer actually pays (including accrued interest)

  • B. AI = 票息 × NAI = coupon × N

1. 下列哪项不取决于市场贴现率？债券的：1. Which of the following does not depend on the market discount rate? A bond's: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 净价(flat price)。flat price.
  • B. 全价(full price)。full price.
  • C. 应计利息。accrued interest.
答案 C。应计利息只按"上次付息以来的天数比例"计,与市场贴现率无关。净价、全价都随贴现率变动,只有应计利息不随。Answer C. Accrued interest is just the day-count fraction since the last coupon and is independent of the market discount rate. Both flat and full prices move with the discount rate; only accrued interest does not.

§4 当期收益率与到期收益率§4 Current Yield & Yield to Maturity 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: calculate annual yield on a bond; define and compare yield measures。
当期收益率 current yield = 年票息 / 债券整洁价
到期收益率 YTM:使 Σ 现金流现值 = 债券价格 的折现率(即 IRR)
指标Metric含义Meaning
当期收益率Current yield只看票息回报,忽略价差与再投资、时间价值;粗略Looks only at the coupon return, ignoring price change, reinvestment, and time value; rough

当期收益率 官方题Official

票息率 5%、面值 $1,000、整洁价 $973.27。年票息 = $50,当期收益率 = 50/973.27 = 5.14%。折价债券当期收益率 > 票息率,但 < YTM(6%)。Coupon rate 5%, par $1,000, flat price $973.27. Annual coupon = $50, current yield = 50/973.27 = 5.14%. A discount bond's current yield > coupon rate but < YTM (6%).

考点·各种收益率一次讲清:
• 当期收益率(current yield) = 年票息 ÷ 价格,只看票息、不含资本利得。
• 到期收益率(YTM, yield to maturity) = 持有到期、票息按 YTM 再投时的内部收益率,含资本利得/损失。
• 赎回收益率(YTC, yield to call) = 假设在某赎回日被赎回时的收益率。
• 最差收益率(YTW, yield to worst) = 到期与各赎回情形中最低者,是可赎回债的保守下限。
关系:溢价债 YTM < 当期收益率 < 票息率;折价债相反。Exam · the yield family at a glance:
• Current yield = annual coupon ÷ price, coupon-only, no capital gain.
• Yield to maturity (YTM) = the IRR if held to maturity with coupons reinvested at the YTM, including capital gain/loss.
• Yield to call (YTC) = the yield assuming the bond is called on a given call date.
• Yield to worst (YTW) = the lowest among maturity and all call yields — a conservative floor for a callable.
Relations: premium bond YTM < current yield < coupon; the reverse for a discount bond.
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

当期收益率 vs 到期收益率

• 当期收益率(current yield)= 年票息 ÷ 价格:只看票息现金,忽略资本利得/损失与时间价值。
• 到期收益率(YTM):使全部现金流现值 = 价格的内含报酬率(IRR),假设持有到期。

三者排序(必考)

• 折价债:票息率 < 当期收益率 < YTM。
• 溢价债:票息率 > 当期收益率 > YTM。
• 平价债三者相等。

易错对比

① current yield 只算票息、不含价差;② YTM 是 IRR、含价差;③ 记住折价债「YTM 最高」、溢价债「YTM 最低」。

Current yield vs yield to maturity

• Current yield = annual coupon ÷ price: only the coupon cash, ignoring capital gain/loss and time value.
• YTM: the internal rate of return (IRR) that sets the PV of all cash flows equal to price, assuming hold to maturity.

Ordering (tested)

• Discount bond: coupon rate < current yield < YTM.
• Premium bond: coupon rate > current yield > YTM.
• At par all three are equal.

Common traps

① Current yield is coupon-only, excludes price change; ② YTM is the IRR, includes it; ③ remember a discount bond has the highest YTM, a premium bond the lowest.

9. 当期收益率的公式和局限是:The current yield formula and its limitation: 官方题Official

  • A. 完整考虑全部现金流Fully accounts for all cash flows
  • B. = 年票息/整洁价;只看票息,忽略价差、再投资和时间价值= annual coupon/flat price; it counts only the coupon, ignoring the price gap, reinvestment, and time value
  • C. = 票息 × N= coupon × N
答案 B。当期收益率只反映票息现金流。Answer B. Current yield reflects only the coupon cash flow.

10. YTM 的本质是:The essence of YTM is: 官方题Official

  • A. 年票息率The annual coupon rate
  • B. 当期收益率The current yield
  • C. 使债券未来现金流现值等于其价格的折现率,即内部收益率(IRR)The discount rate that makes the present value of a bond's future cash flows equal its price — the internal rate of return (IRR)
答案 C。YTM 就是债券现金流的 IRR。Answer C. YTM is the IRR of the bond's cash flows.

11. 折价债券的当期收益率与票息率、YTM 的大小关系是:For a discount bond, the size relationship among current yield, coupon rate, and YTM is: 官方题Official

  • A. 票息率 < 当期收益率 < YTMCoupon rate < current yield < YTM
  • B. YTM < 当期收益率 < 票息率YTM < current yield < coupon rate
  • C. 三者相等The three are equal
答案 A。折价债三者呈递增关系。Answer A. For a discount bond the three are in ascending order.
1. 一只4.5%票息、10年期、到期面值$100、当前价格$85.70的债券，其当期收益率(current yield)最接近：1. The current yield for a 4.5% coupon, 10-year bond, with a maturity par value of $100 and currently priced at $85.70 is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 4.50%4.50%
  • B. 5.25%5.25%
  • C. 5.93%5.93%
答案 B。当期收益率 = 年票息 ÷ 价格 = 4.5 ÷ 85.70 = 5.25%。它只看票息现金流、不含资本利得;含资本利得的更高值(5.93%)是到期收益率。Answer B. Current yield = annual coupon ÷ price = 4.5 ÷ 85.70 = 5.25%. It captures only coupon cash flow and ignores the capital gain; the higher figure (5.93%) that includes the gain is the yield to maturity.

§5 YTM 的三个隐含假设§5 The Three Implicit Assumptions of YTM

LOS 对应:LOS: describe the assumptions concerning the reinvestment of coupons and holding to maturity。

只有同时满足三条,实际实现收益率才 = YTM:
① 持有到期;
② 所有票息按YTM 再投资;
③ 发行人不违约、按时足额兑付。若再投资利率低于 YTM,或提前卖出,实现收益率会偏离 YTM——这就是再投资风险与价格(利率)风险的来源。The realized return equals YTM only if three conditions all hold:
① held to maturity;
② all coupons reinvested at the YTM;
③ the issuer does not default and pays in full and on time. If the reinvestment rate is below YTM, or the bond is sold early, the realized return deviates from YTM — the source of reinvestment risk and price (interest-rate) risk.

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

YTM 的三个隐含假设

只有当以下三条全部成立,实现收益率才等于买入时的 YTM:
① 持有到期;
② 所有票息按 YTM 再投资;
③ 发行人不违约、按时全额支付。

机制

关键是再投资假设:若实际再投资利率高于 YTM,实现收益 > YTM;若更低,则 < YTM。提前卖出还引入价格风险(未来 YTM 未知)。

易错对比

① 再投资率 = YTM 是核心假设;② 利率上升时再投资收益改善、但价格下跌(两风险反向);③ 违约/提前赎回都会打破该收益。

The three implicit assumptions of YTM

Realized return equals the purchase YTM only if all three hold:
① hold to maturity;
② all coupons reinvested at the YTM;
③ the issuer does not default and pays in full on time.

Mechanism

The key is the reinvestment assumption: if the actual reinvestment rate exceeds YTM, realized return > YTM; if lower, < YTM. Selling early adds price risk (future YTM unknown).

Common traps

① Reinvestment at the YTM is the core assumption; ② when rates rise, reinvestment improves but price falls (the two risks offset); ③ default/early call breaks the realized yield.

12. 实现收益率等于 YTM 需要哪三个假设:What three assumptions are needed for the realized yield to equal the YTM: 官方题Official

  • A. 票息不再投资Coupons not reinvested
  • B. 持有到期、所有票息按 YTM 再投资、发行人不违约Held to maturity, all coupons reinvested at the YTM, and the issuer does not default
  • C. 提前赎回Called early
答案 B。再投资率假设是关键前提。Answer B. The reinvestment-rate assumption is the key premise.

§6 即期利率与债券定价§6 Spot Rates & Bond Pricing

LOS 对应:LOS: define spot rates and calculate a bond's price using spot rates。
🔰 零基础讲解:即期利率 = 对应期限的"零息利率"

即期利率🎯 YTM 是对整只债券用"一个统一利率"折现;而现实中不同期限的钱有不同利率。即期利率(spot rate)就是"从今天借到第 t 年"这一段的零息利率。用每期对应的即期利率分别折现,是更精确的定价法。是各期限零息债的收益率;用它分期折现比用单一 YTM 更精确。Spot rates🎯 YTM discounts the whole bond at "one uniform rate"; but in reality money of different maturities has different rates. The spot rate is the zero-coupon rate for the segment "borrowing from today to year t." Discounting each cash flow by its own maturity's spot rate is a more precise pricing method. are the yields of zero-coupon bonds at each maturity; discounting period by period with them is more precise than a single YTM.

价格 P = Σt=1..N CFt / (1 + zt)t
符号Symbol含义Meaning
zt第 t 期的即期利率(spot rate),各期可不同The spot rate for period t, which can differ by period
CFt第 t 期现金流The period-t cash flow

13. 即期利率(spot rate)是什么:What is a spot rate: 官方题Official

  • A. 对应期限零息债的收益率;用各期即期利率分别折现可精确定价The yield of a zero-coupon bond of the corresponding maturity; discounting each period at its own spot rate prices the bond exactly
  • B. 当期票息率The current coupon rate
  • C. 远期利率The forward rate
答案 A。即期利率即零息利率。Answer A. A spot rate is a zero-coupon rate.

14. 用即期利率给债券定价的公式是:The formula for pricing a bond with spot rates is: 官方题Official

  • A. P = Σ CFₜ/(1+YTM)ᵗP = Σ CFₜ/(1+YTM)ᵗ
  • B. P = Σ CFₜ × zₜP = Σ CFₜ × zₜ
  • C. P = Σ CFₜ/(1+zₜ)ᵗP = Σ CFₜ/(1+zₜ)ᵗ
答案 C。各期现金流按对应即期利率折现。Answer C. Each period's cash flow is discounted at its corresponding spot rate.

15. 零息债券如何用即期利率定价:How is a zero-coupon bond priced with spot rates: 补充Extra

  • A. P = FV/(1+z_N)ᴺ,只有到期一笔现金流P = FV/(1+z_N)ᴺ, with only one cash flow at maturity
  • B. P = FV × z_NP = FV × z_N
  • C. P = FV − z_NP = FV − z_N
答案 A。零息债仅有到期一笔面值现金流。Answer A. A zero has only one par cash flow at maturity.

16. 为什么用即期利率曲线定价比单一 YTM 更准确:Why is pricing with the spot-rate curve more accurate than a single YTM: 补充Extra

  • A. 不同期限现金流面对不同利率;单一 YTM 忽略期限结构差异Cash flows of different maturities face different rates; a single YTM ignores the term-structure differences
  • B. 两者精度完全相同Their accuracy is identical
  • C. 单一 YTM 更准确A single YTM is more accurate
答案 A。即期曲线对每期现金流用匹配的利率折现。Answer A. The spot curve discounts each cash flow at a matching rate.
1. 一只按无套利价值交易的债券溢价定价。以即期利率折现的债券现金流现值之和：1. A bond trading at its no-arbitrage value is priced at a premium. The sum of the present value of the bond's cash flows discounted at spot rates is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 小于以到期收益率折现的现值之和。less than the sum of the present values of the bond's cash flows discounted at its yield to maturity.
  • B. 等于以到期收益率折现的现值之和。equal to the sum of the present values of the bond's cash flows discounted at its yield to maturity.
  • C. 大于以到期收益率折现的现值之和。greater than the sum of the present values of the bond's cash flows discounted at its yield to maturity.
答案 B。无套利下,用即期利率逐期折现与用 YTM 折现得到相同价格——YTM 本就是使二者相等的那个单一利率。故"等于"。Answer B. Under no-arbitrage, discounting each cash flow at spot rates gives the same price as discounting at the YTM — the YTM is by definition the single rate that equates the two. So "equal."

§7 远期利率§7 Forward Rates 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: define forward rates and calculate spot rates from forward rates and vice versa。
🔰 零基础讲解:远期利率 = "未来某段"锁定的利率

远期利率🔮 即期利率是"从现在开始"的利率;远期利率是"从未来某个时点开始、持续一段时间"的利率。比如"1 年后开始、期限 1 年"的利率,记作 f(1,1)。核心恒等式:先投 1 年即期、再接 1 年远期,应等于直接投 2 年即期——否则就有套利。是未来某时段的隐含利率;由即期利率的无套利关系推出。Forward rates🔮 Spot rates are rates "starting now"; forward rates are rates "starting at some future point and lasting a while." For example, the rate "starting in 1 year for a 1-year term," written f(1,1). The core identity: investing 1 year spot then rolling into a 1-year forward should equal investing 2 years spot directly — otherwise there is arbitrage. are the implied rates for a future period; derived from the no-arbitrage relationship of spot rates.

两期关系:(1 + z2)2 = (1 + z1) × (1 + f1,1)
一般式:(1 + zA)A × (1 + fA,N)N = (1 + zA+N)A+N
符号Symbol含义Meaning
zAA 年期即期利率The A-year spot rate
fA,N"A 年后开始、期限 N 年"的远期利率The forward rate "starting in A years for an N-year term"
远期利率计算 官方题Official

z1=3%、z2=4%,求 1 年后 1 年期远期利率 f1,1。(1.04)2 = (1.03)(1+f) → 1.0816/1.03 = 1+f → f = 5.01%。远期利率高于即期,反映向上倾斜的曲线。z1=3%, z2=4%; find the 1-year forward rate one year out, f1,1. (1.04)2 = (1.03)(1+f) → 1.0816/1.03 = 1+f → f = 5.01%. The forward rate exceeds the spot, reflecting an upward-sloping curve.

考点·隐含远期利率(implied forward rate)= 盈亏平衡再投资率:它是"投长期"与"投短期后再投资"两条路径收益相等时的再投资率,故又称盈亏平衡再投资率(break-even reinvestment rate)。由即期利率(spot rate)推出:(1+z₂)² = (1+z₁)(1+f₁,₁),一般式 (1+z_{a+b})^{a+b} = (1+z_a)^a·(1+f_{a,b})^b。远期利率也能像即期利率一样逐期折现给债券定价。Exam · implied forward rate = break-even reinvestment rate: it is the reinvestment rate that makes "invest long" equal "invest short then reinvest," hence the break-even reinvestment rate. From spot rates: (1+z₂)² = (1+z₁)(1+f₁,₁), general form (1+z_{a+b})^{a+b} = (1+z_a)^a·(1+f_{a,b})^b. Forward rates, like spot rates, can also price a bond by discounting each cash flow.
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

远期利率

远期利率是即期(spot)曲线内含的未来某期利率。无套利下,「先存 1 年再滚 1 年」应等于「直接存 2 年」:(1+z2)^2 = (1+z1)(1 + f₁,₁),解出 1 年后起的 1 年期远期利率 f。

机制

因此长端即期利率是各段远期利率的几何平均。曲线向上时,远期率高于即期率;向下时反之。可用远期率给未来现金流定价、或搭建对冲。

易错对比

① 远期率是隐含值,不是市场对未来的预测;② 复利用几何链接、别做算术平均;③ 上升即期曲线 → 远期 > 即期。

Forward rates

A forward rate is the future-period rate embedded in the spot curve. By no-arbitrage, "invest 1yr then roll 1yr" equals "invest 2yr": (1+z2)^2 = (1+z1)(1 + f₁,₁), solving for the 1-year rate one year forward, f.

Mechanism

So a long spot rate is the geometric average of segment forward rates. With an upward curve, forwards exceed spots; downward, the reverse. Forwards price future cash flows and build hedges.

Common traps

① A forward rate is implied, not a market forecast; ② chain compounding geometrically, not arithmetically; ③ an upward spot curve → forward > spot.

17. 远期利率的两期无套利关系式是:The two-period no-arbitrage relationship for forward rates is: 官方题Official

  • A. (1+z₂)² = (1+z₁)(1+f₁,₁)(1+z₂)² = (1+z₁)(1+f₁,₁)
  • B. (1+z₂) = (1+z₁) + (1+f₁,₁)(1+z₂) = (1+z₁) + (1+f₁,₁)
  • C. z₂ = z₁ × f₁,₁z₂ = z₁ × f₁,₁
答案 A。两年即期等于一年即期与一年远期的复合。Answer A. The two-year spot equals the compound of the one-year spot and the one-year forward.

  • B. 5.01%5.01%
  • C. 3.50%3.50%
答案 B。(1.04)²/1.03 − 1 = 5.01%。Answer B. (1.04)²/1.03 − 1 = 5.01%.

19. 远期利率高于即期利率说明曲线形状:A forward rate above the spot rate indicates what curve shape: 官方题Official

  • A. 收益率曲线向上倾斜(正常)An upward-sloping (normal) yield curve
  • B. 向下倾斜(倒挂)Downward-sloping (inverted)
  • C. 完全水平Perfectly flat

1. 盈亏平衡再投资率最可能等同于：1. A break-even reinvestment rate is most likely equivalent to a(n): 真题模考Mock

答案 C。盈亏平衡再投资率 = 隐含远期利率:它正是"投长期 vs 投短期后再投资"两条路径收益相等时的再投资率。平价利率、即期利率都不是。Answer C. The break-even reinvestment rate = the implied forward rate: exactly the reinvestment rate that equates "invest long" versus "invest short then reinvest." Not the par or spot rate.

§8 利差:G/I/Z-spread 与 OAS§8 Spreads: G/I/Z-Spread & OAS

LOS 对应:LOS: describe, calculate, and interpret yield spread measures。
利差Spread相对什么Relative to what
G-spread相对同期限国债收益率的差(政府基准)The difference relative to the same-maturity government bond yield (the government benchmark)
I-spread相对互换利率(swap)的差The difference relative to the swap rate
Z-spread加到每个即期利率上、使折现后价格等于市价的固定利差A constant spread added to every spot rate so that the discounted price equals the market price
OAS(期权调整利差)OAS (option-adjusted spread)Z-spread 剔除内含期权价值后的利差;可比较含权债与直债The Z-spread with the embedded-option value removed; allows comparing option-embedded bonds with straight bonds

利差反映信用与流动性风险溢价:利差越宽,风险补偿越高。经济恶化时信用利差走阔。Spreads reflect the credit and liquidity risk premium: the wider the spread, the higher the risk compensation. Credit spreads widen when the economy deteriorates.

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

四种利差

• G-spread:债券 YTM 减去同期限国债收益率。
• I-spread:相对互换利率之差。
• Z-spread:加到整条即期曲线上的常数利差,使按此折现的现金流现值 = 价格。
• OAS(期权调整利差):把内含期权价值剥离后的利差。

关系

对可赎回债:期权对投资者不利,OAS < Z-spread(Z 里含了期权补偿);可回售债则相反。OAS 才能在含权债间做「同口径」比较。

易错对比

① G-spread 用单一国债点、Z-spread 用整条曲线;② callable:OAS < Z;③ 比较含权债信用要用 OAS。

Four spread measures

• G-spread: bond YTM minus the same-maturity government yield.
• I-spread: the difference vs the swap rate.
• Z-spread: a constant spread added to the whole spot curve so discounted cash flows equal price.
• OAS (option-adjusted spread): the spread with the embedded-option value stripped out.

Relationship

For a callable bond the option hurts investors, so OAS < Z-spread (Z includes option compensation); putable is the reverse. Only OAS gives a like-for-like comparison across option-bearing bonds.

Common traps

① G-spread uses a single government point, Z-spread the whole curve; ② callable: OAS < Z; ③ compare option-bearing credit with OAS.

20. G-spread 相对什么衡量:Against what is the G-spread measured: 官方题Official

  • A. 相对即期利率的利差The spread over the spot rate
  • B. 相对票息率的利差The spread over the coupon rate
  • C. 相对同期限国债收益率的利差The spread over the same-maturity government-bond yield
答案 C。G-spread 基于政府债基准收益率。Answer C. The G-spread is based on the government-bond benchmark yield.

21. Z-spread 是什么:What is the Z-spread: 官方题Official

  • A. 加到每一个即期利率上、使折现后现值等于债券市价的固定利差The constant spread added to every spot rate that makes the discounted present value equal the bond's market price
  • B. 单期利差A single-period spread
  • C. 国债收益率The government-bond yield
答案 A。Z-spread 是加在整条即期曲线上的常数利差。Answer A. The Z-spread is a constant spread added across the entire spot curve.

22. OAS 与 Z-spread 的区别是:The difference between OAS and Z-spread is: 官方题Official

  • A. OAS = Z-spread 剔除内含期权价值后的利差,便于比较含权债与直债OAS = the Z-spread with the embedded-option value removed, easing comparison of option-bearing bonds with straight bonds
  • B. OAS = Z-spread + 期权价值OAS = Z-spread + option value
  • C. 两者完全相同They are identical
答案 A。OAS 是"去期权"后的纯信用/流动性利差。Answer A. OAS is the pure credit/liquidity spread after 'removing the option.'

23. 信用利差走阔通常意味着:A widening credit spread usually means: 官方题Official

  • A. 市场对信用/流动性风险要求更高补偿,常见于经济恶化时The market demands higher compensation for credit/liquidity risk, common when the economy deteriorates
  • B. 风险下降Risk is falling
  • C. 与经济无关Unrelated to the economy
答案 A。利差走阔反映风险溢价上升。Answer A. A widening spread reflects a rising risk premium.
1. 某债券相对于同期限、同币种标准互换利率的收益率利差，最好地描述为：1. The yield spread of a specific bond over the standard swap rate in that currency of the same tenor best describes the: 真题模考Mock
  • A. I-利差(插值互换利差)。I-spread.
  • B. Z-利差。Z-spread.
  • C. 期权调整利差(OAS)。option-adjusted spread.
答案 A。相对"同期限、同币种标准互换利率"的利差 = I-spread(插值互换利差)。相对主权债是 G-spread;相对整条即期曲线的常数利差是 Z-spread。Answer A. The spread over the same-maturity, same-currency standard swap rate = the I-spread (interpolated swap spread). Over a sovereign it is the G-spread; the constant spread over the whole spot curve is the Z-spread.
2. 相对于插值主权债券的收益率利差，最好地描述为：2. The yield spread over an interpolated sovereign bond is best described as a(n): 真题模考Mock
  • A. I-利差。I-spread.
  • B. G-利差。G-spread.
  • C. Z-利差。Z-spread.
答案 B。相对"插值主权债券"的收益率利差 = G-spread。相对互换是 I-spread;相对即期曲线是 Z-spread。Answer B. The yield spread over an interpolated government (sovereign) bond = the G-spread. Over swaps it is the I-spread; over the spot curve, the Z-spread.

§9 货币市场收益率惯例§9 Money-Market Yield Conventions

LOS 对应:LOS: describe the yield measures for money market instruments。

货币市场工具报价惯例特殊,须区分:贴现收益率(discount yield)基于面值、用 360 天;附加收益率(add-on yield / 银行贴现)基于本金。同一工具两种口径数值不同,注意换算成债券等价收益率再比较。Money-market instruments have special quoting conventions to distinguish: discount yield is based on face value using 360 days; add-on yield (bank add-on) is based on principal. The same instrument has different figures under the two conventions — be careful to convert to the bond-equivalent yield before comparing.

考点·货币市场收益率(money-market yields)按单利:货币市场工具(期限 ≤ 1 年)收益率按单利(simple interest)、不复利,且天数惯例各异。两种报法:
① 银行贴现率(bank discount yield) = (面值−价格)/面值 × (年天数/剩余天数),以面值为基,低估真实收益;
② 加息收益率(add-on yield / 债券等价收益率)以价格为基,更准确。跨复利频率比较须换成有效年收益率(EAY, effective annual yield)。Exam · money-market yields use simple interest: money-market instruments (≤ 1 year) quote yields on a simple-interest (non-compounded) basis with varying day counts. Two conventions:
① bank discount yield = (face − price)/face × (year days/days to maturity), based on face value, which understates the true return;
② add-on (bond-equivalent) yield, based on price, is more accurate. To compare across compounding frequencies, convert to the effective annual yield (EAY).

24. 贴现收益率与附加收益率的计算基础有何不同:How do the calculation bases of discount yield and add-on yield differ: 官方题Official

  • A. 两者都基于本金Both are based on principal
  • B. 贴现收益率基于面值;附加收益率基于本金(购买价)Discount yield is based on par; add-on yield is based on principal (purchase price)
  • C. 两者都基于面值Both are based on par
答案 B。基数不同,须换算后才能比较。Answer B. Different bases must be converted before comparison.
1. 按半年债券基准表述的年到期收益率为3.66%。有效年收益率最接近：1. The stated annual yield to maturity on a semiannual bond basis is 3.66%. The effective annual yield is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 3.63%3.63%
  • B. 3.69%3.69%
  • C. 7.45%7.45%
答案 B。半年债券基准 YTM=3.66% 是"名义年利率、半年复利"。有效年收益率 EAY=(1+0.0366/2)²−1 = 3.69%。3.63% 方向反了,7.45% 是错误翻倍。Answer B. A semiannual bond-basis YTM of 3.66% is a nominal annual rate compounded semiannually. Effective annual yield = (1+0.0366/2)² − 1 = 3.69%. 3.63% reverses the sign; 7.45% wrongly doubles it.
2. 对于收益率为负的票息债券，年内更频繁地复利会使到期收益率：2. For a coupon bond with a negative yield, compounding more frequently within the year results in a yield-to-maturity that is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 更负。more negative.
  • B. 不变。the same.
  • C. 负得更少。less negative.
答案 A。对负收益率债券,年内复利越频繁会使到期收益率更负——复利机制对负利率反向放大(与正利率时"更高"相反)。Answer A. For a negative-yield bond, more frequent compounding makes the YTM more negative — compounding amplifies a negative rate in the opposite direction to the positive-rate case.
3. 一只5年期半年付息债券的年化百分率(APR)为8%。换算为季度周期后，APR 最接近：3. A five-year semiannual bond has an annual percentage rate (APR) of 8%. Converted to a quarterly periodicity, the APR is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 1.98%1.98%
  • B. 3.92%3.92%
  • C. 7.92%7.92%
答案 C。方法:先把半年 APR 8% 转成有效年,再换成季度 APR:季度 APR=4×[(1+0.08/2)^(2/4)−1] ≈ 7.92%。不同复利频率间要经有效年过桥。Answer C. Method: convert the semiannual APR 8% to effective annual, then to a quarterly APR: quarterly APR = 4×[(1+0.08/2)^(2/4)−1] ≈ 7.92%. Bridge between compounding frequencies via the effective annual rate.
4. 货币市场收益率：4. Money market yields are: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 年化且复利。annualized and compounded.
  • B. 按统一周期表述。stated for a common periodicity.
  • C. 按单利基础表述。stated on a simple interest basis.
答案 C。货币市场收益率按单利(simple interest)表述,不复利,且常用不同天数惯例(如实际/360)。所以既非"复利"也非统一周期。Answer C. Money-market yields are quoted on a simple-interest basis, not compounded, and often use varying day counts (e.g., actual/360). So neither compounded nor on a uniform periodicity.
5. 一张商业票据具有以下特征：
兑付价值$5,000,000
所得利息$140,500
到期天数160
按365天计年，其贴现率最接近：5. A commercial paper has the following characteristics:

Days to maturity160
For a 365-day year, the discount rate is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 6.2%6.2%
  • B. 6.4%6.4%
