§2 矩阵定价 Matrix Pricing§2 Matrix Pricing

LOS 对应：describe matrix pricing。

若某债券没有近期成交价，可根据相似信用质量、期限、票息和行业债券的收益率或利差估计其要求收益率，再折现现金流。这就是矩阵定价。If a bond has no recent transaction price, its required yield can be estimated from the yields or spreads of bonds with similar credit quality, maturity, coupon, and industry, then used to discount the cash flows. This is matrix pricing.

例题

一只 5 年期 BBB 债券缺少报价。市场上 4 年期和 6 年期 BBB 债券收益率分别为 5.2% 和 5.6%。简单插值可估计 5 年期要求收益率约 5.4%，再用 5.4% 给目标债券定价。A 5-year BBB bond lacks a quote. In the market, 4-year and 6-year BBB bonds yield 5.2% and 5.6% respectively. Simple interpolation estimates the 5-year required yield at about 5.4%, then prices the target bond at 5.4%.

风险：相似债券并不完全相同；流动性、契约和内含期权差异会造成估值误差。

1. Matrix Pricing 用于什么情形:When is matrix pricing used:

  • A. 目标债券缺少可靠市场报价时,用相似债券收益率或利差估值When the target bond lacks reliable market quotes — value it using yields or spreads of similar bonds
  • B. 债券有活跃报价时When the bond has active quotes
  • C. 计算久期时When computing duration
答案 A。矩阵定价用可比券的收益率插值定价。Answer A. Matrix pricing interpolates from comparable bonds' yields.
1. 矩阵定价(matrix pricing)最可能用于估计下列哪种债券的价格：1. Matrix pricing is most likely used to estimate the price of a bond that: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 高流动性的债券。is highly liquid.
  • B. 尚未发行的债券。is not yet issued.
  • C. 信用质量未知的债券。has unknown credit quality.
答案 B。矩阵定价(matrix pricing)用于估计尚未发行或缺乏活跃报价的债券价格——借用信用/期限相近债券的收益率插值。高流动性债有现成价、不需矩阵定价。Answer B. Matrix pricing estimates the price of a bond that is not yet issued or lacks active quotes, by interpolating yields from bonds of similar credit/maturity. A highly liquid bond has an observable price and needs no matrix pricing.
2. 分析师获得以下信息：
期限到期收益率
债券13年3.4%
债券28年5.4%
仅据此，一只信用质量相近的5年期债券的估计市场贴现率为：2. An analyst gathers the following information:
Time to MaturityYield to Maturity
Bond 1Three years3.4%
Bond 2Eight years5.4%
Based only on this information, the estimated market discount rate for a 5-year bond with similar credit quality is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 4.2%4.2%
  • B. 4.4%4.4%
  • C. 4.6%4.6%
答案 A。方法:用相近期限债券的收益率线性插值,得到 5 年期的估计市场贴现率 ≈ 4.2%。矩阵定价的核心就是"用可比债券插值"。Answer A. Method: linearly interpolate yields from bonds of nearby maturities to estimate the 5-year market discount rate ≈ 4.2%. That interpolation is the essence of matrix pricing.

§3 浮动利率工具的利差度量§3 Spread Measures for Floating-Rate Instruments

浮息债票息定期重设：A floating-rate note's coupon resets periodically:

Coupon Rate = Reference Rate + Quoted Margin
概念Concept含义Meaning
Quoted Margin, QM发行时写入合约、加在参考利率上的固定利差The fixed spread written into the contract at issuance, added to the reference rate
Required Margin市场当前对该信用和流动性风险要求的利差The spread the market currently requires for that credit and liquidity risk
Discount Margin, DM使预期浮动现金流现值等于市场价格的利差The spread that makes the present value of expected floating cash flows equal the market price
  • 若 QM = Required Margin，FRN 通常接近面值。If QM = Required Margin, the FRN is usually near par.
  • 若 QM > Required Margin，票息相对丰厚，价格通常高于面值。If QM > Required Margin, the coupon is relatively generous and the price is usually above par.
  • 若 QM < Required Margin，价格通常低于面值。If QM < Required Margin, the price is usually below par.
FRN Discount Margin 数值例题

面值 100、两年期、每年付息。未来参考利率假设维持 3%，Quoted Margin=1%，所以每年票息为 4。市场价格为 98.50。令包含信用和流动性补偿的总折现率为 3%+DM：Par 100, two years, annual coupons. Assuming the future reference rate stays at 3% and Quoted Margin = 1%, the annual coupon is 4. The market price is 98.50. Let the total discount rate including credit and liquidity compensation be 3%+DM:

98.50 = 4/(1+3%+DM) + 104/(1+3%+DM)2

求得总折现率约 4.804%，因此 DM≈1.804%。DM 高于 QM 的 1%，说明市场要求更高利差，所以价格低于面值。Solving gives a total discount rate of about 4.804%, so DM≈1.804%. DM exceeds the QM of 1%, meaning the market demands a higher spread, so the price is below par.

计算逻辑：Quoted Margin 决定未来票息；Discount Margin 是令预期现金流现值等于市场价格的利差。不要把 QM 直接当作 DM。实际题目可能按季度或半年重设，应使用对应期数和周期利率。

3.1 货币市场收益率的三种口径

Discount Yield = (面值−价格)/面值 × 360/天数
Add-on Yield = (面值−价格)/价格 × 360/天数
Bond Equivalent Yield = (面值−价格)/价格 × 365/天数
例题

90 天工具面值 100、价格 98.50。Discount Yield=1.5/100×360/90=6.00%；Add-on Yield=1.5/98.5×360/90=6.091%；BEY=1.5/98.5×365/90=6.175%。分母和年化天数不同，所以同一工具的报价不同。A 90-day instrument, par 100, price 98.50. Discount Yield = 1.5/100×360/90 = 6.00%; Add-on Yield = 1.5/98.5×360/90 = 6.091%; BEY = 1.5/98.5×365/90 = 6.175%. The denominators and annualization days differ, so the same instrument has different quotes.

2. QM 低于市场要求利差时,FRN 通常高于还是低于面值:When the QM is below the market's required margin, does an FRN usually trade above or below par:

  • A. 恰等于面值Exactly at par
  • B. 低于面值,因合约票息利差不足以补偿市场要求的风险Below par, because the contractual coupon spread is insufficient to compensate the market's required risk
  • C. 高于面值Above par
答案 B。quoted margin 低于 required margin 时 FRN 折价。Answer B. When the quoted margin is below the required margin, the FRN is at a discount.
1. 对浮动利率票据(FRN)而言，规定的、相对参考利率的收益率利差最好地定义了：1. For a floating-rate note, the specified yield spread over the reference rate best defines the: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 票息。coupon.
  • B. 报价利差(quoted margin)。quoted margin.
  • C. 要求利差(required margin)。required margin.
答案 B。FRN 合约里写定的、相对参考利率的利差 = 报价利差(quoted margin)。市场按当前信用要求的利差是要求利差(required margin);二者相等时 FRN 平价。Answer B. The spread over the reference rate fixed in the FRN's terms = the quoted margin. The spread the market currently demands is the required margin; when they are equal the FRN trades at par.

§4 Spot、Par 与 Forward Curves§4 Spot, Par & Forward Curves 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

曲线Curve定义Definition主要用途Main use
Spot Curve各期限零息债券的即期利率The spot rates of zero-coupon bonds at each maturity逐笔折现不同期限现金流Discount each maturity's cash flow one by one
Par Curve使各期限债券价格等于面值的票息率The coupon rate that makes each maturity's bond price equal par新发平价债券票息和市场报价Coupon and market quote of a newly issued par bond
Forward Curve由即期利率隐含的未来期间利率Future-period rates implied by spot rates无套利定价和远期利率分析No-arbitrage pricing and forward-rate analysis
100 = Σt=1..n Cn/(1+zt)t + 100/(1+zn)n

给定 Spot Curve，可逐期求使债券等于 100 的票息 Cn，得到 Par Curve。给定相邻 Spot Rates，则用现金流可加性求 Forward Rates。Given the Spot Curve, solve period by period for the coupon Cn that makes the bond equal 100 to obtain the Par Curve. Given adjacent Spot Rates, use cash-flow additivity to solve for Forward Rates.

例题 1 · 计算两年期 Par Rate

一年期 Spot Rate z1=3%，两年期 z2=4%，面值 100、每年付息。令平价票息为 C：One-year Spot Rate z1=3%, two-year z2=4%, par 100, annual coupons. Let the par coupon be C:

100 = C/1.03 + (100+C)/(1.04)2

解得 C=3.9803，所以两年期 Par Rate 约为 3.98%。它不是 z2 的 4%，因为第一年票息按一年期 Spot Rate 折现。Solving gives C=3.9803, so the two-year Par Rate is about 3.98%. It is not z2's 4%, because the first year's coupon is discounted at the one-year Spot Rate.

例题 2 · Spot 与 Forward 互推并定价

z1=3%、z2=4%，则一年后开始的一年期远期利率：z1=3%, z2=4%, so the one-year forward rate starting one year out:

f1,1 = (1.04)2/1.03−1 = 5.0097%

反向计算时，z2=[1.03×(1+5.0097%)]1/2−1=4%。若两年期债券票息为 4，则：Working in reverse, z2=[1.03×(1+5.0097%)]1/2−1=4%. If a two-year bond has a coupon of 4, then:

P = 4/1.03 + 104/[1.03×(1+5.0097%)] = 100.04

用 Forward Rates 逐期折现和用对应 Spot Rates 折现必须得到同一价格，否则存在套利。Discounting period by period with Forward Rates and discounting with the corresponding Spot Rates must give the same price, or there is arbitrage.

曲线辨析：Spot Curve 用于逐笔折现；Par Curve 是使各期限假设债券等于面值的票息率；Forward Curve 是由当前 Spot Curve 无套利推导的未来期间利率，不等于对未来即期利率的保证预测。

3. Spot Rates 为 3% 和 4% 时,两年期 Par Rate 是否等于 4%:With spot rates of 3% and 4%, does the 2-year par rate equal 4%:

  • A. 恰好等于 4%Exactly 4%
  • B. 等于 3%Equal to 3%
  • C. 不等于,逐期折现后约为 3.98%No; after period-by-period discounting it is about 3.98%
答案 C。Par Rate 是各期即期利率的加权结果,略低于末期即期。Answer C. The par rate is a weighted result of the spot rates, slightly below the final spot rate.

债券最重要的风险是利率风险。本讲教你用久期衡量"利率变一点、价格变多少",用凸性修正久期的估计误差。这是固定收益最重的计算模块,几乎每年必考。A bond's most important risk is interest-rate risk. This lecture teaches you to use duration to measure 'how much the price moves when rates move a little,' and convexity to correct duration's estimation error. This is the heaviest calculation module in fixed income, tested almost every year.

§1 债券回报来源与两类利率风险§1 Sources of Bond Return & the Two Types of Interest-Rate Risk

LOS 对应:LOS: calculate and interpret the sources of return from investing in a fixed-rate bond。

持有固定利率债券的回报有三块:
① 票息与本金;
② 票息再投资收益;
③ 若提前卖出的资本利得/损失。利率变动引发两个方向相反的效应:The return on holding a fixed-rate bond has three parts:
① coupons and principal;
② coupon reinvestment income;
③ a capital gain/loss if sold early. A rate change triggers two opposing effects:

风险Risk利率上升时When rates rise
价格(市场)风险Price (market) risk债券价格下跌(提前卖出受损)The bond price falls (a loss if sold early)
再投资风险Reinvestment risk票息可按更高利率再投资(受益)Coupons can be reinvested at a higher rate (a benefit)

两者此消彼长。当投资期限 = 麦考利久期时,两种效应恰好抵消,实现收益率锁定(免疫 immunization)。短于久期→价格风险主导;长于久期→再投资风险主导。The two offset each other. When the investment horizon = the Macaulay duration, the two effects exactly cancel and the realized return is locked in (immunization). Shorter than the duration → price risk dominates; longer → reinvestment risk dominates.

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

回报来源与两类利率风险

持有债券的总回报 = 票息 + 票息再投资 + 资本利得/损失。利率变动同时引发两种方向相反的风险:
• 价格风险:利率↑ → 价格↓。
• 再投资风险:利率↓ → 票息再投资收益↓。

免疫的直觉

两风险相互抵消:当投资期限 = 麦考利久期时,价格损失恰被再投资收益弥补(或反之),实现收益锁定 → 单期免疫(immunization)。

易错对比

① 价格风险与再投资风险反向;② 持有期 < 久期 → 价格风险主导;持有期 > 久期 → 再投资风险主导;③ 二者相等即被免疫。

Sources of return & the two rate risks

A bond's total return = coupons + reinvestment of coupons + capital gain/loss. A rate move triggers two opposing risks:
• Price risk: rates ↑ → price ↓.
• Reinvestment risk: rates ↓ → coupon reinvestment income ↓.

Immunization intuition

The two offset: when the investment horizon = Macaulay duration, the price loss is exactly made up by reinvestment income (or vice versa), locking the realized return — single-period immunization.

Common traps

① Price and reinvestment risk are opposite; ② horizon < duration → price risk dominates; horizon > duration → reinvestment risk dominates; ③ equal → immunized.

1. 固定利率债券的回报有哪三个来源:The three sources of return for a fixed-rate bond are: 官方题Official

  • A. 只有票息Only coupons
  • B. 只有资本利得Only capital gains
  • C. 票息与本金、票息再投资收益、提前卖出的资本利得/损失Coupons and principal, coupon reinvestment income, and the capital gain/loss from selling early
答案 C。票息本金 + 再投资 + 资本损益三部分。Answer C. Coupons/principal + reinvestment + capital gain/loss, three parts.

2. 利率上升同时带来哪两个相反效应:A rise in rates brings which two opposing effects: 官方题Official

  • A. 价格风险(价格下跌)和再投资风险的缓解(票息可按更高利率再投)Price risk (price falls) and eased reinvestment risk (coupons can be reinvested at higher rates)
  • B. 两者都是损失Both are losses
  • C. 两者都是收益Both are gains
答案 A。价格与再投资两种风险方向相反。Answer A. Price and reinvestment risks move in opposite directions.

3. 当投资期限等于麦考利久期时会发生什么:What happens when the investment horizon equals the Macaulay duration: 官方题Official

  • A. 价格风险与再投资风险恰好抵消,实现收益率被锁定(免疫)Price risk and reinvestment risk exactly offset, locking in the realized yield (immunization)
  • B. 风险最大Risk is maximized
  • C. 一定亏损A loss is certain
答案 A。久期匹配投资期即实现免疫。Answer A. Matching duration to the horizon achieves immunization.

4. 为什么再投资风险和价格风险方向相反:Why do reinvestment risk and price risk move in opposite directions: 补充Extra

  • A. 利率上升:价格下跌但票息再投收益上升;利率下降则相反When rates rise: price falls but coupon reinvestment income rises; when rates fall, the reverse
  • B. 两者方向相同They move the same way
  • C. 两者互不相关They are unrelated
答案 A。正是这种对冲支撑了久期免疫。Answer A. This very hedge underpins duration immunization.
1. 若持有期内利率上升，持有至到期的票息债券其总回报最可能：1. If interest rates rise over the holding period, the total return of a coupon bond held until maturity is most likely to be: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 小于购买时的到期收益率。less than the yield to maturity at purchase.
  • B. 等于购买时的到期收益率。equal to the yield to maturity at purchase.
  • C. 大于购买时的到期收益率。greater than the yield to maturity at purchase.
答案 C。利率上升 + 持有至到期:虽短期价格下跌,但票息再投资收益提高,持有到期后再投资效应主导 → 实现总回报大于购买时 YTM。Answer C. With rising rates and holding to maturity: the price falls short-term, but coupons are reinvested at higher rates, and over the full horizon that reinvestment effect dominates → the realized return is greater than the purchase YTM.
2. 分析师获得一只债券以下信息：
面值100
票息率5.50%
付息频率年
期限5年
持有期3年
若持有期内市场贴现率为4.75%，持有期末再投资票息的终值最接近：2. An analyst gathers the following information about a bond:
Par value100
Coupon rate5.50%
Coupon frequencyAnnual
Time to maturity5 years
Holding period3 years
If the market discount rate is 4.75% for the holding period, the future value of reinvested coupons at the end of the holding period is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 15.0515.05
  • B. 17.3017.30
  • C. 18.1218.12
答案 B。方法:把各期票息按持有期贴现率复利到期末求和(再投资终值)。用 4.75% 把票息滚到期末 ≈ 17.30。这考的是"票息再投资终值"。Answer B. Method: compound each coupon forward to the horizon at the reinvestment rate and sum (the reinvestment future value). Rolling the coupons up at 4.75% ≈ 17.30. This tests the coupon-reinvestment FV.
3. 就利率风险而言，在收到第一次票息之后、到期之前卖出固定利率债券的投资者，面临：3. With respect to interest rate risk, an investor who sells a fixed-rate bond after the first coupon is received and before its maturity is exposed to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅市场价格风险market price risk, only
  • B. 仅票息再投资风险coupon reinvestment risk, only
  • C. 市场价格风险与票息再投资风险两者both market price risk and coupon reinvestment risk
答案 C。在到期前卖出的投资者同时承担市场价格风险(卖价随利率波动)和票息再投资风险(已收票息要再投)。两种风险方向相反、不能只占其一。Answer C. An investor selling before maturity bears both market price risk (sale price varies with rates) and coupon reinvestment risk (coupons already received must be reinvested). The two offset in direction, so it is not just one.
4. 组合经理获得一只持有至到期的无期权债券以下信息：
已实现持有期收益率4.2%
再投资利率4.1%
购买时的到期收益率最可能：4. A portfolio manager gathers the following information about an option-free bond that was held to maturity:
Realized horizon yield4.2%
Reinvestment rate4.1%
The yield to maturity at purchase was most likely: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 小于4.2%。less than 4.2%.
  • B. 等于4.2%。equal to 4.2%.
  • C. 大于4.2%。greater than 4.2%.
答案 C。无期权债持有至到期:若实现总回报被算出高于 4.2%,则购买时 YTM 必大于 4.2%(YTM 就是持有到期、票息按 YTM 再投时的回报基准)。Answer C. For an option-free bond held to maturity: if the realized return works out above 4.2%, the purchase YTM must be greater than 4.2% (the YTM is the benchmark return when held to maturity with coupons reinvested at the YTM).
5. 对固定利率债券，当利率下降时，再投资票息的终值最可能：5. For a fixed-rate bond, when interest rates decrease, the future value of reinvested coupon payments most likely: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 减少，且债券市场价格上升decreases and the market price of the bond increases
  • B. 增加，且债券市场价格下降increases and the market price of the bond decreases
  • C. 增加，且债券市场价格上升increases and the market price of the bond increases
答案 A。利率下降时两个相反效应:票息再投资终值减少(再投利率低),但债券市场价格上升(折现率低)。选"再投资终值减少 且 价格上升"。Answer A. When rates fall, two opposing effects: the coupon reinvestment FV falls (lower reinvestment rate) while the bond's market price rises (lower discount rate). Choose "reinvestment FV down and price up."
6. 投资者获得一只10年期债券投资的以下信息：
购买价95.27
卖出价102.06
再投资票息合计24.28
若持有期为7年，则持有期收益率最接近：6. An investor gathers the following information about an investment in a bond with a 10-year tenor:
Purchase price95.27
Sale price102.06
Sum of reinvested coupon payments24.28
If the holding period was seven years, the horizon yield is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 2.29%2.29%
  • B. 2.86%2.86%
  • C. 4.11%4.11%
答案 C。方法:持有期收益率 = [(期末价格 + 再投资票息终值)/买价]^(1/年) − 1。把 7 年的价格与再投资票息代入 ≈ 4.11%。Answer C. Method: holding-period return = [(ending price + reinvested-coupon FV)/purchase price]^(1/years) − 1. Plugging the 7-year ending price and reinvested coupons ≈ 4.11%.

§2 麦考利久期§2 Macaulay Duration

LOS 对应:LOS: define, calculate, and interpret Macaulay duration。
🔰 零基础讲解:久期 = 收回投资的"平均等待时间"

麦考利久期⏳ 想象债券的每笔现金流都挂在一根时间轴上,按"现值"作为重量。久期就是这根杠杆的平衡点——加权平均回收时间(单位:年)。久期越长,说明钱回收得越晚,对利率越敏感。零息债的久期恰好等于期限。是以现金流现值为权重的平均回收时间(年)。Macaulay duration⏳ Imagine each of a bond's cash flows hanging on a time axis, weighted by its "present value." Duration is the balance point of this lever — the weighted-average time to recover the money (in years). A longer duration means the money comes back later and is more sensitive to rates. A zero-coupon bond's duration exactly equals its maturity. is the weighted-average time to recovery (years), weighted by cash-flow present values.

麦考利久期 MacDur = Σ [ t × (CFt 的现值 / 债券价格) ]
符号Symbol含义Meaning
t各现金流发生的时间(期)The time (period) at which each cash flow occurs

2. 零息债券的麦考利久期最可能：2. The Macaulay duration of a zero-coupon bond is most likely: 真题模考Mock

§3 修正久期与价格变动估算§3 Modified Duration & Estimating Price Changes 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: define, calculate, and interpret modified duration; estimate the percentage price change。
修正久期 ModDur = MacDur / (1 + 每期收益率)
价格变动估算(一阶):%ΔPfull ≈ − ModDur × Δy
符号Symbol含义Meaning
ModDur收益率每变动 1%(100bp),价格约变动的百分比The approximate percentage price change per 1% (100bp) change in yield
Δy收益率变动(小数,如 +0.005 表示 +50bp)Yield change (decimal, e.g., +0.005 means +50bp)
负号Negative sign价格与收益率反向:收益率升→价格降Price and yield are inverse: yield up → price down
修正久期估价 官方题Official

ModDur = 7.0,收益率上升 50bp(Δy = +0.005)。%ΔP ≈ −7.0 × 0.005 = −3.5%。若债券全价 $980,价格约下跌 $980 × 3.5% = $34.3,至约 $945.7。ModDur = 7.0, yield rises 50bp (Δy = +0.005). %ΔP ≈ −7.0 × 0.005 = −3.5%. If the bond's full price is $980, the price falls by about $980 × 3.5% = $34.3, to about $945.7.

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

修正久期与价格估算

修正久期 ModDur = MacDur ÷ (1 + YTM/k)(k 为每年付息次数)。它把久期变成「利率每变 1%,价格约变百分之几」的敏感度:%ΔP ≈ − ModDur × Δy。

机制

这是价格-收益曲线的一阶(线性)近似——切线斜率。负号体现反向关系。小幅利率变动足够准;大幅变动要再加凸性二阶项。

易错对比

① 别漏负号;② Δy 用小数(1% = 0.01);③ 大 Δy 时线性会低估价格(债券凸性使实际更好)。

Modified duration & price estimation

ModDur = MacDur ÷ (1 + YTM/k) (k = coupons per year). It turns duration into a sensitivity "price % change per 1% rate move": %ΔP ≈ − ModDur × Δy.

Mechanism

This is the first-order (linear) approximation of the price-yield curve — the tangent slope. The minus sign encodes the inverse relation. Accurate for small moves; large moves need the second-order convexity term.

Common traps

① Don't drop the minus sign; ② use Δy as a decimal (1% = 0.01); ③ for large Δy the linear estimate understates price (convexity makes actual better).

7. 修正久期与麦考利久期的关系是:The relationship between modified duration and Macaulay duration is: 官方题Official

  • A. ModDur = MacDur×(1+收益率)ModDur = MacDur × (1 + yield)
  • B. 两者相等They are equal
  • C. ModDur = MacDur/(1+每期收益率)ModDur = MacDur/(1 + periodic yield)
答案 C。修正久期在麦久期基础上除以 (1+y)。Answer C. Modified duration divides Macaulay duration by (1+y).

  • B. −7%−7%
  • C. +3.5%+3.5%
答案 A。%ΔP ≈ −7×0.005 = −3.5%。Answer A. %ΔP ≈ −7×0.005 = −3.5%.

近似修正久期 ≈ (PV− − PV+) / (2 × Δy × PV0)

PV0当前价格Current price
PV−收益率下降 Δy 后的价格(更高)The price after yield falls by Δy (higher)

§6 有效久期(含权债 / 曲线法)§6 Effective Duration (Option-Bearing Bonds / Curve-Based)

LOS 对应:LOS: define and calculate effective duration; compare to yield duration。
有效久期 EffDur = (PV− − PV+) / (2 × ΔCurve × PV0)
要点Key point含义Meaning
ΔCurve基准收益率曲线平移的幅度(而非单一 YTM)The size of the parallel shift of the benchmark yield curve (rather than a single YTM)
适用Applicability含内含期权的债券(现金流随利率变化),必须用有效久期而非收益率久期Bonds with embedded options (cash flows change with rates) must use effective duration, not yield duration
考点提示:直债、无期权→用收益率久期(修正久期);含权债(可赎回/可回售/MBS)→现金流不确定,必须用有效久期(基于曲线情景重定价)。
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

有效久期(含权债)

对含内含期权的债券,现金流会随利率改变,不能用解析久期,改用有效久期:EffDur = (V₋ − V₊) ÷ (2 × V0 × Δ曲线)。做法:把整条基准收益率曲线平行上/下移动 Δ,重估价 V₊、V₋。

机制

V₋、V₊ 用含权定价模型(如二叉树)算,已把赎回/回售的行权可能纳入。故有效久期能捕捉「利率下降时可能被赎回,价格上行受限」的效应。

易错对比

① 含权债用 EffDur,不用 ModDur;② 用的是曲线变动 Δ曲线,不是单一 YTM;③ callable 在低利率时有效久期缩短(接近赎回)。

Effective duration (option-bearing bonds)

For bonds with embedded options, cash flows change with rates, so use effective duration: EffDur = (V₋ − V₊) ÷ (2 × V0 × Δcurve). Shift the entire benchmark yield curve up/down by Δ and reprice to V₊, V₋.

Mechanism

V₋, V₊ come from an option-pricing model (e.g., a tree) that already includes the chance of call/put exercise, so effective duration captures "price upside capped as rates fall because it may be called."

Common traps

① Option-bearing bonds use EffDur, not ModDur; ② it uses a curve shift Δcurve, not a single YTM; ③ a callable's effective duration shortens at low rates (near call).

13. 有效久期与修正久期的适用区别是:The applicability difference between effective duration and modified duration is: 官方题Official

  • A. 含权债用修正久期Option-bearing bonds use modified duration
  • B. 两者可随意通用The two are interchangeable
  • C. 直债无期权用修正久期;含内含期权(现金流随利率变)的债券须用有效久期Straight bonds without options use modified duration; bonds with embedded options (cash flows change with rates) must use effective duration
答案 C。现金流不确定时须用基于曲线情景的有效久期。Answer C. When cash flows are uncertain, use curve-scenario-based effective duration.

  • C. PV₀PV₀
答案 A。有效久期基于收益率曲线的整体平移。Answer A. Effective duration is based on a parallel shift of the yield curve.

15. 可赎回债券临近赎回时有效久期如何变化:How does a callable bond's effective duration change as the call approaches: 补充Extra

  • A. 不变It is unchanged
  • B. 缩短——价格上行空间被赎回价"封顶",对利率下降不再敏感It shortens — the price upside is 'capped' by the call price, so it is no longer sensitive to falling rates
  • C. 延长It lengthens
答案 B。赎回价封顶压缩了价格上行,久期缩短。Answer B. The call-price cap compresses price upside, shortening duration.
1. 债券价格对基准利率的敏感性最好地定义了：1. The sensitivity of a bond's price to benchmark interest rates best defines: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 收益率久期。yield duration.

9. 其他条件相同，当市场利率跌破债券票息率时，价格上涨潜力最受限制的是：9. All else being equal, when the market interest rate falls below a bond's coupon rate, potential price appreciation is most limited for a: 真题模考Mock

11. 零息债券的收益率久期与曲线久期在下列何种情况下最为接近：11. The yield duration and the curve duration of a zero-coupon bond are most similar when the: 真题模考Mock

  • C. 债券大幅折价定价。bond is priced at a significant discount.
答案 A。基准收益率曲线平坦时,零息债的收益率久期与曲线久期最接近(曲线平移≈YTM平移)。期限长短、折价程度不改变这一条件。Answer A. When the benchmark curve is flat, a zero's yield duration and curve duration are closest (a curve shift ≈ a YTM shift). Maturity length or deep discounting does not change this condition.
12. 有效久期在下列何种情况下是债券最合适的利率风险度量：12. Effective duration is the most appropriate interest rate risk measure for a bond when: 真题模考Mock

答案 C。有效久期最合适的情形 = 发行人可提前偿还(可赎回)→ 现金流不确定。曲线形状变化用关键利率久期;信用利差变化不改变"该用哪种久期"。Answer C. Effective duration is most appropriate when the issuer can prepay (callable) → uncertain cash flows. Curve-shape changes call for key-rate durations; a credit-spread change doesn't determine which duration to use.
13. 有效久期是可赎回债券合适的利率风险度量，因为它：13. Effective duration is the appropriate interest rate risk measure for callable bonds because it: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 衡量债券价格对最差收益率变动的敏感性。measures the sensitivity of the bond price to a change in the yield to worst.
  • B. 考虑了对可赎回债券可能显著的凸性调整。accounts for the convexity adjustment which can be significant for callable bonds.
  • C. 可用于不具备明确内部收益率的债券。can be calculated for bonds that do not have a well-defined internal rate of return.
答案 C。有效久期适合可赎回债,因为它可用于没有明确内部收益率(YTM)的债券(靠曲线移动重定价)。A、B 表述不准确。Answer C. Effective duration suits callables because it can be used for bonds without a well-defined internal rate of return (YTM) (it reprices under curve shifts). A and B are inaccurate.

§7 久期的影响因素§7 Factors Affecting Duration

LOS 对应:LOS: explain how a bond's maturity, coupon, and yield level affect its interest rate risk。
因素Factor久期(利率敏感性)Duration (rate sensitivity)
期限越长Longer maturity久期越长(敏感性↑)Duration longer (sensitivity ↑)
票息越低Lower coupon久期越长(零息债久期最长=期限)Duration longer (a zero-coupon bond's duration is the longest = maturity)
收益率越低Lower yield久期越长Duration longer
含可赎回/可回售期权With a call/put option期权临近行使时,有效久期缩短As the option nears exercise, effective duration shortens
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

久期的影响因素

其他条件不变:
• 期限↑ → 久期↑(现金流更靠后)。
• 票息率↑ → 久期↓(早期现金流占比更大)。
• YTM↑ → 久期↓(高折现压低远期现金流权重)。
• 含可赎回权 → 久期↓(有上限)。

推论

零息债没有中途票息,其麦考利久期 ≈ 到期期限(最大)。要久期长:选长期、低票息、低 YTM 的债。

易错对比

① 票息与久期反向、期限与久期正向;② YTM 越高久期越短;③ 零息债久期≈期限,是同期限里最长的。

Factors affecting duration

Holding else equal:
• Maturity ↑ → duration ↑ (cash flows later).
• Coupon ↑ → duration ↓ (more weight on early flows).
• YTM ↑ → duration ↓ (heavy discounting lowers far-flow weight).
• A call feature → duration ↓ (capped).

Corollary

A zero-coupon bond has no interim coupons, so its Macaulay duration ≈ its maturity (the maximum). For long duration pick long-maturity, low-coupon, low-YTM bonds.

Common traps

① Coupon is inverse, maturity is direct with duration; ② higher YTM → shorter duration; ③ a zero's duration ≈ its maturity, the longest at that maturity.

16. 期限越长,久期怎么变:How does duration change with a longer term: 官方题Official

  • A. 久期越长,利率敏感性越高Longer duration, higher rate sensitivity
  • B. 久期越短Shorter duration
  • C. 无关Unrelated
答案 A。期限越长现金流越靠后,久期越长。Answer A. A longer term pushes cash flows later, lengthening duration.

17. 票息越低,久期怎么变:How does duration change with a lower coupon: 官方题Official

  • A. 久期越长(零息债久期最长)Longer duration (a zero has the longest duration)
  • B. 久期越短Shorter duration
  • C. 无关Unrelated
答案 A。低票息使现金流重心靠后。Answer A. A low coupon shifts the cash-flow center of gravity later.

18. 收益率水平越低,久期怎么变:How does duration change with a lower yield level: 官方题Official

  • A. 久期越短Shorter duration
  • B. 无关Unrelated
  • C. 久期越长Longer duration
答案 C。低收益率下远期现金流权重更大。Answer C. At a low yield, distant cash flows carry more weight.

§8 凸性与二阶修正§8 Convexity & the Second-Order Correction 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: calculate and interpret convexity and estimate a bond's percentage price change。
🔰 零基础讲解:凸性 = 修正久期的"误差补丁"

凸性🌙 久期假设价格-收益率是一条直线,但真实曲线是弯的(凸向原点)。所以久期在大幅变动时会低估价格涨、高估价格跌。凸性就是给这条直线加一个"弯度修正":收益率大跌时价格涨得比久期预测的多,大涨时跌得比久期预测的少——凸性对债券持有人总是好事。修正久期的线性误差;正凸性对投资者有利。Convexity🌙 Duration assumes the price-yield relation is a straight line, but the true curve is bent (convex toward the origin). So for large moves, duration underestimates the price rise and overestimates the price fall. Convexity is a "curvature correction" to that straight line: when yields fall sharply the price rises more than duration predicts, and when they rise sharply it falls less — convexity is always good for the bondholder. corrects duration's linear error; positive convexity favors investors.

近似凸性 ≈ (PV− + PV+ − 2 × PV0) / (Δy2 × PV0)
价格变动(含凸性,二阶):%ΔP ≈ (− ModDur × Δy) + (½ × 凸性 × Δy2)
符号Symbol含义Meaning
凸性项 ½ × C × Δy2The convexity term ½ × C × Δy2永远为正(Δy 平方),修正久期的低估/高估Always positive (Δy squared), correcting duration's under/overestimate
Δy2收益率变动的平方(注意是幂,不是下标)The square of the yield change (note it's a power, not a subscript)
久期+凸性估价 官方题Official

ModDur = 7.0、凸性 = 60、收益率上升 100bp(Δy=+0.01)。%ΔP ≈ (−7.0×0.01) + (0.5×60×0.012) = −0.07 + 0.003 = −6.7%。凸性把仅用久期的 −7% 修正为 −6.7%(跌得少一点)。ModDur = 7.0, convexity = 60, yield rises 100bp (Δy=+0.01). %ΔP ≈ (−7.0×0.01) + (0.5×60×0.012) = −0.07 + 0.003 = −6.7%. Convexity corrects the duration-only −7% to −6.7% (falling a bit less).

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

凸性与二阶修正

更精确的价格变动:%ΔP ≈ − ModDur × Δy + ½ × 凸性 × (Δy)²。第一项是久期(线性),第二项是凸性修正——它把价格-收益曲线的「弯」补进来。

机制

普通债凸性为正:利率下降时价格涨得多、上升时跌得少,故真实价格总在切线上方——凸性对投资者有利,利率大幅波动时尤其明显。可赎回债在低利率区呈负凸性(价格被赎回价压住)。

易错对比

① 凸性项恒为正(普通债),且用 (Δy)²;② 大 Δy 才需要它、小 Δy 影响甚微;③ callable 低利率负凸性、putable 更高正凸性。

Convexity & the second-order correction

A sharper price change: %ΔP ≈ − ModDur × Δy + ½ × convexity × (Δy)². The first term is duration (linear); the second is the convexity correction, adding back the curvature of the price-yield line.

Mechanism

An ordinary bond's convexity is positive: price rises more when rates fall and falls less when they rise, so the true price is always above the tangent — convexity benefits investors, especially for big moves. A callable bond shows negative convexity at low rates (price capped by the call).

Common traps

① The convexity term is always positive (ordinary bonds) and uses (Δy)²; ② needed only for large Δy; ③ callable = negative convexity at low rates, putable = extra positive convexity.

19. 凸性修正的必要性是:The need for a convexity adjustment is: 官方题Official

  • A. 久期是线性近似,大幅变动时低估价格上涨、高估价格下跌;凸性做二阶修正Duration is a linear approximation that understates price rises and overstates price falls for large moves; convexity provides a second-order correction
  • B. 久期已完全准确Duration is already fully accurate
  • C. 凸性没有用处Convexity is useless
答案 A。凸性弥补久期的线性误差。Answer A. Convexity corrects duration's linear error.

20. 含凸性的价格变动公式是:The price-change formula including convexity is: 官方题Official

  • A. %ΔP ≈ 凸性×Δy%ΔP ≈ convexity×Δy
  • B. %ΔP ≈ (−ModDur×Δy) + (½ × 凸性 × Δy²)%ΔP ≈ (−ModDur×Δy) + (½ × convexity × Δy²)
  • C. %ΔP ≈ −ModDur×Δy − 凸性×Δy²%ΔP ≈ −ModDur×Δy − convexity×Δy²
答案 B。一阶久期项加二阶凸性项。Answer B. The first-order duration term plus the second-order convexity term.

21. ModDur=7、凸性=60、收益率+100bp,价格变动约:ModDur = 7, convexity = 60, yield +100bp; the price change is about: 官方题Official

  • A. −7.0%−7.0%
  • B. −6.4%−6.4%
  • C. −6.7%−6.7%
答案 C。(−7×0.01)+(0.5×60×0.01²)=−0.07+0.003=−6.7%。Answer C. (−7×0.01) + (0.5×60×0.01²) = −0.07 + 0.003 = −6.7%.

22. 正凸性对债券持有人是好是坏:Is positive convexity good or bad for a bondholder: 官方题Official

  • A. 好事:收益率大跌时价格涨得比久期预测多,大涨时跌得比久期预测少Good: when yields fall sharply the price rises more than duration predicts, and when they rise sharply it falls less
  • B. 坏事Bad
  • C. 没有影响No effect
答案 A。正凸性带来"涨多跌少"的非对称好处。Answer A. Positive convexity gives an asymmetric 'rise more, fall less' benefit.
1. 当到期收益率下降100个基点时，某无期权债券价格上涨7%。若该债券价格下跌7%，则到期收益率最可能上升：1. The price of an option-free bond increases by 7% when the yield to maturity decreases by 100 basis points. If the price of this bond decreases by 7%, the yield to maturity most likely increases by: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 少于100个基点。less than 100 basis points.
  • B. 100个基点。100 basis points.
  • C. 多于100个基点。more than 100 basis points.
答案 C。价格-收益率曲线是凸的:同样幅度,收益率下降使价涨 7%,则价下跌 7% 需收益率上升多于 100bp(下行价格更"抗跌")。这正是正凸性。Answer C. The price-yield curve is convex: a yield fall gives +7%, so a 7% drop requires a yield rise of more than 100 bp (prices resist falling). That is positive convexity.
2. 其他条件相同，无期权债券百分比价格变动的绝对值最可能：2. All else being equal, the absolute value of the percentage price change for an option-free bond is most likely: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 当市场贴现率下降时小于其等幅上升时。less when the market discount rate decreases than when it increases by the same amount.
  • B. 无论市场贴现率等幅下降或上升都相同。the same whether the market discount rate decreases or increases by the same amount.
  • C. 当市场贴现率下降时大于其等幅上升时。greater when the market discount rate decreases than when it increases by the same amount.
答案 C。凸性使价格上行>下行:同幅度变动时,贴现率下降的价涨幅 大于上升的价跌幅(绝对值)。故"下降时大于上升时"。Answer C. Convexity makes the upside exceed the downside: for equal-size moves, the price rise on a discount-rate fall is greater (in absolute value) than the fall on a rise. Hence "greater when it falls."
3. 一只价格99.4的债券，修正久期6.9、年凸性统计量−212。若市场收益率上升75个基点，该债券价格最接近：3. A bond priced at 99.4 has a modified duration of 6.9 and an annual convexity statistic of −212. If the market yield increases by 75 basis points, the price of this bond is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 93.793.7
  • B. 94.394.3
  • C. 94.994.9
答案 A。方法:ΔP% ≈ −ModDur×Δy + ½×凸性×Δy²。−6.9×0.0075 + ½×(−212)×0.0075² ≈ −5.77% → 99.4×(1−0.0577) ≈ 93.7。负凸性让跌幅更大。Answer A. Method: ΔP% ≈ −ModDur×Δy + ½×convexity×Δy². −6.9×0.0075 + ½×(−212)×0.0075² ≈ −5.77% → 99.4×(1−0.0577) ≈ 93.7. The negative convexity deepens the fall.
4. 分析师获得一只债券以下信息：
价格96.00
到期收益率上升10bp时价格95.80
到期收益率下降10bp时价格96.30
该债券的近似凸性最接近：4. An analyst gathers the following information about a bond:
Price96.00
Price with yield-to-maturity 10 bps higher95.80
Price with yield-to-maturity 10 bps lower96.30
The approximate convexity of this bond is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 521521
  • B. 1,0421,042
  • C. 2,6042,604
答案 B。方法:近似凸性 =(V₋ + V₊ − 2V₀)/(V₀ × Δy²),用上下移两价与现价。代入 ≈ 1,042。凸性衡量价格-收益率曲线的弯曲度。Answer B. Method: approximate convexity = (V₋ + V₊ − 2V₀)/(V₀ × Δy²), using the up/down prices and the current price. ≈ 1,042. Convexity measures the curvature of the price-yield relation.
5. 分析师获得一只零息债券以下信息：
期限5年
年凸性28.835
年到期收益率2%
若收益率下降1%，该债券的价格百分比变动最接近：5. An analyst gathers the following information about a zero-coupon bond:
Time to maturity5 years
Annual convexity28.835
Annual yield to maturity2%
If the yield decreases by 1%, the bond's percentage change in price is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 4.76%4.76%
  • B. 5.05%5.05%
  • C. 5.14%5.14%
答案 B。方法:零息债价格变动 = 久期项 + 凸性项。零息久期=期限,凸性亦大;1% 变动代入两项 ≈ 5.05%。只用久期会低估。Answer B. Method: a zero's price change = duration term + convexity term. A zero's duration equals its term and its convexity is sizable; a 1% move over both terms ≈ 5.05%. Duration alone would understate it.
6. 两只平价债券久期相同但凸性不同。其他条件相同，若到期收益率上升10个基点，最可能：6. Two par bonds have the same duration but different convexity. All else being equal, if yields to maturity increase by 10 basis points, it is most likely that: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 凸性更高的债券跑输凸性较低者the more convex bond underperforms the less convex bond
  • B. 两只债券价格下跌相同幅度both bond prices decrease by the same amount
  • C. 凸性更高的债券跑赢凸性较低者the more convex bond outperforms the less convex bond
答案 C。久期相同、凸性不同时:凸性更高者在收益率上升时跌得少(凸性总是利好)→ 跑赢凸性低者。收益率下降时它也涨得多。Answer C. With equal duration but different convexity: the higher-convexity bond falls less when yields rise (convexity always helps) → it outperforms. It also rises more when yields fall.
7. 分析师获得一只年付息无期权债券以下信息：
修正久期13.2
凸性统计量1,081
若该债券收益率下降10个基点，其预期价格百分比变动最接近：7. An analyst gathers the following information about an option-free coupon bond that pays annually:
Modified duration13.2
Convexity statistic1,081
If the bond's yield decreases by 10 basis points, the expected percentage price change for this bond is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. −1.27%−1.27%
  • B. 1.27%1.27%
  • C. 1.37%1.37%
答案 C。方法:ΔP% ≈ −ModDur×Δy + ½×凸性×Δy²。收益率降 10bp,久期项 + 凸性项相加 ≈ 1.37%(比只用久期的 1.27% 略高,凸性加分)。Answer C. Method: ΔP% ≈ −ModDur×Δy + ½×convexity×Δy². On a 10 bp fall, the duration plus convexity terms ≈ 1.37% (slightly above the duration-only 1.27%, convexity adds).
8. 可赎回债券表现出：8. Callable bonds exhibit: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅正凸性。positive convexity only.
  • B. 仅负凸性。negative convexity only.
  • C. 正凸性或负凸性均可。either positive or negative convexity.
答案 C。可赎回债正凸性或负凸性均可:利率高、远离赎回价时表现正凸性;利率低、逼近赎回价时因赎回压顶转为负凸性。Answer C. A callable bond can show positive or negative convexity: positive when rates are high and far from the call price; negative when rates are low and the call price caps the upside.
9. 下列哪项表述最准确？凸性调整：9. Which of the following statements is most accurate? The convexity adjustment is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 对无期权债券在任何情况下都为正。positive for an option-free bond in all circumstances.
  • B. 当期权价值很低时对可赎回债券为负。negative for a callable bond when the value of the option is very low.
  • C. 当收益率下降时为正、上升时为负。positive when bond yields decrease and negative when bond yields increase.
答案 A。无期权债的凸性调整在任何情况下都为正(总是抬高预测价格,是利好)。可赎回债在低利率时可能负凸;凸性调整并非"降为正、升为负"。Answer A. For an option-free bond the convexity adjustment is always positive (it always raises the predicted price — a benefit). A callable can be negatively convex at low rates; the adjustment is not "positive on a fall, negative on a rise."

§9 组合久期§9 Portfolio Duration

LOS 对应:LOS: calculate the duration of a portfolio。

组合久期 ≈ 各债券久期的市值加权平均。用于衡量整个债券组合对利率平移的敏感度。局限:假设收益率曲线平行移动;若曲线非平行变化(变陡/变平),需用关键期限久期(key rate duration)分段衡量。Portfolio duration ≈ the market-value-weighted average of the bonds' durations. Used to measure the whole bond portfolio's sensitivity to a parallel rate shift. Limitation: it assumes the yield curve shifts in parallel; if the curve changes non-parallel (steepening/flattening), use key rate durations to measure by segment.

23. 组合久期怎么估:How is portfolio duration estimated: 官方题Official

  • A. 各债券久期的市值加权平均The market-value-weighted average of the individual bonds' durations
  • B. 简单算术平均A simple arithmetic average
  • C. 各久期直接求和Summing the durations directly
答案 A。按市值权重加权。Answer A. Weighted by market value.

24. 组合久期的关键假设及其局限是:The key assumption of portfolio duration and its limitation: 官方题Official

  • A. 没有任何假设It has no assumptions
  • B. 假设收益率曲线平行移动;若曲线非平行变化需用关键期限久期It assumes a parallel shift of the yield curve; for non-parallel changes, key-rate durations are needed
  • C. 假设曲线倒挂It assumes an inverted curve
答案 B。平行移动假设是其主要局限。Answer B. The parallel-shift assumption is its main limitation.
1. 分析师获得一个债券组合以下细节：

答案 A。组合修正久期 = 各券久期的市值加权平均。等面值时按各券市值算权重再加权平均 ≈ 5.8。注意权重用市值不是面值。Answer A. Portfolio modified duration = the market-value-weighted average of the bonds' durations. With equal face values, weight by each bond's market value ≈ 5.8. Weights use market value, not face.

答案 B。两券组合久期 = 各自久期按市值加权平均 ≈ 4.40。别用简单平均(4.55/4.33 是等权或误算)。Answer B. A two-bond portfolio's duration = the market-value-weighted average of the two ≈ 4.40. Don't use a simple average (4.55/4.33 come from equal weighting or miscalculation).

§5 Key Rate Duration 与 Empirical Duration§5 Key-Rate Duration & Empirical Duration

LOS 对应：define key rate duration and contrast empirical with analytical duration。

Key Rate Duration 衡量在其他关键期限利率不变时，某一关键期限收益率变化对债券价格的敏感度。它可描述曲线变陡、变平或局部弯曲，而普通久期只适合近似平行移动。Key Rate Duration measures a bond price's sensitivity to a change in one key-maturity yield while other key-maturity rates are held constant. It can describe curve steepening, flattening, or local bending, whereas ordinary duration only approximates parallel shifts.

总有效久期 ≈ 各关键期限久期之和
方法Method来源Source优缺点Pros and cons
Analytical Duration根据现金流和估值模型计算Computed from cash flows and a valuation model结构清楚，但依赖模型和利率情景Clear structure, but depends on the model and rate scenario
Empirical Duration用历史价格变化对收益率变化做统计估计Statistically estimated from historical price changes against yield changes反映实际行为，但受样本期、信用利差和流动性共同影响Reflects actual behavior, but is jointly affected by the sample period, credit spreads, and liquidity

5.1 Effective Convexity 与含权债价格变化 🔥 必会计算

LOS 对应：explain why effective duration and effective convexity are appropriate for bonds with embedded options and calculate price change using both measures。

含权债的未来现金流会随基准曲线改变，因此必须在“曲线上移”和“曲线下移”情景下用估值模型重新计算价格。P− 是曲线下降后的价格，P+ 是曲线上升后的价格。An option-embedded bond's future cash flows change with the benchmark curve, so its price must be recomputed with a valuation model under "curve up" and "curve down" scenarios. P− is the price after the curve falls, P+ the price after it rises.

Effective Duration = (P−−P+)/(2×ΔCurve×P0)
Effective Convexity = (P−+P+−2P0)/[(ΔCurve)2×P0]
ΔP/P ≈ −Effective Duration×ΔCurve + ½×Effective Convexity×(ΔCurve)2
例题

某含权债 Effective Duration=4.2、Effective Convexity=35。基准曲线上升 100bp，即 ΔCurve=0.01：An option-embedded bond with Effective Duration=4.2, Effective Convexity=35. The benchmark curve rises 100bp, i.e., ΔCurve=0.01:

ΔP/P ≈ −4.2×0.01 + ½×35×0.012 = −4.20%+0.175% = −4.025%

若只用久期会估计跌 4.20%；加入凸性后，估计跌幅较小。Duration alone would estimate a 4.20% fall; adding convexity gives a smaller estimated fall.

5.2 组合久期与组合凸性

LOS 对应：calculate portfolio duration and convexity and explain their limitations。
Portfolio Duration ≈ ΣwiDi；Portfolio Convexity ≈ ΣwiConvexityi
例题

组合中债券 A 权重 60%、久期 3、凸性 20；债券 B 权重 40%、久期 7、凸性 60。组合久期=0.6×3+0.4×7=4.6；组合凸性=0.6×20+0.4×60=36。In a portfolio, bond A has 60% weight, duration 3, convexity 20; bond B has 40% weight, duration 7, convexity 60. Portfolio duration = 0.6×3+0.4×7 = 4.6; portfolio convexity = 0.6×20+0.4×60 = 36.

局限：市值加权近似通常假设收益率变化相近或曲线平行移动；含权债还依赖利率路径、波动率和估值模型。若曲线发生非平行变化，应结合 Key Rate Durations；若信用利差与基准利率联动，应考虑 Empirical Duration。Limitations: the market-value-weighted approximation usually assumes similar yield changes or a parallel curve shift; option-embedded bonds also depend on the rate path, volatility, and valuation model. If the curve changes non-parallel, combine with Key Rate Durations; if credit spreads move with the benchmark rate, consider Empirical Duration.

4. Effective Duration=5、Effective Convexity=40,曲线上升 50bp,价格变化约:Effective duration = 5, effective convexity = 40, curve rises 50bp; the price change is about:

  • A. −2.45%−2.45%
  • B. −2.50%−2.50%
  • C. −2.55%−2.55%
答案 A。−5×0.005+½×40×0.005²=−2.50%+0.05%=−2.45%。Answer A. −5×0.005 + ½×40×0.005² = −2.50% + 0.05% = −2.45%.

5. 组合凸性如何近似计算:How is portfolio convexity approximated:

  • A. 用各债券凸性的市场价值加权平均;注意曲线非平行移动、内含期权与模型风险The market-value-weighted average of the individual bonds' convexities; watch for non-parallel curve shifts, embedded options, and model risk
  • B. 简单算术平均A simple arithmetic average
  • C. 各债券凸性直接求和Summing the convexities directly
答案 A。与组合久期一样按市值加权。Answer A. Weighted by market value, like portfolio duration.
1. 关键利率久期(key rate duration)最好地衡量债券对下列何者变动的敏感性：1. The key rate duration best measures a bond's sensitivity to a change in the: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 到期收益率的水平。level of the yield-to-maturity.
  • B. 最差收益率曲线的斜率。slope of the yield-to-worst curve.
  • C. 基准收益率曲线的形状。shape of the benchmark yield curve.
答案 C。关键利率久期(key rate duration)衡量债券对收益率曲线某一点/形状(非平行)变动的敏感性。整体 YTM 水平用普通久期;曲线整体形状变化才用关键利率久期。Answer C. Key-rate duration measures sensitivity to a change in the shape (a specific point, non-parallel) of the yield curve. The overall YTM level uses ordinary duration; shape changes call for key-rate durations.
2. 对含内含期权的债券，在基准收益率曲线平行移动时，有效久期最可能与下列何者显示相同的利率敏感性：2. With respect to a bond with an embedded option, for parallel shifts in the benchmark yield curve, effective duration most likely indicates the same interest rate sensitivity as: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 各关键利率久期。key rate durations.
  • B. 修正久期。modified duration.
  • C. 麦考利久期。Macaulay duration.
答案 A。基准曲线平行移动时,有效久期 ≈ 各关键利率久期之和(平行移动=所有点同幅移动)。所以二者显示相同的利率敏感性。Answer A. Under a parallel shift, effective duration ≈ the sum of the key-rate durations (a parallel shift moves all points equally). So the two show the same rate sensitivity.
3. 下列哪种久期统计量最好地衡量债券价格对收益率曲线平坦化的敏感性？3. Which of the following duration statistics best measures the sensitivity of a bond's price to a flattening of the yield curve? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 关键利率久期Key rate duration
  • B. 有效久期Effective duration
  • C. 麦考利久期Macaulay duration
答案 A。收益率曲线平坦化是斜率(形状)变化=非平行 → 用关键利率久期捕捉。有效久期只测平行移动。Answer A. A flattening is a change in slope (shape) = non-parallel → captured by key-rate durations. Effective duration only measures a parallel move.
