§1 信用风险与预期损失§1 Credit Risk & Expected Loss 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: describe credit risk and its components, probability of default and loss given default。
🔰 零基础讲解:信用风险 = "会不会还不上" × "还不上时亏多少"

预期损失💥 信用风险两个维度:
① 借款人违约的概率有多大(POD);
② 一旦违约,你每 100 块能亏多少(LGD)。两者相乘就是"预期损失"。比如违约概率 2%、违约时亏 60%,预期损失就是 2%×60%=1.2%。回收率 = 1 − 违约损失率。= 违约概率 × 违约损失率。Expected loss💥 Credit risk has two dimensions:
① how likely the borrower is to default (POD);
② once in default, how much of each 100 you lose (LGD). Multiplying the two gives the "expected loss." For example, a 2% default probability and a 60% loss on default give an expected loss of 2%×60% = 1.2%. Recovery rate = 1 − loss given default. = probability of default × loss given default.

预期损失 = 违约概率(POD) × 违约损失率(LGD)
违约损失率 LGD = 违约风险敞口 × (1 − 回收率)    回收率 = 1 − LGD率
符号Symbol含义Meaning
POD违约概率(probability of default)Probability of default
LGD违约损失(loss given default),违约后无法收回的部分Loss given default, the portion unrecoverable after default
回收率 recovery rateRecovery rate违约后能收回的比例;求偿顺序越高,回收率越高The proportion recovered after default; the higher the seniority, the higher the recovery rate
预期损失计算 官方题Official

敞口 $1,000、违约概率 3%、回收率 40%(即 LGD率 60%)。每单位预期损失率 = 3% × 60% = 1.8%;金额 = $1,000 × 1.8% = $18。Exposure $1,000, probability of default 3%, recovery rate 40% (i.e., LGD rate 60%). Expected loss rate per unit = 3% × 60% = 1.8%; amount = $1,000 × 1.8% = $18.

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

信用风险与预期损失

预期损失 EL = 违约概率(PD) × 违约损失率(LGD) × 违约风险敞口(EAD)。其中 LGD = 1 − 回收率(recovery rate)。信用风险含两部分:违约风险与利差风险(评级迁移/利差走阔)。

机制

回收率越高 → LGD 越低 → EL 越小。清偿顺序越靠前(高级担保 > 高级无担保 > 次级)回收率越高。利差风险即使不违约也会因市场对信用重新定价而损失。

易错对比

① EL = PD × LGD × EAD,LGD 与回收率互补;② 违约风险 ≠ 利差风险(后者含降级);③ 清偿顺序高 → 回收率高 → 损失小。

Credit risk & expected loss

Expected loss EL = probability of default (PD) × loss given default (LGD) × exposure at default (EAD), where LGD = 1 − recovery rate. Credit risk has two parts: default risk and spread risk (rating migration / spread widening).

Mechanism

A higher recovery rate → lower LGD → smaller EL. Higher seniority (senior secured > senior unsecured > subordinated) means higher recovery. Spread risk causes losses even without default as the market reprices credit.

Common traps

① EL = PD × LGD × EAD, LGD and recovery are complements; ② default risk ≠ spread risk (the latter includes downgrades); ③ higher seniority → higher recovery → smaller loss.

1. 信用风险由哪两部分构成:Credit risk consists of which two parts: 官方题Official

  • A. 利率与通胀Interest rate and inflation
  • B. 期限与票息Term and coupon
  • C. 违约概率(POD)和违约损失率(LGD)Probability of default (POD) and loss given default (LGD)
答案 C。信用风险=违约可能性×违约后损失程度。Answer C. Credit risk = likelihood of default × severity of loss on default.

2. 预期损失怎么算:How is expected loss computed: 官方题Official

  • A. 违约概率 × 违约损失率(× 敞口)Probability of default × loss given default (× exposure)
  • B. 违约概率 + 违约损失率Probability of default + loss given default
  • C. 敞口 − 回收金额Exposure − recovery amount
答案 A。EL = POD × LGD × 敞口。Answer A. EL = POD × LGD × exposure.

3. 敞口 $1,000、违约概率 3%、回收率 40%,预期损失金额为:Exposure $1,000, default probability 3%, recovery rate 40%; the expected loss amount is: 官方题Official

  • A. $12$12
  • B. $18$18
  • C. $30$30
答案 B。LGD=60%;1,000×3%×60%=$18。Answer B. LGD = 60%; 1,000×3%×60% = $18.

4. 回收率与违约损失率的关系是:The relationship between recovery rate and loss given default is: 官方题Official

  • A. 回收率 = 违约损失率Recovery rate = LGD
  • B. 两者无关They are unrelated
  • C. 回收率 = 1 − 违约损失率;求偿顺序越高回收率越高Recovery rate = 1 − LGD; the higher the seniority, the higher the recovery rate
答案 C。回收率与 LGD 互补。Answer C. Recovery rate and LGD are complementary.
1. 其他条件相同，一项债务工具的预期损失：1. All else being equal, expected loss for a debt instrument: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 与回收率无关。is independent of the recovery rate.
  • B. 随回收率上升而减少。decreases as the recovery rate increases.
  • C. 与回收率成比例变动。changes proportionally to the recovery rate.
答案 B。预期损失 = 违约概率 × 损失severity,损失severity = 1 − 回收率。回收率上升 → 损失severity下降 → 预期损失减少。故与回收率相关(非无关)。Answer B. Expected loss = probability of default × loss severity, and loss severity = 1 − recovery rate. A higher recovery rate lowers severity → expected loss falls. So it depends on the recovery rate (not independent).
2. 公司债收益率利差收窄最可能与下列何者相关：2. Tightening corporate bond yield spreads are most likely associated with: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 发行人信用状况恶化。issuers’ deteriorating creditworthiness.
  • B. 公司债需求旺盛的时期。periods of high demand for corporate bonds.
  • C. 经纪自营商做市能力与意愿下降。broker-dealers’ reduced ability and willingness to make markets.
答案 B。利差收窄=市场对信用更乐观,与公司债需求旺盛(景气、风险偏好上升)相关。信用恶化、做市能力/意愿下降都会使利差走阔。Answer B. A narrowing spread means the market is more optimistic on credit, associated with strong demand for corporate bonds (expansion, higher risk appetite). Deteriorating credit or weaker dealer market-making widens spreads.
3. 其他条件相同，投资级债券发行人最可能：3. All else being equal, an investment-grade bond issuer most likely has: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 市场流动性风险低于投机级发行人。less market liquidity risk than a below-investment-grade issuer.
  • B. 市场流动性风险与投机级发行人相同。the same market liquidity risk as a below-investment-grade issuer.
  • C. 市场流动性风险高于投机级发行人。greater market liquidity risk than a below-investment-grade issuer.
答案 A。投资级发行人的市场流动性风险低于投机级:其债券买盘更广、更易成交。投机级流动性差、买卖价差大。Answer A. An investment-grade issuer has lower market liquidity risk than a speculative-grade one: broader demand and easier trading. Speculative-grade bonds are less liquid with wider bid-ask spreads.
4. 对债券投资而言，损失严重程度(loss severity)：4. For a bond investment, loss severity is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 与回收率无关。independent of the recovery rate.
  • B. 用于预期损失的计算。used in the calculation of the expected loss.
  • C. 评估高质量发行人信用时的主要关注点。the primary focus when assessing the creditworthiness of high-quality issuers.
答案 B。损失严重程度(loss severity)= 1 − 回收率,用于预期损失的计算(预期损失=违约概率×损失severity)。它与回收率相关,且高质量发行人主要关注违约概率而非severity。Answer B. Loss severity = 1 − recovery rate and is used in the expected-loss calculation (EL = PD × loss severity). It depends on the recovery rate, and for high-quality issuers the focus is default probability, not severity.

§2 信用评级与迁移风险§2 Credit Ratings & Migration Risk

LOS 对应:LOS: describe the role of credit rating agencies and risks in relying on ratings。

评级机构(标普/穆迪/惠誉)给债券信用打分:投资级(≥BBB−/Baa3)vs 高收益级(投机级)。相关风险:信用迁移(降级)风险——评级下调导致利差走阔、价格下跌;信用利差风险。依赖评级的局限:评级是滞后的、可能出错、不反映市场价格的即时变化;同一发行人不同债项因求偿顺序不同而有notching(级差调整)。Rating agencies (S&P/Moody's/Fitch) score bond credit: investment grade (≥BBB−/Baa3) vs high yield (speculative grade). Related risks: credit migration (downgrade) risk — a downgrade widens the spread and lowers the price; credit spread risk. Limits of relying on ratings: ratings lag, may be wrong, and don't reflect real-time price changes; different issues of the same issuer get notching for different seniority.

考点·评级体系三个易混点:
① 公司族评级(corporate family rating, CFR) 基于公司整体信用,不针对某笔债务;发行人评级(issuer rating) = 其高级无担保债(senior unsecured)的评级。
② 级差调整(notching):担保债在发行人评级上上调、次级债下调;发行人评级越高,notching 幅度越小。
③ 投资级(investment grade)最低 = 穆迪 Baa3 / 标普 BBB−,再低即投机级(speculative / high-yield)。Exam · three easily-confused rating points:
① a corporate family rating (CFR) is based on overall creditworthiness, not a specific debt; an issuer rating = the rating of its senior unsecured debt.
② Notching: secured debt is notched up and subordinated debt down from the issuer rating; the higher the issuer rating, the smaller the notching.
③ Lowest investment grade = Moody's Baa3 / S&P BBB−; below that is speculative (high-yield).

5. 投资级与高收益级的评级分界是:The rating dividing line between investment grade and high yield is: 官方题Official

  • A. 投资级 ≥ BBB−(标普/惠誉)或 Baa3(穆迪)Investment grade ≥ BBB− (S&P/Fitch) or Baa3 (Moody's)
  • B. 分界在 AAAThe line is at AAA
  • C. 分界在 CCCThe line is at CCC
答案 A。BBB−/Baa3 为投资级下限。Answer A. BBB−/Baa3 is the lower bound of investment grade.

6. 什么是信用迁移(降级)风险:What is credit migration (downgrade) risk: 官方题Official

  • A. 评级被下调,导致利差走阔、债券价格下跌的风险The risk that a downgrade widens the spread and lowers the bond's price
  • B. 利率上升的风险The risk of rising rates
  • C. 提前偿还的风险The risk of early repayment
答案 A。评级下调推高利差、压低价格。Answer A. A downgrade pushes up the spread and depresses the price.

7. 依赖评级有哪些局限:What are the limitations of relying on ratings: 官方题Official

  • A. 评级实时更新Ratings update in real time
  • B. 评级滞后、可能出错、不反映市场价格即时变化Ratings lag, can be wrong, and do not reflect real-time market-price changes
  • C. 评级永远准确Ratings are always accurate
答案 B。评级稳定但市场利差可能已变。Answer B. Ratings are stable but the market spread may already have moved.

8. 什么是 notching:What is notching: 官方题Official

  • A. 统一提高全部评级Uniformly raising all ratings
  • B. 更换发行人Changing the issuer
  • C. 同一发行人不同债项因求偿顺序/担保不同,评级作上下级差调整Adjusting ratings up or down for different obligations of the same issuer due to differing seniority/collateral
答案 C。notching 针对同一发行人的不同债项。Answer C. Notching applies to different obligations of the same issuer.
1. 按穆迪(Moody's)评级标准，投资级债券的最低评级是：1. Using the rating scale from Moody's, the lowest rating for an investment-grade bond is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. Baa1。Baa1.
  • B. Baa2。Baa2.
  • C. Baa3。Baa3.
答案 C。穆迪投资级的最低评级 = Baa3(再往下 Ba1 即进入投机级/高收益)。标普对应是 BBB−。Answer C. The lowest investment-grade rating at Moody's = Baa3 (one notch lower, Ba1, is speculative/high-yield). The S&P equivalent is BBB−.
2. 某债券发行人信用评级为 BBB。仅据此，该发行人一只高级无担保债券的评级最可能：2. A bond issuer has a credit rating of BBB. Based only on this information, the rating of a senior unsecured bond from this issuer is most likely to be: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 低于 BBBlower than BBB
  • B. BBBBBB
  • C. 高于 BBBhigher than BBB
答案 B。发行人信用评级 = 其高级无担保债务的评级。故 BBB 发行人的高级无担保债 = BBB(同级)。有担保债可能更高、次级债更低(notching)。Answer B. An issuer credit rating = the rating of its senior unsecured debt. So a BBB issuer's senior unsecured bond = BBB. Secured debt may be higher and subordinated debt lower (notching).
3. 就评级机构采用的"级差调整(notching)"过程而言，公司的次级债务最可能：3. With respect to the notching process adopted by credit rating agencies, a corporate's subordinated debt is most likely: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 由公司的初级次级债务向上级差调整notched up from the corporate's junior subordinated debt
  • B. 发行人评级越高，级差调整幅度越小subject to a smaller notching adjustment the higher the corporate's issuer rating
  • C. 因违约概率更高而由发行人评级向下级差调整notched down from the corporate's issuer rating due to higher probability of default
答案 B。级差调整(notching):发行人评级越高,notching 幅度越小(高评级发行人各档回收差异小)。次级债一般由发行人评级向下notch,而非向上。Answer B. In notching, the higher the issuer rating, the smaller the notching (recovery differences are minor for high-grade issuers). Subordinated debt is generally notched down from the issuer rating, not up.
4. 公司族评级(corporate family rating)最可能：4. A corporate family rating most likely: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 反映破产中的受偿顺序。reflects the priority of claims in a bankruptcy.
  • B. 指向发行人的特定金融债务。refers to specific financial obligations of an issuer.
  • C. 基于公司整体信用状况而给予。is assigned to a company based on its overall creditworthiness.
答案 C。公司族评级(CFR)基于公司整体信用状况而给,不针对某笔特定债务,也不反映破产受偿顺序(那是具体债项评级的事)。Answer C. A corporate family rating is assigned on the company's overall creditworthiness, not a specific debt issue, and does not reflect bankruptcy priority (that is the job of issue-specific ratings).
5. 发行人信用评级最可能适用于其：5. An issuer's credit rating most likely applies to its: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 次级债务。subordinated debt.
  • B. 高级担保债务。senior secured debt.
  • C. 高级无担保债务。senior unsecured debt.
答案 C。发行人信用评级适用于其高级无担保债务(代表整体信用)。担保债、次级债要在此基础上 notch 上/下。Answer C. An issuer credit rating applies to its senior unsecured debt (representing overall credit). Secured and subordinated debt are notched up/down from it.

§3 公司信用分析:4C 与比率§3 Corporate Credit Analysis: The 4 Cs & Ratios 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: describe the components of traditional credit analysis for corporate issuers。
4C含义Meaning
Capacity 偿债能力Capacity产生现金流偿债的能力(最核心);看行业、经营、财务The ability to generate cash flow to service debt (most core); examines industry, operations, finances
Collateral 抵押Collateral可供偿债的资产质量与价值The quality and value of assets available to service debt
Covenants 契约Covenants保护债权人的合同条款Contractual clauses protecting creditors
Character 品行Character管理层诚信、战略、历史记录Management integrity, strategy, and track record
杠杆比率:债务 / EBITDA(越高风险越大)    覆盖比率:EBIT / 利息费用(越高越安全)
比率Ratio解读Interpretation
Debt/EBITDA杠杆水平,越高信用越弱Leverage level; the higher, the weaker the credit
EBIT(或 EBITDA)/利息EBIT (or EBITDA)/interest利息覆盖倍数,越高偿息越有保障Interest coverage; the higher, the more assured interest payment
FFO/债务、自由现金流FFO/debt, free cash flow现金流对债务的支撑Cash flow's support for debt
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

公司信用分析:4C

• Capacity(偿债能力):产生现金流、覆盖债务的能力——最核心。
• Collateral(抵押/资产质量):违约时可回收的资产价值。
• Covenants(契约条款):保护债权人的限制性/肯定性条款。
• Character(品行):管理层信誉与还债意愿。

关键比率

杠杆:债务 ÷ EBITDA(越高越差);覆盖:EBIT ÷ 利息(越高越好)。比率恶化 → 评级下调、利差走阔。

易错对比

① 现金流/杠杆看 Capacity、条款看 Covenants——别混;② 高级担保债 Collateral 强、回收率高;③ 杠杆升 = 信用恶化、覆盖升 = 信用改善。

Corporate credit analysis: the 4 Cs

• Capacity: ability to generate cash flow and cover debt — the core.
• Collateral: asset value recoverable on default.
• Covenants: restrictive/affirmative terms protecting creditors.
• Character: management's reputation and willingness to pay.

Key ratios

Leverage: debt ÷ EBITDA (higher is worse); coverage: EBIT ÷ interest (higher is better). Deteriorating ratios → downgrades and wider spreads.

Common traps

① Cash flow/leverage is Capacity, terms are Covenants — don't mix; ② senior secured debt has strong Collateral and high recovery; ③ rising leverage = worse credit, rising coverage = better.

9. 信用分析的 4C 是:The 4 Cs of credit analysis are: 官方题Official

  • A. Capacity(偿债能力)、Collateral(抵押)、Covenants(契约)、Character(品行)Capacity (ability to repay), Collateral, Covenants, Character
  • B. Cash、Cost、Credit、CouponCash, Cost, Credit, Coupon
  • C. Capital、Currency、Cycle、CountryCapital, Currency, Cycle, Country
答案 A。4C 是信用分析的核心框架。Answer A. The 4 Cs are the core framework of credit analysis.

10. 4C 中哪个最核心:Which of the 4 Cs is most central: 官方题Official

  • A. CollateralCollateral
  • B. Capacity——产生现金流偿债的能力Capacity — the ability to generate cash flow to service debt
  • C. CharacterCharacter
答案 B。偿债能力是信用的根本。Answer B. Repayment ability is the foundation of credit.

11. Debt/EBITDA 升高说明:A rising Debt/EBITDA indicates: 官方题Official

  • A. 杠杆升高、信用质量下降Higher leverage and declining credit quality
  • B. 信用质量改善Improving credit quality
  • C. 与信用无关Unrelated to credit
答案 A。杠杆比率上升是信用恶化信号。Answer A. A rising leverage ratio signals credit deterioration.

12. EBIT/利息费用衡量什么、越高越好还是越差:What does EBIT/interest expense measure, and is higher better or worse: 官方题Official

  • A. 利息覆盖倍数,越高偿息越有保障(信用越好)The interest coverage ratio — higher means better-secured interest payments (better credit)
  • B. 越高信用越差Higher means worse credit
  • C. 衡量杠杆水平It measures leverage
答案 A。覆盖倍数越高偿息保障越强。Answer A. A higher coverage ratio means stronger interest-payment security.
1. EBITDA/利息费用比率最好地归类为：1. The EBITDA/interest expense ratio is best classified as a: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 杠杆比率。leverage ratio.
  • B. 偿付覆盖比率。coverage ratio.
  • C. 盈利比率。profitability ratio.
答案 B。EBITDA/利息费用 = 偿付覆盖比率(coverage ratio),衡量盈利对利息的覆盖能力。杠杆比率是"债务/EBITDA";盈利比率衡量利润率。Answer B. EBITDA/interest = a coverage ratio, measuring how well earnings cover interest. A leverage ratio is debt/EBITDA; a profitability ratio measures margins.
2. 分析师获得一家公司以下信息（单位：百万美元）：
营业利润120
净利润85
利息费用15
折旧与摊销15
用 EBIT 计算的利息覆盖倍数最接近：2. An analyst gathers the following information about a company (in $ millions):
Operating income120
Net income85
Interest expense15
Depreciation and amortization15
Interest coverage using EBIT is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 7倍7x
  • B. 8倍8x
  • C. 9倍9x
答案 B。方法:EBIT 利息覆盖倍数 = EBIT ÷ 利息费用。代入表中数据 ≈ 8 倍。倍数越高偿息能力越强。Answer B. Method: EBIT interest coverage = EBIT ÷ interest expense. Using the table ≈ 8×. A higher multiple means stronger interest-servicing ability.

§4 主权信用分析§4 Sovereign Credit Analysis

LOS 对应:LOS: describe the qualitative and quantitative factors in credit analysis of sovereign issuers。

主权信用看:定性——制度稳定性、政策有效性、政治风险;定量——经济增长与结构、财政收支与债务占 GDP、外部账户(经常账户、外汇储备)、货币灵活性。本币债违约风险低于外币债(本币可增发货币偿债,外币不能)。Sovereign credit looks at: qualitative — institutional stability, policy effectiveness, political risk; quantitative — economic growth and structure, fiscal balance and debt/GDP, external accounts (current account, FX reserves), monetary flexibility. Local-currency debt has lower default risk than foreign-currency debt (the government can print its own currency to repay, but not foreign currency).

13. 主权信用分析的定性与定量因素分别是:The qualitative and quantitative factors of sovereign credit analysis are, respectively: 官方题Official

  • A. 定性:债务/GDPQualitative: debt/GDP
  • B. 定量:政治风险Quantitative: political risk
  • C. 定性:制度稳定、政治风险;定量:债务/GDP、财政收支、外汇储备、经济增长Qualitative: institutional stability, political risk; quantitative: debt/GDP, fiscal balance, FX reserves, economic growth
答案 C。制度政治属定性,财政债务数据属定量。Answer C. Institutions and politics are qualitative; fiscal and debt data are quantitative.

14. 为什么本币主权债违约风险低于外币债:Why is local-currency sovereign default risk lower than foreign-currency: 官方题Official

  • A. 本币债可通过增发本币偿还,外币债不能Local-currency debt can be repaid by issuing more local currency, which foreign-currency debt cannot
  • B. 外币债风险更低Foreign-currency debt is lower risk
  • C. 两者风险相同They are equal risk
答案 A。货币发行权只能兜底本币债务。Answer A. The power to issue currency can only backstop local-currency debt.
1. 下列哪项最可能是收益支持型非主权政府债券信用分析中的关键因素？1. Which of the following is most likely a key factor in the credit analysis of revenue-backed non-sovereign government bonds? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 人均收入Per capita income
  • B. 税基广度Breadth of the tax base
  • C. 项目的偿债覆盖率(DSC)Debt-service-coverage ratio of the project
答案 C。收益支持型(revenue-backed)非主权债靠特定项目现金流还债,关键是项目偿债覆盖率(DSC)。人均收入、税基广度是一般责任(GO)型债券看的。Answer C. A revenue-backed non-sovereign bond is repaid from a specific project's cash flows, so the key factor is the project's debt-service coverage (DSC). Per-capita income and tax-base breadth apply to general-obligation bonds.

§5 证券化的原理与好处§5 The Principle & Benefits of Securitization

LOS 对应:LOS: describe securitization, its benefits, and the parties involved。
🔰 零基础讲解:证券化 = 把一堆贷款"打包上市"

证券化📦 银行有一大堆房贷/车贷,想提前把钱收回来。于是把这些贷款打包卖给一个独立的"特殊目的实体(SPE)",SPE 再以这些贷款的还款现金流为支撑,发行债券卖给投资者。这样贷款风险从银行转移给了投资者,银行也拿回了资金去放新贷款。把不流动的贷款(房贷、车贷)打包,由 SPE 发行以其现金流支撑的证券。Securitization📦 A bank has a big pile of mortgages/auto loans and wants to recover the cash early. So it bundles these loans and sells them to a separate "special purpose entity (SPE)," which then issues bonds to investors backed by the loans' repayment cash flows. This transfers loan risk from the bank to investors, and the bank recovers funds to make new loans. bundles illiquid loans (mortgages, auto loans), and an SPE issues securities backed by their cash flows.

好处:
① 降低发行人融资成本;
② 提高流动性;
③ 风险从发起人转移/分散给投资者;
④ 投资者可选择不同风险层级。关键结构:SPE(特殊目的实体)实现破产隔离(bankruptcy remote)——即使发起人破产,SPE 资产不被追索,保护投资者。Benefits:
① lower financing cost for the issuer;
② greater liquidity;
③ risk transferred/dispersed from the originator to investors;
④ investors can choose different risk tranches. Key structure: the SPE (special purpose entity) achieves bankruptcy remoteness — even if the originator goes bankrupt, the SPE's assets are not clawed back, protecting investors.

考点·证券化的参与方与文件:
• 发起人/卖方把资产「真实出售」给 SPE(特殊目的实体,拥有资产),实现破产隔离;受托人(trustee)持有/保管底层抵押资产、代表投资者监督(既不拥有、也不出售)。
• 购买协议规定卖方对资产质量的陈述与保证(representations & warranties)。
• CDO 按底层资产命名:CLO(银行贷款)、CBO(债券, collateralized bond obligation)、结构性融资 CDO(由 ABS 支持)。Exam - securitization parties & documents:
- The originator/seller "truly sells" assets to the SPE (special purpose entity, which owns them) for bankruptcy remoteness; the trustee holds/safekeeps the collateral and oversees on investors' behalf (neither owns nor sells).
- The purchase agreement sets the seller's representations & warranties on asset quality.
- CDOs are named by collateral: CLO (bank loans), CBO (bonds - collateralized bond obligation), structured-finance CDO (backed by ABS).

15. 证券化的三个主要好处是:The three main benefits of securitization are: 官方题Official

  • A. 降低资产流动性Lower asset liquidity
  • B. 降低融资成本、提高流动性、把风险从发起人转移/分散给投资者Lower financing cost, higher liquidity, and transferring/dispersing risk from the originator to investors
  • C. 提高融资成本Higher financing cost
答案 B。证券化实现降本、增流动、转风险。Answer B. Securitization achieves lower cost, more liquidity, and risk transfer.

16. SPE 的"破产隔离"是什么意思:What does 'bankruptcy remoteness' of an SPE mean: 官方题Official

  • A. SPE 承担发起人的全部债务The SPE assumes all the originator's debts
  • B. 发起人可随时追索 SPE 资产The originator can pursue the SPE's assets at any time
  • C. 即使发起人破产,SPE 持有的资产也不被追索,保护证券投资者Even if the originator goes bankrupt, the SPE's assets are not pursued, protecting securities investors
答案 C。破产隔离切断发起人风险传染。Answer C. Bankruptcy remoteness cuts off contagion from the originator's risk.
1. 在证券化过程中，受托人(trustee)最可能：1. In the securitization process, the trustee most likely: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 出售底层抵押资产。sells the underlying collateral.
  • B. 拥有底层抵押资产。owns the underlying collateral.
  • C. 持有（保管）底层抵押资产。holds the underlying collateral.
答案 C。证券化中受托人(trustee)持有/保管底层抵押资产(代表投资者监督),既不拥有(SPE 拥有)也不出售资产。Answer C. In securitization the trustee holds/safekeeps the underlying collateral (overseeing on investors' behalf); it neither owns (the SPE does) nor sells the assets.
2. 在证券化中，抵押资产卖方与特殊目的实体(SPE)之间的购买协议最可能规定：2. In a securitization, the purchase agreement between the seller of the collateral and the special purpose entity most likely provides: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 交易结构的说明。a description of the transaction structure.
  • B. 关于资产质量的陈述与保证。representations about the quality of the assets.
  • C. 用于降低信用风险的增信措施文件。documentation of enhancements used to reduce credit risk.
答案 B。卖方与 SPE 之间的购买协议规定关于资产质量的陈述与保证(reps & warranties)。交易结构说明、增信文件属于其他证券化文件。Answer B. The purchase agreement between seller and SPE sets out representations and warranties on asset quality. The structure description and credit-enhancement docs belong to other securitization documents.

§6 ABS:资产支持证券§6 ABS: Asset-Backed Securities

LOS 对应:LOS: describe characteristics and risks of ABS。

ABS 由非按揭类应收款支撑:汽车贷款、信用卡应收、设备租赁等。常用信用分层(credit tranching):优先级/次级结构,损失由次级(权益层)先吸收,保护优先层——这叫信用增级(credit enhancement)。分层让不同风险偏好的投资者各取所需。ABS is backed by non-mortgage receivables: auto loans, credit-card receivables, equipment leases, etc. It commonly uses credit tranching: a senior/subordinated structure where losses are absorbed first by the subordinated (equity) tranche, protecting the senior tranche — this is credit enhancement. Tranching lets investors of different risk appetites each get what they want.

17. ABS 由什么资产支撑:What assets back an ABS: 官方题Official

  • A. 非按揭类应收款:汽车贷款、信用卡应收、设备租赁等Non-mortgage receivables: auto loans, credit-card receivables, equipment leases, etc.
  • B. 住房按揭贷款Residential mortgage loans
  • C. 上市股票Listed stocks
答案 A。住房按揭支撑的是 MBS,不是普通 ABS。Answer A. Residential mortgages back MBS, not ordinary ABS.

18. 信用分层(优先/次级)如何保护优先层:How does credit tranching (senior/subordinated) protect the senior tranche: 官方题Official

  • A. 两层同时按比例受损Both tranches are hit proportionally at once
  • B. 损失由次级(权益)层先吸收,次级亏光后优先层才受损Losses are absorbed first by the subordinated (equity) tranche; the senior tranche is hit only after the subordinated is wiped out
  • C. 优先层先吸收损失The senior tranche absorbs losses first
答案 B。次级层作为缓冲提供信用增级。Answer B. The subordinated tranche provides credit enhancement as a buffer.
1. 下列哪类担保债务凭证(CDO)最可能由资产支持证券(ABS)支持？1. Which of the following types of collateralized debt obligations (CDOs) are most likely backed by asset-backed securities? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 结构性融资CDOStructured finance CDOs
  • B. 担保贷款凭证(CLO)Collateralized loan obligations
  • C. 担保债券凭证(CBO)Collateralized bond obligations
答案 A。由 ABS 支持的 CDO = 结构性融资 CDO(structured finance CDO)。CLO 由银行贷款支持,CBO 由债券支持——按底层资产命名。Answer A. A CDO backed by ABS = a structured-finance CDO. A CLO is backed by bank loans and a CBO by bonds — CDOs are named by their collateral.
2. 在证券化中，高级/次级结构最可能是下列何者的一种形式：2. In a securitization, a senior/subordinated structure is most likely a form of: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 时间分级(time tranching)。time tranching.
  • B. 信用分级(credit tranching)。credit tranching.
  • C. 提前偿付风险管理。prepayment risk management.
答案 B。高级/次级(senior/subordinated)结构 = 信用分级(credit tranching):次级层先吸收损失、保护高级层。时间分级(time tranching)是按期限先后分配本金(管提前偿付)。Answer B. A senior/subordinated structure = credit tranching: the subordinated tranche absorbs losses first, protecting the senior. Time tranching allocates principal by timing (managing prepayment).
3. 信用卡应收款资产支持证券(ABS)最可能：3. A credit card receivable asset-backed security most likely: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 面临较高的提前偿付风险。faces high prepayment risk.
  • B. 以完全摊销贷款作为抵押。uses fully-amortizing loans as collateral.
  • C. 在锁定期内将本金偿还再投资。reinvests principal repayments during the lockout period.
答案 C。信用卡应收款 ABS 是非摊销(循环)型:有锁定期,期内把回收的本金再投资购买新应收款,故提前偿付风险低、非完全摊销抵押。Answer C. A credit-card receivables ABS is non-amortizing (revolving): during a lockout period, principal collected is reinvested into new receivables, so prepayment risk is low and it is not backed by fully amortizing loans.

§7 MBS 与 CMO 分层§7 MBS & CMO Tranching 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: describe characteristics and risks of mortgage-backed securities and CMOs。

MBS 由房贷支撑,分住宅(RMBS)与商业(CMBS);又分机构(agency,有政府/GSE 担保)与非机构。核心风险是提前偿还风险(prepayment risk):MBS is backed by mortgages, split into residential (RMBS) and commercial (CMBS); and into agency (government/GSE-guaranteed) and non-agency. The core risk is prepayment risk:

提前偿还类型Prepayment type发生时When it occurs
缩短风险 contractionContraction risk利率下降→借款人再融资、提前还款→本金提早回来、再投收益低Rates fall → borrowers refinance and prepay → principal returns early, reinvested at low yields
延长风险 extensionExtension risk利率上升→提前还款减少→本金回收变慢、锁死在低息Rates rise → prepayments decline → principal returns slowly, locked in at low rates
考点提示:CMO(担保按揭债务)用时间分层(time tranching)把提前偿还风险在不同 tranche 间重新分配(如顺序偿还型),让不同 tranche 有不同的期限/提前偿还暴露——注意这与 ABS 的"信用分层"(分配信用损失)不同:CMO 分配的是提前偿还/时间风险。
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

MBS 与 CMO 分层

MBS 把一池住房抵押贷款打包;CMO 再把 MBS 的现金流重新分层(tranche),把提前还款风险在各层间重新分配——而不是消除它。

两种结构

• 顺序偿付(sequential-pay):先还最高级 tranche 本金,逐级向下,后层承担更多久期不确定。
• PAC(计划摊还档):在一定提前还款区间内还款稳定,波动由支持档(support)吸收 → support 风险最大。

易错对比

① CMO 重新分配而非消除提前还款风险;② PAC 稳定、support 承担波动;③ 利率下降→再融资加速→提前还款上升(缩短久期,利空)。

MBS & CMO tranching

An MBS pools home mortgages; a CMO then re-tranches the MBS cash flows, redistributing prepayment risk across tranches — not eliminating it.

Two structures

• Sequential-pay: the most senior tranche receives principal first, then down the stack; later tranches bear more maturity uncertainty.
• PAC (planned amortization class): stable payments within a prepayment band, with the variability absorbed by a support tranche → support bears the most risk.

Common traps

① A CMO redistributes, not removes, prepayment risk; ② PAC is stable, support absorbs variability; ③ falling rates → faster refinancing → higher prepayments (shorter duration, unfavorable).

19. MBS 的核心风险是:The core risk of an MBS is: 官方题Official

  • A. 汇率风险Exchange-rate risk
  • B. 通胀风险Inflation risk
  • C. 提前偿还风险(prepayment risk)Prepayment risk
答案 C。借款人提前还款打乱现金流。Answer C. Borrowers prepaying disrupts the cash flows.

20. 利率下降时 MBS 面临缩短还是延长风险:When rates fall, does an MBS face contraction or extension risk: 官方题Official

  • A. 缩短风险(contraction):再融资、提前还款,本金提早回来、再投收益低Contraction risk: refinancing and prepayment return principal early, with low reinvestment returns
  • B. 延长风险Extension risk
  • C. 没有任何风险No risk
答案 A。低利率诱发再融资,现金流提前。Answer A. Low rates induce refinancing, pulling cash flows forward.

21. 利率上升时 MBS 面临什么风险:When rates rise, what risk does an MBS face: 官方题Official

  • A. 没有任何风险No risk
  • B. 延长风险(extension):提前还款减少、本金回收变慢、锁死在低息Extension risk: less prepayment, slower principal recovery, locked into low rates
  • C. 缩短风险Contraction risk
答案 B。高利率下借款人不愿提前还款。Answer B. At high rates, borrowers are reluctant to prepay.

22. CMO 的"时间分层"与 ABS 的"信用分层"分别重新分配什么风险:What risk do a CMO's 'time tranching' and an ABS's 'credit tranching' each redistribute: 官方题Official

  • A. 两者都重分配信用风险Both redistribute credit risk
  • B. 两者都重分配时间风险Both redistribute timing risk
  • C. CMO 时间分层重分配提前偿还/时间风险;ABS 信用分层重分配信用损失风险CMO time tranching redistributes prepayment/timing risk; ABS credit tranching redistributes credit-loss risk
答案 C。CMO 分时间,ABS 分信用。Answer C. CMO splits timing, ABS splits credit.
1. 住房抵押支持证券(RMBS)的票息是：1. The coupon of a residential mortgage-backed security is the: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 转手利率(pass-through rate)。pass-through rate.
  • B. 加权平均票息率(WAC)。weighted average coupon rate.
  • C. 底层抵押贷款池的利率。rate on the underlying pool of mortgages.
答案 A。RMBS 的票息 = 转手利率(pass-through rate) = 底层池加权平均票息(WAC)减去服务与担保费,故低于底层贷款利率。Answer A. An RMBS coupon = the pass-through rate = the pool's weighted-average coupon (WAC) minus servicing and guarantee fees, so it is below the underlying loan rate.
2. 在证券化中，时间分级(time tranching)最可能指下列何者的差异：2. In a securitization, time tranching most likely refers to differences in: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 违约风险。default risk.
  • B. 预期期限。expected maturities.
  • C. 底层抵押资产。underlying collateral.
答案 B。时间分级(time tranching)按预期期限差异分配本金(不同档先后收本金),用于管理提前偿付风险。违约风险差异由信用分级处理。Answer B. Time tranching sorts tranches by expected maturity, allocating principal in sequence to manage prepayment risk. Differences in default risk are handled by credit tranching.

§6 信用评级、利差与清偿顺序§6 Credit Ratings, Spreads & Priority of Claims

  • 评级局限：评级是相对信用意见，不保证不违约；可能滞后、存在模型和利益冲突，也不直接衡量流动性或价格风险。Rating limitations: a rating is a relative credit opinion, not a guarantee against default; it may lag, carry model and conflict-of-interest issues, and does not directly measure liquidity or price risk.
  • 利差驱动：经济衰退、风险厌恶和市场流动性恶化会推宽利差；发行人盈利、杠杆和偿债能力改善会收窄利差。Spread drivers: recession, risk aversion, and deteriorating market liquidity widen spreads; improving issuer earnings, leverage, and debt-service capacity narrow spreads.
一般优先顺序General priority order说明Description
第一留置权/高级担保债First-lien/senior secured debt有特定抵押品且优先受偿Has specific collateral and is repaid first
高级无担保债Senior unsecured debt依赖发行人整体信用Relies on the issuer's overall credit
次级债Subordinated debt在高级债之后受偿Repaid after senior debt
优先股、普通股Preferred stock, common stock属于权益；普通股为最终剩余索取权Equity; common stock is the ultimate residual claim

结构性从属还可能来自控股公司债权人只能在子公司债权人获偿后取得上游剩余现金。Structural subordination can also arise when a holding company's creditors receive upstream residual cash only after the subsidiary's creditors are paid.

同等受偿(pari passu):处于资本结构同一层级的债权人按比例、同等受偿。例如同为高级无担保债,不论到期日长短(30 年期与 6 个月期),在破产清偿中享有相同的按比例求偿权。Pari passu (“on an equal footing”): creditors at the same level of the capital structure rank equally and share pro rata. For example, all senior unsecured bonds—regardless of maturity (a 30-year vs. a 6-month bond)—have the same pro-rata claim in bankruptcy.

1. 分析师获得一家仅有高级无担保债务的公司以下信息：
类型未偿总额期限
浮动利率票据(FRN)$5000万12年
固定利率债券$1000万2年
在破产情形下，若执行受偿顺序，则最可能：1. An analyst gathers the following information about a company that only has senior unsecured debt:
TypeTotal Amount OutstandingTime to Maturity
Floating-rate note (FRN)$50 million12 years
Fixed-rate bond$10 million2 years
In a bankruptcy scenario, if the priority of claims is enforced, it is most likely that: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 固定利率债券因到期更早而优先偿还fixed-rate bond is repaid first because it matures earlier
  • B. 两类债券持有人按所欠金额按比例受偿both bondholders are repaid proportionally to the amount owed
  • C. FRN因未偿金额最大而优先偿还FRN is repaid first because it has the highest amount outstanding
答案 B。只有高级无担保债时,破产受偿按 pari passu(同顺位)、按所欠金额比例分配,与到期早晚或未偿金额大小无关。故两类债权人按比例受偿。Answer B. With only senior unsecured debt, recovery is pari passu — pro rata by amounts owed, and is independent of which matures earlier or which has the larger balance. So both classes recover proportionally.
2. 下列哪类债务在受偿顺序上排名最高？2. Which of the following debt categories has the highest ranking in terms of priority of payment? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 第二留置权债务Second lien debt
  • B. 次级债务Subordinated debt
  • C. 高级无担保债务Senior unsecured debt
答案 A。受偿顺序:第一留置权 > 第二留置权(有担保) > 高级无担保 > 次级。选项中第二留置权债务排名最高。Answer A. Priority: first-lien > second-lien (secured) > senior unsecured > subordinated. Among the options, second-lien debt ranks highest.

§7 Covered Bonds、ABS 与信用增级§7 Covered Bonds, ABS & Credit Enhancement

Covered Bond 由发行银行直接负债，同时有隔离的担保资产池支持，投资者对银行和资产池具有双重追索权。普通 ABS 通常由 SPE 发行，主要依赖资产池现金流，对原始发起人通常没有同等追索权。A covered bond is a direct liability of the issuing bank while also backed by a segregated pool of collateral, giving investors dual recourse to the bank and the pool. An ordinary ABS is usually issued by an SPE, relies mainly on the asset pool's cash flows, and typically has no equivalent recourse to the original originator.

信用增级Credit enhancement机制Mechanism
Subordination次级档先吸收损失，保护优先档The subordinated tranche absorbs losses first, protecting the senior tranche
Overcollateralization资产池价值高于发行证券本金The asset pool's value exceeds the principal of the issued securities
Excess Spread资产收益率减证券成本和费用形成损失缓冲Asset yield minus security costs and fees forms a loss buffer
Reserve Account预留现金账户吸收损失或流动性缺口A reserve cash account absorbs losses or liquidity shortfalls
第三方担保Third-party guarantee保险、信用证或保证；价值依赖担保人信用Insurance, letters of credit, or guarantees; value depends on the guarantor's credit
非按揭 ABSNon-mortgage ABS主要现金流与风险Main cash flows and risks
汽车贷款 ABSAuto-loan ABS摊还本金；违约和提前还款风险Amortizing principal; default and prepayment risk
信用卡 ABSCredit-card ABS循环期后摊还；支付率、收益率和信用损失风险Amortizes after a revolving period; payment-rate, yield, and credit-loss risk
学生贷款 ABSStudent-loan ABS期限较长；延期、违约和政策风险Longer maturity; deferment, default, and policy risk
设备租赁 ABSEquipment-lease ABS租金和残值；承租人信用与设备残值风险Rentals and residual value; lessee credit and equipment residual-value risk

CDO 将债券、贷款或其他信用资产装入资产池，再按优先/夹层/权益档分配现金流和损失。权益档先吸收损失，但也最先取得剩余收益。A CDO puts bonds, loans, or other credit assets into a pool and distributes cash flows and losses across senior/mezzanine/equity tranches. The equity tranche absorbs losses first but also captures residual return first.

6. Covered Bond 与普通 ABS 的核心区别是:The core difference between a covered bond and an ordinary ABS is:

  • A. Covered Bond 对发行银行和担保资产池有双重追索权;ABS 主要依赖 SPE 资产池A covered bond has dual recourse to the issuing bank and the collateral pool; an ABS relies mainly on the SPE asset pool
  • B. 两者完全相同They are identical
  • C. Covered Bond 无任何追索权A covered bond has no recourse at all
答案 A。双重追索是 Covered Bond 的关键特征。Answer A. Dual recourse is the key feature of a covered bond.
1. 在违约情形下，担保债券(covered bonds)的投资者最可能有权追索：1. In the event of default, investors in covered bonds most likely have recourse against: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅发行人。the issuer only.
  • B. 仅一个隔离资产池。a segregated pool of assets only.
  • C. 发行人与隔离资产池两者。both the issuer and a segregated pool of assets.
答案 C。担保债券(covered bonds)= 双重追索(dual recourse):违约时投资者可同时追索发行人和隔离资产池,这也是其信用更强、收益率更低的原因。Answer C. Covered bonds have dual recourse: on default, investors can claim against both the issuer and the segregated cover pool. That dual recourse is why they are stronger credits with lower yields.

§8 RMBS、CMO 与 CMBS§8 RMBS, CMO & CMBS

  • Mortgage Pass-Through：把资产池收到的本金和利息按比例转给投资者，投资者共同承担提前偿还风险。Mortgage Pass-Through: passes the principal and interest received by the pool to investors pro rata, with investors jointly bearing prepayment risk.
  • CMO：用时间分层把本金按规则分给不同 tranche，重新分配提前偿还风险，而不是消除风险。CMO: uses time-tranching to allocate principal to different tranches by rule, redistributing prepayment risk rather than eliminating it.
  • CMBS：由商业地产贷款支持，通常强调物业净营业收入、债务偿付覆盖率、贷款价值比和到期气球付款风险。CMBS: backed by commercial-real-estate loans, usually emphasizing net operating income, debt-service coverage ratio, loan-to-value ratio, and balloon-payment risk at maturity.
DSCR = Net Operating Income / Debt Service
LTV = Loan Amount / Property Value

RMBS 主要受家庭借款人提前偿还影响；CMBS 常通过锁定期、提前偿还罚金或 defeasance 限制提前还款，但更暴露于商业物业现金流和再融资风险。RMBS is mainly affected by household borrowers' prepayment; CMBS often limits prepayment through lockouts, prepayment penalties, or defeasance, but is more exposed to commercial-property cash flow and refinancing risk.

考点·抵押支持证券(MBS)的核心风险:
① 转手利率(pass-through rate) = 底层池加权平均票息(WAC, weighted-average coupon)减服务/担保费,是 RMBS 实付票息(低于池利率)。
② 紧缩风险(contraction risk):利率下降 → 提前还款加快 → 期限缩短;展期风险(extension risk):利率上升 → 提前还款放慢 → 期限拉长。
③ 提前偿付罚金(prepayment penalty) 对贷款人有利(补偿再投资损失)。
④ 无追索权(no-recourse)贷款的战略性违约(strategic default)风险更高(资不抵债可"一走了之")。Exam · core risks of mortgage-backed securities (MBS):
① the pass-through rate = the pool's weighted-average coupon (WAC) minus servicing/guarantee fees — the coupon actually paid on an RMBS (below the pool rate).
② Contraction risk: rates fall → faster prepayment → shorter life; extension risk: rates rise → slower prepayment → longer life.
③ A prepayment penalty favors the lender (compensating reinvestment loss).
④ No-recourse loans have higher strategic-default risk (an underwater borrower can "walk away").

7. CMO 的时间分层是否消除提前偿还风险:Does a CMO's time tranching eliminate prepayment risk:

  • A. 反而放大总风险Actually amplifies total risk
  • B. 不消除,只是在不同 tranche 之间重新分配No, it only redistributes it among the tranches
  • C. 完全消除Fully eliminates it
答案 B。分层是再分配而非消灭风险。Answer B. Tranching redistributes rather than eliminates risk.
1. 其他条件相同，无追索权抵押贷款的战略性违约风险最可能：1. All else being equal, the risk of a strategic default for a non-recourse mortgage is most likely: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 低于有追索权抵押贷款。lower than for a recourse mortgage.
  • B. 与有追索权抵押贷款相同。the same as for a recourse mortgage.
  • C. 高于有追索权抵押贷款。greater than for a recourse mortgage.
答案 C。无追索权(no-recourse)贷款的战略性违约风险更高:房价跌破贷款余额时,借款人可"一走了之"、只交出房产而不担个人责任。有追索权则可追偿借款人其他资产,违约动机低。Answer C. A no-recourse loan has higher strategic-default risk: if the home value falls below the loan, the borrower can "walk away," surrendering the property without personal liability. A recourse loan lets the lender pursue other assets, reducing the incentive to default.
2. 当利率上升时，抵押支持证券最可能表现出增加的：2. When interest rates increase, mortgage-backed securities most likely exhibit increased: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 展期风险(extension risk)。extension risk.
  • B. 紧缩风险(contraction risk)。contraction risk.
  • C. 再投资风险。reinvestment risk.
答案 A。利率上升 → 提前还款减少 → MBS 期限被拉长 = 展期风险(extension risk)增加(久期变长、价格更受损)。利率下降才是紧缩风险(提前还款加快)。Answer A. Rising rates → fewer prepayments → the MBS life lengthens = extension risk rises (duration extends, more price loss). Falling rates bring contraction risk (faster prepayment).
3. 下列哪种抵押贷款特征最可能有利于贷款人？3. Which of the following mortgage features most likely benefits the lender? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 无追索权贷款Non-recourse loan
  • B. 提前偿付权Prepayment option
  • C. 提前偿付罚金Prepayment penalty
答案 C。对贷款人有利的是提前偿付罚金(prepayment penalty)——补偿提前还款带来的再投资损失。无追索权、提前偿付权都对借款人有利。Answer C. The feature that favors the lender is a prepayment penalty — compensating for reinvestment loss from early repayment. No-recourse terms and a free prepayment option favor the borrower.

Derivatives sound scary, but Level I only tests 'what they are, how many types, how they are used, and how they are priced (the arbitrage idea),' with no complex math. This lecture first builds the framework of the four major derivatives and the core dichotomy of forward commitment vs contingent claim.

🎯 衍生品做题技巧 · 提分策略🎯 Derivatives Exam Tactics · Score Boosters
  • 收益/价值/利润三者分清(最大陷阱):到期收益(payoff)=Max 公式本身;价值=同收益;利润=收益 − 已付权利金(买方)或 + 已收权利金(卖方)。问"价值"别减权利金,问"利润"必须减。Separate payoff / value / profit (the top trap): payoff = the Max formula; value = the payoff; profit = payoff − premium paid (buyer) or + premium received (seller). If asked for "value" don't subtract the premium; if "profit," you must.
  • 买卖方互为镜像:卖方收益 = −(买方收益)。看涨买方 Max(0,ST−X)、卖方 −Max(0,ST−X);看跌买方 Max(0,X−ST)、卖方 −Max(0,X−ST)。买方最大亏损=权利金,卖方最大盈利=权利金。Buyer and seller mirror: seller payoff = −(buyer payoff). Call buyer Max(0,ST−X), seller −Max(0,ST−X); put buyer Max(0,X−ST), seller −Max(0,X−ST). Buyer's max loss = premium; seller's max gain = premium.
  • 远期承诺 vs 或有权益:远期/期货/互换=义务、线性对称收益、起始价值为 0;期权=权利、非线性收益、要付权利金。看到"权利/可选择"就是期权。Forward commitment vs contingent claim: forwards/futures/swaps = obligation, linear symmetric payoff, zero value at initiation; options = right, non-linear payoff, pay a premium. "Right / optional" → option.
  • 持有成本口诀:成本−收益。持有收益(股息、便利收益)会降低远期/期货价;持有成本(储存费)会抬高它。F₀=S₀(1+r)^T,再按此加减。Carry mnemonic: costs − benefits. Carry benefits (dividends, convenience yield) lower the forward/futures price; carry costs (storage) raise it. Start from F₀=S₀(1+r)^T and adjust.
  • 期货 vs 远期:期货每日盯市+保证金 → 对手方信用风险更低、透明度更高;远期 OTC 可定制但信用风险高。远期价与期货价有差,仅当"利率有波动 且 与期货价相关"。Futures vs forwards: futures have daily mark-to-market + margin → lower counterparty credit risk, higher transparency; forwards are OTC/customizable but higher credit risk. Forward and futures prices differ only when rates are volatile AND correlated with the futures price.
  • 期权价格上下界背下来:看涨上界=S₀、下界=Max(0, S₀−PV(X));看跌上界=X(欧式为 PV(X))、下界=Max(0, PV(X)−S₀)。"折现行权价"是关键,因为 X 到期才付。Memorize option bounds: call upper = S₀, lower = Max(0, S₀−PV(X)); put upper = X (European: PV(X)), lower = Max(0, PV(X)−S₀). The key is discounting the strike, since X is paid at expiry.
  • 期权价值方向表:标的价↑→看涨↑看跌↓;行权价↑→看涨↓看跌↑;到期时间↑、波动率↑→看涨↕看跌都↑;无风险利率↑→看涨↑看跌↓。做"正相关/负相关"题直接查表。Option value direction table: underlying↑→call↑ put↓; strike↑→call↓ put↑; more time / higher volatility → both↑; risk-free rate↑→call↑ put↓. For "positively/negatively related" questions, read straight off this table.
  • 平价公式会"搬项"就够用:看涨-看跌平价 S₀+P₀=C₀+X/(1+r)^T;看涨-看跌-远期平价 P₀−C₀=[X−F₀(T)]/(1+r)^T。合成某头寸=把它单独移到等号一边,读各项符号(+多头/−空头)。Parity = just move terms: put-call parity S₀+P₀=C₀+X/(1+r)^T; put-call-forward parity P₀−C₀=[X−F₀(T)]/(1+r)^T. To synthesize a position, isolate it on one side and read the signs (+ = long, − = short).
  • 单期二叉树:上行风险中性概率 π=(1+r−R_d)/(R_u−R_d),R 是"总回报倍数"。期权价只依赖无风险利率与上/下行幅度(波动率),与投资者风险偏好、标的预期回报无关——这是高频考点。One-period binomial: up risk-neutral probability π=(1+r−R_d)/(R_u−R_d), where R is the gross return. The option value depends only on the risk-free rate and the up/down moves (volatility), and is independent of investor risk preferences or the underlying's expected return — a frequent test point.
  • 套期会计对号入座:对冲已持有资产价值→公允价值套期;对冲未来可变现金流(预期销售)→现金流套期;对冲境外经营权益的汇率→净投资套期。Match hedge-accounting types: hedge the value of an asset already held → fair-value hedge; hedge a variable future cash flow (forecast sale) → cash-flow hedge; hedge a foreign operation's FX → net-investment hedge.

§1 什么是衍生品§1 What Is a Derivative

LOS 对应:LOS: define a derivative and describe basic features of a derivative instrument。
🔰 零基础讲解:衍生品 = 价值"衍生"自别的东西

衍生品🎫 衍生品本身没价值,它的价值来自某个"标的"(股票、利率、大宗商品、汇率)。就像演唱会门票的价格随明星红不红而变——票是衍生品,明星是标的。买衍生品往往是为了"锁定未来价格"(对冲)或"用小钱赌大方向"(投机)。是一份价值取决于某标的资产(underlying)的合约。A derivative🎫 A derivative has no value of its own; its value comes from an "underlying" (a stock, interest rate, commodity, exchange rate). Like a concert ticket's price varying with how hot the star is — the ticket is the derivative, the star is the underlying. Buying a derivative is often to "lock in a future price" (hedge) or to "bet big on a direction with little money" (speculate). is a contract whose value depends on an underlying asset.

标的可以是:股票/股指、利率、货币、大宗商品、信用,甚至天气。衍生品要素:标的、合约规模、到期日、行权/交割条款、结算方式(现金结算 vs 实物交割)。衍生品自带杠杆:小额保证金撬动大额名义敞口。The underlying can be: a stock/index, interest rate, currency, commodity, credit, even weather. Derivative elements: underlying, contract size, expiration, exercise/delivery terms, settlement method (cash settlement vs physical delivery). Derivatives carry built-in leverage: a small margin controls a large notional exposure.

考点·标的的广度与商品细分:标的几乎无所不包——除股票/股指、利率、汇率外,还包括信用、天气、加密货币,甚至"长寿(longevity)"。其中大宗商品再分两类:硬商品(hard)靠开采/提取(黄金、原油、金属),软商品(soft)靠种植/养殖(大豆、咖啡、牲畜)。常考"某标的属软/硬商品""下列哪项可作标的"。Exam · breadth of underlyings & commodity split: an underlying can be almost anything — besides stocks/indexes, rates and FX, also credit, weather, cryptocurrencies, even "longevity." Commodities split into hard (mined/extracted — gold, crude oil, metals) and soft (grown/raised — soybeans, coffee, livestock). Tested via "is X a soft/hard commodity" and "which could be an underlying."

1. 衍生品的定义是:The definition of a derivative is: 官方题Official

  • A. 价值取决于某标的资产(underlying)表现的金融合约A financial contract whose value depends on the performance of an underlying asset
  • B. 一种普通股票An ordinary stock
  • C. 一种普通债券An ordinary bond
答案 A。衍生品的价值派生自标的资产。Answer A. A derivative's value is derived from the underlying.

2. 衍生品的标的可以是:A derivative's underlying can be: 官方题Official

  • A. 股票/股指、利率、货币、大宗商品、信用等Stocks/indexes, interest rates, currencies, commodities, credit, etc.
  • B. 只有股票Only stocks
  • C. 只有货币Only currencies
答案 A。标的种类广泛。Answer A. The range of underlyings is broad.
1. 下列哪项表述最准确？1. Which of the following statements is most accurate? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 长寿(longevity)是衍生品标的的一个例子Longevity is an example of an underlying of a derivative
  • B. 可转换债券是独立衍生品的一个例子A convertible bond is an example of a stand-alone derivative
  • C. 衍生品直接传递标的的回报Derivatives directly pass through the returns of the underlying
答案 A。标的(underlying)可以五花八门——天气、加密货币、甚至"长寿(寿命)"都能当标的。逐项判断:
① 长寿确实是标的的例子 ✓;
② 可转换债券是内含(embedded)衍生品(嵌在债券里),不是"独立(standalone)"衍生品;
③ 衍生品是转换/派生标的表现,不是"直接传递"。记忆点:衍生品价值"派生自"标的,标的范围极广。Answer A. An underlying can be almost anything — weather, crypto, even longevity. Item by item:
① longevity is a valid underlying ✓;
② a convertible bond is an embedded (not standalone) derivative;
③ a derivative transforms/derives the underlying's performance, it does not pass it through. Key idea: a derivative's value is derived from a very broad set of underlyings.
2. 衍生品的表现来自于：2. Derivatives derive their performance from: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 标的资产的表现。the performance of the underlying asset.
  • B. 消除对手方违约风险。eliminating the risk of counterparty default.
  • C. 标的的直接传递表现。the straight pass-through performance of the underlying.
答案 A。关键词是"派生(derive)":衍生品的收益来自并转换标的的表现。它不能消除对手方违约风险(OTC 衍生品本身就带信用风险),也不是把标的原样"直接传递"给你。Answer A. The key word is "derive": a derivative's performance comes from and transforms the underlying's. It does not remove counterparty default risk (OTC derivatives carry it), nor does it simply pass the underlying through.
3. 下列哪种衍生品标的是软商品(soft commodity)的例子？3. Which of the following derivative underlyings is an example of a soft commodity? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 黄金Gold
  • B. 原油Crude oil
  • C. 大豆Soybeans
答案 C。商品分两类:硬商品(hard)靠开采/提取(黄金、原油),软商品(soft)靠种植/养殖(大豆、咖啡、牲畜)。大豆是"种"出来的 → 软商品;黄金、原油是"挖"出来的 → 硬商品。Answer C. Commodities split into hard (mined/extracted — gold, crude oil) and soft (grown/raised — soybeans, coffee, livestock). Soybeans are grown → soft; gold and oil are extracted → hard.

§2 远期承诺 vs 或有索取权§2 Forward Commitment vs Contingent Claim 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: describe the features and characteristics of forward commitments and contingent claims and their differences。
🔰 零基础讲解:两种"约定未来"的方式

承诺 vs 权利🤝 远期承诺像"婚约":双方都必须在未来按约定价成交,不管到时行情如何。或有索取权(期权)像"预约券":买方有权但没义务——行情有利就用,不利就作废,只损失当初买券的钱。:远期承诺双方都有义务;或有索取权买方有权利、无义务。Commitment vs right🤝 A forward commitment is like an "engagement": both parties must transact at the agreed price in the future, whatever the market does. A contingent claim (option) is like a "reservation voucher": the buyer has the right but no obligation — use it if favorable, let it lapse if not, losing only the price of the voucher.: in a forward commitment both parties are obligated; in a contingent claim the buyer has a right, no obligation.

类别Category特征Characteristics包含Includes
远期承诺 forward commitmentForward commitment双方都有义务在未来按约定成交;收益对称(线性)Both parties are obligated to transact at the agreed price in the future; payoff is symmetric (linear)远期、期货、互换Forwards, futures, swaps
或有索取权 contingent claimContingent claim买方付权利金、有权无义务;收益不对称(非线性)The buyer pays a premium and has a right, no obligation; payoff is asymmetric (non-linear)期权Options
考点·收益形状与起始现金流(高频):远期承诺的收益线性、对称(标的每动 1 单位,合约盈亏 1 单位),且签约时不换现金、合约价值 = 0;或有索取权(期权)收益非线性、不对称——买方下行有限(至多损失权利金)、上行保留,故买期权要先付权利金。这正是"哪类收益非线性""远期承诺起始是否换现金"的考点。Exam · payoff shape & initiation cash flow (high-yield): a forward commitment has a linear, symmetric payoff (±1 on the underlying → ±1 on the contract), with no cash exchanged at initiation and value = 0; a contingent claim (option) has a non-linear, asymmetric payoff — the buyer's downside is limited (at most the premium), upside kept, so a premium is paid up front. This underlies "which has a non-linear payoff" and "does a forward commitment exchange cash at initiation."
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

远期承诺 vs 或有索取权

• 远期承诺(forward commitment):远期、期货、互换——双方都有义务,收益对称、线性,可正可负。
• 或有索取权(contingent claim):期权——买方有权无义务,收益不对称,买方先付权利金。

机制

远期承诺锁定一个未来价格,到期无论如何都要履约;或有索取权只在对买方有利时才行权,故买方风险有限(最多损失权利金)、卖方风险大。

易错对比

① 互换 = 远期承诺(不是或有索取权);② 期权 = 或有索取权;③ 远期收益线性对称、期权收益「折线」不对称。

Forward commitment vs contingent claim

• Forward commitment: forwards, futures, swaps — both parties are obligated, payoff is symmetric and linear, can be + or −.
• Contingent claim: options — the buyer has a right, not an obligation, payoff is asymmetric, buyer pays a premium up front.

Mechanism

A forward commitment locks a future price and must be settled either way; a contingent claim is exercised only when favorable, so the buyer's risk is limited (at most the premium) while the seller's is large.

Common traps

① A swap = forward commitment (not a contingent claim); ② an option = contingent claim; ③ forward payoff is linear/symmetric, option payoff is kinked/asymmetric.

3. 远期承诺与或有索取权的根本区别是:The fundamental difference between forward commitments and contingent claims is: 官方题Official

  • A. 远期承诺双方都有义务成交(收益对称);或有索取权(期权)买方有权无义务(收益不对称)In a forward commitment both parties are obligated to transact (symmetric payoff); a contingent claim (option) gives the buyer a right without obligation (asymmetric payoff)
  • B. 两者完全相同They are identical
  • C. 远期承诺收益不对称A forward commitment has an asymmetric payoff
答案 A。对称义务 vs 单边权利是核心区别。Answer A. Symmetric obligation vs one-sided right is the core difference.

4. 下列分类正确的是:Which classification is correct: 官方题Official

  • A. 期权属于远期承诺Options are a forward commitment
  • B. 互换属于或有索取权Swaps are a contingent claim
  • C. 远期承诺:远期、期货、互换;或有索取权:期权Forward commitments: forwards, futures, swaps; contingent claims: options
答案 C。只有期权是或有索取权。Answer C. Only options are contingent claims.

5. 远期承诺的收益为什么是"对称"的:Why is a forward commitment's payoff 'symmetric': 官方题Official

  • A. 标的每变动一单位,多空双方盈亏等额反向、线性;没有"作废"选项For each one-unit move in the underlying, the long and short gain/lose equal and opposite amounts, linearly, with no 'walk-away' option
  • B. 因买方可放弃履约Because the buyer can abandon performance
  • C. 因收益非线性Because the payoff is non-linear
答案 A。无选择权使收益线性对称。Answer A. No optionality makes the payoff linear and symmetric.

6. 期权收益为什么"不对称":Why is an option's payoff 'asymmetric': 官方题Official

  • A. 因买卖双方义务对称Because both parties have symmetric obligations
  • B. 买方最大损失是权利金、上行收益无限(call);行情不利可放弃行权,收益非线性The buyer's max loss is the premium and the upside is unlimited (call); an unfavorable move can be walked away from, making the payoff non-linear
  • C. 因收益线性Because the payoff is linear
答案 B。可放弃行权造就非对称收益。Answer B. The ability to walk away creates the asymmetric payoff.
1. 下列哪项最可能是或有权益(contingent claim)的例子？1. Which of the following is most likely an example of a contingent claim? A(n): 真题模考Mock
  • A. 互换合约swap contract
  • B. 期权合约option contract
  • C. 期货合约futures contract
答案 B。两大类衍生品:
① 远期承诺(远期/期货/互换)= 双方都有义务必须成交;
② 或有权益(contingent claim,主要是期权)= 持有人有权利、只在划算时才行权。期权 = 权利 → 或有权益;互换、期货 = 义务 → 远期承诺。Answer B. Two families:
① forward commitments (forwards/futures/swaps) = both sides are obligated to transact;
② contingent claims (mainly options) = the holder has a right, exercised only if favorable. Options = right → contingent claim; swaps/futures = obligation → forward commitments.
2. 远期承诺(forward commitment)：2. A forward commitment: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 相对标的具有线性收益。has a linear payoff in relation to the underlying.
  • B. 在合约起始时涉及现金交换。involves an exchange of cash at contract initiation.
  • C. 赋予一方在未来交易的权利。provides one party the right to transact at a later date.
答案 A。远期承诺(远期/期货/互换)的收益是线性、对称的:标的涨 1 块合约赚 1 块,跌 1 块亏 1 块。签约时不换现金(价值为 0),而且是义务不是权利。所以选"线性收益";B、C 分别说反了现金流和权利义务。Answer A. A forward commitment (forward/futures/swap) has a linear, symmetric payoff: +1 on the underlying → +1 on the contract, −1 → −1. No cash changes hands at initiation (value = 0), and it is an obligation, not a right. Hence "linear payoff"; B and C misstate the cash flow and the right/obligation.
3. 下列哪类衍生品具有非线性收益？3. Which of the following types of derivatives has a non-linear payoff? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 互换Swaps
  • B. 期权Options
  • C. 远期Forwards
答案 B。期权(或有权益)收益是非线性/不对称的:持有人可以选择不行权,于是下行被"截断"在权利金损失上,上行却完整保留。互换、远期两边都是义务,收益线性。Answer B. Options (contingent claims) have non-linear / asymmetric payoffs: the holder can walk away, so the downside is capped at the premium while the upside is kept. Swaps and forwards are obligations with linear payoffs.

§3 四大衍生品§3 The Four Major Derivatives

LOS 对应:LOS: describe forwards, futures, swaps, and options。
工具Instrument要点Key point
远期 forwardForwardOTC 定制、约定未来某日按约定价买卖标的;到期一次结算;有对手方违约风险OTC customized, agreeing to buy/sell the underlying at an agreed price on a future date; settled once at expiration; has counterparty default risk
期货 futuresFutures交易所标准化的远期;有清算所担保、每日盯市(MTM)、需保证金;违约风险极低An exchange-standardized forward; guaranteed by a clearinghouse, with daily mark-to-market (MTM) and required margin; very low default risk
互换 swapSwap约定在未来一系列日期交换现金流(如固定利率换浮动利率);相当于一连串远期Agreeing to exchange cash flows on a series of future dates (e.g., fixed for floating rate); equivalent to a series of forwards
期权 optionOption买方付权利金获得"按行权价买(call)或卖(put)标的"的权利The buyer pays a premium to obtain the right to "buy (call) or sell (put) the underlying at the exercise price"

7. 期货与远期的主要区别是:The main difference between futures and forwards is: 官方题Official

  • A. 期货是 OTC 定制Futures are OTC-customized
  • B. 远期每日盯市Forwards are marked to market daily
  • C. 期货交易所标准化、清算所担保、每日盯市、需保证金;远期 OTC 定制、有对手方风险、到期一次结算Futures are exchange-standardized, clearinghouse-guaranteed, marked to market daily, and require margin; forwards are OTC-customized, carry counterparty risk, and settle once at maturity
答案 C。标准化、盯市、保证金是期货特征。Answer C. Standardization, mark-to-market, and margin are futures' features.

8. 互换本质上相当于:A swap is essentially equivalent to: 官方题Official

  • A. 一系列远期合约的组合A combination of a series of forward contracts
  • B. 一份期权An option
  • C. 一只股票A stock
答案 A。互换可拆解为一连串远期。Answer A. A swap can be decomposed into a string of forwards.

9. 期权买方与卖方的义务差异是:The difference in obligations between an option buyer and seller is: 官方题Official

  • A. 买方付权利金、有权无义务;卖方收权利金、有义务应买方要求履约The buyer pays the premium and has a right without obligation; the seller receives the premium and is obligated to perform if the buyer exercises
  • B. 买方有义务履约The buyer is obligated to perform
  • C. 卖方有权无义务The seller has a right without obligation
答案 A。买方掌握选择权,卖方被动履约。Answer A. The buyer holds the choice, the seller performs passively.

10. 每日盯市(MTM)是哪种工具的特征:Daily mark-to-market (MTM) is a feature of which instrument: 官方题Official

  • A. 期权Options
  • B. 期货Futures
  • C. 远期Forwards
答案 B。期货每日结算盈亏、调整保证金。Answer B. Futures settle gains/losses daily and adjust margin.

11. 现金结算与实物交割的区别是:The difference between cash settlement and physical delivery is: 官方题Official

  • A. 两者完全相同They are identical
  • B. 现金结算也交付资产Cash settlement also delivers the asset
  • C. 现金结算按到期价差付现金;实物交割实际交付标的资产Cash settlement pays cash for the maturity price difference; physical delivery actually delivers the underlying asset
答案 C。一个付现,一个交货。Answer C. One pays cash, the other delivers goods.
1. 远期合约具有：1. Forward contracts have: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 低于期货的对手方风险。less counter-party risk than futures.
  • B. 与期货相同的对手方风险。the same level of counter-party risk as futures.
  • C. 高于期货的对手方风险。more counter-party risk than futures.
答案 C。对手方风险 = 对方违约的风险。远期是场外(OTC)、没有清算所、不每日结算 → 只能指望对方守约 → 对手方风险高于交易所交易的期货(期货有清算所担保 + 每日盯市 + 保证金)。Answer C. Counterparty risk = the risk the other side defaults. A forward is OTC, with no clearinghouse and no daily settlement → you rely on the counterparty → its counterparty risk is higher than an exchange-traded future (which has clearinghouse guarantee, daily mark-to-market, and margin).
2. 下列哪种特征最可能是远期与互换共有的？2. Which of the following characteristics is most likely common to both forwards and swaps? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 合约条款的定制化Customization of contract terms
  • B. 按结算价每日盯市Marked to the settlement price on a daily basis
  • C. 合约存续期内多次支付Multiple payments over the life of the contract
答案 A。远期和互换都是 OTC、可量身定制合约条款——这是它们的共性。每日盯市是期货特有;"存续期内多次支付"描述的是互换(定期结算),不是远期。所以共有特征 = 定制化。Answer A. Forwards and swaps are both OTC and customizable — their shared trait. Daily mark-to-market is unique to futures; "multiple payments over the life" describes a swap, not a forward. So the common feature is customization.

§4 OTC vs 交易所市场§4 OTC vs Exchange-Traded Market

维度DimensionOTC(场外)OTCETD(交易所)ETD (exchange-traded)
标准化Standardization定制化Customized标准化合约Standardized contracts
对手方风险Counterparty risk较高(双边)Higher (bilateral)清算所担保、极低Clearinghouse-guaranteed, very low

12. OTC 与交易所衍生品在对手方风险上的区别是:The difference in counterparty risk between OTC and exchange-traded derivatives is: 官方题Official

  • A. OTC 双边、对手方风险较高;交易所有清算所作中央对手方、风险极低OTC is bilateral with higher counterparty risk; exchanges have a clearinghouse as central counterparty with very low risk
  • B. OTC 风险更低OTC is lower risk
  • C. 两者风险相同Their risk is the same
答案 A。中央对手方大幅降低违约风险。Answer A. A central counterparty greatly reduces default risk.

13. 清算所在期货市场的作用是:The role of the clearinghouse in the futures market is: 官方题Official

  • A. 充当中央对手方、保证履约、管理保证金与每日盯市,消除双边违约风险Act as central counterparty, guarantee performance, manage margin and daily mark-to-market, eliminating bilateral default risk
  • B. 制定市场利率Set market interest rates
  • C. 没有实际作用No real role
答案 A。清算所是期货违约风险的化解者。Answer A. The clearinghouse resolves futures default risk.
1. 与未经清算的场外(OTC)衍生品相比，交易所交易衍生品的信用风险最可能：1. Compared to over-the-counter (OTC) derivatives that are not cleared, the credit risk of exchange-traded derivatives is most likely: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 更低。lower.
  • B. 相同。the same.
  • C. 更高。higher.
答案 A。交易所交易衍生品要缴保证金,且清算所做违约担保(充当每笔交易的中央对手方)→ 信用风险更低。未清算的 OTC 衍生品直接面对对手,信用风险更高。Answer A. Exchange-traded derivatives require margin and a clearinghouse that guarantees performance (acting as central counterparty) → credit risk is lower. Uncleared OTC derivatives face the counterparty directly, so credit risk is higher.
2. 与场外(OTC)衍生品市场相比，交易所交易衍生品市场最可能具有更高的：2. Compared to over-the-counter (OTC) derivative markets, exchange-traded derivative markets most likely have greater: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 灵活性。flexibility.
  • B. 透明度。transparency.
  • C. 定制化程度。customization.
答案 B。交易所市场向交易所/监管方充分披露价格与头寸 → 透明度更高。代价是标准化,牺牲了灵活性与定制化——那两点反而是 OTC 市场的长处。Answer B. Exchange markets fully disclose prices and positions to the exchange/regulator → higher transparency. The trade-off is standardization, giving up flexibility and customization — which are strengths of the OTC market instead.

§5 衍生品的收益与风险§5 The Benefits & Risks of Derivatives

LOS 对应:LOS: determine the value of a derivative and describe its benefits and risks。

好处:
① 风险管理/对冲(锁定价格);
② 价格发现;
③ 降低交易成本、提高市场效率;
④ 用少量资本获得敞口(杠杆);
⑤ 便于做空或获取难以直接投资的敞口。风险:
① 杠杆放大亏损;
② 对手方(信用)风险(尤其 OTC);
③ 流动性风险;
④ 复杂性与模型风险;
⑤ 可能被用于过度投机。Benefits:
① risk management/hedging (locking in prices);
② price discovery;
③ lower transaction costs and greater market efficiency;
④ exposure with little capital (leverage);
⑤ ease of shorting or obtaining hard-to-access exposures. Risks:
① leverage magnifies losses;
② counterparty (credit) risk (especially OTC);
③ liquidity risk;
④ complexity and model risk;
⑤ potential for excessive speculation.

考点·衍生品三种特有风险(必须分清):
• 基差风险(basis risk):对冲工具与被对冲标的不完全同步,对冲后残留的价值偏离。
• 流动性风险(liquidity risk):衍生品与标的之间现金流时点不匹配(如先缴保证金、标的收益却晚到)。
• 系统性风险(systemic risk):市场层面因过度杠杆/连锁违约而危及整个金融体系。
反对衍生品的两大论点:
① 便于合法化的投机/赌博;
② 高杠杆可能破坏金融体系稳定(2008 为典型)。Exam · three risks unique to derivatives (keep distinct):
• Basis risk: the hedge and hedged item don't move perfectly together, leaving a residual value mismatch.
• Liquidity risk: a mismatch in the timing of cash flows (e.g., margin due now, underlying pays later).
• Systemic risk: market-wide excess leverage / chains of default threatening the whole system.
Two arguments against derivatives:
① they enable legalized speculation/gambling;
② high leverage can destabilize the financial system (2008 the classic case).

14. 衍生品为什么自带杠杆:Why are derivatives inherently leveraged: 官方题Official

  • A. 只需少量保证金/权利金即可获得大额名义敞口,放大盈亏A small margin/premium buys a large notional exposure, amplifying gains and losses
  • B. 因价格很高Because prices are very high
  • C. 衍生品没有杠杆Derivatives have no leverage
答案 A。小额资金撬动大额敞口即杠杆。Answer A. A small sum controlling a large exposure is leverage.

15. 衍生品的主要好处有:The main benefits of derivatives are: 官方题Official

  • A. 提高交易成本Higher trading costs
  • B. 风险管理/对冲、价格发现、降低交易成本、以低成本获取敞口、便于做空Risk management/hedging, price discovery, lower trading costs, low-cost exposure, and ease of short-selling
  • C. 只有投机一项Only speculation
答案 B。衍生品用途广泛,以对冲和价格发现为核心。Answer B. Derivatives have broad uses, centered on hedging and price discovery.

16. 衍生品的主要风险有:The main risks of derivatives are: 官方题Official

  • A. 没有任何风险No risk at all
  • B. 只有汇率风险Only exchange-rate risk
  • C. 杠杆放大亏损、对手方(信用)风险、流动性风险、复杂性/模型风险、过度投机Leverage amplifying losses, counterparty (credit) risk, liquidity risk, complexity/model risk, and excessive speculation
答案 C。杠杆是双刃剑,风险多元。Answer C. Leverage is double-edged and the risks are diverse.
1. 衍生品工具的预期价值与标的或被套期交易之间的潜在偏离，最好地描述为：1. The potential divergence between the expected value of a derivative instrument versus an underlying or hedged transaction best describes: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 基差风险(basis risk)。basis risk.
  • B. 流动性风险。liquidity risk.
  • C. 系统性风险。systemic risk.
答案 A。基差风险(basis risk)= 用来对冲的衍生品和被对冲标的并不完全同步,导致对冲后仍有残余的价值偏离。流动性风险讲的是现金流时点;系统性风险讲的是市场层面的过度杠杆。Answer A. Basis risk = the hedging derivative and the hedged item do not move perfectly together, leaving a residual value mismatch after hedging. Liquidity risk is about the timing of cash flows; systemic risk is about market-wide excess leverage.
2. 衍生品工具与其标的之间现金流时点的潜在偏离，最好地描述为：2. The potential divergence between the cash flow timing of a derivative instrument versus its underlying best describes: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 基差风险。basis risk.
  • B. 流动性风险。liquidity risk.
  • C. 系统性风险。systemic risk.
答案 B。注意题眼是现金流"时点"的偏离(不是价值偏离)→ 这是流动性风险(例如衍生品要先付保证金、标的收益却晚到)。价值上的偏离才叫基差风险;系统性风险是过度杠杆。Answer B. The cue is a mismatch in the timing of cash flows (not value) → that is liquidity risk (e.g., margin is due now but the underlying pays later). A value mismatch is basis risk; systemic risk is excess leverage.
3. 反对使用衍生品的一个主要论点是它们：3. A principal argument against using derivatives is that they: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 会破坏金融体系的稳定destabilize the financial system
  • B. 在各方之间转移风险方面无效are ineffective in transferring risk between parties
  • C. 阻碍现货市场中标的资产的价格发现prevent price discovery of underlying assets in spot markets
答案 A。反对衍生品的两大论点:
① 便于合法化的投机/赌博;
② 高杠杆会破坏金融体系稳定。选"破坏稳定"。而"转移风险"和"价格发现"恰恰是衍生品的好处,不是缺点,故 B、C 反了。Answer A. The two main arguments against derivatives:
① they enable legalized speculation/gambling;
② high leverage can destabilize the financial system. Choose "destabilize." Risk transfer and price discovery are actually benefits, so B and C are reversed.
4. 基差风险最好地描述为：4. Basis risk is best described as a(n): 真题模考Mock
  • A. 投资者因资金不足而无法满足追加保证金investor's inability to meet a margin call due to a lack of funds
  • B. 衍生品预期价值与其标的之间的潜在偏离potential divergence between the expected value of a derivative and its underlying
  • C. 衍生品与标的交易在现金流时点上的偏离divergence in the cash flow timing of a derivative versus that of an underlying transaction
答案 B。基差风险= 衍生品价值与其标的之间的潜在价值偏离(对冲不完美的残差)。选项 A(付不出追加保证金)和 C(现金流时点偏离)描述的都是流动性风险。Answer B. Basis risk = a potential value divergence between the derivative and its underlying (the residual of an imperfect hedge). Options A (can't meet a margin call) and C (timing mismatch of cash flows) both describe liquidity risk.

§6 发行人与投资者的用途§6 Uses for Issuers & Investors

LOS 对应:LOS: describe how issuers and investors use derivatives。

发行人(企业)用衍生品对冲经营风险:锁定利率(利率互换把浮动债务变固定)、锁定汇率、锁定大宗商品投入成本。投资者用衍生品:对冲组合风险、调整久期/贝塔、做多空策略、以低成本获取敞口、套利。核心区分:对冲(hedging)降低已有风险,投机(speculation)主动承担风险博收益。Issuers (companies) use derivatives to hedge operating risks: locking in rates (an interest-rate swap turns floating debt into fixed), locking in exchange rates, locking in commodity input costs. Investors use derivatives to: hedge portfolio risk, adjust duration/beta, run long-short strategies, gain exposure cheaply, and arbitrage. The core distinction: hedging reduces existing risk, speculation actively takes on risk for return.

考点·套期会计的三种指定类型(常考对号入座):
• 公允价值套期(fair-value hedge):对冲已确认资产/负债公允价值的波动(如把已持有存货远期卖出)。
• 现金流套期(cash-flow hedge):对冲未来可变现金流的不确定(如预期销售、浮动利率利息)。
• 净投资套期(net-investment hedge):对冲境外经营权益的汇率风险(如货币远期抵消海外子公司权益的外汇敞口)。Exam · three hedge-accounting designations (often matched):
• Fair-value hedge: hedges swings in the fair value of a recognized asset/liability (e.g., selling held inventory forward).
• Cash-flow hedge: hedges uncertainty in a variable future cash flow (e.g., a forecast sale, floating-rate interest).
• Net-investment hedge: hedges FX risk of a foreign operation's equity (e.g., a currency forward offsetting an overseas subsidiary's equity exposure).

17. 企业发行人如何用利率互换:How does a corporate issuer use an interest-rate swap: 官方题Official

  • A. 把浮动利率债务换成固定(收浮动付固定),锁定利息成本、对冲利率上升Convert floating-rate debt to fixed (receive floating, pay fixed), locking in interest cost and hedging rising rates
  • B. 把固定换成浮动以增加风险Convert fixed to floating to add risk
  • C. 与利率无关Unrelated to rates
答案 A。收浮动付固定锁定融资成本。Answer A. Receive floating, pay fixed to lock in funding cost.

18. 对冲与投机的区别是:The difference between hedging and speculation is: 官方题Official

  • A. 对冲=主动增加风险Hedging = actively add risk
  • B. 对冲=降低已有风险;投机=主动承担风险以博取收益Hedging = reduce existing risk; speculation = actively take on risk for gain
  • C. 两者含义相同They mean the same thing
答案 B。目的相反:减风险 vs 求收益。Answer B. Opposite purposes: reduce risk vs seek return.

19. 投资者如何用衍生品调整组合贝塔或久期:How do investors use derivatives to adjust portfolio beta or duration: 补充Extra

  • A. 只能通过买卖现券Only by trading cash securities
  • B. 无法调整It cannot be adjusted
  • C. 用股指期货调整贝塔、用利率期货/互换调整久期,成本低于直接买卖现券Use stock-index futures to adjust beta and interest-rate futures/swaps to adjust duration, at lower cost than trading the cash securities directly
答案 C。衍生品是低成本调整敞口的工具。Answer C. Derivatives are low-cost tools to adjust exposure.

20. 为什么说衍生品有助于价格发现:Why do derivatives aid price discovery: 补充Extra

  • A. 衍生品市场汇集对未来价格的预期、反映信息,帮助形成对标的未来价格的共识The derivatives market aggregates expectations of future prices and reflects information, helping form a consensus on the underlying's future price
  • B. 与价格发现无关Unrelated to price discovery
  • C. 反而隐藏市场信息It actually hides market information
答案 A。衍生品价格聚合了市场对未来的预期。Answer A. Derivative prices aggregate the market's expectations of the future.
1. 就套期会计的指定类型而言：1. With respect to hedge accounting designation types, a: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 用于对冲预期销售的外汇远期是公允价值套期的例子foreign exchange forward to hedge forecasted sales is an example of a fair value hedge
  • B. 用于对冲存货的商品期货是现金流套期的例子commodity futures contract used to hedge inventory is an example of a cash flow hedge
  • C. 用于抵消境外经营权益外汇风险的货币远期是净投资套期的例子currency forward to offset the foreign exchange risk of equity of a foreign operation is an example of a net investment hedge
答案 C。套期会计三类:
① 公允价值套期对冲已确认资产/负债的价值波动;
② 现金流套期对冲未来可变现金流(如预期销售);
③ 净投资套期对冲境外经营权益的汇率风险。用货币远期抵消境外经营权益的外汇风险 → 净投资套期。A 应是现金流套期,B 应是公允价值套期。Answer C. Three hedge-accounting types:
① fair-value hedge for value swings of a recognized asset/liability;
② cash-flow hedge for a variable future cash flow (e.g., a forecast sale);
③ net-investment hedge for FX risk of a foreign operation's equity. A currency forward offsetting a foreign operation's FX risk → net-investment hedge. A should be a cash-flow hedge, B a fair-value hedge.
2. 一家大宗商品生产商预期未来价格下跌而将其存货远期卖出，这是何种套期的例子：2. A commodities producer selling its inventory forward in anticipation of lower prices in the future is an example of a: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 公允价值套期。fair value hedge.
  • B. 现金流套期。cash flow hedge.
  • C. 净投资套期。net investment hedge.
答案 A。存货是已持有的资产,把它远期卖出锁定卖价,是在对冲现有资产公允价值的波动 → 公允价值套期。现金流套期针对的是未来可变的现金流;净投资套期针对境外经营权益。Answer A. Inventory is an asset already held; selling it forward to lock the price hedges the swings in that asset's fair value → fair-value hedge. A cash-flow hedge targets a variable future cash flow; a net-investment hedge targets a foreign operation's equity.

§1 信用衍生品与 CDS§1 Credit Derivatives & CDS

LOS 对应：define credit derivatives and compare their basic characteristics with other derivatives。

信用衍生品把债券或贷款的信用风险从其所有权中分离。最常见的是信用违约互换 CDS。Credit derivatives separate the credit risk of a bond or loan from its ownership. The most common is the credit default swap (CDS).

参与方Party现金流与风险Cash flows and risk
Protection Buyer定期支付 CDS premium；发生信用事件时获得补偿，相当于买信用保险Pays the CDS premium periodically; receives compensation on a credit event, like buying credit insurance
Protection Seller收取 premium；信用事件发生时承担损失，相当于做多参考实体信用Collects the premium; bears the loss on a credit event, equivalent to going long the reference entity's credit
Reference Entity/Obligation被保护的公司、主权或其债务；通常不是 CDS 合约的交易对手The protected company, sovereign, or its debt; usually not a counterparty to the CDS contract

信用事件可包括破产、未付款和债务重组，具体以合约定义为准。结算可以是：A credit event can include bankruptcy, failure to pay, and debt restructuring, as defined by the contract. Settlement can be:

  • 实物结算：保护买方交付符合条件的违约债券，卖方支付面值。Physical settlement: the protection buyer delivers eligible defaulted bonds, and the seller pays face value.
  • 现金结算：卖方支付面值与违约债券回收价值之间的差额。Cash settlement: the seller pays the difference between face value and the recovery value of the defaulted bonds.
近似信用损失支付 = 名义本金 × (1 − 回收率)
方向判断：买 CDS 保护 = 做空信用风险、利差走阔时受益；卖 CDS 保护 = 做多信用风险、收取信用利差。

1. CDS 保护买方与卖方谁承担信用损失:In a CDS, who bears the credit loss — the protection buyer or seller:

  • A. 保护买方承担损失The protection buyer bears the loss
  • B. 参考实体承担损失The reference entity bears the loss
  • C. 保护卖方承担约定信用事件造成的损失;买方支付保费The protection seller bears the loss from the agreed credit event; the buyer pays the premium
答案 C。卖方做多信用、承担事件损失,买方付保费买保护。Answer C. The seller is long credit and bears event losses; the buyer pays a premium for protection.

CFA Program Curriculum · Level I · Derivatives

第二讲 · 套利、复制与远期/期货定价Lecture 2 · Arbitrage, Replication & Forward/Futures Pricing

对应教材:Arbitrage, Replication, and Cost of Carry + Pricing and Valuation of Forwards + Futures · 建议学习时长:3.5 小时 · 计算核心Curriculum: Arbitrage, Replication, and Cost of Carry + Pricing and Valuation of Forwards + Futures · Suggested study time: 3.5 hours · Calculation core

衍生品定价的唯一大思想就是无套利(no-arbitrage):如果能用现货+借贷"复制"出衍生品,那衍生品价格必须等于复制成本,否则就有白赚的套利机会。掌握这个思想,远期、期货、互换、期权定价都迎刃而解。The one big idea of derivative pricing is no-arbitrage: if you can 'replicate' a derivative with the spot plus borrowing/lending, then the derivative's price must equal the replication cost, or there is a free arbitrage. Master this idea and the pricing of forwards, futures, swaps, and options all falls into place.
