§1 无套利原则与复制§1 The No-Arbitrage Principle & Replication

LOS 对应:LOS: explain how the concepts of arbitrage and replication are used in pricing derivatives。
🔰 零基础讲解:天下没有白赚的钱

无套利⚖️ 套利=零成本、零风险却能赚钱。市场上这种机会会被瞬间抢光,所以均衡时不存在。定价就靠这条:如果我能用"借钱买现货"完全复制出一份远期合约的到期结果,那么这份远期今天的合理价格,必须正好等于复制它的成本——多一分少一分都会引来套利。:若能复制衍生品的收益,其价格必须等于复制成本。No-arbitrage⚖️ Arbitrage = making money at zero cost and zero risk. Such opportunities are snapped up instantly in the market, so none exists in equilibrium. Pricing rests on this: if I can perfectly replicate a forward's expiration outcome with "borrow money and buy the spot," then the forward's fair price today must exactly equal the cost of replicating it — any more or less invites arbitrage.: if a derivative's payoff can be replicated, its price must equal the replication cost.

复制(replication):用标的资产 + 无风险借贷组合,造出与衍生品相同的到期收益。无套利定价要求:相同收益的两个组合,今天必须同价。这也引出持有到期的"现货+融资"与"远期"等价关系。Replication: use the underlying asset + risk-free borrowing/lending to build a payoff identical to the derivative's at expiration. No-arbitrage pricing requires: two portfolios with the same payoff must cost the same today. This also yields the equivalence between holding "spot + financing to maturity" and a "forward."

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

无套利原则与复制

一价定律:现金流完全相同的两个组合必须同价,否则存在套利。复制(replication):用「标的 + 无风险借贷」搭出与衍生品相同的收益,其成本即衍生品的无套利价格。

套利的三条件

套利机会 = 零净投入 + 无风险 + 正收益。发现价差时,买低卖高、锁定无风险利润,直到价格回到无套利水平。

易错对比

① 无套利定价不需要对未来价格的预期,也不依赖风险偏好;② 因此可用「风险中性」思路;③ 复制组合的成本 = 衍生品应有价格。

No-arbitrage & replication

Law of one price: two portfolios with identical cash flows must have the same price, else arbitrage exists. Replication: build the derivative's payoff from "underlying + risk-free borrowing/lending"; that cost is the derivative's no-arbitrage price.

Three conditions for arbitrage

Arbitrage = zero net outlay + no risk + positive return. On a mispricing, buy low/sell high to lock a riskless profit until prices return to no-arbitrage levels.

Common traps

① No-arbitrage pricing needs no forecast of the future price and doesn't depend on risk preferences; ② hence the "risk-neutral" approach; ③ the replicating portfolio's cost = the derivative's fair price.

1. 什么是套利:What is arbitrage: 官方题Official

  • A. 零成本、零风险却能获得正收益的机会;均衡市场中不存在A zero-cost, zero-risk opportunity that still yields a positive return; it does not exist in an equilibrium market
  • B. 高风险高收益的投机High-risk, high-return speculation
  • C. 存贷利差A deposit-loan spread
答案 A。套利是无风险的免费午餐,均衡时会被消除。Answer A. Arbitrage is a risk-free free lunch, eliminated in equilibrium.

2. 复制在定价中的作用是:The role of replication in pricing is: 官方题Official

  • A. 复制仅用于对冲汇率Replication is only for hedging FX
  • B. 用标的+无风险借贷造出与衍生品相同的收益,衍生品价格必须等于复制成本Use the underlying + risk-free borrowing/lending to build the same payoff as the derivative; the derivative's price must equal the replication cost
  • C. 复制与定价无关Replication is unrelated to pricing
答案 B。无套利要求价格等于复制组合的成本。Answer B. No-arbitrage requires the price to equal the replicating portfolio's cost.
1. 衍生品定价模型中通常用于折现预期收益的利率是：1. The rate typically used in derivative pricing models to discount expected payoffs is the: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 无风险利率risk-free rate
  • B. 无风险利率加风险溢价risk-free rate plus a risk premium
  • C. 无风险利率乘以风险中性概率risk-free rate multiplied by the risk-neutral probability
答案 A。衍生品定价用风险中性估值:先用"风险中性概率"算出预期收益,再按无风险利率折现——不加风险溢价(因为已用完美对冲消掉了风险)。B 加溢价、C 把概率当折现率都错。Answer A. Derivatives are priced by risk-neutral valuation: take the expected payoff under risk-neutral probabilities, then discount at the risk-free rate — with no risk premium (a perfect hedge removed the risk). B adds a premium and C confuses the probability with the discount rate.
2. 无风险利率3%，某资产的风险溢价2%。若投资者通过将资产与衍生品组合建立完美对冲，则组合头寸应获得：2. The risk-free rate is 3% and the risk premium for an asset is 2%. If an investor creates a perfect hedge by combining the asset with a derivative, the combined position should earn: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 0%0%
  • B. 3%3%
  • C. 5%5%
答案 B。无套利要点:如果用资产 + 衍生品搭出一个完美对冲(无风险)组合,它就只能赚无风险利率,否则会有套利。所以答案是 3%,而不是含 2% 溢价的 5%。Answer B. The no-arbitrage point: if an asset + derivative form a perfectly hedged (riskless) position, it can only earn the risk-free rate, else arbitrage exists. So 3%, not the 5% that includes the 2% premium.

§2 持有成本 cost of carry§2 Cost of Carry

LOS 对应:LOS: explain the carry costs and carry benefits in pricing。

持有现货到未来会产生持有成本(仓储费、保险、融资利息)和持有收益(股息、利息、便利收益)。远期价格 = 现货价 + 净持有成本(以利率计入)。持有收益压低远期价、持有成本抬高远期价。Holding the spot to the future incurs carry costs (storage, insurance, financing interest) and carry benefits (dividends, interest, convenience yield). Forward price = spot price + net carry cost (compounded at the interest rate). Carry benefits lower the forward price, carry costs raise it.

3. 持有收益与持有成本如何影响远期价格:How do carry benefits and carry costs affect the forward price: 官方题Official

  • A. 持有收益提高远期价Carry benefits raise the forward price
  • B. 两者都降低远期价Both lower the forward price
  • C. 持有收益(股息等)降低远期价;持有成本(仓储等)提高远期价Carry benefits (dividends, etc.) lower the forward price; carry costs (storage, etc.) raise it
答案 C。收益减、成本加。Answer C. Benefits subtract, costs add.
1. 其他条件相同，派息股票的持有成本(cost of carry)：1. All else being equal, the cost of carry on a dividend-paying stock is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 低于不派息股票的持有成本lower than the cost of carry on a stock with no dividends
  • B. 与不派息股票的持有成本相同the same as the cost of carry on a stock with no dividends
  • C. 高于不派息股票的持有成本higher than the cost of carry on a stock with no dividends
答案 A。持有成本(cost of carry)= 持有成本 − 持有收益。股息是持有股票带来的收益,会抵消一部分持有成本 → 派息股票的净持有成本低于不派息股票。这也让派息股的远期价更低。Answer A. Cost of carry = carrying costs − carry benefits. A dividend is a benefit of holding the stock that offsets part of the cost → a dividend-paying stock has a lower net cost of carry than a non-payer (and thus a lower forward price).
2. 下列哪类资产最可能具有便利收益(convenience yield)？2. Which of the following asset classes is most likely to have a convenience yield? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 大宗商品Commodities
  • B. 利率Interest rates
  • C. 外汇Foreign exchange
答案 A。便利收益(convenience yield)= 实物持有大宗商品(而非其衍生品)带来的非现金好处(如缺货时能随时取用)。利率、外汇没有"实物短缺"的用处,故只有大宗商品才有便利收益。Answer A. Convenience yield = the non-cash benefit of physically holding a commodity (rather than its derivative), e.g., availability during shortages. Interest rates and FX have no "physical-shortage" use, so only commodities have a convenience yield.

§3 远期价格公式§3 The Forward-Price Formula 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: calculate the price of a forward contract。
无收益无成本:F0(T) = S0 × (1 + r)T
符号Symbol含义Meaning
F0(T)今天约定、T 时刻交割的远期价格The forward price agreed today for delivery at time T
S0标的当前现货价格The underlying's current spot price
r无风险利率(年化)The risk-free rate (annualized)
T到期时间(年);T 是指数Time to maturity (years); T is an exponent
远期价格计算 官方题Official

现货 S0=$100,无风险利率 5%,期限 1 年,无股息。远期价格 F0 = 100 × 1.05 = $105。若市场远期报价 ≠ $105,即存在套利。Spot S0=$100, risk-free rate 5%, 1-year term, no dividends. Forward price F0 = 100 × 1.05 = $105. If the market forward quote ≠ $105, arbitrage exists.

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

远期价格公式

无收益无成本资产:F0 = S0 × (1 + r)^T(把现价按无风险利率复利到到期)。这来自复制:今天借 S0 买入标的、到期还本息,故远期价必等于终值,否则套利。

带持有成本/收益

F0 = (S0 − PV(收益) + PV(成本)) × (1+r)^T,等价于 F0 = S0(1+r)^T − FV(收益) + FV(成本)。持有收益(股息、便利收益)压低远期价,持有成本(仓储)抬高远期价。

易错对比

① 收益减、成本加,方向别记反;② 远期价不是对未来现货的预测;③ 连续复利时改用 e^{(r−q)T}。

The forward-price formula

For an asset with no income/cost: F0 = S0 × (1 + r)^T (compound the spot at the risk-free rate to maturity). From replication: borrow S0 today, buy the asset, repay at maturity — so the forward must equal that future value, else arbitrage.

With carry costs/benefits

F0 = (S0 − PV(benefits) + PV(costs)) × (1+r)^T, i.e. F0 = S0(1+r)^T − FV(benefits) + FV(costs). Carry benefits (dividends, convenience yield) lower the forward; carry costs (storage) raise it.

Common traps

① Benefits subtract, costs add — don't flip the sign; ② the forward is not a forecast of the future spot; ③ with continuous compounding use e^{(r−q)T}.

4. 无收益无成本时的远期价格公式是:The forward-price formula with no carry benefit or cost is: 官方题Official

  • A. F₀(T) = S₀(1+r)ᵀF₀(T) = S₀(1+r)ᵀ
  • B. F₀ = S₀/(1+r)ᵀF₀ = S₀/(1+r)ᵀ
  • C. F₀ = S₀ × rF₀ = S₀ × r
答案 A。现货按无风险利率复利至到期。Answer A. The spot compounds at the risk-free rate to maturity.

5. 现货 $100、r=5%、1 年、无股息,远期价格为:Spot $100, r = 5%, 1 year, no dividends; the forward price is: 官方题Official

  • A. $100$100
  • B. $105$105
  • C. $95$95
答案 B。100×1.05=$105。Answer B. 100×1.05 = $105.

6. 利率上升(其他不变)对远期价格的影响:The effect of rising rates (all else equal) on the forward price: 官方题Official

  • A. 远期价下降The forward price falls
  • B. 远期价不变The forward price is unchanged
  • C. F₀=S₀(1+r)ᵀ 上升——融资持有成本更高F₀ = S₀(1+r)ᵀ rises — higher cost of financing the holding
答案 C。更高利率抬高持有成本与远期价。Answer C. Higher rates raise the carry cost and the forward price.

7. 远期价格是对未来现货价格的无偏预测吗:Is the forward price an unbiased predictor of the future spot price: 补充Extra

  • A. 不一定;远期价格由无套利(持有成本)决定,不等于对未来现货的预期Not necessarily; the forward price is set by no-arbitrage (cost of carry), not equal to the expected future spot
  • B. 是精确的无偏预测Yes, an exact unbiased predictor
  • C. 远期价永远高于未来现货The forward price is always above the future spot
答案 A。远期价反映持有成本,而非纯预期。Answer A. The forward price reflects carry cost, not pure expectation.
1. 某资产的即期价格为$70.00。若年无风险利率为2.50%，则9个月远期价格最接近：1. The spot price of an asset is $70.00. If the annual risk-free rate is 2.50%, the 9-month forward price is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. $68.72$68.72
  • B. $71.31$71.31
  • C. $71.75$71.75
答案 B。无收益资产的远期价 = 即期价按无风险利率复利到到期(把"现在买、持有到期"的成本加进去):F₀(T)=S₀(1+r)^T = 70×(1.025)^0.75 = $71.31。远期价高于即期价,是因为多了持有成本。Answer B. For an asset with no yield, the forward price = the spot compounded to expiration at the risk-free rate (adding the cost of "buy now, carry to expiry"): F₀(T)=S₀(1+r)^T = 70×(1.025)^0.75 = $71.31. It exceeds spot because of the carry cost.

§4 远期合约在存续期的价值§4 The Value of a Forward During Its Life 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: calculate the value of a forward contract。
🔰 零基础讲解:价格 ≠ 价值

远期价格(price)是约定的成交价,签约时定死;远期价值(value)是这份合约现在值多少钱。签约瞬间价值 = 0(定价公平);之后随现货变动,一方盈、一方亏。The forward price is the agreed transaction price, fixed at signing; the forward value is what the contract is worth now. Value at the instant of signing = 0 (fairly priced); afterward, as the spot moves, one side gains and the other loses.

多头价值(存续期 t):Vt = St − F0(T) / (1 + r)(T−t)
符号Symbol含义Meaning
Vtt 时刻多头合约的价值The value of a long contract at time t
Stt 时刻现货价The spot price at time t
F0(T)/(1+r)(T−t)约定远期价格的现值The present value of the agreed forward price
初始 t=0Initial t=0V0 = 0(因为 F0=S0(1+r)T)V0 = 0 (because F0=S0(1+r)T)
远期价值计算 官方题Official

上例远期价格 $105、期限 1 年、r=5%。半年后(t=0.5)现货涨到 $110。多头价值 V = 110 − 105/1.050.5 = 110 − 105/1.0247 = 110 − 102.47 = +$7.53(多头盈利)。In the example above the forward price is $105, term 1 year, r=5%. Half a year later (t=0.5) the spot rises to $110. The long's value V = 110 − 105/1.050.5 = 110 − 105/1.0247 = 110 − 102.47 = +$7.53 (the long profits).

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

远期在存续期的价值

多头远期在 t 时点的价值:Vt = St − F0 ÷ (1+r)^(T−t)(无收益无成本)。直觉:现在的标的价 St 减去「到期须付的约定价 F0」的现值。

推导:三个关键时点

• 起始 t=0:F0 恰好使 V0 = 0(所以进场不花钱)。
• 存续中:标的涨 → 多头价值转正。
• 到期 T:VT = ST − F0(折现因子=1),即最终盈亏。

易错对比

① V0=0 是「定价」的结果,不是恒等;② 价值用现值,别忘折现 (T−t);③ 空头价值 = −多头价值。

Value of a forward during its life

A long forward's value at time t: Vt = St − F0 ÷ (1+r)^(T−t) (no income/cost). Intuition: today's spot St minus the present value of the agreed price F0 due at maturity.

Three key moments

• At t=0: F0 is set so that V0 = 0 (no cash to enter).
• During life: spot up → the long's value turns positive.
• At T: VT = ST − F0 (discount factor = 1), the final P/L.

Common traps

① V0=0 is a result of pricing, not an identity; ② value uses present value — don't forget to discount over (T−t); ③ short value = −long value.

8. 远期合约签约瞬间的价值及原因:The value of a forward contract at the instant of signing and why: 官方题Official

  • A. 小于 0Less than 0
  • B. 等于 0;远期价格按无套利设定,双方公平、无人占便宜Equal to 0; the forward price is set by no-arbitrage, so it is fair to both parties with no advantage
  • C. 大于 0Greater than 0
答案 B。公平定价使初始价值为零。Answer B. Fair pricing makes the initial value zero.

9. 存续期多头远期价值的公式是:The formula for the value of a long forward during its life is: 官方题Official

  • A. Vₜ = F₀ − SₜVₜ = F₀ − Sₜ
  • B. Vₜ = Sₜ + F₀Vₜ = Sₜ + F₀
  • C. Vₜ = Sₜ − F₀(T)/(1+r)^(T−t)Vₜ = Sₜ − F₀(T)/(1+r)^(T−t)
答案 C。当前现货减去约定价的现值。Answer C. The current spot minus the present value of the agreed price.

10. 远期价格 $105、r=5%、半年后现货 $110,多头价值约:Forward price $105, r = 5%, spot $110 after half a year; the long value is about: 官方题Official

  • A. +$7.53+$7.53
  • B. +$5.00+$5.00
  • C. −$7.53−$7.53
答案 A。110 − 105/1.05^0.5 = 110 − 102.47 = +$7.53。Answer A. 110 − 105/1.05^0.5 = 110 − 102.47 = +$7.53.

11. 现货上涨对远期多头和空头的价值分别有何影响:How does a spot rise affect the value of the long and short forward, respectively: 官方题Official

  • A. 两者都上升Both rise
  • B. 多头价值上升、空头价值下降(对称)The long's value rises and the short's falls (symmetric)
  • C. 多头下降、空头上升The long falls, the short rises
答案 B。远期收益对称,多空盈亏相反。Answer B. Forward payoff is symmetric; long and short gain/lose oppositely.

12. 为什么远期多头在现货高于远期价现值时获利:Why does a long forward profit when the spot exceeds the present value of the forward price: 官方题Official

  • A. 多头此时亏损The long loses here
  • B. 与现货价无关Unrelated to the spot price
  • C. 多头有权按较低的约定价买入,现货越贵越划算,价值为正The long has the right to buy at the lower agreed price; the more expensive the spot, the better, so value is positive
答案 C。约定价低于现货即多头浮盈。Answer C. An agreed price below the spot gives the long an unrealized gain.

13. 到期时(t=T)远期多头价值等于:At maturity (t = T), the long forward value equals: 补充Extra

  • A. V_T = S_T − F₀(T),即到期现货与约定价之差V_T = S_T − F₀(T), the difference between the maturity spot and the agreed price
  • B. V_T = F₀ − S_TV_T = F₀ − S_T
  • C. V_T = 0V_T = 0
答案 A。到期价值就是现货减约定价。Answer A. The maturity value is the spot minus the agreed price.
1. 远期合约卖方到期时的收益定义为：1. The payoff to the seller of a forward contract at expiration is defined as the: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 远期价格加上到期时标的价值。forward price plus the value of the underlying at expiration.
  • B. 远期价格减去到期时标的价值。forward price minus the value of the underlying at expiration.
  • C. 到期时标的价值减去远期价格。value of the underlying at expiration minus the forward price.
答案 B。远期卖方到期时交出资产(市值 ST)、收进约定的远期价 F₀(T),所以他的收益 = F₀(T) − ST(收到的 − 交出的)。买方正好相反 = ST − F₀(T)。这是一对零和。Answer B. At expiration the forward seller delivers the asset (worth ST) and receives the agreed forward price F₀(T), so the seller's payoff = F₀(T) − ST (received − delivered). The buyer is the mirror image = ST − F₀(T); the two net to zero.
2. 一份远期协议具有以下条款：
起始时即期价格$275
远期价格$285
股数2,000
到期时若即期价格为$282，则对卖方的价值为：2. A forward agreement has the following terms:
Spot price at inception$275
Forward price$285
Number of shares2,000
At expiration, if the spot price is $282, the value to the seller is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. −$6,000−$6,000
  • B. $6,000$6,000
  • C. $14,000$14,000
答案 B。对卖方的价值 = (F₀(T) − ST) × 数量。卖方锁定了高卖价 285,而现价跌到 282,对他有利:(285 − 282) × 2,000 = $6,000。若换成买方视角则是 −$6,000。Answer B. Value to the seller = (F₀(T) − ST) × quantity. The seller locked in the higher price 285 while spot fell to 282, which favors the seller: (285 − 282) × 2,000 = $6,000. From the buyer's side it would be −$6,000.
3. 投资者观察到某标的资产价格为$20，随即签订一份一年后以$10买入该标的的远期合约。在合约起始时，该远期合约的价值最接近：3. An investor observes that the price of an underlying asset is $20. The investor immediately enters into a forward contract to purchase the underlying asset in one year at a price of $10. At contract initiation, the value of the forward contract is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. $0$0
  • B. $10$10
  • C. $30$30
答案 A。关键概念:合约起始时,远期价值必为 0——它既不是资产也不是负债,双方此刻都不占便宜(这正是均衡远期价的定义)。题中 $10 只是个"非均衡"的举例价,不影响"起始价值 = 0"这一结论。Answer A. Key concept: at initiation a forward's value is 0 — neither asset nor liability, with no advantage to either side (that is what an equilibrium forward price means). The $10 here is just a non-equilibrium example price and does not change the "initial value = 0" result.

§5 带收益/成本的远期定价§5 Forward Pricing with Carry Benefits/Costs

LOS 对应:LOS: describe the effect of carry on forward pricing。
F0(T) = [S0 − PV(收益) + PV(成本)] × (1 + r)T
等价:F0(T) = S0(1+r)T − FV(收益) + FV(成本)
项Item影响Effect
持有收益(股息/利息/便利收益)Carry benefit (dividends/interest/convenience yield)降低远期价格Lowers the forward price
持有成本(仓储/保险)Carry cost (storage/insurance)提高远期价格Raises the forward price
考点·持有成本的完整定价式:把"持有到期"的净成本算进远期价:F₀(T) = S₀(1+r)^T − (γ − θ)(1+r)^T,θ=持有成本(储存费,+)、γ=持有收益(股息/便利收益,−),净持有成本 = 成本 − 收益。特例:
① 无收益 → F₀=S₀(1+r)^T;
② 连续收益率 i → F₀=S₀·e^((r−i)T);
③ 净持有成本为零 → F₀=S₀(1+r)^T。储存费若在期末付,要先折现再计入。Exam · full cost-of-carry pricing: fold the net carry into the forward: F₀(T) = S₀(1+r)^T − (γ − θ)(1+r)^T, with θ = carrying costs (storage, +), γ = carry benefits (dividends/convenience yield, −), and net cost of carry = costs − benefits. Special cases:
① no yield → F₀=S₀(1+r)^T;
② continuous yield i → F₀=S₀·e^((r−i)T);
③ zero net carry → F₀=S₀(1+r)^T. A storage cost paid at maturity is discounted before being added.

14. 标的支付股息时远期价格怎么调整:How is the forward price adjusted when the underlying pays dividends: 官方题Official

  • A. 股息不影响远期价Dividends do not affect the forward price
  • B. F₀ = S₀(1+r)ᵀ − FV(股息);股息降低远期价F₀ = S₀(1+r)ᵀ − FV(dividends); dividends lower the forward price
  • C. 股息提高远期价Dividends raise the forward price
答案 B。持有收益扣减远期价。Answer B. Carry benefits reduce the forward price.

15. 若市场远期价格高于无套利价格,如何套利:If the market forward price is above the no-arbitrage price, how to arbitrage: 官方题Official

  • A. 买入远期、卖空现货Buy the forward and short the spot
  • B. 无法套利No arbitrage possible
  • C. 卖出(高估的)远期、同时借钱买入现货持有到期交割(cash-and-carry)Sell the (overpriced) forward and simultaneously borrow to buy the spot and hold to delivery (cash-and-carry)
答案 C。卖高估远期、持有现货锁定价差。Answer C. Sell the overpriced forward and hold the spot to lock in the gap.

16. 便利收益(convenience yield)如何影响远期价:How does convenience yield affect the forward price: 官方题Official

  • A. 属于持有收益,降低远期价格It is a carry benefit and lowers the forward price
  • B. 提高远期价格It raises the forward price
  • C. 不影响远期价格It does not affect the forward price
答案 A。持有现货的隐性好处压低远期价。Answer A. The implicit benefit of holding the spot depresses the forward price.

17. cash-and-carry 套利涉及哪些操作:What operations does cash-and-carry arbitrage involve: 官方题Official

  • A. 只买入期权Only buy an option
  • B. 借钱买现货 + 卖出远期,持有到期交割还款,锁定价差Borrow to buy the spot + sell the forward, hold to delivery and repay, locking in the gap
  • C. 卖空现货 + 买入远期Short the spot + buy the forward
答案 B。持有现货并卖出高估远期。Answer B. Hold the spot and sell the overpriced forward.
1. 一只股息率3%的股票在现货市场以$50交易。若年无风险利率5%，则该股票的6个月远期价格最接近：1. A stock with a dividend yield of 3% is trading in the spot market at $50. If the annual risk-free rate is 5%, the 6-month forward price of the stock is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. $49.50$49.50
  • B. $50.50$50.50
  • C. $51.27$51.27
答案 B。带连续股息率的远期价:F₀(T)=S₀·e^((r−i)T)。股息 i 会降低远期价(持有股票有分红这个好处)。= 50·e^((0.05−0.03)×0.5)=50·e^0.01 = $50.50。Answer B. Forward price with a continuous dividend yield: F₀(T)=S₀·e^((r−i)T). The yield i lowers the forward (holding the stock earns dividends). = 50·e^((0.05−0.03)×0.5)=50·e^0.01 = $50.50.
2. 若净持有成本为零，则大宗商品的远期价格最可能：2. If the net cost of carry is zero, the forward price of a commodity is most likely: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 小于商品即期价格按无风险利率在合约期内的复利值less than the commodity's spot price compounded at the risk-free rate over the life of the contract
  • B. 等于商品即期价格按无风险利率在合约期内的复利值equal to the commodity's spot price compounded at the risk-free rate over the life of the contract
  • C. 大于商品即期价格按无风险利率在合约期内的复利值greater than the commodity's spot price compounded at the risk-free rate over the life of the contract
答案 B。净持有成本 = 持有成本 − 持有收益。当它为零时,远期价就退化为"即期价按无风险利率复利":F₀(T)=S₀(1+r)^T。所以既不低也不高,恰好等于复利后的即期价。Answer B. Net cost of carry = costs − benefits. When it is zero, the forward reduces to the spot compounded at the risk-free rate: F₀(T)=S₀(1+r)^T. So it is neither below nor above, but exactly equal to the compounded spot.
3. 分析师获得以下信息：原油当前即期价$120/桶；无风险利率3%（年复利）；期货合约距结算182天；储存成本$5/桶，于期货合约末支付。按每年365天，原油每桶期货价格最接近：3. An analyst gathers the following information: the current spot price of crude oil is $120 per barrel; the risk-free rate is 3% with annual compounding; a futures contract has 182 days until settlement; the storage cost is $5 per barrel, payable at the end of the futures contract. Based on 365 days per year, the futures price per barrel of crude oil is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. $126.78$126.78
  • B. $126.86$126.86
  • C. $126.93$126.93
答案 A。储存成本是"持有成本",要加进去;题目说成本在合约末支付,所以先折成现值再一起复利:f₀(T)=[S₀+PV(储存)](1+r)^T = [120 + 5×(1.03)^(−182/365)]×(1.03)^(182/365) ≈ $126.78。Answer A. Storage is a carrying cost, so it is added; since it is paid at maturity, take its present value then compound: f₀(T)=[S₀+PV(storage)](1+r)^T = [120 + 5×(1.03)^(−182/365)]×(1.03)^(182/365) ≈ $126.78.

§6 期货定价与每日盯市§6 Futures Pricing & Daily Mark-to-Market

LOS 对应:LOS: compare the pricing and value of futures and forwards。

期货定价逻辑与远期相同(无套利、持有成本),但因每日盯市(MTM):每天盈亏结算进保证金账户,合约价值每日重置为零。所以期货没有像远期那样累积的合约价值——盈亏已每日兑现。若利率与期货价格相关,期货与远期价格会有细微差异,但一级通常视为近似相等。保证金:初始保证金、维持保证金、追加保证金(margin call)。Futures pricing logic is the same as forwards (no-arbitrage, cost of carry), but because of daily mark-to-market (MTM): each day's gains/losses settle into the margin account and the contract value resets to zero daily. So futures have no accumulated contract value like forwards — gains/losses are realized daily. If interest rates correlate with the futures price, futures and forward prices differ slightly, but Level I usually treats them as approximately equal. Margin: initial margin, maintenance margin, margin call.

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

期货 vs 远期:每日盯市

期货每日盯市(mark-to-market),盈亏当日以现金结算、保证金账户随行就市;远期到期一次性结算。清算所 + 保证金机制使期货违约风险极低。

利率相关性带来的价差

若利率与期货价正相关:价格上涨时盈利可按更高利率再投资、下跌时亏损可按更低利率融资 → 对多头有利 → 期货价略高于远期价;负相关则反之;利率恒定时两者相等。

易错对比

① 盯市 → 每日现金流、再投资风险;② 远期有交易对手信用风险、期货几乎没有;③ 只有利率与标的相关时期货≠远期价。

Futures vs forwards: daily mark-to-market

Futures are marked to market daily — gains/losses settle in cash each day through the margin account; a forward settles once at maturity. The clearinghouse + margin make futures' default risk very low.

The rate-correlation spread

If rates are positively correlated with the futures price: gains can be reinvested at higher rates and losses financed at lower rates → favors the long → futures price slightly above the forward; negative correlation reverses it; with constant rates they are equal.

Common traps

① MTM → daily cash flows and reinvestment risk; ② forwards carry counterparty credit risk, futures almost none; ③ futures ≠ forward price only when rates correlate with the underlying.

18. 期货和远期的定价逻辑相同吗:Do futures and forwards share the same pricing logic: 官方题Official

  • A. 完全不同Entirely different
  • B. 期货不用无套利定价Futures do not use no-arbitrage pricing
  • C. 相同(无套利、持有成本);差异在结算方式(期货每日盯市)Yes (no-arbitrage, cost of carry); the difference is in settlement (futures are marked to market daily)
答案 C。定价逻辑一致,差异在盯市结算。Answer C. The pricing logic is the same; the difference is mark-to-market settlement.

19. 每日盯市对期货合约价值有何影响:How does daily mark-to-market affect a futures contract's value: 官方题Official

  • A. 每日结算盈亏,合约价值每日重置为零,不累积Gains/losses are settled daily, resetting the contract value to zero each day without accumulating
  • B. 价值不断累积Value keeps accumulating
  • C. 价值永远为正Value is always positive
答案 A。盯市使浮动盈亏每日兑现、价值归零。Answer A. Mark-to-market realizes unrealized P/L daily, resetting value to zero.

20. 什么是初始保证金和维持保证金:What are initial margin and maintenance margin: 官方题Official

  • A. 初始保证金是账户下限Initial margin is the account floor
  • B. 初始=开仓须存入的金额;维持=账户不得低于的下限,跌破则追加(margin call)Initial = the amount to deposit to open a position; maintenance = the floor the account must not fall below, triggering a top-up (margin call) if breached
  • C. 两者含义相同They mean the same thing
答案 B。跌破维持保证金触发追加。Answer B. Breaching maintenance margin triggers a margin call.

21. 期货保证金与股票融资保证金的概念区别是:The conceptual difference between futures margin and stock-margin borrowing is: 补充Extra

  • A. 两者完全相同They are identical
  • B. 期货保证金也是借款Futures margin is also a loan
  • C. 期货保证金是履约保证金(非借款)、每日盯市;股票保证金是借款购股的自有比例Futures margin is a performance bond (not a loan), marked to market daily; stock margin is the own-equity portion of borrowing to buy shares
答案 C。一个是履约担保,一个是杠杆借款。Answer C. One is a performance guarantee, the other leveraged borrowing.

22. 无套利定价的自由借贷、卖空假设放松会怎样:What happens when the no-arbitrage assumptions of free borrowing/lending and short-selling are relaxed: 补充Extra

  • A. 交易成本、卖空限制会使实际价格在无套利价格附近一个区间内波动,而非精确相等Trading costs and short-selling limits make the actual price fluctuate within a band around the no-arbitrage price rather than exactly equal it
  • B. 价格仍精确相等The price still exactly equals it
  • C. 价格完全无关The price is entirely unrelated
答案 A。摩擦形成无套利带而非单点。Answer A. Frictions create a no-arbitrage band rather than a single point.
1. 期货合约的：1. A futures contract’s: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 盯市直到到期才结算。mark-to-market is not settled until maturity.
  • B. 价格在合约到期前保持不变。price remains fixed until the contract matures.
  • C. 变动保证金降低对手方信用风险。variation margin reduces counterparty credit risk.
答案 C。期货每天盯市(mark-to-market):每日把浮盈浮亏结清、交换变动保证金,于是敞口每天归零 → 降低对手方信用风险。A、B 说反了:期货每日结算(不是到期才结)、价格每日波动(是远期价在存续期内保持不变)。Answer C. Futures are marked to market daily: gains/losses are settled and variation margin exchanged each day, resetting exposure to zero → lower counterparty credit risk. A and B are reversed: futures settle daily (not only at maturity), and their price moves daily (it is the forward price that stays fixed over the life).
2. 远期价格与期货价格之差由下列何者决定？2. The differential between forward and futures prices is determined by which of the following? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅利率波动率Interest rate volatility only
  • B. 仅期货价格与利率的相关性The correlation between futures prices and interest rates only
  • C. 利率波动率与期货价格–利率相关性两者Both interest rate volatility and the correlation between futures prices and interest rates
答案 C。远期价与期货价是否有差,取决于两件事同时成立:利率的波动率,以及期货价格与利率的相关性。只要利率恒定或与期货价不相关,两者价格就相同。故选"两者都要"。Answer C. Whether forward and futures prices differ depends on both: the volatility of interest rates and the correlation between the futures price and rates. If rates are constant or uncorrelated with the futures price, the two are equal. Hence "both."
3. 其他条件相同，在下列何种情况下远期合约价格最可能高于期货合约价格：3. All else being equal, the price of a forward contract is most likely higher than the price of a futures contract if interest rates are: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 与期货价格负相关negatively correlated with futures prices
  • B. 与期货价格不相关uncorrelated with futures prices
  • C. 与期货价格正相关positively correlated with futures prices
答案 A。直觉:期货每日结算,盈亏要再投资。若期货价与利率负相关(赚钱时利率往往在降),多头再投资吃亏,期货相对不利 → 远期价更高。正相关利好期货,零相关则两者相等。Answer A. Intuition: futures settle daily, so gains/losses are reinvested. If the futures price is negatively correlated with rates (you gain when rates tend to fall), the long reinvests at worse rates, making futures less attractive → the forward price is higher. Positive correlation favors futures; zero correlation makes them equal.

§2 利率远期合约与远期利率§2 Interest-Rate Forward Contracts & Forward Rates

LOS 对应：explain how forward rates are determined for interest rate forward contracts and describe their uses。

Forward Rate Agreement，FRA 允许双方锁定未来某一期间的借贷利率，但通常只按利息差额现金结算，并不实际交换贷款本金。A Forward Rate Agreement (FRA) lets two parties lock in the borrowing/lending rate for a future period, but usually settles only the interest difference in cash, without actually exchanging loan principal.

(1 + zm)m × (1 + fm,n)n−m = (1 + zn)n
fm,n = {[(1+zn)n/(1+zm)m]1/(n−m)} − 1
例题

一年期即期利率 3%，两年期即期利率 4%，则一年后开始的一年期远期利率为 (1.04)2/1.03−1 = 5.01%。这是无套利隐含利率，不等于对未来即期利率的无偏预测。With a one-year spot rate of 3% and a two-year spot rate of 4%, the one-year forward rate starting one year out is (1.04)2/1.03−1 = 5.01%. This is the no-arbitrage implied rate, not an unbiased forecast of the future spot rate.

考点·隐含远期利率与凸性偏差:
① 隐含远期利率(IFR):由即期(zero)利率推出——先由零息债价反解 z₂、z₃,再用 (1+z₃)³ = (1+z₂)²·(1+IFR₂,₁) 解出"2 年后起的 1 年"远期利率。
② 凸性偏差(convexity bias):FRA 带折现结构,其隐含远期利率随折现期变长而偏差变大;利率期货每日结算、无此折现 → 无凸性偏差。故折现期越长的 FRA 偏差越大。Exam · implied forward rate & convexity bias:
① Implied forward rate (IFR): from spot (zero) rates — back out z₂, z₃ from zero-coupon prices, then solve (1+z₃)³ = (1+z₂)²·(1+IFR₂,₁) for the "1-year rate, 2 years forward."
② Convexity bias: an FRA carries a discounting structure, so its implied forward is biased, and the bias grows with a longer discounting period; interest-rate futures settle daily with no such discounting → no convexity bias. The longer-discounting FRA has the larger bias.
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

利率远期与 FRA

远期利率协议(FRA)锁定未来某期的借贷利率。约定一个远期利率,到期与实际参考利率(如市场利率)比较,按利差的现值现金结算。

远期利率从即期利率推出

无套利下,「先存短期再滚动」应等于「直接存长期」:(1+z2)^2 = (1+z1)(1+f),解出隐含远期利率 f。这体现即期利率曲线内含的未来利率预期。

易错对比

① FRA 结算是利差的现值(提前贴现),不是到期额;② 远期利率是隐含值,非预测;③ 长端即期率由各段远期率复合而成。

Interest-rate forwards & FRAs

A forward rate agreement (FRA) locks a borrowing/lending rate for a future period. It fixes a forward rate; at settlement it is compared to the realized reference rate and settled in cash for the present value of the rate difference.

Forward rate from spot rates

By no-arbitrage, "roll short then reinvest" must equal "invest long": (1+z2)^2 = (1+z1)(1+f), solving for the implied forward rate f — the future rate embedded in the spot curve.

Common traps

① An FRA settles the present value of the rate difference (discounted early), not the maturity amount; ② the forward rate is an implied value, not a forecast; ③ long spot rates compound the segment forward rates.

2. 无套利远期利率是否必然等于未来即期利率:Does the no-arbitrage forward rate necessarily equal the future spot rate:

  • A. 不必然;它由当前期限结构的无套利关系决定,不是保证实现的预测Not necessarily; it is set by the no-arbitrage relationship of the current term structure, not a guaranteed prediction
  • B. 必然精确相等Necessarily exactly equal
  • C. 永远高于未来即期利率Always above the future spot rate
答案 A。远期利率是隐含利率,并非对未来即期的无偏预测。Answer A. The forward rate is an implied rate, not an unbiased predictor of the future spot.
1. 2年期与3年期政府基准零息债券价格分别为96和93（每100面值）。自今起2年后的1年隐含远期利率最接近：1. Two-year and three-year government benchmark zero-coupon bonds are priced at 96 and 93 (per 100 face value), respectively. The implied one-year forward rate in two years’ time is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 3.00%3.00%
  • B. 3.23%3.23%
  • C. 3.36%3.36%
答案 B。两步:
① 由零息债价反推即期(spot)利率:96=100/(1+z₂)²→z₂=2.0621%;93=100/(1+z₃)³→z₃=2.4485%。
② 隐含远期利率把"3 年"拆成"2 年 + 之后 1 年":IFR₂,₁=(1+z₃)³/(1+z₂)²−1 = 1.075269/1.041667 − 1 = 3.23%。Answer B. Two steps:
① back out spot rates from the zero prices: 96=100/(1+z₂)²→z₂=2.0621%; 93=100/(1+z₃)³→z₃=2.4485%. ② the implied forward splits "3 years" into "2 years then 1 more": IFR₂,₁=(1+z₃)³/(1+z₂)²−1 = 1.075269/1.041667 − 1 = 3.23%.
2. 下列哪种利率衍生品最可能具有最大的凸性偏差(convexity bias)？2. Which of the following interest rate derivatives most likely has the largest convexity bias? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 基于1个月市场参考利率的远期利率协议Forward rate agreement on a 1-month market reference rate
  • B. 基于3个月市场参考利率的远期利率协议Forward rate agreement on a 3-month market reference rate
  • C. 基于3个月市场参考利率的利率期货Interest rate futures contract on a 3-month market reference rate
答案 B。凸性偏差(convexity bias)来自 FRA 的折现结构,且随折现期越长越大。3 个月 MRR 的折现期比 1 个月长 → 偏差最大。利率期货每日结算、没有这种折现,故不产生凸性偏差,排除 C。Answer B. Convexity bias arises from the FRA's discounting and grows with a longer discounting period. A 3-month MRR discounts over a longer horizon than 1-month → largest bias. Interest-rate futures settle daily with no such discounting, so no convexity bias — rule out C.

§3 FRA 的经济用途与结算方向§3 The Economic Use & Settlement Direction of an FRA

风险暴露Risk exposure适合头寸Suitable position何时受益When it benefits
未来需要借款，担心利率上升Will need to borrow in the future, worried rates riseLong FRA：付固定、收浮动Long FRA: pay fixed, receive floating结算时市场利率高于合约利率When the market rate at settlement is above the contract rate
未来将投资资金，担心利率下降Will invest funds in the future, worried rates fallShort FRA：收固定、付浮动Short FRA: receive fixed, pay floating结算时市场利率低于合约利率When the market rate at settlement is below the contract rate

FRA 通常在贷款期开始时结算，但利息差原本对应期末，因此需按市场利率折现：An FRA usually settles at the start of the loan period, but the interest difference originally corresponds to the period end, so it must be discounted at the market rate:

Long FRA 结算额 = N(Rmkt−RFRA)δ / [1 + Rmktδ]

其中 N 为名义本金，δ 为计息期占一年比例。正值表示多头收款。where N is the notional principal and δ is the accrual period as a fraction of a year. A positive value means the long receives payment.

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

FRA 的经济用途与结算方向

FRA 用来对冲/锁定未来利率。约定方向:多头 FRA(相当于未来借款方)在利率上升时获利——因为它锁定了较低的借款利率;空头(未来放贷方)在利率下降时获利。

机制

企业预期未来要借款、担心利率上升,可买入(做多)FRA:若利率真的升,FRA 的正收益抵消更高的借款成本,净成本被锁定在约定利率。

易错对比

① 利率↑ → 多头 FRA(借款方)赚;② 利率↓ → 空头(放贷方)赚;③ 结算金按利差现值在期初支付。

Economic use & settlement direction of an FRA

An FRA is used to hedge/lock a future rate. Direction: the long FRA (like a future borrower) gains when rates rise — it locked in a lower borrowing rate; the short (future lender) gains when rates fall.

Mechanism

A firm expecting to borrow and fearing higher rates buys (goes long) the FRA: if rates do rise, the FRA's gain offsets the higher borrowing cost, locking the net cost at the agreed rate.

Common traps

① Rates ↑ → the long FRA (borrower) profits; ② rates ↓ → the short (lender) profits; ③ settlement is the PV of the rate difference paid at the start of the period.

3. 未来借款人担心利率上升,应持有 FRA 哪个方向:A future borrower fearing rising rates should hold which side of an FRA:

  • A. Long FRA,付固定、收浮动Long the FRA, pay fixed, receive floating
  • B. Short FRA,收固定、付浮动Short the FRA, receive fixed, pay floating
  • C. 不需要持有 FRANo need to hold an FRA
答案 A。多头 FRA 在利率上升时受益,锁定借款成本。Answer A. A long FRA benefits when rates rise, locking in the borrowing cost.
1. 当市场参考利率升至高于初始固定利率时，下列哪种衍生品实现收益？1. Which of the following derivatives realize a gain as the market reference rate rises above the initial fixed rate? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅远期利率协议多头Long forward rate agreements only
  • B. 仅利率期货空头Short interest rate futures contracts only
  • C. 远期利率协议多头与利率期货空头两者Both long forward rate agreements and short interest rate futures contracts
答案 C。MRR(浮动利率)上升到高于固定利率时:
① FRA 多头(收浮动、付固定)获益;
② 利率期货空头获益——因为期货价=100−利率,利率升则价跌,空头赚。两者都赚,选"两者"。Answer C. When MRR (the floating rate) rises above the fixed rate:
① the FRA long (receive floating, pay fixed) gains;
② the rate-futures short gains — since futures price = 100 − rate, a higher rate lowers the price and the short profits. Both gain → "both."

远期价值(多头)Forward value (long)Vₜ = Sₜ − F₀/(1+r)^(T−t);初始=0Vₜ = Sₜ − F₀/(1+r)^(T−t); initial = 0
带carry定价Pricing with carryF₀ = S₀(1+r)ᵀ − FV(收益) + FV(成本)F₀ = S₀(1+r)ᵀ − FV(benefits) + FV(costs)
期货 vs 远期Futures vs forwards定价逻辑相同;期货每日盯市、价值每日归零Same pricing logic; futures mark to market daily, value resets to zero daily

这一讲讲两件事:互换(把它看成"一串远期"就通了)和期权的基础(收益图、内在价值与时间价值、哪些因素让期权更值钱)。期权的收益公式和"影响因素方向"是必考。This lecture covers two things: swaps (which click once you see them as 'a string of forwards') and option basics (payoff diagrams, intrinsic and time value, and which factors make an option more valuable). The option payoff formulas and the 'direction of each factor' are key exam points.

§1 互换:一串远期的组合§1 Swaps: A Combination of Forwards

LOS 对应:LOS: describe how swaps are equivalent to a series of forward contracts。
🔰 零基础讲解:互换 = 定期"交换现金流"的约定

利率互换🔄 最常见的"普通香草"利率互换:A 每期付固定利率、收浮动利率;B 反过来。相当于把"浮动利率贷款"换成"固定利率贷款"。把每一期的交换看成一份小远期,一整个互换就是一串到期日不同的远期打包在一起。:双方约定在未来一系列日期交换现金流(如固定换浮动)。An interest-rate swap🔄 The most common "plain vanilla" interest-rate swap: A pays a fixed rate and receives floating each period; B does the reverse. It's like converting a "floating-rate loan" into a "fixed-rate loan." Viewing each period's exchange as a small forward, a whole swap is a bundle of forwards with different maturities.: the two parties agree to exchange cash flows on a series of future dates (e.g., fixed for floating).

普通香草利率互换(plain vanilla):一方付固定利率、收浮动;另一方相反。本金(名义)通常不交换,只交换利息差额。互换 = 一系列远期的组合,也可看成一份固定利率债券与一份浮动利率债券的多空组合。Plain vanilla interest-rate swap: one party pays a fixed rate and receives floating; the other does the reverse. The (notional) principal is usually not exchanged, only the interest difference. A swap = a combination of a series of forwards, and can also be seen as a long-short combination of a fixed-rate bond and a floating-rate bond.

考点·互换 = 一串"非市场化"远期,合计价值为零:互换用单一固定利率把内嵌各期远期打包,而每期真实远期价并不相同 → 有的隐含远期价值为正、有的为负,但设计成合计恰为零,于是互换起始价值 = 0(与 FRA/远期一样起始不换现金)。这正是"互换与一串 FRA 何时最相似""互换起始现金流"的考点。Exam · a swap = a strip of off-market forwards summing to zero: a swap packages its embedded per-period forwards at a single fixed rate, though each period's true forward price differs → some embedded forwards are positive, some negative, but by design they sum to exactly zero, so the swap's initiation value = 0 (no cash at inception, like an FRA/forward). This is the point behind "when is a swap most like a strip of FRAs" and "a swap's initiation cash flow."
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

互换 = 一串远期的组合

互换可拆成一系列不同到期日的远期。普通利率互换 = 固定利率换浮动利率;起始时价值为 0,固定利率(swap rate)被设成使固定腿与浮动腿现值相等。

机制

浮动腿每期重置为市场利率,其现值在重置日回到面值;固定腿是一串等额支付。令两腿现值相等即解出 swap rate——本质是「一篮子远期利率」的加权平均。

易错对比

① 互换初始价值 0、但存续期随利率变动;② swap 不是单一远期,而是一串;③ 固定腿付款方在利率上升时头寸增值(类似一串多头 FRA)。

A swap = a bundle of forwards

A swap decomposes into a series of forwards with different maturities. A plain-vanilla interest-rate swap = fixed for floating; at inception its value is 0, with the fixed rate (swap rate) set so the fixed and floating legs have equal present value.

Mechanism

The floating leg resets to the market rate each period and prices to par on reset dates; the fixed leg is a stream of level payments. Equating the two PVs gives the swap rate — essentially a weighted average of forward rates.

Common traps

① A swap's initial value is 0 but changes over life as rates move; ② a swap is not one forward but a series; ③ the fixed-rate payer gains when rates rise (like a strip of long FRAs).

1. 互换本质上等价于:A swap is essentially equivalent to: 官方题Official

  • A. 一系列远期合约的组合;也可看成固定利率债与浮动利率债的多空组合A combination of a series of forward contracts; also viewable as a long/short combination of a fixed-rate bond and a floating-rate bond
  • B. 一份期权An option
  • C. 一只股票A stock
答案 A。互换可拆解为一串远期。Answer A. A swap can be decomposed into a string of forwards.

2. 普通香草利率互换交换什么:What does a plain-vanilla interest-rate swap exchange: 官方题Official

  • A. 交换股票Exchanges stock
  • B. 固定利率与浮动利率的利息现金流;名义本金通常不交换Fixed-rate and floating-rate interest cash flows; the notional principal is usually not exchanged
  • C. 交换名义本金Exchanges the notional principal
答案 B。只交换利息现金流,本金作计息基础。Answer B. Only interest cash flows are exchanged; the principal is the basis for interest.
1. 一系列覆盖相同期间、使用相同市场参考利率的远期利率协议与一份利率互换合约，最可能具有相同的：1. A series of forward rate agreements and an interest rate swap contract covering the same periods and using the same market reference rate will most likely have the same: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 固定利率fixed rates
  • B. 起始现金流cash flows upfront
  • C. 结算现金流settlement cash flows
答案 B。把互换看成"一串远期"。共同点是起始现金流都为 0(签约时不换钱)。不同点:各期 FRA 有各自不同的固定利率、期初一次结算;而互换只有一个恒定固定利率、在各期末定期结算。故只有"起始现金流"相同。Answer B. Think of a swap as a strip of forwards. Their common feature is a zero cash flow at initiation. Differences: each FRA has its own fixed rate and settles once up front; a swap has a single constant fixed rate settling periodically at period-ends. So only the "initiation cash flow" matches.
2. 互换在下列何种情况下最类似于一系列远期合约：2. A swap is most likely similar to a series of forward contracts when: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 所有远期合约按使其合计价值为零的方式构建。all forward contracts are created with the combined value equal to zero.
  • B. 所有远期合约都按远期市场形成的价格签订。all forward contracts are entered into at the price created in the forward market.
  • C. 每个互换支付日多头远期的价值与空头远期的价值相匹配。the value of the long forward contracts are matched with the value of the short forward contracts at each swap payment date.
答案 A。互换用一个统一的固定价把内嵌的各期远期"非市场化"地打包:有的远期价值为正、有的为负,但设计成合计为零(这样互换起始价值才为 0)。所以最贴切的是"各远期合计价值为零"。Answer A. A swap packages its embedded per-period forwards "off-market" at one uniform fixed price: some forwards are worth positive, some negative, but they are set to sum to zero (so the swap's initial value is 0). Hence "all forwards constructed so their total value is zero."

§2 互换的定价与估值§2 Pricing & Valuation of Swaps

LOS 对应:LOS: describe the pricing and valuation of interest rate swaps。

定价(pricing)=确定使互换初始价值为零的固定利率(swap rate)。这个固定利率的设定,使得固定端现金流的现值 = 浮动端现金流的现值。估值(valuation)=存续期内,随利率变化,互换偏离零、对一方为正对另一方为负。核心思想仍是无套利:把互换拆成远期或债券组合来定价。Pricing = determining the fixed rate (swap rate) that makes the swap's initial value zero. This fixed rate is set so that the present value of the fixed-leg cash flows = the present value of the floating-leg cash flows. Valuation = over the life, as rates change, the swap deviates from zero, becoming positive for one party and negative for the other. The core idea is still no-arbitrage: price the swap by decomposing it into forwards or a bond combination.

考点·互换定期结算与估值方向:每期对固定支付方的净结算 = (MRR − 固定利率) × 名义本金(浮动收取方相反)。MRR 高于固定利率则固定支付方净收、否则净付。估值:MRR上升 → 固定利率收取方(=浮动支付方)应付浮动的现值增大 → 互换对其价值下降(对固定支付方则升值)。Exam · swap periodic settlement & valuation direction: each period's net settlement to the fixed-rate payer = (MRR − fixed) × notional (opposite for the floating receiver). If MRR exceeds fixed the fixed payer nets a receipt, else a payment. Valuation: when MRR rises, the fixed-rate receiver (= floating payer) owes a larger PV on the floating leg → the swap's value to them falls (and rises for the fixed payer).

3. 互换"定价"指确定什么:What does 'pricing' a swap mean determining: 官方题Official

  • A. 确定名义本金The notional principal
  • B. 确定浮动利率The floating rate
  • C. 确定使互换初始价值为零的固定利率(swap rate)The fixed rate (swap rate) that makes the swap's initial value zero
答案 C。swap rate 使初始价值为零。Answer C. The swap rate makes the initial value zero.

4. 互换存续期价值为什么会偏离零:Why does a swap's value deviate from zero over its life: 官方题Official

  • A. 利率变动使固定端与浮动端现值不再相等,对一方为正、对另一方为负Rate changes make the fixed leg's and floating leg's present values no longer equal — positive for one party, negative for the other
  • B. 因本金发生变化Because the principal changes
  • C. 价值永不偏离零Value never deviates from zero
答案 A。利率变动打破两端的初始平衡。Answer A. Rate changes break the two legs' initial balance.
1. 从固定利率收取方(fixed-rate receiver)的角度，若市场参考利率上升，则互换合约的价值：1. From the fixed-rate receiver’s perspective, if the market reference rate increases, the value of a swap contract: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 下降。decreases.
  • B. 不变。stays the same.
  • C. 上升。increases.
答案 A。固定利率收取方 = 浮动利率支付方:他付 MRR、收固定。MRR 上升会加大他"要付的浮动"的现值 → 互换对他价值下降。(反过来,浮动收取方在利率升时获益。)Answer A. The fixed-rate receiver = the floating-rate payer: pays MRR, receives fixed. A rise in MRR increases the present value of the floating leg he must pay → the swap's value to him falls. (Conversely, the floating receiver gains when rates rise.)
2. 一份$1000万、年付息的利率互换，固定互换利率1.95%。隐含远期利率为：
年隐含远期利率(%)
10.50
21.15
31.35
固定利率支付方在第3年的定期结算值预计最接近：2. A $10 million interest rate swap with annual payments has a fixed swap rate of 1.95%. The implied forward rates are:
YearImplied Forward Rate (%)
10.50
21.15
31.35
The periodic settlement value in Year 3 for the fixed-rate payer is expected to be closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. −$95,000−$95,000
  • B. −$60,000−$60,000
  • C. $60,000$60,000
答案 B。某期结算(对固定支付方)=(MRR − 固定利率)× 名义本金。第 3 年 MRR=1.35% 低于固定 1.95%,他吃亏:(0.0135 − 0.0195)×10,000,000 = −$60,000(负=净付出)。Answer B. A period's settlement (to the fixed payer) = (MRR − fixed) × notional. In year 3, MRR 1.35% is below fixed 1.95%, so he loses: (0.0135 − 0.0195)×10,000,000 = −$60,000 (negative = net pay).

LOS 对应:LOS: describe the characteristics of options。
术语Term含义Meaning

看跌期权 putPut option买方有权按行权价卖出标的The buyer has the right to sell the underlying at the strike price

5. 看涨与看跌期权分别赋予买方什么权利:What right does a call and a put option each give the buyer: 官方题Official

  • A. 两者权利相同The rights are the same
  • B. 看涨=按行权价买入的权利;看跌=按行权价卖出的权利Call = the right to buy at the strike; put = the right to sell at the strike
  • C. 看涨=卖出,看跌=买入Call = sell, put = buy
答案 B。call 买入权,put 卖出权。Answer B. Call is a right to buy, put a right to sell.

6. 欧式与美式期权的区别是:The difference between European and American options is: 官方题Official

  • A. 欧式可提前行权European can be exercised early
  • B. 两者行权规则相同Their exercise rules are the same
  • C. 欧式只能到期日行权;美式可到期前任意时点行权European can be exercised only at expiration; American can be exercised at any time before expiration
答案 C。美式行权更灵活。Answer C. American exercise is more flexible.

§4 实值/平值/虚值§4 In/At/Out-of-the-Money

LOS 对应:LOS: determine the moneyness of an option。
状态State看涨 callCall看跌 putPut

7. 看涨期权什么时候是实值(ITM):When is a call option in the money (ITM): 官方题Official

  • A. 标的现价 S > 行权价 XSpot price S > strike X
  • B. S < XS < X
  • C. S = XS = X
答案 A。现价高于行权价,看涨实值。Answer A. Spot above strike means the call is ITM.

8. 看跌期权什么时候是实值:When is a put option in the money: 官方题Official

  • A. S = XS = X
  • B. 标的现价 S < 行权价 XSpot price S < strike X
  • C. S > XS > X
答案 B。现价低于行权价,看跌实值。Answer B. Spot below strike means the put is ITM.
1. 实值程度(moneyness)最大的看跌期权，其行权价：1. A put option with the greatest moneyness has a strike price: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 小于标的价格less than the price of the underlying
  • B. 等于标的价格equal to the price of the underlying
  • C. 大于标的价格greater than the price of the underlying
答案 C。看跌期权:当标的价 ST 低于行权价 X 时为实值,实值程度 = X − ST。要"实值程度最大",就要 X 相对 ST 尽量大 → 行权价 大于标的价格。Answer C. A put is in-the-money when spot ST is below strike X, and its moneyness = X − ST. To be deepest in-the-money, X must be as far above ST as possible → strike greater than spot.
2. 若标的价格为$57，下列哪个期权多头头寸是虚值(out of the money)？2. If the price of the underlying is $57, which of the following long option positions is out of the money? A: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 行权价$60的看跌期权put with a strike price of $60
  • B. 行权价$50的看跌期权put with a strike price of $50
  • C. 行权价$50的看涨期权call with a strike price of $50
答案 B。虚值(OTM)= 现在行权不划算。ST=57:
① $60 看跌 → X>ST,实值;
② $50 看跌 → X不划算 → 虚值 ✓;
③ $50 看涨 → 50 买、市价 57,实值。故 B。Answer B. Out-of-the-money = exercising now is unfavorable. ST=57:
① $60 put → X>ST, ITM;
② $50 put → Xunfavorable → OTM ✓;
③ $50 call → buy at 50 vs 57, ITM. Hence B.
3. 其他条件相同，若同一标的的欧式看涨与欧式看跌期权的行权价值相等，则该看涨与看跌必然是：3. All else being equal, if the exercise values of a European call option and a European put option on the same underlying are equal, then the European call and the European put must be: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 实值期权in-the-money options
  • B. 平值期权at-the-money options
  • C. 虚值期权out-of-the-money options
答案 B。行权价值:看涨 = Max(0, ST−X),看跌 = Max(0, X−ST)。同一行权价下,若看涨为正则看跌必为 0,反之亦然;只有两者都为 0 时才相等,这恰好发生在 ST=X → 平值(ATM)。Answer B. Exercise values: call = Max(0, ST−X), put = Max(0, X−ST). At the same strike, if the call is positive the put is 0 and vice versa; they are equal only when both are 0, which happens exactly at ST=X → at-the-money.

§5 期权到期收益与盈亏§5 Option Payoff & Profit at Expiration 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: calculate the exercise value and profit of options at expiration。
看涨期权买方收益 = max(0, ST − X)    看跌期权买方收益 = max(0, X − ST)
买方盈亏 = 收益 − 权利金;卖方盈亏 = 权利金 − 收益(与买方相反)
符号Symbol含义Meaning
ST到期日标的价格The underlying price at expiration
X行权价The strike price
买方最大损失The buyer's maximum loss= 权利金(有权不行权)= the premium (has the right, need not exercise)
看涨买方最大收益The call buyer's maximum gain理论上无限(S 可无限涨);看跌买方最大收益 = X − 权利金Theoretically unlimited (S can rise without limit); the put buyer's maximum gain = X − premium
期权盈亏计算 官方题Official

买入行权价 X=$50 的看涨,权利金 $3。到期 ST=$58:收益 = max(0, 58−50) = $8,盈亏 = 8 − 3 = +$5。若 ST=$48:收益 = 0,盈亏 = −$3(损失权利金)。盈亏平衡点 = X + 权利金 = $53。Buy a call with strike X=$50, premium $3. At expiration ST=$58: payoff = max(0, 58−50) = $8, profit = 8 − 3 = +$5. If ST=$48: payoff = 0, profit = −$3 (lose the premium). Breakeven = X + premium = $53.

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

期权到期收益与盈亏

• 多头看涨:收益 = max(0, ST − X);盈亏 = 收益 − 权利金。
• 多头看跌:收益 = max(0, X − ST);盈亏 = 收益 − 权利金。
• 空头是买方的镜像(收权利金、承担对方行权)。

盈亏边界(必背)

• 买看涨:最大亏损 = 权利金,盈利无上限,盈亏平衡 = X + 权利金。
• 买看跌:最大盈利 = X − 权利金,盈亏平衡 = X − 权利金。
• 卖方与买方盈亏零和、方向相反。

易错对比

① 买方最多亏权利金、卖方风险大;② 看涨盈利无限、看跌盈利有上限(标的最低到 0);③ 盈亏平衡要把权利金算进去。

Option payoff & profit at expiration

• Long call: payoff = max(0, ST − X); profit = payoff − premium.
• Long put: payoff = max(0, X − ST); profit = payoff − premium.
• A short is the mirror of the buyer (receives premium, bears exercise).

P/L bounds (memorize)

• Long call: max loss = premium, gain unlimited, breakeven = X + premium.
• Long put: max gain = X − premium, breakeven = X − premium.
• Buyer and seller P/L are zero-sum, opposite in sign.

Common traps

① The buyer loses at most the premium, the seller's risk is large; ② call gain is unlimited, put gain is capped (spot can fall only to 0); ③ include the premium in breakeven.

9. 看涨期权买方的到期收益公式是:The maturity payoff formula for a call buyer is: 官方题Official

  • A. max(0, S_T − X)max(0, S_T − X)
  • B. max(0, X − S_T)max(0, X − S_T)
  • C. S_T − X(可为负)S_T − X (can be negative)
答案 A。看涨收益不为负,下限为 0。Answer A. A call payoff is non-negative, floored at 0.

10. 看跌期权买方的到期收益公式是:The maturity payoff formula for a put buyer is: 官方题Official

  • A. max(0, X − S_T)max(0, X − S_T)
  • B. max(0, S_T − X)max(0, S_T − X)
  • C. X − S_T(可为负)X − S_T (can be negative)
答案 A。看跌收益不为负,下限为 0。Answer A. A put payoff is non-negative, floored at 0.

11. 买入 X=$50 看涨、权利金 $3,S_T=$58 时盈亏为:Buy an X = $50 call, premium $3; the profit at S_T = $58 is: 官方题Official

  • A. +$8+$8
  • B. −$3−$3
  • C. +$5+$5
答案 C。收益 8 − 权利金 3 = +$5。Answer C. Payoff 8 − premium 3 = +$5.

12. 该看涨期权的盈亏平衡点是:The breakeven point of this call is: 官方题Official

  • A. $53$53
  • B. $50$50
  • C. $47$47
答案 A。X + 权利金 = 50 + 3 = $53。Answer A. X + premium = 50 + 3 = $53.

13. 期权买方的最大损失是:The maximum loss for an option buyer is: 官方题Official

  • A. 等于行权价Equal to the strike
  • B. 等于所付权利金(可放弃行权)Equal to the premium paid (can abandon exercise)
  • C. 理论上无限Theoretically unlimited
答案 B。买方损失以权利金为上限。Answer B. The buyer's loss is capped at the premium.

14. 看涨期权卖方的风险特征是:The risk profile of a call seller is: 官方题Official

  • A. 最大损失=权利金Max loss = the premium
  • B. 收益无限Unlimited gain
  • C. 最大收益=权利金,潜在损失(裸卖)理论无限,与买方镜像Max gain = the premium, potential loss (naked) theoretically unlimited, mirroring the buyer
答案 C。裸卖看涨风险无限、收益有限。Answer C. Selling a naked call has unlimited risk and limited gain.
1. 投资者以$5.75买入一份行权价$130的看涨期权。若该看涨期权到期价值为$17.80，则到期时标的价格最接近：1. An investor buys a call for $5.75 that has a strike price of $130. If the value at expiration for this call is $17.80, the price of the underlying at expiration is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. $112.20$112.20
  • B. $142.05$142.05
  • C. $147.80$147.80
答案 C。看涨到期收益 = Max(0, ST − X)。已知收益 17.80,行权价 130,且 17.80>0 说明是实值:17.80 = ST − 130 → ST = $147.80。(买价 5.75 只影响利润、不影响"收益/价值"。)Answer C. Call payoff at expiry = Max(0, ST − X). Given payoff 17.80 with X=130, and 17.80>0 means ITM: 17.80 = ST − 130 → ST = $147.80. (The 5.75 paid affects profit, not the payoff/value.)
2. 一份看涨期权具有以下特征：
到期时标的价值$2,020
行权价$2,100
看涨期权权利金$80
看涨期权卖方的利润最接近：2. A call option has the following characteristics:
Value of underlying at expiration$2,020
Exercise price$2,100
Call premium$80
The profit to the call seller is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. −$80−$80
  • B. $0$0
  • C. $80$80
答案 C。看涨卖方与买方镜像:卖方利润 = −Max(0, ST−X) + 权利金。ST=2,020 < X=2,100 → 期权作废,Max=0 → 卖方白收权利金:−0 + 80 = $80。这也是看涨卖方的最大利润 = 权利金。Answer C. The call seller mirrors the buyer: profit = −Max(0, ST−X) + premium. ST=2,020 < X=2,100 → the option expires worthless (Max=0) → the seller keeps the premium: −0 + 80 = $80. This is also the seller's maximum profit = the premium.
3. 一份看涨期权在创建之日具有以下特征：
行权价$20
期权权利金$3
若到期时标的价格为$17，则期权持有人的利润最接近：3. A call option had the following characteristics on the date it was created:
Exercise price$20
Option premium$3
If the price of the underlying is $17 at expiration, the profit to the option holder is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. −$3−$3
  • B. $0$0
  • C. $3$3
答案 A。看涨期权买方分两步:先算"到期收益(payoff)",再减"已付权利金"。
① 到期收益 = Max(0, ST − X):看涨给你"按行权价 X 买入"的权利。到期标的价 ST=17 < 行权价 X=20——花 20 买只值 17 的东西不划算,所以放弃行权,收益 = 0(Max 里那个 0 的含义:再差也只是 0)。
② 利润 = 收益 − 权利金:但买期权时已付出 $3 权利金(沉没成本,拿不回),所以利润 = 0 − 3 = −$3。这也是看涨买方的最大亏损 = 权利金。
排除:B($0)忘了减权利金;C(+$3)是卖方视角。Answer A. A call buyer's profit has two steps: first the payoff, then subtract the premium paid.
① Payoff = Max(0, ST − X). At expiry ST=17 < X=20 — buying at 20 something worth 17 makes no sense, so the holder lets it expire, payoff = 0.
② Profit = payoff − premium. But $3 was already paid (a sunk cost), so profit = 0 − 3 = −$3 — the call buyer's maximum loss = the premium.
Eliminate: B ($0) forgets the premium; C (+$3) is the seller's view.
4. 一份以$4卖出、行权价$40的看涨期权。若到期时标的价格为$43，则该期权对卖方的价值最接近：4. A call option that is sold for $4 has an exercise price of $40. If the price of the underlying is $43 at expiration, the value of the option to the seller is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. −$3，且卖方损失$1−$3, and the loss to the seller is $1
  • B. −$3，且卖方利润$1−$3, and the profit to the seller is $1
  • C. $3，且卖方损失$1$3, and the loss to the seller is $1
答案 B。两个概念要分清:价值(到期收益)与利润。卖方价值 = −Max(0, ST−X) = −Max(0, 43−40) = −$3(被行权,要贴 3);利润 = 价值 + 收到的权利金 = −3 + 4 = +$1。所以"价值 −$3、利润 +$1"。Answer B. Separate two ideas: value (payoff) vs profit. Seller's value = −Max(0, ST−X) = −Max(0, 43−40) = −$3 (assigned, pays 3); profit = value + premium received = −3 + 4 = +$1. Hence "value −$3, profit +$1."
5. 投资者获得一份欧式看跌期权及其标的以下信息：
行权价$29
期权购买价$2
购买时即期价格$28
若到期时标的价格为$27，则看跌期权买方的利润为：5. An investor gathers the following information about a European put option and its underlying:
Exercise price$29
Option purchase price$2
Spot price at the time of purchase$28
If the price of the underlying at expiration is $27, the profit for a buyer of the put is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. −$1−$1
  • B. $0$0
  • C. $2$2
答案 B。看跌买方利润 = Max(0, X − ST) − 权利金。ST=27 < X=29,实值,收益 = 29−27 = 2;再减已付权利金 2 → 利润 = 2 − 2 = $0(刚好保本)。A 忘了它是实值,C 忘了减权利金。Answer B. Put buyer's profit = Max(0, X − ST) − premium. ST=27 < X=29, ITM, payoff = 29−27 = 2; minus the 2 premium → profit = 2 − 2 = $0 (break-even). A forgets it is ITM; C forgets the premium.
6. 其他条件相同，若到期时标的价格超过行权价，看跌期权卖方到期时的期权价值最可能：6. All else being equal, if the price of the underlying at expiration exceeds the exercise price, the option value at expiration for the seller of a put most likely is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 小于看涨期权卖方到期时的期权价值less than the option value at expiration for the seller of a call
  • B. 等于看涨期权卖方到期时的期权价值equal to the option value at expiration for the seller of a call
  • C. 大于看涨期权卖方到期时的期权价值greater than the option value at expiration for the seller of a call
答案 C。当 ST > X 时:看跌卖方收益 = −Max(0, X−ST) = 0(看跌作废,他没损失);看涨卖方收益 = −Max(0, ST−X) < 0(被行权,要贴钱)。0 > 负数 → 看跌卖方的价值更大。Answer C. When ST > X: the put seller's payoff = −Max(0, X−ST) = 0 (put expires worthless, no loss); the call seller's payoff = −Max(0, ST−X) < 0 (assigned, pays out). 0 > a negative → the put seller's value is greater.
7. 投资者支付$5购买一份行权价$102的欧式看跌期权。到期时若标的价格为$100，则该看跌期权的价值为：7. An investor pays $5 for a European put option with an exercise price of $102. At expiration, if the price of the underlying is $100, the value of the put option is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. −$3−$3
  • B. $0$0
  • C. $2$2
答案 C。注意问的是价值不是利润。看跌到期价值 = Max(0, X − ST) = Max(0, 102 − 100) = $2。若减去买价 5 得 −3,那是利润——题目没问利润,别多减。Answer C. Note it asks for value, not profit. Put value at expiry = Max(0, X − ST) = Max(0, 102 − 100) = $2. Subtracting the 5 paid gives −3, which is profit — not asked, so do not subtract.
8. 一份美式看跌期权行权价 ¥5,000、一年后到期。标的当前价格 ¥4,200，无风险利率2%。该看跌期权的最大价值为：8. An American put has a strike price of ¥5,000 and expires in one year. The current price of the underlying is ¥4,200 and the risk-free rate is 2%. The maximum value of this put is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. ¥800¥800
  • B. ¥4,900¥4,900
  • C. ¥5,000¥5,000
答案 C。看跌收益 = Max(0, X − ST),标的价 ST 越低收益越大;极限是 ST = 0(股票跌到一文不值),此时收益 = X − 0 = 行权价。故看跌的最大价值 = 行权价 ¥5,000(利率/现价此处不影响这个上界)。Answer C. Put payoff = Max(0, X − ST) rises as ST falls; the extreme is ST = 0 (the stock worthless), giving X − 0 = the strike. So the put's maximum value = the strike, ¥5,000 (the rate and current price do not change this bound).
9. 若 ST 表示到期日标的价格、X 为期权行权价，则看涨期权卖方到期时的收益最好地描述为：9. If ST denotes the price of the underlying at the expiration date and X is the exercise price of the option, the payoff at expiration to a call seller is best described as: 真题模考Mock
  • A. −Max(0, ST − X)−Max(0, ST − X)
  • B. −Max(0, X − ST)−Max(0, X − ST)
  • C. Max(0, ST − X)Max(0, ST − X)
答案 A。看涨卖方与买方互为镜像:买方收益 = Max(0, ST−X),卖方就取负号 = −Max(0, ST−X)(实值时为负、否则为 0)。B 是看跌卖方,C 是看涨买方,故选 A。Answer A. The call seller mirrors the buyer: buyer's payoff = Max(0, ST−X), so the seller's is its negative = −Max(0, ST−X) (negative if ITM, else 0). B is the put seller, C is the call buyer, so A.
10. 下列信息与一份看跌期权及标的股票有关：
到期时股价$85
欧式看跌期权行权价$78
到期时该看跌期权对卖方的价值为：10. The following information relates to a put option and the underlying stock:
Stock price at expiration$85
European put strike price$78
The value of the put option to the option seller at expiration is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. −$7−$7
  • B. $0$0
  • C. $7$7
答案 B。看跌对持有人的收益 = Max(0, X − ST) = Max(0, 78 − 85) = 0(ST>X,看跌作废)。卖方收益是持有人的负数,也是 −0 = $0。故对卖方价值 = $0。Answer B. Put payoff to the holder = Max(0, X − ST) = Max(0, 78 − 85) = 0 (ST>X, expires worthless). The seller's payoff is the negative of the holder's, also −0 = $0. So value to the seller = $0.
11. 下列哪个欧式期权到期时价值最大？11. Which of the following European options has the greatest value at expiration? A: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 行权价72、标的价83的看涨期权call with an exercise price of 72 and an underlying priced at 83
  • B. 行权价83、标的价70的看涨期权call with an exercise price of 83 and an underlying priced at 70
  • C. 行权价70、标的价83的看跌期权put with an exercise price of 70 and an underlying priced at 83
答案 A。逐个算到期价值。看涨 = Max(0, ST−X),看跌 = Max(0, X−ST):(A) Max(0, 83−72)=11;(B) Max(0, 70−83)=0;(C) Max(0, 70−83)=0。最大是 A 的 11(它是实值看涨)。Answer A. Compute each expiry value. Call = Max(0, ST−X), put = Max(0, X−ST): (A) Max(0, 83−72)=11; (B) Max(0, 70−83)=0; (C) Max(0, 70−83)=0. The largest is A's 11 (an ITM call).

§6 内在价值与时间价值§6 Intrinsic Value & Time Value

LOS 对应:LOS: contrast the exercise value and time value of an option。
期权价值(权利金)= 内在价值 + 时间价值
成分Component含义Meaning
内在价值 intrinsicIntrinsic value立即行权的价值:看涨 = max(0, S−X);看跌 = max(0, X−S)The value of immediate exercise: call = max(0, S−X); put = max(0, X−S)
时间价值 time valueTime value= 权利金 − 内在价值;反映到期前标的可能变得更有利的可能性= premium − intrinsic value; reflects the chance the underlying becomes more favorable before expiration
到期时At expiration时间价值归零,期权价值 = 内在价值Time value goes to zero, option value = intrinsic value
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

内在价值与时间价值

期权价格 = 内在价值 + 时间价值。内在价值(看涨)= max(0, S − X),(看跌)= max(0, X − S)——即立即行权能得到的价值,不为负。时间价值 = 期权价 − 内在价值,永远 ≥ 0,反映到期前标的可能进一步有利变动的可能性。

机制

时间价值随到期临近而衰减,到期时归零(期权价 = 内在价值)。平值附近时间价值最大;深度实值/虚值时间价值很小。

易错对比

① 内在价值不为负(不利时=0);② 到期时时间价值=0;③ 波动率升高主要抬升时间价值。

Intrinsic value & time value

Option price = intrinsic value + time value. Intrinsic (call) = max(0, S − X), (put) = max(0, X − S) — the value from exercising now, never negative. Time value = price − intrinsic, always ≥ 0, reflecting the chance of further favorable moves before expiry.

Mechanism

Time value decays as expiry nears and is zero at expiration (price = intrinsic). It is largest near at-the-money and small when deep in- or out-of-the-money.

Common traps

① Intrinsic value isn't negative (0 when unfavorable); ② at expiry time value = 0; ③ higher volatility mainly lifts the time value.

15. 期权价值由哪两部分构成:An option's value consists of which two parts: 官方题Official

  • A. 内在价值 + 时间价值Intrinsic value + time value
  • B. 本金 + 利息Principal + interest
  • C. 股息 + 资本利得Dividend + capital gain
答案 A。期权费=内在价值+时间价值。Answer A. The premium = intrinsic value + time value.

16. 内在价值怎么算(看涨):How is intrinsic value computed (call): 官方题Official

  • A. max(0, S − X)max(0, S − X)
  • B. max(0, X − S)max(0, X − S)
  • C. S + XS + X
答案 A。看涨内在价值=现价超出行权价的部分。Answer A. A call's intrinsic value is the amount the spot exceeds the strike.

17. 时间价值在到期日等于:Time value at expiration equals: 官方题Official

  • A. 权利金The premium
  • B. 0——到期时期权价值 = 内在价值0 — at expiration option value = intrinsic value
  • C. 最大值The maximum
答案 B。时间价值随到期归零。Answer B. Time value decays to zero at expiration.

18. 为什么虚值期权仍有正的市场价格:Why does an out-of-the-money option still have a positive market price: 补充Extra

  • A. 因其内在价值为正Because its intrinsic value is positive
  • B. 完全是定价错误It is entirely a pricing error
  • C. 因为存在时间价值——到期前标的仍可能变得对期权有利Because of time value — before expiration the underlying may still move favorably
答案 C。虚值期权的价值全部来自时间价值。Answer C. An OTM option's value is entirely time value.
1. 一份距到期一个月的欧式看涨期权，若即期价格低于行权价，则该看涨期权最可能具有：1. For a European call option with one month until expiration, if the spot price is below the exercise price, the call option most likely has: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅正的时间价值positive time value only
  • B. 仅正的内在价值positive intrinsic value only
  • C. 正的时间价值与正的内在价值两者both positive time value and positive intrinsic value
答案 A。期权价值 = 内在价值 + 时间价值。虚值看涨(S正的时间价值。故只有正的时间价值。Answer A. Option value = intrinsic + time value. An OTM call (Spositive time value. Hence only positive time value.

§7 影响期权价值的因素§7 Factors Affecting Option Value 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: identify the factors that determine the value of an option and their effect。
因素上升Factor rising看涨 call 价值Call value看跌 put 价值Put value
标的现价 SUnderlying price S↑↓
行权价 XStrike price X↓↑
到期时间(美式)Time to expiration (American)↑↑
波动率 σVolatility σ↑↑
无风险利率 rRisk-free rate r↑↓
标的现金收益(股息)Underlying cash yield (dividends)↓↑
考点提示:
① 波动率上升,看涨和看跌都更值钱(不确定性=期权持有者的朋友,因为下行有限、上行开放)。
② 记忆:S↑利好看涨、X↑利好看跌;r↑利好看涨;股息利好看跌。
③ 到期时间对美式期权总是正向;对欧式看跌可能反向(个别情形),一级一般记"越长越值钱"。
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

影响期权价值的因素

• 标的价 S:升 → 看涨↑、看跌↓。
• 行权价 X:升 → 看涨↓、看跌↑。
• 波动率 σ:升 → 看涨、看跌都↑(尾部收益更大、下行有限)。
• 无风险利率 r:升 → 看涨↑、看跌↓。
• 到期时间:越长,美式期权越值钱;欧式看跌可能反向。
• 持有成本/收益:标的付息 → 看涨↓、看跌↑。

易错对比

① 波动率对看涨看跌都是正向(最爱考);② r 升 → 看涨升、看跌降;③ 更长到期未必让欧式看跌更值钱。

Factors affecting option value

• Underlying S: up → call ↑, put ↓.
• Strike X: up → call ↓, put ↑.
• Volatility σ: up → both call and put ↑ (bigger tails, limited downside).
• Risk-free rate r: up → call ↑, put ↓.
• Time to expiry: longer helps American options; a European put can move the other way.
• Carry cost/benefit: underlying pays income → call ↓, put ↑.

Common traps

① Volatility raises both calls and puts (a favorite); ② r up → call up, put down; ③ more time doesn't always make a European put worth more.

19. 标的价格上升对看涨、看跌价值的影响:The effect of a rise in the underlying price on call and put values: 官方题Official

  • A. 看涨价值上升,看跌价值下降Call value rises, put value falls
  • B. 看涨下降,看跌上升Call falls, put rises
  • C. 两者都上升Both rise
答案 A。标的涨利多看涨、利空看跌。Answer A. A rising underlying favors the call and hurts the put.

20. 波动率上升对看涨和看跌的影响:The effect of rising volatility on calls and puts: 官方题Official

  • A. 两者价值都上升——不确定性增加,下行有限、上行开放Both values rise — more uncertainty, with limited downside and open upside
  • B. 两者都下降Both fall
  • C. 看涨上升、看跌下降Call rises, put falls
答案 A。波动率对看涨、看跌均为正向。Answer A. Volatility is positive for both calls and puts.

21. 行权价越高,对看涨和看跌价值的影响:The effect of a higher strike on call and put values: 官方题Official

  • A. 看涨价值下降,看跌价值上升Call value falls, put value rises
  • B. 看涨上升,看跌下降Call rises, put falls
  • C. 两者都上升Both rise
答案 A。高行权价利空看涨、利多看跌。Answer A. A high strike hurts the call and favors the put.

22. 无风险利率上升对看涨和看跌的影响:The effect of a rise in the risk-free rate on calls and puts: 官方题Official

  • A. 看涨价值上升,看跌价值下降Call value rises, put value falls
  • B. 看涨下降,看跌上升Call falls, put rises
  • C. 两者都上升Both rise
答案 A。利率上升利多看涨、利空看跌。Answer A. A rising rate favors the call and hurts the put.

23. 标的支付股息对看涨和看跌的影响:The effect of the underlying paying dividends on calls and puts: 官方题Official

  • A. 两者都上升Both rise
  • B. 看涨价值下降、看跌价值上升(股息压低标的价格)Call value falls, put value rises (dividends depress the underlying price)
  • C. 看涨上升、看跌下降Call rises, put falls
答案 B。股息除权压价,利空看涨、利多看跌。Answer B. Ex-dividend price drops hurt the call and favor the put.

24. 到期时间越长,美式期权价值如何变化:How does a longer time to expiration change an American option's value: 补充Extra

  • A. 通常越值钱——更多时间让标的向有利方向变动Usually more valuable — more time for the underlying to move favorably
  • B. 越不值钱Less valuable
  • C. 完全不变Completely unchanged
答案 A。更长期限给期权更多获利机会。Answer A. A longer term gives the option more chance to profit.
1. 看涨期权价值的上界是：1. The upper bound of a call value is the: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 标的价格underlying's price
  • B. 标的价格加行权价现值与零孰大者underlying's price plus the present value of its exercise price or zero, whichever is greater
  • C. 标的价格减行权价现值与零孰大者underlying's price minus the present value of its exercise price or zero, whichever is greater
答案 A。看涨的无套利上界 = 标的现价 S₀:买"以 X 买入的权利"绝不会比直接买股票本身还贵。下界才是 Max(0, S₀ − X 现值)。B、C 混入了下界的表达式。Answer A. The no-arbitrage upper bound of a call = the spot S₀: the right to buy at X can never cost more than the stock itself. The lower bound is Max(0, S₀ − PV(X)). B and C mix in the lower-bound expression.
2. 其他条件相同，若无风险利率上升，欧式看跌期权的价值：2. All else being equal, if the risk-free rate increases, the value of a European put option: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 下降。decreases.
  • B. 不变。remains the same.
  • C. 上升。increases.
答案 A。欧式看跌价值与无风险利率负相关:利率升 → 未来才收到的行权价 X 折现后更"缩水",看跌值钱之处正是"以 X 卖出",故其价值下降。(看涨则相反,与利率正相关。)Answer A. A European put's value is negatively related to the risk-free rate: a higher rate shrinks the present value of the strike X you receive later, and a put's worth is "selling at X," so its value falls. (A call is the opposite — positively related.)
3. 欧式看跌期权多头头寸的价值与下列何者正相关：3. The value of a long position in a European put option is directly related to the: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 行权价exercise price
  • B. 无风险利率risk-free interest rate
  • C. 标的价值value of the underlying
答案 A。欧式看跌值钱靠"以 X 卖出",所以 X 越高看跌越值钱 → 与行权价正相关。它与无风险利率、标的价格都负相关(标的越高越不想按 X 卖)。故选行权价。Answer A. A European put profits by "selling at X," so a higher X makes it worth more → positively related to strike. It is negatively related to the risk-free rate and to the underlying price (a higher underlying makes selling at X less attractive). Hence strike.
4. 看跌期权价值的上界是：4. The upper bound of a put value is the: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 行权价exercise price
  • B. 标的价格price of the underlying
  • C. 行权价现值减即期价格present value of the exercise price minus the spot price
答案 A。看跌收益 = Max(0, X − ST),最好情形是 ST=0,此时收益 = X。所以看跌上界 = 行权价 X(持有人最多拿到 X)。标的现价是看涨的上界,别弄反。Answer A. Put payoff = Max(0, X − ST); the best case ST=0 gives X. So the put's upper bound = the strike X (the holder receives at most X). The spot is the call's upper bound — don't swap them.
5. 欧式看涨期权的价值与下列何者负相关：5. The value of a European call option is inversely related to the: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 行权价exercise price
  • B. 到期时间time to expiration
  • C. 无风险利率risk-free interest rate
答案 A。欧式看涨值钱靠"以 X 买入",X 越高越不值钱 → 与行权价负相关。它与到期时间、无风险利率都正相关(时间越长、利率越高,晚付 X 越划算)。故选行权价。Answer A. A European call profits by "buying at X," so a higher X makes it worth less → negatively related to strike. It is positively related to time-to-expiry and the risk-free rate (more time / higher rate makes paying X later more attractive). Hence strike.
6. 其他条件相同，欧式看涨期权的价值最好地描述为具有：6. All else held equal, the value of a European call option is best characterized as having a: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 与标的价格负相关negative relationship with the price of the underlying
  • B. 与标的波动率负相关negative relationship with the volatility of the underlying
  • C. 与到期时间正相关positive relationship with the time to expiration
答案 C。欧式看涨与到期时间正相关:时间越长,标的越有机会涨过 X,且晚付行权价更划算 → 更值钱。它也与标的价格、波动率正相关(A、B 把方向说反了)。Answer C. A European call is positively related to time-to-expiry: more time gives the underlying more chance to rise above X, and paying the strike later is better → more valuable. It is also positively related to the underlying price and volatility (A and B reverse the sign).
7. 标的当前价格$7.40，年无风险利率6%。一份6个月、行权价$7.50的看涨期权的最低价格最接近：7. The current price of the underlying is $7.40 and the annual risk-free rate is 6%. The minimum price for a 6-month call option with a strike price of $7.50 is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. $0.00$0.00
  • B. $0.12$0.12
  • C. $0.31$0.31
答案 B。"最低价"= 无套利下限。期权是权利不是义务,价值不会为负;无套利又要求欧式看涨不能低于其折现内在价值,否则能套利。
公式:看涨最低价 = Max[0, S₀ − X/(1+r)^T]。 为什么折现行权价 X? 因为 X 要到到期 T 才付,折回今天现值更小,"晚付钱"是好处,所以下限用 X 的现值。
代入:S₀=7.40、X=7.50、r=6%、T=0.5 → X 现值=7.50/(1.06)^0.5=7.28 → 7.40−7.28=0.12。
排除:A 当成 0,忽略了折现内在价值为正;C 没折现行权价(直接用 7.50)才偏大。Answer B. "Minimum price" = the no-arbitrage lower bound. An option can't be worth less than zero, and no-arbitrage requires a European call to be at least its discounted intrinsic value.
Formula: Max[0, S₀ − X/(1+r)^T]. Why discount X? X is paid only at expiry T, so its present value is smaller — paying later is an advantage, so the bound uses PV(X).
Plug in: S₀=7.40, X=7.50, r=6%, T=0.5 → PV(X)=7.50/(1.06)^0.5=7.28 → 7.40−7.28=0.12.
Eliminate: A treats it as 0; C fails to discount the strike (using 7.50), overstating it.

§1 保护性看跌 vs 受托看涨§1 Protective Put vs Fiduciary Call

LOS 对应:LOS: explain put–call parity for European options。
🔰 零基础讲解:两种组合,到期结果一模一样

保护性看跌🛡️ 持有股票 + 买一份看跌期权 = "保护性看跌":股价跌破行权价时,看跌保你的底,相当于给股票买了保险。它的到期收益图,竟然和"买一份看涨 + 存一笔到期正好等于行权价的钱(受托看涨)"完全相同——这就是看跌看涨平价的来源。(股票+看跌)与受托看涨(看涨+现金)到期收益相同,故今天价值也相同。A protective put🛡️ Holding a stock + buying a put = a "protective put": when the price falls below the strike, the put backstops you, like buying insurance on the stock. Its payoff diagram at expiration turns out identical to "buying a call + setting aside cash that grows to exactly the strike at expiration (a fiduciary call)" — the source of put-call parity. (stock + put) and a fiduciary call (call + cash) have the same expiration payoff, so they are worth the same today.

组合Portfolio构成Composition
保护性看跌 protective putProtective put持有标的 S + 买入看跌 pHold the underlying S + buy a put p
受托看涨 fiduciary callFiduciary call买入看涨 c + 持有现值为 X 的无风险资产Buy a call c + hold a risk-free asset with present value X
考点·基础期权策略(option strategies):
• 抵补看涨(covered call)= 持有标的 + 卖出看涨:牺牲部分上行、换取权利金收入,适合温和看涨/中性;最大收益封顶,下行仍有(减权利金)。
• 保护性看跌(protective put)= 持有标的 + 买入看跌:为下行买「保险」,保留上行、成本是权利金。
• 由看跌看涨平价:多头标的 + 多头看跌 + 空头看涨(领口)= 合成无风险债券。Exam - basic option strategies:
- Covered call = long the underlying + short a call: give up some upside for premium income; suits a mildly bullish/neutral view; upside is capped, downside remains (less the premium).
- Protective put = long the underlying + long a put: buy "insurance" on the downside, keep the upside, cost is the premium.
- By put-call parity: long underlying + long put + short call (a collar) = a synthetic risk-free bond.

1. 保护性看跌由什么构成:What makes up a protective put: 官方题Official

  • A. 卖出标的 + 买入看涨Short the underlying + buy a call
  • B. 只买入看跌Only buy a put
  • C. 持有标的 + 买入看跌期权Hold the underlying + buy a put option
答案 C。持股 + 买 put 提供下行保护。Answer C. Holding the stock + buying a put provides downside protection.

2. 受托看涨由什么构成:What makes up a fiduciary call: 官方题Official

  • A. 买入看涨 + 持有现值为 X 的无风险资产Buy a call + hold a risk-free asset with present value X
  • B. 卖出看涨 + 持有标的Sell a call + hold the underlying
  • C. 只买入看涨Only buy a call
答案 A。fiduciary call = 买 call + 无风险债券。Answer A. A fiduciary call = buy a call + a risk-free bond.

3. 为什么保护性看跌与受托看涨今天价值相等:Why are a protective put and a fiduciary call worth the same today: 官方题Official

  • A. 两者到期收益完全相同,由无套利,今天价值必相等Their maturity payoffs are identical, so by no-arbitrage their values today must be equal
  • B. 因风险偏好相同Because risk preferences are the same
  • C. 纯属巧合Pure coincidence
答案 A。相同的到期收益必有相同的现值。Answer A. Identical maturity payoffs must have identical present values.
1. 其他条件相同，保护性看涨(fiduciary call)的成本必然：1. All else being equal, the cost of a fiduciary call must be: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 小于合成保护性看跌的成本less than the cost of a synthetic protective put
  • B. 等于合成保护性看跌的成本equal to the cost of a synthetic protective put
  • C. 大于合成保护性看跌的成本greater than the cost of a synthetic protective put
答案 B。看涨-看跌-远期平价的直白含义:"保护性看涨(fiduciary call)"= 买看涨 + 买一只面值 X 的无风险债券;"合成保护性看跌"是另一种搭法。二者到期收益完全相同 → 成本必然相等,否则可套利。Answer B. The plain meaning of put-call-forward parity: a "fiduciary call" = long call + a risk-free bond with face X; a "synthetic protective put" is an alternative build. They have identical payoffs → their costs must be equal, else arbitrage exists.
2. 保护性看涨(fiduciary call)是交易者买入看涨期权并同时的策略：2. A fiduciary call is a strategy in which a trader purchases a call option: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 同时持有标的资产空头and takes a short position in the underlying asset
  • B. 以卖空一只与看涨期权同期限零息债券所得资金买入with funds received from selling short a zero coupon bond of the same maturity as the call option
  • C. 同时买入一只与看涨期权同期限、面值等于行权价的零息债券along with a zero coupon bond of the same maturity as the call option and with a face value equal to the exercise price of the option
答案 C。保护性看涨(fiduciary call)= 买看涨 + 买一只无风险零息债券,债券到期日 = 期权到期日 T,面值 = 行权价 X(到期正好凑出 X 去行权)。A(空标的)、B(卖空债券)都不是它的构成。Answer C. A fiduciary call = long call + a risk-free zero-coupon bond, with the bond maturing at the option's date T and face value = strike X (so at expiry it funds exercise at X). A (short underlying) and B (short the bond) are not its components.
3. 按看涨-看跌-远期平价，合成保护性看跌的收益等价于下列何种组合的收益：3. According to put-call-forward parity, the payoff on a synthetic protective put is equivalent to the payoff on a portfolio consisting of: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 多头看涨与多头无风险债券。a long call and a long risk-free bond.
  • B. 多头看涨、空头远期与多头无风险债券。a long call, a short forward contract and a long risk-free bond.
  • C. 多头看跌、空头远期与空头无风险债券。a long put, a short forward contract and a short risk-free bond.
答案 A。平价式的一端"合成保护性看跌"= 债券 + 远期 + 看跌;另一端"保护性看涨"= 多头看涨 + 多头无风险债券。两端收益相等,所以合成保护性看跌 ≡ 多头看涨 + 多头债券,选 A。Answer A. One side, the "synthetic protective put" = bond + forward + put; the other, the "fiduciary call" = long call + long risk-free bond. The two sides have equal payoffs, so synthetic protective put ≡ long call + long bond → A.

§2 看跌看涨平价§2 Put-Call Parity 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: calculate values using put–call parity。
看跌看涨平价:S0 + p0 = c0 + X / (1 + r)T
符号Symbol含义Meaning
S0标的现价The underlying's current price
p0 / c0同行权价、同到期的欧式看跌 / 看涨价格Prices of European put / call with the same strike and expiration
X/(1+r)T行权价的现值(无风险折现)The present value of the strike (risk-free discounted)
看跌看涨平价计算 官方题Official

S0=$100,X=$100,r=5%,T=1 年,看涨 c=$8。求看跌 p。由 S+p = c + X/(1+r)T:100 + p = 8 + 100/1.05 = 8 + 95.24 = 103.24 → p = $3.24。S0=$100, X=$100, r=5%, T=1 year, call c=$8. Find put p. From S+p = c + X/(1+r)T: 100 + p = 8 + 100/1.05 = 8 + 95.24 = 103.24 → p = $3.24.

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

看跌看涨平价(put-call parity)

核心恒等式:受托看涨 = 保护性看跌,即 c0 + X ÷ (1+r)^T = p0 + S0。左边「买看涨 + 存 X 现值的无风险债」到期至少拿回 X;右边「买看跌 + 持股」到期至少值 X——两组合到期收益相同,故今天同价。

推导与用途

移项即可合成任意一腿:如 c0 = p0 + S0 − X÷(1+r)^T;p0 = c0 − S0 + X÷(1+r)^T。任何一边偏离都构成套利。

易错对比

① 债券端是 X 的现值(要折现),不是 X;② 平价用欧式、同标的同 X 同到期;③ 违反平价 → 买低卖高套利。

Put-call parity

Key identity: fiduciary call = protective put, i.e. c0 + X ÷ (1+r)^T = p0 + S0. The left ("buy call + risk-free bond paying X") returns at least X; the right ("buy put + hold stock") is worth at least X — same payoff at expiry, so same price today.

Derivation & uses

Rearrange to synthesize any leg: c0 = p0 + S0 − X÷(1+r)^T; p0 = c0 − S0 + X÷(1+r)^T. Any deviation is an arbitrage.

Common traps

① The bond leg is the PV of X (discount it), not X; ② parity is for European options, same underlying/X/expiry; ③ a violation → buy-low/sell-high arbitrage.

4. 看跌看涨平价公式是:The put-call parity formula is: 官方题Official

  • A. S₀ + c₀ = p₀S₀ + c₀ = p₀
  • B. S₀ + p₀ = c₀ + X/(1+r)ᵀS₀ + p₀ = c₀ + X/(1+r)ᵀ
  • C. S₀ − p₀ = c₀ + XS₀ − p₀ = c₀ + X
答案 B。保护性看跌 = 受托看涨。Answer B. Protective put = fiduciary call.

5. S=100、X=100、r=5%、T=1、c=$8,p 为:S = 100, X = 100, r = 5%, T = 1, c = $8; p is: 官方题Official

  • A. $8.00$8.00
  • B. $5.00$5.00
  • C. $3.24$3.24
答案 C。100+p=8+100/1.05=103.24→p=$3.24。Answer C. 100 + p = 8 + 100/1.05 = 103.24 → p = $3.24.

6. 市场价格违反看跌看涨平价意味着什么:What does a market price violating put-call parity mean: 官方题Official

  • A. 存在套利机会:买入被低估组合、卖出被高估的等价组合锁定无风险利润An arbitrage opportunity: buy the undervalued combination and sell the overvalued equivalent to lock in risk-free profit
  • B. 市场已经关闭The market is closed
  • C. 没有任何影响No effect
答案 A。平价失衡即无风险套利。Answer A. A parity imbalance is a risk-free arbitrage.

7. 平价关系严格适用于欧式还是美式期权:Does the parity relationship strictly apply to European or American options: 官方题Official

  • A. 严格适用于欧式期权(同标的、同 X、同到期)It strictly applies to European options (same underlying, same X, same expiration)
  • B. 严格适用于美式期权It strictly applies to American options
  • C. 两者都不适用It applies to neither
答案 A。提前行权使美式期权不满足严格平价。Answer A. Early exercise means American options do not satisfy strict parity.

According to put-call parity, the price of the put is closest to: 真题模考Mock
