Solve for the put: P₀ = C₀ + X/(1+r)^T − S₀ = 10 + 60/1.03 − 40 = $28.25. (Just equate the two equivalent bundles "stock + put" = "call + bond.")

§3 用平价合成头寸§3 Synthesizing Positions with Parity

LOS 对应:LOS: use put–call parity to create synthetic positions。

移项即可"合成"任意工具:合成看涨 c = S + p − X/(1+r)T;合成看跌 p = c − S + X/(1+r)T;合成标的 S = c − p + X/(1+r)T;合成无风险债券 X/(1+r)T = S + p − c。若市场价格违反平价关系,可套利:买入被低估的组合、卖出被高估的等价组合。Rearranging "synthesizes" any instrument: synthetic call c = S + p − X/(1+r)T; synthetic put p = c − S + X/(1+r)T; synthetic underlying S = c − p + X/(1+r)T; synthetic risk-free bond X/(1+r)T = S + p − c. If market prices violate parity, one can arbitrage: buy the undervalued combination and sell the overvalued equivalent.

8. 如何用平价合成一个看涨:How to synthesize a call using parity: 官方题Official

  • A. c = p − Sc = p − S
  • B. c = S + p − X/(1+r)ᵀc = S + p − X/(1+r)ᵀ
  • C. c = S − p + Xc = S − p + X
答案 B。由平价式移项得到合成看涨。Answer B. Rearranging the parity equation gives the synthetic call.

9. 如何合成无风险债券:How to synthesize a risk-free bond: 官方题Official

  • A. = S − p + c= S − p + c
  • B. = c − p= c − p
  • C. X/(1+r)ᵀ = S + p − cX/(1+r)ᵀ = S + p − c
答案 C。持股 + 买 put − 买 call 复制无风险债券。Answer C. Hold stock + buy put − buy call replicates a risk-free bond.

10. 合成看跌的表达式是:The expression for a synthetic put is: 官方题Official

  • A. p = c − S + X/(1+r)ᵀp = c − S + X/(1+r)ᵀ
  • B. p = S − c + Xp = S − c + X
  • C. p = c + Sp = c + S
答案 A。由平价式移项得到。Answer A. Obtained by rearranging the parity equation.

11. 若 c=$9.98,要给对应看跌定价,可用什么快速求:If c = $9.98, what can quickly price the corresponding put: 补充Extra

  • A. 无法快速求Cannot be found quickly
  • B. 用看跌看涨平价 p = c − S + X/(1+r)ᵀ 直接换算Use put-call parity p = c − S + X/(1+r)ᵀ to convert directly
  • C. 重新建一棵二叉树Build a new binomial tree
答案 B。平价关系可一步换算看跌价。Answer B. The parity relationship converts to the put price in one step.
1. 按看涨-看跌平价，看跌期权多头等价于：1. According to put-call parity, a long put option is equivalent to being: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 多头看涨、空头标的、多头无风险债券long a call, short the underlying asset, and long a risk-free bond
  • B. 多头看涨、多头标的、空头无风险债券long a call, long the underlying asset, and short a risk-free bond
  • C. 空头看涨、多头标的、多头无风险债券short a call, long the underlying asset, and long a risk-free bond
答案 A。从平价 P₀ = C₀ − S₀ + X/(1+r)^T 直接读出:看跌多头 = 多头看涨 + 空头标的 + 多头无风险债券。这就是"合成看跌"。符号:+C、−S、+债券 → 选 A。Answer A. Read straight off parity P₀ = C₀ − S₀ + X/(1+r)^T: long put = long call + short underlying + long risk-free bond — the "synthetic put." Signs +C, −S, +bond → A.
2. 按看涨-看跌平价，标的空头头寸的收益等价于下列何种组合的收益：2. Based on put-call parity, the payoff on a short underlying position is equivalent to the payoff on a portfolio consisting of a: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 空头看涨、多头看跌、多头债券short call, a long put, and a long bond
  • B. 空头看涨、多头看跌、空头债券short call, a long put, and a short bond
  • C. 多头看涨、空头看跌、空头债券long call, a short put, and a short bond
答案 B。把平价整理成 −S₀ = −C₀ + P₀ − X/(1+r)^T,读符号:标的空头 = 空头看涨 + 多头看跌 + 空头债券。逐项对照符号即可锁定 B。Answer B. Rearrange parity to −S₀ = −C₀ + P₀ − X/(1+r)^T and read the signs: short underlying = short call + long put + short bond. Matching signs term-by-term gives B.
3. 按看涨-看跌平价，无风险债券多头的收益可通过下列何种组合合成复制：3. According to put-call parity, the payoff of a long risk-free bond can be replicated synthetically by going: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 多头资产、多头看跌、多头看涨long an asset, long a put and long a call
  • B. 多头资产、多头看跌、空头看涨long an asset, long a put and short a call
  • C. 多头资产、空头看跌、空头看涨long an asset, short a put and short a call
答案 B。把平价解出债券:X/(1+r)^T = S₀ + P₀ − C₀,读符号:多头债券 = 多头标的 + 多头看跌 + 空头看涨。这正是"抵补看涨(covered call)+保护性看跌"合成的无风险头寸,选 B。Answer B. Solve parity for the bond: X/(1+r)^T = S₀ + P₀ − C₀, then read the signs: long bond = long underlying + long put + short call — the riskless position synthesized by a collar. Hence B.

§4 看跌看涨远期平价§4 Put-Call-Forward Parity

LOS 对应:LOS: explain put–call–forward parity。
看跌看涨远期平价:c0 + X/(1+r)T = p0 + F0(T)/(1+r)T

用远期价格 F0(T)/(1+r)T 替代现货 S0(因为 F0=S0(1+r)T,两者现值相等)。这在标的难以直接持有(如商品、指数)时更实用。Replace the spot S0 with the forward price F0(T)/(1+r)T (because F0=S0(1+r)T, their present values are equal). This is more practical when the underlying is hard to hold directly (e.g., commodities, indexes).

12. 看跌看涨远期平价公式是:The put-call-forward parity formula is: 官方题Official

  • A. c₀ = p₀ + F₀(T)c₀ = p₀ + F₀(T)
  • B. c₀ − p₀ = Xc₀ − p₀ = X
  • C. c₀ + X/(1+r)ᵀ = p₀ + F₀(T)/(1+r)ᵀc₀ + X/(1+r)ᵀ = p₀ + F₀(T)/(1+r)ᵀ
答案 C。用远期价现值替代现货价。Answer C. Replace the spot price with the present value of the forward price.

13. 为什么可用 F₀/(1+r)ᵀ 替代 S₀:Why can F₀/(1+r)ᵀ replace S₀: 官方题Official

  • A. 因为 F₀=S₀(1+r)ᵀ,两者现值相等Because F₀ = S₀(1+r)ᵀ, so their present values are equal
  • B. 因两者数值相等Because their values are numerically equal
  • C. 没有理由No reason
答案 A。远期价现值恰等于现货价。Answer A. The present value of the forward price exactly equals the spot price.
1. 其他条件相同，按看涨-看跌-远期平价，看跌期权价格高于看涨期权价格的情形是：1. All else being equal, based on put-call-forward parity, the price of a put is higher than the price of a call when: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 标的远期价格低于行权价the forward price of the underlying is lower than the exercise price
  • B. 标的远期价格等于行权价the forward price of the underlying is equal to the exercise price
  • C. 标的远期价格高于行权价the forward price of the underlying is higher than the exercise price
答案 A。看涨-看跌-远期平价:P₀ − C₀ = [X − F₀(T)]/(1+r)^T。要 P₀ > C₀,就要右边为正,即 X > F₀(T)——远期价低于行权价时,看跌更贵。Answer A. Put-call-forward parity: P₀ − C₀ = [X − F₀(T)]/(1+r)^T. For P₀ > C₀ the right side must be positive, i.e. X > F₀(T) — when the forward price is below the strike, the put is dearer.
2. 下列哪项最准确？看涨-看跌-远期平价：2. Which of the following is most accurate? Put-call-forward parity: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 假设期权行权价等于标的远期价格assumes that the strike of the options is equal to the forward price of the underlying
  • B. 通过令平值看跌与平值看涨价格相等推导is derived by equating the price of an at-the-money put to the price of an at-the-money call
  • C. 假设看跌、看涨、远期与债券的到期日相同assumes that the maturity of the put option, the call option, the forward and the bond are the same
答案 C。看涨-看跌-远期平价把"合成保护性看跌(债券+远期+看跌)"等同于"保护性看涨",前提是看跌、看涨、远期、债券到期日都相同。它对任意行权价都成立(不要求 X=远期价),也不是靠"令平值看涨=平值看跌"推的。故 C。Answer C. Put-call-forward parity equates a "synthetic protective put (bond+forward+put)" with a "fiduciary call," provided the put, call, forward and bond share the same maturity. It holds for any strike (not requiring X = forward price) and is not derived by setting ATM put = ATM call. Hence C.
3. 按看涨-看跌-远期平价，交易者可通过一个看涨期权多头，并配合下列何者，来构建无风险债券的合成空头头寸：3. According to put-call-forward parity, a trader can create a synthetic short position in a risk-free bond by setting up a long position in a call option along with a: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 远期合约空头与看跌期权多头short position in a forward contract and a long position in a put
  • B. 远期合约多头与看跌期权空头long position in a forward contract and a short position in a put
  • C. 远期合约空头与看跌期权空头short position in a forward contract and a short position in a put
答案 C。要合成"无风险债券空头",把平价整理出 −X(1+r)^(−T) = C₀ − P₀ − F₀(T)(1+r)^(−T),读符号:多头看涨 + 空头看跌 + 空头远期。选 C。Answer C. To synthesize a short risk-free bond, rearrange parity to −X(1+r)^(−T) = C₀ − P₀ − F₀(T)(1+r)^(−T) and read the signs: long call + short put + short forward. Hence C.

§5 单期二叉树模型§5 The One-Period Binomial Model 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: calculate the value of an option using a one-period binomial model。
🔰 零基础讲解:假设未来只有"涨"或"跌"两种

二叉树🌳 假设一期后股价只有两种可能:涨到 uS 或跌到 dS。我们可以用股票+借款复制期权的两种到期结果,由无套利定出期权今天的价格。神奇的是,算出来用的不是真实涨跌概率,而是"风险中性概率"——一种让定价与风险偏好无关的数学捷径。:假设标的一期后只有上涨/下跌两种结果,用无套利复制定价。The binomial tree🌳 Assume that after one period the price has only two possibilities: rising to uS or falling to dS. We can replicate the option's two expiration outcomes with stock + borrowing, and no-arbitrage pins down the option's price today. Remarkably, the computation uses not the real up/down probabilities but the "risk-neutral probability" — a mathematical shortcut that makes pricing independent of risk preferences.: assume the underlying has only an up/down outcome after one period, and price by no-arbitrage replication.

期权现值 c0 = [ π × cu + (1 − π) × cd ] / (1 + r)
符号Symbol含义Meaning
cu / cd标的上涨 / 下跌情形下期权的到期收益The option's expiration payoff in the up / down case for the underlying
u / d上涨因子 / 下跌因子(如 u=1.2 表示涨 20%)The up factor / down factor (e.g., u=1.2 means a 20% rise)
π(风险中性概率)π (risk-neutral probability)见下节公式;不是真实概率See the formula below; not the real probability
r单期无风险利率The single-period risk-free rate
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

单期二叉树定价

设标的从 S 涨到 S·u 或跌到 S·d。第一步求风险中性概率 π = (1 + r − d) ÷ (u − d);第二步对期权到期收益按 π 加权、再用无风险率折现:c0 = [π·c⁺ + (1−π)·c⁻] ÷ (1 + r)。

为什么用风险中性概率

因为可用「标的 + 借贷」复制期权,定价与投资者的真实上涨概率、风险偏好无关;π 只是让复制成立的无套利权重。

易错对比

① 折现用无风险率、概率用 π(不是真实概率);② u、d 是乘数(如 1.2、0.8);③ 看跌用同一 π,只把到期收益换成 max(0, X−S)。

One-period binomial pricing

The underlying goes from S to S·u or S·d. Step 1: the risk-neutral probability π = (1 + r − d) ÷ (u − d). Step 2: weight the option's expiry payoffs by π and discount at the risk-free rate: c0 = [π·c⁺ + (1−π)·c⁻] ÷ (1 + r).

Why risk-neutral probabilities

Because the option is replicated by "underlying + borrowing/lending," pricing is independent of the real up-probability and risk preferences; π is just the no-arbitrage weight that makes replication hold.

Common traps

① Discount at the risk-free rate and weight with π (not the real probability); ② u, d are multipliers (e.g., 1.2, 0.8); ③ for a put use the same π, just replace the payoff with max(0, X−S).

14. 单期二叉树的定价公式是:The single-period binomial pricing formula is: 官方题Official

  • A. c₀ = c_u − c_dc₀ = c_u − c_d
  • B. c₀ = [π·c_u + (1−π)·c_d]/(1+r)c₀ = [π·c_u + (1−π)·c_d]/(1+r)
  • C. c₀ = π·c_u + (1−π)·c_dc₀ = π·c_u + (1−π)·c_d
答案 B。风险中性期望收益贴现。Answer B. Discount the risk-neutral expected payoff.

§6 风险中性概率§6 Risk-Neutral Probability

LOS 对应:LOS: calculate and interpret the risk-neutral probability。
风险中性上涨概率 π = (1 + r − d) / (u − d)
符号Symbol含义Meaning
π风险中性世界里标的上涨的"概率";用于折现期望收益The "probability" of the underlying rising in the risk-neutral world; used to discount the expected payoff
u, d上涨、下跌因子The up and down factors
二叉树期权定价 官方题Official

S0=$100,一期后 u=1.20($120)或 d=0.85($85);行权价 X=$100 的看涨;r=3%。上涨时 cu=max(0,120−100)=$20,下跌时 cd=max(0,85−100)=$0。π = (1.03 − 0.85)/(1.20 − 0.85) = 0.18/0.35 = 0.514。c0 = [0.514×20 + 0.486×0]/1.03 = 10.28/1.03 = $9.98。S0=$100, after one period u=1.20 ($120) or d=0.85 ($85); a call with strike X=$100; r=3%. In the up case cu=max(0,120−100)=$20, in the down case cd=max(0,85−100)=$0. π = (1.03 − 0.85)/(1.20 − 0.85) = 0.18/0.35 = 0.514. c0 = [0.514×20 + 0.486×0]/1.03 = 10.28/1.03 = $9.98.

考点提示:
① π = (1+r−d)/(u−d),记牢分子是 1+r−d、分母 u−d。
② 定价用风险中性概率而非真实概率——这是无套利定价的核心结论,与投资者风险偏好无关。
③ 看跌期权同理,只是把 cu/cd 换成看跌的到期收益 max(0,X−S)。

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

风险中性概率

π = (1 + r − d) ÷ (u − d)。它不是真实世界里标的上涨的概率,而是一个人工构造的权重,使「按 π 求期望、再用无风险率折现」正好等于无套利价格。

机制

在无套利世界里,复制组合消去了风险,故定价与风险溢价、真实概率无关。这也解释了为何两个对未来看法不同的人,只要同意无套利,就会给出同一期权价。

易错对比

① π ∈ (0,1) 要求 d < 1+r < u,否则存在套利;② 用 π 必须配无风险率折现;③ 真实上涨概率、投资者风险偏好在定价中用不到。

Risk-neutral probability

π = (1 + r − d) ÷ (u − d). It is not the real-world probability of an up move but an artificial weight that makes "expectation under π, discounted at the risk-free rate" equal the no-arbitrage price.

Mechanism

In a no-arbitrage world the replicating portfolio removes risk, so pricing is independent of the risk premium and the true probability. This is why two people with different views agree on the option price as long as they accept no-arbitrage.

Common traps

① π ∈ (0,1) requires d < 1+r < u, else arbitrage exists; ② π must be paired with risk-free discounting; ③ the real up-probability and risk preferences are not used in pricing.

19. 风险中性概率公式是:The risk-neutral probability formula is: 官方题Official

  • A. π = (1+r−d)/(u−d)π = (1+r−d)/(u−d)
  • B. π = (u−1−r)/(u−d)π = (u−1−r)/(u−d)
  • C. π = (u+d)/2π = (u+d)/2
答案 A。由无套利条件解出的合成概率。Answer A. A synthetic probability solved from the no-arbitrage condition.

20. 上题的风险中性概率 π 为:The risk-neutral probability π above is: 官方题Official

  • A. 0.4860.486
  • B. 0.3500.350
  • C. 0.5140.514
答案 C。(1.03−0.85)/(1.20−0.85)=0.18/0.35=0.514。Answer C. (1.03 − 0.85)/(1.20 − 0.85) = 0.18/0.35 = 0.514.

21. 二叉树定价用真实概率还是风险中性概率:Does binomial pricing use real or risk-neutral probabilities: 官方题Official

  • A. 风险中性概率——无套利定价与投资者风险偏好无关Risk-neutral probabilities — no-arbitrage pricing is independent of investors' risk preferences
  • B. 真实概率Real probabilities
  • C. 两者都要用Both are needed
答案 A。无套利定价采用风险中性测度。Answer A. No-arbitrage pricing uses the risk-neutral measure.

22. 风险中性概率 π 必须落在什么区间才无套利:What interval must the risk-neutral probability π fall in for no arbitrage: 补充Extra

  • A. 小于 0Less than 0
  • B. 0 与 1 之间(需 d < 1+r < u)Between 0 and 1 (requires d < 1+r < u)
  • C. 大于 1Greater than 1
答案 B。否则存在无风险套利。Answer B. Otherwise there is a risk-free arbitrage.
1. 分析师获得某标的以下信息：
标的资产当前价格$16.0
期末上行价格$22.0
期末下行价格$12.0
无风险利率4.0%
用单期二叉树模型，价格上行的风险中性概率最接近：1. An analyst gathers the following information about an underlying:
Current price of underlying asset$16.0
End of period upward price$22.0
End of period downward price$12.0
Risk-free rate4.0%
Using a one-period binomial model, the risk-neutral probability of a price increase is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 0.380.38
  • B. 0.460.46
  • C. 0.540.54
答案 B。风险中性上行概率 π = (1 + r − R_d)/(R_u − R_d),其中 R_u、R_d 是上/下行的总回报倍数。R_u=22/16=1.375、R_d=12/16=0.75:π=(1.04−0.75)/(1.375−0.75)=0.29/0.625=0.46。(注意 π 不是真实概率,是定价用的。)Answer B. Risk-neutral up-probability π = (1 + r − R_d)/(R_u − R_d), where R_u, R_d are the up/down gross returns. R_u=22/16=1.375, R_d=12/16=0.75: π=(1.04−0.75)/(1.375−0.75)=0.29/0.625=0.46. (π is a pricing probability, not a real-world one.)
2. 使用二叉树模型时，下列哪个因素影响期权价格？2. Which of the following factors affects the option price when using a binomial model? The: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 无风险利率risk-free rate
  • B. 投资者风险厌恶程度level of investors' risk aversion
  • C. 标的的预期回报expected return of the underlying
答案 A。二叉树用风险中性定价:期权价值只取决于无风险利率和上/下行总回报(即波动率),与投资者风险厌恶、标的预期回报无关——因为对冲组合已把风险消掉。故选无风险利率。Answer A. The binomial model uses risk-neutral pricing: the option value depends only on the risk-free rate and the up/down gross returns (volatility), and is independent of investor risk aversion or the underlying's expected return — the hedge removes the risk. Hence the risk-free rate.
3. 其他条件相同，在单期二叉树模型中若上行总回报增大，则资产价格上行的风险中性概率将：3. All else being equal, if the up gross return increases in a one-period binomial model, the risk-neutral probability of an upward price movement of the asset will: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 下降decrease
  • B. 不变remain the same
  • C. 上升increase
答案 A。π = (1 + r − R_d)/(R_u − R_d)。R_u 变大 → 分母变大 → π 下降。直觉:上行涨得更猛,只需更小的上行概率就能维持无风险定价的平衡。Answer A. π = (1 + r − R_d)/(R_u − R_d). A larger R_u increases the denominator → π falls. Intuition: a bigger up move needs a smaller up-probability to keep the risk-neutral pricing balanced.
4. 风险中性定价确立的无套利期权价值与下列何者无关：4. Risk-neutral pricing establishes no-arbitrage option values independent of the: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 标的即期价格spot price of the underlying
  • B. 投资者对标的波动率的看法investor's views on the volatility of the underlying
  • C. 标的上/下行后的未来价格future price of the underlying following an up or down move
答案 B。风险中性定价给出的是与投资者主观看法/风险偏好无关的无套利价值,所以"投资者对波动率的看法"不影响它。但它仍取决于即期价和上/下行的未来价格(客观波动幅度),故 A、C 有关、B 无关。Answer B. Risk-neutral pricing gives a no-arbitrage value independent of investors' subjective views or risk preferences, so "investors' view of volatility" does not affect it. It still depends on the spot and the up/down future prices (the objective move), so A and C matter — B does not.

第一讲 · 另类投资的特征、方法与结构Lecture 1 · Alternative Investment Features, Methods & Structures

对应教材:Alternative Investment Features, Methods, and Structures · 建议学习时长:3 小时Curriculum: Alternative Investment Features, Methods, and Structures · Suggested study time: 3 hours

欢迎进入 Volume 8 · 另类投资。页面配色已切换为品红色。另类投资=股票债券现金以外的一切:私募股权、私募债、房地产、基础设施、大宗商品、对冲基金、数字资产。这一讲讲它们的共同特征、投资方法、以及基金结构和费用(2-and-20)——费用计算是必考。Welcome to Volume 8 · Alternative Investments. The page color has switched to magenta. Alternatives = everything besides stocks, bonds, and cash: private equity, private debt, real estate, infrastructure, commodities, hedge funds, and digital assets. This lecture covers their common features, investment methods, and fund structures and fees (2-and-20) — the fee calculation is a must-know.

🎯 另类投资做题技巧 · 提分策略🎯 Alternative Investments Exam Tactics
  • 定义与分类:另类 = 股/债/现金纯多头之外;低相关、低透明、定价欠有效 → 改善风险调整回报。类别:私募股权(含VC)、对冲基金、房地产、基础设施、商品、数字资产。Definition & categories: alternatives = outside long-only stocks/bonds/cash; low correlation, low transparency, less-efficient pricing - improving risk-adjusted return. Categories: private equity (incl. VC), hedge funds, real estate, infrastructure, commodities, digital assets.
  • 投资方式:基金投资(门槛低,机构起步)< 共同投资(费更低、有权并肩直投)< 直接投资(灵活/控制最强、门槛最高)。LP 被动出资、GP 管理。Access: fund investing (low barriers, where institutions start) < co-investing (lower fees, right to invest alongside) < direct (most flexibility/control, highest barriers). LPs are passive; the GP manages.
  • 费用:管理费 HF按AUM、PE按承诺资本;激励费20% + 高水位线(防重复) + 门槛收益率(超过才收) + 回拨(利LP);美式瀑布利GP、欧式利LP。Fees: management - HF on AUM, PE on committed capital; incentive 20% + high-water mark (no double-charging) + hurdle rate (only above it) + clawback (favors LPs); American waterfall favors the GP, European favors LPs.
  • 估值:私募盯市滞后→平滑→低估波动与相关性(私募指数高估业绩);mark-to-model=理论价;保守法=多头bid、空头ask。Valuation: private stale pricing smooths returns, understating volatility/correlation (private indexes overstate performance); mark-to-model = theoretical value; conservative = longs at bid, shorts at ask.
  • 私募股权:成长资本=少数股权;退出 = IPO / 战略出售(trade sale) / 二次出售 / 资本重组 / SPAC。私募债:风险债务(早期)、不良债务(困境成熟)、单一档级(混合、成本低)、夹层(次级于高级担保、优先于权益)。Private equity: growth capital = minority equity; exits = IPO / trade sale / secondary sale / recapitalization / SPAC. Private debt: venture debt (early-stage), distressed (troubled mature firms), unitranche (blended, lower cost), mezzanine (subordinate to senior secured, senior to equity).
  • 房地产:REITs流动性好;策略核心 < 核心增益 < 增值型 < 机会型(风险递增);异质性、交易成本高。Real estate: REITs are liquid; strategies core < core-plus < value-add < opportunistic (rising risk); heterogeneous with high transaction costs.
  • 基建:绿地(新建、风险高)vs 棕地(有运营史);经济vs社会基建;照付不议=缓解需求风险;通胀保护+低相关。Infrastructure: greenfield (new build, higher risk) vs brownfield (operating history); economic vs social; take-or-pay mitigates demand risk; inflation protection + low correlation.
  • 商品:硬(开采,原油)vs软(种植/养殖);期货 F ≈ S(1+r)+储存−便利收益;升水(contango)曲线上倾、贴水(backwardation)下倾。原油=硬商品。Commodities: hard (mined, oil) vs soft (grown/raised); futures F ≈ S(1+r) + storage − convenience yield; contango slopes up, backwardation slopes down. Crude oil = hard commodity.
  • 对冲基金:可用衍生品/空头/杠杆;市场中性 beta≈0;可转债套利=相对价值;激进=公开股权;锁定期(禁赎)vs通知期(有序清算);FoF多一层费用。Hedge funds: use derivatives/shorts/leverage; market-neutral beta ≈ 0; convertible arbitrage = relative value; activist = public equity; lockup (no redemptions) vs notice period (orderly liquidation); a fund-of-funds adds a fee layer.
  • 数字资产:无基于底层资产/现金流的内在价值;通证化=在分布式账本上表示实物资产所有权;去中心化交易所更难监管、更难被黑;直接投资需加密钱包。Digital assets: no intrinsic value from underlying assets/cash flows; tokenization = representing physical-asset ownership on a distributed ledger; decentralized exchanges are harder to regulate and harder to hack; direct investment needs a crypto wallet.

§1 另类投资的共同特征§1 The Common Features of Alternative Investments

LOS 对应:LOS: describe features and categories of alternative investments。
🔰 零基础讲解:另类="非传统"资产

另类投资🏛️ 传统投资=上市股票、债券、现金。另类投资是"其他所有"——私募股权、对冲基金、房地产、大宗商品、甚至加密货币。它们通常流动性差、门槛高、费用贵、透明度低,但能带来分散化和潜在更高回报,是机构和高净值人群的配置工具。相对传统(股债现金)而言,具备一些共同特点。Alternative investments🏛️ Traditional investments = listed stocks, bonds, cash. Alternatives are "everything else" — private equity, hedge funds, real estate, commodities, even cryptocurrency. They are usually illiquid, high-threshold, expensive, and low-transparency, but offer diversification and potentially higher returns, and are allocation tools for institutions and high-net-worth investors., relative to traditional (stocks, bonds, cash), share some common features.

特征Feature说明Description
低流动性Low liquidity常有锁定期(lockup)、赎回限制;私募资产尤甚Often have lockup periods and redemption restrictions; especially private assets
与传统资产相关性低Low correlation with traditional assets提供分散化好处(但危机时相关性可能上升)Provide diversification benefits (but correlations can rise in a crisis)
专业化管理、费用高Specialized management, high fees常见 2-and-20;信息不对称、尽调要求高Commonly 2-and-20; information asymmetry, high due-diligence demands
杠杆与做空Leverage and shorting许多策略使用杠杆或卖空Many strategies use leverage or short selling
业绩计量难Hard to measure performance估值困难(非上市)、存在偏差(生存者/回填)Difficult valuation (not listed), with biases (survivorship/backfill)

1. 另类投资相比传统资产的共同特征是:The common characteristics of alternative investments vs traditional assets are: 官方题Official

  • A. 与股债高度相关Highly correlated with stocks/bonds
  • B. 低流动性、与传统资产相关性低、费用高、常用杠杆/做空、估值与业绩计量困难Low liquidity, low correlation with traditional assets, high fees, frequent use of leverage/short-selling, and difficult valuation and performance measurement
  • C. 高流动性、低费用High liquidity, low fees
答案 B。低流动性、低相关、高费用是共性。Answer B. Low liquidity, low correlation, and high fees are the commonalities.

2. 为什么另类投资能提供分散化:Why can alternative investments provide diversification: 官方题Official

  • A. 与股债高度相关Highly correlated with stocks/bonds
  • B. 没有分散化作用No diversification effect
  • C. 与传统股债相关性较低,可降低组合整体波动;但危机时相关性可能上升Their low correlation with traditional stocks/bonds can lower overall portfolio volatility, but correlations may rise in a crisis
答案 C。低相关带来分散化,但危机时可能失效。Answer C. Low correlation brings diversification but may fail in a crisis.

3. 另类投资费用高的原因是:The reason alternative investments have high fees is: 官方题Official

  • A. 主动专业管理、尽调与信息成本高、需激励 GP 创造超额收益Active professional management, high due-diligence and information costs, and the need to incentivize GPs to create excess returns
  • B. 因流动性高Because of high liquidity
  • C. 因风险很低Because risk is very low
答案 A。专业管理与激励推高费用。Answer A. Professional management and incentives push up fees.

4. 为什么另类投资业绩计量比传统资产难:Why is alternative-investment performance measurement harder than for traditional assets: 官方题Official

  • A. 因流动性很高Because liquidity is high
  • B. 非上市资产估值困难、报告频率低,且存在生存者偏差、回填偏差Unlisted assets are hard to value with low reporting frequency, plus survivorship and backfill biases
  • C. 因每日都有可靠估值Because there is reliable daily valuation
答案 B。估值困难与数据偏差使业绩难以衡量。Answer B. Hard valuation and data biases make performance hard to measure.

5. 锁定期(lockup)对投资者意味着:What does a lockup period mean for an investor: 补充Extra

  • A. 一段时间内不能赎回,牺牲流动性以换取策略执行空间No redemption for a period, sacrificing liquidity for room to execute the strategy
  • B. 可随时赎回Redeemable at any time
  • C. 提高了流动性It raises liquidity
答案 A。锁定期体现另类投资的低流动性特征。Answer A. A lockup reflects the low liquidity of alternatives.
1. 下列哪项表述最准确？另类投资：1. Which of the following statements is most accurate? Alternative investments: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 往往比传统投资定价更有效。tend to be more efficiently priced than traditional investments.
  • B. 不属于股票、债券和现金的纯多头持仓定义之内。fall outside of the definition of long-only positions in stocks, bonds, and cash.
  • C. 与传统投资的回报相关性相对较高。have relatively high correlation of returns with those of traditional investments.
答案 B。另类投资 = 不属于"股票、债券、现金的纯多头持仓"定义之内的投资。它通常定价不那么有效、透明度低、与传统资产相关性较低(分散化好处),故 A、C 错。Answer B. Alternatives = investments outside the definition of long-only holdings of stocks, bonds, and cash. They are typically less efficiently priced, less transparent, and have lower correlation with traditional assets (a diversification benefit), so A and C are wrong.
2. 下列哪项最恰当地归类为传统投资？2. Which of the following is most appropriately categorized as a traditional investment? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 黄金Gold
  • B. 现金Cash
  • C. 房地产Real estate
答案 B。传统投资 = 股票、债券、现金。现金是传统投资;黄金(商品)、房地产是另类。Answer B. Traditional investments = stocks, bonds, cash. Cash is traditional; gold (a commodity) and real estate are alternatives.
3. 将另类资产加入传统资产组合的一个公认好处最可能是更高的：3. A perceived benefit of adding alternative assets to a portfolio of traditional assets is most likely the higher: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 所得组合的风险调整后回报特征。risk-adjusted return profile of the resulting portfolio.
  • B. 另类资产相对传统资产的监管与透明度。regulation and transparency of alternative assets relative to traditional assets.
  • C. 另类资产与传统资产之间回报的预期相关性。expected correlation of returns between alternative assets and traditional assets.
答案 A。加入另类资产的公认好处 = 改善组合的"风险调整后回报"(靠低相关分散化)。另类资产监管/透明度通常更低、与传统资产相关性更低,故 B、C 错。Answer A. A recognized benefit of adding alternatives = improving the portfolio's risk-adjusted return (via low-correlation diversification). Alternatives usually have lower regulation/transparency and lower correlation with traditional assets, so B and C are wrong.

§2 主要类别一览§2 Overview of the Main Categories

LOS 对应:LOS: describe categories of alternative investments。
类别Category内容Content
私募资本Private capital私募股权(并购 buyout、风投 VC)、私募债Private equity (buyouts, venture capital VC), private debt
房地产Real estate直接持有物业、REITs、按揭债Direct property ownership, REITs, mortgage debt
基础设施Infrastructure公路、电力、机场等长期资产Roads, power, airports, and other long-term assets
自然资源Natural resources大宗商品、农田、林地Commodities, farmland, timberland
对冲基金Hedge funds多种主动策略(多空、事件驱动、宏观等)Various active strategies (long-short, event-driven, macro, etc.)
数字资产Digital assets加密货币、代币等Cryptocurrencies, tokens, etc.

6. 另类投资的主要类别有:The main categories of alternative investments are: 官方题Official

  • A. 只有对冲基金Only hedge funds
  • B. 普通股票与债券Ordinary stocks and bonds
  • C. 私募资本、房地产、基础设施、自然资源、对冲基金、数字资产Private capital, real estate, infrastructure, natural resources, hedge funds, digital assets
答案 C。另类投资涵盖多个非传统类别。Answer C. Alternatives cover several non-traditional categories.
1. 风险投资(venture capital)最好地归类为下列何者的子类别：1. Venture capital is best classified as a sub-category of: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 房地产。real estate.
  • B. 对冲基金。hedge funds.
  • C. 私募股权。private equity.
答案 C。风险投资(venture capital)是"私募股权(private equity)"的子类(投早期未上市公司)。它不属房地产或对冲基金。Answer C. Venture capital is a subcategory of private equity (investing in early-stage private companies). It is not real estate or a hedge fund.
2. 另类投资：2. Alternative investments: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅包含有形资产。include tangible assets only.
  • B. 仅包含无形资产。include intangible assets only.
  • C. 可包含有形与无形资产两者。may include both tangible and intangible assets.
答案 C。另类投资"有形与无形资产两者"都可包含(如房地产/商品是有形,私募股权/对冲基金份额是无形)。Answer C. Alternatives can include both tangible and intangible assets (e.g., real estate/commodities are tangible, private-equity/hedge-fund stakes are intangible).

§3 三种投资方法§3 The Three Investment Methods

LOS 对应:LOS: describe methods of investing in alternative investments。
方法Method说明Description
基金投资 fundFund investment投给专业基金经理管理(如 PE 基金、对冲基金);省心但费用高Invest with a professional fund manager (e.g., a PE fund, hedge fund); hands-off but high fees
直接投资 directDirect investment自己直接买资产/公司;控制力强但需专业能力Buy the asset/company yourself; strong control but requires expertise
共同投资 co-investmentCo-investment既投基金、又随基金对特定项目追加直投;费用低于纯基金、灵活度介于两者Invest in a fund and also add direct investment alongside it in specific deals; lower fees than pure fund, flexibility in between
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

三种投资方法(控制与费用的权衡)

• 基金投资(fund):通过基金间接投,最省事、最分散,但费用最高、控制最少。
• 共同投资(co-investment):投基金的同时对特定交易直接跟投,费用居中、控制居中,需一定尽调能力。
• 直接投资(direct):自己买资产,费用最低、控制最高,但需最强的专业能力与资源。

易错对比

① 控制力/所需专业度:直接 > 共同 > 基金;② 费用:基金 > 共同 > 直接;③ co-investment 让投资者以更低费用参与看好的单笔交易。

Three investment methods (control vs fees)

• Fund investing: indirect, most hands-off and diversified, but highest fees, least control.
• Co-investment: invest in a fund while also directly co-investing in specific deals — middling fees and control, needs some due-diligence ability.
• Direct investing: buy assets yourself — lowest fees, highest control, but needs the most expertise and resources.

Common traps

① Control/expertise needed: direct > co > fund; ② fees: fund > co > direct; ③ co-investment lets an investor add exposure to a favored deal at lower cost.

7. 三种投资方法是:The three investment methods are: 官方题Official

  • A. 基金投资、直接投资、共同投资(co-investment)Fund investment, direct investment, co-investment
  • B. 只有基金投资Only fund investment
  • C. 只有直接投资Only direct investment
答案 A。基金、直投、共投三种路径。Answer A. Funds, direct, and co-investment are the three paths.

8. 共同投资(co-investment)的特点是:The features of co-investment are: 官方题Official

  • A. 完全不投基金No fund investment at all
  • B. 在投基金同时随基金对特定项目追加直投;费用低于纯基金,灵活度介于基金与直投之间Investing in a fund while additionally investing directly alongside it in a specific deal; lower fees than a pure fund, with flexibility between fund and direct
  • C. 费用高于纯基金Higher fees than a pure fund
答案 B。共投兼具低费用与更强控制力。Answer B. Co-investment combines lower fees with more control.

9. 直接投资相比基金投资的优缺点是:The pros and cons of direct investment vs fund investment: 官方题Official

  • A. 优点是分散化更好The pro is better diversification
  • B. 缺点是控制力更弱The con is weaker control
  • C. 优:控制力强、无基金层费用;缺:需专业能力、分散化差、尽调负担重Pros: strong control, no fund-level fees; cons: needs expertise, poor diversification, heavy due-diligence burden
答案 C。直投省费用但要求能力与承担集中风险。Answer C. Direct saves fees but demands ability and concentrated risk.
1. 在共同投资(co-investing)中，投资者通过基金间接投资于另类资产，同时还拥有：1. In co-investing, the investor invests in alternative assets indirectly through a fund but also has the: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 与基金并肩直接投资于同一资产的权利。right to invest directly in the same assets alongside the fund.
  • B. 与基金并肩直接投资于同一资产的义务。obligation to invest directly in the same assets alongside the fund.
  • C. 投资于普通合伙人基金管理公司的权利。right to invest in the general partner's fund management company.
答案 A。共同投资(co-investing):通过基金投资,同时拥有"与基金并肩直接投资同一资产的权利"(是权利、非义务)。它不投 GP 管理公司,故 B、C 错。Answer A. Co-investing: invest via a fund while also holding the right to invest directly alongside the fund in the same asset (a right, not an obligation). It does not invest in the GP's management company, so B and C are wrong.
2. 与另类投资的基金投资方式相比，共同投资方式最可能：2. Compared with fund investing in alternative investments, the co-investing method most likely has: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 更低的管理费。lower management fees.
  • B. 相同的管理费水平。the same level of management fees.
  • C. 更高的管理费。higher management fees.
答案 A。共同投资相对基金投资"管理费更低"(部分资金绕过基金费用)。直接投资费用最低但门槛最高。Answer A. Co-investing has lower management fees than pure fund investing (part of the capital bypasses fund fees). Direct investing has the lowest fees but the highest requirements.
3. 下列哪种另类投资方式为投资者提供最大的灵活性？3. Which of the following methods of investing in alternative investments provides the most flexibility to the investor? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 共同投资。Co-investing.
  • B. 基金投资。Fund investing.
  • C. 直接投资。Direct investing.
答案 C。直接投资(direct investing)灵活性最大(自主选择、条款、时点),但需要最强的专业能力与资源。基金投资灵活性最低。Answer C. Direct investing offers the most flexibility (choose the asset, terms, timing), but needs the most expertise/resources. Fund investing offers the least.
4. 与共同投资相比，另类投资中的直接投资最可能提供：4. Compared with co-investing, direct investing in alternative investments most likely offers: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 对投资选择过程的控制更少。reduced control over the investment selection process.
  • B. 相同的控制水平。the same level of control over the investment selection process.
  • C. 对投资选择过程更高的控制。higher control over the investment selection process.
答案 C。直接投资相对共同投资"对投资选择过程的控制更高"(完全自主)。共同投资只能跟着基金选的资产走。Answer C. Direct investing gives more control over the selection process than co-investing (full autonomy). Co-investing follows the assets the fund chooses.
5. 机构投资者通常通过下列何种方式开始进行另类投资：5. Institutional investors typically begin investing in alternative investments via: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 共同投资。co-investing.
  • B. 基金投资。fund investing.
  • C. 直接投资。direct investing.
答案 B。机构投资者通常从"基金投资(fund investing)"起步(门槛低、靠管理人专业、易分散),再逐步走向共同投资/直接投资。Answer B. Institutions typically start with fund investing (lower barriers, relying on the manager's expertise, easy diversification), later moving to co-investing/direct.

§4 基金结构:GP 与 LP§4 Fund Structure: GP & LP

LOS 对应:LOS: describe investment ownership and compensation structures。

私募基金多为有限合伙:普通合伙人(GP)管理基金、决策投资、承担无限责任;有限合伙人(LP)出资、责任以出资为限、不参与管理。GP 靠管理费 + 业绩报酬(carried interest)获利。资金承诺(committed capital)后按需提取(capital call / drawdown)。Private funds are mostly limited partnerships: the general partner (GP) manages the fund, makes investment decisions, and bears unlimited liability; the limited partners (LPs) contribute capital, have liability limited to their contribution, and do not manage. The GP profits from a management fee + carried interest. After capital is committed, it is drawn down (capital call) as needed.

10. GP 与 LP 的责任和角色区别是:The difference in responsibilities and roles between GP and LP is: 官方题Official

  • A. GP 管理基金、决策、承担无限责任;LP 出资、责任以出资为限、不参与管理The GP manages the fund, decides, and bears unlimited liability; the LP contributes capital, is liable up to its contribution, and does not manage
  • B. LP 承担无限责任The LP bears unlimited liability
  • C. GP 只出资不管理The GP only contributes and does not manage
答案 A。GP 主动管理担无限责任,LP 被动出资。Answer A. The GP actively manages with unlimited liability; the LP contributes passively.

11. 什么是承诺资本和资本提取:What are committed capital and capital drawdown: 官方题Official

  • A. GP 承诺出资The GP commits capital
  • B. LP 承诺一笔总出资,GP 按投资需要分次提取(capital call/drawdown)The LP commits a total amount, and the GP draws it in tranches as investments require (capital call/drawdown)
  • C. LP 一次性全额出资The LP contributes the full amount at once
答案 B。承诺资本按需分批 drawdown。Answer B. Committed capital is drawn down in tranches as needed.

12. 私募基金常见的法律结构是:The common legal structure of a private fund is: 官方题Official

  • A. 有限合伙(GP + LP)A limited partnership (GP + LP)
  • B. 上市股份公司A listed joint-stock company
  • C. 公益信托A charitable trust
答案 A。有限合伙是私募基金的标准架构。Answer A. The limited partnership is the standard private-fund structure.
1. 关于有限合伙的下列表述哪项最准确？有限合伙人(LP)：1. Which of the following statements about limited partnerships is most accurate? Limited partners: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 在合伙中扮演被动角色。play passive roles in the partnership.
  • B. 参与合伙的管理。are involved in the management of the partnership.
  • C. 仅就合伙经营作有限决策。make only limited decisions related to the operations of the partnership.
答案 A。有限合伙人(LP)在合伙中扮演"被动角色"(只出资、不参与管理、负有限责任)。经营由普通合伙人(GP)负责。Answer A. A limited partner (LP) plays a passive role (contributes capital, does not manage, has limited liability). The general partner (GP) runs operations.
2. 以合伙形式设立的私募股权基金由谁管理：2. A private equity fund structured as a partnership is managed by: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅普通合伙人。the general partner only.
  • B. 仅有限合伙人。the limited partners only.
  • C. 普通合伙人与有限合伙人两者。both the general partner and the limited partners.
答案 A。以合伙形式设立的私募股权基金仅由普通合伙人(GP)管理。LP 是被动出资方。Answer A. A partnership-form private-equity fund is managed only by the general partner (GP). LPs are passive capital providers.
3. 在有限合伙结构中，有限合伙人最可能：3. Within a limited partnership structure, the limited partner is most likely to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 共同控制基金的经营与决策。jointly control the operations and decisions of the fund.
  • B. 对基金的总承诺仅限于前期现金流出。have total commitments to the fund limited to the upfront cash outflows.
  • C. 被期望理解并有能力承担与投资相关的风险。be expected to understand and be able to assume the risks associated with the investments.
答案 C。有限合伙结构中,LP 被期望"理解并有能力承担投资相关风险"(合格投资者)。LP 不参与经营控制,承诺资本可能分期抽取(非仅前期),故 A、B 错。Answer C. In a limited partnership, LPs are expected to understand and be able to bear the investment risks (accredited investors). LPs do not control operations, and committed capital may be drawn over time (not just upfront), so A and B are wrong.

§5 费用结构:2-and-20§5 Fee Structure: 2-and-20 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: calculate management and incentive fees。
管理费 = 管理费率 × 基数(承诺/已投资本 或 资产净值 NAV)
业绩报酬(carry)= 业绩报酬率 × 超过门槛的利润
要素Element含义Meaning
2-and-202% 管理费 + 20% 业绩报酬(典型对冲基金/PE)2% management fee + 20% performance fee (typical hedge fund/PE)
管理费基数Management-fee base对冲基金常按 NAV;PE 早期常按承诺资本、后期按已投资本Hedge funds often use NAV; PE often uses committed capital early and invested capital later
业绩报酬Performance fee只对利润(常为超过门槛的部分)计提Charged only on profit (often the part above a hurdle)
费用计算 官方题Official

基金年初 NAV $100M,2-and-20,年末(计管理费前)增值到 $120M。管理费 = 2% × 期末 NAV(假设按期末)= 2% × 120 = $2.4M。业绩报酬 = 20% × 利润 $20M = $4M。注意:若费用先扣管理费再算业绩报酬,基数会不同,须看题目约定。A fund with beginning NAV $100M, 2-and-20, grows (before fees) to $120M at year-end. Management fee = 2% × ending NAV (assuming on ending) = 2% × 120 = $2.4M. Performance fee = 20% × profit $20M = $4M. Note: if fees are computed as management fee first, then performance fee, the base differs — check the problem's terms.

考点·另类基金费用结构:
• 管理费:对冲基金按 AUM;私募股权在抽取完成前按承诺资本(committed capital)。
• 激励/业绩费(carried interest):常为 20%,配三重保护:门槛收益率(hurdle rate)超过才收、高水位线(high-water mark)净值创新高才收(防对同一段业绩重复付费)、回拨条款(clawback)早期多收后期亏损须退还(利于 LP)。
• 分配瀑布:美式(American,按单笔交易收 → 利 GP)vs 欧式(European,按整只基金 → 利 LP)。Exam - alternative fund fee structures:
- Management fee: hedge funds on AUM; private equity on committed capital before drawdown is complete.
- Incentive/carried interest: often 20%, with three protections: a hurdle rate (fee only above it), a high-water mark (fee only above the prior NAV peak - prevents paying twice for the same gain), and a clawback (excess early carry returned if later losses occur - favors LPs).
- Distribution waterfall: American (deal-by-deal - favors the GP) vs European (whole-fund - favors LPs).
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

2-and-20 费用结构

• 管理费(management fee)≈2%:按承诺资本(committed)、已投资本(invested)或 AUM/NAV 计——基数是常见考点。
• 业绩费/激励费(incentive fee)≈20%:对利润分成,常受门槛与高水位约束。

计算顺序

净回报 = 毛回报 − 管理费 − 业绩费。母基金(FoF)会再叠一层(如 1-and-10),形成双重收费,拖累净回报。

易错对比

① 管理费基数是 committed 还是 NAV,数值差别很大;② 业绩费只对超过门槛/高水位的部分收;③ FoF 费用双层、投资者净回报被显著侵蚀。

The 2-and-20 fee structure

• Management fee ≈2%: charged on committed capital, invested capital, or AUM/NAV — the base is a frequent trap.
• Incentive/performance fee ≈20%: a share of profits, often subject to a hurdle and high-water mark.

Order of calculation

Net return = gross − management fee − incentive fee. A fund-of-funds adds a second layer (e.g., 1-and-10), a double fee that drags net returns.

Common traps

① Committed vs NAV base changes the fee materially; ② the incentive fee applies only above the hurdle/high-water mark; ③ FoF fees stack, notably eroding investor net return.

13. "2-and-20"指什么:What does '2-and-20' mean: 官方题Official

  • A. 2% 业绩报酬 + 20% 管理费2% performance fee + 20% management fee
  • B. 20% 管理费20% management fee
  • C. 2% 管理费 + 20% 业绩报酬(carried interest)2% management fee + 20% performance fee (carried interest)
答案 C。典型的私募/对冲费率结构。Answer C. The typical private/hedge fee structure.

14. 管理费怎么算、对冲基金常用什么基数:How is the management fee computed, and what base do hedge funds commonly use: 官方题Official

  • A. 管理费 = 费率 × 基数;对冲基金常按资产净值 NAVManagement fee = rate × base; hedge funds commonly use net asset value (NAV)
  • B. 按承诺资本On committed capital
  • C. 按利润On profit
答案 A。对冲基金管理费多以 NAV 计。Answer A. Hedge-fund management fees are mostly on NAV.

15. NAV $100M、2-and-20、年末增值到 $120M,管理费(按期末 NAV)为:NAV $100M, 2-and-20, grows to $120M by year-end; the management fee (on ending NAV) is: 官方题Official

  • A. $4.0M$4.0M
  • B. $2.4M$2.4M
  • C. $2.0M$2.0M
答案 B。2%×120=$2.4M。Answer B. 2%×120 = $2.4M.

16. 上题的业绩报酬(按利润 $20M)为:The performance fee above (on the $20M profit) is: 官方题Official

  • A. $2.4M$2.4M
  • B. $20M$20M
  • C. $4M$4M
答案 C。20%×20=$4M(若无门槛/未先扣管理费)。Answer C. 20%×20 = $4M (if no hurdle and not net of the management fee).
1. 管理费最可能以管理资产规模(AUM)为基础的是：1. Management fees are most likely based on assets under management for: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅对冲基金。hedge funds only.
  • B. 仅私募股权基金。private equity funds only.
  • C. 对冲基金与私募股权基金两者。both hedge funds and private equity funds.
答案 A。以"管理资产规模(AUM)"为基础收管理费的是对冲基金。私募股权在抽取完成前多按"承诺资本"收费(见下题),故只选对冲基金。Answer A. Hedge funds charge the management fee on AUM. Private-equity funds, before drawdown is complete, usually charge on committed capital (see next), so only hedge funds here.
2. 在资本抽取(drawdown)完成之前，私募股权基金的管理费最可能以何为基础：2. Until drawdown of capital is complete, the management fee on a private equity fund is most likely based on: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 已抽取资本。drawn capital.
  • B. 已投资资本。invested capital.
  • C. 承诺资本。committed capital.
答案 C。资本抽取完成前,私募股权管理费以"承诺资本(committed capital)"为基础(而非已投/已抽资本),激励 GP 尽快部署。Answer C. Before drawdown is complete, a private-equity management fee is based on committed capital (not invested/drawn capital), incentivizing the GP to deploy quickly.
3. 在另类投资中，美式瀑布(American waterfall)分配方式对下列何者更有利：3. In alternative investments, the American waterfall distribution method is more advantageous to the: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 有限合伙人，因为业绩费按单笔交易收取。limited partners because performance fees are collected on a per-deal basis.
  • B. 普通合伙人，因为业绩费按单笔交易收取。general partner because performance fees are collected on a per-deal basis.
  • C. 有限合伙人，因为普通合伙人在达到门槛收益率前不分享任何利润。limited partners because the general partner does not participate in any profits until the hurdle rate has been met.
答案 B。美式瀑布(American waterfall)按"单笔交易"收业绩费 → 对普通合伙人(GP)更有利(早收费)。欧式瀑布按整只基金、对 LP 更有利。Answer B. An American waterfall pays carry deal-by-deal → more favorable to the GP (earlier fees). A European waterfall is fund-as-a-whole and more favorable to LPs.
4. 私募股权基金的回拨条款(clawback)最可能有利于：4. The clawback provision of a private equity fund most likely benefits the: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 经纪商。broker.
  • B. 投资者。investors.
  • C. 普通合伙人。general partner.
答案 B。回拨条款(clawback)有利于"投资者(LP)"——若 GP 早期多收了业绩费而后期亏损,须把多收的退还给 LP。Answer B. A clawback provision favors investors (LPs) — if the GP took too much carry early and later suffers losses, it must return the excess to LPs.
5. 分析师获得某对冲基金以下信息：年初管理资产$2亿；按年末AUM计2%管理费；20%激励费（在扣除管理费后计算）。若当年基金毛回报25%，则基金经理赚取的总费用为：5. An analyst gathers the following information about a hedge fund: $200 million in assets under management at the beginning of the year; a 2% management fee based on year-end assets under management; a 20% incentive fee calculated net of the management fee. If the fund's gross return is 25% during the year, the total fees earned by the fund manager are: 真题模考Mock
  • A. $1100万。$11 million.
  • B. $1400万。$14 million.
  • C. $1500万。$15 million.
答案 B。方法:管理费 = 2%×年末AUM;激励费 = 20%×(毛利 − 管理费)。年末AUM=2亿×1.25=2.5亿,管理费=500万;毛利=5000万,激励=20%×(5000−500)=900万;总费=$1400万。Answer B. Method: management fee = 2%×ending AUM; incentive = 20%×(gross gain − management fee). Ending AUM = 200m×1.25 = 250m, mgmt fee = 5m; gross gain = 50m, incentive = 20%×(50−5) = 9m; total = $14m.
6. 某对冲基金年初AUM为$2000万、年末为$2400万。基金按年末AUM收取2%管理费和20%激励费。若激励费在扣除管理费后计算，则当年收取的总费用最接近：6. A hedge fund has assets under management of $20 million at the beginning of the year and $24 million at the end of the year. The fund charges a 2% management fee based on year-end assets under management and a 20% incentive fee. If the incentive fee is calculated net of the management fee, the total fee charged for the year is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. $88万。$0.88 million.
  • B. $118万。$1.18 million.
  • C. $128万。$1.28 million.
答案 B。方法同上:管理费 = 2%×2400万=48万;毛利 = 400万,激励 = 20%×(400−48)=70.4万;总费 = 48+70.4 ≈ $118万。Answer B. Method: mgmt fee = 2%×24m = 0.48m; gross gain = 4m, incentive = 20%×(4−0.48) = 0.704m; total = 0.48+0.704 ≈ $1.18m.

§6 门槛收益率与高水位线§6 Hurdle Rate & High-Water Mark

LOS 对应:LOS: describe hurdle rate and high-water mark provisions。
条款Provision作用Purpose
门槛收益率 hurdle rateHurdle rate只有回报超过门槛,GP 才能计提业绩报酬(保护 LP)The GP can charge a performance fee only when the return exceeds the hurdle (protecting LPs)
高水位线 high-water markHigh-water mark业绩报酬只对超过历史最高 NAV 的新增利润计提,避免对同一段亏损后的复原重复收费The performance fee is charged only on new profit above the historical peak NAV, avoiding double-charging on recovery after a loss
catch-up 追补Catch-up超过门槛后,允许 GP"追补"到完整分成比例Once above the hurdle, the GP is allowed to "catch up" to the full profit-share ratio
清算优先/瀑布 waterfallDistribution waterfall规定 LP 与 GP 之间收益分配的先后顺序Specifies the order of profit distribution between LPs and the GP
考点提示:
① 高水位线保护 LP:亏损后必须先涨回历史高点,GP 才能再收业绩报酬。
② 门槛收益率是计提业绩报酬的"起跑线"。
③ 费用计算要看清基数(NAV vs 承诺/已投资本)和顺序(是否先扣管理费)。
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

门槛收益率(hurdle)

业绩费只对超过门槛回报的部分才可能计提。
• 硬门槛(hard hurdle):只对超过门槛的超额部分计费。
• 软门槛(soft hurdle):一旦回报超过门槛,就对全部收益计费。
• 追补条款(catch-up):超过门槛后 GP 先「补齐」到约定分成比例。

高水位线(high-water mark)

只对超过历史最高 NAV 的新增部分计业绩费,防止对同一波动重复收费——先前亏损须先赚回。

易错对比

① hard 只对超额、soft 对全部;② 高水位保护投资者、避免「涨-跌-再涨」被重复分成;③ 门槛与高水位可叠加使用。

Hurdle rate

The incentive fee applies only to returns above the hurdle.
• Hard hurdle: fee on the excess above the hurdle only.
• Soft hurdle: once the hurdle is exceeded, fee on the entire return.
• Catch-up: after the hurdle, the GP "catches up" to the agreed split.

High-water mark

Incentive fee only on gains above the prior peak NAV, so the manager isn't paid twice on the same swing — earlier losses must be recouped first.

Common traps

① Hard = on excess only, soft = on the whole return; ② the high-water mark protects investors from paying on "up-down-up"; ③ hurdle and high-water mark can both apply.

17. 门槛收益率(hurdle rate)的作用是:The role of a hurdle rate is: 官方题Official

  • A. 只有回报超过门槛,GP 才能计提业绩报酬,保护 LPThe GP earns a performance fee only when returns exceed the hurdle, protecting LPs
  • B. 保护 GPIt protects the GP
  • C. 与业绩报酬无关Unrelated to the performance fee
答案 A。门槛确保 LP 先获得基准回报。Answer A. The hurdle ensures LPs get a benchmark return first.

18. 高水位线(high-water mark)如何保护 LP:How does a high-water mark protect LPs: 官方题Official

  • A. 保护 GPProtects the GP
  • B. 业绩报酬只对超过历史最高 NAV 的新增利润计提,亏损后须先涨回高点才再收费The performance fee is charged only on new profit above the historical peak NAV; after a loss, the NAV must first climb back above the peak before fees resume
  • C. 对全部利润计提Charged on all profit
答案 B。高水位避免亏损回补期重复收费。Answer B. The high-water mark avoids double-charging during loss recovery.

19. catch-up 条款是什么:What is a catch-up clause: 官方题Official

  • A. LP 追补出资The LP catches up on contributions
  • B. 降低 GP 分成It lowers the GP's share
  • C. 回报超过门槛后,允许 GP 追补到完整分成比例After returns exceed the hurdle, it lets the GP catch up to its full share ratio
答案 C。catch-up 让 GP 补回门槛前的分成。Answer C. Catch-up lets the GP recoup its share on the pre-hurdle portion.

20. 收益分配 waterfall 规定什么:What does a distribution waterfall specify: 官方题Official

  • A. LP 与 GP 之间收益分配的先后顺序(如先返 LP 本金和门槛收益,再分 GP)The order of profit distribution between LP and GP (e.g., return LP principal and hurdle first, then the GP's share)
  • B. 投资标的的选择顺序The order of selecting investments
  • C. 管理费的计提顺序The order of charging management fees
答案 A。瀑布式规定收益的分配次序。Answer A. The waterfall specifies the sequence of distributing returns.
1. 保护对冲基金客户免于对同一业绩重复付费的特征最可能是：1. A feature that protects hedge fund clients from paying twice for the same performance is most likely a: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 费率折扣。discount.
  • B. 门槛收益率。hurdle rate.
  • C. 高水位线(high-water mark)。high-water mark.
答案 C。高水位线(high-water mark):只有净值超过历史最高点才收激励费 → 防止对同一段业绩重复付费(亏损补回前不收费)。门槛收益率是另一机制。Answer C. A high-water mark: incentive fees are charged only when NAV exceeds its prior peak → preventing paying twice for the same performance (no fee until prior losses are recouped). A hurdle rate is a separate mechanism.
2. 仅在基金超过特定回报后才能赚取激励费的对冲基金特征，最好地定义了：2. A hedge fund feature that allows an incentive fee to be earned only after the fund exceeds a specified return best defines a: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 锁定期。lockup.
  • B. 门槛收益率。hurdle rate.
  • C. 高水位线。high-water mark.
答案 B。门槛收益率(hurdle rate):只有回报超过设定水平后才赚激励费。锁定期限制赎回;高水位线防重复收费。Answer B. A hurdle rate: incentive fees are earned only on returns above a set level. A lockup restricts redemptions; a high-water mark prevents double-charging.
3. 某对冲基金具有以下特征：

答案 B。方法:净回报 = 毛回报 − 管理费 −(激励费,基于扣管理费后的回报)。按表逐层扣费 ≈ 16.4%。Answer B. Method: net return = gross return − management fee − incentive (on the after-management-fee return). Netting the fees per the table ≈ 16.4%.
4. 分析师收集某对冲基金以下信息：

A hedge fund has the following characteristics: initial investment capital of $200 million; a 2% management fee based on assets under management at the end of the year; a 20% incentive fee, calculated independent of the management fee and based on returns in excess of a 7% hurdle rate. §1 业绩评估的困难§1 The Difficulty of Performance Evaluation

LOS 对应:LOS: describe the performance appraisal of alternative investments。

另类投资业绩难评估的原因:
① 非上市资产估值困难(常用模型/评估价而非市场价),导致回报被平滑(smoothing)、低估波动率和相关性;
② 报告频率低;
③ 收益分布常非正态(偏度、肥尾),使夏普比率等基于正态的指标失真;
④ 有各种数据偏差(见下)。Why alternative-investment performance is hard to evaluate:
① non-listed assets are hard to value (often model/appraisal prices rather than market prices), so returns are smoothed, understating volatility and correlations;
② low reporting frequency;
③ return distributions are often non-normal (skewness, fat tails), distorting normal-based metrics like the Sharpe ratio;
④ various data biases (see below).

考点·另类投资估值:
• 盯市滞后/平滑(stale pricing):私募资产估值不频繁 → 报告回报被平滑 → 低估真实波动与相关性(看着更稳)。私募股权指数因此高估业绩。
• 按模型估值(mark-to-model):无活跃市场时用模型算的理论价值。
• 最保守法:多头用买价(bid)、空头用卖价(ask)(假设以最不利一侧成交)。Exam - valuing alternatives:
- Stale pricing/smoothing: private assets are valued infrequently, so reported returns are smoothed and understate true volatility and correlation (they look calmer). Private-equity indexes therefore overstate performance.
- Mark-to-model: a theoretical value computed by a model when no active market exists.
- Most conservative method: value longs at the bid and shorts at the ask (assume the least favorable side).

1. 为什么另类投资回报常被"平滑":Why are alternative-investment returns often 'smoothed': 官方题Official

  • A. 因流动性很高Because liquidity is high
  • B. 非上市资产用评估价/模型价而非市场价,估值滞后,使回报波动被低估Unlisted assets use appraisal/model values rather than market prices, so valuation lags and return volatility is understated
  • C. 因每日按市场定价Because they are marked to market daily
答案 B。评估价滞后平滑了真实波动。Answer B. Lagging appraisal values smooth true volatility.

2. 回报平滑会低估哪些统计量:Which statistics does return smoothing understate: 官方题Official

  • A. 高估波动率Overstates volatility
  • B. 没有任何影响No effect
  • C. 低估波动率和与其他资产的相关性,高估分散化好处和风险调整后收益Understates volatility and correlations with other assets, overstating the diversification benefit and risk-adjusted return
答案 C。平滑使风险被低估、分散化被高估。Answer C. Smoothing understates risk and overstates diversification.

3. 为什么夏普比率不适合评估某些另类投资:Why is the Sharpe ratio unsuitable for evaluating some alternative investments: 官方题Official

  • A. 另类回报常非正态(偏度、肥尾),夏普基于正态假设会误导Alternative returns are often non-normal (skew, fat tails), and the Sharpe ratio's normality assumption can mislead
  • B. 夏普永远适用Sharpe always applies
  • C. 因回报完全正态Because returns are perfectly normal
答案 A。非正态分布使标准差失真。Answer A. A non-normal distribution distorts the standard deviation.

4. 为什么 IRR 对现金流时点敏感:Why is IRR sensitive to cash-flow timing: 官方题Official

  • A. IRR 是使净现值为零的贴现率,现金流发生的时间不同会显著改变 IRRIRR is the discount rate that makes NPV zero, and different timing of cash flows significantly changes the IRR
  • B. IRR 与时点无关IRR is timing-independent
  • C. IRR 只看现金流总额IRR looks only at total cash flow
答案 A。早回款抬高 IRR,晚回款压低 IRR。Answer A. Early inflows raise the IRR, late inflows lower it.
1. 私募股权投资盯市的滞后最可能使私募股权显得：1. The lag in marking private equity investments to market most likely makes private equity appear: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 波动性低于其真实水平。less volatile than it really is.
  • B. 韧性低于其真实水平。less resilient than it really is.
  • C. 与传统资产的相关性高于其真实水平。more correlated with traditional assets than it really is.
答案 A。私募股权盯市滞后(stale pricing)→ 报告回报被"平滑" → 显得波动性低于真实水平(也使相关性显得偏低)。故看起来更稳,实则不然。Answer A. Private-equity stale pricing → reported returns are smoothed → volatility appears lower than it truly is (and correlation appears lower too). It looks calmer than reality.
2. 对冲基金的按模型估值(mark-to-model)最可能反映：2. Hedge fund mark-to-model valuations most likely reflect a: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 清算价值。liquidation value.
  • B. 理论价值。theoretical value.
  • C. 公开交易价格。publicly traded price.
答案 B。按模型估值(mark-to-model)反映"理论价值"(无活跃市场时用模型算)。清算价值、公开交易价是别的估值基准。Answer B. Mark-to-model valuation reflects theoretical value (a model estimate when no active market exists). Liquidation value and traded prices are different bases.
3. 当用市场价格为对冲基金持有的底层头寸估值时，最保守的方法采用：3. When market prices are used to value underlying positions held by a hedge fund, the most conservative approach uses: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅买价(bid)。bid prices only.
  • B. 买价与卖价的平均。the average of bid and ask prices.
  • C. 多头用买价、空头用卖价。bid prices for longs and ask prices for shorts.
答案 C。最保守的市场估值:多头用买价(bid)、空头用卖价(ask)——即假设以最不利的一侧成交,给出最保守(偏低)的净值。Answer C. The most conservative market valuation: value longs at the bid and shorts at the ask — assuming trades at the least favorable side, giving the most conservative (lower) NAV.

§2 业绩偏差:生存者与回填§2 Performance Biases: Survivorship & Backfill 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: describe the biases in alternative investment return data。
🔰 零基础讲解:数据库里的"幸存者叙事"

生存者偏差🏆 对冲基金数据库只统计"还活着"的基金——业绩差的早就清盘、消失了。于是数据库里剩下的都是赢家,平均回报被人为拔高,风险被低估。就像只统计打赢的将军,会以为打仗很容易。让另类投资的历史回报看起来比真实更好。Survivorship bias🏆 A hedge fund database counts only funds that are "still alive" — poor performers were wound up and vanished long ago. So what's left in the database are winners, artificially inflating average returns and understating risk. Like counting only victorious generals and concluding war is easy. makes alternative investments' historical returns look better than reality.

偏差Bias成因Cause后果Consequence
生存者偏差 survivorshipSurvivorship bias清盘/失败的基金退出数据库,只剩幸存者Wound-up/failed funds exit the database, leaving only survivors高估平均回报、低估风险Overstates average return, understates risk
回填偏差 backfillBackfill bias基金成功后才被纳入数据库,并把过去的好业绩"补录"进去A fund is added to the database only after success, with its past good performance "backfilled" in高估历史回报Overstates historical return
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

两大业绩偏差(都使回报「上偏」)

• 生存者偏差(survivorship bias):失败/清盘基金退出数据库,只留存活者 → 高估平均回报、低估风险。
• 回填偏差(backfill bias):新纳入基金把过去好看的历史回填进指数 → 指数被上偏。

机制

对冲基金自愿报告,表现差的不报或退出;数据库只见「赢家」。两者叠加使报告回报系统性偏高、波动偏低。

易错对比

① 两种偏差都使回报上偏(不是一升一降);② 生存者=退出者消失、回填=好历史被补入;③ 对冲基金指数尤其受影响。

Two performance biases (both bias returns UP)

• Survivorship bias: failed/closed funds leave the database, leaving only survivors → overstates average return, understates risk.
• Backfill bias: a newly added fund's favorable past history is backfilled into the index → the index is biased up.

Mechanism

Hedge-fund reporting is voluntary; poor performers stop reporting or exit, so the database sees mostly "winners." Together they systematically raise reported returns and lower reported volatility.

Common traps

① Both biases push returns up (not one up one down); ② survivorship = exits vanish, backfill = good history added in; ③ hedge-fund indices are especially affected.

5. 生存者偏差怎么产生、有何后果:How does survivorship bias arise and what are its consequences: 官方题Official

  • A. 没有后果No consequences
  • B. 失败/清盘基金退出数据库,只剩幸存者,导致高估平均回报、低估风险Failed/liquidated funds drop out of the database, leaving only survivors, so average returns are overstated and risk understated
  • C. 低估平均回报Understates average returns
答案 B。只留下赢家使统计结果偏乐观。Answer B. Keeping only winners makes the statistics look optimistic.

6. 回填偏差是什么:What is backfill bias: 官方题Official

  • A. 基金成功后才被纳入数据库并补录过去好业绩,抬高历史平均回报A fund is added to the database only after success and its past good performance is backfilled, raising the historical average return
  • B. 补录差业绩Backfills poor performance
  • C. 降低历史回报Lowers historical returns
答案 A。回填历史好业绩抬高平均。Answer A. Backfilling good historical performance raises the average.

7. 生存者偏差和回填偏差都往哪个方向影响回报:In which direction do survivorship and backfill bias both affect returns: 官方题Official

  • A. 都向下低估Both downward (understate)
  • B. 方向相反In opposite directions
  • C. 都向上(高估)历史平均回报Both upward (overstate) the historical average return
答案 C。两种偏差都抬高历史平均回报。Answer C. Both biases raise the historical average return.
1. 私募股权指数最可能高估：1. Private equity indexes most likely overestimate: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 波动性。volatility.
  • B. 业绩。performance.
  • C. 与传统资产的相关性。correlation with traditional assets.
答案 B。私募股权指数最可能高估"业绩"(存活/自选偏差、平滑估值使回报看起来更好)。它反而低估波动/相关性。Answer B. A private-equity index most likely overstates performance (survivorship/self-selection bias and smoothed valuations flatter returns). It understates volatility/correlation instead.

§3 净回报与费用侵蚀§3 Net Returns & Fee Erosion

LOS 对应:LOS: calculate and interpret returns net of fees。

另类投资费用高,净回报(扣除管理费和业绩报酬后)可能显著低于总回报。计算净回报时须依约定顺序扣除:先管理费、再(超过门槛/高水位的)业绩报酬。对 PE,常用内部收益率(IRR)和投资倍数(MOIC = 总价值/投入资本)衡量;IRR 对现金流时点敏感。Alternative investments have high fees, so the net return (after management and performance fees) can be materially below the gross return. Computing net return requires deducting in the agreed order: management fee first, then the (above-hurdle/high-water) performance fee. For PE, performance is commonly measured by internal rate of return (IRR) and investment multiple (MOIC = total value/invested capital); IRR is sensitive to cash-flow timing.

8. 净回报与总回报的区别是:The difference between net and gross return is: 官方题Official

  • A. 净回报扣除了管理费和业绩报酬,可能显著低于总回报Net return is after management and performance fees and can be significantly below gross return
  • B. 净回报高于总回报Net return is higher than gross return
  • C. 两者相同They are the same
答案 A。费用侵蚀使净回报低于总回报。Answer A. Fee erosion makes net return below gross return.

9. 为什么高水位线与私募债/PE 的净回报计算相关:Why is the high-water mark relevant to the net-return calculation for private debt/PE: 补充Extra

  • A. 只影响总回报Affects only gross return
  • B. 业绩报酬只对超过历史高点的利润计提,直接影响扣费后的净回报The performance fee is charged only on profit above the historical peak, directly affecting the after-fee net return
  • C. 与净回报无关Unrelated to net return
答案 B。高水位决定何时计提业绩报酬,进而影响净回报。Answer B. The high-water mark decides when the performance fee applies, affecting net return.

§4 私募股权:并购与风投§4 Private Equity: Buyouts & Venture Capital 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: describe types of private equity investments。
类型Type特征Characteristics
杠杆并购 LBOLeveraged buyout (LBO)用大量债务收购成熟公司,改善运营/治理后退出;目标现金流稳定、可负债Acquire a mature company with heavy debt, improve operations/governance, then exit; targets have stable cash flows and can bear debt
风险投资 VCVenture capital (VC)投early-stage 高增长初创;按阶段:种子、早期、成长期;高风险高回报、多数失败靠少数大赢Invest in early-stage high-growth startups; by stage: seed, early, growth; high risk/high return, most fail and a few big winners carry the returns
成长资本 growthGrowth capital投相对成熟、需扩张资金的公司,通常不控股Invest in relatively mature companies needing expansion capital, usually without taking control
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

私募股权两大类

• 并购(buyout / LBO):收购成熟企业,现金流稳定可预测,常用杠杆;靠运营改善 + 财务杠杆 + 多重扩张(multiple expansion)创造价值。
• 风险投资(venture capital):投早期/初创,失败率高、回报呈幂律(少数「本垒打」撑起整只基金),现金流不确定、通常不用杠杆。

退出方式(exit)

IPO、战略出售(trade sale 卖给同业)、二级出售(secondary sale 卖给另一 PE)、资本重组(recapitalization)。

易错对比

① buyout 现金流稳、上杠杆;VC 早期高风险、不上杠杆;② VC 回报靠少数大赢家;③ 退出方式辨认:IPO / trade sale / secondary。

Two kinds of private equity

• Buyout / LBO: acquire mature firms with stable, predictable cash flows, usually with leverage; value from operational improvement + financial leverage + multiple expansion.
• Venture capital: early-stage/startup investing, high failure rate, power-law returns (a few "home runs" carry the fund), uncertain cash flows, typically no leverage.

Exit routes

IPO, trade sale (to a strategic buyer), secondary sale (to another PE firm), recapitalization.

Common traps

① Buyout = stable cash flow + leverage; VC = early-stage, high-risk, no leverage; ② VC returns rest on a few big winners; ③ identify exits: IPO / trade sale / secondary.

10. PE 常用哪两个业绩指标:What two performance metrics does PE commonly use: 官方题Official

  • A. 夏普比率与贝塔Sharpe ratio and beta
  • B. P/E 与 P/BP/E and P/B
  • C. 内部收益率 IRR 和投资倍数 MOIC(总价值/投入资本)Internal rate of return (IRR) and the multiple of invested capital (MOIC = total value/invested capital)
答案 C。IRR 看时间价值,MOIC 看总倍数。Answer C. IRR captures time value, MOIC the total multiple.

11. 杠杆并购(LBO)的核心特征是:The core feature of a leveraged buyout (LBO) is: 官方题Official

  • A. 用大量债务收购成熟、现金流稳定的公司,改善后退出Using heavy debt to acquire mature, stable-cash-flow companies, then exiting after improvement
  • B. 投资早期初创Investing in early-stage startups
  • C. 全股权收购All-equity acquisition
答案 A。高杠杆收购成熟现金牛。Answer A. High-leverage acquisition of mature cash cows.

12. LBO 的目标公司通常具备什么特点:An LBO target company usually has what features: 官方题Official

  • A. 完全没有改善空间No room for improvement
  • B. 现金流稳定可预测、可承担较高负债、有改善空间Stable, predictable cash flows, capacity to bear high debt, and room for improvement
  • C. 现金流不稳定Unstable cash flows
答案 B。稳定现金流支撑高杠杆偿债。Answer B. Stable cash flows support high-leverage debt service.

13. 风险投资(VC)的特征是:The features of venture capital (VC) are: 官方题Official

  • A. 投成熟稳定公司Investing in mature stable companies
  • B. 风险很低Very low risk
  • C. 投早期高增长初创,风险高、多数失败,靠少数成功获得高回报Investing in early-stage high-growth startups, high risk with most failing, earning high returns from a few successes
答案 C。VC 靠少数"本垒打"覆盖多数失败。Answer C. VC relies on a few 'home runs' to cover the many failures.

14. VC 按投资阶段可分为:By investment stage, VC is divided into: 官方题Official

  • A. 种子期、早期、成长/扩张期Seed, early, and growth/expansion
  • B. 只有种子期Only seed
  • C. 只有成熟期Only mature
答案 A。从种子到扩张的阶段划分。Answer A. Stages from seed to expansion.

15. 成长资本(growth equity)与并购的区别是:The difference between growth equity and buyout is: 官方题Official

  • A. 两者完全相同They are identical
  • B. 成长资本投相对成熟、需扩张资金的公司,通常不控股;并购通常控股Growth equity invests in relatively mature companies needing expansion capital, usually without control; buyout usually takes control
  • C. 成长资本总是控股Growth equity always takes control
答案 B。成长资本多为少数股权,并购取得控制权。Answer B. Growth equity is mostly minority stakes; buyout takes control.

16. MOIC=2.0x 是什么意思:What does MOIC = 2.0x mean: 补充Extra

  • A. 年化收益 2%2% annualized return
  • B. 亏损一半Half loss
  • C. 总价值是投入资本的 2 倍(不考虑时间价值)Total value is 2× invested capital (ignoring time value)
答案 C。MOIC 是不考虑时间的倍数指标。Answer C. MOIC is a time-agnostic multiple.
1. 就私募股权而言，成长资本(growth capital)策略又称为：1. With respect to private equity, the growth capital strategy is also known as: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 风险投资。venture capital.
  • B. 资本重组。recapitalization.
  • C. 少数股权投资。minority equity investing.
答案 C。成长资本(growth capital)又称"少数股权投资"(向较成熟公司注资、通常不取得控股)。风险投资投更早期。Answer C. Growth capital is also called minority-equity investing (injecting capital into more mature firms, usually without control). Venture capital invests earlier-stage.

§5 价值创造与退出§5 Value Creation & Exit

LOS 对应:LOS: describe the exit routes and value creation in private equity。

价值创造途径:运营改善(提升利润率/增长)、财务工程(杠杆、税务)、治理改善、多重套利(以更高倍数卖出)。退出方式(exit):
① IPO 上市;
② 并购/战略出售(trade sale)卖给产业买家;
③ 二次出售(secondary sale)卖给另一 PE;
④ 管理层收购;
⑤ 清算。Value-creation routes: operational improvement (raising margins/growth), financial engineering (leverage, taxes), governance improvement, multiple arbitrage (selling at a higher multiple). Exit methods:
① IPO;
② M&A/trade sale to an industry buyer;
③ secondary sale to another PE firm;
④ management buyout;
⑤ liquidation.

考点·私募股权的收购方式与退出:
• 杠杆收购(LBO):用大量债务收购成熟、有现金流的公司。
• 管理层收购(MBO):「现有」管理层买下公司(常配 LBO)。
• 管理层买入(MBI):「外部」管理团队买入并接管公司(与 MBO 的关键区别在于是内部还是外部管理层)。
• 退出策略:IPO、战略出售(trade sale, 卖给同业)、二次出售(卖给另一 PE)、资本重组(recapitalization)、SPAC。Exam - PE acquisition methods & exits:
- Leveraged buyout (LBO): acquire a mature, cash-generating firm with heavy debt.
- Management buyout (MBO): the "existing" management buys the firm (often via LBO).
- Management buy-in (MBI): an "external" management team buys in and takes over (the key MBO vs MBI difference is internal vs external management).
- Exits: IPO, trade sale (to an industry buyer), secondary sale (to another PE firm), recapitalization, SPAC.

17. PE 创造价值的主要途径是:The main ways PE creates value are: 官方题Official

  • A. 运营改善、财务工程(杠杆/税务)、治理改善、以更高倍数退出(多重套利)Operational improvement, financial engineering (leverage/tax), governance improvement, and exiting at a higher multiple (multiple arbitrage)
  • B. 只靠杠杆Only leverage
  • C. 不创造价值Creates no value
答案 A。运营、财务、治理与退出倍数多轮驱动。Answer A. Driven by operations, finance, governance, and exit multiple.

18. PE 常见的退出方式有:Common PE exit routes are: 官方题Official

  • A. 从不退出Never exits
  • B. IPO、战略出售(trade sale)、二次出售给另一 PE、管理层收购、清算IPO, trade sale, secondary sale to another PE, management buyout, liquidation
  • C. 只有 IPO 一种Only IPO
答案 B。退出渠道多样。Answer B. Exit channels are diverse.
1. 从私募股权公司的角度，通过特殊目的收购公司(SPAC)退出被投企业的一个优势最可能包括：1. From the perspective of a private equity firm, an advantage of exiting a portfolio company through a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) most likely includes: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 浮动估值。floating valuation.
  • B. 交易结构的灵活性。flexibility of the transaction structure.
  • C. 因赎回受限而降低交易风险。lower deal risk due to restrictions on redemptions.
答案 B。用 SPAC 退出的优势 = 交易结构的灵活性(谈判空间大)。SPAC 估值不"浮动"、赎回反而带来不确定,故 A、C 错。Answer B. An advantage of a SPAC exit = flexibility in deal structure (room to negotiate). SPAC valuation is not "floating," and redemptions add uncertainty, so A and C are wrong.
2. 下列哪项最可能是私募股权基金组合中被投企业的主要退出策略？2. Which of the following is most likely a primary exit strategy for a company held by a private equity fund's portfolio? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 首次公开发行(IPO)IPO
  • B. 管理层买入(MBI)Management buy-in
  • C. 管理层收购(MBO)Management buyout
答案 A。私募股权被投企业的主要退出策略之一 = 首次公开发行(IPO)(还有战略出售、二次出售、资本重组)。MBI/MBO 是收购方式,非典型退出。Answer A. A primary PE exit strategy = an IPO (plus trade sale, secondary sale, recapitalization). MBI/MBO are acquisition methods, not typical exits.
3. 私募股权经理将公司出售给同行业战略买家的退出策略，最好地描述为：3. An exit strategy where a private equity manager sells a company to a strategic buyer in the same industry best describes a: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 战略出售(trade sale)。trade sale.
  • B. 二次出售。secondary sale.
  • C. 资本重组。recapitalization.
答案 A。把公司卖给同行业战略买家 = 战略出售(trade sale)。二次出售是卖给另一 PE;资本重组是调整资本结构分红。Answer A. Selling the company to a strategic industry buyer = a trade sale. A secondary sale is to another PE firm; a recapitalization restructures capital for a distribution.

§6 私募债§6 Private Debt

LOS 对应:LOS: describe private debt investments。

私募债=非公开发行的债务,由私募基金直接向企业放贷。类型:直接贷款(direct lending)、夹层债(mezzanine)(介于债与股之间,含股权特征,收益更高)、不良债(distressed)(买入困境企业债博重组收益)、风险债(venture debt)。收益高于公募债但流动性差、信用风险高。Private debt = privately placed debt, lent directly to companies by private funds. Types: direct lending, mezzanine (between debt and equity, with equity features and higher returns), distressed (buying troubled companies' debt to profit from restructuring), venture debt. Returns exceed public bonds but with poor liquidity and high credit risk.

考点·私募债(private debt)类型:
• 风险债务(venture debt):向可能几乎无现金流的早期公司放贷,常附股权认购权。
• 不良债务(distressed debt):购买陷入财务困境的成熟公司债务(赌重组/回收)。
• 单一档级(unitranche):把有担保+无担保合成一笔,利率居中 → 借款成本低于纯无担保。
• 夹层债务(mezzanine):次级于高级担保债、优先于权益,常含股权特征。Exam - types of private debt:
- Venture debt: lending to early-stage firms that may have little cash flow, often with equity warrants.
- Distressed debt: buying the debt of financially distressed mature companies (betting on restructuring/recovery).
- Unitranche: blends secured + unsecured into one loan at an intermediate rate - lower cost than pure unsecured.
- Mezzanine: subordinate to senior secured debt, senior to equity, often with equity features.

19. 私募债包含哪些类型:What types does private debt include: 官方题Official

  • A. 只有政府债Only government bonds
  • B. 只有可转债Only convertibles
  • C. 直接贷款、夹层债、不良债、风险债(venture debt)Direct lending, mezzanine debt, distressed debt, venture debt
答案 C。私募债覆盖从直贷到夹层、不良等多类。Answer C. Private debt spans direct lending, mezzanine, distressed, etc.

20. 夹层债(mezzanine)的特点是:The features of mezzanine debt are: 官方题Official

  • A. 介于债与股之间、求偿顺序靠后、常含股权特征(权证),收益高于普通债Between debt and equity, lower priority in the claims order, often with equity features (warrants), and higher yield than ordinary debt
  • B. 求偿顺序最优先Top priority in the claims order
  • C. 收益低于普通债Lower yield than ordinary debt
答案 A。夹层债以更高收益补偿靠后的求偿顺序。Answer A. Mezzanine compensates for its lower priority with a higher yield.

21. 不良债(distressed)投资的思路是:The rationale of distressed-debt investing is: 官方题Official

  • A. 只买国债Buy only government bonds
  • B. 买入困境企业的债务,博重组/清算中的价值回升或获得股权Buy the debt of a troubled company, betting on value recovery in restructuring/liquidation or obtaining equity
  • C. 只买优质债Buy only high-quality debt
答案 B。低价买入困境债,博重组价值。Answer B. Buy distressed debt cheaply, betting on restructuring value.

22. 私募债相比公募债的收益与流动性特征是:The return and liquidity features of private debt vs public debt are: 官方题Official

  • A. 收益更低Lower return
  • B. 流动性更好Better liquidity
  • C. 收益更高、流动性更差、信用风险更高、信息不对称更大Higher return, poorer liquidity, higher credit risk, greater information asymmetry
答案 C。私募债以流动性与风险换取更高收益。Answer C. Private debt trades liquidity and risk for higher return.
1. 在私募债市场中，风险债务(venture debt)：1. In the private debt market, venture debt: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 是购买陷入财务困境的成熟公司的债务。entails buying the debt of mature companies in financial difficulty.
  • B. 向可能几乎没有现金流的早期公司提供资本。provides capital to early-stage companies that may be generating little cash flow.
  • C. 既购买困境成熟公司债务，又向早期公司提供资本。entails buying the debt of mature companies in financial difficulty and provides capital to early-stage companies.
答案 B。风险债务(venture debt)= 向"可能几乎无现金流的早期公司"提供的债务融资(常附股权认购权)。购买困境成熟公司债务是"不良债务",故 A、C 错。Answer B. Venture debt = debt financing to early-stage companies that may have little cash flow (often with equity warrants). Buying distressed mature-company debt is "distressed debt," so A and C are wrong.
2. 与无担保债务相比，单一档级债务(unitranche debt)最可能具有：2. Compared to unsecured debt, unitranche debt most likely features: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 更低的借款成本。lower borrowing costs.
  • B. 相同的借款成本。the same borrowing costs.
  • C. 更高的借款成本。higher borrowing costs.
答案 A。单一档级债务(unitranche)把有担保与无担保合成一笔、利率介于两者之间 → 借款成本"低于"纯无担保债务。Answer A. Unitranche debt blends secured and unsecured into one loan at a rate between them → a lower borrowing cost than pure unsecured debt.
3. 下列哪项是购买陷入财务困境的成熟公司的债务？3. Which of the following entails buying the debt of mature companies in financial difficulty? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 风险债务。Venture debt.
  • B. 不良债务。Distressed debt.
  • C. 单一档级债务。Unitranche debt.
答案 B。购买陷入财务困境的成熟公司债务 = 不良债务(distressed debt)(赌重组/回收)。风险债务投早期;单一档级是混合结构。Answer B. Buying the debt of financially distressed mature companies = distressed debt (betting on restructuring/recovery). Venture debt is early-stage; unitranche is a blended structure.
4. 关于私募债的下列表述哪项最准确？夹层债务(mezzanine debt)是：4. Which of the following statements about private debt is most accurate? Mezzanine debt is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 向现金流为负的初创/早期公司提供的融资。funding provided to start-up or early-stage companies generating negative cash flow.
  • B. 在借款人资本结构中次级于高级担保债务、但优先于权益。subordinated to senior secured debt but senior to equity in the borrower's capital structure.
  • C. 将不同档级的有担保与无担保债务合并为单一贷款的混合结构。a hybrid loan structure that combines different tranches of secured and unsecured debt into a single loan.
答案 B。夹层债务(mezzanine debt):在资本结构中"次级于高级担保债、优先于权益",风险/收益居中,常含股权特征。故 B。Answer B. Mezzanine debt: subordinate to senior secured debt but senior to equity in the capital structure, with intermediate risk/return and often equity features. Hence B.
5. 下列哪种私募债融资来源可能为贷款人或投资者提供股权参与？5. Which of the following sources of private debt financing may provide equity participation to lenders or investors? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅风险债务Venture debt only
  • B. 仅夹层债务Mezzanine debt only
  • C. 风险债务与夹层债务两者Both venture debt and mezzanine debt
答案 C。风险债务与夹层债务"两者"都可能给贷款人/投资者"股权参与"(认股权证/转换权),以补偿较高风险。Answer C. Both venture debt and mezzanine debt can offer the lender/investor equity participation (warrants/conversion) to compensate for higher risk.

CFA Program Curriculum · Level I · Alternative Investments

第三讲 · 房地产、基础设施与自然资源Lecture 3 · Real Estate, Infrastructure & Natural Resources

对应教材:Real Estate and Infrastructure + Natural Resources · 建议学习时长:3 小时Curriculum: Real Estate and Infrastructure + Natural Resources · Suggested study time: 3 hours

这一讲讲三类"实物资产"另类投资:房地产、基础设施、自然资源(大宗商品/农田/林地)。它们共同点是提供抗通胀和分散化;大宗商品的期货结构(contango/backwardation)与回报来源是重点计算/概念点。This lecture covers three 'real-asset' alternative investments: real estate, infrastructure, and natural resources (commodities/farmland/timberland). What they share is providing inflation protection and diversification; commodities' futures structure (contango/backwardation) and sources of return are key calculation/concept points.
