§1 房地产:投资形式§1 Real Estate: Investment Forms

LOS 对应:LOS: describe investment characteristics of real estate。

房地产提供租金现金流 + 增值 + 抗通胀 + 分散化,但流动性差、需专业管理、交易成本高、受利率和经济周期影响。投资可分股权型(持有物业/REITs 股)与债权型(按揭贷款/MBS),又分公开(REITs、CMBS)与私募(直接持有、私募基金)。Real estate provides rental cash flow + appreciation + inflation hedging + diversification, but with poor liquidity, a need for professional management, high transaction costs, and exposure to interest rates and the economic cycle. Investment splits into equity (holding property/REIT shares) and debt (mortgage loans/MBS), and into public (REITs, CMBS) and private (direct holding, private funds).

考点·房地产投资策略(风险递增):
• 核心(core):大城市中心、高质量、稳定出租,风险最低、当期收益为主。
• 核心增益(core-plus):略高风险,少量增值空间。
• 增值型(value-add):适度再开发/升级、出租空置、重新定位以求更高回报。
• 机会型(opportunistic):重大开发/重建,风险与回报最高。
REITs 流动性好;直接持有控制强但耗时、交易成本高;房地产资产异质(heterogeneous)。Exam - real-estate strategies (rising risk):
- Core: prime city-center, high-quality, well-leased - lowest risk, income-focused.
- Core-plus: slightly higher risk, modest upside.
- Value-add: modest redevelopment/upgrades, leasing vacancy, repositioning for higher return.
- Opportunistic: major development/redevelopment - highest risk and return.
REITs are liquid; direct ownership gives control but is time-consuming with high transaction costs; real estate is heterogeneous.

1. 房地产投资的主要收益来源是:The main sources of return for real estate investment are: 官方题Official

  • A. 租金现金流、资本增值,兼具抗通胀和分散化Rental cash flow and capital appreciation, with inflation protection and diversification
  • B. 只有利息收入Only interest income
  • C. 只有股息收入Only dividend income
答案 A。租金 + 增值,并有抗通胀作用。Answer A. Rent + appreciation, with an inflation-hedging effect.

2. REITs 的特点是:The features of REITs are: 官方题Official

  • A. 无任何分红No dividends at all
  • B. 上市、流动性好、须分配大部分应税收入(高分红)、税收穿透Listed, liquid, required to distribute most taxable income (high dividends), with tax pass-through
  • C. 不上市、流动性差Unlisted and illiquid
答案 B。REITs 让小投资者可流动地配置房地产。Answer B. REITs let small investors allocate to real estate liquidly.

3. 房地产投资的主要风险是:The main risks of real estate investment are: 官方题Official

  • A. 流动性很好Very good liquidity
  • B. 没有任何风险No risk at all
  • C. 流动性差、利率与经济周期敏感、交易成本高、需专业管理Poor liquidity, sensitivity to rates and the economic cycle, high transaction costs, and the need for professional management
答案 C。低流动性与周期敏感是主要风险。Answer C. Low liquidity and cycle sensitivity are the main risks.
1. 寻求流动性的另类资产投资者最可能投资于：1. Investors in alternative assets who seek liquidity are most likely to invest in: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 对冲基金。hedge funds.
  • B. 私募股权。private equity.
  • C. 房地产投资信托(REITs)。real estate investment trusts.
答案 C。寻求"流动性"的另类投资者应选REITs(房地产投资信托)——交易所交易、流动性好。对冲基金、私募股权流动性差(锁定)。Answer C. An alternatives investor seeking liquidity should choose REITs — exchange-traded and liquid. Hedge funds and private equity are illiquid (locked up).
2. 直接房地产投资的一个缺点是：2. A disadvantage of direct real estate investing is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 缺乏控制权。a lack of control.
  • B. 不利的税收规则。unfavorable tax rules.
  • C. 管理物业所需的时间。the time required to manage the property.
答案 C。直接房地产投资的缺点 = 管理物业所需的"时间"(与精力)(自持自管)。直接持有反而控制权强、税收常有利,故 A、B 错。Answer C. A drawback of direct real-estate investing = the time (and effort) to manage the property. Direct ownership actually gives more control and often favorable tax, so A and B are wrong.
3. 下列哪项最好地归类为核心(core)房地产？3. Which of the following is best categorized as core real estate? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 农村地区的高质量写字楼A high-quality office building in a rural area
  • B. 大城市中心的低质量写字楼A low-quality office building in a major urban center
  • C. 大城市中心的高质量写字楼A high-quality office building in a major urban center
答案 C。核心(core)房地产 = 大城市中心的高质量、稳定出租物业(低风险、当期收益为主)。农村/低质写字楼风险更高、非核心。Answer C. Core real estate = high-quality, stable, well-leased properties in major city centers (low risk, income-focused). Rural or low-quality offices are riskier, non-core.
4. 关于房地产资产的下列表述哪项最准确？4. Which of the following statements about real estate assets is most accurate? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 房地产资产具有异质性Real estate assets are heterogeneous
  • B. 商业物业按价值占房地产资产的多数Commercial property represents the majority of real estate assets by value
  • C. 私募房地产历来与其他资产类别高度相关Private real estate has historically had high correlations with other asset classes
答案 A。房地产资产具有"异质性(heterogeneous)"(每处物业独一无二)。住宅按价值占多数(非商业)、私募房地产与其他资产相关性低,故 B、C 错。Answer A. Real-estate assets are heterogeneous (every property is unique). Residential is the majority by value (not commercial), and private real estate has low correlation with other assets, so B and C are wrong.
5. 下列哪种房地产投资策略最可能专注于适度的再开发或升级、出租空置空间以及对底层物业进行重新定位以获取更高回报？5. Which of the following real estate investing strategies is most likely to focus on modest redevelopment or upgrades, the leasing of vacant space, and the repositioning of underlying properties to earn a higher return? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 核心增益(Core-plus)Core-plus
  • B. 增值型(Value-add)Value-add
  • C. 机会型(Opportunistic)Opportunistic
答案 B。适度再开发/升级、出租空置、重新定位以求更高回报 = 增值型(value-add)策略。核心增益风险略高于核心;机会型风险最高(重开发/开发)。Answer B. Modest redevelopment/upgrades, leasing vacancy, and repositioning for higher returns = a value-add strategy. Core-plus is slightly above core; opportunistic is the riskiest (major development).
6. 下列哪项最可能是私募房地产市场的特征？6. Which of the following is most likely a characteristic of private real estate markets? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 交易成本高Transaction costs are high
  • B. 私募市场指数可投资Private market indexes are investable
  • C. 小投资者容易建立完全自有物业的多元化组合It is easy for small investors to establish a diversified portfolio of wholly owned properties
答案 A。私募房地产市场特征 = 交易成本高(尽调、佣金、税费)。私募指数不可投、小投资者难自建分散化直投组合,故 B、C 错。Answer A. A feature of the private real-estate market = high transaction costs (due diligence, commissions, taxes). Private indexes are not investable, and small investors cannot easily build a diversified direct portfolio, so B and C are wrong.

§2 四象限§2 The Four Quadrants

LOS 对应:LOS: describe the debt/equity and public/private quadrants。
股权(Equity)Equity债权(Debt)Debt
私募Private直接持有物业、私募房地产基金Direct property holding, private real-estate funds按揭贷款、私募债Mortgage loans, private debt
公开PublicREITs、房地产运营公司股REITs, real-estate operating company sharesMBS、CMBS、抵押 REITsMBS, CMBS, mortgage REITs

REITs:上市、流动性好、分红比例高(常须分配大部分应税收入)、税收穿透;让小投资者也能配置房地产。REITs: listed, liquid, high payout (often required to distribute most taxable income), tax pass-through; let small investors also allocate to real estate.

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

房地产四象限

两维度交叉:公开 vs 私募 × 股权 vs 债权。
• 私募股权:直接持有物业(direct ownership)。
• 私募债:抵押贷款(mortgage / commercial loan)。
• 公开股权:REITs、房地产运营公司股票。
• 公开债:MBS/CMBS(抵押支持证券)。

易错对比

① REIT = 公开股权(不是债);② 抵押贷款 = 私募债;③ MBS = 公开债;④ 直接买楼 = 私募股权。公开工具流动性好、私募工具流动性差但分散化更佳。

The four real-estate quadrants

Two axes crossed: public vs private × equity vs debt.
• Private equity: direct ownership of property.
• Private debt: mortgages / commercial loans.
• Public equity: REITs, real-estate operating company shares.
• Public debt: MBS/CMBS (mortgage-backed securities).

Common traps

① REIT = public equity (not debt); ② a mortgage = private debt; ③ MBS = public debt; ④ owning a building directly = private equity. Public vehicles are liquid; private ones are illiquid but offer better diversification.

4. 房地产的四象限如何划分:How are real estate's four quadrants divided: 官方题Official

  • A. 股权/债权 × 公开/私募:私募股权、私募债、公开股权(REITs)、公开债(MBS/CMBS)Equity/debt × public/private: private equity, private debt, public equity (REITs), public debt (MBS/CMBS)
  • B. 只按地域划分Only by geography
  • C. 只有一种形式Only one form
答案 A。两维度交叉得到四象限。Answer A. Crossing two dimensions gives four quadrants.

5. 抵押 REITs(mortgage REIT)属于四象限的哪一格:Which quadrant does a mortgage REIT belong to: 官方题Official

  • A. 公开债权——投资于按揭贷款/MBSPublic debt — investing in mortgage loans/MBS
  • B. 公开股权Public equity
  • C. 私募股权Private equity
答案 A。抵押 REIT 是公开市场的债权投资。Answer A. A mortgage REIT is a public-market debt investment.

§3 房地产估值方法§3 Real Estate Valuation Methods

LOS 对应:LOS: describe approaches to valuing real estate。
方法Method思路Approach
收益法(income)Income approach用净营业收入 NOI 除以资本化率(cap rate),或 DCF 折现现金流Divide net operating income (NOI) by the capitalization rate (cap rate), or discount cash flows via DCF
成本法(cost)Cost approach重置建造成本 − 折旧 + 地价Replacement construction cost − depreciation + land value
比较法(comparable/sales)Comparable/sales approach参考近期类似物业成交价Reference recent transaction prices of similar properties
物业价值 ≈ 净营业收入(NOI) / 资本化率(cap rate)
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

房地产估值三法

• 收益法(income):直接资本化 价值 = NOI ÷ 资本化率(cap rate);或对未来现金流做 DCF。
• 成本法(cost):重建成本 − 折旧 + 地价。
• 可比销售法(comparable sales):参照近期类似成交价调整。

推导:资本化率

cap rate = NOI ÷ 价值;所以 cap rate 上升 → 估值下降(分母变大)。直接资本化适用于 NOI 稳定的成熟物业。

易错对比

① 别把 NOI 与净利润混:NOI 不扣折旧、利息、税;② cap rate 与估值反向;③ 开发中/无稳定 NOI 的物业不宜用直接资本化。

Three real-estate valuation methods

• Income: direct capitalization, value = NOI ÷ cap rate; or DCF of future cash flows.
• Cost: replacement cost − depreciation + land.
• Comparable sales: adjust from recent similar transactions.

Deriving the cap rate

cap rate = NOI ÷ value; so a higher cap rate → lower valuation (bigger denominator). Direct capitalization suits mature properties with stable NOI.

Common traps

① Don't confuse NOI with net income: NOI excludes depreciation, interest, taxes; ② cap rate and value move inversely; ③ don't use direct cap for a property without stable NOI.

6. 房地产的三种估值方法是:The three real estate valuation methods are: 官方题Official

  • A. 只有比较法Only the comparison approach
  • B. 收益法(NOI/cap rate、DCF)、成本法、比较法Income (NOI/cap rate, DCF), cost, and comparison approaches
  • C. 只有成本法Only the cost approach
答案 B。收益、成本、比较三法并用。Answer B. Income, cost, and comparison used together.

7. 用 cap rate 估物业价值的公式是:The formula to value a property with a cap rate is: 官方题Official

  • A. 价值 = NOI × 资本化率Value = NOI × cap rate
  • B. 价值 = 资本化率 / NOIValue = cap rate / NOI
  • C. 价值 ≈ 净营业收入 NOI / 资本化率Value ≈ net operating income (NOI) / capitalization rate
答案 C。NOI 除以 cap rate 得价值。Answer C. Divide NOI by the cap rate to get value.

8. cap rate 上升(其他不变)对物业估值的影响:The effect of a rising cap rate (all else equal) on property valuation: 官方题Official

  • A. 估值下降(分母变大)Valuation falls (the denominator rises)
  • B. 估值上升Valuation rises
  • C. 估值不变Valuation unchanged
答案 A。cap rate 是分母,上升使估值下降。Answer A. The cap rate is the denominator; a rise lowers valuation.

§4 基础设施投资§4 Infrastructure Investment

LOS 对应:LOS: describe investment characteristics of infrastructure。

基础设施(公路、桥梁、电网、机场、水务等):寿命长、现金流稳定且常与通胀挂钩、监管性强、初期资本大。分新建(greenfield)与成熟运营(brownfield);greenfield 风险高(建设、需求不确定),brownfield 现金流更稳。提供长期稳定收益、抗通胀、与传统资产低相关。Infrastructure (roads, bridges, power grids, airports, water, etc.): long-lived, stable and often inflation-linked cash flows, heavily regulated, large upfront capital. Split into greenfield (new build) and brownfield (mature operating); greenfield is riskier (construction, uncertain demand), brownfield has steadier cash flows. Offers long-term stable returns, inflation hedging, and low correlation with traditional assets.

缓解需求(用量)风险的机制——照付不议(take-or-pay):付款按资产的可用性(availability)而非实际使用量计算;即使用量下降,运营方仍能收到约定款项,从而把需求波动风险转移给付款方,稳定基础设施项目的现金流。A mechanism to mitigate demand (volume) risk — take-or-pay: payments are based on the asset’s availability rather than actual usage; even if volumes fall, the operator still receives the agreed payment. This shifts demand-fluctuation risk to the payer and stabilizes the infrastructure project’s cash flows.

考点·基础设施投资:
• 绿地(greenfield)= 全新建设(无运营史、开发风险高,常与开发商并肩);棕地(brownfield)= 已有运营资产(靠当期收益,风险较低)。
• 经济基础设施(机场、公路、电网、通信塔)vs 社会基础设施(social)(学校、医院、监狱等惩教设施)。
• 照付不议(take-or-pay):买方无论是否提货都须付款 → 缓解"需求(用量)风险"。基建好处:通胀保护 + 与传统资产低相关。Exam - infrastructure investing:
- Greenfield = built from scratch (no operating history, high development risk, often alongside developers); brownfield = an existing operating asset (current income, lower risk).
- Economic infrastructure (airports, roads, power grids, towers) vs social infrastructure (schools, hospitals, correctional facilities).
- Take-or-pay: the buyer pays whether or not it takes delivery, mitigating demand (volume) risk. Benefits: inflation protection + low correlation with traditional assets.

9. 基础设施投资的现金流特征是:The cash-flow features of infrastructure investment are: 官方题Official

  • A. 寿命很短Very short-lived
  • B. 寿命长、现金流稳定且常与通胀挂钩、受监管、初始资本大Long-lived, stable cash flows often tied to inflation, regulated, with large initial capital
  • C. 现金流波动很大Highly volatile cash flows
答案 B。长期、稳定、抗通胀是基建特征。Answer B. Long-term, stable, inflation-protected are infrastructure's features.

10. greenfield 与 brownfield 基础设施的区别是:The difference between greenfield and brownfield infrastructure is: 官方题Official

  • A. 两者定义相反The definitions are reversed
  • B. 两者完全相同They are identical
  • C. greenfield=新建(建设与需求风险高);brownfield=已建成运营(现金流更稳)Greenfield = new build (high construction and demand risk); brownfield = already built and operating (steadier cash flow)
答案 C。新建风险高,存量运营现金流稳。Answer C. New build is riskier; existing operations have steady cash flow.

11. 基础设施为什么能提供抗通胀收益:Why can infrastructure provide inflation-protected returns: 补充Extra

  • A. 许多基础设施的收费/合同与通胀挂钩(如受监管的调价机制)Many infrastructure tolls/contracts are tied to inflation (e.g., regulated price-adjustment mechanisms)
  • B. 与通胀完全无关Entirely unrelated to inflation
  • C. 与通胀负相关Negatively correlated with inflation
答案 A。与通胀挂钩的收费提供对冲。Answer A. Inflation-linked tolls provide a hedge.
1. 绿地(greenfield)基础设施项目的投资者通常：1. Investors in greenfield infrastructure projects typically: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 依赖资产的财务和经营历史。rely on the assets' financial and operating history.
  • B. 与战略投资者或开发商并肩投资。invest alongside strategic investors or developers.
  • C. 开发风险低于棕地(brownfield)项目投资者。have lower development risk than investors in brownfield projects.
答案 B。绿地(greenfield)项目 = 全新建设 → 投资者常"与战略投资者/开发商并肩投资"。它没有经营历史可依、开发风险高于棕地,故 A、C 错。Answer B. A greenfield project = built from scratch → investors often invest alongside strategic investors/developers. It has no operating history to rely on and higher development risk than brownfield, so A and C are wrong.
2. 下列哪项最好地归类为社会基础设施资产？2. Which of the following are best categorized as social infrastructure assets? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 机场Airports
  • B. 惩教设施Correctional facilities
  • C. 通信塔Telecommunication towers
答案 B。社会基础设施 = 惩教设施(监狱)、学校、医院等服务社会的资产。机场、通信塔是"经济基础设施"。Answer B. Social infrastructure = correctional facilities (prisons), schools, hospitals — assets serving society. Airports and communication towers are "economic infrastructure."
3. 下列哪种基础设施投资的风险最可能最高？3. Which of the following infrastructure investments most likely have the highest risk? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 回报主要来自当期收益的棕地投资。Brownfield investments with the majority of their return from current yield.
  • B. 回报主要来自资本增值的棕地投资。Brownfield investments with the majority of their return from capital appreciation.
  • C. 回报主要来自资本增值的绿地投资。Greenfield investments with the majority of their return from capital appreciation.
答案 C。风险最高 = "回报主要来自资本增值的绿地"项目(全新建设 + 靠增值,双重不确定)。棕地(有运营历史、靠当期收益)风险最低。Answer C. The highest risk = a greenfield project whose return comes mainly from capital appreciation (new build + reliance on appreciation, doubly uncertain). Brownfield with current income is lowest risk.
4. 将基础设施资产投资加入组合的好处最可能包括：4. The benefits of adding investments in infrastructure assets to a portfolio most likely include: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅通胀保护。inflation protection only.
  • B. 仅与现有组合资产低相关。low correlation with existing portfolio assets only.
  • C. 通胀保护与低相关两者。both inflation protection and low correlation with existing portfolio assets.
答案 C。基础设施投资的好处 = "通胀保护"与"与现有资产低相关"两者(现金流常与通胀挂钩、且独立于经济周期)。Answer C. Benefits of infrastructure = both inflation protection and low correlation with existing assets (cash flows are often inflation-linked and independent of the cycle).
5. 就基础设施投资而言，"照付不议"(take-or-pay)安排最可能用于缓解：5. With respect to infrastructure investments, a take-or-pay arrangement is most likely used to mitigate: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 需求（用量）风险。demand risk.
  • B. 运营风险。operational risk.
  • C. 建设风险。construction risk.
答案 A。"照付不议"(take-or-pay)安排:买方无论是否提货都须付款 → 缓解"需求(用量)风险"(锁定收入)。它不针对运营或建设风险。Answer A. A take-or-pay arrangement: the buyer pays whether or not it takes delivery → mitigating demand (volume) risk (locking in revenue). It does not address operating or construction risk.

§5 大宗商品与期货回报§5 Commodities & Futures Returns 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: describe investment characteristics of commodities and the sources of commodity futures returns。
🔰 零基础讲解:大宗商品不生息,靠什么赚?

大宗商品🛢️ 一桶原油、一吨铜放着不会像股票分红、不会像债券付息。投资者通常通过期货获取敞口,回报来自三块:现货价格变动 + 展期收益(换月赚/亏)+ 抵押品利息。期货曲线的形状(升水还是贴水)决定展期是赚还是亏。不产生现金流,回报靠价格变动、展期与抵押品利息。Commodities🛢️ A barrel of oil or a ton of copper sitting there pays no dividend like a stock and no interest like a bond. Investors usually gain exposure through futures, with return from three parts: spot-price change + roll yield (gain/loss on rolling) + collateral interest. The shape of the futures curve (contango or backwardation) determines whether rolling gains or loses. generate no cash flow; returns come from price change, rolling, and collateral interest.

大宗商品期货总回报 ≈ 现货价格回报 + 展期收益(roll yield) + 抵押品收益(collateral)
来源Source含义Meaning
价格回报Price return标的现货价格变动Change in the underlying spot price
展期收益 roll yieldRoll yield到期换月时买卖不同月份合约的损益The gain/loss from buying and selling different-month contracts when rolling at expiration
抵押品收益Collateral yield保证金/抵押现金赚取的无风险利息The risk-free interest earned on margin/collateral cash
期货曲线Futures curve形状Shape展期收益Roll yield
升水 contangoContango远月价 > 近月价(向上倾斜)Far-month price > near-month price (upward-sloping)展期亏(高买低卖换月)→ 负 roll yieldRolling loses (buy high, sell low when rolling) → negative roll yield
贴水 backwardationBackwardation远月价 < 近月价(向下倾斜)Far-month price < near-month price (downward-sloping)展期赚 → 正 roll yieldRolling gains → positive roll yield
考点提示:
① contango(升水)→ 展期亏损;backwardation(贴水)→ 展期收益。
② 大宗商品常被视为抗通胀资产。
③ 现货持有几乎无收益还有仓储成本,故多用期货。
考点·商品与商品期货定价:
• 硬商品(hard)= 开采/提取(原油、金属);软商品(soft)= 种植/养殖(农产品、牲畜)。
• 期货价 F ≈ S(1+r) + 储存成本(storage) − 便利收益(convenience yield)。储存=便利收益时抵消,则 F = S(1+r),只要利率为正 F > S。
• 期货升水(contango):远期 > 即期 → 曲线上倾;现货升水(backwardation):远期 < 即期 → 曲线下倾。Exam - commodities & commodity futures pricing:
- Hard commodities = mined/extracted (crude oil, metals); soft = grown/raised (agriculturals, livestock).
- Futures price F ≈ S(1+r) + storage cost − convenience yield. When storage = convenience yield they cancel, leaving F = S(1+r), so F > S whenever the rate is positive.
- Contango: futures > spot, an upward-sloping curve; backwardation: futures < spot, a downward-sloping curve.
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

大宗商品期货回报的三部分

总回报 = 价格回报(spot/price) + 展期收益(roll yield) + 抵押品收益(collateral)。商品本身无现金流,回报靠价格变动与展期。

展期收益的符号

• 期货升水(contango):远期价 > 现货 → 到期换约「高买低卖」→ 负 roll yield。
• 现货升水(backwardation):远期价 < 现货 → 换约获正收益 → 正 roll yield。便利收益(convenience yield)高时,曲线常呈 backwardation。

易错对比

① contango → 负 roll;backwardation → 正 roll;② 别漏抵押品收益;③ 商品无票息/股息,长期回报很依赖曲线形态。

Three parts of commodity futures returns

Total = price (spot) return + roll yield + collateral return. Commodities pay no cash flows; returns come from price moves and rolling.

Sign of the roll yield

• Contango: futures > spot → rolling means "buy high, sell low" → negative roll yield.
• Backwardation: futures < spot → rolling earns a positive amount → positive roll yield. A high convenience yield tends to produce backwardation.

Common traps

① Contango → negative roll; backwardation → positive roll; ② don't forget the collateral return; ③ with no coupon/dividend, long-run returns hinge on the curve shape.

12. 为什么大宗商品本身不产生现金流:Why do commodities themselves generate no cash flow: 官方题Official

  • A. 商品会分红Commodities pay dividends
  • B. 实物商品不像股票分红、债券付息;持有还有仓储成本Physical commodities do not pay dividends like stocks or interest like bonds; holding them also incurs storage costs
  • C. 商品会定期付息Commodities pay interest periodically
答案 B。实物商品无内在现金流,还需仓储。Answer B. Physical commodities have no intrinsic cash flow and require storage.

13. 大宗商品期货回报的三个来源是:The three sources of commodity-futures return are: 官方题Official

  • A. 股息、利息、资本利得Dividends, interest, capital gains
  • B. 汇率、利率、通胀Exchange rate, interest rate, inflation
  • C. 现货价格回报、展期收益(roll yield)、抵押品利息Spot-price return, roll yield, and collateral interest
答案 C。现货 + 展期 + 抵押品收益。Answer C. Spot + roll + collateral yield.

14. contango(升水)的形状及对展期收益的影响:The shape of contango and its effect on roll yield: 官方题Official

  • A. 远月价高于近月(向上倾斜);展期为负(高买低卖换月)Far months priced above near months (upward-sloping); roll yield is negative (buy high, sell low when rolling)
  • B. 远月低于近月Far months below near months
  • C. 展期为正收益Roll yield is positive
答案 A。升水结构带来负展期收益。Answer A. A contango structure gives a negative roll yield.

15. backwardation(贴水)对展期收益的影响:The effect of backwardation on roll yield: 官方题Official

  • A. 远月价低于近月;展期为正收益Far months priced below near months; roll yield is positive
  • B. 展期为负Roll yield is negative
  • C. 没有展期收益No roll yield
答案 A。贴水结构带来正展期收益。Answer A. A backwardation structure gives a positive roll yield.

16. 为什么投资者多通过期货而非现货投资大宗商品:Why do investors mostly invest in commodities via futures rather than the physical: 官方题Official

  • A. 现货持有有仓储成本且无收益;期货便于获取敞口并利用抵押品利息Holding the physical incurs storage costs and yields nothing; futures ease exposure and use collateral interest
  • B. 现货更便宜The physical is cheaper
  • C. 期货无法获取敞口Futures cannot obtain exposure
答案 A。期货避免仓储、便于加杠杆与获取抵押品收益。Answer A. Futures avoid storage and ease leverage and collateral return.

17. 为什么大宗商品被视为抗通胀资产:Why are commodities seen as an inflation-hedging asset: 官方题Official

  • A. 与通胀无关Unrelated to inflation
  • B. 商品价格常随通胀上升,提供对冲通胀的作用Commodity prices often rise with inflation, providing an inflation hedge
  • C. 商品价格与通胀负相关Commodity prices are negatively correlated with inflation
答案 B。商品价格与通胀正相关。Answer B. Commodity prices are positively correlated with inflation.

18. 若某商品期货持续处于 contango,长期被动持有的影响是:If a commodity's futures stay in contango, the effect of long-run passive holding is: 补充Extra

  • A. 会提升回报It boosts returns
  • B. 没有影响No effect
  • C. 持续的负展期收益会侵蚀回报,长期跑输现货价格涨幅The persistent negative roll yield erodes returns, underperforming the spot-price gain over the long run
答案 C。长期升水下的换月成本拖累回报。Answer C. Rolling costs under long-run contango drag on returns.
1. 原油被归类为：1. Crude oil is categorized as: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 软商品。a soft commodity.
  • B. 硬商品。a hard commodity.
  • C. 既非软商品也非硬商品。neither a soft commodity nor a hard commodity.
答案 B。原油是"硬商品(hard commodity)"(开采/提取)。软商品是种植/养殖类(农产品、牲畜)。Answer B. Crude oil is a hard commodity (mined/extracted). Soft commodities are grown/raised (agricultural products, livestock).
2. 下列哪项最好地归类为商品(commodity)？2. Which of the following is best classified as a commodity? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 牲畜Livestock
  • B. 林地Timberland
  • C. 农地Agricultural land
答案 A。牲畜(livestock)是"商品(commodity)"(软商品)。林地、农地是"实物资产/自然资源"投资,不直接算商品。Answer A. Livestock is a commodity (a soft commodity). Timberland and farmland are real-asset/natural-resource investments, not commodities themselves.
3. 若某商品的储存成本等于其便利收益，则当无风险利率为何时其期货价格将高于即期价格：3. If a commodity's storage cost is equal to its convenience yield, its futures price will be greater than its spot price if the risk-free rate is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 为负。negative.
  • B. 为零。zero.
  • C. 为正。positive.
答案 C。由期货定价:F = S(1+r)+储存成本−便利收益。储存成本=便利收益时抵消,剩 F = S(1+r) → 只要无风险利率 r 为正,F > S。Answer C. From futures pricing: F = S(1+r) + storage − convenience yield. When storage = convenience yield they cancel, leaving F = S(1+r) → F > S whenever the risk-free rate r is positive.
4. 其他条件相同，当商品期货市场处于期货升水(contango)时，远期曲线最可能：4. All else being equal, when a commodity futures market is in contango, the forward curve is most likely: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 向下倾斜。downward sloping.
  • B. 平坦。flat.
  • C. 向上倾斜。upward sloping.
答案 C。期货升水(contango):远期价高于即期 → 远期曲线"向上倾斜"。反之现货升水(backwardation)向下倾斜。Answer C. Contango: futures above spot → an upward-sloping forward curve. Backwardation is the reverse (downward-sloping).

§6 农田与林地§6 Farmland & Timberland

LOS 对应:LOS: describe investment characteristics of farmland and timberland。

农田回报来自作物销售 + 土地增值,受天气、作物价格影响。林地(timberland)独特之处:树木可以"存"着不砍——价格低时少砍、等价格回升,兼具生物增长(树在长)+ 木材价格 + 土地增值三重回报,且与金融市场相关性低,抗通胀。Farmland returns come from crop sales + land appreciation, affected by weather and crop prices. Timberland is unique: trees can be "stored" unharvested — cut less when prices are low and wait for a rebound — giving triple returns of biological growth (trees keep growing) + timber price + land appreciation, with low correlation to financial markets and inflation hedging.

19. 农田投资的回报来源是:The sources of return for farmland investment are: 官方题Official

  • A. 作物销售收入和土地增值Crop sales income and land appreciation
  • B. 只有利息Only interest
  • C. 只有股息Only dividends
答案 A。经营收入 + 土地升值。Answer A. Operating income + land appreciation.

20. 林地(timberland)独特的回报特征是:The unique return feature of timberland is: 官方题Official

  • A. 不能择时采伐Harvest cannot be timed
  • B. 生物增长(树木继续生长)+ 木材价格 + 土地增值;可择时采伐(价低少砍)Biological growth (trees keep growing) + timber prices + land appreciation; harvest can be timed (cut less when prices are low)
  • C. 只有土地增值Only land appreciation
答案 B。生物增长赋予林地灵活的采伐择时权。Answer B. Biological growth gives timberland flexible harvest timing.
1. 林地(timberland)投资提供：1. Timberland investments offer: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅收入流。an income stream only.
  • B. 仅资本增值的潜力。the potential for capital gain only.
  • C. 收入流与资本增值潜力两者。both an income stream and the potential for capital gain.
答案 C。林地(timberland)"收入流与资本增值两者"都提供:采伐/出售木材带来收入,林木生长+土地增值带来资本增值。Answer C. Timberland provides both an income stream and capital-appreciation potential: harvesting/selling timber gives income, while tree growth and land value give appreciation.

§7 未开发土地 Raw Land§7 Raw Land

LOS 对应:LOS: explain features of raw land and its investment characteristics。

未开发土地通常没有当期经营现金流，主要回报来自土地升值、取得规划许可或未来开发。其价值高度依赖位置、用途管制、基础设施接入、环境条件和当地人口经济增长。Undeveloped land usually has no current operating cash flow, with returns coming mainly from land appreciation, obtaining planning permits, or future development. Its value depends heavily on location, zoning, infrastructure access, environmental conditions, and local population and economic growth.

潜在优势Potential advantages主要风险Main risks
稀缺性、开发选择权、可能抗通胀、与公开市场相关性低Scarcity, development optionality, possible inflation hedging, low correlation with public markets流动性差、持有成本、无当期收入、规划审批和环境风险、估值主观Poor liquidity, holding costs, no current income, planning-approval and environmental risk, subjective valuation

未开发土地包含明显的实物期权：投资者可以等待需求和审批条件改善后再开发，但等待期间仍承担税费和机会成本。Undeveloped land contains a clear real option: the investor can wait until demand and approval conditions improve before developing, but still bears taxes and opportunity cost during the wait.

§1 对冲基金是什么§1 What a Hedge Fund Is

LOS 对应:LOS: describe investment characteristics of hedge funds。
🔰 零基础讲解:对冲基金 ≠ 一定"对冲"

对冲基金🎭 名字叫"对冲",但很多对冲基金其实主动承担风险博高收益。它们是私募的、灵活的、几乎不受传统监管约束的主动管理基金:能做多能做空、能加杠杆、能用衍生品,追求"绝对收益"(不管市场涨跌都想赚钱)。门槛高、费用贵(2-and-20)、有锁定期。是灵活、主动、追求绝对收益的私募基金。Hedge funds🎭 Named for "hedging," but many hedge funds actually take on risk actively for high returns. They are private, flexible, actively managed funds with almost no traditional regulation: they can go long or short, use leverage, and use derivatives, pursuing "absolute return" (aiming to earn whether markets rise or fall). High threshold, expensive fees (2-and-20), with lockup periods. are flexible, active private funds pursuing absolute return.

特点:私募、面向合格投资者、可做多做空 + 杠杆 + 衍生品、追求绝对收益、费用高(2-and-20)、流动性受限(锁定期、赎回通知期、gate)。Features: private, for qualified investors, can go long/short + leverage + derivatives, pursue absolute return, high fees (2-and-20), restricted liquidity (lockup, redemption notice period, gates).

1. 对冲基金的核心特征是:The core features of hedge funds are: 官方题Official

  • A. 公募、被动Public and passive
  • B. 完全不使用杠杆No leverage at all
  • C. 私募、主动、灵活(可多空+杠杆+衍生品)、追求绝对收益、费用高、流动性受限Private, active, flexible (long/short + leverage + derivatives), absolute-return focused, high fees, restricted liquidity
答案 C。灵活的多空杠杆策略与绝对收益导向是核心。Answer C. Flexible long/short leverage strategies and an absolute-return orientation are the core.

2. "绝对收益"是什么意思:What does 'absolute return' mean: 官方题Official

  • A. 不论市场涨跌都力求获得正收益,而非相对基准跑赢Seeking positive returns regardless of whether the market rises or falls, rather than beating a benchmark
  • B. 只求相对基准跑赢Only beating a benchmark
  • C. 与市场完全同步Perfectly tracking the market
答案 A。绝对收益追求正回报而非相对表现。Answer A. Absolute return pursues positive returns rather than relative performance.

3. 为什么不能仅凭低历史波动判断对冲基金风险低:Why can't low historical volatility alone indicate low hedge-fund risk: 官方题Official

  • A. 对冲基金没有尾部风险Hedge funds have no tail risk
  • B. 非流动资产估值可能平滑波动,且杠杆、融资和尾部风险可能在压力期集中暴露Illiquid-asset valuations may smooth volatility, and leverage, financing, and tail risks can concentrate in stress periods
  • C. 低波动一定意味着低风险Low volatility always means low risk
答案 B。平滑估值掩盖了真实的尾部与杠杆风险。Answer B. Smoothed valuation masks real tail and leverage risk.
1. 下列哪项表述最准确？对冲基金：1. Which of the following statements is most accurate? Hedge funds: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 可以完全投资于传统资产。may be invested entirely in traditional assets.
  • B. 通常投资于高成长潜力的早期公司。typically invest in early-stage companies with high growth potential.
  • C. 通常对成熟、盈利且产生现金流的公司进行杠杆收购。typically pursue leveraged buyouts of established profitable and cash-generating companies.
答案 A。对冲基金"可以完全投资于传统资产"(股债现金)——"对冲基金"是结构/策略灵活性的名称,非资产类别。杠杆收购成熟公司是私募股权;投早期是风投,故 B、C 错。Answer A. A hedge fund can be fully invested in traditional assets (stocks/bonds/cash) — "hedge fund" names a flexible structure/strategy, not an asset class. LBOs of mature firms are private equity; early-stage is VC, so B and C are wrong.
2. 对冲基金最可能具有的特征是：2. A hedge fund is most likely characterized by: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 能够使用衍生品。the ability to use derivatives.
  • B. 禁止空头头寸。a prohibition against short positions.
  • C. 对赎回没有限制。an absence of restrictions on redemptions.
答案 A。对冲基金的典型特征 = 能够使用衍生品(及卖空、杠杆)。它允许空头、对赎回有限制(锁定/通知期),故 B、C 反。Answer A. A hallmark of hedge funds = the ability to use derivatives (plus short selling, leverage). They allow shorts and do restrict redemptions (lockups/notice), so B and C are reversed.

§2 四大类策略§2 The Four Strategy Categories 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: describe the classification of hedge fund strategies。
策略大类Major strategy class做法举例Example approaches
股票对冲 equity hedgeEquity hedge多空股票(long/short equity)、市场中性、卖空型;基于个股选择Long/short equity, market-neutral, dedicated short; based on stock selection
事件驱动 event-drivenEvent-driven并购套利、不良证券、特殊situations;押注公司事件Merger arbitrage, distressed securities, special situations; betting on corporate events
相对价值 relative valueRelative value套取相关证券间的价差(可转债套利、固收套利)Capturing spreads between related securities (convertible arbitrage, fixed-income arbitrage)
宏观/CTA macroMacro/CTA基于宏观趋势/趋势跟踪,交易利率、汇率、指数、商品Based on macro trends/trend-following, trading rates, currencies, indexes, commodities
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

对冲基金四大策略

• 股票对冲(equity hedge):多空(long/short)、市场中性(market neutral)。
• 事件驱动(event-driven):并购套利(merger arb)、困境证券(distressed)。
• 相对价值(relative value):固收套利、可转债套利(convertible arb)。
• 宏观/机会(macro/opportunistic):全球宏观(global macro)、管理期货(CTA/managed futures)。

易错对比(归类是考点)

① merger arb = 事件驱动;② convertible arb = 相对价值;③ global macro = 宏观;④ market neutral 属股票对冲、力求净敞口≈0。

Four hedge-fund strategy groups

• Equity hedge: long/short, market neutral.
• Event-driven: merger arbitrage, distressed.
• Relative value: fixed-income arb, convertible arbitrage.
• Macro/opportunistic: global macro, managed futures (CTA).

Common traps (classification is tested)

① Merger arb = event-driven; ② convertible arb = relative value; ③ global macro = macro; ④ market neutral is equity hedge, targeting ≈0 net exposure.

4. 对冲基金四大类策略是:The four main hedge-fund strategy categories are: 官方题Official

  • A. 只有股票对冲Only equity hedge
  • B. 只做多头Long-only
  • C. 股票对冲、事件驱动、相对价值、宏观/CTAEquity hedge, event-driven, relative value, macro/CTA
答案 C。四大类是主流分类框架。Answer C. The four categories are the mainstream classification.

5. 并购套利属于哪类策略:Merger arbitrage belongs to which strategy: 官方题Official

  • A. 事件驱动(event-driven)Event-driven
  • B. 相对价值Relative value
  • C. 宏观Macro
答案 A。并购是典型的公司事件。Answer A. A merger is a classic corporate event.

6. 可转债套利、固收套利属于哪类:Convertible arbitrage and fixed-income arbitrage belong to which category: 官方题Official

  • A. 相对价值(relative value)Relative value
  • B. 事件驱动Event-driven
  • C. 宏观Macro
答案 A。捕捉相关证券间的价差。Answer A. Capturing the spread between related securities.

7. 趋势跟踪、交易宏观利率汇率属于哪类:Trend following and trading macro rates/FX belong to which category: 官方题Official

  • A. 事件驱动Event-driven
  • B. 宏观/CTAMacro/CTA
  • C. 相对价值Relative value
答案 B。宏观/CTA 交易大类资产趋势。Answer B. Macro/CTA trades trends across major asset classes.

8. 市场中性(market neutral)的目标是:The goal of market neutral is: 官方题Official

  • A. 只做多头Long-only
  • B. 追求市场 betaPursue market beta
  • C. 同时多空,消除市场(beta)敞口,靠选股的 alpha 获利Go long and short simultaneously to eliminate market (beta) exposure and profit from stock-selection alpha
答案 C。对冲掉 beta,只赚 alpha。Answer C. Hedge out beta, earning only alpha.

9. 长短仓股票(long/short equity)属于哪一大类:Long/short equity belongs to which main category: 补充Extra

  • A. 股票对冲(equity hedge)Equity hedge
  • B. 宏观/CTAMacro/CTA
  • C. 相对价值Relative value
答案 A。多空股票是股票对冲的核心。Answer A. Long/short equity is at the core of equity hedge.
1. 下列哪种对冲基金最可能具有接近零的 beta？1. Which of the following hedge funds most likely have a beta close to zero? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 偏空型基金Short-biased funds
  • B. 市场中性基金Market-neutral funds
  • C. 基本面多空成长型基金Fundamental long/short growth funds
答案 B。市场中性(market-neutral)基金 beta ≈ 0(多空对冲掉市场敞口)。偏空型 beta 为负;基本面多空成长型仍有正净敞口。Answer B. A market-neutral fund has a beta near zero (long/short hedges out market exposure). A dedicated-short fund has negative beta; a fundamental long/short growth fund keeps a positive net exposure.
2. 激进(activist)对冲基金策略最可能：2. An activist hedge fund strategy is most likely: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 基于自上而下的分析。based on top-down analysis.
  • B. 归类为相对价值策略。classified as a relative value strategy.
  • C. 在公开股权市场实施。implemented in the public equity market.
答案 C。激进(activist)对冲基金策略在"公开股权市场"实施(买上市公司股份、推动变革)。它基于自下而上(选公司)、属事件驱动类,故 A、B 错。Answer C. An activist hedge-fund strategy operates in public equity markets (buying listed shares to push change). It is bottom-up and event-driven, so A and B are wrong.
3. 可转债套利(convertible bond arbitrage)最好地归类为：3. Convertible bond arbitrage is best classified as a(n): 真题模考Mock
  • A. 宏观对冲基金策略macro hedge fund strategy
  • B. 事件驱动对冲基金策略。event-driven hedge fund strategy.
  • C. 相对价值对冲基金策略。relative value hedge fund strategy.
答案 C。可转债套利(convertible arbitrage)属"相对价值(relative value)"策略(利用可转债与其标的股/债的相对错价)。宏观、事件驱动是别的类别。Answer C. Convertible-bond arbitrage is a relative-value strategy (exploiting mispricing between a convertible and its underlying stock/bond). Macro and event-driven are other categories.

§3 杠杆、做空与流动性条款§3 Leverage, Short-Selling & Liquidity Terms

LOS 对应:LOS: describe leverage, redemption terms, and liquidity provisions。
条款Provision含义Meaning
锁定期 lockupLockup初始一段时间不得赎回No redemption allowed for an initial period
赎回通知期 notice periodNotice period赎回须提前若干天通知Redemption requires advance notice of some days
赎回门 gateGate限制单期可赎回比例,防止挤兑Limits the proportion redeemable in one period, preventing a run
侧袋 side pocketSide pocket把流动性差的资产单独隔离Segregates illiquid assets separately
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

杠杆、做空与流动性条款

• 杠杆:放大收益与风险,可能触发追加保证金、被迫平仓。
• 做空:理论损失无上限,面临逼空(short squeeze)与借券成本。
• 流动性条款:锁定期(lockup)初期不可赎回;通知期(notice)赎回须提前告知;赎回门(gate)限制单期赎回比例;侧袋(side pocket)隔离流动性差的头寸。

易错对比

① lockup(能不能赎)≠ notice period(提前多久告知);② gate 限制的是比例/额度;③ 做空亏损无上限、做多最多亏本金。

Leverage, shorting & liquidity terms

• Leverage: magnifies gains and risk; can trigger margin calls and forced liquidation.
• Short selling: theoretically unlimited loss, exposed to short squeezes and borrow costs.
• Liquidity terms: lockup (no redemption early on); notice period (advance notice to redeem); gate (caps redemptions per period); side pocket (isolates illiquid positions).

Common traps

① Lockup (whether you can redeem) ≠ notice period (how far ahead you must tell them); ② a gate limits the proportion/amount; ③ a short's loss is unlimited, a long loses at most its principal.

10. 锁定期(lockup)的作用是:The role of a lockup period is: 官方题Official

  • A. 初始一段时间禁止赎回,给经理执行策略的空间、防止资金不稳定Prohibit redemption for an initial period, giving the manager room to execute the strategy and preventing unstable capital
  • B. 提高流动性Raise liquidity
  • C. 没有作用No role
答案 A。锁定期稳定资金以便执行策略。Answer A. A lockup stabilizes capital to execute the strategy.

11. 赎回门(gate)是什么:What is a redemption gate: 官方题Official

  • A. 限制单期可赎回的比例,防止集中赎回(挤兑)冲击基金Limiting the proportion redeemable per period, preventing a concentrated redemption (run) from hitting the fund
  • B. 禁止一切赎回Prohibiting all redemptions
  • C. 允许无限赎回Allowing unlimited redemptions
答案 A。gate 平滑赎回节奏。Answer A. A gate smooths the pace of redemptions.

12. side pocket(侧袋)的用途是:The use of a side pocket is: 官方题Official

  • A. 把流动性差/难估值的资产单独隔离,单独计价与赎回Isolating illiquid/hard-to-value assets separately, with separate valuation and redemption
  • B. 隔离现金Isolating cash
  • C. 没有用途No use
答案 A。侧袋处理难估值的非流动资产。Answer A. A side pocket handles hard-to-value illiquid assets.

13. Managed Account 相比单一基金份额的主要优点是:The main advantage of a managed account over a single fund interest is: 官方题Official

  • A. 资产隔离、持仓透明和可定制性较高;代价是门槛和运营成本通常更高Asset segregation, position transparency, and greater customizability; the cost is usually higher minimums and operating costs
  • B. 完全没有透明度No transparency at all
  • C. 成本一定更低Costs are always lower
答案 A。专户以更高成本换取隔离、透明与定制。Answer A. A managed account trades higher cost for segregation, transparency, and customization.

14. 对冲基金为什么使用杠杆:Why do hedge funds use leverage: 官方题Official

  • A. 对冲基金从不用杠杆Hedge funds never use leverage
  • B. 放大策略收益(也放大风险),提高资本效率To amplify strategy returns (also amplifying risk) and improve capital efficiency
  • C. 为了降低风险To reduce risk
答案 B。杠杆放大回报也放大风险。Answer B. Leverage amplifies returns and risk.
1. 对冲基金的锁定期(lockup period)最好地定义为下列何事发生前所需的时间：1. A hedge fund's lockup period is best defined as the required period of time before: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 赚取激励费。incentive fees are earned.
  • B. 允许赎回。redemptions are permitted.
  • C. 抽取承诺资本。committed capital is drawn down.
答案 B。锁定期(lockup period)= 首次投资后"允许赎回"之前必须持有的时间(给经理时间部署)。通知期是赎回前须提前告知的期限。Answer B. A lockup period = the time an initial investment must be held before redemption is allowed (giving the manager time to deploy). A notice period is the advance warning required before redeeming.
2. 下列哪项最可能被设计用来为对冲基金经理提供有序清算头寸、避免放大损失的机会？2. Which of the following has most likely been designed to provide an opportunity for a hedge fund manager to liquidate positions in an orderly fashion without magnifying the losses? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 通知期(notice period)。Notice periods.
  • B. 锁定期。Lockup periods.
  • C. 赎回费。Redemption fees.
答案 A。通知期(notice period)让经理"有序清算头寸、避免放大损失"(提前知道要还多少钱)。锁定期禁赎;赎回费是惩罚性收费。Answer A. A notice period lets the manager liquidate positions in an orderly way and avoid magnifying losses (advance warning of outflows). A lockup bars redemptions; a redemption fee is a penalty charge.

§4 母基金 FoF§4 Fund-of-Funds (FoF)

LOS 对应:LOS: describe fund-of-funds。

对冲基金母基金(FoF)把资金分散投给多只对冲基金:好处是分散化、专业尽调、更低门槛;代价是双层收费(母基金费 + 底层基金费),侵蚀净回报。A fund of funds (FoF) spreads capital across multiple hedge funds: the benefits are diversification, professional due diligence, and a lower threshold; the cost is double fees (FoF fee + underlying fund fees), eroding net return.

4.1 对冲基金投资载体

LOS 对应:LOS: describe investment forms and vehicles used in hedge fund investments。
载体Vehicle投资者获得的敞口Exposure the investor gets主要优缺点Main pros and cons
单一对冲基金Single hedge fund直接投资某一管理人及策略Direct investment in one manager and strategy费用层级较少、透明度可能较高；管理人和策略集中风险大Fewer fee layers, possibly higher transparency; concentration risk in the manager and strategy
Fund of Funds通过一只基金持有多只底层基金Holding multiple underlying funds through one fund分散和专业尽调；双层费用、底层持仓透明度较低Diversification and professional due diligence; double fees, lower transparency into underlying holdings
多策略基金Multi-strategy fund同一管理平台在策略间动态配置One management platform dynamically allocating across strategies集中治理和资本调度；仍受单一平台运营风险影响Centralized governance and capital deployment; still exposed to single-platform operational risk
Managed Account资产在投资者专属账户，由管理人按授权交易Assets in the investor's dedicated account, traded by the manager under a mandate透明、可定制、资产隔离；门槛和运营成本较高Transparent, customizable, asset segregation; higher threshold and operating cost
可投资指数/复制产品Investable index/replication products通过规则或流动工具复制对冲基金因子Replicating hedge fund factors through rules or liquid instruments流动性和透明度较好；存在跟踪误差，难复制非流动性和管理人技能Better liquidity and transparency; tracking error, hard to replicate illiquidity and manager skill

4.2 对冲基金的风险、回报与分散化

LOS 对应:LOS: analyze sources of risk, return, and diversification among hedge fund investments。
策略Strategy主要回报来源Main return source主要风险Main risk分散化特征Diversification character
Equity Hedge选股 alpha、净市场 beta、杠杆Stock-selection alpha, net market beta, leverage股票市场、空头挤压、因子拥挤Equity market, short squeeze, factor crowding净敞口较低时可分散股票风险，但危机时相关性可能上升Can diversify equity risk when net exposure is low, but correlations can rise in a crisis
Event-Driven交易完成或资本结构重组带来的价差收敛Spread convergence from deal completion or capital-structure restructuring交易失败、违约、流动性骤降Deal failure, default, sudden liquidity drops平时与市场相关性中等，压力期尾部损失可能集中Moderate correlation with the market normally, tail losses may concentrate in stress
Relative Value相关证券错误定价和价差回归Mispricing and spread reversion between related securities杠杆、融资、模型与基差风险Leverage, funding, model, and basis risk正常时期波动低，但去杠杆时相关性和损失会突然放大Low volatility in normal times, but correlations and losses amplify suddenly when deleveraging
Macro/CTA宏观方向判断或趋势跟踪Macro directional calls or trend-following趋势反转、模型、杠杆和政策风险Trend reversals, model, leverage, and policy risk部分趋势策略在持续危机趋势中可能提供较强分散化Some trend strategies may offer strong diversification in sustained crisis trends

对冲基金的低波动可能部分来自非流动资产的估值平滑，不能直接等同于低经济风险。评价分散化时应同时看下行相关性、压力期表现、杠杆、赎回条款和尾部风险。Hedge funds' low volatility may partly come from valuation smoothing of illiquid assets and cannot be equated directly with low economic risk. When assessing diversification, also look at downside correlation, stress-period performance, leverage, redemption terms, and tail risk.

15. 对冲基金母基金(FoF)的优点是:The advantage of a hedge fund-of-funds (FoF) is: 官方题Official

  • A. 集中于单一基金Concentration in a single fund
  • B. 没有分散化No diversification
  • C. 跨多只基金分散化、专业尽调、较低准入门槛Diversification across many funds, professional due diligence, and a lower entry threshold
答案 C。FoF 提供分散与专业筛选。Answer C. FoF provides diversification and professional screening.

16. FoF 的主要缺点是:The main drawback of an FoF is: 官方题Official

  • A. 双层收费(母基金费+底层基金费),侵蚀净回报Double-layer fees (FoF fee + underlying fund fees), eroding net returns
  • B. 完全没有费用No fees at all
  • C. 提高净回报Raises net returns
答案 A。叠加两层费用拖累回报。Answer A. Stacking two fee layers drags on returns.
1. 与对冲基金的基金(FoF)相比，单只对冲基金最可能：1. In contrast to a fund of hedge funds, a single hedge fund is most likely to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 收取更低的总费用。charge lower total fees.
  • B. 提供更好的赎回条款。offer better redemption terms.
  • C. 让小投资者能接触到分散化的对冲基金组合。make a diversified portfolio of hedge funds accessible to smaller investors.
答案 A。单只对冲基金相对"基金的基金(FoF)"总费用更低(FoF 多一层费用)。FoF 的好处是分散化与更好条款/准入,故 B、C 属 FoF 优点。Answer A. A single hedge fund has lower total fees than a fund-of-funds (FoF) (FoF adds a fee layer). The FoF's advantages are diversification and better terms/access, so B and C describe FoF.

§5 数字资产:特征§5 Digital Assets: Features

LOS 对应:LOS: describe features of digital assets。

数字资产(加密货币、代币等)基于区块链/分布式账本:去中心化、公开可验证、不可篡改。类型:支付型(比特币)、平台型/功能型代币(以太坊等)、稳定币(锚定法币)、NFT。特征:高波动、监管不确定、无现金流(估值困难)、与传统资产相关性历史上较低但在变化。Digital assets (cryptocurrencies, tokens, etc.) are based on blockchain/distributed ledgers: decentralized, publicly verifiable, tamper-resistant. Types: payment tokens (Bitcoin), platform/utility tokens (Ethereum, etc.), stablecoins (pegged to fiat), NFTs. Features: high volatility, regulatory uncertainty, no cash flow (hard to value), historically low but changing correlation with traditional assets.

5.1 分布式账本技术的金融应用

LOS 对应:LOS: describe financial applications of distributed ledger technology。
应用Application作用Role主要限制Main limitation
支付与清结算Payments and clearing/settlement减少中介、缩短结算时间、支持全天候转移Reduce intermediaries, shorten settlement time, support around-the-clock transfers扩展性、最终性和监管合规Scalability, finality, and regulatory compliance
资产代币化Asset tokenization把证券、基金份额或实物资产权利表示为链上代币Representing rights to securities, fund shares, or physical assets as on-chain tokens法律所有权与链上记录是否一致Whether legal ownership matches the on-chain record
智能合约Smart contracts满足预设条件时自动执行付款、抵押或交割Automatically execute payment, collateral, or delivery when preset conditions are met代码漏洞、预言机和不可逆操作风险Code bugs, oracle, and irreversible-operation risk
身份与记录Identity and records共享可验证的 KYC、所有权和交易记录Sharing verifiable KYC, ownership, and transaction records隐私、数据治理和不同系统互操作性Privacy, data governance, and interoperability across systems
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

数字资产的特征

• 加密货币(cryptocurrency):无内在现金流,估值靠供需/网络效应,波动极大。
• 代币(tokens):证券型(security)、实用型(utility)、非同质化(NFT)。
• 底层是区块链/分布式账本(DLT):去中心化、不可篡改、可编程。

易错对比

① 加密货币无现金流 → 传统 DCF 难用;② 证券型代币代表权益/收益权、受证券法约束,实用型代币是使用某网络的凭证;③ 「不可篡改」来自密码学与共识,不等于「合法/安全」。

Features of digital assets

• Cryptocurrency: no intrinsic cash flow, valued via supply/demand and network effects, highly volatile.
• Tokens: security, utility, non-fungible (NFT).
• Built on blockchain / distributed ledger (DLT): decentralized, immutable, programmable.

Common traps

① Cryptocurrency has no cash flow → traditional DCF is hard to apply; ② a security token represents equity/income rights and is subject to securities law, a utility token grants access to a network; ③ "immutable" comes from cryptography/consensus, not "legal/safe."

17. 数字资产依托什么技术:What technology do digital assets rely on: 官方题Official

  • A. 区块链/分布式账本技术,去中心化、可验证、不可篡改Blockchain/distributed-ledger technology — decentralized, verifiable, tamper-resistant
  • B. 中央数据库A central database
  • C. 纸质账本A paper ledger
答案 A。区块链是数字资产的底层技术。Answer A. Blockchain is the underlying technology of digital assets.

18. 稳定币(stablecoin)的特点是:The features of a stablecoin are: 官方题Official

  • A. 锚定法币或资产以降低波动,便于交易和价值存储Pegged to fiat or assets to reduce volatility, easing trading and value storage
  • B. 刻意保持高波动Deliberately maintaining high volatility
  • C. 不锚定任何资产Pegged to no asset
答案 A。稳定币通过锚定降低波动。Answer A. A stablecoin reduces volatility by pegging.

19. 为什么数字资产估值困难:Why are digital assets hard to value: 官方题Official

  • A. 非常容易估值Very easy to value
  • B. 多数无现金流、无传统内在价值锚,价格由供求和预期驱动、波动极大Most have no cash flow and no traditional intrinsic-value anchor; prices are driven by supply/demand and expectations with extreme volatility
  • C. 有稳定现金流They have stable cash flows
答案 B。缺乏现金流锚使估值主要靠供求预期。Answer B. Lacking a cash-flow anchor, valuation relies mainly on supply/demand and expectations.

20. 数字资产历史上与传统资产的相关性如何:Historically, how correlated are digital assets with traditional assets: 补充Extra

  • A. 一直非常高Always very high
  • B. 恒定为零Constantly zero
  • C. 历史上相对较低(提供潜在分散化),但近年相关性有所上升、并不稳定Historically relatively low (offering potential diversification), but correlations have risen in recent years and are not stable
答案 C。相关性偏低但不稳定,近年趋升。Answer C. Correlation is low but unstable and has trended up recently.
1. 与传统金融资产相比，数字资产：1. Compared to traditional financial assets, digital assets: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 可通过 ETF 等间接投资工具进行投资。can be invested in through indirect investment vehicles such as ETFs.
  • B. 一般记录在由中央中介维护的私有账本中。are generally recorded in private ledgers maintained by central intermediaries.
  • C. 没有基于底层资产或潜在现金流的内在价值。do not have an inherent value based on underlying assets or on potential cash flows.
答案 C。数字资产"没有基于底层资产或现金流的内在价值"(价值靠供求/共识)。它记于"公开分布式账本"(非中央私有账本)、部分可经 ETF 间接投,故 A、B 表述不准。Answer C. Digital assets have no intrinsic value based on underlying assets or cash flows (value from supply/demand/consensus). They are recorded on public distributed ledgers (not a central private one), and some are accessible via ETFs, so A and B are inaccurate.
2. 加密货币价格由下列何者驱动：2. Cryptocurrency prices are driven by: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅监管发展。regulatory development only.
  • B. 仅技术进步。technological advancement only.
  • C. 监管发展与技术进步两者。both regulatory development and technological advancement.
答案 C。加密货币价格由"监管发展"与"技术进步"两者驱动(以及供求、市场情绪)。不是单一因素。Answer C. Cryptocurrency prices are driven by both regulatory developments and technological advances (plus supply/demand and sentiment). Not a single factor.
3. 在分布式账本上表示对实物资产所有权的过程，最好地描述为：3. The process of representing ownership rights to physical assets on a distributed ledger best describes: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 通证化(tokenization)。tokenization.
  • B. 区块链。a blockchain.
  • C. 首次代币发行(ICO)。an initial coin offering.
答案 A。在分布式账本上表示对"实物资产"的所有权 = 通证化(tokenization)。区块链是底层技术;ICO 是发行新代币募资。Answer A. Representing ownership of a physical asset on a distributed ledger = tokenization. Blockchain is the underlying technology; an ICO is issuing new tokens to raise funds.

§6 投资数字资产的方式§6 Ways to Invest in Digital Assets

LOS 对应:LOS: describe methods of investing in digital assets。

途径:
① 直接持有加密货币(需钱包、私钥、托管);
② 间接——加密 ETF/ETP、期货、信托、持有相关公司股票(矿企、交易所);
③ 被动/主动基金。风险:价格剧烈波动、黑客/私钥丢失、交易所倒闭、监管与合规、缺乏内在价值锚。Routes:
① direct holding of cryptocurrencies (requires a wallet, private keys, custody);
② indirect — crypto ETFs/ETPs, futures, trusts, holding shares of related companies (miners, exchanges);
③ passive/active funds. Risks: sharp price swings, hacking/private-key loss, exchange collapse, regulation and compliance, lack of an intrinsic-value anchor.

风险—回报—分散化分析：数字资产回报可能来自网络采用、稀缺性、使用需求和投机资金流；风险包括技术、托管、监管、治理、流动性、杠杆和极端价格波动。历史低相关性不稳定，在流动性紧张时期可能与高风险资产一起下跌。因此，应以压力期相关性和可承受损失评估分散化价值，而不能只使用短期历史平均相关系数。Risk-return-diversification analysis: digital-asset returns may come from network adoption, scarcity, usage demand, and speculative flows; risks include technology, custody, regulation, governance, liquidity, leverage, and extreme price swings. The historical low correlation is unstable and may fall together with risky assets in periods of liquidity stress. So assess diversification value by stress-period correlation and tolerable loss, not just short-term historical average correlations.

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

投资数字资产的方式

• 直接:持有钱包私钥、直接买币(需管理托管与安全)。
• 间接:加密基金/ETF/期货、投资相关公司股票(交易所、矿企)、区块链风投基金。

易错对比

① 直接持有面临托管/私钥丢失风险;② 期货/ETF 提供受监管、免自托管的敞口,但可能有展期成本与跟踪误差;③ 买矿企/交易所股票是间接敞口,不等于直接持币。

Ways to invest in digital assets

• Direct: hold wallet keys and buy coins directly (must manage custody and security).
• Indirect: crypto funds/ETFs/futures, shares of related companies (exchanges, miners), blockchain venture funds.

Common traps

① Direct holding carries custody/lost-key risk; ② futures/ETFs give regulated, no-self-custody exposure but may carry roll cost and tracking error; ③ buying miner/exchange stocks is indirect exposure, not the same as holding coins.

21. 间接投资数字资产的方式有:The ways to invest indirectly in digital assets are: 官方题Official

  • A. 加密 ETF/ETP、期货、信托、持有矿企/交易所等相关公司股票Crypto ETFs/ETPs, futures, trusts, holding stock of related companies such as miners/exchanges
  • B. 只能直接持币Only holding coins directly
  • C. 没有间接方式No indirect way
答案 A。可通过多种载体间接获取敞口。Answer A. Exposure can be obtained indirectly through various vehicles.

22. 直接持有加密货币的主要风险是:The main risks of holding cryptocurrency directly are: 官方题Official

  • A. 只有汇率风险Only exchange-rate risk
  • B. 私钥丢失/被盗、交易所倒闭、价格剧烈波动、监管不确定Lost/stolen private keys, exchange collapse, extreme price volatility, regulatory uncertainty
  • C. 没有任何风险No risk at all
答案 B。托管、波动与监管是主要风险。Answer B. Custody, volatility, and regulation are the main risks.
1. 下列哪种数字资产投资形式最可能涉及使用加密货币钱包？1. Which of the following forms of digital asset investment most likely involves the use of a cryptocurrency wallet? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 直接投资Direct investment
  • B. 通过 ETF 间接投资Indirect investment via ETFs
  • C. 通过币信托间接投资Indirect investment via coin trusts
答案 A。"直接投资"数字资产最可能用到加密货币钱包(自持私钥)。通过 ETF/信托间接投资则由中介托管,不需自持钱包。Answer A. Directly investing in digital assets most likely involves a crypto wallet (self-custody of private keys). Indirect investing via an ETF/trust is custodied by an intermediary, needing no personal wallet.
2. 与中心化加密货币交易所相比，去中心化交易所：2. Compared to centralized cryptocurrency exchanges, decentralized exchanges are: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 更不易被监管、也更不易受黑客攻击。less likely to be regulated and less susceptible to attacks from hackers.
  • B. 更不易被监管、但更易受黑客攻击。less likely to be regulated and more susceptible to attacks from hackers.
  • C. 更易被监管、但更不易受黑客攻击。more likely to be regulated and less susceptible to attacks from hackers.
答案 A。去中心化交易所相对中心化交易所:更不易被监管、也更不易受黑客攻击(无中央资金池/托管作为单点)。故 A。Answer A. A decentralized exchange vs a centralized one: harder to regulate and less vulnerable to hacking (no central pooled custody as a single point of failure). Hence A.

CFA Program Curriculum · Level I · Portfolio Management

第一讲 · 组合视角、投资流程与风险回报 ILecture 1 · The Portfolio Perspective, Investment Process & Risk-Return I

对应教材:Portfolio Management: An Overview + Portfolio Risk and Return: Part I · 建议学习时长:3.5 小时Curriculum: Portfolio Management: An Overview + Portfolio Risk and Return: Part I · Suggested study time: 3.5 hours

欢迎进入 Volume 9 · 组合管理。页面配色已切换为蓝色。组合管理是把前面所有资产"组装成一个整体"的学问。这一讲讲为什么要用组合视角、投资流程,以及最核心的两资产组合风险、相关性与分散化、有效前沿、资本配置线——计算与图形都要掌握。Welcome to Volume 9 · Portfolio Management. The page color has switched to blue. Portfolio management is the art of 'assembling all the earlier assets into a whole.' This lecture covers why to take the portfolio perspective and the investment process, plus the core topics of two-asset portfolio risk, correlation and diversification, the efficient frontier, and the capital allocation line — master both the calculations and the graphs.

🎯 组合管理做题技巧 · 提分策略🎯 Portfolio Management Exam Tactics
  • 分散化:相关系数越低降险越强;资产数很大时组合方差趋近"平均协方差";组合方差 = w₁²σ₁² + w₂²σ₂² + 2w₁w₂ρσ₁σ₂。Diversification: the lower the correlation the greater the risk reduction; with many assets, portfolio variance approaches the average covariance; portfolio variance = w₁²σ₁² + w₂²σ₂² + 2w₁w₂ρσ₁σ₂.
  • 效用 U = E(R) − ½Aσ²:风险厌恶 A>0、中性 A=0、偏好 A<0;无风险资产对各类型投资者效用相同(σ=0)。Utility U = E(R) − ½Aσ²: risk-averse A>0, neutral A=0, seeking A<0; a risk-free asset gives the same utility to every type (σ=0).
  • 前沿与 CML:全局最小方差在最左端;加入无风险资产 → CAL,最优风险组合(切点)取决于 Rf、不取决于偏好(两基金分离);CML 用总风险 σ、SML 用 beta。Frontier & CML: the global minimum-variance portfolio is at the far left; adding a risk-free asset gives the CAL, and the optimal risky (tangency) portfolio depends on Rf, not preferences (two-fund separation); CML uses total risk σ, SML uses beta.
  • CAPM:E(R) = Rf + β(Rm − Rf);SML 适用"所有"证券;beta = Cov/σ市² = ρσ资/σ市;预期回报 > SML 要求回报 = 低估。CAPM: E(R) = Rf + β(Rm − Rf); the SML applies to all securities; beta = Cov/σ_market² = ρσ_asset/σ_market; expected return > the SML required return = undervalued.
  • 业绩:夏普 =(R−Rf)/σ(总风险,=CAL斜率,适合"未分散"组合);特雷诺 =(R−Rf)/β、詹森α = 实际 − CAPM(仅系统性风险);M² 与夏普同排序。Performance: Sharpe = (R−Rf)/σ (total risk, = CAL slope, for under-diversified portfolios); Treynor = (R−Rf)/β and Jensen's alpha = actual − CAPM (systematic risk only); M² ranks the same as Sharpe.
  • IPS:目标与约束 = 独特需求;投资指引 = 衍生品/杠杆;程序 = 如何/何时审查;评估与审查 = 反馈。能力(时间跨度、财富/负债)vs 意愿(风险态度),取"较低者"约束。IPS 只写战略(SAA)。IPS: objectives & constraints = distinctive needs; investment guidelines = derivatives/leverage; procedures = how/when to review; evaluation & review = feedback. Ability (horizon, wealth/liabilities) vs willingness (attitude); the lower governs. The IPS specifies only the SAA.
  • 资产配置:SAA = 长期政策(IPS只写这);TAA = 短期主动偏离(超/低配某类);漂移 = 权重随市值偏离政策。风险偏好变化只移动"无差异曲线"。Asset allocation: SAA = long-term policy (the only one in the IPS); TAA = short-term active deviation (over/underweighting a class); drift = weights straying from policy as market values change. A change in risk aversion only shifts the indifference curves.
  • 风险管理:承担"可容忍"风险以最大化价值;5% 一天 VaR = 平均每 20 个交易日(1/0.05)一次;财务风险(信用/流动性/市场)vs 非财务(会计/税务/运营)。Risk management: take a tolerable level of risk to maximize value; a 5% one-day VaR is expected about once every 20 trading days (1/0.05); financial risk (credit/liquidity/market) vs non-financial (accounting/tax/operational).
  • 行为偏差:认知(可纠正)vs 情绪(难纠正);过度自信→分散不足;处置效应=扛亏卖盈;禀赋偏差=死守熟悉资产;后悔厌恶→羊群;控制错觉→集中持仓。Behavioral biases: cognitive (correctable) vs emotional (hard to correct); overconfidence → under-diversification; disposition effect = holding losers/selling winners; endowment = clinging to familiar assets; regret aversion → herding; illusion of control → concentrated positions.
  • 期权希腊字母:delta(标的价)、gamma(delta 的变化)、vega(波动率)、rho(利率)、theta(时间)——用于计量与修改组合的风险敞口。Option Greeks: delta (underlying price), gamma (change in delta), vega (volatility), rho (rate), theta (time) - used to measure and modify a portfolio's risk exposures.

§1 组合视角:分散化的价值§1 The Portfolio Perspective: The Value of Diversification

LOS 对应:LOS: describe the portfolio approach to investing。
🔰 零基础讲解:不要把鸡蛋放一个篮子

分散化🥚 单看一只股票只关心它自己的风险;但放进组合后,真正重要的是它和别的资产"一起波动"的程度。若两资产不完全同步涨跌,它们的波动会部分抵消,组合整体风险低于各自风险的简单平均——这就是"免费的午餐",分散化的核心。:重要的不是单个资产的风险,而是它对组合整体风险的贡献。Diversification🥚 Looking at one stock alone, you care only about its own risk; but once in a portfolio, what truly matters is how much it "co-moves" with other assets. If two assets don't rise and fall perfectly together, their swings partly cancel, and the portfolio's overall risk is below the simple average of their individual risks — this is the "free lunch," the core of diversification.: what matters is not an individual asset's risk but its contribution to the whole portfolio's risk.

组合视角强调用整体而非孤立看待资产:通过组合不完全相关的资产,可在不牺牲预期收益的情况下降低风险(分散化收益)。这是现代组合理论(MPT)的出发点。The portfolio view emphasizes seeing assets as a whole rather than in isolation: by combining imperfectly correlated assets, risk can be reduced without sacrificing expected return (the diversification benefit). This is the starting point of modern portfolio theory (MPT).

分散化比率(diversification ratio)是衡量分散化收益的简单指标 = 等权重组合的标准差 ÷ 组合内各证券的平均标准差。比率越低,说明分散化降低风险的效果越好。例如 5 只股票的等权组合,其标准差约为各单只股票平均标准差的 71%,则分散化比率≈0.71。The diversification ratio is a simple measure of the diversification benefit = the standard deviation of an equally weighted portfolio ÷ the average standard deviation of the individual securities in it. A lower ratio means diversification reduces risk more effectively. For example, an equally weighted 5-stock portfolio whose SD is about 71% of the average single-stock SD has a diversification ratio ≈ 0.71.

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

机制:为什么分散化是「免费的午餐」

两资产组合方差 σ²ₚ = w₁²σ₁² + w₂²σ₂² + 2w₁w₂·ρ·σ₁σ₂。只要 ρ < 1,交叉项就小于「各自方差的加权和」,于是组合风险 低于各资产风险的加权平均——而预期收益是线性加权(不打折)。用「不降收益却降风险」,这就是免费午餐。

推导:N 个等权资产的极限

σ²ₚ = (1/N)·平均方差 + (1−1/N)·平均协方差。当 N → ∞,第一项 → 0,故 σ²ₚ → 平均协方差。结论:分散化能消掉个体(非系统性)风险,但消不掉共同(系统性)风险(协方差项永远留下)。

分散化比率

= 等权组合标准差 ÷ 各资产平均标准差;越小说明分散化降险越有效。

易错对比

① 分散化不降低系统性风险;② 危机时相关性趋近 1、分散化失效;③ 相关性越低(乃至负)降险越强;④ 收益是加权平均、风险不是(因协方差)。

Mechanism: why diversification is a "free lunch"

Two-asset variance σ²ₚ = w₁²σ₁² + w₂²σ₂² + 2w₁w₂·ρ·σ₁σ₂. As long as ρ < 1, the cross term is below the weighted sum of the variances, so portfolio risk is below the weighted average of the assets' risks — while expected return is a linear weighted average (no discount). Lower risk at no cost to return: the free lunch.

Derivation: the large-N limit (equal weights)

σ²ₚ = (1/N)·average variance + (1−1/N)·average covariance. As N → ∞ the first term → 0, so σ²ₚ → the average covariance. Diversification removes idiosyncratic (unsystematic) risk but not common (systematic) risk (the covariance term stays).

Diversification ratio

= the equally-weighted portfolio's standard deviation ÷ the average of the assets' standard deviations; lower means more effective diversification.

Common traps

① Diversification does not reduce systematic risk; ② in a crisis correlations approach 1 and diversification fails; ③ lower (even negative) correlation reduces risk more; ④ return is a weighted average but risk is not (because of covariance).

1. 组合视角的核心思想是:The core idea of the portfolio perspective is: 官方题Official

  • A. 只孤立看单个资产Look at each asset only in isolation
  • B. 完全忽略风险Ignore risk entirely
  • C. 看资产对组合整体风险的贡献,而非孤立看单个资产;通过分散化在不牺牲收益下降低风险Look at an asset's contribution to the portfolio's overall risk, not the asset in isolation; use diversification to lower risk without sacrificing return
答案 C。关注资产对组合风险的边际贡献。Answer C. Focus on an asset's marginal contribution to portfolio risk.

2. 为什么说分散化是"免费的午餐":Why is diversification a 'free lunch': 补充Extra

  • A. 在不降低预期收益的情况下降低了风险,几乎无成本地改善了风险-收益权衡It lowers risk without lowering expected return, improving the risk-return trade-off at almost no cost
  • B. 需以降低收益为代价It costs a lower return
  • C. 没有任何益处No benefit at all
答案 A。低相关资产组合几乎无成本地降风险。Answer A. A low-correlation portfolio lowers risk at almost no cost.
1. 组合的分散化比率(diversification ratio)最好地描述为下列何者之比：1. The diversification ratio of a portfolio is best described as the ratio of the: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 等权重组合回报标准差 与 各证券回报平均标准差 之比。standard deviation of the equally weighted portfolio's returns to the average standard deviation of the individual securities' returns.
  • B. 市值加权组合回报标准差 与 等权重组合回报标准差 之比。standard deviation of the market-capitalization-weighted portfolio's returns to the standard deviation of the equally weighted portfolio's returns.
  • C. 各证券回报平均标准差 与 市值加权组合回报标准差 之比。average standard deviation of the individual securities' returns to the standard deviation of the market-capitalization-weighted portfolio's returns.
答案 A。分散化比率 = 等权重组合的标准差 ÷ 各证券标准差的平均。比率越小(远小于1),分散化降风险的效果越好。它衡量"抱团投资"相对"单看个券"降了多少风险。Answer A. Diversification ratio = the standard deviation of an equally-weighted portfolio ÷ the average of the individual securities' standard deviations. The lower (far below 1), the greater the risk reduction. It measures how much combining reduces risk versus holding one security.
2. 投资的组合方法最可能：2. The portfolio approach to investing most likely: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 在市场下跌时防止组合损失。prevents portfolio losses during market downturns.
  • B. 降低组合中单项资产的系统性风险。reduces the systematic risk of individual assets in a portfolio.
  • C. 在正常市场条件下帮助避免灾难性投资结果。helps avoid disastrous investment outcomes during normal market conditions.
答案 C。组合方法在正常市场下帮助避免灾难性结果(分散化)。但它不能在市场普跌时防损(相关性趋1),也不能降低单一资产的"系统性"风险(只降非系统性),故 A、B 错。Answer C. The portfolio approach helps avoid catastrophic outcomes under normal conditions (diversification). But it cannot prevent loss in a broad market fall (correlations rise toward 1), nor reduce an asset's systematic risk (only unsystematic), so A and B are wrong.
3. 在等权重组合中，分散化比率最好地描述为衡量下列何者的指标：3. In an equally weighted portfolio, the diversification ratio is best described as a measure of the: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 任意两项资产之间的相对风险水平。relative level of risk between any two individual assets.
  • B. 某资产对组合风险的贡献量。amount of risk an asset contributes to the portfolio's risk.
  • C. 投资于组合相对于组合中单一证券的风险降低收益。risk reduction benefit of investing in the portfolio versus a security from the portfolio.
答案 C。分散化比率衡量"投资于组合相对单一证券的风险降低收益"——即抱团比单打独斗风险低多少。它不是两资产间的相对风险,也不是单一资产的风险贡献。Answer C. The diversification ratio measures the risk-reduction benefit of the portfolio versus a single security — how much lower the portfolio's risk is. It is not the relative risk between two assets or one asset's risk contribution.

§2 投资者类型与投资流程§2 Investor Types & the Investment Process

LOS 对应:LOS: describe types of investors and the steps in the portfolio management process。

投资者类型:个人;机构(养老金 DB/DC、捐赠基金、基金会、保险公司、银行、主权财富基金)——各有不同的风险承受、收益目标、时间跨度、流动性和约束。组合管理三大步骤:
① 规划(planning):了解客户、制定投资政策说明书 IPS;
② 执行(execution):资产配置、证券选择、组合构建;
③ 反馈(feedback):监控与再平衡、绩效评估。Investor types: individuals; institutions (pension funds DB/DC, endowments, foundations, insurers, banks, sovereign wealth funds) — each with different risk tolerance, return objectives, time horizon, liquidity, and constraints. Three steps of portfolio management:
① planning: understand the client, draft the investment policy statement (IPS);
② execution: asset allocation, security selection, portfolio construction;
③ feedback: monitoring and rebalancing, performance evaluation.

考点·各类投资者特征(常考对号入座):
• 银行(bank):流动性是首要关注(随时应对存款支取),风险承受低。
• 捐赠基金/基金会(endowment/foundation):期限长(近永续),风险承受较高。
• 保险公司:一般账户与盈余账户的风险承受不同。
• 养老金:DB 由发起方(雇主)承担投资风险;DC 由雇员承担投资与通胀风险。
• 主权财富基金(SWF):政府所有的投资基金——「主权」指所有权而非允许的投资范围;通常不上市交易、投资范围广(含境外资产)。Exam - investor types at a glance (often matched):
- Bank: liquidity is the primary concern (to meet withdrawals), low risk tolerance.
- Endowment/foundation: long (near-perpetual) horizon, higher risk tolerance.
- Insurer: general and surplus accounts have different risk tolerances.
- Pensions: DB has the sponsor (employer) bear investment risk; DC has the employee bear investment and inflation risk.
- Sovereign wealth fund (SWF): government-owned - "sovereign" refers to ownership, not the permitted investment scope; typically not exchange-traded, with a broad mandate (including foreign assets).

3. 组合管理的三大步骤是:The three steps of portfolio management are: 官方题Official

  • A. 规划(制定 IPS)、执行(资产配置与选券)、反馈(监控、再平衡、绩效评估)Planning (formulate the IPS), execution (asset allocation and security selection), feedback (monitoring, rebalancing, performance evaluation)
  • B. 只有执行一步Only execution
  • C. 只有反馈一步Only feedback
答案 A。规划—执行—反馈的闭环。Answer A. The plan-execute-feedback loop.

4. DB 养老金与捐赠基金的目标差异(概念):The goal difference between a DB pension and an endowment (conceptual): 补充Extra

  • A. DB 需匹配未来负债;捐赠基金常追求长期实际增值以支持支出,期限更长A DB plan must match future liabilities; an endowment often seeks long-term real growth to support spending, with a longer horizon
  • B. 两者目标完全相同Their goals are identical
  • C. DB 期限更长A DB plan has a longer horizon
答案 A。DB 重负债匹配,捐赠重长期增值。Answer A. DB emphasizes liability matching, endowments long-term growth.
1. 就资产配置过程而言，自上而下的分析最可能始于考察：1. In regard to the asset allocation process, a top-down analysis most likely begins with an examination of: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 宏观经济增长。macroeconomic growth.
  • B. 公司的董事会。a company's board of directors.
  • C. 公司竞争对手的预期增长。the expected growth of a company's competitors.
答案 A。自上而下(top-down)从宏观经济增长入手,再到行业、再到个股。从董事会/竞争对手起步是自下而上的公司分析。Answer A. Top-down analysis begins with macroeconomic growth, then industry, then the individual stock. Starting from the board or competitors is bottom-up company analysis.
2. 关于不同类型投资者的下列表述哪项最准确？2. Which of the following statements about different types of investors is most accurate? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 对银行而言，其投资的流动性是首要关注。For banks, the liquidity of their investments is a paramount concern.
  • B. 对捐赠基金而言，投资期限因短期支出需求而较短。For endowments, investment horizons are short due to their short-term spending needs.
  • C. 对保险公司而言，其一般账户与盈余账户的风险承受能力通常相同。For insurance companies, the risk tolerance of their general and surplus accounts is typically the same.
答案 A。银行首要关注投资的"流动性"(随时应对存款支取)。捐赠基金期限长(永续),保险公司一般账户与盈余账户风险承受能力不同,故 B、C 错。Answer A. A bank's primary concern is the liquidity of its investments (to meet withdrawals). An endowment's horizon is long (perpetual), and an insurer's general vs surplus accounts have different risk tolerances, so B and C are wrong.
3. 主权财富基金(SWF)最好地描述为下列何种投资基金：3. Sovereign wealth funds are best described as investment funds: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 政府所有的。owned by governments.
  • B. 作为封闭式国家基金交易的。traded as closed-end country funds.
  • C. 被限制投资境外证券的。restricted from investing in foreign securities.
答案 A。主权财富基金(SWF)= 政府所有的投资基金。它不必是封闭式国家基金,也不必被限制只投境内,故 B、C 错。Answer A. A sovereign wealth fund (SWF) = a government-owned investment fund. It need not be a closed-end country fund or restricted to domestic securities, so B and C are wrong.
4. 下列哪项最可能属于组合管理过程中的反馈(feedback)环节？4. Which of the following is most likely part of the feedback step in the portfolio management process? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 组合构建Portfolio construction
  • B. 业绩计量Performance measurement
  • C. 制定投资政策声明(IPS)Developing the investment policy statement
答案 B。组合管理三步:规划(IPS)→ 执行(构建)→ 反馈(feedback)= 监控与业绩计量。业绩计量属反馈环节;IPS、组合构建属前两步。Answer B. The portfolio process: planning (IPS) → execution (construction) → feedback = monitoring and performance measurement. Performance measurement is feedback; the IPS and construction are the earlier steps.

§3 风险厌恶与效用§3 Risk Aversion & Utility 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: explain risk aversion and calculate utility。
效用 U = E(R) − ½ × A × σ2
符号Symbol含义Meaning
U投资者对某组合的效用(满意度)The investor's utility (satisfaction) from a portfolio
E(R)组合期望收益The portfolio's expected return
A风险厌恶系数:A 越大越厌恶风险;A>0 风险厌恶、A=0 风险中性、A<0 风险偏好The risk-aversion coefficient: the larger A, the more risk-averse; A>0 risk-averse, A=0 risk-neutral, A<0 risk-seeking
σ2组合收益方差(σ 是标准差,2 是平方)The portfolio return variance (σ is standard deviation, 2 is a square)
效用计算 官方题Official

E(R)=10%、σ=15%、风险厌恶 A=4。U = 0.10 − 0.5×4×0.152 = 0.10 − 0.5×4×0.0225 = 0.10 − 0.045 = 0.055。A 越大,同样风险扣减越多、效用越低。E(R)=10%, σ=15%, risk aversion A=4. U = 0.10 − 0.5×4×0.152 = 0.10 − 0.5×4×0.0225 = 0.10 − 0.045 = 0.055. The larger A, the larger the deduction for the same risk and the lower the utility.

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

效用函数与风险厌恶系数

U = E(R) − ½·A·σ²(A 为风险厌恶系数;回报与 σ 用小数)。A > 0 厌恶、A = 0 中性、A < 0 偏好。σ² 前的「惩罚项」随 A 增大而增大 → 越厌恶,承担同样风险要求越高的补偿。

无差异曲线

固定 U 时,E(R) 随 σ² 上升(要更多回报补偿更多风险);风险越厌恶,曲线越陡。无风险资产 σ = 0 → U = E(R) 对任何 A 都相同(惩罚项为 0),这是常考点。

例题

组合甲 E(R)=10%、σ=15%;乙 E(R)=8%、σ=12%;A=4。U甲=0.10 − 0.5×4×0.15² = 0.055;U乙=0.08 − 0.5×4×0.12² = 0.0512 → 选甲。

易错对比

① 百分数必须转小数再平方;② A 越大越保守(要求更陡补偿);③ 长期股权风险溢价的存在,说明投资者整体是风险厌恶的。

Utility function & risk-aversion coefficient

U = E(R) − ½·A·σ² (A is the risk-aversion coefficient; use decimals for returns and σ). A > 0 averse, A = 0 neutral, A < 0 seeking. The penalty on σ² grows with A → the more averse, the more compensation demanded for the same risk.

Indifference curves

For fixed U, E(R) rises with σ² (more return to offset more risk); the more risk-averse, the steeper the curve. A risk-free asset (σ = 0) gives U = E(R) for any A (penalty is zero) — a frequent test point.

Worked example

Portfolio A: E(R)=10%, σ=15%; B: E(R)=8%, σ=12%; A=4. U_A = 0.10 − 0.5×4×0.15² = 0.055; U_B = 0.08 − 0.5×4×0.12² = 0.0512 → choose A.

Common traps

① Convert percentages to decimals before squaring; ② higher A = more conservative; ③ the long-run equity risk premium implies investors are risk-averse overall.

5. 效用函数公式是:The utility function formula is: 官方题Official

  • A. U = E(R) − ½Aσ²U = E(R) − ½Aσ²
  • B. U = E(R) + ½Aσ²U = E(R) + ½Aσ²
  • C. U = E(R) × AU = E(R) × A
答案 A。风险带来效用扣减。Answer A. Risk brings a utility deduction.

6. E(R)=10%、σ=15%、A=4,效用是:E(R) = 10%, σ = 15%, A = 4; the utility is: 官方题Official

  • A. 0.0550.055
  • B. 0.1000.100
  • C. 0.1450.145
答案 A。0.10 − 0.5×4×0.0225 = 0.055。Answer A. 0.10 − 0.5×4×0.0225 = 0.055.

7. 风险厌恶系数 A 的取值含义是:The meaning of the risk-aversion coefficient A: 官方题Official

  • A. A > 0 风险厌恶(越大越厌恶)、A = 0 风险中性、A < 0 风险偏好A > 0 risk-averse (larger = more averse), A = 0 risk-neutral, A < 0 risk-seeking
  • B. A > 0 表示风险偏好A > 0 means risk-seeking
  • C. A 恒等于 0A is always 0
答案 A。A 越大越厌恶风险。Answer A. The larger A, the more risk-averse.

8. 无差异曲线代表什么:What does an indifference curve represent: 补充Extra

  • A. 风险相同的组合Combinations with equal risk
  • B. 投资者效用相同的所有风险-收益组合;风险厌恶越强曲线越陡All risk-return combinations giving the investor equal utility; the more risk-averse, the steeper the curve
  • C. 效用不同的组合Combinations with different utility
答案 B。同一曲线上效用相等。Answer B. Utility is equal along one curve.
1. 风险中性投资者最可能寻求最大化：1. A risk-neutral investor most likely seeks to maximize: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 风险与回报两者。both risk and return.
  • B. 回报，而不考虑风险。return irrespective of risk.
  • C. 给定风险水平下的回报。return for a given level of risk.
答案 B。风险中性投资者只追求回报最大化、不在意风险。风险厌恶者要"给定风险下回报最高";在意风险与回报两者的是风险厌恶,故 A、C 错。Answer B. A risk-neutral investor maximizes return without regard to risk. A risk-averse investor wants the most return for a given risk; caring about both risk and return is risk aversion, so A and C are wrong.
2. 关于证券风险-回报权衡的长期历史数据表明投资者最可能是：2. Long-term historical data on the risk–return trade-off of securities show that investors are most likely: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 风险厌恶的。risk averse.
  • B. 风险中性的。risk neutral.
  • C. 风险偏好的。risk seeking.
答案 A。长期历史(股票溢价存在)表明投资者整体是风险厌恶(risk-averse)的——承担风险要额外补偿。Answer A. Long-run history (the existence of an equity risk premium) shows investors are risk-averse overall — they demand extra compensation for bearing risk.
3. 对于风险偏好投资者，投资于无风险资产所产生的效用：3. For a risk-seeking investor, an investment in a risk-free asset generates utility that is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 小于风险厌恶投资者所获效用。less than the utility generated for a risk-averse investor.
  • B. 等于风险厌恶投资者所获效用。equal to the utility generated for a risk-averse investor.
  • C. 大于风险厌恶投资者所获效用。greater than the utility generated for a risk-averse investor.
答案 B。无风险资产回报确定、无风险 → 对任何风险偏好类型效用相同(效用惩罚项 = ½Aσ²,σ=0 时归零)。故风险偏好者与风险厌恶者从无风险资产获得的效用相等。Answer B. A risk-free asset has certain, riskless return → its utility is the same for any risk preference (the penalty ½Aσ² vanishes when σ=0). So a risk-seeking and a risk-averse investor get equal utility from it.

§4 两资产组合的期望与方差§4 Two-Asset Portfolio Expected Value & Variance 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: calculate the expected return and variance for a two-asset portfolio。
组合期望收益:E(Rp) = w1E(R1) + w2E(R2)
组合方差:σp2 = w12σ12 + w22σ22 + 2w1w2ρ12σ1σ2
符号Symbol含义Meaning
w1, w2两资产权重(和为 1)The two assets' weights (summing to 1)
σ1, σ2各资产标准差Each asset's standard deviation
ρ12两资产相关系数(−1 到 +1)The two assets' correlation coefficient (−1 to +1)
2w1w2ρ12σ1σ2协方差项 = 2w1w2Cov12;相关性越低此项越小The covariance term = 2w1w2Cov12; the lower the correlation, the smaller this term
组合方差计算 官方题Official

w1=w2=0.5,σ1=20%、σ2=30%、ρ=0.4。σp2 = 0.25×0.04 + 0.25×0.09 + 2×0.5×0.5×0.4×0.2×0.3 = 0.01 + 0.0225 + 0.012 = 0.0445 → σp = 21.1%,低于加权平均标准差 25%——分散化生效。w1=w2=0.5, σ1=20%, σ2=30%, ρ=0.4. σp2 = 0.25×0.04 + 0.25×0.09 + 2×0.5×0.5×0.4×0.2×0.3 = 0.01 + 0.0225 + 0.012 = 0.0445 → σp = 21.1%, below the weighted-average standard deviation of 25% — diversification works.

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

期望与方差的算法

期望是线性的:E(Rₚ)=w₁E(R₁)+w₂E(R₂)。方差不是:σ²ₚ = w₁²σ₁² + w₂²σ₂² + 2w₁w₂·Cov,其中 Cov = ρ·σ₁·σ₂。别漏协方差项。

三种相关性极端

• ρ = +1:σₚ = w₁σ₁ + w₂σ₂(加权平均,无分散化);
• ρ = −1:可选权重使 σₚ = 0(完全对冲);
• ρ = 0:σₚ = √(w₁²σ₁² + w₂²σ₂²) < 加权平均。

例题(等权、等σ)

若 σ₁=σ₂=σ、各半,则 σₚ = σ·√((1+ρ)/2)。ρ=1→σ;ρ=0→σ/√2≈0.707σ;ρ=−1→0。直观看出相关性如何决定分散化效果。

易错对比

① 方差公式别忘 2w₁w₂Cov;② Cov 与 ρ 的换算 Cov=ρσ₁σ₂;③ 峰度看尾部极端概率、偏度看不对称,别混。

Computing expectation and variance

Expectation is linear: E(Rₚ)=w₁E(R₁)+w₂E(R₂). Variance is not: σ²ₚ = w₁²σ₁² + w₂²σ₂² + 2w₁w₂·Cov, with Cov = ρ·σ₁·σ₂. Don't drop the covariance term.

Three correlation extremes

• ρ = +1: σₚ = w₁σ₁ + w₂σ₂ (weighted average, no diversification);
• ρ = −1: weights exist making σₚ = 0 (perfect hedge);
• ρ = 0: σₚ = √(w₁²σ₁² + w₂²σ₂²) < the weighted average.

Worked example (equal weights & σ)

If σ₁=σ₂=σ and 50/50, then σₚ = σ·√((1+ρ)/2). ρ=1→σ; ρ=0→σ/√2≈0.707σ; ρ=−1→0 — showing how correlation drives the diversification benefit.

Common traps

① Don't forget 2w₁w₂Cov; ② convert Cov=ρσ₁σ₂; ③ kurtosis is about tail extremes, skewness about asymmetry — don't confuse them.

9. 两资产组合期望收益公式是:The two-asset portfolio expected-return formula is: 官方题Official

  • A. E(Rp) = w₁E(R₁) − w₂E(R₂)E(Rp) = w₁E(R₁) − w₂E(R₂)
  • B. E(Rp) = E(R₁) × E(R₂)E(Rp) = E(R₁) × E(R₂)
  • C. E(Rp) = w₁E(R₁) + w₂E(R₂)E(Rp) = w₁E(R₁) + w₂E(R₂)
答案 C。期望收益是权重加权和(线性)。Answer C. Expected return is the weighted sum (linear).

  • B. σp² = w₁σ₁ + w₂σ₂σp² = w₁σ₁ + w₂σ₂
  • C. σp² = w₁²σ₁² + w₂²σ₂²σp² = w₁²σ₁² + w₂²σ₂²
答案 A。必须包含协方差交叉项。Answer A. It must include the covariance cross term.

11. w₁=w₂=0.5、σ₁=20%、σ₂=30%、ρ=0.4,组合标准差为:w₁ = w₂ = 0.5, σ₁ = 20%, σ₂ = 30%, ρ = 0.4; the portfolio standard deviation is: 官方题Official

12. 上题组合标准差为何低于 25%(加权平均):Why is the portfolio standard deviation above below 25% (the weighted average): 官方题Official

3. 当等权重组合中的资产数量变得很大时，组合回报方差最可能趋近于：3. As the number of assets in an equally weighted portfolio becomes large, the portfolio's variance of returns most likely approaches: 真题模考Mock

As the number of equally-weighted assets grows large, the individual variance terms average toward zero, and portfolio variance approaches the average covariance among assets. Diversification removes unsystematic risk but not common (covariance) risk.

§6 有效前沿§6 The Efficient Frontier

LOS 对应:LOS: describe and interpret the minimum-variance and efficient frontiers。

把所有可能的风险资产组合画在"风险-收益"图上,最小方差前沿是每个收益水平下风险最小的组合集合;其上半部分(全局最小方差点以上)就是有效前沿(efficient frontier)——给定风险下收益最高、或给定收益下风险最低的组合。理性投资者只在有效前沿上选。Plotting all possible risky-asset portfolios on a "risk-return" chart, the minimum-variance frontier is the set of portfolios with the lowest risk at each return level; its upper half (above the global minimum-variance point) is the efficient frontier — the portfolios with the highest return for a given risk or the lowest risk for a given return. A rational investor chooses only on the efficient frontier.

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

最小方差前沿 vs 有效前沿

最小方差前沿:每个给定期望回报下、方差最小的组合连成的曲线。全局最小方差组合(GMV)在前沿最左端(风险最小)。有效前沿 = 最小方差前沿上 GMV 以上的那一段(同风险下回报最高)——理性、风险厌恶者只会选它上面的点。

机制

随着可选资产增多、相关性降低,前沿向左上外扩(同风险有更高回报),分散化的价值体现在前沿的形状上。前沿由资产(风险/回报/相关性)决定,与投资者偏好无关。

易错对比

① 有效前沿是上半支(不是整条最小方差前沿);② GMV 在最左端;③ 偏好(无差异曲线)决定在前沿上选哪一点,但不改变前沿本身。

Minimum-variance frontier vs efficient frontier

The minimum-variance frontier is the curve of lowest-variance portfolios for each level of expected return. The global minimum-variance portfolio (GMV) is at the far left (lowest risk). The efficient frontier is the part of that frontier above the GMV (highest return per unit of risk) — the only region a rational, risk-averse investor chooses.

Mechanism

As the asset menu grows and correlations fall, the frontier bulges up and to the left (more return per risk); the value of diversification shows up in the frontier's shape. The frontier is set by the assets (risk/return/correlation), independent of preferences.

Common traps

① The efficient frontier is the upper half (not the whole min-variance frontier); ② the GMV is at the far left; ③ preferences (indifference curves) pick a point on the frontier but do not move the frontier.

17. 什么是最小方差前沿:What is the minimum-variance frontier: 官方题Official

  • B. 每个期望收益水平下风险(方差)最小的组合集合The set of portfolios with the lowest risk (variance) at each expected-return level
  • C. 风险最大的组合集合The set of highest-risk portfolios
答案 B。给定收益下的最低风险组合轨迹。Answer B. The locus of lowest-risk portfolios for a given return.
