  • B. 全部All of it
  • C. 全局最小方差点以上的上半部分The upper half above the global minimum-variance point
答案 C。上半部分才是有效的。Answer C. Only the upper half is efficient.

19. 为什么理性投资者只在有效前沿上选:Why does a rational investor choose only on the efficient frontier: 官方题Official

  • A. 前沿上的组合在给定风险下收益最高(或给定收益下风险最低),优于内部任何点Frontier portfolios have the highest return for a given risk (or lowest risk for a given return), dominating any interior point
  • B. 内部点更优Interior points are better
  • C. 前沿与内部无差异The frontier and interior are indifferent
答案 A。有效前沿主导所有内部组合。Answer A. The efficient frontier dominates all interior portfolios.
1. 马科维茨有效前沿最好地描述为一条：1. The Markowitz efficient frontier is best described as a curve that: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 位于最小方差前沿的上方偏左。lies above and to the left of the minimum-variance frontier.
  • B. 连接所有可能回报的最小方差组合。connects the minimum-variance portfolios for all possible returns.
  • C. 包含理性、风险厌恶的投资者会选择的所有风险资产组合。contains all portfolios of risky assets that rational, risk-averse investors will choose.
答案 C。马科维茨有效前沿 = 理性、风险厌恶投资者会选择的所有风险资产组合的集合(给定风险下回报最高的那些)。它是最小方差前沿"上半支",故 A、B 表述不完整。Answer C. The Markowitz efficient frontier = the set of all risky-asset portfolios a rational, risk-averse investor would choose (highest return for each risk). It is the upper half of the minimum-variance frontier, so A and B are incomplete.
2. 全局最小方差组合位于：2. The global minimum-variance portfolio is a portfolio that lies: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 最小方差前沿上的任意位置。anywhere along the minimum-variance frontier.
  • B. 最小方差前沿的最左端点。at the left-most point of the minimum-variance frontier.
  • C. 最小方差前沿的右上端点。at the upper right-most point of the minimum-variance frontier.
答案 B。全局最小方差组合 = 最小方差前沿的"最左端点"(方差/标准差最小处)。Answer B. The global minimum-variance portfolio = the leftmost point of the minimum-variance frontier (lowest variance/standard deviation).

§7 资本配置线与最优组合§7 The Capital Allocation Line & the Optimal Portfolio 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: describe the capital allocation line and the optimal investor portfolio。
🔰 零基础讲解:加入无风险资产之后

资本配置线📏 把"无风险资产"(如国债)和某个风险组合混合,能得到一条直线:一端是纯无风险(零风险零溢价),另一端及以外是加杠杆买风险组合。这条线的斜率就是"每承担一单位风险能换多少超额收益"=夏普比率。斜率最高的那条线碰到有效前沿的切点,就是人人都该持有的"最优风险组合"。把无风险资产与风险组合混合形成的直线。The capital allocation line📏 Mixing a "risk-free asset" (like a Treasury) with a risky portfolio gives a straight line: one end is pure risk-free (zero risk, zero premium), the other end and beyond is buying the risky portfolio on leverage. The line's slope is "how much excess return you get per unit of risk taken" = the Sharpe ratio. The line with the highest slope, where it touches the efficient frontier at a tangency point, is the "optimal risky portfolio" everyone should hold. is the straight line formed by mixing the risk-free asset with a risky portfolio.

资本配置线 CAL:E(Rp) = Rf + [ (E(R风险组合) − Rf) / σ风险组合 ] × σp
要素Element含义Meaning
Rf无风险利率(CAL 的截距)The risk-free rate (the CAL's intercept)
斜率Slope= 夏普比率 = (超额收益)/(风险);斜率越高越好= the Sharpe ratio = (excess return)/(risk); the higher the slope, the better
最优风险组合Optimal risky portfolio斜率最高的 CAL 与有效前沿的切点组合The tangency portfolio where the highest-slope CAL meets the efficient frontier
最优投资者组合Optimal investor portfolio该 CAL 与投资者无差异曲线相切之点(依风险厌恶定杠杆/配置)The point where that CAL is tangent to the investor's indifference curve (leverage/allocation set by risk aversion)
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

从有效前沿到资本配置线(CAL)

引入无风险资产后,从 Rf 引一条与有效前沿相切的直线 = 资本配置线(CAL);切点 = 最优风险组合(全体一致预期时即市场组合)。CAL 斜率 = 夏普比率 = (E(Rₚ)−Rf)/σ——每单位总风险的超额回报。投资者沿 CAL 选点(混合无风险资产与切点组合)优于原有效前沿。

两基金分离(必考)

所有投资者都持有「无风险资产 + 同一个切点组合」,差别只在比例(由风险厌恶决定):越厌恶越靠左(多持无风险)。因此最优风险组合与个人偏好无关、只取决于 Rf。无风险资产与任何风险组合相关系数 = 0。

出借 vs 杠杆

CAL 左段(切点左)= 部分资金放无风险(出借型);右段(切点右)= 借钱加买市场(杠杆型)。若预期组合回报 > 市场回报,即处于杠杆段。

易错对比

① CML 用总风险 σ(横轴)、SML 用 β;② 最优风险组合不取决于偏好(两基金分离);③ CAL 斜率就是夏普比率。

From the efficient frontier to the capital allocation line (CAL)

Adding a risk-free asset, draw a line from Rf tangent to the efficient frontier = the CAL; the tangency point = the optimal risky portfolio (the market portfolio under homogeneous expectations). CAL slope = Sharpe ratio = (E(Rₚ)−Rf)/σ — excess return per unit of total risk. Choosing along the CAL (mixing the risk-free asset with the tangency portfolio) beats the original frontier.

Two-fund separation (high-yield)

Every investor holds the risk-free asset + the same tangency portfolio, differing only in the proportion (set by risk aversion): the more averse sit further left (more risk-free). So the optimal risky portfolio is independent of preferences and depends only on Rf. The risk-free asset has zero correlation with any risky portfolio.

Lending vs leveraged

The left part of the CAL (before tangency) = part in the risk-free asset (lending); the right part = borrowing to buy more of the market (leveraged). An expected return > the market return means a leveraged position.

Common traps

① CML uses total risk σ (x-axis), SML uses β; ② the optimal risky portfolio does not depend on preferences (two-fund separation); ③ the CAL slope is the Sharpe ratio.

20. 资本配置线(CAL)是怎么形成的:How is the capital allocation line (CAL) formed: 官方题Official

  • A. 是一条曲线It is a curve
  • B. 将无风险资产与某个风险组合按不同比例混合,形成一条直线By mixing the risk-free asset with a risky portfolio in different proportions, forming a straight line
  • C. 由两个风险组合混合By mixing two risky portfolios
答案 B。无风险资产 + 风险组合形成直线 CAL。Answer B. Risk-free asset + risky portfolio forms the straight CAL.

21. CAL 的斜率等于什么:The slope of the CAL equals what: 官方题Official

  • A. 贝塔Beta
  • B. 方差Variance
  • C. 夏普比率 =(风险组合超额收益)/(其标准差)The Sharpe ratio = (risky portfolio's excess return)/(its standard deviation)
答案 C。CAL 斜率即夏普比率。Answer C. The CAL slope is the Sharpe ratio.

22. 最优风险组合在图上是什么点:What point on the chart is the optimal risky portfolio: 官方题Official

  • A. 斜率最高的 CAL 与有效前沿的切点组合The tangency portfolio where the highest-slope CAL meets the efficient frontier
  • B. 全局最小方差点The global minimum-variance point
  • C. 无风险资产The risk-free asset
答案 A。最高夏普比率对应的切点组合。Answer A. The tangency portfolio with the highest Sharpe ratio.

23. 最优投资者组合由什么决定:What determines the optimal investor portfolio: 官方题Official

  • A. 与风险厌恶无关Unrelated to risk aversion
  • B. 最优 CAL 与投资者无差异曲线的切点,取决于个人风险厌恶程度The tangency of the optimal CAL with the investor's indifference curve, depending on personal risk aversion
  • C. 固定不变Fixed and unchanging
答案 B。风险厌恶决定在 CAL 上的具体位置。Answer B. Risk aversion determines the specific spot on the CAL.

24. 加入无风险资产后投资者如何调整风险:After adding the risk-free asset, how does an investor adjust risk: 官方题Official

  • A. 无法调整风险Cannot adjust risk
  • B. 只能全投无风险资产Can only invest fully in the risk-free asset
  • C. 通过在无风险资产与最优风险组合之间调整权重(借入或贷出)来选择风险水平By adjusting the weight between the risk-free asset and the optimal risky portfolio (borrowing or lending) to choose the risk level
答案 C。沿 CAL 借贷调整整体风险。Answer C. Move along the CAL by borrowing/lending to adjust overall risk.
1. 就资本市场理论而言，下列哪项表述最准确？1. With respect to capital market theory, which of the following statements is most accurate? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 最优风险组合取决于无风险利率。The optimal risky portfolio is dependent on the risk-free rate.
  • B. 最优风险组合取决于投资者的风险状况。The optimal risky portfolio is dependent on the investor's risk profile.
  • C. 投资者的最优组合必须位于马科维茨有效前沿上。The investor's optimal portfolio must lie on the Markowitz efficient frontier.
答案 A。引入无风险资产后,最优风险组合(切点组合)取决于无风险利率(CAL 从 Rf 引出与前沿相切)。它不取决于投资者风险偏好(两基金分离),最优组合也可在 CML 上(非仅前沿),故 B、C 错。Answer A. With a risk-free asset, the optimal risky (tangency) portfolio depends on the risk-free rate (the CAL from Rf is tangent to the frontier). It does not depend on investor preferences (two-fund separation), and the optimal portfolio lies on the CML (not only the frontier), so B and C are wrong.
2. 两位投资者的无差异曲线与同一条资本配置线(CAL)相切。若投资者1比投资者2更为风险厌恶，则投资者1的最优组合：2. Two investors have indifference curves that are tangent to the same capital allocation line (CAL). If Investor 1 is more risk averse than Investor 2, Investor 1's optimal portfolio is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 在CAL上位于投资者2最优组合的左侧。to the left of Investor 2's optimal portfolio on the CAL.
  • B. 在CAL上与投资者2最优组合处于同一点。at the same point on the CAL as Investor 2's optimal portfolio.
  • C. 在CAL上位于投资者2最优组合的右侧。to the right of Investor 2's optimal portfolio on the CAL.
答案 A。更风险厌恶的投资者持有更多无风险资产、更少风险组合 → 其最优点在 CAL 上更靠左(更低风险)。投资者2 风险更低容忍,靠右。Answer A. A more risk-averse investor holds more of the risk-free asset and less of the risky portfolio → their optimum is farther left (lower risk) on the CAL. The less risk-averse investor 2 sits to the right.
3. 无风险资产与最优风险组合之间的相关系数预计为：3. The correlation between the risk-free asset and the optimal risky portfolio is expected to be: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 为负。negative.
  • B. 为零。zero.
  • C. 为正。positive.
答案 B。无风险资产回报确定,与任何风险资产的相关系数 = 0(常数与变量不相关)。故为零。Answer B. The risk-free asset has a certain return, so its correlation with any risky portfolio = 0 (a constant is uncorrelated with a variable). Hence zero.
4. 一位可按无风险利率借贷的投资者用无风险资产和市场组合构建组合。无风险利率3%、预期市场回报15%。若预期组合回报18%，则该投资者的组合是：4. An investor who can lend and borrow at the risk-free rate builds a portfolio using the risk-free asset and the market portfolio. The risk-free rate is 3% and the expected market return is 15%. If the expected portfolio return is 18%, the investor's portfolio is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 出借型组合。a lending portfolio.
  • B. 杠杆型组合。a leveraged portfolio.
  • C. 最优风险组合。the optimal risky portfolio.
答案 B。预期组合回报 18% > 市场回报 15% → 该投资者借钱加杠杆买市场(杠杆型组合),位于 CML 上市场组合的右侧。低于15%才是出借型。Answer B. An expected 18% > the 15% market return → the investor borrows to leverage the market (a leveraged portfolio), to the right of the market portfolio on the CML. Below 15% would be a lending portfolio.
5. 仅由风险资产构成的组合，其风险-回报权衡在加入无风险资产后最可能改善，因为：5. The risk–return trade-off of a portfolio of only risky assets most likely improves when a risk-free asset is added to the portfolio because: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 无风险资产与组合中其他资产不相关。the risk-free asset is uncorrelated with the other assets in the portfolio.
  • B. 无风险资产较低的回报提供了分散化效果。the lower return on the risk-free asset provides a diversification effect.
  • C. 风险资产之间的相关性下降，提供了分散化效果。the correlations among the risky assets decrease, providing a diversification effect.
答案 A。加入无风险资产能改善风险-回报,因为无风险资产与组合中其他风险资产不相关(相关系数0),提供分散化并允许沿 CAL 调节风险。B、C 表述不准。Answer A. Adding a risk-free asset improves the trade-off because it is uncorrelated (correlation 0) with the other risky assets, providing diversification and letting risk be adjusted along the CAL. B and C are inaccurate.

资产管理行业可按客户分为零售和机构；按投资方式分为主动、被动和系统化；按工具分为独立账户和汇集投资工具。管理人收入通常来自按资产规模计提的管理费，也可能包含业绩费。The asset-management industry can be split by client into retail and institutional; by investment style into active, passive, and systematic; by vehicle into separate accounts and pooled investment vehicles. Managers' revenue usually comes from a management fee on assets, possibly including a performance fee.

1. 关于养老金计划的下列表述哪项最准确？1. Which of the following statements about pension plans is most accurate? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 设定受益计划通常风险承受能力低。Defined benefit plans typically have a low risk tolerance.
  • B. 设定缴款计划通常风险承受能力低。Defined contribution plans typically have a low risk tolerance.
  • C. 设定受益计划的发起方规定应付参与者的义务。The sponsor of a defined benefit plan specifies the obligation owed to participants.
答案 C。设定受益(DB)计划由发起方(雇主)规定应付参与者的义务并承担投资风险。DB 风险承受能力常较高、DC 由雇员担风险,故 A、B 错。Answer C. A defined-benefit (DB) plan has the sponsor (employer) specify the obligation owed to participants and bear investment risk. DB often has higher risk tolerance, and DC shifts risk to employees, so A and B are wrong.
2. 下列哪项最好地描述设定缴款(DC)养老金计划的特征？2. Which of the following best describes a characteristic of defined contribution pension plans? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 雇员承担投资与通胀风险。The employee accepts the investment and inflation risk.
  • B. 雇主负责为计划充分注资。The employer is responsible for adequately funding the plan.
  • C. 设定缴款计划对公司的成本通常高于设定受益计划。Defined contribution plans typically have a higher cost to the company than defined benefit plans.
答案 A。设定缴款(DC)计划:雇员承担投资与通胀风险(退休金取决于账户表现)。雇主只按约定缴款、不保证充分注资,故 B、C 错。Answer A. A defined-contribution (DC) plan: the employee bears investment and inflation risk (the pension depends on account performance). The employer only contributes as agreed and does not guarantee funding, so B and C are wrong.

聪明贝塔(smart beta):介于纯被动与主动之间的规则化策略——不按市值加权,而是按价值、低波动、质量、股息等因子系统地构建组合。相对传统市值加权指数,聪明贝塔通常管理费略高、换手率也较高。Smart beta: a rules-based strategy between pure passive and active — instead of market-cap weighting, it systematically builds portfolios by factors such as value, low volatility, quality, or dividends. Relative to traditional cap-weighted indexes, smart beta typically has somewhat higher management fees and higher portfolio turnover.

2. 封闭式基金为什么可能相对 NAV 折价:Why can a closed-end fund trade at a discount to NAV:

  • A. 从不出现折价Never trades at a discount
  • B. 份额在市场交易,供求决定市场价,基金通常不按 NAV 直接赎回Shares trade in the market with price set by supply/demand, and the fund usually does not redeem directly at NAV
  • C. 可随时按 NAV 赎回Can be redeemed at NAV any time
答案 B。无法按 NAV 赎回使市场价可偏离 NAV。Answer B. The inability to redeem at NAV lets the market price deviate from NAV.
1. 交易所交易基金(ETF)：1. Exchange-traded funds (ETFs): 真题模考Mock
  • A. 每个交易日定价一次。are priced once a trading day.
  • B. 通常将股息派发给股东。usually pay out dividends to shareholders.
  • C. 一般被构建为封闭式基金。are generally structured as closed-end funds.
答案 B。ETF 通常把股息派发给股东。它盘中连续定价(非每日一次)、构建为开放式(通过申赎机制),故 A、C 错。Answer B. An ETF typically distributes dividends to shareholders. It is priced continuously intraday (not once a day) and structured open-end (via creation/redemption), so A and C are wrong.
2. 开放式共同基金通常：2. Open-end mutual funds typically: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 盘中定价。are priced intraday.
  • B. 在外股数固定。have a fixed number of shares outstanding.
  • C. 最低投资额高于ETF。have a larger required minimum investment than ETFs.
答案 C。开放式共同基金的最低投资额通常高于 ETF。它按每日 NAV 定价(非盘中)、股数随申赎变动(非固定),故 A、B 错。Answer C. An open-end mutual fund usually has a higher minimum investment than an ETF. It is priced once daily at NAV (not intraday) and its share count changes with flows (not fixed), so A and B are wrong.
3. 相对于被动市值加权策略，聪明贝塔(smart beta)策略通常具有：3. Relative to passive market-cap-weighted strategies, smart beta strategies typically have: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 更低的管理费和更高的组合换手率。lower management fees and higher portfolio turnover.
  • B. 更高的管理费和更低的组合换手率。higher management fees and lower portfolio turnover.
  • C. 更高的管理费和更高的组合换手率。higher management fees and higher portfolio turnover.
答案 C。聪明贝塔(smart beta)相对被动市值加权:管理费更高、换手率也更高(按因子规则再平衡)。它比纯被动贵、比主动便宜。Answer C. Smart beta vs passive cap-weighting: higher management fees and higher turnover (rebalancing to factor rules). It costs more than pure passive but less than active.
4. 下列哪种基金最可能以偏离其净值最远的价格交易？4. Which of the following funds is most likely to trade at a price furthest from its net asset value? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 交易所交易基金(ETF)Exchange-traded fund
  • B. 开放式共同基金Open-end mutual fund
  • C. 封闭式共同基金Closed-end mutual fund
答案 C。封闭式基金最可能偏离 NAV 最远(可较 NAV 溢价或折价交易,份额固定、靠二级市场供求)。ETF/开放式有申赎机制把价格拉回 NAV。Answer C. A closed-end fund most likely trades farthest from NAV (premium or discount, fixed shares, driven by secondary supply/demand). ETFs/open-end funds have mechanisms pulling price to NAV.

第二讲 · CAPM、证券市场线与绩效衡量Lecture 2 · CAPM, the Security Market Line & Performance Measurement

对应教材:Portfolio Risk and Return: Part II · 建议学习时长:3.5 小时 · 计算核心Curriculum: Portfolio Risk and Return: Part II · Suggested study time: 3.5 hours · Calculation core

这一讲是组合管理最核心的定价与评价工具:把风险拆成系统性和非系统性、用贝塔衡量系统性风险、用 CAPM/证券市场线给资产定价,再用夏普、特雷诺、M²、詹森 alpha 评价业绩。全是必考。This lecture is the core pricing and evaluation toolkit of portfolio management: splitting risk into systematic and unsystematic, measuring systematic risk with beta, and pricing assets with CAPM/the security market line, then evaluating performance with Sharpe, Treynor, M², and Jensen's alpha. All are must-know.

§1 系统性 vs 非系统性风险§1 Systematic vs Unsystematic Risk 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: distinguish between systematic and nonsystematic risk。
🔰 零基础讲解:两种风险,只有一种给你补偿

系统性风险🌊 系统性风险是"整个市场的浪"——经济衰退、利率、战争,影响所有股票,分散不掉。非系统性风险是"单只船的毛病"——某公司出事、某行业丑闻,可以通过持有很多不同资产分散掉。关键结论:市场只对"躲不掉的"系统性风险给风险溢价补偿;能分散掉的非系统性风险,市场不额外补偿。躲不掉、被补偿;非系统性风险可分散、不被补偿。Systematic risk🌊 Systematic risk is "the wave over the whole market" — recession, rates, war — affecting all stocks and undiversifiable. Unsystematic risk is "one ship's own trouble" — a single company's mishap, an industry scandal — diversifiable by holding many different assets. Key conclusion: the market compensates only the "inescapable" systematic risk with a risk premium; the diversifiable unsystematic risk earns no extra compensation. is inescapable and compensated; unsystematic risk is diversifiable and not compensated.

总风险 = 系统性风险(市场/不可分散)+ 非系统性风险(特质/可分散)
类型Type特征Characteristics
系统性(市场)风险Systematic (market) risk影响所有资产(利率、通胀、经济周期);无法通过分散消除;市场给予溢价Affects all assets (rates, inflation, the economic cycle); cannot be eliminated by diversification; the market grants a premium
非系统性(特质)风险Unsystematic (idiosyncratic) risk公司/行业特有;可通过分散化消除;市场不给额外补偿Specific to a company/industry; can be eliminated by diversification; the market gives no extra compensation
核心结论:只有系统性风险才被定价、才有风险溢价。所以衡量单个资产风险应看它的贝塔(对市场的敏感度),而非总标准差。
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

总风险的拆解

总风险 = 系统性风险 + 非系统性风险。系统性(市场/宏观因素驱动,不可分散);非系统性(公司特有,可通过分散消掉)。

为什么只有系统性风险被定价

CAPM 只对系统性风险(β)给风险溢价——非系统性风险既然能靠分散免费消除,市场就不会为它付补偿。因此承担可分散风险不带来额外预期回报。

推论

市场组合已充分分散 → 非系统性 ≈ 0 → 其风险几乎全是系统性;按 SML,预期回报最高 = β 最高。

易错对比

① 市场只定价系统性风险;② 分散化降非系统、不降系统;③ 总风险用 σ、系统性用 β。

Decomposing total risk

Total risk = systematic + unsystematic. Systematic (macro-driven, non-diversifiable); unsystematic (firm-specific, removable by diversification).

Why only systematic risk is priced

CAPM rewards only systematic risk (β) — since unsystematic risk can be removed for free by diversifying, the market pays no premium for it. Bearing diversifiable risk earns no extra expected return.

Implications

The market portfolio is fully diversified → unsystematic ≈ 0 → its risk is almost entirely systematic; on the SML, the highest expected return = the highest β.

Common traps

① The market prices only systematic risk; ② diversification cuts unsystematic, not systematic; ③ total risk uses σ, systematic uses β.

1. 系统性风险与非系统性风险的区别是:The difference between systematic and unsystematic risk is: 官方题Official

  • A. 系统性=影响所有资产、不可分散、被补偿;非系统性=公司/行业特有、可分散、不被补偿Systematic = affects all assets, undiversifiable, compensated; unsystematic = company/industry-specific, diversifiable, uncompensated
  • B. 系统性可分散且不被补偿Systematic is diversifiable and uncompensated
  • C. 两者含义相同They mean the same thing
答案 A。只有系统性风险获得回报补偿。Answer A. Only systematic risk earns a return compensation.

2. 市场只对哪种风险给予溢价:The market gives a premium only for which risk: 官方题Official

  • A. 所有风险All risk
  • B. 系统性(市场)风险Systematic (market) risk
  • C. 非系统性风险Unsystematic risk
答案 B。可分散的非系统性风险不被定价。Answer B. Diversifiable unsystematic risk is not priced.

3. 衡量单个资产风险应看总标准差还是贝塔:To measure a single asset's risk, look at total standard deviation or beta: 官方题Official

  • A. 看总标准差Total standard deviation
  • B. 看方差Variance
  • C. 看贝塔(系统性风险),因为只有系统性风险被定价Beta (systematic risk), because only systematic risk is priced
答案 C。定价的是系统性风险即贝塔。Answer C. What is priced is systematic risk, i.e., beta.
1. 分析师获得三个证券以下信息：
总回报方差非系统性回报方差
证券10.200.05
证券20.300.25
证券30.350.22
按资本市场理论，哪个证券的预期回报最高？1. An analyst gathers the following information about three securities:
Total Variance of ReturnsNonsystematic Variance of Returns
Security 10.200.05
Security 20.300.25
Security 30.350.22
According to capital market theory, which security has the highest expected return? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 证券1Security 1
  • B. 证券2Security 2
  • C. 证券3Security 3
答案 A。按资本市场理论,预期回报最高 = 系统性风险(beta)最高者(SML:回报随 beta 升)。按表选 beta 最大的证券1。Answer A. By capital-market theory, the highest expected return = the highest systematic risk (beta) (SML: return rises with beta). Per the table, choose the highest-beta security 1.
2. 非系统性风险最好地描述为：2. Unsystematic risk is best described as: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 总风险。total risk.
  • B. 可分散风险。diversifiable risk.
  • C. 由宏观经济变量引起的所有风险资产的变动。the variability in all risky assets caused by macroeconomic variables.
答案 B。非系统性风险 = 可分散风险(diversifiable / firm-specific)(可通过分散消除)。总风险含系统+非系统;宏观因素引起的是系统性风险。Answer B. Unsystematic risk = diversifiable (firm-specific) risk (removable by diversification). Total risk includes both; macro-driven risk is systematic.
3. 市场组合的系统性风险水平最可能：3. The market portfolio's level of systematic risk is most likely: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 小于其非系统性风险水平。less than its level of nonsystematic risk.
  • B. 等于其非系统性风险水平。equal to its level of nonsystematic risk.
  • C. 大于其非系统性风险水平。greater than its level of nonsystematic risk.
答案 C。市场组合已充分分散 → 非系统性风险≈0 → 其系统性风险 > 非系统性风险(几乎全是系统性)。Answer C. The market portfolio is fully diversified → unsystematic risk ≈ 0 → its systematic risk > unsystematic risk (almost entirely systematic).

§2 资本市场线 CML§2 The Capital Market Line (CML)

LOS 对应:LOS: explain the capital market line。
CML:E(Rp) = Rf + [ (E(Rm) − Rf) / σm ] × σp
符号Symbol含义Meaning
CML把无风险资产与市场组合结合的特殊 CAL(以总风险 σ 为横轴)The special CAL combining the risk-free asset with the market portfolio (with total risk σ on the horizontal axis)
市场组合 mMarket portfolio m所有风险资产按市值加权的组合(最优风险组合)The market-cap-weighted portfolio of all risky assets (the optimal risky portfolio)
斜率Slope市场夏普比率 =(市场超额收益)/σmThe market Sharpe ratio = (market excess return)/σm

CML 只适用于有效组合(横轴是总风险 σ)。对单个证券或非有效组合,要用横轴为贝塔的证券市场线 SML。The CML applies only to efficient portfolios (horizontal axis is total risk σ). For a single security or an inefficient portfolio, use the security market line (SML) with beta on the horizontal axis.

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

资本市场线(CML)是什么

CML 由「无风险资产 + 市场组合」的充分分散组合构成:横轴 = 总风险 σ,纵轴 = 预期回报;斜率 = 市场夏普比率 = (Rm − Rf)/σm。

机制

只有有效(充分分散)组合才落在 CML 上;单个证券或未分散组合含非系统性风险,落在 CML 下方(同σ回报更低)。全体一致预期下,切点即市场组合。

CML vs SML

CML 只对有效组合、横轴用总风险 σ;SML 对所有证券、横轴用 β。这是高频区分点。

What the CML is

The CML is made of fully-diversified portfolios of the risk-free asset + market portfolio: x-axis = total risk σ, y-axis = expected return; slope = the market Sharpe ratio = (Rm − Rf)/σm.

Mechanism

Only efficient (fully-diversified) portfolios lie on the CML; a single security or under-diversified portfolio carries unsystematic risk and sits below it (less return for the same σ). Under homogeneous expectations the tangency point is the market portfolio.

CML vs SML

The CML is only for efficient portfolios with total risk σ on the axis; the SML is for all securities with β on the axis — a frequent distinction.

4. CML 的公式是:The CML formula is: 官方题Official

  • A. E(Rp) = Rf + [(E(Rm)−Rf)/σm]×σpE(Rp) = Rf + [(E(Rm)−Rf)/σm]×σp
  • B. E(Rp) = Rf + β(Rm−Rf)E(Rp) = Rf + β(Rm−Rf)
  • C. E(Rp) = Rf × σpE(Rp) = Rf × σp
答案 A。CML 以总风险 σ 为横轴。Answer A. The CML uses total risk σ on the x-axis.

5. CML 适用于什么组合:The CML applies to what portfolios: 官方题Official

  • A. 只适用于单个股票Only a single stock
  • B. 仅适用于有效组合(横轴为总风险 σ)Only efficient portfolios (x-axis is total risk σ)
  • C. 适用于任意资产Any asset
答案 B。CML 只描述有效组合。Answer B. The CML describes only efficient portfolios.

6. 市场组合是什么:What is the market portfolio: 官方题Official

  • A. 所有风险资产按市值加权构成的组合,是理论上的最优风险组合The market-cap-weighted portfolio of all risky assets, the theoretically optimal risky portfolio
  • B. 无风险组合A risk-free portfolio
  • C. 单一股票A single stock
答案 A。市场组合是市值加权的全体风险资产。Answer A. The market portfolio is all risky assets weighted by market cap.
1. 资本市场线(CML)最可能由下列何种组合构成：1. The capital market line most likely consists of portfolios that: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 充分分散的组合。are fully diversified.
  • B. 系统性风险为零的组合。have zero systematic risk.
  • C. 非系统性风险等于beta的组合。have nonsystematic risk equal to beta.
答案 A。资本市场线(CML)由"充分分散"的组合构成(无风险资产 + 市场组合)。零系统性风险不对(市场组合有系统性风险),故 B、C 错。Answer A. The capital market line (CML) is made of fully-diversified portfolios (risk-free asset + market portfolio). Zero systematic risk is wrong (the market has systematic risk), so B and C are wrong.
2. 若所有投资者预期一致，则由无风险资产和最优风险组合构成的组合，其总风险与预期回报绘制在：2. If all investors have homogeneous expectations, the total risk and expected return of portfolios consisting of the risk-free asset and the optimal risky portfolio are plotted on the: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 资本市场线(CML)。capital market line.
  • B. 证券市场线(SML)。security market line.
  • C. 证券特征线(SCL)。security characteristic line.
答案 A。投资者预期一致时,无风险资产 + 最优风险组合的"总风险 vs 预期回报"绘在资本市场线(CML)上(横轴是总风险σ)。SML 横轴是 beta;SCL 是个券回归线。Answer A. Under homogeneous expectations, the risk-free asset + optimal risky portfolio plot on the capital market line (CML) with total risk (σ) on the x-axis. The SML uses beta; the SCL is a single-security regression line.

§3 贝塔:系统性风险度量§3 Beta: The Measure of Systematic Risk 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: calculate and interpret beta。
贝塔 βi = Cov(i, m) / σm2 = ρi,m × σi / σm
符号Symbol含义Meaning
βi资产 i 相对市场的系统性风险敏感度Asset i's systematic-risk sensitivity relative to the market
Cov(i,m)资产与市场收益的协方差The covariance of the asset's return with the market's
σm2市场收益方差The market return variance
解读Interpretationβ=1 与市场同步;β>1 更波动(激进);β<1 更平稳(防御);市场 β=1β=1 moves with the market; β>1 more volatile (aggressive); β<1 steadier (defensive); the market's β=1
贝塔计算 官方题Official

某股票与市场相关系数 ρ=0.7,σi=25%,σm=18%。β = 0.7 × 25/18 = 0.7 × 1.389 = 0.97。略低于 1,略偏防御。A stock with correlation ρ=0.7 to the market, σi=25%, σm=18%. β = 0.7 × 25/18 = 0.7 × 1.389 = 0.97. Slightly below 1, slightly defensive.

考点·证券特征线(SCL)与市场模型(market model):
• SCL:以「证券超额回报」对「市场超额回报」回归得到的直线;斜率 = beta,纵轴截距 = 詹森阿尔法(Jensen’s alpha)。
• 市场模型 Ri = αi + βi·Rm + εi:用于估计异常/超额回报(abnormal return)(αi 与残差),并不估计市场回报或无风险回报。Exam - the security characteristic line (SCL) & market model:
- SCL: the line from regressing a security’s excess return on the market’s excess return; slope = beta, intercept = Jensen’s alpha.
- Market model Ri = αi + βi·Rm + εi: used to estimate abnormal returns (αi and the residual); it does not estimate the market or the risk-free return.
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

贝塔的定义

β = Cov(i, m)/σ²m = ρ(i,m)·σi/σm,衡量证券对市场的系统性敏感度。市场组合 β = 1;β>1 更激进、β<1 更防御。

证券特征线(SCL)与市场模型

SCL:以「证券超额回报」对「市场超额回报」回归的直线,斜率 = β,纵轴截距 = 詹森 α。市场模型 Ri = αi + βi·Rm + εi 用于估计异常回报(αi 与残差)。

例题

σi = 25%、σm = 15%、ρ = 0.6 → β = 0.6 × 25/15 = 1.0(与市场相同的系统性风险)。

易错对比

① β 用 协方差 ÷ 市场方差(不是 ÷ 证券方差);② SCL 截距是 α(不是 Rf);③ β 只反映系统性风险。

Definition of beta

β = Cov(i, m)/σ²m = ρ(i,m)·σi/σm, the security's systematic sensitivity to the market. The market has β = 1; β>1 aggressive, β<1 defensive.

SCL & market model

The SCL regresses the security's excess return on the market's excess return; slope = β, intercept = Jensen's α. The market model Ri = αi + βi·Rm + εi estimates abnormal returns (αi and the residual).

Worked example

σi = 25%, σm = 15%, ρ = 0.6 → β = 0.6 × 25/15 = 1.0 (the same systematic risk as the market).

Common traps

① β = covariance ÷ market variance (not ÷ the security's variance); ② the SCL intercept is α (not Rf); ③ β reflects only systematic risk.

7. 贝塔的公式是:The beta formula is: 官方题Official

  • A. β = σi/σm²β = σi/σm²
  • B. β = Cov(i,m)/σi²β = Cov(i,m)/σi²
  • C. β = Cov(i,m)/σm² = ρ(i,m)×σi/σmβ = Cov(i,m)/σm² = ρ(i,m)×σi/σm
答案 C。贝塔=协方差除以市场方差。Answer C. Beta = covariance divided by market variance.

8. ρ=0.7、σi=25%、σm=18%,贝塔为:ρ = 0.7, σi = 25%, σm = 18%; beta is: 官方题Official

  • A. 0.970.97
  • B. 0.500.50
  • C. 1.391.39
答案 A。0.7×25/18=0.97。Answer A. 0.7×25/18 = 0.97.

9. 市场组合的贝塔等于:The market portfolio's beta equals: 官方题Official

  • A. 无穷大Infinite
  • B. 11
  • C. 00
答案 B。市场组合贝塔恒为 1。Answer B. The market portfolio's beta is always 1.

10. β > 1 与 β < 1 分别意味着什么:What do β > 1 and β < 1 respectively mean: 官方题Official

  • A. 含义正好相反The meanings are reversed
  • B. 两者没有区别There is no difference
  • C. β > 1 比市场更波动(激进);β < 1 比市场更平稳(防御)β > 1 more volatile than the market (aggressive); β < 1 more stable than the market (defensive)
答案 C。贝塔衡量相对市场的波动性。Answer C. Beta measures volatility relative to the market.
1. 分析师估计市场组合回报标准差为15%、某股票回报标准差为25%。若该股票与市场组合回报相关系数为0.6，则该股票具有：1. An analyst estimates the standard deviation of returns for the market portfolio to be 15% and the standard deviation of returns for a stock to be 25%. If the correlation of returns between the stock and the market portfolio is 0.6, the stock has: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 低于市场组合的系统性风险。less systematic risk than the market portfolio.
  • B. 与市场组合相同的系统性风险。the same systematic risk as the market portfolio.
  • C. 高于市场组合的系统性风险。more systematic risk than the market portfolio.
答案 B。系统性风险由 beta = ρ×(σ股/σ市场)衡量。0.6×(25/15) = 0.6×1.667 = 1.0 → beta=1,与市场系统性风险相同。Answer B. Systematic risk is beta = ρ×(σ_stock/σ_market). 0.6×(25/15) = 0.6×1.667 = 1.0 → beta = 1, the same systematic risk as the market.
2. 下列哪条线绘制在以证券超额回报为纵轴、市场超额回报为横轴的图上？2. Which of the following lines is plotted on a graph with the excess return of a security on the y-axis and the excess return of the market on the x-axis? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 资本市场线(CML)Capital market line
  • B. 证券市场线(SML)Security market line
  • C. 证券特征线(SCL)Security characteristic line
答案 C。以"证券超额回报 vs 市场超额回报"作图的是证券特征线(SCL)(斜率=beta、截距=詹森α)。CML 横轴是总风险;SML 横轴是 beta。Answer C. Plotting security excess return vs market excess return gives the security characteristic line (SCL) (slope = beta, intercept = Jensen's alpha). The CML uses total risk; the SML uses beta.
3. 证券特征线(SCL)在纵轴上的截距是：3. The intercept on the y-axis of the security characteristic line is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. beta。beta.
  • B. 詹森阿尔法。Jensen's alpha.
  • C. 无风险回报率。the risk-free rate of return.
答案 B。SCL 的纵轴截距 = 詹森阿尔法(Jensen's alpha)——超越 CAPM 预测的超额回报。斜率才是 beta。Answer B. The SCL's intercept = Jensen's alpha — the excess return beyond the CAPM prediction. The slope is beta.

§4 CAPM 与证券市场线§4 CAPM & the Security Market Line 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: calculate the expected return using the CAPM; describe the security market line。
🔰 零基础讲解:承担多少系统性风险,该拿多少回报

CAPM🎯 CAPM 说:一个资产的合理预期收益 = 无风险利率 + 它的贝塔 × 市场风险溢价。贝塔越高,该拿的回报越高。把这条关系画出来就是"证券市场线(SML)":横轴贝塔、纵轴预期收益的一条直线。所有"公平定价"的资产都应落在这条线上。用贝塔决定资产的合理预期收益。CAPM🎯 CAPM says: an asset's fair expected return = the risk-free rate + its beta × the market risk premium. The higher the beta, the higher the return it should earn. Plotting this relationship gives the "security market line (SML)": a straight line of beta (horizontal) vs expected return (vertical). All "fairly priced" assets should lie on this line. uses beta to determine an asset's fair expected return.

CAPM / SML:E(Ri) = Rf + βi × [ E(Rm) − Rf ]
符号Symbol含义Meaning
Rf无风险利率(SML 截距)The risk-free rate (the SML intercept)
βi资产系统性风险The asset's systematic risk
E(Rm) − Rf市场风险溢价(SML 斜率)The market risk premium (the SML slope)
CAPM 计算 官方题Official

Rf=3%,市场预期收益 E(Rm)=9%,β=1.2。E(R) = 3% + 1.2×(9%−3%) = 3% + 1.2×6% = 3% + 7.2% = 10.2%。Rf=3%, expected market return E(Rm)=9%, β=1.2. E(R) = 3% + 1.2×(9%−3%) = 3% + 1.2×6% = 3% + 7.2% = 10.2%.

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

CAPM 与证券市场线(SML)

E(R) = Rf + β·(Rm − Rf)。SML 以 β 为横轴,适用于所有证券(不论是否有效/分散);斜率 = 市场风险溢价 (Rm − Rf),截距 = Rf。

反解与应用

β = (E(R) − Rf)/(Rm − Rf);市场溢价 = (E(R) − Rf)/β。例:β = 1.5、E(R) = 11%、Rf = 2% → 市场溢价 = (11 − 2)/1.5 = 6%。

易错对比

① SML 横轴是 β,CML 横轴是 σ;② SML 对所有证券成立、CML 只对有效组合;③ 斜率是市场溢价、不是 β。

CAPM & the security market line (SML)

E(R) = Rf + β·(Rm − Rf). The SML uses β on the x-axis and applies to all securities (efficient or not); slope = the market risk premium (Rm − Rf), intercept = Rf.

Inversion & application

β = (E(R) − Rf)/(Rm − Rf); market premium = (E(R) − Rf)/β. Example: β = 1.5, E(R) = 11%, Rf = 2% → premium = (11 − 2)/1.5 = 6%.

Common traps

① SML x-axis is β, CML x-axis is σ; ② the SML holds for all securities, the CML only for efficient portfolios; ③ the slope is the market premium, not β.

11. CAPM 公式是:The CAPM formula is: 官方题Official

  • A. E(Ri) = Rf + βi[E(Rm)−Rf]E(Ri) = Rf + βi[E(Rm)−Rf]
  • B. E(Ri) = Rf + σE(Ri) = Rf + σ
  • C. E(Ri) = βi × RmE(Ri) = βi × Rm
答案 A。要求收益=无风险利率+贝塔×市场风险溢价。Answer A. Required return = risk-free rate + beta × market risk premium.

12. Rf=3%、E(Rm)=9%、β=1.2,要求收益为:Rf = 3%, E(Rm) = 9%, β = 1.2; the required return is: 官方题Official

  • B. 10.2%10.2%
  • C. 9.0%9.0%
答案 B。3%+1.2×(9%−3%)=10.2%。Answer B. 3% + 1.2×(9% − 3%) = 10.2%.

  • B. 贝塔Beta
  • C. 斜率 = E(Rm) − RfThe slope = E(Rm) − Rf
答案 C。SML 斜率就是市场风险溢价。Answer C. The SML slope is the market risk premium.

14. CML 和 SML 横轴的区别是:The difference in the x-axes of the CML and SML is: 官方题Official

  • A. CML 横轴是总风险 σ(仅有效组合);SML 横轴是贝塔(适用任意资产)CML x-axis is total risk σ (efficient portfolios only); SML x-axis is beta (applies to any asset)
  • B. 两者横轴正好相反The x-axes are exactly reversed
  • C. 两者横轴相同The x-axes are the same
答案 A。CML 用 σ,SML 用 β。Answer A. CML uses σ, SML uses β.
1. 证券市场线(SML)适用于：1. The security market line applies: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 所有证券。to all securities.
  • B. 仅有效证券。only to efficient securities.
  • C. 仅具有特异性风险的证券。only to securities that have idiosyncratic risk.
答案 A。证券市场线(SML)适用于"所有证券"(不论是否有效、是否分散),因为它用 beta(系统性风险)定价。CML 只对有效组合。Answer A. The security market line (SML) applies to all securities (efficient or not, diversified or not), because it prices by beta (systematic risk). The CML applies only to efficient portfolios.

§5 SML 应用:高估与低估§5 Applying the SML: Overvalued & Undervalued

LOS 对应:LOS: use the SML to identify mispriced securities。
情形Case判断Judgment
预期(分析师)收益 > CAPM 要求收益Expected (analyst) return > CAPM required return落在 SML 上方 → 被低估,买入Lies above the SML → undervalued, buy
预期收益 < CAPM 要求收益Expected return < CAPM required return落在 SML 下方 → 被高估,卖出Lies below the SML → overvalued, sell
预期收益 = CAPMExpected return = CAPM落在 SML 上 → 公平定价Lies on the SML → fairly priced
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

用 SML 判断高估/低估

比较「分析师预期回报」与「SML 要求回报」:预期 > 要求 → 价格偏低 → 低估(买入);预期 < 要求 → 高估(卖出)。

图形与 α

点落在 SML 上方 = 低估、下方 = 高估、线上 = 定价合理。α = 预期回报 − 要求回报,正 α = 低估。

易错

别把「回报低于市场」当成高估——要和该证券按 β 计算的要求回报比,而不是和市场回报比。

Using the SML to flag over/undervaluation

Compare the analyst's expected return with the SML required return: expected > required → price too low → undervalued (buy); expected < required → overvalued (sell).

Graph & alpha

A point above the SML = undervalued, below = overvalued, on it = fairly priced. α = expected − required; positive α = undervalued.

Common trap

Don't treat "return below the market" as overvalued — compare with the security's β-based required return, not with the market return.

  • B. 预期收益高于 CAPM 要求收益 → 被低估,应买入Expected return above the CAPM required return → undervalued, buy
  • C. 被高估,应卖出Overvalued, sell
答案 B。上方=预期收益偏高即低估。Answer B. Above = expected return too high, i.e., undervalued.

  • C. 定价合理Fairly priced
答案 A。下方=预期收益偏低即高估。Answer A. Below = expected return too low, i.e., overvalued.

§6 绩效衡量指标§6 Performance Measurement Metrics 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: calculate and interpret the Sharpe ratio, Treynor ratio, M², and Jensen's alpha。
夏普比率 = (Rp − Rf) / σp    特雷诺比率 = (Rp − Rf) / βp
詹森 alpha αp = Rp − [ Rf + βp(Rm − Rf) ]
指标Metric风险度量 / 用途Risk measure / use
夏普比率Sharpe ratio用总风险 σ;每单位总风险的超额收益;适合评价整个组合Uses total risk σ; excess return per unit of total risk; suits evaluating a whole portfolio
特雷诺比率Treynor ratio用贝塔;每单位系统性风险的超额收益;适合已分散组合Uses beta; excess return per unit of systematic risk; suits a diversified portfolio
M²基于夏普,转成与市场可比的百分比超额收益Based on Sharpe, converted to a market-comparable percentage excess return
詹森 alphaJensen's alpha实际收益 − CAPM 要求收益;正 alpha=跑赢、选股能力Actual return − CAPM required return; positive alpha = outperformance, stock-selection skill
考点提示:
① 夏普/M² 用总风险(σ);特雷诺/詹森 alpha 用系统性风险(β)。
② 若组合未充分分散,用夏普(总风险)更合适;若已分散、作为大组合一部分,用特雷诺/alpha。
③ 詹森 alpha > 0 表示相对 CAPM 有超额业绩。
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

四大绩效指标

• 夏普 = (Rp − Rf)/σ(总风险,= CAL 斜率,适合未充分分散组合);
• 特雷诺 = (Rp − Rf)/β(系统性风险,适合已分散);
• 詹森 α = Rp − [Rf + β(Rm − Rf)](超越 CAPM 的超额,仅系统性风险);
• M² = (夏普p − 夏普m) × σm(把组合调到与市场同风险后的超额回报,与夏普同排序)。

怎么选

总风险(含非系统) → 夏普/M²;系统性风险(β) → 特雷诺/詹森。评估未分散组合务必用夏普(它惩罚非系统性风险)。

例题

市场 R=8%、σ=12%、Rf=2%;组合夏普 0.8。市场夏普 =(8−2)/12=0.5 → M² =(0.8−0.5)×12 = 3.6%。

The four performance measures

• Sharpe = (Rp − Rf)/σ (total risk, = CAL slope, for under-diversified portfolios);
• Treynor = (Rp − Rf)/β (systematic risk, for diversified);
• Jensen α = Rp − [Rf + β(Rm − Rf)] (excess over CAPM, systematic only);
• M² = (Sharpe_p − Sharpe_m) × σm (excess after scaling the portfolio to the market's risk; ranks the same as Sharpe).

Which to use

Total risk (incl. unsystematic) → Sharpe/M²; systematic risk (β) → Treynor/Jensen. Always use Sharpe for an under-diversified portfolio (it penalizes unsystematic risk).

Worked example

Market R=8%, σ=12%, Rf=2%; portfolio Sharpe 0.8. Market Sharpe = (8−2)/12 = 0.5 → M² = (0.8−0.5)×12 = 3.6%.

17. 夏普比率的公式和风险度量是:The Sharpe ratio's formula and risk measure are: 官方题Official

  • A. 用贝塔Using beta
  • B. 用方差Using variance
  • C. (Rp−Rf)/σp,用总风险(标准差)(Rp−Rf)/σp, using total risk (standard deviation)
答案 C。夏普用总风险衡量单位风险回报。Answer C. Sharpe uses total risk to measure return per unit of risk.

18. 特雷诺比率的公式和风险度量是:The Treynor ratio's formula and risk measure are: 官方题Official

  • A. (Rp−Rf)/βp,用系统性风险(贝塔)(Rp−Rf)/βp, using systematic risk (beta)
  • B. 用总风险Using total risk
  • C. 用方差Using variance
答案 A。特雷诺以贝塔为分母。Answer A. Treynor uses beta in the denominator.

19. 詹森 alpha 的公式是:The Jensen's alpha formula is: 官方题Official

  • A. αp = Rp / βpαp = Rp / βp
  • B. αp = Rp − [Rf + βp(Rm−Rf)]αp = Rp − [Rf + βp(Rm−Rf)]
  • C. αp = Rp − Rfαp = Rp − Rf
答案 B。实际收益减去 CAPM 要求收益。Answer B. Actual return minus the CAPM required return.

20. 詹森 alpha 大于零意味着什么:A Jensen's alpha greater than zero means what: 官方题Official

  • A. 相对 CAPM 要求收益跑赢,体现选股/超额业绩能力Outperformance relative to the CAPM required return, reflecting stock-selection/excess-performance ability
  • B. 跑输 CAPM 要求收益Underperformance vs the CAPM required return
  • C. 没有任何意义No meaning
答案 A。正 alpha 代表超额业绩。Answer A. A positive alpha represents excess performance.

21. 什么时候用夏普而不是特雷诺:When to use Sharpe rather than Treynor: 官方题Official

  • A. 当组合已充分分散时When the portfolio is fully diversified
  • B. 从不使用夏普Never use Sharpe
  • C. 当组合未充分分散、代表投资者全部财富时,用夏普(总风险)When the portfolio is not fully diversified and represents the investor's entire wealth, use Sharpe (total risk)
答案 C。未分散时总风险更相关。Answer C. When undiversified, total risk is more relevant.

22. 什么时候用特雷诺/alpha:When to use Treynor/alpha: 官方题Official

  • A. 当组合已分散、作为更大组合的一部分时,系统性风险(贝塔)更相关When the portfolio is diversified and part of a larger portfolio, systematic risk (beta) is more relevant
  • B. 当组合未分散时When the portfolio is undiversified
  • C. 从不使用Never use them
答案 A。已分散时只有系统性风险相关。Answer A. When diversified, only systematic risk is relevant.

23. M² 衡量什么:What does M² measure: 官方题Official

  • A. 基于夏普,把组合表现转换成与市场可直接比较的百分比超额收益Based on Sharpe, it converts portfolio performance into a percentage excess return directly comparable with the market
  • B. 基于贝塔的比率A beta-based ratio
  • C. 衡量总风险Measures total risk
答案 A。M² 把夏普转成可比的百分比收益。Answer A. M² converts Sharpe into a comparable percentage return.

24. Rp=12%、Rf=3%、σp=20%,夏普比率为:Rp = 12%, Rf = 3%, σp = 20%; the Sharpe ratio is: 官方题Official

  • A. 0.600.60
  • B. 0.450.45
  • C. 0.090.09
答案 B。(12%−3%)/20%=0.45。Answer B. (12% − 3%)/20% = 0.45.

25. Rp=12%、Rf=3%、βp=1.5,特雷诺比率为:Rp = 12%, Rf = 3%, βp = 1.5; the Treynor ratio is: 官方题Official

  • A. 0.090.09
  • B. 0.450.45
  • C. 0.060.06
答案 C。(12%−3%)/1.5=0.06。Answer C. (12% − 3%)/1.5 = 0.06.

26. 上题若市场收益 9%、β=1.5,詹森 alpha 为:For the above, if market return 9% and β = 1.5, Jensen's alpha is: 补充Extra

  • A. 0%(恰好符合 CAPM)0% (exactly matches CAPM)
  • B. +3%+3%
  • C. −3%−3%
答案 A。α=12%−[3%+1.5×(9%−3%)]=12%−12%=0%。Answer A. α = 12% − [3% + 1.5×(9% − 3%)] = 12% − 12% = 0%.
1. 分析师获得某组合与市场以下信息：
组合回报7.0%
市场回报5.0%
无风险回报1.0%
组合beta1.2
该组合的詹森阿尔法(Jensen's alpha)为：1. An analyst gathers the following information about a portfolio and the market:
Portfolio return7.0%
Market return5.0%
Risk-free return1.0%
Portfolio beta1.2
Jensen's alpha for the portfolio is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 0.0%。0.0%.
  • B. 1.2%。1.2%.
  • C. 2.2%。2.2%.
答案 B。方法:詹森α = 实际回报 − CAPM 要求回报[Rf + β(Rm − Rf)]。按表代入 ≈ 1.2%(正α=跑赢)。Answer B. Method: Jensen's alpha = actual return − CAPM required return [Rf + β(Rm − Rf)]. Per the table ≈ 1.2% (positive alpha = outperformance).
2. 下列哪种指标仅用系统性风险来评估组合业绩？2. Which of the following measures uses only systematic risk to evaluate portfolio performance? 真题模考Mock
  • A. M²M²
  • B. 夏普比率Sharpe ratio
  • C. 詹森阿尔法Jensen's alpha
答案 C。只用"系统性风险(beta)"评估业绩的是詹森α与特雷诺比率。夏普、M² 用"总风险(σ)"。故选詹森α。Answer C. Measures using only systematic risk (beta) are Jensen's alpha and the Treynor ratio. Sharpe and M² use total risk (σ). Hence Jensen's alpha.
3. 市场回报8%、回报标准差12%，无风险利率2%。若某组合的夏普比率为0.8，则该组合的 M² 阿尔法最接近：3. The market has a return of 8% and a standard deviation of returns of 12%. The risk-free rate is 2%. If a portfolio has a Sharpe ratio of 0.8, the portfolio's M² alpha is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 3.6%。3.6%.
  • B. 5.6%。5.6%.
  • C. 11.6%。11.6%.
答案 A。方法:M² = 夏普比率×σ市场 −(Rm − Rf)... 更简 M²α = (夏普_p − 夏普_m)×σ市场。夏普_m=(8−2)/12=0.5;(0.8−0.5)×12 = 3.6%。Answer A. Method: M² alpha = (Sharpe_p − Sharpe_m)×σ_market. Sharpe_m = (8−2)/12 = 0.5; (0.8−0.5)×12 = 3.6%.
4. 下列哪种业绩指标等于资本配置线(CAL)的斜率？4. Which of the following performance measures is equal to the slope of the capital allocation line? 真题模考Mock
  • A. M²M²
  • B. 夏普比率Sharpe ratio
  • C. 特雷诺比率Treynor ratio
答案 B。夏普比率 =(组合回报 − Rf)/σ = 资本配置线(CAL)的斜率(每单位总风险的超额回报)。M²、特雷诺不是 CAL 斜率。Answer B. The Sharpe ratio = (portfolio return − Rf)/σ = the slope of the capital allocation line (CAL) (excess return per unit of total risk). M² and Treynor are not the CAL slope.
5. 下列哪种指标最适合评估未充分分散的组合的业绩？5. Which of the following measures is most appropriate to evaluate the performance of a portfolio that is not fully diversified? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 夏普比率Sharpe ratio
  • B. 特雷诺比率Treynor ratio
  • C. 詹森阿尔法Jensen's alpha
答案 A。评估"未充分分散"组合用夏普比率(以总风险σ为分母,含非系统性风险)。特雷诺/詹森用 beta,只适合已分散组合。Answer A. For an under-diversified portfolio, use the Sharpe ratio (total risk σ in the denominator, capturing unsystematic risk). Treynor/Jensen use beta and suit diversified portfolios.
6. 投资者获得某组合与市场以下信息：
回报回报标准差Beta
组合11%4%1.2
市场10%3%1.0
若无风险利率3%，则该组合的詹森阿尔法为：6. An investor gathers the following information about a portfolio and the market:
ReturnStandard Deviation of ReturnsBeta
Portfolio11%4%1.2
Market10%3%1.0
If the risk-free rate is 3%, Jensen's alpha for the portfolio is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. −4.0%。−4.0%.
  • B. −0.4%。−0.4%.
  • C. 0.4%。0.4%.
答案 B。方法:詹森α = 实际回报 − [Rf + β(Rm − Rf)]。按表代入(Rf=3%) ≈ −0.4%(负α=跑输)。Answer B. Method: Jensen's alpha = actual return − [Rf + β(Rm − Rf)]. Per the table (Rf=3%) ≈ −0.4% (negative = underperformance).
7. 分析师获得某组合与市场以下信息：
组合夏普比率0.8
组合回报波动率19%
市场回报波动率10%
组合与市场回报相关系数0.7
该组合的特雷诺比率最接近：7. An analyst gathers the following information about a portfolio and the market:
Portfolio's Sharpe ratio0.8
Volatility of portfolio returns19%
Volatility of market returns10%
Correlation between portfolio returns and market returns0.7
The portfolio's Treynor ratio is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 0.060。0.060.
  • B. 0.114。0.114.
  • C. 0.413。0.413.
答案 B。方法:特雷诺比率 =(组合回报 − Rf)/beta(每单位系统性风险的超额回报)。按表 ≈ 0.114。Answer B. Method: Treynor ratio = (portfolio return − Rf)/beta (excess return per unit of systematic risk). Per the table ≈ 0.114.

§2 Return-Generating Models 与 Market Model§2 Return-Generating Models & the Market Model 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应：explain return-generating models, including the market model, and their uses。

收益生成模型把资产收益拆成一个或多个共同因子和特有部分。它可用于风险预测、情景分析、组合构建和绩效归因。A return-generating model decomposes an asset's return into one or more common factors and an idiosyncratic part. It can be used for risk forecasting, scenario analysis, portfolio construction, and performance attribution.

Ri = αi + βiRM + εi
组成Component含义Meaning
αi不由市场收益解释的截距The intercept not explained by the market return
βi资产对市场收益变化的敏感度The asset's sensitivity to changes in the market return
εi公司特有、可通过分散降低的残差收益Company-specific residual return, reducible by diversification

Market Model 是统计模型；CAPM 是均衡定价模型。两者都使用 beta，但 CAPM 进一步给出必要预期收益 Rf+β(E[RM]−Rf)。The Market Model is a statistical model; CAPM is an equilibrium pricing model. Both use beta, but CAPM further gives the required expected return Rf+β(E[RM]−Rf).

1. Market Model 与 CAPM 的根本区别是:The fundamental difference between the Market Model and CAPM is:

  • A. Market Model 是描述收益关系的统计模型;CAPM 是给出必要预期收益的均衡定价模型The Market Model is a statistical model describing return relationships; CAPM is an equilibrium pricing model giving the required expected return
  • B. 两者定义正好相反The definitions are exactly reversed
  • C. 两者完全相同They are identical
答案 A。一个是统计描述,一个是均衡定价。Answer A. One is a statistical description, the other equilibrium pricing.
1. 市场模型(market model)最可能用于估计：1. The market model is most likely used to estimate: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 市场回报。market returns.
  • B. 无风险回报。risk-free returns.
  • C. 异常回报。abnormal returns.
答案 C。市场模型 Ri = αi + βi·Rm + εi 用于估计"异常回报(abnormal return)"(αi 及残差)。它不估计市场或无风险回报。Answer C. The market model Ri = αi + βi·Rm + εi is used to estimate abnormal returns (αi and the residual). It does not estimate the market or risk-free return.
2. 分析师为某资产估计市场模型，得到以下参数：
截距 (α)1%
斜率系数 (β)0.5
若市场预期回报为2%，则该资产的预期回报为：2. An analyst estimates the market model for an asset and obtains the following parameters:
Intercept (α)1%
Slope coefficient (β)0.5
If the market's expected return is 2%, the asset's expected return is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 1.0%。1.0%.
  • B. 1.5%。1.5%.
  • C. 2.0%。2.0%.
答案 C。方法:市场模型 预期回报 = α + β×市场预期回报。按表(α、β)代入 R = α + β×2% ≈ 2.0%。Answer C. Method: market-model expected return = α + β×expected market return. Per the table, R = α + β×2% ≈ 2.0%.
3. 就多因素回报生成模型而言，公司的盈利最好地归类为：3. With respect to multi-factor return-generating models, a company's earnings are best classified as a: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 统计因素。statistical factor.
  • B. 基本面因素。fundamental factor.
  • C. 宏观经济因素。macroeconomic factor.
答案 B。多因素回报生成模型中,公司盈利属"基本面因素(fundamental factor)"(公司/证券属性)。宏观因素是 GDP/利率;统计因素由数据统计得出。Answer B. In a multifactor return-generating model, a company's earnings is a fundamental factor (a company/security attribute). Macro factors are GDP/rates; statistical factors are derived from the data.

这一讲讲"动手管钱前的规划":投资政策说明书(IPS)怎么写、收益与风险目标怎么定、五大约束是什么、战略资产配置怎么来;以及风险管理框架。IPS 的组成和五大约束几乎必考。This lecture covers 'the planning before you start managing money': how to write the Investment Policy Statement (IPS), how to set return and risk objectives, what the five constraints are, and how strategic asset allocation is derived; plus the risk-management framework. The components of the IPS and the five constraints are near-certain exam topics.
