§1 投资政策说明书 IPS§1 The Investment Policy Statement (IPS) 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: describe the reasons for and major components of an investment policy statement。
🔰 零基础讲解:IPS = 投资的"宪法"

IPS📋 投资政策说明书是客户和管理人共同签署的"投资宪法":写清楚客户想要多少回报、能承受多大风险、有哪些限制(什么时候要用钱、税务、法律、特殊偏好)。有了它,双方对目标有共识,市场大跌时也能按既定方针执行,而不是情绪化操作。是规定投资目标与约束的书面纲领。The IPS📋 The investment policy statement is an "investment constitution" signed jointly by client and manager: it spells out how much return the client wants, how much risk they can bear, and what constraints apply (when they need the money, taxes, legal, special preferences). With it, both sides share a common understanding of the goals and can execute the set policy even when markets plunge, instead of acting emotionally. is the written charter setting out investment objectives and constraints.

IPS 的作用:明确目标、约束双方、提供长期纪律、作为绩效评估基准。主要组成:
① 客户背景与目标;
② 收益目标;
③ 风险目标/承受能力;
④ 五大约束(流动性、时间跨度、税收、法律监管、特殊情况);
⑤ 治理、再平衡政策、评估基准等。Role of the IPS: clarify objectives, discipline both parties, provide long-term discipline, and serve as a performance-evaluation benchmark. Main components:
① client background and objectives;
② return objective;
③ risk objective/tolerance;
④ the five constraints (liquidity, time horizon, tax, legal/regulatory, unique circumstances);
⑤ governance, rebalancing policy, evaluation benchmark, etc.

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

IPS 各部分记什么(对号入座)

• 目标与约束(objectives & constraints):回报/风险目标 + 五大约束——与客户独特需求联系最紧。
• 投资指引(investment guidelines):如何执行——允许的杠杆、衍生品、排除资产。
• 评估与审查(evaluation & review):对投资结果反馈的指引。
• 程序(procedures):IPS 如何/何时审查、应急处理。
• 职责与义务声明:各方角色与经理裁量权。

易错对比

① 衍生品/杠杆 → 投资指引;② 如何何时审查 → 程序;③ 结果反馈 → 评估与审查;④ 独特需求 → 目标与约束。IPS 只规定战略(SAA)目标。

What each IPS section holds (match them)

• Objectives & constraints: return/risk objectives + the five constraints — most tied to the client's distinctive needs.
• Investment guidelines: how policy is executed — permitted leverage, derivatives, excluded assets.
• Evaluation & review: guidance on feedback on results.
• Procedures: how/when the IPS is reviewed and contingencies.
• Statement of duties: roles and managers' discretion.

Common traps

① Derivatives/leverage → investment guidelines; ② how/when to review → procedures; ③ results feedback → evaluation & review; ④ distinctive needs → objectives & constraints. The IPS specifies only the strategic (SAA) targets.

1. IPS 的主要作用是:The main role of the IPS is: 官方题Official

  • A. 没有实际作用No real role
  • B. 明确投资目标与约束、约束双方行为、提供长期纪律、作为绩效评估基准Clarify investment objectives and constraints, discipline both parties' behavior, provide long-term discipline, and serve as a performance benchmark
  • C. 只用于报税Only for tax filing
答案 B。IPS 是投资关系的纲领性文件。Answer B. The IPS is the guiding document of the investment relationship.

2. IPS 的两大类内容是:The two main content categories of an IPS are: 官方题Official

  • A. 只有收益目标Only return objectives
  • B. 只有约束Only constraints
  • C. 目标(收益目标、风险目标)和约束(五大约束)Objectives (return objective, risk objective) and constraints (the five constraints)
答案 C。目标 + 约束构成 IPS 主体。Answer C. Objectives + constraints form the body of the IPS.
1. 投资政策声明的下列哪一部分最可能提供关于获取投资结果反馈的指引？1. Which of the following sections of an investment policy statement most likely provides guidance on obtaining feedback on investment results? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 投资指引Investment Guidelines
  • B. 评估与审查Evaluation and Review
  • C. 职责与义务声明Statement of Duties and Responsibilities
答案 B。IPS 的"评估与审查(evaluation and review)"部分提供获取投资结果反馈的指引。投资指引管执行;职责与义务声明列各方角色。Answer B. The "evaluation and review" section of an IPS provides guidance on feedback on investment results. Investment guidelines cover execution; the statement of duties lists parties' roles.
2. 关于投资政策声明(IPS)的下列哪项最准确？2. Which of the following is most accurate regarding an investment policy statement (IPS)? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 可持续投资政策需要单独的IPS。Policies on sustainable investing require a separate IPS.
  • B. 投资约束可由客户或法律确定。Investment constraints can be determined by the client or by the law.
  • C. 客户可指定不同支出目标，但每个目标必须有相同的风险承受能力和回报目标。Clients can specify different spending goals, but each goal must have the same risk tolerance and return objective.
答案 B。投资约束可由客户(内部)或法律(外部)确定。可持续投资可整合进 IPS(不必单独),不同支出目标可有不同风险/回报目标,故 A、C 错。Answer B. Investment constraints can be set by the client (internal) or by law (external). Sustainable investing can be integrated into the IPS (not separate), and different spending goals can have different risk/return objectives, so A and C are wrong.
3. 关于组合中允许使用衍生品的信息，最可能出现在投资政策声明的哪一部分？3. Information regarding the permissible use of derivatives in a portfolio is most likely found in which of the following sections of an investment policy statement? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 程序Procedures
  • B. 投资指引Investment Guidelines
  • C. 职责与义务声明Statement of Duties and Responsibilities
答案 B。允许使用衍生品的信息在 IPS "投资指引(investment guidelines)"部分(涉及如何执行:杠杆、衍生品、排除资产)。程序部分讲如何更新/应急。Answer B. Information on permissible use of derivatives is in the IPS "investment guidelines" section (how policy is executed: leverage, derivatives, excluded assets). The procedures section covers updating/contingencies.
4. 投资政策声明(IPS)的下列哪一部分最可能说明IPS应如何以及何时审查？4. Which of the following sections of an investment policy statement (IPS) most likely explains how and when the IPS should be reviewed? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 程序Procedures
  • B. 投资指引Investment Guidelines
  • C. 职责与义务声明Statement of Duties and Responsibilities
答案 A。IPS "程序(procedures)"部分说明 IPS 应如何以及何时审查(保持更新的步骤)。衍生品使用在投资指引。Answer A. The IPS "procedures" section explains how and when the IPS should be reviewed (steps to keep it current). Derivatives use is in investment guidelines.
5. 就投资政策声明而言，下列哪项与客户的独特需求联系最紧密？5. With respect to an investment policy statement, which of the following is most closely linked to the client's distinctive needs? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 评估与审查部分The evaluation and review section
  • B. 目标与约束部分The objectives and constraints sections
  • C. 职责与义务声明The statement of duties and responsibilities
答案 B。"目标与约束(objectives and constraints)"部分与客户独特需求联系最紧密(风险/回报目标、约束)。评估审查、职责声明较通用。Answer B. The "objectives and constraints" section is most closely tied to the client's distinctive needs (risk/return objectives, constraints). Evaluation/review and the duties statement are more generic.
6. 养老金计划投资政策声明的下列哪一部分最可能规定组合经理在执行投资策略方面的裁量权？6. Which of the following sections of an investment policy statement for a pension plan most likely specifies the discretion that portfolio managers have with respect to executing the investment strategy? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 程序Procedures
  • B. 投资约束Investment Constraints
  • C. 职责与义务声明Statement of Duties and Responsibilities
答案 C。养老金 IPS 的"职责与义务声明"规定经理执行策略的裁量权(治理安排、各方角色)。程序部分讲更新;约束部分列限制。Answer C. The "statement of duties and responsibilities" in a pension IPS specifies managers' discretion in executing the strategy (governance, roles). Procedures cover updating; constraints list limits.

§2 收益目标与风险目标§2 Return Objectives & Risk Objectives

LOS 对应:LOS: describe the return and risk objectives。

收益目标:区分所需收益(required)与期望收益(desired);须与风险承受一致、现实可行。注意名义 vs 实际(考虑通胀)、税前 vs 税后、总回报 vs 现金流需求。风险目标:用绝对(如最大可接受损失、标准差上限)或相对(相对基准的跟踪误差)表达。Return objective: distinguish the required return from the desired return; it must be consistent with risk tolerance and realistic. Note nominal vs real (accounting for inflation), pre-tax vs after-tax, total return vs cash-flow needs. Risk objective: expressed in absolute terms (e.g., maximum acceptable loss, standard-deviation cap) or relative terms (tracking error vs a benchmark).

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

回报目标

分要求回报(required,必须达到)与期望回报(desired,想达到);可绝对(如年 6%)或相对(相对基准)。设相对目标时,好的基准应「可投资(investable)」——能实际复制。回报目标不能脱离风险目标单独设。

风险目标

分绝对(如波动率不超 X%、下行不超 Y%)与相对(相对基准的跟踪误差)。

易错

① 回报目标可以是要求回报率;② 相对目标要配可投资、可衡量的基准;③ 风险与回报目标要一致设定。

Return objective

Split into a required return (must achieve) and a desired return (would like); may be absolute (e.g., 6%/yr) or relative (vs a benchmark). For a relative objective, a good benchmark must be "investable" — actually replicable. The return objective is not set independently of the risk objective.

Risk objective

Absolute (e.g., volatility ≤ X%, drawdown ≤ Y%) or relative (tracking error vs a benchmark).

Common traps

① A return objective can be a required rate; ② a relative objective needs an investable, measurable benchmark; ③ risk and return objectives are set together.

3. 所需收益与期望收益的区别是:The difference between required return and desired return is: 官方题Official

  • A. 所需收益=实现目标必须达到的回报;期望收益=客户希望但非必须达到的回报Required return = the return that must be achieved to meet goals; desired return = a return the client hopes for but does not have to achieve
  • B. 两者定义相反The definitions are reversed
  • C. 两者完全相同They are identical
答案 A。所需是刚性,期望是弹性。Answer A. Required is rigid, desired is elastic.

4. 为什么风险目标可以用绝对或相对方式表达:Why can the risk objective be expressed in absolute or relative terms: 补充Extra

  • A. 只能用相对方式Only relative
  • B. 绝对如最大损失/标准差上限;相对如相对基准的跟踪误差,取决于客户关注点Absolute such as max loss/standard-deviation cap; relative such as tracking error vs a benchmark, depending on the client's focus
  • C. 只能用绝对方式Only absolute
答案 B。绝对与相对各有适用场景。Answer B. Absolute and relative each have their use.
1. 就投资政策声明而言，关于回报目标的下列表述哪项最准确？1. With regard to an investment policy statement, which of the following statements about return objectives is most accurate? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 回报目标不能是要求回报率。A return objective cannot be a required rate of return.
  • B. 回报目标必须独立于风险目标设定。Return objectives must be set independent of risk objectives.
  • C. 设定相对回报目标时，好的基准应可投资。When setting a relative return objective, a good benchmark should be investable.
答案 C。设定相对回报目标时,好的基准应"可投资(investable)"(可实际复制)。回报目标可以是要求回报率,且与风险目标相关设定,故 A、B 错。Answer C. When setting a relative return objective, a good benchmark should be investable (actually replicable). A return objective can be a required return and is set with the risk objective, so A and B are wrong.
2. 顾问获得某客户退休收入需求信息：退休基金当前余额$150,000；客户计划15年后退休；按今天货币需$500,000用于退休；不再追加缴款。未来15年通胀预计年均2%。不考虑税收，达成目标所需的最低年回报率最接近：2. An adviser gathers the following information about a client's retirement income needs: the current balance of the retirement fund is $150,000; the client plans to retire in 15 years; $500,000 in today's money is needed to fund retirement; no further contributions will be made. Inflation is expected to average 2% per year over the next 15 years. Ignoring taxes, the minimum annual rate of return required to meet the objective is closest to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 6.2%。6.2%.
  • B. 8.4%。8.4%.
  • C. 10.5%。10.5%.
答案 C。方法:先把 $500,000 目标按 2% 通胀调到 15 年后的名义值,再解使 $150,000 在 15 年增长到该值的年回报率。名义目标≈500,000×1.02^15,回报率 ≈ 10.5%。Answer C. Method: inflate the $500,000 goal by 2% for 15 years, then solve for the annual return that grows $150,000 to that nominal value. The nominal target ≈ 500,000×1.02^15, giving ≈ 10.5%.

§3 风险承受能力:意愿 vs 能力§3 Risk Tolerance: Willingness vs Ability

LOS 对应:LOS: distinguish between the willingness and the ability to take risk。
维度Dimension看什么What to look at
承担风险的能力(ability)Ability to take risk客观:财富规模、时间跨度、收入稳定性、流动性需求、目标的重要性Objective: wealth size, time horizon, income stability, liquidity needs, importance of the goal
承担风险的意愿(willingness)Willingness to take risk主观:心理、态度、投资经验Subjective: psychology, attitude, investment experience
考点提示:当能力与意愿冲突时,通常以较保守(较低)的一方为准,并就差异与客户沟通、进行投资者教育。切勿仅凭高意愿而超出客观能力去冒险。
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

承担风险的「能力」vs「意愿」

• 能力(ability):客观——时间跨度越长、相对负债的财富越厚、收入越稳,能力越强。
• 意愿(willingness):主观——风险态度、经历、心理。
规则:总体风险承受能力取「能力与意愿中较低者」约束。若两者冲突(如能力高、意愿低),通常按较低者并与客户沟通教育。

易错对比

① 时间跨度、财富/负债 → 能力;② 风险态度、效用函数、风险厌恶 → 意愿;③ 取较低者,不是平均。

Ability vs willingness to take risk

• Ability: objective — a longer time horizon, more wealth relative to liabilities, and stable income all raise it.
• Willingness: subjective — attitude, experience, psychology.
Rule: overall risk tolerance is governed by the lower of ability and willingness. If they conflict (high ability, low willingness), generally use the lower and discuss/educate the client.

Common traps

① Time horizon, wealth/liabilities → ability; ② risk attitude, utility function, risk aversion → willingness; ③ take the lower, not the average.

5. 承担风险的能力由哪些客观因素决定:The ability to take risk is determined by which objective factors: 官方题Official

  • A. 主观心理态度Subjective psychological attitude
  • B. 个人投资经验Personal investment experience
  • C. 财富规模、时间跨度、收入稳定性、流动性需求、目标重要性Wealth size, time horizon, income stability, liquidity needs, and the importance of the goal
答案 C。能力是客观条件决定的。Answer C. Ability is determined by objective conditions.

6. 承担风险的意愿反映什么:The willingness to take risk reflects what: 官方题Official

  • A. 主观的心理态度、风险偏好、投资经验Subjective psychological attitude, risk preference, and investment experience
  • B. 客观财富规模Objective wealth size
  • C. 时间跨度Time horizon
答案 A。意愿是主观偏好。Answer A. Willingness is a subjective preference.

7. 能力和意愿冲突时怎么办:What to do when ability and willingness conflict: 官方题Official

  • A. 忽略冲突Ignore the conflict
  • B. 通常以较保守(较低)的一方为准,并与客户沟通、进行教育Usually defer to the more conservative (lower) of the two, while communicating with and educating the client
  • C. 以较激进的一方为准Defer to the more aggressive one
答案 B。取低者从谨慎,并做客户教育。Answer B. Take the lower for prudence, with client education.
1. 投资顾问最恰当地用客户的时间跨度来确定客户的：1. A client's time horizon is most appropriately used by an investment adviser to determine the client's: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 风险态度。risk attitude.
  • B. 承担风险的能力。ability to take risk.
  • C. 承担风险的意愿。willingness to take risk.
答案 B。时间跨度(time horizon)决定客户"承担风险的能力(ability)"(时间越长恢复力越强)。风险态度/意愿是"意愿(willingness)"层面。Answer B. The time horizon determines the client's ability to take risk (a longer horizon means more capacity to recover). Risk attitude is the "willingness" dimension.
2. 下列哪项最可能影响客户承担风险的能力？客户的：2. Which of the following most likely affects a client's ability to take risk? The client's: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 效用函数。utility function.
  • B. 风险厌恶程度。degree of risk aversion.
  • C. 相对负债的财富水平。level of wealth relative to liabilities.
答案 C。"相对负债的财富水平"影响承担风险的能力(ability)(财富厚、负债少 → 能力强)。效用函数、风险厌恶程度属"意愿"。Answer C. A client's wealth relative to liabilities affects the ability to take risk (more wealth, fewer liabilities → higher ability). The utility function and risk aversion are "willingness."
3. 下列哪一特征最可能用于确定投资者承担风险的能力？投资者的：3. Which of the following characteristics is most likely used to determine an investor's ability to take risk? The investor's: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 风险态度。risk attitude.
  • B. 自信心。self-confidence.
  • C. 距退休的年数。years until retirement.
答案 C。"距退休的年数"(时间跨度)决定承担风险的能力。风险态度、自信心属意愿层面。Answer C. The number of years to retirement (time horizon) determines the ability to take risk. Risk attitude and confidence are willingness.
4. 资产经理评估三位投资者的风险承受能力：
投资者承担风险的能力承担风险的意愿
1平均平均
2高于平均低于平均
3低于平均高于平均
哪位投资者的总体风险承受能力最可能最高？4. An asset manager evaluates the risk tolerance of three investors:
InvestorAbility to Take RiskWillingness to Take Risk
1AverageAverage
2Above averageBelow average
3Below averageAbove average
Which investor most likely has the highest overall risk tolerance? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 投资者1。Investor 1.
  • B. 投资者2。Investor 2.
  • C. 投资者3。Investor 3.
答案 A。总体风险承受能力 = 能力与意愿中较低者约束。按表,投资者1 的能力+意愿组合最高 → 承受能力最高。Answer A. Overall risk tolerance is constrained by the lower of ability and willingness. Per the table, investor 1's combination is highest → the highest risk tolerance.

§4 五大约束§4 The Five Constraints 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: describe the investment constraints of liquidity, time horizon, tax, legal/regulatory, and unique circumstances。
约束Constraint含义(记忆:流-时-税-法-特)Meaning (mnemonic: Liquidity-Time-Tax-Legal-Unique)
流动性 LiquidityLiquidity近期现金需求;需求高则须配置更多流动资产Near-term cash needs; high needs require more liquid assets
时间跨度 Time horizonTime horizon投资期限;越长越能承受波动、配置更多权益Investment horizon; the longer, the more volatility it can bear and the more equity it can hold
税收 TaxTax税务状况影响资产选择与税后回报Tax situation affects asset choice and after-tax return
法律与监管 Legal/RegulatoryLegal/Regulatory信托法、监管限制(如养老金规定)Trust law, regulatory limits (e.g., pension rules)
特殊情况 UniqueUnique个人偏好、ESG、集中持仓、限制行业等Personal preferences, ESG, concentrated holdings, restricted industries, etc.
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

五大约束(constraints)

① 流动性(liquidity):近期现金需求 → 配置流动资产(如学费用商业票据)。
② 时间跨度(time horizon):影响可承担风险与资产选择。
③ 税收(tax):应税 vs 免税、利得 vs 利息。
④ 法律与监管(legal/regulatory):如内幕交易限制、机构限制。
⑤ 独特情况(unique circumstances):ESG 偏好、集中持仓、遗产等。

易错对比

① 董事发布前受限交易本公司股 = 法律/监管约束;② 养老基金自定的房地产限制 = 独特/内部约束;③ 近期确定支出 → 流动性约束,用短期低风险工具覆盖。

The five constraints

① Liquidity: near-term cash needs → hold liquid assets (e.g., commercial paper for tuition).
② Time horizon: shapes risk capacity and asset choice.
③ Tax: taxable vs exempt, gains vs interest.
④ Legal/regulatory: e.g., insider-trading limits, institutional rules.
⑤ Unique circumstances: ESG preferences, concentrated holdings, legacies.

Common traps

① A director restricted from trading before an earnings release = legal/regulatory; ② a pension's self-imposed real-estate limit = unique/internal; ③ a near, certain outflow → the liquidity constraint, covered with short-term low-risk instruments.

8. 五大约束是(按记忆口诀):The five constraints are (by mnemonic): 官方题Official

  • A. 只有税收Only taxes
  • B. 只有流动性Only liquidity
  • C. 流动性、时间跨度、税收、法律与监管、特殊情况Liquidity, time horizon, taxes, legal and regulatory, unique circumstances
答案 C。五大约束缺一不可。Answer C. All five constraints are indispensable.

9. 流动性约束影响资产配置的方式是:How the liquidity constraint affects asset allocation: 官方题Official

  • A. 近期现金需求高则须配置更多流动性好、波动小的资产High near-term cash needs require allocating more to liquid, low-volatility assets
  • B. 配置更多高风险资产Allocate more to high-risk assets
  • C. 对配置没有影响No effect on allocation
答案 A。短期用款需求要求高流动性资产。Answer A. Near-term cash needs require highly liquid assets.

10. 时间跨度越长,通常如何配置:The longer the time horizon, how to usually allocate: 官方题Official

  • A. 越能承受短期波动,可配置更多权益等高风险高回报资产The more it can bear short-term volatility, allocating more to equities and other high-risk, high-return assets
  • B. 配置更多现金Allocate more to cash
  • C. 与配置无关Unrelated to allocation
答案 A。长期限提升风险承受能力。Answer A. A long horizon raises risk-bearing capacity.

11. 税收约束为什么重要:Why is the tax constraint important: 官方题Official

  • A. 只影响现金Affects only cash
  • B. 影响税后回报和资产/账户选择(如免税账户、税收递延)It affects after-tax returns and asset/account choices (e.g., tax-exempt accounts, tax deferral)
  • C. 与回报无关Unrelated to returns
答案 B。投资者关注的是税后回报。Answer B. Investors care about after-tax returns.

12. 下列属于法律与监管约束的是:Which is a legal and regulatory constraint: 官方题Official

  • A. ESG 个人偏好Personal ESG preferences
  • B. 遗产安排Estate planning
  • C. 信托责任、养老金监管规定、内部人持股限制等Fiduciary duty, pension regulations, insider-holding restrictions, etc.
答案 C。后两者属特殊情况约束。Answer C. The latter two are unique-circumstances constraints.

13. 下列属于特殊情况约束的是:Which is a unique-circumstances constraint: 官方题Official

  • A. ESG 偏好、禁投行业、集中持仓、遗产安排等个人特殊要求ESG preferences, prohibited industries, concentrated holdings, estate planning, and other personal special requirements
  • B. 税收Taxes
  • C. 流动性Liquidity
答案 A。特殊情况涵盖个性化的独特要求。Answer A. Unique circumstances cover personalized special requirements.

14. DB 养老金的流动性和时间跨度特征是:The liquidity and time-horizon features of a DB pension are: 补充Extra

  • A. 时间跨度长(除非临近到期负债多);流动性需求取决于当期给付,需匹配负债Long time horizon (unless liabilities near maturity are large); liquidity need depends on current payouts, requiring liability matching
  • B. 时间跨度总是很短Time horizon is always very short
  • C. 没有流动性需求No liquidity need
答案 A。DB 计划以负债匹配为核心。Answer A. A DB plan centers on liability matching.
1. 下列哪项最可能是投资政策声明中的法律与监管约束？1. Which of the following is most likely a legal and regulatory constraint in an investment policy statement? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 养老基金限制房地产投资的决定A pension fund's decision to limit investments in real estate
  • B. 应税投资者避免投资于产生利息收入证券的要求A taxable investor's requirement to avoid investments in securities generating interest income
  • C. 上市公司董事在财务业绩发布前不久受限交易本公司股票A public company director's restriction on trading the company's stock shortly before the publication of financial results
答案 C。上市公司董事在业绩发布前受限交易本公司股票 = 法律/监管约束(内幕交易法规)。养老基金自定限制、应税者避利息收入是"内部/独特"约束。Answer C. A director restricted from trading the company's stock before an earnings release = a legal/regulatory constraint (insider-trading rules). A pension's self-imposed limit or a taxable investor avoiding interest income are internal/unique constraints.
2. 某投资者时间跨度为15年，但需在一年后从组合中提取资金支付学费。下列哪项投资最适合覆盖因学费产生的流动性需求？2. An investor has a 15-year time horizon but needs to withdraw funds from her portfolio in one year's time to pay for tuition fees. Which of the following investments is most suitable to cover the investor's liquidity requirement due to the tuition fees? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 商业票据Commercial paper
  • B. 私募股权证券Private equity securities
  • C. 大盘股Large-capitalization stocks
答案 A。一年后要付学费的流动性需求 → 用商业票据(短期、低风险、流动性好)覆盖。私募股权(锁定)、大盘股(价格波动)都不适合近期确定支出。Answer A. A liquidity need for tuition in one year → cover it with commercial paper (short-term, low-risk, liquid). Private equity (locked up) and large-cap stocks (price volatility) are unsuitable for a near, certain outflow.

§5 战略资产配置§5 Strategic Asset Allocation

LOS 对应:LOS: describe the specification of asset classes and strategic asset allocation。

战略资产配置(SAA)把 IPS 的目标与约束转化为各资产类别的长期目标权重。资产类别应内部同质、彼此互斥、整体覆盖、相关性较低。SAA 是决定组合长期风险-收益的最主要因素。之后可用战术资产配置(TAA)做短期偏离,并定期再平衡回目标权重。Strategic asset allocation (SAA) translates the IPS's objectives and constraints into long-term target weights for each asset class. Asset classes should be internally homogeneous, mutually exclusive, collectively exhaustive, and relatively low-correlated. SAA is the single most important factor determining a portfolio's long-term risk-return. Afterward, tactical asset allocation (TAA) can make short-term deviations, with periodic rebalancing back to target weights.

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

战略(SAA) vs 战术(TAA) vs 漂移

• SAA(战略资产配置):长期政策权重,写进 IPS,由各类别预期回报、风险及相关性共同决定。
• TAA(战术资产配置):基于短期预测主动偏离政策权重(超/低配某类)博超额。
• 漂移(drift):权重随市值变化被动偏离政策 → 需再平衡拉回。

机制

加入与现有资产低相关的类别可改善风险-回报权衡;定义资产类别时,类别内相关性高、类别间相关性低最理想。风险厌恶变化只移动无差异曲线、不动有效前沿。

易错对比

① IPS 只写 SAA;② TAA = 短期主动偏离(不是选个券,那是证券选择);③ 漂移 ≠ TAA(一个被动一个主动)。

Strategic (SAA) vs tactical (TAA) vs drift

• SAA: long-term policy weights in the IPS, set by each class's expected return, risk, and correlations.
• TAA: a short-term active deviation from policy weights (over/underweighting a class) for excess return.
• Drift: weights straying from policy passively as market values change → needs rebalancing.

Mechanism

Adding a class with low correlation to existing holdings improves the risk-return trade-off; when defining classes, high within-class and low across-class correlation is ideal. A change in risk aversion shifts only the indifference curves, not the efficient frontier.

Common traps

① The IPS specifies only SAA; ② TAA = a short-term active deviation (not picking a security, which is security selection); ③ drift ≠ TAA (passive vs active).

15. 战略资产配置(SAA)是什么:What is strategic asset allocation (SAA): 官方题Official

  • A. 个股选择Individual stock selection
  • B. 把 IPS 的目标与约束转化为各资产类别的长期目标权重Translating the IPS's objectives and constraints into long-term target weights for each asset class
  • C. 短期择时操作Short-term timing
答案 B。SAA 是长期目标权重。Answer B. SAA is the long-term target weights.

16. 好的资产类别应满足哪些标准:What criteria should a good asset class meet: 官方题Official

  • A. 类别间高度相关Highly correlated across classes
  • B. 类别相互重叠Overlapping classes
  • C. 内部同质、彼此互斥、整体覆盖投资域、类别间相关性较低Internally homogeneous, mutually exclusive, collectively cover the investable universe, and low correlation across classes
答案 C。同质、互斥、完备、低相关四标准。Answer C. Homogeneous, exclusive, complete, and low-correlation, four criteria.

17. SAA 在决定组合长期表现中的地位是:The status of SAA in determining a portfolio's long-term performance is: 官方题Official

  • A. 是决定组合长期风险-收益的最主要因素It is the most important factor in a portfolio's long-term risk-return
  • B. 只是次要因素Only a minor factor
  • C. 与长期表现无关Unrelated to long-term performance
答案 A。资产配置解释了绝大部分长期回报差异。Answer A. Asset allocation explains the vast majority of long-term return differences.

18. 战术资产配置(TAA)与再平衡的区别是:The difference between tactical asset allocation (TAA) and rebalancing is: 官方题Official

  • A. 两者完全相同They are identical
  • B. TAA 基于短期观点主动偏离目标权重;再平衡把权重调回 SAA 目标TAA actively deviates from target weights based on short-term views; rebalancing brings weights back to the SAA target
  • C. 两者定义相反The definitions are reversed
答案 B。TAA 主动偏离,再平衡回归目标。Answer B. TAA deviates actively, rebalancing returns to target.
1. 关于资产配置的下列表述哪项最准确？1. Which of the following statements about asset allocation is most accurate? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 投资者应在资产类别间分散财富以消除系统性风险。Investors should diversify their wealth between asset classes in order to eliminate systematic risk.
  • B. 风险承受能力低于平均的投资者应在另类投资上配置高于平均的权重。Investors with a below-average risk tolerance should have an above-average weight in alternative investments.
  • C. 加入与现有资产类别低相关的资产类别可改善投资者的风险-回报权衡。Adding asset classes with a low correlation to existing asset classes improves an investor's risk–return trade-off.
答案 C。加入与现有资产"低相关"的资产类别可改善风险-回报权衡(分散化)。分散化消不掉系统性风险(A错);低风险者不该超配另类(B错)。Answer C. Adding an asset class with low correlation to existing holdings improves the risk-return trade-off (diversification). Diversification cannot eliminate systematic risk (A wrong); a low-tolerance investor should not overweight alternatives (B wrong).
2. 组合战略资产配置的风险-回报特征最可能由各资产类别的预期回报和风险以及下列何者决定：2. The risk–return profile of a portfolio's strategic asset allocation is most likely determined by the expected returns and risks of the individual asset classes and the: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 这些资产类别之间的相关性。correlations between those asset classes.
  • B. 对各资产类别使用证券选择。use of security selection for each of those asset classes.
  • C. 组合权重相对这些资产类别政策权重的允许偏离。allowable deviation of portfolio weights from policy weights for those asset classes.
答案 A。战略资产配置的风险-回报特征由各资产类别的预期回报、风险,以及它们之间的相关性共同决定。证券选择、允许偏离属执行层面。Answer A. A strategic asset allocation's risk-return profile is determined by each class's expected return and risk, plus the correlations among them. Security selection and allowed deviations are execution-level.
3. 为战略资产配置定义资产类别时，资产类别回报之间下列哪个成对相关系数最可取？3. When defining asset classes for a strategic asset allocation, which of the following pairwise correlations between asset class returns is most preferable? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 0.00.0
  • B. 0.50.5
  • C. 1.01.0
答案 A。定义资产类别时,"不同类别之间"的相关性越低越好(0.0 最可取) → 分散化最强。Answer A. When defining asset classes, the lower the correlation between classes the better (0.0 is most desirable) → maximum diversification.
4. 定义资产类别时，同一资产类别内资产的成对相关性应当：4. When defining asset classes, the paired correlations of assets within an asset class should be: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 为负。negative.
  • B. 为零。zero.
  • C. 为正。positive.
答案 C。定义资产类别时,"同一类别内部"资产的成对相关性应为正(高)——类别内要同质,类别间要异质。Answer C. When defining asset classes, the pairwise correlation among assets within a class should be positive (high) — homogeneous within, heterogeneous across.
5. 若组合中各资产类别的权重随时间因市值变化而偏离政策权重，这最好地描述为：5. If the weights of the asset classes in a portfolio deviate from the policy weights over time due to changes in market value, this is best described as: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 漂移(drift)。drift.
  • B. 风险价值(VaR)。value at risk.
  • C. 跟踪误差。tracking error.
答案 A。各类别权重随市值变化偏离政策权重 = 漂移(drift)。VaR 是损失度量;跟踪误差是相对基准的偏差波动。Answer A. Class weights drifting from policy weights as market values change = drift. VaR is a loss measure; tracking error is the volatility of deviations from a benchmark.
6. 下列哪种行为最好地描述战术资产配置(tactical asset allocation)？6. Which of the following actions best describes tactical asset allocation? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 为满足长期目标而提供对不同资产类别的敞口。Providing exposure to different asset classes to meet long-term objectives.
  • B. 相对该资产类别的政策权重低配某资产类别。Underweighting an asset class relative to the policy weight for that asset class.
  • C. 超配预期回报高于基准的特定证券。Overweighting specific securities with higher expected returns than the benchmark.
答案 B。战术资产配置(TAA)= 相对政策权重"低配/超配某资产类别"(短期主动偏离博超额)。长期敞口是战略;超配个券是证券选择。Answer B. Tactical asset allocation (TAA) = under/overweighting an asset class relative to policy weights (a short-term active deviation for excess return). Long-term exposure is strategic; overweighting a single security is security selection.
7. 投资者风险厌恶程度的变化最可能导致投资者的下列何者发生变化：7. A change in an investor's risk aversion most likely results in a change in the investor's: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅有效前沿。efficient frontier only.
  • B. 仅无差异曲线。indifference curves only.
  • C. 有效前沿与无差异曲线两者。efficient frontier and indifference curves.
答案 B。风险厌恶程度变化只改变投资者的"无差异曲线"(偏好),不改变由资产决定的有效前沿。故仅无差异曲线变。Answer B. A change in risk aversion only shifts the investor's indifference curves (preferences), not the efficient frontier (determined by the assets). So only the indifference curves change.
8. 组合经理暂时在权益上投资多于政策权重规定的决定，最好地描述为：8. A portfolio manager's decision to temporarily invest more in equities than the policy weights prescribe is best described as: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 证券选择。security selection.
  • B. 战术资产配置。tactical asset allocation.
  • C. 战略资产配置。strategic asset allocation.
答案 B。暂时在权益上多投于政策权重 = 战术资产配置(TAA)(短期主动偏离)。战略是长期政策权重;证券选择是选个券。Answer B. Temporarily investing more in equities than the policy weight = tactical asset allocation (TAA) (a short-term active deviation). Strategic is the long-term policy weight; security selection picks individual securities.
9. 就组合构建而言，基于对资产类别近期回报的预测、刻意偏离对系统性风险因素的政策敞口以增值的决定，最好地描述为：9. With respect to portfolio construction, the decision to deliberately deviate from the policy exposures to systematic risk factors with the intent to add value based on forecasts of near-term returns of asset classes best describes: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 风险预算。risk budgeting.
  • B. 证券选择。security selection.
  • C. 战术资产配置。tactical asset allocation.
答案 C。基于近期回报预测、刻意偏离对系统性因素的政策敞口以增值 = 战术资产配置(TAA)。风险预算是分配风险额度;证券选择是选个券。Answer C. Deliberately deviating from policy factor exposures based on near-term forecasts to add value = tactical asset allocation (TAA). Risk budgeting allocates risk; security selection picks individual securities.
10. 投资政策声明(IPS)最可能规定：10. An IPS most likely specifies: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅战术资产配置目标。only the tactical asset allocation target.
  • B. 仅战略资产配置目标。only the strategic asset allocation target.
  • C. 战术与战略资产配置目标两者。both the tactical and the strategic asset allocation targets.
答案 B。IPS 只规定"战略资产配置(SAA)"目标(长期政策)。战术偏离是执行中的主动决策,不写进 IPS 的政策目标。Answer B. An IPS specifies only the strategic asset allocation (SAA) targets (long-term policy). Tactical deviations are active execution decisions, not part of the IPS policy targets.

§6 风险管理框架§6 The Risk-Management Framework

LOS 对应:LOS: describe the risk management process, risk tolerance, and risk budgeting。

风险管理不是消灭风险,而是主动选择承担哪些、承担多少风险以匹配目标。要素:
① 风险治理(高层设定风险政策、明确风险偏好);
② 风险承受度(risk tolerance)——组织愿意并能够承担的风险总量;
③ 风险识别与计量(市场、信用、流动性、操作等);
④ 风险预算(risk budgeting)——把总风险容量分配到各资产/策略上。Risk management is not about eliminating risk but actively choosing which risks and how much to take to match objectives. Elements:
① risk governance (senior management sets risk policy and defines risk appetite);
② risk tolerance — the total risk the organization is willing and able to bear;
③ risk identification and measurement (market, credit, liquidity, operational, etc.);
④ risk budgeting — allocating total risk capacity across assets/strategies.

考点·风险分类与极端损失度量:
• 财务风险(financial):市场、信用、流动性(源于金融市场/交易对手)。
• 非财务风险(non-financial):运营、会计、税务、监管、合规、法律等。
• 估计债券的「平均极端损失」最合适用违约损失(expected loss given default)(违约时的平均损失);VaR 给的是分位阈值,标准差是离散度。Exam - risk classification & tail-loss measures:
- Financial risk: market, credit, liquidity (from financial markets/counterparties).
- Non-financial risk: operational, accounting, tax, regulatory, compliance, legal.
- To estimate a bond’s average extreme loss, use expected loss given default (the average loss when default occurs); VaR gives a quantile threshold and standard deviation measures dispersion.
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

风险管理框架

风险管理 = 承担「可容忍」的风险水平以最大化价值(不是最小化风险,也不是预测风险)。风险治理应自上而下(企业整体);风险预算(risk budgeting)把有限风险额度分配到最优处、促成风险权衡。

风险分类

• 财务风险:市场、信用、流动性(源于金融市场/交易对手)。
• 非财务风险:运营、会计、税务、监管、合规、法律。

VaR 与极端损失

5% 一天 VaR = £500 万 意味着「平均每 1/0.05 = 20 个交易日」损失至少 £500 万。估计债券「平均极端损失」用违约损失(loss given default);VaR 给分位阈值、标准差是离散度。

The risk-management framework

Risk management = taking a "tolerable" level of risk to maximize value (not minimizing risk, nor predicting it). Risk governance should be top-down (enterprise-wide); risk budgeting allocates a limited risk budget to the best uses and forces risk trade-offs.

Risk classification

• Financial: market, credit, liquidity (from markets/counterparties).
• Non-financial: operational, accounting, tax, regulatory, compliance, legal.

VaR & tail loss

A 5% one-day VaR of £5m means a loss of at least £5m is expected about once every 1/0.05 = 20 trading days. For a bond's average extreme loss use loss given default; VaR gives a quantile threshold and standard deviation measures dispersion.

19. 风险管理的本质是:The essence of risk management is: 官方题Official

  • A. 消灭一切风险Eliminate all risk
  • B. 完全忽略风险Ignore risk entirely
  • C. 不是消灭风险,而是主动选择承担哪些、承担多少风险以匹配目标Not to eliminate risk, but to actively choose which risks and how much to take to match objectives
答案 C。风险管理是主动的取舍。Answer C. Risk management is an active trade-off.

20. 风险治理的作用是:The role of risk governance is: 官方题Official

  • A. 由高层设定风险政策、明确整体风险偏好,自上而下统筹Senior leadership sets risk policy and defines overall risk appetite, coordinating top-down
  • B. 由基层各自决定Each front-line unit decides on its own
  • C. 无需任何治理No governance needed
答案 A。风险治理提供顶层框架。Answer A. Risk governance provides the top-level framework.

21. 风险承受度(risk tolerance)指什么:What does risk tolerance refer to: 官方题Official

  • A. 完全不承担风险Bearing no risk at all
  • B. 组织愿意并能够承担的风险总量The total amount of risk an organization is willing and able to bear
  • C. 单一资产的风险The risk of a single asset
答案 B。风险承受度是可承担的总风险量。Answer B. Risk tolerance is the total bearable risk amount.

22. 风险预算(risk budgeting)做什么:What does risk budgeting do: 官方题Official

  • A. 只分配资金Only allocate capital
  • B. 消灭全部风险Eliminate all risk
  • C. 把总风险容量分配到各资产类别/策略上Allocate the total risk capacity across asset classes/strategies
答案 C。风险预算是风险的分配机制。Answer C. Risk budgeting is the mechanism for allocating risk.
1. 风险管理过程最好地描述为在下列何种情况下使公司价值最大化的一系列决策：1. The process of risk management is best described as the set of decisions that maximizes a company's value while: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 使所承担风险最小化。minimizing the risk taken.
  • B. 承担可容忍的风险水平。bearing a tolerable level of risk.
  • C. 正确预测潜在风险。predicting the potential risk correctly.
答案 B。风险管理 = 承担"可容忍的风险水平"以最大化公司价值(不是最小化风险,也不是预测风险)。适度而非零风险。Answer B. Risk management = taking a tolerable level of risk to maximize firm value (not minimizing risk, nor predicting it). The right amount, not zero.
2. 下列哪项与有效的风险治理最不一致？2. Which of the following is least consistent with effective risk governance? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 采取企业整体视角Taking an enterprise-wide view
  • B. 界定企业的风险承受能力Defining the enterprise's risk tolerance
  • C. 采取自下而上的过程来指导风险管理活动Following a bottom-up process to direct risk management activities
答案 C。有效风险治理应采取企业整体(自上而下)视角;"自下而上"与有效风险治理最不一致。界定风险承受能力、整体视角都是良好治理。Answer C. Effective risk governance takes an enterprise-wide (top-down) view; a "bottom-up" process is least consistent with it. Defining risk tolerance and an enterprise view are good governance.
3. 风险预算(risk budgeting)的一个好处是它：3. A benefit of risk budgeting is that it: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 促使进行风险权衡。forces risk trade-offs.
  • B. 提供风险监督。provides risk oversight.
  • C. 界定组织的风险承受能力。defines an organization's risk tolerance.
答案 A。风险预算(risk budgeting)的好处 = 促使进行"风险权衡"(把有限风险额度分配到最优处)。风险监督、界定风险承受能力是其他环节。Answer A. A benefit of risk budgeting = it forces risk trade-offs (allocating a limited risk budget to the best uses). Risk oversight and defining risk tolerance are other functions.
4. 下列哪项最好地归类为非财务风险？4. Which of the following is best classified as a non-financial risk? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 信用风险Credit risk
  • B. 流动性风险Liquidity risk
  • C. 会计风险Accounting risk
答案 C。会计风险属"非财务风险"(运营/合规类)。信用、流动性风险是财务风险(源于金融市场/交易对手)。Answer C. Accounting risk is a non-financial risk (operational/compliance). Credit and liquidity risks are financial risks (from markets/counterparties).
5. 下列哪项最好地归类为财务风险？5. Which of the following is best classified as a financial risk? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 税务风险Tax risk
  • B. 信用风险Credit risk
  • C. 会计风险Accounting risk
答案 B。信用风险属"财务风险"(对手方违约,源于金融市场)。税务、会计风险是非财务风险。Answer B. Credit risk is a financial risk (counterparty default, from financial markets). Tax and accounting risks are non-financial.
6. 下列哪种指标最适合估计债券的平均极端损失？6. Which of the following metrics is most appropriate to estimate a bond's average extreme loss? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 损失的VaRVaR of loss
  • B. 损失的标准差Standard deviation of loss
  • C. 违约损失(expected loss given default)Expected loss given default
答案 C。估计债券"平均极端损失"最合适用违约损失(expected loss given default)(违约时的平均损失)。VaR 给的是分位数阈值;标准差是离散度。Answer C. To estimate a bond's average extreme loss, use expected loss given default (the average loss when default occurs). VaR gives a quantile threshold; standard deviation is dispersion.
7. 某银行确定其风险价值(VaR)为一天5%概率下 £500万。该银行预期每隔多久会发生一次至少 £500万的损失：7. A bank determines that its value at risk (VaR) is £5 million at 5% for one day. The bank is expecting a minimum loss of £5 million once every: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 5个交易日。5 business days.
  • B. 13个交易日。13 business days.
  • C. 20个交易日。20 business days.
答案 C。5% 一天 VaR = £500万 意味着"平均每 20 个交易日(1/0.05)有一天"损失至少 £500万。故约每 20 日一次。Answer C. A 5% one-day VaR of £5m means a loss of at least £5m is expected about once every 20 trading days (1/0.05). Hence roughly every 20 days.
8. 良好的风险管理过程应当：8. A good risk management process should: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 预测危机何时发生。predict when a crisis will occur.
  • B. 权衡预期回报与损失之间的平衡。consider the balance between expected returns and losses.
  • C. 仅考虑高概率事件造成的损失。only consider losses occurring from events that have a high likelihood.
答案 B。良好风险管理应权衡"预期回报与潜在损失"(在收益与风险间取舍)。它不能预测危机时点,也不能只看高概率事件,故 A、C 错。Answer B. Good risk management weighs expected return against potential loss (trading off reward and risk). It cannot predict when crises occur, nor consider only high-probability events, so A and C are wrong.
9. 在风险管理中，确定企业风险承受能力时应考虑下列哪项？9. In risk management, which of the following should be taken into account when determining an enterprise's risk tolerance? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 管理层薪酬Management compensation
  • B. 企业的风险价值(VaR)The enterprise's value at risk (VaR)
  • C. 政府与监管环境The government and regulatory landscape
答案 C。确定企业风险承受能力应考虑政府与监管环境(以及财务状况、战略等外部约束)。VaR 是度量结果、管理层薪酬非承受能力决定因素。Answer C. Setting enterprise risk tolerance should consider the government and regulatory environment (plus financial condition, strategy). VaR is a measured output; management pay is not a determinant of tolerance.

§5 ESG 融入组合规划与构建§5 Integrating ESG into Portfolio Planning & Construction

ESG 可以通过多种方式融入，而不是简单地“买绿色公司”：ESG can be integrated in various ways, not simply "buying green companies":

  • Negative Screening：排除不符合价值观或政策的行业。Negative Screening: exclude industries inconsistent with values or policy.
  • Positive/Best-in-Class：在行业中偏好 ESG 表现较好的公司。Positive/Best-in-Class: prefer companies with better ESG performance within an industry.
  • ESG Integration：把重要 ESG 风险和机会纳入现金流、折现率和风险评估。ESG Integration: incorporate material ESG risks and opportunities into cash flows, discount rates, and risk assessment.
  • Thematic/Impact：投资特定可持续主题或追求可衡量社会环境结果。Thematic/Impact: invest in specific sustainability themes or pursue measurable social/environmental outcomes.
  • Active Ownership：通过投票和参与治理推动改变。Active Ownership: drive change through voting and governance engagement.

ESG 约束必须写入 IPS，并考虑其对可投资范围、跟踪误差、流动性、成本和受托责任的影响。ESG constraints must be written into the IPS, considering their impact on the investable universe, tracking error, liquidity, cost, and fiduciary duty.

§6 风险敞口的计量与修改§6 Measuring & Modifying Risk Exposures

方法Method说明Description适用考虑Applicability considerations
标准差/下行风险Standard deviation/downside risk衡量总体波动或不利结果Measures overall volatility or adverse outcomes分布稳定性和尾部风险Distribution stability and tail risk
Beta/Duration衡量市场或利率因子敏感度Measures market or interest-rate factor sensitivity模型和基准是否适当Whether the model and benchmark are appropriate
Scenario/Stress Test评估极端但合理情景Assess extreme but plausible scenarios情景覆盖和相关性变化Scenario coverage and correlation changes
避免/降低Avoid/reduce不承担风险或减少头寸Take no risk or reduce the position可能同时放弃收益May forgo return at the same time
转移Transfer保险、衍生品或合同转给其他方Insurance, derivatives, or contracts pass it to another party成本、基差和对手方风险Cost, basis, and counterparty risk
接受Accept保留风险并配置资本缓冲Retain the risk and allocate a capital buffer风险必须在承受度和预算内Risk must be within tolerance and budget

选择方法时考虑风险规模、流动性、成本、基差风险、对手方风险、会计税务影响和治理能力。When choosing a method, consider risk size, liquidity, cost, basis risk, counterparty risk, accounting/tax impact, and governance capacity.

考点·期权希腊字母(the Greeks)—— 风险敞口度量:
• Delta(δ):期权价值对"标的价格"变化的敏感度(一阶)。
• Gamma(γ):Delta 本身对标的价格变化的敏感度(二阶,即 delta 的变化率)。
• Vega:对"波动率"变化的敏感度。
• Rho:对"无风险利率"变化的敏感度。
• Theta:对"时间流逝"的敏感度(时间价值衰减)。
用这些指标可计量并"修改"组合的风险敞口(如 delta 对冲)。Exam - option Greeks - measuring risk exposure:
- Delta (delta): sensitivity of option value to the underlying price (first-order).
- Gamma (gamma): sensitivity of delta itself to the underlying price (second-order - the rate of change of delta).
- Vega: sensitivity to a change in volatility.
- Rho: sensitivity to a change in the risk-free rate.
- Theta: sensitivity to the passage of time (time-value decay).
These are used to measure and "modify" a portfolio's risk exposures (e.g., delta hedging).

3. 用期货降低股票 beta 属于哪类风险处理:Using futures to lower a stock's beta is which type of risk handling:

  • A. 消除信用风险Eliminating credit risk
  • B. 与风险处理无关Unrelated to risk handling
  • C. 通过衍生品修改或转移市场风险敞口Modifying or transferring market-risk exposure via derivatives
答案 C。用衍生品调整市场(系统性)风险敞口。Answer C. Using derivatives to adjust market (systematic) risk exposure.
1. 衡量衍生品delta对标的价值变化敏感性的风险管理指标，最好地描述为：1. The risk management measure that captures the sensitivity of a derivative's delta to a change in the value of the underlying best describes: 真题模考Mock
  • A. rho。rho.
  • B. vega。vega.
  • C. gamma。gamma.
答案 C。衡量"delta 对标的变化的敏感性"= gamma(伽马)——delta 的变化率(二阶)。rho 对利率敏感;vega 对波动率敏感。Answer C. Measuring how delta changes with the underlying = gamma — the rate of change of delta (second-order). Rho is sensitivity to rates; vega to volatility.

§1 行为偏差:两大类§1 Behavioral Biases: The Two Categories 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: distinguish between cognitive errors and emotional biases。
🔰 零基础讲解:脑子错了 vs 心态坏了

两类偏差🧠 认知错误是"信息处理/推理"出问题,像算错题——可以通过教育、数据、提醒来纠正。情绪偏差源于感受和冲动(恐惧、后悔、贪婪)——很难靠讲道理纠正,通常只能通过设计流程来"适应"。所以:认知错误易矫正,情绪偏差多适应。:认知错误可矫正,情绪偏差多只能适应。Two types of bias🧠 Cognitive errors are problems in "processing information/reasoning," like miscalculating a problem — correctable through education, data, and reminders. Emotional biases stem from feelings and impulses (fear, regret, greed) — hard to correct by reasoning, usually only "adapted to" by designing processes. So: cognitive errors are easily corrected, emotional biases mostly adapted to.: cognitive errors can be corrected, emotional biases mostly only adapted to.

类别Category来源Source应对Response
认知错误 cognitiveCognitive errors信息处理/记忆/推理失误Faults in information processing/memory/reasoning可通过教育、信息、纪律矫正Can be corrected through education, information, and discipline
情绪偏差 emotionalEmotional biases感受、冲动(恐惧、后悔、过度自信)Feelings, impulses (fear, regret, overconfidence)难矫正,多只能适应Hard to correct, mostly only adapted to
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

两大类偏差:认知 vs 情绪

• 认知错误(cognitive errors):源于推理/信息处理出错——可通过更好的信息、教育、纪律纠正/减轻。
• 情绪偏差(emotional biases):源于感觉/冲动——较难纠正,往往只能适应(accommodate)。

机制

认知错误又分「信念固守」(保守性、确认、代表性、控制错觉、后见之明)与「信息处理」(锚定、心理账户、框架、可得性);情绪偏差含损失厌恶、过度自信、自控、现状、禀赋、后悔厌恶。

易错对比

① 情绪偏差比认知更难纠正;② 情绪偏差非有意产生、非由错误推理引起(那是认知);③ 顾问对认知错误多「纠正」、对情绪偏差多「适应」。

Two families: cognitive vs emotional

• Cognitive errors: from faulty reasoning/information processing — can be corrected/mitigated with better information, education, discipline.
• Emotional biases: from feelings/impulses — harder to correct, often only accommodated.

Mechanism

Cognitive errors split into "belief perseverance" (conservatism, confirmation, representativeness, illusion of control, hindsight) and "information processing" (anchoring, mental accounting, framing, availability); emotional biases include loss aversion, overconfidence, self-control, status quo, endowment, regret aversion.

Common traps

① Emotional biases are harder to correct than cognitive; ② emotional biases aren't consciously produced or caused by faulty reasoning (that is cognitive); ③ advisers tend to "correct" cognitive errors and "accommodate" emotional biases.

1. 认知错误与情绪偏差的根本区别是:The fundamental difference between cognitive errors and emotional biases is: 官方题Official

  • A. 认知错误源于信息处理/推理失误(可矫正);情绪偏差源于感受冲动(多只能适应)Cognitive errors stem from faulty information processing/reasoning (correctable); emotional biases stem from feelings/impulses (often can only be adapted to)
  • B. 两者定义相反The definitions are reversed
  • C. 两者完全相同They are identical
答案 A。认知可纠正,情绪多只能适应。Answer A. Cognitive can be corrected, emotional can mostly only be adapted to.

2. 哪类偏差更容易通过教育纠正:Which type of bias is more easily corrected through education: 官方题Official

  • A. 两者都不可纠正Neither can be corrected
  • B. 认知错误Cognitive errors
  • C. 情绪偏差Emotional biases
答案 B。认知错误可通过信息与训练矫正。Answer B. Cognitive errors can be corrected with information and training.

3. 保守性偏差为什么可能形成价格动量:Why can conservatism bias create price momentum: 补充Extra

  • A. 价格立即完全调整到位Prices adjust fully immediately
  • B. 与价格动量无关Unrelated to price momentum
  • C. 投资者对新信息更新不足,价格未一次性调整到位,后续持续修正表现为动量或公告后漂移Investors underweight new information, so prices do not adjust fully at once; the subsequent gradual correction shows up as momentum or post-announcement drift
答案 C。更新不足导致价格分批修正,形成动量。Answer C. Under-updating causes prices to correct in stages, forming momentum.
1. 关于情绪偏差的下列表述哪项最准确？1. Which of the following statements about emotional biases is most accurate? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 它们通过有意识的努力产生。They arise through conscious effort.
  • B. 它们由错误的认知推理引起。They are caused by faulty cognitive reasoning.
  • C. 它们比认知偏差更难纠正。They are more difficult to correct than cognitive biases.
答案 C。情绪偏差(emotional biases)源于感觉/冲动,比认知偏差更难纠正(只能适应)。它非有意产生,也非由错误推理引起(那是认知偏差),故 A、B 错。Answer C. Emotional biases stem from feelings/impulses and are harder to correct than cognitive biases (often only accommodated). They are not consciously produced or caused by faulty reasoning (that is cognitive), so A and B are wrong.

§2 常见认知错误§2 Common Cognitive Errors

LOS 对应:LOS: describe cognitive errors。
偏差Bias含义Meaning
保守性 conservatismConservatism抱住旧观点、更新太慢Clinging to old views, updating too slowly
确认偏差 confirmationConfirmation只找支持自己观点的信息Seeking only information that supports one's view
代表性 representativenessRepresentativeness凭刻板印象/小样本下结论Drawing conclusions from stereotypes/small samples
锚定 anchoringAnchoring过度依赖初始值Over-relying on an initial value
心理账户 mental accountingMental accounting把钱按来源用途分格、区别对待Bucketing money by source/use and treating it differently
框架效应 framingFraming问题表述方式改变决策The way a question is phrased changes the decision
可得性 availabilityAvailability凭容易想起的信息判断概率Judging probability by easily recalled information
🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

常见认知错误(逐个辨认)

• 保守性(conservatism):对新信息反应迟缓、固守旧观点 → 助长「反应不足」。
• 确认偏差(confirmation):只找支持已有观点的证据。
• 代表性(representativeness):以偏概全、忽略基率(base-rate neglect)。
• 锚定(anchoring):过度依赖初始参考值。
• 可得性(availability):凭易得/近期显著信息判断 → 助长动量效应。
• 控制错觉(illusion of control):以为能左右结果 → 集中持仓、过度交易。

易错对比

① 反应迟缓固守 = 保守性;② 追逐近期显著信息 = 可得性 → 动量;③ 以为能控制 = 控制错觉 → 集中/过度交易。

Common cognitive errors (identify each)

• Conservatism: underreacting to new information, clinging to prior views → fuels underreaction.
• Confirmation: seeking only evidence that supports a held view.
• Representativeness: over-generalizing, ignoring base rates (base-rate neglect).
• Anchoring: over-relying on an initial reference.
• Availability: judging by easily-recalled/recent salient information → fuels the momentum effect.
• Illusion of control: believing one can influence outcomes → concentrated positions, overtrading.

Common traps

① Underreacting/clinging = conservatism; ② chasing recent salient info = availability → momentum; ③ believing you control outcomes = illusion of control → concentration/overtrading.

4. 确认偏差是什么:What is confirmation bias: 官方题Official

  • A. 只搜寻和重视支持自己既有观点的信息,忽视反面证据Seeking and weighting only information that supports one's existing view, ignoring contrary evidence
  • B. 客观全面地权衡证据Objectively weighing all evidence
  • C. 只关注反面证据Focusing only on contrary evidence
答案 A。确认偏差偏爱印证既有看法。Answer A. Confirmation bias favors validating one's existing view.

5. 锚定偏差是什么:What is anchoring bias: 官方题Official

  • A. 随机做判断Judging randomly
  • B. 过度依赖某个初始参考值(如买入价)来做后续判断Over-relying on an initial reference value (e.g., purchase price) for subsequent judgments
  • C. 完全忽略参考值Completely ignoring reference values
答案 B。锚定使判断被初始值牵制。Answer B. Anchoring lets judgments be tethered to the initial value.

6. 代表性偏差是什么:What is representativeness bias: 官方题Official

  • A. 用大样本严谨推断Rigorous inference from large samples
  • B. 从不下结论Never drawing conclusions
  • C. 凭刻板印象或小样本快速下结论Jumping to conclusions based on stereotypes or small samples
答案 C。以偏概全是代表性偏差。Answer C. Overgeneralizing is representativeness bias.

7. 心理账户属于哪类偏差、含义是:Which category is mental accounting, and its meaning: 官方题Official

  • A. 认知错误;把资金按来源/用途分格、区别对待,忽视整体最优A cognitive error; compartmentalizing money by source/use and treating it differently, ignoring the overall optimum
  • B. 情绪偏差;总能实现整体最优An emotional bias; always achieving the overall optimum
  • C. 不属于任何偏差Not a bias
答案 A。心理账户割裂了资金的整体配置。Answer A. Mental accounting fragments the overall allocation of money.
1. 下列哪项最可能是过度自信偏差的后果？投资者：1. Which of the following is most likely a consequence of overconfidence bias? Investors: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 持有分散化不足的组合。holding poorly diversified portfolios.
  • B. 继续持有其熟悉的资产类别。continuing to hold classes of assets with which they are familiar.
  • C. 将处于亏损状态的投资持有过久，寄望其回到盈亏平衡。holding investments in a loss position longer than justified, in the hope that they will return to breakeven.
答案 A。过度自信(overconfidence)→ 高估自身选股能力 → 持有"分散化不足"的组合。持有熟悉资产是禀赋/现状偏差;死扛亏损是处置效应,故 B、C 错。Answer A. Overconfidence → overrating one's stock-picking → holding an under-diversified portfolio. Holding familiar assets is endowment/status-quo; holding losers too long is the disposition effect, so B and C are wrong.
2. 在预测公司盈利增长率时，下列哪项最能用过度自信来解释？2. Which of the following can best be explained by overconfidence when predicting companies' earnings growth rates? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 基率忽视Base-rate neglect
  • B. 价值异象The value anomaly
  • C. 处置效应The disposition effect
答案 B。用过度自信解释的现象是价值异象(投资者对成长股过度自信、高估,导致其后跑输,价值股跑赢)。基率忽视、处置效应是别的偏差表现。Answer B. Overconfidence helps explain the value anomaly (investors are overconfident about growth stocks, overpricing them so they later underperform while value outperforms). Base-rate neglect and the disposition effect are other biases.
3. 下列哪种偏差最可能助长金融市场中的动量效应？3. Which of the following biases most likely contributes to the momentum effect in financial markets? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 可得性偏差Availability
  • B. 现状偏差Status quo
  • C. 预测过度自信Prediction overconfidence
答案 A。可得性偏差(availability bias)→ 追逐近期显著/易得的信息 → 助长动量效应。现状偏差趋于不动;预测过度自信是另一类。Answer A. Availability bias → chasing recent salient/easily-recalled information → fuels the momentum effect. Status-quo bias resists change; forecasting overconfidence is a different bias.
4. 下列哪项最可能是控制错觉(illusion of control)偏差的后果？4. Which of the following is most likely a consequence of the illusion of control bias? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 投资者组合换手率过低。An investor's portfolio turnover is too low.
  • B. 投资者组合含有对公司的集中持仓。The investor's portfolio contains concentrated positions in companies.
  • C. 投资者使用简单的预测模型构建组合。An investor uses a simple forecasting model for portfolio construction.
答案 B。控制错觉(illusion of control)→ 以为能影响结果 → 组合含"对某公司的集中持仓"(过度交易/集中)。它导致换手率过高、用复杂模型,故 A、C 反。Answer B. Illusion of control → believing one can influence outcomes → concentrated positions in a company. It leads to excessive (not low) turnover and complex models, so A and C are reversed.

§3 常见情绪偏差§3 Common Emotional Biases

LOS 对应:LOS: describe emotional biases。
偏差Bias含义Meaning
损失厌恶 loss aversionLoss aversion亏损痛感 > 同额盈利快感;死扛亏损Pain of loss > pleasure of an equal gain; clinging to losses
过度自信 overconfidenceOverconfidence高估自身能力/判断,过度交易Overestimating one's ability/judgment, trading excessively

3.1 行为偏差如何形成市场特征 🔥 官方 LOS

LOS 对应:LOS: describe how behavioral biases of investors can lead to market characteristics that may not be explained by traditional finance。
行为机制Behavioral mechanism投资者行为Investor behavior可能形成的市场特征Possible market feature formed
羊群行为与后悔厌恶Herding and regret aversion因为别人都在买而跟随，避免与群体不同造成后悔Following because everyone else is buying, avoiding the regret of differing from the crowd价格脱离基本面的泡沫、拥挤交易，以及情绪逆转后的快速崩盘Bubbles where prices detach from fundamentals, crowded trades, and rapid crashes after sentiment reverses
过度自信与自我归因Overconfidence and self-attribution高估信息和选股能力，成功归因自己、失败归因外部Overestimating one's information and stock-picking skill, attributing success to self and failure to external factors过度交易、成交量异常高、组合分散不足Excessive trading, abnormally high volume, insufficient portfolio diversification
保守性与确认偏差Conservatism and confirmation bias对新信息反应不足，只接受支持原观点的证据Underreacting to new information, accepting only evidence supporting the prior view价格对盈利信息调整缓慢，形成短中期动量或公告后漂移Prices adjust slowly to earnings information, forming short-to-medium-term momentum or post-announcement drift
代表性与可得性Representativeness and availability把近期好表现外推太远，过度重视醒目事件Extrapolating recent good performance too far, overweighting salient events成长股过度定价、热门主题追涨，随后出现长期反转Overpricing of growth stocks, chasing hot themes, followed by long-term reversal
损失厌恶与处置效应Loss aversion and the disposition effect过早卖出盈利头寸、长期持有亏损头寸Selling winning positions too early, holding losing positions too long坏消息被缓慢反映、交易量和卖压呈不对称Bad news reflected slowly, asymmetric volume and selling pressure
锚定Anchoring依赖历史高点、买入价或旧估值Relying on historical highs, purchase price, or old valuations价格向新均衡调整不足，关键整数和历史价位附近交易集中Prices adjust insufficiently toward a new equilibrium, with trading concentrated near round numbers and historical price levels

传统金融假设投资者理性、信息迅速进入价格。行为金融并不保证每个偏差都能带来可交易超额收益，因为套利者还面临期限、资金、卖空、噪声交易和基本面风险限制。Traditional finance assumes investors are rational and information enters prices quickly. Behavioral finance does not guarantee every bias yields a tradable excess return, because arbitrageurs also face horizon, funding, short-selling, noise-trader, and fundamental-risk limits.

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

常见情绪偏差(逐个辨认)

• 损失厌恶(loss aversion):怕实现损失、急于锁定盈利 → 处置效应(disposition):扛亏卖盈。
• 过度自信(overconfidence):高估自身能力 → 分散化不足;可解释价值异象。
• 禀赋偏差(endowment):因「已拥有」而高估、死守熟悉资产。
• 后悔厌恶(regret aversion):怕做错后悔 → 羊群行为(跟大家一起错更不后悔)。
• 现状/自控偏差:惯性不动、短期诱惑压过长期计划。

易错对比

① 扛亏卖盈 = 处置效应;② 守熟悉资产 = 禀赋;③ 羊群 = 后悔厌恶;④ 过度自信 → 分散不足/换手过高。

Common emotional biases (identify each)

• Loss aversion: reluctant to realize losses, eager to lock gains → the disposition effect: hold losers, sell winners.
• Overconfidence: overrating one's ability → under-diversification; can explain the value anomaly.
• Endowment: overvaluing what one owns, clinging to familiar assets.
• Regret aversion: fearing regret → herding (being wrong with the crowd feels less regrettable).
• Status-quo / self-control: inertia; short-term temptation over long-term plans.

Common traps

① Holding losers/selling winners = disposition; ② clinging to familiar assets = endowment; ③ herding = regret aversion; ④ overconfidence → under-diversification/high turnover.

8. 损失厌恶是什么:What is loss aversion: 官方题Official

  • A. 亏损带来的痛苦大于同额盈利的快乐,常导致死扛亏损、过早卖盈The pain of a loss exceeds the pleasure of an equal gain, often leading to holding losers and selling winners too early
  • B. 盈利的快乐更大The pleasure of a gain is greater
  • C. 对盈亏无偏好No preference between gains and losses
答案 A。损失厌恶造成"处置效应"。Answer A. Loss aversion causes the 'disposition effect.'

9. 过度自信偏差的后果是:The consequence of overconfidence bias is: 官方题Official

  • A. 没有任何后果No consequences
  • B. 高估自身判断,导致过度交易、组合分散不足Overestimating one's own judgment, leading to overtrading and under-diversification
  • C. 过度谨慎Excessive caution
答案 B。过度自信引发频繁交易与集中持仓。Answer B. Overconfidence causes frequent trading and concentrated holdings.

10. 禀赋效应是什么:What is the endowment effect: 官方题Official

  • A. 对自己资产估值偏低Undervaluing one's own assets
  • B. 无任何偏差No bias
  • C. 对自己已持有的资产估值偏高,不愿卖出Overvaluing assets one already owns and being unwilling to sell
答案 C。持有使人高估该资产价值。Answer C. Ownership makes people overvalue that asset.

11. 现状偏差和后悔厌恶如何影响决策:How do status-quo bias and regret aversion affect decisions: 官方题Official

  • A. 倾向维持现状、不作为,或为避免将来后悔而随大流,错失调整机会A tendency to keep the status quo and do nothing, or follow the crowd to avoid future regret, missing chances to adjust
  • B. 促使频繁主动调整Prompting frequent active adjustment
  • C. 对决策没有影响No effect on decisions
答案 A。这些偏差导致惰性与从众。Answer A. These biases cause inertia and herding.

12. 自我控制偏差的典型表现是:The typical manifestation of self-control bias is: 官方题Official

  • A. 短期消费诱惑压倒长期目标,导致储蓄/投资不足Short-term consumption temptation overriding long-term goals, leading to under-saving/under-investing
  • B. 过度储蓄Over-saving
  • C. 没有任何表现No manifestation
答案 A。缺乏自控使长期目标让位于当下消费。Answer A. Lack of self-control lets long-term goals yield to present consumption.
1. 过久持有亏损、过快卖出盈利，最好地刻画了下列哪项？1. Holding on to losers for too long and selling winners too quickly best characterizes which of the following? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 后见之明偏差Hindsight bias
  • B. 处置效应Disposition effect
  • C. 锚定与调整偏差Anchoring and adjustment bias
答案 B。过久持亏损、过快卖盈利 = 处置效应(disposition effect)(不愿实现损失、急于锁定收益)。后见之明、锚定是别的偏差。Answer B. Holding losers too long and selling winners too soon = the disposition effect (reluctance to realize losses, eagerness to lock gains). Hindsight and anchoring are different biases.
2. 金融市场参与者的下列哪种倾向最可能是禀赋偏差(endowment bias)的后果？2. Which of the following tendencies of financial market participants is most likely a consequence of endowment bias? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 从事羊群行为Engaging in herding behavior
  • B. 为未来储蓄不足Saving insufficiently for the future
  • C. 继续持有其熟悉的资产类别Continuing to hold classes of assets with which they are familiar
答案 C。禀赋偏差(endowment bias)→ 因"已拥有"而高估、继续持有熟悉的资产类别。羊群、储蓄不足是别的偏差表现。Answer C. Endowment bias → overvaluing what one already owns and continuing to hold familiar asset classes. Herding and undersaving are other biases.
3. 下列哪项最好地描述后悔厌恶(regret-aversion)偏差对金融市场参与者的潜在后果？3. Which of the following best describes a potential consequence of the regret-aversion bias for financial market participants? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 从事羊群行为Engaging in herding behaviour
  • B. 过度借款以资助当前消费Borrowing excessively to finance present consumption
  • C. 因风险承受能力问题的表述方式而错误识别风险承受能力Misidentifying risk tolerances because of how questions about risk tolerance were framed
答案 A。后悔厌恶(regret aversion)→ 怕做错决定后悔 → 从众/羊群行为(跟大家一起错就不那么后悔)。过度借款、误判风险承受是别的问题。Answer A. Regret aversion → fear of regret from a wrong decision → herding (being wrong with the crowd feels less regrettable). Over-borrowing and mis-assessing risk tolerance are other issues.

§4 技术分析:假设与工具§4 Technical Analysis: Assumptions & Tools

跨科复习：技术分析在 2026 Equity Investments 的市场有效性 LOS 中用于讨论弱式有效市场的含义，并非 Portfolio Management 独立模块。

技术分析假设:价格由供求决定,而供求受理性与非理性因素共同影响;市场行为(价格、成交量)会呈现趋势并重复,历史会以相似形态再现。它只用市场数据(价、量),不看基本面。与基本面分析互补;对没有现金流的标的(货币、大宗商品)尤其常用。Technical analysis assumes: prices are set by supply and demand, which are driven by both rational and irrational factors; market behavior (price, volume) trends and repeats, with history recurring in similar patterns. It uses only market data (price, volume), not fundamentals. It complements fundamental analysis; it is especially common for instruments with no cash flow (currencies, commodities).

🔬 深入讲解🔬 Deep Dive

技术分析的假设与逻辑

技术分析假设价格由供求决定,而供求受理性与非理性因素共同驱动,且行为会形成可识别的价格/成交量模式并重复。它用市场数据(价、量)而非基本面,故与「弱式有效」相冲突(弱式下历史价量已反映、技术分析无效)。

与基本面/有效市场的关系

技术分析不看内在价值;若市场弱式有效则技术分析失效。它常用于把握时机与情绪,而非估值。

易错对比

① 技术分析用价量、基本面用财务数据;② 弱式有效 → 技术无效、基本面仍可能有效;③ 它假设模式会重复。

Assumptions & logic of technical analysis

Technical analysis assumes prices are set by supply and demand, driven by both rational and irrational factors, and that behavior forms recognizable, repeating price/volume patterns. It uses market data (price, volume), not fundamentals, so it conflicts with weak-form efficiency (where past price/volume is already reflected and technicals fail).

Relation to fundamentals/efficiency

Technical analysis ignores intrinsic value; if the market is weak-form efficient, technical analysis fails. It is used more for timing and sentiment than valuation.

Common traps

① Technicals use price/volume, fundamentals use financial data; ② weak-form efficiency → technicals fail, fundamentals may still work; ③ it assumes patterns repeat.

13. 技术分析的核心假设是:The core assumption of technical analysis is: 官方题Official

  • A. 只看基本面Only fundamentals matter
  • B. 价格由供求决定,市场行为呈现趋势并重复,历史形态会再现Prices are set by supply and demand, market behavior trends and repeats, and historical patterns recur
  • C. 价格完全随机Prices are entirely random
答案 B。趋势与形态重复是技术分析前提。Answer B. Trends and pattern repetition are the premise of technical analysis.

14. 技术分析使用什么数据:What data does technical analysis use: 官方题Official

  • A. 只看财务报表Only financial statements
  • B. 只看宏观数据Only macro data
  • C. 仅市场数据——价格和成交量,不看基本面Only market data — price and volume, not fundamentals
答案 C。技术分析基于价量。Answer C. Technical analysis is based on price and volume.

§5 常见技术指标§5 Common Technical Indicators

LOS 对应:LOS: describe common technical analysis tools。
工具Tool说明Description
趋势线、支撑/阻力Trend lines, support/resistance支撑=下方买盘密集;阻力=上方卖盘密集Support = dense buying below; resistance = dense selling above
移动平均线Moving averages平滑价格,判断趋势;金叉/死叉Smooth price to judge the trend; golden cross/death cross
相对强弱 RSI、动量Relative strength (RSI), momentum振荡指标,判断超买超卖Oscillators judging overbought/oversold
形态Patterns头肩顶、双顶双底、三角形等反转/持续形态Head-and-shoulders, double top/bottom, triangles, and other reversal/continuation patterns
成交量Volume确认价格走势的强度Confirms the strength of a price move
相反意见/情绪指标Contrarian/sentiment indicators市场过度一致时反向操作Trade against the crowd when the market is overly unanimous

15. 支撑位和阻力位分别是什么:What are support and resistance levels: 官方题Official

  • A. 支撑=下方买盘密集、价格易止跌;阻力=上方卖盘密集、价格易受阻Support = dense buying below, price tends to stop falling; resistance = dense selling above, price tends to be capped
  • B. 两者定义相反The definitions are reversed
  • C. 两者完全相同They are identical
答案 A。支撑托底,阻力压顶。Answer A. Support holds the floor, resistance caps the top.

16. 移动平均线的作用是:The role of moving averages is: 官方题Official

  • A. 没有作用No role
  • B. 平滑价格波动、识别趋势方向;金叉/死叉给出信号Smooth price fluctuations and identify trend direction; golden/death crosses give signals
  • C. 放大价格波动Amplify price fluctuations
答案 B。均线帮助识别趋势与交叉信号。Answer B. Moving averages help identify trends and crossover signals.

17. 为什么技术分析常用于货币和大宗商品:Why is technical analysis often used for currencies and commodities: 官方题Official

  • A. 它们有稳定现金流They have stable cash flows
  • B. 它们易于贴现估值They are easy to value by discounting
  • C. 它们没有现金流,难用贴现模型估值,更依赖价量分析They have no cash flow and are hard to value with discount models, relying more on price/volume analysis
答案 C。无现金流资产难以基本面估值。Answer C. Cash-flow-less assets are hard to value fundamentally.

18. 相反意见指标的逻辑是:The logic of contrarian indicators is: 官方题Official

  • A. 当市场情绪过度一致时反向操作(极度看多可能见顶)Act against the market when sentiment is excessively unanimous (extreme bullishness may signal a top)
  • B. 一味顺势操作Always follow the trend
  • C. 没有任何逻辑No logic
答案 A。极端一致的情绪往往预示反转。Answer A. Extremely unanimous sentiment often signals a reversal.

19. 大数据的"3V"是:The '3 Vs' of big data are: 官方题Official

  • A. 没有 3V 之说There is no such thing as the 3 Vs
  • B. Volume(量)、Velocity(速)、Variety(多样);另加 Veracity(真实性)Volume, Velocity, Variety; plus Veracity
  • C. Value、Volatility、VolumeValue, Volatility, Volume
答案 B。量、速、多样,常再加真实性。Answer B. Volume, velocity, variety, often plus veracity.

20. 监督学习与无监督学习的区别是:The difference between supervised and unsupervised learning is: 官方题Official

  • A. 两者定义相反The definitions are reversed
  • B. 两者完全相同They are identical
  • C. 监督学习用带标签数据训练做预测/分类;无监督学习在无标签数据中发现结构/聚类Supervised learning trains on labeled data for prediction/classification; unsupervised learning finds structure/clusters in unlabeled data
答案 C。有无标签是二者的关键区别。Answer C. Labeled vs unlabeled is the key difference.

21. 智能投顾(robo-advisor)的价值是:The value of a robo-advisor is: 官方题Official

  • A. 以低成本、自动化方式为大众提供组合建议与管理Providing portfolio advice and management to the mass market in a low-cost, automated way
  • B. 高成本的纯人工服务High-cost purely human service
  • C. 没有实际价值No real value
答案 A。智能投顾普惠、低成本。Answer A. Robo-advisors are inclusive and low-cost.

22. 分布式账本技术(DLT)的特点与应用是:The features and applications of distributed ledger technology (DLT) are: 官方题Official

  • A. 没有任何应用No applications
  • B. 去中心化、不可篡改、可验证;用于清结算、资产代币化、智能合约Decentralized, tamper-resistant, verifiable; used for clearing/settlement, asset tokenization, and smart contracts
  • C. 中心化、可随意篡改Centralized and freely alterable
答案 B。DLT 支撑代币化与智能合约。Answer B. DLT underpins tokenization and smart contracts.

23. 机器学习中的"过拟合"是什么风险:What is the risk of 'overfitting' in machine learning: 补充Extra

  • A. 泛化能力更强Stronger generalization
  • B. 没有任何风险No risk
  • C. 模型过度拟合训练数据的噪声,样本外表现差、泛化能力弱The model over-fits the noise in the training data, performing poorly out-of-sample with weak generalization
答案 C。过拟合把噪声当成规律,样本外失效。Answer C. Overfitting mistakes noise for patterns and fails out-of-sample.
1. 智能投顾(robo-advisers)最可能：1. Robo-advisers most likely: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 面临高进入壁垒。face high barriers to entry.
  • B. 迎合可投资产较少的投资者需求。cater to the demand from investors with lower levels of investable assets.
  • C. 在构建客户组合时偏好主动管理基金而非指数基金。prefer actively managed funds to index funds when constructing client portfolios.
答案 B。智能投顾(robo-advisers)迎合"可投资产较少"的投资者(低门槛、低成本)。它进入壁垒低、偏好低成本指数基金,故 A、C 反。Answer B. Robo-advisers serve investors with smaller investable assets (low minimums, low cost). They face low entry barriers and favor low-cost index funds, so A and C are reversed.
