🎯 职业伦理做题技巧 · 提分策略🎯 Ethics Exam Tactics
  • 从严原则:法律与准则冲突守"更严"者;知法准则核心 = 与违法/不道德行为"脱离(dissociate)"(仅报告或详知法律不够)。Most-strict rule: when law and the Code conflict, follow the stricter; the core of Knowledge of the Law = dissociate from illegal/unethical conduct (merely reporting or knowing the law is not enough).
  • 独立客观:发行人付费研究须披露报酬性质;客户礼品=补充报酬须披露;若公司阻止负面意见→把该公司移出研究范围+列入受限名单。Independence: issuer-paid research must disclose the nature of pay; a client gift = supplemental compensation, disclose it; if the firm blocks a negative opinion, remove the company from coverage and put it on a restricted list.
  • 不实陈述:不得"保证/承诺未来业绩"、不得虚假归属/抄袭;马赛克理论(非重大信息+自身分析)合法。市场操纵:拉高出货、制造虚假交易/信息。Misrepresentation: no guaranteeing/promising future performance, no false attribution/plagiarism; the mosaic theory (non-material info + own analysis) is legitimate. Market manipulation: pump-and-dump, faking trades/information.
  • MNPI:必须"重大且非公开"才受限(内部会议的重大法律纠纷=MNPI);泄露方与据此交易方"双方"都违规。MNPI: restricted only if material AND non-public (a material legal dispute from an internal meeting = MNPI); both the tipper and the one who trades on it violate.
  • 忠诚/审慎/关注:客户与"受益人"利益优先于雇主/管理层(养老金义务归受益人);软美元须惠及客户。公平交易:建议须公平且"内部与客户同时"传达。Loyalty/Prudence/Care: clients and beneficiaries come before the employer/management (pension duty runs to beneficiaries); soft dollars must benefit clients. Fair Dealing: disseminate recommendations fairly and to internal staff and clients simultaneously.
  • 适当性:在"整体组合"背景判断;共同基金经理按"授权(mandate)"管理;须"行动前"了解客户。业绩陈述:须注明模拟业绩、税前/税后,不得用单一代表账户。Suitability: judge in the total-portfolio context; a fund manager invests per the mandate; know the client before acting. Performance Presentation: flag simulated results and before/after tax; don't use a single representative account.
  • 对雇主忠诚:在职时另立门户"前须通知";无竞业协议可用"公开信息"联系前客户;不得挪用雇主财产(交易软件/记录)。额外报酬:接受前取得"所有相关方书面同意"。Loyalty to Employer: notify before starting an outside business while employed; with no non-compete, contact former clients using public information; don't misappropriate employer property (software/records). Additional compensation: get written consent from all parties before accepting.
  • 交易优先:客户/雇主优先于个人;有"表决权或裁量权"即视为"受益所有";个人交易须预审批+经纪商副本确认单。督导责任:合规系统不足应"书面拒绝"督导。Priority of Transactions: clients/employer before self; voting authority or discretion counts as beneficial ownership; personal trades need pre-clearance + duplicate broker confirms. Supervisors: if the compliance system is inadequate, decline supervision in writing.
  • 冲突/介绍费:利益冲突须"显著、事前"披露;介绍安排(即使无费)须向"现有与潜在客户"披露,并含"预估金额"。记录保存:无法规时建议至少保留 7 年。Conflicts/Referral fees: disclose conflicts prominently and in advance; a referral arrangement (even fee-free) must be disclosed to both existing and prospective clients, including the estimated amount. Record retention: at least 7 years absent regulation.
  • 会员/考生准则:仅"已报名并注册下次考试"才是候选人;不得暗示"CFA 带来更优业绩";不得泄露具体考题(可表达一般看法)。Candidate conduct: only someone enrolled and registered for the next exam is a candidate; don't imply the CFA charter yields superior performance; don't disclose specific exam content (general opinions are fine).
  • GIPS:综合按"授权(mandate)"汇总所有全权委托组合(防择优);"全公司"合规;初次至少呈现 5 年 → 逐年加至 10 年;验证=自愿、独立第三方、全公司。GIPS: composites aggregate all discretionary portfolios by mandate (prevents cherry-picking); compliance is firm-wide; present at least 5 years initially, building to 10; verification is voluntary, independent, and firm-wide.

§1 伦理与信任§1 Ethics & Trust

LOS 对应:LOS: explain ethics and the role of a code of ethics; describe the importance of ethics to the investment profession。
🔰 零基础讲解:金融业卖的其实是"信任"

信任🤝 投资业本质是"把钱托付给别人打理"。客户看不懂复杂产品、信息也远少于专业机构,只能靠"信任"。一旦从业者滥用信任(欺诈、内幕、利益冲突),客户就会离场,整个市场的资金成本上升、效率下降。所以伦理不是"额外的美德",而是行业赖以生存的地基。是投资业的基石;伦理保护信任,信任维系市场。Trust🤝 The investment business is essentially "entrusting money to others to manage." Clients can't understand complex products and have far less information than professional institutions, so they can only rely on "trust." Once practitioners abuse that trust (fraud, insider dealing, conflicts of interest), clients leave, the whole market's cost of capital rises, and efficiency falls. So ethics is not an "extra virtue" but the foundation the industry depends on to survive. is the cornerstone of the investment business; ethics protects trust, and trust sustains markets.

伦理=一套关于对错的道德原则与行为准则。投资业存在严重信息不对称和委托代理关系,客户高度依赖从业者的诚信。良好的职业伦理能:维护客户信任、保护市场诚信、降低系统性风险、提升行业长期价值。职业(profession)的特征:服务客户利益、有专业知识体系、有共同的行为准则、自律。Ethics = a set of moral principles and codes of conduct about right and wrong. The investment business has severe information asymmetry and principal-agent relationships, and clients depend heavily on practitioners' integrity. Good professional ethics can: maintain client trust, protect market integrity, reduce systemic risk, and enhance the industry's long-term value. Characteristics of a profession: serving client interests, having a specialized body of knowledge, sharing a code of conduct, and self-regulation.

1. 为什么伦理对投资业尤其重要:Why is ethics especially important for the investment industry: 官方题Official

  • A. 投资业存在严重信息不对称和委托代理,客户高度依赖信任;伦理维护信任、市场诚信、降低系统性风险The industry has severe information asymmetry and principal-agent issues, and clients depend heavily on trust; ethics preserves trust, market integrity, and lowers systemic risk
  • B. 与信任毫无关系Nothing to do with trust
  • C. 伦理并不重要Ethics is unimportant
答案 A。信任是投资业的立业之本。Answer A. Trust is the foundation of the investment industry.

2. 职业(profession)的特征是:The features of a profession are: 官方题Official

  • A. 没有行为准则No code of conduct
  • B. 服务客户利益、专业知识体系、共同行为准则、自律Serving client interests, a body of specialized knowledge, a shared code of conduct, and self-regulation
  • C. 只求个人利益Seeking only personal gain
答案 B。专业、准则与自律构成职业。Answer B. Expertise, a code, and self-regulation make a profession.

3. 伦理为什么最终有利于从业者自身:Why does ethics ultimately benefit practitioners themselves: 官方题Official

  • A. 对从业者没有益处No benefit to practitioners
  • B. 只利于客户Only benefits clients
  • C. 维护信任带来长期客户关系与行业繁荣,损害信任则损害所有人的长期利益Preserving trust brings long-term client relationships and industry prosperity; damaging trust harms everyone's long-term interests
答案 C。信任是行业繁荣与个人长期利益的基础。Answer C. Trust is the basis of industry prosperity and personal long-term interest.
1. "专业(profession)"最可能被描述为这样一群人：1. A profession is most likely described as a group of people that: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 对某一学科具有共同的基础知识水平。has a common level of basic knowledge about a particular subject.
  • B. 依据一致同意的道德准则监督其成员。monitors its members based on an agreed-on code of ethics.
  • C. 将其成员的利益放在首位。puts the interests of its members first.
答案 B。"专业(profession)"的核心特征 = 依据一致同意的道德准则(code of ethics)监督其成员(自律)。共同知识是一部分,但把成员利益置于首位与"专业以服务社会/客户为先"相悖。Answer B. A hallmark of a profession = it oversees its members under an agreed code of ethics (self-regulation). Shared knowledge is part of it, but putting members' interests first contradicts a profession's service to society/clients.
2. 大多数社会最不可能将下列哪项视为道德原则：2. Most societies would least likely consider ethical principles to include: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 公正。justice.
  • B. 欺骗(duplicity)。duplicity.
  • C. 勤勉。diligence.
答案 B。欺骗(duplicity)不是道德原则——它本身就是不道德。公正、勤勉是普遍认可的道德原则。Answer B. Duplicity is not a moral principle — it is itself unethical. Fairness and diligence are widely recognized moral principles.

§2 伦理 vs 法律§2 Ethics vs Law

LOS 对应:LOS: compare and contrast ethical and legal standards。
关系Relationship说明Description
合法但不道德Legal but unethical某些行为法律未禁止,但违背伦理(如利用信息优势占客户便宜)Some conduct is not prohibited by law but violates ethics (e.g., using an information advantage to exploit a client)
道德但违法Ethical but illegal极少数情形(如某些吹哨)可能道德却触法In rare cases (e.g., certain whistleblowing) conduct may be ethical yet break the law
核心结论Core conclusion法律是底线,伦理要求更高;仅"守法"不等于"合乎伦理"Law is the floor, ethics demands more; merely "obeying the law" does not equal "being ethical"

CFA 准则要求:遵守适用法律法规;当准则与法律冲突时,遵守更严格者。The CFA standards require: comply with applicable laws and regulations; where the standards and the law conflict, follow the stricter.

4. 伦理和法律的关系是:The relationship between ethics and law is: 官方题Official

  • A. 法律是底线,伦理要求更高;合法未必合伦理The law is the floor and ethics demands more; legal is not necessarily ethical
  • B. 伦理是底线,法律要求更高Ethics is the floor and law demands more
  • C. 两者完全等同They are identical
答案 A。伦理标准高于法律底线。Answer A. Ethical standards are above the legal floor.

5. 当准则与当地法律冲突时应遵守哪个:When the Standards conflict with local law, which should be followed: 官方题Official

  • A. 两者都不遵守Follow neither
  • B. 遵守更严格(more strict)的一方Follow the more strict of the two
  • C. 遵守更宽松的一方Follow the more lenient one
答案 B。从严原则:择更严者遵守。Answer B. The stricter-of-the-two principle.

6. 下列哪项属于"合法但不道德"的例子:Which is an example of 'legal but unethical': 补充Extra

  • A. 利用相对客户的信息优势推销高费产品——不一定违法,但违背对客户的诚信义务Using an information advantage over the client to push a high-fee product — not necessarily illegal, but violating the duty of good faith to the client
  • B. 内幕交易Insider trading
  • C. 伪造财务报表Falsifying financial statements
答案 A。后两者本身违法;A 合法却违背诚信义务。Answer A. The latter two are illegal; A is legal but violates the duty of good faith.

§3 为什么会有不道德行为§3 Why Unethical Behavior Occurs

LOS 对应:LOS: identify challenges to ethical behavior。

挑战来源:
① 过度自信,高估自己的道德水平(内在-外在偏差);
② 情境压力(situational influences)——奖金、上级压力、从众、忠诚往往比个人品性更能左右行为;
③ 只顾眼前利益、忽视长期后果;
④ "大家都这么做"的合理化。认识到情境的力量是防范的关键——预先建立框架、而非临场靠意志力。Sources of challenge:
① overconfidence, overestimating one's own morality (the internal-external bias);
② situational influences — bonuses, superior pressure, conformity, and loyalty often sway behavior more than individual character;
③ focusing on immediate gain while ignoring long-term consequences;
④ the "everyone does it" rationalization. Recognizing the power of the situation is key to prevention — build a framework in advance rather than relying on willpower in the moment.

7. 最能影响人做出不道德行为的因素是:The factor that most influences people to act unethically is: 官方题Official

  • A. 只有个人品性Only personal character
  • B. 没有任何因素No factor
  • C. 情境压力(奖金、上级压力、从众、忠诚)往往比个人品性更起作用Situational pressure (bonuses, superior pressure, conformity, loyalty) often outweighs personal character
答案 C。情境压力常压过个人品德。Answer C. Situational pressure often overrides personal character.

8. 为什么过度自信不利于道德行为:Why is overconfidence bad for ethical behavior: 官方题Official

  • A. 人们高估自己的道德水平(内在-外在偏差),放松警惕、易被情境左右People overestimate their own moral level (the internal-external bias), lowering their guard and becoming easily swayed by circumstances
  • B. 会提升道德水平It raises the moral level
  • C. 对道德没有影响No effect on ethics
答案 A。高估自我道德使人疏于防范。Answer A. Overestimating one's own morality leads to complacency.

9. 为什么要在事前建立框架而非临场靠意志:Why establish a framework in advance rather than rely on willpower in the moment: 补充Extra

  • A. 情境压力极强,事前框架和制度能在压力下提供稳定的行为指引Situational pressure is very strong, and a pre-set framework and rules provide stable behavioral guidance under pressure
  • B. 临场靠意志更可靠In-the-moment willpower is more reliable
  • C. 根本不需要框架No framework is needed at all
答案 A。预设框架抵御临场的情境压力。Answer A. A pre-set framework resists in-the-moment situational pressure.

§4 道德决策框架§4 The Ethical Decision-Making Framework

LOS 对应:LOS: describe a framework for ethical decision-making。
步骤Step做什么What to do
识别 IdentifyIdentify相关事实、利益相关方、伦理原则、冲突Relevant facts, stakeholders, ethical principles, conflicts
考量 ConsiderConsider征询指导(合规、法务、准则)、考虑情境影响与备选方案Seek guidance (compliance, legal, the standards), consider situational influences and alternatives
决策 Decide & ActDecide & Act作出并执行决定Make and carry out the decision
反思 ReflectReflect事后复盘,是否达到预期伦理结果Review afterward whether the intended ethical outcome was achieved

10. 道德决策框架的主要步骤是:The main steps of an ethical decision-making framework are: 官方题Official

  • A. 没有固定步骤No fixed steps
  • B. 识别(事实/相关方/原则/冲突)→考量(征询指导、备选方案)→决策与行动→反思Identify (facts/stakeholders/principles/conflicts) → consider (seek guidance, alternatives) → decide and act → reflect
  • C. 先行动后识别Act first, then identify
答案 B。识别—考量—行动—反思四步。Answer B. Identify-consider-act-reflect, four steps.

§5 道德准则 Code of Ethics 六条§5 The Six Articles of the Code of Ethics 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: describe the six components of the Code of Ethics。

CFA 会员与考生必须(members and candidates must):CFA members and candidates must:

#准则(Code)Code
1以诚信、能力、勤勉、尊重并合乎伦理的方式,对待公众、客户、潜在客户、雇主、雇员、同业及其他资本市场参与者Act with integrity, competence, diligence, and respect and in an ethical manner toward the public, clients, prospective clients, employers, employees, colleagues, and other capital-market participants
2把行业诚信和客户利益置于个人利益之上Place the integrity of the profession and clients' interests above their own
3在投资分析、建议、行动及其他专业活动中,运用合理的谨慎和独立的专业判断Use reasonable care and independent professional judgment in investment analysis, recommendations, actions, and other professional activities
4践行并鼓励他人以专业、合乎伦理的方式执业,以为行业赢得声誉Practice and encourage others to practice in a professional and ethical way that reflects credit on the profession
5提升全球资本市场的诚信与活力,以造福社会Promote the integrity and viability of the global capital markets for the ultimate benefit of society
6维持并提升自身的专业能力,并致力于同业的专业水准Maintain and improve their own professional competence and strive to maintain that of others in the profession

11. Code of Ethics 有几条、第 2 条讲什么:How many articles does the Code of Ethics have, and what does the 2nd cover: 官方题Official

  • A. 三条Three
  • B. 十条Ten
  • C. 六条;第 2 条:把行业诚信和客户利益置于个人利益之上Six; the 2nd: place the integrity of the profession and clients' interests above personal interests
答案 C。Code 共六条,第 2 条强调客户利益优先。Answer C. The Code has six articles; the 2nd stresses client-interest priority.

12. Code 第 3 条的要求是:The requirement of the Code's 3rd article is: 官方题Official

  • A. 运用合理的谨慎和独立的专业判断Use reasonable care and exercise independent professional judgment
  • B. 追求个人利益最大化Maximize personal gain
  • C. 没有具体要求No specific requirement
答案 A。合理谨慎与独立判断。Answer A. Reasonable care and independent judgment.
1. CFA 协会道德准则(Code)与职业行为准则(Standards)要求成员：1. The CFA Institute Code of Ethics (the Code) and Standards of Professional Conduct (the Standards) require members to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅鼓励他人以专业和道德的方式执业。encourage others to practice in a professional and ethical manner only.
  • B. 仅为投资行业的最终利益促进全球资本市场的诚信与生存力。promote the integrity and viability of the global capital markets for the ultimate benefit of the investment profession only.
  • C. 既鼓励他人以专业和道德方式执业，又为投资行业的最终利益促进全球资本市场的诚信与生存力。both encourage others to practice in a professional and ethical manner and promote the integrity and viability of the global capital markets for the ultimate benefit of the investment profession.
答案 A。道德准则与行为准则要求成员仅"鼓励他人以专业和道德方式执业"。促进全球资本市场诚信是"为社会整体利益"而非"仅为行业利益",故 B、C 的措辞不准。Answer A. The Code and Standards require members to encourage others to practice professionally and ethically. Promoting market integrity is for society's ultimate benefit, not merely the industry's, so B and C are worded inaccurately.

§6 七大行为准则总览§6 Overview of the Seven Standards of Professional Conduct 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: identify the seven Standards of Professional Conduct。
🔰 零基础讲解:七大准则的记忆地图

准则(Standards)比准则(Code)更具体、可操作,共 7 大类、下含多个子条款。先记住七大类的"对象/主题":对行业、对市场、对客户、对雇主、对分析行动、利益冲突、对 CFA 机构。The Standards are more specific and actionable than the Code, comprising 7 categories with multiple sub-provisions. First memorize the seven categories' "object/theme": toward the profession, toward the market, toward clients, toward employers, toward analysis and action, conflicts of interest, and toward CFA Institute.

标准Standard主题Theme子条款Sub-provisions
I专业精神 ProfessionalismProfessionalismA 熟知法律 / B 独立客观 / C 不实陈述 / D 不当行为A Knowledge of the Law / B Independence and Objectivity / C Misrepresentation / D Misconduct
II资本市场诚信Integrity of Capital MarketsA 重大非公开信息 / B 市场操纵A Material Nonpublic Information / B Market Manipulation
III对客户的责任Duties to ClientsA 忠诚谨慎勤勉 / B 公平对待 / C 适当性 / D 业绩陈述 / E 保密A Loyalty, Prudence, and Care / B Fair Dealing / C Suitability / D Performance Presentation / E Preservation of Confidentiality
IV对雇主的责任Duties to EmployersA 忠诚 / B 额外报酬安排 / C 主管责任A Loyalty / B Additional Compensation Arrangements / C Responsibilities of Supervisors
V投资分析、建议与行动Investment Analysis, Recommendations, and ActionsA 勤勉与合理依据 / B 与客户沟通 / C 记录保存A Diligence and Reasonable Basis / B Communication with Clients / C Record Retention
VI利益冲突Conflicts of InterestA 披露冲突 / B 交易优先顺序 / C 介绍费A Disclosure of Conflicts / B Priority of Transactions / C Referral Fees
VII作为 CFA 会员/考生的责任Responsibilities as a CFA Member/CandidateA CFA 考试行为 / B 引用 CFA 称号与项目A Conduct in the CFA Program / B Reference to CFA and the Program
考点提示:七大准则的顺序和主题要能背出:I 专业、II 市场、III 客户、IV 雇主、V 分析行动、VI 冲突、VII CFA 机构。下一讲逐条详解子条款——这是伦理得分的关键。

13. 七大准则中 Standard I 的主题是:The theme of Standard I among the seven standards is: 官方题Official

  • A. 利益冲突Conflicts of Interest
  • B. 专业精神(Professionalism)Professionalism
  • C. 资本市场诚信Integrity of Capital Markets
答案 B。Standard I 为专业精神。Answer B. Standard I is Professionalism.

14. Standard II 的主题是:The theme of Standard II is: 官方题Official

  • A. 专业精神Professionalism
  • B. 对雇主的责任Duties to Employers
  • C. 资本市场诚信(Integrity of Capital Markets)Integrity of Capital Markets
答案 C。Standard II 为资本市场诚信。Answer C. Standard II is Integrity of Capital Markets.

15. Standard III 的主题及子条款是:The theme and sub-provisions of Standard III are: 官方题Official

  • A. 对客户的责任:忠诚谨慎勤勉、公平对待、适当性、业绩陈述、保密Duties to Clients: loyalty/prudence/care, fair dealing, suitability, performance presentation, confidentiality
  • B. 对雇主的责任Duties to Employers
  • C. 利益冲突Conflicts of Interest
答案 A。Standard III 是对客户的责任。Answer A. Standard III is Duties to Clients.

16. Standard IV 的主题是:The theme of Standard IV is: 官方题Official

  • A. 利益冲突Conflicts of Interest
  • B. 对雇主的责任(忠诚、额外报酬安排、主管责任)Duties to Employers (loyalty, additional compensation arrangements, responsibilities of supervisors)
  • C. 对客户的责任Duties to Clients
答案 B。Standard IV 是对雇主的责任。Answer B. Standard IV is Duties to Employers.

17. Standard V 的主题是:The theme of Standard V is: 官方题Official

  • A. 利益冲突Conflicts of Interest
  • B. 专业精神Professionalism
  • C. 投资分析、建议与行动(勤勉合理依据、与客户沟通、记录保存)Investment Analysis, Recommendations, and Actions (diligence and reasonable basis, communication with clients, record retention)
答案 C。Standard V 涉及分析、建议与行动。Answer C. Standard V covers analysis, recommendations, and actions.

18. Standard VI 的主题是:The theme of Standard VI is: 官方题Official

  • A. 利益冲突(披露冲突、交易优先顺序、介绍费)Conflicts of Interest (disclosure of conflicts, priority of transactions, referral fees)
  • B. 对客户的责任Duties to Clients
  • C. 专业精神Professionalism
答案 A。Standard VI 为利益冲突。Answer A. Standard VI is Conflicts of Interest.

19. Standard VII 的主题是:The theme of Standard VII is: 官方题Official

  • A. 对雇主的责任Duties to Employers
  • B. 作为 CFA 会员/考生的责任(考试行为、引用 CFA 称号与项目)Responsibilities as a CFA Member/Candidate (conduct in the program, reference to CFA designation and program)
  • C. 利益冲突Conflicts of Interest
答案 B。Standard VII 关乎 CFA 会员与考生责任。Answer B. Standard VII concerns CFA member and candidate responsibilities.

20. Code 和 Standards 的关系是:The relationship between the Code and the Standards is: 官方题Official

  • A. 两者定义正好相反The definitions are exactly reversed
  • B. 两者完全相同They are identical
  • C. Code 是高层原则性宣言;Standards 更具体、可操作,细化 CodeThe Code is a high-level statement of principles; the Standards are more specific and actionable, elaborating the Code
答案 C。Standards 是 Code 的可操作细化。Answer C. The Standards are the actionable elaboration of the Code.
1. 下列哪项是 CFA 协会七大职业行为准则(Standards)之一？1. Which of the following is one of the seven CFA Institute Standards of Professional Conduct? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 对雇主的义务Duties to Employers
  • B. 业绩诚信Performance Integrity
  • C. 交易披露Disclosure of Transactions
答案 A。七大准则之一 = 对雇主的义务(Duties to Employers, Standard IV)。"业绩诚信""交易披露"不是七大准则的名称。Answer A. One of the seven Standards = Duties to Employers (Standard IV). "Performance integrity" and "trade disclosure" are not names of the Standards.

§1 Professional Conduct Program 执法结构§1 The Enforcement Structure of the Professional Conduct Program

LOS 对应：describe the structure of the CFA Institute Professional Conduct Program and enforcement process。
主体Body职责Responsibility
Board of Governors对 Professional Conduct Program 保持监督和最终责任Maintains oversight of and ultimate responsibility for the Professional Conduct Program
Professional Conduct Staff接收线索、调查、收集文件、访谈并提出处理意见Receives leads, investigates, gathers documents, interviews, and proposes handling
Disciplinary Review Committee由 CFA charterholders 组成；在当事人不接受指控和拟议处分时，由其 panel 审理Composed of CFA charterholders; when the respondent does not accept the charges and proposed sanction, its panel hears the case
Rules of Procedure与 CFA Institute Bylaws 一起构成执法程序基础Together with the CFA Institute Bylaws, forms the basis of the enforcement process

1. 谁对 Professional Conduct Program 保持监督责任:Who retains oversight of the Professional Conduct Program:

  • A. CFA Institute Board of GovernorsThe CFA Institute Board of Governors
  • B. SECThe SEC
  • C. Disciplinary Review CommitteeThe Disciplinary Review Committee
答案 A。PCP 由 CFA Institute 理事会保持监督。Answer A. The PCP is overseen by the CFA Institute Board.
1. CFA 协会鼓励成员以书面形式向 CFA 协会的下列哪一机构报告其他成员对道德准则的违规：1. CFA Institute encourages members to report other members’ violations of the Code and Standards in writing to the CFA Institute: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 理事会。Board of Governors.
  • B. 职业行为项目(PCP)。Professional Conduct Program.
  • C. 纪律审查委员会。Disciplinary Review Committee.
答案 B。CFA 协会鼓励以书面形式向职业行为项目(PCP, Professional Conduct Program)报告其他成员的违规。Answer B. CFA Institute encourages reporting other members' violations in writing to the Professional Conduct Program (PCP).

§2 调查来源、流程与处分§2 Investigation Sources, Process & Sanctions

调查线索可来自：年度 Professional Conduct Statement 自我披露、书面投诉、媒体或监管公告、考场监考报告、考后成绩和材料分析，以及网络或社交媒体中的保密考试信息。Investigation leads can come from: self-disclosure on the annual Professional Conduct Statement, written complaints, media or regulatory announcements, exam-proctor reports, post-exam analysis of scores and materials, and confidential exam information found online or on social media.

  1. Professional Conduct Staff 启动调查，可能要求书面解释、访谈相关方并收集记录。Professional Conduct Staff initiate an investigation and may request a written explanation, interview relevant parties, and gather records.
  2. 调查后可以无处分结案、发出 cautionary letter，或继续纪律程序。After investigation, they may close with no sanction, issue a cautionary letter, or continue disciplinary proceedings.
  3. 若认为存在违规，成员或考生可以接受或拒绝指控和拟议处分。If a violation is believed to exist, the member or candidate may accept or reject the charges and proposed sanction.
  4. 拒绝时，案件提交 DRC panel；panel 判断是否违规以及应施加何种处分。On rejection, the case goes to a DRC panel; the panel decides whether there was a violation and what sanction to impose.
可能处分Possible sanction例子Example
Public Censure公开谴责Public censure
Suspension暂停会员资格和 CFA designation 使用权Suspension of membership and the right to use the CFA designation
Revocation撤销 CFA charterRevocation of the CFA charter
Candidate Sanctions暂停或禁止继续参加 CFA ProgramSuspension or prohibition from continuing in the CFA Program

2. 当成员拒绝指控和拟议处分时,案件提交给谁:When a member rejects the charges and proposed sanction, to whom is the case referred:

  • A. 当地法院The local court
  • B. 由 Disciplinary Review Committee 成员组成的 panelA panel of Disciplinary Review Committee members
  • C. Board of GovernorsThe Board of Governors
答案 B。争议案件交由纪律复核委员会 panel 裁决。Answer B. Disputed cases go to a Disciplinary Review Committee panel.

§3 防止违反 Standards I–VII 的程序§3 Procedures to Prevent Violations of Standards I–VII 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应：recommend practices and procedures designed to prevent violations。
Standard建议控制程序Recommended control procedure
I Professionalism维护适用法律清单；独立合规部门；礼品限额和预先批准；核查营销陈述、员工背景和资质Maintain a list of applicable laws; an independent compliance department; gift limits and pre-approval; verify marketing statements, employee backgrounds, and qualifications
II Market Integrity信息隔离墙、限制名单、观察名单、个人交易监控；限制接触 MNPI；监测操纵型交易Information firewalls, restricted lists, watch lists, personal-trading monitoring; limit access to MNPI; monitor manipulative trading
III Duties to Clients书面 IPS、定期更新客户资料；公平分配政策；业绩计算标准；客户信息访问控制Written IPS, periodic client-profile updates; fair-allocation policy; performance-calculation standards; access controls on client information
IV Duties to Employers披露外部活动和额外报酬；离职和记录政策；主管建立、培训、监测并执行合理合规系统Disclose outside activities and additional compensation; departure and record policies; supervisors establish, train, monitor, and enforce reasonable compliance systems
V Analysis and Actions书面尽调清单、独立验证、情景分析、模型审查；披露风险限制和重大变化；保留支持记录Written due-diligence checklists, independent verification, scenario analysis, model review; disclose risks, limitations, and material changes; retain supporting records
VI Conflicts能避免则避免；否则以显著、清晰、完整方式披露；客户交易优先；介绍费书面披露Avoid where possible; otherwise disclose prominently, clearly, and completely; prioritize client transactions; disclose referral fees in writing
VII CFA Responsibilities保护考试保密信息；不讨论具体考题；准确描述 CFA designation 和 candidacy，不暗示保证业绩Protect confidential exam information; do not discuss specific questions; describe the CFA designation and candidacy accurately, without implying guaranteed performance
答题方法：若题目问“最适当的预防措施”，优先选择事前的书面政策、独立监督、充分披露和持续监控，而不是违规发生后才处分。

Volume 10 · 职业伦理
CFA Program Curriculum · Level I · Ethical and Professional Standards

第二讲 · 七大行为准则逐条详解Lecture 2 · The Seven Standards of Conduct, Explained One by One

对应教材:Guidance for Standards I–VII · 建议学习时长:4 小时 · 伦理最核心、最能拿分的一讲Curriculum: Guidance for Standards I–VII · Suggested study time: 4 hours · The most core, most point-scoring lecture in ethics

这一讲是整个伦理科目的核心——逐条讲解七大准则的子条款、常见违规情形与合规做法。伦理题几乎都在考"某人这么做违反了哪条准则",所以重点不是背条文,而是能判断行为对错并对应到具体条款。请结合每条的"违规示例"记忆。This lecture is the core of the whole ethics subject — a clause-by-clause walk through the seven Standards' sub-provisions, common violation scenarios, and compliant practices. Ethics questions almost always ask 'which Standard did this action violate,' so the point is not to memorize the text but to judge whether an action is right or wrong and map it to the specific provision. Memorize using the 'violation examples' under each clause.

§1 Standard I · 专业精神§1 Standard I · Professionalism 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: demonstrate and explain appropriate conduct under Standard I。
子条款Sub-provision要求 & 违规示例Requirement & violation example
I(A) 熟知法律I(A) Knowledge of the Law须了解并遵守适用法律法规;冲突时守更严格者。发现违规须脱离(dissociate)。违规:明知同事造假仍参与。Must know and comply with applicable laws and regulations; on conflict follow the stricter. On discovering a violation, must dissociate. Violation: knowingly participating while a colleague falsifies data.
I(B) 独立与客观I(B) Independence and Objectivity保持独立客观,不受礼品、款待、投行关系影响。可收象征性小礼,但客户/第三方的贵重馈赠须警惕。违规:接受发行人豪华旅游后出具好评报告。Maintain independence and objectivity, uninfluenced by gifts, entertainment, or investment-banking relationships. May accept token small gifts, but valuable gifts from clients/third parties warrant caution. Violation: issuing a favorable report after an issuer's lavish trip.
I(C) 不实陈述I(C) Misrepresentation不得就投资、资质、业绩作虚假或误导性陈述;不得抄袭。违规:把他人研究当自己的、夸大过往业绩。No false or misleading statements about investments, qualifications, or performance; no plagiarism. Violation: passing off others' research as one's own, exaggerating past performance.
I(D) 不当行为I(D) Misconduct不得有涉及欺诈、欺骗、不诚实或有损职业声誉的行为。违规:醉酒影响工作、私下诈骗(即使与投资无关也可能违规)。No conduct involving fraud, deceit, or dishonesty or reflecting adversely on professional reputation. Violation: drunkenness affecting work, private fraud (may be a violation even if unrelated to investments).
I(B) 独立客观记忆点:
① 只可接受不影响独立性的小额礼品/款待,来自客户的须向雇主披露/获批。
② 卖方分析师受投行部门压力是经典考点——须抵制。
③ 差旅最好由本公司出资(避免受制于被分析公司)。

1. 分析师明知同事伪造数据仍署名参与,违反哪条:An analyst knowingly co-authors a report where a colleague fabricated data; which standards are violated: 官方题Official

  • A. I(A) 熟知法律(须脱离违规)+ I(C) 不实陈述I(A) Knowledge of the Law (must dissociate) + I(C) Misrepresentation
  • B. III(A) 忠诚谨慎勤勉III(A) Loyalty, Prudence, Care
  • C. VI(A) 披露利益冲突VI(A) Disclosure of Conflicts
答案 A。须脱离违规活动并不得参与不实陈述。Answer A. Must dissociate from the violation and not participate in misrepresentation.

2. 卖方分析师因投行部门压力出具偏乐观评级,违反:A sell-side analyst issues an overly optimistic rating under pressure from the investment-banking department; this violates: 官方题Official

  • A. I(B) 独立与客观I(B) Independence and Objectivity
  • B. I(C) 不实陈述I(C) Misrepresentation
  • C. II(A) 重大非公开信息II(A) Material Nonpublic Information
答案 A。屈从内部压力损害了独立客观。Answer A. Yielding to internal pressure harms independence and objectivity.

3. 把他人研究报告改头换面署自己名,违反:Rebranding someone else's research report under one's own name violates: 官方题Official

  • A. I(C) 不实陈述(抄袭 plagiarism)I(C) Misrepresentation (plagiarism)
  • B. I(B) 独立与客观I(B) Independence and Objectivity
  • C. IV(A) 对雇主的忠诚IV(A) Loyalty to Employer
答案 A。抄袭属不实陈述。Answer A. Plagiarism is misrepresentation.

4. 会员因酒驾被判刑,是否可能违反准则:A member is convicted of drunk driving; could this violate the standards: 官方题Official

  • A. 可能违反 I(D) 不当行为——涉及有损职业声誉/诚信的行为It may violate I(D) Misconduct — conduct harming professional reputation/integrity
  • B. 违反 II(A)Violates II(A)
  • C. 完全不违反准则Does not violate any standard
答案 A。有损诚信声誉的行为可触发 I(D)。Answer A. Conduct harming reputation/integrity can trigger I(D).

5. 接受发行人赞助的豪华旅行后出好评,违反:Writing a favorable review after accepting an issuer-sponsored luxury trip violates: 官方题Official

  • A. I(B) 独立与客观(应自费或拒绝,以保持独立)I(B) Independence and Objectivity (should pay one's own way or decline to preserve independence)
  • B. VI(C) 介绍费VI(C) Referral Fees
  • C. III(E) 保密III(E) Preservation of Confidentiality
答案 A。受赠豪华招待损害独立客观。Answer A. Accepting lavish hospitality harms independence and objectivity.
1. 按准则，被要求撰写发行人付费研究报告的成员须：1. According to the Standards, a member who is asked to produce an issuer-paid research report is required to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 避免现金报酬。avoid cash compensation.
  • B. 在报告中披露其报酬的性质。disclose the nature of their compensation in the report.
  • C. 若其公司为发行人提供投行服务则拒绝撰写报告。decline to write the report if the member’s firm provides investment banking services to the issuer.
答案 B。发行人付费研究:成员须在报告中披露报酬的性质(以维护客观性)。不必拒收现金或拒绝撰写(只要披露并保持客观),故 A、C 过严。Answer B. Issuer-paid research: the member must disclose the nature of the compensation in the report (to preserve objectivity). Refusing cash or refusing to write is not required (disclose and stay objective), so A and C are too strict.
2. 下列哪项是独立性与客观性准则的合规推荐程序？成员应鼓励其公司：2. Which of the following is a recommended procedure for compliance with the Standard relating to independence and objectivity? Members should encourage their firms to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 禁止任何员工参与与股权相关的IPO。prohibit any employee participation in equity-related IPOs.
  • B. 若公司不愿传播对某企业客户的负面意见，则将该公司移出研究范围并列入受限名单。remove a corporate client company from the research universe and put it on a restricted list if the firm is unwilling to disseminate adverse opinions about the company.
  • C. 向每位客户提供举报潜在不道德行为、违规或其他有损公司声誉活动的程序与政策。provide every client with the procedures and policies for reporting potentially unethical behaviour, violations of regulations, or other activities that may harm the firm’s reputation.
答案 B。独立性与客观性的推荐程序:若公司不愿传播对某企业客户的负面意见,就把该公司移出研究范围并列入受限名单(只发事实、不发评级)。Answer B. A recommended procedure for Independence & Objectivity: if the firm is unwilling to disseminate a negative opinion on a corporate client, remove that company from the research universe and place it on a restricted list (facts only, no rating).
3. 某成员认为一位同事在工作中参与不道德活动。该成员未与同事的活动脱离。该成员最可能违反了：3. A member believes a colleague is participating in unethical activities at work. The member does not disassociate himself from the activities of his colleague. The member has most likely violated: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅关于知法的准则。only the Standard relating to knowledge of the law.
  • B. 仅关于冲突披露的准则。only the Standard relating to disclosure of conflicts.
  • C. 知法准则与冲突披露准则两者。both the Standard relating to knowledge of the law and the Standard relating to disclosure of conflicts.
答案 A。认为同事参与不道德活动却未脱离 → 违反知法(Knowledge of the Law, Standard I(A))——须与违法/不道德行为脱离。这不涉及冲突披露,故只违反知法准则。Answer A. Believing a colleague is acting unethically yet not dissociating → violates Knowledge of the Law (I(A)) — one must dissociate from illegal/unethical conduct. It does not involve conflict disclosure, so only Knowledge of the Law.
4. 下列哪些属于独立性与客观性准则的合规推荐程序？
程序1对投资人员在私募配售中购买证券施加限制。

程序3若公司不愿传播对某企业的负面意见，则将该公司从受限名单中移除。
4. Which of the following are among the recommended procedures for compliance with the Standard relating to independence and objectivity?
Procedure 1Impose limits on investment personnel acquiring securities in private placements.

 真题模考Mock
  • A. 程序1与程序2Procedure 1 and Procedure 2

  • C. 程序2与程序3Procedure 2 and Procedure
答案 A。按题给程序表,程序1与程序2符合独立性与客观性准则的推荐做法(如限制/餐旅自付、避免利益挂钩)。Answer A. Per the listed procedures, procedures 1 and 2 are recommended for Independence & Objectivity (e.g., limits, paying one's own travel, avoiding tie-ins).
5. 下列哪项是知法准则的合规推荐程序？成员应鼓励其公司：5. Which of the following is a recommended procedure for compliance with the Standard relating to knowledge of the law? Members should encourage their firms to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 至少每年向客户分发适用证券法律的摘要。distribute summaries of applicable security laws to clients at least annually.
  • B. 为举报疑似违法或违规行为提供书面规程。provide written protocols for reporting suspected legal or regulatory violations.
  • C. 对潜在违规行为的应对有疑问时寻求监管机构的意见。seek the advice of a regulatory agency when in doubt about which action to take regarding potential violations.
答案 B。知法准则的推荐程序:公司应为举报疑似违法/违规提供书面规程(内部举报机制)。Answer B. A recommended procedure for Knowledge of the Law: the firm should provide written procedures for reporting suspected legal/ethical violations (an internal whistleblowing mechanism).
6. 按独立性与客观性准则：6. According to the Standard relating to independence and objectivity: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 来自客户的礼品可被视为补充报酬。a gift from a client could be considered supplementary compensation.
  • B. 薪酬安排应将分析师报酬与投行任务挂钩。compensation arrangements should link analyst remuneration to investment banking assignments.
  • C. 若卖方分析师的评级变动不利于客户组合，组合经理可向被覆盖公司举报该分析师。portfolio managers may report sell-side analysts to covered companies if analysts’ changes in recommendation adversely affect client portfolios.
答案 A。按独立性与客观性,来自客户的礼品可被视为"补充报酬(supplemental compensation)",可能影响客观性 → 须向雇主披露/管理。B、C 描述违规做法。Answer A. Under Independence & Objectivity, a gift from a client can be viewed as supplemental compensation that may impair objectivity → it must be disclosed/managed. B and C describe improper practices.
7. 按独立性与客观性准则，成员必须：7. According to the Standard related to independence and objectivity, a member must: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 拒绝一切与业务相关的礼品。refuse all business-related gifts.
  • B. 遵守约束发行人付费研究如何进行的严格行为标准。adhere to strict standards of conduct that govern how issuer-paid research is conducted.
  • C. 在赴发行人总部开会时自付交通、酒店和餐饮费用。pay for transportation, hotel and meal expenses when attending meetings at an issuer’s headquarters.
答案 B。成员必须遵守约束"发行人付费研究"如何进行的严格行为标准(披露、保持客观)。不必一律拒收礼品或自付所有费用(合理接待可接受),故 A、C 过严。Answer B. Members must adhere to strict standards governing how issuer-paid research is conducted (disclosure, objectivity). They need not refuse all gifts or pay every expense (reasonable hospitality is acceptable), so A and C are too strict.
8. 成员若未做到下列哪项，最可能违反知法准则：8. A member most likely violates the Standard relating to knowledge of the law if she fails to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 脱离不道德行为。dissociate from unethical conduct.
  • B. 向适当的监管机构举报非法活动。report illegal activity to the appropriate regulatory organization.
  • C. 详知可能约束其专业活动的所有法律。have detailed knowledge of all the laws potentially governing her professional activities.
答案 A。最可能违反知法准则的是未与不道德行为"脱离(dissociate)"。举报、详知法律是推荐/要求,但"脱离"是知法准则的核心义务。Answer A. The most likely Knowledge-of-the-Law violation is failing to dissociate from unethical conduct. Reporting and knowing the law are recommended/required, but dissociation is the core duty here.
9. 按独立性与客观性准则，下列哪项准确？

9. According to the Standard relating to independence and objectivity, which of the following is accurate?
Statement 1A member should encourage her firm to remove a covered company from a restricted list if the firm is unwilling to permit dissemination of an adverse opinion about the company.

 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅陈述1Statement 1 only
  • B. 仅陈述2Statement 2 only
  • C. 陈述1与陈述2均是Both Statement 1 and Statement 2
答案 B。按独立性与客观性,仅陈述2准确(需结合题给两陈述,通常涉及"礼品/接待须披露、不损客观性")。Answer B. Under Independence & Objectivity, only statement 2 is accurate (per the two given statements, typically about disclosing gifts/hospitality without impairing objectivity).
10. Rita Melmo, CFA 是 Greensky Investment (GI) 的分析师。周末她作为当地一家慈善机构的付薪员工工作，负责谈判采购协议。Melmo 未向 GI 披露该慈善机构的工作。Melmo 被要求为慈善机构购买一辆新卡车，并与当地卡车经销商谈判采购协议。协议中，慈善机构被多收取比卡车正常售价高 $500 的价格。作为回报，Melmo 从经销商处获得价值 $500 的零售代金券供其私用。Melmo 最可能违反准则的行为是：10. Rita Melmo, CFA, is an analyst at Greensky Investment (GI). On weekends, she works as a paid employee of a local charity where she negotiates purchase agreements. Melmo does not disclose the charity employment to GI. Melmo is asked to purchase a new truck for the charity and negotiates a purchase agreement with a local truck dealership. In the agreement, the charity is charged $500 more than the truck’s normal sale price. In return, Melmo receives retail vouchers worth $500 from the dealership for her private use. Melmo has most likely violated the Standards: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅未向 GI 披露慈善机构的工作。only by failing to disclose the charity employment to GI.
  • B. 仅谈判了慈善机构被多收费的采购协议。only by negotiating a purchase agreement in which the charity is charged more than the truck’s normal sale price.
  • C. 既未向 GI 披露慈善工作，又谈判了慈善机构被多收费的协议。both by failing to disclose the charity employment to GI and by negotiating a purchase agreement in which the charity is charged more than the truck’s normal sale price.
答案 B。Melmo 仅因"谈判使慈善机构被多收费的采购协议"违规——她为私利损害了她所服务方(慈善机构)的利益(欺诈/不当行为)。未披露兼职虽也是问题,但题问"最可能违规行为",核心是损害受益方,故选 B。Answer B. Melmo violates by negotiating a purchase that overcharged the charity — harming the party she served for personal gain (fraud/misconduct). Non-disclosure of the outside work is an issue too, but the core violation is harming the beneficiary, so B.
11. Rebecca Chen, CFA 是专注科技板块的组合经理。她近期把覆盖范围扩展到石油板块。Chen 在担任新角色前参加培训以确保对石油板块有足够了解。经全面研究，Chen 认定 First Oil Company (FOC) 被低估，并为适合该投资的客户买入 FOC 股票。两个月后，FOC 股价下跌20%。Chen 是否违规？11. Rebecca Chen, CFA, is a portfolio manager who has specialized in the technology sector. She recently expanded her coverage to the oil sector. Chen attends training to ensure she has sufficient knowledge of the oil sector before taking the new role. After comprehensive research, Chen concludes that First Oil Company (FOC) is undervalued and buys FOC shares for her clients for whom the investment is suitable. Two months later, FOC’s price declines by 20%. Has Chen violated the Standards? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 没有No
  • B. 违规，胜任能力准则Yes, the Standard relating to competence
  • C. 违规，勤勉与合理依据准则Yes, the Standard relating to diligence and reasonable basis
答案 A。Chen 没有违规:她扩展覆盖前接受了培训、做了充分研究、有合理依据才买入。事后股价下跌不代表违反胜任或勤勉准则(结果不等于过程)。Answer A. Chen did not violate: she trained before expanding coverage, researched thoroughly, and had a reasonable basis. A later price drop does not mean a competence or diligence violation (outcome ≠ process).
12. 下列哪项属于不实陈述准则的合规推荐程序？

12. Which of the following is among the recommended procedures for compliance with the Standard relating to misrepresentation?

13. 按不实陈述准则的合规推荐程序，成员应：13. According to the recommended procedures for compliance with the Standard relating to misrepresentation, a member should: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 避免使用从第三方获得的信息。refrain from using information received from a third party.
  • B. 至少每季度更新其职业资质摘要。update a summary of her professional qualifications at least quarterly.

14. 成员若有下列哪种行为，最可能违反不实陈述准则：14. A member most likely violates the Standard relating to misrepresentation if he: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 向其客户分发另一家公司撰写的研究报告。distributes a research report written by another firm to his clients.
  • B. 把引文归于"一位领先分析师"而不具名。attributes a quotation to "a leading analyst" without naming the analyst.
  • C. 使用一位已离职分析师所做的研究而不注明其贡献。uses research done by an analyst who no longer works for the firm without providing attribution to that analyst.
答案 B。最可能违反不实陈述的是把引文归于"一位领先分析师"而不具名/未经授权(虚假或无法核实的归属)。分发他人报告、使用离职分析师研究只要恰当署名/披露则可。Answer B. The most likely Misrepresentation is attributing a quote to "a leading analyst" without naming/authorization (false or unverifiable attribution). Distributing others' reports or using a departed analyst's research is fine if properly attributed/disclosed.
15. Donovan Jones, CFA 在 Grae Investments (GI) 工作。GI 投资于商品、股票和债券。其非流动性持仓的价格由一家独立估值公司确定。Jones 用一只小盘股指数作为基准来营销业绩。Jones 因另一家估值公司客户服务更好、成本更低而更换了估值公司。更换导致其非流动性资产当前估值略有上升。Jones 最可能违反不实陈述准则的行为是：15. Donovan Jones, CFA, works at Grae Investments (GI). GI invests in commodities, stocks, and bonds. Prices for its illiquid holdings are determined by an independent valuation firm. Jones markets performance using a small-cap equity index as a benchmark. Jones switches to a different valuation firm due to its better customer service and lower cost. The switch results in a marginal increase to the current estimated value of its illiquid assets. Jones has most likely violated the Standard relating to misrepresentation: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅更换估值公司。only by switching valuation firms.
  • B. 仅使用小盘股指数作为基准。only by using the small-cap equity index as a benchmark.
  • C. 既更换估值公司，又使用小盘股指数作为基准。both by switching valuation firms and by using the small-cap equity index as a benchmark.
答案 B。Jones 仅因"用小盘股指数作基准营销业绩"违反不实陈述(基准不匹配其持仓 → 误导)。更换更好更便宜的估值公司本身无问题。Answer B. Jones violates Misrepresentation only by marketing performance against a small-cap index benchmark (a benchmark that mismatches the holdings → misleading). Switching to a better, cheaper valuation firm is fine.
16. Fred Berkam, CFA 在向客户就其股票型对冲基金的沟通中做出以下两项陈述：陈述1："该基金已连续七年报告盈利，故投资者确保明年可避免亏损。"陈述2："该基金复杂的策略与任何标准基准都不匹配；因此不提供业绩基准。"Berkam 最可能违反准则的是：16. Fred Berkam, CFA, makes the following two statements in his communication to clients regarding his equity-based hedge fund: Statement 1: "The fund has reported seven consecutive years of gains, so investors are assured of avoiding losses next year." Statement 2: "The fund’s complex strategy does not fit well with any standard benchmark; therefore no performance benchmark is provided." Berkam has most likely violated the Standards with: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅陈述1。Statement 1 only.
  • B. 仅陈述2。Statement 2 only.
  • C. 陈述1与陈述2均是。both Statement 1 and Statement 2.
答案 A。仅陈述1违规:"连续七年盈利,故投资者确保明年避免亏损"是对未来业绩的保证(不实陈述)。因策略独特而不提供基准是可接受的解释。Answer A. Only statement 1 violates: "seven profitable years, so investors are assured of avoiding a loss next year" is a guarantee of future performance (Misrepresentation). Not offering a benchmark because the strategy is unique is acceptable.
17. 某成员居住在 Adovia（其证券法规宽松于道德准则）。她在 Batavia（其证券法规宽松于 Adovia）开展业务。下列哪项表述准确？该成员最可能须遵守：17. A member resides in Adovia, a country with securities laws and regulations that are less strict than the Code and Standards. She does business in Batavia, a country with securities laws and regulations that are less strict than those of Adovia. Which of the following statements is accurate? The member must most likely adhere to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 道德准则。the Code and Standards.
  • B. Adovia 的法律法规。the laws and regulations of Adovia.
  • C. Batavia 的法律法规。the laws and regulations of Batavia.
答案 A。当地法律"宽松于"道德准则时,须遵守更严格者 = 道德准则(Code)。这是知法准则的"从严"原则。Answer A. When local law is less strict than the Code, follow the stricter one = the Code. This is the "most strict" principle under Knowledge of the Law.
18. Martha Ray, CFA 基于"环境社会治理"(ESG)风格管理组合。Ray 也是环保活动人士。她在参加一场政府批准的、针对一家被指控破坏环境公司的非暴力抗议时因公民不服从而被捕。Ray 最可能是否违规？18. Martha Ray, CFA, manages a portfolio based on an "Environment Social Governance" (ESG) style of investing. Ray is also an environmental activist. She is arrested for civil disobedience while participating in a government-authorized nonviolent protest against a company that is accused of damaging the environment. Has Ray most likely violated the Standards? 真题模考Mock

  • B. 违规，不当行为准则。Yes, the Standard relating to misconduct.
  • C. 违规，忠诚、审慎与关注准则。Yes, the Standard relating to loyalty, prudence, and care.
答案 A。Ray 没有违规:参加政府批准的非暴力抗议中的公民不服从,不涉及欺骗/欺诈/损害职业诚信,故不违反不当行为准则(该准则针对欺诈、不诚实等)。Answer A. Ray did not violate: civil disobedience at a government-sanctioned non-violent protest involves no deceit/fraud/harm to professional integrity, so it does not breach Misconduct (which targets fraud, dishonesty, etc.).
19. Adam Johnson, CFA 在一家大型投资公司工作。在丢失一次商务会议的出租车发票后，他用同事一张价值略高的出租车发票提交月度报销给雇主。近期，Johnson 因家人巨额医疗账单宣告个人破产。Johnson 是否违反不当行为准则？19. Adam Johnson, CFA, works at a large investment firm. After losing his taxi receipt for a business meeting, he uses his colleague’s taxi receipt of a slightly higher value to submit his monthly expense claim to his employer. Recently, Johnson declared personal bankruptcy due to large medical bills for a family member. Has Johnson violated the Standard relating to misconduct? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 没有。No.
  • B. 违规，因提交该报销。Yes, by submitting the expense claim.
  • C. 违规，因宣告个人破产。Yes, by declaring personal bankruptcy.
答案 B。Johnson 因"用同事发票冒领报销"违反不当行为准则(欺诈、不诚实,损害诚信)。个人破产本身不违反不当行为准则(非欺诈性)。Answer B. Johnson violates Misconduct by submitting a colleague's receipt for reimbursement (fraud/dishonesty harming integrity). Personal bankruptcy alone is not a Misconduct violation (not fraudulent).
20. 下列哪一准则规定成员不得从事任何有损其职业声誉、诚信或能力的行为？下列准则：20. Which of the following Standards states that members must not commit any act that reflects adversely on their professional reputation, integrity, or competence? The Standard relating to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 公平交易fair dealing
  • B. 不当行为misconduct
  • C. 忠诚、审慎与关注loyalty, prudence, and care
答案 B。规定"不得从事有损职业声誉、诚信或能力的行为"的是不当行为(Misconduct, Standard I(D))。Answer B. The Standard prohibiting "conduct reflecting adversely on professional reputation, integrity, or competence" is Misconduct (I(D)).
21. 成员对不当行为准则的违反必须涉及：21. Member violations of the Standard relating to misconduct must involve a(n): 真题模考Mock
  • A. 非法行为。illegal act.
  • B. 对其他某项准则的违反。violation of one of the other Standards.
  • C. 有损成员职业声誉的行为。act that reflects adversely on the member’s professional reputation.
答案 C。违反不当行为准则必须涉及有损成员职业声誉/诚信/能力的行为(如欺诈、不诚实)。不必非法,也不必同时违反其他准则。Answer C. A Misconduct violation must involve conduct reflecting adversely on professional reputation/integrity/competence (e.g., fraud, dishonesty). It need not be illegal or also breach another Standard.

§2 Standard II · 资本市场诚信§2 Standard II · Integrity of Capital Markets 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: demonstrate and explain appropriate conduct under Standard II。
子条款Sub-provision要求 & 违规示例Requirement & violation example
II(A) 重大非公开信息II(A) Material Nonpublic Information掌握重大且非公开(MNPI)信息时,不得据此交易或促使他人交易。"重大"=会影响价格/投资决策;"非公开"=尚未向市场披露。合规:建立信息隔离墙(firewall);可用马赛克理论(综合公开信息+非重大非公开信息得出结论)。违规:听到未公开并购消息抢先买入。When holding material nonpublic (MNPI) information, must not trade on it or cause others to trade. "Material" = would affect price/investment decisions; "nonpublic" = not yet disclosed to the market. Compliant: establish an information firewall; may use the mosaic theory (combining public information + non-material nonpublic information to reach a conclusion). Violation: buying ahead on an undisclosed merger.
II(B) 市场操纵II(B) Market Manipulation不得进行信息型(散布虚假信息)或交易型(虚假交易、拉抬价格)操纵。违规:对倒制造虚假成交量、放假消息拉股价。No information-based (spreading false information) or transaction-based (fake trades, pumping prices) manipulation. Violation: wash trades to fake volume, spreading false news to pump a stock.

6. 什么是"重大非公开信息(MNPI)":What is 'material nonpublic information (MNPI)': 官方题Official

  • A. 会影响证券价格或投资决策(重大)、尚未向市场公开(非公开)的信息Information that would affect a security's price or an investment decision (material) and has not yet been released to the market (nonpublic)
  • B. 已经公开的信息Already public information
  • C. 与价格无关的信息Information unrelated to price
答案 A。兼具"重大"与"非公开"两条件。Answer A. It must be both material and nonpublic.

7. 掌握 MNPI 后应怎么做:What should you do after obtaining MNPI: 官方题Official

  • A. 私下告诉朋友Tell a friend privately
  • B. 不得据此交易或促使他人交易;建立信息隔离墙,直到信息公开Do not trade on it or induce others to trade; establish an information barrier until the information is public
  • C. 立即据此交易Trade on it immediately
答案 B。禁止交易并设隔离墙。Answer B. Prohibit trading and set up a firewall.

8. 什么是马赛克理论(mosaic theory):What is the mosaic theory: 官方题Official

  • A. 综合公开信息与非重大非公开信息得出结论并交易,不违反 II(A)Combining public information and non-material nonpublic information to reach a conclusion and trade, which does not violate II(A)
  • B. 使用重大非公开信息交易Trading on material nonpublic information
  • C. 违反 II(A)Violates II(A)
答案 A。拼图式分析是合规的。Answer A. Mosaic-style analysis is compliant.

9. 通过对倒制造虚假成交量,违反:Creating fake trading volume through wash trades violates: 官方题Official

  • A. II(B) 市场操纵(交易型)II(B) Market Manipulation (transaction-based)
  • B. II(A) 重大非公开信息II(A) Material Nonpublic Information
  • C. I(B) 独立与客观I(B) Independence and Objectivity
答案 A。虚假交易属交易型市场操纵。Answer A. Fake trading is transaction-based market manipulation.
1. 按准则，下列哪项最可能被视为重大非公开信息？1. According to the Standards, which of the following is most likely considered material nonpublic information? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 某对冲基金一笔大额买单近期已执行。The recent execution of a large buy order from a hedge fund.
  • B. 公司管理层内部会议上披露的重大法律纠纷。Significant legal challenges revealed at an internal meeting of the company’s management.
  • C. 股东年会上讨论的公司董事会薪酬近期上调。Recent increases in a company’s board remuneration discussed at the annual general meeting.
答案 B。最可能是重大非公开信息(MNPI)的 = 管理层内部会议披露的"重大法律纠纷"(未公开且会影响股价)。年会讨论的薪酬、已执行的大额订单属公开或非重大。Answer B. Most likely MNPI = a material legal dispute disclosed in an internal management meeting (non-public and price-moving). Compensation discussed at an AGM or an executed large order is public or non-material.
2. 下列哪项成员行为最可能违反市场操纵准则？2. Which of the following member actions most likely violates the Standard relating to market manipulation? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 卖出一只证券并买入另一只以最小化税负Selling one security and buying another to minimize tax liability
  • B. 在社交媒体上就新产品的进展撰写误导性帖子Writing misleading posts on social media about the development of a new product
  • C. 将大额整笔订单拆分为一系列小单以获得更好执行Dividing a large block order into a series of smaller orders to achieve better execution
答案 B。最可能违反市场操纵的 = 在社媒发布"误导性"帖子拉抬产品/股价(信息型操纵)。为税负换券、拆单求更好执行是合法交易。Answer B. Most likely Market Manipulation = posting misleading claims on social media to pump a product/price (information-based). Tax-loss swapping or splitting an order for better execution is legitimate.
3. Shirin Regali, CFA 是备受尊敬的卖方分析师，覆盖生物科技板块。在研究 BioHeal 公司药物前景时，Regali 采访了与试验或 BioHeal 无关联的行业专家。这些专家表示有信心药物将通过试验。基于这些专家见解进行充分分析后，Regali 对 BioHeal 发出"买入"建议，并只发给客户而不向公众发布。Regali 最可能是否违反重大非公开信息准则？3. Shirin Regali, CFA, is a well-respected sell-side analyst covering the biotech sector. Researching drug prospects for BioHeal Inc., Regali interviews industry experts who are not affiliated with the trials or BioHeal. These experts express confidence the drug will pass the trials. After thorough analysis based on these experts’ insights, Regali issues a "buy" recommendation for BioHeal and distributes it to her clients and not to the public. Has Regali most likely violated the Standard relating to material nonpublic information? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 没有No
  • B. 违规，因只把建议发给客户而不向公众发布Yes, by distributing the recommendation to her clients and not to the public
  • C. 违规，因发出"买入"建议Yes, by issuing a "buy" recommendation
答案 A。Regali 没有违规:她用"马赛克理论(mosaic theory)"——综合非重大信息 + 专家见解 + 自身分析 得出结论,信息不是 MNPI。只发客户不发公众也不违反 MNPI(那是公平交易/沟通的话题)。Answer A. Regali did not violate: she used the mosaic theory — combining non-material information, expert views, and her own analysis; the inputs are not MNPI. Sending only to clients is not an MNPI issue.
4. 下列哪项成员行为最可能违反重大非公开信息准则？
行为1分析师从公司 CEO 处得知公司将报告超出分析师预期的盈利后，买入该股票的看涨期权。
行为2分析师与一位知名行业专家交谈后（该专家认为地缘政治风险将推高油价）买入一只石油公司股票。
4. Which of the following member actions most likely violates the Standard relating to material nonpublic information?
Action 1An analyst buys call options on a stock after learning from the company’s CEO that the company will report earnings exceeding analyst expectations.
Action 2An analyst buys an oil company stock after speaking to a well-known industry expert who believes oil prices will rise due to geopolitical risk.
 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅行为1Action 1 only
  • B. 仅行为2Action 2 only
  • C. 行为1和行为2均是both Action 1 and Action 2
答案 A。最可能违反 MNPI 准则的是仅行为1(按题给,如据内幕信息交易/泄露)。Answer A. The most likely MNPI violation is only action 1 (per the listed items, e.g., trading/tipping on inside information).
5. Iris Hadid, CFA 是投行分析师。她建立财务模型对 Ski Mountain Lodge (SML) 估值。Hadid 的朋友 Peter Jackson, CFA 在另一家咨询公司工作。Hadid 向 Jackson 透露其分析细节以听取其对 SML 估值的反馈。基于这些信息，Jackson 买入 SML 的看涨期权。谁违反了准则？5. Iris Hadid, CFA, works as an investment banking analyst. She builds a financial model to value Ski Mountain Lodge (SML). Hadid’s friend, Peter Jackson, CFA, works for a different advisory firm. Hadid shares with Jackson details about her analysis to receive his feedback on her valuation of SML. Based on this information, Jackson buys call options on SML. Who has violated the Standards? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅 HadidHadid only
  • B. 仅 JacksonJackson only
  • C. Hadid 与 Jackson 均是Both Hadid and Jackson
答案 C。Hadid 与 Jackson 均违规:Hadid 泄露了重大非公开的估值信息(违反 MNPI/保密),Jackson 据此买入看涨期权(内幕交易)。Answer C. Both Hadid and Jackson violate: Hadid disclosed material non-public valuation information (MNPI/confidentiality), and Jackson traded on it (buying calls).
6. 关于市场操纵，下列哪项表述与准则一致？成员必须避免：6. Which statement regarding market manipulation is consistent with the Standards? Members must refrain from: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 通过传播可核实的信息诱导交易。inducing trading by disseminating verifiable information.
  • B. 从事利用所察觉市场无效性的做法。engaging in practices which exploit perceived market inefficiencies.
  • C. 在某金融工具中取得主导地位以操纵标的资产价格。securing a dominant position in a financial instrument to exploit the price of the underlying asset.
答案 C。与准则一致的是须避免:在某金融工具中取得"主导地位"以操纵标的资产价格(交易型操纵)。传播"可核实"信息、利用市场无效性是允许的。Answer C. Consistent with the Standard, one must avoid securing a dominant position in an instrument to manipulate the underlying price (transaction-based manipulation). Spreading verifiable information or exploiting inefficiencies is allowed.
7. Judy Naden, CFA 是覆盖航空航天板块的分析师。Naden 的建议常影响板块内股价。Naden 使用已公布财务数据及从行业专家和竞争对手处获得的非重大、非公开信息完成了对一家公司的投资建议。她仅通过邮件把报告发给公司客户。公司客户在报告几天后向公众发布之前就据此交易。Naden 最可能是否违规？7. Judy Naden, CFA, is an analyst covering the aerospace sector. Naden’s recommendations often impact stock prices within the sector. Naden finalizes an investment recommendation on a company using published financial data and nonmaterial, nonpublic information gathered from industry experts and competitors. She distributes the report only to her firm’s clients by email. Her firm’s clients trade on this information before her report is made available to the general public a few days later. Has Naden most likely violated the Standards? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 没有No
  • B. 违规，因在报告中使用从行业专家和竞争对手处获得的信息Yes, by using the information gathered from industry experts and competitors in her report
  • C. 违规，因未同时向公司客户和公众提供其建议Yes, by failing to make her recommendation available to her firm’s clients and the public at the same time
答案 A。Naden 没有违规:她用已公布数据 + 非重大非公开信息(马赛克)得出结论;客户先于公众交易不构成她的违规(她未提供 MNPI,发布节奏是公司政策/公平交易范畴,题设无不当)。Answer A. Naden did not violate: she used published data plus non-material non-public information (mosaic). Clients trading before the public is not her violation (she provided no MNPI).
8. 按道德准则的指引，下列哪项"不是"重大非公开信息准则的合规推荐程序？8. According to the guidance provided by the Code and Standards, which of the following is not a recommended procedure for compliance with the Standard relating to material nonpublic information? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 部门的实体隔离Physical separation of departments
  • B. 采用重大非公开信息的披露程序Adopt disclosure procedures for material nonpublic information
  • C. 避免公开传播所收到的重大非公开信息Avoid public dissemination of material nonpublic information received
答案 C。"避免公开传播所收到的 MNPI"不是推荐程序——正确做法是防止不当传播/交易并促使公开,而非把 MNPI 保密后自用。实体隔离、披露程序才是推荐程序。Answer C. "Avoiding public dissemination of MNPI received" is NOT a recommended procedure — the correct approach is to prevent improper use and encourage public disclosure, not keep MNPI private for one's own use. Information barriers and disclosure procedures are recommended.
9. 几年前，某成员为自己的账户购买了一只小盘股的大量头寸。因该股流动性有限，成员无法卖出全部头寸。为改善流动性，成员在卖出自己头寸之前在两个客户账户之间交易该股。该成员从事了：9. Several years ago, a member purchased a large position in a small-cap stock for her own account. The member is unable to sell the entire position due to the stock’s limited liquidity. To improve liquidity, the member trades the stock between two client accounts before selling her own position. The member has engaged in: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅交易型操纵。transaction-based manipulation only.
  • B. 仅信息型操纵。information-based manipulation only.
  • C. 交易型操纵与信息型操纵两者。both transaction-based manipulation and information-based manipulation.
答案 A。在两个客户账户间对倒以制造流动性假象 = 交易型操纵(transaction-based manipulation)。未散布虚假信息,故非信息型。Answer A. Trading between two client accounts to fake liquidity = transaction-based manipulation. No false information was spread, so not information-based.
10. Venture Energy Exchange (VEE) 推出一款新的原油衍生品。交易所 CEO Adam Jaafar, CFA 与 VEE 十大会员达成保密协议，这些会员承诺在推出后头六个月内交易该新产品的大量最低成交量。该产品流动性在接下来五个月改善。Jaafar 对结果满意，决定在协议到期后不再续期。Jaafar 是否违规？10. Venture Energy Exchange (VEE) launches a new derivatives product on crude oil. The exchange’s CEO, Adam Jaafar, CFA, enters into a confidential agreement with VEE’s ten largest members, who commit to trading substantial minimum volumes of the new product in the first six months after its launch. The product’s liquidity improves over the next five months. Jaafar is satisfied with the results and decides not to extend the confidential agreement once it expires. Has Jaafar violated the Standards? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 没有。No.
  • B. 违规，公平交易准则。Yes, the Standard relating to fair dealing.
  • C. 违规，市场操纵准则。Yes, the Standard relating to market manipulation.
答案 C。Jaafar 与十大会员约定"最低成交量"以人为改善流动性 = 违反市场操纵准则(制造虚假交易活动)。Answer C. Jaafar's agreement with the ten members to trade a minimum volume artificially improved liquidity = a Market Manipulation violation (creating artificial trading activity).
11. 成员在下列哪种情况下违反市场操纵准则：11. A member is in violation of the Standard relating to market manipulation if he: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 频繁交易两只股票以利用市场无效性。frequently trades two stocks to exploit market inefficiencies.
  • B. 取得一家公司股票的控制性头寸以利用该公司潜在的收购。secures a controlling position in a company’s stock to exploit a potential acquisition of the company.
  • C. 发布夸大一家公司负面方面的报告，意图压低其股价。issues a report exaggerating negative aspects of a company with the intent to drive down its share price.
答案 C。违反市场操纵的是发布"夸大负面"的报告意图压低股价(信息型操纵)。利用市场无效性、为收购取得控制性头寸是合法的。Answer C. The Market-Manipulation violation is publishing a report exaggerating negatives to depress the price (information-based). Exploiting inefficiencies or taking a control position for a takeover is legitimate.
12. Tim Howley, CFA 通过散布误导信息"拉抬"某证券价格，待价格达到人为高位后"抛售"该证券。Howley 最可能违反下列哪一准则：12. Tim Howley, CFA, "pumps up" the price of a security by spreading misleading information and later "dumps" the security after the price reaches an artificially high level. Howley has most likely violated the Standard relating to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 市场操纵。market manipulation.
  • B. 独立性与客观性。independence and objectivity.
  • C. 重大非公开信息。material nonpublic information.
答案 A。"拉高出货(pump and dump)"靠散布误导信息抬价再抛售 = 市场操纵(Market Manipulation, Standard II(B))。Answer A. "Pump and dump" — spreading misleading information to inflate price then selling — is Market Manipulation (II(B)).

§3 Standard III · 对客户的责任§3 Standard III · Duties to Clients 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: demonstrate and explain appropriate conduct under Standard III。
子条款Sub-provision要求 & 违规示例Requirement & violation example
III(A) 忠诚、谨慎与勤勉III(A) Loyalty, Prudence, and Care把客户利益置于自身和雇主之上;为客户最佳利益行事(信义义务)。违规:为赚佣金频繁交易(churning)。Place the client's interest above one's own and the employer's; act in the client's best interest (fiduciary duty). Violation: churning to earn commissions.
III(B) 公平对待III(B) Fair Dealing对所有客户公平(不必完全相同)地披露与执行;投资建议/变动须公平地通知各客户。违规:先把好机会给大客户、散户滞后。Deal fairly (not necessarily identically) with all clients in disclosure and execution; investment recommendations/changes must be communicated fairly to all clients. Violation: giving good opportunities to big clients first while retail lags.
III(C) 适当性III(C) Suitability了解客户情况(IPS),确保投资对该客户适当;组合层面看整体适当性。违规:给保守退休客户配高风险衍生品。Know the client's situation (IPS), ensure the investment is suitable for that client; judge overall suitability at the portfolio level. Violation: putting high-risk derivatives in a conservative retiree's account.
III(D) 业绩陈述III(D) Performance Presentation业绩展示须公平、准确、完整,不得误导。违规:只展示挑选出的好账户、夸大回报。Performance presentations must be fair, accurate, and complete, not misleading. Violation: showing only cherry-picked good accounts, exaggerating returns.
III(E) 保密III(E) Preservation of Confidentiality为客户信息保密,除非法律要求、涉及违法活动或获客户同意。违规:泄露客户持仓给第三方。Keep client information confidential, unless required by law, involving illegal activity, or with client consent. Violation: leaking a client's holdings to a third party.
考点·非请求交易(unsolicited trade)与适当性:客户主动下达、与其 IPS 不符的交易:成员应先与客户沟通该交易偏离 IPS 之处;若客户仍坚持,可以执行,并视情况:
① 记录客户指示;
② 若此类偏离频繁,建议更新 IPS 或重新评估客户关系。无需强行拒绝,也不必先修改 IPS 才能执行。Exam - unsolicited trades & suitability: for a client-initiated trade that is inconsistent with the IPS: the member should first discuss with the client how it deviates from the IPS; if the client still insists, the trade may be executed, and one should: (1) document the client's instruction; (2) if such deviations are frequent, recommend updating the IPS or re-evaluating the relationship. There is no need to refuse it, nor to amend the IPS before executing.

10. 频繁交易客户账户以赚佣金(churning),违反:Frequently trading a client's account to earn commissions (churning) violates: 官方题Official

  • A. III(A) 忠诚、谨慎与勤勉III(A) Loyalty, Prudence, and Care
  • B. VI(B) 交易优先顺序VI(B) Priority of Transactions
  • C. III(B) 公平对待III(B) Fair Dealing
答案 A。churning 违背对客户的忠诚义务。Answer A. Churning breaches the duty of loyalty to the client.

11. 把 IPO 好额度只分给大客户、忽视小客户,违反:Allocating good IPO shares only to large clients while neglecting small ones violates: 官方题Official

  • A. III(B) 公平对待III(B) Fair Dealing
  • B. III(C) 适当性III(C) Suitability
  • C. III(A) 忠诚谨慎勤勉III(A) Loyalty, Prudence, Care
答案 A。厚此薄彼违反公平对待。Answer A. Favoritism violates fair dealing.

12. 给风险承受低的退休客户配置高杠杆衍生品,违反:Allocating high-leverage derivatives to a low-risk-tolerance retired client violates: 官方题Official

  • A. III(C) 适当性III(C) Suitability
  • B. III(B) 公平对待III(B) Fair Dealing
  • C. III(D) 业绩陈述III(D) Performance Presentation
答案 A。不符合客户风险画像即违反适当性。Answer A. Not matching the client's risk profile violates suitability.

13. 只展示表现最好的账户业绩,违反:Showing only the best-performing accounts' performance violates: 官方题Official

  • A. III(D) 业绩陈述(须公平、准确、完整)III(D) Performance Presentation (must be fair, accurate, complete)
  • B. III(C) 适当性III(C) Suitability
  • C. I(C) 不实陈述I(C) Misrepresentation
答案 A。挑选业绩误导投资者。Answer A. Cherry-picking performance misleads investors.

14. 未经许可把客户持仓透露给他人,违反:Disclosing a client's holdings to others without permission violates: 官方题Official

  • A. III(E) 保密III(E) Preservation of Confidentiality
  • B. IV(A) 对雇主的忠诚IV(A) Loyalty to Employer
  • C. VI(A) 披露利益冲突VI(A) Disclosure of Conflicts
答案 A。泄露客户信息违反保密义务。Answer A. Leaking client information violates confidentiality.

15. 保密义务的例外情形是:The exceptions to the duty of confidentiality are: 官方题Official

  • A. 没有任何例外No exceptions at all
  • B. 任何时候都可披露May disclose at any time
  • C. 法律要求披露、涉及客户违法活动、或获得客户同意Disclosure required by law, involving the client's illegal activity, or with the client's consent
答案 C。法定、违法、同意是三种例外。Answer C. Legal requirement, illegal activity, and consent are the three exceptions.
1. Dennis Kim, CFA 为客户 Amelia Frost 管理账户。Frost 要求 Kim 将其组合的1%投资于生物科技股。Kim 认为该投资与 Frost 的投资政策声明(IPS)不一致。CGP 对非请求交易的执行没有政策。Kim 与 Frost 讨论了顾虑，但她未改变指令。在未修改 IPS 的情况下，Kim 执行了该交易。Kim 是否违规？1. Dennis Kim, CFA, manages an account for client Amelia Frost. Frost tells Kim to invest one percent of her portfolio in biotech stocks. Kim believes the investment is inconsistent with Frost’s IPS. CGP has no policy on execution of unsolicited trade requests. Kim discusses his concerns with Frost, but she does not change her instruction. Without amending the IPS, Kim executes the trade. Has Kim violated the Standards? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 没有No
  • B. 违规，因为 Kim 为 Frost 执行了不适当的交易Yes, because Kim executes an unsuitable trade for Frost
  • C. 违规，因为 Kim 在执行交易前未修改 Frost 的 IPSYes, because Kim does not change Frost’s investment policy statement before executing the trade
答案 A。Kim 没有违规:他就非请求(unsolicited)、与 IPS 不符的交易与客户充分沟通了顾虑,客户坚持,则可执行且无需修改 IPS(非请求交易按适当性准则处理)。Answer A. Kim did not violate: for an unsolicited trade inconsistent with the IPS, he discussed his concerns; when the client insisted, he may execute without amending the IPS (unsolicited trades are handled under Suitability).
2. 按公平交易准则的合规推荐程序，在大公司工作的成员应：2. According to the recommended procedure for compliance with the Standard relating to fair dealing, a member who works in a large firm should: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 根据客户投资需求选择性地向客户提供不同层次的服务。offer different levels of service to clients selectively based on the clients’ investment needs.
  • B. 向客户及潜在客户披露她如何挑选账户参与某笔订单。disclose to clients and prospective clients how she selects accounts to participate in an order.
  • C. 告知全体员工即将发布的投资建议内容，以确保满足所有客户的投资需求。inform all firm staff of the content of upcoming investment recommendations to assure that all clients’ investment needs are met.
答案 B。公平交易的推荐程序:成员应向客户及潜在客户披露"她如何挑选账户参与某笔订单"(分配政策透明)。选择性分层服务、提前告知全员建议内容都不当。Answer B. A recommended Fair Dealing procedure: disclose to clients and prospects how accounts are selected to participate in an order (transparent allocation). Selective tiered service or pre-announcing recommendations is improper.
3. Andrew Milton, CFA 是服务个人客户的顾问。Milton 推荐与客户目标和风险承受度一致的投资。其公司对推荐自营产品的顾问给予奖金。若其他条件相同，Milton 使用自营产品。Milton 未告知客户该奖金。Milton 最可能是否违规？3. Andrew Milton, CFA, is an advisor working with individual clients. Milton recommends investments consistent with clients’ objectives and risk tolerance. His firm gives advisors a bonus for recommending the firm’s proprietary products. If all other variables are equal, Milton uses the proprietary products. Milton does not inform clients of the bonus. Has Milton most likely violated the Standards? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 没有。No.
  • B. 违规，适当性准则。Yes, the Standard relating to suitability.
  • C. 违规，忠诚、审慎与关注准则。Yes, the Standard relating to loyalty, prudence, and care.
答案 C。Milton 因"公司给推荐自营产品发奖金"而在同等条件下选自营却未向客户披露该奖金 → 违反忠诚、审慎与关注(Loyalty, Prudence and Care)(利益冲突损害客户利益)。Answer C. Milton, receiving a bonus for recommending in-house products and choosing them all else equal without disclosing the bonus, violates Loyalty, Prudence and Care (a conflict harming clients).
4. Tom Dixon, CFA 向客户提供其投资业绩的简要摘要，并说明可应要求提供更多信息。他基于自己强劲的过往业绩告诉客户未来三年可预期5%的回报。Dixon 最可能是否违规？4. Tom Dixon, CFA, provides a brief summary of his investment performance to his clients. He indicates that further information is available upon request. He tells his clients they can expect a return of 5% in the next three years based on his strong track record. Has Dixon most likely violated the Standards? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 没有。No.
  • B. 违规，因表示可应要求提供更多信息。Yes, by indicating that further information is available upon request.
  • C. 违规，因告诉客户未来三年可预期5%回报。Yes, by telling his clients they can expect a return of 5% in the next three years.
答案 C。Dixon 因"告诉客户未来三年可预期 5% 回报"违反业绩陈述/不实陈述(承诺/预测未来业绩)。提供简要摘要并说明可应要求提供详情是允许的。Answer C. Dixon violates by telling clients to expect a 5% return over three years (promising/projecting future performance). Providing a brief summary with detail on request is allowed.
5. Amy Joy, CFA 在 Parklane Investments Ltd. (PIL) 工作。向 PIL 潜在客户展示时，Joy 使用简要的投资业绩摘要，并仅应客户要求提供详细的支持信息。Joy 是否违规？5. Amy Joy, CFA, works at Parklane Investments Ltd. (PIL). When presenting to PIL’s prospective clients, Joy uses a brief investment performance summary and makes available detailed supporting information only upon client request. Has Joy violated the Standards? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 没有。No.
  • B. 违规，公平交易准则。Yes, the Standard relating to fair dealing.
  • C. 违规，业绩陈述准则。Yes, the Standard relating to performance presentation.
答案 A。Joy 没有违规:提供简要业绩摘要、并"应要求"提供详细支持信息,符合业绩陈述准则的推荐做法。Answer A. Joy did not violate: giving a brief performance summary and providing detailed support "on request" complies with the Performance Presentation recommendations.
6. 下列哪项是保密准则的合规推荐程序？
程序1仅向获授权的同事披露有助于改善对该客户服务的信息。
程序2鼓励采用行业领先公司所用的标准保密程序。
6. Which of the following is a recommended procedure for complying with the Standard relating to preservation of confidentiality?
Procedure 1Disclose to authorized fellow employees only information that will improve service to the client.
Procedure 2Encourage the adoption of standard confidentiality procedures utilized by leading firms in the industry.
 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅程序1。Procedure 1 only.
  • B. 仅程序2。Procedure 2 only.
  • C. 程序1与程序2均是。Both Procedure 1 and Procedure 2.
答案 A。保密准则的推荐程序 = 仅程序1(按题给,如尽量少询问不必要的敏感信息、妥善保管客户信息)。Answer A. A recommended Confidentiality procedure = only procedure 1 (per the listed items, e.g., minimizing unnecessary sensitive data and safeguarding client information).
7. 下列哪项最可能违反保密准则？7. Which of the following most likely violates the Standard relating to preservation of confidentiality? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 把一位前客户推荐为当地慈善机构的潜在捐赠人Recommending a former client as a potential donor for a local charity
  • B. 向 CFA 协会职业行为项目披露客户活动细节Disclosing details of client activity to the CFA Institute Professional Conduct Program
  • C. 在潜在客户允许时提供其保密信息Providing confidential information about a prospective client when permitted by the prospective client
答案 A。最可能违反保密准则的 = 把"前客户"推荐给慈善机构作潜在捐赠人(未经许可披露/使用客户信息)。向 PCP 披露、经许可提供信息是允许的。Answer A. The most likely Confidentiality violation = referring a former client to a charity as a prospective donor (disclosing/using client information without permission). Disclosing to the PCP or sharing with permission is allowed.
8. Linda Barr, CFA 是组合经理，收到一位客户的非请求股票订单。她与公司分析师讨论该订单以确定其对该客户组合的影响。分析师认定该股严重低估且适合 Barr 的许多客户。Barr 致电适合该股的客户推荐该股，随后为原客户及其他适合的客户执行了一笔整块交易。Barr 最可能违反准则的行为是：8. Linda Barr, CFA, a portfolio manager, receives an unsolicited stock order from a client. She discusses the order with her firm’s analysts to determine how it will impact that client’s portfolio. The analysts determine the stock to be highly undervalued and suitable for many of Barr’s clients. Barr calls clients for whom the stock is suitable to recommend the stock. She then executes a single block trade for the original client as well as other clients for whom the stock is suitable. Barr most likely violated the Standards: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅执行该整块交易。only by executing the single block trade.
  • B. 仅与分析师讨论非请求客户订单。only by discussing unsolicited client orders with her analysts.
  • C. 既执行整块交易，又与分析师讨论非请求客户订单。both by executing the single block trade and by discussing unsolicited client orders with her analysts.
答案 A。Barr 仅因"执行整块交易(block trade)"违反公平交易?——不,重读:她致电"适合"客户推荐后为原客户及其他适合客户整块成交,这本身没问题;与分析师讨论非请求订单也允许。故答案 A 表示"仅执行整块交易"是被点名行为——但整块交易若公平分配则不违规。此题正确项 A 意在:她的唯一可疑处是执行了整块交易(公平分配下不违规),即"仅执行该整块交易"为最可能被质疑却仍合规。核心记忆:整块交易须公平分配、非请求订单可与分析师讨论。Answer A. Barr's only flagged action is executing the block trade; discussing an unsolicited order with an analyst is allowed, and a fairly-allocated block trade is proper. Key memory: block trades must be allocated fairly, and unsolicited orders may be discussed with an analyst.
9. 为符合准则，若适用法律要求成员对客户信息保密，则必须保密，除非：9. To comply with the Standards, if applicable law requires members to maintain confidentiality of client information, confidentiality must be maintained unless: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 客户已去世。the client has died.
  • B. 客户信息涉及非法活动。the client’s information involves illegal activities.
  • C. 客户允许披露该信息。the client permits the disclosure of the information.
答案 C。法律要求保密时须保密,除非"客户允许披露"。客户去世、信息涉非法活动本身不自动解除保密义务(除非法律另有要求)。Answer C. When law requires confidentiality, maintain it unless the client permits disclosure. A client's death or the information involving illegality does not by itself lift the duty (unless law requires otherwise).
10. Susana Garcia, CFA 是备受尊敬的交通运输板块分析师。她完成了一家公司的新建议。次日上午，她把建议用邮件发给公司最大的客户。午餐后，她把建议用邮件发给所有其他客户。一小时后，她致电最大客户详细讨论该建议。Garcia 违反公平交易准则的行为是：10. Susana Garcia, CFA, is a widely respected analyst covering the transportation sector. She completes a new recommendation for a company. The next morning, she emails the recommendation to her firm’s largest client. After lunch, she emails the recommendation to all other firm clients. One hour later, she calls the largest client to discuss the recommendation in detail. Garcia has violated the Standard relating to fair dealing: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅致电最大客户详细讨论建议。only by calling the largest client to discuss the recommendation in detail.
  • B. 仅在发给所有其他客户之前先把建议发给最大客户。only by emailing the recommendation to the largest client prior to sending it to all other clients.
  • C. 既致电最大客户详细讨论，又提前把建议发给最大客户。both by calling the largest client to discuss the recommendation in detail and by emailing the recommendation to the largest client prior to sending it to all other clients.
答案 B。Garcia 仅因"先把建议发给最大客户,再发其他所有客户"违反公平交易(不公平优待)。事后致电最大客户详谈,只要建议已公平传达,通常允许。Answer B. Garcia violates Fair Dealing only by emailing the largest client before all other clients (unfair preferential treatment). Calling the largest client afterward to elaborate is generally allowed once the recommendation was disseminated fairly.
11. Robin Herring, CFA 是一家独立信用评级机构的政府债券研究分析师。一家竞争对手刚下调了 Herring 所跟踪政府的债券评级。Herring 注意到竞争对手报告中的全部信息在他上周发布的分析中都已涵盖。过去 Herring 下调评级较慢，故看到竞争对手报告后他怀疑自己的分析。Herring 决定重新发布信用评级、与竞争对手的下调保持一致。在修订报告中，Herring 声称有新信息可佐证下调。Herring 把修订版发布在机构网站上，并通过邮件提供给收到原报告的所有客户。Herring 的评级变动最不可能违反下列哪项准则？11. Robin Herring, CFA, is a government bond research analyst at an independent credit rating agency. A competitor just downgraded the bonds of a government Herring follows. Herring notes that all of the information in the competitor’s report was covered in his analysis published last week. In the past, Herring has been slow to downgrade bonds, so he doubts his own analysis after seeing the competitor’s report. Herring decides to reissue his credit rating and match the competitor’s downgrade. In his revised report, Herring states that new information has been made available to justify the downgrade. Herring posts the revision on the agency’s website and provides it by email to all clients who received the original. Herring’s rating change least likely violated which of the following Standards? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 公平交易Fair dealing
  • B. 勤勉与合理依据Diligence and reasonable basis
  • C. 与客户及潜在客户沟通Communication with clients and prospective clients
答案 A。Herring 的评级变动最不可能违反"公平交易"(他把修订版同时发网站和所有原客户,传达公平)。但"声称有新信息"却无新信息、跟风改评级涉及勤勉与沟通问题。Answer A. Herring's change is least likely to violate Fair Dealing (he posted the revision and emailed all original clients — fair dissemination). Claiming "new information" that doesn't exist and copying a competitor raises Diligence and Communication concerns.
12. 某成员有一位为高端服务支付更高费用的客户。准则最可能允许成员向该客户提供：12. A member has a client who pays higher fees for premium services. The Standards most likely allow the member to provide that client with: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 超额认购IPO的更大配额。larger allocations of oversubscribed IPOs.
  • B. 更早获得投资建议和评级变动。earlier access to investment recommendations and rating changes.
  • C. 直接接触研究分析师以更详细讨论已发布的投资评级。direct access to research analysts to discuss published investment ratings in greater detail.
答案 C。准则允许向付高价客户提供"直接接触分析师、更详细讨论已发布评级"等增值服务,只要不损害其他客户获得该评级的公平性。提前给评级、IPO 更大配额不公平。Answer C. The Standards allow premium-fee clients extra services like direct access to analysts to discuss already-disseminated ratings, provided other clients are not disadvantaged in receiving the rating itself. Earlier access to recommendations or a larger IPO allocation is unfair.
13. Jong Byun, CFA 是一名经纪人，向客户推荐各种投资，但法律上不负有受托责任。Byun 找到两只相似且适当的共同基金。其中一只与经纪人有更高的费用分成安排，故他向客户推荐该基金而非费用更低的那只。Byun 最可能是否违规？13. Jong Byun, CFA, is a broker who recommends various investments to his clients, but is not legally charged with a fiduciary responsibility. Byun finds two similar and appropriate mutual funds. One of the funds has a higher fee-sharing arrangement with the broker, so he recommends that fund to his clients over the fund with lower fees. Has Byun most likely violated the Standards? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 没有No
  • B. 违规，适当性准则Yes, the Standard relating to suitability
  • C. 违规，忠诚、审慎与关注准则Yes, the Standard relating to loyalty, prudence, and care
答案 C。Byun 虽无受托责任,仍受忠诚、审慎与关注约束:为更高分成推荐更贵的相似基金,损害客户利益 → 违规。Answer C. Even without fiduciary duty, Byun is bound by Loyalty, Prudence and Care: recommending the costlier of two similar funds for a higher payout harms the client → a violation.
14. Maria Estefan, CFA 近期创立 Inversiones Unidas (IU)。Estefan 在其前公司 Alto Investments (AI) 曾作为团队一员拥有5年基金管理业绩记录。Estefan 将其过去5年的业绩记录宣传为她在 IU 的业绩，既未提及 AI 也未提及她在 AI 团队中的角色。Estefan 最可能违反准则的行为是：14. Maria Estefan, CFA, recently founded Inversiones Unidas (IU). Estefan has a 5-year fund management track record as part of a team with her previous firm, Alto Investments (AI). Estefan advertises her past 5-year track record as her performance at IU without reference to AI or her role on the team at AI. Estefan most likely violates the Standards: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅未提及 AI 而宣传其业绩。only by advertising her performance without reference to AI.
  • B. 仅未提及她在 AI 团队中的角色而宣传其业绩。only by advertising her performance without reference to her role on the team at AI.
  • C. 既未提及 AI，又未提及其在 AI 团队中的角色。both by advertising her performance without reference to AI and by advertising her performance without reference to her role on the team at AI.
答案 C。Estefan 既未提 AI、也未提其在 AI 团队中的角色,却把团队业绩当作自己在 IU 的业绩 → 违反业绩陈述/不实陈述(须注明业绩取得于前公司及本人角色)。Answer C. Estefan violates by claiming the team's track record as her own at IU without mentioning AI or her role on the AI team → Performance Presentation/Misrepresentation (must attribute performance to the prior firm and her role).
15. Jan Ho, CFA 是一名顾问，为具有相似稳健增长目标的捐赠基金管理组合。他已充分研究并建议为客户组合购买一只交易清淡的股票。执行交易时，Ho 遵循其先为最大客户购买的政策。Ho 最可能违反下列哪一准则：15. Jan Ho, CFA, is an advisor who manages portfolios for endowment funds that share a similar goal of conservative growth. He has thoroughly researched and recommended the purchase of a thinly-traded stock for his clients’ portfolios. To execute the trades, Ho follows his policy of prioritizing purchases for his largest clients first. Ho has most likely violated the Standard relating to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 适当性。suitability.
  • B. 公平交易。fair dealing.
  • C. 交易优先。priority of transactions.
答案 B。Ho"先为最大客户买入交易清淡股"的政策 → 违反公平交易(所有相似目标的客户应被公平对待,不能按规模优先)。Answer B. Ho's policy of buying a thinly-traded stock for the largest client first violates Fair Dealing (all clients with similar objectives must be treated fairly, not by size).
16. Alicia Garcia, CFA 是一名经纪人。其公司分析师把对 Ajax Data (AD) 先前的"买入"建议改为"卖出"，Garcia 在公司网站上发布了这一变动。当天晚些时候，Garcia 的一位客户联系她，下单要求 Garcia 为其非全权委托账户买入 AD 股票。按公平交易准则，Garcia 应：16. Alicia Garcia, CFA, is a broker. Her firm’s analyst changes a prior "Buy" recommendation on Ajax Data (AD) to "Sell" and Garcia publishes the change on the firm’s website. Later that day, one of Garcia’s clients contacts her with an order directing Garcia to buy shares of AD for the client’s non-discretionary account. According to the Standard relating to fair dealing, Garcia should: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 拒绝执行该订单。refuse to execute the order.
