  • B. 在接受订单前告知客户建议已变动。advise the client of the recommendation change before accepting the order.
  • C. 因客户账户为非全权委托而接受并立即执行订单。accept and immediately execute the order because the client’s account is non-discretionary.
答案 B。评级已从"买入"改"卖出"并公布后,客户下单要买,Garcia 应在接受订单前告知客户"建议已变动"(公平交易 + 保护客户)。不必拒单,也不能因"非全权"就直接执行。Answer B. After the rating changed from Buy to Sell and was posted, if a client orders to buy, Garcia should inform the client of the changed recommendation before accepting the order (Fair Dealing + client protection). She need not refuse, nor execute blindly because it is non-discretionary.
17. Ria Preston, CFA 在一家投资公司工作。她的兄弟是公司的付费客户。Preston 为一只她认为适合公司所有客户的超额认购IPO分配股份。为避免潜在利益冲突，Preston 未把 IPO 股份分配给自己或她的兄弟。Preston 最可能是否违规？17. Ria Preston, CFA, works for an investment firm. Her brother is a fee-paying client of the firm. Preston allocates shares in an oversubscribed IPO that she considers suitable for all of her firm’s clients. To avoid potential conflicts of interest, Preston does not allocate shares from the IPO to herself or to her brother. Has Preston most likely violated the Standards? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 没有No
  • B. 违规，公平交易准则Yes, the Standard relating to fair dealing
  • C. 违规，勤勉与合理依据准则Yes, the Standard relating to diligence and reasonable basis
答案 B。Preston 因"把适合所有客户的超额认购 IPO 未分配给自己或兄弟"违反公平交易?——不,重点:她因兄弟是客户而把其排除在适合的 IPO 之外,反而"不公平"地剥夺了该客户应得的公平配售 → 违反公平交易(客户应被一视同仁)。Answer B. Preston violates Fair Dealing: by excluding her brother (a paying client) from a suitable IPO out of a misplaced conflict concern, she unfairly denies that client the pro-rata allocation he deserves — clients must be treated equally.
18. 某成员在一家投资公司工作，实施政策以确保软美元(soft dollars)的使用惠及客户。这些政策最可能是为遵守下列哪一准则而设：18. A member works for an investment firm and implements policies to ensure that the use of soft dollars benefits clients. These policies are most likely put in place to comply with the Standard relating to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 介绍费referral fees
  • B. 忠诚、审慎与关注loyalty, prudence, and care
  • C. 额外报酬安排additional compensation arrangements
答案 B。软美元(soft dollars)政策旨在确保用客户佣金买的研究"惠及客户" → 遵守忠诚、审慎与关注(客户资产/佣金为客户利益使用)。Answer B. Soft-dollar policies ensure that research bought with client commissions benefits clients → complying with Loyalty, Prudence and Care (client assets/commissions used for the client's benefit).
19. 按忠诚、审慎与关注准则的合规推荐程序，掌控客户资产的成员应：19. According to the recommended procedures for compliance with the Standard relating to loyalty, prudence, and care, a member who has control of client assets should: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 为其公司的最大利益投票代理表决。vote proxies in the best interests of her firm.
  • B. 向客户提交季度的逐项账户报表。submit quarterly itemized account statements to her clients.
  • C. 将客户资产与其他方资产合并以降低管理成本。combine her clients’ assets with other parties’ assets to reduce administrative costs.
答案 B。忠诚、审慎与关注的推荐程序:掌控客户资产者应向客户提交"季度逐项账户报表"。为公司(而非客户)最大利益投票、合并客户资产都违规。Answer B. A recommended Loyalty/Prudence/Care procedure: those with custody should send clients quarterly itemized account statements. Voting for the firm's (not clients') benefit or commingling client assets are violations.
20. Mark Joy, CFA 管理 Bank Ltd. (BL) 的养老基金。Joy 认为 BL 股票被高估。BL 的 CEO 要求 Joy 为 BL 养老基金购买 BL 股票以帮助阻止对 BL 的敌意收购。Joy 照办，其为养老基金购买 BL 股票帮助阻止了收购。随后 BL 股价上涨，也提高了 BL 养老基金的价值。Joy 最可能是否违反忠诚、审慎与关注准则？20. Mark Joy, CFA, manages the pension fund for Bank Ltd. (BL). Joy believes that BL stock is overvalued. BL’s CEO requests Joy purchase BL stock for BL’s pension fund to help prevent a hostile takeover of BL. Joy complies and his purchase of BL stock for the pension fund helps prevent the takeover. Subsequently, BL’s stock price increases, which also increases the value of BL’s pension fund. Has Joy most likely violated the Standard relating to loyalty, prudence, and care? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 没有No
  • B. 违规，因 BL 股票随后上涨Yes, because BL stock subsequently increased
  • C. 违规，因 Joy 照 CEO 的要求行事Yes, because Joy complies with the CEO’s request
答案 C。Joy 照 CEO 要求为养老基金买入他认为高估的本公司股票以阻止收购 → 违反忠诚、审慎与关注(受益人利益优先,而非雇主/管理层利益);事后股价上涨不改变违规性质。Answer C. Joy buying overvalued company stock for the pension at the CEO's request to block a takeover violates Loyalty, Prudence and Care (the beneficiaries' interest comes first, not the employer's/management's); the later price rise does not cure it.
21. 按忠诚、审慎与关注准则，受雇管理股票共同基金的成员：21. According to the Standard relating to loyalty, prudence, and care, a member who is hired to manage an equity mutual fund: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 在所有情况下都必须投票代理表决。is required to vote proxies in all instances.
  • B. 对雇用她担任基金经理的公司负有忠诚、审慎与关注义务。owes the duty of loyalty, prudence, and care to the firm who hired her to serve as fund manager.
  • C. 负有忠诚、审慎与关注义务，以符合既定授权(mandate)的方式投资。owes the duty of loyalty, prudence, and care to invest in a manner consistent with the stated mandate.
答案 C。受雇管理共同基金者,负忠诚、审慎与关注义务,须"以符合既定授权(mandate)的方式投资"。并非所有情况都须投票代理,义务也主要归于基金份额持有人而非雇主。Answer C. A mutual-fund manager owes Loyalty/Prudence/Care and must invest consistently with the stated mandate. Proxy voting is not always required, and the duty runs to the fund's shareholders, not the employer.
22. Alesha Alsagoff, CFA 受雇于 Acacia Papermill 管理其养老金计划。她须向计划受托人报告年度业绩结果。Alsagoff 的忠诚、审慎与关注义务主要归于：22. Alesha Alsagoff, CFA, is hired by Acacia Papermill to manage its pension plan. She must report annual performance results to the plan trustees. Alsagoff’s duty of loyalty, prudence, and care is primarily owed to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. Acacia Papermill 公司。Acacia Papermill.
  • B. 养老金计划受托人。the pension plan trustees.
  • C. 养老金计划的受益人。the beneficiaries of the pension plan.
答案 C。Alsagoff 管理养老金计划,其忠诚、审慎与关注义务主要归于"养老金计划的受益人"(而非发起公司或受托人)。Answer C. Managing a pension plan, Alsagoff's Loyalty/Prudence/Care duty is owed primarily to the plan beneficiaries (not the sponsoring company or the trustees).
23. 按适当性准则，成员须做下列哪项？23. According to the Standard relating to suitability, a member is required to do which of the following? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 在客户整体组合的背景下判断投资的适当性。Judge the suitability of an investment in the context of the client’s total portfolio.
  • B. 在对客户建议作任何变动后尽快更新客户的投资政策声明。Update a client’s investment policy statement as soon as possible after making any changes to recommendations for the client.
  • C. 既在整体组合背景下判断适当性，又仅在采取投资行动后才合理了解客户投资经验。Both judge the suitability of an investment in the context of the client’s total portfolio and make a reasonable inquiry into a client’s investment experience only after taking investment action.
答案 A。适当性准则要求在客户"整体组合"的背景下判断投资适当性(而非孤立看单笔)。须在"行动前"了解客户并适时更新 IPS(重大变动才更新),故 B、C 不准。Answer A. Suitability requires judging an investment's suitability in the context of the client's total portfolio (not in isolation). One must know the client before acting and update the IPS as warranted, so B and C are inaccurate.
24. Chris Taylor, CFA 是 Zenith Advisors (ZA) 的投资顾问。ZA 维护一份推荐股票清单，并为所有客户以整块交易购买新评级证券。Taylor 刚获得一位持有现有股票组合的新客户。在首次会面前，Taylor 在未从客户处收集额外信息的情况下按公司推荐股票清单重新配置了该组合。Taylor 最可能违反的准则是：24. Chris Taylor, CFA, is an investment advisor with Zenith Advisors (ZA). ZA maintains a list of recommended equity securities and purchases newly rated securities for all clients in block transactions. Taylor has just gained a new client who has an existing equity portfolio. Before their first meeting, Taylor reallocates the portfolio in accordance with the firm’s recommended equity list without gathering additional information from the client. Taylor most likely violated the Standard(s) relating: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅适当性。only to suitability.
  • B. 仅公平交易。only to fair dealing.
  • C. 适当性与公平交易两者。both to suitability and to fair dealing.
答案 A。Taylor 仅违反适当性:在首次会面前、未收集客户信息就按公司模型清单重配新客户组合(未确认适合该客户)。整块交易若公平分配不违反公平交易。Answer A. Taylor violates Suitability only: reallocating the new client's portfolio to the model list before meeting or gathering client information (no suitability basis). A fairly-allocated block does not breach Fair Dealing.
25. 按准则，在展示业绩结果时，成员应鼓励其公司：25. According to the Standards, when presenting performance results, members should encourage their firms to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 披露结果是税前还是税后。disclose whether the results are before or after tax.
  • B. 将已终止账户排除在业绩历史之外。exclude terminated accounts as part of performance history.
  • C. 用最具代表性的单一账户来展示结果。present the results using the most representative single account.
答案 A。业绩陈述的推荐做法:成员应鼓励公司披露"结果是税前还是税后"。排除已终止账户、用单一"代表性"账户都会误导,不当。Answer A. A recommended Performance Presentation practice: disclose whether results are before or after tax. Excluding terminated accounts or using a single "representative" account is misleading and improper.
26. 下列哪项是业绩陈述准则的合规推荐程序？成员应鼓励其公司：26. Which of the following is a recommended procedure for compliance with the Standard relating to performance presentation? Members should encourage their firms to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 在适用时说明业绩结果是模拟的。state, when applicable, that performance results are simulated.
  • B. 用一个代表性账户来展示综合业绩。use a representative account to present composite performance.
  • C. 对所有类型客户使用相同的业绩陈述报告。use identical performance presentation reports for all types of clients.
答案 A。业绩陈述的推荐程序:成员应鼓励公司"在适用时说明业绩是模拟(simulated)的"。用代表性账户、对所有客户用同一报告都不当。Answer A. A recommended Performance Presentation procedure: indicate when results are simulated/hypothetical. Using a representative account or the same report for all client types is improper.
27. 就适当性准则而言，作为共同基金组合经理的成员须：27. With respect to the Standard relating to suitability, members who are portfolio managers for a mutual fund are required to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 投资前考虑客户的情况和目标。consider clients’ circumstances and objectives before investing.
  • B. 以符合基金授权(mandate)的方式管理基金。manage the fund in a manner consistent with the fund’s mandate.
  • C. 收集投资者税务及其他投资约束的相关信息。gather information related to investors’ taxes and other investment constraints.
答案 B。共同基金经理须"以符合基金授权(mandate)的方式管理基金"(适当性针对基金策略,而非逐个投资者情况)。故 A、C(针对个人客户)不适用于基金经理。Answer B. A mutual-fund manager must manage the fund consistent with its mandate (suitability applies to the fund's strategy, not each investor's circumstances). So A and C (individual-client focus) do not apply to a fund manager.
28. Hemant Sampath, CFA 是财富经理。一家慈善机构联系他请求捐赠。Sampath 为保护客户保密拒绝分享现有客户信息。在与现有客户沟通时，Sampath 分享了该慈善机构的联系方式。他还把前客户的联系方式分享给了慈善机构。Sampath 是否违规？28. Hemant Sampath, CFA, is a wealth manager. He is contacted by a charity requesting donations. Sampath refuses to share information about existing clients to protect client confidentiality. While communicating with existing clients, Sampath shares contact details of the charity. He also shares contact details of former clients with the charity. Has Sampath violated the Standards? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 没有。No.
  • B. 违规，保密准则。Yes, the Standard relating to preservation of confidentiality.
  • C. 违规，与客户及潜在客户沟通准则。Yes, the Standard relating to communication with clients and prospective clients.
答案 B。Sampath 因"把前客户联系方式给慈善机构"违反保密准则(未经许可使用前客户信息)。向现有客户分享慈善机构信息不涉及泄露客户机密。Answer B. Sampath violates Confidentiality by giving a former client's contact details to the charity (using former-client information without permission). Sharing the charity's details with a current client discloses no client secret.
29. Emilio Torro, CFA 拥有一家小型投资公司。他向潜在客户发送宣传册，内容为："作为 CFA 持证人，Emilio Torro 将提供优于竞争对手的投资业绩。过去6年，Torro 每年都跑赢市场，未来也将继续如此。"Torro 最可能违反的准则是：29. Emilio Torro, CFA, owns a small investment firm. He sends a brochure to potential clients which states: "As a CFA charterholder, Emilio Torro will deliver better investment performance compared to the competition. Over the past 6 years, Torro has beaten the market in every single year and will continue to do so in the future." Torro has most likely violated the Standard(s) relating to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅业绩陈述。performance presentation only.
  • B. 仅关于 CFA 协会、CFA 称号及 CFA 项目的引用。reference to the CFA Institute, the CFA Designation, and the CFA Program only.
  • C. 业绩陈述与 CFA 引用两者。both performance presentation and reference to the CFA Institute, the CFA Designation, and the CFA Program.
答案 C。Torro 同时违反"业绩陈述"与"CFA 引用"两准则:保证"跑赢市场并将持续"(不实业绩承诺)+ 暗示 CFA 持证带来更优业绩(不当引用 CFA 称号)。Answer C. Torro violates both Performance Presentation and Reference to CFA: guaranteeing to "beat the market and continue to" (false performance promise) plus implying the CFA charter yields superior performance (improper reference).
30. Tom Oak, CFA 是高净值个人的顾问。Oak 客户的风险承受度从保守到激进不等。他推荐一只股票共同基金，招募书将其描述为"高增长高风险工具"。Oak 观察到该基金价格在过去三个季度波动很低。因此他援引低波动和优异回报潜力，建议每位客户把大比例组合投资于该基金。Oak 最可能违反的准则是：30. Tom Oak, CFA, is an advisor to high-net-worth individuals. The risk tolerances of Oak’s clients range from conservative to aggressive. He recommends an equity mutual fund which the prospectus describes as a "high-growth and high-risk vehicle." Oak observes that the volatility of the fund’s price has been very low over the past three quarters. He therefore recommends investing a large proportion of each client’s portfolio in the fund, citing the low volatility and excellent return potential. Oak has most likely violated the Standard(s) relating to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅适当性。only to suitability.
  • B. 仅不实陈述。only to misrepresentation.
  • C. 适当性与不实陈述两者。both to suitability and to misrepresentation.
答案 C。Oak 同时违反"适当性"与"不实陈述":据"招募书称高风险"却因近期低波动而让"每位客户大比例投入"(不适当),并把短期低波动当作低风险误导(不实)。Answer C. Oak violates both Suitability and Misrepresentation: recommending a "high-risk" fund in large weights to every client because of recent low volatility (unsuitable), and passing off short-term low volatility as low risk (misrepresentation).
31. Rayan Tengku, CFA 管理一只股票基金。在与潜在投资者交谈时，Tengku 把基金的平均历史业绩表述为投资者未来一年可预期的最低业绩。在发布最近季度基金报告后，Tengku 发现报告中有一处错误。他立即通过邮件把更正报告发给所有客户，然后只致电那些支付高端服务费用的客户讨论报告。Tengku 最可能违反的准则是：31. Rayan Tengku, CFA, manages an equity fund. When talking to potential investors, Tengku presents the fund’s average historical performance as the minimum performance investors can expect over the next year. After releasing the most recent quarterly fund report, Tengku finds an error in the report. He immediately sends the corrected report to all clients by e-mail and then calls only those clients who pay for premium services to discuss the report. Tengku has most likely violated the Standard(s) relating: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅公平交易。only to fair dealing.
  • B. 仅业绩陈述。only to performance presentation.
  • C. 公平交易与业绩陈述两者。both to fair dealing and to performance presentation.
答案 B。Tengku 仅违反业绩陈述:把"平均历史业绩"说成"未来一年最低业绩"(承诺未来)。更正报告先邮件发全体、再致电付费客户"讨论"通常不违反公平交易(评级已同时传达)。Answer B. Tengku violates Performance Presentation only: presenting average historical performance as the minimum future result (promising the future). Emailing the corrected report to all, then calling premium clients to discuss, generally does not breach Fair Dealing.
32. 下列哪项属于保密准则的合规推荐程序？
程序1向客户说明并非所有公司提供的资源都适合用于保密沟通。
程序2确保公司支持的沟通遵循旨在防止意外分发保密信息的做法。
32. Which of the following is among the recommended procedures for compliance with the Standard relating to preservation of confidentiality?
Procedure 1Convey to clients that not all firm-sponsored resources may be appropriate for confidential communications.
Procedure 2Ensure that firm-supported communications follow practices designed to prevent the accidental distribution of confidential information.
 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅程序1。Only Procedure 1.
  • B. 仅程序2。Only Procedure 2.
  • C. 程序1与程序2均是。Both Procedure 1 and Procedure 2.
答案 C。保密准则的推荐程序 = 程序1与程序2均是(按题给,如限制敏感信息知悉范围、妥善保管)。Answer C. Recommended Confidentiality procedures = both procedures 1 and 2 (per the listed items, e.g., limiting access to sensitive data and safeguarding it).
33. Jayson Kite, CFA 是一名资深分析师，正在准备一家航运公司的研究报告。Kite 认定该股是良好投资，决定给出"买入"建议。按合规推荐程序，Kite 应如何传达该建议：33. Jayson Kite, CFA, a senior analyst, is preparing a research report on a shipping company. Kite concludes that the stock is a good investment and decides to put a "buy" recommendation on the stock. According to the recommended procedures for compliance, Kite should communicate the recommendation: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 先在公司内部然后向客户。within the firm first and then to customers.
  • B. 先向客户然后在公司内部。to customers first and then within the firm.
  • C. 在公司内部与向客户同时进行。simultaneously within the firm and to customers.
答案 C。按公平交易的推荐做法,投资建议应"在公司内部与向客户同时传达"(避免内部人抢先)。Answer C. Per Fair Dealing recommendations, a recommendation should be communicated internally and to clients simultaneously (to prevent insiders front-running).

§4 Standard IV · 对雇主的责任§4 Standard IV · Duties to Employers

LOS 对应:LOS: demonstrate and explain appropriate conduct under Standard IV。
子条款Sub-provision要求 & 违规示例Requirement & violation example
IV(A) 忠诚IV(A) Loyalty在雇佣期间以雇主利益行事,不得损害雇主。离职相关:不得带走机密客户名单/文件;离职前不得招揽客户;但可依记忆的公开信息、准备(未实际展业)。违规:在职期间为将来单干挖客户。Act in the employer's interest during employment, not harming the employer. On leaving: must not take confidential client lists/documents; must not solicit clients before departure; but may use publicly known information from memory and prepare (without actually doing business). Violation: poaching clients for a future solo venture while still employed.
IV(B) 额外报酬安排IV(B) Additional Compensation Arrangements接受可能与雇主利益冲突的额外报酬/馈赠须获雇主书面同意。违规:客户私下承诺奖金而不告知雇主。Accepting additional compensation/gifts that may conflict with the employer's interest requires the employer's written consent. Violation: a client privately promising a bonus without telling the employer.
IV(C) 主管责任IV(C) Responsibilities of Supervisors主管须采取合理措施防止下属违规;发现须调查与纠正。违规:无有效合规制度、放任下属违规。Supervisors must take reasonable steps to prevent subordinates' violations; on discovery, investigate and correct. Violation: no effective compliance system, letting subordinates violate.

16. 离职时可以带走什么、不可以带走什么:What may and may not be taken when leaving a job: 官方题Official

  • A. 不可带走机密客户名单/公司文件/记录;可凭记忆的公开信息,离职后再展业May not take confidential client lists/company documents/records; may use public information from memory and solicit after leaving
  • B. 可带走全部客户名单May take the entire client list
  • C. 什么信息都不能使用May use no information at all
答案 A。机密资料归雇主,不得带走。Answer A. Confidential materials belong to the employer and cannot be taken.

17. 在职期间为自己将来创业招揽现雇主客户,违反:Soliciting the current employer's clients for one's own future startup while still employed violates: 官方题Official

  • A. IV(A) 对雇主的忠诚IV(A) Loyalty to Employer
  • B. III(A) 忠诚谨慎勤勉III(A) Loyalty, Prudence, Care
  • C. VI(C) 介绍费VI(C) Referral Fees
答案 A。在职期间损害雇主利益违反忠诚。Answer A. Harming the employer's interests while employed violates loyalty.

18. 接受客户私下奖金而不告知雇主,违反:Accepting a private bonus from a client without informing the employer violates: 官方题Official

  • A. IV(B) 额外报酬安排(须获雇主书面同意)IV(B) Additional Compensation Arrangements (requires the employer's written consent)
  • B. VI(C) 介绍费VI(C) Referral Fees
  • C. IV(A) 对雇主的忠诚IV(A) Loyalty to Employer
答案 A。额外报酬须经雇主书面同意。Answer A. Additional compensation requires the employer's written consent.

19. 主管未建立合规制度导致下属违规,违反:A supervisor failing to establish a compliance system, leading to a subordinate's violation, violates: 官方题Official

  • A. IV(C) 主管责任IV(C) Responsibilities of Supervisors
  • B. IV(A) 对雇主的忠诚IV(A) Loyalty to Employer
  • C. I(A) 熟知法律I(A) Knowledge of the Law
答案 A。主管有建立并执行合规制度的责任。Answer A. Supervisors are responsible for establishing and enforcing compliance.
1. 按（对雇主的）忠诚准则，下列哪项表述准确？
陈述1员工在所有事务中都必须将雇主利益置于个人利益之前。
陈述2成员公司的高级管理层应设计不诱发不道德行为的薪酬结构。
1. According to the Standard relating to loyalty (to employers), which of the following statements is accurate?
Statement 1Employees must place employer interests ahead of personal interests in all matters.
Statement 2Senior management of a member’s firm should create financial compensation structures that do not drive unethical behavior.
 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅陈述1。Statement 1 only.
  • B. 仅陈述2。Statement 2 only.
  • C. 陈述1与陈述2均是。Both Statement 1 and Statement 2.
答案 B。按对雇主的忠诚准则,仅陈述2准确(通常:仍在职时另立门户/独立业务须先通知雇主;不得挪用雇主财产)。Answer B. Under Loyalty to Employer, only statement 2 is accurate (typically: notify the employer before undertaking independent practice while still employed; do not misappropriate employer property).
2. 按（对雇主的）忠诚准则，成员必须：2. According to the Standard relating to loyalty, members must: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 在所有事务中将雇主利益置于个人利益之上。place their employer’s interest above their personal interests in all matters.
  • B. 在仍受雇期间从事独立业务前通知其雇主。notify their employer before engaging in an independent practice while still employed.
  • C. 在履行对客户义务时绝不违背雇主利益。never act against their employer’s interests when complying with their duties to clients.
答案 B。按对雇主的忠诚准则,成员"在仍受雇期间从事独立业务前须通知雇主"。并非任何时候都把雇主利益置于个人之上,履行对客户义务优先于雇主商业利益。Answer B. Under Loyalty to Employer, a member must notify the employer before undertaking independent practice while still employed. One need not always put the employer above oneself, and client duties take precedence over the employer's business interests.
3. 按（对雇主的）忠诚准则，在没有竞业协议且未取得雇主同意的情况下，成员可以：3. According to the Standard relating to loyalty, in the absence of a noncompete agreement and without employer consent, a member is permitted to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 离职时把客户名单用邮件发给自己。email himself a list of his clients when leaving his employer.
  • B. 在仍受雇期间开展独立的竞争性业务。enter into an independent competitive business while still employed.
  • C. 用公开信息联系前雇主的客户以在新公司招揽业务。contact clients from his previous employer using public information to solicit business at his new firm.
答案 C。无竞业协议且未获同意时,成员可"用公开信息联系前雇主客户以在新公司招揽"。带走客户名单、在职时开展竞争业务则违规。Answer C. With no non-compete and no consent, a member may contact former-employer clients using public information to solicit at the new firm. Taking a client list or running a competing business while employed is a violation.
4. 按督导责任准则的合规推荐程序，成员应鼓励其公司：4. According to the recommended procedures for compliance with the Standard relating to responsibilities of supervisors, members should encourage their firms to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 持续就公司所有合规程序对员工进行教育。continually educate personnel regarding all of the firm’s compliance procedures.
  • B. 将员工的职业行为评估与其绩效考核分开。separate employees’ professional conduct evaluations from their performance reviews.
  • C. 将公司合规程序整合进其道德准则以形成一份综合文件。integrate the firm’s compliance procedures into its code of ethics to provide a comprehensive document.
答案 A。督导责任的推荐程序:公司应"持续就所有合规程序对员工进行教育"。把行为评估与绩效考核分开、把合规并入道德准则成一份文件都不是推荐做法。Answer A. A recommended Responsibilities-of-Supervisors procedure: continually educate staff on all compliance procedures. Separating conduct from performance reviews or merging compliance into the code as one document are not recommended.
5. Jan Loots, CFA 从一家投资公司辞去组合经理职务，几年前他曾与该公司签署竞业招揽限制协议。Loots 获准带走其投资业绩记录，还带走了公司软件交易平台的副本。随后，Loots 在社交媒体上发布消息，宣布他在为其新投资管理公司寻找客户。Loots 的社交媒体仅限好友、家人和前客户访问。Loots 最不可能因下列哪项违反 CFA 协会职业行为准则：5. Jan Loots, CFA, quit his job as a portfolio manager at an investment firm with which he had a non-solicitation agreement signed several years ago. Loots received permission to take his investment performance history with him and also took a copy of the firm’s software-trading platform. Subsequently, Loots sent out messages on social media sites announcing he was looking for clients for his new investment management firm. Access to Loots’ social media sites is restricted to friends, family, and former clients. Loots least likely violated the CFA Institute Standards of Professional Conduct concerning his: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 交易软件。trading software.
  • B. 竞业招揽限制协议。non-solicitation agreement.
  • C. 投资业绩记录。investment performance history.
答案 C。Loots 最不可能因"投资业绩记录"违规(经允许可带走)。带走公司交易软件副本(挪用雇主财产)、违反竞业招揽限制协议才是违规。Answer C. Loots is least likely to violate over the performance record (he was permitted to take it). Taking a copy of the firm's trading software (misappropriating property) and breaching the non-solicit agreement are the violations.
6. Mark Monroe, CFA 是一家投资公司的股票分析师。业余时间，他为当地体育俱乐部做会计工作，作为回报，俱乐部免除其会费并支付其参加俱乐部社交活动的费用。Monroe 未向雇主披露该工作或报酬。Monroe 最可能是否违规？6. Mark Monroe, CFA, is an equity analyst at an investment firm. In his spare time, he performs accounting work for his local sports club in return for the club waiving his membership fees and paying his expenses to attend club social events. Monroe does not disclose either the work or the compensation to his employer. Has Monroe most likely violated the Standards? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 没有。No.
  • B. 违规，忠诚准则。Yes, the Standard relating to loyalty.
  • C. 违规，额外报酬安排准则。Yes, the Standard relating to additional compensation agreements.
答案 A。Monroe 没有违规:为体育俱乐部做兼职会计换取免会费/活动费,与雇主业务无冲突、无客户影响,题设未构成须披露的额外报酬冲突(通常与投资无关的小额安排)。Answer A. Monroe did not violate: doing club accounting for waived fees does not conflict with the employer's business or affect clients, so it is not a reportable additional-compensation conflict here.
7. Ming Xu, CFA 是 Topnotch Advisors (TNA) 的投资顾问。Xu 计划离开 TNA 并开办一家与 TNA 竞争的独立咨询业务。在未通知 TNA 其计划的情况下，Xu 在非工作时间为开办独立业务做准备。Xu 最可能是否违规？7. Ming Xu, CFA, is an investment advisor at Topnotch Advisors (TNA). Xu plans to leave TNA and start an independent advisory practice that would compete with TNA. Without notifying TNA of his plans, Xu makes preparations during non-working hours to start his independent practice. Has Xu most likely violated the Standards? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 没有No
  • B. 违规，忠诚准则Yes, the Standard relating to loyalty
  • C. 违规，冲突披露准则Yes, the Standard relating to disclosure of conflicts
答案 A。Xu 没有违规:仅在非工作时间"准备"独立业务、尚未与雇主竞争或损害其利益,不违反忠诚准则(准备不等于竞争;真正开展前须通知)。Answer A. Xu did not violate: merely preparing (on personal time) to start an independent business, without yet competing or harming the employer, does not breach Loyalty (preparation ≠ competition; notify before actually competing).
8. Max Cohen, CFA 收到一位缴纳高端费用客户提供的礼品。在接受礼品前，他取得了主管和赠礼客户的书面同意。他未向其常规费用客户披露该礼品。Cohen 是否违规？8. Max Cohen, CFA, is offered a gift by one of his premium-fee-paying clients. Prior to accepting the gift, he obtains written consent from his supervisor and the client offering the gift. He does not disclose the gift to his regular-fee-paying clients. Has Cohen violated the Standards? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 没有。No.
  • B. 违规，独立性与客观性准则。Yes, the Standard relating to independence and objectivity.
  • C. 违规，额外报酬安排准则。Yes, the Standard relating to additional compensation arrangements.
答案 A。Cohen 没有违规:接受高端客户礼品前已取得"主管和赠礼客户的书面同意",符合额外报酬安排准则;无需再向常规客户披露该礼品。Answer A. Cohen did not violate: he obtained written consent from his supervisor and the gifting client before accepting the gift, satisfying Additional Compensation; he need not disclose it to other clients.
9. 按督导责任准则，因公司合规系统不完善而无法履行督导职责的成员应：9. According to the Standard relating to responsibilities of supervisors, a member who cannot discharge supervisory responsibilities due to his firm’s inadequate compliance system should: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅书面拒绝接受督导责任。decline in writing to accept supervisory responsibility only.
  • B. 仅向 CFA 协会报告不完善的合规系统。report the inadequate compliance system to the CFA Institute only.
  • C. 既书面拒绝督导责任，又向 CFA 协会报告。both decline in writing to accept supervisory responsibility and report the inadequate compliance system to the CFA Institute.
答案 A。因合规系统不完善而无法有效督导,成员应"书面拒绝接受督导责任"直至系统改进。仅报告 CFA 协会不是要求的应对方式。Answer A. When an inadequate compliance system prevents effective supervision, a member should decline supervisory responsibility in writing until it is improved. Reporting to CFA Institute is not the required response.
10. 按准则，作为督导者的成员最可能须：10. According to the Standards, members who are supervisors are most likely required to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 深入了解准则。have in-depth knowledge of the Standards.
  • B. 持续亲自评估其所有员工的行为。personally evaluate the conduct of all of their employees on a continuing basis.
  • C. 向 CFA 协会报告其督导下任何员工的准则违规。report violations of the Standards by any employee under their supervision to CFA Institute.
答案 A。作为督导者,成员最可能须"深入了解准则"(以识别/防止违规)。不必"持续亲自评估所有员工",也不必把每一起违规上报 CFA 协会。Answer A. As a supervisor, a member must most likely have thorough knowledge of the Standards (to detect/prevent violations). One need not personally assess every employee continuously or report every violation to CFA Institute.
11. Bertram Kendall, CFA 是一家银行的投资顾问。Kendall 计划业余在当地大学教一门经济学课程，将获得费用报酬。此外，Kendall 计划为一家社区中心的捐赠基金担任投资顾问。社区中心不付酬，但作为回报给予他免费使用通常收费的健身设施。按准则，Kendall 须取得雇主书面同意的是：11. Bertram Kendall, CFA, is an investment advisor at a bank. Kendall plans to teach an economics course at a local university in his spare time, for which he will be paid a fee. In addition, Kendall plans to serve as an investment advisor for the endowment fund of a community center. Kendall will not be paid by the community center but will be given free access to its athletic facilities, which normally charge fees, in return for his services. According to the Standards, Kendall is required to obtain written consent from his employer: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅教授经济学课程。only for teaching the economics course.
  • B. 仅担任社区中心捐赠基金顾问。only for serving as an advisor for the community center endowment.
  • C. 既教授经济学课程，又担任社区中心捐赠基金顾问。both for teaching the economics course and for serving as an advisor for the community center endowment.
答案 B。Kendall 仅"担任社区中心捐赠基金顾问"须取得雇主书面同意——该角色以"免费健身"作报酬且与其投资专业相关,构成可能的利益冲突/额外报酬。教经济学课程通常无冲突。Answer B. Kendall must get written employer consent only for the endowment-adviser role — compensated with free gym use and related to his investment expertise, a potential conflict/additional compensation. Teaching economics is generally no conflict.
12. 下列哪个例子最可能违反准则？作为督导者的成员：12. Which of the following examples is most likely a violation of the Standards? A member who is a supervisor: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 把督导职责委派给监管其他员工的下属。delegates supervisory duties to subordinates who oversee other employees.
  • B. 依赖员工"以前的过错不会再发生"的陈述而不采取额外措施。relies on an employee’s statement that previous wrongdoing will not reoccur and takes no additional steps.
  • C. 虽已采取合理步骤实施有效合规程序，但未能发现所有违规。fails to detect all violations, although the member has taken reasonable steps to implement an effective compliance program.
答案 B。最可能违反督导责任的是"依赖员工‘过错不会再犯’的陈述而不采取额外措施"(未加强监督)。委派给下属、已尽合理步骤仍未发现全部违规则不违规。Answer B. The most likely supervision violation is relying on an employee's assurance that "it won't happen again" without further measures. Delegating to a subordinate, or failing to catch every violation despite reasonable steps, is not a violation.
13. 为符合准则，若成员被提供一个可能与其雇主利益冲突的额外有薪职位，他最可能须：13. To comply with the Standards, if a member is offered a paid position in addition to his current position that may conflict with his employer’s interests, he is most likely required to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 拒绝该职位。decline the position.
  • B. 在接受该职位前书面通知其雇主。notify his employer in writing before accepting the position.
  • C. 在接受该职位前取得所有相关方的书面同意。obtain written consent from all parties involved before accepting the position.
答案 C。面对可能与雇主冲突的额外有薪职位,成员须"在接受前取得所有相关方的书面同意"(额外报酬安排准则)。不必一律拒绝,仅通知不足。Answer C. For an additional paid position that may conflict with the employer, the member must obtain written consent from all parties before accepting (Additional Compensation). Outright refusal is unnecessary, and mere notice is insufficient.
14. 成员收到第三方的报酬要约，可能与其雇主产生利益冲突。按额外报酬安排准则，该成员最可能须：14. A member receives an offer of compensation from a third party that might create a conflict of interest with the member’s employer. According to the Standard relating to additional compensation arrangements, the member is most likely required to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 拒绝该要约。refuse the offer.
  • B. 仅向雇主披露该要约。only disclose the offer to the employer.
  • C. 在接受要约前取得所有相关方的书面同意。obtain written consent from all parties involved prior to accepting the offer.
答案 C。第三方报酬要约若可能与雇主冲突,须"在接受前取得所有相关方书面同意"。仅向雇主披露不够,也不必一律拒绝。Answer C. A third-party compensation offer that may conflict with the employer requires written consent from all parties before acceptance. Disclosing to the employer alone is insufficient; refusal is not required.
15. Anna Schulz, CFA 是证券分析师。她加入公司时，其经理 Zhang Feng, CFA 只告诉她"CFA 协会道德准则基本涵盖了公司的合规规则"。在个人账户中，Schulz 持有一家她向客户推荐买入公司的大量头寸。Schulz 未向公司或客户报告该持仓。准则最可能被违反的是：15. Anna Schulz, CFA, is a securities analyst. When she joined her firm, Schulz’s manager, Zhang Feng, CFA, informed her only that "the CFA Institute Code and Standards pretty much cover the company’s compliance rules." In her personal account, Schulz holds a large position in a company that she recommends for purchase to clients. Schulz does not report this holding to her firm or clients. The Standards were most likely violated: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅 Zhang。only by Zhang.
  • B. 仅 Schulz。only by Schulz.
  • C. Zhang 与 Schulz 均是。both by Zhang and by Schulz.
答案 C。Zhang 与 Schulz 均违规:Zhang 作为督导者未建立/传达充分合规规则(督导责任);Schulz 持有所荐股票的大量个人头寸却未披露(利益冲突/交易优先)。Answer C. Both Zhang and Schulz violate: Zhang, as supervisor, failed to establish/convey adequate compliance rules (Supervisors); Schulz held a large personal position in a recommended stock without disclosure (Conflicts/Priority of Transactions).

§5 Standard V · 投资分析、建议与行动§5 Standard V · Investment Analysis, Recommendations & Actions 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: demonstrate and explain appropriate conduct under Standard V。
子条款Sub-provision要求 & 违规示例Requirement & violation example
V(A) 勤勉与合理依据V(A) Diligence and Reasonable Basis投资分析/建议须有充分调查和合理、充分的依据。用第三方研究须核实其合理性。违规:凭传闻/未经核实的报告就推荐。Investment analysis/recommendations must have thorough investigation and a reasonable, adequate basis. Using third-party research requires verifying its soundness. Violation: recommending on hearsay/unverified reports.
V(B) 与客户沟通V(B) Communication with Clients披露投资流程、假设、局限与风险;区分事实与观点;及时告知重大变化。违规:把观点当事实、隐瞒重大风险。Disclose the investment process, assumptions, limitations, and risks; distinguish fact from opinion; promptly inform of material changes. Violation: presenting opinion as fact, hiding material risks.
V(C) 记录保存V(C) Record Retention保存支持分析、建议与行动的记录(通常建议至少 7 年);记录归雇主所有,离职不得带走。Keep records supporting analysis, recommendations, and actions (usually recommended at least 7 years); records belong to the employer and cannot be taken on departure.

20. 凭未经核实的小道消息就发出买入建议,违反:Issuing a buy recommendation based on unverified rumors violates: 官方题Official

  • A. V(A) 勤勉与合理依据V(A) Diligence and Reasonable Basis
  • B. V(B) 与客户沟通V(B) Communication with Clients
  • C. II(A) 重大非公开信息II(A) Material Nonpublic Information
答案 A。建议须建立在合理充分的依据上。Answer A. Recommendations must rest on a reasonable and adequate basis.

21. 把自己的主观判断当作既定事实告诉客户,违反:Telling a client one's own subjective judgment as established fact violates: 官方题Official

  • A. V(B) 与客户沟通(须区分事实与观点)V(B) Communication with Clients (must distinguish fact from opinion)
  • B. V(A) 勤勉与合理依据V(A) Diligence and Reasonable Basis
  • C. III(D) 业绩陈述III(D) Performance Presentation
答案 A。必须清楚区分事实与意见。Answer A. Fact and opinion must be clearly distinguished.

22. 研究记录归谁所有、建议保存多久:Who owns research records, and how long should they be kept: 官方题Official

  • A. 归雇主所有;通常建议至少保存 7 年(V(C))Owned by the employer; generally recommended to keep at least 7 years (V(C))
  • B. 归个人所有;保存 1 年Owned personally; kept 1 year
  • C. 归客户所有;无需保存Owned by the client; no need to keep
答案 A。记录归雇主并建议保存 7 年。Answer A. Records belong to the employer and are recommended to be kept 7 years.
1. Lisa Hajak, CFA 在 Cornerstone 乡村银行做了20年房地产研究，近期自立门户。一位前 Cornerstone 客户请她更新她在 Cornerstone 时所写的报告。Hajak 更新了该报告（她曾在银行不知情下将其拷贝到个人电脑），并把对银行的引用替换为自己的新公司。她还纳入了《华尔街日报》上刊登的房地产协会研究结论，但只标注了《华尔街日报》。就重新发布的报告而言，Hajak 最不可能因下列哪项而违规：1. Lisa Hajak, CFA, specialized in real estate research at Cornerstone Country Bank for twenty years. She recently started her own firm. A former Cornerstone client asks Hajak to update a report she wrote while at Cornerstone. Hajak updates the report, which she had copied to her personal computer without the bank’s knowledge, and replaces references to the bank with her new firm. She also incorporates conclusions of a real estate study by the Realtors Association that appeared in the Wall Street Journal, referencing only the Journal. Concerning the reissued report, Hajak least likely violated the Standards because she: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 招揽了银行的客户。solicited the bank’s client.
  • B. 未取得使用银行报告的同意。did not obtain consent to use the bank report.
  • C. 未标注房地产研究的实际来源。did not cite the actual source of the real estate study.
答案 A。Hajak 最不可能因"招揽银行客户"违规(用公开信息联系前客户、无竞业协议可行)。未经同意使用银行报告(挪用)、未标注房地产研究真实来源(不实归属)才是违规。Answer A. Hajak is least likely to violate by soliciting the bank's clients (contacting former clients via public information without a non-compete is allowed). Using the bank's report without consent (misappropriation) and failing to cite the true source (false attribution) are the violations.
2. 按勤勉与合理依据准则，成员须：2. According to the Standard relating to diligence and reasonable basis, a member is required to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 在分析投资时保持勤勉、独立和周密。exercise diligence, independence, and thoroughness in analyzing investments.
  • B. 成为投资建议所用模型技术层面的专家。become an expert in the technical aspects of the models used for investment recommendations.
  • C. 若集体报告不反映其观点则脱离并从报告中撤下自己的名字。dissociate and remove her name from a company group report if the report does not reflect her opinion.
答案 A。勤勉与合理依据要求成员"在分析投资时保持勤勉、独立和周密"。不必成为模型技术专家;若集体报告不反映己见,只要有合理依据,可保留署名(不必撤名)。Answer A. Diligence & Reasonable Basis requires diligence, independence, and thoroughness in analysis. One need not be a technical modeling expert, and may keep one's name on a group report with a reasonable basis (no need to withdraw).
3. 按准则，成员在其投资研究中使用定量模型时须：3. To use a quantitative model in her investment research, a member is required by the Standards to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 已开发或共同开发该模型。have developed or co-developed the model.
  • B. 成为他人所开发模型每个技术细节的专家。become an expert in every technical aspect of the model developed by others.
  • C. 理解他人所开发模型的固有假设和局限。understand the assumptions and limitations inherent in the model developed by others.
答案 C。使用他人开发的定量模型时,成员须"理解其固有假设与局限"(不必亲自开发或精通每个技术细节)。Answer C. When using a quantitative model developed by others, a member must understand its inherent assumptions and limitations (need not have built it or master every technical detail).
4. Emma Berkstein, CFA 用第三方数据撰写公司报告。她未亲自核验数据有效性，而是依赖资深同事进行尽职调查。另一分析师 Jimmy Brooks, CFA 与小组共同撰写行业报告。经充分研究，小组一致同意发布看好前景的报告。Brooks 不同意该结论，但保留了自己的署名。勤勉与合理依据准则最可能是否被违反？4. Emma Berkstein, CFA, uses third-party data to prepare a report on a company. Berkstein does not check the validity of this data herself but relies on her senior colleagues to conduct due diligence. Another analyst, Jimmy Brooks, CFA, prepares an industry report with a group. After thorough research, the group agrees to issue a positive-outlook report. Brooks disagrees with this conclusion but leaves his name in the report. Has the Standard relating to diligence and reasonable basis most likely been violated? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 没有。No.
  • B. 违规，Brooks。Yes, by Brooks.
  • C. 违规，Berkstein。Yes, by Berkstein.
答案 A。勤勉与合理依据没有被违反:Berkstein 依赖资深同事的尽职调查(合理依赖)有合理依据;Brooks 不同意结论但保留署名——只要有合理依据即可,保留署名不违规。Answer A. Diligence & Reasonable Basis is not violated: Berkstein reasonably relied on a senior colleague's due diligence, and Brooks may keep his name on a report he disagrees with as long as there is a reasonable basis.
5. 按勤勉与合理依据准则的合规推荐程序，成员应鼓励其公司：5. According to the recommended procedures for compliance with the Standard relating to diligence and reasonable basis, members should encourage their firms to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 对每个外部顾问定制评估标准来评估其充分性。evaluate the adequacy of external advisers by customizing the evaluation criteria for each adviser.
  • B. 为评估金融工具所用的所有计算机模型设定情景测试的上限水平。establish maximum levels of scenario testing of all computer-based models used in evaluating financial instruments.
  • C. 指定一名督导分析师在对外发布前判定研究报告是否有合理充分的依据。appoint a supervisory analyst to determine whether research reports have a reasonable and adequate basis prior to external circulation.
答案 C。勤勉与合理依据的推荐程序:公司应"指定一名督导分析师在发布前判定研究是否有合理充分的依据"。为每个顾问定制标准、设情景测试上限都非推荐做法。Answer C. A recommended Diligence procedure: designate a supervisory analyst to determine whether research has an adequate/reasonable basis before dissemination. Custom criteria per adviser or capping scenario tests are not recommended.
6. Meera Doka, CFA 管理一只股票基金。某日，基金因所有市场参与者都未预见的事件遭受巨大损失。在该事件前，Doka 未向客户披露此事件发生的风险。一个月后，Doka 决定将基金5%的资产外包给外部经理。因外部经理采用非常相似的投资流程，她未告知客户这一变动。Doka 的行为是否符合与客户沟通准则？6. Meera Doka, CFA, manages an equity fund. One day, the fund experiences a large loss due to an event unforeseen by all market participants. Prior to the event, Doka failed to disclose the risk of this event occurring to her clients. One month later, Doka decides to outsource 5% of the fund’s assets to an external manager. She does not inform her clients of this change because the external manager follows a very similar investment process. Are Doka’s actions consistent with the Standard relating to communication with clients? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 是Yes
  • B. 否，因她未披露导致巨大损失的风险No, because she failed to disclose the risk that resulted in the large loss
  • C. 否，因她未告知客户外包了基金5%的资产No, because she failed to inform her clients about outsourcing 5% of the fund’s assets
答案 C。Doka 因"未告知客户外包了 5% 资产"违反与客户沟通准则(重大变动须披露,即使流程相似)。未预见的市场事件风险无法事先披露,不构成违规。Answer C. Doka violates Communication with Clients by not informing them she outsourced 5% of assets (a material change must be disclosed, even if the process is similar). The unforeseeable market event could not be disclosed in advance.
7. 按与客户及潜在客户沟通准则，成员必须：7. According to the Standard related to communication with clients and prospective clients, members must: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅在展示投资分析时区分事实与意见。only distinguish between fact and opinion in the presentation of investment analyses.
  • B. 仅及时披露其选股投资流程中的重大与非重大变动。only promptly disclose material and nonmaterial changes in the investment processes they use to select securities.
  • C. 既区分事实与意见，又及时披露重大与非重大流程变动。both distinguish between fact and opinion in the presentation of investment analyses and promptly disclose material and nonmaterial changes in the investment processes they use to select securities.
答案 A。与客户沟通准则要求成员"仅在展示投资分析时区分事实与意见"。须披露"重大"流程变动(非重大不必及时披露),故 B、C 措辞过宽。Answer A. Communication with Clients requires distinguishing fact from opinion when presenting analysis. One must disclose material process changes (immaterial ones need not be reported promptly), so B and C overstate the duty.
8. 对外部经理的选择采用标准化标准，是下列哪一准则的要求：8. Applying standardized criteria for the selection of external managers is a requirement of the Standard relating to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 适当性。suitability.
  • B. 独立性与客观性。independence and objectivity.
  • C. 勤勉与合理依据。diligence and reasonable basis.
答案 C。"对外部经理选择采用标准化标准" = 勤勉与合理依据(Diligence and Reasonable Basis)的要求(以确保尽职、有依据地选聘)。Answer C. Using standardized criteria to select external managers is a requirement of Diligence and Reasonable Basis (to ensure a sound, evidence-based selection).
9. Sue Yong, CFA 是大型投资公司的分析师。经充分研究，她对一家公司发出"买入"评级并提交给公司投资委员会审查。委员会不同意她报告中的假设，结果报告被改为"中性"评级。最终报告发布，Yong 同意在报告上保留自己的名字。Yong 是否违规？9. Sue Yong, CFA, is an analyst at a large investment firm. After thorough research, she issues a "buy" rating on a company and submits her report to her firm’s investment committee for review. The committee disagrees with Yong’s assumptions in the report. As a result, the report is changed to a "neutral" rating. The final report is issued and Yong agrees to leave her name on the report. Has Yong violated the Standards? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 没有。No.
  • B. 违规，忠诚、审慎与关注准则。Yes, the Standard relating to loyalty, prudence, and care.
  • C. 违规，勤勉与合理依据准则。Yes, the Standard relating to diligence and reasonable basis.
答案 A。Yong 没有违规:她研究充分、有合理依据;委员会改变结论后她"同意"保留署名,说明她认可最终报告(有合理依据即可署名),故不违反勤勉准则。Answer A. Yong did not violate: she had a reasonable basis; after the committee changed the conclusion, she agreed to keep her name, indicating she stands by the final report (allowed when a reasonable basis exists).
10. 受雇于投资公司的成员应客户要求进行研究。该研究的记录属于：10. A member employed by an investment firm carries out research at the request of a client. The records of that research are the property of the: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 客户。client.
  • B. 成员本人。member.
  • C. 该投资公司。investment firm.
答案 C。应客户要求所做的研究,其记录属于"该投资公司(雇主)"(工作产出归公司,除非法律另有规定)。Answer C. Research done at a client's request — the records belong to the investment firm (employer) (work product belongs to the firm unless law provides otherwise).
11. Michael Butcher, CFA 近期加入 Patriot Investments (PI) 任投资经理。Butcher 用从公开来源收集的信息，为在 PI 的投资建议重建其前公司的支持记录。Butcher 还审查客户头寸，并常规删除那些未导致变动的审查记录。Butcher 最可能违反准则的行为是：11. Michael Butcher, CFA, has recently joined Patriot Investments (PI) as an investment manager. With information gathered from public sources, Butcher re-creates supporting records from his former firm for investment recommendations at PI. Butcher also reviews client positions and routinely deletes records of the reviews that do not result in a change. Butcher has most likely violated the Standards: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅删除未导致变动的审查记录。only by deleting the reviews that do not result in a change.
  • B. 仅重建投资建议的支持记录。only by re-creating supporting records for investment recommendations.
  • C. 既删除未导致变动的审查，又重建支持记录。both by deleting the reviews that do not result in a change and by re-creating supporting records for investment recommendations.
答案 A。Butcher 仅因"删除未导致变动的审查记录"违规(记录保存:审查记录须保留)。用公开信息重建前公司支持记录是允许的。Answer A. Butcher violates only by deleting review records that led to no change (Record Retention requires keeping them). Recreating a prior firm's support records from public information is allowed.
12. Anna Yeung, CFA 是 TL Securities (TLS) 的研究分析师。TLS 没有记录保存政策，适用法律也不要求保留记录。Yeung 仅以电子形式保留其工作记录，并删除超过三年的记录。Yeung 的行为是否符合记录保存准则的合规推荐？12. Anna Yeung, CFA, is a research analyst with TL Securities (TLS). TLS does not have a policy on record retention, and applicable law does not require retaining records. Yeung only retains her work records electronically and deletes records older than three years. Are Yeung’s actions consistent with the recommendations for compliance with the Standard relating to record retention? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 是。Yes.
  • B. 否，因她仅以电子形式保留记录。No, because she only retains her work records electronically.
  • C. 否，因她删除超过三年的记录。No, because she deletes her records that are older than three years.
答案 C。Yeung 因"删除超过三年的记录"不符合记录保存推荐(建议至少保留 7 年)。仅电子形式保存本身可接受。Answer C. Yeung does not comply because she deletes records older than three years (the recommendation is at least seven years). Keeping records only electronically is acceptable.
13. 在没有法规或公司政策的情况下，准则建议投资相关记录至少保留：13. In the absence of regulations or firm policies, the Standards recommend retaining investment-related records for a minimum of: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 五年。five years.
  • B. 七年。seven years.
  • C. 十年。ten years.
答案 B。无法规/公司政策时,准则建议投资相关记录至少保留"七年"。Answer B. Absent regulation/firm policy, the Standards recommend retaining investment-related records for at least seven years.
14. Herman Standish, CFA 是半导体行业的顶级分析师。Standish 向公司客户发布关于 International Chips (IC) 的报告，重点指出他把评级从"持有"改为"强力买入"。他在报告中写道："正如过去两年一样，IC 将使其盈利和股利翻番。"三个工作日后，Standish 把报告发给财经媒体。Standish 最可能违反下列哪一准则？14. Herman Standish, CFA, is a top analyst in the semiconductor industry. Standish issues a report on International Chips (IC) to clients of his firm that highlights a change in his recommendation from "hold" to "strong buy." He writes in the report: "Just as it has in the past two years, IC will double its earnings and its dividend." After three business days, Standish releases the report to the business press. Which of the following Standards has Standish most likely violated? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅重大非公开信息准则。Only the Standard relating to material nonpublic information.
  • B. 仅与客户及潜在客户沟通准则。Only the Standard relating to communication with clients and prospective clients.
  • C. 重大非公开信息准则与沟通准则两者。Both the Standard relating to material nonpublic information and the Standard relating to communication with clients and prospective clients.
答案 B。Standish 仅违反"与客户沟通"准则:"IC 将使盈利和股利翻番"把预测当事实/保证(未区分事实与意见)。使用非重大非公开信息+公开数据(马赛克)不违反 MNPI;三天后给媒体不影响。Answer B. Standish violates Communication with Clients only: "IC will double earnings and dividends" states a projection as fact/guarantee (fact vs opinion). Using non-material non-public plus public data (mosaic) does not breach MNPI.
15. 一名参加 CFA 二级考试的候选人在一家经纪公司做无薪实习期间开发了一个分析模型。在完成实习前，该候选人复制了用于创建该模型的支持文件，打算在她预计不久后加入的新公司重建该模型。该候选人是否违规？15. A candidate taking the CFA Level II exam develops an analytical model while working as an unpaid intern at a brokerage firm. Before completing her internship, the candidate copies supporting documents used to create the model with an intention to recreate the model at a new firm she expects to join soon. Has the candidate violated the Standards? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 没有。No.
  • B. 违规，仅记录保存准则。Yes, the Standard relating to record retention only.
  • C. 违规，记录保存准则与忠诚准则两者。Yes, the Standard relating to record retention and the Standard relating to loyalty.
答案 C。该候选人同时违反"记录保存"与"对雇主的忠诚":复制实习期间的支持文件带去新公司(挪用雇主工作产出 + 记录归属)。无薪实习不改变忠诚义务。Answer C. The candidate violates both Record Retention and Loyalty to Employer: copying the internship's support files to recreate the model at a new firm (misappropriating work product). An unpaid internship does not change the loyalty duty.
16. 为符合记录保存准则，成员应保留下列哪些记录？
项目1发布在社交媒体上的建议变动。
项目2未导致建议变动的材料审查。
16. To be consistent with the Standard relating to record retention, a member should maintain records of which of the following?
Item 1A change in recommendation posted on social media.
Item 2Reviews of materials that do not lead to a change in recommendation.
 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅项目1。Item 1 only.
  • B. 仅项目2。Item 2 only.
  • C. 项目1与项目2均是。Both Item 1 and Item 2.
答案 C。为符合记录保存准则,成员应保留"项目1与项目2均是"(按题给,支持研究结论与投资行动的记录)。Answer C. To comply with Record Retention, a member should keep both items 1 and 2 (per the listed items — records supporting research conclusions and investment actions).
17. 关于使用杠杆、板块或行业风险及证券特定风险的披露，最可能包含在下列哪一准则中：17. Disclosures about the use of leverage, sector or industry risk, and security-specific risk are most likely included in the Standard relating to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 独立性与客观性。independence and objectivity.
  • B. 督导责任。responsibilities of supervisors.
  • C. 与客户及潜在客户沟通。communication with clients and prospective clients.
答案 C。关于"杠杆、板块/行业风险、证券特定风险"的披露,属"与客户及潜在客户沟通(Communication)"准则(须披露投资流程与重大风险)。Answer C. Disclosures about leverage, sector/industry risk, and security-specific risk fall under Communication with Clients and Prospective Clients (disclosing the process and material risks).

§6 Standard VI · 利益冲突§6 Standard VI · Conflicts of Interest 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: demonstrate and explain appropriate conduct under Standard VI。
子条款Sub-provision要求 & 违规示例Requirement & violation example
VI(A) 披露冲突VI(A) Disclosure of Conflicts充分、公允地披露所有可能影响独立性的利益冲突(如自持股票、投行关系),用清晰语言、显著位置。违规:推荐自己重仓的股票却不披露持仓。Fully and fairly disclose all conflicts of interest that may impair independence (e.g., self-held stock, investment-banking relationships), in clear language and a prominent place. Violation: recommending a stock one holds heavily without disclosing the position.
VI(B) 交易优先顺序VI(B) Priority of Transactions客户 > 雇主 > 个人。客户和雇主交易须优先于本人相关账户。违规:抢在客户单之前为自己账户成交(front-running)。Clients > employer > self. Client and employer transactions must take priority over one's own related accounts. Violation: front-running by trading one's own account ahead of a client order.
VI(C) 介绍费VI(C) Referral Fees收取或支付的介绍费(referral fee)须向客户和雇主披露,让客户评估其对公正性的影响。违规:推荐某托管行而隐瞒对方给的回扣。Referral fees received or paid must be disclosed to clients and the employer, letting clients assess the impact on impartiality. Violation: recommending a custodian while hiding the kickback received.

补充——封锁期(blackout period):准则 VI(B) 的推荐程序之一。参与投资决策的人员应在为客户交易前设立封锁期,期间禁止本人相关账户交易,以防止利用对客户交易的了解进行抢先交易(front-running)。Supplement — blackout period: one of the recommended procedures under Standard VI(B). Personnel involved in investment decisions should establish a blackout period before trading for clients, during which their own related-account trading is prohibited, to prevent front-running using knowledge of client trades.

考点·利益冲突披露与返点(revenue-sharing):成员/公司须向客户显著、事前披露可能影响客观性的利益,例如:公司从某些类别共同基金收取的服务费返点(revenue-sharing)、分析师自持所荐证券、投行关系、董事职位。
介绍费安排(即使是无现金、部门间的激励)也须披露其性质与预估金额,且时点在「介绍时」,以便客户评估全部成本。Exam - disclosure of conflicts & revenue-sharing: a member/firm must disclose, prominently and in advance, interests that could impair objectivity, e.g., revenue-sharing received from certain mutual-fund classes, an analyst's own holdings in a recommended security, investment-banking relationships, and board seats.
Referral arrangements (even non-cash, inter-department incentives) must disclose their nature and estimated amount, at the time of the referral, so the client can assess the full cost.

23. 推荐自己大量持有的股票却不披露持仓,违反:Recommending a stock one holds heavily without disclosing the position violates: 官方题Official

  • A. VI(A) 披露利益冲突VI(A) Disclosure of Conflicts
  • B. VI(B) 交易优先顺序VI(B) Priority of Transactions
  • C. III(A) 忠诚谨慎勤勉III(A) Loyalty, Prudence, Care
答案 A。自有持仓构成利益冲突须披露。Answer A. A personal holding is a conflict of interest that must be disclosed.

24. 交易优先顺序的正确排序是:The correct priority-of-transactions order is: 官方题Official

  • A. 雇主 > 客户 > 本人Employer > clients > self
  • B. 客户 > 雇主 > 本人(个人账户最后)Clients > employer > self (personal account last)
  • C. 本人 > 客户 > 雇主Self > clients > employer
答案 B。客户利益优先,个人账户最后。Answer B. Client interests come first, personal accounts last.

25. 抢在客户大单成交前为自己账户买入,违反:Buying for one's own account ahead of a client's large order being executed violates: 官方题Official

  • A. VI(B) 交易优先顺序(front-running)VI(B) Priority of Transactions (front-running)
  • B. VI(A) 披露利益冲突VI(A) Disclosure of Conflicts
  • C. II(B) 市场操纵II(B) Market Manipulation
答案 A。抢先交易违反交易优先顺序。Answer A. Front-running violates priority of transactions.

26. 收受介绍费却不告知客户,违反:Accepting a referral fee without informing the client violates: 官方题Official

  • A. VI(C) 介绍费(须向客户和雇主披露)VI(C) Referral Fees (must disclose to clients and employer)
  • B. IV(B) 额外报酬安排IV(B) Additional Compensation Arrangements
  • C. VI(A) 披露利益冲突VI(A) Disclosure of Conflicts
答案 A。介绍费须向客户与雇主披露。Answer A. Referral fees must be disclosed to clients and the employer.
1. Hannah Hostettler, CFA 是组合经理。她与一位律师有安排：她把需要法律建议的客户介绍给该律师，该律师又把客户介绍给她。因不涉及介绍费，Hostettler 未向其现有或潜在客户披露此安排。Hostettler 最可能是否违规？1. Hannah Hostettler, CFA, is a portfolio manager. She has an arrangement with a lawyer whereby she refers clients needing legal advice to the lawyer, who in turn refers clients to Hostettler. Because no referral fees are involved, Hostettler does not disclose this arrangement to her existing or prospective clients. Has Hostettler most likely violated the Standards? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 没有。No.
  • B. 违规，仅因未向现有客户披露该安排。Yes, only by failing to disclose the arrangement to existing clients.
  • C. 违规，既未向现有客户也未向潜在客户披露该安排。Yes, both by failing to disclose the arrangement to existing clients and to prospective clients.
答案 C。Hostettler 与律师的相互介绍安排,即使无介绍费,也须"向现有与潜在客户披露"(利益冲突/介绍安排)。仅披露给现有客户不足。Answer C. Hostettler's mutual referral arrangement, even without a fee, must be disclosed to both existing and prospective clients (a referral arrangement/conflict). Disclosing only to existing clients is insufficient.
2. Thomas Huang, CFA 是 Newline Partners (NP) 的投资顾问。NP 与经纪公司 Ridge Capital (RC) 有协议：Huang 为获取报酬将客户介绍给 RC，RC 就介绍向 NP 支付现金费用。签订正式协议前，Huang 向 NP 客户披露："请注意 Newline Partners 因介绍客户每年从 Ridge Capital 获得现金百分比费用。"Huang 省略了对预估金额的披露。Huang 是否违规？2. Thomas Huang, CFA, is an investment advisor for Newline Partners (NP). NP has an agreement with brokerage firm Ridge Capital (RC): Huang refers clients to RC for compensation, and RC pays a cash fee to NP for referrals. Before entering formal agreements, Huang discloses to NP’s clients: "Please note that Newline Partners receives an annual cash percentage fee from Ridge Capital for the referral of clients." Huang omits disclosure of the estimated dollar value. Has Huang violated the Standards? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 没有。No.
  • B. 违规，因接受介绍客户的现金费用。Yes, by accepting a cash fee for referral of clients.
  • C. 违规，因未披露该费用的预估金额。Yes, by not disclosing the estimated dollar value of the fee.
答案 C。Huang 因"未披露介绍费的预估金额"违规(介绍安排须披露费用性质与"预估金额")。接受现金介绍费本身在披露后允许。Answer C. Huang violates by omitting the estimated amount of the referral fee (referral arrangements require disclosing the nature and the estimated value). Accepting a cash referral fee is allowed once disclosed.
3. 按交易优先准则的合规推荐程序，成员应：3. According to the recommended procedures for compliance with the Standard relating to priority of transactions, members should: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 劝阻客户在封锁期内交易。discourage clients from trading during blackout periods.
  • B. 应要求向客户提供其个人证券交易副本。supply copies of their personal securities transactions to clients upon request.
  • C. 即使参与IPO与客户利益无冲突，也预先审批其IPO参与。preclear their participation in IPOs even if there is no conflict of interest between their participation in an IPO and the client’s interests.
答案 C。交易优先准则的推荐程序:成员应"即使参与 IPO 与客户无冲突,也预先审批其 IPO 参与"。劝阻客户封锁期交易、应要求提供个人交易副本(应主动)措辞不准。Answer C. A recommended Priority-of-Transactions procedure: pre-clear participation in IPOs even when there is no client conflict. Discouraging client trades in blackout periods, or providing personal-trade copies only on request, are inaccurate.
4. Sharon Chan, CFA 是分析师。Chan 对一家其兄弟持有股份的公司发出"买入"评级。因她对兄弟的账户无受益所有权，故未在报告中披露兄弟的持股。Chan 是否违规？4. Sharon Chan, CFA, is an analyst. Chan issues a "buy" rating on a company in which her brother holds shares. Chan does not disclose her brother’s holdings in her report as she has no beneficial ownership in her brother’s account. Has Chan violated the Standards? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 没有No
  • B. 违规，冲突披露准则Yes, the Standard relating to disclosure of conflicts
  • C. 违规，与客户及潜在客户沟通准则Yes, the Standard relating to communication with clients and prospective clients
答案 A。Chan 没有违规:她对兄弟的账户"无受益所有权",故兄弟持股不构成她须披露的个人利益冲突。Answer A. Chan did not violate: she has no beneficial ownership in her brother's account, so his holding is not a personal conflict she must disclose.
5. 某成员在其公司管理两个付费的家庭账户。该成员对账户1所持股份有表决权，对账户2所持股份有出售裁量权。按准则，该成员是否被视为其家庭账户所持股份的受益所有人？5. A member manages two fee-paying family accounts at her firm. The member has the power to vote on the shares held in Account 1 and the discretion to sell shares held in Account 2. According to the Standards, is the member considered a beneficial owner of the shares held in her family accounts? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 否No
  • B. 是，仅账户1Yes, for Account 1 only
  • C. 是，账户1和账户2均是Yes, for both Account 1 and Account 2
答案 C。对账户1有"表决权"、对账户2有"出售裁量权",两者都构成受益所有权(beneficial ownership) → 账户1和账户2均是(控制/裁量即视为受益所有)。Answer C. Having voting authority over account 1 and sale discretion over account 2 both constitute beneficial ownership → both accounts (control/discretion counts as beneficial ownership).
6. Amanda Covington, CFA 在 McJan 投资管理公司工作。按合规程序，McJan 员工的个人投资须事先获批，需提交书面申请注明证券、数量和经纪商。获批交易仅在当日有效。Covington 已获事先批准如下：
证券数量经纪商事先获批
A100Easy Trade是
B150Easy Trade是
获批两天后，B 股价格下跌，Covington 决定仅购买250股 B 股。在其购买250股 B 股的决定中，Covington 是否违反准则？6. Amanda Covington, CFA, works for McJan Investment Management. McJan employees must receive prior clearance of personal investments per compliance procedures, providing a written request identifying the security, quantity, and broker. Pre-cleared transactions are approved only for that trading day. Covington received prior clearance as shown:
SecurityQuantityBrokerPrior Clearance
A100Easy TradeYes
B150Easy TradeYes
Two days after she received prior clearance, the price of Stock B had decreased, so Covington decided to purchase 250 shares of Stock B only. In her decision to purchase 250 shares of Stock B, did Covington violate any Standards? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 没有。No.
  • B. 违规，勤勉与合理依据。Yes, relating to diligence and reasonable basis.
  • C. 违规，其雇主的合规程序。Yes, relating to her employer’s compliance procedures.
答案 C。Covington 因"只买 250 股(与获批不符)"违反雇主合规程序(获批交易须按申请执行,变更数量需重新申请)。这与勤勉无关。Answer C. Covington violates her employer's compliance procedures by buying only 250 shares (differing from what was pre-cleared) (a changed quantity needs re-approval). This is not a Diligence issue.
7. Wang Dazong, CFA 是独资投资顾问。Dazong 主张与客户一同承担风险，交易与客户相同的证券。为确保所有账户公平，他轮换交易分配，使每个账户成交机会均等。该分配程序也适用于 Dazong 自己的账户。按道德准则，Dazong 所用的分配程序：7. Wang Dazong, CFA, is a sole-proprietor investment advisor. Dazong believes in putting his money at risk along with his clients and trades the same securities as his clients. To ensure fair treatment of all accounts, he rotates trade allocations so that each account has an equal likelihood of receiving a fill on their orders. This allocation procedure also applies to Dazong’s own account. According to the Code and Standards, the allocation procedure used by Dazong: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 符合准则。complies with the Standards.
  • B. 需修订以确保客户交易优先。requires revision to ensure client trades take precedence.
  • C. 应披露并取得客户书面批准。should be disclosed and written approval received from clients.
答案 B。Dazong 让"自己账户与客户账户轮换均等成交" → 需修订以确保"客户交易优先"(个人交易不得与客户平起平坐,须让客户优先)。Answer B. Dazong's equal rotation including his own account must be revised to ensure client transactions come first (personal trades cannot rank equally with clients'; clients get priority).
8. 下列哪项是交易优先准则的合规推荐程序？投资人员应：8. Which of the following is a recommended procedure for compliance with the Standard relating to priority of transactions? Investment personnel should: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 在成交后立即检查所有个人交易的潜在冲突。examine all personal trades for possible conflicts immediately after execution of the trades.
  • B. 指示其经纪商向公司提供其所有个人证券交易的副本确认单。direct their brokers to supply their firms with duplicate confirmations of all their personal securities transactions.
  • C. 在受雇关系开始时一次性向公司披露其有受益权益的持仓。make a one-time disclosure of holdings in which they have a beneficial interest to their firm upon commencement of the employment relationship.
答案 B。交易优先的推荐程序:投资人员应"指示经纪商向公司提供其所有个人证券交易的副本确认单"(便于监控)。成交后才查、仅一次性披露都不够。Answer B. A recommended Priority-of-Transactions procedure: direct brokers to supply the firm with duplicate confirmations of all personal securities transactions (for monitoring). Checking only after execution, or a one-time disclosure, is insufficient.
9. 按冲突披露准则，成员应：9. According to the Standard relating to disclosure of conflicts, a member should: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 拒绝在其公司计划发起研究报告的公司中任董事职位。reject a board position in a company on which the member’s firm is planning to initiate a research report.
  • B. 确保其公司向客户披露从某些类别共同基金向投资者收取的服务费中获得的返点。ensure that her firm discloses to clients any rebates received from the service fee some classes of mutual funds charge to investors.
  • C. 若其公司持有某公司股份的期权，则将该公司列入受限名单并只发布事实信息。place a company on a restricted list and issue factual information about the company if the member’s firm holds options on the company’s shares.
答案 B。冲突披露准则:成员应"确保公司向客户披露从某些类别共同基金收取的服务费返点(revenue-sharing)"。任董事、期权持仓等要披露而非一律拒绝/限制。Answer B. Under Disclosure of Conflicts: a member should ensure the firm discloses revenue-sharing/service fees received from certain mutual-fund classes. Board seats or option holdings are to be disclosed, not automatically refused/restricted.
10. 下列哪项是交易优先准则的合规推荐程序？
程序1成员应应要求向客户披露涉及其公司研究范围内股份的个人交易。
程序2成员应在为客户交易前设立封锁期。
程序3成员应将其有受益所有权的付费家庭账户与其个人账户同等对待。
10. Which of the following is a recommended procedure for compliance with the Standard relating to priority of transactions?
Procedure 1Members should disclose personal transactions relating to shares in their firm’s research universe to clients upon request.
Procedure 2Members should establish blackout periods prior to trades for clients.
Procedure 3Members should treat fee-paying family accounts in which they have beneficial ownership in the same manner as they would treat their personal accounts.
 真题模考Mock
  • A. 程序1Procedure 1
  • B. 程序2Procedure 2
  • C. 程序3Procedure 3
答案 B。交易优先的推荐程序 = 程序2(按题给,如设个人交易限制/披露、客户与雇主优先于个人)。Answer B. A recommended Priority-of-Transactions procedure = procedure 2 (per the listed items — e.g., personal-trading limits/disclosure, clients and employer before self).
11. Kate Clark, CFA 和 Tom Matt, CFA 之间有介绍安排。Clark 把股票客户介绍给 Matt，作为回报，Matt 把固定收益客户介绍给 Clark。Matt 和 Clark 都向现有客户披露了安排细节。但只有 Clark 向潜在客户披露了介绍安排。准则最可能是否被违反？11. Kate Clark, CFA, and Tom Matt, CFA, have a referral arrangement between them. Clark directs equity clients to Matt. In return, Matt refers fixed income clients to Clark. Matt and Clark both disclose the details of the arrangement to their existing clients. However, only Clark discloses the referral arrangement to her prospective clients. Have the Standards most likely been violated? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 没有。No.
  • B. 违规，Matt。Yes, by Matt.
  • C. 违规，Clark。Yes, by Clark.
答案 B。仅 Matt 违规:相互介绍安排须向"现有与潜在客户"都披露;Clark 都披露了,而 Matt 只向现有客户披露、遗漏了潜在客户 → Matt 违规。Answer B. Only Matt violates: a mutual referral arrangement must be disclosed to both existing and prospective clients; Clark did both, but Matt disclosed only to existing clients, omitting prospects → Matt violates.
12. Agnes Dupy, CFA 在一家大型经纪公司管理全权委托账户。她为一位客户找到一组合适的公司自营股票共同基金。Dupy 的公司对使用适合基金清单中费用最高之一基金的经理发放特别季度奖金，于是她在未联系客户的情况下为客户投资了该基金。Dupy 最可能违反的准则是：12. Agnes Dupy, CFA, manages discretionary accounts at a large brokerage firm. She finds a suitable set of the firm’s proprietary equity mutual funds for one of her clients. Dupy’s firm is awarding a special quarterly bonus to managers who use one of the highest-fee funds on the list of suitable funds, so she invests in that fund for her client without contacting the client. Dupy has most likely violated the Standard(s) relating: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅公平交易。only to fair dealing.
  • B. 仅回避或披露冲突。only to avoid or disclose conflicts.
  • C. 公平交易与回避/披露冲突两者。both to fair dealing and to avoid or disclose conflicts.
答案 B。Dupy 因"公司给用高费基金发奖金"而选贵基金却未联系客户 → 违反"回避或披露冲突"(未披露奖金冲突)。全权委托下无需事先联系客户,故非公平交易问题。Answer B. Dupy violates Disclosure of Conflicts: choosing the high-fee fund for a bonus without disclosing the conflict. With a discretionary account she need not contact the client, so it is not a Fair Dealing issue.
13. Anna Schulz, CFA 在一家投资公司工作。她与一位独立税务顾问达成安排：由该税务顾问免费为 Schulz 编制个人纳税申报，作为交换，Schulz 把她的客户介绍给该税务顾问。按准则，Schulz 须向下列哪些方披露与税务顾问的安排：13. Anna Schulz, CFA, works for an investment firm. She enters into an arrangement with an independent tax advisor to prepare Schulz’s personal tax returns free of charge in exchange for Schulz referring her clients to the tax advisor. According to the Standards, Schulz is required to disclose her arrangement with the tax advisor to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅她的客户。her clients only.
  • B. 仅她的雇主。her employer only.
  • C. 她的客户与雇主两者。both her clients and her employer.
答案 C。Schulz 与税务顾问的相互安排(免费报税换客户介绍)须"向她的客户与雇主两者披露"(介绍安排 + 可能的额外报酬冲突)。Answer C. Schulz's arrangement with the tax adviser (free tax prep for client referrals) must be disclosed to both her clients and her employer (a referral arrangement plus potential additional-compensation conflict).
14. Vikram Shah, CFA 是 AZ Bank (AZ) 的财富经理。Shah 把其客户 Sean Tan 介绍给 AZ 的投行部门，因为 Tan 正考虑让其公司上市。AZ 的政策是向员工支付介绍费。按准则，Shah：14. Vikram Shah, CFA, is a wealth manager with AZ Bank (AZ). Shah refers his client, Sean Tan, to the investment banking division of AZ as Tan is considering taking his company public. AZ’s policy is to pay its employees a fee for referrals. According to the Standards, Shah is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 须拒绝介绍费，因 Tan 是 AZ 的现有客户。required to decline the referral fees because Tan is an existing client of AZ.
  • B. 无需向 Tan 披露介绍费安排，因该介绍费为部门间激励款。not required to disclose the referral fee arrangement to Tan because the referral fee is an interdepartmental incentive payment.
  • C. 须在介绍时向 Tan 披露介绍费安排，以便 Tan 评估投行服务的全部成本。required to disclose the referral fee arrangement to Tan at the time of referral to allow Tan to evaluate the full cost of the investment banking service.
答案 C。Shah 须"在介绍时向 Tan 披露介绍费安排",以便 Tan 评估投行服务的全部成本(部门间介绍费也须披露)。不必拒收,也不能因是内部激励就不披露。Answer C. Shah must disclose the referral-fee arrangement to Tan at the time of referral, so Tan can assess the full cost of the IB services (inter-department referral fees must be disclosed too). He need not refuse, nor skip disclosure because it is an internal incentive.
15. Patrick Tam, CFA 是一家投资公司的化工行业分析师。Naxos Chemicals (Naxos) 总裁请 Tam 提供全球行业趋势的定制报告，作为回报提供参加 Naxos 年度股东大会的免费差旅和住宿。为符合准则，Tam 最可能须：15. Patrick Tam, CFA, is a chemicals industry analyst for an investment firm. The president of Naxos Chemicals (Naxos) asks Tam to provide customized reports on global industry trends in return for free travel and accommodations for the Naxos annual shareholder meeting. To comply with the Standards, Tam is most likely required: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅向公司所有客户充分披露与 Naxos 的安排。only to fully disclose the arrangement with Naxos to all of the firm’s clients.
  • B. 仅在接受 Naxos 要约前取得雇主书面许可。only to obtain written permission from his employer before accepting the offer from Naxos.
  • C. 既向所有客户充分披露与 Naxos 的安排，又在接受前取得雇主书面许可。both to fully disclose the arrangement with Naxos to all of the firm’s clients and to obtain written permission from his employer before accepting the offer from Naxos.
答案 C。Tam 为 Naxos 做定制报告换免费差旅 → 须"既向所有客户充分披露与 Naxos 的安排,又在接受前取得雇主书面许可"(利益冲突 + 额外报酬)。Answer C. Tam doing a custom report for Naxos in exchange for free travel must both fully disclose the Naxos arrangement to all clients and obtain written employer permission before accepting (conflict + additional compensation).

§7 Standard VII · 作为 CFA 会员/考生的责任§7 Standard VII · Responsibilities as a CFA Member/Candidate

LOS 对应:LOS: demonstrate and explain appropriate conduct under Standard VII。
子条款Sub-provision要求 & 违规示例Requirement & violation example
VII(A) 作为考试参与者VII(A) As an exam participant不得作弊、泄露考题内容、违反考试规则或损害 CFA 项目声誉。违规:考后在网上讨论具体考题。Must not cheat, disclose exam content, violate exam rules, or harm the CFA Program's reputation. Violation: discussing specific exam questions online afterward.
VII(B) 引用 CFA 称号与项目VII(B) Reference to CFA and the Program正确、不夸大地表述 CFA 会员资格/称号;不得暗示 CFA 保证更好的业绩;"CFA"是形容词(如 "she is a CFA charterholder",不说 "a CFA")。违规:声称"持证=更高回报"、把 CFA 当名词滥用。State CFA membership/designation correctly without exaggeration; must not imply CFA guarantees better performance; "CFA" is an adjective (e.g., "she is a CFA charterholder," not "a CFA"). Violation: claiming "holding the charter = higher returns," misusing CFA as a noun.
VII(B) 记忆点:
① CFA 必须作形容词修饰名词(charterholder),不能当名词或复数。
② 考生只能说"CFA Level II candidate",不能暗示已持证或分数排名。
③ 绝不能宣称 CFA 称号预示更优业绩。

27. 考试后在社交媒体讨论具体考题,违反:Discussing specific exam questions on social media after the exam violates: 官方题Official

  • A. VII(A) 作为考试参与者的行为VII(A) Conduct as Participants in CFA Programs
  • B. VII(B) 引用 CFA 称号VII(B) Reference to CFA Designation
  • C. I(D) 不当行为I(D) Misconduct
答案 A。泄露考题违反考试保密行为规范。Answer A. Leaking exam questions violates exam-confidentiality conduct rules.

28. 宣称"持有 CFA 称号能带来更高投资回报",违反:Claiming that 'holding the CFA designation brings higher investment returns' violates: 官方题Official

  • A. VII(B) 引用 CFA 称号(不得暗示更优业绩;CFA 须作形容词)VII(B) Reference to CFA Designation (must not imply superior performance; CFA must be used as an adjective)
  • B. VII(A) 考试参与者行为VII(A) Conduct as Program Participants
  • C. I(C) 不实陈述I(C) Misrepresentation
答案 A。不得暗示 CFA 称号带来更优业绩。Answer A. One must not imply the CFA designation brings superior performance.

1. Marianne Lynn 报名了 CFA 一级考试。报名几周后，她因工作原因无法备考，遂通知 CFA 协会她放弃参加考试。之后，临近考试日，她在社交媒体上发帖称自己是 CFA 候选人。另外，Thomas Petrov, CFA 匿名在社交媒体上发布投资观点，并给帖子加了"#CFAcharter"标签。谁违规了？1. Marianne Lynn is registered for the CFA Level I exam. A few weeks after registration, she realizes she cannot prepare due to work commitments, so she informs CFA Institute that she declines to sit for the exam. Afterwards, shortly before the exam date, she posts on social media that she is a CFA candidate. Separately, Thomas Petrov, CFA, posts his investment views anonymously on social media and tags his post using "#CFAcharter." Who has violated the Standards? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅 LynnLynn only
  • B. 仅 PetrovPetrov only
  • C. Lynn 与 Petrov 均是Both Lynn and Petrov
答案 C。Lynn 与 Petrov 均违规:Lynn 放弃考试后仍自称"CFA 候选人"(不当引用);Petrov 用"#CFAcharter"暗示持证并匿名发投资观点亦不当引用 CFA 称号。Answer C. Both Lynn and Petrov violate: Lynn calls herself a "CFA candidate" after withdrawing (improper reference); Petrov's "#CFAcharter" tag implies the charter improperly.
2. 下列哪位个人可以称自己为 CFA 项目的候选人？
个人1已通过二级，预计几个月后报名三级
个人2一级未通过，预计下次考试重考
个人3正在等待三级考试结果
2. Which of the following individuals can refer to themselves as a candidate in the CFA Program?
Individual 1Has passed Level II and expects to register for Level III in a couple of months
Individual 2Has failed Level I and expects to retake the exam in its next administration
Individual 3Is awaiting results of the Level III exam
 真题模考Mock
  • A. 个人1Individual 1
  • B. 个人2Individual 2
  • C. 个人3Individual 3
答案 C。可自称"CFA 项目候选人"的是个人3——必须"已报名并注册"下一次考试才算候选人(仅通过某级但未注册下一级不算)。Answer C. The one who may call themselves a "CFA candidate" is individual 3 — a candidate must be enrolled and registered for the next exam (passing a level without registering for the next does not qualify).
3. Kelvin Lee, CFA 是组合经理。他的社交媒体简介写道："Kelvin Lee 在连续三年通过全部三级 CFA 考试。作为 CFA 持证人，Lee 取得更好的投资业绩。"Lee 是否违规？3. Kelvin Lee, CFA, is a portfolio manager. His social media profile reads: "Kelvin Lee passed all three CFA examinations in three consecutive years. As a CFA charterholder, Lee achieves better investment performance results." Has Lee violated the Standards? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 没有No
  • B. 违规，因声明连续三年通过全部三级考试Yes, by stating that he passed all three CFA Program examinations in three consecutive years
  • C. 违规，因声明作为 CFA 持证人取得更好的投资业绩Yes, by stating that he achieves better investment performance results as a CFA charterholder
答案 C。Lee 因"作为 CFA 持证人取得更好投资业绩"违规(暗示持证带来更优业绩,不当引用)。"连续三年通过三级考试"若属实可陈述(但不得夸大)。Answer C. Lee violates by claiming that as a charterholder he achieves better performance (implying the charter yields superior results — improper reference). Stating he passed all three levels in three consecutive years is allowable if true.
4. Anita Delgado 是 CFA 项目候选人。参加二级考试后，Delgado 在社交网站上发帖称她觉得考试很难，且在她看来 CFA 项目和 CFA 协会正在失去公众信誉。Delgado 最可能是否违规？4. Anita Delgado is a candidate in the CFA Program. After taking the Level II examination, Delgado posts on a social networking website that she found the exam very difficult and that in her opinion, the CFA Program and CFA Institute were losing credibility with the public. Has Delgado most likely violated the Standards? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 没有。No.
  • B. 违规，因在公共网站发布关于考试的信息。Yes, by posting information about the exam on a public website.
  • C. 违规，因损害 CFA 协会的声誉或诚信。Yes, by compromising the reputation or integrity of CFA Institute.
答案 A。Delgado 没有违规:表达"觉得考试难""在她看来 CFA 项目在失公信力"是个人意见,不泄露考题、不违反项目参与者行为准则(可表达观点)。Answer A. Delgado did not violate: saying the exam felt hard and expressing a personal opinion that the program is losing credibility discloses no exam content and does not breach the candidate conduct standard (opinions are allowed).
5. Agnes Boucault 属于一个二级考生在线论坛。Boucault 在论坛上写道："大家好，我是 CFA 二级候选人。一位上月参加二级考试的朋友告诉我考试很难。让我们把更多学习时间放在固定收益和衍生品，我认为这两块最难。"Boucault 最可能是否违规？5. Agnes Boucault belongs to an online forum of candidates studying for the Level II exam. Boucault writes on the forum: "Hello, I am a Level II candidate in the CFA Program. A friend who took the Level II exam last month tells me that it’s very difficult. Let’s focus more study time on the fixed income and derivatives areas, which I think are the hardest." Has Boucault most likely violated the Standards? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 没有。No.
  • B. 违规，因不当引用 CFA 项目。Yes, by improperly referencing the CFA Program.
  • C. 违规，因泄露 CFA 考试的保密信息。Yes, by revealing confidential information about the CFA exam.
答案 A。Boucault 没有违规:自称"二级候选人"属实,讨论"把时间放在固收和衍生品"是学习策略,未泄露具体考题内容,不违反保密。Answer A. Boucault did not violate: calling herself a Level II candidate is true, and suggesting to focus study on fixed income and derivatives is study strategy, not disclosure of specific exam content.
6. Brigid O’Rourke, CFA 担任 CFA 协会志愿者并批改三级 CFA 考卷。批改后，O’Rourke 与同事分享经历（这些同事都不是 CFA 候选人）。她说："三级考试非常难。"她还说："我很惊讶很少有考生能记住 Black–Scholes 方程。"O’Rourke 最可能是否违规？6. Brigid O’Rourke, CFA, serves as a CFA Institute volunteer and grades Level III CFA exams. After grading, O’Rourke shares her experience with work colleagues, none of whom are CFA candidates. She says, "The Level III exam is very tough." She also states, "I was surprised how few candidates could remember the Black–Scholes equation." Has O’Rourke most likely violated the Standards? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 没有。No.
  • B. 违规，仅因说"我很惊讶很少有考生能记住 Black–Scholes 方程"。Yes, only by saying "I was surprised how few candidates could remember the Black–Scholes equation".
  • C. 违规，既因"很少考生记住 Black–Scholes 方程"，又因"三级考试非常难"。Yes, both by saying "I was surprised how few candidates could remember the Black–Scholes equation" and by stating "The Level III exam is very tough".
答案 B。O'Rourke 仅因"很少考生记住 Black–Scholes 方程"违规(泄露具体考题/答案相关的保密信息)。说"三级很难"是一般性意见,可接受。Answer B. O'Rourke violates only by saying "few candidates could recall the Black–Scholes equation" (disclosing specific confidential exam content). Saying "Level III is very hard" is a general opinion, acceptable.
7. 一名候选人在在线论坛发布最新 CFA 考试的题目。此行为违反了下列哪一准则：7. A candidate posts questions from the most recent CFA exam in an online forum. This action is a violation of the Standard(s) relating: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅保密准则。to preservation of confidentiality only.
  • B. 仅作为 CFA 协会项目参与者的行为准则。to conduct as participants in CFA Institute programs only.
  • C. 保密准则与项目参与者行为准则两者。both to preservation of confidentiality and to conduct as participants in CFA Institute programs.
答案 B。在论坛发布最新考试的"题目" → 违反"作为 CFA 协会项目参与者的行为准则"(泄露考试保密信息)。该行为由项目参与者准则规范(而非 Standard III 保密客户信息)。Answer B. Posting actual exam questions online violates the Conduct as Participants in CFA Institute Programs standard (disclosing confidential exam information) — governed by the candidate standard, not the client-Confidentiality Standard.
8. 下列哪些陈述与作为 CFA 协会项目参与者的行为准则一致？
陈述I即使在被告知考试结果后，候选人也不能披露 CFA 考试中出现的题目。
陈述II考试未考的宽泛主题领域和公式，候选人在考后也不能公开讨论。
8. Which of the following statements are consistent with the Standard relating to conduct as participants in CFA Institute programs?
Statement IQuestions that appear on the CFA examinations cannot be disclosed by candidates even after they are notified of their exam results.
Statement IIBroad topic areas and formulas not tested on the exam cannot be publicly discussed by the candidates after the exam.
 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅陈述I。Statement I only.
  • B. 仅陈述II。Statement II only.
  • C. 陈述I与陈述II均是。Both Statement I and Statement II.
答案 C。与项目参与者行为准则一致的是"陈述I与陈述II均是"(按题给,如可表达对项目的合理看法、不泄题)。Answer C. Consistent with the candidate-conduct standard = both statements I and II (per the listed items, e.g., voicing reasonable views without disclosing exam content).
9. Elana Paralova 是一家资产管理公司的 CFA 一级候选人，她对一位潜在客户说："取得 CFA 特许资格将显示我认真地保护客户利益，并将提升我的声誉。一旦取得资格，我也希望通过升职赚更多钱！"她的同事 Jacob Klemmer, CFA 对 Paralova 说："每门考试都要学习所有科目，你永远不知道会考什么。这三门考试将是你参加过的最难的考试。任何升职和加薪都将反映你增强的技能。"Paralova 或 Klemmer 是否有人违规？9. Elana Paralova, a Level I CFA candidate at an asset management firm, tells a prospective client: "Getting the CFA Charter will show I am serious about protecting the interests of my clients and it will boost my reputation. Once I get the Charter, I also hope to make more money by getting promoted!" Her colleague, Jacob Klemmer, CFA, tells Paralova: "Study all subjects for each exam, you never know what will be included. The three exams will be the most difficult exams you will ever take. Any promotion and pay raise will reflect your enhanced skills." Did either Paralova or Klemmer violate the Standards? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 没有。No.
  • B. 仅 Paralova 违规。Only Paralova violates the Standards.
  • C. 仅 Klemmer 违规。Only Klemmer violates the Standards.
答案 A。Paralova 与 Klemmer 都没有违规:Paralova 说取得资格能显示尽责、提升声誉/薪酬是合理动机;Klemmer 描述考试难度、说加薪反映技能提升,均无不当引用或泄题。Answer A. Neither Paralova nor Klemmer violates: Paralova's comments about the charter showing diligence and improving reputation/pay are reasonable, and Klemmer's remarks on exam difficulty and skill-based raises contain no improper reference or exam-content disclosure.
