第三讲 · GIPS 全球投资业绩标准与案例应用Lecture 3 · GIPS Global Investment Performance Standards & Case Applications

对应教材:Introduction to the Global Investment Performance Standards (GIPS) + Ethics Application · 建议学习时长:3 小时 · Volume 10 收官Curriculum: Introduction to the Global Investment Performance Standards (GIPS) + Ethics Application · Suggested study time: 3 hours · Volume 10 finale

Volume 10 收官讲:GIPS(全球投资业绩标准)——一套让业绩报告可信、可比的自愿标准;以及综合案例应用,训练把复杂情境对应到具体准则。GIPS 的目的和关键特征是必考概念。The Volume 10 finale: GIPS (Global Investment Performance Standards) — a voluntary standard that makes performance reporting credible and comparable — and integrated case applications that train mapping complex scenarios to specific Standards. The purpose and key features of GIPS are must-know concepts.

§1 GIPS 是什么§1 What GIPS Is 🔥 高频必考🔥 High-Yield

LOS 对应:LOS: explain the purpose and scope of the GIPS standards。
🔰 零基础讲解:让业绩数字"可信可比"的统一尺子

GIPS📏 不同资产管理公司如果各自用有利于自己的方法算业绩(挑好时段、藏差账户),投资者根本没法横向比较。GIPS 是一套自愿遵守的全球标准,要求用统一、公允、完整的方法计算和披露业绩,谁声明合规就得全公司照做——于是投资者能放心比较不同机构的历史业绩。是一套统一、公允计算与呈现投资业绩的全球自愿标准。GIPS📏 If different asset managers each compute performance using methods that flatter themselves (picking good periods, hiding bad accounts), investors cannot compare across firms at all. GIPS is a voluntary global standard requiring a uniform, fair, complete method of calculating and disclosing performance, and any firm that claims compliance must apply it firm-wide — so investors can confidently compare different institutions' historical performance. is a global voluntary standard for uniformly and fairly calculating and presenting investment performance.

目的:
① 保证业绩计算与披露的公平、准确、可比、完整;
② 让投资者能跨机构、跨地域比较;
③ 增强对行业的信任。GIPS 由 CFA Institute 发布。核心精神是公平表述与充分披露(fair representation and full disclosure)。Purpose:
① ensure performance calculation and disclosure are fair, accurate, comparable, and complete;
② let investors compare across institutions and geographies;
③ strengthen trust in the industry. GIPS is issued by CFA Institute. Its core spirit is fair representation and full disclosure.

1. GIPS 的主要目的是:The main purpose of GIPS is: 官方题Official

  • A. 强制统一收费标准Mandate uniform fee schedules
  • B. 与业绩呈现无关Unrelated to performance presentation
  • C. 保证投资业绩计算与呈现的公平、准确、可比、完整,便于投资者跨机构比较Ensure fair, accurate, comparable, and complete calculation and presentation of investment performance, easing cross-firm comparison for investors
答案 C。GIPS 追求业绩呈现的公平可比。Answer C. GIPS pursues fair, comparable performance presentation.

2. GIPS 的核心精神用一句话概括是:The core spirit of GIPS in one phrase is: 官方题Official

  • A. 公平表述与充分披露(fair representation and full disclosure)Fair representation and full disclosure
  • B. 保证高投资回报Guaranteeing high investment returns
  • C. 尽量隐藏不利信息Hiding unfavorable information as much as possible
答案 A。公平表述 + 充分披露。Answer A. Fair representation + full disclosure.

3. 谁发布 GIPS 标准:Who publishes the GIPS standards: 官方题Official

  • A. IOSCOIOSCO
  • B. CFA InstituteCFA Institute
  • C. SECThe SEC
答案 B。GIPS 由 CFA Institute 发布。Answer B. GIPS is published by CFA Institute.
1. 下列哪项表述最准确？遵守 GIPS 标准：1. Which of the following statements is most accurate? Compliance with the GIPS standards: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 使投资者无需进行深入尽职调查。by firms eliminates the need for in-depth due diligence by investors.
  • B. 使公司能与其他遵守 GIPS 的公司参与竞标。enables firms to participate in competitive bids against other GIPS-compliant firms.
  • C. 对在没有投资业绩呈现法规国家开展业务的公司强制。is mandatory for firms conducting business in countries that do not have regulations relating to investment performance presentation.
答案 B。遵守 GIPS 的作用 = "使公司能与其他遵守 GIPS 的公司同台竞标(参与竞争)"。它不免除尽调,也不是无业绩法规国家的强制要求(GIPS 是自愿标准)。Answer B. Complying with GIPS lets a firm compete for business alongside other GIPS-compliant firms. It does not remove the need for due diligence and is not mandatory where no performance regulation exists (GIPS is voluntary).
2. GIPS 标准的目标包括：2. The objectives of the GIPS standards include: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 促进金融监管机构的利益。promoting financial regulators’ interests.
  • B. 在全球范围促进行业自律。promoting industry self-regulation on a global basis.
  • C. 取得对多种本地标准的接受以准确呈现业绩。obtaining acceptance of multiple local standards for accurate performance presentation.
答案 B。GIPS 的目标包括"在全球范围促进行业自律(self-regulation)"(统一、可比、公允的业绩呈现)。不是为促进监管机构利益或迁就多种本地标准。Answer B. A GIPS objective is to promote industry self-regulation globally (uniform, comparable, fair performance presentation). Not to advance regulators' interests or accommodate many local standards.
3. 下列哪些陈述描述了 GIPS 标准的关键概念？
陈述1GIPS 标准是确保投资业绩充分披露的道德标准。
陈述2GIPS 标准要求公司为其管理全权委托和非全权委托账户的所有策略维护综合。
陈述3GIPS 标准涵盖业绩计量的所有方面。
3. Which of the following statements describe the key concepts of the GIPS standards?
Statement 1The GIPS standards are ethical standards to ensure full disclosure of investment performance.
Statement 2The GIPS standards require firms to maintain composites for all strategies for which the firm manages discretionary and nondiscretionary accounts.
Statement 3The GIPS standards address all aspects of performance measurement.
 真题模考Mock
  • A. 陈述1Statement 1
  • B. 陈述2Statement 2
  • C. 陈述3Statement 3
答案 A。描述 GIPS 关键概念的是陈述1(按题给,如全公司定义、综合的使用、公允呈现)。Answer A. The statement describing a GIPS key concept is statement 1 (per the listed items — e.g., firm-wide definition, use of composites, fair presentation).
4. GIPS 标准最可能：4. The GIPS standards most likely: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 向潜在客户保证公司所报告投资业绩的准确性。assure prospective clients of the accuracy of a firm’s reported investment performance.
  • B. 帮助潜在客户考虑所有相关信息以评估公司过去的投资业绩。help prospective clients consider all relevant information in order to evaluate a firm’s past investment performance.
  • C. 要求投资公司以标准化形式向潜在客户披露其自有的业绩计算方法。require investment firms to disclose to prospective clients in a standardized form their own methodologies for calculating performance.
答案 B。GIPS 最可能"帮助潜在客户考虑所有相关信息以评估公司过去业绩"(可比、完整)。它不"保证"业绩准确,也不要求披露"自有的"计算方法(而是标准化方法)。Answer B. GIPS most likely helps prospects consider all relevant information to evaluate a firm's past performance (comparable, complete). It does not "assure" accuracy or require disclosing a firm's own bespoke methods (it uses standardized ones).
5. 下列哪项陈述准确？
陈述1遵守 GIPS 标准使投资者无需对投资管理公司进行深入尽职调查。
陈述2外部经理遵守 GIPS 标准有助于理解资产所有者监督的资金的风险与回报来源。
5. Which of the following statements is accurate?
Statement 1Compliance with the GIPS standards eliminates the need for an investor to conduct in-depth due diligence of an investment management firm.
Statement 2Compliance with the GIPS standards by external managers facilitates understanding of risk and return sources of funds supervised by an asset owner.
 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅陈述1Statement 1 only
  • B. 仅陈述2Statement 2 only
  • C. 陈述1与陈述2均是Both Statement 1 and Statement 2
答案 B。按题给,仅陈述2准确(通常涉及 GIPS 的公司层面定义、综合要求等)。Answer B. Per the items, only statement 2 is accurate (typically about GIPS's firm-wide definition and composite requirements).

§2 GIPS 的关键特征§2 The Key Features of GIPS

LOS 对应:LOS: describe the key features of the GIPS standards。
特征Feature说明Description
自愿遵守Voluntary compliance非强制,但一旦声明合规须全面、持续遵守Not mandatory, but once compliance is claimed it must be followed fully and continuously
公司整体合规Firm-wide compliance合规必须公司层面(firm-wide),不能只选个别账户/组合Compliance must be firm-wide, not just for selected accounts/portfolios
综合账户 compositeComposite把类似策略/目标的所有实际付费组合汇总,防止只挑好账户展示Aggregate all actual fee-paying portfolios with similar strategy/objective, preventing showing only good accounts
不得选择性披露No selective disclosure须包含所有符合条件的组合、按规定期数呈现历史业绩Must include all eligible portfolios and present historical performance for the required number of periods
可独立验证 verificationIndependently verifiable可由第三方验证(自愿),增强可信度,但验证针对公司整体、非单一综合账户Can be verified by a third party (voluntary), boosting credibility, but verification is at the firm level, not a single composite
考点·GIPS 关键数字与概念:
• 最少呈现年数:初次合规须呈现至少 5 年(成立不足 5 年则自成立起);之后每年加一年,直至满 10 年。
• 综合(composite):把"相同投资授权(mandate)"的所有实际、付费、全权委托组合汇总 → 防止用表现最好的账户择优代表某策略。
• 合规是"全公司(firm-wide)"层面,不能部分合规。
• 验证(verification):自愿、由独立第三方、全公司范围,测试流程是否按 GIPS 设计呈现业绩,并不保证某一具体综合的准确性。Exam - key GIPS numbers & concepts:
- Minimum years shown: initially present at least 5 years (or since inception if younger); then add a year each year up to 10.
- Composite: aggregates all actual, fee-paying, discretionary portfolios with the same mandate - preventing cherry-picking the best accounts to represent a strategy.
- Compliance is firm-wide; there is no partial compliance.
- Verification: voluntary, by an independent third party, firm-wide, testing whether processes are designed to present performance per GIPS - it does not assure any single composite's accuracy.

4. GIPS 是强制的吗:Is GIPS mandatory: 官方题Official

  • A. 对所有公司强制Mandatory for all firms
  • B. 声明后可选择性遵守Selectively followed after claiming
  • C. 自愿遵守;但一旦声明合规,须全面、持续地遵守全部要求Voluntary; but once compliance is claimed, all requirements must be followed comprehensively and continuously
答案 C。自愿采用,但合规须全面持续。Answer C. Voluntary to adopt, but compliance must be comprehensive and continuous.

5. 什么是综合账户(composite)、为何重要:What is a composite, and why does it matter: 官方题Official

  • A. 把相似策略/目标的所有实际付费组合汇总;防止公司只挑表现好的账户展示It aggregates all actual fee-paying portfolios with similar strategies/objectives, preventing a firm from showing only well-performing accounts
  • B. 只包含单一账户It contains only a single account
  • C. 与业绩展示无关Unrelated to performance presentation
答案 A。composite 杜绝"挑肥拣瘦"。Answer A. A composite prevents cherry-picking.

6. GIPS 验证(verification)针对什么层面:At what level is GIPS verification performed: 官方题Official

  • A. 针对公司整体(firm-wide),不是单一综合账户;且为自愿Firm-wide, not a single composite; and it is voluntary
  • B. 针对单一账户On a single account
  • C. 是强制的Mandatory
答案 A。验证是公司层面的自愿行为。Answer A. Verification is a voluntary firm-level action.

7. 为什么 composite 能防止业绩"挑肥拣瘦":Why does a composite prevent performance cherry-picking: 补充Extra

  • A. 与业绩展示无关Unrelated to performance presentation
  • B. 它要求纳入所有符合条件的实际组合,公司无法只展示表现最好的账户It requires including all eligible actual portfolios, so a firm cannot show only its best-performing accounts
  • C. 它允许只展示最好账户It allows showing only the best accounts
答案 B。全纳入原则杜绝选择性展示。Answer B. The include-all principle blocks selective presentation.
1. 关于 GIPS 标准的下列陈述哪项准确？1. Which of the following statements regarding the GIPS standards is accurate? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 所有付费客户组合都必须纳入至少一个综合(composite)。All fee-paying client portfolios must be included in at least one composite.
  • B. 所有具有相同投资授权的组合被汇总为一个综合。All portfolios with the same investment mandate are aggregated into a composite.
  • C. 组合汇总为综合每年基于组合的实际业绩。Aggregation of portfolios into composites is based on the actual performance of the portfolios every year.
答案 B。关于 GIPS:"所有具有相同投资授权(mandate)的组合汇总为一个综合(composite)"。并非所有付费组合都须入综合(只有全权委托的须入),综合按策略而非事后择优汇总。Answer B. On GIPS: all portfolios with the same mandate are aggregated into one composite. Not all fee-paying portfolios must be in a composite (only discretionary ones), and composites are by strategy, not cherry-picked ex post.
2. 下列哪项"不是" GIPS 标准的关键概念？针对公司的 GIPS 标准：2. Which of the following is not a key concept of the GIPS standards? The GIPS standards for firms: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 要求使用综合(composites)。require the use of composites.
  • B. 依赖输入数据的完整性。rely on the integrity of input data.
  • C. 涵盖业绩计量的每一个方面。address every aspect of performance measurement.
答案 C。"涵盖业绩计量的每一个方面"不是 GIPS 的关键概念(GIPS 规范呈现与披露,而非计量的每个细节)。要求用综合、依赖输入数据完整性才是关键概念。Answer C. "Covering every aspect of performance measurement" is NOT a GIPS key concept (GIPS governs presentation/disclosure, not every measurement detail). Requiring composites and relying on input-data integrity are key concepts.
3. 关于满足 GIPS 标准要求的综合(composites)，下列哪项评论正确？3. Which of the following comments concerning composites meeting the requirements of the GIPS standards is correct? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 公司的合规声明要求公司管理的所有付费账户都纳入至少一个综合。A firm’s claim of compliance requires all fee-paying accounts managed by the firm be included in at least one composite.
  • B. 创建、使用和维护综合的要求旨在防止公司用表现最佳的账户来代表某投资策略。The requirement to create, use and maintain composites is designed to prevent firms using the best-performing accounts to represent an investment strategy.
  • C. 综合必须纳入按相同投资授权/目标/策略管理的所有实际、付费、全权委托及非全权委托的组合。A composite must include all actual, fee-paying, discretionary and non-discretionary portfolios managed in accordance with the same investment mandate, objective, or strategy.
答案 B。关于综合:"创建/使用/维护综合的要求旨在防止公司用表现最好的账户代表某策略"(防择优)。合规声明不要求"所有付费账户"入综合(只全权委托),故 A、C 不准。Answer B. On composites: the requirement to create/use/maintain composites prevents a firm from cherry-picking its best accounts to represent a strategy. A compliance claim does not require all fee-paying accounts (only discretionary ones), so A and C are inaccurate.
4. 声称遵守 GIPS 标准的公司必须：4. A firm claiming compliance with the GIPS standards must: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 声明其计算方法符合 GIPS 标准。state that its calculation methodology is in accordance with the GIPS standards.
  • B. 披露公司哪些资产仅部分符合 GIPS 标准。disclose for which firm assets only partial compliance with the GIPS standards is achieved.
  • C. 记录用于建立 GIPS 合规的政策和程序。document policies and procedures used in establishing compliance with the GIPS standards.
答案 C。声称遵守 GIPS 的公司必须"记录用于建立 GIPS 合规的政策和程序"。不能只"声明"计算合规、不能"部分合规"(要么全公司合规、要么不声称)。Answer C. A firm claiming GIPS compliance must document the policies and procedures used to establish compliance. It cannot merely "assert" compliant calculations or be "partially" compliant (compliance is firm-wide or not claimed).
5. 按 GIPS 标准，下列哪项陈述正确？
陈述1当本地法规与 GIPS 标准冲突时，若冲突涉及综合构建，公司须遵守 GIPS 标准。
陈述2当本地法规就业绩呈现与 GIPS 标准冲突时，公司须遵守本地法规。
5. According to the GIPS standards, which of the following statements is correct?
Statement 1When local regulations conflict with the GIPS standards, firms are required to comply with the GIPS standards if the conflict relates to composite construction.
Statement 2When local regulations conflict with the GIPS standards for performance presentation, firms are required to comply with local regulation.
 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅陈述1Statement 1 only
  • B. 仅陈述2Statement 2 only
  • C. 陈述1与陈述2均是Both Statement 1 and Statement 2
答案 B。按题给,仅陈述2正确(通常涉及综合、全公司合规、公允呈现)。Answer B. Per the items, only statement 2 is correct (typically about composites, firm-wide compliance, fair presentation).
6. 某公司已存续七年。为遵守 GIPS 标准，公司最初须呈现的 GIPS 合规业绩数据的最少年数为：6. A firm has been in existence for seven years. In order to comply with the GIPS standards, the minimum number of years of GIPS-compliant performance data the firm is initially required to present is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 三年。three years.
  • B. 五年。five years.
  • C. 七年。seven years.
答案 B。存续七年的公司,首次呈现 GIPS 合规业绩至少须"五年"(不足五年则自成立起全部);此后每年增加一年直至满十年。Answer B. A seven-year-old firm must initially present at least five years of GIPS-compliant performance (or since inception if shorter), then add a year annually up to ten.
7. 作为遵守 GIPS 标准的一部分，资产管理人最可能须做下列哪项？7. Asset managers are most likely required to do which of the following as part of their adherence to the GIPS standards? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 遵守某些计算方法。Adhere to certain calculation methodologies.
  • B. 在创建综合时仅遵循最低 GIPS 要求。Only follow the minimum GIPS requirements at the time of composite creation.
  • C. 将所有非全权委托基金纳入至少一个反映投资授权的综合。Include all non-discretionary funds in at least one composite reflecting the investment mandate.
答案 A。遵守 GIPS 的资产管理人须"遵守某些计算方法(standardized methodologies)"。综合须纳入所有相同策略的"全权委托"组合(非"非全权委托"),且不能只满足最低要求,故 B、C 不准。Answer A. A GIPS-compliant manager must follow certain (standardized) calculation methodologies. Composites include all discretionary (not non-discretionary) portfolios of the same strategy, and one cannot do only the minimum, so B and C are inaccurate.
8. 一家成立3年的公司在呈现至少三年 GIPS 合规业绩后，GIPS 标准要求公司每年增加一年业绩，直至公司报告至少：8. After a 3-year-old firm has presented a minimum of three years of GIPS-compliant performance, the GIPS standards require the firm to present an additional year of performance each year until the firm reports a minimum of: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 五年。five years.
  • B. 七年。seven years.
  • C. 十年。ten years.
答案 C。初次呈现至少三年后,GIPS 要求公司每年增加一年业绩,直至至少报告"十年"GIPS 合规业绩。Answer C. After initially presenting at least three years, GIPS requires the firm to add a year each year until at least ten years of compliant performance are shown.

§3 谁能声明合规§3 Who Can Claim Compliance

LOS 对应:LOS: describe the fundamentals of compliance。

只有投资管理公司(firms)能声明 GIPS 合规,单个个人或某一账户不能。声明合规须公司整体遵守全部要求,不能部分合规、不能只对某产品合规。若不合规却宣称合规,即违反诚信。GIPS 与《道德准则》相辅相成——都指向公平、透明地对待客户。Only investment management firms can claim GIPS compliance; an individual or a single account cannot. Claiming compliance requires firm-wide adherence to all requirements — no partial compliance, no compliance for just one product. Claiming compliance while non-compliant violates integrity. GIPS and the Code of Ethics reinforce each other — both point to treating clients fairly and transparently.

8. 谁可以声明 GIPS 合规:Who can claim GIPS compliance: 官方题Official

  • A. 投资管理公司(firm)整体;个人或单一账户不能声明合规The investment management firm as a whole; an individual or single account cannot claim compliance
  • B. 个人可以声明An individual can claim
  • C. 单一账户可以声明A single account can claim
答案 A。合规是公司层面的声明。Answer A. Compliance is a firm-level claim.

9. 可以只对某个产品声明 GIPS 合规吗:Can GIPS compliance be claimed for just one product: 官方题Official

  • A. 可以只对某产品声明Yes, for one product only
  • B. 可以只对单一账户声明Yes, for a single account only
  • C. 不可以;合规必须是公司层面(firm-wide)、全面的No; compliance must be firm-wide and comprehensive
答案 C。合规是全公司范围的。Answer C. Compliance is firm-wide.

10. 若公司实际未合规却声称 GIPS 合规,后果是:If a firm is not actually compliant but claims GIPS compliance, the consequence is: 官方题Official

  • A. 属误导性陈述、违反诚信原则(并损害投资者信任)A misleading statement that violates integrity principles (and damages investor trust)
  • B. 没有任何后果No consequences
  • C. 反而提升信任It actually boosts trust
答案 A。虚假合规声明是误导性陈述。Answer A. A false compliance claim is a misleading statement.

11. GIPS 与《道德准则》的关系是:The relationship between GIPS and the Code of Ethics is: 补充Extra

  • A. 相辅相成,都强调公平、透明地对待客户与充分披露Complementary — both emphasize fair, transparent treatment of clients and full disclosure
  • B. 相互矛盾Contradictory
  • C. 完全无关Entirely unrelated
答案 A。两者理念一致、相互支撑。Answer A. The two are aligned and mutually reinforcing.
1. 声称遵守 GIPS 标准的公司须：1. A firm claiming compliance with the GIPS standards is required to: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 对公司的合规声明执行验证。perform verification of the firm’s claim of compliance.
  • B. 即使经独立第三方验证后仍维持其合规。maintain its compliance even after the firm has been verified by an independent third party.
  • C. 在报告期末确定纳入综合的现有组合的遴选标准。determine selection criteria regarding which existing portfolios to include in a composite at the end of the reporting period.
答案 B。声称遵守 GIPS 的公司须"即使经独立第三方验证后仍持续维持合规"。验证并非强制(自愿),遴选标准应事前定义,故 A、C 不准。Answer B. A GIPS-claiming firm must maintain compliance even after independent third-party verification. Verification is not mandatory (voluntary), and inclusion criteria are set in advance, so A and C are inaccurate.
2. 下列哪项可以声称遵守 GIPS 标准？2. Which of the following can claim compliance with the GIPS standards? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅资产所有者。Only asset owners.
  • B. 仅协助公司声称遵守 GIPS 的软件供应商。Only software vendors that assist firms in claiming compliance with the GIPS standards.
  • C. 资产所有者与协助合规的软件供应商两者。Both asset owners and software vendors that assist firms in claiming compliance with the GIPS standards.
答案 A。可声称遵守 GIPS 的是"仅资产所有者(asset owners)"(及资产管理公司)。软件供应商只是工具,不能声称合规。Answer A. Those who may claim GIPS compliance are asset owners (and asset managers). Software vendors are merely tools and cannot claim compliance.

§4 综合案例:如何判定违规§4 Integrated Cases: How to Determine a Violation

LOS 对应:LOS: apply the Code and Standards to specific situations。
案例演练 官方题Official

情境:某分析师从上市公司 CFO 处听到"下季度盈利将大幅超预期"(尚未公告),随即为个人账户买入、并把好额度优先配给最大客户,事后未保留分析记录,也未披露自己已持仓。
判定:
① 依 MNPI 交易 → 违反 II(A);
② 好机会只给大客户 → III(B) 公平对待;
③ 个人账户抢先 → VI(B) 交易优先顺序;
④ 未披露持仓 → VI(A);
⑤ 未保留记录 → V(C)。一个情境常同时踩多条。Scenario: an analyst hears from a listed company's CFO that "next quarter's earnings will greatly beat expectations" (not yet announced), then buys for her personal account and allocates the good quota preferentially to the largest client, keeps no analysis records afterward, and does not disclose her existing position.
Verdict:
① trading on MNPI → violates II(A);
② giving the good opportunity only to the big client → III(B) Fair Dealing;
③ personal account front-running → VI(B) Priority of Transactions;
④ non-disclosure of the position → VI(A);
⑤ no records kept → V(C). One scenario often breaches several provisions at once.

4.1 复杂案例一：马赛克理论还是 MNPI？

情境

分析师通过公开卫星图像发现某零售商停车场客流增加，又从多家供应商处分别获知“不重大的”订单变化，并据此上调盈利预测。报告发布前，公司 CFO 私下告诉她：“你的预测与尚未公布的内部数字基本一致。”分析师随后立即买入。An analyst finds via public satellite imagery that a retailer's parking-lot traffic has increased, and separately learns "non-material" order changes from several suppliers, then raises her earnings forecast. Before the report is published, the company's CFO privately tells her: "Your forecast is basically in line with our unpublished internal figures." The analyst then buys immediately.

分析：仅依赖公开信息和分别不重大的非公开信息形成结论，通常符合马赛克理论。但 CFO 的确认可能使结论成为重大非公开信息；确认后交易违反 II(A)。在确认之前形成的独立分析仍应保留研究记录，以满足 V(A) 和 V(C)。Analysis: forming a conclusion from public information and separately non-material nonpublic information generally accords with the mosaic theory. But the CFO's confirmation may make the conclusion material nonpublic information; trading after the confirmation violates II(A). The independent analysis formed before the confirmation should still retain research records to satisfy V(A) and V(C).

预防：研究人员收到发行人确认或异常精确信息时立即停止交易，通知合规部门，将证券加入限制名单，并记录此前独立分析的时间线。Prevention: when a researcher receives an issuer's confirmation or unusually precise information, stop trading immediately, notify compliance, add the security to a restricted list, and document the timeline of the prior independent analysis.

4.2 复杂案例二：投行业务压力与发行人招待

情境

卖方分析师原计划把某公司评级下调。投行部门告知该公司正在选择承销商，并要求推迟下调。公司同时邀请分析师乘私人飞机参加海外工厂考察并承担家属费用。分析师接受后只在报告末尾笼统写“本公司可能与发行人开展业务”。A sell-side analyst originally planned to downgrade a company's rating. The investment-banking department says the company is choosing an underwriter and asks to delay the downgrade. The company also invites the analyst to tour an overseas factory by private jet with family expenses covered. The analyst accepts and only writes vaguely at the end of the report "our firm may do business with the issuer."

分析：投行业务压力和奢华招待威胁独立客观性，涉及 I(B)。模糊披露不足以让客户判断实际冲突，还可能违反 VI(A) 和 V(B)。单靠披露不能挽救已经失去的独立性。Analysis: investment-banking pressure and lavish hospitality threaten independence and objectivity, implicating I(B). The vague disclosure is insufficient for clients to judge the actual conflict and may also violate VI(A) and V(B). Disclosure alone cannot rescue independence already lost.

预防：研究与投行之间建立信息隔离和独立薪酬体系；差旅由分析师雇主支付；重大利益冲突使用显著、具体的披露。Prevention: establish an information barrier and independent compensation between research and banking; have travel paid by the analyst's employer; use prominent, specific disclosure for material conflicts of interest.

4.3 复杂案例三：交易分配、个人账户与公平对待

情境

一只热门 IPO 获配不足。经理先给自己和家属账户分配，再把剩余额度给支付最高管理费的客户；其他适合该投资的客户没有获配。当天收盘价格上涨 30%。A hot IPO is under-allocated. The manager first allocates to his own and family accounts, then gives the remaining quota to the client paying the highest management fee; other clients suitable for the investment receive none. The closing price rises 30% that day.

分析：个人账户抢先违反 VI(B)；只偏向高费用客户而没有预先制定公平分配政策，违反 III(B)；若动机是增加自身或雇主收费，还可能违反 III(A)。Analysis: personal-account front-running violates VI(B); favoring only high-fee clients without a pre-set fair-allocation policy violates III(B); if the motive is to increase his own or the employer's fees, it may also violate III(A).

预防：交易前制定并披露按比例或轮换分配政策；个人相关账户最后参与；合规部门复核热门发行的最终分配。Prevention: set and disclose a pro-rata or rotation allocation policy before trading; personal related accounts participate last; compliance reviews the final allocation of hot offerings.

4.4 复杂案例四：客户情况变化与组合层面适当性

情境

客户原本收入稳定、风险承受力较高。后来失业并计划一年内购房，但经理没有更新 IPS，仍把客户新增资金投入锁定期五年的高杠杆私募基金。经理辩称“该基金长期预期回报很高”。A client originally had stable income and high risk tolerance. Later he becomes unemployed and plans to buy a home within a year, but the manager does not update the IPS and still puts the client's new funds into a five-year-lockup, highly leveraged private fund. The manager argues "the fund's long-run expected return is very high."

分析：没有及时更新客户目标和约束，并忽视新的流动性需求，违反 III(C)。适当性必须从整个组合和客户现实情况判断，不能只看单项投资的预期收益。Analysis: failing to update the client's objectives and constraints promptly and ignoring the new liquidity need violates III(C). Suitability must be judged from the whole portfolio and the client's actual situation, not just one investment's expected return.

预防：至少定期并在重大生活事件后更新 KYC/IPS；建立流动性缺口检查；下单前记录投资与客户目标、期限和风险承受能力的一致性。Prevention: update KYC/IPS at least periodically and after major life events; establish a liquidity-gap check; document the alignment of the investment with client objectives, horizon, and risk tolerance before placing orders.

4.5 复杂案例五：离职、研究记录与客户招揽

情境

分析师准备创业，在仍受雇期间把公司客户名单和研究模型发送到私人邮箱，并联系客户承诺离职后降低费用。离职后，他使用从公司文件中复制的模型和业绩记录开展营销。An analyst preparing to start a business, while still employed, sends the firm's client list and research models to a personal email and contacts clients promising lower fees after departure. After leaving, he markets using models and performance records copied from firm files.

分析：在职期间招揽客户和带走机密资料违反 IV(A)；研究记录通常属于雇主，复制带走还违反 V(C)；将原雇主业绩暗示为新公司的业绩可能违反 I(C) 和 III(D)。可以在职期间做一般性创业准备，但不得竞争、招揽或盗取记录。Analysis: soliciting clients and taking confidential materials while employed violates IV(A); research records usually belong to the employer, so copying and taking them also violates V(C); implying the former employer's performance as the new firm's may violate I(C) and III(D). General start-up preparation while employed is allowed, but not competing, soliciting, or stealing records.

预防：明确离职和资料归属政策；禁用私人邮箱转移记录；离职后仅使用合法取得的公开资料和自行重建的研究。Prevention: clear departure and record-ownership policies; ban personal email for transferring records; after leaving, use only lawfully obtained public materials and independently rebuilt research.

4.6 复杂案例六：主管责任与“发现后才行动”

情境

主管知道交易员长期绕过个人交易预先批准，但认为“尚未发现客户损失”而没有调查。后来交易员利用客户大单进行抢跑。主管在事件发生后立即解雇交易员。A supervisor knows a trader has long bypassed pre-approval for personal trades but does not investigate, thinking "no client harm has been found yet." Later the trader front-runs a large client order. The supervisor fires the trader immediately after the incident.

分析：交易员违反 VI(B)。主管早已知道控制失效却未采取合理预防和调查措施，违反 IV(C)；事后解雇不能消除主管此前的失职。主管不必保证零违规，但必须建立、执行并持续监控合理制度。Analysis: the trader violates VI(B). The supervisor, who long knew the control had failed but took no reasonable preventive or investigative steps, violates IV(C); firing afterward does not undo the supervisor's prior dereliction. A supervisor need not guarantee zero violations but must establish, enforce, and continuously monitor reasonable systems.

预防：个人交易预先批准、限制名单、重复违规自动升级、独立监测和书面调查流程；若制度不充分，主管应拒绝或暂停相关监督职责，直到得到纠正。Prevention: pre-approval of personal trades, a restricted list, automatic escalation of repeat violations, independent monitoring, and a written investigation process; if the system is inadequate, the supervisor should decline or suspend the relevant oversight duties until it is corrected.

4.7 复杂案例七：额外报酬、介绍费与冲突披露

情境

客户承诺若组合跑赢基准就直接给经理奖金；某基金公司还按引流资产向经理支付介绍费。经理只向客户口头提到“可能存在商业关系”，没有取得雇主同意。A client promises to pay the manager a bonus directly if the portfolio beats the benchmark; a fund company also pays the manager a referral fee for assets brought in. The manager only mentions orally to the client "there may be a business relationship" and does not obtain the employer's consent.

分析：客户额外奖金可能与雇主利益冲突，接受前须获得雇主书面同意，涉及 IV(B)。介绍费须向客户和雇主充分披露其性质和金额或计算方式，涉及 VI(C)；笼统口头说明通常不足。Analysis: the client's additional bonus may conflict with the employer's interest and requires the employer's written consent before acceptance, implicating IV(B). The referral fee must be fully disclosed to the client and employer as to its nature and amount or calculation, implicating VI(C); a vague oral statement is usually insufficient.

预防：所有外部报酬事前书面申报和批准；介绍费用显著书面方式披露；定期更新冲突清单。Prevention: declare and approve all external compensation in writing in advance; disclose referral fees prominently in writing; update the conflicts list periodically.

12. 依 MNPI 抢先交易违反哪条准则:Front-running based on MNPI violates which standard: 官方题Official

  • A. II(A) 重大非公开信息II(A) Material Nonpublic Information
  • B. VI(B) 交易优先顺序VI(B) Priority of Transactions
  • C. III(B) 公平对待III(B) Fair Dealing
答案 A。利用 MNPI 交易违反 II(A)。Answer A. Trading on MNPI violates II(A).

13. 把好交易机会只给大客户违反哪条:Giving good trading opportunities only to large clients violates which standard: 官方题Official

  • A. III(B) 公平对待III(B) Fair Dealing
  • B. III(C) 适当性III(C) Suitability
  • C. VI(A) 披露利益冲突VI(A) Disclosure of Conflicts
答案 A。厚此薄彼违反公平对待。Answer A. Favoritism violates fair dealing.

14. 个人账户抢在客户前成交违反哪条:A personal account trading ahead of clients violates which standard: 官方题Official

  • A. VI(B) 交易优先顺序VI(B) Priority of Transactions
  • B. VI(A) 披露利益冲突VI(A) Disclosure of Conflicts
  • C. II(B) 市场操纵II(B) Market Manipulation
答案 A。抢先交易违反交易优先顺序。Answer A. Front-running violates priority of transactions.

15. 推荐自己持仓股票不披露违反哪条:Recommending a stock one holds without disclosure violates which standard: 官方题Official

  • A. VI(A) 披露利益冲突VI(A) Disclosure of Conflicts
  • B. VI(B) 交易优先顺序VI(B) Priority of Transactions
  • C. III(A) 忠诚谨慎勤勉III(A) Loyalty, Prudence, Care
答案 A。自有持仓须披露利益冲突。Answer A. A personal holding requires conflict disclosure.

16. 未保留支持建议的分析记录违反哪条:Not retaining analysis records supporting a recommendation violates which standard: 官方题Official

  • A. V(C) 记录保存V(C) Record Retention
  • B. V(A) 勤勉与合理依据V(A) Diligence and Reasonable Basis
  • C. V(B) 与客户沟通V(B) Communication with Clients
答案 A。缺失记录违反记录保存。Answer A. Missing records violate record retention.

17. 交易优先顺序的正确排序是:The correct priority-of-transactions order is: 官方题Official

  • A. 雇主 > 客户 > 本人Employer > clients > self
  • B. 客户 > 雇主 > 本人Clients > employer > self
  • C. 本人 > 客户 > 雇主Self > clients > employer
答案 B。客户优先,个人最后。Answer B. Clients first, self last.

18. 分析师用公开与非重大非公开信息形成结论后,发行人私下确认结论准确;此后能否交易:An analyst forms a conclusion from public and non-material nonpublic information, then the issuer privately confirms the conclusion is accurate; can they trade afterward: 补充Extra

  • A. 可以照常交易May trade as usual
  • B. 与合规无关Unrelated to compliance
  • C. 不能;发行人的确认可能使信息成为重大非公开信息,应停止交易并通知合规No; the issuer's confirmation may make the information material nonpublic, so stop trading and notify compliance
答案 C。此前或符合马赛克理论,但确认可能"点石成 MNPI"。Answer C. It may have fit the mosaic theory before, but the confirmation can turn it into MNPI.

19. 主管发现制度不足但尚未发生客户损失,是否可以等待实际违规后再处理:A supervisor finds inadequate systems but no client loss has yet occurred; can they wait until an actual violation to act: 补充Extra

  • A. 不可以;IV(C) 要求主管采取合理的事前预防、监督和纠正措施,不能以尚无损失为由不行动No; IV(C) requires supervisors to take reasonable preventive, monitoring, and corrective measures in advance and cannot fail to act just because there is no loss yet
  • B. 可以等到发生损失再处理May wait until a loss occurs
  • C. 无需处理No action needed
答案 A。主管责任要求事前而非事后行动。Answer A. Supervisory responsibility requires acting in advance, not after the fact.

20. 披露奢华招待是否必然消除 I(B) 独立与客观问题:Does disclosing lavish hospitality necessarily eliminate the I(B) Independence and Objectivity problem: 补充Extra

  • A. 不必然;若招待足以影响独立客观性,应拒绝或由雇主承担合理费用,披露不能挽救已受损的独立性Not necessarily; if the hospitality is enough to affect independence/objectivity, it should be declined or the employer should bear reasonable costs — disclosure cannot rescue already-compromised independence
  • B. 披露即可完全消除问题Disclosure fully eliminates the problem
  • C. 无需任何处理No action needed
答案 A。披露不是万能药,独立性受损时须拒绝。Answer A. Disclosure is not a cure-all; when independence is compromised, it must be declined.

§5 伦理答题方法论§5 Methodology for Answering Ethics Questions

LOS 对应:LOS: exam technique for ethics。

做伦理题的步骤:
① 找出关键行为和相关方;
② 逐一对照七大准则问"这个行为触了哪条";
③ 注意披露/同意/优先顺序这三个高频触发点;
④ 警惕"貌似合理但缺披露"的陷阱;
⑤ 冲突时记住客户 > 雇主 > 个人、以及守更严格的规则。多数题不是考条文原文,而是考判断。Steps for ethics questions:
① identify the key conduct and stakeholders;
② check each of the seven standards asking "which provision did this conduct breach";
③ watch the three high-frequency triggers of disclosure/consent/priority;
④ beware the "seemingly reasonable but lacking disclosure" trap;
⑤ on conflict, remember clients > employer > self and follow the stricter rule. Most questions test judgment, not the letter of the provisions.

21. 准则与当地法律冲突时的原则是:The principle when the Standards conflict with local law is: 官方题Official

  • A. 遵守更严格的一方Follow the more strict of the two
  • B. 遵守更宽松的一方Follow the more lenient one
  • C. 两者都不遵守Follow neither
答案 A。从严原则。Answer A. The stricter-of-the-two principle.

22. 做伦理题时哪三个触发点最常见:Which three trigger points are most common in ethics questions: 官方题Official

  • A. 没有固定触发点No fixed trigger points
  • B. 披露、同意(尤其雇主/客户)、交易优先顺序Disclosure, consent (especially employer/client), and priority of transactions
  • C. 只有披露一个Only disclosure
答案 B。披露、同意、优先顺序是三大高频考点。Answer B. Disclosure, consent, and priority are the three high-frequency points.

23. 一个情境只会违反一条准则吗:Does a scenario violate only one standard: 官方题Official

  • A. 只会违反一条Only one
  • B. 从不违反任何一条Never violates any
  • C. 不一定;常同时违反多条,需逐条排查Not necessarily; it often violates several at once, requiring a standard-by-standard check
答案 C。一个情境可能触发多条准则。Answer C. One scenario can trigger multiple standards.

§4 GIPS 中 Firm 与 Discretion 的定义§4 The Definitions of Firm & Discretion in GIPS

LOS 对应：describe fundamentals of compliance, including definition of the firm and discretion。

Firm 应定义为向客户或潜在客户展示的、具有明确业务边界的投资管理实体。定义应有意义，并避免通过过窄定义排除表现不佳的业务。组织重组或定义变化必须适当披露。A firm should be defined as the investment-management entity presented to clients or prospects with clear business boundaries. The definition should be meaningful and avoid excluding poorly performing business through an overly narrow definition. Reorganizations or definition changes must be appropriately disclosed.

Discretionary Portfolio 指公司能够按预定投资策略实施管理的组合。客户限制若没有显著妨碍策略执行，组合仍可视为 discretionary；若限制严重妨碍策略，则应视为 non-discretionary，不能放入相关 composite。A discretionary portfolio is one the firm can manage according to a predefined investment strategy. If client restrictions do not significantly impede strategy execution, the portfolio can still be treated as discretionary; if restrictions seriously impede the strategy, it should be treated as non-discretionary and cannot be placed in the relevant composite.

判断Judgment处理Handling
策略和客户限制仍允许正常执行Strategy and client restrictions still allow normal executionDiscretionary，纳入相应 compositeDiscretionary, included in the appropriate composite
限制使组合无法代表策略Restrictions make the portfolio unrepresentative of the strategyNon-discretionary，不纳入该 compositeNon-discretionary, not included in that composite
只挑选表现好的账户Cherry-picking only well-performing accounts不允许；符合 composite 定义的实际付费 discretionary portfolios 应纳入Not allowed; actual fee-paying discretionary portfolios meeting the composite definition should be included

3. 客户限制何时使组合成为 non-discretionary:When do client restrictions make a portfolio non-discretionary:

  • A. 只要存在任何限制就是Whenever any restriction exists
  • B. 客户限制从不影响其性质Client restrictions never affect its nature
  • C. 当限制显著妨碍公司执行预定投资策略时When the restrictions significantly impede the firm's execution of the intended investment strategy
答案 C。只有实质性妨碍策略执行才转为非全权委托。Answer C. Only when they materially impede strategy execution does it become non-discretionary.
1. 一家投资公司按小盘成长风格管理一个 $2 亿的综合。公司把其中 $5000 万的受管理资产卖给一家竞争的基金经理。为保持遵守 GIPS 标准，公司必须：1. An investment firm manages a $200 million composite to a small-cap growth style. The firm sells $50 million of these managed assets to a competing money manager. In order to remain in compliance with the GIPS standards, the firm must: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 把 $5000 万从公司历史业绩中剔除。exclude the $50 million from the firm’s historical performance.
  • B. 在资产出售前继续把 $5000 万计入公司历史业绩。continue to include the $50 million in the firm’s historical performance until the assets were sold.
  • C. 把 $5000 万的历史业绩与其余 $1.5 亿的公司历史业绩分开列示。show the historical performance of the $50 million separately from the firm’s historical performance of the remaining $150 million.
答案 B。为保持 GIPS 合规,公司须"在资产出售前继续把该 $5000 万计入公司历史业绩"(历史业绩不得因资产转出而剔除或分离——历史记录须完整保留)。Answer B. To stay GIPS-compliant, the firm must continue to include the $50m in the firm's historical performance up to the sale date (history is not removed or carved out when assets leave — the record must remain complete).

§5 Independent Verification 的范围§5 The Scope of Independent Verification

Verification 由独立第三方对公司整体执行，主要评价：Verification is performed by an independent third party on the firm as a whole, mainly assessing:

  • 公司是否按 GIPS 要求构建并维护 composites；Whether the firm constructs and maintains composites as GIPS requires;
  • 计算、数据和业绩呈现政策是否设计为符合 GIPS，并在公司整体得到执行。Whether calculation, data, and performance-presentation policies are designed to comply with GIPS and are enforced firm-wide.

Verification 不是对某一 composite 的业绩保证，也不保证数字绝对无误、未来一定取得类似表现。公司可以进一步对特定 composite presentation 接受 performance examination，但它不同于 firm-wide verification。Verification is not a performance guarantee for any single composite, nor a guarantee that the figures are absolutely error-free or that similar performance will be achieved in the future. A firm may further undergo a performance examination for a specific composite presentation, but this differs from firm-wide verification.

4. GIPS verification 是否保证未来业绩:Does GIPS verification guarantee future performance:

  • A. 不保证;它评价公司整体的 composite 构建及相关政策程序,不是业绩保证No; it assesses the firm's overall composite construction and related policies and procedures, not a performance guarantee
  • B. 保证未来业绩表现It guarantees future performance
  • C. 保证公司不会亏损It guarantees the firm will not lose money
答案 A。验证针对流程与政策,不对未来业绩作任何担保。Answer A. Verification concerns processes and policies, guaranteeing nothing about future performance.
1. 就 GIPS 标准而言，下列哪项表述最准确？验证(Verification)：1. With respect to the GIPS standards, which of the following statements is most accurate? Verification: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 若公司声称遵守 GIPS 则强制验证。of GIPS compliance is mandatory if the firm claims GIPS compliance.
  • B. 由公司在自律并自我认证其遵从声明时执行。is performed by the firm when self-regulating and certifying its claim of compliance.
  • C. 测试公司的流程是否被设计为按 GIPS 标准呈现业绩结果。tests whether the firm’s processes are designed to present performance results in compliance with the GIPS standards.
答案 C。验证(Verification)"测试公司的流程是否被设计为按 GIPS 呈现业绩"(全公司层面)。它不是强制的、也不能由公司自我认证(须独立第三方)。Answer C. Verification tests whether a firm's processes are designed to present performance per GIPS (firm-wide). It is not mandatory and cannot be self-certified (an independent third party is required).
2. 按 GIPS 标准，验证：2. According to the GIPS standards, verification is: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 针对整个公司执行。performed with respect to an entire firm.
  • B. 由公司合规部门执行。performed by a firm’s compliance department.
  • C. 对声称遵守 GIPS 的公司强制执行。mandatory for firms that claim compliance with the GIPS standards.
答案 A。按 GIPS,验证"针对整个公司(firm-wide)执行"(不是单个综合、也不能由公司合规部门自己做)。Answer A. Under GIPS, verification is performed firm-wide (not on a single composite, and not by the firm's own compliance department).
3. 按 GIPS 标准，验证必须：3. According to the GIPS standards, verification must be performed: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 针对整个公司执行。with respect to an entire firm.
  • B. 针对公司的特定综合执行。on specific composites of a firm.
  • C. 由公司合规部门执行。by a firm’s compliance department.
答案 A。按 GIPS,验证必须"针对整个公司执行"(全公司范围,由独立第三方)。Answer A. Under GIPS, verification must be performed firm-wide (across the entire firm, by an independent third party).
4. 按 GIPS 标准，验证：4. According to the GIPS standards, verification: 真题模考Mock
  • A. 在全公司范围执行。is performed on a firm-wide basis.
  • B. 必须由公司合规部门执行。must be performed by a firm’s compliance department.
  • C. 确保特定综合陈述的准确性。ensures the accuracy of specific composite presentations.
答案 A。按 GIPS,验证"在全公司范围执行"。它由独立第三方(非合规部门)进行,且不针对"特定综合"提供准确性保证,故 B、C 不准。Answer A. Under GIPS, verification is performed firm-wide. It is done by an independent third party (not the compliance department) and does not assure a specific composite's accuracy, so B and C are inaccurate.
5. 验证对下列哪些内容按 GIPS 标准设计提供保证？5. Verification provides assurance that which of the following have been designed in compliance with the GIPS standards? 真题模考Mock
  • A. 仅公司业绩的计算与呈现。Only the calculation and presentation of the firm’s performance.
  • B. 仅公司与综合及集合基金维护相关的政策。Only the firm’s policies related to composite and pooled fund maintenance.
  • C. 公司业绩的计算与呈现，以及与综合及集合基金维护相关的政策两者。Both the calculation and presentation of the firm’s performance, and the firm’s policies related to composite and pooled fund maintenance.
答案 C。验证按 GIPS 设计为对以下"两者"提供保证:公司业绩的计算与呈现,以及与综合/集合基金维护相关的政策。Answer C. Verification is designed to provide assurance on both: the firm's performance calculation and presentation, and the policies related to composite/pooled-fund maintenance.
